review_title: Nice room and price but has Bedbugs
review_text:
This is the second time I have used this hotel and booked this last time because of the perceived value.
Room is updated and staff is great ...but woke this morning to bedbugs. I travel alot for work and this is the first time I have seen these in person.
 Staff went right after the room but... They are present :( so beware upon checking into the room.

review_title: Stay here often. Always a pleasure.
review_text: Stay frequently for business. The staff goes out of their way to make sure you are well looked after. My home away from home.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Houston Energy Corridor

review_title: Excellent service!!! and a great hotel.
review_text: Service is excellent!!! it's the most important thing to me. Kudos to all the staffs... you guys are doing great job. You can't go wrong with the location - trust me. Room is great and the television is BIG! I didn't have to press any button in the elevator coz they'll do it for you - and they know what your floor is! I can't ask for more...

San Carlos is a find. Located in a quiet neighborhood convenient to Grand Central and subway. Wonderful diner across the street. The staff is well trained and strives to please. Our suite was roomy and comfortable. Only complaint, the free breakfast pastry dry and would like fresh fruit.

My family absolutely enjoyed our stay at San Carlos. Cleanliness was supreme and the one bedroom suite was spacious. The mini kitchenette was fabulous especially traveling with an infant and a child who has food allergies. We will be staying there again next year for our December trip.

review_title: Nothing special, but a decent value for NYC during the holidays.
review_text:
Like many hotels in NYC this one is an updated, but an old one with all the issues that would normally accompany one (poor lighting, plumbing tha rattles, small bathroom, etc). 
While i had a "courtyard" view (really just a brick wall 10 feet away from the window) there was none of the street noise that bothered others on the other side of the hotel. 
Finally - the 'free' breakfast leaves a lot to be desired, but at least the coffee is okay.

This hotel is within walking distance of many attractions in Manhattan: the United Nations, Times Square, MOMA, etc. We had a suite and it was very nice. New York is an expensive city and other, more famous hotels were charging much more for the same thing.
We did not eat in the restaurant as there was a good deli across the street and, of course, many restaurants nearby, but they do have a breakfast available.
 All in all, a good find.

This hotel is awesome! From the looks to the rooms. We stayed in a balcony suite which was great... very spacious clean...The only thing is the view isn't the best but to me it didn't really matter cause the room was great. There is a skywalk to the mall which is convenient. Overall stay is much better than the Westin galleria. Will be coming back!

Room was awesome! Super clean! Love the wood floors and only carpet near bed. Great for allergies! I always wonder if the carpeted hotel rooms have dirt or God knows what else that hasn't been properly cleaned. I only wish they had a way to play music like an iPod station, etc. Also, the food could be better. Our breakfast arrived cold. The dessert selection wasn't great. I couldn't believe they didn't have hot chocolate or even 24 hour room service. Overall, I would return in a heartbeat.

This place is great during the week, but stay away on the weekend.
They book a lot of weddings, and it is extremely loud.
Do not stay on the courtyard side of the hotel on the weekend - unless you are out until after the bands stop playing in the bars - around 3AM.
A very nice hotel - but definitely missing something at this price point. 
FYI - I travel a great deal for business (3 months a year) and would not recommend this hotel if you plan on staying over the weekend.

Was here on business for two weeks, my wife came along for the trip... We both enjoyed our stay here, hotel was great, location was perfect (for shopping, eating & drinking) and room was decent! The only one negative thing I would have is the gym was pretty poor, but I think all guests get free passes to the external gym which is just 100 meters away from the hotel...
I will return to sorella next time I'm in Houston on business and would definatly recommend it to anyone...

review_title: So good we stayed 2 extra days
review_text: We found this hotel through Trip Advisor and couldn't have been happier. We had one bed suite, roomy with kitchenette ideal with 2 children. Staff friendly especially Bobby. We were more than happy with breakfast, and free wifi and cleanliness very good. We stayed longer because of hurricane Irene but were glad to do so.

This is by far the best hotel I have stayed in. Every part of the hotel is decorated in a unique, chic way. The beds are amazingly soft! Breakfast is open near the main lobby with lounges, couches and huge windows leading out to a patio. I also highly recommend the hotel bar, Mona Lisa.

Stayed on first floor. Service excellent. Nicely decorated for Xmas. Looks brand new everywhere. Room very clean and modern. Excellent value for $55. Fabulous breakfast. Complete with Texas shaped waffles! Kids loved it!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Houston - Normandy

review_text: Hotel Sorella for my birthday. I absolutely love this hotel. The decor is hip, the location is great. Shopping and night life is just steps away. The one thing I don't like about this place are the vallet guys. They're quick to try to hustle the guests. Other than that, great place to take a staycation.

My husband and I stayed at the Sorella for the second time for a weekend getaway, and it was just as amazing the 2nd time around as our 1st stay. The rooms are extremely clean and the staff are very polite and professional!
Loved the hotel, nice room, great food at Bistro Alex, great band at Monnalisa bar, upscale and trendy atmosphere.

Needed a quiet weekend away from my hectic life and Hotel Icon was the perfect choice. Loved the huge bathtub, comfy bed and decore. Very secure, service was exceptional! Great valet too, guys remembered my name

This place is new, so no complaints with the rooms, etc.
The service from the hotel staff was outstanding! 
Very enjoyable stay....

review_title: Great Etiquette, Clean, Upscale, Fun and Safe location!
review_text: There are a thousand GREAT things to say about hotel sorella and nothing negative to add. I love that the hotel is business friendly, but set up wonderfully for intimacy. It has a cozy, chic, fun, relaxing atmosphere too it. The scenery surrounding it provides a nice mature atmosphere for nite life, but yet still fun for kids in the day time with nice shops and eatery. The hotel itself just has an environment of warmth and comfort. My two times staying there, once march 2010 and then march 2011 has just been exceptional. The staff just gets better and better. Service is EXTOUNDING! We look forward to spending 50+ years together. My husband and I and plan to make hotel sorella our resting place for the nite. We live in waller and enjoy just traveling to houston for our anniversary (45 mins) to stay at hotel sorella for a nite. It a great getaway spot without even getting away. Love hotel sorella!

I stayed at Icon for a couple of nights while visiting my daughter. 
This is a good non chain hotel with the ground floor all one large area with bar, reception and restaurant. Staff were very friendly, breakfast good and the rooms a good size. Only black mark - you cannot open the windows which may ok in summer but not for me in November

Room was nice, clean and quiet. But, for a room that you mostly just sleep in, the price was out of line. No special experience here. Meal at Quattro restaurant in the morning was also way over priced. Two eggs bacon and fried potatoes for $22. Never again.

I stayed here after the Rihanna concert and made dinner reservations too and I could not have picked a better hotel.
This hotel is beautiful. Everything about out is convenient. I love the location, I am fairly young and there were alot of bars in the area and driving distance o other locations wasn't long at all. Coming back I was surprised to see people still at the lounge bar around 2am!
VOICE is delicious, great service. Kevin (manager I believe), is extremely caring and checked up on us multiple times, our severs michael and lisa were super nice and had thoughtful insight on our orders. 
Rooms are nicely decorated, I love the hallways and the red doors. Very nice boutique hotel. I stayed in a superior w jacuzzi and that bathroom was my favorite part. I loved it. 
Stay here for a night out or a special occasion!

review_title: If you are looking for nice--stay elsewhere
review_text: This is definitely not a 4 star luxury property! Room was dark and hallways creepy, and when first walked in noticed the lampshade peeling off. Ordered room service and they messed up order not once but twice. Had to call and ask for maid service one day (4 star really?!?). One of the elevators broke down which made for long wait. Wireless was touted as a free amenity. However, it was spotty at best--thank goodness it wasn't a business trip. Let's just say "not worth the money" is an understatement!

On point on all fronts. Great location downtown with immaculate, posh rooms and interior. You feel the luxuriousness oozing from the walls. But not really a hotel for the family, that is unless you just want a great place to sleep. for adults though theres few places in houston that compare.

We have stayed at this hotel several times. The staff always seems to outdo themselves with over the top customer service. This time, they had gifts waiting for my two daughters at the check-in counter. 
The service definitely made up for the rainy weather!

Heres the long and short of it .Was here on business Wonderful loc for theatre door and bell staff were very attentive upon checkin and departure. Front desk needs to be re- trained. rooms fantastic to tech savvy nice hotel but not 5 star.

I only stayed one night but it was absolutely fantastic. I was on a business trip but staying at several places in order to "scope" out hotels for a longer family trip planned for December with the whole family. This place is a hidden gem with a great location. Truthfully, I had second thoughts about writing a review on it since I plan to come back and I don't want to see it all booked up all the time! It is small (~70 rooms) but really new and luxurious and super friendly, helpful and gracious, welcoming staff. Lively front lobby bar at night.
What a pleasant surprise. Great room,service and location at a reasonable price for NYC.

review_title: One of my favourite business hotels, in one of my favourite business cities
review_text:
I have stayed at this hotel many times, including once, a three-week residence. I always have a pleasant experience.
Parking is easy and free. The lobby is dominated by glass elevators, and the tasteful ceiling decorations.
This time, I was upgraded to a suite, and front desk made this feel like their pleasure to do so - thanks guys.
The hotel is well located just off Sam Houston tollway at Westheimer, and that makes getting around very easy.
There are restaurants in walking distance (Outback steak house), as well as interesting ones a short drive (Texas Land and Cattle on I-10, and Yao's Chinese on Westheimer).
All-in-all, I'd call this the best Houston hotel for the energy corridor. I have recommended it to others many times.
Stayed here for a week. Staff were always friendly and helpful. Free Internet, although this was a bit slow. Overall the facilities were great and the price reasonable.

review_title: You get what you pay for.
review_text: I've realized that hotels under 70-80 per night are going to come with a fair share of issues. But when you're on a tight budget your willing to deal with a few of those. I will list those issues I experienced. The initial room I got (136) had an issue with the lights. The only light that worked was the bathroom light. Once I got light I noticed red stains in the comforter that immediately registered in my head as blood. Changed rooms. The second room was fine except for a few dark stains on the sheets and a loosely shutting door that had signs of forced entry. Both rooms had that strong hotel scented perfume, with no traces of cigarette smell. Included was a free small breakfast, not much to choose from but it was nice.

review_title: Great location and very friendly staff.
review_text: I stayed here for almost a whole month. Never had any problems. Coffee was always ready for me very early in the morning. Friendly staff. The only complaint I have is they need to update their gym. They have one very loud treadmill and a bike that's probably from the 1970s. Other than that everything was great.

This was our first time at the four seasons. We celebrated our 11th wedding anniversary. The staff treated us like royalty. The hotel lobby was beautiful and our room was spacious and relaxing. We were excited about staying at the four seasons and it was everything we thought it would be. We plan on making it an annual event.
At the front desk, Maddie and Rita, both, make us feel welcome, and happy to see us. That means a lot to us. jason, the bartender, is the greatest.

We started this year needing a place to stay while watching our son play football at Uof Houston. Close, clean, friendly people and great service. We feel well taken care of each week. 
Rick Kolster
hotel_name: Hampton Inn and Suites Houston Medical Center - Reliant Park

review_text: I can't begin too explain how excellent this hotel was! The location, the rooms, the staff, everything was GREAT! I usually don't do reviews but this hotel deserves one, if there was a problem or I needed anything the staff were there for me. The rooms were clean and the bed was nice and comfortable. Coffee was fresh and ready, fruits were nice and cold and there was also cake and watermelon! I will definitely be returning too Carefree Inn when I'm in town!
Great location. Top notch service. Very modern rooms. Boutique Hotel.

From the moment we pulled up the doorman made us feel very welcome. Checking in was effortless We booked the apartment suite for 7 days. We wanted the feeling of living once again in NYC. The apt was fantastic. We were so surprised to have even had Miele washer and dryer. Closets were wonderful, bathroom really large all the comforts of home with no details overlooked. The best part was the complimentary pastries to our room late afternoon and then again I the evening. Also the complimentary beverages and water completed the wow experience. Location was amazing we were able to walk everywhere from the flatiron district to theatre district. The hospitality at this hotel is incredible. The entire staff from housekeeping to Managers remember your name and always as know your day is going. You actually believe they care what your answer is. This is the only hotel we will stay in when we return which now will be much more often.
hotel_name: The Setai Fifth Avenue, a Capella managed Hotel

review_text: When I checked in late evening I found I had a room facing the inside attrium of the hotel, in general very claustrophobic. I went back to the reception and asked for a room facing outside. I was given another room which was also facing inside. How do they expect some one staying over 4 nights including a weekend to survive without having ANY outside view?? Bad design, bad service.
The beds are extremely firm and uncomfortable.... Location for MD Anderson is good, but beds make it a deal breaker... Probably wont stay here again.

My husband and I stayed for over 2 weeks in August. We had a very relaxing stay, despite the hurricane. 
We had beautiful room with a terrace and well worth while to open this up to extra light and the world outside.
When our flight home was unexpectedly canceled The Chatwal was there to help us out with accomodation at short notice.

review_title: Luxury and peace one block from Times Square
review_text:
From the moment you arrive until your car pulls up from valet you know you are in a special property. Like staying on a small exclusive cruise ship, everyone seems to know you and smiles warmly. When have you had the manager of a hotel come to your room to personally welcome you? And the rooms OMG! 
We had a room with a terrace and although we didn't use it often it serves a great purpose - you are not on the street which means sleeping is truly a dream. Slept like babies for 3 nights.
Now the place is not cheap and in some cases a little over the top, ($50.00 for a manicure!), but for a fabulous location, and a real treat the Chatwal can't be beat. Once again Trip Advisor gets it right!

review_title: Good experience,bad service at the bar and from housekeeping
review_text: I have stayed at the Setai for over a month. We chose a deluxe apartment that was spacious and clean. We also liked the facts that the windows were openable allowing us to refresh the suite with fresh air every day. The bathroom has very large windows with a beautiful view. The only two negative experiences I had at the hotel were with the Bar at the lobby and the housekeeping service. It took the waitress almost 15 min to bring one soda and orange juice amid a very empty bar. We paid immediately and did not even take a sip from the beverages. To our surprise, the waitress did not seem to care and brought the check to us as soon as we asked for it. Regarding the housekeeping, their service is not consistent, with some ladies performing remarkably better than the others. Also, when I ask for the service, the ladies do not show up soon after my call. To the hotel management, please improve on these two points.
hotel_name: The Setai Fifth Avenue, a Capella managed Hotel

review_text: From check-in to check-out everything was perfect. Outstanding staff. Brendon, the butler, handled every request with a smile. The room, a deluxe King, was beautiful, bathroom roomy and the shower with the overhead shower head was a welcome treat after a day walking around the city. Location was great. We were just a couple blocks from many of the major subway stations and though a half block away from Time Square, 44th St was very quiet. We've stayed in mnay of the finest hotels in NYC, but this is now our favorite property Definitely book The Chatwal. What a class act!
We stayed here for business purposes, the staff was amazing. Hotel was clean and quiet. We had no use for the shuttle, however we did notice that it ran constantly.

My husband and I enjoyed our stay at the Crown. The staff was great!! From the moment we entered until we checked out we experienced great service. We want to especially acknowledge two staff members especially, Henry Strait (front desk) and Laurie (hostess in Remington). Both employees provided extraordinary customer service!! We will definitely stay at the Crown on our next visit to Houston.

review_title: Best hotel experience in my life!
review_text: Although I travel extensively on business (and stay at the usual places - Fairmont, Four Seasons, Westin, etc.), we decided to stay here for 5 days in July on a summer vacation with our daughters. The room (Queen suite) was outstanding, the atmosphere and location ideal, but what really made the stay so wonderful was the friendly, impeccable service from everyone we dealt with. The concierge helped us to get great tickets to a couple of shows and was bang on with his restaurant recommendations, the reception and bell staff were always smiling and helpful, and even the maintenance staff member we dealt with briefly was extremely service-oriented (we had a minor problem with our in-room safe, which was solved within minutes). We will definitely be back on our future visits to NYC!
Exceeded my expectations. Felt very welcomed and service was great. Will definately stay again.

I stayed at this hotel with my mum from the 19th nov-22nd nov. From reading some of the reviews I was abit anxious however the hotel was superb. We had 2 double beds which were very comfy. The room size was small but cozy. The molten brown toiletries were re-stocked everyday. The location to all the main attractions were great. Bill was fantastic. Also the concierege were very knowledgable and gave us maps with directions to various locations. Also the day we left we were going to get a taxi to the airport but the lovely lady at the concierge suggested we walk 2 blocks and wait a max of 15 minutes and catch a shuttle bus-this cost 30 dollars for 2 us, instead of the 100 quoted by many taxi drivers. I feel that everyone i came into contact with went the extra mile! I would definately stay at this hotel again!

I really enjoyed this property. The free wine and water were a great treat for an end to a long day. The location is great and near everything. There a few hotels on this street and they are all nice. This one is a step above the others.

I'm a frequent Starwood user and this hotel came up in my wife and I's search for hotels in New York. I'm so glad we booked here. It was a wonderful stay. The rooms are first class and this is the first time I can say the rooms were actually better than the photos depict. The service was excellent as well. We will be staying here again on our next visit.

review_title: New York as it once was.
review_text:
I have been coming to New York for a long time and I recall when hotels like the Waldorf and Essex House offered quality rooms and service at a price that wouldn't break the bank. Few hotels in 
New York can make that claim today. The Iroquois can. Our room, though not spacious, was comfortable with adequate dresser and closet space for at least a three night stay. The furnishings were first class. The bathroom was fitted with high quality fixtures and the shower met my high standards. Service was excellent. I had some trouble getting heat and the engineer came to my room instantly. My requests to the front desk and concierge were met quickly and helpfully. On Thursday night the lounge in the hotel was a real scene. The only improvement I might suggest is that the restaurant associated with the hotel offer a more varied menu. Not every guest wants to eat a full dinner.

If your lucky, you will get Ally as your bellman. He made our stay! 
Great place with a lot of restaurant and bar options right outside the entrance without going into time square. 
Don't be fooled by their term "upgrade" to a room in the rear of the hotel where it is nice and quiet. That actually means you will be looking at a brick wall instead of a street view on the other side. 
This hotel is a must stay.

review_title: Simply the best hotel experience I've ever had.
review_text:
Let me start by stating that I have never written a review about anything before. However, I have regularly read the reviews of others. Based on my recent experience at the Setai I felt I must throw in my two bits this time. 
I travel a fair amount and have stayed at a variety of hotels - boutique and major brands. Not one has exceeded the experience that I just had at the Setai Fifth Avenue. 
Their exceptional service started before I even arrived when our 'personal assistant' connected with me to see how our stay could be made more special. Jennifer Hughes (one of the Setai's personal assistants) is nothing short of phenomenal. Not only did she get us reservations at one of the city's top restaurants (Jean Georges) when nobody else could, she followed up and made all of our other reservations too. When we arrived she personally greeted us when we arrived and even came up to our room to see if we were all settled in or any of our clothes needed pressing after being in our bags. When we said yes, she took the wrinkled garments (along with my wife's boots that needed a polishing) personally to be taken care of. 
We arrived early (9ish) but even then we were given our room right away. We also knew we had a late flight out, but Jennifer saw to it that we could checkout at a time to suit our schedule - not the hotel's. 
As for our room, it was simply outstanding. Aside from it being enormous (this is New York after all and almost 800 sq ft for a room is massive), we had a wonderful view of Fifth avenue. The decor is very modern, but warm at the same time. Our huge bathroom with one of the largest soaker tubs I've ever seen was only matched by an equally large walk-in closet. 
As for snacks and beverages, well nothing is spared. All soft drinks, sparkling water and espresso (a machine right in the room!) are complimentary. Twice-daily maid service with late-day turn-down service rounds out the top-notch experience. And don't even get me started on the spa - my wife and I had a couples massage that was hands down one of the best we ever had - 90 minutes of heaven! The spa at the Setai is stellar. 
But while all these 'little' things are nice - truthfully its a long list of 'nice little' things - the real difference is the warm and personable service from the staff. Jennifer was marvelous, but in fact everyone who we met that works at the Setai are warm and friendly. In a city like New York where sometimes people get a bad rap for being rough or abrasive - the Setai reminds you just how great the city and New Yorkers are and what a pleasure it is to visit. 
I suppose the only one thing I can say is that to some degree you get what you pay for. The Setai is far from cheap. However when you look at what the Plaza, St. Regis or the Mandarin Oriental, as examples cost, the Setai is a bargain and a much better experience. 
So while its certainly not inexpensive the Setai is an experience that is leaps and bounds ahead of the competition. If you can swing it - try the Setai you will not be disappointed.
hotel_name: The Setai Fifth Avenue, a Capella managed Hotel

review_text: Me hospede hasta ayer en el hotel con familiares y el hotel estaba sÃºper limpio, desayuno muy variado cada dÃ­a, el personal atento, la habitaciÃ³n impecable y el precio accesible. Lo recomiendo y definitivamente me hospederÃ­a nuevamente en el hotel.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn and Suites Houston Medical Center - Reliant Park

review_title: For the price totally worth it
review_text:
Older hotel remodeled. Everything brand new in my room. Walking distance to Toyota centre and minute maid park plus convention centre. 
Free town car to take you anywhere you wanna go at night

This hotel is stylish & comfortable. I love it & so does my husband. We have stayed here on a number of occasions while in Houston. 
The location may not be the best but it's close to sambucca, a great restaurant and has easy travel to other locations in downtown including parks & meuseums. 
I also love that they provide aveda toiletries!

Although our room was small, it was very clean and very comfy. The staff were very nice, friendly and very helpful. I still remember one of staff members, Alex, he was very helpful. he took the time to explain everything to us. that made me feel very welcome. I am planning to go back there again soon.
the hotel is really in the heart of everything. We were able to walk to most of our activities. 
you should visit this hotel. front desk staff like Alex and the door men will make you feel at home and very comfortable.

review_title: Wonderful stay in a great location.
review_text:
Spent three nights at The Iroquois. The stay was great. Our room had NO view, but it was oh so quiet. 
Two elevators made getting out easier. The in-room safe was easy to use and made me feel more secure leaving my valuables. 
The location was so convenient. Right off Fifth Avenue, near Times Square, walking distance to Central Park. We used the Times Square subway to get around. 
The concierge helped our party navigate the city and scored hard-to-get tickets.

review_title: Great Staff - But Pay the Few $ More & Stay at a Nicer Property.
review_text:
I was very surprised that this property has the Marriott name, or any other chain Hotel name on it. I have nothing horrific to say about this property, but The property needs updating DESPERATELY! My mattress was the worst mattress I've ever slept on. The grab and go breakfast was cereal, bagels, juice,milk and coffee. They have an outside pool with small BBQ area.
It was INEXPENSIVE for a long stay, but you sacrifice dearly for the lower rate. I won't stay here again unless the hotel is completely remodeled. 
The staff was super friendly. I would like to specifically mention by name LAUREN. She was great & did everything she could to make my stay as pleasant as possible.

Just stayed in the Hotel for 6 nights and shouldn't complain. Everything is as expected in a Holiday Inn Express. Fine. Just the bathroom could have been more clean. 
Everything else was nice. Free Wifi is a given. Like a good breakfast. 
I would consider coming back next time when I'm in Houston.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Houston NW-Beltway 8-West Road

review_text: I've never enjoyed a staff as much as I did here! EVERYONE was so very nice and BEYOND helpful! The entire hotel was VERY clean and absolutely gorgeous. The rooms were extremely comfortable as well as clean. We're originally from Houston and back to visit. This wS a GREAT location for is to quickly reach our families in both the northern outskirts of Houston as well as the Clearlake area. HIGHLY recommended!!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Houston NW-Beltway 8-West Road

review_text: En general esta bien el hotel el problema es lo lejos que se encuentra lo que dificulta trasladarse a los atractivos no saben como explicarte como irte nadie habla espanol tu no conoces ellos no te explican y es frustrante
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Houston NW-Beltway 8-West Road

review_text:
Spent 3 nights in NYC for business. WOW! Impeccable staff and extraordinary service. Large rooms, great amenities.
Auriga Spa - outrageous! Hot and cold treatment rooms..great masseuse. 
Beautiful Bar with terrific cocktails.
Can't wait to return.
hotel_name: The Setai Fifth Avenue, a Capella managed Hotel

review_text:
This is a 4 star hotel trying very hard to be 5 star but just not getting there in lots of areas.
We booked a terrace suite and the plants on the terrace were either dead or in desperate need of water. There were only 2 sun beds and no other furniture like a table to rest drinks on. It felt dusty and bare and the whole point of booking a terrace room was so we could fully use the terrace but it was just a sad space.
The tiles and granite counter tops in the bathroom have not been sealed properly and have become water and soap stained which makes the bathroom appear dirty. The main glass teardrop pendant feature in the lobby is reflected by a circle of mirror which has been cracked and left unfixed. Overall, the hotel just has an unfinished feel, like they've run out of money to do the finishing touches or pay for maintenance.
The service was generally good, however, the hotel made the mistake of sending 2 limosines to pick us up from the airport. The concierge told us we would have to pay a "no show" fee for one of them even though we didn't make the booking with the car company. When I pointed out it was their error and didn't see why we should be charged, the concierge continued to argue with me. Typically, this is not how customers in 5 star hotels are treated.
We've stayed in many, many 5 star hotels and I would not rate this as one of them.
hotel_name: The Setai Fifth Avenue, a Capella managed Hotel

review_text: Rooms beautiful. Staff attentive and friendly. Complimentary mini bar, daily delicious treats in your room. No set check out times.. Next time Im in NY I'm here :)
hotel_name: The Setai Fifth Avenue, a Capella managed Hotel

review_text: Great hotel, lovely staff, rooms were beautiful and the loation couldn't be better!

review_title: Make sure you ask for a quiet room!
review_text:
Yes, the Iroquois is quaint, reasonably clean, centrally located, and cheaper than the Sofitel next door. But the lower floors have several rooms with large generators immediately outside if the windows. One of these generators was outside of my room on my first night in the hotel. At first, I thought it was just a noisy air conditioner but when I realised I could not stop the racket, I called the front desk who sent a maintenance guy upstairs. He informed me in that charming New York fashion, "It's the generator outside your window. There's nothing I can do. This is New York. It can be loud here. You got a loud room". When I protests that this was unacceptable, he referred me back to the front desk who assured me that I had a rare condition of sleep sensitivity and most people never had any such problem. I told the night clerk that this was clearly nonsense, especially as he could hear the generator OVER THE PHONE! Finally, at around 2:00 am, I was offered an alternative room. This was s special room designed for the handicapped which I was understandably, but again inconveniently forced to vacate the next day.
The ultimate outcome of all of this for me was that I was an utter zombie at my business meeting the next day for which I had flown to New York.
From now on, I'm paying the extra $100 per night to stay in the Sofitel next door.

I have atajes in many HI and this one is not so good. Very noisy rooms, both from the AC and from the elevators. Our bathroom was not really clean when we Checked in and we didnt have a blow drier.
All the employees were very helpfull and kind. Breckfast was good . Location is excelent but if they offered transportation to the Galleria it would be great!
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Houston - Near The Galleria

review_title: A great place to stay, friendly staff, clean & large rooms, fantastic airport location & great on price!
review_text:
The staff at this hotel really are one of its' great points! They realise they're an airport hotel & check-in after a 10 hour flight was smooth & simple!
I was left alone to get on with my daily business, but I was always greeted with a friendly acknowledgment on my return.
If I needed anything then I felt free to ask & when I did ask my requests were dealt with in an efficient, friendly manner!
I cannot give this hotel any more praise - so I have written to their General Manager telling them what a delight it was to stay for 5 nights! In a world that complains too much it was a delight to write a letter a praise! Well done Hyatt Place Houston....you really are "my Hyatt Place"

Our beautiful night here:
Take the beautiful limestone facade in and walk through the mahogany doors to the elegant but minimalist lobby. Rooms have everything you need but nothing you don't. Beautiful pale colors are very comforting. Nice linens, slippers, and amazing Belgian chocolates for turndown. The library is a must see I am sorry we neither had breakfast or dinner here but I am certain it is excellent. Walk to all theaters and 5th ave shopping. Considering the quality and service, the mid $400 rates are a steal.

I booked this hotel months ago for an examination nearby. I was alarmed by the recent reviews. I almost changed my plans but on arrival I was pleasantly surprised that the hotel seemed both safe and secure. The back entrance to the parking was gated and most parking was easily visible from the lobby. The staff was helpful and the room was clean. The only downside was that room service was not delivered to the room and there wasn't a very good selection.

review_text: En famille ( 2A+2enfants+1 bb) nous avons adorÃ© notre sÃ©jourvau sein de cet hÃ´tel! A tel point que nous avions du mal Ã  aller nous promener et partir en visites....! review_title: Location makes you feel like you're a New Yorker!
review_text:
My family (mum, dad, 2 kids) stayed in a 2 bedroom apt for 10 days over Christmas and loved every minute of it. It was a very spacious apartment and had everything we needed...but out of the hustle and bustle of Times Square, etc. 
It's located near a main subway station making transit easy. Concierge and Front Desk were very helpful, even lending us a stroller for our youngest child for the duration of the stay. 
The market over the road is just great. 
The only slight downside was the housekeeping.... they just did the minimum each day and not very thoroughly. 
We stayed on level 6, in a corner room which was fantastic! Close enough to feel part of the action and do some people watching, but far enough away that it was never noisy. So don't get too hung up on getting on a high floor. 
I would definitely recommend this hotel and hope I go back one day :)

review_title: Spacious and clean, all around great hotel
review_text: We stayed here in early December for 3 nights. The room was great, actually a two room suite with a small kitchenette. The beds were comfy, lots of closet space. Great location, 2 blocks from the subway and a $10 cab fare from times square and the theater district. Staff was friendly, especially the adorable doorman!

Me And my small family stayed there while visiting kemah, it was homely. The staff was extremely helpful. I had accidentally booked my reservation for the wrong date and they help me fix it. It was easy to find and the room was ok. We will definitely stay there again in the future.

review_title: Best hotel I've ever stayed in!
review_text:
Perfect location, outstanding customer service, gorgeous room with amazing bathroom, comfiest bed, free mini bar!
I can't rate this hotel any higher, simply perfect! I will never stay anywhere else now whenever I go to New York. Would give it 6 out of 5 of I could. Help to make this the best holiday I've ever been on.

Stayed in the Andaz on our first trip to New York - fantastic rooms with lovely walk in shower. Complimentary mini bar topped up daily is really good when u need water after walking for hours. Excellent location. Down side is the bar which is in the basement and loud and claustrophobic.

review_title: Great staff, great rooms, close to food
review_text:
This place has the best staff. The rooms are nice and well kept. The price is fair. There are places to eat within walking distance.
A+ You can't go wrong here
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Houston West / Energy Corridor

review_text:
Perfect location for Beacon Theater. Fantastic Fairway Market across street to supply your own little kitchenette in the room. Bright, decent size rooms for NY, where you often get a broom cupboard with a view of a wall. 
Great hotel for Upper West side. No restaurant but who cares when you're seconds from great food elsewhere.

Just come back and the hotel was lovely and the location perfect. Less than a 5 minute walk to Times Square, great customer service, lovely room but the only draw back, couldn't open a window and mirrors tinted so had to dry hair in the bathroom. Would definitely stay there again.

review_title: Your choice -- do you want design and hip, or remotely professional? If it's the latter, don't stay here.
review_text: All attitude and design above all. Unfortunately this precludes almost anything one would actually require from a real hotel or a genuinely trained staff. Neither of which this over-designed trying too hard place is, in the hands of true amateurs.

Poor service - staff with a bad attitude. Computer check in is not acceptable. Waiting on line to be greeted by a computer. Restaurant is too expensive for what you get and staff is far from friendly. Had to beg for bread which was stale and thrown at me.

This hotel is great for anyone who likes to be in a great city but not in the tourist trap areas . The king rooms have small kitchen area where you can easily make a great breakfast and larger rooms have full kitchen 2 tvs and great views. Walking distance to central park and museums.
Room was great and breakfast was bettter quality than expecting.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Houston Hobby Airport

review_text: The place is old, outdated, smells like feet, the fire alarm lights are covered with either corn pads or bandaids and this morning I noticed there was still standing water in the shower from my husbands shower last night. I think this is the worst hotel I've ever stay at, and I've stayed at many hotels. Think about this seriously. Ugh!! Shame Marriott!!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Houston Hobby Airport

review_text: This is a great extended stay hotel. Its the most adorable area Comfortable beds and clean rooms.

Been telling them for a month that espn don't work in my room. They won't fix it. The maids are rude,maintenance is rude. Clerks and management are rude. I hear the studio 6 next-door is way better and a little cheaper. Want to get a refund on the rest of my month and move next-door.

The beacon is a great hotel. We were visiting new York for the first time. The 1 line subway is just a block away and the express train will have you in times square in about 3 minutes. You are 3 blocks from central park which my husband and I loved to run in. We also walked across the park to the met which only took 30 minutes. Upper westside has a good choice of restaurants and shops. We enjoyed eating out in the hells kitchen area which is only 2 stops away 50th St on the 1 line. There is a great supermarket fairway across the street for lovely fresh fruit and gourmet meals if you don't feel like eating out. The hotel rooms are a good size and freshly rennovated. All in all a great place to stay that allows you to unwind from the hustle of downtown but is still close to all the sites of new York.

review_title: What a fantastic place to stay
review_text:
Recently went to NYC for 10th wedding anniversary. Chose this hotel based on location. when we arrived checking went well , got to our room and found it was twin . I went back to reception explain why were here and the assistant manager went out of his way to find a king room. Could not have been happier with the new room 2203. Great views to the river, heaps of Room, kitchenette . Great shower.
The neighborhood was fantastic 2 blocks to subway, awesome restaurants near by , we did not have a bad meal. Great bars. Would go back to the hotel Beacon in a flash. Awesome holiday

We flew in to Hou and were promptly picked up by the courtesy shuttle. Our room was clean and neat. We had the breakfast buffet which included potatoes, scrambled eggs, Belgian waffles, bacon, sausage, breads, cereal and more! All the staff were pleasant.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Houston Hobby Airport

review_text:
Stayed here for a week in September 2010/2011. 
Love this place. 
Location wise it's fantastic , away from the frantic streets of downtown , it's nice a chilled up on the west. 
Plenty of lovely little pizza joints and restaurants. 
Fairway market / trader joes across the street is great for food. 
5 minute walk to central park/Columbus Square. 
10 minute walk to central park end of 5th avenue. 
20 mins to 41street/time square. 
Subway station across the road which is great. 
The staff were great! 
Checked us in nice and quick. 
Big room with nice views outside. 
Little kitchen with fridge , sink , microwave etc. 
Big tv.
Ihome radio/alarm clock. 
Nice big bed.

New York City is a vibrant and exciting city, at the same time people are frustrated about the very limited nice choices NYC has on offer when it comes to hotels. Andaz is Hyatt's fresh take on putting the customer back into the center of attention. With free WiFi and a free in-room minibar this hotel is a great choice for people looking for convenience without paying through the roof. Three nights in the hotel's Splash Suite are the best choice for people that wanna pamper themselves and the free-standing bathtub is the highlight of this Suite. The ambience is more like an apartment, I like the residential feel. Rainfall shower, high ceilings, lots of natural light and Bigelow amenities make for a different 'hotel' experience. Staff and service are fabulous and for breakfast they serve Grumby Coffee - what a difference! This hotel is younger and hipper than its peers, at the same time luxurious and accommodating. Loved my stay here and will be back for sure!
Stayed in this hotel recently, awesome place. Very clean, friendly staff and location is perfect. No ifs no buts or maybe's...book this hotel you won't be disappointed!
This property is in need of renovation. Furnishings seem very dated. No restaurants within walking distance.

Check in time is 3:00. It is currently 4:30 and we are waiting in the lobby for our room to be ready!!! We have been here since 3:00. NOT the way I wanted to spend my time in NYC. We have to leave for our dinner reservations in less than an hour for a 7:30 curtain. I am with my mother in law for her 75th birthday. This is terrible. Don't stay here!

review_title: large rooms, close to subway station bottle of bubbly on arrival.
review_text: We stayed for Three nights at start of honeymoon. Staff friendly on arrival. A few minutes after we had checked into our room the Manager arrived up with a bottle of champagne. A really nice touch. very close to subway and restaurant/diner attached to hotel was perfect for breakfast. A bit out of the way but as I've said close to subway. Very large rooms.

review_title: Fair hotel, fair location: 10 minutes from downtown, 10 minutes from airport
review_text: a typical super 8: Fair basic hotel. reasonably location between airport (bush) and downtown. Rooms are quite clean though not recently renovated, breakfast is very basic (2 types of cheap cereals, bagel and cheese). Free wifi. For its moderate price, it's ok.

review_title: You get what you pay for.
review_text: Clean and friendly service. Breakfast bar good but basic.

review_title: Great location. Nice clean room. Comfortable bed. Highly recommended.
review_text: Would recommend to any traveller. Very obliging. Location is excellent with restaurants close by. Times Square and shopping areas nearby.

review_title: Great for expense accounts and conventions.
review_text:
The Hilton Westchase on Westheimer is a very nice hotel in an area of Houston that had become slightly blighted over the past decade. Over all, this is a nice property and is very suitable for international conventions. However, for the leisure traveler worried about being nickle and dimed, I would keri looking for a better overall better value.
The room is well appointed with a single granite vanity in the same room as the commode and bath. Same granite is used for the TV armoire. The ssh is nice, but a bit small. Pedestal lights next to the bed include power outlets to connect your various chargers.
In room iron was usable, but the board was old and rugged. Also had to reach behind the TV to plug it in.
Closet took a minute to find. It was right next to the main door. Don't open the wrong door if you are naked!
Water pressure was superb. Could be used for water blasting. But the drainage was very poor in the toilet, tub, and sink.
Other than a few molds spots expected just about anywhere, and outdated panels above the vanity, room was comfortable.

review_title: Chic, trendy and fashionable by Bryant Park
review_text: Enjoyed the modern design of the aesthetic And the alternative service by staff in checking in. Rooms are modern and comfy. one draw back, it's pretty noisy even at higher floors, I realize it is NYC but other hotels are just a bit more tranquil

Although the location was good, the hotel is old, run down and dirty. The toilet in our room was broken, they put us in a different room at our adamant request, and the toilet in our new room was on it's last leg. The carpets were filfy and the rug in our bathroom had hair and dirt all over it. We will never recommend this hotel to anyone and we will not stay here again.

I'm not known for my 'gushing' praises but have to say staying at the Beacon Hotel made our trip to New York one of the best holidays ever! Viande's restaurant next door, Fairway's across the road and two min walk to 72nd St. for the Metro 123 plus Central Park behind a couple blocks made this a perfect location. Rooms clean and beds made every day, guest services brilliant, however male receptions manner slightly cold but that didn't bother us, we had a great time and definitely would re-book again.

review_title: Location convenient to Hobby but not much else
review_text: The location is literally at the end of the runway? So close you will want a room facing the back!

review_title: Location and high tech design but comfort
review_text:
Enjoyed the location of this trendy Hyatt offspring but as others have noted they have a unique lobby...no check in desk but the friendly "conceige" will also take you your room. Which will be fine for one or two nights but for any more dont expect the glass closets in the middle of the entry to hold much But loved the free soft drinks and water 
Three requests never got the shower head fixed so it wouldn't point to the floor when showering (it is an open shower no door) was frustrating 
Interesting bar in basement but kitchen was closed after theatre and drinks were limited to trendy drinks

Stayed as a family with young child. It was great. Easy access to times square ( 10 mins door to door). Great deli across the road. Lots of good local restaurants. Safe neighbouhood. Quiet rooms, spacious and well furnished. Helpful staff. Wouldn't dream of staying anywhere else.

Stayed in the andaz when in newyork celebrating our 5 year wedding anniversary. 
There is nothing about this hotel that I could fault! 
The room wasn't huge but more than big enough for 2 people. Bathroom was very big with a huge rainforest shower with a foot bath... Just what you need after a long day walking NYC! 
Non alcoholic drinks where free in the room and in the huge hidden fridge in reception. This actually saved a decent amount of cash.
There was also a complementary free glass of wine each night too, these small touches were lovely! 
The staff where very very friendly!! We were stuck in the hotel when a hurricane hit the city and the staff could not have looked after us any better!! 
The location is also brilliant! Right opposite the library with Bryant park behind it. Lovely to sit and enjoy sunset. You can see the empire state from the corner of the hotel and walk to it in 5/10 mins. 5th avenue is also right next to the hotel and walking down it will take you to central park. 15 mins away. 
Time square was also less than 10 mins away!! 
Overall, we will 100% stay here next time we are in NYC! 
It's not cheap, but it was stress free!!

My friends and I stayed at this hotel for 9nights, the location and surrounding shops were amazing and very close to the subway station. As we arrived for checkin the welcome cud have been better from the assistant manager, we asked questions but he answered them for the sake of providing the answer and care factor low, we were put on a smoking floor... All of us are non smokers and the disgusting smell flowed into the room and became quite nauseating... Other than this the rest of the customer service was amazing and hotel rooms quite big. Great hotel... Especially if you are a smoker

review_title: Excellent on every level LOVED my stay.
review_text: I visits NYC frequently. This was my first stay @ The Andaz. Their customer service was superior from the momnent I exited my cab. The staff is friendly and over and beyond my expectations. The room was nothing short of amazing. Just beautiful. From the room to the comlimentarty wine bar and eating at the restaurant. I had a experience I will never forget. I will also never Choose to stay at any other hotel in NYC..I love love love Andaz!

I've stayed at a couple "boutique" hotels in Manhattan and this one by far out does them all. The customer service was excellent from the moment I checked in. Free coffee and water in the lobby. Their complimentary wine from 6-9! Free and NY are rarely in the same sentence. The room's fridge is stocked with beverages that are also complimentary! The rooms were great, I especially loved the shower with the waterfall effect.

review_title: Great service but not enough storage space!
review_text: To be fair, overall we really enjoyed our stay at the Andaz 5th Ave. The location was superb, the service impeccable, and the complimentary wifi and snack bar were appreciated. However, of course, there is always a but...the rooms have very little storage space. There was one tiny closet enough to hang 4 shirts and 2 pants. My husband and I literally lived out of our suitcase for 6 nights. This may not seem like a big deal but when you have nowhere to put your clothes for 6 days, it gets annoying fast. Also, please be aware that there is a restaurant/bar right next to the hotel that plays very loud music. On our last night at the hotel, on a Tuesday night, we were kept awake until 1:00 am because of the loud music. I called the front desk at 11:20 pm and they advised they expect the music to stop in 10 minutes. That, did not happen. At midnight we noticed the volume went down a bit but the bass continued. They finally turned the music off around 1:00am. Needless to say we were not happy. For an upscale boutique hotel, they should at least offer a good night's sleep, without the loud party music on a Tues. night!!
Don't be fouled by the outside of the motel. The rooms were clean and the bed was comfortable. The breakfast was not to good. There was no milk for cereal and nobody around to help.

Nos hemos alojado 8 dias en este hotel y ha sido la mejor elecciÃ³n.
Las habitaciones muy amplias y limpieza impecable.
La ubicacion excepcional a tan solo 5 minutos de los principales lugares de midtown y a 2 minutos del metro.
El personal muy amable y atento.
Sin duda lo recomiendo y en mi proximo viaje a Nueva York repetire en este hotel.

review_title: Like our own apartment in NYC!
review_text: This hotel is fantastic, wonderful, leafy location. Nice restaurants nearby and a well stocked liquor store too. It was just like having a little home to stay at. Very clean and after staying at a number of hotels in NYC, real value for money. Can't say enough good things about it.

Dirty rooms, dirty tub and toilet. Pee stains on floor, pubic hairs on floor, food particles all over room, blood on comforter and sheets. Disgusting. Unfriendly staff. No breakfast left at 7:45 when breakfast lasts till 9 am. Overpriced!!!

We stayed at the Andaz for the second time and were sadly a bit disappointed. It is a great hotel, we had a nice suite, the location is great, the staff are friendly. Design is cool, as is the concept of the hotel. But, it has lost the little bits that made it exceptional for us only a year before. 
Staff: friendly enough but could have been more proactive, it's nice not to have to ask for things like drinks refills etc. Very helpful in giving us a late checkout though and certainly had a nice demeanor.
Room: good room (modern design) no free Internet tho on the giant in room screen, seems strange to charge for that when there is free wifi for your laptop etc. Drinks in fridge and complimentary snacks not refilled unless you ask for them, used glasses etc not tidied up / replaced. Turn down service was hardly noticeable, had to keep asking for toiletries to be restocked.
Location: excellent, really good links to transport from airport by bus and also near the subway. Bryant Park very close which is great.
In fairness to them, they dealt with our feedback well and if they can put right these little things it'll be great again.

review_title: Fantastic value for money master the subways and your fine
review_text: We mastered the subways in 1day which meant we come home to the beacon and it was peaceful staff very friendly clean perfect hotel what a great first experience in new york i will be back to NYC soon and will use same hotel again

This was the second time I've stayed at this location, but never again. The property is old and worn, and on my most recent trip I made an unsettling discovery that my room had bed bugs. While the mattress seemed fine, after sleeping in the bed for an hour and waking from itching of being bitten, later inspection showed evidence of bed bug feces on the cover to the box spring (among other things like hair, gross!) I alerted the front desk, who simply asked if I wanted another room--clearly they don't understand that if it's in one room, its likely in others. They offered me points and to not charge me for the room, but did not seem to take the matter seriously, even after I showed them pictures. I immediately left and went to the hampton inn down the street that helped me treat my clothing in their dryer and set me up with a nice room. Not only is the Sheraton below standard for a Starwood property, I was saddened by their non-chalante attitude and made sure to report the incident to corporate.
hotel_name: Sheraton North Houston at George Bush Intercontinental

review_text: We had a 1 BR suite and had plenty of room especially in the living room area. Bathroom could have had more counter space but it was not tiny. Comfortable beds and linens. Ac was hard to regulate to keep room cool during the nite but had it right by the 3rd nite.

review_title: Do not stay here if you want to sleep peacefully.
review_text:
This is the absolute worst hotel by Starwood that I have ever seen. I travel every week and usually stay in a Hilton property. I got stuck with the Sheraton at Houston airport due to last minute booking and couldn't be more disgusted. I felt like I was dealing with a girl who wasn't capable of comprehension when I checked in. When I finally got to my room I immediately noticed the dingy, mold smell. Next thing I noticed were the dirty surfaces and stains on absolutely everything. I asked for sheets to cover the couch because it looked so terrible and old. I also borrowed cleaner to clean every surface. Sadly, this doesn't solve the stains on the bed including comforter, sheets, and bed skirt. The walls and lamp shades also have random stains all over them. The bathroom is tiny and has rusty fixtures. I'm am 100% disgusted by this establishment. My boss pricelined the hotel and I'm stuck here for 3 nights. 
I'm in hotel hell.
hotel_name: Sheraton North Houston at George Bush Intercontinental

review_text: Horrible place to stay!! Front desk lady is rude! We took a shower that night so we needed clean towels the next morning and they told us to come get it or wait tell room service starts at 9 than at 9 we called it was changed to 10:30!! My husband went to get it and she told him to go take the dirty ones to the laundry room!( talk about poor quality hotel) breakfast has cold boiled eggs, hard donuts and apple juice if you go early enough bc once there out too bad!!! Pay a few bucks more and get a better hotel!! Don't waste your money or time here

review_title: Good for an in and out night
review_text: I expected much for it being a ramada. There was no continental breakfast which pissed me off being i was there for a week. Its only good for an overnight stay.

I booked a Junior Suite which was supposed to have been recently refurbished. Check in was an unsual experience as the gentleman took 4 telephone calls during the process and pointed and gestured a lot (I'm a 'valued' Platinum SPG member by the way). I was assigned a low floor, oddly shaped Junior Suite which was worn, shabby and unfortunately infested with roaches. On calling the front desk i was was offered a room on the Club floor instead (so a down-grade) which I obviously had to take. Someone did bring the keys for the new room, but no offer of assistance with luggage was made. The Club floor room was actualy in much better shape and was more than acceptable and bug free. No one from the hotel called to check if everything was ok with the new room or appologised for the inconvenience - not what I needed after a 10 hour flight. In general the hotel is ok, it has supposedly gone through a mulit-million dollar refurbishment but I'm not sure where thet spent the money. Fortunately I stayed on cheap corporate rate so I wasn't too bothered and know to avoid this place in future.
hotel_name: Sheraton North Houston at George Bush Intercontinental

review_title: Smart new hotel in great location.
review_text: First stay at the Andaz 5th Ave hotel. I arrived late and tired after a flight delay, but the staff were welcoming and friendly and got me to my room with smooth efficiency. The roomwas fabulous, the location better and the hotel calm and serene. Great place. Can't wait for an excuse to visit again
For the price of the stay not having free wifi, just in the lobby and nor a breakfast place make me think twice.
hotel_name: Sheraton North Houston at George Bush Intercontinental

review_text: Un albergo con una meravigliosa posizione , ottimi servizi , camere molto grandi , cosÃ¬ pure i bagni .biancheria del letto molto raffinata. Tv al plasma in bagno.macchina per caffÃ¨ espresso e frigobar complimentary. Maserati a disposizione dei clienti dell'albergo sempre complimentary ! Il personale gentilissimo , vieni subito chiamato per nome , e veramente si fanno in 4 per soddisfare ogni esigenza. All'arrivo fino a 4 capi vengono stirati gratis..la mia camera aveva un terrazzo grande con 2 lettini per prendere il sole.
hotel_name: The Setai Fifth Avenue, a Capella managed Hotel

review_text:
I've stayed here many times on business. It's a great value, clean comfortable rooms, and a good restaurant and bar in the lobby.
Biggest complaint is the Concierge Lounge. The morning attendant is awful. He constantly let's coffee, cups, and breakfast item run out and busy business travelers just don't have time to wait around for him in the morning. Further, I witnessed his unsanitary method for washing the silverware and was very grossed out.
As a whole this is a great place to stay if you have business near IAH.
hotel_name: Sheraton North Houston at George Bush Intercontinental

review_text:
We stayed for 6 nights in the Beacon Hotel. We were visiting from the UK and was given the choice when booking of the Beacon or a compact room in a Midtown hotel which worked out more expensive. The Beacon was by far the best choice. In a great neighbourhood, the subway a very short walk, good shops and restaurants near by. I would recommend Crumbs Bake shop for all your cupcake needs and Viand for breakfast lunch or tea. The hotel itself was spacious and very clean with a small kitchenettes and huge comfy bed. The staff were very helpful and couldn't do enough for you. 
If I come to New York again I will most definately be staying here again! Well done Hotel Beacon!

review_title: It's ok for a short stay given the price (I paid $52 per night), but you get what you pay for.
review_text: The room was clean with new carpet, paint, furniture, linens, etc... But I arrived to a room that must have been 130 degrees at 8pm, it was unbearable. I had to turn on the AC and leave because the room was so hot, and it took several hours for it to cool. The paint/texture on the shower ceiling was pealing, the bed was not very comfy and there was alot of road noise. The breakfast was just breads; toast, waffles, muffins, or danish, juice and coffee. No cereal, or fruit, it was disappointing. There is a Days Inn close by (airport) that is much better, in the same price range.

When Me n my boyfriend first got ther we had a dirty room. Condoms Wer everywhere n the room. Some Wer open some Wer closed. Towels Wer wet on the counter. So they gave us another room. Tha next room was ok..so I thought some perverted man kept callin the room. N Wen my boyfriend would answer he wouldn't say n e thing, so that was it I pakd my things n called for the security guard to escort us out...uh that was a horrible ghetto stay!

If your stuck on a lay over in Houston stay someone else!! The rooms are dirty, needs updating and bug infested. The food is just off and on the verge of going bad. We got sick!! There is a reason the rooms are so darn cheap!! Stay somewhere else!!

Ottima accoglienza all'arrivo in hotel, personale preparato e variegato! Ho potuto anche parlare la mia lingua con la gentilissima Mina. Le stanze sono molto curate nel dettaglio, stile sobrio ed elegante, qualitÃ  italiana! Letti comodi! La posizione del plesso Ã¨ molto interessante, a due passi dall'empire state building, dalla Public library e non molto distante da Central Station e dal Cryseler building. Nel complesso molto soddisfacente!
hotel_name: The Setai Fifth Avenue, a Capella managed Hotel

review_text: My week stay in Houston was to be amazing. My mother had come from fort hood on a week long military break to see her family and pet chihuahua. Our stay in the hotel was ABSOLUTE HELL. We had two towels in the room, and when we asked for more, we were told there were no more towels. On friday night (11-6-11) we left to see the space center for a few hours. On our way out the door, the spanish cleaning lady was told to absolutely not enter hour room. The "do not disturb" signs were missing. When we came back to greet our happy little puppy, we found him missing. Immediatly distressed, we searched the neighborhoods (unknown to us, we're all from wichita) for hours before finding him DEAD in a plastic bag near a bus stop. Sebastion (our dog) was securely in his room before we left, and there were no signs of forced entry. One of those people let our dog out, and none of them would confess to it. If I had only seen this site, my dog would still be alive. Now, an American soldier has to go to Iraq with the stress of a recently lost loved one, and it's the fault of the Westheimer Quality Inn. Do NOT stay in this hotel.
Location, restaurant, personalized service, Room decoration: Excellent!

review_title: Fantastic Hotel close to central park.
review_text: Very good position...walking distance to central park...nice area. We had a two bedroom/2 bathroom apartment kitchen dinig/lounge area 3 flat screen televisions. Plenty of room for the four of us...very impressed...except for the Internet charges.

review_title: Basic Sheraton and no frills but great service with a smile.
review_text:
We stayed here for one night since we had a 15 hour layover. The hotel was a few miles from the airport. The rooms need to be updated a bit, our room had a large flat panel TV.

I am a experienced traveler, so I know what to expect from hotels. I stayed in 4 star hotels and I have stayed in motels. No matter what the star level, one thing there is no excuse for is uncleanness. We were a large group, so I rented 6 rooms. 3 of the rooms had a horrific smell.coming from them. I have no idea what was the cause, but it was nauseating. We switched all 3 rooms, and it was hit and miss. Some of the replacement rooms smelled, so we changed again. We finally all ended up in non smelly rooms, but there should be no excuse for such a horrible smell. When I asked the front desk, they appeared not to be aware of the problem, but they were lying. I saw the housecleaning crew carpet bombing an empty room with air freshner. if it wasn't for the smell, the hotel would be great for the price. Its an easy fix, any halfway decent manager would fix the problem. But trust me, it is a systemic problem with the whole hotel.

Spent 4 nights at the Hotel Beacon and once again had a fantastic time (stayed in May 2010 also). The rooms were just as great as I remember from last time. review_title: Cheap and it feels like it
review_text:
I stayed here on business at short notice, location was admittedly handy for my meeting but little else. On the plus side the bed was comfy.
Minus sides: right by the freeway and railway, noisy air-con, room door opening onto the street, tiny pool overlooked by said freeway (literally yards away), awful breakfast in styrofoam dishes (!?), general bargain basement feel of the place.

I booked this hotel based on price and decent reviews. The first room they put us in the ac did not work. Second room was better but sheets were not clean. The pool was very dirty as I had to use the pool net myself to get the layer of grime off of the water. Overall bad experience as we did not even stay the night. They at least did not charge me.

I was very impressed with the impeccable service. I was greeted immediately upon entering, offered a beverage and checked-in. The staff is excellent and can offer great dining recommendations. The rooms are nice and spacious (for NYC) and in-line with the swanky upscale atmosphere. I would definitely stay here again.

I stayed here for the week of my wedding in NYC. I was apprehensive at staying in only a 3 star, but needed the space afforded by a suite and this hotel was very reasonable. I needn't have worried.
The suite we were in was very spacious (huge by NYC standards!) lovely and spotlessly clean, very comfortable indeed with a massive bed and loads of storage. There were 3 wardrobes, so I could afford to have a 'wedding dress cupboard' as well as hanging up our other clothes. 2 large TVs with a full range of cable channels including movies.
The kitchenette was very handy and The Fairway across the road is impressive as reported by other reviewers.
The upper West Side location is a leafy and pleasant area and was a relief to return to after the chaos of downtown. The Park & Natural history museum are very close and we found everything we found we needed within a few blocks - pharmacy, stationers, off licence, hairdresser, nail salon to name a few. Try Arties diner on W83rd/broadway we only found it on our last day, was filled withlocals, great food.
The subway is very close and easy to use - just jump on the red line! It's a 5min trip to times square and beyond goes all the way downtown to staten island ferry via Greenwich village and all in-between. Very easy trip.
The staff were unfailing pleasant and friendly, however we learnt to to request things (eg 
extra glasses sent up/ someone to come & fix telly) twice every time as any request made was never completed first time - although they were always very positive when request made.
The only other slight criticisms I'd make are that the air con in our room seemed to have a loose part which jangled making it impossible to leave on at night (the one in the other room was fine though).
Although there are 2 PCs available in the lobby for Internet use, WIFI in room is $10 a day. In this day & age free wifi needs to be standard. Also it says 20mins max on a PC but there was a man who seemed to be on it all day everyday, I don't even think he was a hotel guest. I wouldn't mention it, but we desperately needed to print off an important doc asap and this man informed us he would be at least another hour - some monitoring of the Internet use would have come in handy there!
Very minor niggles in what was overall a fantastic stay. I believe the 3* rating of this hotel reflects the amenities (eg no health facilities/ restaurant) rather than room standard, as the room standard can't be faulted.

Overall the hotel is decent but the customer service is so terrible I would stay at one of the many other nice hotels right down the street.

When I stay in the Energy Corridor area of Houston, I usually stay at Omni Westside or Embassy Suites. Travelling with othersed to my stay at Hampton Inn. It ended up being a pretty good stay! 
Friendly front desk workers, holiday decorations all around the lobby and front entrance, decent-sized rooms, coffeemaker, plasma tv's and SUPER comfortable beds and pillows made the stay great. 
Only issues were small things like poorly working lamp, tv that had technical issues, etc. Small issues that weren't a huge deal. 
I got a deal on an internet booking site for the room and feel as if it was more than worth the price. I would stay again if the price was right and needed accomodations at a cheaper price.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Houston - I-10W, Energy Cor

review_title: Good place for a quick stay
review_text: Nice, simple rooms. Very comfy place to stay. The pool is small but refreshing. The workout room leaves a bit to be desired, but it works. All of the staff here is very nice & helpful. Good place for a quick business trip.

review_title: Best place to stay in Manhattan!
review_text: Stayed here for four nights. Kimpton hotels are known for top-notch service and the Eventi does not disappoint. The customer service here is, simply put, outstanding. Every staff member goes out of his or her way to ensure an excellent stay. They greet you at the door, at the desk and at the elevator, which adds a level of security as well that is reassuring. Wine reception is a lovely treat and we loved sitting with our wine on the verandah with a view of the Empire State Building. Very civilized! The rooms are gorgeous with cool, modern touches, great art and a sweet shower. First class all around. Location is perfect. We walked to Times Square, Greenwich Village and Chelsea Market, no problem. We will stay here again and we will recommend it to everyone we know traveling to NYC. Become an Kimpton member and enjoy the perks. Like them on Facebook for other bonuses. Love the Eventi and love the Kimpton chain!

review_text: I stayed here not through choice but because my hotel had doublebooked my room. I would not choose to stay here again as the walls are wafer thin and the air con sounds like a freight train. The bedrooms are in need of a makeover but the shower in the bathroom was powerful although the sink was slow to drain. Both desk clerks I dealt with seemed pleasant enough but not terribly attentive.

review_title: You would think there couldn't be anything nicer than staying at the Hilton, wrong it's a nightmare!
review_text: Let's see it started from checking in. I made reservations for a king size bed. At check-in I was given a room with a double with the option of a king bed but in a smoking room. 1st sorry of inconvenience. We get to our room 802 and our keys do not work so back to the lobby to reprogram the keys. 2nd sorry of inconvenience. On my way back an employee walks me back to the room and offers to open the door, it doesn't open. He calls for maintenance who uses a contraption to open the door and then he fixes the motor in the door. 3rd sorry of inconvenience. We go to eat dinner at the hotel restaurant (not very good). I order ribeye Cooked medium but get the strip medium well(I know the strip is a better meat but I prefer ribeye). 4th sorry. We return to our room after a few drinks. We go to shower and notice pubic hair along the side of shower and my husband points out the gum on the soapdish(it's kinda high so I didn't notice). We than put our breakfast order on the door. Wake up to the knock, breakfast. I noticed that the bacon I ordered was not on the tray so I pick up the phone to call, no ringtone, try the other phone, no ringtone. Has to use my cell. I tell the front desk, 5th sorry. She connects me to the restaurant where the lady tells me she wasn't sure about some of the order so she called the room but no one answered, I explain that's cause our phones weren't working. 6th sorry. Next time I come for my business trip to Houston, I will definitely not stay at this Hilton!!!!!

review_title: Nice place. Helpful staff. Pricey for what you get at the regular room rate.
review_text: Stayed here in June 2011 and found the hotel offered everything we needed. Rooms were smallish but who goes to New York to stay in their room?Location for Chelsea is perfect but it's a bit of a walk to midtown and the theatres. Close to subways which was good but lots of track construction meant train cancellations. Not easy to follow if you're not from NYC.

review_text: Amazing rooms, comfy beds, staff were attentive and genuinely friendly, free wifi, good location. Can't go wrong.

The staff at Eventi were very friendly and helpful. Wine time on the terrace was an excellent idea, coming from Australia we were able to mingle with American and OS travelers and talk about our travel adventures. 
Food Parc next door was excellent for breakfast and we loved the outdoor eating area. We also ate there for dinner one night. Overall an excellent experience and have already recommended this hotel to few people who are headed for NY.

review_text:
One thing that I usually enjoy about Marriott is that I usually always enjoy my stay, whether it's in a Category 2 joint or a Category 4 palace. After reading the rave reviews about this particular place, I was looking forward to my business trip to Houston.
 The location is great; not even 10 minutes from the airport. When I arrived late at night and got to my room, I pulled the covers back and saw a huge silverfish crawling on one of the pillows. Ok, not comforting, but not a deal breaker, either. Bugs find their way into even the cleanest hotel. 
The next night, I went to the gym only to find that the floor was damp from a water leak and the place reeked of mildew. At dinner, I went to get a salad and the lettuce looked like it had been sitting in the sun all day. I was starting to see a pattern. The next day, breakfast consisted of eggs mixed with cut up hot dogs from the night before. Yuck. My mom used to do that trick with leftovers when I was a kid. The staff seemed complacent and did not talk much, not even to smile or say hi in the hall.
I have stayed in dozens and dozens of Marriotts, and this one ranks in the bottom 5%. I don't know what the other reviewers saw in this place.

The place is great. Staff is friendly too. But their gym / fitness center stinks. The A/C in the fitness center is leaking water and We all have complained about it a zillion times, no one has bothered to fix it. They keep saying someone will have the maintainance guy look at it. But nothing! We were moving to Houston due to work relocation and we stayed here for a month. Reception Service was great, but the location is BAD! yes, it is close to the airport, and they do have a shuttle, but there is nothing around to do or even grocery shop. I would say find another location. Overall, I would give it a 3 out of 5.
Really helpful staff! Great stay. they really have a great pool it's really pretty and when it's hot outside, its amazing
hotel_name: Residence Inn Houston by The Galleria

review_text: On a precruise vacation I needed a hotel for one night at a reasonable cost. Marriott worked perfectly. It was easy access from the interstate and a short drive to Galveston Island to the cruise port. I highly recommend this hotel
hotel_name: Houston Marriott South at Hobby Airport

review_title: Warning do not stay run away to another hotel full of roaches
review_text:
I awoke at 4:30 am to feeling like something was crawling on me in my bed ..turned on the lights there was huge roaches in my bed, and on the walls and ceilings...I had NO food in my room....
