I am home and scared to close my eyes
That hotel needs to be condemned ...Marriott should be ashame to allow their name on that place. That hotel is not even a 1 star...Io would not re omen this place to my worst enemy
hotel_name: Marriott Houston Airport at George Bush Intercontinental

review_text: The bathrooms are small and not updated. Food not very good. Air units in the rooms hard to regulate.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Houston Reliant Park Area

review_text: The hotel looks very nice....little bit old in some areas but overall is very worth for the money we paid ($60/night for king bed). Three drawbacks: Small restroom smell muddy in the room and narrow inside room hallway. Literally next to reliant stadium. Conveniently located around supermarket and restaurants (frenchy's, dimassi, olive garden, Ross, Fiesta market and many more).
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Houston Reliant Park Area

review_text: this hotel is located in a good area and it is very close to downtown. There was a good price deal and parking is free so it was excellent for us. The hotel offers a pricey breakfast so we didnt eat there. overall it was a good stay and since there are so many places and bakeries in houston we didnt mind having our breakfast out of the hotel.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Houston Southwest

review_text: We are staying here with 2 toddlers and it is just what we needed at a good price. The room is clean and having the kitchen is so helpful. The free breakfast is great, especially on weekends. The Ritz it is not, but it's comfortable, clean and affordable. The staff is very pleasant and kind. The young woman manning the weekend breakfast was especially lovely.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Houston - Westchase

review_text: We stayed free last night on our Hilton Honors points... unbelievably accommodating... very clean... bed was just right... great breakfast. Night clerk "Ada" is a real jewel. Other housekeeping staff and lady preparing breakfast were all smiling and pleasant. GREAT PROPERTY!!
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Houston - Westchase

review_text:
Business stay. Very good service, nice looking, inside and out. Easy wifi connection that worked well. Everything was clean and fairly new. Used the coffee maker in the morning, no problem. A good selection of pillows.
Only a couple issues. One, the bed was VERY soft. Me, I really prefer a firmer mattress, but that is just me. Two, the AC seemed to wait a long time to come on. And when it did, it really stayed on for a while. So it would get uncomfortably warm, enough to wake me up and kick off the covers, then get cold enough to wake me up to grab some covers. After doing that cycle several times, not the best nights sleep. I probably should have just turned it down lower and curled up under the thick comforter.
But other than that, it was all good!
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Houston - Westchase

review_text: First, we were put into a room with stains all over the comforters and trash on the floor. We were given attitude about it then put into another room with hair all over the bathroom. We were too tired to do anything about it. The last straw however was being woke up at 7am by housekeeping! All these doors were slamming starting around 6 but my husband got woken up at 7, went to the hallway and it was the maids! He told them politely to please stop slamming the doors, that itwas shaking the whole room. We were given attitude when we complained and were told the doors were heavy and they have to clean the rooms. Uhhhh hello, the guests are the reason the cleaning staff is even here. Care should be taken as to not disturb them. Closing the door instead of letting it slam itself would have been awesome. We were also told that they couldn't do anything about all of this as there is no manager on duty. All i can say about this stay is wtf!

review_title: Great location but in desperate need of renovation
review_text: Bathrooms are dated and small. TV is old and room wireless in not available. Revolving restaurant food selection is poor. Bottom line is hotel needs update.
hotel_name: Marriott Houston Airport at George Bush Intercontinental

review_title: Great for a night or even a month
review_text: The hotel is located conveniently between West Houston and Katy with quick access to both. We stayed in a one bedroom suite which I felt was comfortable enough for one (possibly two) person to stay in for an extended period. The furnishings are new, attractive, comfortable and clean. It was a great place for our family for our two night stay. The hotel pool was small but nice, the workout facility very limited but well maintained and the kitchens in the rooms stocked with appropriate cookware and dinnerware. Wifi is included but our connection was painfully slow and unreliable. The daily breakfast is more than adequate and also included. We didn't have the chance to attend the evening food and beverage buffet (M-Th) but the posted menu looked to be an adequate dinner for most. Service was excellent overall, quite friendly and visible. Overall a fantastic value for the amount of space and extras included.

I have been staying at this hotel since it opened and my minimum stay is a week. I now find it much less comfortable, it's now noisy. The A/C and the refrigerator combine to force the need for ear plugs if sleep is wanted. This has been the first exposure to the dreaded Houston curse, the Cockroach. Need I say more.

review_title: You get what you pay for.
review_text: I will not stay here again. The towels had hair in them. The housekeepers came in my room while my husband & I were asleep. They could only speak spanish & I had to go speak to a Supervisor which helped out. The air didn't get very cool.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Houston Southwest

review_text:
I stayed here for one night.
Goodness:
Room was clean & spacious. 
Free shuttle to the airport, leaves every 30min.
Comfortable bed.
Need improvements:
The AC was making so much noise, felt like i was on the plane. Their Sunday breakfast doesnt open until 7am...a disadvantage for those whose flights are as early as 6am. Wifi didnt work in the room. 
Staffs are not friendly. 
If you're just basically looking for a place to crash it'll work just fine.

This is a hotel that has tried to be
Trendy but failed to update the
Necesities. The floors have no signs to find rooms and the A/C never got
Cool. The staff was very friendly but the room quality ruined the experience. The location is convenient if u have a car.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Houston Southwest

review_title: Very close to hospitals and food
review_text:
This was an OK hotel. I stayed here for business and found the check-in staff to be nice, but not knowledgeable and the check-out staff to be more knowledgeable but not very friendly or helpful. There seemed to be a lot of confusion around being "tax exempt".
The room was fine, but nothing special. The bathroom tub didn't drain well and the towels were really thin. But it was really cheap compared to the other hotels in the area, so it was OK. 
Because it's near the hospital there are several food choices nearby. Mostly fast food, but they're within easy walking distance. 
As an aside, it bothered me that the hotel parked its car in the fire lane. 
I wouldn't recommend this hotel to a friend unless they had to stay near the hospital. If they did, this hotel would be OK for the money.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Plaza Hotel & Suites at Medical Center Houston

review_title: Property great. Location not so great.
review_text:
The interior of the hotel is much better than I thought from reading other reviews. I like the modern lobby set-up and the room was nice . Having reasonably priced food available most of the day was helpful. 
During the day the area may be different but at my free evening time the surrounding blocks looked rundown and empty. 
I like Courtyards, though, and would stay again for business.

Enjoyable stay! Good sized rooms, comfortable decor, excellent beds, slept like a dream. Room had terrific view of Empire State building. Only downside was low waterpressure in shower. Free coffee in lobby in AM, free wine party 5-6pm. Room service was good food, but arrived late. Workout facility was decent size, plenty of equipment. Nice open patio on 5th floor. Great spot to sit outside and read. I also went to Foodparc directly next door for take out one night, it was good inexpensive food.

review_text: Definitely enjoyed staying here. Was in a great location for walking-many stores, including Macy's - was only a short walk away. Room was a good size and very clean. Bathroom was large. review_title: Wonderful stay, can't wait to return!
review_text: Love this hotel! We went for my 50th birthday celebration and it was perfect. We had champagne and chocolate in our room upon arrival, the staff was friendly, we had a great view of the Empire State Building, it was truly a perfect stay. The details: A very comfy room with a great view. Really comfy bed. Friendly, accommodating staff. From the desk staff down to the cleaning staff. The security guard remembered us, we never had to show our key after our first day, the doorman, very tall man, knew all the spots to go to and had helpful information. The location was perfect for everything we did, right in the middle. There is a great rooftop deck that they sometimes serve afternoon wine/sangria on. If I had even one tiny complaint I would say the light in the bathroom wasn't great but that was so minor that it hardly matters. We love New York and like to try different hotels whenever we are there but honestly, I can't imagine staying anywhere else now, thanks Eventi for a great stay!

review_title: Nice, covienent for a flight but in need of a major remodel.
review_text:
My title kind of sums it up. Very covent hotel as it's locates in the airport. The staff are very nice and friendly. The restaurant and bar upstairs are good. 
However, the rooms are very dated now and in need of a major remodel. Other than that no real complaints.

review_text:
My family and I did an overnight in NYC and got a very good deal at Eventi. Although they had overbooked and didn't have the room we'd reserved, they did give us 2 rooms instead. The rooms were great - a little small, but that's normal in NYC, and for what we paid (about $230) it was a great deal. The rooftop terrace on the 5th floor was a good place for coffee and to take in the view. 
Foodparc next door, which belongs to Eventi, is a fun place to eat with kids, you order your food at touchpad kiosks and pick up. The food was ok, nothing great, but prices were reasonable. 
The service staff in the hotel was friendly, but seemed a little distracted when there were large crowds in the lobby. 
Overall we enjoyed our stay and would come back here.

review_title: Noisy, dingy and all around let down.
review_text: We arrived at the hotel after a 9.5 hour drive at 3 am. The front desk staff was rude when we checked in. We got to our room and went into te bathroom to notice roaches in the bathtub!!! We killed them and decided this would not ruin our tine here. We laid down to sleep having to be up in a few hours for an audition. We were on the end room on the lower level and we heard almost every car passing by and the tenants upstairs walking around like ogres. I was awaken a couple of times with what sounded like gun shots the first night. That morning we were up and ready to go at 6:00 am and headed to the reliant stadium center. Relatively easy access to the stadium and to the shops at the galleria section of Houston. We had the do not disturb sign up and then asked for some clean towels and was told to bring the dirty towels to the office for an exchange, first time I've ever had to do that in all of my hotel stays. Awoke on day 3 of our stay to 4 ROACHES in the bathtub!!! GROSS! We notified the hotel staff an they said they would take care of it when they did the house cleaning. They did and cleaned the room and didn't disturb our personal things other than setting the thermostat to 10* higher than we had it. Minor complaint there. It was quick and easy access to restaurants and shopping so that was a plus. The tv was extremely outdated and the layout of the room was odd. Had a fridge and microwave which would have been nice if we had eaten in the hotel more. all in all it was a let down after reading some of the reviews.

review_title: This is why you stay at HIEX - a high standard every time. And with Texas style!
review_text: Very clean and comfortable. Really great Texas flair in it's design. This is why I stay at HIEX consistently. No surprises, always a minimum standard of cleanliness and customer service orientation, and at a price that doesn't break the bank. Not the cheapest in town, but c'mon, do you really want to stay a the cheapest in town?! Great hotel -very clean. Gotta love that.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Houston West-Energy Corridor

review_text: Stayed for business. Rooms were clean, staff was very nice. Location is handy for the airport. I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_name: John F. Kennedy Inn and Suites

review_text: I've been traveling and coming to Houston for the last 13 years, I've stayed at the Marriotts, Hiltons, Holidays Inn and so on. I have even stayed at the Candlewood Suites which some could say isn't a good hotel but staying at the Hyatt Summerfield @ Sage Road wasn't a good experience for the $149/night rate. The rooms appears clean but they aren't.....you can see that they rarely vacuum and is dust everywhere even right after they make your room. It is a shame as the hotel could be nice and worth every penny.

review_title: Perfect if you want to stay close to the airport, but far from everything else.
review_text: Stayed here for 3 days. Room is good. Breakfast is not so bad. There is one restaurant nearby (at another adjacent hotel). Overall, recommended!
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites Houston Intercontinental Airport

review_text: Two nights stay. A tip for those that are allergic to cigarettes/smoke... avoid the 3rd floor because all rooms on that floor are smoking rooms. Upon arrival we weren't even asked if we'd like a non-smoking room. Receptionist was so rude and unaccomodating. Our first room was 314 & it was too smoky. We asked to be moved and were told by the receptionist that the only rooms available were on the 3rd floor. We were moved to 309 which was much better. If you are traveling with 3 adults bring an air mattress. Rooms are small but clean and modern. The Zenith tv in our room was outdated. The 97 room hotel overall is nice, just beware of the rude receptionist.
Daughter's wedding. Had 2 emergencies. Staff could not have been more caring or accomodating. Very clean.

Rooms, service and amenities were all very good. The location is fabulous and near restaurants, clubs, Galleria and downtown. 
Only thing I would change is add safes in the rooms and minubars. 
Always enjoy my stays here!

All the other hotels were booked near where I needed to be on other side of downtown. Hotel was in an unsafe neighborhood. Room carpet looked dirty so didn't take my shoes off. Bathtub drain was clogged so I was standing in 6 inches of water before my shower was done.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Houston-Downtown Convention Center

review_text: Wine in the evening, coffee in the morning, spotless modern facilities and very efficient service. Cafe / deli next door is worth a look.
hotel_address: {'region': 'NY', 'street-address': '851 Avenue of the Americas (Sixth Avenue)', 'postal-code': '10001', 'locality': 'New York City'}

review_title: Next to the Toyota Center & Minute Maid Park
review_text: Great location for venues and museum parks. Room was fine, nice welcome package for priority members, breakfast bar was good but crowded. Had to wait for a table. Wireless speed is slow, have to pay extra for faster download. AC worked well. Morning paper was free. Would go back.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Houston-Downtown Convention Center

review_text: This hotel is so nice for the price!! The beds were SUPER comfy and the people were friendly. We had a really nice view of the city and it's only a short cab ride to the bars. Only thing that would deter me from staying again was the parking and location of the hotel. It was so hard to get to and had to circle the block a few times to find the hotel parking. Even the cab driver had problems. But overall a great stay!

Great hotel downtown. We stayed in a suite which had a nice living room and attached bedroom. The blinds didn't block all sun light but that's about the only fault I could give this place. Geat arty lobby, big designer bathrooms with Aveda amenities. Friendly staff. The hotel car took us to Reef for dinner, mid town, and collected us afterwards.
To go shopping at Galleria is a 20 USD cab ride, or 30 USD in a town car the hotel can call for you. Taxi from Houston airport to the Alden is 50 USD so the town car they organized to take us back, at only 50 USD was a bargain. 
There is separate air con control for the living and bedroom. Living room had plasma TV while bedroom had a dinosaur of a huge old CRT TV. It looked a bit odd. Certainly looked older than the hotel. There was a DVD player in the bedroom and a CD player in the clock radio.
The wireless Internet works throughout the hotel and was fast.
The mini bar has motion sensors. The staff were great though and didn't doubt it when we said we took one thing but not another. None of that radioing staff to check the room before they let you leave. Well if they did do it, they were discreet which was a nice touch.

review_title: Great place to stay if you're going to a concert in the Verizon theater!
review_text: Very cute. Was recently remodeled yet still has a feeling of a warm historic hotel. Rooms were nice & spacious and loved that they used Aveda products!! Didn't like that there wasn't much to do or eat in the surrounding walking distance area. It was perfect for us though since it was only a couple of miles away from the concert at Verizon.
Stayed here one night. Fancy place, fridge in room. Spacious, comfy bed! My only complaint is the fact that there was no microwave in the entire hotel that could be used by guests.
hotel_name: Sheraton Suites Houston Near The Galleria

review_title: Great rooms for a great price!
review_text: Rooms are like a home away from home with a living area separated from the bedroom. It's also pet friendly and the service was excellent and friendly!
hotel_name: Sheraton Suites Houston Near The Galleria

review_title: Loved it! Loved pool! Great staff!Awesome suites!
review_text: Nice hotel. Pool & ht tub are same size as any other hotel . It was clean well kept! Nice breakfast with plenty to choose hot & cold! Coffee available day and night! The suites are so large, better than other hotel suites I've stayed in. Close to Memorial city mall & lots of shopping. IMAX & improv across interstate! Loved it!!!!!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Houston - Memorial Park Area

review_text:
The hotel was cute & charming. Front desk staff was nice & friendly! Especially the gentleman who checked me in. 
The space in the bedroom and bathroom was perfect. 
My only downfall was the feeling of the couch. A bit rough.
This hotel is a great location for shopping! I attended the Katy Perry concert that weekend at the Toyota Center & the location was perfect. Cheap cab ride! Valet was super helpful in assisting me get a cab quick! 
Great stay!
hotel_name: Sheraton Suites Houston Near The Galleria

review_text: Special request met lightning fast. Bed reasonably comfortable however the A/C didn't seem to work well overnight, I think they have it on a motion sensor so kept waking up due to the temp. Overall good value for the money.
hotel_name: Sheraton Suites Houston Near The Galleria

review_text: If you want to shop, eat and be in the heart of the Galleria, look no further. The valet parking is very convenient, usually don't need the car once I get there. Easy to walk or cab and the access to the Galleria is literally steps away. The rooms are large and well appointed, comfortable beds and quiet outside. It's usually a pick on Hotwire so give it a shot. Great value for often under $100.
Excellent customer service on all levels. Great location. Great amenities.

Got a great rate for a one night stay from hotwire. Stayed in room 604. It was small but very clean with all the amenities. 
There was a minor problem with the plumbing--it would scream like a banshee! Simply flushing the toilet once would get rid of the noise. Weird, I know, but it only occurred twice during our stay. I suspect this was why the room was so steeply discounted, so this was an acceptable trade-off. 
All in all, it was a nice comfortable room and would definitely stay again. Just watch out for room 604.

review_title: A+ service A+ price A+ clenliness
review_text: Excellent, Manager (the one who checked me out on my departure, Sorry I do not recall his name). All around A+ all they way...will be back!!!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn Houston Greenway Plaza

review_text: Location is perfect. Can have a roof over your head. Then shop till you drop. Westin delivers as always.....Will come back again once in Houston...

Because we travel so much, price is a major factor in where we stay, but comfort is equally important. There were 2 cheaper hotels near our convention site, but I'm glad we paid the extra to stay here. This La Quinta is a fine example of quality and good customer service.
Our room (2 full beds) included a micro/ fridge which was not listed on the website. Very nice outdoor pool, laundry facilities, and with separate buildings on site, we never had to wait long on an elevator, even though the hotel was booked to capacity.
A dog show (elsewhere in the area) was going on during our stay. The guests (and their owners, lol) were all well-behaved, and the hotel definitely accomodated to their needs as well. Parking lot is small, but as long as you are not endangering or inconveniencing others, they allow you to park in non-spaces during large events. (Several trailers took up regular spots during our stay. This did not cause us any problems.)
Breakfast is good fare - bagels, toast, muffins, yogurt, fruit, hardboiled eggs, waffles, cereal, oatmeal. The dining area has plenty of seating, without feeling crowded.
We'll come back to this one.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn Houston Greenway Plaza

review_text: The rooms were clean and spacious. The king size bed was comfortable and the bathroom was a good size and well lit up. Walking distance to the galeria. Good value for money when you do the pre-paid.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Houston by the Galleria

review_text:
This hotel surpassed all expectations. From the doorman to the butler service, there was absoluetly no complaints. With just 83 rooms, you get almost an exclusive treatmeant as if you were the only one in the buliding. Everyone was very friendly and seemed very sincere as if they really take pride in their jobs and hotel. 
The room was amazing! Even the toilet has a remote ; No more sitting on a cold toilet seat. In addition to extra features, there is a television that appears in the mirror wall in the bathroom. The huge showerhead delivers an awesome shower experience like no other. Ther is also a shower system in the wall with a handheld shower handle if you choose to opt out of the most wonderful shower experience you will ever have. Even the soap is the only one of its kind in the United States. 
There is also an amazing mini-bar tucked away behind a leather wrapped door accessed by leather handles. AMAZING! The alcoholic beverage avaiable are the ones you will actually want. It also comes with snacks, books, magazines, etc... but for a small fee. 
The room I stayed in had a nice leather wrapped desk that converts into a vanity just in case you do not feel like standing up in the mirror in the bathroom. The bed has a comfortable firm mattress and your head just melts into the pillows providing you with the best night's sleep ever! The remote control for the blinds comes in handy in the a.m. when you don't have the self-discipline to get up to allow some sunshine to help you in the process.
The location is superb!!! In the heart of Times Square, you get a chance to enjoy all the perks but as soon as you walk in the hotel you actually forget you are in the middle of Time Square.
Sorry to be so long winded but I just want the staff to know how appreciative I am of their outstanding hospitality and service. The pictures on the site is proof of the luxuries and amenities of The Chatwal, but does no justice to the service and hospitality that this hotel provides. I will definately make this my home away from home. THE CHATWAL IS A TRUE 5 STAR HOTEL!

review_title: Everything we expected nothing more nothing less!
review_text: We checked into the doubletree after having to check out of the embassy suites on sage due to some issues. When I called the doubletree at 9:00am needing a room they were amazing only being a few blocks away we rushed over valet was a little rude stating check in was at 3:00 but after ignoring the guy and walking to the front desk we were greeted with cookies and smiles. They only had the executive floor which has some perks. The rooms were clean could some updating we originally didn't rent the rooms here because of the look of the kitchen (dated) but it's not really in the living room, it's in it own little area. We used the shuttle service and they promptly picked us up when we called for our ride back which was very nice after dinner and drinks. Overall it was a good experience we had stayed in six hotels in two weeks and the hotel was nice, clean, inexpensive, and had a great location we would stay again!
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Houston by the Galleria

review_text: Different place with charming and caring people. It Is the perfect place to go when you just want to get away. I stayed here multiple occasions. It has the MOST friendly staff I have ever met. They care about their guest and cater to them. They always lend a hand when they can and really become a part of your FAMILY.
Very nice hotel, good location and the staff very friendly and helpful!

Stayed at this hotel twice in October and were very impressed. The staff in all departments were attentive and courteous. Nothing was ever too much trouble. We had interconnecting rooms which were very clean. Wifi was a bit weak in one room though. The room service breakfast was substantial and good value for money. My only negative comment would be the length of service in the Lantern cocktail bar. However, when served the martinis were excellent. The hotel is in an excellent location, close to theatres and shopping without being too noisy. We would definitely stay again

Houston's Galleria is known for great shopping and Westin is known for heavenly beds and dual-head showers, but if you're headed to stay at the Westin Galleria, don't expect to find any bargains (except in the mall parking garage, where hotel guests can self-park for free.)
The hotel room was spacious and well-appointed, but smelled musty and mildewed. The legendary beds were wonderful as ever, but the floor to ceiling windows were covered by custom blinds that had seen better days and the wall above the fire alarm was badly stained. The room did have a mini-fridge but it was inoperable. This hotel has wonderful conference facilities, but hotel hallways were kept at near-arctic temperatures, which oddly did nothing to chase the stagnant air.
The workout room was closed for remodeling, and the hotel has no onsite restaurant, referring guests instead to the Daily Grill next-door, where breakfast entrees with eggs start at $12.95 and dinner entrees run twice that. To get a late night drink, we were directed to the lobby bar at the Westin Oaks property (also at the Galleria) where a single vodka shot cost a whopping $9. (Helpful hint: pack a flask and skip the lobby bar!) The Westin Galleria is in a prime location, but one may find better-scented, full-service luxury accommodations nearby for less.

review_title: Just a place to stay, nothing out of the usual.
review_text:
basic room and service. Nothing special
My keys kept deactivating?

Stayed for 10 days on a business trip. The location is great as it is connected to the Galleria Mall with shops and several choices of restaurants. The standard room I had was big. The bathrooms are a little outdated though.The breakfast at the Daily Grill was probably the best I have had at hotels in the US. The concierge desk was extremely helpful and made reservations for us at restaurants in the mall. The gym was also well equipped and very spacious.
Service and location so good, we decided to stay an extra day. Just a great overall experience.

This hotel is located near the galleria mall and there is shuttle service which you can book at your own timing however they are only able to drive you to 3 miles radius distance.
The hotel staffs are very friendly and even the cleaners greet you with a warm smile each time you walk pass. 
There is a car rental service in the hotel. This is very convenient for the guest as we can rent and return the car in the hotel. 
I would definitely recommend this hotel to my friends visiting Huston.

review_title: Easy to go around with free shuttle to almost everywhere nearby
review_text: Was greet by friendly service staff when check in... Cosy room with very comfortable bed ... Loved the free shuttle service which able to bring you to anywhere with good service staff

I have stayed at this hotel many many times since it opened. It was until recently my favorite hotel in Houston. They have recently made some changes to the Internet service that are just awful! It is now so slow! I was downloading a rather large file the other night and it was taking forever. I stopped it after 30 minutes and it was not even 50% done. I connected with my air card, which is slow, and it only took 3 minutes! 
As much as I have loved this hotel I don't think I will stay any longer, as I need decent Internet service for work.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Houston West-Energy Corridor

review_text: This hotel was a lot for $99 a night. Kitchenette, breakfast and very clean. Breakfast consisted of eggs, sausage, biscuits and gravy and the usual fare. I highly recommend this place.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Houston - Willowbrook Mall

review_text:
My husband and I have stayed at other Springhill Suites and were quite satisfied with our stay.
The hotel is dated, which is not a problem, as long as the customer service aspect is maintained.
My husband lost a pair of sunglasses, he called the front desk to report the loss. He was told that all lost items were locked up and only housekeeping could access the room. He was pomised a call back which did not happen. He had to call twice AND go back to the hotel for resolution. The walls were very thin. We could hear the people in the next room having a normal conversation. My husband asked to be moved, which he was, to another room. The toilet would not flush. We had to move again. The hotel needs a renovation at most. I normally rate my experiences with the Marriott chain on a high scale, however, this property did not meet my expectations.
hotel_name: Springhill Suites Houston Medical Center/Reliant Park

review_text: Second time to stay here this visit was far better they our first!! Large spacious room with mini balcony over looking the pool. Shuttle service with 3 mile radius of hotel. Our driver was helpful, friendly prompt to pick us up. Will stay here again

review_title: Clean , Comfortable and Attentive staff at the Westin Galleria!
review_text: I stayed here with my husband and 3 small children for one night, June 27, 2011. Getting to the actual hotel was a bit of a trouble for our gps due to some lane closures however once we arrived everything was perfect. I have to admit I did get a GREAT deal $79 on priceline. We pulled into the vallet, which was about $27. The vallet was very friendly and was able to offer us some suggestions and answer our questions. We checked in about 3:30 and it went fast and smooth. I requested a crib and it was brought to our room within 10 minutes. The room was clean and very welcoming. 30 minutes after we arrived we received a call making sure everything was ok and to see if we needed anything, wow! We didn't but it was sure a great gesture. The area was perfect for us, great shopping! My only complaint about this hotel would be the pool area. My kids loved the pool,but as an adult it did lack a bit of appeal. I would definately stay here again.
Real nice. This hotel has been updated recently, looks great. We bid for a hotel and got this on the weekend for fifty five dollars a night. Parking is fourteen with in and out privileges.

review_title: Worse hotel ever don't stay here you'll be sorry it's a courtyard Marriott with disgrace to Marriott's name rooms stink bad and
review_text:
They didn't help two ladies by theirselves with their luggage at all.spent two nights. There for cancer checkup. The rooms stunk so bad took 4 rooms before found one we could breathe in.upon checkout asked for cart because luggage too heavy for us carry. I started taking out our stuff to cat in garage while my friend waited in room for cart when I went through lobby told desk asked for cart never got one lady just shook head yes. Got back to room we had take rest of stuff to car
 Never got a cart. TV was on desk on left side room wasn't in front of bed so if u were on left side of bed u really couldn't see it. THIS is a courtyard Marriott hotel and was worse hotel I've ever stayed in an I have traveled a lot. Find another hotel don't stay here.

Stayed at the Westin Galleria in May for business. The location of the hotel is nice, attached to the Galleria mall. The room was average, heavenly bed, LG flat screen TV, very tiny bathroom (door hits shower). I was displeased with the lack of service and recognition of my SPG Platinum status. I received a basic room on a low floor, even though the hotel was not close to sold out. If you are a platinum member looking for an upgrade or even a high floor room, this hotel has failed to comply on my only two visits. I would reccomend visiting the other SPG properties in the area over this property, they have shown much better service on stays.

I am writing this review from the hotel room using the most expensive Internet connection ever in any hotel I've stayed in over my many years of travel. My wife and I arrived to a nice sized room and settled in for our stay. She is a college professor and is in the process of marking her student's exams over the internet so access is important. A number of hotels offer free wifi these days but those who don't usually charge about ten dollars a day. This is what I was given to understand when we checked in. I proceed to connect my iPad for surfing the web and that goes okay. I'm told that my charge will be $12.75 which is for the highest speed. I accept. My wife then goes to get online on her laptop and the message comes back that only one user can use the connection at a time. I called the service center on our phone via the speaker, because our handset is not working, and I am informed that if we both want to use the internet we would have pay another fee. So, right now I have a $12.75 room charge and my wife has a $9.95 room charge which means that we are paying $22.70 for both of us to get online. There is no other way to describe that other than RIP OFF! It's too bad that this first impression has put us off what could have been a pleasant stay. The phone was fixed the following day and there was a slight incident were the handle in the sink came off in my wife's hand. The shower is great and the room is generally okay but if this hotel can't do something about its wifi access then it is not a place that I can recommend and not a place where I would return.

The beds were very comfortable, clean rooms, great front desk service. Good breakfast next morning too, with an adequate selection of hot and cold items.
Remember to ask for a room as far from the highway as possible so you can get some sleep.

review_title: Clean and efficient for Energy Corridor business
review_text:
The good - new hotel, very nice for a Marriott; HD programming on flat screens: well laid out and appointed rooms
The bad - gym didn't always have fresh towels or wipes for equipment
The ugly - room service options are limited and not many fresh and healthy options - hummus is good but my salmon was dry and sitting in a pool of butter

After reading the reviews, I was bracing myself for an ungodly experience. Needless to say, it was the exact opposite. The location was perfect for me because i was attending an event at the reliant stadium area. 
The check in was nice and the staff was very friendly. The rooms were amazingly nice with new decor and expanded size in comparison to typical courtyards I've stayed at. 
The free indoor parking below the hotel was nice it rained that day.
I visited the weight room which had basic equipment and free weights.
I purchased the room at a reduced rate on priceline and I will be back there again on my return to Houston.
I have stayed multiple times here and it's like being home!

review_title: This was a good location for a weekend visit.
review_text: Overall stay was good. The staff was pleasant and flexible when asked to make accommodations. Parking was pricey but if you travel over the weekend there is a parking garage across the street offering a much better deal for parking.

review_title: Highly overpriced with many extra charges.
review_text: I spent two nights here and was very disappointed. My employer has a discounted rate and I still felt like I paid too much. Parking was extra. Internet access was extra. No big surprise for this type of hotel and location, but I never expected things to be so run down. Half of the elliptical machines were broken. The carpet heading toward the garage was really faded. When I considered staying elsewhere, I was told there is a $75 early check-out fee! Your money would be better spent elsewhere.
If you are visiting Methodist Hospital the location can't be beat. Ok rooms, great service, weekday prices are outrageous though! The staff were very nice!

The location of the Marriott can't be beat if you need easy access to the Texas Medical Center, especially The Methodist Hospital. The front desk service is helpful. The valet parking is very overpriced. Food options are ok however the Starbucks in the lobby closes very early. In room wi-fi is overpriced however you may be able to pick up Methodist Guest wi-fi. The hotel is also convenient to Rice University. I can't speak to the value as I was there on a corporate account.

Room was very clean and recently updated with a modern, bright, design. New flat screen TVs and comfortable beds. Staff was very helpful and friendly. Free breakfast had plenty of variety. Loved that the hotel is smoke free. Would definitely stay again!

Very nice hotel. I've stayed in many Courtyard's but this one is definitely a step above. Rooms and hotel are completely updated with modern colors and decor. Beds are very comfortable. Convenient to freeway, Rice Village and medical center.

-nice, new upon entering
-friendly, accommodating staff but gave my reserved room away the 1st night & had to put me in a handicapped room. The general manager upgraded me the next night to a King "suite". It was 1/4 of the size of the handicapped room, with a couch shoved into the corner. I suppose the couch I'd what differentiates the "suites" from the regular rooms
-could hear EVERYTHING my neighbors said or did, unfortunately. (He had a cold...She "over active bladder syndrome" & trouble w a daughter-in-law back home)
-when bathroom flooded & toilet flushing mechanism broke, I cut my losses & moved to the fabulous new Hyatt Place in Sugar Land for $80 a night! Worth the drive.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Houston West Energy Corridor

review_text: Once I got to this hotel for the first time staying here was such a great pleasure after being greeted by such a great staff member once I walked thru the door and attended I felt the the warmest welcome ever to stay at this suite. I was recommended by a friend and I would definately as well recommend it to a friend as well. :)

Standard Marriott Courtyard business hotel. Â Lobby is great, convenient to everything. Â Value is good if you boon a week in advance. Â  Â Staff is very friendly and helpful.
Room appeared to be very clean, but I didn't have the ultra violet light! Â Kidding.. Room was very clean...
I've stayed here around 10 times and will continue.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Houston by the Galleria

review_text:
I stayed at this hotel for one night while at the airport. The shuttle drivers were very nice as well as the front desk staff. I checke in quickly and found my room to be very clean and bright. I really enjoy the decorating.
The bed was comfortable and they allowed us to have a late check-out. We had breakfast downstairs and loved it. The food was great and the staff were once again very friendly. I would definitely stay there again.

review_title: Such Potential, But Falls Far Short
review_text:
The room had no microwave or refrigerator. The bathroom was so small two adults couldn't be in there at the same time. The door hit the shower curtain rod preventing it from fully opening and creating a roadblock by the toilet. The air conditioning worked but not very well and the room was always warm. I had maintenance up to check it out, but it was always warm in the room. I slept a total of 5 hours in two days. 
I couldn't watch TV, even though it was a very large and nice screen. The TV rarely picked up Or maintained a Signal, so I couldn't even pass the time watching TV. 
 This hotel has a great location & I usually love the Hilton properties; but this hotel falls so very short of the Hilton Family Brand Standards that I would prefer to stay in a ** Hotel than this Hilton. 
 I brought this to the attention of the general manager, but I've received no response. Not even an acknowledgement of my discontent
Wait till construction over. Up at crack of dawn, no sleep and long drive ahead. Marriott said nothing at check in so call ahead. Other than construction great room for price.

This place is on the other side of downtown Houston but the service and look of the place were just great! We went to a Astros game and the hotel gave us a free ride to and from the game. The staff was very friendly and nice and the area had some good reaturants near during the day. I would stay here again.

I have to say this is one cool hotel. Great service. Amazing beds. Great decor. Great price. Totally reccomended. A little dissapointed I had an old tv set in the room but everything else was great. Loved to hear it is haunted !!!

Stayed here for 24 hours. Very enjoyable stay. Good location directly opposite the Galleria Mall. Nice room,spotless. Comfy bed,modern decor good flat screen LG TV. Nice breakfast though didn't have room service. Good gym. Staff very friendly. Didn't have any problems at all. Only gripe having to pay for wifi in the room! But to be fair there is free wifi for all in the lobby.
Stayed here for a baseball game. Very easy to get downtown. Neighborhood could be better but no incidents.

I stayed at the JW Marriott in Houston last week on business and was overall very pleased with my stay. There was some slight misalignment of when I was to arrive so I showed my itinerary from my travel agent and was upgraded because my reserved room was not available the first night and they were booked for a conference. The people I dealt with at the front desk were very professional and there was no blame placing done. They definitely just focused on solving the problem and taking care of the customer.
My bed was very comfortable and the room was very clean my entire stay. I did not eat at the restaurant on the second floor, however ate at the lobby bar a few times and was extremely pleased with the service there. The drinks were all well made and food was pretty good. Side dishes were large enough to share. 
This hotel is surrounded by plenty of shopping and restaurants. The Galleria is across the street. I ended up doing a little too much shopping while I was there. The temptation was strong.
Try Truluck's down the street for a great dinner. One of the best ribeye steaks I've ever had. Great seafood and wine list too.

review_title: Comfortable. Warm chocolate chip cookie was a yummy touch!
review_text:
I was here for 1 night/1 day for a meeting held at the hotel. Guest room was clean and comfortable. Getting a warm chocolate chip cookie was a nice touch!
The conference rooms were spacious but a bit cold. When I asked the front desk for help, they said yes. But, after over an hour of freezing in the room, in ran into the banquet staff who said that the message was never relayed! The banquet staff was quick to turn up the thermostat and laid out a yummy lunch with a smile!

review_title: Check for last minute deals on website!
review_text: We love to stay here for a fun weekend getaway, especially when it is a spontaneous decision to shop, eat, and stay over night. Westin Oaks has last minute or Friday specials most of the time, and it makes the treat even sweeter. Check their website before picking a subpar hotel that adds parking fees,etc. Great to park free, stay in a beautifully remodeled hotel, and enjoy walking right off the elevator to shop in the Galleria.
hotel_name: Westin Oaks Houston at the Galleria

review_text: The hotel is very visually appealing. The staff is courteous and efficient. And there's a Starbucks in the lobby! What more could you ask for. I just wish I would've had more time to try out the swimming pool and workout room!!

review_title: Does the trick. What woman doesn't want her hotel attached to a great mall.
review_text: Everything was fab. Got a great deal on Expedia. 75 bucks. Construction in the lobby but it was minor. The lounge bar on the mall level has a great young host who was very entertaining. Room was spacious and very clean. I was very happy all around.
hotel_name: Westin Oaks Houston at the Galleria
hotel_address: {'region': 'TX', 'street-address': '5011 Westheimer Road at Post Oak Blvd.', 'postal-code': '77056', 'locality': 'Houston'}

review_text:
I stayed here on a business trip. While it's convenient to the airport, there's nothing walkable so even though there is a kitchenette, there is nowhere to buy groceries or grab lunch. There is no restaurant or room service so you're stuck with dominoes or chinese food. 
The staff is friendly and the room was clean. I enjoyed Hilton's Embassy Suites more.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton HOU Intercontinental Airport

review_text:
Sadly I do not think this hotel deserves it's JW branding! I used to regularly stay in the Marriott at Woodbridge and although not a JW brand it was far superior in service and attention to detail.
The rooms in the JW are very clean and the beds are incredibly comfortable plus I love having power sockets by the bed so I can lie back and use my laptop however the furnishings are very old, there us no mini bar and all the little touches you expect from a JW are not there.
Location is great for the Mall and eateries and I found the staff to be pleasant.
Normt a bad place but do bit expect a flagship Marriott hotel!

review_title: Very good service - people know you and often refer to you by name
review_text: Veronica is awesome in making group arrangment successful - we have used this location many times and haven't considered another in years... Thanks Veronica and please pass on thanks to your staff - especially Front Desk and meals !!
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton HOU Intercontinental Airport

review_title: Horrible room and service.... beds are hard as a rock, better off sleeping in you car.
review_text: Request a king bed with hotel stay and they reserved a queen room. Hotel staff not knowledgeable of hilton rewards or hilton services. If you don't travel with conditioner, don't expect this hotel to provide this common hotel service. Over priced, didn't gedt my monies worth.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton HOU Intercontinental Airport

review_text:
Stayed for 3 nights, this is an annual trip, so I'll probably be back. This time I started wandering why is it that 3 star hotels seem to have better costumer service and perks, but I'll get back to that. 
We were in room 414, unless yu have children AVOID that floor, our window had a pool view, but that ment that the room's window became a display window... I have to admit that being on that floor did have an advantage, the Westin Oaks elevators are slow, so we could just take the stair to the lobby. 
The rooms are DARK, when you get into the room at night you have to find your way to the nearest lamp (the switch next to the door didn't work).
Out of the three nights we were there, 2 days there was no hot water, so the tech had to come in and fix it, I can understand one night, but two in a row???? Despite that problem, service express was helpful and made surenthe problem was solved fast.
Now back to the 3 star vs 4 star. Why is it that cheaper hotels can offer FREE internet and include breakfast and the more luxurious have a tendency to overcharge costumers for everything?

Nice and clean room. Free breakfast with a lot to choose from. Small but clean pool where our kids played for an hour without complaining.... And I really appreciate the free guest laundry and the possibility to buy snacks and drinks from the shop in the lobby for a decent price. Also good location with easy walking to both the Galleria and different restaurants.

review_title: l'ubicazione e' il punto di forza
review_text: ubicazione eccellente. Anche la dimensione piccola ma curata fa sentire a proprio agio. Molte camere affacciate sull'interno sono un po' rumorose , specialmente nella stagione estiva, per la presenza diffusa dei condizionatori.Anche la colazione non e' esaltante, ma comunque intorno c'e' l'imbarazzo della scelta. Nel complesso consigliabile: e' bello essere a pochi metri dalla 5 strada..da Broadway..da St Patrick...dal Rockefeller Center...dal cuore di Manhattan
Great room, convenient to medical center, good breakfast.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Houston Medical Center

review_text: I booked my hotel on Priceline and got what I thought was a pretty good deal. But when I arrived at the hotel they charged me 23 dollars a day for parking and an extra 30 dollars per night for a double bed instead of a king. Usually a double and king cost the same and I know they were pretty empty during my stay, especially since it was the offseason. I realize booking on Priceline gives you less arguing power but I have had great service from Marriott brand hotels even when booking on Priceline. They still refused to give me the normal price for a double bed which is the main reason I am giving such a low rating. The rooms are pretty nice and clean though.

review_title: Masculine vibe in a great location. Great for business stay or for a game
review_text: Hotel decor is masculine and cozy...leather sofas, navy and green baseball decor. You will feel right at home! Aveda bath products a nice treat. Coffee ready at 630 in the lobby if you're the early riser who wants your spouse to sleep in. Pleasant lobby with lots of seating to read a while. Breakfast of salmon and bagel was super! I was there for fun, but lots of business travelers seemed right at home.

Since staying here just 2 months ago the rooms now have wireless Internet and it works GREAT! This was a great improvement, as my trips here are all for business. Thank you!!
I also want to comment on the incredibly friendly and helpful staff. Chris and John at the front desk were efficient, jovial, accommodating and welcoming. Throughout my stay they remembered my name and greeted me. Johnny, the concierge, also remembered my name, let me know I'd won the 5,000 Priority Club Reward points given away at the Tuesday night happy hour and helped with a local restaurant recommendation for Farrago. It really felt welcoming and like a home away from home to be greeted by name each time I walked through the lobby. Even the hotel staff I didn't meet by name said hello.
Laura from the Sales department let me know some refresh work is coming and that will be welcome. The Tempur-Pedic bed was so comfortable and I slept solidly. Little touches like adding a pad on the ironing board and updating the decor just might give this a perfect score for a perfectly located business hotel.
I'll be back!

My husband and I came to Houston for a wedding for 1 night. We missed the room block rate at the Marriott, and the price went up considerably, so after reading the reviews, I somewhat hesitantly booked at the Lancaster via a discount booking website. I was worried because it was so much less expensive than the surrounding hotels, but it was within 4 blocks of the reception and we're on a budget, so I went with it. 
Wow, am I glad we did! The lobby was stately and clean, and had decanters of ice water and glasses. The reception agents were warm and gave us a key immediately 
even though we were an hour early. 
The hotel was small and boutique-like, but very clean and charming. I don't really understand the people who complained about the dated decor. First of all, it's not that bad. Second, it's not a Ritz Carlton! The decor matched the "homey" feel of the hotel.
Our room was probably slightly smaller than an average single hotel room, but completely adequate. The king size bed was super comfy and the bathroom was very big for a hotel bath. All of the standard amenities were included, plus some others that chain hotels don't usually include, such as Q-tips and cotton balls. There were even 2 pieces of chocolate on the nightstand. 
The free breakfast buffet was a tasty bonus! Eggs, French toast, pancakes, small Danishes, breakfast potatoes, bacon, juice and coffee! 
They even offer a free van that will take you to various locations downtown on a first come, first 
serve basis. 
Oh, and valet at the hotel was $30 a night, but there are multiple lots within a couple blocks that are much cheaper!
Overall, a great experience!

review_title: Its age is showing, but service was good.
review_text:
I checked into The Lancaster for a one night business stay, but meeting with local friends for dinner that evening. The first room seemed fine, but it was directly above street construction, construction the staff assured me would be done by 10. The valet kindly drove me to dinner, which was a pleasant and unexpected surprise. They were quite gracious When I came back from dinner, the construction continued. I had to change rooms (no small feat, but handled with a smile) across the hotel. The second room was smaller, but like the first, a big two-poster bed and slip-covered couch (i did not peek under the slipcover.). Problem was the entire hallway smelled of sewage - apparently that was what the construction was all about. The bed was quite comfortable. Wish I could say the same about the non-existent water pressure in the shower. No realistic work space as it had a very small desk. 
So, I give it two thumbs up for service (with the caveat that they probably shouldn't have been booking the room directly above the construction), but the hotel needs a little TLC and modernization in the rooms - if you need bland slipcovers, time to buy a new couch. Very convenient location too.

I've been staying at this Drury for 5 months so I feel qualified to review it. The service is wonderful. Second to none. Rooms could use an update but suites are spacious. Free breakfast and happy hour plus munchies. Price can't be beat. Walking distance to nearby restaurants.
Close to airport. Check in was slow. Computer down? Difficult to make key. Had reserved a king but got 2 beds instead. Walls could use fresh paint. Did have free beer to watch the rangers

I booked 2 rooms at this hotel. One for my husband and myself and the other for my nanny and baby. I told them when making the reservation I needed adjoining rooms. They assured me there would not be a problem. When we arrived it was nothing but problems. At check in They gave me 2 rooms not even beside eachother. When we got to the room and realized and called down the manager got on the phone and sprung it on me that adjoining rooms would not be possible. Someone that was supposed to check out had not done so. I told him that was going to be a big problem. After a long silence he proceeded to offer me free breakfast buffets and an in room fridge as if this would solve my problem. I would have never booked here had I known this was going to happen. He then moved us to another floor and our rooms were across the hall from one another. And they had no king beds. We got double beds. So my husband and I slept in separate beds on our trip. And my nanny got a handicapped room with no bath tub for the baby. What a mess. When we arrived to the rooms there was an unflushed toilet in the bathroom. Disgusting. Clearly they had not even been cleaned. And the bathroom in my room was so tiny and claustrophobic I could hardly stand it. The hotel was outdated and dirty. I would never stay here or recommend this hotel to anyone. It was the quality of an old dirty motel. The only plus is the location and the flat screen tvs. Had I had the time to deal with it I would have moved hotels.

There were lots of smudges and stains on the walls, doors, drapes, and floors, but the room was clean--just not super, deep clean. I think it speaks to the age of the property. review_title: Beautiful hotel with below par service.
review_text:
Stayed at this hotel last night. The lobby and common areas were absolutely beautiful. 
The front desk person I worked with was terribly condescending and rude, to the point that I would have grabbed my bags and left if the parking garage weren't such a long walk. I bit my tongue and restrained my fist and continued with the check in process. 
I got to my room, and the room was in worse condition than you would expect from a far lesser quality property. The drinking glasses appeared dirty, the toilet seat was dirty and the area immediately above the toilet paper was soiled with fecal matter. 
The bed was comfortable, however, I am not sure if the air conditioner was malfunctioning or was just not capable of completely cooling the room. 
I would not recommend this hotel to anyone else and will definately try other hotels in the area now that I will be traveling to Houston regularly for work now. With 2 nights a week on the schedule for the next 3 months, I need to find a comfortable, clean and friendly place to stay.

If you need to be in downtown Houston then this is where you should stay. The consierge service representatives were very knowledgeable. They helped us pick out, and made our reservations, for all of our dining. 
The rooms were very nice and cleane.
My only recommendation is to hire a driver. The cab service for Houston is awful. We used one from the airport to the hotel. It was so dirty I wouldn't even put my seatbelt on.

review_title: Great staff, great value, but there were problems

review_text: Easy check in. Lots of night time activity outside in parking lot upon arrival, looks somewhat suspect. Room on the 3rd floor very quite surprised me. Beds are average. If you are female traveling through wouldn't recommend but couples or males no problems really. Ask for room on upper floors due to all the wandering strangers outside.

review_title: Wonderful hotel for md Anderson patients
review_text: I stay at this hotel every time I come to Mda for checkups as well as surgery. It is more expensive than other nearby hotels but so convenient to the hospital. The parking is 5$ per day with in and out privileges which is cheaper than the hospital parking garage. Many of the rooms and suites can be connected if you are traveling with other family members. The service is excellent. The hotel is geared for patients. Wheelchairs are plentiful. Every bath has a needle disposal and tub handrails. The room service menu includes clear liquid options. There is a phlebotomy station in the lobby open til 8 so I can get my labs drawn the night before my scans and avoid the hospital lab the next morning. This is a clean, well run marriott. There is a self service laundry, 24 hour gym, free wifi. In addition the staff is very accommodating when you need to suddenly shorten or extend your hotel stay. I suspect they plan for some spare of rooms for this purpose. On several occasions I have had to extend my stay by An extra 2-3 days for extra test even when the hotel was "booked" and there was never an issue. There is a patient relations office where you can get your schedules printed and get directions. The staff is wonderful. On our last visit the front staff had called the fire department to check on a guest/patient who had not answered his wake up call, and was not answering the deadbolted door. In the middle of the night you the staff will wheel you over in a wheelchair to the Mda emergency room. Can't say enough good things about this hotel

Airport shuttle was on time and the driver was a great guy! Great value!

review_text: I stayed here for 6 nights while attending a conference. Everything was so good, I don't know where to start. The meeting facilities and staff were great. The hotel food they served us for our meeting was outstanding. I had a 1 room suite and the room was large and comfortable. The shuttle driver was a gem. We were going to go out for Mexican food and recommended an alternate place were the food was excellent and very reasonably priced. Taxies are always available on site. Don' t miss this hotel!

I went to take a look at the pool and to my surprise it was closed the surprise being that I asked questions about the pool the prior day when making my reservation, the staff assured us it would reopen the following day and it did. It's not a made to order it's like a classic continental with a huge line of people waiting for one lady to make you an omelet pancakes or eggs who does not make more than one thing at a time it took 18 minutes to get the worst omelet I have ever had. Before going to bed you can hang your breakfast selection and delivery time on the door. Room service was perfect and the coffee was better than expected too.

I was in town for a wedding with my husband and we stayed 2 nights at this hotel because it was so close to the airport and we love starwood hotels. This hotel definitely lived up to the starwoood reputation and our expectations. 
The hotel was very pretty and the beds were super comfortable. We ate breakfast and had dinner/drinks in the hotel restaurant one night. The restaurant was so good and reasonably priced that we didn't feel like we were in a hotel restaurant at all and we didn't want to leave the hotel. The hotel even had a jacuzzi, which is becoming harder to find in hotels these days.
I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone traveling through houston, especially if you are flying into Hobby airport. They have a fast, free airport shuttle and the staff is great

review_title: Relax entirely at the hotel or take the shuttle for a short ride to the action.
review_text: This was a weekend treat for my husband and I! We dropped the kid off at the grandparents and headed to the Omni, just four miles from our house. The rooms are spacious with a lounge chair, large desk and credenza. The credenza has plenty of drawers, a mini bar with lovely snacks as well, an in-room safe and a coffee service. The bathroom has plush towels and luxurious shower amenities. If you are a select guest loyalty member (free), up to two guests get a free morning drink. It is high marks for me to wake up, slip on the complementary robe and open the door to freshly brewed coffee!!!!! Members also get free wifi. The bar and restaurants I did not visit this time, but they looked comfortable and open to after work drinks to a nightcap. I did read the menu and there were several appetizing dishes I would have tried. The pool is a nice size and there is a hot tub. They have a shuttle to CityCentre where there are an array of restaurants, shops, a cute Saturday farmers market, and dancing under the stars on the central square. We were able to snag a weekend deal for $75/night - we will be back very soon at those prices!!!!

This hotel came highly recommended by Enterprise Jet. Unfortunately, it is falling apart. That is surprising considering it is supposed to be two months old. 
The toilet paper dispenser was falling off the wall and you could see where the used a gloss paint to cover the old dispenser location (the rest of the wall is flat paint). 
The lower shower faucet was not properly secured and felt like it could come out of the wall when I turned the shower on. 
There was a 6 inch area of missing sheet rock near the door.
The shades don't close.
There are no outlets in the main room. I had to run my laptop plug to a bed from the bathroom.
The bed was so close to the bathroom I had to walk sideways to get by. If you are wondering, I am average height and weight. 
I spend 18 nights a month in hotel rooms. I have never seen a new property in this state of disrepair.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Houston Hobby Airport

review_text: Tuve que quedarme en este hotel perdi el vuelo hacia San Antonio. Este hotel esta cerca del aeropuerto , tiene transportacion incluida, tiene sportbar con barra, comida buena y economica, habitaciones limpias y comodas, el desayuno buffet excelente$13 por persona pero vale la pena, piscina interior y gym.
