Just watch the rates per night as they fluctuate frequently.

review_title: Nice location but the NYC traffic (=honking ) would make me skip next time
review_text: Overall the hotel is fine except for the traffic noises which were too much until 3am in the morning... I think it has something to do with the lane closure outside so check carefully unless you can sleep with some ear plugs.

Fantastic - great service - all the staff were really helpful - this really is a hidden gem - a great alternative to staying in the usual mid town NYC experience - instead of visiting les/nolita& soho - stay there and soak up the memories -Amazing roof terrace for views and bring up breakfast or bring your of champagne appreo and watch the big apple at night- loved it - c u soon x

review_title: Very nice and clean, but outside traffic drives you crazy
review_text: The place is nice, the rooms are clean and well kept and breakfast is decent - actually pretty decent. Staff are very kind and the lobby is quite nice. There are two things We didn't like: the room we stayed in was particularly small, and the noise in the street (Houston Av) was too loud at night - we had a pretty bad night on our first night. Maybe it would be best to stay in a room looking towards the back.

review_title: Modern stylish hotel in good location
review_text:
This hotel is very modern and stylish. Great shower but small rooms. Great view of the empire state building from our room! The rooftop terrace was also fab, but breakfast was basic continental, the bagels were good though.
It's easy to get a cab from the hotel and it's right opposite a subway station. If you use the greyline tourist bus it stops right around the corner from the hotel. 
In the immediate vicinity there is a nice Irish pub over the road which does amazing buckets of chicken wings - cheap too! There is a nice pizza place around the corner as well. The hotel is right near katz' deli but I wouldn't recommend it, it was a real disappointment with poor service and bland food. Does not live up to its reputation.
The hotel is also a couple of doors away from an independent cinema which is really cool and shows some great independent films.

review_title: Great location! Great city boutique hotel Service ! Just right!
review_text:
A very nice experience, safe, central, and great staff!
:D

Decent location with short walk to subway and several options for food nearby. Hotel as a whole is underwhelming. Rooms small and bland - although I had ok view from high floor. Lobby bar small but busy and quite relaxing at the same tome. Didn't try the restaurant. Ok choice if you want functional but don't plan on spending much time in the hotel itself.

We got a double deluxe room which is large, modern , clean and equipped with fridge( you need it in the heat of August), flat screen TVand air conditioning. The first room we got was very large and nice but on Broadway and that was just too noisy at night for us. The hotel staff moved us the next day to the back of the hotel which has great views on lovely roof tops and the Hudson river. The staff is helpful and polite, the Manhattan dinner across the road delivers good value tasty food night and day. The location of the hotel is great: only two blocks from the natural history museum and Central park. I think this hotel offers great value for money. Will go there again.

review_title: Unbelivable value at a great location!
review_text: This hotel is located right next to Rockefeller plaza and is within walking distance of many major attractions. The staff are great and the room was very nice. It's an older building and you can see that in some of the fixtures and other amenities but the place is very clean and well kept. If you're one to stay in your room a lot this probably isn't the right place for you but if you just need a home base for your trip to New York then you can't get much better and the rates are great for the location.

So the first thing I must do is commend this hotel for offering a rate of just over $200 two weekends before Christmas! While the other hotels jacked up prices to even *start* in the 300s, I appreciated this cost. You might think that it was because this was a much inferior hotel, but all considered it was simply a basic, but clean, no-frills place to spend a night. 
Some minuses include no control over thermostat (but it was comfortable enough given outside was pretty chilly!), older bathroom fixtures, a manual elevator/lift ( but someone was there at 11:00 to bring me up, so it was not an issue.)
And as far as courtesy hoes, I interacted with probably 3 or 4 front desk staff, and I think they were perfectly fine... and a few quite friendly. 
My overall impression was that they are probably trying hard to build up their reputation. The lobby was quite nice and welcoming. I got there at noon and the room wasn't ready yet, but they happily offered to tag and store my bags with no problem at all. 
There wasn't an opportunity to give 1/2 stars, otherwise for the price I may have given it an overall 3.5. Bit again, don't expect luxury! Just a place to lay your head after a busy New York day of sightseeing, shows or whatever it is that brings you to The Big Apple! :-)
I hope this helps!

Four of us in NYC for the Holidays. Only place we could find with a 3 bed suite. Price is not bad, for NYC, the rooms are tiny though. Complementary breakfast is decent and the coffee is good. Would stay here again.

review_title: Overall a great hotel. Staff could not handle unruly pot-smoking guests.
review_text: Overall the day staff was great and friendly, but the night staff did not handle unruly pot-smoking/drunk college students. The aforementioned would head to the roof, slamming the door to the staircase constantly with open containers The hallways reek of pot, and the disturbance forced us to leave the room at 12:30 am. When we returned at 2:30 am, the same activity was occurring; door slamming and stoned/drunk 20-something's stumbling through the halls.
hotel_name: The GEM Hotel-SoHo, an Ascend Collection hotel

review_title: Smelly too cold or too hot ventilation
review_text: Staff very friendly. Vent in room either blew freezing cold air or was off no in between and smelt like old pee. Also, our charge card was billed a mystery 2$ charge. Maybe cause we used the tiny shampoo bottle. Granted its not a lot of money but what the heck?
hotel_name: The GEM Hotel-SoHo, an Ascend Collection hotel

review_title: Great Hotel in brilliant neighbourhood location
review_text: I've stayed at this hotel twice now and would return again. It's downtown location on the Lower East Side couldn't be better. It is a 2 min walk to the great bars and restaurants on Ludlow st. The other way it is a short walk to Soho. The hotel is no frills in the respect it doesn't have a bar but you really don't need one. Rooms are great - again we're not talking high spec design but super comfy beds and good showers. There is a huge Wholefoods opp the hotel where you can get breakfast if you want something simpler than the big breakfast places. If you want to stay in a part of town where you feel like you are living in an actual neighbourhood rather than a tourist area then this is for you. If you want to be close to all the iconic NY sights such as the Empire State then you should stay in midtown. The front desk staff are really helpful and friendly - they make it a great stay. This hotel really is a gem.
hotel_name: The GEM Hotel-SoHo, an Ascend Collection hotel

review_text: great location with average looking rooms. good value for money. only criticism was the saggy bed. noise was not an issue although they provided ear plugs. would stay there again.

review_title: Place promised a lot delivered very little
review_text: They put us in a basement room. When we complained they said " next time tell the you don't want the basement" really???
hotel_name: The GEM Hotel-SoHo, an Ascend Collection hotel

review_title: When all you need is a room to sleep in
review_text: This hotel is exactly as advertised... Nothing more and nothing less. I think that is all one can ask for. Check in was a breeze. M wife and I went straight to our roo which was literally a room with a bed that was slightly smaller than the room, a closet and a sink to was up. We were right next to the bathroom and never had a conflict with other guests over use of the bathroom. There are several bathrooms on each floor. It was noisy at night but it is NYC! Finally, we parked across the street where Americana Inn validated our ticket and we only had to pay $30 per day which included tax. This place was perfect for us as we only wanted a place to stay since we were exploring the city all day. The room was very nice and relaxing to return to for the evening. Location is great as well. Just a 2 minute walk to macys o 34 th and 7 moinutes to times square and broadway. For the price, a stay here is definitely worth it if you are just exploring the city.
Spent 1 day here, rooms are dirty, staff is rude, and beds have bed bugs. Don't stay here, you will regret it.
Shared bathroom was clean, room was small and basic, but had a TV and vanity. Cheap enough for a New York hotel if you just need somewhere to sleep. Top location only a short walk to Times Square.

Felt safe, rooms cleaned daily, air conditioning, two blocks to Subway, clean sheets. Rooms are very small and it can be noisy at night but we were very happy with our stay. We wanted to stay in NY as cheaply as possible and this turned out to be a great hotel for us.

We stayed for a week in may/ June for our first ever trip to NYC. From the word go the staff, particularly Anthony and Kieth, made us welcome and were always on hand to offer advice and answer our questions. Rooms were small but very clean and very comfy beds. Would definately return
hotel_name: The GEM Hotel-SoHo, an Ascend Collection hotel

review_title: Only in NY could they charge this much.
review_text:
This was our first time in NY and would not have paid more than $50 for this room in any other metro area.
The room was very small with no frills and a shared bathroom with no ventilation. The bedding was horribly old, to the point of falling apart at the touch. The blanket felt like Styrofoam and the comforter had what looked like a knife cut in it. 
The only entertainment was a 12" tv mounted to the wall. We tried to stay out.as long as possible.
Location is the only saving grace.

You get what you pay for. We stayed here in January and it was perfectly adequate. Staff were friendly and helpful. Location was perfect, and I'm sure still is ;). Rooms were tight but well priced and clean. I'd recommend staying here if your on a budget and have reasonable expectations.

review_title: This is a nice hotel with a great price.
review_text: I recommend this hotel, it is located in west midtown. It's very near of central park and a nice 20 to 30 minutes walk to downtown (otherwise you can take a taxi which will cost about 8 to 10 dollars). The Hotel is clean and fresh towels/bed are made up everyday. I took a mini-suite at the back of the hotel, it is quite and relaxing, but small, we were 4 staying on the same room. They don't offer parking, but there are a lot of offers near the hotel for about $40 to $50 a day. This is a great value hotel.

review_title: Great hotel in a nice peaceful location
review_text: Would recommend-not in midtown New York eg times square/shops etc but this doesn't matter as it's right opposite central park and a lovely 20-30 min walk downtown (otherwise a taxi about 8-10 dollars). We had great weather so walking fine otherwise think about the costs. Hotel itself clean and fresh towels/bed made up everyday. Shared bathroom was clean and no probs as it was always vacant although we did shower 730am everyday-any later it may be busier.
This hotel is small but it is really all you need. We visited NYC for 2 nights and if you are spending a lot of time in your room, you are not enjoying New York!

Rooms & bathroom are way too small, noisy inside & out, power points don't work, heater makes loud noises during the night, shower looks dirty & takes ages to warm up etc etc etc....not worth what you pay for it!

The rooms of the hotel are the smallest which I have seen. There is no everyday cleaning. They clean our room just 4 times during 7 days. Managers are rude and they know just one phrase "I just came here and know nothing and can say nothing to you". I wrote few times to the management of Holiday Inn by their official site, but they are even less competent and hepfull then managers from reception. Don't choose this hotel!
My husband and I stayed here while in NYC the end of September 2011. We absolutely loved it. Small but charming. Great service. Awesome location.

review_title: Solid choice and convenient, safe location.
review_text: I was pleased with my decision to stay at park 79 hotel. The rooms are small but not extremely cramped. The bathroom looked brand new and everything wa very clean. The service was friendly and prompt every day, every shift. Best of all, the location allowed easy access to a vatiety of sights and experiences. We felt very safe in the area. My only complaint was that other guests were loud when returning at night, and the wooden floors inthe halls caised the noise to echo- it was annoying.
The hotel is old and in desperate need of updating. Poor ventilation in the rooms. The bathroom was the smallest I have ever been on. I definitely do not recommend this hotel.

Stayed here over Thanksgiving. Good location near Herald Square. We thought we would pick a more adventurous local hotel rather than a chain, and this came up on a travel website. Once I saw the room I wished I had rethought that decision! Spacious enough but VERY worn and dingy, to the point of icky. Very basic.

review_title: NEVER stay here! It will will ruin you NYC experience!
review_text: Rude and unfriendly staff, my room was only cleaned once in a whole week. Microscopic rooms, no mini bars, old smelly AC. It is really overpriced comparing to other offers.

The rooms are small & bathroom oh do tiny but the shower wad clean & comfy. Clean environment friendly staff. Conviniently located. Convenience store across the street. Very few restaurants very close bit some good ones within walk distance. Find your own car parking close by. Quiet neighborhood.

I booked this hotel on points and I have to say I was a little dissapointed. The location is ok. It is fairly centrally located. The rooms were not that good though. I realize this is Manhattan and space is a premium but these rooms were excessively small. I mean, to open the bathroom door you had to squeeze around it. For the price, if I paid, it was extremely small and not that nicely anointed. 
Other qualms where that the sound didnt work on the tv. The elevators were painfully slow and always packed because of this. Lastly, the internet was also brutally slow. 
Would I go back? Maybe I'd it was the only one I could book on points in the area but other then that I would try elsewhere.

review_title: Good location, good food, basic rooms
review_text: The hotel was centrally located, just 2 blocks from subway which we found very handy for getting round the city. The room was pretty small especially the bathroom but we were expecting this as I had read that this was standard for hotels in city centre. We really just wanted somewhere to wash and sleep as we were out and about from morning to evening and the holiday served this purpose for us. It is expensive for what it is but it seems the hotels in NYC can get away with this. The air conditioning was noisy and the settings were not great, it was either very cold or else turned off! There are only 2 lifts serving 25 floors so the wait times were long at times and it took a long time getting up and down with all the stops. The dinner in the restaurant was lovely, the waiting staff were very friendly and everything was cooked exactly as we had orders it. I would recommend this hotel if u are just looking for a basic place as a base for your sightseeing. Don't expect luxury!

This hotel was more than what I expected. Great location , good service, clean rooms and the price was not too bad. The only thing is that the rooms are small but that is expected of any hotel in NYC...Would stay here again...Texas

Was very happy with my break in NY. Very centrally located. Complimentary breakfast included
Good value hotel.
will be staying again

review_title: Gorgeous, clean, reasonably priced hotel near a ton of things to do and see in the City
review_text: I try to stay at this hotel when I am in NY but unfortunately rooms are booked. The hotel has old gorgeous architecture. It is convenient walking distance to just about everything in the city. Shopping, Empire State Bld., St Pats church, Grand Central Station, Madison Sq. Garden, Times Square, Rockefeller Center, and much more!

review_title: A fantastic budget hotel in a great location
review_text:
I booked this hotel for a 7 night stay and was attracted by the good reviews combined with its reasonable prices.
For the price, this is a great hotel and is conveniently located being less than a block from Times Square. My room was a good size and was both clean and well maintained. Although the room overlooked the central courtyard, this was not a problem and in fact meant I was not plagued by street noise. 
There was plenty of power points for charging laptops, phones etc and indeed free wifi.
The staff were really friendly and very helpful.
The only minor negative is the lack of tea/coffee making facilities in the room but at the price they charge, isn't a problem. 
I recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a clean, good value hotel in the heart of the city. One final tip, do check out the Cranberry Deli Cafe next door, the food is excellent and competitively priced.
Five nights,. 2 days after getting home bites started

review_title: Great long weekend vacation stay - would recommend!
review_text:
Pros: great location, excellent value for NYC, friendly staff, overall nice property, well maintained, clean, and quiet - we didn't hear any neighbors.
Cons: not anything significant. Bed is fairly hard...could be upgraded, and need at least one accessible outlet that isn't in the bathroom.
Overall great room, we would go back for sure.

review_title: Really perfect for everything in usa.
review_text:
I stayed at this hotel after getting a deal for 180 usd per night. We stayed for 5 nights on the 16th floor. 
The room was a little small but perfectly fine and clean. Great comfortable beds of good size and good bathroom.
Yes you have to wait a fee mins for the lift in busy times but it's fine.
Great location with a 20 min walk to times square. On Sunday's there is a lovely street Market down the road. 
Staff were good and helpful.
Overall perfect for us. Will come again!!

review_title: Fabulous! Great price for the city.
review_text: The beautiful architectual features made this hotel feel luxurious and nostalgic. The room was spacious enough to accommodate a family of four. The best featute-the blackout curtains made for a peaceful nights sleep. I brag all the time about finding this fabulous hotel for the price we paid.

Very well kept and clean room, excellent bathroom and good hot water pressure. Had a room fairly high up with a good view of the New Yorker building. Relatively quiet with little street or hotel noise. Air con unit kept the room cool and personal safe was good to keep valuables safe during the day. Friendly staff. A few blocks from subway and 15min walk to Times Square area.
hotel_name: Doubletree By Hilton - Times Square South

review_text:
We found the hotel to be first class.
At first impression the hotel location seemed a little 'unsavoury'. However this is not the case and it is within easy walking distance of Times Square, Pennsylvania train/subway and the main Port authority bus depot. It is worth mentioning that we found New York to be a very safe place, I have never seen as many police in a city as I witnessed in New York. 
All the hotel staff were extremely helpful and facilities were good. Free wifi in the room was an essential for us. The rooms were cleaned and towels changed daily. The breakfast choice was a lot more extensive than we were led to believe. 
To summarise, I would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel and would definately stay here again
hotel_name: Doubletree By Hilton - Times Square South

review_text:
200 dollars for 4 nights, between 2, on 5th avenue,10 mins from time square!!!!!
If you want cheap and cheerful, no frills but in a fantastic location...ideal......if you intend to spend anytime actually in the hotel other then sleeping or washing, go elsewhere!!!

I think most comments here are way to negative. The beds are pretty small for a two persons room, but it's okay since we booked a normal room - the cheapest option, for only $90 a night per 2 people -. The location is even more than perfect: just walk one street and you're on Times Square! You can walk almost anywhere: central park, times square - obviously -, Rockefeller center, empire state building..
I loved my stay here. I have had Internet all the time, & the people were really nice.
Also I see it as a positive thing that you have to leave the key at the lobby - you won't lose it!

Hotel was very nice! Looked great and hotel was very clean. I found it odd that in the mornings hotel staff didn't always give guests priority on the elevators(seemed like they thought they deserved the elevator more). I have worked and stayed in many hotels and guests should ALWAYS come first no matter what. 
Overall I would gladly stay in this hotel again.
hotel_name: Doubletree By Hilton - Times Square South

review_title: Nice hotel with two small niggles.
review_text: Just back from 4 nights in wolcott, very good location, room was small but nice. Shower hard to keep at good temperature, and some banging from central heating, other than that very good overall

review_title: Great value! Impressed for three stars and great staff.
review_text: Great experience didn't exPect do much from three star. Great location room not so small.
hotel_name: Doubletree By Hilton - Times Square South

review_text: The hotel room was small but very clean as was the rest of the hotel. The staff could do with some training in customer relations, not friendly at all. The free coffee and muffins were plenty and a nice touch. Great location - 5 mins from Macy's and empire state building

review_title: The only good thing is the location
review_text: The hotel its being renewed, the service is rude and the breakfast it terrible.

review_title: Good quality for a cheap price.
review_text: Less than 1min to Times Square.the reception is helpfull and sympathic.the housekeeping always clean the room and change towels.i will suggest this hotel to all my friends

review_title: This hotel will make you cry
review_text: Booked 3 nights and stayed for 30 minutes. The hallways smelled like homeless people and the room smelled like an ashtray. The guy at the front desk was obviously high, everything about this place sucked. Don't even consider staying here.
Stayed for just two nights. People helpful and friendly. Room clean. Would have liked a better tv and a fridge in the room, but the value was good and the location excellent! Would come again.

I stayed here for a weekend in September 2010. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the muffin breakfast was a nice start the day. The room was basic, but clean and the bed was comfy. Location was great for seeing the sights; didn't user the tube once! It's not the sort of place you'd go for a luxury break, but a great base for a weekend.

review_title: By NYC standards a good hotel
review_text:
Everyone knows hotels in NYC fall into two categories:
Very Expensive
Very poor quality
Many fall into both categories, the Skyline however is different it is by NYC standards a decent hotel at a reasonable price. 
It is dated, the bathroom was not as clean as I would wish (long hairs on face cloth and floor) and the safe didnt work but the room was huge and so was the bathroom. 
The only disappointment was a man on reception who was generally surly and an ongoing problem with the electronic room key. 
If this were any other city I would not return but in New York it's a good hotel to use.

We chose to stay at the Skyline for our anniversary trip to NYC.. Overall, we had a wonderful experience! We had a couple minor issues but after speaking with management, we were completely taken care of. We were moved to a newly renovated room which surpassed our expectations! Michelle, the manager went above and beyond to ensure that we left having a positive experience! The beds are super comfy too! If you're in the city to see the sights, this is a great choice!

My sister, dad & I recently stayed at the skyline for 7 nights in October.
Now, I spent WEEKS researching accommodation for NYC - it was giving me a headache and really stressing me out as each day closer to leaving the prices just kept going up & I read so many mixed reviews on so many different hotels.
We originally wanted to stay in an apartment but I was too nervous of scams so decided on a hotel. We wanted to keep it at a certain price around $2000 but everything I found just looked crappy and reviews were bad etc.. 
The out of the blue I stumbled across the skyline.. It hadn't come up before in ANY of my searches on any of the discount websites I'd been using, or on any of the reviews I'd read so I was a little skeptical when the price fit, the reviews looked good & the pictures looked good. So I street viewed, I rang them & then thought what the heck and booked it as I was completely over it by then. 7 nights was $2100 which is a bargain! We booked it through expedia or something,thus the discount & I recommend checking all those sites before ever booking anything. Paying up front doesn't bother me because if you change your mind before you depart you can get a refund.
Anyway the hotel was great. 
Everyone has this thing where they think you have to stay near times square.. Well if you're the type of person that is just going to NYC to say youve been and is only interested in M&M world and getting a photo in times square well then spend a fortune and stay in times square BUT if you're going to NYC to see NYC & take it all in- cabs, subways, walking the streets then stay here.
The staff were friendly & helpful. The rooms were spacious & nice & clean.. Flat screen tv, lots of channels etc. Hotel restaurant was nice & do buffet breakfast (little slow so eat somewhere else if in a hurry though). A deli across the road for snacks & also meals (really nice).. A liquor shop across the road. You can request a mini fridge be brought up to your room at no extra cost if you wanna stock up too. 
You can walk to times square in ten mins if you're a fast walker. If you stroll it takes 15-20.. Only a little timely cause of waiting to cross the streets at pedestrian lights.
The nearest subway is 2 blocks away, so about a 5 min walk so that subway can get you anywhere u need to go.
You can get a free map off reception that has all the subway lines on it too.
If you don't want to spend a fortune but want somewhere nice to stay in NYC then I'd stay here.
If you're pulling your hair out like I was & are stressing about location DON'T!! anywhere you stay in NYC is fine... Subways completely connect you!! And cabs are so cheap that you can get around so easily! On that, if there are more than 2 of you, work out whether the subway or a cab is a cheaper option situation by situation.. Cause 3 of you could pay $2.50 each for one trip totaling $7.50 or $5.00 on a cab ride... I'm all about saving money so that's a money-savers opinion! The subways are really quick too - you're downtown before you know it.
For me, finding the skyline was such a nice surprise after weeks of searching and I wasn't disapointed. If you're someone that wants glam though you need to up your budget.
Enjoy :)

Kleine kamers maar wel schoon; ontbijt niet mijn smaak maar het is er wel. Airco maakt veel lawaai. Douche ook klein maar wel elke dag schone handdoeken. Koffie en thee elke dag aangevuld. Locatie is prima!

Great value. Clean and tidy rooms.. Pool was a bonus also.
 Staff were polite. Helpful and not too in your face.
Handy location. Just 3 blocks from Times square. 10mins walk.
But Taxis pass every few seconds. About 6 dollars gets you to times square etc.
Would go back.

Overall this hotel was good. The location was fab and when going to new York city I think that's what is most important. Hotel was comfortable and clean and staff friendly - but in truth if your spending alot of time in your hotel in new York - ur missing out. It was a place to sleep for us only. Deli across the road was fab, should defo try there paninis x

review_title: Don't waste your money to stay in a dirty hotel, you might as well sleep ion the streets!!!!
review_text: Check in was over 30 minute wait with know one else checking in. The girl that checked my family in was rude and immature. She kept going to different areas of the lobby to talk to other hotel workers as we stood there in disbelief. The rooms were a great size. The sheets were dirty as was the bathroom. When I called for clean towels the Sunday December 18 manager told me to tuff it out. We paid over $375 for this room we should of stayed in Jersey!!!

one of the worst hotels I've ever been in. so loud and noisy and filthy. you can hear your neighbors shutting doors and talking AND also doing all their bathroom business through the air vent in the bathroom. 
housekeeping is atrocious. I asked to move rooms after finding fecal matter and cigarette butts all over my original room. my new room has a tub backflows dirty disgusting water from other people's bathrooms every morning. this backflow leaves a black filmy residue with hair in it all over the tub. 
the noise outside the hotel room is constant and lasts all night long with industrial noise. 
the free breakfast is a joke. stale pastries and staff that practically accost you for a tip.
the front desk staff are rude and act like they are inconvienced with any question. 
the hotel rooms are large and the location is central to many attractions but it is NOT worth the outrageous price they charge for this 2 star dump.

The hotel lacks elegance and style. The design and furnishings in hotel room are minimal and contemporary. The service is decent. The carpets in hallways are deplorable. Despite all of these negative aspects, the hotel is centrally located and the views from windows are hard to beat.

review_title: Please read, before you book this hotel!
review_text:
This hotel is filthy! From the carpets, to the kitchen, to the bathroom, whoever owns this property has totally neglected it. I stayed in one of their top suites and it was massive but it was so unkept we were shocked. I am without a doubt notifying the Board of Health to inspect this place! It is that bad. Our original room was so bad we were on our way to check out when they upgraded us. I honestly want to know who is recommending this place because they should not be allowed to write reviews any more. 
I travel at least twice a week and sample hotels all across this country, from the best to some very average places. The Flatotel is the most unkept hotel I have ever stayed at. Add on the fact that it features worn, dirty outdated furniture and fixtures and you have the makings of a disaster. 
The only bright spot is the staff who were helpful, kind, and attentive, but that can not overcome the disaster and the absolute filth of this hotel.
YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!

My fiancÃ© and myself stayed here on our first trip to New York. It is close to almost everything, and if not it's only a subway or taxi journey away. The room we had was spacious for our needs with a great skyline view. The housekeeping came every day while we were out. My only gripe would be that the Internet I paid for only lasted 2 days instead of 5 and the number I was given for customer services didn't seem to work. Other than that a smashing place. Hope to stay again soon.

review_title: Does the job.... But a very dull hotel....
review_text: I went to new york for my birthday with a few friends. Stayed there for 5nights... The first night we got there we was late because we had to travel all the way from newark airport which took ages... Lady at the desk said our room had been taken so she would upgrade us free of charge to the a bigger room for the night which i thought was good of them... The coincerage lady downstairs near the reception was very helpful her name was christy I think nice person and good looking ;).... The room we had the 2nd night was really bad... The plugs weren't safe looked like they were falling apart and very dangerous the window when opened was very wide so if have kids beware..... Was looking for my phone that night and lifted the mattress to see where it had gone.. Not only did I find my phone but also a used condom which was disgusting..... When using the shower the cold water would always come out first which made it difficult to twist the handle to make it medium hot because u can't dodge the water without the cold water hitting..... The security of the hotel is a joke I was walking in and out around 4am and didn't see any1 there to greet me... I could have been a tramp off the streets and I could have went up to any floor and they wouldn't have known... Rooms were very hot as well making us very restless some nights.... The only good about the hotel was the fact that a 24hour shop was open with the same name but better service... I think the hotel is decent but I did expect more especially,,,,,,,..

The hotel is situated very well, 5th ave, central park, and times square all within a few minutes walk.
Room was very large, only thing lacking was a coffee maker! Clean, tidy and good views of the city.
Elevators very slow considering the number of floors it was covering.
Would happily stay here again in the future
Great rooms for a family -placed central to Times Square but they all have to learn some service

review_title: Not the highlight of our honeymoon!
review_text: We went to New York for our honeymoon & I can safely say that the Skyline hotel was certainly not the highlight. Staff were rude, hotel looked old & tired and the location was not inviting. The maid also did not understand that we did not need our room cleaning from the Do Not Disturb sign & just went ahead anyway & left it on the floor. The only positive thing I can say is that the hotel was clean but that's it. Do not stay here!

I had a very nice stay at this hotel. The lobby is beautiful and Rooms are fabulous. Indoor pool was great. Thanks to the hotel manager Tara. She was extremely friendly and helpful. Thank you for making our stay memorable. we will definitely stay there again.

Hotel is old and worn (lights hanging off the wall old!) but clean. What is really bad is the service. The staff don't engage you at all even when struggling with luggage, they just watch you fall. I have not been to a hotel before where ALL of the staff are bad, but I have now.
The only reason to stay there is the location, which is brilliant.
Anyone who rates this hotel more than a 2 star has never stayed in a decent hotel.

review_title: Old and dirty hotel feels like a cheap motel
review_text: Clean but not much service, took forever to have a clean room in the morning, location is great but I would not stay in the Astor again, 120$ per night is way overpriced, the only thing I could say is that it was nothing more than 'ok'

review_title: UyIn the heart of it all..clean and just right
review_text: This hotel was perfect. Simple, quiet,clean and pretty....price averaged 96.00 a night...just perfect location, rooms cleaned everyday, nice staff, safe, room was decent size for NYC, honestly found the place we will always stay..really should b rated higher, only negative thing was the elevator needs a face lift.other then that just a nice perfect cute hotel in the heart of it all

Stayed at this hotel for our summer vacation. Location is good (Just in front of Central Park and 3 blocks from subway station) but rooms are tiny and the second night we found a huge roach in the room.
If you're traveling on a budget I guess it's ok, but otherwise stay some place else!
Very well located and the rooms were very nice. The only problem os that for New Year's you can't get close to Times Square because all the roads are barricaded. Apart from that all great.

review_title: Love this place! Book it now!
review_text:
This was my third trip to the Mayfair, but my first since the remodel. We booked a queen bed and it was glorious! Stayed in 3 other hotels on this trip, and this bed was the best AND the least expensive.
Fab location great service will B back!

I stayed here w my family for a weekend. I did reservations for 2 non-smoking rooms and when we arrived they had no non smoking rooms available. It was very late and we were exhausted so we had no choice but to take smoking rooms. The smell inside the rooms wasnt that bad, however the smell in the hallways and the noise were ridiculous. Both nights I had to call the front desk to complaint about other guest making very loud noises. They did take care of the guests right away. Probably my review reflects my overall experience which wasn't very good, but not necessarily the hotel itself. I'm sure if we would've gotten the right rooms my overall experience could've been better. Great location by the way!

review_title: Fantastic location, service should be better, rooms too dark!
review_text:
Can't fault the location of this hotel! Walking distance to 49th & 57th St subway stations, 7th/5th Avenue, Central Park, Times Square and amazing Carneige deli (big recommendation!!). 
However if you have a room on the front expect it to be noisy at times with deliveries (but i'm sure that is the same with all NYC hotels). Paid extra for a superior room. Rooms are large and more importantly cleaned with modern interior. First placed on 8th floor, but asked to move higher as the noise from the lift motor room was terrible! Moved to 16th a few nights into stay. Rooms can be very dark with minimal lighting however fits in with the contemporary feel of the hotel. We had to ask for an additional mirror as they are only available in the bathroom.
Beware the lift service in this hotel is dreadful!! Only two lifts servicing 46 floors, and they are very slow. Be prepared to queue and wait! 
Reception staff on check in were fairly helpful, (but did mis-place our Yankee's tickets for the day) however when we moved we were told three times that our luggage would be moved during the day to the new room, however when we returned late on the evening it was still not done, and staff were extremely rude. Suppose it's who get really!! Communication between porters, housekeeping, maintenance could do with being better.
Generally an okay hotel. However compared to hotels stayed in by our friends at the same time in new York I wouldn't go back for the price we paid. However is clean, modern and fantastic location. Just needs a few extras to justify the price!!
The only thing we didn't like was the shower. There wasn't enough water. To wash a long hair like mine, took a long time.

I stayed at this hotel with my family. Great location. Rooms are spacious and clean. Hotel manager Tara was very friendly and helpful. Thank you Tara!
We really enjoyed our stay.

review_title: Tired and needs updated but overall no complaints!
review_text: We have just come back from an amazing few days in NY. I had booked the Holiday Inn Midtown through an unnamed hotel bidding site so when I read the reviews on here about the HI I was very apprehensive. I have a huge phobia of rodents so some of these reviews came as a shock and made me panic. We also had our 2 year old daughter with us and I didn't want her sleeping on a bug infested bed. When we got to the hotel I asked for a room quite high up and the only room they could give us was 1532 which is the room I was most paranoid about after the review on here. I immediately asked if I could swap to another room and it didn't matter which floor so we were given room 530. I immediately inspected the entire room and mattresses and found absolutely no sign of bed bugs, rodents etc. The room was very tired and in need of an update but it was also very clean. Our three nights there were good, room and towels changed daily and when a plug started smoking when I used the hair dryer, maintenance was sent up immediately with a new dryer and they were prepared to change plug socket too if it continued to smoke. Staff were all very helpful, no complaints. We ordered soup for our toddler one night and it was very nice. All I can say is that hotel does need a refurb but there is a notice on wall saying they are doing this in next 6 months, there was no date on this so it could have been there a while. If you can get a cheap rate then this hotel is good but I wouldn't pay a lot for it due to the quality of decor. Fantastic location though!

review_title: Simple hotel with everything you need.
review_text: Had a great stay at the best western for four nights! Complimentary breakfast was gorgeous loads to go around and eat as much as you want! Staffing was brilliant and a great help especially manager Annie and Mike. Rooms are very simple but very clean with a television and heating. Maids come in everyday. Overall great stay would recommend to anybody even the area of hotel not far from times square on the hop on hop off tour bus.

I don't understand where are all negative rewiews from. This hotel is absolutely perfect, 10 minutes from Times Square for this value, what else can man wish for? The staff is very kind and always ready for help, room was small, but very clean, with new bed sheets and towels everyday. Breakfast was also good,
there was everything for good start of the day. Only problem was that wifi didn't work on our iPhones, but on laptop worked well. If I come bavk to NY, I'll definitely stay here again. Can only reccomend this hotel

review_title: Small rooms, good value, close to Times Square, Penn Station
review_text:
Most of the other reviews summarize this hotel quite accurately. I just want to confirm that it is a good place to stay. Clean, affordable, small rooms.
Lots of taxis on 10th Avenue. 10 minutes to MSG to see a hockey game. 10 minutes to Times Square in the other direction.
No problems walking there after dark.
Rooms were small, but we were never there except to sleep. We got a room on the 10th floor so it was quiet.
Staff was very helpful. Arranged a town car for us for an early departure to La Guardia.

review_title: La zona non Ã¨ tanto centrale
review_text: Camera piccolissima non si riusciva ad aprire la valigia.. PerÃ³ la vista dalla camera era bellissima.. Il personale Ã¨ cordiale e gentile..wifi gratuito .. PerÃ³ l hotel Ã¨ datato e la zone non mi Ã¨ piaciuta.. Per arrivata a times square ci sono da fare 20 blocchi di strade..una buona mezz'ora.. E il prezzo per Essere un 3 Stelle non Ã© buono.

Great location. Easy to get to anywhere. Rooms good size. Beds comfortable. Pity breakfast was ordinary so we walked down 8th Ave to great diner where we could get good fresh fruit, croissants and a decent cup of tea
Good location good room size but bathrooms are awful this hotel need a major refurb

In town on a budget & priceline bid put me here, coincidentally where my meeting was being held. The room was better than expected as far as comfort & cleanliness, but the bathroom was quite archaic. The meeting room had those thin sliding cardboard walls, & of course our neighbor was some sort of Japanese Kung-Fu festival. I didn't try the restaurant, but some colleagues were displeased w/ lunch. I did feel safe while in the hotel. The best part of the property was the quick 10' walk to Columbus Circle.

review_title: Great family suite for the price
review_text: You won't find anything in the city with so much space and convenience as the Flatotel's family suite. Not the most beautifully decorated room, but definitely the most convenient.

As other reviews stated, the hotel is ready to be updated....but don't let that deter you from staying here! The bedding is super clean and updated and the room and public areas are kept very clean. We had no issues with the elevators, wait time was short. Location is great to walk to Times Square and Central Park. Subway is 2 blocks away, short walk. The rooms are large, just like you would expect a normal hotel room to be. Most in NYC are tiny! Price is great too, hard to find a room under $275/nt in NYC with a location this good. I am a travel agent and would have no problem recommending this hotel to my clients. I would definitely stay here again.
The room is nice n clean, and the location is super. The staff is really, really helpful!! I am very impressed. Will definitely stay again!!!

review_title: This is unAmerican in every way! I'm shocked, get a clue when they impose a 15% gratuity on a table for two; cheeseburgers and a
review_text: This place should be inspected and shut down. There are moldy walls in the bathroom, causing the wallpaper to bubble, along with a nice rippling effect of the plaster; I pulled back the sheets to make sure the bed had been changed; and I found lint and a hair under the pillow; obviously, the management is too busy to care about reputation. Not once did anyone ask us, if we liked the food(NOT!); we went to the diner because we were starving after the flight; 2 cheeseburgers that we didn't touch because of the 3rd world smell arriving before our meal($40+ and they automatically added gratuity- I see why); we couldn't take it, so we booked a diff hotel, and not once did anyone ask us why we were leaving or how can we help you? I couldn't refer my dog to this hotel. It's hopefully one for the history books! Obviously, people have become complacent enough to pick up their checks and not care about anything else. This can't be American owned, can it? I've been to nicer hotels in 3rd world countries; this is a fair warning! You can't be fooled, we're in our second room, but the walls are the same wripped wall paper and molding drywall!

I guess the reason people stay in chain hotels is that you know what you'll get with minor variations. 
This hotel is on the tired side of the Holiday Inn brand. Kind of what you would expect of this brand in general. It's all here, just very well used.
The upside is the location, which is unbeatable in this price range and the great service.

Stayed here for a week in Feb with my partner got 2 double beds in our room so nice extra. Hotel staff friendly and helpful breakfast nice although we only ate there once. The location is perfect it is in the middle of times square & central park 10 mins walk from both! Would definitely stay here again next time we go to new York!

Like a very large youth hostel. Pleasant desk staff, clean bed. But...door did not shut properly, huge gap under door, dirty carpets, falling ceiling in ancient bathroom, no curtains to block sun, battered walls and furniture. In short, a disaster.

We have been at this hotel with our grown children (2 rooms)
The rooms are big butl old one ,
The location is great 
The hotel isn't very clean 
Again location great!

review_title: Horrific service....much better last night at the Holiday Inn Houston Intercontinental .....AVOID AT ALL COSTS
review_text: IsOur group should have anticipated a disaster upon arrival when mobs of customers were lined up at 3:30 with complaints of rooms not ready....we overheard one couple state this was their 5th visit to the desk only to be given keys to a VERY occupied room. No bellman was even available to assist in the pouring rain....for 10 women!!! The desk clerk was very nice and upon request offered 6 vouchers for drinks for a party of 10...I requested to speak to the manager and explain that when rooms are supposed to be ready at 3 ....new arrivals really do not care to hear explanations such as we allow our "platinum and gold" members to check out late....thereby inconveniencing minions such as our obviously unimportant party. I might have felt I was being overly critical had there not been a long line waiting to speak with management. To compound matters....after one full hour at the desk and the absolute refusal of the "welcome desk talent coach" Scott -- to at least provide a measly cocktail for our entire party....some of our keys failed to work resulting in a subsequent return and wait at the dreaded desk. Mr -- is a poor representative of what is usually a wonderfully branded hotel. Choose well and differently....our previous stays at The Mela, Grand Hyatt, Marriott Marquis, Renaissance Times Square and even the Holiday Inn Empire State have exceeded my first abysmal 3 hours at this horrible place. The room...coined a cozy queen is without doubt the smallest room in existence.

Beautiful hotel in the perfect location at Christmas with dining, shopping so near. Highlight was the staff, particularly Derron who greeted us with such a welcoming smile. So knowledgeable and helpful, which is rare and delightful in this bustling city!

review_title: Affordable and clean but needs updating
review_text:
Good bang for the buck but this hotels rooms need to be upgraded. The decor is old and out of date and there are no flat screen televisions. 
The lobby is nice and the service was good. 
Parking is right outside and an overnight was only $27 which is great for manhattan.

This was our second stay at the W on Lexington and we enjoyed this stay as much as the first. The staff was extremely helpful, from the person who checked us in at the front desk, to Fermin Archer, our welcome ambassador and Freddy, who always made sure that we had a ride with a good driver. Any mistakes that were made were corrected quickly and efficiently. We will definitely come again.

review_title: Great if you enjoy the buzz and don't mind room size.
review_text: Excellent location, nice modern room with superb bed and toiletries, but very small, poor view and noise from air condition when on, and some noise (presumably air-con systems) from outside. The lounge is excellent, has good music and fantastic cocktails. Wifi didn't work in our room which was very annoying, I didn't bother to ask for change.

review_title: Rooms were tiny but it's NY!
review_text: Great location and I like the bliss products. Good security--- They always asked for our hotel room and key cards at night. Concierge was helpful for questions too. Umbrellas were offered when it unexpectedly rained.

review_title: Luck of the draw, could be good or terrible!
review_text:
Me and my traveling buddy booked the hostel through a travel agent, our only requests were that we did share a room with others.
The room was very basic, a bunk bed and a bin. The sheets on the bed were not thick at all, requested more and was handed two moth eaten blankets. We decided not to use these as we had read reviews on here about bed bugs so didn't want to introduce any insects to our seemingly beg bug free beds. Instead slept in jumper and trousers. 
Common areas not a good a ones we had in LA (pool table, bar etc missing) and this meant meeting other travelers was not the easiest. (but when you are in NY there are plenty of other things to do. 
Lots of people complaining of noisy pipes, bed bugs, cockroaches, filth and grime etc. We did not see much of these things. But in the bathroom the pipes were banging loudly and I'm sure some rooms have bed bugs. I could see this hostel potentially being a nightmare for some travelers, but luckily for us it was adequate and we were fine! 
I wouldnt stay there again because it's just too unpredictable what your stay will be like, but if you don't mind roughing it out. This place is cheap and in a good spot!

Amazing comfort, fun bar in the hotel also a Bliss spa -though this is cosmetic and pricey. Room was on the small side, but this is NYC.
Love the W hotels and the ambience they have. Cool comfort.
Convenient location for Manhahattan.

Just arrived after a long flight from the uk!! Very ignorant staff!! Place smells!! Full of creepy people!! Room disgusting!! No tv or sink or plug, stains on the walls, dirty bedding!! Burst into tests and wishing I was on next flight home!! Awful awful!!!

Got a deal on hotels.com. Good location, not great. We had a long wait to check in and they had waters and champagne available. Room was small but nice. Pet friendly. They had a dj in the lobby after 9 pm. Not the quietest, but you are in NYC. I was awakened at 130 am by a vocal young lady that let's just say wasn't sleeping,

Old and simple, but good service and excellent location. 3min walking to central park, 1min to train station. We really liked it!
Very hot room with no air. The hotel is rather run down. Not what I expected for a W hotel at all.

The location is very convienient to all of mid-town. The W scene can be very loud so do not expect a quite environment as you enter the lobby in the evening hours. The bar, Whisky Blue, is small but comfortable with great service. The rooms are generally quite, are very comfortable but are very small. In fact, their upgrade, spectacular room, is smaller than most hotel rooms. Their "cozy" room is smaller than the walk-in closet in my house. That said, most people are not in NYC to be in their room so the great location out weighs the noise and tight quarters.

Yes the rooms are small but come on, you are in NYC! Unless you want to pay half your mortgage in one night, a smaller but fairly priced room is just fine. Plus you should be out in the city playing! You do great free wifi and bonus Starwood points when you stay here. That's a nice bonus! The lobby does turn into a club atmosphere on Fri and Sat nights. That didn't bother us, but we also weren't expecting it. The location was stellar because it was so close to the 6 subway which can easily take you to great parts of town like Soho.

review_title: Worst hotel that I have stayed!!!
review_text: I wouldnt recommend to stay on this hotel. The room is not well ventilated and upon asking the front desk guy to put a/c in will just say that it is not possible because the a/c is centralize with a rude manner. you will be stuck in the room like your in sauna and the bed is itchy. This hotel stinks and the worst hotel i had experience. stay away from this hotel!!!

What I have encountered here that the room is not well ventilated. I asked the front desk to make the room colder or at least add the fan speed and told me that he can't (with an attitude) because the a/c is centralized. So i asked if he has an available fan for me to borrow but again with an attittude that he say that he dont have. Well it seems that i'm gonna be stuck here for 2 nights without any ventillation!!!

The majority of commentsvabout this hotel is true, however the building is no longer condemed and (going by the photos on the website) it is much cleaner. The receptionist is very helpful and cant do enough to help you in you inqurey. The hotel is very close to Time Square and a Subway station. This hotel is ideal for backpackers or young people expected a bed and private WC.
Very good site ro go visiting the city, it's near to All the famous places and so helpful atention.

So i had a week in NYC and i was looking for a place to stay and pay less than 200$ a day. 
This hotel is located right in the middle of everything, it is near the subway, it offers free transportation in the city, and most of all, it has a great bar and lobby.
The room was a bit small but it was clean and tidied everyday, the bath was amazing with Gliss products

review_title: It's not a hotel! SERIOUSLY - According to the 3 NYPD officers we met while being there for 30 mins
review_text:
It's certainly not worth the $128 I paid for it. Only thing I will give it is that I have worked at summer camps and lived in a tent for a summer which was better but the sheets were clean. The police officer story: we went to the vending machine for a snack and when we came back 3 officers asked if we lived there? We said no and they said well there has been complaints by residents who said its being used as a hotel. We said we were staying the night and they told us that it is not allowed to be used as a hotel and who did we get the room from. I said travelocity and they said well try and get your money back. SERIOUSLY if they are right and why would they be there if not, then believe me when I say, its NOT a hotel! 
MY FIANCEE WAS SCARED THE WHOLE NIGHT - couldn't afford anywhere else at short notice...

review_title: We walked in, then immediately left, funniest experience of my life.
review_text: I'm from Florida and have never been to ny. From the outside I was excited to stay there, we walked in and I thought I was in a horror movie. It literally smelled like murder and hookers. The elevator was a joke and the hallways were disgusting and scary. 5 seconds of being in the room we saw 2 roaches. I've never seen anything like it. My friends and I were laughing histerically as we sat in the room looking for another hotel, then left the key and walked out the front door. Don't bring children here. If you're looking for a new york experience you'll never forget, check this place out. But don't stay!!!

review_title: Trendy, upscale and very well located. Small rooms and pricey but a nice stay
review_text:
We stayed at the W for two nights in Oct. Overall it was a great stay. Service was awesome with champagne at check in and a very attentive staff. It's a small room but its clean and comfortable.
The location on Lexington is great. I got the room on Priceline and overall very happy with the stay.

This Hostel is in a great location. It is close to China Town and Little Italy and is only a short stroll to Soho. 
The rooms are small and the bed feels like you are sleeping on concret! 
It is not worth what I paid to stay there and they over charged me for the rooms! Still waiting to get refunded the extra they charged.

review_title: Hip, stylish, appointed and impeccably serviced.
review_text: My W stay was an eye opener. Starwood central reservations was inept and did the property a disservice. Upon arrival my reservation issue was immediately resolved by the hotel manager calling Starwood SPG. Do not let Starwood central reservations detour you from staying at this top notch impeccably serviced hotel. Every single request I had this W exceeded. I have SPG Gold courtesy of Amex with 20 Starwood nights. I have Marriott gold with 360 nights of stay. I felt 100% more valued at this W than any Marriott in the city. If you want delight in customer indulgence and feel true guest appreciation, W is the hands down superior choice. This W is Marriott price comparable but truly Ritz Calton, Four Seasons level delivering. I plan to reach 365 Marriott nights as a milestone then switch exclusively to SPG. I will never consider my next W option anything less than a first choice.
You have a great service and wonderful location.

review_title: Basic 'you get what you pay for' hotel.
review_text: Safe, Chinese dominated area with range of OK oriental dominated restaurants. Close to good subway link into Manhattan, and La Guardia Airport.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Queens Court Hotel

review_text:
I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. The staff is great - friendly, helpful, courteous. The beds could not be more comfortable. The location is terrific. 
I was worried after reading some of the negative reviews but there was no need to be. Loved it!

review_title: The staff here never took customer service 101, but they could use it.
review_text: We were thrilled with the priceline booking of this great location and brand. As a Starwood employee I've learned the importance of great service and mistakenly thought I'd get it here. When I asked manager to switch me to a room with 2 beds he was very accommodating and promised an upgrade the next day since the hotel was sold out that night. Once we got to the room we realized the tub doesn't drain, so a shower is very uncomfortable while standing in a tub full of water. We mentioned the faulty plumbing to the front desk, but they did not make a note of it during our conversation. I went back the front desk on the second night to find out what room number I'd been moved to but was told there was no record of my previous request or of the manager's promise to move our room. Tomorrow I'll wake up early, take a shower with water up to top of the tub, and try to enjoy the rest of my stay despite the hotel issue.

We are a young couple who came for our honeymoon. After hearing that most rooms are pretty small, we asked to upgrade our room and got the "superb room", which was excellent, although the bed was only a quin size, without anymore charge. The room is very cool and well designed, the stuff is very nice and there is a party in the lobby every weekend (but in the room it's quite). We enjoyed our stay!
Is a good hotel, very clean and is good located.. The service is excelent

review_title: Perfect location and great vibe, you only get what you pay for.
review_text:
Overall the perfect choice if you want a great location, funky rooms and a great vibe. Everyone is very cool and the bar in the lobby pumps every night. They also have a nice free limo transfer service - but book early as it fills up quickly.
On the downside rooms are NY small, so don't buy the lead in price. The beds are also doubles, so whilst very comfortable are small. Probably the biggest downside is that you need to be prepared to pay considerably for anything extra - wi fi, business centre etc. Look for a room rate with as much included as possible.
Concierge was also very helpful - I emailed them in advance and they organized a heap of restaurant reservations for me.
Overall, would stay there again.

review_title: Friendly, helpful staff & basic room in good location
review_text:
Small room but ok if you're not spending much time there. 
Sheets weren't clean so ended up sleeping on top of the duvet & covering with our towels! 
Talking of towels... The cleaner took my towel! Not entirely sure how that happened as their towels are white & beige... Mine was blue! 
Location is good, about 10 mins walk to Times Sq... Right in the fashion district.
I've noticed reviews about the noise... The air con is loud, the ice machine in the hallway is louder & did wake us up in the early hours - but who really sleeps in NYC anyway..?!
For a short, basic stay I would definitely stay here again. It was 'fine'.

review_title: Great suite stay with times square view
review_text: We stayed in a great suite at the W Times Square. It was spacious and was fabulous for three guests because there was a divider that separated the living room from the bedroom so there was privacy between the two rooms. There were also large flat screen TVs in both rooms which was great. The room was dim and had little light but that didn't bother us. However, one tv was fuzzy and a bathroom light was burned out and it took three phone calls to the front desk on three different occasions over 2 days to get them to actually show up and fix them. That being said, we really enjoyed our stay and the fabulous W bed!

review_title: Good location but room is yuk!
review_text:
The room that I stayed in had an odour, the air conditioning was broken, everything in it was old. The lifts are tiny and can barely fit 2 ppl.
If your not planning on spending much time in your room then get it. The location is great (only 5-10 min walk to times square), the lady at the front desk was very resourceful and this was one of the cheapest hotels I could find when researching places to stay in NYC which was close to times square. I guess you get what u pay for!
tened cuidado porque no te avisan que en tu habitacion a parte de las personas tambien duermen tantas cucarachas como el hotel quieran

review_title: Words can't describe but I'll try
review_text:
Pros: the location is good, the tv worked and I got a really cheap price booking through priceline
Cons: everything else. We walk into the place and it's a small, dark hallway entrance. The staff was friendly enough but as we took the single tiny elevator to our room, we had to make two trips so we could fit in the elevator with our luggage. The room was about the size of a single-person freshman college dorm room only I know when I was in college, those dorm rooms were actually nicer and cleaner. The room was filthy. The phone looked like it had been thrown against the wall about 12 times but it worked. The beds were hard and sheets were dirty. The old A/C unit worked but was level with the beds so if you're stuck in that bed the A/C blows on you and you'll probably get sick too (or at least freeze all night). The bathroom was small and disgusting. We had to call down to the front desk to get an iron and ironing board as this wasn't in the room. There was no closet but a small rack on the wall to hang things. The place had one ice machine on the bottom floor so I guess that's better than none, but just something you expect. 
From seeing the place I wouldn't have been surprised at all if the police had raided one of the rooms to bust some degenerate. It seems like one of those places where you'd see them catch a scumbag on Law & Order. We kept our doors locked the entire time for fear of armed robbery. I'm sure the place rents these rooms by the hour to hookers. 
The only other positive I can think of is that after getting back from a night out, we didn't come back to find all of our possessions stolen. Of course, you wouldn't list that as a positive at a normal hotel you just expect it. 
This place is ideal for a homeless person that would like 4 walls and a roof over their heads. I could also see poor college kids on a budget cramming in here for an nyc weekend trip because in college you're generally used to living in filth. However, if you do stay here, be sure not to pay what some of these other morons paid. Get the room off of priceline so you at least save more money and be sure to bring a knife, pepper spray or a hand gun so you feel safer.

review_title: Great staff, awesome for the price
review_text: Stayed at this hotel with a couple of friends last week. After reading all the reviews here we were rather skeptical. However, the overall experience turned out great. Although the furniture may be old and sometimes dusty, the place is decently clean overall. You also get urself a nice bathroom and very good service from the front desk. Overall, if you're on a budget, but wants a decent place to stay at a great location, this hotel shouldn't let you down.

review_title: N'y allez pas - dont go to this hÃ´tel
