Returned to the W New York last week and my stay was great as usual. They upgraded my room based on my spg platinum status. Returning again in a few weeks. Great hotel and awesome location.

Stayed twice at the Radisson Lexington in Midtown.
It's location is very good in midtown, close to Grand Central. Service is friendly and rooms clean.
Negatives are that it is a bit old building and rooms can be small (like in most NY hotels). It is also not great value for money but OK compared to other NY hotels.

review_title: Location may be good, but din't be fooled by the lobby. Rooms are circa 1979.
review_text: It's adequate. I have a favorite hotel I normally stay in when in NY for business, but it (as many) hotels were full as it's December in NY. I had to ask to change rooms as the initial room had so much damp in the walls the paper was bubbling and peeling. Ick. I was 'taken care of' by getting the exact same (small) room minus the damp. Am sitting in the lobby writing this rather than go to the room - it's not inviting. As a tourist this would be a good central stop if you just need a room to sleep in (I assume it is less expensive at other times). For a tired business traveller, the damp wall experience will mean I will never be back.

review_title: Please try to find a different hotel before booking at this property.
review_text: I travel often and have NEVER written a negative review but this was my worst hotel stay ever. A "non-smoking" hotel and the rooms smell like smoke! Don't make any special requests when booking (pillows, roll-away, etc.) because they won't accommodate you. Most of the guests standing on line at check-in are complaining about the condition of their rooms. Stay somewhere else unless your desperate. Thanks for ruining our annual Christmas trip Paramount staff and owners!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Fab location, not a bad hotel
review_text: I had low expectations, honestly. But this was a decent hotel in a great location. The hotel shows some wear, but it was very clean and adequate for a great shopping trip to the city. Great value this time of year too ( ny in December is very pricey).

This hotel is good value for money, mainly due to the location! Minutes from 5th Avenue and Times Square etc. Our room size appeared very generous for New York,plenty of room for 2 ladies with luggage and shopping bags! My only negative with the hotel was that we did request a twin room when we booked and asked several times through out the stay however I can appreciate it was Thanksgiving week and the hotel was very busy so we made do with one double bed! Overall you get what you pay for,this hotel isn't luxury by any means and it's probably more of a 3 star than a 4 but for people who are after a brillantly located hotel at a reasonable price then this hotel is perfect!

This hotel was in a perfect location to fit our needs! We definitely wanted to experience Times Square, but also wanted to experience the outskirts by walking. We were steps from Times Square & within very short walking distance of Broadway, Fifth Avenue (Garment District), Central Park, and Hell's Kitchen Restaurant Row. All we had to do to reach other areas (SOHO & Lower Manhattan) was to take a short bus or cab right.
Now the location as I said was wonderful & the hotel is very classy & nice, but the rooms were SMALL! Imagine the smallest room you can & then half that! Even after reading other reviews we were very shocked at just how small it was. That being said, we spent very little time in our room & it ended up being functional for us. I guess to pay for a bigger room & miss out on other experiences would not have been worth it to us!
Most of the service staff was very helpful & courteous including the front desk & doormen (who made the hotel feel very secure). I was quite disappointed in the concierge however. The first full day we were there I told him we were headed to Central Park & I asked him if there was anything in particular we should see or do there. He looked very puzzled & said "No, but I can give you a map." Turns out the most helpful people in that area were our hired drivers to & from the hotel. I would recommend that over a taxi.
Overall, it was a great experience & I would definitely recommend!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Never again a lot of money for a hole of a hotel
review_text: We stayed over thanks giving basically there's your key your on the 3rd floor, once in the room no tea/coffee making facilities no info of the hotel peeling paint on the ceiling the water in the bathroom had to be run for a couple of mins as it smelled when first turned on, upon complaining about cigarette smoke in our room we was fobbed of with a breakfast and the smokers persisted next door we also complained about Mosquitos in the room to which the lady behind the counter said they don't fly to which I said what doesn't she replied bed bugs that's when I realised that's what we had felt a few times crawling over us my wife had been bitten a few times too.the only good thing about the hotel was the Starbucks next to the lobby, if I was you spend a bit extra for somewhere nicer

review_title: It was a great hotel in a wonderful location! No complaints!
review_text:
We were a little nervous about staying here after reading some of the previous reviews, but we didn't find even ONE of the things/complaints with our room or the hotel at all. 
I do have to say though that we confided in the young man at the front desk about our concerns and asked for one of the "renovated" rooms and something up higher in the building. We were given a really nice room on the 26th (top) floor and it was fabulous. No problem with cleanliness or water pressure or noise and I am picky! I checked everything and it was all good!
I do think that they are willing to accomodate their guests if they aren't too full and I don't doubt that maybe some of the other rooms are run down and need renovated on other floors. I would definitely just ask to be moved to a renovated, different room on a higher floor. Hopefully they will be willing and able to help you. We were lucky too because we had reserved a deluxe room, which was fairly standard I think, but it seemed to be a step up from basic. I got this at a great price through Groupon. We will definitely go back to this hotel! Loved it, the location and the luxury of it all!
Great location. Quaint small rooms. Nothing fancy. Clean linen, no bed bugs. Great little pizza joint right next door.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Brilliant hotel in a fantastic location
review_text:
Got back from this hotel today after 4 nights in New York and what a fab hotel it is! There were 3 adults n my party and we had a room with 2 double beds, no problem with the size of the room and bathroom, it was more the storage room, but saying that we managed, the only time we were in the room was to sleep and shower!! We didn't eat in the hotel so can't comment but we did try the small pizza place just next door 'patzeria' they were delicious!! And also we had breakfast at a place called 'carve' out the hotel to the right and follow round the corner, great food!!
The staff at the hotel was more than helpful, the concierge helped us with the attraction tickets which worked out about $150 for 72hr hop on hop off bus tours all around new york plus 5 attraction tickets which can be used for empire state, statue of liberty etc. Great value for money. Location is perfect! 2 seconds from Times square!! 
We had an absolute ball at this hotel and would have no problem recommending this hotel!! And yes we will be goin back to new York it's a fab place!!!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Not much to the rooms... But it's the Chelsea!!
review_text: Definitely pricey - I think we paid around $285 for our old sparsely furnished room. But it's NYC! What it lacks in luxury it makes up for in character. Staff was pleasant, friendly, helpful, and location was perfect, right in the Chelsea neighbourhood and about a minute walk from the subway. Sweet guitar shop right beside it too.

review_title: Great location With big cleanig issues...
review_text: The bathroom and the kitchen of the apartment 10J in which we stayed, were really old even if equipped with all necessary utensils. The real problem Was the big amount of dust everywhere in the apartment and the fact that we noticed our bedrooms were used as a closet for the cleaning stuff, smelly sometimes, of all the apartments of the property. I think this is a problem of this Only apartment but noone told us anything before our arrival. Except all of this, the location Was great and at walking distance from major attractions in midtown and the doorman Charlie Was really helpful and kind.
Val @ check-in was warm, gracious, efficient and immediately made me feel welcome. The rest of the stay equally perfect. Thanks.

Estuvimos 7 noches en el estudio 7A. La ubicacions es muy buena, ya que se encuentra a 5 min. caminando de la Central Station.. El apto. EstÃ¡ algo deteriorado porque la finca ya tiene unos aÃ±itos, pero en general esta bien acondicionado.. Como aspectos negativos destacar los ruidos: los muelles de la cama son bastante ruidosos, la nevera hay que desonectarla para poder dormir, y los ventiladores del parking que colinda con el edificio son bastante molestos ( aunque el cansancio era tal en nuestro caso, que no impidieron que durmieramos).
En general la limpieza correcta (la ropa de cama y toallas muybien).
En conclusiÃ³n, teniendo en cuenta calidad-precio-ubicacion le damos un 6 sobre 10.

review_title: Excellent location, very modern and very clean.
review_text: I stayed in this hotel on a 5 day shopping trip last december, the location is excellent, it is very close to all of the main attractions, such as times square, st patricks cathedral, 5th avenue and central park, and it is in a save area. The staff were very helpful, and although the room was not massive there was wardrobe space, an compact bathroom and a very comfy bed with a good tv, there was still space for 2 people to move around in, it is not a home which some people seem to expect from their revues, it is a room. I was so impressed I have rebooked for this year and will be returning for 8 days and can't wait.

review_title: very average hotel, small room, great location
review_text: stayed for few nights on honeymoon, got a tiny room on 16th floor, hotel and room pretty average, price was ok, location was really good though

stayed at this hotel for 5 nights and would definitely recommend. Rooms were clean, modern and beds ultra comfy. And location was great for all sights in NY! Staff were brilliant. I'd give this hotel an A* for everything and would recommend for a great stay

review_title: Very nice hotel in a great location
review_text:
I arrived about 11.30am and although check in was not till 3pm they found me a room straight away.
It is called a cozy room and it is but perfectly comfortable with everything you might need. 
I used the spa and they were great at finding a convenient time for me and the massage i had was fantastic (thanks vivian). 
The bar was also nice with friendly staff and a good atmosphere. 
I had a very nice stay here.

review_title: Not 4 star, tiny room, loud toilet, unhelpful staff
review_text: Stayed 2 nights, no staff to greet and help with bag, asked for quiet room, gave me low level room with traffic noise and flag that knocked on the window, loudest toilet I ever encountered. I stayed at other w hotels which was great but this is the worst w hotel, more like upgraded motel.... Find other true 4 star hotel.

Loved my stay at this hotel. This is my third trip to NYC and decided to splash out this time and stay in Times Sq. Great value given the location,rooms clean,tidy,staff helpful. Food and drink a little pricey but lots of alternatives to be found elsewhere. Billy Elliott musical just across the road so put it on your list of things to do! Thank you to all at the Paramount for my best NYC experience to date!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: The Paramount Hotel is excellently situated just off Times Square. The reception, bar and dining areas are stunning and smell divine. However if you plan to book a double for 4 people then I am afraid the rooms just don't work. We looked at 3 rooms before eventually settling on the quieter 8th floor. It had just a single wardrobe with a safe and 2 small drawers, no storage at all in the rest of the room and no dressing table or storage space for cases. We had to live out of our cases and step over them to move around the room. One bed was up against the window forcing me to have to climb over my companion if I needed tto go to the bathroom. I am firmly of the view that you just need your room to sleep and get changed in and certainly don't expect a city hotel to be particularly large but the Paramount prefers style over function and when the hairdryer plug means that to dry your hair you can't see a mirror its just becomes annoying. For 4 people for 5 nights it was just far too small.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: Booked thru travel agents.room small.bed very tiny about 4foot width not a British double.next door building night club . We on level 3 night club below.notuch sleep went on till 4am on 2 nights.advise get a higher floor and ring hotel before about room size. New York fantastic city enjoyed every minute other than hotel.be warned

This isn't the first time I've stayed at this location but I feel as though I have to write a review because I stayed here twice in one month and each time it has been fabulous! The welcome staff is great, Teddy, to mention my favorite! He is always upbeat, happy to help, and fun to talk to. The music, drinks upon arriving, and the eagerness to please sends this staff to the top, in my book. 
The rooms are tight but they have used the space to their advantage. Never overlooking a chance to throw in their sheek style. I stayed in the spectacular room and it was spectacular! 
The area is perfect if you want to walk to central park or times square... Either way, you'll never have a problem finding your way around when you have such helpful staff! 
Thank you W for another great stay! We will be back! :)

review_title: Great location at a competitive price!!!!!!!
review_text: Stayed at W new york in July for a getaway weekend with my wife for an anniversary. Its one of the W's oldest properties in NYC, but it is very well maintained. The lobby itself is modern and all the staff as you enter are fantastic. The basic room is extremely small, yet well-appointed. Do your homework on the size of the room. If size is important, upgrade quickly to avoid disappointment. Loved the lobby bar on Friday nite. Cozy yet very chic. I would definitely recommend this property to anyone.

My two fav hotels in NY are now The Waldorf Astoria if you are in the mood for pomp and splendor. Or the W at Lex which is a lighter and more modern place. The receptionist Yeshira promptly checked me in and gave me an upgrade that was free. Later someone came by with free goodies (toiletries and a spatial puzzle). The weather was so hot (over 100*) so the W thoughtfully provided free water bottles in the lobby you could carry with you. And they gave me free wi-fi in the room A nice comfortable place - expensive - but then this is NY. 
Sid Mehta

review_title: Great location, boutique hotel and still in a chain
review_text:
I loved the place, lobby, not to big, elevators small but what can you expect from manhattan. 
Rooms not to big even though we took 'spectacular', actually it was small, but the design awesome. Staff very nice! Place actually gets crowded in the evenings. Walking distance everywhere you wanna go on the island. Car rental just around the corner.

review_title: More than adequate hotel in a great location to explore Manhattan
review_text:
My wife and I stayed at the Paramount on the first leg of our honeymoon in NYC. The room was fairly standard fair but certainly very clean, modern decor, and flat screen tv. The bathroom was a very good size and overall the room was of a good size for hotels in Manhattan. The bed was a double but big enough. 
I noticed a few reviews commenting on the noise. I can't deny that you can hear the traffic so if you are a light sleeper then it may not be for you, but IMO this really shouldn't be complained about as a negative given the superb location, 2 minutes walk from Time Square, middle of theatre district and all the buzz. If you don't want that then go look in Greenwich Village which is a lot quieter.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text:
Paramount hotel forever
Next time we will check again in paramount.small rooms but its okay to only sleep.gym is very clean and youtube got everything what youtube need
Very good place, everything is in the near.
One minute to go to time square, so beautiful trip.
Nyc never sleeps:-)

Greetings from germany
alex, halis
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: I recently stayed at the Paramount Hotel, New York with my boyfriend for the 2nd time. I loved the place last year when we visited for my birthday & thought the service was great. This year there were a couple of minor incidents that happened which I reported to a staff member on the way out, mainly regarding the bar staff upstairs & when trying to order some food. The barman said they couldn't get waiters to take orders & serve around the side tables overlooking the square ground lobby, (near the elevators). Why?? Yet, I saw a waiter clearing tables on the next table to where we were sitting?? We ended up just having a drink & leaving to go & eat elsewhere. The Paramount lost customers there! As we have paid a lot of money last year & this year at this hotel, I feel put off ordering any meals there again. We will always think twice about eating at the Paramount. Other than that, the rooms were ok, the boutique style lobby was nice, (it was different to last year), & I would always go back to the Paramount as it's in a great location. Great.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: Me and my partner stayed here for 7 nights in november, check in was late as they had organised a free room upgrade for my partners birthday which was nice :) They also left choc covered strawberries and cookies in our room which was a nice touch. we had a queen room which was perfectly sized for 2 plus 2 suitcases. Bed was comfy, pillows not so much, bathroom was small but not too much, u do have to sit on an angle pn toilet but thats not really a biggie. Shower was amazing so powerful. Room was cleaned every day with clean towels, considering the state we left the room in the cleaners did an awesome job!! Free safe was good as a lot of places charge for that service. Only doenside was expensive wifi (it was sold to us in the travel agents as having free wifi but thats only in lobby and it can b slow, $43 for the week) You cant beat the location, for that alone i wud recommend this hotel and wud stay again.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Living like a Manhattan Babe xxx
review_text: My best friend and I stayed here for our 25th birthday. We were on New York a week and stayed here for 4 days, the staff were lovely, helped us with our bags, and humoured our English accents, slight drunken behaviour, hang overs in the morning, they helped with taxi's and cutting the arms off a top I wanted cutting. We made a mess with some peanuts and they cleaned up quickly with no bother. The location is perfect for young arty types, we were so close to bars, tattoo shops, funky clothes shops and million food places. Perfect in every way. Made my 25th unforgettable thank you do much!!

This place is terrible. The bed sheets has blood on the sheets and has been there for the 3 days I've been here. The two double beds amounts to a single bed, and a double. No phone in the room. The drawers fall apart when you open them. The only thing that was remotely exciting was realizing that there was a pop machine. Mountain dew and pepsi give me ginger ale which sets this place to the worst place ever. Next time I'm going to sleep on a park bench in central park that way I at least know Im getting raped.

review_title: This is not a hotel. It is a hostel. It is perfect for a cheap room in a good location.
review_text: We had a run in with the manager over a leak in the roof. She was rude, patronising and unhelpful. Other than that the atay was fine we were a group of friends looking for cheap accommodation in ny and this suited us. Good location but dont expect anything fancy. It shouldn't be classifed as a hotel. There is no communal eating area/kitchen so no where to leave food. Other than thhat, clean towels, nice staff and WiFi.

We stayed at the Radisson on Lexington Ave for 6 nights in Oct 2011.
The room was small but more than adequate and the service was friendly and efficient.
After having read mixed reviews for this hotel prior to our stay, we were presently surprised at what we found.
The hotel location is very central and convenient.
Didn't stand out in any way really. Evrything with the hotel are at least good - rooms, lobby, elevators etc. Thus a good stay

review_title: Small rooms and nickeling and diming!
review_text:
Stayed for four nights. Very expensive considering the very small rooms but the location is of course great. 
Trying to get an extra dollar out of whatever you ask for, and this really reduced our impression!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: The website shows nice rooms and decent amenities. When you get there and see all the young kids hanging out on the front porch, you feel like you are entering a hostel. The rooms are barely big enough to walk around the beds. The bathrooms are communal. And the shower has no hot water, but they said they are working on it. I guess the front desk forgot to tell us that when we checked in. The price was $185 for two people to stay one night. If I wanted to stay in a hostel I would have only had to pay a third of this price. Avoid this hotel unless you like to pay way too much for a crappy room.

review_title: Poor rooms reminiscent of student halls of residence but with 4 star price!
review_text: We got allocated a double room on 19th floor which was a jole we are not big people but we had to push the bed near the wall so as not to fall out. It was a very noisy room and even worse when the a/c came on. We changed the next night but had to pay $100 extra for a room we thought we had in the first place. The decor is very cold and it smells fusty just like student halls! The location is great but not worth the price
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: All depends on the room you are given
review_text: We checked in on a Saturday in mid October and were given a room on the 19th floor. It was barely big enough for 1, had a 3/4 size bed and not a double. I could almost touch both walls with outstretched arms. The smallest hotel room I have ever had and I travel alot. I asked to move but they were full. Were moved to an acceptable sized room the following day which was fine. Other than that it was clean, staff were good and the location is great.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text:
Our party of four stayed at the Paramount at the end of September for three nights. It was amazing! 
It was our first trip to New York and we picked the hotel for its location right on Time Square. It was just what we needed. 
The hotel itself was beautiful, especially the lobby and bar, and the staff were very helpful. 
The only problem we had was my sisters room. We know hotel rooms in NY are famous for their size (or lack of it) and were more than prepared. My partner and I were very happy with our room, we loved it. My sister and her husband however had a 'double' room the same as us but a 'single bed'. I know, I know, those smaller beds are still technically a bed for two but it was just plain uncomfortable. Also, needless to say my sister was a bit put out after seeing ours! 
But, the staff were great. They were full so couldn't do anything the first night but got them a new 'double' room (with 'double' bed) the next morning. 
Overall we found our time in NY and the Paramount amazing and will definitely be back.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Great hotel in a fab location!
review_text:
We stayed here for the first part of our honeymoon. (26-29 sept) 
The lobby is dark as previous people have said however this is part of the appeal of the hotel the sweet smell in the lobby also adds the ambience of the hotel. 
Check in was quick - however we were not aware of the $75 deposit we would would have to leave at reception during our stay.
We were upgraded to a queen room as it was our honeymoon and we were really pleased with the room. The rooms were clean and smaller than average however We were hardly there anyway and so it didn't matter much to us.
The location of the hotel is fabulous - you come out of the hotel, turn left and right ahead of you is times square (30 sec walk) 
We found the open top bus ride was a great deal as we could visit all of the main attractions over a 2 day period and hop on and off the bus for $54 each.
Rockefeller is must at night! World trade centre is a place you need to visit. Central park is exactly what it says in the tin - a park! We took a pedicab around it - what an adventure.
One issue we did have was the ac unit - it was so noisy yet we needed it on to stay cool. 
Overall the hotel is great and we would definitely return.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Close to everything, clean, small, need at least Queen size bedroom, clothes stolen from room, air cond extremely noisy, front d
review_text: Stayed the first week of September. Clean hotel and perfect location. Had free wifi in foyer which was very beneficial. Hotel staff nice and helpful. Stayed in queen room very small. Air conditioner extremely noisy and hard to sleep. Shirt stolen from room from cleaning staff not impressed. Conceige very good getting tickets however extremely expensive sometimes doubling the price!! The location is awesome.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Liz Pantaleon was amazing at the front desk
review_text:
lovely room, large an airy for new York. we felt really welcomed and at home by the warm reception at the front desk,especially Liz.
would def recommend it

review_title: Small rooms, great lobby and breakfast
review_text: Overall this hotel is pretty good, with quite small but fairly well kept rooms. The selling points are the fantastic location in relation to Times Square, the beautiful lobby, great bar and snacks, Dean and Delucca adjacent to the lobby and a fantastic breakfast buffet in the mornings.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Great location for first NY trip but shop around!
review_text:
I would sum the Hotel up as fine. It didn't wow me but there was nothing majorly wrong with it. Our travel agent told us this hotel was 4*..the location may be 4* but the hotel itself is a 3*. In my opinion it was not worth what we paid but maybe if you get a cheap rate it would be ok.
There were 3 positives: 1. location! Times Square is 90 seconds away and you can walk to all major attractions which is the main appeal of the hotel. The road outside was very quiet and you never would know how close you were! 2. The room was clean and sheets changed every day. 3. The shower was hot and powerful even in the morning.
However this was my first trip to New York and I expected the rooms to be small, especially reading some of the reviews and the room was VERY small. The bathroom was half the size of the main room. We only stayed for 3 nights but I don't think I could have been there for any longer. We had a double room and if you are a couple maybe consider twin beds instead.
When we checked in the lady on the desk was on the phone dealing with a complaining guest..not a great first impression! But rather than ask us to wait, she checked us in while continuing the call which I found very rude. 
Overall, I would shop around for other hotels in the Times Square area and only recommend if you can get a majorly discounted rate. I would stay else where in future though.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: Rude, un helpful staff, dark dingy small rooms with poor facilities. Spoilt whole trip and should have stayed in the Marriott across the road.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text:
I booked this hotel through AAA at a great rate. It is conveniently located close to Times Square and Broadway. 
The room is small but served it's purpose. The bathroom had lots of mildew. Surprisingly, you could not hear any of the city traffic, but that is because it is drowned out by the sound of flushing toilets and showers running. You can literally hear every bit of plumbing that is going on. One morning I sneezed in the bathroom and heard someone say god bless you. If you plan to sleep past six AM do not stay here.

review_title: Fantastic location with very friendly staff
review_text: Lets face it if you want a big room then don't go to this hotel instead go to a hotel that charges Â£1000 dollars a night. This was my first time in new York and I loved it. The location was amazing. The staff were very friendly and rooms were always clean. I would use this hotel again.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text:
It is my second stay in this hotel and the experience has been quite bad. OK great location and OK prices for NYC however when I checked in on August 4 at approximately 1am I was provided wrongly the room key of 724 vs 727 which was my real room. I therefore entered room 724 when someone was watching TV and was laying on the bed. lucky for me that person was sleeping and I ran out and when back to the front desk where limited apologies were provided to me and on the top of that no follow up was provided by hotel management. Come on guys, you know that if you don't do anything people are now going t.o web site as trip advisors to complain ... Not so smart.
Furthermore I noted that:
- Floor 7 is in very bad shape as carpet outside the rooms needs to be changed;
- Front desk did not properly take the frequent flyer card number I gave them when I checked in and now apparently they can not apply it to my stay ...
- The morning when I checked out (after stay of 4 nights) the maid knocked at the door relatively early in the morning and asked me at what time I was checking out? I felt that this was quite rude.
Overall I feel that hotel is going down and with the new Hyatt opening right in front they better watch out.
Bertrand - Aug 13, 2011

review_title: Stylish Hotel close to Times Square
review_text:
Most reviews comment on the small rooms at the Paramount. We were on honeymoon and were upgraded to a king deluxe room, and welcomed with some chocolate covered fruit and sparkling water, plus two complimentary drinks for the bar. We certainly got a great welcome. The room size must really depend on the type of room you go for, our room was more than big enough with a built in wardrobe and a small, but not too small, bathroom. The room was clean and stylish with a huge wall mounted tv. 
The air con was noisy enough to compete with the noise of the city outside, which I guess could be more annoying in the summer. 
The location is amazing, closer to Times Square than I imagined, next door to the Scientologists. A protest going on outside there made one evening more interesting. Being so close to Times Square for a longer stay could get tiresome, turn right out of the hotel and head up 8th Avenue for cheaper souvenir stores and some great delis.
The staff are all very pleasant and helpful, the concierge(s) are all very knowledgeable. One small thing was when we had an early dinner reservation in the West Village, the concierge told us a cab would take 15mins to get there, however at 4-5pm all the cabs are heading home to Queens at the end of their shift, and it took us 45 mins to get a cab to go downtown, this kind of local knowledge would have been useful. But the restaurant held our table, so no harm done. 
The Paramount is a great, stylish and special hotel to stay at. By our UK standards the rooms are plenty big enough, I guess if this is an issue, pay the extra and go for a bigger room.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: I stayed in this hotel for 4nights, this was my first time in new York And this hotel is very central and a short walk to times square. All staff are very helpful and friendly and rooms are very clean and tidyed every day. Rooms are small but I've heard this is common for the manhatta area. I had a great stay at this hotel, would love to return and would recommend it to anyone.

review_title: Location location location great hip hotel super breakfast included.
review_text: Best location for theater times square .. Small efficient room . Super breakfast. Included. Loved it
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: In the corner of a dream, and made for modern and cool people. Totally Manhattan!
review_text: I have chosen the Paramount to stay in NY at least for the 3 latest times I've been In the city. New York is my favorite place in the world and choosing the hotel is a big deal. Paramount is so perfect, modern and sofisticated! And just next to Broadway and at the corner of Times Square! Isn't this magical?
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: The W should stand for Why? why are you mopping tread mills at 6:45 AM and not drying them? Why Invite the guest to coffee and then charge for it? Why is the hotel so unhip? 80's are over, get back to serving your business cliental.

If you want a big room don't stay in a classic, if all you want to do is sleep and shower then go for this cheapest option. Despite the size of the room I can't praise this hotel enough, the location is fantastic for travelling around the city and for quick midnight shopping and snacks. The rooms are clean and well maintained, we may have just been lucky but we had a quiet room away from the lift.
For people like me who love a cup of tea you can't do better than the little takeaway next door which is open all hours for soft drinks and best of all a slice of pizza-a cheap eating option.
Times square isn't the best of places as it can be too crowded so get out of there as much as you can using the subway all lines are so close. My tips for places not to miss are Top of the Rock, the high line, staten island ferry, Brooklyn bridge, central park on a Sunday to see the roller skate disco and a row around the lake, there is so much to do for free.
I would definitely stay here again, the staff are very helpful and courteous, as we have been to NYC numerous times we didn't need to ask any questions of the concierge but from what I overheard they were very knowledgeable and helpful.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Tired hotel with very noisy windows!
review_text:
We booked this hotel through priceline & after reading the reviews we were worried.
Check in was a breeze & we had a room on the 12th floor. Room was compact but in need of repair. There was peeling wallpaper & the windows let in a lot of noise. It sounded like you had the windows open!
Wi-fi was silly, it was charged if you wanted it in your room but the free wi-fi in the lobby was difficult to connect to.
The hotel was lovely especially the location it just needs some TLC and better Wi-Fi services.

Stayed in the Paramount during a girly holiday to NYC. Excellent location so close to Time Square, but the room is very small and air conditioning noisy. Plus bar and restaurant quite expensive. Good value if all you want is a base but not very luxurious.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text:
We stayed for 5 nights at the Radisson then could not take any more so checked into the W Hotel for the remainder of our stay. 
We arrived at 11pm to be given a room on the 9th floor that was on the apex of both streets. It was so incredibly noisy neither if us got a inch of sleep. This entirely ruined our first day in NY. We asked to change rooms but were told we could not do so until 3pm (so could not catch up on sleep until then which led to us having to cancel our first nights dinner with friends since I felt so ill). 
Our new room on the 19th floor was still noisy, but to have such a difference in room quality at near $300 a night was unbelievable. In contrast, our room at the W Hotel in the 4th floor was super quiet. 
We didn't receive one apology throughout and the manager said he could do nothing about street noise (see contrast to W Hotel / do not let this room in comparison to higher floor away from street). 
Their moto says "if we can't fix it, you won't pay". Downgrading our room at 3pm the next day is not considered fixed and we only had a $70 discount off a $270 room. Not worth my trip to NY! 
On top of this we had maintenance call who decided they wanted to fix our bathroom roof "because of rubble", housekeeping removed towels and forgot to replace, and our room keys worked intermittently. 
Incredibly noisy, rude staff and tired rooms. 
Will be recommending ALL to avoid (or request rooms on floors 20+ at a minimum).

Be wary of this Hotel, esp if u book thru Priceline.com! We are Australians & planning to visit Big Apple this Xmas. Aft saving our hard earn $, cost us USD10K in air tickets, I offer a bid of $150 per nite for a 3star Hotel in NYC & was accepted by Radisson Lexington. Instead of offering us a decent size room, we were given the cheapest & smallest room, called "petite room", which has a going rate of $158per nite if booked directly w Radisson! The deceitful thing is; Priceline.com ad ertised on its website a savings of 40-60% if we bid for a hotel room. In our case, we only save $8per nite & not the 40-60% as claimed. When I contacted Priceline, they asked me to contact Hotel directly. I did that & Radisson pushed the responsibility back to Priceline. After many emails later, Radisson said they are happy to upgrade us to bigger room w King bed but have to pay upgrade fee! When I ask how much is the upgrade fee, both Priceline & Radisson would not tell me! How dodgy! We feel very cheated by both Priceline & Radisson! So beware folks!

review_title: Don't stay, it's the absolute pits.
review_text: Withdoubt the rudest and most ignorant staff ever employed in a hotel. The only saving grace was the cleaning lady. Reception staff were officious and curt, one concierge had manners and wasn't hinting at a payback, and as for a bell boy called Ralp... I would lose him without a second thought..grumpy, verbally rude and probably hated his job... Why is he there . Would never ever stay there again and would certainly Warne friends from doing so....

review_title: Very pricey with no real justification for a shoe box room - a real letdown. How can they get away with offering so little?
review_text:
the rooms in this hotel are a joke. they are tiny. They also overheat during the night unless you can somehow work out how to set the air con at auto mode - the auto mode on the control panel means the air con works to get to the temp you select for ever! (even if it is the same as the current room temperature i.e. it does not work).
I ended up sleeping with no covers and still waking up all sweaty!
the room is "styllishly" EMPTY! the wardrobe is a tiny whole in the wall. For the price I would expect something more, a bit more furniture.
The location is great BUT this also means there are plenty more hotels next to this one which is where you should book to stay

Booked into the paramount as a group for a wedding. The staff are v helpful. But be advised the price reflects the location not the rooms. We had a double booked and it was tiny!! Managed to upgrade to queen which was much better. US doubles are not the same as UK. if you are doing a normal NY visit where u spend no time in the room it's great, but if you book as you are wanting some luxury it's not the best. The lobby has free wifi, and looks amazing. The bar is very expensive, but there are loads of 
other bars close by. I recommend turning right out if the hotel walking in the opposite direction to time sq the next block over has loads of great restaurants and bars. 
Room do have a hairdryer, mirror is on bathroom door so it's hard if you want to use it and someone wants to come out if the bathroom. 
I would not recommend sharing if you are going with someone who you don't know. 
To sum this place up for me. Nothing wrong with it, but stayed in low cost good location hotels before (check out the pod hotel) but thought I would be getting luxury this time.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: We had an excellent stay in New York and the Paramount contributed to this perfectly. The location was ideal and made visiting the city as easy as it can be, being less than a minute from Times Square we really felt in the centre of it all. The hotel itself was very conformable and our room was a decent sized double room with a spacious bathroom and the staff were very helpfull with a great knowledge of the city
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: I will always make this my first choice.
review_text: The staff is great. Lounge very nice. Had alot of fun. Food was great. Bar was great. Excellent . Comfortable stay.
Fantastic location, beautiful lobby/bar areas...small but lovely rooms. We would definitely stay here again :-)
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text:
My husband brought me here at christmas for my 30th birthday present. Couldn't be better for location, 2 min walk and you're standing in the middle of Times Square. 
Stunning lobby, room pretty good but lacking the same wow factor. It was FREEZING when we were here and the heating didn't seem to be working, a maintenance guy did come and fix it but took ages to turn up. Otherwise our newly decorated room was small but lovely and very modern. 
We had to pay a huge deposit when we checked in- we did get it back but I didn't think this was a particularly welcoming start to our stay and not for those on a tight budget. Staff were friendly, courteous and helpful. Don't buy show tickets from the hotel booth- way cheaper to get them from the discount machines in Times Square- well worth the queue. All in all a nice hotel but it's best feature is it's location.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text:
This is the Best Place to stay in New York! Special thanks to Nils Bergmann who really took Care of us! Best recommondations ever!!!! Restaurant, Bars, Shopping.
We had a very charming and Quite Room to the Patio.
The bar in the hotel in One of the Best Bars in manhattan...my Wide Envoyed the cocos Apples daiquiry
Every day!

review_title: Great location but very tiny room
review_text:
We stayed in this hotel for a week in the begining of July as a vacation. The location is great, very close to the Time Square and all other theaters. The room is clean but very small. We booked a double bed room but the bed is only 120cm wide; for a week both of us had to sleep straight every night and felt tired and unrelaxed in the mornings. And since the room was so small, the aircon is just next to the bed. Every night it's a hard decision for us - it's too warm if we turned the aircon off, but it's too cold and too noisy if we let it on. The bathroom was clean; I have nothing against it, but the shower was somehow "strange" - water came out either from the lower tap or from both the lower tap and the higher shower head. By this I think we wasted alit water everytime when we showered but we had no way to fix it.
Overall, it's still an OK hotel, but do expect too much as other 4/5 stars hotel.
(I would still recommend this hotel to a friend for a short stay or for a single)
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: Ne merite aucun commentaire! J y suis pour une semaine mais j ai reellement envie de changer d hotel je n ose meme pas dormir et manque de pot si j annule je perd tout! Hotel a eviter sincerement

My wife and I stayed 2/17/11. My wife was scheduled for delivery of of our baby the next day. Cindy at the front desk asked about our special day and put us in the most incredible room with a free standing tub inside the room/suite. Shortly after we checked in, we received a delivery of cupcakes and a cool book about pregnancy - talk about service! Cindy went byond and when we settled into our room after walking to dinner, we had a great night. My son entered the world in style the next day. Thanks W... Really nice time before our big day.

This is a great hotel to stay at, the location couldn't get much better, right amongst Times Square and the Theatres. The staff are very friendly and the rooms are very modern and clean. Will definitely stay here again!!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Good hotel in a quiet part of east side

Decor in the hotel is classic contemporary. If you like starbucks there is one on lex which is part of the hotel. As most of the nyc hotel the only amenities they have is a gym, but you can bur your extra calories walking it off in any part of the city.
Never buy the petite room for two persons...the bed is actually for ONE person and you are obliged to get the supplement id. You want Ã  NORMAL bed!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Why oh why did they have to make rooms so tiny?
review_text: Stayed here for 2 nights before taking a cruise out of New York, they have done a great job on the refurb but such a shame ghe rooms & beds are not small they are tiny. As two not very big people my wife & I can't see how 2 larger people could even get in the room never mind share the bed, 2 pillows could not lie side by side without 1 falling on the floor, rest off hotel & location very good although we allowed doorman 2 use hotel taxi to docks & he got lost & charged about $30 more than a yellow so just stick 2 yellow
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Great midtown location, but small rooms and not the best hotel for business travelers.
review_text:
This is a great location. The bar is a hot spot for drinks. The lobby is very contemporary and full of life. And excitement. For these reasons, I would not consider this hotel again when on business travel. It is noisy with music and too many patrons crowding the lobby and walkway to the elevators. 
The rooms are very small as well. Although, that is common in the city I think they are smaller here that in many other area hotels. I've stayed across the street at the Waldorf many times and rooms are much bigger (although the hotel class is different). You can get an averaged size room at the W New York, but you will pay a lot more (almost double for us).
I would come back to this hotel if I was on a leisure visit but not for business. Too much noise, distractions, and small rooms are convenient for working.

review_title: Overall very good with some minor negatives.
review_text: Good location, very clean, excellent service from all staff. We had to pay for WIFI which cost us about $24 for three days PER DEVICE! Also there was only one bedside table & lamp which was surprisingly annoying.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: I was hesitant about staying here because of the reviews however I was pleasantly surprised! Perhaps Australians expect a little less because this hotel was of a really high standard compared to ones of similar prices in Australia. My only complaint is that the shower did not have very hot water, infact one morning it was cold. The staff were apologetic, it seemed there was a problem with the whole system. I would definitely stay here again, the location was unbeatable!

Not a great stay. Small rooms, no desk at all, a mouse trap in plain view in the room, a rusty heater under the window, peeling paint, a closet that didn't fit my suit to hang it up and so on. Staff were pleasant and although they couldn't move me because the hotel was full they did their best. Probably ok place to stay as a tourist visiting NY: not a good place of you're in town for business.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

Location is good, it's not far from any of the major attractions but I think there are probably better hotels in better locations for better value.

People at reception are very kind. The location is fine. But the hotel needs a complete renovation. I wouldn't go there again. There are better places on NYC.

review_title: Fine hotel, but the bar in the lobby could be better..
review_text: Great hotel, clean, good position but the lady with the bun behind the bar is Very grumpy and moody, everyone in the hotel was nice except the lady with the bun. The beer already was expensive, but now I got it delivered with a grumpy face.

Cosy and comfortable hotel situated in the heart of New York. One can choose either to go to the Broadway show next door or to enjoy the view of the Times Square. The rooms are clean, well-equipped and the beds are very comfortable and soft. Though the price is reasonable and not very high.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: I stayed in a single room and found the room to be just fine. The location is fabulous and compared to other hotels in the same few blocks, the price was unreal! A nice little find which I will use often until everyone discovers it and the prices spike!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: My wife and I stayed here for 3nights in Feb.We had been to NY previously and had a bad experience in the hotel,however this was soon rectified when we arrived at the Paramount. The location is the obvious draw to he hotel but there are so much more to it. The staff are friendly and extremely helpful and couldn't do enough for us. We had read some reviews saying the rooms were small but our room was perfect for the 2 of us with 2 really large suitcases, plenty of room and very clean. We would recommend this hotel to anyone.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Absolutely fine for where and what it is!
review_text: Nothing too flash but hey, it's clean and comfortable and who spends much time in their room whilst in NYC? Staff are friendly and helpful, the lady on the concierge desk was invaluable in helping me to decide what broadway shows to see! Good rooftop pool but should stay open past 6pm. Very close Columbus circle subway station.

The paramount is in the most amazing spot - so convenient! The rooms are modern and comfortable, but very compact. The lobby is beautiful and the restaurant serves tasty and well priced food. 
The only downside is the incredibly poor service. The reception staff ignored me initially and when they finally spoke to me they did not listen and constantly interrupted me.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_title: Great location not a great hotel
review_text:
We stayed at the paramount whilst On our honeymoon this month, before arrival my husband called stating he wanted to make the stay special and asked for a upgraded room etc. 
On arrival we were told we had an upgraded queen room but had to wait till 3 as room wasn't ready. We waited for our room an hour but thought it would be worth the wait. 
We were very disappointed with our room we were on the 17 th floor and the lifts are very creaky and shakey! 
The room was so SMALL we opened our door and was literally on the bed we had to move a chair to put our luggage on the floor the cupboard is not adequate for hanging clothes as there is a unit with the safe inside so long items can't hang i'n the cupboard, we had been travelling for three weeks around America so needed some hanging space for clothes but they had to remain i'n suitcases. 
The air con is really loud when on and cold and when turned off room is instantly hot! The plug on the wall was hanging off as was the towel rail. Bathroom so small two people cannot be i'n there at the same time my husband is over 6 foot and quite broad so trying to have a shower was a challenge as it was so tiny! 
There is no fridge no kettle so can't make tea or coffee and although the rooms are cleaned daily the floor was not hoovered which isn't nice when you have been staying a week! 
Internet has a charge of 40 dollars for week and luggage holding has a cost too
Bit of a let down considering we were on our honeymoon and asked for it to be special 
Bet bit of hotel the lobby!

review_text: My colleague booked this hotel so I blame him for being impressed by their website. Only the lobby area is truly tasteful - the bar area is smart but when you get in the lift you leave all that behind. The room was a close fit for the tiny wardrobe and compact bathroom. The decor was a bit like a student room in a halls of residence with bright red thrown in to save it from total lack of style. The.bath had damaged enamel, stained grout and the shower head was not fixed in to the tiles properly. There was a stain on the ceiling above my bed and I just wanted to get out. Put more money in to your hotel rather than stay here.

review_text:
We stayed five nights in this hotel around christmas. For Manhattan standards, the room was really large, but somewhat outdated. The interior of the hotel was nicely decorated. Service at this hotel was very good and helpful. 
If you're not looking for a design- hotel, but want a simple, but spacious and clean room, this is a good choice.

review_title: TV did not work, moved to another room next day, tv also did not work, lighting poor, second room dingy, dent in wall...not lik
review_text: Not comfortable recommending it. Good news- no bed bugs and staff always courteous and smiling.
Very trendy. Rooms ok, not massive but central NY !! Best part is the location, 5 mins from almost most things. We walked everywhere, felt safer than in the UK!
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text: Felt very welcome as we arrived. Rooms were comfy and were a decent size. We had a buffet breakfast at the Gotham cafe downstairs which was yum. Great service there too! Very close to central park and other areas. All within walking distance - which is what you want to do in new York to see everything. Only about a ten minute walk to time square. Would definitely return!

Hotel e camere pulite, non molto spaziose ma quel che serve per dormire (in camera si rimane ben poco). Ho prenotato una camera con bagno in comune: non ho avuto alcun problema, i bagni venivano puliti spesso (la pulizia dipende anche da chi utilizza i servizi....). La zona Ã¨ tranquilla, ben servita dalla metropolitana. Unico neo la connessione ad Internet decisamente lenta in camera, ma io scendevo nella hall e non avevo problemi.

This is a BUDGET hotel. People expecting luxury look elsewhere. The staff were all so friendly (this coming from a southerner). Our rooms were clean but very small with a great view of the Hudson. A bus stop right across the street that stops right at the Empire St. One block to famed Zabars. Riverside Park across the street is lovely. We really only slept in the hotel so it was perfect. I'm currently trying to book this hotel for another family vacation but it seems to stay full.
It was a nice stay. Its not my favorite location, but nice and clean.

review_title: Attaccato a Times square ottima posizione
review_text:
Hotel ubicato a circa 2 muniti da Times square e quindi con una posizione ottimale per girare a new york.
L'albergo e piuttosto datato ma risulta ottimale come base di appoggio nel soggiorno.
La pulizia delle camere e purtroppo medio bassa ma per un breve soggiorno si puÃ² soprassedere se si considera che solitamente si resta in camera solo per riposare la notte.
Rapporto qualitÃ  prezzo e ubicazione direi ottimale! Wi fi gratuita per i clienti.
This hotel was on the subway ride from JFK. Easy three block walk from Columbus circle stop. Quiet rooms even overlooking the street. Short walk to Times Square.

After reading reviews prior to our trip we were a bit worried to say that least but found this hotel to be fine - for the money! Basically the location is fantastic for central Manhattan so obviously the place is not going to be plush. Remember that you get what you pay for! The rooms are shabby and definitely in need of a refurb but they are clean and that is all that matters to me. Staff are pretty â€œghettoâ€ and unhelpful but thankfully didn't have to have much to do with them. Overall a great location for the price. I would go again.

Was very nervous about staying here after the reviews I read. The place was great. Staff were very nice and helpful. Location is amazing. Have stayed in New York numerous times and have paid much more and the hotels haven't been in such great locations or as clean. The Port Authority is only minutes walk away. Westin hotel is 2 minutes walk away and costs quite a bit more. A post office is on 42nd street,near the port authority. Would stay there again in a heartbeat.

I'm from Sydney and after a 22 hour flight we were happy to be checked in immediately. The room was very spacious and tidy and had a well working heater (it was 3 degrees outside!)
We ordered room service for breakfast and it was delicious! The service was prompt however it was extremely expensive. We also dined in the restaurant for dinner and although the food was good we were not too happy that the tip was already placed on the bill. This was because our waiter was very rude and didn't show any initiative what do ever. 
I would recommend this hotel however if you are looking for somwhere closer to the heart of new York, ie times square, it is a fair walk.

review_title: Good location, good size room, comfortable stay and for new York, price is value for money.
review_text: We could not find fault with this hotel, bar the need to update it. It is looking tired and threadbare. Great location and reasonable value for money compared to other new York hotels. clean and comfortable. Staff were friendly and helpful.

Yes, the hotel is older, yes the doors have been painted a few time, yes some of the carpets need replacing.. However, this place was clean, the staff very helpful, the cleaning lady on our floor was very nice and let us change out towels and leave garbage in the hall since we didn't really need our room cleaned everyday and we got rooms for 135 a night which was the cheapest in the city for what you got... And a discount on the parking at $25 per day. Easy to get to from the Lincoln tunnel and a good neighborhood to stay in. Def would stay here again.

review_title: Great, location, great pillows, shame the staff only pay lip service to problems, but do nothing about it
review_text:
Arrived with 10 friends, for 3 day stay. Beds and rooms too small to accomodate families, ( one of our families a group of 3 was given 1 single bed for all 3 on first night!!!) No wardrobe space, in fact, did I say, no space full stop! One families case was tampered with and our personal belongings (toiletries) were removed. The hotel staff were not concerned and although they claimed to involve security, we waited for security but they didnt turn up. Even though they knew we had a flight to catch!
Generally a nice modern hotel from a foyer perspective but the rooms and service let it down.
hotel_name: Paramount Hotel Times Square New York

review_text:
I decided to go to New York for my partners 21st birthday, so when looking for a hotel we decided to pick a good one. At Â£157 per night for a 'cozy' room we thought it must be good. Also we had viewed the website beforehand and it looked great. 
When we arrived the lobby looked impressive, all marble and with a lovely christmas tree just before thanks giving. We thought we'd picked a good hotel, especially as times square is a five minute walk away!
However, upon making our way to the room, (we had already been upgraded as we had trouble with the hotel before we had got there) we noticed that the carpets in the corridors were stained and the whole place looked dated. We arrived at the room, which was right next to a busy staff room, it looked nice enough, although the decor looked like something out of the 1980's. Upon closer inspection, we found that the safe, the tv, the phones and one of the lamps didn't work. In fact, the lamp was shorting out and giving off sparks. We were subsequently moved to another room. This room was a family room, so we had to be moved again! 
The third room was on the 15th floor, looked nice and had a great view of the chrysler building. Yet again we were dissappointed with the quality of the room. The shelves in the wardrobe were dirty, and we had to clean them before putting clothes on them. One of the electrical sockets was completely unsafe and hanging off the wall, the safe didn't work, the floor was dirty, the shower leaked all over the floor, the windows were dusty, the bedding was dirty and ripped and the towels were ripped! 
After complaining again we were offered another room, we had a look at it, but after checking the phone and safe and finding that they didn't work we refused. 
We then contacted our booking agent (airmiles or avios as they are now known). They changed our hotel free of charge to the carlton hotel on 28th st. This hotel was incredible compared to the Roosevelt.
We wouldn't consider ourselves fussy people, however when you pay Â£157 per night you would expect a nice clean safe place to sleep. We've paid Â£70 for a premier inn and had a far better experience.
I would advise anyone not to bother with this hotel, and please listen to the reviews that you read about it! We weren't the only ones with problems there, we spoke to several others who weren't satisfied with the place. Try the carlton instead, that was a great place. 
Subsequently, we sent all of the pictures to avios, and an email explaining the faults, and we were refunded one of the two nights we stayed at the roosevelt.

review_title: Quite simply the worst hotel experience I have ever had.
review_text: Let me start by saying this is the first time I have ever written a review, but the paramount hotel was so bad I felt I had to comment. Firstly, the rooms are tiny, with virtually no hanging space and are very dimly lit. Our first room had a fly infestation in the shower, we asked to be moved, and although the bellboy was prompt and helpful, there was no apology or offer of any compensation for the infestation or inconvenience of having to move. Our second room had a wet room style bathroom, and the drain was blocked enough to flood the bathroom floor. There were also more flies in the bathroom (not an infestation, but one is still too many). There were mildew marks on the door, and no fan in bathroom so there was a constant damp smell throughout the room. On our final night, I was told that my credit card was declined, and after speaking to a very unhelpful receptionist, it turned out they had been charging $75 per day on a PREPAID room as some sort of security deposit, without ever telling me it was happening. Avoid this place at all costs, you're better off sleeping in Times Square.

review_title: Bed was ideal as was location!
review_text:
One of the more affordable hotels in New York, we found it one of the best we've stayed in.
Staff are friendly, rooms clean and adequate for a stop-over for a few days. Bathroom nice but no bath tub so you may need to request a room with one if you want one! We stayed in November but ironically had to turn the air con on as was too hot in the room - this was really quite noisy but this didn't interrupt sleep.
Most importantly: the bed was a comfortable size for 2 large (!) people and just so comfortable to sleep in!!
Would highly recommend as a good relatively inexpensive base for a city break as you're right in the best part of NYC for visitors & the best bed we've stayed in in NYC by far!

review_text:

The location is excellent and the hotel itself is beautiful. The lobby most definitely has the wow factor and we certainly can't complain about our room either. review_title: Definitely not what the website would lead you to believe!
review_text:
Booked a 3 night stay at The Roosevelt as I wanted to treat my mum with a trip to new York. Booked a superior double double as the site lead me to believe that the rooms were spacious - not the case.
I had emailed the hotel in advance and asked for a room on a renovated floor (had read that they had undergone a multi million dollar refurbishment), away from the elevators and on a high floor. When we checked in, we were allocated a room on the 3rd floor right next to the elevator. The girl on reception had told me that the room was one of the renovated ones. 
Upon arrival in the room I was disappointed to say the least. Dirty bathroom floor, room that was so small I had to go out into the hallway to change my mind, and wallpaper that was peeling - hardly what I would consider as a refurbished room.
I called reception to complain and was advised that every other room was full. I asked about upgrading and was told that it would cost $60 per night but the room wasn't refurbished. Had a look at the other room and it stank of smoke and looked like something out of a time warp - I was scared to open the closet in case I found a body!
Complained again and was advised that the only floors that had been refurbished were 3,4 and 16. We were eventually allocated another room on 3rd which was marginally better than the other 2 but still not great. The room we ended up with had a lovely view of a brick wall and noisy air con vent in addition to a bath from which the water didn't drain! 
All in all a very misleading establishment - website looks great as does the lobby but the rooms are a shambles - pay the extra and stay at the fabulous New York Palace!

review_text:
Me and my girlfriend stayed at the carter hotel from the 1st - 5th December, we as many others have said read the reviews on this site and were very very nervous and apprehensive when we landed at JFK, so much so that we had packed our own towels and bed sheets!
We were greeted by a very old looking lobby and signs detailing that they were going through a refurbishment which I could see no evidence of as it was very old and dated. The staff were very friendly and gave us our room key 1539 on the 15th floor. The room itself appeared dirty and very dated however the sheets were clean and the towels were clean. Its worth noting that there is a notice in the lobby behind reception which tells you that you have ten minutes in your room before you cant change so get in quickly and make sure you are happy with the room you've been given. We had hot water the whole time we were there and showered at different times of the day (admittedly on occasions we had to let the tap run for 5 minutes before it got hot but who cares about that?)
A cleaner came to our room on the third day we were there but we opted not to have our room cleaned as we had our own sheets and our own towels. The so called concierge in the hotel was useless apart from giving us quite a decent map of the city. The cafe attached to the hotel was also quite good however due to the location of the hotel (The main attraction) you could walk out the door, turn right, walk 100yards and you were on times square with plenty of places to eat and drink. On the day we left we had a late flight so opted for a late check out which the staff were more than happy to organise and cost us 10dollars an hour past 1pm.
In essence this hotel is old, dated but for the location and price i would definitely stay at the carter hotel again. As the title states, don't panic and be prepared. You can always take things that you are happy to leave behind to fit all that shopping in on the way back!

review_title: HELLHOLE! Still in shock...PLEASE DONT STAY HERE!!!
review_text:
We arrived after a long bus journey on Saturday night so were looking forward to getting into bed. On the front door there was a sign to say 'no more check ins' but we ignored this as we had a reservation. When we got to the desk the rude man said he couldnt check us in and hadnt we seen the signs?! We explained we had a reservation and had already paid for 2nights online. He tod us to look around because lots of people were sat around the lobby all with the same problem. They had an admin error and overbooke by 400 people...! We kicked up a fuss but werent rude and all they said was that it wasnt their problem! Nowhere else nearby in NY had free rooms so we had no choice but to sleep on the floor in the hotel lobby with about 100 other people. 15 hours later...we were given a room key! 
The room had the weirdest smell...like something had died in there?! We checked all the cupboards but just thick dust and dirt. The room was filthy and the carpets looked like they hadnt ever been hoovered, there were blood stains in the bed and up the walls there were dirty marks. The bathroom was dirty with tiles missing and the floor was flooded?!!
We moved rooms and it was still filthy but the beds looked clean and fresh! We slept until 4am when we woke up to a loud 'drip drip drip'. In the corner of the room the ceiling had a bulge and water was dripping in..right above the electric socket and down the wall. We were scared about the water near the electrics so ran into the bathroom to grab towels initially...only to find that the bathtub was Full of soggy wet plaster. The ceiling had come away in the bathroom and fallen into the bath! We got dressed and checked out straight away... When we told the lady about the issues of the leak above the electrics and the ceiling collapsing...she just laughed and said...this hotel is old and cheap..
We were so angry we just got out of there! A couple over heard us complaining and followed us to say they had been bitten to death by bedbugs and found a cockroach in there wardrobe!
We also got told by police that this hotel is known for hookers walking the corridors, drugs and a lady was murdered in 2008!!
If ONLY we had read the reviews before booking!! They are all true!!!! Worst hotel EVER!!! Cant believe its still open! Someone needs to shut the place down!! Sleeping in the hotel lobby was actually nicer than the room!!!!

The phone and lamp were so dirty, after afew seconds staring at the sight, we went back to the lobby , pretty much to ask, WTF. Customer service was horrible. review_title: I should have trusted the reviews!!
review_text:
I have just returned back from new York, after staying at the hotel carter for 5nights. I really wanted to give this hotel an okay review after all the negative views i read I generally thought it couldn't possibly be that bad. I bring towels and sheets from home just incase which we did need! The towels did not get changed throughout the whole time we was there and the excuse was that the maid couldn't open our door to clean it. This was a pretty funny comment considering my partners IPod went missing from our room on the second day after we stupidly left it on the bed that morning. The reception told us they'd look into it and I spoke to the manager everyday to check whether there was any news, on the last day I asked again and got a reply "there's nothing we can do about it, you should of made a police complaint". Yet noone decided to tell us this from the beginning. As for the rest of the reviews they could not be more accurate the hotel is dirty, carpets look as though they have been there for ages you can literally feel the amount of filth on them (wear flip-flops at all times), reception are rude, your belongings will go missing, sheets ate dirty, tv rarely works. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone not even if you are out most of the time! If you have already booked and there's no time to cancel then just prepare yourself for the worse, bring towels and sheets, lock up your belongings and spend most of your time outside the hotel! 
Please listen to these reviews or you may be in the same position I was.

We stayed in the Carter from August 8th-11th of this year (2011). We were both a little nervous about this place after reading some of the reviews people wrote about this place. When you first walk into the lobby you can automatically tell the building is extremely old and has never been completely renovated. Literally everything from the carpeting, to the front desk, to the elevator doors are old and weathered. Check in was quick and easy and we didn't have any problems with our reservation. When we got up to our room however, our key cards didn't work and we could not get into the room. So I went back down stairs and informed the front desk of the problem. The gentleman working the front desk tried to activate the cards again but when I got back up to our 7th floor room they still didn't work so I had to go back down. I was a little frustrated at this point but I remained polite and the front desk called the manager, his name was Minh, he was very polite and helpful and he immediately came up to our room and took care of the problem. When we entered the room it was FAR from fancy but after a quick inspection we found no signs of bed bugs, no mice or rats, and no trash or dirt. The mattress had a clean mattress cover on it, and the sheets and the bedspread were clean as well. Our room was small. It had just enough room for the bed, a desk, nightstand, and a TV stand. The furniture was extremely old and beat up and had graffiti in it but served it's purpose. Our room also had a small closet, which came in handy for my wife. The tile on the bathroom floor was clean, the sink and the shower were clean, and we had what looked to be a brand new toilet, which was also clean. You can tell the bathroom had been thoroughly scrubbed down before our arrival. We had 3 clean towels, but no wash cloths. Just a word of advice.. If you stay in this hotel bring your own towels and wash cloths, or hang your towels after using them because they won't bring clean ones to your room unless you go to the front desk and ask them for clean ones. It would also be a good idea to bring a trash bag or two because they don't clean the room during your stay either. The walls in our room had no artwork or anything on it, which was no big deal to us. They had what looked to be a fresh coat of a lavender colored paint, and the ceiling was white. The room was very small and plain, but that was ok with us, it served it's purpose. The carpeting in the room was very old and worn out but it was vacuumed clean. The door to the room was sturdy and had 3 different locks on it so we felt safe. Just don't plan on watching much TV because we only got 3 channels. Two of them were news channels an the other one was cartoon network. We didn't spend much time in the room during our stay anyway. We were out Times Square most of the time. The location and the price of this hotel can't be beat. You are literally a half block a way from Times Square, and everything is within walking distance. Fine restaurants, theaters, shopping, night clubs.. Anything you could want in NY is a short walk away. All the people that posted reviews and said this hotel is a nightmare are wrong. It's clean, and there were no bed bugs or rats!! I think people take the fact that it's an extremely old building and associate that with being dirty. We had no problems with this hotel and would definitely stay here again. For 99 dollars a night you can't beat this hotel. Anywhere else in Times Square you'll be paying 300 bucks a night if not more. I would definitely recommend this hotel to a friend.

stayed for 3 nights in july for a long weekend getaway with my friend. I booked the room via hotels.com. The rooms do not look like the photos on the website. My room was horrible the floors had stains on them and there were dead flies and a huge cockaroach 3 inches long in the wardrobe! I complained to the staff and they showed me another room, which looked a bit better, so I took the 2nd room. But when I lay my head to sleep that evening, the pillow smelled like someone took a dump on the bed!! This is not a hotel! This is a 2 star shelter halfway house. Garbage by the elevators were there when we checked in on thursday and still there when we checked out on monday! Please invest a few extra dollars and stay in a cleaner place. I learned my lesson. The most frustrating thing over all has to be the wi-fi. Yes there is wifi in every room, but at a ridiculous price. It was $15 for 24 hours for one device. 
However, the location is excellent, especially the proximity to grand central, and we saw sacha baron Cohen there filming his new film, so it wasn't all bad.

review_title: Have a sense of humor about it.
review_text: Okay, everyone. Calm down for a second. I booked this hotel a few weeks ago for a last-minute trip to New York without really looking into it much. Once I started reading the reviews, I was terrified to stay there, but my friend and I decided to give it a go anyway, and it's not that bad. Yes, the lobby is grimy and some of the staff members are pretty shady looking. The carpet was pretty dirty and disgusting, and I wouldn't suggest walking around barefoot. Bring flip flops for the shower or something. Anyway, a soon as we entered the room we tore the sheets off the bed and flipped the mattress to look for bed bugs. We didn't find any and neither of us ever had any bites, so I have no reason to think that there were bed bugs. We did, however, buy some cheap blankets at a Walgreens around the corner and we slept with those rather than under the sheets. There are basically zero amenities, so if you were expecting the Hilton, you should probably stay somewhere else. However, not many people I know go to New York City to sit in a hotel room, so if you're like us and just need a shower and a place to sleep, this will be just fine. I wouldn't want to stay there for a long period of time, but for just a few days, it served its purpose. If you have a good sense of humor, it's actually pretty hilarious. It just added more character to our trip, and now we get to say that we survived the dirtiest hotel in America!
Watch your charges on your credit cards and service desk is dry and rude.
