We stayed in the Hilton millennium in November 2011. After cheekily asking the hotel we got an upgrade to a suite room which was very beautiful and had a living room area as well as a bedroom. 
The room was on the 50th floor which gave us great views of the city and also of the world trade centre site. While we were there we witnessed the builders filling the site with water. 
On our first night there we took a look inside the mini bar. However once we had finished investigating we saw a sign saying that any items handled would automatically be charged onto our bill! I've never come across this kind of sensor technology so was quite surprised. Right away we called the reception area and explained we hadn't taken anything out, just handled a couple of bottles. They were very nice about it and said they would wipe the charges off our account right away. So be sure not to play around in the mini bar unless you actually want to consume the products. 
Food and drink in the hotel is quite expensive so try to venture outside to local cafes and shops. Two bottles of still water were $11! So don't purchase much there. 
There is a subway station right outside the hotel which is the R line and goes to central park, times square and other tourist attractions. 
Getting around is pretty easy and the new Yorkers are very friendly so don't hesitate to ask directions.

review_title: The view overlooking the new construction of the world trade centers and the memorial was mesmerizing .
review_text:
My wife and I stayed at this hotel and it was very nice .The view we had from our room overlooked the new construction and the memorial.
Our tv was never turned on because I was always watching the team work of the construction guys rebuilding the towers . The service from the staff was excellent . Transportation from there is easy , 
You can catch the subway right out front or cabs are always on stand by . Very nice hotel .

As I read through these posts, I can see how opinions bounce around a little. I imagine there's a significant variance between deluxe and executive rooms at this hotel. Considering that the rooms are expectedlu small - add to that "plain" and it might be disappointing for the money. However, our executive class room, still small, is beautiful and has remarkable views. It is extremely quiet even though our room wraps around the elevator (I expected the worst with that, but I can't hear a thing.)
The staff is very friendly, eager to help. If the concierge is unavailable, the front desk staff is knowlegeable about restaurants and haven't failed us yet. 
The location of this place is fantastic, literally two blocks from Times Square's TKTS booth. We are within a few blocks of most theaters and half a block from restaurant row on 9th avenue. Subway access is easy as well. One small warning when reading NYC reviews; Manhattan blocks are twice as wide as they are long - if precise walking distance is important to you, look at a map to get your bearings. 
This hotel, with its wonderful staff and location, is an easy recommendation - especially for the money. Barring any conflicts forthcoming, I am excited about the rest of our stay. For now, though, time to nestle down in this big, comfortable bed a while longer. Thanks Belvedere!

Located in a happening district on Manhattan, you can't miss the hotel from the outside because of it's round windows. Staff were friendly and helpful. Our room has three of the round windows I mentioned along with modern, cool, good quality furnishings, done tastefully. It feels special. 
Outdoor pool has a novel 'beach' - I preferred the rooftop bar which has a stunning view. Maybe one day I'll get to DJ here ! Unfortunately, this time we couldn't access the rooftop bar as it was closed off for a private party going on, unfortunate ( not sure if it that was a one off due to the hotel just opening?) However, overall, this hotel is the business, I'd come back.

Arrived mid morning on a cold, rainy day having walked 10 blocks from the bus
 Although check in was not until 4pm the front desk gave me my room immediately. With a smile!
Great theater location

review_title: Ideal hotel when visiting New York.
review_text:
The room was not over sized but you do not go to The Big Apple to sit in your room. The bath room was in good order and the maids kept it topped up with soaps and shampoo etc. The bar was average price with excelant food on sale. Tick tock diner was great value. 
From the hotel you can walk to central park in 30 mins, Macy's in under 10 mins if you get moving. You can also go to Bowling Green within an hour. All in all great hotel.

review_title: If your looking for a great central hub in manhatten this a great choice.
review_text: The New Yorker, what to say, typical ny small rooms, older style with few in room modern ammenities. Staff is fantastic and will go out of their way to help how ever they can. Super clean and a very safe feeling both inside and out. Mcdonalds across the street, great bar in the hotel and a cafe on the corner. Excellent. Now the problems, the furnishings are oldish and could stand to be more modern retro. The rooms dont offer a coffee pot and their isnt vending or ice on every floor. All minor problems. Their are a few bums that hang out outside but hey, its New York. The doorman act more like security and less like guest services and im not sure but they act like their in cahoots with the cabs their so Id say walk a block and hail your own. Overall, loved it and for the price I would definately go back

review_text: stayed just one night and really enjoyed it. large room, no noise, free water bottles...whats not to love.
We stayed one week and everything went well from check in to check out. Rooms are tidy and clean. Service is great and friendly. It is very near to key locations ans subway

review_title: Excellent location to Financial District / WTC Memorial / Battery Park!
review_text:
Basic but new and clean rooms. Great rates and very friendly staff. I love this hotel as it is dependably good!
Two things though:
1) No hair conditioner
2) Bring earplugs because the construction on the WTC Memorial can be heard throughout the night (literally the entire night)

review_title: Great location, water dispenser, complimentary drink, great view.
review_text: Very impressed with the view (rm 1516) and the purified water dispenser in the hallway was awesome. Coffee machine in the lobby brewed excellent coffee and the lobby was very relaxing. Room was decent size (queen with pull out love seat). Parking right next door. Subway real close as well as excellent breakfast nearby. Restaurant on 20th floor nice option. Complimentary drink was a plus.

Overall, my stay at Club Quarters WTC was great. The location, while not in the thick of tourist activities, was convenient. Several subway lines are within 2-5 minutes walk. Despite what I'd read prior to my arrival, the area is not deserted at night. There definitely aren't crowds of people after dark, but there are several big hotels nearby, and enough bars and pizza/fast food places around that there were always cabs driving around and people walking about, even at 1:00 in the morning. The front desk staff were very helpful and professional. Housekeeping was similarly well-maintained, although the bathroom in my room did smell mildewy. I suspect this has more to do with the lack of ventilation and cheap shower curtain in the bathroom than lack of housekeeping. People who complained that their sheets weren't being changed must not have read the laminated card that was placed on the bed on arrival. If you want fresh sheets, you must put the card on your bed, otherwise they will simply make your bed with the existing sheets. This is clearly explained and certainly not unique to this hotel. Same thing applies for towels (leave them on the floor if you want fresh towels). We originally booked a standard room with queen bed, but upgraded to a much larger room with mini-fridge and microwave for an extra $20/night, and it was surprisingly roomy for Manhattan. The WTC construction really is 24/7, but we requested a room on a higher floor, on the opposite side away from the construction, and we couldn't hear it at all. We DID hear the elevators going all night long. Our room must have shared a wall with the elevator shaft and the walls are thin. I was also disappointed that there wasn't a safe in the room to lock up valuables. 
My only true complaint about the hotel, however, is with the restaurant. We went there once, for breakfast, and did not have a good experience. The food was fine, but I was not impressed with the service. The hostess did not crack a smile even once. She looked like she truly loathed her job. When we arrived, she offered us the worst table in the place. When I asked for a different table (one that wasn't in the middle of a nearly empty room, in the path of the main aisle used by the servers), she robotically brought us us to a better table and said, "Here," before walking away. Thirty seconds later, a server came and told us not to sit at that table because we were only two people, and told us to "sit there", while pointing to a smaller table. We had the buffet, which was fine, however I was irritated to find that they tacked an automatic 18% gratuity on the bill, which I do not think is warranted for a buffet, ESPECIALLY since I had to flag someone down to get coffee and to get a menu, and since the bill was dropped on my table before we'd even finished our first plate. I took a small portion of eggs, not wanting to heap my plate with food and look like a slob, and intended to go back for some fruit, but I was so irritated when our "server" dropped the bill on the table when I was still eating (without asking if I wanted anything more), that I had to leave. The automatic gratuity was just icing on the cake. 
Aside from the restaurant, I'd return to this hotel in a heartbeat. Good location, helpful staff, convenient amenities, and GREAT value.

We booked a basic room for 2 - turned out to be a 2x2 cell block!! There was a double (not queen) bed and less then one metre one side and 20cm the other side. Horrible and cramped! Uncomfortable hard bed! The staff were rude and unhelpfull! We had changed our flights and needed longer accomodation, we asked about extending our stay, the lady at reception just gave us attitude and told us it aS going to be a rediculous $$, so we changed hotels.The view was ok. The bathrooms were cramped and moldy! Location is ok but on busy road with lotsa traffic.

review_title: Cheaper than the average, ok location
review_text:
Rooms: not the biggest, but thats the norm in NYC. They are all like serviced apartments. 
A nice feature of the hotel is to offer filtered cold water bottles on every floor. 
Location is right opposite the trade centre and not noisy at all. 
The hotel has a nice rooftop bar on L20.

review_title: Ubicacion perfecta a un precio razonable !
review_text: Voy a volver a este hotel cada vez que vaya a NY. Limpio, atencion amable y muy bien ubicado. Perfecto que tenga conexion wifi.

L'hotel e' splendidamente posizionato nel cuore di Manhattan a due passi da Times square. Ottimo rapporto qualitÃ  prezzo.
Nei dintorni ci sono un sacco di caratteristici ristorantini in cui cenare o semplicemente prendere un ottimo aperitivo.
La colazione inclusa nel prezzo e' self sevice e la si puo' gustare nella corte interna veramente carina.
Il personale e'estremamente gentile.

review_title: The Best Hotel In NYC-amazing price!
review_text: I stayed at this hotel last weekend. It was one of the cheapest hotels we could find in NYC so when I saw the nice photos and 4star rating, I thought I would show up and be disappointed. But the hotel was exactly like the photos. The staff was super helpful and courteous. I have paid double the price for hotel n NYC and was not nearly as happy with the quality of my stay. Love this hotel!

I came to new York city for he first te this year with four of my girlfriends. We just had a ball. The hotel is in a prime location of NYC. The staff were friendly and helpful. The hotel had staff to ensure only guests were entering the hotel. The room was a little small or average for a new York city hotel. Great hotel. Would definatly return to it again;)

review_title: Excellent location great having some where to eat on site
review_text: Some rooms are small, family rooms are good size but hay you only sleep in the room very clean and friendly staff. we were a large party of 27 and would say we would all stay in this hotel again it's in such a good location

This was our first trip to New York and we selected the hotel from a Travel Agent's brochure. We were given a room with a fabulous view towards the Empire State building. The room was very clean and food in the Tick Tock Diner was good. Check-in was the most dissapointing feature of the Hotel, we were not welcomed at all. The hotel is a great landmark in the city and convenient for everything. We will come back.

I called in at 3:30 the day before my reservation to cancel. I talked to Mike and informed him that I was just informed that I had mandatory pre-deployment training for the next day. He informed me I had to cancel by noon and I was 3 1/2 late. I asked him if he could waive it since I had nothing to do with my plans changing. He informed me that he had to charge me the full nights rate. To me that is horrible customer service. I gave a 26 hour notice and I had no control over this. I will make sure to spread the word about this hotel being non-military friendly.

review_title: What kind of hotel room has NO BED!!!
review_text: Seriously, my room had only a sofa bed. No real bed. Horrible. Shame on you.

Staff helpful, room upgrade to view empire state building foc! Will have many happy memories of our wedding day there as we were made to feel really special, thank The New Yorker! Hopefully be back soon!

review_title: Dirty and staff needs a seminar on friendliness.
review_text: Will never go again. I'm embarrassed that I took my guests there.

review_title: Super hotel-totally made my first stay in NYC!
review_text: When we arrived just before lunch time, one of our rooms was not quite ready (we were early for check in). They happily gave us the one room key so we could leave our bags. When we returned that night, we were given our second room key and shown to our room which was amazing! On the 30thfloor with a fantastic view of the empire state and chrystler building! It was thanksgiving while we were there and we were given loads of advice on where to go to watch the parade and the cheapest places to buy bus tickets etc. the tick tick diner was a great place to eat late at night and soak in the atmosphere, definitely the city that never sleeps! The hotel is in a great location, 5 mins walk from times square. I had such an amazing week, wouldn't hesitate to book here again! Holiday was booked with Thompson

review_title: Good location but that's about it
review_text:
Centrally located next to Madison Square Gardens and the art deco lobby is pretty spectacular but it just sets you up for a bigger disappointment when you get out of the lift and walk along a dark, dingy corridor with flickering lights and peeling paint.
Our room was the tiniest I've seen, smaller than student halls even and was well in need of a revamp. Out of the 3 stops on our honeymoon, this was the only hotel that didn't do anything to acknowledge it and generally the staff were very harsh & abrupt.

Great location, close to Penn Station, Macy's and Port Authority Bus Terminal. Rooms were small and in need of updating. Super lobby and Tick Tock diner had fab breakfasts in great style. Get to breakfast pre 8.30am or there are queues!
Lovely hotel rooms tad small to be expected be prepared to que half N hour to check in and any other time you need to talk to reception and not that friendly at all!!

We have just come back from a 4 night stay here and had a great time. However I feel the check in experience was spoiled by Mohammed, who made it too obvious he was wanting a tip for what he said was " upgrading us"! He kept telling us we had only booked a basic room and he had managed to upgrade us, and how we should come back to reception to thank him if we were happy with the room. He even called us in the room after abut 5 mins to ask if we liked the room. On the way out I gave him a $ 50 bill, as a thank you, he wasn't that impressed. The tic tick diner is attached to the hotel and serves good basic food, but still can't believe they give you a card at the end of your meal suggesting you should leave at least 15, 18, or 20% . The hotel also has a bar/restaurant attached but at $10 for a wine and $ 10 for a beer is pricey, and the service isn't that good either. One show I say is a " Must" is Times Scare ! Turn left out of the lobby, keep on the same side of the street and after approx 10 mins your there ! There's a magic show, and a scary tour afterwards or before ( it is unreal don't miss it ) there is also a trendy bar in here with nice people. Your only a 5-10 min walk from Time Square, Broadway etc. There is a big ticket office there, and we went about 5.30 pm and got discount ( 40% off) tkts for the 7pm show for that night. We found the transfer driver from the airport very rude, never talked to anyone, threw the cases in, even talked and txt on his mobile while driving ( pretty much the same on the way back ). The average price of a beer or a wine was about 7-10$ ( plus they expect $1 each time you get a drink. The hotel charges you $1.50 to leave your bags and another $ 1.50 to pick them up, with a $1 tip each time as well. Hotel staff seem friendly, and remember your room card or you won't get past security. Enjoy.

review_title: Brilliant hotel will be back to stay again
review_text:
Stayed I this hotel dec 2011, staff were friendly and very helpful, rooms were very clean, beds were really comfortable just what you needed after along day of shopping and sight seeing. The location of te hotel was brilliant on the same street as maceys and the empire state building and only a short walk from times square. The tick tock dinner was great the service was brilliant the food was lovely, the coffee bar in the lobby was really handy to grab a quick coffee an pastry to bring up to your room. 
Overall my stay in this hotel was brilliant and I would recommend it to anyone going to new York
Great hotel would would highly recommend it the Tick Tock diner which is part of the hotel is amazing.

The hotel is in Hell's Kitchen and very close to the theaters and gay nightlife. The lobby is surprisingly nice, and the staff are very courteous. review_title: Worst service I've ever had at a hotel.
review_text:
I stayed at the New Yorker Hotel the weekend of the 11th and checked out the next day. Although we only stayed there for a day, it was one of the worst experiences that Ive had EVER!! 
I am in the hospitality industry and know all the bad things and delays that could happen, but the problem here was not the hotel but the people working there. They were rude and when we asked questions about directions, they would say that it wasn't their job to find that out for us. Also during check in, they said that we cancelled our reservation when we clearly didn't and after around half an hour of saying we did not cancel, she finally "found" it. 
I have been to several hotels in new York and only stayed here because if the closeness to the Javits Center that my convention was at. But never again.
Have a great holiday and hotel was lovely and clean and tidy
Very good location. Rooms were kind of small but very neat and comfortable. Nice bar in hotel. Would definitely stay there again!

I've stayed at this hotel 6 or 7 times over the last few years. It's probably the most consistent hotel I've found in NYC in terms of service quality and rooms. Rooms are good size by NYC standards and ammenities are above average. Clean, well maintained, good service, excellent management. It's also a great location, being situated on 44th. It's a great hotel in a city with most hotels being average at best.
Brilliant welcome, fab service, great breakfast, roomwas spacious with fantastic facilities including kitchen with fridge and dishwasher! Will stay again soon.

My favorite part of the hotel was the lobby. Wonderfully done, and a nice oasis from the busy streets of New York.
Other than the absent doorman/busboy service when we arrived (arond 11pm), our stay was wonderful.
Happy travels!

Staff went out of their way to make us feel good. Salena was wonderful to us during breakfast.
Rooms are quite small, but that is expected in a city like New York. Hotel looks like it's been recently remodeled and staff keeps it ultra clean. Did not really expect a Hampton Inn to be this nice.

review_text:

U cannot beat this hotel, save yourself from reading a ton of reviews on other hotels and just book the new yorker cause u will have peace of mind and will defo not be disappointed!! My husband and I first trip to New York and we booked this holiday via expedia really good as it was recommend by them. I obviously checked reviews by trip advisor seemed pretty good. I am the most fussy person when it comes to hotels, anyways we checked in very tired because of the flight ( KLM best service ) our room toilet door did not shut at all and a musky smell was in the air. We were sooo tired we waited until the morning and explain everything to the hotel reception. She was so nice service with a smile is important to me and I could not fault her nor any of the staff very helpful and friendly. There is no in room safe which a lot of hotels do not have at New York but it's very easy and the staff are very helpful. Cleaners are very welcoming too. I personally would not rate tick tock dinner as there is an amazing take away foot steps away from the hotel (when u walk out of the hotels it to ur left) and starbucks and mcdonalds are opposite the hotel too. Brilliant location too every things was just 10 mins away from each other time square was 10 mins macys literally down the road. I really enjoyed my stay hope you find this helpful.

review_title: Good, newer Hilton in super location, views and excellent staff.
review_text:
Staying at this newer - opened 18 months ago - Hilton right now. I'm gazing at The Empire State Building from our room on the 20th floor with amazing views. 
This is a new, smaller, hipper style hotel for Hilton, more akin to a W Hotel but without the pretentiousness. I'm not a huge fan of the decor, but it wasn't designed for people like me - lovers of everything old world - in mind. Nonetheless everything functions very well.
The rooms while small - actually slightly above average in size for nyc - have been very smartly designed and lack for nothing. They also feature an industrial power a/c unit that can keep the room freezing cold. Bathrooms are well laid out and efficient.
The staff has been excellent. Always efficient and friendly. My only two slight complaints: 1) the elevators take too long to come - they must not have installed enough for the traffic, and 2) the security guard in the lobby for the rooftop bar - seems a tad pretentious.
Otherwise, Hilton fashion district is another fine addition to the world's best hotel family.

review_title: Extremely good value for money, friendly staff, great location.
review_text:
We checked into our hotel for a 5 day stay. As there are many Hampton Inn properties we were unsure where we were going to be or what o expect. As thus is our last evening in NYC I felt I had to let you all know that I HIGHLY recommend this property to you all, rooms are very clean and comfortable, breakfast is excellent though can be a battle some days. The staff are very accommodating and the free coffee/tea and hot chocolate on tap 24/7 were unexpected. Only down side to this hotel is no where to get water or keep bottled water cool in your room
The location of the hotel is close enough to times square without being in the noise and hubbub of the crowds, took less than 5 minutes to walk to the centre of times square, 15/20 minutes walk to circle line pier for cruise and 20 minute subway ride to Brooklyn.
Give it a try you won't be dissatisfied or disappointed, I wasn't and I am a self confessed hotel snob!!!!
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Manhattan / Times Square South

review_text: I'm staying here as I type this review. It's between 9am and 10am in the morning and the housekeeping staff is SO loud! They are talking loudly in the hallways and banging around in the room next to ours - literally shaking the walls. Really? I get that you have a job to do, but recognize that this is a hotel and that there are guests in these rooms.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Manhattan / Times Square South

review_text: The rooms are small but who spends a whole day there when your in new York.. The hotel is clean, the service is great, wifi is awesome. A little street noise but nothing headphones can't fix. A little wait on elevators but it didn't bother us. Street is a little suss at night but in general great location! Check in and out was fast. No dramas. Great hotel.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Manhattan / Times Square South

review_text: As I get older I am placing a higher value on quiet rooms. This hotel room I had was not quiet. The fan in the a/c would turn off and on even though I had it turn on high and not auto. I was put near the elevator and heard it arrive, depart, hear how much fun the occupants were going to have. I was also on the third floor and my view was nothing. Thank you Hilton for treating a diamond member like talc.
Front Desk staff (especially Robert) was very helpful. I can't wait to stay here again next time I'm in NYC
We reserved a Suite with a King size bed and they only had a Queen size! Call the concierge for a restaurant recommendation and they never got back to us!

review_title: Loved the location. The air con/heating left me with no sleep!
review_text: I'm really bad at sleeping with earplugs so every half an hour or so when the heating unit fired up it woke me. The room was very small for four people. Saying that tho the staff were lovely, the hotel was clean and the complimentary coffee on the way out was perfect! I loved NYC

review_title: Poor service at upper west side hotel
review_text: Poor service, unfriendly staff at front desk, not a memorable experience

review_title: Modern chic, with just the right amount of flare!
review_text: This was our favorite boutique hotel during our honeymoon! Luckily it ended our honeymoon with fashion & style on our final night in NYC. The staff was friendly & accommodating. The room was perfect & clean! The location was superb! The hotel ranks 5 stars easily! We loved the whole experience & definitely a night to remember!!

review_title: Good quality hotel in a great location
review_text:
If you need to stay in the UWS, OTA is modern, clean and safe. I was surprised by the modern decor, TV etc.
Who cares what size the rooms are when you're asleep?! Big bathroom though.
Small complaints: perfunctory desk staff, noisy in-room fridge, low fixed shower head.
Big complaints: no free wifi ($14 per day?!) and rip off minibar, even for a minibar ($10 1L water +tax) but hey, the headline room rate is cheap, so go to a corner deli, and any bar/restaurant/starbucks for free wifi.
(OTA please note this is the 21st century, if you charge for wifi, why not for electricity, water, etc.?)

I booked this hotel through Expedia undisclosed program where you only know the rating of the hotel but not its name before you book it. This hotel was advertised as a 4-star hotel but it was definitely not one. The lobby was unmemorable. We had to go through the security in order to use the elevators. The bathroom in our room needed a renovation and the list goes on. More than the hotel, I am disappointed with Expedia for advertising this hotel on their site as a 4-star.

review_title: Amazing rooms at an affordable rate in NYC!
review_text: Would defintely stay at this hotel again! The rooms are clean, beds are really comfortable, and the bathrooms are amazing. The bathroom was stocked with loccitane products, had a huge soaking rub and separate shower. This hotel was also conveniently located to grand central station, the Bryant park subway stop, and only a few blocks from Times Square. This place was luxurious yet very affordable compared to other high end NYC hotels.

review_title: An Oasis in busy New York
review_text:
Upon entering the lobby we were warmly greeted by one of the staff who led us to the front desk where the extremely professional staff checked us in ever so efficiently. We splurged a little and stayed in a suite which was beautiful! The bathroom was luxurious, the linen and towels were also first class. 
During our stay all of our interactions and observations of the staff show just how good this hotel is. A porter ran quite a way down the road to hail a taxi for us. I also noticed them carrying bags for people in the rain down to 5th avenue when the street was closed due to a parade. 
The peacefulness and serenity of the hotel also helped us to relax after a hectic day in New York City. I would definitely stay there again!

Great neighbourhood if you hate the crowd of Times Square like I do and love the ambiance of Chelsea, the Village and Meatpacking District like I do. Great service, all employees greeted us with a smile. I read some reviews here that said that they could hear everything what happened behind walls and it took ages to take the elevator. I spent 3 nights here in room 1209 just in front of the elevator and that never ever happened to me. Rooms are small but the bed it's so comfy that I didn' care about room space. Closet is tiny so it's better to keep clothes on the luggage. Coffee and tea for free in the room and delicious mini cupcakes for free in the lobby are a nice touch. Wi-fi isn't for free in the room. I thought that was a drawback at first but then I was happy that I could stay a bit disconnected. And there are 2 computers in the lobby I could use to surf the web. Don't hesitate to stay here!
Great hotel,perfect location right opposite central park and 15 min walk to times square.

We had room 1228, 12th floor, above broadway. Windows are poor quality and let filter the street noise like they are opened!!
The room is clean but not perfect (bathroom)
Service was adequate but not excellent.
Internet is not free except in the lobby.
Great sky view on the 16th floor.

Located on broadway and 77th street on the upper west side of Manhattan it is convenient to many of the sites but safely away from the crowds and tourist traps. We took our two dogs and spent some great afternoons at Central & Riverside Parks. The service was very good especially at the front desk.
This place is all about the convenience of an excellent midtown location. Rooms are small but clean. My room seemed as if it had recently been update. I would consider this a 3 star hotel.

This is my 2nd stay at this hotel. Love the location - one block from just about everything and Times Square. Room was ready and very clean. We stayed on 9th floor and my only complaint is elevator is kinda slow. I'd rather stay on 4th or below so I could use stairs. Breakfast is very good with eggs' sausage, bagels, doughnuts and 24 hour coffee. U r half mile from Penn station for Amtrak and we hoped on subway and were at ground zero in half hour. Definitely stay again

review_title: So much better than I was hoping!!!!
review_text: My boyfriend and I stayed here the week of thanksgiving, and I have nothing bad to say really, yes the room was small but hey who sits in there hotel room in NYC?! The shower was really powerful and the bathroom was clean, there wasn't a view but we were out in the city and didn't wanna stare out of a window anyway!! The breakfast was included and had so much choice, we were really pleased with it, and to top it off we walked literally 30 seconds and were in times square! The staff were all friendly and we would defiantly stay here again!!

review_title: The service at the front door made the stay worth it.
review_text: This was our first time at the fashion 26 and we were taking chance because we usually stay at the midtown location. I am now a fan of Hilton 26. The rooms were just ok but I received world class service and hospitality especially from a young man named Brandon. This young man went above and beyond to help us in any way possible. That kind of service will definitely make us here when we return to New York City. Thank you for making our stay worthwhile.

review_title: They seem to not want to clean
review_text: This looks like a semi posh place to stay from the pictures but don't be fooled. Upon arriving they checked us into a dirty room where the beds weren't made. They didn't even aplogize. The on site manager seemed particularly bothered snd barely noticed me. After getting into my "clean room" I discovered half eaten groceries in the honor bar and an empty bag of food on the floor. Although the check out lady was very sweet, I would not stay here again.

review_title: Worth a stay 20seconds to times square
review_text:
Good clean rooms yes a little small for 4 people but it was clean which is more important bed,s are comfortable ,bathrooms clean staff friendley,lift was never a problem and breakfast was ok just 20 seconds to times square would I stay there again yes I would not a bad price compared to other hotels in times square thank u very much for makeing our stay trouble free Belinda Liam england 
Q

This is right in the heart of Times Square, perfect location and great value for the location. The room was nice but really small and didn't have a fridge, which is a problem if you like to eat a lot on vacations as we do. There is no place for leftovers and you end up throwing out a lot of food. The hotel in general was small but service was good and it was clean. I would stay there again.

review_title: Clean, comfy and does the job
review_text: We were well welcomed into the hotel. The rooms are of a decent size for new York. Everywhere was very clean. Free Internet access in the lobbey. Staff and concierge were very friendly and helpful. Couldn't fault it one bit , however the cleaner did walk in on me while I was in the shower......what is it with this hotel and the cleaners :-)

review_title: Fantastic hotel - new, modern and first class service
review_text: Stumbled upon this hotel on expedia - photos looked good, but hotel even better in te flesh. A good 4 star - everything is new and modern, including the comfortable beds, flat screen tv and power shower. The staff and service was amongst the friendliest and best I have experienced in the USA. Additionally, the hotel has an excellent concierge service (complemented by a knowledgable front desk team too) which we used at least once a day, plus the RARE grill restaurant is a hidden gem - great food and reasonably priced.

Friendly employees upon arrival, was able to sit at roof top bar early in the evening but it was always reserved in the evenings. Room was clean and a decent size for a manhattan king room. Overall, I did not have any complaints- and I am really picky when it comes to here I lay my head down at night!

review_title: Great Location at a fair price
review_text: 3 adults and 1 child shared a 2double bed room and even though the room is small (normal for Manhattan) it worked out well...decent breakfast...good service etc. No problems getting the one elevator and we were on 7th floor. Great location..what else is there to say!

Pros: good location, very nice stuff, free coffee, pool (I didn't visit), nice street entrance, rooftop bar (open 5-11pm)
Cons: a bit small room, a bizzare system to go to the 1st floor in order to get to the rooftop bar even if you are 1 floor away (but it was even fun), this bar hours of operation, Internet access being expencive (but later they gave login and password for a free use).
Overall very pleasant experience, I would recommend it for shopping purposes, business, and romantic if you don't plan to stay too much time in the room :)

Four stars? And not even a breakfast service.
Elevators are used by staff and the ride could take ages, when both cars are available , which was not the case. On a 3 nights stay one elevator was out of service 2 days!
I met a customer in the lobby that told me that this situation happened at least twice this year.

review_title: Great location, very comfortable and good value!
review_text: Very friendly staff on arrival, clean and comfortable room. Hotel is in an excellent location, very close to Central Park and lots of good restaurants and shops. This was our third visit!

review_title: Location is ok but staff are not friendly
review_text: The reason that l choosed this hotel is the location and reviews about the hotel.But when we arrived to the hotel we were a little bit surprised because of the cleanliness.The pillows were not clean enough and there were some stains on them.The staff who work in the lobby and entrance were not friendly.They were not willing to help.

This was our first trip to NYC and it was fab because we stayed at the sofitel, we had good views the bed was really comfortable and the room was clean, the staff were friendly and there was just nothing that we could fault it was that nice I still keep going on about it and desperate to return again soon.

The hotel is in a great spot, a 1 minute walk to Times Square. The breakfast was ok, not great, not bad. The room was tiny but that's to be expected, like one of the other posters on here said , it's not that clean if you look close, well they were right, so I just didn't look close, but let's just say it was obvious that the bed skirt and spread was not washed in a bit. I would stay there again because of the great location, wifi also worked great!

I stayed at the New Yorker for a week in October 2010. I thought it was just okay. The room was very dark and we had a few instances of staff being a bit on the abrupt side. One thing to definitely avoid - Tick Tock Diner. The fries were like cardboard and the service was non-existent. Location is amazing for Broadway and Empire State building, which we went up at midnight and had no queues and an amazing time! Probably wouldn't stay here again though.

review_title: Could be great if there were services....
review_text:
Great location (close to Central Park and Colombus circle), but the lack of services downgrades the overall impression : no breakfast, no bar, no restaurant... It is just a collection of top price bedrooms. 
We paid 370$ a night for the first night and 160$ for an additional night....
Anyway pleasant stay very friendly staff, it is a shame because the hotel has everything to be great.
Great Hotel,Best location in the heart of Times Square!!! Great rooms and great service!!!

Many annoyances for this hotel, but will start with the good points first :) 
My spouse and I were there for 5 days. Chose it for the history and location.
It was good for:
1. The location. Look up the map and u'll see what I mean.
It was awful for:
1. Housekeeping who wouldn't stop ringing the doorbell from 8am. This was despite a 'do not disturb' sign being placed on the door knob. They insisted that they have to start cleaning the room by 10am because they have a tight schedule everyday! Otherwise, they will not have time to do it. They did this throughout our stay. And because of point #1 above, the problem was not solved. Did I say the front desk was not helpful as well?
3. Tiny room. Enough floor space for only 1 luggage with minimal walking space.
4. Very old bathroom that desperately needs some upgrading. From shower head that sprays water in ALL directions, rendering the walls and surrounding floor wet, to moldy walls, worn down toilet bowl and flush system... You get my point.
I will never go back, history or not. And I do not recommend this hotel at al.

My wife and I had a wonderful stay at this hotel, ideally placed in the Upper West Side of NYC. The room was small but well fitted and comfortable with a nice view over Broadway. Since the hotel offers no breakfast, you can find a supermarket jut across the avenue where you can buy everything you need, at any time, for a gorgious breakfast. In addition, the nearest underground station is round the corner and Central Park at 5 min. walking distance.

review_title: So glad we chose On The Ave!
review_text:
We had originally booked a three star hotel in Times Square for our 7 night stay in NYC. Just a few nights before we were to leave we started to rethink our choice of hotels. A friend had suggested to check out On The Ave so we did some research and decided to cancel our reservation made previously and book with On The Ave. Best decision we made the whole trip.
We had been reading about how tiny the rooms are in NYC. I was pleasantly surprised with the size of our room. Closet space was great, large shower.king sized bed, great bed linens, we had a great view.
Great coffee served in the lobby, staff were very pleasant from desk staff, maids, bellmen, everyone! Supplying umbrellas was a great touch. We happened to be there for a very rainy day on Thursday and then had the great beautiful snow on Saturday!
Loved the neighborhood, so glad we decided not to stay in Times Square!
Thank you for making my 50th birthday even more special! We'll be back! Thanks from the Dozier's!

review_title: A good size clean room but lacking Sofitel's Service Standard
review_text:
If you are looking for a good size room (and bathroom) that is clean and bedbug free, this a good value for your money. However, the service level is very much three star level and not remotely close to what other Sofitel hotels give.
Loacation - good. Neat metro stop. Plenty of taxis.
Check In - quick, efficient, and hassle free. Really nice front desk and bellman staff.
Concierge - Utterly the worst I have ever experienced. We tried two restaurants and a bar, they recommended and both were very substandard. Plus they were extremely snobby. Save yourself the disappointment and ask a local.
The Room - good size and good size bathroom. Comfy bed and well appointed. The only odd thing was the iron was so ancient. Not a huge thing. More weird and out of place. 
Room Service - Eh... We just had large pot coffee delivered to the room each morning and the service was ok. They delivered on time but every morning forgot something. One morning it was the paper. The next it was the milk. Also, they did not do the little things other Sofitels do, like included a glass of ice water or a flower on the tray.
Dry-cleaning Service- horrible. Returned late and still partially wrinkled. For $22 for a suit (pressing only non express service), I really can not understand why it was late after having it for 12 hours. And still wrinkled? Horrible... Horrible... Horrible.
Unlike other Sofitels, it seemed that much of the staff wa just going through the motions. In all fairness, they did send up cake and give us breakfast because it was my birthday. But, as for "non special occasion" service, they fall short.
Again, get a great rate and you get a bed bug free room of solid size. Just be prepared for a lack of Sofitel service standard.
Courtyard Marriott is in the heart of Manhattan ... Door man always there to greet you and the hotel is kept in great condition. Great find!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott New York Manhattan / Midtown East

review_text:
First the bad - no free wifi anywhere in the hotel. This is to be expected from Hilton 
Good - clean and nicely furnished rooms with friendly staff. Location is great - close to Macy's st Herald Sq and close to Penn Station
Restaurant was expensive and food was average. I had a better burger at BRGR around the corner
I would stay here again

review_title: Huge corner rooms (not just by New York Standards)..
review_text: We were skeptical to stay away from our usual Times Square hotels; however, we loved this hotel and location.. so much bang for the buck! A corner room was given to us with no extra charge, and it was HUGE! Service, location, cleanliness, and staff were wonderful during our stay..
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott New York Manhattan / Midtown East

review_text: We loved this new, clean, convenient hotel. The upstairs terrace is great, free coffee in the lobby each morning, and in the heart of the vibrant Upper West Side. Only drawbacks were the lack of good lighting in the bathroom and the flat pillows! I'm a stickler for that - at least give us a few different kinds. We also broke the handle on the shower and they sent a plumber immediately. Very good service.

Myself and my friend stayed at the Newyorker for 5 nights, we flew straight from Vegas where we had been in the lap of luxury so I was dubious about staying 3 star. I had read a lot of reviews on TA about how small the rooms were and this was my main concern. 
Check in was easy, its worth taking a credit card specifically for giving hotels for incidentals. The elevators are well guarded by security staff, this made.me feel very safe. 
The room had 2 queens, a flat screen, 2 wardrobes, a walk in closet and a desk. The bathroom was small but this is New York afterall. 
Room was very clean and the beds were so so comfy. The subway is just outside the door, get a 7 day pass for better value. 
The diner in the hotel is great, head up to Alpha on 34th and 9th. The food is amazing and excellent value (sushi, noodles, amazing Thai curry) 
The staff were all quite short and Sharp.but they did give us an extra hour in our room for.free. 
I would.stay again.

We stayed here for 4 nights, on a trip from London to celebrate a special birthday. Could not have asked for better ! Very clean spacious hotel, friendly staff, good bar, excellent location. Room was fantastic, comfy bed and pillows. All
In all we were very impressed. A nice added touch was the hotel putting a complimentary birthday cake in our room ! Would most definately stay here again.

Amazing Stay Â and Great Staff
Â 
I was in NYC for over a week and my company made reservations for me to stay at the Intercontinental New York Times Square.
What a great location, right in the heart of Times Square and near subway station that connects you to the entire city within minutes.
At the hotel, rooms are very spacious and super clean; Staff members are awesome and always helpful, in special Cesar (front desk) and Glori (Guest Relations) who were always available providing information and assistance with a great smile and you can tell they were happy to be able to assist you. "Guys, you rock"
I am very glad I stayed at the Intercontinental New York Times Square and sure I will word out to my company and family.

review_title: Great hotel in a great location!
review_text: Stayed here for one night while taking in the sights and Christmas spirit of New York City. It's 2 blocks from times square. 5 blocks from Central Park. A ten minute walk to Rockefeller Center and 5th Ave. shopping. We drove into the city from Baltimore and it was 4 blocks outside of the Lincoln tunnel which made it very easy to get to and easy to leave on the way home. Room was nice. Whole hotel looks like it was recently remodeled. Very modern feel. Had valet parking available which was a plus. Checked out early Saturday and explores the city. Left out bags with the bell man and had no issues getting them later that night when we were ready to go. I would definitely stay here again!

Excellent location within midtown new York. The hotel is clean and tidy with pleasant hotel staff. The nearest subway is half a block walk - 2 minutes. I would use hotel again as the location was perfect

review_title: Excellent rooms, wonderful location and fantastic service
review_text: We booked this hotel for six nights based on Trip Advisor reviews, we booked via the hotel website and got a great reduced rate. We opted for a Superior Room with a King bed which was glorious. Very spacious room and gorgeous neat bathroom, the bed was fantastic. The view was of the other side of the building, but we didn't mind because the quality of the room made up for it. The hotel is in a fantastic spot, lots to do locally and a great Market over the road. Big Nick's do fantastic burgers and pizzas of you want cheap, good food. The staff were all extremely helpful and friendly, we were treated really well. I would recommend On The Ave to any visitor to New York, we loved our stay. Thanks very much!

It was an ok 4 nights for me. The size of the place makes the elevators slow to come and makes it feel very impersonal in terms of service. Cable tv channels were limited and it seems completely unnecessary to me to charge for storing luggage, even if it is just a token amount. Fine...but nothing more.

Stayed here based on trip advisor reviews. Staff friendly & welcoming. Room was excellent. We had a delux king which was roomy. Friends stayed in STD room which was very tight but adequate. Good location. Construction across the road was not an issue. Definitely stay here again. Great to be greeted by staff who happy to serve you!
Had an apartment style room with separate lounge room and kitchen which was fantastic to have. Good value. Staff are friendly and helpful. Short walk to 5th Ave and Rockfeller Centre

First off I stayed at this hotel from June 6th - June 8th. Staff were friendly and helpful. The LCD tv and iPod dock was a nice touch. The had a special cover on bed to prevent bed bugs which was a worry for me with a lot of reports in NY. The best and worst thing is location. To explain best is because it's near a lot of places like time square but worst because the actual street is scary walking after dark because of the bars. Also the hall when you get off the elevator is very small. And it is nice you can check in under 21 I'm 20 and a lot of hotels would not allow me to stay. Overall this is a great hotel for it's location and value.

Stayed June 6Th-June 8th. Cost about $300 A night. Stayed in room 202. I love the fact they have LCD screen tv and iPod dock. The best thing and Worst thing is location. Best is because I was about a 2 min walk to timesquare and worst thing is because the actual street the hotel is on has a lot of bars and can be scary to walk down after Dark. Staff friendly and helpful the hallway a little small. The room was clean and I believe had bedbug proof beds meaning the beds CAN'T get bedbugs because there was somekind of nylon wrap around matteress this is GOOD because I was worried with reports in NY...Overall I would stay again plus you can check in if your under 21 which is VERY rare only found like 3 hotels in New York
Just return from our holiday here. Loved everything about the hotel. A special thank you to Paulina for her great help whilst making the booking.
We had great views, lovely hotel, friendly staff, nothing to much trouble, great location.

Could not fault except my trip wasn't long enough!! Check-in was swift & welcoming as were all staff! We had 2xdbl bed room which was spacious & not special request! Linen crisp & changed daily! Hotel situated for easy walking distance to Macys dept store, Times Sq, 5th Ave & Empire State building! Tik Tok Diner excellent & U can get take away too after a long sightseeing day if you want to eat then collapse ontop of your bed! I'll def use New Yorker Hotel again if I ever return to the fabulous city New York City is.

review_title: Good value for money great location
review_text: The New Yorker was a great place to arrive at in NYC with reasonably sized rooms for this city and a location close enough to all the action without the traffic that keeps you up at night! Better than some of the boutique type places we stayed in Times Square and cheaper .Lots of restaurants and shopping nearby including Macys and try Lucy's Cantana bar/ Mexican restaurant for drinks and music - great crowd!

I've stayed in this hotel before and it's always worked out well (great location & clean), but on our most recent trip, it was fantastic! Not sure if it's had some renovations since our last trip, but it was super clean and the room seemed more spacious than we remembered (ask for a room that ends in 7, e.g., 407, 807 - that might have had something to do with it). Granted, still small, but relatively spacoius by Manhattan standards in this price range. The staff were friendly and helpful and the free breakfast was decent. Yes, the elevator is small and slow and the hallways are narrow, but it's an older building. Overall, I'd say the best hotel in this price range in the Times Square area.

review_title: Great Location and Staff. Room Amenities Could be Better.
review_text: We spent 3 nights here last week. Great location - within easy walking distance of Times Square and Central Park and Subway Station right outside the hotel. Huge rooms - we had two queen size beds but they were very soft and the pillows were very small and were far too soft! The bedding was tired and scruffy - the thin duvet wasn't even in a cover, but was placed in between two sheets! This meant that when you moved at night, the two came apart and you were left sleeping under a very tired and grubby looking duvet! There was a fab TV in the room - but no mirror at all! We were told that we couldn't have Air Conditioning as it was cold outside - it would be nice to have the choice though! We were on the 26th floor and were shocked that the windows opened easily with no locks! I'd be worried if I had a young child in the room! There was no kettle but there was a coffee making machine - in the bathroom!!!? An exceptionally strange place to have an electrical appliance and not much use if you fancied a coffee while someone was in the shower!! The shower was average and the bath tiny and not deep enough to paddle in! The towels were very small and very tired - although they were in plentiful supply and were changed every day! On a positive note, the staff were lovely and couldn't do enough for you! The car that was booked for us to go to the airport was fantastic and the driver was excellent! This could be the perfect place to stay if the rooms were just brought up to date in terms of bedding and towels - 2 of the most important components of a hotel stay surely? Lastly - please put a mirror in the room and some locks on the windows!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott New York Manhattan / Midtown East

review_text:
We stayed 2 separate days in September. Our rooms were a little cozy, but certainly comfortable for 2 
of us. Front desk people and other staff were uniformly friendly and clearly eager to please. Room rates were surprisingly low for what you got. I'd be happy to return for a longer stay.
Is becoming one of my fav NYC hotels! Love the staff, location, awesome rooms and suites. They take of their guest so they can't wait to come back! Thank you!

Very good hotel in the centre of new York. Brilliant value for money, staff are always friendly and happy to answer any questions. The hotel was very clean, fresh towels and bedding every day! We will be going back to the new yorker soon!

review_title: Very nice hotel in financial district.
review_text: Stayed here with family for a week. Hotel is very clean and nice. Hotel staff was very hospitable and helpful. Would highly recommend.

Stayed here for a business trip. It is right next to the temporary entrance to the 9/11 memorial. That is about the only thing it is close to (unless you want to be exclusively in the financial area). About a 30 minute cab or subway trip to Times Square. Can be hard to get cabs because it is not a popular tourist area. We found that if you go a few blocks behind the hotel it is easier to hail a cab. 
Room was average. We were on the 7th floor with a view of West St. Not the best and noisy. Would request a higher floor if available. Faucet leaked a bit in the sink. TV had some quirks but we weren't in the room much. 
So, overall ok hotel for NYC prices, just be aware of the location.

I read some bad reviews before I went to this hotel so was a little worried. We arrived at lunch time and got seen to quite quickly and I asked if it would be possible for a room with a view and the guy was very helpful and put us a little higher so we could see a bit more. The room was spotless and was kept that way for all 7 nights of our stay. We had no problems with the lifts or any of the services. We had a great time and would go back to this hotel when visiting ny again. Martin from London

Had high hopes for this hotel but were very disappointed. This hotel sells itself on fantastic views but despite a request from our travel agent for a room on a high floor, we were given a room (which was very well appointed to be fair) on floor five overlooking the bins and horrible buildings behind. We asked reception if we could move but they were totally disinterested and very dismissive. Overall it left a bad taste in our mouth and we won't be back. This is an expensive hotel, even for the 'lower' rooms...there are better value options nearby.

The hotel is a typical NYC mega chain facility. It did it's job with all the standard accommodation. Can't be more convienent if you're touring the WTC site. I still don't understand why these places insist on charging 12.95 a day for Internet in the room and offer it free in the lobby. For the price of the hotel it should be included, since you can go to MacDonald and surf for free.

I liked the place! Theres a good gym, clean rooms verywella located.
If youdontlike the breakfast (or the price of it) there's a very good option beside the hotel. I would stay there again!

I took my boyfriend for his 21st birthday and pictures of the hotel did no justice! I emailed prior to my arrival explaining it was a surprise visit and they upgraded my room to a large room free of charge and with a great city view!! Was in a great location easy to walk pretty much everywhere and was very close to times square!! It was my first time in new York so wasn't sure where the hotel was etc but was amazing! Very clean and the staff was very helpful! Would definitely stay there on my next visit as it's very good value! You would never think it is a 3 star since it has been refurbished! Only ate once in the tick tock diner and only had a desert! But only because we wanted to experience other places all over! Alot of my friends who have been or are going are using this hotel so is very popular!!

review_title: Excellent location for a whirlwind tour of NYC.
review_text: My daughter and three small grandkids were visiting from Texas, so we took an overnight visit to NYC. We stayed in a Jr Suite which consisted of two queen beds and a pull-out sofa. The room included a separate kitchen area with a fridge and stove and dishes. Very spacious for a New York City hotel. They had a lobby on the 2nd floor which was wonderful to stop by and let the kids rest between tour stops (especially the first day when we were waiting for our room to be ready and the baby needed to be changed). We checked out the next day and they kept our luggage until our trian departed that afternoon, which allowed us more time to tour. There are plenty of restaurants nearby to choose from. The staff we dealt with were friendly and helpful. The room was a bit pricey, but it was in a great location and it was a very nice hotel! We thought it was definitely worth the value!

review_title: Still good, but needs some improvement
review_text: On the whole, this is still a great option for NYC and I will stay again. But it would help if the elevators worked. This was my second visit where one or more of the elevators were out of order and the others are painfully slow. It took me twenty minutes one time to get downstairs. Also, the housekeeping cart is left in the hallway 24 hours, in plain sight and blocking the pathway, which is unsightly and inconvenient. Other than that, the service is still great, the staff friendly, the hotel clean and the location excellent, and I would stay here again definitely!

having booked this hotel relatively last minute I was not sure what to expect. I have been away for nearly five weeks and stayed in eight hotels around the world so far, and this is the best. I arrived here much later than expected due to flight delay and finally arrived at two in the morning to be greeted by excellent concierge/porter and friendly guy behind the desk( HAbib) we got a complementary upgrade, the room actually has a large area outside with four chairs to sit for some morning sun. The room is very tidy, comfortable bed, nice bathroom and excellent cleaners! We even found two chocolate mints on our pillow after a night out(the simple touches) overall I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone that wants to stay in a nice place with a decent surrounding area dor a reasonable price- new York price!! You won't be disappointed

We stayed in the new yorker hotel last December and have been meaning to write a review ever since! It was our first ever time to new York and we were not disappointing. Check in was extremely quick, the reception staff couldn't be nicer. We were first wowed by the beautiful reception area, it was so new York.. And completely beyond our expectations. Our room was quite small but just perfect for the two of us. Absolutly spotless, and was cleaned everyday without fail. Then we get to the beds... Comfyest bed we have ever slept in EVER!!! Seriously heaven! We were on the 31st floor and had a scary but magnificent view looking out onto Madison square garden! Location couldn't have been better. Be sure to sample hersheys chocolate pancakes & maple syrup from tick tock diner. On a night after hours of being out in the cold we would sometimes go to the diner, get a take out and go chill in our room. Would recommend this hotel to anybody!!!! Thank you to the new yorker hotel for a fantastic stay!

My wife and I stayed for two nights and loved it. We enjoyed the 16th floor (valcony) with a bottle of wine on our last night. There were only three things that did not make it a perfect staying: the toilet was clogged, one drawer did not closed completely and the closet's door had a damaged area (cosmetic). Obviously, as soon as we called the lobby to fix the toilet, they came right away. Besides those things, we really enjoyed this hotel.

Great location and decent rooms but lack of staff can be a real irritant starting with long queues on check in, getting a bellman or getting a plastic ice bucket which housekeeping had forgotten. Took three calls and 90 minutes before an attempt was made to deliver the missing ice bucket! Seems like an absentee manager running the hotel. Pity!
I stayed here for a couple of days with my son. The rooms were huge for NY standards. View from the room was great and the convenience to the Subway was a bonus.

review_title: Great hotel in a great city
review_text:
A friend and I stayed at this hotel in April 2011 for 3 nights. Before arrival we had requested a room on a high floor with a view. We was given a room on the 33rd floor with a view over ground zero and in the background u can see the empire state building :-)
The room was very nice, with big flat screen tv and 2 comfy doubles beds, and big windows for enjoying the views. the room was very 
modern as was the bathroom. 
The room was very quiet, didn't hear any noice from the ground zero building work.
The location is great, its away from all the hussle and bussle and a 
short walk from wall street, battery park, south street seaport where u 
can get discounted broadway tickets. You will need to take the subway to go to mid/uptown but this is easy and cheap to use, we 
also felt very safe using the subway most nights using it to get back to the hotel at 11pm-12am was always still busy at this time.
Overall we had a fantastic time, would definitely recommend the hotel and new York what a fantastic city.

Having had terrible experience at Sheraton time square a couple of weeks ago, really didn't expect too much from this one which is even closer to time square. Turned out it is truly an Intercontinental. Standards are not a bit compromised because of the location (some hotels actually think their location could make up for lousy facility and service). Stayed three nights here. Room was of good size and decor and spotlessly clean; well proportioned bathroom and nice amenities; very very good service throughout the stay. Most important of all, the bed was heavenly. Will definitely come again.

review_title: Beware, desk agent may look at your face and talk to you.
review_text:
Full disclosure: I am a hotelier and I have a very trained eye for the best and the worst. 
Marriott downtown is located on the west side highway aka Henry Hudson Highway. Location is near the harbors, parks etc but still, the hotel is ON THE HIGHWAY. 
Rooms are extremely well cleaned and maintained. There are no mold, dust etc issues. I checked all the trouble spots and nothing. It looked lime someone just deep cleaned the room. Congrats on that. 
I had booked the room on priceline which is something I never do. But it was a last min deal and I needed a place for a friend to stop for a shower and a few hours of sleep while passing through NYC. The rate was $99 for a Sunday eve. Yes $99. But the front desk agent who checked me in made me feel like a $99 guest. At any point during the transaction, she did not look at me or confirmed anything. I am aware that priceline bookings are run of house but it still does not override courtesy. She took my Identification and cc and produced a set of keys and that's all. No directions, no hi, no bye. Nothing. I am very familiar with the people that come
To the desk and treat the agents like an ATM but I assure you I made a deliberate attempt to be very nice. Only because I wish people are nice to me. anyway, overall the hotel is nice except for the resentful guest service agents who look like they can't wait for the shift to be over and some priceline cruising jerk is holding them up and taking their rooms for (almost) nothing. Simple recommendation to the management: either convince your workers that lower paying guests are a beneficial practice to your operation and they should not be treated as second class citizens, or don't discount your rooms because it leaves a bad taste on your customer's mouth for the entire stay.

review_title: Great location however hotel was let down by one rude staff member on reception.
review_text: The hotel is in a great location, walking distance to all the main sites.On checking in the lady on reception was extremely helpful, polite and professional, she is a great credit to the hotel.throughout our first half of our stay we found all the staff very efficient however the cleaners would occassionally forget to replenish the toiletries and tea facilities.Towards the end of our stay the cleaner threw away several of our shopping bags containing purchase reciepts, I had complained to Peter on reception who was extremely rude and unhelpful in this case, basically claiming that it was company policy to throw away empty looking bags.I explained that the missing bags had been there for the past 4 days.It was the 2nd time that we have found Peter on reception extremely rude and patronising to us during our stay which basically ruined our general experience at the hotel.

review_text: Photos sur le site officiel non conformes a la rÃ©alitÃ©. Rapport qualitÃ© prix satisfaisant. Pour autant, Il ne faut pas s'attendre a une vÃ©ritable prestations hÃ´teliÃ¨res. Juste une permanence de la rÃ©ception en cas de souci. Aucune information sur la seule prestation qui rÃ©side dans un fitness de 10 mÂ² (on a appris son existence au moment de notre dÃ©part).

This is the most comfortable place I ever stayed not only did we ck in early 1pm but the whole stuff was very friendly like we knew each other for years !!! The door when welcomed us by opening the door tipping his hat and say to is welcome home gentalman welcome home !!! So sweet !!! I stay in a few hotels but this so far was more like I stayed with fame !!! From the cleaning lady to the front desk to the door man !! And good coffee too !!!
The location was perfect for walking around Manhattan. The rooms were really nice and updated. I had a fabulous breakfast in the restaurant. No complaints!

We stayed at the New Yorker from 18-25 April. The front desk staff were easily charmed, quick and efficient in dealing with queries and our booking. I had read some bad reviews about them before arriving but found these untrue. Excellent with safety deposit boxes however these are in a room off the lobby not in your room. The hotel also offers a place to keep your bags until you check in/out at a reasonable $1 per bag. 
We had 2 rooms, one was quite a lot smaller than the other but we were there to sight see and shop. I don't believe it should be compared to beach holiday resorts. It was literally a place to sleep, shower and leave our belongings.
All in all, the hotel added to the New York experience and I would recommend it to anyone.

I stayed here for 2 nights. The location is great and the hotel itself was a real find. My room was bigger & better than I expected. The staff was really warm, friendly, and accommodating. The outdoor deck is an oasis - a must if you are staying at the hotel. I've been to NYC many times and this stay was one of the best.

review_title: Great location uptown, helpful staff, housekeeping needs improvement.
review_text: Modern styling in a pleasant lobby and efficient, professional and helpful front desk and front door staff. I was upgraded to a suite. Great except a brickwall was a foot away from all the windows. Help! The front desk came up within 5 minutes to move me to another room with windows and light. Large room, high ceiling, sitting area, good sized, modern, black marble bath, with huge well lit shower. Very nice, very clean with lots of towels. On the down side the copious blinds in both rooms were very dusty. The desk top was warped and damaged, and a sheet had a rip, which made the room feel shabby when otherwise it was not. Good, firm, comfortable bed. I would stay here again - at a good rate. If you check hotel specials, for $50 more a night there are better choices, but that said, this is a perfectly reasonable hotel selection.

review_title: Lovely hotel in a great spot in Manhattan with fab staff.
review_text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for 6 days. The room we had was lovely, keep very clean by house keeping with an excellent ciew down to rhe Hudson River. The staff went out of their way to help with any queries we had. We met Mark the hotel manager who is brilliant and couldn't do enough to help make our stay perfect. The location is great for the shops and very close to Macy's which had their sales on so bargains galore! There are loads of diners, cafes, fast food places and restaurants surrounding the hotel. There's also a cinema opposite too. I wasn't that keen on their diner Tick Tock. I requested a table for breakfast for 2 & i was told I couldn't be seated by myself until my boyfriend arrived (he was in the hotel room) after much a to do i was allowed to sit at the table for 2, I ordered a latte.. It mever came.. So I asked my waiter if I could call my room to hurry my boyfriend along only to be told I wasn't allowed to leave my table?! I felt like I was back at school! We chose The New Yorker because of the good reviews it had on Trip Advisor. I would recommend people stay here.

review_title: Last resort for the upper west side.
review_text: We booked here because our trip was last minute and the lucerne had no rooms. On arrival we waited with no help for about ten minutes. When they did come, they made us feel very unwelcome. I had a suit pressed, and they didn't bother to let me know it was done until I called and asked the front desk where it was. The Internet is only available for free in the lobby area. That space is loud and has no light or tables. The business center is similarly dark and unusable. The elevators were semi-broken or completely out of service, so getting to my room was a pain. The one positive is that there are good views from the balconies on the 14th and 16th floors (though there are no Internet access or electrical outlets). At this hotel it all comes down to service which was non-existent or rude at worst and average at best

review_title: Great location, great GYM!! And nice friendly staff
review_text: Got upgraded to a bigger room on arrival, room was large and new looking. Bathroom is dated but fine. Gym is great and very modern, best I have seen in a long time. Front desk is efficient and friendly. Location is convenient to penn station for travellers from Newark Airport by train and close to all attractions. Would I come back to this hotel yes, but hope to get free upgrade again.

I stayed April 16th 2011, without looking at reviews. We left this morning with bed bug bites everywhere. Location and service is fine but I obviously would not return because they are most definitely infested. Also, the shower was scorching hot and the only way to fix it was to shut the hot water off completely but that may have been an issue only in the room I 
stayed in.

The place was so wonderful 4 blocks from the bus stTion everything for the theater and times square within walking distant! The best lobby bar And restaurant. child friendly travelled with my 6 year old son and 11 year old daughter

We are currently staying at The New Yorker and will be leaving in 2 days. The hotel is brilliant value for money. We got a free upgrade and were given a corner room on the 36th floor with amazing views of the Empire State Building. The room is clean, and very comfortable. Yes, the bathroom is small but it's spotless and has everything you need-toiletries, hair drier, fresh towels etc. Check in was a breeze and FRIENDLY staff! 
Tick Tock Diner is good for food-not cheap and the tips are a must (but fair enough-people need to make a living!), but massive portions and tasty. 
Location is a dream-opposite subway, 10 mins from Times Square and Empire State Building. Opposite a cinema (which we have used to rest our tired feet!), places to eat, and generally we felt very safe. 
We would come back to this hotel in a flash and will be very sad to leave at the weekend.

review_title: Good mid-range hotel, perfect Midtown location, terrific value
review_text:
We booked on the basis of Tripadvisor reviews and were not disappointed. The location next to Penn Station, on the A, C and E subway lines is perfect for getting around Manhattan. Macy's is a block away and Times Square is walkable in 10-15 minutes. The rooms are recently renovated and quite spacious. The bathroom didn't have much space for putting things down, the shower temperature never stayed still (although there was always hot water) and the towels were very small! All was very clean though. No coffee maker or fridge in the room, but there was a drugstore across the street and a breakfast coffee kiosk in the lobby.
Overall, and we had the feeling of staying in a stylish, individual hotel with every convenience, but for terrific value for money (booked through Hotels.com). Definitely going to stay here again next time we're in Manhattan!

Great clean hotel with modern room and gorgeous huge bathroom. We ate breakfast around the block and enjoyed using the subway to go uptown for shopping. Great deal on the room using Marriott Rewards. 2 full beds for 149 plus parking
