review_text: Needed a hotel close to Javits Convention center, this one has a walking distance, breakfast included, decent fitness center. No roomservice, but lots of restaurants and Times Square close by.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: Nice room but slight fishy location
review_text:
It is in walking distance to Times Square. Be warned though that the street it is on also has a NY Parole Board office which you have to pass to get to the subway/main street. So it was a little disturbing walking past a line of parolees in the morning. That and the carpark, adult film shop and rather dodgy characters hanging around the corner. Plenty of tourists so never felt that unsafe.
The room was small but did include utensils, a stovetop, dishwasher, fridge. No kettle, it had one of those coffee warming machines instead. 
Housekeeping didn't automatically give us an extra toilet roll when we were down one.
Breakfast can be hectic if you arrive late. The selection was okay, good fresh fruit.
Good service and reception/porter/concierge, free WiFi. The lifts are busy so we took the stairs a few times. Self laundry service available which was great.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: HGI is the best value for the location!
review_text: HGI Times Square is an unbelievable location for the price. Other reviews complain about subway rumblings and the wear of the hotel, but in this case location trumps everything! I actually think the subway rumblings is our 5th floor corner room is part of the ambiance of New York. A block away from both times square and the beginning of the theatres.

Stayed 6 nights at the Staybridge and really appreciated this hotel. Next door the te Port authority, therefore subways were right at hand for our travel to different points in the city. We had a room on the 26th floor and had a view of psrt of the city. Room size is typical for New York and had a king size bed with the kitchen. Although we did not do any cooking, apprecated the large fridge. Were quite surprised to see that it also had a dshwasher provided. Free breakfast was good as were the Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday 5 to 7, with free beer, wine, colas and appetizers. Great place to make new friends. We had read reviews of the slow elevators (3) but it was not that bad for us eing on the 26th. People on lower floors would sometimes meet full elevators on the way down and had to wait sometimes for a 3-4 other ones, but this was rare. Would return on our next trip without hesitation.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: Good hotel clouded by bad experience and a lack of good customer service
review_text:
Affinia has nice rooms (we stayed on the 29th floor) but my whole experience there was negatively affected by a couple of incidents. 
I, Along with 7 other guests got stuck in the elevator on my first day there for almost an hour. The elevator stopped on the 11th floor and wouldn't budge. The emergency alarm didn't work, which is when we all started panicking. Good thing I had a phone, so I called down to the reception who sent maintenanace people up. For 10 mins they tried opening the door to no avail. So I decided to call the fire department to get help from professionals. While waiting for the firemen, one of the guests was telling me how the day before she had issues with the same elevator. She had reported it to the reception, and obviously it wasn't solved. 
One hour later, we were helped out by a couple of firemen while the manager took note of ourr room numbers. I thought we would get some kind of apology or a fruit basket or something, but nothing! They acted as if nothing ever happened. Consistent elevator problems is a serious safety issue, from hearing from the other guests and one of the employees, the elevators were having issues a while ago!
To make matters worse. I took the other elevator that same afternoon to go to the lobby, the elevator not only didn't stop at the lobby but stopped at the mezzazine and it droped a couple of inches as we were getting out. I took the stairs afterwards. 
To go through all of this in a hotel of Affinia's category and price range, and not even get any sort of customer servicee acknolwedgement of the inconvenience, I believe is very unprofessional. I am very dissapointed and terrified of those elevators, don't think ill ever return.

We stayed for one night on our vacation to NYC. The hotel was clean and nice. The rooms seemed up to date. The rooms were clean. The front desk staff seemed friendly. The location was good and near a few subway stops.

review_title: An Oasis On a Creepy Street
review_text:
The first thing you will notice arriving on this street are the 1970's Times Square seedy porn shops and accompanying ouside hustlers. The second thing you will notice is the side of the Port Authority Bus Teminal with busses lining up to get in.
Once you have made it past these eyesores and arrive to the lobby of The Staybridge you will be greeted by a modern yet sterile lobby. The front desk staff was professional and also a bit sterile.
The hotel is next to several other hotels that all look identical. They appear to have all been built at the same time under some sort of revitilization plan.
The room was very modern, clean and and the kitchen area was simply fantastic. There was no blackout curtain on the windows. If you walk around your room unclothed be aware it is very possible people in the surrounding buildings could get a free show. I hope Staybridge will correct this privacy issue.
The all glass shower is nice and the bathroom roomy. The breakfast buffet is outstanding, however some of the staff at the breakfast act aloof. Better take your breakfast up to your room to avoid the hustle and busstle of the small dining room.
If you plan on a late night out spring for a cab as it can save you from some very unpleasant ecounters.
As long as you take the necessary precautions and don't expect much pampering from the staff you will have a pleasant stay.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_text: Nothing bad with this hotel. Nothing. Ok , the elevators could take some time during rush hour but we would never change this hotel only for that. It is worth it! Will absolutly stay here Next time in NY.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: Great stay, great service, perfect location.
review_text:
HGI Times Square is perfect for anyone visiting New York. Centrally located, you are within walking distance of many NY attractions and the subway. The breakfast is fantastic, we had great service from the concierge and all the staff, and our room was always clean and ready when we returned from sightseeing. 
Highly recommended. We will be back.
Recommend. Great location. Comfortable bed. Clean. Large room for NYC.

We were a group of 11 relatives staying for 6 nights. I read the previous reviews with interest before setting off for our trip. True the location is a bit daunting at first, especially for first timers in NY, but after the first night we had settled in and were confident in moving around. Staff here were fantastic and very welcoming, especially Barry the bell boy. The sundowners tues-thursday proved a great hit with our group, especially as otherwise beer was $10/ bottle in the bar! Downsides as previously mentioned are the shortage of lifts (or more so the rudeness of some of the guests 'pushing' in) and the chaos at breakfast, mainly as everyone wants to eat the same time. Lots of guests were filling take out bags for lunch (double choc muffins seemed like gold dust) which didn't help. Definitely would stay here again. Also recommend Caprizzi just around the corner for great pizza
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_text: I helped an important client book a special event here. The maitre'd "Seems" was his name, had absolutely no clue what he was doing. Completely unprofessional with a lot of attitude-night was a mess. Food came out over hour late. Will be booking Plaza again for next event. Lost a huge account! I can't speak for the hotel rooms- only banquet. Stay away!

We stayed for 5 nights in August, and cannot rate the hotel highly enough. Staff were helpful and friendly, rooms were a decent size for NYC and well appointed. Breakfast buffet was well stocked, and the wireless access and speed was superb. The noted issues surrounding the lack of elevators were not bad at all. Would return for sure and definitely would recommend. Ideally suited for both the tourist traps of Times Square, and also the (better) restaurants and bars on 9th Avenue and 46th Street.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: Very nice hotel with good location!
review_text: Very nice hotel with good location and friendly staff. Grocery store is right next to the hotel, Starbucks is on the other side of 8th Avenue, to the subway is about two min walk. We were on 8th floor on 8th Avenue, and we did heard some traffic noise, but hey, it's the part of New York! :)

review_title: Great hotel-the New York Palace has it all-ambiance, location, service.
review_text: This is a great hotel-I have stayed at the Ritz Carlton Central Park twice before, and the New York Palace is just as nice. It is beautiful, with a great location. You will love it-trust me!

We snapped up a great deal on SniqueAway and spent two nights in the towers. The room was palatial in size for New York, with all the pampering requirements such as gowns , slippers, Molton Brown cosmetics and complimentary macaroons and the new York Times. An excellent breakfast was included at the tower lounge, as was all day snacks, cocktails and the like. Dinner at Gilt had this princess smiling all weekend. Overall classy classy service but friendly and not over the top.

review_title: This hotel is all about you!!!
review_text:
To be completely honest this my first trip advisor review. And all I can say is WOW what and amazing hotel. Ok, ok maybe the lifts are a little slow, and the hotel quite mediocre in appearance; the staff makes a three star hotel feel like a 5 star! From the very moment that we arrived, I couldn't believe how enthralled Barry the doorman was in making sure our stay was perfect. 
Thank you Barry!!! It was personally my first trip in New York city and certainly won't be my last. 
 The breakfast is served in the morning and could get crowded at times but I took mines back to my room on a few occasions to avoid the limited seating. I was 
recommened a great pizza restaurant that was close and convenient to eat at and loved it, thanks again Barry. I really enjoyed NYC alot and miss it very much, this hotel is the frosting on the cake that made my stay perfect. I just really thank the staff for taking the extra step and accommodating my family and I in every way.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: Perfect, clean suites very close to all the action!
review_text:
As with other positive reviews about the hotel, I totally agree with them. The rooms are spotless and fairly spacious, I think 4 people in one room would be cramped however! The breakfast and sundowner receptions are busy, but we never failed to get a seat even during the busiest periods! Another issue a lot of people have commented on are the lifts, yes there are only three but the overall majority of the time we only waited 2/3 mins before one arrived, the only time we had a long wait was on check out at the check out time, which can be expected even in hotels that have double the lifts, so overall it's really not a major issue!
Anyway the hotel offers lovely accommodation in an area that is central and easily accessible to all the attractions. The price for what you get is very reasonable and I will certainly stay here again!
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: Lovely clean room with fantastic views!
review_text:
We arrived at the Dumont the last week of August and stayed for 10 nights - so our stay overlapped into September. The rooms had been renovated, with new carpets and tv installed shortly before our arrival. We had two rooms - both one bedroom suites on the 27th & 34th floors. Views were stunning - really couldn't of asked for more. Rooms were always exceptionally clean and staff extremely helpful and friendly. We could walk everywhere from the Murray Hill neighbourhood - and for us it was an ideal base as didn't want to be in the madness of Times 
Square! All in all, a great stay and will definitey be returning! One added bonus would be free wifi in the rooms - especially as so many hotels offer this. But that would be my only complaint!

This hotel is in a good location near the empire state building and walking distance to times square. The hotel needed a renovation which they were doing while we were there. I only stayed here because it was close to a friend's apartment and because I got a good rate through booking.com. Their standard rates seemed a bit expensive. I think the hotel will certainly benefit from the makeover (they told me it's new beds TVA and carpet). Bathrooms were already renovated. Our room also had a kitchenette which was nice but also a bit dated
Ideally located in Times Square, great ameneties across the street. Check out Restaurant Row nearby. Staff are very accommodating and helpful, rooms are second to none.

the hotel is really nice and well positioned if you like to walk a bit. it is useful and interesting the kitchen corner. also the free laundry ant the 24 hours small market are really useful. breakfast is nothing special. there are few tables compared to the number of rooms and air conditioning is freezing. you need several minutes to take the elevators. not all the people in the hotel are so friendly.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: Best location for seeing Broadway shows, great service, very small rooms!
review_text: My 2 sisters stayed here for my birthday weekend. It is, like all Midtown decent hotels, expensive. We loved the location and easy access to the subway and to Broadway. No bedbugs! Service was 100% amazing! Kudos to Michael, our porter the night we arrived!!!!

Very nice small hotel in quiet neighborhood but in short walking distance to many attractions such as the Empire State Building and Times Square. 
Staff was very helpful and friendly.

review_title: Fantastic location - worst service I ever had
review_text:
This hotel has a great location, nice rooms and nice molton brown amenities. 
But the service is very poor and really unfriendly. Honestly I go there only for location and rooms don't expect more. I would be really severe with the F&B. Breakfast room size is a joke for such a big hotel. The quality is really bad too and so expensive. They sell you for nearly 10usd a glass of orange juice out of the can and declare that it's freshly squeezed (a lie). I was running NYCmarathon, I wanted early in the morning a nice healthy breakfast ordered with room service. Impossible at 5am, no flexibility. It was proposed a ridiculous bag for 30Usd like a snack not even a banana... or tea. 
Next time I might go back to the peninsula.

Ok, I love this hotel. I booked a business stay at first for three nights. Then I decided to cash in some HHonors Points and start with 4 nights of vacation time. They made this conjoined stay seamless. I was contacted personally before arriving and spoke to a live person who arranged to let me stay in the same room the whole trip. This isn't always possible when you combine points and paid stay. 
Next, the location is perfect. It's one block away from Times Square, so you don't have the eternal light and noise, close to Everything. Cross the street and there's a subway to the financial district. One block walk - Broadway! A dozen theatres right there. Restaurant row in Hell's Kitchen? One block. Central Park? Easy walk. Likewise Rockefeller Plaza, MOMA, Radio City. I'll be back. Pricey? You bet, but no more than other NYC places. I'll be back.

We have just returned from a Wonderful stay in the New York Palace. We have been to NYC on other occasions but decided to stay at the Palace as we were travelling with our children and my Mother in law. We stayed in a two bedroom suite on 47th floor with access to the Tower's. All of the staff were friendly and helpful and our Bell Man Henry was wonderful with the Children. When we returned to the hotel from having a look around the city there was a lovely bottle of wine and a plate of fresh fruit to welcome us to the hotel. The hotel is located on Maddison which is local for shopping, visiting tourist attractions such as central park, top of the rock etc. The suite was wonderful, spacious and clean with fantastic views and towels were changed twice per day and turn down service on an evening. The beds were the most comfortable bed's we have ever had in a hotel and the service and quality of the food and refreshments in the Tower's were first class. The Lounge is open from early in the morning until 9:00pm every night and you can call in for drinks and snacks throughout the day. A wide selection of soft drinks, wine, beer and hot drinks as well as a delicious range of food for breakfast, lunch and evening snacks. I can't imagine staying anywhere else the next time we return to New York! I would recommend the hotel to friends and family and our children have loved their first holiday in NYC.

review_title: Excellent place to stay in times square For business or for pleasure
review_text:
I have stayed at many Hilton's and Starwood and kimpton properties. I like this Hilton in times square because of the service and the staff. Front desk is extremely friendly an helpful. And if they can check you in early they will. The rooms are nice, the only down fall is they only have king beds. No doubles or two queens. Room is always fresh and clean. 
Bell service and front door men are also excellent and very helpful with directions and getting a taxi. 
The hotel also offers breakfast that is included at Pigalle which is fabulous. The food there is delicious and they are always accommodating and service there is wonderful. 
I love love the business center, there. Extremely helpful with incoming packages and out going packages. Printers are always available at no charge. Fed ex picks up at midnight also. Excellent business hotel.

review_title: Generally good but with a few glaring problems
review_text:
We stayed in one of the suites on the 19th floor for a week and had mixed feelings about this hotel.
The good: fabulous views of the Chrysler Building and the river, ideal location that isn't in the tourist trap that's Times Square, loads of great restaurants nearby and easy access to the subway.
The staff were generally good and friendly although there were some that were a little under informed and don't seem to have had much training. For instance, this hotel advertises itself as a dog friendly place and has guides to dog friendly places in the city such as dog runs, etc. When we asked for a list, the front desk staff didn't seem to have the lists & didn't have suggestions. To their credit,they were well meaning and tried to help but didn't seem to be as knowledgeable or as ready as the hotel website suggested.
Being on a high floor probably helped to cut down on the noise from the streets so that was a plus. The other guests on our floor were quiet too so that helped.
The bad: the rooms, though spacious, were really worn out. The carpet in our room was ripped in certain spots and the blinds in the room were getting warped from age and tough to operate. While housekeeping did a good job cleaning, the room was just too old and there wasn't too much the conscientious housekeepers could do. The hotel website also advertises a special pillow menu but I couldn't tell the difference between the different types of pillows, they all just seem too soft and lumpy.
When we were there, one of the 2 guest elevators was under maintenance,which led to long waits for the elevator. The hotel did try to use the service elevator to alleviate the problem but still it didn't help too much.
Other bugbears: the television in the rooms is a joke. You couldn't watch anything on it as the tube picture quality was so bad. The hotel lobby was a little too cramped and looked like it hadn't been updated since the early 80s - time for a makeover! And the hotel doesn't have wifi either except in the lobby.
Overall, it wasn't a bad hotel due to the good service staff. The rates were not exorbitant either, at just under $300 per night. But there are issues that I highlighted above that the management ought to fix to make the experience even better.

Thought the hotel was very clean and great location! The staff was mixed!! Our bellman was awesome but the young lady at check in was a little rude!! Our room was on the top floor - 54- in the tower! I was amazed how noisy it was at night!! First night there were jack hammers going for hours and late at night!! Just seems that high up would be very quiet!! Almost sounded as though the windows were open!! The exec loung was great!!!

review_title: A good hotel in a great location.
review_text: This hotel is one block from the Gershwin theater (Wicked), one block from Times Square and one block from the #1 subway. If you are a tourist, a better location is hard to find. Rooms were clean and comfortable with ample room for 3 people. (4 adults would be tight) The bathroom was a bit cramped but plenty of hot water available made up for it. The staff on the floor were great, the concierge was always on the phone and the staff in the lobby did not do much. (front desk being the exception, she was good) There is a business center near the lobby with 5 or 6 pc's. and a printer and wifi was included at no extra cost. I liked the hotel and will stay here again.

I recently stayed at this hotel on a business trip and I was terribly dissapointed with the service and attitude of staff. The staff were either helpful and lovely or on 2 occasions I experienced downright rude. I tipped the first bellboy who took my bags outside for a taxi on departure 7 dollars then he handed my bags to another bellboy who threw them into the boot of the taxi then held open the taxi door (not letting the driver leave for about 3 mins) and was rude, nasty and sarcastic as well as being quite threatening expecting another tip even though he had just been past my bags. I'm a 22 year old female travelling on my own from London and I was deeply distressed and upset by his behaviour towards me. 
It also has bedbugs as I have 4 bites on one of my legs. Avoid, avoid, avoid!!

Let me start buy saying the customer service was top notch. The rooms were accomidating and very clean. I was very impressed by the professionalism, and the view from my room on the 37th floor was outstanding. I would highly recommend this hotel and stay again. Oh the room service was really good too. Great job New York Palace!

I spent my 1 year anniversary here and it was perfect. Garnet Lee was very helpful and took very good care of us. The house keeping staff responded to our requests in a lighting fast manner. Thank you for a memorial stay. See you next year! Thanks Dumont!!
The service at the Palace has always been great. Our room gave us access to the club which was a lovely place for a quick breakfast or a late night drink. The rooms in the Tower are nicer, however.

review_title: Good hotel with very good location
review_text:
This was our first time to NYC, and chose this hotel after reading reviews and getting a good deal. The location is very good for getting about in New York, around 5-10 mins walk to Time Square. From the moment we arrived staff were helpful, we did have a room right outside the elevator. But that didn't have no bearing, having read previous about noise. The breakfast was very good and more than adequate for out stay, which was four nights from 6th July. The street is more than suitable as again people say it isn't the nicest street, disagree as it was fine and just like other streets in NYC.
We even managed to have tea in our room as we had a take out and used the kitchen facilities, a little bonus.
I would stay at this hotel again, room was equipped with everything and when we had a problem with our tv the staff fixed it by the time we reported it at foyer to getting to our room.
The only one thing I will say is that another lift wouldn't go a miss, we were on the eight floor and sometimes just walked up and down.
Great location for getting about, ad the subway is on the same street.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_text: Comfortable, modern, well equipped, clean room! Good selection at breakfast. Free wine, beer and snacks selected evening lovely touch. Great location! Would highly recommend!
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_text: Didn't spend much time in hotel but the amenities and comfort are excellent. Most impressive was that I tried to make reservations for any of the Nobu restaurants while in NY, and was unable to, but the concierege got us a table. Also, beds are very, very, comfortable! Excellent location. Walking distance to many tourist sites and great shopping.

We recently stayed for 4 nights at the New York Palace. We found this to be an excellent hotel, lovely large rooms which were very clean, and beautiful public areas. 
The only thing I feel it's worth mentioning was the price of breakfast! The first morning we ate at the restaurant (there were 6 of us) and it cost well over $360! (can't remember the exact cost). We are not penny pinching people and we were aware of our location, but even so it seemed a little excessive. Future mornings we just ate out. 
However, food costs aside, I would highly recommed this hotel. Wonderful location also!

review_title: Great location. Clean rooms. Friendly staff.
review_text:
Overall our stay was wonderful. The only reason I have "service" a 4 instead of a 5 is because every time we asked the concierge to help us with tickets to something either she couldn't do it at all or she was more expensive than us just getting what we needed on our own.
Other than that our stay was great. We ordered room service one night and it arrived quickly and tasted great.
I would stay here again, just make sure you book the tickets for everything you want to stop ahead of time.

review_title: Unbelievable location with great value and quality staff.
review_text: The staff at this Hotel was very friendly and the concierge made us reservations at a great restaurant. The room was perfect for sleeping with dark shades, consistent fan and kept sound out. Broadway shows are a short walk away and the Hotel was very clean with a nice breakfast restaurant attached.

Directly next door is a pneumatic jackhammer that runs all day and according to the staff has done so for weeks and will continue way into the future. Thankfully it stops at night. I wondered why I was able to book this hotel so cheap thru expedia $385. Now I know. Be sure you'll not be needing to relax in the room during a weekday or be prepared for torture. Otherwise it's a great place.

Stayed at this hotel with points over the July 4th weekend. Tremendous value for NYC! Did not live the location of this hotel, getting down 40th street was not the best with the people hanging on the corner. The room we had was really nice, big for NY stanadards. The breakfast which was included was adequate, not great, but to have breakfast included in NYC is amazing. I would definitely stay at this hotel again. C
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_text:
This review is of our recent stay from Oct 8-10. We booked using our Hilton points, so this narrowed our choices for our NYC trip. Location: This Hotel's location is a few walking blocks off of Times Square with easy walking access to several Broadway shows, so if that's what you are looking for, then this might be a good hotel for you. The Book of Mormon & Chicago are just around the corner. Lion King & Spiderman are also walkable but we took a cab at night since I was in heels. The center of Times Square is just a few blocks as well as is Rockefeller Plaza & Central Park. We walked to all of these areas. Taxis are easy to hail yourself but have the doorman hail one for you if you have trouble or need a special request. The doormen here were great! The only thing I didn't particularly care for was the area directly outside the hotel. While I was not afraid there, there are more attractive areas with hotels. That being said, I would consider returning here if I were coming back for Broadway, but at $500 a night, it's still pricey & I probably would have chosen elsewhere based on that prior to my stay there. However after my stay I can tell you the positives.
Service: check in was simple & done with a smile. We checked in early at 12:30 & our room was very clean. Housekeeping promptly delivered foam pillows to replace the down that I am allergic to. One night we requested more towels & it took about 50 minutes but when they showed up, the gentleman gave us an apology gift bag of goodies & bottled water which was much appreciated. ~ We were not a fan of the concierge's recommendations. He recommended "Cosmic Cafe" for breakfast. Avoid!! It was the most awful food I've ever had for breakfast. They also recommended John's Pizza which was good but not the best pizza to be had in NYC. They also couldn't give us any recommendation for Sunday night except a comedy club. They need better concierges to really make this place shine. Overall though, service was friendly here. This surprised me for being in NYC. The staff appear to work hard at wanting to please you.
The Room: clean & comfortable bed. White linens ( important for checking for bed bugs... I saw none here). The bed is an air bed & you can adjust the firmness. 
Mini fridge was not cooling & the iron dumped water constantly when ironing. Microwave was fine & there is a small coffee pot, but no fancy coffee. Neutrogena toiletries in the bath were nice and the shower head is a waterpik & should be adjustable to the spray you want but ours wasn't working. The preside was fine though & the water was hot.
Our room was on the 6th floor & relatively quiet. We were on the back side of the hotel so ask for that. We heard an occasional siren but not much else. 
Overall, this is a great hotel, comparable to other Hilton Garden Inn in room size. Add doorman and room service & take away the free breakfast. What could they do to make it more cozy... Add fresh cookies like the one in Savannah , GA & get better concierge service. All in all, we had a nice stay here & may return in the future if they can keep prices down.

Could not beat the price and location. 1st time staying at this hotel, very clean room and bathroom. Only issue was that it took several minutes to get the hot water running in the shower, but after that all was good. Could not have been more satisfied. Will return in the future.

I've stayed at this hotel twice now. The location in midtown is great, and the hotel rooms are vast. 
The price is high but in line with the sort of prices you pay in NYC, especially when you consider room size and location.
Located near times square and tour line stops. Rooms are clean and have everything you need.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_text:
Sono stato a Giugno per 6 Notti e mi sono trovato molto bene. Appena arrivato, al check-in mi hanno comunicato che avendo prenotato molti notti, mi avevo dato la cameria di una categoria superiore rispetto a quella prenotata, senza dover pagare il supplemento: risultato ci hanno dato due camere all' ultimo piano, con la finestra che dava sull, Empire state Bldg. review_title: Decent hotel and super location but NOISE is terrible !
review_text: Can't fault the facilities, the room is good, service is fine but seriously avoid staying here until the construction across the road is finished or you're a deep sleeper, the drilling and jackhammers are incessant and continue all day and all night, while the noise is not the hotel's fault, reception does not warn you and didn't even bother to ask how our stay was, which was annoying, plus no offer of discount when this complaint was raised.

We selected the New York Palace for our family weekend trip mostly for the location and it was the perfect choice! We usually stay in Times Square but were looking for a less congested area and couldn't be happier. The hotel is within walking distance of everything midtown including the famed shopping area 
of 5th Avenue and the activities of Central Park. The concierge was extremely knowledgeable and the courtyard was the perfect place to unwind after a long day of shopping and sightseeing. The only thing missing in the room for me was a vent in the bathroom for the steam of the shower. Other than that, the hotel was opulent in every way and more than met our expectations. We'll we back for sure... Probably for some Holiday shopping later this year!

review_title: Great rooms, location may not work for everyone but isn't bad
review_text:
My husband and I stayed here for an anniversary getaway and were very happy with the design of the hotel (very modern, especially for an extended stay hotel). The location is right by Times Square and close to all the typical tourist destinations. We stayed on the 30th floor and had great views of the sky line. 
The only things we didn't like were our room not being ready when we checked in despite our having loyalty club benefits that guarantee early check-in. However, the hotel was at capacity and the issue was eventually resolved thanks to a helpful front desk staffer (two other staff members weren't as helpful). The other issue is that the block the hotel is on can get a little sketchy at night. It's not horrible, but I wouldn't say my husband and I enjoyed walking home in the late evening. We are from a large city and are used to dealing with sketchy people, so it wasnt a huge issue for us, but could be for others. If it was really late we just took a cab home. It also helps that there are other hotels on the block so there is a fair amount of traffic at night. Overall, the quality of the rooms are great and worth the semi-sketchiness.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_text:
I stayed on the second floor in a cupboard off the darkness where I assume the corridor is hidden.
The incessant noise from the bar echoed through my tiny room until the early hours. They give you two things to stop this disturbing your sleep some earplugs and a ridiculous large cushion plug which you are to put in the novelty porthole shaped window, which I duly did. It did not work. Its worth pointing out that this was a Sunday, the bar nearly empty yet they still persisted with this noise.
If you're planning on being out on it every night from 5pm onwards then this is fine, obviously if you're nor, well, it's not and you should avoid.
The 6 kitchen staff stood smoking by the main entrance to the lobby doesn't befit the stature the hotel's nightly rate implies.

This was our first trip to New York and we were expecting to have a small hotel room but the Affinia really surprised us. The one bedroom suite was fantastic. We had a massive comfortable bed, and a very clean well appointed ensuite. The living room was spacious with two sofa's and entertainment unit and a large desk if you need to work during your stay. There is also a small kitchen if you like to cook your own meals ( full size fridge included ). The staff are friendly and helpful and the location was perfect. Being midtown and right near the subway meant we had easy access to everything the city had to offer.

Par contre excellent localisation et prix abordables.

I used half priority club points and cash for my stay! I never stayed here and was suprised how nice it was! Location was good close to all major subway lines! Enjoyed the free breakfast and of course the free wine in the evening! I will stay there again for sure!
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: A bit pricey, but otherwise ideal and it is New York
review_text: The hotel was in a great location, close to times square a big supermarket and the subway. The staff were good and efficient. There were a couple of hairs in the bathroom and on the towels when I arrived which was a little off putting, but otherwise the room was very clean and newly furnished. The bed was a bit soft, but that didn't bother me. I was on a high floor on 8th ave which meant I didn't hear any street noise. Overall a pretty good place to stay

It's true, the construction noise is bad-they cranked up at 2:00am this morning, and they're working loudly this morning--but I love this hotel. My husband and I are celebrating our 25th anniversary here and, except for this noise, which is not the fault of the hotel, I'm glad we are here for this special event. The lobby is beautiful and the staff has been helpful. Our room is very spacious and clean. The location is great for shopping or just exploring the city.
Excellent hotel, friendly staff, large rooms, clean, modern, perfect location. We'll stay there again next year, you get so much hotel for the price you pay.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: A staff that will go above and beyond!!!!
review_text:
I am a person that travels all over the world. I stay in hotels 2 weeks a month. This hotel by far has the best staff...period. I never came across a nicer more helpful group of people in my life. They truly will go out of thier way to make sure your stay is the best ever.the front desk staff and bell men were great. I met Rob who is the gentleman who greets you at the door. I can't say enough about this person. All I can say is Hilton is very lucky to have him as part of the team. From the friendly greeting to helping with directions to reccomending restaurants that are not tourist traps. He really shows his concerns for the
guests. He made my trip to NYC a trip I would not forget. He even offered me a special discounted rate to come back to NYC and see they new timeshare Hilton has. I found my new home in NYC, thanks to Rob.

Very clean centrally located hotel. Despite a few shady stores on the block, we felt very safe any time of day or night. Great breakfast buffet & helpful staff. Rooms were immaculate & well stocked. Would definitely stay here again!
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_text: This hotel was very nice. Great location few blocks from times square, central park, today show, David Letterman etc..

Outstanding location for midtown shopping, sights, etc. Staff knew we were traveling with our 6 year old daughter and they brought her a child's robe and Teddy bear with turn-down service. Amex platinum got us a nice upgrade. Continental Breakfast is limited and expensive if paying although the option of taking it via room service is a nice option. Overall, highly recommend.

review_title: Great location and very friendly staff!
review_text: We stayed here on labor day weekend we were in town for some sight seeing and a Yankees game! The hotel staff was very helpful and friendly! Charles in the lobby was super nice and helpful! We plan on visiting again in november!

Hotel staff was incredibly friendly and accommodating. From check in to check out I couldn't ask for anything more. Got a great value just a few steps from the heart of times square, will definitely be staying here again. Rooms are very clean, bed was very comfortable.

I must say this is one of the best hot
 I have been to. The staffs were really friendly, funny, helpful, and welcoming. I couldn't ask for more. I will definitely return this hotel in the future. This hotel is one of my most memorable memory that happened in nyc. I hope when I return again I will meet those friendly staffs again and keep up with the quailty. Hotel was nearby attractions, all in walking distance, afdordable restaurants. Room was comfortable except bed was too soft for me but my friend loved it, kitchen and room was well equiped. Only thing I thing I didn't like was elevator took forever.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Times Square - New York City

review_title: Great location exceeded only by awesome staff!
review_text: We chose this HGI for our first wedding anniversary celebration and could not have been more pleased with the service. The staff was very attentive and genuinely interested in the fact that we were celebrating a special occasion. So much so they placed us in a room with a beautiful view of the waterfront. They also presented us with a bottle of champagne and a very kind note. Other traveler reviews will mention the great location. We will be coming back because of the great staff!

House keeping and concierge were fabulous, however bar staff and done restaurant staff had real attitude, which is a shame to a truly magical hotel! Next time in NY we probably chose a hotel in the meat packing district but for a first time visitor the hotel is great.

I stayed in the Affinia Dumont for a total of 8 nights at the end of November with a friend to check out the sights and do some shopping. I had previously read the great reviews on Trip Advisor and decided to give it a try.
We arrived late after delays at customs and on checkin i requested a room higher up but the highest we could be offered was the 22nd floor so we took it.
The room was very spacious and cosy although a little closer to the ground than i would have liked i requested the next day to be moved higher and the lady on reception agreed to move us but after the first night we decided to just stay put. The rooms beds 
are cosy and although we didn't use it, the pillow menu was a great touch. The fridge in the kitchenette come in very handy, but unfortunately we didn't use any of the cooking appliances as coming all this way we didn't really want to cook!
The staff are very friendly and informative in the AD especially one of the doormen (wore a hat cant remember his name). We was always welcomed and the door was held open for us upon each arrival.
We did not try any of the food from the hotel or room service but we went to the Barking Dog next door literally every breakfast lunch and dinner! couldn't get enough of the place, brilliant staff, great food and atmosphere and very reasonable prices.
We payed around 1600 GBP for our stay here which seemed quite reasonable. I would definitely stay here again next time i vist New York. The only downside to this hotel was that we kept getting nasty electric shocks off one of the light switches in our room, but we informed someone on the desk before we checked out.

I was originally going to book via expedia but I called the hotel to see if I could reserve a room and pay cash on arrival. I was told that this was possible and that the room rate was $269. I thought that was great and made the reservation. So I was surprised when the bill was $312.17. What i was NOT told is that it is $269 plus tax. When I paid the bill the receptionist apologised and said this often happens with foreign visitors. Personally dont think this is good enough.
The next surprise was when we went for breakfastnwhich we had paidnfornin the room rate. On leaving I was presented with a bill for $14.90 when I pointed out I had already paid I was told by the waiter "ah that dent include gratuity". Now I don't mind paying a tip but I don't expect to be presented with a bill for it! 
That been said I enjoyed my stay and would recommend the hotel, just watch out for the additional tax.

Check in was super quick and the front desk staff was so friendly. The room was absolutely gorgeous and suprisingly roomy. I loved the modern chic decor. They had pillowtop mattresses which were extremely comfortable for a good nights sleep. The hotels location is perfect, you're only a couple of blocks from all the excitement of Times Square but its quiet enough that you can get a good nights sleep. review_title: First time at an Omni, and they wowed me!
review_text: We stayed for 2 nights while visiting family for thanksgiving. Booked our hotel via hotels.com and got a good rate as it was prepaid. Travelling with a 5 year old, so we are more picky with location and the hotel. We were not disappointed! Staff were very friendly, incredibly service minded and professional. One night our room was pretty warm, and when we mentioned it the morning after, they had sent someone within 5 minutes to address it. Food: we did not eat at the hotel but ventured out. SO many options within 5 minute walk. The deli across the hotel has great breakfast too! Subway: all within 5 to 10 minute walk, it was perfect location. Room: we had an interior room on a high floor. Though it would have been nice to have a view, it was so quiet you forget you are in NYC. Loyalty program: sign up (free) and get wifi, coffee/juice in the AM delivered to your room, welcome cookies and water/milk, and a little backpack for the kiddo with activities inside. Parking: we drove, so we self parked one block away for $35/day (hotel validates). No biggie getting from parking to hotel as you just walk on 52nd all the way for about 5 minutes. Macy's parade: we positioned ourselves on 7th ave and 52nd and it was perfect (less than 10 minute walk from Omni). We got there at 9:30 and it was not crowded yet. It got crowded around 10am. There was Starbucks on this intersection for some warm cocoa! Next time we are back in NY, we are staying at Omni again.

We stayed here 2 nights for new year. Had booked it months before and were seriously disappointed to have a room overlooking new roadworks with a very enthusiastic pneumatic driller who worked from 8am till 9pm. The hotel staff were great and moved us to a quiet lovely room overlooking St Patricks cathedral and much the best place to take in new York with a glass of wine. Good location for most sights.

review_title: A good hotel marred by privacy and dignity issues
review_text:
This is a hotel in a good location My room was petite but well presented. 
Unfortunately, it turned out to be the most stressful hotel visit I think I have ever had. Jet lagged I was keen to get my head down, but without fail a member of staff would be knocking on the door in the evening for some reason or another and be very reluctant to leave. On the last day I had a late check-out, but despite also having a privacy notice on the door it did not stop the housekeeping staff wanting to get in. The second time there was no gap between knocking and entering while I was showering, the excuse being that the privacy tag had somehow disappeared.
The worst was yet to come. I was being picked up to get to the airport and the doorman kindly offered to tell me when the car driver appeared. 10 minutes later he called my name and I was in the Town Car and off to JFK T4 as confirmed by the driver.
Or so I thought. Half way there after battling through a busy NY the driver got a call saying I was the wrong person for that car and that he insisted he had to go back to get the correct one who had a dissimilar name but the same destination. This would have led to me missing my plane so I ended up getting out with my bags and standing next to the Midtown tunnel. Thankfully I had been given contact details for the correct car which was luckily only 10 mins away. This driver said the doorman had told him I had already gone in another car but did not elaborate. Quite.
I am sure there are many other ways that hotel staff can make someone feel uneasy and vulnerable, but this one takes the prize for me. Looking at the other reviews I can only hope for this hotel's sake that I had a uniquely bad experience.

We were evacuated from our home in Long Island City due to hurricane Irene and I think I'd have been more comfortable sleeping in an evacuation center and not gouged to do it. I'm pretty sure Marriot saw the demand for rooms go up and in turn charged the max to those seeking shelter from the storm. I'm disgusted by this place. The bell man in front stood there while we got our ownbags out of the car and practically stood in our way when we tried to get our own bags to the lobby. Fail! The desk was uninterested in us other than throwing a key at us and sending us on our way. The room is so dim and dark but that's probably to hide how dirty the roomis. review_title: 5 star service and atmosphere with a 3.5 star price tag (for NYC).
review_text:
Everyone knows you will likely have to take out a second mortgage to afford NYC hotel prices, especially if you want to stay somewhere nice. Not in this case. Although it was slightly expensive (approx. $240 a night plus taxes for a double room) it was only half the price of other options presented to us for this trade show at the Javitz Center. I stayed for four nights with a few other co-workers and I was impressed. I've always thought of the Renaissance as a lower tiered hotel, but not this one. The atmosphere is really 5 stars. The lobby, lounges and rooms were very modern. The view from the R Lounge has got to be one of the very best in NYC. I would love to spend New Year's Eve here one year. The R Lounge doubles as the concierge lounge in the morning for gold and platinum Marriott rewards members with a yummy complimentary breakfast. They lose one star for not having a concierge lounge that runs similar hours to other Marriott properties. But the food was delicious. Other than the lounge, I didn't eat at the hotel so I can't comment on the food.
Going back to my room, it was a pretty large for a NYC hotel and the bathroom had a ton of counter space. I didn't have any problems with hot water or water pressure. The TV was a huge HD TV with HD channels. (it really bugs me when hotels have HD TVs with Standard definition channels.) I didn't hear any neighbors in adjacent rooms. The bed was comfortable and I loved the soft bathroom towels. Carpet was a little old and not very cushiony. So overall, a great room.
I also used the gym and the business center, both of which were nice. The gym equipment was rather new and you could dock your iPod in the treadmill.
Location wise some pros and cons--if you are a NYC tourist, it's awesome. You are in the middle of Times Square. If you've ever lived in NYC or close by, it's a little expensive and you will realize right away the tourist trap you are in. Plenty of restaurants, bars, etc within walking distance. It's a 15-20 minute cab ride from the convention center. 
Overall a great experience and highly recommended.

Otherwise a great value and a regular spot for me.

The Bowery is a great haven in busy New York the location is great if you like walking around the nearby areas Soho etc but also is right near subway. Corner room views were great, loved coming back to lobby bar to unwind . Couldn't fault it!

review_title: One of NYC's absolute best boutiques. A gem!
review_text:
I'm an experienced traveller and NYC hotel resident. But I was still very impressed.
- This place is classy style. Extremely well appointed with great style.
- highlight is the guest-only back patio. A great oasis.
- Service is very warm and personal. Everyone seemed like they were in a good mood. (special thanks to Jaime and Vanna for great bar service)
- rooms are small, but beautiful. Besides, you will spend all your time in library and awesome back patio.

review_title: Cool hotel in NYC without any attitude!
review_text: We stayed here on the first leg of our honeymoon and had a great time. The building was amazing and we loved the old-school feel inside. We stayed in a suite that was spacious and even had an outside terrace with a seating area and sun loungers which was fab! The staff were all really friendly and helpful and a good resource for recommendations and restaurant bookings-they even left us a bottle of champagne in our room to celebrate our marriage. The location is great and it's easy to wander into Soho or jump in a cab anywhere. The bar was cool and a good place to do some celebrity spotting in an unpretentious setting...and Gemma restaurant served amazing italian food and lovely breakfasts. We liked it so much that we're looking to go back next year!

Io e la mia compagna siamo stati ospiti dell'hotel per una decina di giorni, dal 30/12/10 al 09/01/11 festeggiando capodanno.
Oltre alla camera abbiamo riservato cena dell'ultimo e pacchetto happy new year che prevedeva uno spazio riservato in Time Square per assistere al count down.
Ãˆ stata una esperienza memorabile, a parte un disguido al nostro arrivo che ci ha costretti a soggiornare in una stanza di livello inferiore a quanto prenotato e pagato, cosa risolta brillantemente da uno dei responsabili che ci ha assegnato tempestivamente nuova camera ed accesso gratuito alla lobby, per il resto non posso raccomandare vivamente la struttura.
