review_title: Great base for New York city trip
review_text: This was my second time staying at this Hilton Garden Inn. It is a great base for visiting New York. The location is perfect and the rooms, although a little small, are well appointed. Big showers. Great views if you are on one of the higher floors. They also offer discounts at the parking garage across the street. If you are looking for dining options close to the hotel, the Keens Steakhouse is a 2 minute walk and the food is great.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_title: Great location, cozy and a great base!
review_text:
Stayed here for 3 nights, and found it to be a great spot. Only 10 mins walk to Times Square and Empire State Building, 15 mins to Rockafella Centre and there is a subway station just outside the hotel entrance. The room itself is small, but from what I heard, everywhere in NYC is small. It had a big comfy bed, the only downside was that the linen looked a bit sad and a few threads were loose, but it was really clean, no bed bugs! The bathroom was very clean and practical. There was a microwave in the room and a mini fridge which was handy for late night "nom noms". There is also a 24 hour hotel pantry for snackies that was very reasonable and free guest wifi. We were going to buy tickets to a show thru the hotel, but took our chances with TKTS in Times Square on the day, and got them alot less than they were selling them thru the hotels agent. We were on the 20th floor, there wasn't much of a view but in the morning you can still hear the sirens, get used to sirens in NYC. 
On the whole, good place to stay, good value, and good location. Also, if you have limited time like we did, we'd recommend a hop on hop off tour to tick off some bucket list items in a hurry...
Thumbs up!
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_title: Un hotel di charme nel cuore della cittÃ
review_text: Sono stata al Morgans a fine maggio per 8 notti e mi sono trovata davvero bene. La posizione e' molto comoda per visitare la citta', e' vicino all'Empire, alla Grand Central, ai negozi della Fifth Avenue. La camera (una Queen Superior) non era enorme ma confortevole, il bagno piccolo ma comodo, la colazione a buffet proponeva croissant, bagel, pane, marmellate, yogurt, succhi, te', latte e caffÃ¨. Credo sia uno dei pochi che la comprendano nel prezzo. C'Ã¨ una bella sala comune con wi-fi, te', acqua e caffÃ¨. Le camere sono pulite, il personale giovane e disponibile a dare informazioni e prenotare ad esempio i ristoranti. Ho trascorso un buon soggiorno.

We got a great deal for the grand opening of this hotel. It was very clean and modern with a Japanese flare. The rooftop bar and restaurant were great along with coffee and muffins in the morning.
Cons of this place are simple. Work out the bugs before opening doors to the public.
Upon returning to the hotel at 1 am on Friday night the elevators were out. My wife and I were staying on the 20th floor. Not a fun walk! Then after falling asleep we had a fire alarm for roughly 30 min @3:30am.
hotel_name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West

review_title: Gentle staff but really bad organisation and communication
review_text:
Advise for the fb manager : google "continental breakfast"... It will help you to find the way...
Advise for the owner : buy some ABB stock it will certainly help you to past the pain of your unusefulled investment
hotel_name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West

review_text: Hotel is nice and clean. Staff is friendly. Room has the basics and is nicely decorated. Shower is nice, no bath tub. Bed is firm. A little too firm for my liking, but still comfy. I will be staying here again.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: Don't expect big room. It is small but decent. Room and bathroom were clean. Bed was superb; you can control firmness and blankets were good. Everything is located in conveniently short walking distance.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text:
I stayed here Sunday-Monday and had the best time! Overlooked the empire state building, and room was quiet and clean! I told the hotel I had allergies and they gave me a room with an air purifier without me asking for it- which made my stay a million times more comfortable! They even made me their guest of the day- which was just a fun surprise that made me smile all day!!! (big thanks to ali during check-out!)
Parking was so easy- and cheap for NYC rates. The staff answered all of my needs quickly. I travel a ton for work- and I am happy to have found a solid place to stay on the road!!
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: Close to Penn Station and a reasonable walk from Times Square. Clean and quiet room--even though I was only four floors up, I couldn't hear the street. Great value in these parts for $231/night.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_title: Worst nightmare if you want to sleep
review_text:
There is attention to detail, things look trendy , spacious and new, at first glance, but the bathrooms lack ventilation and are very moldy. They give the brand new rooms the scent of mold.
The rooms are not insulated for sound and our first night was disrupted by fire drills and trucks at 3am. The second night we had to listen to the drunk college kids party until 4:30 am next to our room. After several calls to the front desk and only apologies from the manager on duty we finally went to sleep.
Thankfully we were leaving the next day and during checkout the manager Ray - was as rude as our neighbor- hotel guests. We did not even get an apology from him.
The staff in the restaurant and the bellhops were very friendly and helpful. The Restaurant food was good but if you don' t have reservations you won't get a table. It is very hard to be a City Restaurant and a Hotel 3etaurant without sacrificing the hotel guests

review_title: Wow! An absolute gem in the centre of town!
review_text:
I am staying at the Yotel for 5 nights on business. Finding a hotel in NYC that is in a great location for less than 300 bucks is impossible, most of them are relics and awful. The Yotel is anything but awful! Modern, super clean, immaculate and helpful staff, really really cool rooms, a fantastic bar and the restaurant food is out of this world! I travel 140 days a year with work and I can safetly say on experience this is the best for the price. 
Other things to take note of; it is 3 blocks from time square if you are sight seeing, it is 2 blocks from the Hudson if you are into running, it is one block from 9th ave and a plethora of great restaurants. 
The staff are super, really friendly and go out of their way to help you.
These guys have nailed it and only been open for 2 weeks!
hotel_name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West

review_title: Interesting idea, but a very bad service!
review_text:
If you want to have a different for either good or bad reasons you should definately stay here.
Yotel is young, modern and very tiny, but there's enough of everything you'll need: great location, comfortable bed and a nice outdoor area for a drink in a summer night.
But what you need to runaway from is the service! Housekeeping often forgot our room and the rest of the staff was badly trained and often one says something different from what they say in their website and even the menu. Getting a pitcher took us 1hour... And complimentary breakfast is a very bad idea due to its poor quality and lack of space.
Do yourself a favour and put something in your head: this is a sleep only hotel or be prepared to wait and discuss a lit fir a good service...
hotel_name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West

review_text: We were booked for a room with two twin beds but they didn't have one when we checked in. They assured me they would have one the next day for our last two nights. When we arrived after being out all day they still didn't have a room so they upgraded us to a suite that was available. Very classy and great customer service. I will tell all my friends about this "Jewel"!

My mum and I stayed at Yotel only a couple of days after opening. The staff were fabulous. They are polite, friendly and very helpful. The location was fantastic. It is a couple of blocks away from Times Square so it's not as noisy however you still have a great location. It's walking distance to a lot of the happening tourist spots including hell's kitchen, broadway, times square, macys plus more. Being to women in a foreign place we felt extremely safe staying here. There is free wi-fi in your room, computers you can use and a little kitchenette on every level which has cold water, ice, coffee, tea and a vending machine. Only downside was the size of the room. EXTREMELY SMALL. We had enough of the room after a week of shopping it just got too crowded. The continental breakfast was only coffee, tea and muffins. You had to pay for everything else. If your a keen walker then fifth avenue and central park is only a 20 minute walk. Overall I would definitely stay there again and recommend it to all types of travelers.
hotel_name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West

review_text:
You can't ask for a better location smack bang on 5th and 51st and over looking Rockefeller Plaza. Metro lines and just a block away and you can walk to the park in ten minutes. 
Rooms are a really decent size which is a surprise in NY. 
No swanky or lobby dips the price and it's no fuss but clean, smart, modern and rooms Inc iPod docks. 
We got a voucher for a welcome drink at the Jewel's sister hotel a few doors down and had Old Fashioneds on their terrace. Nice little bonus. 
Didn't bother with breakfast. Why mess around with homogenous hotel fare when you can gorge on pancakes, waffles, syrup and more at any number of classic NY joints.

review_title: Incredible? Amazing? Can't decide between the two!
review_text:
Seriously don't know where to start. From everyone/anyone at front desk, to Ray, to the bellmen and the guys at the elevators- everyone superfriendly, supernice. 
Coffee and tea in the morning, wine in the early evening. Great food in the restaurant. 
Not sure how they can improve! Love it here- love Kimpton!

review_title: High grades say it all: excellent property.
review_text: Pretty much ditto to all the other positive reviews. Have stayed here three times on business in NY and a delight every time. Rooftop bar/view is unbelievable to the most jaded travelers. All around great feel to the place.

My boyfriend and I stayed here during fashion week and the US Open. It was a great stay. Extremely economical,clean, and hospitable. Great location,right near great shopping and the subway so you can get wherever you need to.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_title: Great value for $150 but not a penny more
review_text: This is a great fresh new hotel with great features. They have maximized the room space. Good location and a fun place to stay, that's the good. The staff require a lot more training, they are friendly but have no answers to to small issues. They are always insearch of info or supplies. The is no free breakfast, it's coffee and muffins, the "breakfast included" is a joke. They should be honest is not breakfast. This is worth $150 a night and I would pay that for it but when it's at it's "regular" price of around $300 I would look elsewhere.
hotel_name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West

review_text: Every staff member I saw was amazingly friendly and engaging. It may not sound like much but in the world of hotels, it's a big thing.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: We were able to check in early, received a discount at the little terrace restaurant next door and we just steps away from Central Park, Times Square, Rockefeller Center. I'd stay again!

My wife and I enjoyed our stay very much. The location was perfect and made travel very easy with a subway station a few blocks east.
Also, this was perfect walking distance to times square but far enough away to avoid the crowds and the noise. Plus, rockerfeller center is literally accross the street!
Great place, great value, we would go back again!

My first impression was Yotel was very modern! "Ground Control" (the main lobby) had a huge automatic revolving door, airport-style e-check in, and a huge luggage sorting robot! There were plenty of staff to help guide us thru this space-shuttle-like building, which is a plus.
After check-in, we're brought up to the 4th floor "Mission Control" which is the site of the bar, outdoor terrace, public computers, and lots of sitting room & lounge space. From there, we take another elevator to the room.
The room is great. All Times Square hotels are gonna be small, but Yotel makes up for the compact space with very clever and functional room design. The bed has 
motor controls which let you either lay the bed flat or recline it up to watch TV (the reclined position also creates extra space in the room - very nice feature)
There's a plethora of lighting options at your disposal. Natural light comes in thru the bathroom window and illuminates the rest of the room. There's a lack of division between bathroom & the bedroom (a white curtain) so if you've had Mexican food earlier that day, be sure to warn your girlfriend or play the TV loud or something :P
The TV is an LG displaying true HD and there's an audio jack to hook up an iPod/music player and play thru the TV speakers. 
One thing missing that I think would be standard in any hotel room was an ironing board & iron. Room service brought me an iron, but I had to flatten my pants on top of the bed with a towel :P I guess, in Yotel's defense, thy offer pressing/ironing services - but I'd rather just do it myself.
Overall, the decor and ambiance is a great touch and really sets this hotel apart from other hitems. Location is great too and I'd definitely stay here again :)
hotel_name: YOTEL New York at Times Square West

review_title: Great stays, friendly staff... and pet-friendly!!
review_text: We stayed at the Ink48 twice in the last 2 weeks--for one night on our way from DC to Boston, and for two nights on the way back. Both stays were wonderful. For NYC, the rooms are very large and an excellent value, many with great views of the city. Although it is not right in Times Square, the location is pretty central, and our cab rides rarely exceeded $10. The staff is extremely friendly. All Kimpton hotels have a free wine happy hour from 5-6 every day, which is a nice touch. All of the hotels are also very pet-friendly, with treats and water in the lobby. Our 5 month old Bulldog puppy loved the hotel and all of the attention that he got from the great staff! We'll be back--I can't imagine staying anywhere else in NYC!
Very friendly staff. Exceptional service. Terrific location. Very well connected by subway. Will stay there again.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: Could not be happier, not the cheapest, but worth the little extra. Human sized rooms were a pleasant change! Great service.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: Everything is good. the only thing they can improve is the elevatorï¼šif it can be larger, that would be betterï¼
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_title: Beautiful hotel. Impeccable service. Incredible location
review_text: We just left the hotel after having spent the weekend. This was our first new York trip during Christmas season with our children(3 and 5). The hotel was absolutely gorgeous. The bed was delightful. Their was a pillow menu from which we selected every night. The service was outstanding and they were incredibly forgiving of and accommodating to our not so well behaved boys. What could have been a challenging trip turned out to be delightful as a result of the hotel. There was housekeeping twice daily, a lovely turn down service with delicious treats, at which time they also set up the pull out beds for the kids. When the children somehow set the tv to Japanese, there was someotheron the room within minutes to fix it. The lifeguard at the pool eagarly gave balls and kick boards to the boys in the pool. Everyone was kind and tremendously helpful. We will without question be back and if this is any indication of how the trump properties are run, we look forward to visiting the others.

review_title: Don't be stupid be a smarty c'mon join the Trump Towers party!
review_text: Checked into a one bedroom park view suit with the wifey in Feb. Third time we have stayed here because apart from great service it's hard to go past the view of central Park which is right accross the road. If you get a Park view suite there are two types. We get the one on the corner because the lounge looks over Columbus circle and Central park and main bedroom looks over Central Park. The Park viewsuites that are not on the corner have all windows facing the Park. Beds are very comfy and staff culture is excellent. A lot of celebs stay here because it's more of a boutique hotel and therefore more private. Sat in the restaurant for breaky and Nicole Kidman and family were a couple of tables away. Upper East side location is fantastic and of course you get to run or walk through Central Park in the morning. Bathrooms could be a little bigger but that's the only downside. If it's your first visit to the Big Apple it's a must just for the views. Guaranteed to put a smile of the wifeys dial !

review_title: Great, but not sure whether it's a hotel or an apartment block
review_text: Stayed here for 4 nights because the Mandarin Oriental was booked up. Generally a great experience, rooms are lovely and room service food the best I have had. The hotel suffers from lack of a proper lobby (and bar area) which takes away from the experience somewhat - you whisk from the front door to your room without really having any opportunity to take in any sense of the place.
clean, safe, convenient, affordable, quiet, comfortable, great wi-fi, great breakfast, simple hotel, perfect for sightseeing
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: I'm a frequent traveler to NYC, this is the best hotel I ever stay in the city. Ideal For first timers at the city. Pros: reach in 30-45 minutes from JFK via metro. steps to Rockefeller ice ring and metro lines. Instant ck in ck out. Free wifi. Free bottle water. Card elevator. Modern rooms. Free bags storage. Cons: don't find.

First time in NY so didn't know what to expect but this hotel was brilliant. Very friendly and helpful staff (though they could do with stools instead of having to stand all the time). Clean and cool room and free wifi. Amazing location - 5 or 10 minutes walk to Times Square and near 5th avenue. Will definitely come back.

review_title: Great Room, Great Staff, Great Location
review_text: Nothing bad to say. Trump covers all the details. The room was very large overlooking Central Park. Electronic shades/curtains mood lighting. Bed was very comfortable and the room was immaculate.

review_title: Funky Boutique Hotel With Class Leading Service!
review_text:
Everything has already been said numerous times however I can confirm that this hotel lives up to all the hype! Me & my wife celebrated her 30th birthday & the hotel staff could not have been more attentive. From the warm welcome given by John on Reception, to the free bottle of wine in the room, to the continued superb service from Sian-Pierre, absolutely first class! City View King Room definately worth the extra money & the free coffee, hot chocolate & wine were winning free touches. The only thing we could not work out was the duty & purpose of the doormen. They sometimes appeared too busy chatting up the local talent or standby around to notice people struggling with the front door with luggage etc. This was the only negative & struck us as strange as everything else was high end 
boutique so a big thank you to the 
staff & management for making our
 trip & my wife's 30th birthday such
 a memorable stay!

We were upgraded to a 2 bedroom suite. Room was fantastic. Great views even though we were only on the 6th floor. The kids were treated like royalty. It was a great weekend to celebrate our son's birthday.

The hotel is great- very clean, well appointed, fabulous location. Rooms are not large (typical for NYC) but extremely well designed- they have everything laid out quite well (even a microwave and fridge!). The staff was A+- very helpful with advice.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: Booked hotel weeks prior to arrival date. Had confirmation number. Went straight to hotel from airport. Wanted to check in and have bags taken to room while we kept our spots in city. We were told "No problem. We'll keep your bags and you can check in upon return.". Upon our return, we were told that they had no room for us, but would put us in their sister property a few doors down. That was unacceptable, however we were talked into viewing the property. It was horrible and had a greasy hamburger smell throughout! I was able to secure a room elsewhere through my connections and left the property immediately!

review_title: Best value for money hotel in NYC
review_text:
I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough. I stayed there for 17 nights, and selected it for it's location......close to three subway lines, Herald Square, and far enough away from 42nd street so as to be less touristy and noisy. Easy walk to everything as well...around the corneron Sixth Avenue there is a Duane Reade, Pax Whole Foods, and a fresh fruit cart on the street daily. Around the corner on Fifth Avenue four blocks up is Lord and Taylor.....and a quick block over from that on Madison, the Pierpont Morgan Library...a must see for everyone. 
The hotel staff, without exception, were all wonderful, helpful, attentive. The room on the 26th floor was spacious,and a great view of the Empire State Building, with a large bathroom with a walk in shower...something rarely found in NYC hotels in this price range....and great air conditioning. The half size fridge and microwave and coffee maker made a huge difference to my long stay. Excellent flat screen TV.....and maid service excellent....tons of towels daily. Book far as you can in advance to get the best deals.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: Stayed for two nights at the end of a touring holiday. Reception staff were extremely polite and helpful nothing was too much trouble. The room was very clean and gave us a great view of the Empire State Building. I would deffinatly recommend this hotel.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: We just returned from a one night stay (our second). Once again, we had a wonderful experience. We travelled with our 3 children (ages 13, 11, and 7) and are so impressed that the hotel is so kid friendly, from the welcome hot chocolate at check-in, to the personalized stationery kits for the kids, to the kid-friendly DVDs and board games left in our room at turn-down. The location is wonderful (despite the nasty weather we could easily walk to the theater for a show). The staff was just wonderful and really made our stay special (we were celebrating 2 birthdays). We will never stay anywhere else in New York!

review_title: So glad I found this place. Best in NYC
review_text: Stayed here on my first stay in NY. Great location and phenomenal price. Best value. Close to everything. Staff was great and rooms were comfortable. We had an evolution room with a city view of the Empire State Building. Will definately stay here again.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_title: The bad side of this apt and its service
review_text:
So much had been said of this apt so I thought I will just highlight two bad experiences instead:
1. Do not expect the counter staff to take or pass on your enquiries/ requests/instructions from one to another (the counter staff work in shifts and on different days) - apparently they don't.
2. Do not use the laundry services because they go by weight and you have no clue how heavy your clothes are unless you have a weighing machine. Ours cost a bomb and two Calvin Klein polos went missing. Instead of delivering the next day as promised, they took 3 days. So if you really need to use the laundry please make sure you budget for extra time and $. Otherwise take a 10 mins walk down the avenue and spend 2 hours waiting for your laundry to be done. We did not want to do the latter as we were on holiday and it was raining but only to encounter something so unreliable. We only got our clothes before check out and discovered the loss at our next destination. When we called BW to help, they said "we are not responsible". But certainly they can help to check with the laundromat for us as it was recommended by BW who have been using them all this time?

Even the call to book the room was pleasant.
The front desk receptions were very friendly and informant.
We booked a pure room which is a couple of dollars more than a standard room, but for the cost, the room was super clean. The bathroom was immaculate. The bed has an adjustable knob for more firm to more soft. 
I strongly believe this hotel deserves more than just three stars. For the price/ location/cleanliness...we can't complain.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_title: Spacious, clean, high quality, great location, great value & friendly staff! Top class holiday!!!
review_text: We have just spent 3 nights here & it was seriously better than we could have imagined! We were travelling with a baby & so we wanted to stay somewhere with a kitchen... And what a find this was! I can't fault it at all! The bedrooms are very comfortable, the living areas are spacious & nicely decorated, the kitchen is practical, the bathroom was clean & had a bath too! Breakfast is great & they provide trays in your room, so get down for 7am & pick it up & enjoy in the comfort if your own living room! This was by far better than staying in any hotel... I will be recommending it to our friends & family and I hope we will make it back some day! The staff are friendly, happy to help & keep this place ticking over nicely! Thankyou all for making our stay so wonderful!

Upgraded to a corner room on a higher floor with a great view. Room was freshly decorated with an updated bath. We were very happy with the room and it's amenities. The size was adequate for 2 women but it would have been nice to have a separate vanity outside the bath so one could use the shower while other used the vanity. Very comfortable bed with extra pillows. Unlike many other NY hotels, our room had a small dresser, desk and chair and closet. 
As this was our first time to NYC we were out of the hotel early everyday until late, so we did not use the hotel's restaurant or other amenities. The concierge was helpful, the front desk staff were courteous and always greeted us when we entered the hotel. The belllman on our first day was friendly and helpful; the other bellmen were curt and 1 didn't know where the winter garden theatre was (MAma Mia) 
We knew before booking our room that the front entrance and lobby were under construction and that we would have to use W42 entrance. We allowed for extra time to do this. This entrance is not very attractive as its a hallway where luggage is stored. 
Our trip to NYC was a great way to celebrate our milestone birthdays and if I would recommend this hotel

You could not ask for a better hotel for the price. 150/nt a week before arrival in December. Hotel is close to everything. Rooms are very clean. Staff was very friendly. Everyone gets free breakfast in the morning but make sure you get there early to avoid the line. The only con I have is that the hallways could use a little revamp. Other than that everything was great
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_title: A great hotel at a great location.
review_text: Room was rather small, but had everything you generallly need in a hotelroom and most of all: it was very clean. The bed was marvelous, as was the shower. The hotel is literally one minute away from Herald Square (and Macy's...), and just a few minutes more from the ESB.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: Le camere della Towers sono fantastiche, spaziose e con un servizio impeccabile. Credo i soli bagni di NY con il bidet. Colazione eccezionale con vista strepitosa e light lunch e dinne compresi. La posizione eccezionale dell'hotel in piena mid towm dietro la cattedrale di San Patrick, lo rende tra i migliori di Ny.

My husband and I just left the Hilton Times Square, and we had a fabulous stay. The location of this hotel is the best! You are literally steps away from the subway, restaurants, shops, 5th avenue, the Rockefeller center, etc. You'll never miss a thing staying in the heart of Times Square. The rooms are extremely clean and comfortable. The staff was friendly, the lobby and lounge are beautiful, and did I mention the great location! The only 4 I gave was due to the small bathroom, but this should be expected considering this prime real-estate.

review_title: Four nights of fun in NY
review_text: Our party of four (two couples) looked at the hotel options and this was both economical and convenient. The two bedroom aparments are spacious, clean and well equipped with everything you need for a short break in the city. Front desk staff very helpful and friendly. Breakfast was adequate and I was helped with Internet access when my laptop failed late at night. The location is good with a short walk to the Rockerfella Centre and a 15 minute wall to Times Square. We loved it and would recommend to anyone wanting a practical, reliable, clean and homely stay in this crazy place :-). Thanks to all the staff for making our stay so pleasant.

review_title: Great location, lousy service; a poor experience during the holiday season.
review_text: I stayed here because of the location and the location is excellent if you want to be in the middle of Times Square. The room was clean except for the mold in the shower area. Also, the room was nicely sized and we had a distant view of the Statue of Liberty. As for the service, it was nonexistent. We asked for bottled water which was never delivered. Getting your car out of parking in a reasonable time frame required a big tip and a $52 fee. I had reserved two rooms and the mixed up the reservations We tried to get bell hop service on checkout, but they never answered the phone. We accidentally left a camera in the room so we called the hotel asking for assistance. I know that the hotel is not reponsible but a little concern would have been appreciated. Instead, we got rude uncaring behavior. All during the Christmas holiday. This hotel should be a pass.
just off times square, good room, clean, people friendly, resaurant i would skip though.

Rooms are in need of updating. I have stayed in Hampton inns much cleaner and nicer than this place. Warm weather in December means rooms are hot, could not sleep at night due to room temp. Manager said nothing they could do. No fans were available , seriously how do you not offer fans if you are too cheap to turn on the a/c when it's 50 plus degrees out

I go to New York twice a year, and for the last 11 years and have stayed primarily at The Doubletree Tree Suites Times Square or the Hilton Times Square. Not anymore! The Hampton Inn North was everything I could have imagined being a Hilton property and more. The staff was warm, friendly and attentive. The location is a particular high point for me. Where the Doubletree was right in Times Square's hustle bustle and noise, the Hampton Inn North is more quiet, centrally located and PERFECT! I have already booked again for my visit in March.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: Love the location as you can walk easily to times square, rock center, and Columbus circle. And there are many subway lines close by as well. Rooms are NOT your typical closet sized NYC hotel rooms. They are actually good sized and you can move around without tripping over each other!! It's also a relatively quiet hotel with good soundproofing. It's tough to find a good hotel in NYC and this one is a real gem.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: Abbiamo scelto questo hotel come prima tappa del nostro viaggio di nozze e siamo rimasti pienamente soddisfatti. Servizio ottimo tutti molto cordiali e disponibili,ci hanno risolto un problema causato da un loro errore, chiamando direttamente in banca. L'hotel e' bellissimo e enorme con un ottimo ristorante al suo interno

review_title: Al centro del mondo in tutto e x tutto!!
review_text:
Abbiamo soggiornato in questo hotel x 6 notti, 6 al centro di New York e ti puoi muovere liberamente a piedi!La fermata della metro e' vicinissima se ti devi spostare, le camere sono essenziali come la reception ma con un servizio impeccabile!
Il personale e' cortese e disponibile e a fine soggiorno si puÃ² usufruire di un deposito bagagli se si ha l'aereo in tarda serata!

This is a wonderful hotel for business travelers, families and couples. It is exactly what you expect from Hilton, 5-star service and large, clean rooms. The rooms have stunning views and it is centrally located in the times square area. I highly recommend the Hilton times square.

review_title: Best place to go for the holidays!
review_text: I came here with my husband and 2 small children for a little holiday vacation. The staff here treated us like family from the second we walked in the front door. The lobby is decorated and inviting, especially for the holiday season. The front desk gave us a room at 12 noon, which was appreciated for the children. We were near everything and our room was spacious enough for the 4 of us. This is my new favorite holiday hotel in the city.

I stayed here with my family in early November and was so impressed with the service here. They gave us a high floor with the best view of downtown NYC! The rooms were huge and the staff was extremely helpful and helped with every question we had. Thanks Hilton!

The vies are amazing; our room on the 38th floor looked over the empire state building. Thank you for naking our trip memorable.

review_title: By far best property for value if you are looking in Theater District
review_text: Two nights on this stay. Fully the level of consistant Hampton quality I have come to expect. SO close to restaurants, theaters and Times Square. Subway entrance for A-C-E right there at 50th/51st. Staff is very polite though maybe a little unseasoned.

review_text: I came to the hotel and the staff was very helpful. I was able to upgrade to a room on a high floor. The rooms are nice and have great views. The one down side is that it is a bit too crowded. Times square is full of tourist, from allover. Try to avoid 42nd street if you can.
The hotel was clean, the front desk was gracious and I could see the empire state bldg from my window. Yes, rooms on the small side, but you're sleeping! Will be staying here in future

review_title: One of the Best hotels I have stayed in.
review_text: Stayed here for 4 nights mid April. good room size, despite what some seem to think! Beds were super comfy, very little street noise (we were on the 4th floor), breakfast very good, staff all fairly pleasant, though my sister took a bit of cheek from one receptionist when trying to reactivate her room key. Probably best to keep your keycard away from your mobile phone! Overall a good hotel and good location, I would stay here again.

Our stay at this hotel was very pleasant. Smiling staff and welcoming atmosphere included. Coming in from a hectic day of walking around in the city, we can say it was a breath of fresh air to enjoy the Hilton's wonderful services. review_title: On my way to the airport
review_text: I just left the hilton times square and I have to say the service was great. (He staff took care of me like a vip. I was upgraded to a room on the 44 floor by danae, and I received complimentary water, slippers, and water everyday. Thank for the great experience

review_title: Friendly staff, brilliant location! Family friendly
review_text:
Stayed 4 nights in October with husband and 2 year old. Absolutely loved it. The rates were more than we have ever paid anywhere in the world, but that just seems o be manhattan and it was worth it to be walking distance to times sq, central park (brilliant playground for kids just 10 mins away), FAO Swartz, 5th ave, Rockefeller building and even grand central station. We did loads of walking but so much to see. 
Also has subway really close, which we took to brooklyn (followed a lonely planet walk in reverse from Brooklyn neighbourhood brownstones to bridge and then over it - much better to walk towards manhattan for view and largely downhill). Also took subway to far end of central park and walked back. Subway cheap and efficient and not crowded outside peak hours esp on the local stop line near the hotel.
We were up early with toddler so breakfast quiet and plentiful. Hot foods change daily but maple sausage should be on every day. 
The guys who helped with luggage were great. All staff helpful with our endless questions. The bowl of apples and cookies were fantastic. So amazing to be so close to times sq etc at night. Always felt really safe as so many people around and not far to go to get home. Very family friendly. Free crib provided was big enough (just) for nearly 3 year old so lots of pace in room.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: I came to the hotel with my girlfriends to have a fun weekend and the hotel porovided the perfect location. Being in the middle of evrything is so cool. Thank you chris for the great service at ther bar, and the free shots. Really want to come back, and yes we will.

Situation inmejorable en el corazon de Manhattan. Que pena que el hotel sea muy ruidoso, la amabilidad del personal nula y los ascensores permanentemente ocupados ( contra basta 10' minutos para bajar ! )

review_title: I want to love the Surrey.
review_text: But, they don't make it easy. Room service takes an hour, IF you are lucky, even if you do the night-before-door-tag-thing. (Tip, order it for 45 minutes before you actually want it.) And earplugs will help not hear the vacuum cleaners in the hallway before it is light outside. I can't say what time because I couldn't read the time on the tv. And I was very disappointed that they closed the hotel bar for a private party. Although they did offer the aforementioned room service. (ice delivery took 20 minutes) That said, great upper east-side location with nice rooms. And they really do want to please.

Pricey of course, it's Times Square. Good location, very clean rooms. BUT the hallways, on the Hilton Honors floor, disgusting. Room service trays from the night before remained in the hallways all day. And this was for two days straight. That should be addressed immediately before this 4 star hotel becomes an average two star for cleanliness.

We stayed at the Surrey for 11 nights. After arriving from Australia we were told that our booking had been cancelled. Luckily they found a room for us which we stayed in for one night before being moved to another room the next day which was beautiful. We got married in NY and they sent us a lovely bottle of champagne. They also set up a tea service for my husband. Susie the room maid was delightful. The front desk staff were always great. They got me into a dentist when I broke a tooth. Except for the first day the whole experience was great. The location is fantastic. It was very expensive but it is a 5 star hotel.

review_title: Excellent vfm would stay here again
review_text: Stayed here in september with my wife and adult daughter. The location is bang on for the theatre district and close to subway stations if you want to go further. The staff were good , the breakfast well presented and hot (albeit busy at times) and the all day coffee and fruit and cookies a welcome sugar boost on return from a day out. We were particularly impressed with the afternoon staff give aways in the foyer ! Fruit punch, orios, bottled water, all added to the experience! I would definitely recommend this place, and will stay again I'm sure.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: The staff was really cool and dressed up for Halloween. They gave me awesome candy at the door. Mmmm, Swedish Fish. Carla, Amanda, and Sarah were super friendly and hilarious.

I came to the hilton times square with plans to ask my girlfriend to marry me. The concierge booked the perfect restaurant and when my fiace and I got back to the room, there was champagna and chocolates, compliments of the hotel. Thank you for the help, and ill make sure to send pictures of the wedding next year.

I came to the city with my girlfriends, and the hotel staff took care of all our plans. The rooms are huge and have two queen beds, which was perfect for the four of us. We got the change to enjoy the center of the city because the hotel is in the center of the city. The managers are very friendly, three of them were even kind enough to take pictures of us in the lobby. We had a great time. This place rocks.

L'hotel si trova in una posizione eccellente, di fronte il rockefeller center, a due passi dalla fifth ave, vicino alla fermata della metropolitana e cinque minuti a piedi da times square. review_text: The staff at this hotel is very nice. I got a room on the 38th floor overlooking downtown. The lobby is ok, but needs to look a little nicer. I had a lot of fun, and everything is really close. The bellman always have cabs ready, and I always got free water.
I had a great time at this hotel, the staff is lovely and welcoming. I want to say thank you for the upgrade to a high floor, and for all the help with my plans.

Amanda at the front office always recognized me when I walked by the lobby. I will be coming back next year, thank you all for the personal attention

Great bar and restaurant (cafe boulud) in lobby - excellent food and service.

review_text: My husband took me on a surprise get-a-way to NY...it has been a place I've always wanted to go for the longest. Upon arrival we were greeted by the doorman who helped us from our cab and at checkin we were able to get to our room quickly. The room was spectacular with a view of the empire state building (we were even given a comp upgrade!). Our housekeeper always gave us fresh towels and would smile at us while we passed by her in the hallway. The we ate at the restaurant for dinner and one of my favorite things was the banana chocolate bread. We chose not to pay for breakfast buffet and found some restaurants/cafes only a few minutes of walk from the hotel with good valued breakfast.
Had a very good time and will recommend this hotel to everyone!

review_text: Location is very nice for putting a little distance between the frenzy of mid-day in Mid-Town and evening recuperation. The staff are attentive but not intrusive, and very helpful. The restaurant is very pleasant with a Continental breakfast buffet that suggests deep European roots.

The elevator was broken and the hallways are so loud when they are cleaning other rooms making it impossible to take a nap in the afternoon. Other then those minor things the hotel is what it is.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Hilton. I will be straight to the point, great customer service, clean room, and definitely reasonablly priced for the location. We were so happy the hotel was near all the action of time square.

review_title: Great location, friendly staff, cool property - we will return
review_text:
Spent one evening at The Surrey this past weekend. Perfect NYC boutique hotel. Fabulous location. 5 minute walk from Central Park. Property is new, modern, cool and fun. Room was nice. Rooftop bar is a great spot for an early evening or after dinner drink. Staff was 
perfect. We will return.

This place was all around excellent! We have nothing bad to say. The breakfast was great. The staff was superb, from the people at the front desk, to the guy that helped us to our room with our bags. The location is great as well. You are within walking distance of Central Park & a lot more of what NYC has to offer, which helps out with transportation costs. I can't say enough great things about our experience, at this place! Definitely worth the price!

review_text: As we arrived we were at the lobby eating our dessert we needed spoons so I went to the coffe session quickly Wilbert one of the employees in the lobby approached me and kindly asked if I was in need of anything I asked for spoons but I noticed there was none he kindly told me that he would get me the spoons he went to the back room and got me the spoons I needed.The next day we had finished breakfast and I was with my doughter she was still tyred and a little cranky and began to cry Alonso one of the employees approached us and he began to speak like Donald Duck my daughter stoped crying she began to giggle truly very happy with the excellent detailed customer service rooms where spotless beds so comfortable
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text:
My family and I had a very enjoyable stay in July 2011. This was our first trip to the US and New York could have been like jumping in at the deep end but I can honestly say that I never felt anything but safe and we enjoyed every minute.
We were determined to cram in as much as possible and do the obvious tourist things. To help other visitors, here are our recommendations:
Empire State Building - People told us to go early. The problem was that everyone went early. The ques went down quite quick but it was very busy at the top. At 2pm when we came down, there were no ques. Do this by day.
Top of the Rock- A must do by night! After all, you cannot miss the city by night and it'sthe best place to see the Empire State Building lit up. We found the Rock a much more relaxing and romantic experience. there is more viewing room from several levels. They do photographs which whilst not cheap are worth it. You can book tickets for the time you want and go back at night and avoid any ques.
Natural History Museum - We tried to do this in one afternoon lol. Give yourself a full day and take it all in. The planetarium is worth a visit!
NYC Tour -My wife booked a whistle top tour of Manhatten on our first day. This may not be good for everyone as it involved jumping on and off a bus to see the sights but we enjoyed it and in one day we got really orientated which helped us for the rest of our trip. The tour included a boat trip and the guide on the boat was excellent, entertaining and informative.
TKTS - We had to see a Broadway show so got tickets from the TKTS booth near the ferries (the onein Times Square is always busy). We paid half price for Chicago, about $70, but a couple from Norway went to the box office on the morning of the show and got them for $35! 
Subway - we were a little nervous about the subway but it could not have been easier to use. It was on time and clean. The driver explained which station was next as we approached and told us when to get off for a free coach due to maintenance work on the line.
Planet Hollywood - This was booked as a treat for my birthday and was a big disapointment. The food was ok but the staff did not know what was on the pre-paid VIP menu, we ended up having to pay for desert which sould have been included. The movie memrobilia was ok but not worth the money paid for the meal.
TFI Time Square and 5th Ave - Not cheap but great food and great service. Choose Times Square to watch the world go by & 5th Ave for a quieter meal.
JFK transfer - we booked a shuttle bus for about $120. The problem is you will share the bus and therefore have to go to all the other hotels on the way. Get a cab! The fares are a set $45 plus tips (and toll if you go thru them so ask to go over the bridges). The shuttle bus drivers are not polite and the buses that we had were ok from the outside but well worn on the inside.
Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island- You have to do this trip at least once in your life. I may not be an American but the history speaks for itself. If you can make it, see the film in Ellis visitors centre about the immigrants. Very moving and thought provoking.
Finally, the hotel. We found the Hampton in welcoming, clean, good sized rooms and amenities. The breakfast is essential for a good days sight seeing (get up before 7am to beat the rush for a table). Great fresh food, constantly replenished and great staff keeping everyone happy at breakfast.
The concierge are very helpful and have leaflets on everything. They will book show tickets but be aware they will charge a booking fee.
Hotel Definatley Recommended!
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: We stayed here on a friend's recommendation for the convenient location. As we were only in NYC for 4 days it presented good value. Although the area is not the most salubrious, we could walk to so many places and many of the theaters are close by. The subways and buses are just around the corner and it is only two stops to Penn Station. If you stay make sure you get to breakfast early as long queues form after 7:30. The staff are helpful, there is a big safe for valuables in the room and also a good gym. And the wifi is free.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_title: Great stay, great locatotion, great city
review_text:
Third time in NYC first time in this hotel and everything was spot on! Stayed here for 6 nights for new year and couldn't ask for more! Spotless, polite staff and great location macys pretty much on the doorstep what more do want!
Marc
Southampton
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_title: The best possible location in New York!?
review_text: Stayed here for 5nts in September and was my first visit to New York. The hotel has an enviable location with only a few minutes walk to Hells Kitchen and it's many restaurants, Times Square and Central Park. There is a Metro Station 2 minutes from the hotel. The hotel is ideally suited to those first timers in New York or those that want to shop on or around 5th Avenue. Staff are friendly if not necessarily proactive with it but are happy to assist with any questions etc. Rooms are fine if a little dated and the normal size for a New York hotel. The hotel offers breakfast which is rare in the City but it does get very busy so recommend an early start. All in all a perfect hotel for an enjoyable stay for all that New York has to offer.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: Stayed at the Hilton Times Square because my Flight was cancelled (paid myself Not the airline). Room was Big, especially for a Manhattan Hotel. Despite the Ton of tourists it was a good Place to stay.

I stayed several Hilton group hotels during my stay in NY to check where to stay next month and this hotel was best value. Reception staffs were very kind enough, breakfast area staffs took care of foods and tables very well. Room was clean, and bigger than other hotels I stayed. Location was good ( bit far from my fav bagle shop though) Good stay and hope they stay the same until next time.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text:
Let me preface my comment by saying I'm a Hilton Diamond level traveler. I spend well north of 100 nights per year in hotels and more than half in Hilton hotels. 
With the context out of the way, let's begin with the neighborhood. I'm a large and imposing adult male and I felt unsafe walking on W 42nd street in early evening through midnight. The criminal element was out in force. Mugging or just being victim of a "flash mob" seemed a likely outcome. I would NEVER take my family into Times Square after 4pm when the businesspeople begin to leave for the day. There is a large police presence, but the NYPD is VASTLY outnumbered by the thugs with their pants around their ankles. Bad scene!
The hotel itself has no visible security and you enter a street level lobby where there is only a bellboy. You take an elevator to the 15th floor lobby where there is a concierge and lounge. The rooms are floors 16-44 and they're ok by Hilton standards except they could be cleaner. Rooms are large by NYC standards and views from upper floors are spectacular. The hotel itself is a solid 3 stars. 
Bottom line - for business travel stay elsewhere if you can. Single women should avoid at all costs. If you just MUST see Broadway try to go in a large group. If you can afford it, hire some protection. The criminal element in Times Square is the worst I've seen it in years and there are nowhere near enough cops to protect you.
I loved the hotel because of it's prime location. It's close to everything; from broadway shows, to all times square has to offer. The staff is very friendly and welcoming. Will definitely come back.

We just arrived home this morning after a wonderful 3 nights in New York, our first trip.
We like the Hilton chain & stay at one a couple of times a year. The Hilton Times was one of the best Hiltons we've ever stayed at! Perfect location, 2-3 mins walk from Times Square, friendly reception staff & our room the 24th floor was massive, especially by NYC standards! I'm fussy about cleanliness but the room was spotless.
Wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to others & we would stay there again when we go back. 
If I had to state one small negative, it would be the Internet charge in the rooms. WIFI is free in the lobby, so why not the rooms?
A tip on returning to the airport, the hotel will provide you with a hotel
Booked private taxi, we paid $60 set fee including tip to JFK, cheaper & much more luxurious than a yellow taxi. 
You won't be disappointed.

I stayed at the Hampton Inn from 26th - 31st August 2011, this motel was fantastically located a block away from Times Square and Broadway Strip - easy walking distance to everything including Central Park. I actually cabbed to Battery Park and walked the entire way back to the motel - easily!!
The room was comfortable, a little small but served the purpose, the was no fridge in the room, so cooling bottled water was a little hard. There was no tea/coffee facilities in the room, but there was a very good self service area in the lobby which we used regularly. (I like to have a cup of tea first thing in the morning, which meant I had to get dressed to go downstairs and get a cuppa, and bring it back up to my room).
Breakfast in the motel servery was very adequate, offered a wide array of foods, however very very busy, so you usually had to fight for a spare seat. (cutlery and crockery was cardboard & plastic - which I found quite bizarre, but again adequate). The fresh baked cookies in the hotels foyer were a HUGE hit for us...available daily from 3:00pm (I think).... A very welcoming gesture.
I would stay in this motel again, it was suitable for our needs, the staff we always friendly and helpful, and it was central to everything.
Thank you for making our stay in New York enjoyable.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: I came in to manhattan to celebrate my anniversary, and the staff at the hilton times square made my weekend. Wed asked for a room in a high floor, and we were given the best corner room with a view of tbe hudson river. I also got great restaurant recomendations , ando eddie, one of tbe managers told me about the rooftop bar 230Fith. My wife loved,thank you again. the best staff ever.

I brought my family for the firsttime to new York city, and we had a great time. The staff at the hotel was very friendly. Amanda at the frontdesk gave us an upgrade to a room in the 41emergency floor; and also got my girls milk and cookies. Everyone else was incredible. Thank you for making my family and myself feel special. Im already planning a trip for next year.

review_title: Family friendly hotel with great service at superb NYC location.
review_text:
We stayed at the Surrey for 2 nights with our two kids and their grandparents. the lady who checked us in was extremely friendly and helpful with a nice sense of humor. She found us two rooms that faced each other. All the staff at the hotel were very friendly and always ready to help with whatever we needed. The concierage was especially nice and resourceful. 
The rooms are well appointed with very nice rain-showers. The hotel is one block away from Central Park and 5 blocks away from the Met. We would definitely be visting this hotel again.

When I arrived at the Hilton Times Square, I was expecting an NYC room; but to my surprise the rooms are probably the largest I've seen in New York. They also provide slippers, water and complimentary robes in the room. I'm a frequent business traveler, and I'm thinking I finally found my hotel in NYC.

My sister and I stayed at this hotel with her 3 active boys. Good amount of room especially for a NYC hotel room. Hotel staff very helpful and friendly. 2 really went above and beyond -- Richard brought up a screwdriver so we could put batteries in the kids' toy store purchases and Lois (?) at breakfast gave the 3 boys packets of Oreos for snacks to have during the day. We also enjoyed the all day coffee and hot chocolate as well as the cookies in the lobby late afternoon. Also, the free breakfast was great...good variety and we always found seats. Overall a great hotel and easy walking distance to Times Square, Rockefeller Center, Central Park, theaters, etc.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: I came to NYC last month, and found the perfect hotel. In the middle of everthing, with big rooms and the most memorable service. From the bellman, to danae at the desk, and the houskeeping staff. Everyone always smiled. We were given complementary slippers, water and robes every day. Thank you for making my trip a great one.

review_title: Wonderful base to see LA from - fantastic service
review_text:
We stayed at the four seasons for 3 nights bases in Trip Advisor reviews - we were not disappointed.
The rooms were large, clean and comfortable, with great views of LA and the best beds of our whole holiday. The hotel was older, but had everything you needed for the stay.
The pool area was fantastic and town car a great addition.
The stand out however was the service, the staff printed maps, gave recommendations and advice and were overall brilliant.
Top tips are to book the town car n hour in advance around dinner and you can self park for free if you don't want to pay valet parking (access is from rear of the hotel)
hotel_name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills

review_title: Fabulous hotel in a fantastic location.
review_text: Myself and my husband have just returned home from a week in your hotel. It was a wonderful experience from the start until we left. Our trips in the Rolls Royce to Rodeo Drive & The Polo Lounge made it magical. We will be back. Thank you.
hotel_name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills

review_text: My experience was more than pleasurable and comfortable. Upon arriving, the front desk staff was courteous and engaging. All In all, the staff was extremely attentive and made my stay one to remember. Thank you for the water and chocolates Eri, we will see you again.

Raquel works at the front desk and she is fabulous to work with. She's always friendly, up beat, and knows her stuff. The best part, because I stay here so often for business, she immediately recognizes me and calls me by name. Even with so much travel, it's nice to feel like a person and not just a room number.

Stayed for a week with a friend who was there for nearly a month. The suite was beautiful, breakfast daily was delivered promptly. The staff was outstanding and we particularly enjoyed the complimentary Rolls taking us to & from shopping etc. 
The cabana/pool area & gym were tranquil and massages heavenly. Even the toiletries were divine. 
Dinner at Culina was outstanding and our server was fabulous and vert patient with our large and raucous party. He even went out of the way to have a fabulous salted caramel gelato dessert prepared for me when nothing else appealed. The bar scene was lively with music nightly & a see & be seen crowd, especially later in the evening. 
They were doing some prep work as I left for an awards reception and the noise in our suite overlooking pool/hills was troubling and they quickly moved my friend to a larger more fabulous suite. 
There is nothing like a Four Seasons bed and the service here was on par with what I have come to expect from this creme de la creme in other cities worldwide. Definitely the right choice in Beverly Hills.
hotel_name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills

review_title: Great location, friendly staff, great conciereges.
review_text:
Great location, clean, modern facility, smallish but comfortable. The concierge staff was professional and helpful, with great recommendations for "real" New York restaurants not tourist. Traps. 
Did not try the restaurant in the hotel.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text: The Hilton Times Square provides the perfect location. In the heart of manhattan, for real. I got the chance to reach every part of the island without any struggles. The staff is so welcoming, specially Dino at the door. Thank you for always having a cab ready.

review_title: Not on par with other Hampton inns I stayed.
review_text:
Our family loves Hampton Inns, but this one disappoints. 
First the lovables:
1) Superb locations. Just a few blocks to times square. Literarily steps to subway line C/E, one block away from subway line 1. Cross the street is stop for the double decker tour bus.
2) Quiet. I have complains (see later comments). But over it is a quiet hotel.
3) Free and fresh breakfast. Not a lot of varieties but quite OK for us.
Now onto the dislikes.
1) Noise. Windows seem to be sound proof'd, but walls are paper-thin. I hear my neighbor's chatting, my mom's neighbor coughing for the whole night. You can hear the noise from the isle so clearly. 
2) Cleaness. Rooms are not 'hampton-clean'. The carpet looks pretty dirty. I'd suggest not to walk bare foot in the room. We got a few itchy spots on the face and bodies while staying at the room.
3) Service. Some staff are nice. Others are not.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: I would recommend this hotel to my friends, for the great service that was provided to me . I want to thank Alexandra for get me in last minute reservation for Tao Restaurant . She went above and beyond for me. Maura help us out with recommend of the area romantic things for two newly wed couple. She sent us a bottle of champange to make our stay special. Samira was wonderful with great night club recommendations. The staff was so friendly and wonderful , our room was so beautiful and wonderful ,especially clean. Thank so much for everything .
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn New York West 35th

review_text:
Just spent two nights at this hotel with my wife and son (8 years).
From check in to check out this was a wonderful experience. Far too many good things to mention all but to give you an idea:
Fast, welcoming valet
Excellent check in
Spotless room - rollaway was already in the room with child robe, slippers and amenities
The hotel is not new but is very well maintained and spotlessly clean and efficiently run. This is as good as service gets.
hotel_name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills

review_text: My kids and I always come in to New York City during the summer. We usually look for the cheapest hotel in Times Square; but not anymore. I loved the Hilton Times Square and its staff. It is a little pricy, but their service is so increadible. The front desk staff always made sure my kids got gummy bear and chocalates everyday everytime we went by. Thank you Kabita, thank you Amanda, thank you all. Until next year.

just visited august 19 and all I can say is wow , thanks to all front desk staff was so excited to be in 42 floor awesome view also hotel room was very clean and bed were extra soft and location was great

This hotel is the best value in New York City! Big rooms, great location close to everything. The staff is amazing, breakfast is perfect. Fresh coffee all day. You are a 15 min walk from everything. Tour busses across the street. Lots of restaurant choices close by. Beds are super comfortable. I could go on and on about the value, location, and amenities. I highly recommend this hotel for business, family travel, or whatever your needs. Airport is only 15 mins by cab as well. Location, Location, VALUE, Location!
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: I've always wanted to see Times Square, and the Hilton Times Square provides the perfect location. The staff is awesome and we got free water and chocolates throughout our stay. Thank you Eddie; and yes we will be back soon.

I was expecting a tiny NY room and was pleasantly surprised.
The in room bar/refrigerator didn't work so instead they just brought us what we wanted and didn't charge us!
Highly recommended!
