review_title: Amanda, front desk manager, understands business travelers requirements, going over and above to ensure excellent service, iden
review_text: This is a great hilton, less crowded than the others. Nice, quiet rooms, some with views. Overall staff are good but can make billing and other mistakes. Amanda, the front desk manager is incredible and won't tolerate anything less than exceptional service. She is the main reason we return to this property. Kudos to her consistently going over and above. Hilton, you should have her train staff on customer service.

This is a nice hotel. The lady at concierge Honor was very helpful. Hotel staff is active and ready to serve. The in house car and Ray were also very helpful. Room service gave me everything I asked in my room. It's a quality hotel carrying their legendary name.
hotel_name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills

review_title: I have my children there and my husband
review_text: L liked everything in this hotel l loved it because I have my kids there and my husband
hotel_name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills

review_text:
So I was invited by my godfather to spend a night at The Surrey the weekend before my college graduation, to make up for his missing my graduation.
It was, one of my best hotel experiences, paralleled only by my stay at The Wynn LV. I can go on about the decor and service and say everything everyone else has said but what really got me about the Surrey were the little things.
The Vanity Fair coffee table collection, the Pratesi bathrobes and slippers, the Bulova alarm clocks, poetry inscribed on the furnishings and oh, the delectable Milanese Veal from Cafe Boulud. Just a few of my highlights.
Needless to say I will be returning the The Surrey in the near future when i can afford it on my own dime.

Just checked out after 7 nights at this brilliant hotel. Every single member of staff is welcoming, pleasant and eager to help in any way. The whole hotel is spotless and the 24hr tea, coffee & hot chocolate is very much appreciated. The location is perfect with 2 subway stations within a 5 min walk. Ask April for any help and a 
map. I would recommend this hotel to anyone in a heartbeat !!!!
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: Good for those who want to be near the theaters and the time sq. The rooms are perfect furnished with modern style.
Will definitely go back again. Everything was perfect. Couldn't have been cleaner with the nicest people.

The staff was excellent and truly represent Hilton well. I only wish it was closer to the heart of Times Square. It was pretty far away from Central Park but only a $7 plus tip taxi ride. The staff should get all the praise. When we checked out we left our luggage with the bell hops and I had my IPad and my wife's Kate Spade purse. When we returned 6 hours later everything was accounted for and we got service with a smile. It's nice to be around staff that act like they have perfect lives. Hats off to you all and thanks for a great stay. We will be back again.

review_title: Location location location! If you want the NYC experience this is the Hotel for you.
review_text:
Double Tree Suites in Time Square is a excellent hotel in the heart of Time Square. The staff makes all the difference. 
 The hotel suites are spacious, clean and provide a family of four plenty of room. If staying brings you to NYC this is the hotel for you.

Everything was nice, from check out to departure. The room was very comfy and clean. The concierge recommended a great restaurant for our first night in town. The location was perfect. I will be back for sure!

I came to NYC for a weekend in July with my fiance and stayed at the Hilton Times Square. The front desk was polite and curtious and had our rooms ready when we came in. Eriberto in house keeping made sure to bring us complementary bottled water and chocolates. Not to mention turn down service was excellent and our rooms were kept immaculate! In the center of everything so we didn't have to go far for fine dinning and night life. Too bad we only stayed for a weekend. Will definitely return to stay at this hotel when I come visit NYC again!

review_title: Located in the heart of NYC this hotel and it's staff are the best thing in times square.
review_text: I had a great time in NYC this past June. I stayed at this hotel for a weekend and it was wonderful. The check in staff was very friendly and helful. The housekeeping manager Eddie brought us water, slippers and chocolate and various stages of our stay. For such a crowed and busy city the hotel and it's staff and very knowledgeable and patient. I would stay at this hotel every time I visit NYC.

Just spent a few days in NYC and stayed at the here. This is our second stay and we can not say one bad statement about this hotel. The location is right in the heart of the theatre district, close to times square. The staff is friendly and the rooms are large. Yes, breakfast is extremely crowded but there is a diner and Starbucks less then a block away. We will definitely be back.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: Great, spacious room (suite); great service; great midtown location to enjoy Christmas-time in NYC. Will definitely stay here again!

I was in New York with my college roommate and we had the best stay at the Hilton!! Everyone at the front desk were sooo helpful!! I had no idea how to get to the nearest subway and Amanda was so helpful! She even gave us restaurant suggestions that were so great. We will definitely return!!

This hotel is in a perfect location if you are doing touristy things. Smack bang in the middle of times square, the rooms are spacious and clean. Staff are very friendly and super helpful. The only bad thing i could think of is that the breakfast was soo expensive, why would you pay so much when there is an applebees down below who serve a way better breakfast for a fraction of the price?! Overall a good experience in a nice hotel.
We stayed two nights. The room was very comfortable and clean. The area is very touristy being right in time square. Very congested area

review_title: Fantastically upgraded rooms, great location, fair price.
review_text:
This hotel is REALLY renovated from the old days of being the Rigyah Royale (sp?). Top to bottom in each room .... Hard wood floors with area rugs, gorgeous bathrooms better than Four Seasons, separate sleeping area from living space - ideal for having a meeting in your room without felling uncomfortable. Beds are comfortable, and rooms are bright and spacious - not the typical tiny NYC hotel room.
Must try for anyondine ending to stay in midtowne area.

review_title: Hilton made fourth of July a blast!
review_text: We are getting ready to check out of the Hilton Times Square, what a great place! We mentioned my daughters birthday and they made sure we had a high floor with a great view! The view was the best I have ever had in NYC and the room was very spacious. Location is smack in the middle of all of the action. Thank you Hilton! We will be back!

We stayed in a double bed suite with a fold out couch. We were there for five days and were happy overall. 
Initially we were horrified to discover a pillow case that looked like it had blood or lipstick on it, but at least it appeared to be stained, as if it had been laundered. After prompt removal of the offending case, the rest of the room was clean. The mini refrigerator wasn't working and maintenance had to come reset it. Even after that it never got very cold.
Basically those were our only complaints. The location was fantastic. Easy walking to so many things, plus 42nd St. subway connects to everything else. 
The room provided lots of space, a big bathroom plus a bar sink. The fold out couch was easy to manage. 
Housekeeping was friendly and efficient, providing us with extra coffee, cups, etc. All we had to do was ask. We found great Cuban food and authentic NY pizza slices nearby too. 
No view to speak of, but we weren't there to be in the room. I felt safe here with my kids. There are guards at the main door checking room keys.
Overall, we would stay there again.

review_title: Don't judge a book by its cover
review_text: If I was to choose a hotel for just my wife and I we would have never booked this hotel based upon the look from the street. How foolish would I have been? When you enter the door you are greeted by friendly doorman who direct you to the 3rd floor reception area. Wow what a surprise a crisp shiny modern and clean reception and very friendly staff. We had a wait for our room which did annoy however a few glasses of complimentary red wine eased the frustration and we were guided to our Familly suite on the 23rd floor. Good elevators and quick a rarety for New York Hotels. Our room was fantastic it accommodated 5 of us very adequately and would have taken 6. Great amenities coffe maker, fridge, microwave and 2 massive TV's. Very Clean and lovely bedding. The location is brilliant for any first visit to New York in the heart of time square. Great shopping,shows and resturaunts on your door step. As our kids had never visited New York we took them on the bus tour with the start point literally across the street. In summary if you are looking for a room in new York that can accommodate a Familly of 6 and you don't want the hassle of two rooms then look no further. Final point the complimentary cookies were to die for. Thanks for a lovely post cruise stop over

review_title: Two reasons I won't stay here again: indifferent bell staff and no coffee maker.
review_text: The rooms are great, the location superb, the showers fantastic. I but I like my coffee in the morning and room service is $40 for coffee and half a grapefruit. No coffee maker in the room. What offended me, though, was the bell staff. No one even opened the door for me when I came in at 12:30 pm with a large bag. When my husband and I left two days later, a group of bell hops was standing outside the doors and did not move an inch to open the doors when we and a second couple approached the doors to exit, all of us with bags. I have never had this experience in NYC, and, by the way, we are good tippers.

review_title: The BEST hotel for attending a broadway show or seeing the midtown sites!
review_text: The London NYC has everything one could want when staying in Manhattan. We bring our 3 boys often and stay in the 2BR suites. They are lovely. Soft lighting, exceeding clean, modern furnishing with excellent bed linens. The service is excellent and accommodating. We ate at Gordon Ramsey's Maze with our 3 boys(12,9,7). The food was excellent and although they didn't have a children's menu-the staff offered the boys pasta/chicken fingers and other kid friendly meals. The children always ask to stay here and it will be our first choice always.

review_title: The People Make It Worth It!
review_text: Beautiful rooms with breathtaking views! All of the staff was extremely helpful and accommodating!If you are looking for some truly helpful people at the front desk, ask for Heather or Jimmy and as a Bellman Adam went above and beyond! Couldn't have asked for better service and I would definitely come back!
Staff knows the meaning of "excellent customer service"

This is not the place to stay if you have business in NYC. We took 2 rooms for a convention at Javits Center. The location is fairly good for that. What I literally found offensive was the 12.95 day per device wireless charge. I needed to print boarding passes. The "business center" had three printers with 2 drawers each for paper. On the sixth I found some. The floor was covered with wasted receipt sheets. When I put paper in the printer for the computer I was paying .50 minute for, it spit out over twenty such receipts going back three days, so obviously the printer was empty for three days. It cost me $20.00 to print two boarding passes by the time I was finished.
Also, housekeeping. They never replaced face cloths, but they did take them. Second day I had to use a hand towel. Toilet paper was so thin it was like using none at all. My bill was over $5,000 for the two rooms for the five days. This is my third stay at this hotel and will be my last. It may be my last at a Doubletree as it seems they are now taking on the greedy policies that often keep me away from Hiltons.

fist night we arrived we got of the taxi ans there was this guy wih the fakest smile at the entrance who couldnt hold its fake wittiness for too long...he put our bags on the trolley and left it next to us at the counter sayin : here is your stuff some one else will take it upstairs ( then he just stayed there standing still next to us just staring with his super fake smile waiting for a tip whilst we where speaking to the girl at the front desk... then we tipped him... next came up to the room with a diff guy who by the way made a big effort to be polite and got his tip... 
The room is ok. (full stop) the wardrove is an open hole in he wall which makes the room feel messy and full once you open your luggage... 
im in he room at this precise moment and there is a terrible noise outside that sounds like an helicopter (day & night) we actually tought it was one flying outside our room... 
We called for house keeping and yes they made the bed and change towels but was is no attempt in making the room look neat...
When you walk in and out the building there is no one and when there is they dont even notice you are there... not even look at you or say hi... Its weird for us ... Im not sure if its normal... 
Any ways... the gave us free breakast with Amex and guess what? the crappy buffet only includes shopped fruit, super strong chesse, crapy bread, salami and coffee or tea... ahh and yoghurt.... the service at the restaurant was also terrible ( they completely ignore you) plus they came up wih a 60USD check (bill) like if they wanted to charge us even when hey knew it was included... 
Last thing... the very first night we arrived we ordered room service and guess the total for a tuna salad and a burger(no drinks) ??? well it was 89USD including 17% service fee + 10$ for bringing it up +5$ for the hour and some other creative fees lol... they are funny arent they?? 
Im very happy that we are leaving tomorrow!!

review_title: As New York hotel should be
review_text: Great service, huge rooms, brilliant concierge service and an excellent location.

review_title: Nice hotel in the heart of Times Square
review_text: Nice and large rooms. We have just stayed at a nice suite with bedroom and adjacent living room. Awesome experience. And it is not noisy at all, in spite of being right on the eye of Times Square!

We traveled to the US as tourists and really enjoyed the Crowne Plaza Suites in Houston. We really enjoyed the staff's friendliness. The hotel was VERY clean. The rooms are all suites, very nice, comfortable with several amenities. We liked the little touches such as microwave, refrigerator, Flat Screen TV's and the best of all complimentary in room safes, ( so we were never worried about our passports or currency, which has always been a prime concern as we traveled around this beautiful country) The indoor heated pool and hot tub with Gym was great! The food in the restaurant was fabulous, with a breakfast buffet. The hotel is quite close to Sugar Land and we really enjoyed the Towne Square shops and restaurant. We will definetly be staying here again when we come to the US again.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Suites Houston - Near Sugar Land

review_title: Busy hotel in a handy location
review_text:
I recently spent 3 nights here and have to say it was not for me. The hotel in a handy location and close to some great places to eat on 9th ave.
However it is incredibly busy and the walls are paper thin. It appears to be popular with groups as the first night teenagers were running about the floor banging doors and chatting in rooms until 0400!
I moved rooms and the next night was disturbed by a couple next door who appeared to have friends in and were laughing shouting until late, again i complained and the management dealt with it superbly and it was quiet within 5 minutes.
Breakfast was a nightmare get there before 0700 if you dont want to queue.
Overall clean large rooms good management team, understaffed perhaps in the lobby. Way over priced at $400 a night inc taxes.
hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_text: I stayed here last week for 5 nights with my boyfriend. It was our first time to New York so we were not really sure what to expect - only that we had paid Â£1500 each for flights and the hotel!! Needless to say, we had high expectations. Well, we were absolutely blown away! The room (we went for The London Suite) was incredible. Huge bed, French doors separating the bedroom with the living area, 2 showers in the bathroom! It was just to die for! We were on the 22nd floor which was plenty high enough. We did not have a room with a view but this did not matter at all. The hotel off a 'Turndown Service' which is when they come and get your room ready for bed whilst you are out in the evening...usually between about 7 and 8 I think. The bed was remade and the room generally tidied. All staff were wonderful. Concierge certainly know their stuff so ask them where to eat etc. don't go to TGI's in Times Square. We were very disappointed. Had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this hotel! Didn't eat in the Gordon Ramsey restaurant as it was very pricey!

review_title: Great location, beautiful hotel, horrible service.
review_text: At check in on Friday night there s barely enough staff to handle 3 checking at once let alone to 20 or so that they had continuously for 2 hours. The housekeeping person never finished our room and left counters dirty, and things were never put away. At the bar during the day, there was 1 bartender for 24 barstools and 20 tables. You can imagine the wait for service.

The hotel is located in the heart of the city. Awesome wave. The staff was friendly; especially a suit named Eddie. My sister and I ran into him by the elevator and he gave us great dinner and partying suggestions (had the cutest smile). He also sent is water and chocolates. I will definitely revisit the hotel, thank you all so much. 
Karen & family
Nice spacious rooms, friendly fast service and a great outdoor pool for 6am swim when you are still on European time.

review_title: NYC luxury that wont break bank
review_text: Everything about the London is terrific with the exception of the unprofessional and icy cold front desk staff. The rooms,location,food doormen and bell staff are wondeful. If they could just teach the front desk staff how to treat guests it would be a gem. Unfortunately they greet you as if they are doind you a big favor by checking you in.

We stayed here and were pleasantly surprised. The rooms were quiet
and the staff was super nice. The a/c was not very good but the bed was very comfy. The location has a lot to offer but you need a car and there is a charge for parking.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Suites Houston - Near Sugar Land

review_text: Special thanks to Eugene, the morning chef for his support of our special breakfast diet. 'Mostly eggwhite scramble with veggies' became a routine during our extende visit. Thank you Eugene!!

London hotel has mini suites perfect for a new York getaway --within walking distance to theatre 5th ave shopping and fabulous restaurants and an Avis rental office right next door could not ask for more .the staff Is superb

I had an amazing stay. I was checked in by the friendliest person ever the clerk enrolled me into a membership program that had awesome benefits like a late check out gift bag and fresh baked cookies! and the best part the membership was free!!! the room was huge and had The most comfortable bed EVER!!!!! the breakfast buffet was awesome it even included an omelet station!!!! i will make sure to visit again!
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Suites Houston - Near Sugar Land

review_title: Best Family vacation ever- Thank you St. Regis Hotel & Staff!
review_text: We are SPG members and usually book the Westin but they were out of suites and we likes the separate room because we have a 2 year old son. We tried the St. Regis and booked an Astor suite and we were amazed at how spacious and lovely it was. The valet service men were always very prompt and super curtious with us and even played with my son which I loved! We were in and out quite a bit since we planned trips to the zoo and museums. We requested a crib and a coffee maker and both were promptly delivered. We stayed 2 nights and at first only planned on 1 but loved it so much we extended our stay and the staff assisted with ease. We were made aware of the butler service the second day and requested French press coffee for breakfast and it arrived so quickly. Our son loved the Jacuzzi bath tub and the swimming pool. We loved our stay so much and enjoyed the friendly staff that we have planned our next trip back in June and we can't wait! I didn't try the spa services but hopefully next time! This is our new favorite hotel by far

review_title: Family vacation of a lifetime thanks to the St. Regis Hotel and staff!
review_text: We are SPG members and picked this hotel for our family vacation to take our 2 and a half year old son to the Houston Zoo for the weekend. We choose the St. Regis because they had suites so we could be separate from our son and booked an Astor suite. I normally choose The Westin but they were out of these types of rooms so this was our first stay at a St. Regis. The valet men were always so curtious to our family and quickly retrieved our car many times as we were often coming and going. They even played with my son. The front desk experience was pleasant and the decor is gorgeous. Our Astor suite was on the 8th floor and was trully beautiful! Very large and bright. My son loved the Jacuzzi bath. Room service is pricey but so worth it! It's very prompt and comes on a rolling tray set up as a table. We requested a crib and one was delivered as prommised as well as a coffee maker (there is not one in the room). We found out the next morning of our 2 night stay our room came with butler service and could as for french press so we did so the second morning. The butler service is very prompt and she even talked to our son as well which always gets a plus in my mind! My husband and son swam in the pool one day and the water was a bit chilly so it would be nice to have a heater in the pool but you can have food and drinks out there. They are doing construction on part of the pool area but it was never too noisy just smelled like paint. Overall we loved this hotel and have planned our next trip back because of our wonderful stay.

review_title: I would look forward to staying here again.
review_text: Me and husband went here for a weekend get away and we were very impressed with the service.The service is next to none we have experience any where so far.So KEEP UP THE GOOD CUSTOMER SERVICE..St. Regis!
Maze is great, and the rooms are among the largest in the city. Great location and service.
Goede ligging, met draadloos internet op kamers en Starbucks aan de overkant. Personeel zeer klantvriendelijk.

review_title: One of the best hotels in NYC
review_text: Stayed for 9 days in room 4510, thoroughly recommend the hotel. Concierge staff are amazing, bed was one of the most comfortable I have slept in and all in all one of the best stays I have had in NYC. Will definitely be a returning customer

review_text:
We stayed here on a pre Christmas shopping break, it was cold and snowing and arriving at the London certainly warmed us up.
Check in was smooth, simple and friendly, the London Suite was excellent, plenty of space, great fittings and extremely comfortable.
The bar is great, maybe a touch unorganised, they insisted on undercharging us on two occasions, I assumed that it was an early Xmas gift from them and enjoyed the complementary cocktail.
I have stayed at quite a few properties now in NYC and the London is by far the best, I will be checking in again on my next trip.

review_title: I love NY and I LOVED this hotel!
review_text: Although a little pricey, well worth it. Got the upgrade to a Times Sqaure view room for 2 nights for about $10. PERFECT location, could not have been any better, 2 blocks to our show Rock of Ages--we walked everywhere! View from our room, awesome! Could see all the activity in Times Square. Friendly staff. Spacious rooms/bathroom--all suites. Plenty of elevators. Extremely clean. Would absolutely return! Loved, loved New York ( I was a first time visitor, my husband had been here before), and loved, loved, loved this hotel! Would return and bring our 4 year old daughter with!!!!

If you want to be in the middle of the action in NYC...this is the place! Broadway shows are steps away, along with the hustle and bright lights of Times Square. I walked just a few blocks over to Hells Kitchen neighborhood, and the selection of great restaurants was unlimited. I was on the 222nd floor, overlooking Times Square, and the room was amazingly quiet for sleep. A subway station is across the street and Penn Station just a short walk...so getting to my meetings was easy. The room was very clean...no bugs...and the breakfast was great...service very friendly. For business, pleasure, or both this hotel was a good value and I would return again.
A good hotel with a great location. The staff was friendly and the room was clean. The room was a bit small but was otherwise fine.

After a few weeks of Europe and Asia it was nice to be back in the US. When we got to the hotel it looked like a normal nice hotel in NYC but like most other hotels here I expected to get to my room and step into a closet sized room with a view of a brick wall.. I couldn't have been more wrong, this hotel makes me feel at home. The bed is big and comfortable, the room is large and fully accommodating.. Went to the hotel concierge and he was able to find us tickets to a sold out play and then we went to the hotel bar , it was so friendly and fully stocked we really didn't have to leave.. I couldn't have been more impressed by a hotel, from the staff to the rooms I give The London in NYC 5 stars..
Stayed four nights - Jan 2011- close to metro, dining, times square and walking distance to central park if u don't mind walking.

review_text: This is not your typical hotel brand. The property was designed to be Eco-friendly and the little attention to detail designs add up to a very nice experience. The rooms have large windows and plenty of natural light. Each comes complete with a great work space, sitting area, and kitchenette. The breakfast bar included some healthy and still tasty choices. There are a variety of comfortable sitting areas throughout the lobby and grounds and the pool was sparkling clean. There is a guest reception in the lobby on weeknights with snacks and beer or wine but when I returned from downtown at 10pm the front desk associate offered me a glass of wine and invited me to join some other guests to wind down from my day. The closets are huge but the only drawback I could mention is the lack of drawers. I travel a lot and wish there were more locations of this brand. The property is 30 minutes from downtown but 5 minutes from the freeway in a quiet wooded neighborhood. Peaceful, comfortable, pleasant stay.
hotel_name: Element by Westin Houston Vintage Park

review_text:
My wife and I checked into The Element this past Labor Day weekend. I can't say enough about our stay there. We had a one bedroom suite and it was fantastic! Besides the large size of the suite the furnishings were awesome. High tech and very comfortable, we were impressed.
 The kitchen area was perfect: coffee maker, microwave, refrigerator, oven, and all glassware and utensils, it had it all. From the glass tiled backsplash to the stainless appliances, the room was done in great taste. 
 The den/living area was very comfortable containing a nice size sectional ( with pull-out single), large flatscreen and all necessary computer plug-ins. Again very tastefully decorated, very comfortable.
 The bedroom unit was very comfortable containing plenty of closet space and the most comfortable king sized bed we had ever slept in: a "Heavenly" bed!
 What a bathroom! Very high tech looking, lighting was great, and the rainfall shower was terrific. 
 A "Green" hotel at it's utmost! All the hardwood flooring (laminate) was made from recycled tires. The fabrics, carpeting and tiles were all manufactured from recycled materials. All appliances were energy efficient.
 The lobby area was also tastefully decorated, again using all green products. Breakfast is served in the lobby area and was delicious. 
All sorts of healthy choices were offered from various granolas and cereals along with healthy wraps. Topped off with juices and coffees, you couldn't beat this complimentary feature.
 The pool area was gorgeous. Large crystal geodes were placed in the landscaping along with sitting areas featuring constantly lit firepits and running fountains. All Elements were present: fire, water, and earth. It was truly relaxing.
 My thanks to David and John who were working the front desk during our stay. Very courteous and enthusiastic, these two employees made our stay in Houston extremely enjoyable.
hotel_name: Element by Westin Houston Vintage Park

review_text:

The only complaint we had was that we had to ask three times for a fridge to be brought up and that there was a random $7 minibar charge on checkout even though we never even opened the door - but it was taken care of with no hassle. And these were matched by the courteous and helpful doorman who got us to Penn Station in the hotel's complimentary vehicle in the pouring rain - that was a great gesture.
So, our recommendation would be to stay here - and book the Vista Suite. It's a great hotel.

review_title: Second stay not as good, housekeeping issues
review_text: This was my 2nd stay, somehow the review submitted for our 1st stay in Oct 2010 was "reposted" as the review for my June 2011 stay. I am resubmitting my review for June 2011. We had several housekeeping issues ranging from annoying to "are you kidding me?", not sure if there was a mgmt change since Oct. We were very disappointed with the housekeeping during our recent trip. Things like having the same candy wrapper on the floor for five days (annoying) to skipped turn down service at night ("are you kidding me?") simply should not happen at The London. We were very surprise given our wonderful experience this past Fall. The Reception Staff are top class, very nice and professional, as is the staff at the restaurant. If the service was consistent we would not think twice about staying at The London when we return to NYC in September. Given the lack of housekeeping service (there were several additional faults/misses that simple should not happen when paying $500 a night) we'll try another hotel next trip. I would not feel comfortable recommending The London to friends after this last experience.

review_text:
The location is beautiful - heavily wooded location with lush trees - very nice. And the property common areas are very nice - heavy oak wood, big floor to ceiling fireplace in the lobby, etc..... 
But the rooms are like Holiday Inn rooms that have been spruced up. 
Bathrooms are ridiculously small and difficult to move in. Most fixtures are old and worn. 
Bedding and furniture is not new. 
Service is not conducive to a modern business's traveler who arrives late and may want room service or even a beverage after 11pm. 
I would never stay here again. Too many other fine choices to earn my business.

review_title: Not as good as our last visit
review_text: This was our second stay at The London. Check in was easy, friendly staff at reception but I have to say, I was very surprised to be "offerred" a room on the 6th floor. When making the rez through AMEX Platimun we paid for a higher level suite - this certainly should have put us above the 6th floor (never mind the add'l free upgrade if available which comes with using the Platinum card). We asked to wait for another suite to become available, this worked out better - 42nd floor with a nice view of Central Park. While I found the staff friendly as we left and returned to the property, we were disappointed with Housekeeping. The same candy wrapper remained on the floor our entire stay. We received a card honoring our request not to be disturbed and to call Housekeeping for turn down service, but the following night this did not happen. We left the hotel thinking Housekeeping had not come by only to return later that evening to find the room was not serviced. Poor timing because a lightbulb next to the bed needed replacing that night so this did not happen. When paying $500 a night this should not happen. Also, I should not have to leave a note to Housekeeping to please leave a 2nd pair of slippers. For goodness sake, there are 2 people in the room - leave 2 pairs of slippers. My husband already made it clear will will not be staying at the London for our next trip to NYC. Too bad, I was very impressed after our last visit in the Fall.

The staff where very helpful and friendly. Rooms where very clean and comfortable.

review_title: You won't regret it - stay here!!!!
review_text:
We stayed in a Superior queen for a week over christmas. Firstly: location- excellent! 30 seconds to times sq, 5 minutes to rockerfeller, 15 to empire state, 15 to central park. It is amazingly central yet very very quiet. Our room was on 8th floor and we didn't hear any street noise at all. 
Secondly: staff - always courteous friendly welcoming you back after a long days sightseeing. Allowed us an extra hour to check out and stored our luggage for 8 hours!
Thirdly: the hotel - amazing boutique style, low lighting, music and very funky decoration. Was very cool. Can't comment on the more expensive rooms but ours was 'normal' ie big enough to store your stuff and move around in definitely did not feel 'small' however it was not bigger than it needed to be! Flat screen tv too with movie channels, sport and news. Breakfast included as well 7am - 10am. Free wifi which had a good signal. Rooms spotless!!!
No parking but who brings a car to new York?!
Overall I felt it will be your best choice for price location and quality combined.when we return we will definitely stay here again :)
Only one minor complaint and that is there I'd only 1 toaster for breakfast so most days there was a queue for it. No biggie but if the hotel was to purchase another one it would make breakfast a bit less chaotic. We were told their rooftop bar and restaurant will be ready in spring 2012 that will make it perfect!
Nearby can recommend Devlish Turkish restaurant good food reasonable price, Pearls Chinese Â£ rays pizza on times sq around 49th.
Can't wait to come back!

My family and I plan on returning to enjoy that fabulous Sunday brunch on the terrace again! There is nothing like it in Texas! This is a well deserved member of the Leading Hotels of the World. review_title: It was great, but a part of me expected more.
review_text:
So we were only in NYC for 4 days, and the location of this hotel sealed the deal. It's convenient to everything. We booked a sky suite and I'll say we were impressed; great views, we had hoped for a central park view, but ours was fine. Room was very clean, nice little sound system in all rooms, pain in the butt tv system, but we weren't there to watch tv. Great bathroom. 
Staff:
Front Desk: Cold and unfriendly. Not the kind of service expected on $800+ a night. 
Room service: "order will be there in 45minutes or less" 1hr20min later, 3 phone calls, and the lady actually getting an attitude with me, finally got some lukewarm food. 
Doormen: with the exception of the guy there after 11pm (for us on 4/23/2011) every single one of them was awesome. Prompt, friendly, helpful, etc. The one guy though wouldn't even step out the front door. It seems the evening staff is young, lots of socializing goes on in the evening between employees.
Housekeeping: awesome 
Concierge: useless and pretentious. These folks always make me laugh, but even more at this place. These folks get things done for you, and I've experienced this before at other hotels. I didnt hear them accomplish one thing for any guest the 4 days i was there including myself. 
Bar: cool setting, they will randomly close early on you. 
Looking back I wanted to be close to everything and have a nice place to stay at as my girlfriend had never been to NYC. The location was perfect for seeing a lot in 4 days. In the future though since all of the touristy things are knocked out, I don't think I could justify the money for this hotel. I'd recommend for seeing sights, but not as just a place to stay.
