review_text:
Prime location in the middle of the magnificent mile the hotel has stunning floor to celiling windows that offer a stunning view of the lake that anyone would love to wake up to. The hotel has a bar on the upper floor which is nice and about average in price for the area. 
Personal favorite place to stay in Chicago.

review_title: If you not in a convention don't stay here
review_text: If you like spending money on Internet and parking stay here. About an hour walk to anything good. If you don't stay on a high floor then you are missing out on the one good thing about the hotel ...... The view

review_title: Terrible, you're better off at a budget hotel!
review_text:
We stayed here for a conference. They made multiple screw ups, some small and some big.
Our first night we arrived exhausted with our small children in tow. We were pressured to hurry and unload even though there was no one else waiting behind us to get into the loading/unloading zone. I felt rather unwelcome, as that made getting settled quite stressful. We then got room service for dinner, and ordered a set of mini burgers for our toddler for dinner (kids menu). They arrived rare, which we did not ask for and is really dangerous for a kids' entree. I called to complain and they were actually gracious and gave us a fruit platter to compensate. This is the only time they made good on mistakes.
Housekeeping walked into our room twice while we had the do not disturb sign up, once while our infant was asleep and the other time my husband was urinating. They never knocked.
Their only parking option is valet, so we paid the $48/day for that. When we went to pick up the car, we saw that the door on my husband's brand new car had clearly been hit into a concrete wall, a big dent and scrape. The dash heads-up display that was glued on had been ripped off and stepped on and no longer works. Between these two things that was nearly $1000 damage to the car. We filled out a report but no one was apologetic, in fact they acted like it was not their problem. A small ding is one thing but this was a large dent and scrape.
Not pleased at all. Even if I attend another conference here, I would stay at a different hotel and walk over. I've had better service at a comfort inn! For the price you'd think they would make more of an effort.

review_title: Location is unbeatable for a New York tourist
review_text:
This hotel is literally 25m from Times Square and the subway and the room we had was very quiet. If you are visiting as a tourist wanting to visit all areas from Central Park to Battery Park then this is perfect.
The heart sank a little on arrival - a tired 3* reception with old lifts and dark stairs but don't be put off. The room was very good with a king size bed, plenty of storage, good shower and bathroom amenities, wall mounted flat screen, free safe, free wi fi etc. turn down service each night.
Some guests we spoke to complained that their bed was very small. We had booked a King and got one so you may wish to check when reserving? Not sure if there is a price differential.
A big plus is that you do not have extra cost coming from all directions. Coffee, water and snacks (free) are available 24/7 from the second floor lounge - no coffee/tea facilities in the room. Between 5pm and 8pm this extends to wine, cheese etc - again included in the room rate. It is worth adding that this is given freely and with a smile.
Staff at the front desk always helpful and welcoming.
In our view, a very good hotel for visiting New York, location is fab and it is a refreshing change to the international brands. We recommend.

The hotel was great for the whole family. We are just a quick taxi ride into downtown about $8 each way. We booked the hotel with AAA what a deal, the free breakfast food and service was impressive. Each person cares about your stay and they want to help you anyway they can. If you eat at the shore ask for Luz, loves kids and does a great job. Occupancy was low during our stay and the upgraded us to an executive suite with a great view. Room 2433 has full view of the water all the way north and south ask for a corner suite when u stay period.

review_text:
Stayed in 3 US hotels in 10 days, and it has to be said that this was comfortably the poorest. Poor is unfair, but we agreed it was distinctly average. 
Checked in ok. Room was a decent size, but as others have reported, the bathroom was very small. If they'd have extended the bathroom into the biggest ironing board cupboard I've ever seen, it would have been a decent size.
It was hot in Chicago this week, so the air conditioning was a necessity. Well it certainly worked ok, but was possibly propelled by two jet engines. Others had reported this, but crikey, what a noise! Turned it off and sweated it out, otherwise a good nights sleep would not Â have been possible. The bed was huge and comfortable. The TV was a good size also.
The room in general was fine, just a little tired, as were the corridors. Our room was 3201, bang next to the housekeeping store, and we were woken up early by the maids on both mornings. I would recommend putting your 'privacy' sign up regardless, otherwise the maid will join you automatically early doors.
The gym was empty, had it to myself; fine, but again a little tired. The rooftop pool, was nice, but a little tired. Free wireless and use of the business centre was great. Allowed us to log on and print boarding tickets etc.
Biggest annoyance was that the guy who checked me in said changing my travellers cheques the following day would be no problem at all. So I didn't panic and find an exchange facility elsewhere. Sure enough, when asking his colleague (he wasn't on shift) the following morning it was like I'd asked to have the President to bring me room service. A definite no go, which left me panicking that morning and rushing around to get cash so that I wasn't late for an appointment.
Staff in general were friendly, but some evidently mis-informed. This was the only place not to acknowledge we were on honeymoon throughout the stay in the US. Of course, no given right to this, but a nice touch from others in various ways.
3rd out of 3 during the honeymoon. Ok, but nothing special, would try elsewhere if there's a next time.

Went there for the C2E2 convention and everything about the service was great from have our car parked and our items taken to our room by the staff was worth the trip , food was great and just the whole set up of everything was just all that and more, not one problem with anything will go back again next year thank you to all the staff at the HYATT mccormick place

review_title: Located near Central Park, Subway & walking distance to shops, theatre, etc.
review_text: Good quiet location, very close to Central Park, Subway access & Carnegie Hall. Easy walk to Times Square and shopping on 5th avenue. Many food & facilities nearby. Room basic, I miss having a fridge to keep milk & water cold, but otherwise acceptable.

I've stayed at many Hyatts, and this one simply did not live up to my expectations. The staff seemed stressed and overworked. There definitely was a lack of attention to details. Parking was pretty pricey, which is expected, but the valet staff was outright rude at times. I've stayed at Hyatts in Kansas City, St. Louis, and Hawaii; all of them were heads above this location.

review_title: An amazing hidden gem - fantastic service, great location - perfect hotel!
review_text: We stayed for 2 nights, the staff were very friendly and helpful, the room was great and the location could not be better. We were on our honeymoon and the staff left us a bottle of wine in our room on our first night and every morning we had a great complementary breakfast. Definitely deserves its great rating on Trip Advisor!

Mi familia y yo acabamos de pasar une semana en la ciudad de New York. Nos encanto el Hotel Hilton en Times Square. Los agentes de recepciÃ³n son un amor, siempre con una sonrisa. Las habitaciones son bien grande y en ellas hay todo lo que alguien podrÃ­a llegar a necesitar. Le quiero dar las gracias al SeÃ±or Heriberto RodrÃ­guez; tremendo pibe. Nos asesoro mucho, y a mi hija le encanto todas sus recomendaciones. Espero volver.

review_title: Pulito, posizione eccellente, camere ampie per NEW york
review_text: Sono stato in questo hotel dal 16-08 al 22-08 del 2011 , la posizione e' indiscutibilmente eccezionale, camere pulite ma c'e la moquet come in tutti gli hotel americani, dai piani alti si gode di una vista eccellente, il personale e' nella media, la concierge molto disponibile, ristorante carissimo e colazione a prezzi improponibili, la camera dove sorgionnavo io, non aveva la cassaforte, aveva pero una tv 37", una poltroncina con puff, una scrivania... Il bagno, da considerarsi normale, con un buon lavandino e spazi giusti, internet a pagamento, ma gratis nella lobby, onestamente in camera navigavo con la password della lobby. Consigliatissimo

review_title: Good location, small but modern rooms.
review_text: Small hotel with small but renovated rooms. Free breakfast. Nice area with a lot of restaurants and walking distance to many tourist attractions.
hotel_name: Hotel Cass, a Holiday Inn Express

review_title: It was like sleeping in a closet
review_text: Rooms are small and beds are very uncomfortable.. People are nice and beakfast was great..
hotel_name: Hotel Cass, a Holiday Inn Express

review_title: Not as good as other hi expresses
review_text: Rooms very small, not very clean, very expensive as well. Breakfast is a scrum. It's only upside is the location
hotel_name: Hotel Cass, a Holiday Inn Express

review_text: I found this hotel to be a great little gem in the heart of Times Square. Many extras as well such as breakfast and the wine and cheese service. Highly recommend.

Stayed here 3 nights at end of September and was really impressed, nice quiet hotel but just of Broadway with 5 star service. Lots of nice touches too like continental breakfast, 24 hour tea and coffee and free wine and nibbles every day. Although we upgraded to a bigger room, it was still a liitle tight but I guess down to the fact you are in Central Manhattan. I would definately use this hotel again.

I was bumped on a United flight last night and as a 1k they put me up at the Chicago O'Hare Hilton. 
When I checked in with my voucher I gave them my HH Diamond Card and they gave me a great room on the 10th floor that overlooked the airport.
Yea, I know it is sort of geeky, but it was cool viewing the airport from the room.
The room itself was great with a comfortable bed, decent size bathroom, and good size flat screen tv.
Just completed two night stay at Casablanca. Lived up to expectations and previous reviews.Would certainly recommend and will return next time we're in New York.

review_title: Real nice surprise after a long day
review_text: Ended up staying overnight in airport after airline problem. We were there just overnight with a flight again first thing in the am. Called hotel same day and they had a room and a great caa rate for us. Hotel was lovely. Beds were comfortable. Rooms nicely done. Really nice comfortable surprise after a very long day.

review_title: Great hotel but don't order room service - $$$
review_text: All was good until I ordered a sandwitch and 2 glasses of wine - the base price was ok but tax, more tax, ten dollar charge for delivery, and tip came to sixty-six dollars!! Insane!!! Bring your own food/wine and you'll be fine.

Great location, it is close to every important places in Chicago and rooms are clean. This hotel has wonderful staff and it has almost everything a business traveler could need. Very good experience. Bottom: Rooms are extremely small.
hotel_name: Hotel Cass, a Holiday Inn Express

review_title: Unbeatable location but tiny rooms and thin walls
review_text: I would stay here again ten thousand times solely for the location. Right in the heart of the mag mile and fun rush neighborhood. You really can't beat it. I've also read reviews about it smelling but we didn't have that problem. However, starting at 7am, you can hear every door slam and conversation. Yes the rooms are small but if you plan on staying in the room the whole time then this isnt for you. Front desk was helpful but maids didn't turn down the bed or clean the room until our second night
hotel_name: Hotel Cass, a Holiday Inn Express

review_text: Wonderful experience. The staff was exceptional and the hotel was beautiful! It was also very affordable and located practically "in" times square! I will stay here every time I return to New York!

Was put in the Hilton Airport as I bumped my flight and loved it. Great location overlooking the airport and proximity to the blue line L, taking me downtown Chicago in approx half an hour for 2,25 one way, and the people mover from/to the international terminal 5.
Never had a more efficient and professional check in - thank you so much Dwight. The 3 different muffins and fresh croissants made my day at the breakfast, which had a lot more good food by the way. Just the egg was not as good. Too bad I didnt have time to test the pool. The giant tv screens are touch screens with all the (airport) info you are interested in. I was given a corner room which was totally awesome since it had ground to ceiling windows all around. Open all curtains in the morning and see all the movements around the airport while getting a fresh cup of coffee from the in room coffee machine combined with great shower... loved it!

I travel to Chicago for both business and pleasure about 10 times a year and always make it a point to stay at the Majestic. It is the perfect big city combination of hotel and B&B for a great price. The location is great, the staff always attentive, the cookies and coffee plentiful, reasonable parking and decent breakfast. The small upgrade to a Sunroom suite is worth the extra since the standard rooms are a bit on the small size and the suites are very large. Mona is a wonderful as are all the staff. Ask for a free day pass to the local fitness club. To sum it up... A great place to stay !

review_title: Loved it's Location! Central and great service.
review_text: This Hotel was great... Exactly where we wanted to be, walked out the door and everything was right there or within walking distance. Service was great and it wasn't expensive! We would happily stay there again!

review_title: No A/C, no maid, bad restaurant
review_text:
This has been one of the worst stays I have ever had at a hotel. I'm shocked that a Hilton would be so poorly equipped.! Our room 636 - air conditioner did not cool the room the 1st night so I called the desk. Nobody even showed up. The 2nd day I called again and the guy came after an hour and said there's nothing they can do because he HVAC systemis not really controlled by the thermostat in the room. If it's cold oitside, the heat comes on, no matter how hot your room is. Likewiae with the A/C. So they brought me a FAN The next day the system quit blowing air altogether, so when I called, they brought me a SECOND fan. Ridiculous. I was told that they had had complaints about rooms being either too hot or too cold and they have no control over it. DON'T STAY ON THE SIXTH FLOOR!
And I had to call the desk to get my room cleaned because they skipped our room.
The menu in the restaurant is not very good, either.

Have stayed at this hotel 4 or 5 times this month and it has been great 4 out of 5 times and on the one occasion I had an issue they took care of it. 
The check in staff is excellent. I love the media rooms and Andiamo has the best continental breakfast. 
Right next to the airport so convenient for early flights. 
Keep it up.

review_title: Great location but rooms need work.
review_text: The hotel is in a great location on Michigan Ave. Close to shopping and many great resteraunts. The lobby is very nice and lively with a great bar. The concierge lounge is also a nice touch as well. The room we had was very small and nothing special. I expected better being a Gold Rewards Member. The pool was OK but you could tell it was a bit outdated. I would stay there again but could use some updates.
Excellent location, great hotel! Highly recommended.

I stay at this hotel when I just want peace and quiet. The hotel is near shopping and great restaurants. The rooms are very clean. The one time I had a problem with my heat someone came up in 5 minutes to fix it. I love this hotel because of the price and the tranquilty I receive.
hotel_name: Hotel Cass, a Holiday Inn Express

review_text: Good, cheap hotel near wrigley. Plenty of places around within walking distance to eat. Less than a mile from the el for easy access to the loop

review_title: Excellent for a very high traffic hotel
review_text:
It is a very busy place, yet service at check in is very efficient, speedy and friendly. Standard rooms are nothing special, bathrooms small, but well appointed and clean.
King Size beds with very good mattress and linen made for very comfortable rest.
Room service very efficient, good quality, and very friendly, helpful
staff.
It's usually not much fun to spend time at an airport hotel but this one at least is very comfortable and reasonable value for money.

This is the ultimate airport hotel if the weather is bad - you don't even have to leave the terminal to get to the Hilton. Older building, but the rooms have been updated and are very nice, if small. Some rooms have a great view of the tarmac and airplanes, if you like that. Food at the restaurant is good, if very expensive. The fitness center is one of the best, and is a reason to stay here all by itself. There is also Blue Line CTA access directly from the hotel as well, so even if you have downtown meetings this hotel will work. The only drawback - it can be expensive depending on the meetings scheduled in their conference facilities. Also, it is typically full every night. If you are driving in and flying, you can park in the long-term lots and take the tram right to the front door of the hotel. Overnight parking at the hotel is $30 / night in the short-term airport parking. Valet parking is available as well.
Great location, concierge lounge is nice, linens are good. Rooms are WAY too small, it's a little tired.
Incredible location, not bad for a hotel in the airport. Rooms are a bit dark and small, but otherwise friendly staff and good service.

review_title: Disappointed, expected better from Marriott: Shabby rooms with worn out beds and bathrooms.
review_text: The location is great and the conference center is by far the only reason this place is ever full. Conference areas are clean and look recently renovated; wish we could say the same for the rooms. Shabby rooms, beat up furniture, totally worn out lumpy beds and thin, cold windows. I have never been so dissapointed in a Marriot! The sirens from the fire trucks and ambulances woke us up often every night and we were 30 floors up!!!! Sounded like the window was open! Hotel must be on a main route they use. If you have a conference here, stay at another hotel within walking distance if possible. Wish we had!!!

This w our first time visiting New York and we didn't really know what to expect. We were delighted by the city and the reception we received at Casablanca. From the front desk people to the doorman to the housekeeping people they really could not have been more plesant and helpful. The afternoon drinks and nibbles, all complimentary, were a refreshing change to what you normally get in the larger less personal hotels. Location was great and well suited our needs. All in all Casablanca ws a wonderful boutique hotel that we are happy to thoroughly recommend. It usually helps if you pat the tiger in the Level 2 lobby.

review_title: The only hotel to stay at in New York City!!
review_text: Service, hotel room and location in the very best. The Staff had a bottle of wine and a birthday card waiting for me on arrival. The Staff makes you feel at home. I love staying at the Casablanca Hotel.....

We stayed here one night and normally wouldn't be able to afford a hotel on the Magnificent Mile. The room was small but very clean and modern. The bed was very comfortable and we had a quiet night's sleep.
Didn't check out the hotel's restaurant but there were plenty within walking distance as well as bars and clubs, and close cafes in the morning. Overall, great value

Room was clean and well maintained. Small but not cramped. The desk was well appointed with an LCD monitor on an arm, several outlets, interconnect cables, reading lamp and a shelf. Very comfortable working chair. Bathroom was for 1 but had plenty of space. Shower not a tub. Toilet was European style flush of 2 different water volumes. Good use of space for cabinet drawers and closet in the room. Free bottled water on every floor--fill it yourself near the elevator. Great feature. I found a closet in the hallway near the elevator where guests self-serve ironing board, iron, extra blankets, etc. Nice touch. To check into the room, just insert your credit card into the kiosk in the small lobby. Confirm a few details and out pops your room keys/cards. Must use the cards in the elevator to get to your floor. Restaurant next to the lobby is room service. Overall, it's a self-service hotel with little staff. But it's efficient, clean, well designed, in a great location and a great value at $139/night.

This hotel has a excellent location on Michigan Ave., however it is very noisy. We were on the 38th floor and it was still enough to wake you at night. To make things worse our room was very stuffy and we had to sleep with the window open and have a fan brought up. The AC did not work well and the heat seemed to be on all the time. On the plus side the staff was great. Always acknowledged you and were very accommodating. I do wish the entire fitness center would open earlier for those of us that always have early days.

review_title: Not what I would have chosen.
review_text:
My husband booked this hotel for a weekend trip. Thankfully I will only be here 2 nights. It's clean & would be great for a business trip or something like that. It's very tiny & I was on the 17th floor with no view. There is a walk in shower with a very sad shower curtain. The bed is okay, but mine @ home is nicer.
It's not terrible, but it just isn't somewhere I would ever stay...ever...& definitely not for an anniversary trip. When we go away it's usually to a place with deluxe accomodations to relax & rejuvenate from our hectic lives & this is not up to my standards. I'm very disappointed. 
There is a good little italian restaurant connected to it.

We decided to have a stop over in Chicago and wanted an airport hotel for convenience as we knew we could get the train to downtown. When I knew the Hilton was actually on the airport I was a bit wary because of noise. The reviews I read were positive, so we decided to take a chance and we were not disappointed, in fact we were most impressed and had an excellent stay. After baggage collection the hotel is well signed and we walked to the monorail, got the lift down and straight into the hotel. It was 2.30pm and we received a very friendly welcome and were able to check in and our room was ready, king size, non smoking, just what we had booked. it is worth shopping around to get a good rate. We had rom service for food later on in the day, there is a good choice only down side was the service was a bit slow, but the quality of the food made up for this. We had an excellent buffet breakfast. Used the AA check in booth for our flight and strolled back over to the airport readynfor our flight. There was virtually no noise at all from the airport during the night. We were also able to walk to the train station without leaving the Hilton - we couldn't have picked a better place to stop and would give it the highest recommendation for a stop over.

review_title: Friendly little hotel in times square
review_text: My wife and I stayed here for four nights in the end of July. It lived up to the reviews! This was our first time to NYC, and we thought the location was perfect. The service was great and rooms were small, but nice. Would recommend this hotel to friends and family and can't wait to come back!

review_title: Great hotel, decent value, fabulous location
review_text: Stayed here for a conference and was generally happy with the hotel all around. Great food, clean rooms, excellent location. The rooms are not 4 star but for the price, not too bad. There are some great new hotels in Chicago but in a pinch, the Marriot isn't a bad alternative.

This was my second stay at the Marriott Magnificent Mile. The hotel has great location close to great shopping and fabulous restaurants. The staff is friendly and helpful. Beware if you plan to drive parking is expensive both self park and valet. Great hotel for both leisure and business.

review_title: Great location, great rooms, and a historic building
review_text: The River Hotel occupies floors 3 - 10 of a historic building built in 1928. It is located directly across the street (Whacker) from the Chicago river between Michigan ave and Wabash. In terms of location, this place could not be beat in my opinion. Magnificent Mile, Millennium Park, 'L' trains, many restaurants and bars, all within walking distance. We chose not to rent a car and got around just fine. Additionally, we found the rooms to be clean, comfortable, nicely updated, and good size for a hotel in a downtown area of a major city. If we make it back to Chicago again, this is were we'll stay.

review_title: Great Hotel in an amazing place.
review_text:
We recently stayed at The Casablanca Hotel and from the moment we were welcomed into the hotel we knew our holiday had begun. 
Great setting, great hotel, great staff, great experience. 
Thankyou very much.
We loved the location of this hotel, right by the river within easy walking distance of both the loop and magnificent mile. Staff were friendly & helpful. The room was clean & comfortable.

This is pretty much your standard hilton. Rooms are about what you'd expect from a hilton. Location is great given its right in the airport (you don't even need to go outside). Only one issue with this hotel: $15 to use the gym?!?! You have got to be kidding me.

review_title: A calm and welcoming port in the storm.
review_text: My husband and I have just spent 5 nights at the Casablanca. We were very pleased with the cleanliness, comfort and service we received during our stay. After the hustle and bustle of times square entering the doors to the Casablanca were like entering a different time. We felt pampered and special. Special thanks to Peter on the front desk who made our arrival special and all the girls in Ricks cafe who assisted us with our breakfast and evening wine and cheese. Excellent champagne! We would definitely recommend staying here and hope to return in the future.

review_title: Impressive and relaxing, an absolutely wonderful stay!
review_text: I took my wife here on the tail end of our honeymoon and was nothing less than impressed. The service was so helpful and friendly, the atmosphere was classy and beautiful, and the extras perfect. Our room was beautiful and wonderful after day in the city. Ricks Cafe always hit the spot and was a great escape from hectic time square. We loved our stay!

Stayed here for one night. The location really is superb but the Hotel is tacky to say the least. The rooms were ok, the beds comfy but the public areas were either dark and dingy or like a bingo hall with lots of noise and old people sat around. Would not have wanted to stay more than one night. 
Also the recommendation for brunch from the concierge was awful.

review_title: It was a so great to step back into the peaceful and quiet atmosphere of this hotel after being in Times Square.
review_text: We loved our stay here over the July 4 holiday. The room was great, we also enjoyed the breakfast each morning and wine and cheese in the afternoon. We also loved Jeffery.

review_title: Great location, awesome staff, small rooms!
review_text: For the price we paid for this location it's an awesome hotel. You can walk to tons of attractions from this hotel! Valet service is very quick and easy. It's $4 more to valet park, with 24 hr in and out privileges. If you self park you cannot go in and out without paying an additional fee. As others have stated the rooms are small, but for my husband and I it was perfect. If you are planning on being out in the city most of the day it's the perfect hotel!
hotel_name: Hotel Cass, a Holiday Inn Express

review_text: Booked this to be in the Loop close to the Art Institute, Architecture Tours, Millenium Park, and still a walk away from River North restaurants. Convenience is rhe point. Otherwise a business spartan style, beds a tad too well worn. For a few nights stay you don't need a car though.

review_title: Great location for a good deal
review_text:
Room-small rooms, but updated decoration. Room was clean and functional. Wish it had a fridge.
Location- excellent location. Easy access to public transportation. Parking lot next door. Trader joes across the street was very convenient.
Good deal for the price, booked this for the price, location, and breakfast included.
hotel_name: Hotel Cass, a Holiday Inn Express

review_title: Can't imagine a better place to stay in Times Square!!!
review_text: Couldn't have found a nicer place to stay in NYC!! Right in Times Square. Just steps to the theatre, restaurant, subway, all the action. But the hotel is like stepping into an intimate, beautiful, welcoming quiet place all your own. Rick's Cafe is simply wonderful. An all day place to escape and relax. Rooms are small but well equipped for comfort. Service is awesome. Attention to every detail. The perfect hotel!!!

Loved this place in spite of it being close to Times Square. I tend to prefer less busy parts of the city. The staff is great. Everyone was helpful. The room was a bit small but it's NY so that's the norm. Use of the NY Sports Club was nice because you get the benefit of a full gym. Would definitely stay here again.

Me, my dad, and wife stayed at this hotel and it was the best we've been at in New York City yet. The staff was friendly, the rooms were incredible and the snack and coffee cafe on the second floor was an incredible service. Try this place out you won't regret it.

review_title: Perfect place for a stay in Times Square!
review_text: We wanted something close to Times Square and they are right in the heart of it. The service was excellent and the staff was very friendly. As soon as you stepped in from the street it was easy to forget you were in the bustle of New York. The rooms were small but quiet and clean. The complimentary breakfast and evening wine hours were a perfect way to get the days and evenings started. I would stay again without hesitation.

review_title: Wonderful hotel, wonderful staff, wonderful location
review_text: We have just returned from our stay at the Casablanca hotel, I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough, we were in a suite, it was a great size, the refreshments and breakfast in ricks bar were a complete bonus, wifi also was a bonus too, the staff everyday went out of their way to help in any way they could, at the end of our stay after we had checked out we were still allowed to leave our luggage, when I was initially looking for someone to stay I was looking at other hotels and when we were wandering around NYC and I spotted these I was soooooooo glad I chose the Casablanca, it gets 5 * from me, thanks to all the staff
Great location. Very friendly staff. Clean. Loved the lounge for breakfast and wine and appy's.

This is the worst place to stay. Honestly, I probably would have been better staying at Red Roof Inn. The rooms are mediocre. The front desk service is sub-par. The fact that they charge you $13.00 a day to park in a nearly empty parking lot is highway robbery. Just what they charge 120.00 a night for, I haven't figured out yet. Then, on top of that, they continue placing holds on my card everyday for "incidentals" even though I haven't charged a thing to my room. What is that about? I understand keeping a card on file, but continuously placing holds on my account for nothing being charged is ridiculous. I stayed here because I figured a big name like Marriott would have excellent customer service, but because of this stay I will not return to Marriott ever again.

Stayed 8 nights, mini-suite, $578 per night all in. Lovely boutique hotel. However big downside was the noise. Our room faced the front. Loading docks for the large building across the street was right across from the hotel. Two floors in that tower were being demolished and all materials were loaded into large metal/wall board crusher trucks which operated with ungodly noises until midnight. We checked and they actually had a permit to work until that time. After midnight every night the newspaper recycling truck would come to same loading dock and crunch and grind a days worth of newspapers until 12:40 AM. Needless to say sleeping was difficult. Recommend getting an internal room or back facing room. Also multiple fire engines/sirens all night long. For $578 was not very happy. Our bad luck for the demolition timing but all the other noises a function of a city that never sleeps. So Beware.

This is the nicest Hilton I've been to. Full of character and history but renovated at some point in the modern era. Beautiful decor, excellent Executive Floor, excellent service, reasonable price point. 
Overall, a great hotel in the city.

We had a mostly enjoyable stay on the executive floor of this very large, historic and well-positioned hotel. The rooms were comfortable and clean, if a bit dated, and a good size. Given our mainly positive feelings about the place, I have to wonder whether the income Hilton derives from - for example - charging two dollars each to hold our bags for a couple of hours after check out is worth the bad taste generated. (Let's not even talk about Internet fees).
Good hotel in a nice area within walking distance to good restaurants and shopping.

review_title: Small, friendly and a perfect location!
review_text:
You know how hotels never look as good as the pictures on the website? Well this one actually does! 
Small but very comfortable rooms, friendly staff and great amenities, including a generous continental breakfast and free snacks and tea/ coffee/ cold drinks available all the time in the restful Rick's Cafe. An absolute haven from the busy outside world and yet so close (about 100 m) to Times Sq and all that NY has to offer. 
A really great choice!

The Hilton had some very nice features. A beautiful place with a grand ballroom. Our room was very small though, and everything was considered extra. From local calls to wifi, even in the lobby. We stayed 4 nights and the sheets were not changed once. The location was great, lots to do and see. Like many big city hotels, the concierge was very helpful.

review_title: A little bolt hole in tourist mayhem!
review_text: We absolutely loved & adored the Casablanca hotel on many levels. We always stay @ the embassy suites downtown battery park but as we discovered this year it's sadly closed & is now under new ownership & being renovated. We had therefore very low expectations of Casablanca simply inclusionary breakfast; complimentary wifi & the lure for us at the embassy suites - the complimentary managers reception. We were SO impressed we would for sure return there as our first choice hotel. Positives include: (1) vv friendly staff (2) relaxed atmosphere ESP in ricks cafe (3) Tonys was an awesome restaurant considering it's in theatre area & attached to our hotel (4) the manager John & the doctor Ronald affiliated with the hotel I only wish I could teleport back to London (5) the relaxed clientele & relaxed evening reception meant we felt very much home from home (5) the DVD selection was US based nonetheless extensive. On the negative side (only to ensure fair review) (1) rooms pumped out heat & set times per day which was due to it needing an update in it's outdated heating system (2) brighter & better lit rooms would be wonderful (3) toilet systern kept breaking (4) it would have been much more alluring with a hotel having a nearer else it's own in house gym, especially as numerous guests are regulars. Overall the staff & management made our experience one we would love to repeat!!

the Chicago Hilton is one of the nation's classic hotels... but she is tired and weeping at the edges. too bad, of course, as the most ordinary of clean redecoration would have (and will stlll) avoided disappointment. the Palmer House -- also Hilton branded - delivers what this grande dame could but does not.

review_title: Great for accrss to trade shows
review_text: Front desl staff are friendly, rooms are ok but getting old. Bar really rocks on Tuesday night kareoke night if that is your thing. No breakfast except a little sandwich place and don"y bother.

I visited Chicago on a budget and decided to stay because the cost. The place makes you feel like you are on a budget, the rooms are very plain. The service was below average. Tried being friendly to the staff but they act emotionless and like they don't like their jobs. It was by no means the worse place I've stayed, but I felt like a cheap skate for staying here. If you are just passing thru this is an okay place, but if you want a Chicago experience, spend a little more and stay somewhere else.

review_title: Great hotel, close to convention center.
review_text: This is a great value. Nice hotel, clean and close to convention center. Free parking that is gated.

review_title: Typical Hilton comfort with a unique historical twist
review_text:
Did you know that if you stayed one night in each room in the Chicago Hilton, you'd be there for more than 4 years? This is one of the many trivial facts you can learn about the hotel just by standing in the elevator. I thought this was a neat touch for a hotel that is steeped with hitorical significance. 
You can't go wrong by staying in a Hilton. Rooms are neat and the hotel's ambience is quite nice with friendly concierge staff. There really isn't a lot to shout about as the basic necessities are all available. Nonetheless if you want to be nearer to the offices and shopping district, you may want to consider the Intercontinental instead.

review_title: Hot room smelling of sewer gas and locked out three of four nights.
review_text: Stayed here for more than 70 nights in 04 and 05. I liked it. Just checked out and was very disappointed. Foam mattress, hot room with no cooling hvac " until it warmer", unwarranted charge on bill, sewer gas smell in bathroom and had to go to the front desk for a new key for three of the four nights. Cancelled the remaing stays and am moving to the Conrad next door. This Marriott has become a convention hotel. Stay at JW on Adams or the Conrad next door.

The hotel by itself was okay. Service was fine but seemed like the staff wasn't willing to go the extra mile for attention. No one helped with the bunch of luggage I was carrying. Best thing was the room. Very clean and spacious and the free parking. Worst thing is the neighborhood where the hotel is located and their key system seemed to be not working. During the 3 days I stayed, both my keys stopped working repeatedly and had to be redone. I don't think I'd be coming back to this hotel any time soon.

review_title: Pretty hotel, perfect location and excellent quality price ratio.
review_text: We were very happy to stay there. The staff was always friendly and helpful. The location of the hotel could not be better, it is nearby all the cool places. The accommodations were always nice and clean and the decoration is lovely. The price quality ratio is excellent. Congratulations on a great service.

review_title: Small suites but big on customer service
review_text:
Very clean hotel & rooms. Loved the pool: warm, decent size and an incredible view of Lake Michigan. 
Great fitness room & hours are perfect. Great location just a block off of Mag Mile. Super close to More & Sprinkles Cupcakeries along with Williams & Sonoma. We recommend this highly and this will be the only place we stay in Chicago for now on.

review_title: Don't ever want to stay here.
review_text: My company and i have been at the south loop hotel for a few weeks now and during my experience here I have been locked out of my room on a daily occurance which I dealt with at first then it had gotten out of hand when hours have gone by without us getting into our room. The hotel staff tried bribing us with free pizza for the inconvienance and a great review of there staff and security but the facts show that this hotel is one to stay away from there service and hospitality are the of the most ignorance that I have ever seen traveling with the government of the united states of America. During my stay here I've been bribed by the hotel staff and security, I've been locked out of my room on a daily occurance for hours, the hotel is infested with spiders and cockroaces which I had founded out during the last several days here. The motels staff was switching our rooms but no matter what room you stay in there is a problem with each such as the locks dont work or the air conditioning doesn't work or the room is infestested with spiders, the hotel is also infested with hookers. I had never been more humiliated during my stay here with the hotel staff trying to set me up with prostitutes. I was impelled by the motion of this staff at the south loop hotel in chicago,Il.

review_title: Great hotel, great location. Good value for the location.
review_text:
This hotel is in such a great location with 1/2 block access to the Magnificent mile and great shopping. Great value when compared to surrounding hotels. 
The high speed Internet sucks though but with everything around you who needs high speed anyway.

review_title: Great overall experience, nice rooms, great location, friendly staff
review_text: I stayed here for a week in early november while in town for business. Overall nice experience as you would expext from a hilton. Perfect location on magnificent mile with a friendly staff, clean large rooms, and a nice gym with a view.

Thank u, Regina,Kierra,Kevin& Monique for making my stay so stress free and understanding that due to the weather that people get stuck and it puts a strain on there original travel plans 
 You folks made it painless for me to adjust the room rate du to an act of god.
 Plus everyone is so friendly including the guest 
 Thank u......tha fisherman

hotel_name: The Hampton Inn Times Square North

review_title: Great location for business stays and meetings, business staff were excellent.
review_text: I stayed at this hotel for 8 nights in August 2011 and thought this gave good service with excellent value for money? I would watch the breakfast as it was not a buffet but they charge for each item and it can be expensive. The team who run the meeting rooms were fantastic and could not be any more helpful. I had a meeting on the Sunday and they were as good at the weekend as during the week? This is my 1st trip to Chicago and the location was great for sightseeing with the limited free time I had. I will return for a few days next year with my wife.

review_title: Stay with a lot of space
review_text: We took a day trip to downtown and stay at this place with our two young kids. This is right behind the Hancock building. The rooms are modern and spacious. We had a living room and and a wet bar kitchen. The stay was amazing.

I was extremely satisfied. Everything was absolutely perfect
during my brief stay; I look forward to a longer one next time.
The Casablanca has a feeling of warmth and hospitality thatÂ 
other hotels just do not have. From the little thoughtful touches
(newspapers, free Internet, computer station, toiletries),Â to the
uniformly friendliness, responsiveness andÂ helpfulnessÂ of the staffÂ 
(likeÂ one of the gentleman at the front desk puttingÂ a phone call onÂ

The Casablanca is a gracious and welcoming hotel. The staff deserved praise for their personal touches and interaction with
the guests. It is obvious hotel personnel take pride in their efforts.

review_title: You can't get closer to lake Michigan. Get ready for $60 parking fee!!
review_text:
Stayed 5 nights during oncology convention in June. Even though I live in Chicago, I couldn't pass up a company paid room in a premium location in the city. 
The hotel is modern, trendy, and offered free local rides via the Acura driving experience. Everything at the hotel is expensive even for Chicago. $18 dollar grey goose Martinis at the bar to the $60 valet parking fees. 
Good view from the hotel especially if you have the lake view, but since you are right next to the lake shore drive, its a long walk or short can ride to the Michigian ave for shopping. 
If you are in to the spa thing the Bliss Spa on site is amazing of course at astronomical prices.

Service is good, rooms are clean and spacious. Our only problem was that we booked a room for 4 adults, and they gave us a suite with one queen bed and a sofabed. So we changed rooms to one with two beds, but we were a little disappointed to find that they only offer 2 full-size beds in their suites. Every other hotel on this trip has had 2 queen-size beds in the rooms. So it was a little surprising to find that the Hilton doesn't provide that. But everything was very clean, with a cafe bar on site. There are lots of restaurants in the area. Within walking distance of navy pier and opposite the John Hancock building.

Essentially a family hotel.
Minimal lobby, inadequate exercise room, and somewhat noisy.
Suite only fairly furnished but does contain two separate rooms. There is only one bathroom.

Great location. Walked to Michigan ave. for holiday shopping, only four blocks away. Didn't use many amenities but everyone we came into contact was friendly and helpful. Rooms were nice and roomy. Only thing strange, and was mentioned before in a review is the little window with shutter that goes into bathroom. Not a big thing if alone or with companion but if with family members could be little annoying.
Muy bien ubicado, muy buenas habitaciones amplias, limpias, muy buen trato del personal, y espectacular el servicio de desayuno en el bar del piso 40

review_title: Evelyn Yee is a great staff there.
review_text: The hotel rooms are amazingly spacious, with two queen size beds, a small sitting area and a mini fridge. We were still able to fit a play pen in between two beds off our toddler son. The bathroom was roomy enough to fit a family of four in it. Evelyn was very helpful at the front desk - great recommendations with the local eats and attractions. We loved the fact that the hotel parking lot was fenced in. We felt very safe inside the hotel premises. Definitely recommended.

Fantastic rooms, exceptional service, great location and a quality price. The rooms were very modern and clean. I loved everything about my stay. I liked the views and the staff was great. Evelyn Yee was our contact and she was excellent. Very friendly and made us feel at home. We will definitely be recommending the South Loop to our friends and plan on coming back ourselves.

I stayed here on business and it was pretty good for its price. Negatives are: no conditioner, so my hair looked like dry hay; oddly shaped and somewhat small rooms; and reaaaaaally slow computers in the business area. Good stuff: good location, decent fitness room, free wireless.
The best hotel in my trip to USA this summer. The view of the rooms is amazing. And the service is perfect.
The staff was very courteous & friendly. Rooms were very average & mostly clean. The selling point is the location. Very near lots of restaurants, shops, transportation. Nice bar/lounge in the lobby.

review_title: Great location, 80s decor & attack of the tourists.
review_text:
I think the subject says it all...
It's cheap for a reason, but definitely not a bad spot.

review_title: Previous guests nail clippings all over bathroom....
review_text: Nothing could make up for the bad impression of poor housekeeping on arrival.

Despite a mix-up in my reservation, which was resolved by extremely helpful staff, I settled into a very quiet, small room om the 8th floor. The free bottled water was refreshing and the tv cable, andwifi were terrific! I wish they had plastic bottle recycling for all the water bottles. The room was very clean. Nice place to stay again!

This was my first stay at this Hilton, normally stay at the Hyatt or Sheraton but my conference was held here. The hotel is positively HUGE - the elevator trivia said it would take 4 years and 83 days to stay in all the rooms! The decor is nice, a mix of old and new. A lot of history in this hotel.
Quick notes;
-definitely take a room with 2 beds versus a King room. The King rooms are about half the size of the 2 bed rooms. No kidding!
-request a high floor to minimize noise.
-nice bathroom amenities!
-Starbucks out the front and to the left. They don't open until 7 am though.
-phone and internet connectivity can be sketchy in conference rooms.
-staff are very friendly with a special shout out to Amey in housekeeping :)
I have only a couple of knocks - one is location. If you're coming to Chicago for shopping/sightseeing/nightlife, it's not really walking distance to much of that. Even though it's on Michigan Ave, it's closer to Soldier Field than Watertower, pretty far south. Second, the only free gym activities are the pool and walking track, otherwise it's $15/day which is crazy (but typical of the larger chains).
Nice stay and would recommend.

This hotel is very convient to IIT campus. We checked in with Monique who was very cheerful in helping with directions and restaurant recommendations. After a smooth check in Kevin helped with our luggage. He had much to talk about regarding the city and his favorite restaurant as well. 
All in all this hotel is great and I will stay here again.

First room smelled like cigarette smoke. Staff quickly moved us to a different room, which smelled much better. Wifi costs $15. Really? Even at my small hotel in Rome last week, wifi was free. Hotel cose to Navy Pier but not much else. Loud music in lobby, teeny bopper clientele not my cup of tea.

Stayed 4 nights mid-sept. Two blocks to the L where u can get to just about anywhere in city in 20 min for $2.25. Great for business & leisure. Restaurants all around. Bottled water refreshing way to start/end the day. We will return!

Good stuff :
All valet/doormen are VERY friendly and helpful. Feels clean. Excellent location for tourists. Connected to Restaurant / Bar. Safe area. 
Bad stuff :
They charge $15 a day for Internet which is absurd. The pullout beds are incredibly uncomfortable. There are no vending machines in building so if you are thirsty after 9pm when the the little coffee shop/store closes , you are our of luck. Our tv did not work, was told it was broken, sorry.

Very large hotel. Rooms were clean. Buffet was Expensive. Had a billing issue but they took care of it. Had an early check out and had a few drunks in lobby that was only down side but in good location.

No reservation? No problem, Christine at the front desk got me a room instantly! I had to see Chicago in 24 hours and Robert Shumate (concierge) made it happen for me... Great restaurant suggestions and perfect bar/lounges to top it off! Room, spa, and gym were spectacular as well. Awesome service wish I could've stayed longer.

Visiting during a busy 2day conference in Chicago. Most hotels booked solid. The full hotel allows you to meet a wide array of customers. Everyone is complaining about service, cleanliness, and overall experience. Location is good. Hotel is tired. Employees surly. Too many cool properties to choose from in this town, will never stay here again and will re-think Hilton in general

I must say my wife and I had a great time in this hotel. Many hotels in midtown treat you like your a number, but not casablanca. We felt like we mattered and that their staff wanted to make sure we were cared for. We especially like how quiet the hotel was even though your in the bustle of the city. We highly recommend this hotel to everyone and we can't wait to come back and stay again. This is truely one of the best hotels in New York.

This is the best Hotel I've stayed at in Chicago! Great sized rooms withs a great view of the Hancock Tower. The bathrooms are amazing with a wonderful rainshower shower head to boot. Can't wait to go back.

review_title: Better Starwood properties to stay at.
review_text:
The room size is good. The beds are not comfortable. The heater is loud. The amenities are awesome. Love the bliss spa!!! Excellent services and products. The front desk relied a lot on the conceirge. Which was always busy and he was overwhelmed and had an attitude. The doormen were extremely helpful with directions and getting us a taxi everyday. 
The wave restaurant is excellent. Food is delicious and service there is also very good. 
Overall I have stayed at better W hotels and Starwood properties.
Dirty, loud, smelly, smallest bathtub I have ever seen it is about one foot tall, no closet, no drapes, and peeling wallpaper. Complained and they did not care.

We stayed here for our anniversary and while the location was great; nothing else was! I'll try to sum it up: our room was the size of a closet, I had to stand on the bed and hold on to the headboard to look into the full length mirror! No food service at that time & since we paid with a debit card, they made an actual withdrawal of over $200.00 just in case we drank/ate from the mini bar! They said they would "refund" us after we checked out and it could take up to 10 days before we would see it! I will never go back & have told others not to go a well.

I have stayed here several times for business travel. Good rooms for work, some have nice views. Showers have curved shower rods for added comfort. Wish they would have lamps with built in plugs near the bed. Artwork in the rooms not so good. Beds very comfy with lots of pillows. Great location on Michigan Avenue. Many sites are walkable from here including Millennium Park and Rush Street. Lots of shopping on Michigan as well. Rush- the lobby bar- is always a great place to hang out. Staff friendly. Easy to grab cabs from here.
Both concierge Victor and Jackie were extremely helpful! I'd definitely recommend this hotel to friends.

Excellent staff!! From the guys out front, to the people at the desk, to the cleaning staff...I can go on and on. We especially loved the guys outside, they are always so so so helpful! The room was better than expected, walls could use a new coat of paint. Other than that the room was great. I needed a fridge in my room and they got us a room with one. We came to Chicago for the city not the room anyone who complains about this place needs to get off their soapbox. My only complaint is the Internet is pretty bad so we used our iPhones. I have a MacBook air so I know it's not my device. But like I said earlier we came to see the city and not spend to much time in the room. Hubby and I both agree that we will do this hotel again!

review_title: Good location but very poor service
review_text: Stayed 2 nights during the air and water show weekend. Good location, just off the miracle mile, but service was very poor. They didn't clean our room the first night, until after 5 pm. Complained but the front desk didn't seem to care. Check out was more of the same, bad attitude. Will not stay there again.

Stayed here for a conference. Very modern - renovations are wonderful. Only downsides were small size of bathrooms in the rooms & the pillows were too squishy for me. Common areas were great - love the lobby bar. Location is awesome with access to both Michigan Ave & Rush St.
Me and my family stayed during the 4th and the hotel took us to the fireworks! Thanks for making my kids happy and many thanks to the front desk and Renee. The bus driver was really nice.

We stayed there over July 4th and had a great time. We didn't know where to see fireworks. The hotel had a bus that took us there! A special thanks to Renee for this. She was nice and made sure everyone was there to get back.

Great location in proxemity to Michigan Ave. shopping. Hotel was very contemporary & inviting.
Rooms are spacious, clean & comfortable. 
Staff was friendly & accomdating.
Bernita was so sweet and very helpful!!! I definitely will be coming back here

review_title: Poor service - not what the website portrays
review_text:
We stayed for 2 nights
The hotel Is overpriced
The staff were totally unfriendly and completely unhelpful - I had to ring and make bookings myself
I operate a hotel myself and for a hotel that considers itself a boutique hotel I was most astonished
Our room was very small and the tv didn't work so struggled to keep the children occupied in the rooms while getting ready to go out
Over all I felt the door staff were good perhaps tipping them generously helped
I would certainly not stay here again as it was a last minute visit to Chicago and will stay elsewhere next time

review_title: Great hotel but construction across the street.
review_text: This is the second time I have stayed at this hotel while in Chicago for work (one night each time). Â Both times I got a room with one king bed, which was very clean and comfortable but relatively small. My impression is that the hotel caters primarily to the business traveler, who does not need to stay in the room (or the hotel) for very long, but it can also be a great value for the budget-minded tourist who is looking for a nice and clean place to stay for a few nights. It is in the very heart of Chicago, within a short distance from stores, restaurants and only a couple of blocks away from subway stations. Irons and iron boards are available in communal rooms on every floor - but you might need help locating them. You can have as much purified water as you want for free from communal fountains on each floor. Â Printing and wireless internet is also free. The staff are very friendly and helpful. So a good hotel overall. BUT during my latest visit (early April 2011) there was construction going on across the street on the west side of the building, and I could hear the noise all the way up to the seventh floor... in the middle of the night! It was not terribly annoying Â  but enough to wake me up. So ask for a room on a different side of the building.

review_title: Nice accommodations, front desk service disappointing
review_text:
My corner room with two queen beds was booked using Priceline.com and is much nicer than I expected. It is huge with a desk and seating area, hugest closet I've ever seen in a hotel, big bathroom and comfy beds.
If you are bringing a car, the location won't be a problem, but be prepared for parking fees at your destination. Despite having to pay to park everywhere we go, the hotel's low rates and free parking are stil saving us money.
My only complaint is the front desk staff...they have only been moderately helpful and have made their minimal efforts seem like a chore each time we needed something, like recoding a room key or help finding our bearings on a map. After reading the other glowing reviews of customer service, I couldn't disagree more.
Overall, however, I would stay here again. Free parking, free wifi, and big rooms are all perks.

We have stayed at the South Loop many times, and we have never been disappointed. Todd, the general manager, is a gem. He deserves recognition for maintaining such high standards for this hotel. His staff is always respectful and willing to help, and I've never encountered anyone there who was less than professional and courteous. Besides the wonderful staff, the South Loop meets my standards for cleanliness--and that's saying something. When I found myself snuggling down under the covers and pulling the comforter all the way up to my neck, I knew I was in a clean hotel! Thanks Todd for a job well done.

Just good words for this hotel!
Friendly staff! They're always happy to help.
Comfortable beds, clean quiet rooms (west side is above the bar so could be noisier late but not enough noisy not to sleep).
Walking distance to McCormick exhibition place.
Super easy 29 bus route (always have a seat too!) and 15 mins max time to get to downtown. If you fall asleep on the bus, you will end-up to Pier 21, Chicago must see attraction! Buy a transit pass is your best bet (sold at all Walgreens pharmacies).
Would definitely go back to this hotel!
Oh, free wi-fi and fridge in the room too!

If it weren't for Steve in the front desk, I would be sleeping in my car. I arrived 12 hours early before my check in. Steve Went the extra mile and got me my room on an early check in! The room was excellent and larger than most hotels. I was highly impressed and grateful! Thank you Chicago South Loop Hotel and Steve for the excellent service!

If it weren't for Steve in the front desk, I would be sleeping in my car. I arrived 12 hours early before my check in. Steve Went the extra mile and got me my room on an early check in! The room was excellent and larger than most hotels. I was highly impressed and grateful! Thank you Chicago South Loop Hotel and Steve for the excellent service!

review_title: Two stays, two totally different experiences
review_text:
We stayed at this hotel twice in the past week, two nights each time. The rooms booked had identical descriptions but were quite different. The first room was on the top floor with a great view looking towards downtown and was very spacious with enough room for our daughters pack n play crib as well as a large picnic blanket spread out on the floor. The room was modern and recently redone. 
The second room had an identical description but was quite dated and considerably smaller. The water pressure was quite low and the wallpaper was peeling in places. We called the front desk to see if we could switch rooms but there were no other rooms available. If we had this room during our first stay we probably would not have returned. It was clean, but after the first room very disappointing. 
The hotel overall is in a great location, only about a 20 min walk to the magnificent mile. The hotel staff were very friendly, especially the bellman. 
If we could be guaranteed a stay in a new larger room we would return in a heartbeat. Otherwise we'll look elsewhere.

Great lake view, location, nicely designed, spacious. The service ranged from very good to fairly cold. The room was acceptable, but not of the calibre I've come to expect from the W organisation. The minibar was just cooler than the room. The charge for wireless was $14.95 PER DEVICE, which is really obnoxious when you're paying Hotel W prices for a Holiday Inn standard of room. To add insult to injury, after paying for multiple devices, there is only two electric sockets (on 1 wall plate), so you can't keep all your devices charged. Coming from the UK, we need to use converters, which adds a bit of bulk, so that you can't access both sockets at the same time.

review_title: Beautiful hotel, smallest, most UNcomfortable beds, staff wouldn't move us.
review_text:
We are staying in this hotel now, tonight is our first night. There are 4 of us in a room with two "full sized" beds. Make no mistake, these are barely "double" beds, not even close to a queen. Our kids, who are 9 and 12, cannot get comfortable so one is sleeping on the floor. Shame on you, Hilton for not moving us to a more comfortable situation, and letting my baby sleep on the FLOOR! I did ask front desk to please help us change rooms or figure out bigger beds for us. But they were not willing to do anything for us unless we upgraded and paid more money. Oh, by the way, as I've been typing this, my husband has also moved to the floor. I have stayed in cheaper hotels with better beds. I'm sleepless in Chicago! (And furious that my child is so uncomfortable that he's sleeping on the FLOOR). Its always a shame when an individual's lack of customer service reflects poorly on the whole hotel.
I also think its a shame when you book on Travelocity, a "top secret" hotel...and end up with an awesome rate, but you get treated like they're doing you a favor because you only paid $78 for your room, rather than people who may have booked differently, and had to pay more. I would be willing to bet that if we paid the regular rate, they would have moved us to a more comfortable room. I love this hotel, but I can't recommend it because of the front desk person's lack of customer service. Management, you can contact me at tandksmom02@yahoo.com, if I haven't contacted you first!
Renee was great and couldn't have helped any more. She hooked us up with a taxi and some sweet laundry service. Victor got us an awesome room and told us the hotspots downtown.

review_title: Cheap hotel in quiet area of city
review_text:
The hotel is located right near the La Salle subway station which is on the same line as O'Hare airport although the trip is about 45 mins. 
The hotel reception is poorly sign posted when you enter from the entrance closest to the subway station.
Most businesses near hotel closed on weekends.
Rooms are big and cheap however are getting a bit tired. Dirty towels annoyed me however there were four in the room and most were clean. 
Breakfast is included however its a self serve arrangement with only 3 tables. You have to be fast to get anything decent and also time it right to get a seat at a table. We found it better to eat out.
Good view of Lake Michigan from our room on the eastern side of the building.

review_title: Very nice hotel but reflects the age of the building
review_text:
My wife and I decided to spend 3 nights in Chicago for a brief vacation and selected the W because my wife had stayed at the W in Austin and loved it. I had visited W hotels in other cities and liked the lobbies and energetic atmosphere so I was interested in finding out more about them. 
The W on Lakeshore Drive is not in the heart of the downtown area, but it is conveniently located and a short walk from most of the major sites. It also is right across the street from Lake Michigan, which our 12th floor room overlooked, great view of the beach, which was constantly busy.
Overall, our experience was very pleasant, but the hotel is an older building (someone told us that it used to be a Days Inn), which the four really slow elevators reflected. From the hotel room, you wouldn't have any idea about the age of the building - everything was clean, modern, and state-of-the-art. Only real complaint is that you have to pay $15 a day for in-room internet (free in the lobby) - Katy Perry, whom I understand refuses to stay in a hotel that charges for WiFi, has it right- there is no reason a high-class hotel should be charging for WiFi nowadays. On Friday night, the lobby bar was hopping and was an exciting place to hang out before a nice dinner on the town.
One of the best parts of the hotel stay was the free Accra delivery service the hotel arranged. We had free rides from the hotel to any place within five miles of the hotel in a brand new Acura, which was great for our trip to Wrigley Field and to dinner.

review_title: Excellent Service with a outstanding staff
review_text: Renee & Evelyn the front desk employees were very helpful & understanding to our every needs. They made our stay May15th,2011 a very enjoyable one. I highly recommend this hotel to friends & family.
