We reserved this room on priceline for half off the normal price. We then called to make sure the room would have two beds- which was an additional 70, of course. Room was okay- minus the roach we found in the bathroom and the faucet that wouldn't turn off, way to go green! The bar staff in the lounge was rude and spent his time ignoring us- had to wait over a half hour for the check. He must have thought the girls splitting the salad would tip more.
During the check out process, the computer system was down. After waiting 10 min she reported there was nothing she could do- so she would email us a receipt. We had to call again and they had to resend it to us since emails apparently take 10min to an hour to be received. Funny since we got the resent one right away! We then noticed an extra 200 fee for the room with two beds on top of the already charged price.
Also, the adjoining parking garage was 70 total plus 10 for having an suv. Not to mention them not being able to make change or losing the keys.
Overall, I recommend the marriott next door.

review_title: Wonderful hotels with lots to do
review_text: We came to stay at the hyatt regency for my birthday weekend and it was a great experience. The hotel is located in a great spot where you are close to most spots a person would like to adventure too. The veiws from the hotel are great also. the rooms are clean and very tastefully decorated making them nice and cozy. The beds were so comfy, my only problem with the room was the bathroom...the plug-in was hanging out of the wall and did not work the second day we stayed here, also the shower seemed to be clean with the exception of a nice long dark hair hanging out and the dirty spots on the inside shower curtain..over all our experience was quite enjoyable..i would recommend this hotel.

review_title: Old Classic hotel - well worth a try.
review_text:
Drake Hotel - Chicago 25 Oct 2011
Aestetics:
This hotel is old, classic and classy. Â The location is exceptional and everything in the area is pristine and upscale - really showcases Chicago at its best and classest.Â 
Hotel Staff: I found all the hotel staff friendly and customer oriented. The young lady at the front desk was exceptional - friendly, efficient, and interested in assuring that I enjoyed my stay - very friendly and engaging. The room service folks were also especially helpful.Â 
Hotel Room: My room was spacious and clean with a bar. The room was old but well maintained and clean with new carpets and fixtures Â Everthing worked and the closet was especially spacious. Â The mattress was also very comfortable.Â 
Location: The location is excellent - upscale restaurants are located on the premisis and shopping is outstanding.Â 
Technology:Â There are not enough plugs in the room or near the beds but I'd still rate them above average. I did not use their business center so it's not included here. The radio allowed the plugin of an MP3 Player which I always appreciate. Also had flat screen HD TV. Â  No wifi in the rooms - disappointing in today's world - even the Drake can't get away with that - not good a must fix. 
General Features and Safety: my room had a Fire Alarm and Fire Sprinklers - always a plus. The bathtub and shower were tricky at first as I couldn't get water flowing but a call to the front desk fixed that.Â Â The elevator was Â fast I always love that in any hotel.Â 
Overall: This hotel is exceptional and an excellent solid bet for all travelers - road warriors and families alike. I would stay here again and will highly commend it to friends and colleagues alike as a definite good solid choice in the area. Â I also plan to return and bring the wife I'm sure she will love it as I do.Â 
I am dissipointed that when I had to cut my trip short they charged me a half days lodging. Even for the Drake Â or perhaps especially for the Drake I found that a shoddy pratice clearly since I checked out in the morning the undoubtedly they sold the room again with little effort.Â 
Also, had a tough time getting a cab each day - the bellman said it was because their hotel taxi lineup is at the end of the line - so word to the wise, if you want to make your meeting on time get your taxi early.Â 
Oh, well I shall return - it is the Drake after all hrs an excellent place to stay and play.

review_title: Convenient & comfortable; friendly service with a smile!
review_text: We stayed for 3 mites with 2 days at 98 degrees & 1 at 50 degrees and the hotel was really good. Only criticism- no AC in the enclosed pool area but that's being picky! All good & convenient to all the best places- so close to shopping, restaurants including Portillos, the Grill Room & the Chop House as well as Ginos & Due for pizza but we went to Lou Manatis which was AMAZING!!! we will remember the lovely reception staff the most!
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Chicago Downtown / Magnificent Mile

review_title: Amazing experience! Staff is extremely welcoming and make you feel at home.
review_text: I always want to stay at this hotel, because of the staff and the amazing rooms. Alexandra Gale checked me in and out and she remembered our conversation from when I checked in. U call that AMAZING customer service.

The hotel is in a great location. We had a view of the lake and Navy Pier and there was plenty to do within walking distance. The inside of the room was nice but had some visible damage to the wallpaper in areas. The walls were really thin and we could easily hear our neighbors talking, luckily they were on a similar schedule to us. The hotel also charges 50 for parking, 25 for a fridge, and 13 for Internet.

review_title: Great amenities for families and excellent location!
review_text: Excellent location within a few blocks of North Michigan Ave shopping and tourist attractions like the Hard Rock Cafe and Rainforest Cafe. Includes full breakfast each morning and happy hour in the afternoon. Breakfast and happy hour can be busy, so expect a little wait. Our kids loved the indoor pool too. The rooms are a great size for families. There is a bedroom on one end and a living area with a pullout sofa and chair on the other separated by a wet bar area with a mini fridge and microwave. We felt it was a great value and a great location. Perfect for our family! We would definitely stay again.

review_title: Not to happy about my stay
review_text: I stayed here on 4/2 an and was not able to check in unti after 6pm. all I was told was that they were booked and the customer that was in my room paid half of the room rate to check out late. There was no customer.service offered to me at all I wasnt offered to check out late since I had to check in so late. I really like staying at this hotel but after this I wont anymore I will not stay at anymore hilton family hotels after this.

review_title: Great for a very reasonable Chicago adventure.
review_text: Have stayed here many times for business and with family. Love the "Parking included"! Always very friendly staff. Location is very handy, great dinning within walking or taxi. Rooms always clean, some are a bit small but not bad, comfortable beds. Restaurant on property is reasonable. Some hotel packages available through Chicago attractions--check on the web! This place makes going to Chicago on a budget very appealing--will return.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS River North Chicago Downtown Hotel

review_text: I've stayed at the regency at least 25 times and I have not encountered a hotel in Chicago with more consistent quality guest services. The rooms are great, especially for business. It's slightly on the high side for a hotel, but for the location, it's absolutely appropriate.
Good convenient location, helpful and polite staff. Very good size room with everything you need. Really enjoyed our stay
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Chicago Downtown / Magnificent Mile

review_text:
I stayed here Dec 5th. It chose me, because it was a blind "name your own price" on priceline (I named $75). I couldn't have been more pleased. 
1st- don't pay the $50 a day to park at the hotel lot- there's a $35 one at 111 Wacker (just west of the hotel). 
2nd-this hotel is on the river, which is the most beautiful part of chicago in my opinion. Our room happened to look out toward the river and the lake, and it had ceiling to floor windows to add to the drama. :)
3rd- its a big place but staff was friendly and helpful with finding our way. 
4th- the room was spacious, clean and modern. 
5th- it is a very easy walk (5min) to michigan and the magnificent mile shopping, and to the theater district (7min to the Chicago theater) 
Downsides- no pool (I didn't care since I didn't bring my kids this time) and no microwave to heat up your leftover deep dish pizza. 
That's it! Overall, a perfect stay.

Hotel is full of history. Rooms nice, view great, short walk to beach, right near everything. Customer service top notch. Everyone was very attentive.It is ungodly expensive though. Glad the company was paying

review_title: Great location and price plus free parking
review_text: This was my first stay at this hotel and I would definately stay again. The location is great, just a few short blocks from Michigan Ave and if you are driving into town, you cannot beat the free parking. Staff was very friendly and room was very clean. Loved the roof top pool and patio. The only down side was that the pull out couch in our suite was listed to sleep 2, but it was clearly only a single so we had to rent a cot.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS River North Chicago Downtown Hotel

review_title: Great Location, but there are better hotels in Chicago
review_text: Large, comfortable room, but dark and disappointing view. The Hyatt Regency is positioned well, near the corner of Wacker and Michigan, but was very busy, crowded and impersonal. In the morning we waited for about a quarter of an hour for an elevator whilst elevator after elevator passed our floor filled to the brim with guests.

My husband and I stayed here for six nights in September. We chose the Drake for it's historic charm and it did not disappoint. All of the staff could not have been more courteous and friendly. The hotel location is fantastic, close to Michigan Ave and Oak St beach. The bike path is easily accessible for jogging and walks to the lake. 
We ate at the Drake Bros restaurant, the food was good and the service was very attentive. The High Tea was also very enjoyable, the scones and sandwiches were tasty and, again, the service was remarkable. 
My only complaint would be that the water pressure in the shower was extremely low, even after maintenance came to the room and changed the showerhead. Perhaps that's best the historic plumbing can do.

If you like posh decor in a hotel with a rich history then check out The Drake in Chicago. Good rates to be found on line. It's a reminder of a different time. Reeks of old money charm. The staff is excellent. Rooms are large and well appointed. The decor is dated but it fits the hotel. Several restaurants to choose from. In walking distance of high end shops and great food establishments. Ask for a room with a Lake Michigan view, well worth it.
The quintessential Chicago experience!

This hotel is clean and convenient to all of Chicago's attractions.
Within walking distance to Miracle Mile and near free trolley service. 
It is not fancy, but I would recomend it and would certainly go back.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS River North Chicago Downtown Hotel

review_text: Stayed here many times. It's not an upscale hotel but if you are looking for a nice clean hotel close to all the River North attractions and restaurants this is the place.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS River North Chicago Downtown Hotel

review_text: Came here for a romantic weekend.Booked hotel directly,they mis spelled our name,thank goodness I brought my confirmation # or it would have been a disaster. Anyway,we got our room and it was very comfortable. The conciergesd were wonderful and gave us lots of ideas for lunch and dinner. The location was perfect and we could walk everywhere. Beds were super comfy too! All in all a nice placebo stay.

review_title: A Dump - Hilton Should Be Ashamed
review_text: After staying at the Drake for business, I'm very disappointed in the appearance and general disrepair of this historic property. The rooms aren't clean and smell like mold. The entire property needs to endure a major renovation. Shame on Hilton for allowing this property to fall from grace.

I stayed The Drake several times and i keep loving it more. Staff is great, especially the concierge is patiently doing its best for each guest. Bar alternatives, lounge, overall atmosphere of the hotel is truly warm. Can not beat the location; though it is few steps away from the center, it is a very pleasant walk and also it is right around corner from Chicago's upscale Oak street.

Came to Chicago for holiday with friends. Stayed in a suite and had no issues. Bed was hard to leave on the morning it was so comfortable. Love room renovations. Staff was all very accommodating. Was able to walk to everything. Valet of $50 is pricey, but it is smack dap in middle of city. Might consider taking train to city next time. Certainly will return on future Chicago trips.

review_title: Clean rooms, no ice and a femake robot handling check-ins
review_text:
Pros: The room was a nice size, clean and the bed was comfortable. The housekeeping personnel were nice. All around it was a pleasant stay. The burgers at Bistro 151 (or 51?) were much better than I expected.
Cons: at check-in an employee couldn't find the correct reservation and just kept repeating that they were full and only had us for one night, even though the seminar we were attending at the hotel lasted 4 days. Her attitude was surprisingly uninterested, basically "well, sorry you'll have to sleep in the open". Then magically she found the correct reservation and suddenly was annoyingly chirpy asking for forgiveness. A robot or maybe, Siri!, would have shown more empathy at the possibility of us having to somehow find a hotel at the last minute. However, must say that the next day we went to check if everything was finally resolved and the other lady we spoke to was very polit and professional.

We were here for 1 night only but this place is amazing!!! The building is beautiful & the staff are warm & inviting after a long day of traveling! We chose as it was close to the Amtrak/Union station (5 min taxi ride). The rooms were big/spacious/clean & modern & the beds were soooo comfortable & soft. The concierge (Tracey) was really helpful & the bell desk (Sean) was so friendly & went above & beyond his duties & we were extremely impressed. This place I would highly recommend to any traveller.....we are returning to Chicago but staying in another hotel which if I had known I would have continued to stay at the Palmer House Hilton
Hotel is centrally located- very clean and service one expects from Hyatt.

review_title: Grand ol' dame still speaks "luxury" and style
review_text: Fabulous three nights for 3 generation family visit! Reservations worked with me months in advance to get optimum suite and connecting room for 7. Executive lounge service was nicebut area is a bit small fornumber of clients. Housekeeping did get things in place after some calls. A/C had to be augmented with fans but enginer did that immediately. Views of Lake michigan were terrific and fun. Lack of free wifi was a downer and needs to becorrected. Overall a goid value and great location will return!

We found this hotel to be a great value. In addition to having reasonable rates, they also have free parking. The staff was extremely helpful, and we were able to get most of our tickets at the front desk at discounted prices. The rooms are not luxurious, but we didn't go to Chicago to stay in our room! I would definitely stay here again,
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS River North Chicago Downtown Hotel

review_text: Title says it all, the West Tower was very nice...the only way to improve the stay would be improved TV service. (HD). But who spend much time in the room?
Terrific location and top shelf service! From check in to the trendy bar with awesome staff it was a great experience

We had a great stay at the hotel, it was really clean (it met my high standards) and comfortable! The decor was obviously consistent with touristy Hard Rock feel (which didn't contribute much to my opinion of the hotel). Additionally, it was in the perfect downtown location, and was a great place to make your home base on a trip to Chicago! The general feel was clean and comfortable, and I would go back.

Great stay located near alot of things and near a hop on and off double decker. Ginos east and pizzaria uno super close. Free parking as well. Walking distance to many places. Must see the blue man group and skydeck ledge.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS River North Chicago Downtown Hotel

review_text:
The hotel is located very close to O Hare and there is a train station nearly connected to the hotel. Here you can take the train straight to downtown Chicago to the heart of everything in about 35 minutes.
The hotel has a Starbucks in the lobby but you dont even need it because there are coffee makers in the rooms, airport shuttle and snack shop in the hotel.
The hotel was clean with excellent amenities and exceptional service.

Bought a room off of Hotwire and stayed in the West Tower. This must be where they put Hotwire guests. The room was dark and depressing. King bed with a huge indent in the mattress. No wifi in the room. Nice bathroom, But unfortunately I did not spend much time there. With all the great hotels in Chicago, this Hyatt should be toward the bottom of your list of options.
The only issue we had with this hotel was the valet. It's a zoo getting the car. Great room for a great price on Hotwire.com.

review_title: excellent room for location, value and staff!
review_text: I stayed here Oct 27-29 and had an excellent stay! We checked in early without any problems. The room was conveniently located and we were on a high floor with a nice view of the lake and river. I especially liked the floor to ceiling window. The staff was very welcoming and accommodating. The only thing I was not fond of, was that the room was handicapped accessible and I was unaware this was the type of room we were assigned until we got to it. There was no counter space in the bathroom but we made do by placing a towel over the luggage rack that we placed by the sink. I'm sure I could've called to request a change, but we had already settled in. The hotel was a great value and I would definitely stay there again as the room was extremely quiet and made for a very pleasant stay!! Additionally, I had checked out their Facebook page prior to arriving and received a personal card and a small gift from the staff - was a nice touch after coming back from dinner. Thanks again for a great weekend trip!

Stayed here overnight with my wife and three kids on route to Texas from Ireland. Room was great, though the sofa bed not brilliant! We asked at reception about any local restaurants, the girls nearly came to blows over which pizzeria each wanted us to dine in!
The hotel shuttle bus dropped and collected us too, which was great.
On our way back from Texas we had a ten hour wait for our connection home. I called the hotel to see if they could look after our luggage while we went into the city. No problem at all!
The staff, from the shuttle bus driver to the household and front desk staff, are a credit to the hotel.

My family just returned from a three night visit over Thanksgiving. We chose The Palmer for the location to attend the parade. I had not been to the Palmer in over 30 years. Back then it was a dump. 
The renovation is beautiful. The public areas are very nice. Our room was small and would only accommodate two double beds where we would normally get queens. Some aspects of the room are starting to show wear again. Our room had absolutely no view. 
Would I stay there again...without a doubt. The location was awesome. We walked everywhere we wanted to go. Our daughter loved the pool and hot tub...a must for a 12 year old. We had a super time!
I walked everywhere from this hotel. The best location. Sear tower a mile away, navy pier a mile away. Shopping over the bridge and your there.

review_title: One of the worst on the Mag Mile
review_text:
First let me say that I have never written a review before. Why? I have never been that dissatisfied to want to write one. I travel quite often for work and all over the world so my basis for comparison is quite good. 
I live in Chicago and decided to try the Drake for a "staycation" with my wife. I expected the Drake to be a little old but... 
Biggest issue
The walls in the hotel are paper thin! You can hear the person in the room next door burp! The sound of doors opening and closing kept us up all night. And that was in our second room. What happened to thr first room? Other than the party in the room next door, everytime the heat turned on the room get this toxic smell similar to cigarettes and skunk. We are not typically complainers so we tried to ignore it. Couldn't do it. Called the front desk and they moved us ASAP. No questions asked which is why I give this hotel a good service rating. 
The location is great and the service staff does its best with what it has but frankly, for 100 more go ahead and splurge on the Elysian or the Trump and have no concern that one of your few nights alone with your spouse will be ruined.

review_title: Great hotel, buy sheets that fit the bed
review_text:
Stayed in hard rock jotel, great hotel, location, bar and cant beat the guitar loaner program. 
But why cant they buy sheets that fit the bed. Cheap flat sheet on the bottom that was a foot shorter than the bed. So the bottom of the bed is nothing but mattress.

review_title: One of the worst hotels ever.
review_text: I have stayed in many Best Westerns and I have to say this was the worst. The building was unattractive, the staff seemed like they hated their job, except Becky who deserves to work in a nicer hotel. The magnificent mile website sited them as a location sponsoring MoÃ«t Chandon specials and upon arrival not one person had even heard of MoÃ«t. My partner called down to the front desk on our last night to request two wine glasses and was told that they had none. I knew this was not true since there is a restaurant attached and I do not take no as an answer in customer service. I then called down and requested them and the room service steward rudely stated that in order to honor my request he would have to charge three dollars per plastic wine glass to be brought to the room but could leave them at the front desk for no charge. I was not happy that the hotel needed to nickel and dime me for such trivial items. I will not ever stay at this hotel and will not recommend it to anyone staying in chicago. Worst Best Western ever.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS River North Chicago Downtown Hotel

review_text: Great treatment start to finish. Got upgraded to a corner lake-view room even though I don't have high points status. Ate lunch in the bar two days. Bookbinders soup is delicious and the clam chowder is the best I've had - coast to coast.

review_title: If you want a nice Marriott Property close to O' Hare this is it.
review_text: We always stay here when we are flying out of Ohare. Nice rooms for kids and I love their breakfast Buffet. On the weekends they play kid movies at the pool areas. We've been there when they are full and when they weren't and the service is always the same. Great:)

I stayed at the PH for a recent convention. The hotel is beautiful, well situated, and the service is good. The rooms are retro chic and very comfortable. My only complaint is related to Internet service at the hotel. The fee of $8 per hour or $15 per day is out of line. Furthermore, the only available option is hardwired connections in the guest rooms, so leave your iPad at home. And, for whatever reason, my 3G service on my iPhone seemed to be blocked in the hotel building. It is 2011 and Internet service should not be this difficult or expensive.

Traveled to Chicago on business an brought my son. We stayed at this grand old hotel on the executive suite level. Service was excellent. The suites have two full baths, are very large, and the hotel overall was very nicely restored. One block from the Metropolitan Museum of Art. The subway is right outside. The restaurant is OK at best, room service is terrific.

review_title: Worst service for a hyatt ever experienced!!!
review_text: My pregnant wife and I stayed two nights at the hyatt and we were not pleased at all. We stayed at a hyatt in kuaui and it pleased us so much that we decided to pick hyatt again, but let me tell you that this hyatt was not the same. Upon arrival we were not greeted by anyone, no one opened a door for us the whole time we stayed. They kept giving us wrong information at the front desk, first they told us the sky deck closed at 10 when we showed up there we found out it closed at 8 which cut our time short, then we asked for our room to be cleaned and when we came back all they did was give us new towels. they didn't even pick up our old ones, then I called the front desk to acquire about the airport shuttle tickets the told us it picked up every 15 min and that it was free, but when we missed the bus by 5 min they told us it picks up at 35 and 05. Then when the shuttle did arrive they charged us 20$ per person which I wouldn't have minded if they told us that when I called the first time. Overall a very bad experience and we will NOT PICK hyatt for our future stays

review_title: A grand historic hotel with average rooms
review_text: The lobby is grand, although almost completely taken over by the bar. There are few hotels in Chicago that can claim or display the kind of history that the Palmer House can. Once leaving the lobby, the rooms are not great. They are large, the room we had would be a Jr suite anywhere else, and included 2 bathrooms; however, the furniture included was inadequate, the layout made no sense, and the tiny tv was so far away from the bed it wasn't easy to view. The hotel is large, and it is difficult to avoid stairs. The entry doors are not automated, which makes the hotel difficult for anyone loaded with luggage or who has mobility issues.

We stayed at the Palmer the weekend of Nov 12. We had a sporting event to attend for our kids so location was key. We were just a couple blocks from where we needed to be and super lose to shopping. Hotel was very nice, rooms were a tad small but nicely appointed. We didn't interact with any hotel staff so I can't comment. Overall nice stay.

Booked this as a last minute trip on Thanksgiving weekend. Got a great deal in Hotwire. Location was great but the room left something to be desired. Very noisy- sounded like an elevator running constantly. Didn't sleep well.

review_title: Good location to explore the city
review_text: The hyatt is a very nice and cosy hotel to explore the city of chicago. The reception and hotel can be a bit overwhelming at the start, it is all big and business manner. But, as said, the location and room are great!
Room was average, only worth is because of Groupon.

The room itself is difficult to rate. The bathroom was newly renovated with a huge shower, tile, granite, etc. The living roo had cheap wood furniture, a carpet that had seen better days, and a creaky older couch. The bedroom was somewhere between the other two rooms in terms of quality. The mattress was fine. The bedroom is a bit on the small side.
The hotel restaurant is wonderful for breakfast. It is cooked to order and delicious. Even better than Embassy suites in my opinion. And the service in the restaurant is outstanding. 
Overall I would stay here again if the price was right. One big recommendation to Renaissance O'Hare is to please put some trashcans in common areas such as the lobby. It is annoying having to take trash back to your room or give it to the front desk to throw out if you have a coke in the lobby.

Very busy and noisy lobby. Upon arival I noticed that the Bed sheet was stained with a small drop of blood...therefore sheets are not changed in between patrons. I slepted in other bed. Not a good start.
Location is excellent. Close to Millenium park, Navy Pier, Willis Tower, and the Magnificant Mile area.

We were treated to a great stay. This is really a perfect spot for marathon participants. Close to shuttle for expo packet pick up. Close to start/ finish line but you don't get hung up in any foot or car traffic from the marathon. Strong social media/web presence. Like the Hyatt on Facebook for discounts and the possibility of special treatment. We were given a room upgrade and free coffee and pastry as well as access to the Regency Club as VIP guests of the day. Really top notch. Our friends and other marathon participants were given goodies and many hearty handshakes. Great location! Great service! Will stay again- maybe for next years marathon.

review_title: Lobby bartenders especially Tim, went out of the way to correct what could have been a bad stay into a GREAT stay!
review_text:
The lobby bar is like sitting in an art gallery! Very busy! Service at tables very slow! Waited a long time to order, get drinks And even longer to just pay our bill! Sit at the bar instead (if you can get a seat)! Tim & Marty were full of knowledge on where to go in Chicago! 
We loved all of thier reccomendations! Tim even got us a reservation at a restaurant that was full when we called! We were all very impressed about the knowledge of the Hotel's history that he knew! It is nice to see people that enjoy ones job
 and share that with thier customers! 
We only stayed at the Palmer for one day, because they were sold out, but we went to the palmer everyday for happy hour and reccomendations all week we were in town! The doorman (I believe his Name was patrick) remembered us everytime!

The hotel is gorgeous, and location is wonderful. The service was only average however. I was there for a conference, and it frequently felt as though they were not interested in customer service. The concierge desk, although well appointed, did not seem particularly helpful, and actually felt that we were interrupting them. The rooms were gorgeous, bed comfortable, and clean.

Couldn't stop looking out our window. The view was breathtaking. Rooms were nice and modern too. Great location so we could walk to everything. Beautiful lobby. Dinner too expensive as these type of hotels do, but this one actually had another option which was a mini cafe with coffee and snacks and friendly staff. My two teens loved using that. I would definitely stay again. Just beautiful.

This is great location at a world class hotel in Chicago. My wife and I enjoy old historic hotels and this one fills the bill. Check in can be crowded and the rooms can be small, but the quality of this hotel is well worth it.

review_title: A dump unless you are on the club floor
review_text: Spent 7 days in the subterranean conf facilities. No sun, no air. Freezing cold and the engineers tok 2 days to fix it. Rooms are bad, unless you are on the club floor, and the they are fine, not exceptional. Room service was consistently 5 min late beyond the promised time.

If you like rock-n-roll, you'll love this hotel. All sorts of music memorabilia, hotel floors named for different music personalities/groups. Easy walk to Millenium Park, Art Institute, lake shore, Navy Pier, The Loop, shopping on Mag Mile. We booked a platinum two-queen bed, great room layout, clean, large bathroom, comfy beds, safes, excellent closet space. You'll have a "rocking great time" at the Hard Rock in Chicago!

First I must disclose that I am not a fan of big old hotels. This place is huge and very busy. Rooms are small even by downtown Chicago standards. Internet not free. I was here on business and would not make this choice if I were visiting Chicago for fun. There is a Starbucks on the ground floor!

review_title: Historical hotel with some modern features
review_text:
Stayed at the Palmer House Hilton on business. My initial impression was one of amazement as the ceiling in the lobby area is stunning.
Staff are helpful and rooms well appointed.
A little disappointed that there was no wi-fi available. Also despite reporting a leaking toilet on Tuesday, by the time I checked out on the Thursday, it still hadn't been taken care of.
If you need to take the elevators, allow 5 minutes! Seriously slow and always had to wait for them.

review_title: Great antique building. Great location but pricey
review_text:
Overall a nice place to stay. 
Atmosphere: great looking very nice. Gold plated everything. Lobby is gorgeous. 
Food: it's ok but way too pricey. Not worth it
Rooms: they are ok. Nothing special tho. A bit tired looking. Washrooms need update. 
Service : good 
Locale: great. Surrounded by quick bite places like Starbucks n mcdonalds. Minutes walk from art institute. Close to millennium park and the bean. 
Mag mile us close too. Just like 10 min walk.

Located in, probably, most beautiful '30th skyscraper and in best possible city center location. Confy beds, nice in-room furniture, everything ok. Unfortunately no free Wifi and noise comes from outside window even if at 11th floor

review_title: Jason at the front desk rocks!
review_text: My second stay at this hotel for business, able to bring my wife on this trip as it was our anniversary. By chance (or good luck) Jason checked me in both times, he remembered me from my first stay a month prior. He exemplified a high service attitude both times and when he found out it was our anniversary he went out of his way to make sure our stay was special. The rest of the staff was great. Room clean, but a little dated. Bed great and service outshined any negatives we found which were few. I' stay there again.

review_title: Older hotel, with average size rooms and small bathrooms.
review_text: We got a great deal through Priceline, which made this a good value. The lobby, with bar and restaurant, is grand- makes you want to sit and have a drink. The rooms, however, had the older carpet and drapes; also a decorative fireplace. Small bathroom, but very comfy bed. I would go more modern next time.

Was really looking forward to staying at this hotel, and it has turned me off Hyatt for life. Housekeeping was really sloppy, there was a sheet missing on the bed, the garbage was still in the bins, I had to ring three times before someone came to clean it and the first time they said they would give me a sheet and I could remake the bed!!!! The car attendant was rude. We were here for 5 days, not impressed!!!!

review_title: Clean, trendy, comfortable stay just blocks away from the Magnificent Mile!
review_text: This is my favorite hotel to stay at in downtown Chicago. I love the contemporary look of the rooms. It's close close to great restaurants and shopping. The service here is outstanding!

review_title: Great location and ambience, but not without glitches
review_text: Wonderful location, amazing ambience. Unfortunately the internet was down during part of my short stay and the room had no minibar, coffee, and was very tight. Also, service was somewhat spotty.

L'hotel Ã¨ in un ottima posizione, vicino a molti dei principali luoghi d'interesse, la hall Ã¨ ben tenuta ed arredata. Dai corridoi e dalle camere si nota che l'hotel non Ã¨ nuovissimo, le camere tuttavia sono pulite e spaziose, con una TV 42" e la sveglia con adattatore per iPod/iPhone. Ho approfittato di un'offerta di Atrapalo trovata tramite Trivago ed ho speso poco piÃ¹ di 100 euro al giorno, ad agosto! Consigliato!
We just returned from a girls weekend in Chicago and had a great stay at the Hard Rock! Great location, clean big room, great view of the city! The service was impeccable!

paid 45 a day for valet that ended up cracking my tail light and leaving a dent and chipped paint surrounding the area. valet tried to hand it back like nothing had happened. very unapologetic when i brought it to their attention and i ended up having to wait over an hour just for a manager to get here to write a report.

review_title: Great stay at the Palmer House Hilton
review_text: My wife and I stayed here for one night while we were in town for the Chicago marathon. This was our second time staying here (stayed here in 2009 for the marathon). The service was great. The room was clean. They even let any guest running the marathon have a late check out which was nice because we didn't have to rush after running. We really enjoyed staying here and would recommend it to anyone.

Fantastic hotel set in wonderful, historic building with great staff and access to down-town Chi.
Reception staff were spot on & friendly at all times of the day; Katie Axi Rose was particularly helpful and of great assistance to my wife & I
It's set in an ideal location with immediate access to 95% of all the tourist-type stuff we wanted to do in Chi.
We were disappointed that there was no hard rock cafe on site and that breakfast was not included in the price but otherwise have nothing negative to say
Our room on 18th floor was very modern with a good view of the river & bridge...it was very clean and had all the mod cons including HD flatsscreen TV!

review_title: Great value, fun, hip hotel attracts party crowd
review_text:
This hotel has a hip, Vegas vibe. Nice location; just south of the Wrigley Building on Michigan Ave. Nice, easy walk all the way to 900 North Mich. Very sleek, large,modern rooms ( slate grey, white with shock of orange color scheme). We stayed on Annie Lennox floor in renovated room. The reason for the 3 rating was because I coudnt sleep b/c of the
noise. We could hear partying, laughing and shouting near the elevator all night through the wee hours. Would not bring my girls here. Bring ear plugs or if you're a night owl, you'll love it!

review_title: Hard Rock Hotel Chicago: I'll be Back
review_text:
I checked into the Hard Rock in mid-December for a holiday shopping trip with my girlfriend and was blown away by everything. The staff was incredibly kind and knowledgeable, the hotel was very cool but low key and the beds were insanely comfortable. 
I will definitely visit the Hard Rock again.
The beds in this place were the most comfortable of any hotel I have ever stayed in. Good view from 22nd flr of city - Chicago Tribune Bldg.

I try to stay at Hilton properties however I was not impressed with this hotel. It has so much history to it that you would think service would be amazing or al least what u would expect from a Hilton. Everything was just average. The bed was very uncomfortable. Sorry I won't be back until things improve.

review_title: Nice hotel, but smells like vomit...
review_text: Staying here for a few nights while celebrating my anniversary with my husband. The hotel for the most part is great. Room is clean but hallway and every elevator so far has smelled like vomit...makes for a nauseating ride. Location is pretty good. Room service cheesecake was Eh. Staff very nice. Overall a decent stay thus far aside from smell once we leave the room (also very very cold too). Got a good deal on priceline but probably would not stay again.

Upon arriving, you are immediately impressed by the grand foyer near the lobby. The rooms are of moderate size, which is typical of older hotels.
The overall atmosphere is very upscale. An excellent place to stay for business.

We booked through priceline.com (first time using priceline). The price was $190 for a king bed on the weekend of the Chicago Marathon. Not bad. Rooms were clean though the hotel was an older classic property. Service was good. We would have preferred to be closer to the 600 block Michigan Ave which is more centrally located.

review_title: Magnificent 1925 unbelievable lively hotel that feels pure Chicago thru and thru!
review_text:
I have stayed at the Palmer House a 
couple of times now. Would definately Pprecommend! Recently did Mr. Ken Price"s lunch tour in hotels Lockwood Res. And personal tour for $50 totally worth it! Still think about! I am a Chicagoan and go downtown often, always stop it in to visit and admire, look at lobby and people watch, always feel welcome!

Highly recommend the hyatt. During my stay, a maid accidentally walked into the room while I was in the shower...the management quickly addressed the situation and provided us a refund as well as a free stay. Next time I stay in Chicago, I sill definitely look to stay at the Hyatt.
The staff is extremely friendly and the hotel is very nice/elegant.

review_title: Thin walls. Even though it is a nicely remodeled hotel you can't sleep. You can hear anything going on in the room next to you.
review_text: Good location and decent rooms. The maids need to clean better and the food needs some work. Most irritating was the thin walls and having to feel like the people next door may as well have been in my room.

review_title: Wonerfully renovated older hotel with excellent service and great location
review_text: This is an older property in the loop/theater district a few blocks from Michigan avenue which has been newly renovated in a modern style which features excellent service and is a very good value. I have stayed there four times and return for: value location and service.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Fantastic hotel combining boutique charm and impeccable service.
review_text: This hotel is a fantastic choice for Downtown Chicago. Little touches like the free wine reception each evening and the artwork in the rooms help it stand out above the competition. Staff ar incredibly friendly.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Excellent service - attuned to details from pre-arrival welcome through rest of stay. Treated like we were family returning for a visit. Great location.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: After our flight from uk to come here was a dream. The hotel is grand, extravagant and flawless. It's huge and our room although a tad small was clean, modern and stylish. The area itself is fine and there are homeless people in Chicago! It's a city for heavens sake and if your gullible enough to think you wont see them you're mistaken! They do not pester you for money they actually tell you to 'have a great day'. The area is fine and is clean and respectable. The hotel bar is a bit pricey and we didn't expect to pay ten dollars to use their gym either but the facilities are very good and popular. Defo stay here again!
Palmer is a traditional, classy hotel with a great location and beautiful lobby.

This hotel is old old old. Rooms are tiny with small bathrooms. Finishes are updated but you feel closed in. When people walk by in the hall it seems like they are in your room due to the lack of any sound proofing. Central location but I would pass next time.

Like stepping back in time in many ways. It's one of Chicago's gems although definitely pricey. Our room was spacious & the lobby is a beautiful place to hang out, have a drink, & people watch. Nice shops & restaurants within hotel. Parking is expensive, but typical for Chicago where it's best to walk, use public transportation or take a cab. We'll be back!

Blast!We stayed here with 4 other couples for for a getaway weekend. Great place and within walking distance to the L, which can get you anywhere. Yes, the rooms are tiny... Why are you sitting in your room? Friendly service and clean. We got a great deal on room rate and had a blast!
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: I stayed here for a conference several months ago. This was my first trip to Chicago, and the hotel was in a great location of the city... Almost everything was within walking distance. Check in was easy, and the cocktail hour was a plus ... Great way to meet others attending the conference. The room was nicely decorated, and the staff were very helpful. The only downfall was the conference rooms. They were quite small, and oddly shaped ( I had difficulty seeing the speaker due to a large pole, and the room was L shaped, making it difficult for those people sitting near the corners ofvtge room. Overall, my stay was pleasant.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: We had a wonderful trip to the Hyatt. The room had a nice view of the river. The staff was very friendly. We had mentioned on their Facebook page that we were going to celebrate our anniversary. We were quite surprised when a cake was delivered to our room. We also used the Facebook word of the week to save on wifi and parking. It was a great trip and we will definitely go back again. Also visit the Big Bar if you go. It is a very fun atmosphere with great drinks.

review_title: Classic giant in the middle of it all.
review_text: Beautiful lobby & cool bar. Centrally located in the Loop & near trains. Always crowded, incl afterthought indoor pool. Very cramped room with no view.
Really small bed. Smelled like an ash tray. Waited over an hour for a new room. Next time I'll pass.

We were impressed by the whole experience of our visit. We arrived in mid afternoon and were told our room was not ready. The clerk gave us a $50 certificate for the restaurant while we waited. We upgraded to the executive floor and it was the best value for the dollar. Location is in the middle of everything.
Loved their wine hour and amazing staff!!!! Walking distance to Navy Pier and Riverwalk. Gorgeous Art Deco decor.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: ....goes above & beyond to make you feel welcome & your stay enjoyable.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
E' un ottimo hotel per visitare Chicago. A piedi si possono raggiungere molti posti, o comunque c'Ã© la metropolitana vicino. In alternativa i taxi sono economici se presi in 3/4 persone. 
Le camere sono ampie e il personale Ã© gentile e collaborativo. I prezzi sono adeguati al servizio offerto.
Il caffÃ¨ in camera Ã© gratuito.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS River North Chicago Downtown Hotel

review_title: good hotel in an excellent location
review_text: you are in the heart of the loop, you are near everything, there was a very nice view from the room, the breakfast is good, they were so friendly, the internet was expensive 13$ / day and there was no free wifi even in the reception

review_title: Elegant old hotel with noisy pipes
review_text: Bed was wonderful but only a double not queen. No handrails in tub. Got woken up at 5:28 am when shower next door started. Sounded Luke it was in my room. Old tv sets in armoir. Desk blocking one window so I couldn't get TP it to close curtain. Dust in bedside lamp. Easy to trip walking into bathroom because marble floor is not flush with carpet. In room breakfast was terrific. Fast response.

Just stayed for a convention I was in town for. While it's large and somewhat intimidating, lots of people to help you out. Fitness area is excellent and room was just fine. Lots of bars and reataurants. Location is very good as well.

Awesome place to stay!! Great customer service!! Several bars and restaurants located on the premises. The decor is a little dated. WIFI is an extra charge, but with the price of staying here, it should be included. The location is excellent!!

Stayed here 5 nights for a conference and an extra day to do some sightseeing. Great location, felt safe walking the streets as I was by myself. Plenty of shopping, restaurants, drug stores all within short walking distances. Highly recommend!

Stayed for business, rooms were clean. Charge for Internet and use of refrigerator, even if just for personal items. Ended up with room right next to elevators that ran all night, did not sleep well at all. Second night woke up sweating, co-workers said same happened to them. Don't eat at hotel, very pricey and you can walk to restaurants nearby. Also places to eat in lower level of west tower. Walking distance to most attractions. Would stay again but would not eat there or take a room right against the elevators.
Hotel was nice but the rooms are like sleeping in a broom closet.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Check-in was painless and quick. We arrived at noon and room was ready-bonus. Room was a corner room so probably larger than a standard room. The bathroom was microscopic. Two people can not fit inside at the same time! I had read the reviews so I was prepared for that, but it was almost comical. Location was ok. We were a short cab ride to Michigan (although you can walk it). The happy hour is a nice gesture but you get what you pay for....it's free.
We found a deal on Sniqueaway for $170 so for that price it was good. Enough said.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: This hotel was nice, clean and in a great location. One thing worth noting is that it is huge, which is no big deal if you don't mind it. It just kind of feels like you're in a mall or an airport. It was very busy with lots of people all over the place. Nice bar in the main lobby. Close to shopping and restaurants, all in walking distance. The bathroom in our room could stand to be updated, but all in all we were very comfortable and the price was really good. Would stay here again.

review_title: u r in the heart of chicago
review_text:
i really enjoyed my stay there,
the rooms are very clean,
the stuff are so friendly,
the location is awesome u can go anywhere in the downtown in few minutes walking,
the view from the room was really nice 
the only annoying thing was the internet it cost 13$ per day, i went to starbucks which is about 5 min. walking to take my cofee and enjoy a free wifi

My boyfriend and I made a trip to Chicago in March for a weekend. I had never been before and wanted to really experience the downtown area. The location of this hotel is excellent. We had a nice view of the river and the busy streets. The inside of the hotel was extremely clean and the staff was very courteous. We received valet parking and someone brought our bags to our room. We decided to tour the downtown area on Saturday but didn't know where to leave our car. Although we had checked out of the hotel already, we were able to leave our car in their parking garage all day. When we returned, we turned in our ticket and the car was brought right to us. This is an outstanding hotel full of elegant features and exceptional staff. I would recommend it to anyone!
Great trip wonderful hotel and service . As a diamond member I would have liked a quicker check in

review_title: Just ok, nothing to rave about
review_text: Stayed here for 2 nights over a weekend in July. The location of the hotel is great, right in the loop, but during the weekends its pretty dead. All the shops nearby are closed, except for the 7 eleven or walgreens (even all the Starbucks were closed). The hotel itself feels somewhat old. The carpets are dark and drabby and one of the elevators stank of puke. Our room was very small. We booked a king bedroom for 2 adults and even the king bed seemed smaller than usual. the bathroom was tiny and could hardly fit 2 people in it at once. they had tiger print bathrobes (not the standard clean white bathrobes) and I was hesitant to use the robe because I couldn't tell if it was absolutely clean. They also did not offer slippers which I always like at hotel.The one nice thing was that all their toiletries were Aveda, which was a very nice. The towels were not great -very fibery and I would get all these little white fibers all over my face every time I wiped my faced. The one big tnegative was that they didn't offer free internet/wireless. You had to sign up to their kimpton "keep in touch" club to get internet and I counldn't tell if I had to pay or not to join. Needless to say, it was too much work just to figure out how to get free internet access. I would think that by now it should be standard for hotels to provide internet to their guests. However, one big plus was that they offered free cocktail hour everyday from 5-6pm. I think that's the hotel's saving grace. They offered white & red wine, strawberry sangria and beer which was really nice. And overall all the hotel staff were very very nice. But, would I stay at another kimpton hotel? Absolutely not until they upgrade their facilities and offer nicer extras for their guests. I'd rather spend my hard-earned money elsewhere.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: My trip to Chicago ended in smiles much of that thanks is due to Matt at the front desk. He saved what was a potentially disastrous situation with grace and kindness. I had come down to the desk as my room was filthy and he took great care in making sure he personally rectified the situation. The regency itself is an excellent location and great deals can be found on rooms. I would advise staying there and checking out the architectural boat tour.

The staff at hotel allegro were amazing. The day before our trip I received an email asking If there was anything the hotel could do to make our trip great. I responded by telling them that I planned a surprise trip for my fiancÃ©'s birthday and asked for early check-in. 
Not only did we have an early check in but they upgraded us to a king suite room and surprised us with s birthday card, chocolates and champagne in celebration of my fiancÃ©. 
On top of the superior customer service, the entire staff was wonderful, the hotel was hip and upscale and the location was walking distance to Chicago hot spots. 
Next time we are in Chicago we will absolutely return to Hotel Allegro.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
My wife and our seven year-old daughter stayed at the Palmer House for four nights during our vacation. We arrived four hours before check in, but were able to get into our room right away. We found our room to be spotless and well decorated.
Yes, the bathrooms are small and the tv was old. If those things are important stay somewhere else (for that matter, I can't imagine spending much time in a hotel room when in the middle of Chicago).
Otherwise, you have a beautiful hotel, a nice pool, in a perfect location to see all the best Chicsgo has to offer. We were able to well to the Shedd Aquarium, the Field Museum, Navy Pier, the Willis Tower, and to the Hancock Tower all from the Palmer House. The most expensive taxi was $8.50, not including tip, when we decided to use them.
Staying in the Palmer House allowed our daughter to see a historic hotel that has been beautifully maintained. Add to that the amazing cultural attractions Chicago has to offer and you have the makings for excellent trips.
We'd rather pay for the location and the history rather than flat screen tvs and the other expensive amenities that if you're going to use, force you to miss the great things in the city. Or, you could pay for both in a more expensive hotel. We'll stay at the Palmer House again.

This mammoth hotel is in need of a major overhaul as it pertains to the rooms. They are small and dated. The bathroom doors (plural as I requested a second room) are split from water damage. The first room I was assigned had torn wall paper and smudges on the wall. The overall experience of the rooms is unpleasant though clean for the most part. The positives are the beds are comfortable, location, on site restaurants and amenities. Shops etc if you forget anything. Check in does what they can with what they have. The room assigment process is comical due to the number of stipulations around the type of room you can pay for. Overall not worth the trouble, not a good experience and I would not go back.

review_title: Great hotel but hard to get to with all the construction
review_text: Fabulous hotel, excellent service and beautiful lobby - felt like a princess in a castle. Rooms were clean but dated - that said, they are remodeling floor by floor and have the bottom 5 floors done (I stayed on the 16th). Super location but with gps not able to get a signal, construction on many roads and preparations for lala-pallooza, it took me 45 minutes to get there! It was a happy splurge to stay there and friends tell me it is one of the more reasonable priced hotel in downtown.

Novembre 2011. Sono stato al Casablanca con mia moglie i miei due figli e i miei genitori in occasione della NY marathon. Se siete stanchi dei soliti mega hotel impersonali questo e' l'albergo che fa per voi. Ottima posizione attaccati a Times square, con il notevole vantaggio di avere molti buoni ristoranti a portata di passeggiata. L'albergo ha una sala al secondo piano aperta 24h dove potete trascorrere se siete stanchi qualche piacevole momento ascoltando buona musica e mangiando qualche stuzzichino (te caffÃ¨ biscotti frutta..., totalmente gratuiti). Le camere non sono grandissime, comunque sono pulite e ben curate. Forse da sconsigliare d'estate, quando il rumore del condizionatore esterno e' veramente forte. Ottimo, anche per persone non piÃ¹ giovani

review_title: Apparently we stayed at the 2 star tower of a 4 star hotel. Who rates these places?
review_text:
First let me say, I try not to be too critical, but in some cases the truth is warranted! We checked in and things seemed fine. Location was excellent. Woke up the first morning, to a slightly rumpled bed covered in "stains", I hope-filthy and not 4 star hotel quality. Requested a linen change and heard a knock on the door- a gentleman was there to let me know if I wanted it done to take off the privacy sign, I did and no one even came until later in the day.
The room was big enough, had no drawers, suposedly remodeled but carpet didn't reach the wall, toilet paper holder fell off constantly and shower head was broken. The mirrors were great and the water was always hot!
The walls were paper thin, I heard every conversation the guests next door had. They were not noisy but you could hear everything including the t.v. through the walls and vents.
Internet was $13.00, worked for a bit and then not again, I called customer service and spent 25 minutes on the phone and they asked if they could work on resetting the system and call back later. The hotel did give us a credit for the charges. 
At this point, enough was enough, we packed our bags and checked out. The front desk was very helpful- kudos to Rocco for caring and being the only friendly staff we saw other than the bell hops!!

SituaciÃ³n perfecta, desayuno muy variado y el pesonal muy atento. Un hotel para volver.

My first time using electronic check-in and it was a breeze. I was pleased with my room. It was spacious and modern in design. I wasn't expecting to like the hotel because of the noisy atrium entrance. But the other amenities won me over. I plan to stay there again.

My first impression when i came into palmers was " this is beautiful i am going to have a great stay" That feeling died when i got to my smaller than average room and minimalistic bathroom. Since i was there for business, i needed internet, Which wasn t complimentary and my port was out of service the second day. No complimentary breakfast and each time i called for assistance, i was put on hold for 5 minutes At least since they were busy. 
Great looking lobby And location but that is it

We stayed 2 nights and were extremely pleased with the accommodations and service we received. We were able to check in @ 10:45am which was a relief (reg checkin was 3pm). Rooms were fantastic and we were given a great view of the city overlooking the riverwalk. Fitness center is great also. One disappointment: no pool / jacuzzi.

review_title: Bon hotel. TrÃ¨s sympa. TrÃ¨s bien place. Personnel aux petits soins.
review_text: Petite chambre agrÃ©able, lit un peu petit (seul reproche). TrÃ¨s propre. Petit dÃ©jeuner et collations tous les jours plus que bien. Personnel souriant et trÃ¨s serviable. Emplacement idÃ©al. On y retournera sans hÃ©siter !

review_title: Nice to visit- not to stay
review_text:
Stunning hotel with beautiful architecture, rich history, and great proximity to downtown attractions. Was not impressed by front desk staff who (in my interaction) spoke poor English but delivered with curt tone as if I was inconveniencing them by needing to check in. That said, it was better than my
experience with the bartender in the Potter's Lounge who spoke zero 
English. I appreciate the 
international element to be sure, 
but not when I have to struggle to 
communicate with regard to eating and sleeping. As a Hilton Diamond Member I was pretty dissapointed at the way I was treated by the staff and by my minuscule sleeping room. Will likely walk through there in the future but probably won't be staying there again.

review_title: Horrible service horrible hotel. Worse than your average big convention hotel.
review_text: The housekeeping in the hotel is terrible. Rooms remain unmade even after multiple calls requesting service. It took 2 hours to get extra hangers and two phone calls. The rooms stare straight into an office building. There is no privacy. Water pressure in the shower was poor. There is simply nothing good that I can say about the place. The final rip off was guest parking at 50 bucks per night.

review_title: One of the best hotels in chicago
review_text: Great staff with very cozy and welcoming rooms. I love kimpton hotels and have to say this is one of their unique and amazing ones yet!
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Stayed there for one night to celebrate my birthday, and once I mentioned that occasion, it was upgrades and freebies from there on! Our room was upgraded to a suite, my husband ordered champagne and chocolate and after he put the order in and hung up , he received a call back explaining that it was on the house. That night we enjoyed a free bottle of champagne and chocolate! I would definitely stay here again, they offered many amenities and made us feel comfortable and welcome. We've stayed at Hotel Burnham in the past and the service far better here at the Allegro. My only reason I didn't give 5 stars on the location was that it was a little further from State St and Mich Ave , but we certainly didn't mind the walk and little bit of exercise.
hotel_name: Hotel Allegro Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Belle ambiance, joli dÃ©cor , le personnel trÃ¨s accueillant et le tarif trÃ¨s acceptable pour l'endroit.

review_title: A few issues, overall a good hotel
review_text: House keeping was pretty bad, but the front desk was always good about sending stuff up. The beds were not made well, glasses were left dirty, coffee wasn't replaced.All the givens were not handled well. Not what we have come to expect from Omni.
Beautifully restored hotel in a great location. Enjoyed dinner at the hotel's lockwood restaurant.

review_title: Great location if attending a conference in Chicago
review_text: This is a beautiful historical hotel. The rooms are smaller than other hotels, but still very livable. I stayed for business. I would not want to bring my family of five here. Staff are wonderful, very helpful. The location is close to great shopping, many restaurant choices and a close commute to the conference centre. I am so pleased that I chose not to stay at the conference centre hotel as that part of town is not where you want to be (barred windows on restaurants, run down establishments, and generally unsafe). It is worth the $8 can fare. Another benefit is that this hotel is located right on two main subway lines (red and blue). So it was great to be able to take the subway to US Cellular (20 or 30 min) and to the airport (45 min).

review_title: Nice modern rooms, great central location
review_text:
Good sized rooms with nicer, more modern decor than many similar places--appears to have undergone a recent remodel. Bathroom had great lighting and decor, though shower a bit wimpy outside of full-on massage blaster mode. Decent flat screen tv, storage. In-room safe too small for most laptops. Comfortable beds with a pillowtop mattress that was on the softer side. 
Service was friendly and brisk at the desk. I appreciate that the maid insisted on ID when I arrived at my room while it was being cleaned (scary how many places don't). 
Food in the 151 restaurant was actually pretty good, if typically overpriced. Wouldn't recommend the lobby area bars, which were either crazy packed or devoid of anyone, including bartenders. 
Convention facilities themselves felt like Reno or Downtown Vegas, hidden away deep in the gold-carpeted bowels of the hotel, a windowless land clearly untouched by the remodel. But for those of us who just show up where we're told, overall a very nice option for the hotel part of your stay.

Hi I stayed at the Omni hotel and would recommend. The hotel rooms are spacious and clean. It's in a fantastic location and easy to walk to all the sight seeing land marks. The gym is kept clean with fresh water available and head phones to watch tv or music channels. We did alot of sight seeing but the best day out was hiring push bikes and going on the lake cycle path such a great day and lots to see. We had dinner at the Hancock tower and were lucky enough to get a window seat it was amazing!! And excellent food too but very pricey. The bar and restaurant at the Omni was also very good quality and we had a lovely breakfast that set us up for the day every morning with a wide variety there is something for everyone. I look forward to coming back soon xx
Stayed for 4 nights for icaac. Clean, quiet room. Friendly and helpful staff. Close to shopping and some restaurants
Helpful and nice staff, great location!! Would stay again, most definatelly!

Think this was my 3rd visit to this hotel this year and again, they did a consistent job in delivering good value and service for a very reasonable price considering it is a downtown Chicago Hotel.
Rooms are very clean and spacious. Nice big desk at the window to spread out your work. Power outlets for your laptop, iPad and iPhone and a comfy business class chair that does not hurt the back. 
Free wifi as it should be. 
The breakfast is included and they have something for just about everyone's taste (self serve buffet style).
This La Quinta has a modern business class feel to it. Great value and a great stay
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Chicago Downtown

review_text:
Stayed here for one night using a $99 Hotwire deal. Did not experience any of the 2nd class customer attitude you sometimes come across in these situations.
The beds at this hotel are heavenly! Extremely comfortable. Classy bathroom, nice ambiance through entire hotel. 
We would definitely stay again!

I'm staying here for a conference, so my room is paid for. The list price seems very high for what one gets. My one overwhelming complaint is the noisiness of the elevator in the east tower. They moved me once, and were very gracious, but it sounds like a train is running through the back wall. Surely, they could have done a better job with the acoustics!

review_title: A nice hotel in downtown chicago
review_text:
This is my first time to Chicago and we chose this hotel because it's right in downtown chicago and the location was good. It was around 5 blocks from the magnificent mile and close to a train station
The staff gave us the wrong room on our first night. It was a smoking room when we requested a non-smoking room. But they weren't able to change the room because they were fully booked. But they changed our room to a non-smoking room.
The room includes free breakfast and quite a complete selection of food to choose from, hot and cold breakfast.
The staff is also friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again if i'm back in chicago
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Chicago Downtown

review_text: The hotel is a nice place to stay but weekends are limited breakfast. No eggs or bacons. Just sausage when they passed them out in person on Saturday. I think they should serve eggs and bacons in weekends too.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Chicago Downtown

review_text: Stayed here for two nights. Love the location! Breakfast was nice at their restaurant. Rooms and hallways need an update... They are looking a bit outdated and tired. The valet service was quick and efficient. Overall nice hotel at a great location.

We just returned from 4 nights at the Omni Chicago and couldn't say enough good things about the hotel. The accommodations were excellent for my husband, 3 kids and I. We had plenty of space and do much storage room! The pool is small but kids loved it (I did too as it was very warm). The service was great, everyone was so nice and helpful and they do an excellent job of making the kids feel welcome. The location couldn't be better. I signed up for the loyalty program which has many benefits and I highly recommend it. We all really enjoyed our stay at the Omni and will definitely stay here again when in Chicago.

review_title: Great location!!! Can't wait to go back!!!
review_text: Great location, right on Michigan Ave! Hotel staff was very accommodating. We got there a couple hours before check-in time and they had a room available for us. They also held our bags for a few hours after we checked out since we had an evening flight. 676 Bar was great, bartender made very good drinks. We definitely enjoyed our stay and can't wait to go back!

Whenever I travel to Chicago for business, I always stay at La Quinta. The location is unbeatable. You receive free breakfast in the morning and the rooms are clean, modern and spacious. There is free wi fi available too. Those are the pros. For the cons, due to construction, Franklin is currently a 2 way street, which means a little more street noise than normal. When the hotel is busy, the two small elevators can take a little while. 
Overall, even though my colleagues think it is funny, I love this place.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Chicago Downtown

review_title: Excellent service and staff. Rooms are modern and well-appointed. Nice comp breakfast.
review_text: Excellent service and hotel. Staff was exceptional.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Chicago Downtown
