One story summed up our stay ... On our final day we shared a lift with a janitor. He asked us how our stay was. We told him about out very enjoyable stay. He said "we are very proud of OUR hotel". It demonstrated the staff's dedication to the sofitel Chicago experience. Everyone contributed from the check in staff who got us an early available room to the bar staff who gave us shopping recommendations. Exceptional service.

I like this hotel. I've visited many times in the past and everything couldn't be better. Until...based on their internal category...they upgraded us. But an upgrade is due to view...not sq footage. Hence...were things broke down. This is a great place...as long as the plans don't change.
Upgrade from space view point...was a downgrade. No available rooms in the hotel at price point...had to pay over $200 to fix. Turn down service never happened..roll-away never appeared. When we called...maid service wasn't prepared.
I travel and love these hotels. But this was the first time things didn't happened as planned and the hotel service fell flat. I don't expect this from this type of hotel.

Stayed for 2 nights in December. This hotel does what it does quite well. Impeccable service, spotless rooms, lovely amenities. The room was quite large with a nice selection of high end products. The bathroom had a deep run as well as separate marble shower with a glass door - a must in my view for a hotel of this calibre. Our choice of newspapers delivered in the AM, extremely comfortable bed with housekeeping service like stealth - you never knew they were around, yet everything always picked up and immaculate. Location in the heart of North Michigan. Ate breakfast both days at the restaurant - overall quite good. Sunday hosted an unbelievably well stocked buffet. Workout room clean and well equipped with cardio and weights- complimentary for guests. We expected alot here, and we were not disappointed. A great splurge!
Very disappointing it was rated as 4 star. Very confined small non personable rooms. Staff very friendly. Too many rude guests. Would not stay again

review_title: Fantastico! Non sembra nemmeno un Hampton Inn!
review_text:
Ho trascorso una settimana in questo Hampton Inn all'inizio dell'estate e sono rimasta davvero soddisfatta.
Ubicazione: fantastica, downtown, ad un tiro di schioppo da Michigan Avenue, raggiungibile anche attraverso l'entrata posteriore di Nordstrom, quasi attaccata all'hotel. Nelle immediate vicinanze ci sono vari locali dove mangiare per tutti i gusti. Personalmente, ho evitato i ristoranti italiani e ho sempre mangiato bene. Se vi piace il tex mex c'e' anche un Chili's non lontano. 
Struttura: non sembra nemmeno un Hampton Inn, piuttosto un Garden Inn o un Homewood Suites! E' stato recentemente completamente rinnovato e le camere sono molto carine (ovvio, non e' un mariott ne' un hilton, ma davvero piacevoli e spaziose), con un letto extraking che definire comodissimo e' poco. La mia stanza aveva anche un wetbar, con microonde, lavello e frigo, comodo per soggiorni un po' piu' lunghi. Pulizia inappuntabile, bagno piccolino ma non scomodo. 
Staff: come spesso negli Usa, molto cordiale, sorridente, gentile e disponibile.
Colazione: come in tutti gli Hampton Inn, e' inclusa nel prezzo (in quasi tutte le altre catene della Hilton family la colazione si paga a parte) ma non e' eccezionale. O meglio, la sala colazione e' spesso molto affollata e la qualita' del cibo offerto non e' altissima. C'e' pero' tutto il necessario per iniziare bene la giornata! Si possono fare anche i waffles da soli e ci sono anche dei piatti caldi (non buonissimi sinceramente).
Plus: Comodissimo il caffe' e il the sempre caldi disponibili 24 ore su 24 all'entrata della sala breakfast. 
C'e' anche una piscina che pero' non ho provato. 
Insomma, consigliatissimo, specie se trovate un'offerta advance booking!
Muy recomendable. Buen desayuno gratuito. La atenciÃ³n en recepciÃ³n, estupenda.

I spent a night at the hotel. Good, food, service and location. Rooms are a decent size. Overall it is impressive and good for business or pleasure.
One caveat, The walls are thin and I had sexually noisy neighbours!!

review_title: Greatest Hotel in the Windy City
review_text: We stay there at least once a year. Again they prove in all ways large and small that they are the greatest hotel in Chicago.
Stayed again at Peninsula for Holiday Lights Festival and the entire experience was superb. Friendly helpful staff, amazing rooms, an absolutely heavenly stay!

My stay at the Peninsula was wonderful. The location was perfect and I was pleasantly surprised by the 60 degree November weather which was great for walking around the city! I wasn't able to take advantage of all of the amenities at the hotel since I was working, but the rooms were comfortable and spotless. The bathroom was amazing. Only complaint is that the service is too good; I do not like that the room attendant found my dirty laundry and folded it nor did I like finding my toothbrush in a different place. I would highly recommend this hotel.

Stayed two nights under their 10 year deal. Fantastic hotel, fantastic service. Frankly I find it difficult to fault anything!
Best hotel I have ever visited.

Excellent few days in Chicago...hotel is a haven to relax in post meetings. Staff are helpful and do not beg for tips which is great as you don't feel hassled. Rooms are quiet, bathrooms and bed lovely, nice cosmetics etc...all good!

If I need to comment something then it would be to cold welcome at the front desk, but this personal and will not make me pick another hotel next time. I also found the temperature in the common areas way to low, but now i am realy looking to find something. 
Would defenetly recommend this hotel and go back, good chinese restaurant, good breakfast, great rooms with walk in shower etc.

review_title: Great hotel, location, staff and service.
review_text: Great hotel, location, staff and service. 4 Seasons quality with Chicago heart. I have stayed at most of Chicago's large luxury hotels and the Four Seasons has trumped them. If you have not been to the hotel in a while, come back. It is wonderful.

If you can afford to stay at The Peninsula, you must!! It is hands down the best hotel I have ever stayed in. The service is exceptional and the staff will go above and beyond to make your stay comfortable, convenient and wonderful! The beds are to die for, the restaurants are great, and high tea was amazing! I would absolutely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Chicago. Amazing!!!

This is an elegant hotel, that certainly is well located. Staff is prompt and friendly, and the rooms are spacious but starting to show age.
Our 3 day stay afforded a number of opportunities for something 'special' but nothing stood out. The hotel is too large for anything personal, and a bit too formulaic for any real magic.

review_title: Great location, but rooms are not as nice as we have come to expect from a Four Seasons.
review_text:
The location of this hotel is great. You are on Michigan Avenue and attached to the 900 North shopping center. The lobby is nicely appointed. 
I have two primary complaints about this hotel. First off, the rooms are average. The carpet was slightly frayed in our room. The main door that closed off our room had pieces chipped up at the base of the door. And the decor is average. We were there with family and were able to see both the 1 Bedroom Suite rooms, as well as the Junior Suite. 
Our second complaint is about the Thanksgiving buffet. The food itself was fantastic. They had huge selections of seafood, Asian inspired cuisine and other specialty items, in addition to the typical Thanksgiving fare. But our service was lacking. We had to wait for several minutes to sit at our table. We were left out of the loop as to what the delay was. Once we were finally seated, we had to wait at least 15 minutes to get a drink order in. This buffet was ~$130 per person, so we had high expectations for the evening. 
We have already stayed at the Four Seasons in Atlanta and Costa Rica this year and were really happy with both of those hotels. I just think this one is not reaching its potential.

Everything was well thought out and nicely appointed. The room could be made dark, and was very quiet. The bed, pillows, towels and robes felt luxurious. The shower was set high...good for tall folks. Specific programs and channels could be found easily on the flat screen TV. A Keurig coffee maker made making coffee and tea easy. Free internet access. At $190/night for Gold Coast Chicago, it was a very decent value. Only change I would request--trade out the mini-bar for a mini refrigerator.

I spent my 3 night Birthday weekend here in a 1 bedroom suite I highly recommend this Four Seasons hotel. Beautiful 5 star hotel. The Decor in both the hotel & lovely well maintained indoor pool & spa were exceptional The location is perfect its close to Rush St where there are many great restaurants & bars, it's also close to the Navy Pier & Shopping.
Clean hotel in a great location. Would definitely Tay here
Lovely hotel. Excellent standard for 5 star status. Enjoyed it very much. Tiffany & co on corner along with all the main shopping areas

review_title: Nothing else to say except that the Peninsula was perfection
review_text: From the moment we arrived, at 10:00am on Friday, and were greeted warmly by Klara, to the time we left on Sunday, we marveled at the opulence of the hotel. The rooms were beautiful and large, the location perfect, and the overall attention to detail unmatched... The hotel was worth every penny. After checking out we enjoyed a wonderful brunch in the main restaurant, and that too was worth the $75 price tag. We will be back!

This Four Seaons does not disappoint.great service, clean, great location. Loved the suites...comfy beds and pillows. We are pretty picky travelers and would definitely stay here again. Great massage in the spa with Anna.

review_title: One of the best near the Mag Mile
review_text: I don't typically stay in $600/night hotels, but they have an American Girl package that gives you gifts for the kids' dolls, custom embroidered pillowcases and very nice dessert package. My girls absolutely loved it and the fact that the American Girl store is 2 blocks away was a dream. The hotel is in a great location and the service is awesome. The only drawback is the price, but then again, this is a full service, luxury, family friendly hotel - so you do get what you pay for.

The location is perfect for shopping and restaurants. The service was outstanding. Employees were always willing to help without being "in your face". The concierge Todd is the best anywhere. Nothing negative to say.

We spent a long weekend at this hotel and were very happy with the location and services offered. 
As others have mentioned the hotel lobby and hallways are decorated in a traditional style with lots of marble and chandeliers. However, the rooms are decorated in a more contemporary fashion which is a little bit odd. They really need to redo the common areas t match the rooms. 
Breakfast in the restaurant was good, but the Sunday brunch is spectacular. 
It is easy to walk to many tourist attractive from the hotel and there is a very nice if quiet shopping arcade connected to the hotel. We were provided with a shopping discount booklet though the hotel which adds additional discounts to the shops located downstairs; we made good use of it. 
I had read about the noise caused by the moving building and we did in fact have earplugs provided in our rooms for this; luckily we didn't have to make use of these. 
If paying full price I will probably try a different hotel next time I'm in Chicago, but if I get a good deal at this hotel, I would return in a heartbeat. 
Because all rooms are located in the higher floors, they all have very nice views.

review_title: Great location, good value. Very nice rooms.
review_text: Great location off of N.Michigan Ave. Room was nicely appointed and very clean. Breakfast at Bice outside was very nice and quite reasonable with the breakfast vouchers.

This is an old hotel that got the renovation right. Timeless elegance meets high tech. I knew I loved it when I saw the Mac mini connected to the flat screen tv. The room was roomy with a high ceiling, comfy king aize bed with a beautiful canopy effect which rippled in the air flow and displaced the draft from the air conditioning, sumptuous fabrics, nice desk with free wireless Internet, huge bathroom with marble and granite and double sinks. I asked for a view and had two tall windows overlooking the street. One opened. Bice, the restaurant, has a gorgeous outdoor terrace. The surprised me with 15.00 breakfast vouchers for each of my 3 days there and I enjoyed a lovely meal on the terrace each morning. I had dinner on the terrace and the risotto was fabulous. Great service from the moment you walk in the door till you leave. I was sad to go and cannot wait to come back. Great value, too.

Thank god for this hotel. After a sudden change of plans, I had to book Talbott Hotel on the fly. I'm so glad I did. I received an amazing rate and warm reception. The room was spacious, well appointed, impeccably clean and comfortable. Great location as well. I'm a tough critic and can't say enough about this place. Would highly recommend.
Nice and really great staff! Would definitely stay again!

Excellent location, fantastically friendly and efficient staff. The gym and spa are good and the staff there brilliant. I went on business without my husband, from the UK, and was made to feel welcome and that nothing was too much trouble. A very high quality member of FS.

review_title: You can't go wrong with this one
review_text: This Four Seasons really lives up to its name. Everything there made my stay very comfortable and pleasant. Highly recommended
We spent one night at the Hotel Monaco after going to the theater - hotel was very clean, great location and quiet - would stay at Hotel Monaco again!
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Every year we stay here for a meeting. The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming. We love the nightly wine hour as it brings all of our friends who stay here together. No matter what goes on with the meeting, we meet at 5 for a wine.
The location is great- easy walk to Michigan. Rooms are big with window seats. Art deco style and very clean. Only hang up is the gym room which was small until recently. Now it has been expanded and is pretty nice. The adjacent restaurant serves a nice breakfast too! Free wifi if you join the Kimpton rewards program (for free). The net effect is that we feel like we will keep returning here!
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
All the trimmings of a conveniently located boutique hotel
A little overpriced
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Four Seasons Chicago is a "total guest focus" place - amazing consistency of excellent and attentive and friendly service from the entire staff - not a single "dud" in the mix. They must be attracting and training with a lot of discipline, it's really a standout in service.

review_title: Location makes this a great downtown hotel.
review_text:
Spent 2 nights and really liked being able to walk many places so easily. The rooms are comfortable and the window seat is so fun. We had a top floor room with a view so make sure to request river view.
It was special for a country dweller like me!
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Top Notch Service - Never a Bad Experience
review_text: We have stayed at the Talbot at least 6 times in that last 2 years and every time has been an absolute pleasure. The staff is friendly and helpful - we always feel welcome. The location makes it easy to grab a taxi or hop on the subway - close to downtown theatre (2 stops on the red line) or the art museum.

As I lay in my room right now, I lay very disappointed. The constant dings of the elevators are making me nuts. The room feels to be about 90 degrees with no air circulation. There is NOTHING for my child to eat from room service, the restaurant, nor the bar. It is catered to adults.
The pool was freezing, and no towels were available. I don't think there was much upkeep in the pool area, as I fell with all the puddles.

review_title: Beautiful hotel; rooms look better than they feel.
review_text:
Personnel & service were outstanding from beginning to end. We stayed three nights over XMas. Given free room upgrade just for asking. Breakfasts also free each day, which was unexpected and a treat--the food was really great. 
Pool & gym areas very spacious and nice -- especially fun to play on bball court! All necessary amenities were provided. 
As for the rooms: VERY attractive and the bed was very comfortable, which is the most important thing. Everything else seemed better to look at than to actually use. We had a jr suite; furniture was uncomfortable, table too low to be useful, very little storage space for clothing. Bathroom is awkward-- the sliding doors offer almost no privacy, and the shiny, sparkling surfaces look dirty almost as soon as you breathe on them. We loved the complimentary espresso but would really have preferred a regular coffee maker. TV did not provide programming listings, which is frustrating. 
The entire staff, from check-in to departure, was excellent. The concierge offered to come in on his day off if we needed it. In addition to daily breakfast, we had dinner at Felini one night and it was terrific.

review_title: A delightful night the night-before-the-night-before Christmas.
review_text:
Purpose for my stay: My wife and I stayed here for our date night/stay-cation.
The "feel" of the hotel: the wave design of the "Aqua" tower has quickly become iconic in a city renowned for its iconic buildings. It is undeniably chic. With its clean lines, heavy reliance on white, and dark blue neon accents, the lobby reflects the design aesthetic used throughout the hotel.
We stayed on a night that was probably one of their lightest for occupancy. Nonetheless, hotel guests used most of the seating areas in the lobby, which appeared to be quite comfortable.
The hotel bar: another example of the super-contemporary design of the hotel, my wife enjoyed spending a few minutes in the bar before heading upstairs for the night. I recommend the cappuccino; it's excellent.
The room: we stayed in a corner room with a view of Lake Shore East Park, Navy Pier, and a bit of Streeterville. Our king size bed was comfortable. 
The layout was a bit unconventional. Upon walking through the doorway, the room's closet was on the immediate left. Straight ahead was the coffee maker/refrigerator setup (in a large cabinet). On the wall above and to the left of the cabinet was a small flat-screen TV that faced the desk and chair (on your right as you walk in from the doorway).
The bathroom was beautiful. Lots of frosted glass, new fixtures, and lots of space. The tub appeared spacious, but was unused. The separate shower was great.
The room had a wrap-around balcony, too.
The aesthetic of the room reminded me a bit of high end Ikea. Although it's a beautiful space, it does not have much embellishment. I am hesitant to call it spartan, but the emphasis on white, cool blues, and blonde wood floors and cabinets is undoubtedly minimalist.
Service: The hotel staff was superb. The evening manager who checked us in escorted us to the elevator, which was a nice touch.
Overall impressions: I think this hotel would be excellent for business travelers. For a romantic weekend in Chicago, it's a bit cold, unless you are really "into" modern architecture. The service was great, and the views were fantastic. It was an excellent visit.

review_title: Good rooms and now I trust the brand
review_text: After staying here for business trip I was happy enough that I now booked same hotel brand in another city a year later. Experience in both monacos was great. Will definitely go back again. Location was not very central in Chicago though. For going out purposes.
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Stayed for work and going back for pleasure!
review_text: I stayed here for 2 nights for a business trip and loved the hotel. I've stayed at 2 of the other Kimpton hotels in Chicago (Burnham and Allegro) and all 3 are great but this one has a slightly better location in my mind than the other 2 mentioned. Love the wine hour and Starbucks coffee in the morning. If you join the Kimpton loyalty program, you also get a $10 mini bar credit, free Wi-fi, a newspaper, and a nightly turndown service. Wow! Room was large and comfortable. Great fitness room. Everything about this hotel was great and I'm heading back in December for a pleasure stay this time!
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Great location. Great service. Boutique hotel with lots of little amenities. The most powerful hotel shower ever!
review_text: Spent a weekend here for a much needed girls weekend. Close to Michigan ave shopping, right on the river. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. Classic Kimpton kitch (leopard print robes!) combined with high quality service. Make sure to ask for a room with a large window overlooking the river so you can enjoy the windowsill makeshift lounge area.
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Chic Hotel in upscale loop location
review_text: This hotel (located at 225 n Columbus not 221) opened Nov 1 2011 and can best be described as euro-chic. Mod interiors in nice sized rooms each with a balcony and decent if not awesome view. The hotel shares amenities with the condo above which is a bonus: oversized health club, indoor and outdoor pools. Easy walking distance to Millennium Park, Navy Pier and the Mag Mile. Watch for specials and discounts for great value stays!

review_title: Fabulous hotel, I'll come and stay again!
review_text:
My husband & I stayed here while visiting Chicago to attend the restaurant show. We normally stay at the Marriott because it's what we know. The restaurant show offers special rates for attendees but by the time we made a reservation the Marriott was sold out. We decided to try the Sofitel instead. Now I'm so grateful for the turn of events. The Sofitel is far superior in every way.
It's in a great location! Many good restaurants nearby and lots of shopping. It's in the trendy Gold Coast neighborhood. I highly suggest talking a walk through the streets and view the beautiful landscape and amazing buildings.
My only complaint would be that our king sized bed was two twins stuck together. I could feel the break in the middle.

review_title: Great stay some newer hotel issues still to be ironed out.
review_text: Loved the look and feel of this hotel. From the start everyone who worked here was extremely friendly. Some small issues with no soaps in the shower and items missing in the mini fridge but that was not enough to take away from the sleek newness of the hotel and the comfort of the room. And its the hubbys new favorite spot.

review_title: Stylish European Hotel in a great location
review_text:
Recently we visited Chicago for a holiday shopping weekend and decided to stay at Radisson Blu at Aqua. The hotel is brand new.
We had a suite on the 16th floor that had a large sitting area, desk, king-sized bed and large, modern bathroom with a large tub and a separate large rain shower. The room also had a small balcony with a view of Millenial park one block away although it was too cold to go out on it during our visit.
The hotel also has a nice Italian restaurant, Felini that we enjoyed, and a great lobby bar with a pizza oven.
We enjoyed the location, just a short walk to all the holiday activities on State St and Michigan Ave. We will definitely be back.

This hotel is upscale and very plush. If you're willing to spend a little more, you won't regret staying here. Great location, great views, comfortable rooms and wonderful staff. The room service is extremely pricey, but that is to be expected. They really take care of you though and make sure you have everything you need. It was an excellent overall experience.
hotel_name: The Ritz-Carlton Chicago (A Four Seasons Hotel)

review_text: We have stayed at several Kimpyons and have consistently been impressed by the service, location, rooms, and overall experience. Because of this we had very high expectations for the Hotel Monaco. Our expectations were exceeded at every turn! Our room was spacious and inviting - especially the window seat overlooking the river. Every employee we came in contact with was friendly, cheerful, knowledgeable, and helpful. We were staying during Lollapalooza, and employees frequently asked us questions about the festival and our experience there, and didn't bat an eye when we returned dripping wet and muddy from one of the shows. The Hotel Monaco was exactly what we've cone to expect from Kimpton and ensured that we will continue to patronage this spectacular hotel chain.
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Stayed 6 nights during a business convention and July 4th holiday. Never had to worry about a thing, meaning service, travel info, leisure time, etc. Great location for a variety of restaurants and nightlife. It was great to sit outside among the arts and craft space heaters with a drink or read the morning news. The hotel's lobby display of flower foliage is breathtaking!
Great stay right before business week. Just perfect. A bit jetlagged? enjoy the room, order some appetizers, good chardonnay, as I said heaven. Great deal thx to booking.com

review_title: May be too early for accurate review
review_text:
This hotel just opened a couple weeks ago and is going through minor growing pains I think. One of the only 2 hotel elevators close to the lobby was not working. There were no towels at the indoor pool and when the guy arrived with them there was nowhere to put them. He volume control on our TV jumped from 9 to 16, we could not set it at a comfortable level. They could definitely use better access from the self park garage to the lobby, right now it's kind of a maze. The place is set up for the valet parking. The height clearance in the garage is not 9 feet as they told us on the phone before our trip as our box top carrier has many new gouges and scratches on it from the signs and pipes hanging from the ceiling. All these issues I can write off to the place being so new. The one issue that I cannot excuse however were the charges that showed up on our bill for room service and mini fridge items when we didn't use either. They removed them without delay but that's one mistake that is a major red flag in my book. Even if it was an innocent error it leaves me with the impression that they were hoping to make a few extra $$ from me if I didn't take the time to check my bill.
Now the positives: Great location, good value when compared to other nice hotels in the area, modern room decor, reminded me of IKEA style furnishings very nicely done. Outstanding workout facility, game room with pool and poker tables and half basketball court. Very friendly and helpful staff.
A note on lounge prices - ask for 2 glasses of house red at the bar and get a bill for $26. Not being a regular guest of hotel bars I have no idea if that is typical or not.
I'll give this place another visit at a later date (unless the prices go up much).

Having just got married in Tuscany my husband had to fly to the states for a month, travelling from city to city with work so I went with him, along with our then 18 month old son. We stayed in the Sofitel and had the best stay ever. The hotel was very modern and clean and bright. The staff were amazing especially with our son and would take him for a walk around the restaurant or sit and play with him so that we could eat!! The rooms were perfectly spaced, not huge but just what we wanted/needed. The location was great, we
Were just slightly off the MAIN drag but it was nice as it was a more
Kitch area with lots of little boutiques and was right in the middle of a triangle of Starbucks! There is a supermarket around the corner as well as a basement car park. All in all, for what was a very short honeymoon, our stay at the Sofitel was perfect and we can't wait to go back, this time hopefully alone!!

I stayed here for two nights back in February for a conference. The hotel is on a busy street with the elevated train tracks just half a block away, yet when I entered the lobby all that faded away. The lobby was warm, clean and inviting. The front desk personnel efficient and very nice. 
My room was excellent! Comfortable, clean and very well appointed. The bathroom was huge and I never lacked hot water or towels. 
Wi-Fi from the room was good and I enjoyed the view of Chicago streets.
Good service, great value and a great nights sleep. Everything one can ask for.
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: We have just returned from a very pleasant week in Chicago. Highly recommend the Sofitel. Great Gold Coast location - very convenient for the shops and Oak St beach. There was a slight mix up with our booking, but the desk staff sorted it all out without any fuss - very impressive. Concierge was full of great recommendations, and the rooms were spotless. Amazing lake and Hancock Centre views from our room. About the most comfortable bed going. Would definitely return.

Pretty average hotel for me. Good points first:
- Soft bed with pillow top mattress was comfortable
- Bose radio in the room
- large separate cubicle shower-good shower
- great location next to MM
- great cafe for breakfast if breakfast not included
Points why I rated the hotel average overall
- luggage was left on a trolley at the check in desk no offer to bring it up to the room-poor
- the room didn't have the wow factor just a standard room in beige with standard hotel type furniture
- door men hit and miss sometimes they were there to open the doors sometimes not. Sometimes there but didn't open the door.
- no assistance with luggage on check out (except for the guy who hails the taxis outside who was excellent)
- pillows were lumpy shame as they spoilt a good bed
- air conditioning too noisy
Worst of all I filled in the feedback form that was sent by email and had an email from the director of customer services (I think) asking if everything was ok. I spent a long while giving some very comprehensive feedback and it wasn't even acknowledged and no thank you. It'll be the last time I do that!
-

review_title: Piacevole sorpresa l'hotel BURNHAM di Chicago.
review_text: E' veramente piacevole soggiornare in questo albergo. La sua posizione permette di raggiungere facilmente il centro della citta'. Il personale cordiale e disponibile. Le 4 stelle se le merita tutte. Per i nostalgici del caffe' italiano vicino l'albergo trovate un famoso caffe' italiano dove gustare caffe' e cappuccini come in Italia.

We stayed here for three nights eith our two kids, ages 8 and 4. We had a two-bedroom suite. The kids got to "camp" in the living room in a hotel-set-up tent. It was quiet and lovely. We had an amazing view of the lake and Navy Pier. Great location. Loved!

review_text: The Sofitel Watertower is just behind the Magnificent Mile near the Watertower Plaza. It's a great location for shopping, but there are often weddings at the weekends which can feel a bit strange as a guest. Brilliant diner on the same block!

review_title: Un buen hotel, nuevo y con excelente ubicaciÃ³n
review_text: El hotel es muy nuevo y esta en una zona buenÃ­sima en plena Magnificent Mile, hay de todo cerca, tiendas, restaurantes, sitios para desayunar...tiene una terraza con vistas en la parte de arriba del edificio, un bar muy sofisticado con vistas espectaculares de la ciudad:recomendable.

My wife and I spent four nights in this wonderful, very well located hotel in downtown Chicago recently. Staff were extremely helpful and courteous and our every request was met with a smile. Easy walking to many of Chicago's attractions and excellent restaurants makes for a hassle free break in this fabulous city. I wouldn't hesitate to return to the Sofitel Chicago Water Tower.

Recently stayed for 3 nights at The Ritz in Chicago. The location is excellent right on the magnificent mile and on top of the Water Tower Mall. The service and quality of the hotel is what you would expect from a Four Seasons Hotel. The rooms were clean and the beds very comfortable. We had asked for a coffee maker in our room as it was not a standard feature in the rooms.
They sent one up immediately however we did have to call down daily as they never replenished the coffee or gave us clean cups when they removed the old cups. Aside from that small inconvenience everything else was very good and we would not hesitate to stay there again.

As always, the Ritz rolls out the red carpet for our 4 year old which is appreciated by all. We will definitely stay here again. review_title: Value for money with great service in a good location.
review_text: Of all the hotels we have stayed in during our US trip, this stay has been the best yet. The service was outstanding. We arrived from a long 16 hour flight to Chicago at 8.30 in the morning and our room wasn't ready then since check in time was 3 pm. We thought we might have to leave our luggage in the lobby and go on a walkabout or rest up on the lobby couches. The staff at front desk took initiative and gave us a temporary room so we could rest up a bit, have a shower if needed etc till our room was ready. That was beyond what I expected and it really set the tone. First impressions are so important! We did not have coffee making facilities in the room we were in but front desk sent a coffee maker without a fuss. The service was hospitable and efficient. Everyone we met in the hotel was in good spirits and since the holiday season can be stressful for staff, it certainly did not show. The location of the hotel is great. A short walk to magnificient mile (in fact you can go straight to the mile if you walk through the mall) we got a great "Xmas in July" deal and hope to get lucky again the next time we visit Chicago. I would definitely recommend this hotel to everybody!
Impeccable service--walking down the hall an employee pressed the down button for me since they saw me approaching. Gym was great--peppermint infuse chilled towels!!!

review_text: Great hotel, lovely rooms of a good size. The breakfast each day was fantastic - continental but you can also make your own waffles. Great to fill you up for a big day of sightseeing. Good location for theatres etc, we will probably stay a bit closer to the magnificent mile next time round as it was about 25 walk to the shopping district.

We felt relaxed from the moment we walked through the doors of this elegant art deco historic hotel. Rich jewel tones, marble and mosaic floors and ornate wrought iron conjured images of sophistication of an era long past. It was a pleasant surprise to see the many canine guests in the lobby at this dog friendly establishment. The size of room was standard for a hotel in a big city. The organza canopy that floated on the extra high walls and crown moulded ceiling above the bed made me feel reminiscent of a princess. The granite bath room was adequate, although the shower was superb with its massaging beams of water relaxing my shoulders! The his and hers substantially heavy cotton robes wrapped us in warmth and comfort.

review_title: Great location, room and service. So close to everything.
review_text:
This was our first time visiting Chicago and we wanted to cover a lot. The hotel is two blocks from Millenium Park, 3 blocks from the Magnificant Mike and 2 blocks from the Riverwalk. The subway stop is 1 block away. Short cab rides to Old Town. 
Extremely clean and staff was very informative. If we stayed elsewhere we likely would not have had as good of a time. 
The rooms are perfect.

review_title: The perfect location and a great hotel in every way!
review_text:
The hotel is beautiful with wonderful service. I stayed there on a business trip and it was 
My first time in Chicago. Everything went so well, the staff was so helpful. It was so easy to get around and I was close to many tourist attractions! Truly a Great place to stay, quite a value! I hope I get to travel there again!
Nothing but positives. Staff are great, rooms classy and location perfect for Magnificent Mile, Lake and restaurants. Just need to put a coffee maker in the room and it will be perfect.

review_text: Hotel has a small boutique feel to it. The breakfast area has major congestion during the morning due to the front desk being next to the breakfast area. Overall, the staff is great. They are very courteous ad helpful.

review_title: Extremely pleased with the hotel staff, location, amenities, bar and restaurant.
review_text: My wife and I spent two days at the hotel over the Christmas holiday. We could'nt have asked for a better experience, the entire staff is top notch, the bar and restaurant are excellent (best old fashioned in town), the location is excellent, walk to shopping, entertainment, restaurants and bars. We would recommend this hotel over any other hotel in the area. It's rare that you feel that you've received your monies worth when you stay at a hotel in downtown Chicago but that is not the case at the Palomar. We will definitely stay here again. A big thank you to the Palomar Hotel staff and management for a most enjoyable experience.
As usual the Conrad represents the best in quality and service. It's the only place I will stay in Chicago and you'd be crazy to stay anywhere else!
Loved the location right on mag mile. Can walk just about anywhere. Good concierge restaurant recommendations. Attached by a bridge to some fabulous shopping too. Breakfast typical of hotels.

Those are the highlights. The bathroom was unusually spacious, even compared to other 4-star+ hotels and free wifi was a pleasant surprise. Otherwise, it's a standard business-class experience; no complaints but also nothing to rave about. Recommended for a quiet and uneventful stay.

From the moment we arrived until we checked out, the Hotel Palomar delivered exceptional service for us. The hotel manager contacted us by email before we arrived asking if there was anything he could do for us. The hotel upgraded our reservation to a Fuji tub suite when we told them it was our 20th anniversary. Service was perfect, the room was clean and spacious and everyone we met was friendly.

I have stayed at over 8 different hotels in the River North area of Chicago. The Hotel Palomar tops my list for service--from managing a unusual reservation request (on a Priceline room, none the less), to the valet, reception, housekeeping and restaurant staff--The people at Hotel Palomar go out of their way to make you feel like their favorite cousin. I even got a hug from the concierge as I was leaving! Definitely the place to stay if you want that warm, welcome feeling. Try and get a corner room. The views are outstanding.

review_title: A beautiful hotel with a friendly atmosphere
review_text: We stayed at the Monaco for our anniversary and I was completely impressed with our experience there. Every staff member we encountered was friendly and accommodating. But one staff member really went above and beyond for us. A few days prior to our trip I corresponded with concierge Ryan. I wanted to have a few things in our room upon arrival (flowers, wine, and some bath products) Ryan was so helpful and his friendly positive attitude was reassuring. The minute I got off the phone with him the day before our trip I knew everything would be taken care of and I could just relax. When we got to the hotel everything was perfect. The room was beautiful. Hotel Monaco has been remodeled since my first visit and they have done a wonderful job. I couldn't be more pleased. We spent three wonderful days there and I didn't want to leave!
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Chicago - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Spending a weekend in Chicago with the wife and stayed at this Hotel. We upgraded to a King Spa Suite, which is a decent sized room with a sitting area, a jetted tub for two and a separate shower. 
No problems with the hotel in general. It is as advertised. There's a very helpful, considerate staff, upscale interior, and high end furnishings. The room is quiet, has good heat/AC, and great black out curtains. The bed is on the firm side (which is a preference) but you can tell the mattress is well maintained and has nice bedding. 
The only drawbacks we encountered had to do with the bathroom. Regarding what could be fixed, our jetted tub had a malfunctioning drain stop which would not allow water to drain with the turn of the designated nob. In order to get the water to drain, you had to get your fingers to pry up the drain. A screwdriver would have helped! We told the front desk and they said they would send an engineer, but when we got back to the room things had not changed. 
Regarding what can't be fixed, the vanity only has one sink, and it should have two. The shower is huge for a hotel. At least 4x4 or even larger. Only problem is it has a single shower head more appropriate to a cheap motel. There should be a rain shower or at least multiple shower heads. Although two people can comfortably fit in the shower, don't try it, one of you will freeze while the other one gets the less than generous stream from the old fashioned shower head. For one person the shower is fine, but not 4star quality. Considering the high quality experience which is the Palomar, the bathroom failings are not enough to stop me from coming back.

review_title: Very classy with exceptional customer service!
review_text: Stayed here on our honeymoon. The location was great! Close to shopping (the shops at northbrook) was an elevator ride away. Many restaurants within walking distance as well. Top notch hotel in a great location! If you want to treat yourself to an exceptional time in Chicago stay here!!

Stayed here for business trip for two nights and was very pleased with location,room,etc. Staff was very helpful and accommodating during my stay. Breakfast was very good with the buffet. Bed and pillows some of the best ever slepted on in my travels and room very clean.

review_title: Great stay for business and anniversary
review_text: We really enjoyed the room, the pillow menu, the finish level of the decor and the staff. The gentleman cleaning the lobby restroom was pleasant and encouraged me to fill out a comment card. The only poor thing I encountered was a coffe bar attendant that took the drip tray and dumped it back into the coffee urn that was setting out for the morning rush!! I brought it up with the front desk. I have to say the front desk staff was great the whole time. They had a nice gift in our room from the front desk for our anniversary.

review_title: Very quiet, elegant, comfortable, and classy!
review_text: Just stayed here on business for 2 nights for the first time. Great stay- amazing free breakfast for HHonors Gold members, comfy bed, very spacious bathroom (although water pressure in shower wasn't great) and friendly people at the front desk. Conrad's are always SO quiet, which I love. Would definitely stay here again!

Truly 4+star hotel! From exiting the car at arrival until loading to leave this hotel delivers outstanding service and hospitality. We asked for a high room and had the top floor, what a view. The staff added to the joy of our Chicago experience. Excellent! 5 star in my book!

review_title: Fabulous hotel. I'd stay the again and again.
review_text:
We stayed in a newly remodeled suite on the 14th floor. The suite was really large which we weren't expecting. We loved the window seats and I often sat in the window while updating on my iPad. The jacuzzi tub was a really nice touch. Service was great - they did their jobs without us even knowing they were there. Very QUIET hotel. Although we occasionally heard the nearby above ground subway, we never heard another hotel guest or any hall noise. Location was the best - right in the middle of everything and great for St. Patrick's Day festivities.
Only complaints are that the bed was too firm and that there are strangely no dresser drawers of any kind in the room. We had to keep our things in our suitcases and strewn over the couch.

review_text: We stayed at the Conrad for 4 nights. The rooms are large, very quiet and extremely clean. The only thing I would tell travelers is that some of the rooms face a large office building. The Conrad is close to everything. We loved it!

review_title: Great place - we will be back
review_text: Never stayed here before but will again in the future. Great location, close to just about everything. Rooms were very nice, we were upgraded to an Executive level room and they had lots of space. It was a little cumbersome going in, then up an elevator to the 5th floor, checking in then off to another set of elevators, but we got used to it. The only part I absolutely detest about Chicago in general is the $50+ per night it costs to park! That has to change.

review_title: Good value, but sub-optimal location for a tourist.
review_text:
We were attracted to this hotel by it's positive reviews and good price. We were not disappointed with the room or location and would recommend it to others.
However this hotel is most well suited to people with a vehicle. For tourists looking to see Hollywood and downtown LA without a car, be aware that travel by public transport will take the best part of an hour there and back. Disneyland can be reached via buses in 1.5-2 hours.
Very clean, friendly service, free wifi, cheap price and very close to the main attractions on Hollywood boul. I would highly recommend for anyone to stay here.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn - Los Angeles / West Sunset Blvd.

review_text:
My stay at Hotel Palomar has exceeded my expectations. Being a college student, I have to travel on a budget. This is the second time I have used Hotwire to book a room in Chicago. The first time, I was not impressed. Quality was considerably compromised. Such was not the case at Hotel Palomar. 
My bus from Minnesota arrived to Chicago at 6:30AM. I went to the hotel to request that they accommodate my luggage until check in. To my surprise, the more than friendly attendant allowed me to check in. Having been on a bus over night, a shower and a nap upon my arrival was more than appreciated. 
The room decor is interesting, the lighting is interactive and ambient, cleanliness was impeccable, beds are comfortable, not once did I have to adjust the temperature. Best of all, they offer free wi-fi if you sign up as a Kimpton Guest! 
In addition to that the hotel is in close proximity to Michigan Ave. and just a block away from the red line. 
Overall, my stay at Hotel Palomar was pleasant and I was given no reason to complain. I would definitely stay here again.

review_text: It's a miracle that my friends and I were not evicted. If you're going to Hollywood to party this is a great spot. If you are looking for a quiet place to sleep look elsewhere. The Seventh Vail and Crazy Girls are each about a block away.

Ps. It is nicely located a block from the Civic Center But the neighborhood is quite sketchy.

I almost feel bad for giving this hotel a bad review but being honest about my experience so that other travellers can be aware before choosing this hotel. The saying, "it's about all Location, Location, Location" rings true, and sadly this hotel does not have it. First, our room was facing a main road. If you're a light sleeper or easily distracted by traffic noises, you're best to come prepared with own ear plugs or better yet, choose another hotel. Second, we parked right outside the hotel, and the next morning, the roof rack was stolen off the location. Of course this isn't the hotel's fault but just a warning to others about the location. Although the hotel description says it's minutes away from nice neighborhoods such as Beverly Hills and Rodeo Drive, it is nowhere nearby.
Just a few more incidences that added to a bad experience: the toilet was clogged (although the staff fixed it promptly), no one was at the front desk for check-in right away, and the bath towels was a tiny piece of rough loin cloth.

review_title: Bring your own sheets and slippers.
review_text:
As we drove up Wilahire coming from the airport, we saw the hotel sign light up. The lobby was very nice, the elevator was decent, then we opened the door to our room! The floor stained, the drapes dirty, the window sill mucky, the lamp shade dusty. The bed shears were white, but based on everything else I didn't trust it, so I got my own sheets. Taking showers was uncomfortable, because it was dirty, and our was clogged because the water would build up. The only great thing about this place is location. A week pass is $20 and you can get just about anywhere, the train service is a little slow, but the street bus is frequent. This hotel is in Korea town so it's the center of everything. 
Don't think I will stay here again.

My husband, myself, and our 5 months old daughter traveled to LA to see our friends and families. We chose this hotel for its location. The first night the heater was blowing cold air and I called the front desk and asked for portable heater. Without apology, she simply said the engineer would come to take a look at it. NO ONE CAME and didn't bring the heater. Next morning, I was in the shower when the water turned COLD! What the... I waited few minutes but still cold!!! I came out and spoke with the manager. She was nicer than the previous staff but still annoying. She asks me why I didn't call back for the heater!! How many times do I have to call? This place is soooo not worth the money and my experience here was horrible. Also with the $25 parking fee, the price here is just as expensive as other hotels. Go to the OTHER ONES!!!!

We were forced to leave by manager frank. We complained because they charge guests for parking and then without reserving space for guests who have paid they sell parking for concerts near by. After we complained frank told us "since we won't beable to make you happy u can leave now and we won't charge for the night or tomorrow (we had 2 more nights)!
 We told him that's no way to run a business and then he told us we had 30 minutes to leave or he would call police because we were being "belligerent"....thanks frank! Across the street from this place is best western. Prices are about the same but western has nice staff, nicer rooms.

The hotel was very average! The rooms were okay however the roof squeaked every time someone above walked around above us! Walls were very thin and we could hear outside noises such as talking. The two good things I can say about the rooms were the bathroom! These must have been updated along with the bed! It was extremely comfy and pleasant to sleep in! The owner or worker at the desk was also a little creepy - overly friendly! But overall an average stay in an okay area but quite pricey for what you get!

review_title: Great location, but staff has an attitude
review_text: Me and my family stayed here for a concert at the Hollywood Bowl. The rooms are a bit small and some of the room numbers are missing or typed really small on a minuscule piece of paper taped to the wall. We didnt have any bug problems, but our toilet backed up. My mom called the front desk and told them our toilet was plugged. The guy says he'll bring us a plunger. WHAT?! My mom tells the guy we have four people in the room and the guy responds saying he is not a maitenence guy. The rooms are broken the beds are hard the tv is so outdated, the pool is absolutely pathetic. Don't stay here.

review_title: I'm staying somewhere else next time!
review_text: First time staying at this Comfort Inn and it will be the last. The only good thing was that it was a short walk to the Hollywood Bowl. There were no parking spaces left so the attendant told me to park along the side wall perpendicular to the other cars. When I went to check out, they said my card was charged $8 for a parking fee! The lady ahead of me got charged $25 for parking two cars! No one told us about the charge initially! Anyway, the hallways felt dingy and dark. My window was open all night-it wouldn't shut! Lucky I was on the second floor, who knows who could have easily climbed in a ground window?! The room was pretty bare, a chunk was missing off the nightstand table, the plugs had no outlet covers and many of the lamps were unplugged when I arrived in the room. The upside of the room was a microwave, mini fridge and clean sheets and fluffy pillows. I didn't feel that this hotel was maintained as well as it could be and it wasn't worth the price of a night there. Do your homework if you're planning on staying in Hollywood and avoid this hotel!

Checked in yesterday. Area isn't as bad as I expected. Parking in a back lot semi gated but fills up at night. Cute courtyard with a clean pool. Room is decent with ours having a kitchen. Definitely a good value and just about the cheapest I found with a kitchen and king sizes bed.

review_text: Priced reasonably, located across from C studios and central to Hollywood Blvd & Beverly Hills and within walking distance of the famous Farmers Market, this older inn provides clean spacious rooms and free parking, WiFi and continental breakfast (juice, coffee, Danishes). We would stay here again.

review_title: Jo the manager = excellent customer service
review_text:
Hotel is really nice but mostly our stay has been amazing with the people that run wilshire .
Especially the manager jo , she has been really helpful and patient , jo is brilliant with customer service and has made us feel really welcome and at ease which are paramount when travelling to places unknown .
Thank you for your help jo and we appreciate it .
Ps your cool :)

I checked in and put my bags in my room after I left for the day when I returned my room was broken into and most items were missing. I called the police and they informed me they have many complaints about this problem.1/18/11

We stayed in this hotel for 4 nights so that we could attend some events at the Staples centre and surrounding places. We were a bit cautious due to the cheap prices and lack of photos but we very pleasantly surprised. Very short walk to everything, Staples centre, Ralphs supermarket, Denny's etc. Room size was good and there is paid parking next door if you need it. Staff were helpful too.
Instalaciones adecuadas, tiene estacionamiento, dos rutas de autobus en la esquina y el metro a 4 calles. Lo unico malo es la zona, calles sucias, indigentes, etc

Overall I thought this hotel was very good. The lobby was really nice and although the room wasn't super, the staff made me feel great. Special thanks to Susy who helped me while I was checking in. She directed me to Taylor stake house one night and I had an amazing meal with a friend. This hotel is clearly not up to date, but I enjoyed the service they gave me.

We stayed here for 3 nights, the location is convienient for accessing the rest of Hollywood and LA by foot or public transport however as with most of LA it is very loud and I personally felt unsafe at night. Parking is an issue as there are limited spaces and you are asked to park your car in a rather dubious looking car park 1 block up and hand over your keys, however the car was returned safe and sound. The actual motel is well run, impeccably clean and the staff were very helpful. 
As much as I liked this hotel and it's convienent location I would not stay here again as I personally didn't like the area at night, but others may find it pleasant enough.

review_title: Bad english. Very rude reception staff
review_text: After checking the availability for another night stay, was told no...then maybe. When booked elsewhere due to the unknown he got very rude and told us lies about what was said. Even upon check in before all that it obvious reception doesn't like its job and takes it out on the customer.

Love the location. Close to
Downtown and Dodger Stadium. Rooms are a little updated. Flat Screen Tvs, iron, coffee maker, fridge :) 
On the down side the staff wasn't very friendly, people expect a nice staff especially when you are on vacation. 
Overall, would stay again.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Dragon Gate Inn

review_text:
Si on veut un palace d'holywood avec paillette et glamour : passez votre chemin. Mais si on veut un Hotel a prix correct Tres bien situe pourquoi pas.
Hotel un peu dÃ©suet, les chambres sont assez grandes mais mobilier et salle de bain pas terrible du tout. Lits spacieux.
Tres bien situÃ©, a 3 minutes de hollywood blv et l'hÃ´tel a un parking.
L'accueil est trescourtois mais par contre autant dire qu'il n'y a pas de petit dÃ©jeuner car on nous offre juste du the ou cafÃ© et un muffin sous vide...
L'ensemble est correct pour le prix et la situation.

We booked this hotel basically because we couldn't afford Beverly Hills. If you want a hotel close to Hollywood Boulevard then this is great. The rooms were made each day which was also great.
However, from check in the people that greeted us were rude, spoke in foreign language in front of us, and didn't seem to even know about our booking through expedia.
The rooms were old, run down, and smelt if the a/c wasn't on. The shower was terrible, and the toilet was disgusting.
Pay extra and stay somewhere better, Hollywood is crap

First time review which we are doing because we found Trip Advisor so helpful planning our US holiday.
This hotel is basic but comfortable, clean and the rooms are big. The location is unbeatable for Hollywood Blvd and the metro.
We got breakfast (albeit basic) and wi-fi included which we werent expecting.
Only one of the three receptionists we spoke to seemed to have a good grasp of English or a desire to help.
If you want a basic hotel to sleep in only for a good price and a great location this hotel is fine, just don't ask the reception person for anything too difficult.

review_title: Very nice stay for great price. Definitely would recommend staying here.
review_text: Very nice stay for a great price paid $80-90 dollars for the night. A family friend's wedding was nearby. Great location for shopping and seeing downtown sights. A tad small but it was clean, no frills, and the staff was very friendly. Would definitely recommend staying here.

review_title: Cockroaches, bugs, musty smell. Not worth it.
review_text: I think the above pretty much sums it up. Oh! Tiny room, hairs on blankets, which also smelled a lot like chlorine (maybe a good thing after all). Yes, it is cheap compared to other downtown LA hotels, but like everything else in this world you get what you pay for.
All upgrades were in the front entrance and lobby., rooms, beds, bathroom have to be the worst I have ever seen.. 1 channel tv with snow, 1 iron for the whole hotel.. Need I say more!!!!
You to pay for the valet parking and its expensive. Theres no signal for wifi internet in the rooms - only in lobby!

We booked the suite w/ 2 beds & separate living area for $102 thinking that we would get a better room. We walked in, smelling smoke- curtains were filthy & had mold, ac was not working carpet turned my toddlers feet black in 2 mins. It was so late as we slowly noticed the defects & we were tired to we decided to sleep & speak w the mgr the next day. In the morning, my son & I woke up congested / coughing. I spoke to a nice lady mgr ( julianne ) who upgraded us to the presidential suite due to the complaint i haf and rate i paid. The pres suite was much better but the hot& cold shower was acting up, sink/faucet was rusty & my toddlers feet became black ( he refuses to wear slippers on carpet, this is what he's use too ). The continental bfast had flies around it & not even a mediocher attendant- she was hispanic & did not have even the most basic service training!!
This hotel needs to get all the carpets thoroughly shamppooed- this is a health hazzard. They need to cleqn the airducts/ ac-- another health hazzard./ remove that step from the shower & replace the sink. 
The area is bad but its got good proximity to downtown spots. This property can be great if better management was put into place. The GM or whoever the decision maker is for the property should not even work for a dollar store: should not work for a mcdonalds or at all!

review_title: Fine for a party trip, not families
review_text:
Recently me and my husband spent a few nights here, which felt like a few too many considering the room size (our luggage barely fit anywhere). That being said, it is close to LA Live, staples center, a metro station and several good restaurants. The free continental breakfast was a nice plus, nothing fancy but pretty good.
The hotel does not have a restaurant, but it does have a little pub with cheap drinks and free popcorn! 
I would recommend this hotel to young people going to party for a weekend, or if youre going to an event at the staples center. I would not recommend it to families. There is no pool, and it is not near any child-friendly amenities.

review_title: A weekend in a very tiny room
review_text:
This hotel is not for everyone. 
If you want a cheap, small yet clean room for the weekend it will probably suit you fine. 
The rooms were quite clean and I never saw any vermin or stains but the hallway smelled like smoke. 
The service was lacking. We had to ask for extra pillows and sheets three times before they arrived. 
Probably the most important note is that it is between the nicer part of LA and the sketchy part. So just be a bit more cautious.

This hotel may be a 2 star but dosent deserve a 1!! We have been traveling around the states for a month and this hotel is in a shocking location it's dirty rooms include: paper thin Walls, (parties next door until 3am, hotel staff did nothing about) broken tv and coffee machine, terrible shower, wallpaper coming off Walls and a bed like concrete, an absolute shocking stay! Please keep away!!

Quite a good stay if your on a budget. The breakfast they have are pretty good. Great variety.
Friendly and very helpful staff. Buses just outside the door to Disneyland. 
Close to trains also. And free usage of the local gym in the plaza down the street if you stay at the ritz.
Great food in the area. Lots of Japanese food

Stayed in this hotel for one night at the end of our holiday. After reading previous reviews we were not looking forward to it one bit. However we were really surprised. The hotel smells a bit of damp in the corridors but the room was immaculate and a good size. The tv was ancient but who would be watching tv in downtown LA. For the price of the hotel approx $130 per night inc taxes and parking you cannot go wrong. The location is brilliant with the staples center mins round the corner and a good choice of other bars and restaurants in the area.

Certes l hotel est d un style viellot mais nous y avons sÃ©journer 10 nuits et notre chambre a Ã©tÃ© faite trÃ¨s correctement tous les jours. Le petit dÃ©jeuner, le parking et le Wifi qui sont des services rarement gratuits dans la ville, l ai pour cet hotel. Nous gardons un bon souvenir de notre sÃ©jour il ne faut pas se leurer a ce prix la!!!

review_title: Very happy - don't understand the bad reviews.
review_text:
We made reservations at this hotel after we Pre-paid with an amazing rate without knowing the hotel name. I was happy to have learned it was the Radisson but soon after reading the reviews, I regret the decision of booking my husband and I at this hotel. The only thing I learned after reading the complaints was the cost of the valet. I would have been extremely upset if we weren't prepared financially that this was basically the only option (the other having parking about a mile away). But since we prepared ourselves, the valet actually was one of our favorite parts of the trip. 
The room was very nice and clean. Our room didn't come with a sleep number bed but we found the bed very comfortable. 
The entire staff was very professional. I have no complaints about any of them. 
The only minor problem in the room was the water in the bathroom sink didn't warm up fast enough. It took about 3 minutes before the hot water cane through. That's a lot of water wasted. But like I said, that's a minor problem and easy to fix. Oh, the room we were in did have a refrigerator but not a microwave. That would have been great to have had a microwave. 
Again, I'm not sure why so many bad reviews. My only conclusion is that only the guests who didn't have good experiences are writing the reviews. So I encourage other guest to write about their positive stay.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_title: Stay here if you only NEED to.
review_text:
My girlfriend and I only needed one night here, so we were pretty lucky. We arrived around 8PM and was pretty tired from a day of driving and going to Universal Studios. The frontdesk attendant was lounging in his chair casually carrying on a personal call. That's usually ok for me as I know how hard it can be when your working all day. However, this guy was sitting very laidback with one foot on the counter which would have made Homer Simpson look like an amateur. The complex itself is in a busy location so noise may be a problem. There also appears to be some actual residents that live there which was a bit unusual. I only say this because I left an item in my room after checkout and went back in to retrieve it whenI found an old man who was one of the residents cleaning up the room we just stayed in. The room was pretty dirty when we got it and my assumption is that the old man was simply going to tidy up the room. I doubt the sheets will be washed considering we were only there for a night.
I would only stay here if I seriously just needed a place to crash for the night. Stay any longer and i'm sire you results may vary. Check out the cigarette burn pics I added. All complimentary add ons we didn't ask for! :-P
