If you can find a different place to stay, do it. Although the staff are very friendly this hotel is not very clean and is very noisy. The corners in the room are very dirty even dead bugs were there, the shower is moldy with some kind of black stuff on the shower curtain. The fridge never worked even after asking for someone to come look at it, and the wi-fi sucked! It worked sometimes for a few minutes and then died.

Great location, all-round performer, esp
 swimming pool, great value for money.

This is a convenient location if you need a hotel near the airport. My room was in need of a refresh. Wallpaper was peeling, there were dust marks and holes in the wall from a painting that had been removed. At best, this gets an average score.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text: This is the nicest holiday inn express around. It is nicer than most holiday inn regulars. Only drawback is its right on a really busy road and its pretty noisy in the room at night. Oh well.

Best customer service out there! The concierge remembered us calling and changing the reservation and when the computer didn't put it through, he remembered our name and fixed the issue without us having to find out! Very friendly--you are not just another person!

I had bookes through Travelocity top secret room for $97 with tax. When we arrived and got to our room it was a smoking room. I went back to the front desk asking for a non smoking room and the guy said theu were all reserved thats why i got the smoking room.
We were able to live with it since it was only for one night. 
Other than that the hotel is well located, just one block away from hollywood boulvard and parking is free.

review_title: Ok place to stay, but not recommended for those who want a quiet atmosphere.
review_text: My fiancee and I stayed here for a weekend with our toddler, because it was close to the house of the people we came out here to visit. Unfortunately we didn't take into consideration that some college students live here. On the Saturday night that we were here, we were awakened several times during the night by doors slamming, laughing and carrying on in the hallway, and other noises made by people having a good time. The hotel doors also have knockers on them, and we heard a lot of obnoxious knocking on the doors on our floor at all hours of the night. Not a great atmosphere for a family trying to sleep. However, room was clean and comfortable. Shower/tub combo is a little awkward as it sits about a foot off of the ground. Ok place for people who aren't traveling with young children and don't mind the noise. Price was reasonable

Was there last week. It doesnt look good and clean like it was in the picture on net.i suggest to not come here specially if u have kids. Coz up to now i have 7 big bed bug bites on my 2 on my neck 3 on my left leg 1 on my right belly and 1 on my right arm.i noticed them when i woke up on my last stay there.and i was so pissed!!!! Their curtain looked like it had some blood droplets on it.and their blanket looks old and ugly. I am definitely not comming back there!

review_title: A really nice hotel near hollywood blvd
review_text: A really nice hotel the staff are really friendly and informative rooms are clean and very well presented with a tv fridge and showers , breakfast consists of cereal toast, waffles, coffee and juice the only complaint was the room where you get breakfast was way too crowed during the busy hours, the pool was clean it is right next to hollywood western metro station (only two stops from hollywood highland) and the griffith oberservertory/park and accoss the street a ralphs supermarket which is open till 2 am overall a really nice time thanks

They really need to have a pest service program in affect! We also had mold on the tub and our ac did not cool the room down.The only staff member that knows customer service is the maintenance man. The rooms did look very nice upon entrance, but if they dedicate more time they can avoid many of the issues we encountered.
We booked a room 4 MONTHS in advance, but when we arrived they told us they had no rooms avaliable and sent us away to a more expensive, grubby super 8

Interesting 2 story rooms, recently renovated Beattie heart of century city and close to major attractions.
Friendly staff, easy checkin. 10 min to century city mall
The room was spacious, modern and chic. We have a view of the Hollywood hills! Close to everything. Would stay here again
hotel_name: The Hotel Wilshire, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Alrhough the room was clean it was very noisy. We had room next to reception so could hear noise coming from reception and people walking up and down the stairs. Also going by the prices quoted on here were over charged. 
Very disappointing as we had stayed in a few Days Inn hotels around America and this would have to be the worst

Stayed here for allstar weekend and the cleaning lady stole our leftover tequila.... I told the front desk abt it and all thy could do was have me email the manager who then offered me a discount on a room for one nights stay.....not very accomodating considering the fact that people that work for your hotel are stealing personal items from patrons [--]!! That's not coo other than thy the location was coo it was close to everythng in hollywood and shopping areas. I would stay only if it wass for one night and I am gonna stash my liquor!!
I really enjoyed staying in this hotel. We did a ten mile hike around the city to go to all of the touristy sites and the hotel is the perfect location. The staff was friendly as well.

This hotel is just lovely. Excellent location close to bars shops & major sights. The rooms are large airy and well equipped, with the most amazing comfy bed. The bathroom was spotless and had lots of supplies. However, what really makes this hotel a gem is the staff and their hospitality.... Nothing was too much bother. (We had purchased tropicana orange juice in an outside store, and having noticed that we liked it, the hotel left us two complimentary bottles as a kind gesture). We would highly recommend the Palomar and will definitely be back!

This hotel is really great value. The room I got was huge (209) and was very clean. I got great service from the reception. They offered to carry my bags upstairs. I arrived early and was able to get to my room straight away. I have no complaints.
The room has a good size, the bed is huge. Wifi free. I will stay again.

Stayed here for my 5th wedding anniversary. Rooms are very spacious, designed to relax. Staff was very kind and welcoming. We didnt have the best view, but take the elevator to the pool and enjoy the lights if the city at night.

This was my third visit to the Conrad Chicago. We were there for the Chicago marathon...a 3 night stay. The hotel is modern and clean and in a great central location. It is attached to a shopping area that includes Nordstrom. 
 We had a large corner room that was fairly quiet even though it faced Michigan Avenue. There is a large pillow menu available. We used it to get foam pillows due to allergies. The bed seemed much softer than we remembered from past visits...probably time to replace the mattresses.
The bathroom was large and bright. Acca kappa bath products are provided. When our faucet handle broke, housekeeping had it taken care of right away without us having to request the service...nice that they were on top of it.
The Hilton honors breakfast in the restaurant was delicious and included with our voucher. I also ordered room service very early on the morning of the marathon. It arrived late and was missing part of the order. It would be nice if the restaurant could open early on marathon morning to accommodate the many runners who were staying there that weekend. I recommend a 5:00 am opening. Due to the unseasonably warm weather, the outside terrace was open. We enjoyed drinks and lunch outside and it was fabulous....so glad they opened it up to guests that late in the season. If you are a Starbucks person, there is one next door at the Marriott or across Michigan Avenue in the intercontinental. 
All in all a great stay. I recommend it, but would like firmer mattresses.

review_title: Great place to stay in Chicago
review_text: Was very pleased with the Palomar. Good location, very clean hotel with art throughout. The rooms are spacious and very clean. The pool deck is great with heated pool and nice sun deck to hang out and have a drink. The bar is terrific and the food is great as well. Also the complementary wine tasting is a nice touch. Service was also flawless. I would choose the Palomar over most hotels in downtown Chicago without hesitation.

I debated on staying at a more expensive hotel but since we had three rooms we went more economical. Now first, I am a hotel snob so with that being said...I will never stay anywhere but here. (The Allerton last time was so-so but The Conrad had a great location...even better since its connected to the nordstroms mall. Staff was amazingly helpful, kind and even remembered my name after one meeting. Many hotels do not offer in room coffee pots but when i asked they said they'd have one out in complimentary as well as a mini fridge for mothers diabetic supplies...it helped w left overs too. I can't say enough!! Great experience.

review_title: What do you want for$50 What do you want for $50.00?
review_text: Stayed here for two nights in May. The furnishings are cheap, the bed is not good, but you get free wifi, and a decent TV. The rooms have no phones, so if you have a problem you can use your own or hoof it down to the lobby. The elevator is permanently out of order ( blocked off). But it's really cheap and seems relatively safe.

This was our first time to have to leave a deposit for a room key and tv remote. The rooms were not very clean, carpet dirty, hot water was only warm not hot. Not the best neighbourhood. Not the worst but certainly not even close to the best.

Great gem in the heart of Michigan Ave. Just park the car and the rest is easy. Eating, shopping, shows, museums are walkin distance or maybe a cab ride away. Only complaint is the cost of valet parking.

review_title: This is the best place to stay on Los Angeles area.
review_text: Always clean rooms excellent customer service they remember me. the only place I stay when I come to town. Always quiet and comfortable
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn & Suites Granada Hills

review_title: Top quality rooms, great location, really truly nice staff.
review_text: This was our first trip to Chicago so we selected this hotel based on Tripadvisor reviews and we were not disappointed. When we checked in we mentioned that it was our anniversary and when we returned from our walk we found iced champagne in our room with a card from the concierge. We enjoyed it on the rooftop deck. The hotel location is perfect for walking and for taking the Red Line subway. The wine tasting from 5-6 pm every day is so nice. It is served in the 'living room', is free, and serves as a nice place to meet other visitors to Chicago. The staff members here are a happy group. This place is well-run. We can't wait to come back.

My boyfriend and i stayed at the HHH for a total of three nights. When we first got there we had an unwelcome feeling checking in with the guy working at the front desk. He didnt seem like he cared much about helping us or getting us settled in, instead he decided to talk to his friends. When we finally got our room key the room turned out into a disapointment because the pictures looked so much cleaner and bigger. We had a queen size non smoking room. Theres a tiny mirror in the bathroom and the sink is waaay too small whereas everytime i went to wash my face water would splash everywhere!! The sheets on the bed also had boogers on it. Gross!! And the left side of the bed smelled like seman and bleach. Yeah i wish i was making this up. I couldnt sleep on the bed because it felt so dirty that my boyfriend had to request new sheets! After the first night with new sheets and having some sleep from driving all morning the stay became better. If your going to stay here make sure to bring a candle or air freshner for room and bathroom for the bathroom has NO window it smells BAD!! And make sure to bring your own blanket or throw overall the maids made us feel very safe they welcomed us and when we left one maid even offered to help us with our lugguge. Once we came to the front desk the guy didnt even say anything to us go figure. I mean i understand he WAS busy watching a movie and all.

I was there attending a concert, and had issued, getting a room. I stayed one night there. They didn't fussed over the fact that I didn't check out til later. I was just disappointmened that the location was really far from L.A. itself. But other than that, it was a nice and quiet place.

review_title: Hip in a good way - my gave in Chicago!
review_text: I LOVE the Palomar! You can bring your pets but if that doesn't appeal to you you'll love it here too. Great vibe, cool decor, and very friendly staff. The pool, gym, and living room are fabulous and small/cozy without being cramped or small. Location is great - not crazy busy, only a few steps from the Red Line, plentiful cabs at all hours(hailed by the awesome doormen), close to great food and super close to Michigan Ave and Navy Pier. My room was beautiful, quiet, and the amenities are great (think leopard robe and higher end bath products).

review_title: Just love it! Would stay there every chance I had
review_text:
The hotel is great! The location is perfect, the room is big and nicely decorated. The shower is great. There is free parking and wi fi.
Try to arrive at night and ve very welcome by Vladmir - such a nice, happy, full of great stories guy.

Good location, free parking. Smells a bit old as well. Carpet in staircase is worn out. NO BAR OR BREAKFASTS. If you're on the streetside as I was take earplugs. Single sheeded non isolation glass does not hold any streetnoise. WiFi is free but weak in my room. Location is ok but remember you need a car anyway in LA (and I'm European!)

review_title: STAY HERE IF YOU WANT TO GET ROBBED!
review_text: Our car was broken into and rifled through right in front of the door. Very unsafe area and rude owners!!!

review_title: A good hotel near the airport
review_text:
We stayed at this hotel after a very long flight 
The location was morethan good and also the service 
Parking was very expensive
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text:
I don't have a lot to add to all the other stellar reviews. Have never stayed in a Kimpton before and decided it was time. Picked the Palomar because of the TripAdvisor rating and we really needed to be near a metro stop.
What can I add? Yes, there is construction across the street and a large fire station a block away. We loved both. This IS Chicago. We were interested in Sable as the kitchen and it awesome, particularly for the soft boiled eggs cooked to perfection for my in-room breakfast.
We had to in-and-out our car a few times- the valet service is amazing. The bellmen are all sweet and cute. Desk staff professional.
We needed a hotel where my husband and I can enjoy each other and Chicago but also pick up and drop off our daughter at her new college for the next four years. I think this place does the trick.

The toilet blocked, the room smelt funky, no lift, no staff to help, appalling service, ripped cushions, dirty bathroom, scary location at night, nothing around, far from hollywood blv..... Shall I continue? Don't stay there!

We stayed here during our recent trip to SoCal. We weren't expecting a palace but we also weren't expecting single pane windows that aren't even fully sealed. Every window, when closed, had cracks around the edges. Additionally, we were at the end of the hall. The window was always wide open and the fire escape was located there. The fire escape also offered unrestricted access to our bathroom window, which would not close all the way. The bed was saggy and worn, but very spacious. The room had the historic feel as advertised, and not in the cheapy sense. The halls smelled funky but they also matched the historic feel the hotel is going for. The view of the Hollywood sign out of our windows was superb, though.

review_title: Stay here of hate air conditioning!
review_text:
The air conditioning system doesn't blow hard enough! Nor is it very cold. Seems like a very out-dated a/c system. Not a comfortable stay. Also, they have Sleep Number beds, of which I'm not a fan. 
The restaurant is pretty good and the bar has good service, although a little pricey, as you would expect.
Also, they would not accommodate an early check-in, even though our need for it was an exceptional circumstance.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_title: High rates but off course along an incredible bad service
review_text: To feel the service in this hotel you just have to arrive with a car so you can feel how thevalet service treats you like a bank robber while you just park your car...and not once but twice. Make a line to check in like you were in Vegas. You thought that was it....Noooooo, if you arrive late, lets say 9 pm please hurry to pick up a sandwich onnthe bar before they take them away. But the best part, reserve a room for three people, pay a $180 per night rate and wake up early so you can go to airport on time and hear on the restaurant thatyou have only one breakfast included. What??? But the reservation says breakfast i made a reservation having in mind breakfast and now we have to pay more or have breakfast on airport.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text: The worst experience in over 20 years of travel. Why would an airport hotel rent out the penthouse suite to a private party until 2am. When we called the desk to advise of the excessive noise they just told it was a private party and they had rented the space until 2am. Then there was the moldy ceilings near the Aircon vents that another Trip Advisor also enjoyed.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text:
I wish I would have o
paid attention to guest reviews but booked a room in a hurry, thinking Radisson cant really be a bad choise!? The review from Singbe, makes sence now that I stayed at the hotel, the room was poorly cleaned and very chabby, full of mold which to me is severe due to an asthmatic condition. My healthcondition got even worse when I got home, since this stuff tends to stay with you for a couple of days. To top this they served me hair with my breakfast!!!! 
The hotel is lucky, I was in a hurry that morning and for that resdon didnt find the energy to argue for the little compensation they would have given me, some things money just cant fix. 
My advice, DONT GO THERE unless you are left with no other choise. I was staying there to avoid traffic-jam, between 16-17 july.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text:
I lived in Chicago during medical
school and come back to visit at least 4 times per year; therefore I consider myself a pseudo- Chicagoan. After years of searching, I will not stay in another hotel. Location, service, cleanliness, ambience are all unparalleled!

This was my third stay at the Conrad. I stay here mainly because it is familiar to me. Location is good, parking is easy (expensive), and the rooftop lounge is nice. No major problems, but nothing unforgettable either.

review_title: Rooms were clean, service was terrible.
review_text:
Started when are room keys had to be reprogramed the first night. It got worse. Breakfast was from 6:30 to 9:30, but if you weren't there by 9:00 you didn't get anything. The staff stop refilling breakfast items about 8:45.
On our second morning we discovered they had shorted us a bath towel. I went to the front to get one, but they were out. Housekeeping was supposed to deliver one in 5 mins. My wife finally had to dry off with a hand towel. The towel didn't show up for 45 mins. 
The next night they shorted us again. 
I would find someplace else to stay if I were you. I know I won't stay here again.

review_title: A 5 star stay in every respect.
review_text:
This was our first trip to chicago so as with any first time visit we did not know what to expect. It's safe to say that aside from a really uncomfortable cab ride in this is now our favourite city in the states. 
A big part of this was our stay at the Conrad. From the moment we arrived to the day we checked out we were greeted everywhere with smiles. As we were celebrating an anniversary I applied for the discounted upgrade on booking, whereby if the room is available on check in you can avail of an upgrade for a better deal than booking outright. 
We managed to get the upgrade to the terrace suite 1609. Words can't describe how perfect this room was. It was a corner suite with a large terrace overlooking the mag mile and John Hancock on one side and the tribune building on the other. The room itself was very spacious with a living area and a separate large bed/en suite. Both rooms equipped with 42 inch tvs. Everything was finished to a very high standard. 
Anytime we needed help with anything the concierge was more than helpful. We went to see a NFL game and our tickets were arranged for us. We even got a 50% discount on a special offer that was on for the game which I know we would not have got on our own. Our dinner reservations were made on request all with no issues. I think the ladies name was annaleese that looked after us so a special thank to her. Apoogies if the spellings off ;). 
If you're a shopper then this hotel is definitely for you. It is actually attached to a shopping centre. When you walk out the door of that centre you are on the mag mile. Everything is within walking distance including navy pier, the oak street and north avenue beaches.
All in all we would highly recommend the Conrad for your stay in Chicago really no fault to be found.

Room - awesome, bed comfortable, great bathroom, we were treated to a afternoon snack very thoughtful!
Staff. Exceptional always friendly and helpful. Door men were the best! They gave us outstanding recommendations from dinner to shopping. 
Location. Perfect
Can't wait to stay here again. Be sure to sign up for kimptons reward program. Lots of perks

I am definitely not the type of person who typically enjoys hotels, however I would advise anyone going to Chicago to stay here! I have huge issues with cleanliness, Our room was spotlessly clean and enormous for the price we paid. Although it was located on a busy street we were high enough that we didn't hear any noise. Both nights of our stay I had a peaceful nights sleep. All the staff were really helpful ensuring that our stay was enjoyable. I highly recommend the Conrad and would stay here again.

We stayed here for one night and everything was just right, including the price. The room was a great size and perfectly clean, with a big tv, a fridge, microwave & coffee facilities. Breakfast was basic perfectly adequate and all the staff were nice and friendly.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn Near Universal Studios Hollywood

review_text: After standing in line watching four front desk clerks texting on their phones and eating at the front desk I finally got to the front of the line to be told their was an issue with several rooms and that we needed to WALK to the marriot down the street. At this point it was close to 2 am... Walk in downtown la with a baby and an elderly grandma in the middle of the night? I asked if the other hotel knew we were coming and if it had been arranged I was assured by Jessica that they were aware. We get to the Marriot (we did not walk) and are informed that they cannot check us into our room because they have not received payment from the Raddison. We were one of several families in the same position waiting. The Marriot staff were wonderful and called the Raddision twice, on the second call they were told they would send someone over with the money within 2 hours! At that point we all gave up and pulled out our credit cards to reserve our rooms. In the morning I called the Raddision to see if our room was ready for our second day and told them we would need an early check in since we had all our luggage. I was told a room would be ready at noon . When we got there to check in it took twenty minutes to get through the line and then a very rude person at the desk told me check in was at three and to come back. I explained the situation and was finally given my room key. The room was ok, for the money I would expect a lot more. There were not enough towels and there was still trash in the trash cans. The sleep number beds did not work and the tv remote did not work. The pool was warm but due to construction you had to walk around dumpsters and allies to get to it. Also a homeless man was drying his clothes on the fence line. I took a picture of this because it was so unbelievable. When I checked out I could not get a print out because their printer was broken and when I complained about what we had experienced I was simply starred at. I plan to call the manager tonight and if I am not satisfied I will contuine calling higher up. It was the worst hotel experience I have ever had.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text:
The hotel does not have major worries in dealing with guests. First mistake at check in: we were in 4 and the reception gave us a room with only one bed (despite I remembered the guy at check in) - we had to change room late of night with a lot of lugagge.
Rooms without minibar (at least mine) and a expensive 22 dolar day cost for parking. I will not be back
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text: Convenient location downtown with excellent staff. It would be nicer if there was free WiFi.
One minor glitch at check in, but great location, quality, and value for an upscale hotel in Chicago. Stayed 2 nights, but would have liked to stay longer. Convenient to everything.

Hotel esteticamente carino fuori e alla hall...camere king semplici ma spaziose c'e'addirittura la cabinetta armadio!!!frigo bar e macchinetta per il caffe americano e dalla mia camera dalla finestra vedevi la famosa scritta HOLLYWOOD!purtroppo non c'e' l'ascensore...ottimo prezzo lo consiglio considerando che sei a hollywood e ovviamente avrai bisogno di una macchina per spostarti visto le immense distanze di LA!!!

Location was decent. No parking on the streets so, u must pay extra for parking. Pool very small and look dirty. When I first arrived ther was dirty sheets and garbage bags all the way down the hall. Which sat there for 3 hours. Everything was painted dark and very little lighting. T.v. Didn't work. Cracked wall, hairs and stains on bed sheets. And on top off it all.... The second day I was there I found mouse poop in the bathroom. Oh and I can't forget the $300.00 extra that was charge on my card. And this was after I paid in full and checked out. I'm glad I check my card statements often. Otherwise they would have left those bogus charges on there. Not even the manager could explain why that happened. Stay far far away !
hotel_name: Comfort Inn Near Universal Studios Hollywood

review_title: Best hotel on Chicago and we have stayed at several!!
review_text: Great location! Close to navy pier and michigan ave. We stayed with our 5 year old. They have a guppy program where they will bring a goldfish to your room! Huge hit! Also brought a kids robe and a kids gift bag! Also the hotel offers a free wine tasting at 5. Chipolte is across the street an mcdonalds is close too. Room was very spacious And the pool was great too!

One of my favorite places to stay in chicago. The hotel staff is genuine, the rooms are spacious and clean, mid-century modern with softer lines. I love their beds and the blackout shades! Great location for business and pleasure.

We staid for two nights at the Radisson after arrival at the airport. We did not like it at all. You have to pay 22$ for parking per night. The whole hotel seems to fall apart and is rather shabby. The good times must have been years ago. Do not go there. At least not for more than one night. It is right at the airport and near the car rental area. The pool seems to be alright, but I can not recommend it for a holiday stay. :-(
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text: My husbands birthday was July 2nd and I booked a dinner cruise on the Hornblower out of Marina Del Rey. I chose the Radisson LAX for the location and value. We contracted one of their referred drivers to take the 4 of us to MDR and pick us up. I was amazed at the great price of the transportation in a nice roomy town car. I was pleasently surprised of the 10 to 15 min drive. The driver dropped us off and picked us up right on time. We sure didn't want to drink and drive, this was super. We had appetizers and a drink in the lounge before we left for our cruise, I can't say enough about the special treat the Chef made for us. The bartender was great and attentive. The hitel was very busy with what looked like a large group, but we always were attended to graciously. The rooms were roomy and clean, beds very comfortable. I loved our view of the airplanes but you can't hear a thing.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text:
This hotel is excellent. It didn't get straight 5's for only one reason--room size. The standard king we booked was sold out so we were upgraded (yeah!) to a king with a little sitting area. I'm not sure what the exact title of that is, but the sitting area is necessary. Without it, the room would've been a little tight. Nevertheless, the bed was comfy, bathroom gorgeous and very clean. 
I highly recommend Sable, the in-house restaurant. Try the war if the roses drink and the veggie burgers. You will not be disappointed. 
Location is perfect! Many restaurants are walking distance as are great shops. Get the citypass if you plan on hitting the most popular tourist spots (field museum, willis tower, aquarium, etc). We didn't get it and we spent a lot more money. All in all, wonderful place to visit and it all starts with a fantastic hotel!

The rate was great: $169 
A modernized interior design
The concierge team sent up a complimentary bottle of chandon sparkling wine along with some strawberries and chocolate.
Great view from the 17th floor balcony.
BEWARE: the hotel is in DIRE need of a hot tub and the pool was so cold my dic froZe off lollzzz :)

review_title: The Hotel to Redeem All Other Hotels
review_text: This is what hotel service means: a personalized email to welcome me a couple of days before I arrive, clean and modern hotel, beautiful amenities in the basic room to still make you feel special, plush, cotton terry animal print robes, spa tub, well designed facilities, and a free Barre class on Tuesday mornings in their gym! I'm a super picky gal - and normally a Starwood hotel goer - but Hotel Palomar will be my hoice in Chicago from now on!

Hotel muito bom, recepcionistas meio chatos, mas o concierge Ã© muuuuuito bom!

review_title: I felt like the best part of my trip started when I checked into my hotel.
review_text: I checked in the week of the National food and beverage convention that took over most hotels. Having said that I never felt more like a friend than another quest in a busy hotel. From the kindness of the frontdesk staff to the expertise of Mark the MVP Concierge; I felt they wanted to help and they new how to do so with ease. Mark's recommendations were spot on and smart. He also coordinated my fedex box and the architecture tour that was awesome! Joe from the hotel restaurant Sable seemed to be there every time I was to welcome me in and share some of his recommendations for drinks of the awesome food. Im not sure Kimpton knows just how much of a Pro his really is. What a great guy.The bar and the dinning room were both beautiful and made me feel cooler than I am. I met Heather the Executive Chef who was spot on when she said the chorizo enchiladas were the best. The pool looked great but we never took a dip in it. We did check out the beautiful view on the 17th floor terrace over white wine that we acquired from the wine reception served by the Hotel's management. Long story short..I was blown away from everyone's kindness, the look of my spacious room and I could not beat the location. I cannot wait to come back.

Can't say much that hasn't been said already. The rooms are very comfortable especially the bathrooms. Having both an indoor and outdoor bar option is also great. Best of all is the location and having the mall literally below the hotel and an elevator ride away is super convenient.

review_title: A boutique hotel with style and comfort, idealy located.
review_text: Brilliant experience(unlike LA version). Staff excellent and attentive. Rooms wonderful with Wifi everywhere! Great pool and gym. Nice breakfast and in the best location. Walk everywhere, subway across the road and the concierge got great Bulls tickets! We are frequent travellers and fussy re accom. (hate big chains, like character).

Staff was great, all were polite and quick with fulfilling requests. Bed was amazing, best so far. We requested a coffee maker, they brought us a Keurig, that made coffee and tea, loved it. The room was smaller than I expected, but with so much to see in Chicago, we spent little time in it. Attached to Nordstrom and lots of stores. If you are Hilton gold or diamond, no executive suite or floor, for that, stay at the Drake, also a great Hilton property.

review_title: Very quiet, comfortable rooms close to the airport.
review_text: I needed a place close to the airport to make my noting flight out of LAX less stressfully avoiding the wonderful LA traffic. Very nice hotel, restaurant, and a little bar just off the lobby. Only parking is valet so add that to the price of the room when deciding where to stay.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_title: Good service, ok room, poor wifi, perfect location
review_text: We stayed two nights and it was ok. Please note that there is limiteded parking! Come early.. Very happy with the service. Rooms were clean, good fridge, poor tv.. Very close to Hollywood blvd.

I needed an inexpensive clean room near LAX. 
Plus: continental breakfast, clean and comfortable room
Neg: right under the flight path of the airport so it was a little noisy. Also: early fliers were walking in front of my door pulling their luggage at 4am and it woke me up..bring earplugs and you'll be ok.

review_title: Good location. Walking distance to Kodak theatre.
review_text: Stayed in july. We booked a room with 2 dbl bed for 4 psn. We arrived late at night n was given a room with 1 dbl bed. After insisting n complaining the night clerk reluctantly chkd again n found us a room with 2 dbl.bed. Room size cleanliness are ok acceptable for the price. Location is very good close toKodak theare bus n metro.

Stayed at the Biltmore btw 27-30 November 2011. It is a beautiful hotel and the lobby and general surrounds will blow you away - especially with the Christmas Decoratons now hanging. All staff we encountered and salt with we're very helpful especially the doormen who were always willing to. Provide that little bit of advice travelers seek. We were a family of six (children ranging from 8-14) and we stayed in a large room with 2 queens and a roll away. We found it to be of sufficient size but then again we did not spend much time in the room. Only drawback for me is the location. While close to transport (bus/Subway) anything we wanted to see - Santa Monica, Venice, Disneyland, Hollywood is a bit of trip but incredibly cheap - $1.50 for everywhere except Disneyland which was $2.50. All in all a gret stay and would recommend to others.

review_title: Manners are sometimes a hotels single most important thing...and a hotel is only as good as the worst employee
review_text:
From the outside and the lobby areas, you cannot deny that is is a lovely looking hotel.
Checking in was slow, however friendly (lowlight, highlight).
I had booked a club room (floors 10 or 11) and it was a high standard, a little dated in places (especially the bathroom) but comfortable and spacious enough for my nights stay. I cannot comment as to the standard of the non club rooms.
Took advantage of the evening reception for club room stayer in the upstairs parlour, which was nice...a good selection of wines, other drinks and snacks. Definately a bonus having paid the extra for a club room.
The gallery bar was nice, and did great cocktails.
The onsite pool was small, but time it right, then you will not have a problem. Time it exact, you will have it to yourself.
The locatiom is typical of downtown LA...a bit of a walk to get to anything, however, it is convenient for public transport.
The two onsite restaurants were considered for evening meal, but the menus were quote uninspiring, and quite empty...didn't feel like sitting in a goldfish bowl so opted for room service.
The free breakfast for club room was good.
Ask at the desk to store luggage for day, and the real low point of a three week holidday was the rudeness of the conceirge who gave the impression of being less than obliging to tag and look after the bags. I think perhaps for this reason I would not recommend...lasting impressions and all. No excuse for rudeness.
Nice looking hotel but I don't think it quite hits the mark of what it wants to be. They do old style charm in a sort of out the box corporate 'bulk buy' feel.
I would recommend however, the incident at concierge is my last impression...and manners maketh man...in this case the lack of them maketh not recpmmeded.
Concierge was great. Service was wonderful and the views were beautiful. Great location

review_title: Grungy, dated, worn, inconvenitent shower, and incongruent redecorating.
review_text: I stayed here one night with a colleague. Both rooms had the same corner-style shower that was terrible, the showerhead is a quasi-rain shower and it is oriented such that the spray escapes when the shower door is open making a mess and a slip hazard. The oncongruous redecorating starts in the bathrooms - nice looking marble tiles, porcelain tubs, stone covered vanity contrasts with the showerhead height s-extender and poorly designed shower. The contrast continues in the room with odd louvered wooden doors to the closet (two doors operate and then a third is affixed to the wall), stained carpet that looks dirty, older style window coverings that were dirty, an eighties-style lamp (somebody confused Miami Vice with real art deco). The wooden furniture's styling is supposed to carry a theme from the lobby fails because it clashes with the carpet style, the usual Marriott bed linens (contemporary, not deco), and generic lamps. The lack of any furniture beside the beds (no nightstand) sharpens the incongruities. Beds seemed old in that the mattresses appeared to be cheaper than those usually in a Marriott and were on older-style metal frames - not comfortable. A few good things: room on the freeway side of the hotel but I did not hear the traffic, the staff was very helpful when it came to directions and finding out whehter our chosed eatery was still open, and the check-in and out were easy (the TV check-out worked), the sleep-timer on the TV worked, and the iron and ironing board appeared to be clean.

Hip digs in a cool new Chicago high rise. Nice size rooms, quiet, well designed, and good location north side of river.
Friendly staff makes it a nice place away from home.

review_text:
El hotel dispone de parking y conexiÃ³n wifi gratis.
Las habitaciones son amplias y estÃ¡n limpias. Con microondas y minibar. El lavabo de la habitaciÃ³n un poco viejo pero limpio.

El personal del hotel muy amable.
Se puede ir perfectamente caminando al paseo de la fama, teatro chino y kodak.

Everyone who worked at The Marriott was just so lovely! I honestly didn't expect the Marriott to be very good when we booked it but I was pleasantly surprised. It far exceeded my expectations. The rooms were lovely, the lobby and pools were gorgeous and we were in a great little location, though for anyone visiting LA for the first time, I would recommend staying away from the Little Tokyo region that was also in downtown though a 20 min walk away from our hotel- it was very seedy. However I would definitely stay here again as it was such excellent value for mobey :) a special thankyou to Victor on the reception desk for being so helpful.

Stayed at the hotel for 5 nights. Cheaply remodel. Run down dirty carpet. TV went in and out A LOT. When upstairs would take a shower, the pipes would be very loud. AC made noises that are hard to sleep through.

It is clean and very spacious hotel in downtown LA. It is not as chic as some of the newer properties but the room I got was massive, like it has a tub and a separate stand up shower and the bathroom is 80s
California style in it's size and layout. The room has greenish carpet which was in very good condition and the windows were floor to ceiling. I would not stay here if you are looking for a chic place to stay but if you are looking to be in downtown LA (which is not chic to begin with) then this is a good bet for it's convenience.

review_title: You get what you pay for.
review_text: I have been staying at the Sportsmen's Lodge for years because of its convenience to family I visit. It has a funky charm but needs serious updating if it ever wants to be more than a decent budget family hotel. Carpets throughout are worn and ugly, furnishings basic, and amenities minimal. That being said, rooms are large and the staff is friendly. And, the price is fair for what it is (although I think charging for parking at a place like this is wrong).
The house keeper's supervisor Maria was very tending, very helpful and caring to both me and my wife.

Room ok - clean with fridge and microwave. Good shower. Pool looked nice - but didn't use it. Laundry machines available but you cannot buy washing powder from the hotel - u must walk to local shop and buy a large packet. Breakfast wasn't great - served in reception and quite limited in choice. There is free parking available and carpark was almost empty when we first arrived but had alot of trouble finding a space when we returned at 10pm one evening.
Lady on desk was nice enough to give us an extra half hr after check out time as we were waiting for Laundry to dry tho. Good location near Hollywood blvd.

Arrived in LA for a few nights, excellent location just two stops on underground to central Hollywood. Wifi free and didn't work at corner of room, but fine everywhere else. Room very dated, a little dark, clean, soft bed, fridge, microwave, no safe, toiletries. Breakfast lovely fresh doughnuts and croissants. Overall a good place to stay, nothing flash.

review_title: Clean, convenient, comfortable and courteous-- great value!
review_text:
We chose the Sportsmen's Lodge as the most convenient place to stay for our friends' wedding this month; the ceremony and reception were both at the Event Center next door. The grounds were lovely for the wedding, and we found the location to be excellently sited for all we were doing for the weekend. 
The rooms are frankly just a touch 
worn in a spot or two, but they 
were spotlessly clean each of the four days we stayed, and we always felt safe -- both VERY important to us, much more so than up-to-the-second decor, and we consider that to be the biggest contributions to the great value! And the mattress and bedding were soooooo 
comfortable.... Wonderful!
Even after we had left, when I realized I had left one item behind
and called from the road to have it
sent, Jose at the front desk was great and had it shipped to me immediately. Clean, convenient, comfortable and courteous: I'd definitely stay here again with no question!
Prime location, clean rooms, very nice layout and green-spaces and good value for room. Recommended!
This place is real nice and comfy.they also give u warm freshbaked cookies . Lots of space and its hidden in the back of pedro
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Pedro

review_text: Ottima la posizione nel cuore di Hollywood personale molto gentile e disponibile camere nello standard di un motel6 cosi' come il prezzo vista la zona wifi gratis parcheggio a pagamento sotto l'hotel con non tanti posti,conviene prenotare, altrimenti ad un isolato altro parcheggio sempre a pagamento. Forse un po' rumoroso nei fine settimana

review_title: Good Hotel, i enjoyed my stay
review_text: Great location, great hotel... Friendly and hospitable front desk staff... Nice clean and big rooms... Beds were comfortable... The location was perfect for hollywood street and universal studios... I had a gr8 time and i will b coming bk soon...

Booked 4 nights and at 2nd night stroke a tree the cable and the whole Hotel got no electricity. No Information from the stuff, just the answer: you can check out. No cashback, no compensation.
So, they mentioned that I have to search a New Hotel and pay maybe the difference. So, we stayed 54hrs without light, TV, Internet and heating in the room and the Owner cashed the full prize. NEVER AGAIN!!

review_title: Lobby is nice. Rooms are outdated.
review_text: Lobby is nice, rooms not so much. It's a business traveler hotel for sure. Gym equipment is ok. Good thing it's close to food, cause what's served here is bad.

Please do not stay here. 
I am not one to write reviews, however I feel I should write on this hotel. 
My partner and I stayed here one out of 5 nights at the beginning of this month. We arrived late at night tired and jet lagged. 
On arrival, One block from the hotel was a group of drunk men standing on the corner being abusive. Further up were mass of police and a group of men pinned against a wall. 
On arrival to the hotel we were given our keys and went to our room. The hotel was awful. Damp sheets and bed, fixtures hanging off, non working shower, lights not working bad smells. We did not feel comfortable and slept terrible against the noise and what appeared to be gun shots. 
I know that it sounds far fetched, but it truly was awful! 
We love our basic low cost hotels and usually stay in them for the experience... Afterall it is just somewhere to sleep and we booked here based on the reviews!

review_title: The worst customer service experience in 15 years of traveling to Hollywood !!!
review_text:
The very fact that this hotel had rooms available when 15 other hotels in the vicinity were sold out should have been an indication as to the experience we were about to have!
We usually stay at Roosevelt but due to last min plans we had to make do with staying here for 3 nights as we had no other choice ... The management charged our friend screit card used for reservation as well as ours upon check in,despite dozen calls to management and best western corporate office it took more than a month to get the fraudulent charge reversed!No apology or explanation for the extra charge ,BEWARE of using credit cards here as they will charge it for nonsensical reasons and NOT REFUND.
As to the hotel,rooms were small and not worth the price at all....ridiculously tiny parking lot where we witnessed 2 accidents in 3 days.Nobody ever answers front desk calls and every staff member was always on personal cell phone calls eveyr time we passed by,zero customer service of any kind!Negligent management at the hotel was embarrassing for any franchise hotel .Internet and cell phone reception was non existent so you have to walk to next door hotel for making cell phone call or for Internet .
In summary we will NEVER try a best western chain again due to a very bad experience here...stay far away from this place.

review_title: Good hotel in an out of the way area.
review_text: Spend 6 nights for business in August. Room had comfortable bedding. Outside noise can be heard when there is an outdoor party or large group (room was on second of three floors over the restaurant). Bathroom needs remodeling: poor condition of tile and shower. Mirror had large scratch marks that was annoying by end of stay. Hotel restaurant had good service and tasty meals but is pricey. Not much around the hotel, highly recommend having a car. Outdoor pool is decent size, I'm sure my kids would have liked it if they were here. Conference room and service for group of 30 was excellent. As others have written, their cookies are the best.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Pedro

review_title: Very clean , nice place to stay.
review_text:
The place was well kept and clean 
House keeping was very professional as well as the staff.
"I'll be back."

review_title: More like a motel but fine as a place to sleep
review_text:
We booked this hotel as it was cheap and central. I was hoping to be able to walk to tourist areas of Hollywood Boulevard and Sunset Boulevard but, being naive, I didn't quite grasp the scale of things in the USA! It was actually over 3 miles to the main attractions like the walk of fame etc so a bit far to walk for us, but fine to drive. The area was a bit scary especially at night (run down and some scary looking locals!) so we didn't leave the hotel in the evening as there were no bars or restaurants other than fast food within walking distance (we wanted to drink and budget too small to pay for cabs). 
The hotel has the appearance of a motel, in that each room has it's own front door. Rooms are well equipped including a fridge and microwave! Decor a bit old fashioned but clean. Maid service daily, bathroom fine. The breakfast was included as was cereal, muffins and toast. Concierge man was nice - opened my bottle of wine as I didn't have an opener. There is a small pool but I didn't use it when we were there.
Wouldn't stay again but only because of the area and didn't really like LA but I would recommend it to someone who just wanted somewhere cheap and central to LA.

review_title: Dreadful but decent service on the main desk
review_text: We booked to stop for3nights as we decided to stop off there after spending a week Palm Springs.I was hopeful that it would be a decent hotel having stopped in Best Westerns all over the world.However the rooms were stuck in a 1960's time warp,and were cramped,dated and a little bit grubby.I also thought the open motel style of the hotel wasn't really ideal in such a dodgy area!We decided after one night to cancel as basically the place was a dump,however the guy called Pedro on the desk was really helpful,booked us into our next hotel and seemed genuinely awaken aback at our complaints.A nice guy,shame about the horrible hotel though!!

Another example of the problems with this hotel. Tonight they opened the outside bar, but the beer that I bought came in a 12 ounce cup and they charged the same as the pint(16 oz.) that I was getting at the bar inside. No problem accept the inside bar was closed.

review_title: Great location, great value, friendly honest staff.
review_text: The travelodge is perfectly located at the edge of the Los Feliz village. Out of the tourist zone, close to great restaurants and Griffith Park. The room was quiet, clean and plenty of free parking. For around $70/ night it suited my needs perfectly. All the staff were courteous and helpful and each room had good security with an in room safe for valuables. It isn't super modern or luxurious but very functional with free local calls, voicemail and wireless Internet. I will definitely be back!
Only thing i did not like was the 30.00 vallet parking.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_text: I recently stayed at the holiday inn at lax airport. We had not booked a room, just for the reason because that we only wanted a half day rate. We checked in went up to the room. I personally love the holiday inn's just because the rooms are larger than most. We had lunch the service was slow but we were not in a rush I also feel sorry for the gentleman that was working all on his lonesome. We then had a sleep. Had a shower. Used the free wifi to Skype Australia and then caught the free shuttle bus back to the airport to board our next flight. Now it is close to the airport so you may hear them fly by (well der) but to be honest the window glass is thick as and I could hear a thing. I can't fault this hotel. Pictures below
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Los Angeles International Airport

review_title: Good for overnight for an early flight!
review_text: We booked this hotel as we had an early flight to catch & we are priority club members. As a platinum member we are meant to be upgraded. upon check in we were greeted with an unfriendly male who would not even make eye contact with us & said the hotel did not upgrade & then when we asked for details about transfers to the airport we got one worded answers. When we checked out another male staff member on front desk only mumbled when we asked about a receipt & he said no to us!!! Funny we are now at the Holiday Inn in Washington & got an upgrade no questions asked & a heck of a lot more courteous & helpful!!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Los Angeles International Airport

review_text: No hair dryer in room. Room service is poor. Housekeeping freaks me out as I am staying alone! They kept opening my door 3x over 1 night stay as early as 8am! Luckily I had the door latch on! The complimentary shuttle service from airport is excellent though!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Los Angeles International Airport

review_text: I stayed there twice this summer and both times the room had the scent of too much carpet deodorizor. I bidded for the room and 'won' a $55 daily rate but didn't know that there was a $15 daily parking fee! What I didn't like, not only here but at most hotels, is having to walk through a haze of smokers smoke to enter/exit the hotel.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Los Angeles International Airport

review_title: Nice hotel in a quaint location
review_text: Hotel was very neat and lives up to the usual Holiday inn standard. Room was very clean with an LCD tv. The only gripe i have is that i wad unable to use my IPhone charger in the socket that is on the bedside lamp. No extra benefits as a PC platinum which is fine because i was on an award stay. Would defintely stay again.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Los Angeles International Airport

review_title: Not a bad stay for one night, but...
review_text: We stayed in this hotel for only one night, and it is close to the airport and convenient for this purpose. The room was pretty big and upgraded ( granite in the bathroom and flat screen TV but no refrigerator which we would appreciate). What I did not like: we asked for two beds instead of one king size because we had a daughter with us, but it was $20 more expensive (usually it's the same price). Also, we had to pay $15 for a parking space, which is usually complimentary.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Los Angeles International Airport

review_title: Poor service, small rooms, terrible parking
review_text: Stayed at this hotel after a wedding. Beautiful spot for a small wedding, decent food. Found the room with two double beds quite small/crowded. The bathroom was even smaller. The phones and alarm clock are from the 80s. But the Japanese-ish decor is charming. Panting is tiny, underground garage where the valets have to park on the downhill lane. Then, though we stamped our parking for validation at the wedding the front desk staff tell us that it does include those who stayed overnight with them and that they will charge us $24! The mother of the bride was behind us and was outraged. The staff was rude and unreasonable. Eventually, the woman helping us begrudgingly "gave us" half price. Is that how they treat wedding parties who pay thousands of dollars? Next time we will stay elsewhere and they can keep their lousy room and parking
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_text: This Vagabond Inn has one overwhelming asset--it is next to USC and one of only two hotels in the area. This made it our choice for Parents Weekend.What we did not know--and the manager claimed ignorance as well--was that a "rave" was planned at a venue a block away, on two nights of our stay. Outdoors. Incredibly loud, shaking the building. Until 2 a.m. The solution offered by the management was that we could move to another hotel and they would refund those two nights' stay. Oh, right--pack up all our stuff and find another hotel at the last minute, on a busy weekend in LA and miles away from the university and the festivities we were there to attend. We stayed, put on earphones and gritted our teeth. Oh, gosh, almost forgot, they dropped off several sets of earplugs while we were out. On top of that they charged a premium for it being Parents Weekend and supplied as few towels as possible. And there were bugs in the bathrooom. If you can get a really low price or must be near USC, go for it; I will be searching for alternatives next time.

review_title: Over priced for a room that had 3 pieces of tape to hold the batteries in the remote control
review_text: Ac unit did not have heat? I was freezing in the middle of the night and it got colder when I turned up the heat! I will not be going back I did not have a good experience because I was not a business person , I spent alot of money and my room was horrible! I will be writing a letter to your corprate office! Thanks for the terrible time!
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_text: Had 4 nights in this hotel via contiki tour. Rooms were a good size with two double beds which were very comfortable, also plush pillows! Shower pressure was great, there was no air vents in the bathroom though. Free wifi at Starbucks down stairs. No pool or spa which was unfortunate with the hot weather!
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_title: Not too bad but rather old looking for its price.
review_text: Been here on a business trip. Good bed, many amenities, friendly service but the room and especially its furniture has seen better days. Try to get a good price and you have a good downtown place to stay. The inevitable nightly noise can't be avoided downtown, but I got to sleep quickly.

Hotel was very friendly and busy. Had a nice room with two queen beds and great pillows.
Pool looked very inviting and peaceful. Staff was friendly and helpful, maybe just a tad unorganized, but nothing tragic.
Restaurant was packed on Friday night but they were nice and brought our dinner into the hotel lobby for us.
Location was much better than we thought. Great eating places very close by and short walk to shopping.

some of our items have been stolen out of the luggage in the room. management pays no attention to this. ATTENTION!!!
at the end the room was TOO EXPENSiVE!
housekeeping did not replace towels on the floor or empty the trash...i knoe why. they have obviously been too busy seaching in our suitcases
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Los Angeles International Airport

review_text: Room was ok, typical sheraton. Walls are very thin, heard the neighbors til all hours. Nothing special. Over-priced.

review_title: Nice hotel, does the job and a great night's sleep.
review_text:
Stayed here for 2 nights en route to LV. Can't fault the front desk lady who went out of he'd way to organise us a tour of the main sights within an hour of our arrival as we running to a tight schedule. The rooms were clean and comfortable but the bathroom possibly slightly dated. Didn't bother me as I wasn't on holiday in the 
bathroom! The one and only fault was the location...not the safest if places to walk around after dark and far out of the main tourist hubs.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_title: About as average as you get
review_text: Have stayed here at least a dozen times in the last year. Rooms are fine, location is fine. Just watch crossing the streets to not get a jaywalking ticket to help LA county. The free access to ballys is nice, but it is a total ghetto gym.

review_title: The hotel was clean and inviting, and the staff were friendly and knowledgeable of the area.
review_text: If you're looking for a place to stay in L.A. this is it.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_title: Hotel is convenient if you have an event right there. If nit, plenty of other places to stay. This place is very noisy. Walls a
review_text: Charged me $11.00 to park! Why do they do that? It should have been included with room rate.

review_title: Old school hotel with a modern vibe.
review_text: We stayed here for a convention at their event center. The room was nice and I was digging the balcony outside our room. The price was reasonable. The walls were paper thin but did not affect our sleep. The only negative was the event center had weddings going on and we could not bypass them to get to our event.

My review is a little late but myself and a friend won a competition to attend the Oscars in LA , we are from north east England. As part of the prize package we stayed here for 4 nights and found it wonderful. It is a large hotel, and very impressive in splendour albeit a little dated. Room was a good size two double beds and flat screen, mini bar, fridge. We had a ball as you might expect. We were pretty high up so the view was immense, and we enjoyed walking around the neighbourhood, taxi was 15mins to Hollywood and we even got the bus to Santa Monica one day!
Food at the hotel was lovely and so much selection, all the staff were very polite and chatty to us and made us feel quite at home.
Trip off a lifeline! X
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_title: Beautiful lobby and gardens, comfortable bed, outdated bathrooms
review_text:
Great location, rooms were small, comfortable bed, but bathroom and technology need an upgrade.
Charged for wireless for each device
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_title: Not as good as other holiday inns
review_text: The facility is pretty old. There is a strange smell in the hall way. The tap is leaking in the tub unless you shut It down really hard. Everything has hidden fees. Upgrading from a king bed to two doubles is 20 dollars. Parking is 15 per night. The gate of the parking lot does not work well every time. Internet comes free through.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Los Angeles International Airport

review_title: Nice hotel but on a very busy intersection.
review_text: A nice hotel but if you use the pool you will need to be aware it is next to a busy intersection so its rather noisy. The rest of the hotel is double glazed well so it does not affect your sleep. Location is ok for Hollywood and Universal studios about 5 miles. It is in the financial district so aimed at business people.

Booked this place through hotwire and specifically asked for at least 3 1/2 star or better hotels. Kyoto is rated 3 1/2 and claims the rooms are recently renovated. Apparently only rooms on 14 and above have been renovated and all floors below are crap! It's like staying at Motel 6. We were given a room on the 10th floor and it's old and dated. The bathroom is tiny and the bed is uncomfortable. This hotel sucks! Be warned-if u book the hotel through a third party, you will have a room on the crappy floors! Do not stay at the Kyoto unless you know you'll be staying on the higher level floors. WTF?
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_text: This hotel had amazing people working always very kind and helpful rooms were very nice and fir a good price. I will be staying here again thank you for an amazing experience.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_title: Nice Gardens. For the Price and location, a VERY GOOD OPTION. I would recommend it.
review_text: Good location. Service in Azalea, the Restaurant and in Rendezvous, the Lobby Bar MUST improve and BE FASTER. I think they should hire more waiters!!!
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_title: Great place. Was not expecting this room to be as clean as it was.
review_text: The check inn process was slow,it took the front desk about 15min to check me in. I was nervous about the location. Once we were checked inn,we did not hear a thing. My daughters and I had a wonderful sleep and rest. The room being as clean as it was made it more pleasant.

Great location nice staff no complaints will stay there again. I have not seen any bed bugs as people been complaining about. And its small insect not harmful at all. Overall out of 5 I give it a 4.5.

I have been in this hotel several times when it was under the Days Inn banner, now the name is different but it remains the same, in fact it has improved several things are changing including new flat TV screen just started to be installed, service is friendly, rooms are good size and clean, I know it is not a 5 start hotel but it is good for business stays and families

although not in a particularly fancy area of town, this hotel greatly exceeded my expectations! the rooms were large, clean, and fully equipped. i don't know where else i could have stayed in north hollywood for such great value. i never felt unsafe, staff was courteous and accomodating, breakfast was more than adequate, and amenities were plentious. bathrooms had an enormous amount of counter space, and the shower worked perfectly. plenty of restuarants and shopping are less than 15 minutes away, as are universal studios and hollywood boulevard. i have zero complaints about this hotel as i was expecting something not quite up to par, but best western burbank airport inn thoroughly impressed me. i would highly recommend staying here!

review_title: Good service, clean room, ironing board disaster
review_text: The service was wonderful. My room was decent overall. It was clean, but the ironing board had a funky burnt in stain that I didn't notice in my groggy morning ironing frenzy until I had successfully transferred the stain to a new pair of expensive dress slacks.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown
