The hotel is beautiful, clean and spacious. It is perfectly located for those looking to experience downtown Chicago. The staff was genuinely friendly and prompt with any and all requests. I would recommend staying here to anyone.

Received a very good welcome on arrival by friendly staff. Room was comfortable, clean and felt secure. Free parking and wifi was a bonus as was tea and coffee making facilities in the room along with a fridge. Highpoint of facility is the excellent shower which is by far the best we've had on this trip. Breakfast was simple but plentiful. The motel is perfectly placed for visiting Hollywood Blvd and the staff extremely efficient in booking tours etc. Well done to the Holiday Inn
hotel_name: Comfort Inn Near Hollywood Walk of Fame

review_text:
I came for a conference and stayed for two nights. I loved the beautiful architectural detail in the lobby and the meeting rooms. My room was on the 11th floor. It was spacious, clean, and had comfortable beds. 
The downside of a historic hotel is the difficulty to control the temperatures in the meeting rooms as well as the sleeping rooms. I like that the windows in the room open, but the drawback is the noise outside.
Service was good-from check-in to concierge to housekeeping to wait staff. Everyone was personable and professional.

Stayed in a deluxe room. Recently updated, only one door for double closet, no free Internet nor any frills or extras for the price but it was pleasant. Avalon restaurant had only one server for whole dining room but she was very efficient. Wouldn't be my first choice but when options are limited it is do-able.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_title: As far as value hotels go, this one needs work.
review_text: My friend was visiting CA for the first time so we decided to go to Hollywood and do Let's Make A Deal. We chose Comfort Inn because of it's location and price. The cost of the room was definitely more than you should ever pay for a value hotel, but given that it's on the sunset strip you won't find many hotels around much cheaper. Check in was fine, and we felt pretty safe upon arrival. The room itself needed a lot of work. Soda was splattered on the inside of the front door, the carpet was VERY dirty, there was a strange burning smell from the housekeeping closet next door, and the VCR remote was broken. It looks like it was cheaply remodeled, judging by the holes in the walls and chipped furniture. If you need a relatively inexpensive place to stay for a night and you don't mind a little dirt, then you should be okay here. If not, I would look elsewhere.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn Near Hollywood Walk of Fame

review_title: Stay elsewhere, positive reviews are from luck of the draw. Definite no-go if you have allergies.
review_text:
Just checked in. Our first room smelled stale and of smoke. Assigned new room, it smelled of mildew, the "headboards" were the windows (no, I'm not joking - they did have wood shutters though) and the bathroom was dirty (toothpaste and hair on sink). Went down to desk, complained and insisted on a proper room. Third room least mildew smell. Tried to relocate to Hilton group, but they were booked, so stuck here. Each room had one light fixture not working and this one the phone was unplugged, a safety issue I should think.
We were booked here by the client, so we did not choose. I did look over the other comments and I think that there are different rooms that have been renovated resulting in higher reviews. But I've been in 3 tonight, all sub-par. This is essentially a random experience. $40 parking and $10 wifi another reason to stay elsewhere.
Also, the first room was one of their better ones "designed for the business traveler" with "bright lighting" that is absurd, the first thing we commented on was how dark it was and how to get work done.
For frame of reference, we are not ritz-carlton folks, we are totally satisfied at a Hampton Inn.
Rooms are clean and newly renovated. Hallways are a bit shabby. Sound insulation could be better but location is great for people watching

A brilliant & clean hotel to stay in. Stayed for 4nights in April/may 2011.. Pershing square (metro) was just across the road which has a line taking u straight to universal studios, walk of fame, hollywood and other tourist places. 
The hotel lobby is absolutely breath taking - however food+room service charges are sky high!
The rooms are fine, clean and hav wht u want except a mirror!! U have to use the bathroom mirror all the time. 
As it's in downtown l.a is vry rough outside of the hotel.. The homeless in the parks, parks smelling of urine 
and u don't feel safe walking the local area at night!
The hotel has parking but is was $40 a night!! So u rather pRk else whr for much less - $5-$10 and ur car is safe there! I really do think hotel parking should be provided as part of the package as the rooms are expensive! We paid $170 per night!!

review_title: For the price and downtown location it was great
review_text: For those of you complaining about parking fees just accept the fact that downtown Cities with limited parking i.e. LA, SF etc...,sot hotels charge for parking. The room we got was a deluxe and had the flat screen tv so can't speak about the old rooms the others stayed in, the room looked newly remodeled and a bit small but beds were new and the room including the bathroom were clean. The best part was the location, in Little Tokyo. We felt very safe walking around little Tokyo as there were many people walking around. There is a new condo complex and a police station half a block away and great ramen, curry, and Japanese restaurants. There's even a Pinkberrys that delivers. We booked it through Hotwire so didn't actually choose the hotel but plan to go back to the same hotel for our next seminar in March. The hotel staff were all very friendly and helpful.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Los Angeles Downtown

review_text: I booked three nights here, during a trade show, because it was $100 per night less expensive than the Hyatt who was hosting the show. I was pleasantly surprised to find out how much value I got at the Conrad. Great location to some awesome restaurants, sweet room and some of the friendliest staff that I have met in all of my travels. Great job Conrad!

review_title: Decent option for any traveler with business or an event in downtown LA
review_text: Beautiful building and interesting architecture. There is a pleasant grandeur to the foyer, lobby, bar and restaurant. Walking distance to the event we had at the Oviatt Penthouse, as well as a popular pub. Rooms are in need of an upgrade. Don't expect elegant, anticipate adequate.

Broken tiles in the bathroom and tub, horribly dark room with a stench. The hotel is old and run down, looks like they haven't renovated since 1950. The walls are so thin, there were people running and screaming down the hallway all night. Do not stay at place, not worth the money!

Very uncomfortable room, bad service, dirty, unsafe,
Ripoff parking fee when you can park in the public lot next to the beach a lot cheaper.
Overpriced.
The room is very plain with a horrible excuse of a bed. 
even the homeless all around the place wouldn't stay in one of these rooms.

review_title: Probably the best in the area
review_text:
It is hard to find a good place to stay in this area. Selection is limited, especially if money is an issue. This is probably your best bet.
Rooms are immaculately clean and equipped with a refrigerator and microwave. Nice swimming pool, but it was too cold to swim during most of our stay. 
Parking is not free and is not easy. Hotel has a limited number of spaces, not enough to accommodate all guests. So we did not feel easy being away too late in the evening, and we were always anxious about getting one. A smaller car is strongly recommended if you have a choice. If you are unable to get a space, you will have to settle for metered parking on the street.
Internet access is not free either. It is $5.95 per device for a 24-hour period. Signing on is not easy either.

review_title: It's a nice hotel. It's Venice Beach!
review_text:
It is right on the beach! They have free Starbucks coffee. The rooms are really nice with ceiling fans and the bathrooms are clean and new.
It was a very pleasant stay.

Our first family holiday in the US and for our stay in LA, we chose this hotel. For the price we paid, we felt it did not have the 'value' the lobby was grand and felt magical...until you got to the rooms. Old, paint peeling off the window frames. Parking was expensive, internet was charged (per device) etc etc.
On the day of our check out, we tipped for the valet (as we do every day) but as for service to help us with the luggage, well there was none. Even at the check-out, no mention nor question on whether we needed assistance or asking regarding our onward journey, just a polite(perfunctory) "thank you".
In all, I felt that the service was not from the heart but for the wallet.
We found LA a wonderfully warm and friendly city and will be back but I guess we'll have to try a new hotel.

review_title: Unsuspecting gem in the middle of Venice Beach
review_text: This refurbished small hotel is simple and clean with standard sized double beds and a feel of a boutique hotel. It is right in the middle of Venice Beach making it a very convenient location for those who have choosen to come to seek the sun on this infamous stretch of LA beach. This area is lively and the eateries are right in front of the hotel. It is not a place for families with young children as the area outside the hotel is the a place of rest for many of the denizens of Venice Beach at night. The hotel parking is limited.

I stayed at the biltmore july 2010. From the get go it was a nightmare. My best friend arrived in la before I did and the hotel would not let her check in w out pying for a $100 "incidental fee" even tho she told the hotel I was in transit to the hotel. She waited 4 hours before she was able to check in!!! When I arrived I was told they were out of double beds. So 2 girls had to share a king bed! The next day we asked to move and they claimed they still were out. However, we met 2 guys who had checked in 2 days AFTER us who got a double bed room!! I was very upset. Also parking $30 per day?!!! The hotel is also in a bad location, around the corner from skid row. Not close to anything exciting. The room is a good size, bathroom a lil old. Hotel needs updating. Would not stay again

Perfect location in the city for a nice weekend getaway. Lovely room with great amenities. Enjoyed picking a pillow from the menu of fragrance-infused pillows. 
Will stay again if we get the chance!
Perto do metro, e perto dos principais pontos turisticos de LA. Piscina e bom cafÃ© da manhÃ£. Vale mto a pena!

review_title: Hotel nella media ma molto piÃ¹ pulito dei soliti motel americani!
review_text: Hotel nella media ma fortunatamente molto piÃ¹ pulito dei soliti motel americani. E' ubicato in posizione non centrale ma vicino ai mezzi di trasporto. La piscina Ã¨ piccolina ma va bene per un tuffo a fine giornata... Parcheggio spazioso... Direi un ottimo rapporto qualitÃ /prezzo. In camera ci sono tv, frigo, microonde, ferro da stiro con asse, phone e cassetta di sicurezza.
Its fine, bt for the business reveled? You can do better. I chose the hotel because I got a conference rate but wish I had gone elsewhere. The wifi is so slow its unusable!

Das Hollywood Inn ist einfach und sehr empfehlenswert. Sehr sauber. Sogar ein kleiner Pool im Innenhof ist vorhanden. Das Hotel liegt zwischen sunset - und hollywood boulevard, ist jedoch ziemlich ruhig und auch nicht so ringhÃ¶rig wie andere motels in USA. Bis zum walk of fame ca. 40 min Gehdistanz, Universal-Studios in 15 min Fahrdistanz. Sehr freundliches Personal und gutes Preis-LeistungsverhÃ¤ltnis.

review_title: An upscale weekend in the heart of the city.
review_text:
Staff was friendly and eager to help. Public areas and room were very clean. 
My teenage son especially enjoyed the large flatscreen television.
Would stay there again.
Only minor complaint was several light bulbs were burned out in the room. Wasn't a super big deal though since we were out of the room most of our stay.

review_title: This hotel is wonderful. The service and staff is excellent.
review_text: I would highly recommend this hotel. Exceptional staff, service and the restaurant is unbelievable.

Questo Ã¨ un normale motel, tenuto bene, molto pulito. Piscina piccolina ma ottima per un tuffo veloce.
Ãˆ a due passi dalla stazione della metro, che porta direttamente verso i punti piÃ¹ quotati di Hollywood (Chinese theatre, walk of fame, ...)
Sono disponibili navette gratuite per gli Universal Studios (assolutamente da non saltare), ma se avete la macchina potete tranquillamente utilizzarla: sono vicini e il parcheggio costa circa 15$.
la dalla per le colazioni Ã¨ veramente piccola, solo quattro tavolini, quindi in tanti prendono le cose per la colazione e poi fanno colazione in camera.

review_title: Very nice lobby , but the rooms needs renovation
review_text: Well the location of the hotel is good . Right in the city center . The lobby is fantastic . You get the feeling of very stylish hotel . Nice cages and a good bar full of people every night . The only dissapoinment were the rooms , which are old decorated and the furniture is old . The baths are bad as well . The rooms needs urgent renovation . We also upgraded the room , but the new one was the same only a little bigger .

Super emplacement, dÃ©co sympa, prix parfait ! HÃ´tel trÃ¨s charmant et situÃ© dans une jolie rue et un quartier top. VisitÃ© deja 3 fois en 5 ans. Le service et l'entretien y est constant. Demandez une chambre "nord" en dessus de la rÃ©ception pour voir le Hollywood Sing en vous douchant ;)))) Parking dessous, petit dÃ©jeuner Ã  cÃ´tÃ© ! Si vous cherchez une valeur sÃ»re sans taper dans les chaÃ®nes connues ; c'est parfait !
Beliggenhet ok hvis man vil bo i HollywoodomrÃ¥det. Men rommet vi fikk var skittent. Mye stÃ¸y siden det ligger ved motorveien.

hotel_name: Comfort Inn Near Hollywood Walk of Fame

review_text:
Situe a 100m du metro (a 2 arrets du Koddack Theater), cet hotel est tres moyen. Acceuil glacial, chambre a reserver d'office, je suis arrive a 17h et les femmes de menages terminaient a peine le menage alors que le check-in est possible des 14h!!! La salle de bain est on ne peut plus basique avec des trous au plafond. Le petit dejeuner est a prendre le long de la piscine s'il reste une place et ce qu'ils appellent "continental breakfast" est en fait un donut, du cafe et un jus d'orange... en resume : nul! Quartier sale mais apparemment sans probleme de securite meme le soir.
Je le conseille pour son rapport prix/situation sur Hollywood Blvd, mais si vous voulez un bel hotel, choisissez-en un autre!

Hotel idÃ©al pour une visite en famille Ã  Chicago- trÃ¨s bien placÃ© (proches des bateaux qui font les tours et de tous les magasins) excellent accueil (petits cadeaux pour les enfants notamment), chambres trÃ¨s corrects (pourraient Ãªtre un tout petit plus grandes...), et wifi gratuit si on s'abonne (gratuit) Ã  leur programme de fidÃ©litÃ©.

I got a really good deal at $75 a night through Expedia for two persons in a generously sized room with two queen beds, a writing desk, mini fridge, coffee maker, TV (that was too complicated for a TV) and an iron. The bathroom is a good size, but the sink area located right above the toilet bowl with a very tiny space to place toiletries on makes a fumble risky & plain annoying.
Didn't deal with the staff much, as we were out all day, but from the limited interactions I found them pleasant.
Located in downtown Hollywood, a block away from the metro, it wasn't hard getting places (though the public transport in LA is very limited) and it was about a 20min train ride from Hollywood & Universal Studios.
Overall, it is a pleasant hotel to stay at, but not at full price. I can't comment on the breakfast, because although it was included, we never made it to breakfast.

1) When we reached the hotel, no one was there to help us with out largages. We have 5 huge largages and several small ones. We have to load our stuffs to the trolley ourselves and push it to our room!
2) the room was infested with small roaches! I have killed at least 5 baby ones and 1 teenage one!
3) we had a power trip in our room. I have to call the operator 3 times and waited for 1hr before someone came and attend to me.
Bottomline, Don't ever stay here!

The Carlyle is a great hotel - lovely rooms (we had a free upgrade) with excellent amenities (nice products, flat screen tv, coffee maker, safe, fridge) which are large and very clean. 
The free breakfast is great too (although there was bacon only on one of the four mornings) and served in the bright conservatory room. 
You do need a car to see anything in LA though, but the parking is only $14 a day.
 The Thai restaurant opposite (Shri Laa or something similar) is totally recommended.
Great hotel. Clean, free wifi, free breakfast, nice outdoor seating area.

Never again will I stay at this motel. I needed to be in LA to take care of some emergency business and last minute decided to stay at this motel (Wilshire Motel). There was a big nasty stain on the bed sheets! Trash frm the precious guest on the floor. The door locks didn't work well, the room smelled horriable. All I was trying to do was save a few bucks and it turned out horriable! The motel costed me $80 bucks I shld have just paid $20 bucks more and stayed at a moderate hotel.

The hotel was decent and we had a good stay overall. Our room was clean and so was the bathroom. We had one queen bed, there was a separate room attached like a dressing room with luggage keepers and a fridge and a microwave. There was also an ironing board and a good iron. The only problem we faced in the room was that it was too cold at night. The temperature controls were not working properly. So that was uncomfortable. Also the wifi was very slow. We called the guy nd he rebooted the gateway but said that if kids played games or people were watching movies it will happen. We did not have kids and we never watched movies but if others in the hotel did, we dont know. 
There was complimentary Hot breakfast included. It was ok too. The only things hot were tea, coffee, decaf, waffles, egg which was made into patties with some kind of a substitute. There was fruit, milk, cereal, toast, jam, cream cheese, juice, cold water and some pita bread with salsa. One day the service was good and next day the new people were rude. Nice breakfast room decor like wineries. 
The location was good, 5 mins to Sunset Blvd which you will definitely see if you are visiting LA, nd other places were near too. The parking is not free, it was $18 every night. The decor of the hotel was very hollywoodish! Nice overall. Their bathroom toileteries are good comparitively so dont worry about that. They give lotion, shampoo, conditioner, mouthwash, bathing mit, soap. All not bad quality. So good. It does get noisy and is not sound protected.
The hotel was a 10 min walk to Universal Studios, there's a Starbucks, gas station and restaurants across the street, and the staff were so nice! Very convenient and great value.

review_title: Not bad for first time stay in Los Angeles
review_text: Stayed here for four nights on my first trip to Los Angeles. Overall, hotel is not bad, although it needs updating and new decor. Our room was on the small side, but good enough for two. Bathroom needs some work. Our room was on the main floor right next to reception so it's noisy all night. Beds are okay, pillows not so much. Location is good. There are food places within walking distance. Metro stop is close by, maybe a block away. There is noise almost all night since there are a few hospitals nearby. Neighborhood is safe...no real issues there. Not a bad stay.

review_title: Close to Universal Studios and Hollywood Blvd.
review_text: The hotel is literally close to Universal Studios and just few miles away from Hollywood Blvd and Griffith Conservatory. The hotel room is clean, very nice and friendly staff and a good variety of breakfast, and complimentary bottled of water and some candies from the manager. The other plus for us was they allowed us to check-in 2 hours before the check-in time! The downside was they do not have a shuttle which was stated on their website, also the wifi was not working, our room phone doesn't have a dial tone and the hotel's cable was so slow! They better change their cable/Internet/phone provider. Nevertheless, we had a pleasant stay and might come back only if they fix the problems.

Nothing is perfect. Excellent hotel and excellent price is something really unreal, but Airtel missed the highest mark just by very few issues. First, you need to pay for the parking -$10 per day. There are no fridges in the rooms and no microwave ovens. And they do not accept any pets. Now the good things - it's reasonably priced, rooms are specious and clean, the hotel restaurant serves delicious meals and they are quite cheap, and the service is very good indeed. Not a beautiful hotel, but still highly recommended!
hotel_name: Airtel Plaza Hotel and Conference Center

review_title: I had a very pleasant experience at this hotel. They were very helpful when I told them I had forgotten my toiletries.
review_text: I found the hotel to be very clean and the receptionist was very helpful in providing me a toothbrush and other toiletries I had forgotten. The atmosphere was also quiet; unlike other hotels I've stayed at where there seemed to have been a lot of doors slamming. Overall, it was a great value for the price.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn Near Old Town Pasadena - Eagle Rock

review_text: The hotel is located right on the public transport routes, few mins walk to metro station and bus stop. But i would still recommend to use your own car. During the check out, the lady receptionist being helpful by letting us to use their office for storing luggages few hours. The free breakfast is a plus.

review_title: Great start to our Californian holiday
review_text: We stayed in the Hollywood Hotel on the first night of our Californian visit and what a pleasant surprise we received. A lovely exterior and very helpful reception staff (especially Giselle who helped with an Internet access issue). The room was a welcome site after our travels and the beds were very very comfy. A fab breakfast in the morning (continental with fruit and waffles) set us up for our day of sight seeing. Overall a lovely hotel at a great price, thoroughly recommend!

review_title: Reasonable price for the location + simple good gym
review_text: Despite remodelling works, the hotel was simple and pleasant to visit. Rooms facing road were a little noisy - ask for rear facing room. Staff were friendly and complimentary breakfast / wifi made the stay good value given the location.
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_text: Great service and great rooms, all you need is supplied. You really get a lot for your money! The location is perfect, whether you have a car or not, due to the close-by metrostation. I've actually return three times just this year!

The hotel is bad and especially the front desk employees 
I will never go there again
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_text: Disappointed. I'm a platinum member and stay at Marriott properties often. This one needs a refresh. Valet staff was super friendly, desk staff was ok. Would not return.
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_text: The price was high compared to other courtyard marriott's, but it is reasonable for the area.
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_title: Hotel perfecto para un fin de semana en el corazÃ³n de LA cerca de staples center y distrito joyero
review_text: Cerca de todo los lugares de entretenimiento, conciertos etc... Muy cerca del aeropuerto internacional de LA, justo abajo del sheraton hay un centro comercial, caminando estÃ¡n varios restaurantes, farmacias etc todo realmente alrededor del hotel, las habitaciones de lujo son muy cÃ³modas.

Was pleasantly surprised with our stay. The hotel staff was always pleasant and eager to please. My nine year old daughter loved the special attention they showed her and made her truly feel like a star.
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_text: My husband & I stayed here on a Friday night. This was my first stay. Good location. Disney concert hall is in walking distance, but its a little bit of an up hill walk. Also right across the way is the Los Angeles contemporary Museum of Art. Rooms were very nice. Bed was definitely Hilton quality. Only bad thing is the parking garage cannot fit large vehicles such as a Hummer. Personnel was very pleasant and friendly I can't wait to go back!!
Hotel and room were clean. Staff was friendly. Food from room service was tasty. Location was convenient. Price was reasonable. I have no complaints at all. Would stay here again.
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_text:
I first stayed at this location 9 years ago. It was new and the staff was still happy to have you there. After a few occasions of hanging with friend for cocktails on the roof this hotel became my favorite in L.A. I recently moved across the country and wanted that "feeling" that I missed. So I stayed at the downtown location to bring back that old feeling of LA liveliness. The hotel seems the same. After almost 10 years I expected upgrades to match the rise in room prices. Everything was "standard" to say the least. Housekeeping wouldn't even bring a set of eating utensils to room because I brought in outside food. 
I use to Love this place. Needless to say, I'm over it now.

review_title: Cool unique hotel right in downtown LA
review_text: Our room, one of the humongous rooms, had a huge foot statue in the bathroom. So cool and different. Room has bath which is 10 x bigger than other baths and the bed is on a raised floor not frame. These are fun touches I enjoyed. Restaurant in lobby is great as we had pork chops. Ice maker gives crushed ice in your ice bucket which is ball shaped. Easy walk to macys and wilshire. Heated pool on roof with,a beer garden. This is one of the best in downtown hotel wise.

review_title: Got a cheap deal so okay, not worth what the hotel regularly charges
review_text:
Very basic hotel, somewhere to sleep and that is it. The "frosted" glass between the bedroom and shower is not frosted, so if you do not know your room mate intimately you will after this trip.
If you are planning on going to the night club, staying at the hotel is worth it.

My wife and I were looking for a reasonably priced hotel in the Beverly Hills area. Not being familiar at all with the area, we picked the Courtyard based on the Marriot name and the many positive reviews. We were absolutely thrilled with our choice. The hotel is very clean, tastefully decorated, and every staff member we came in contact with was friendly, helpful and efficient. The valet guys were awesome, offering sightseeing and dining recommendations. Oh, and not to be overlooked, the bed was one of the most comfortable we've ever slept in at a hotel.
The location was perfect, a short 10 minute drive go Rodeo Drive, about 20 minutes to Hollywood, and about 30 minutes or so to the beaches. Overall, we would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for outstanding service, clean comfortable rooms, and easy access to major attractions. We'll be back!
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_text:
My wife and I stayed here when in L.A. because she wanted to stay downtown. When we checked in we were ignored by the front desk for at least five minutes. They were not on the phone, they looked at us and just walked away. The front desk clerk was nice enough, but did not recognize me as a Hhonors member or interact in any way. 
The room was nice and clean. The bed though was slanted back and felt like my legs were elevated.

I stayed because my grandson is at cedar Sinai. The hotel staff is amazing. The parking attendants are the best. They knew my name, asked about my grandson, and quickly retrieved my car. The front desk was accomadating for every request I made. I made several! I really appreciate this hotel's staff for the service I received. The room was nice and the bed was comfy.
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_text: Stayed there twice on my way into LAX and again on my way out. The room was comfortable. Rainy morning made getting to breakfast difficult since the walkways were not covered. Had a day room on my last day. Wanted to visit In & Out but shuttle did not go there so I settled for Denny's on site. All in all I was very pleased and would definitely stay again.
Stayed here for a week-long conf for work. From the person registering me in to the garage guys helping me leave - everyone was friendly and attentive. Very happy with the experience.
hotel_name: Courtyard Los Angeles Century City / Beverly Hills

review_title: Treat yourself to this design hotel
review_text: As a couple who loves modern style and design, this place was great for us. If you're not then I wouldn't recommend it. Rooftop pool and bar are fantastic and we utilised them both. A morning swim on the top of the Standard truly was an experience. They upgraded our room as we were on our honeymoon. Room was well-designed and felt luxurious. The wifi didn't work in our room which was hugely frustrating. Receptionist didn't seem to care when we reported it so we spent a lot of time at the rooftop bar where the wifi did work. Maybe that's what they want you to do. We found parking a few blocks from the hotel for $15 per night which is better than $30 at the Standard. The location's not great for going out. Downtown more-or-less shuts down at night so we ended up paying a lot for parking as we were taking the car in and out of parking to go out in other parts of LA.

review_title: A comfortable stay in a not so pleasant area.....
review_text:
It may seem weird that I rated my overall stay here as average when quite clearly I was happy with quite a few things. 
Initially on my arrival I was a little concerned as the neighborhood didn't appear to be overly inviting. This was confirmed on the second night when I saw a prostitute on the corner trying to work her magic. It's not a neighborhood I felt comfortable walking around during the evening even in the company of my fiancÃ©. 
Check in was fine & after a long journey from Australia we were able to check in early which was a blessing. However no instructions about 'take a lift to the second floor and your room will be to the right' etc was explained. Small gestures go a long way. The woman that assisted us wasn't overly friendly & not a lot of smiles from day staff at all. In fact when questioning them about directions we weren't even offered a map! The evening staff appeared friendlier and would greet us as passing through the lobby. 
We got to the room and were pleasantly surprised. Whilst being small, it was very clean with a super comfortable bed. Unfortunately there was no in room safe but they do have deposit boxes at the front desk. There is a book with information on local restaurants but nothing on what services are available here such as laundry etc. Our room was on Vermont road side & hence quite noisy with a lot of traffic. I think a room on the courtyard side would have been better. This is why I rated it as a 3, and lack of size. 
Cleaning service is done everyday and without fault. Hopefully the cleaners are made aware of the great jobs they are doing. I rated service as 4 due to the cleaning staff only & not front desk. 
They do offer free wi fi which is super easy to connect to & fast.
They also offer a complimentary breakfast which is totally adequate. Bagels, juice, cereal, toast, eggs, yoghurt & some fruit. Perfect way to kick off your day. 
Now as I mentioned earlier the neighborhood is less desirable. However, it's only minutes away from Hollywood Blvd, Walk of Fame etc. All you do is just jump on the subway a block down for $1.50 or buy a day pass for $5.00. There doesn't appear to be many great choices for dining out however we did find a cute 50s diner a few blocks down. Plus there was a pharmacist/mini mart just around the corner. However just due to our safety feeling compromised I rated it as a 3. 
A little bit of extra goes a long way. Plus I want to be able to walk out the front door, amble down the street & find places to eat. My personal preference :)
A nicely located hotel close to the metro and buses. The area is a bit dodgy at night. The rooms are clean and quiet with free wifi!! Definitely value for $!

just stayed there for one night because was going to lax soon in the morning. Noisy room (could hear the other room's tv and talking). It seemed they were about to enter in my room. Bad pillow, dark toilet, looking dirty. Just good for location and shuttle to airport. There's a Dennys right beside.

My husband and I flew from Florida to stay one night. We actually booked the wrong location. We meant to book the one in Hollywood. Once we realized it, we tried to call the one in Hollywood but they had no available rooms so we had no choice. No problem, we thought.
We drove up to the hotel valet and they told us to wait a minute. 20 minutes later, no help. We finally had to go ask for help.
Girl who checked us in was very nice. Hotel has some chic, unique decor however, rooms were alright. No coffee machine, no hair dryer..hallways smelled like smoke and evlevators were old.
Checked out roof top bar, pool is cool but bartender wasnt friendly at all. 
Checked out at 7 am, we booked a deal for free gas card and parking. Once we inquired about the deal.. The gentleman at the desk said he could not give us the gas card, we would have to wait 15-20 minutes or he could send it to us. We asked if he could just take it off our room. He said no and quoted, he had no way of compensating us, "I mean, it AIN'T comin outta my pocket."
Really? We smiled politely and said send the card, that will be fine. Who knows if we'll ever get it
Whole experience was terrible and hotel is totally over priced. Will never go back!
We drove up to the hotel valet and were asked to wait a minute. 20 minutes go by, sitting in our car.. no help. My husband went and found someone finally. They parked

review_title: A fun and interesting alternative to the same olds...
review_text:
Stayed here for one night. As soon as we walked in we were intrigued by the unusual and retro layout of the place. Refreshing to see that there are some different places out there that are not afraid to differ from the same old Hilton/Sheraton/Westin etc layout. 
Everything from the design of the hotel to the in room amenities and furnishings are quaintly presented and a pleasant left field change from the monotony of the usual big city hotel chains. 
Beds were comfortable, rooms spacious and the bar/pool on the roof was a great way to spend a sunny afternoon. 
Gotta laugh at some of the other reviews: if you've got a young family, wedding, or some conventional goings ons like that, you may want to reconsider, but if you're up for an exciting, blast from the past type of place and you're not keen on staying in the average impersonal chain hotel then this is the place for you. Plenty of personality but with respectable standards of hospitality. 
Easily one of the better places I've stayed yet. 
We were greeted by friendly staff who had no hesitation in changing our rooms to accommodate a couple of special requests that our group had.

review_title: Great to use as day room
review_text: We got a day room prior to flying out of LAX. Very good for the price $49. 95 (plus tax of course). Great value if you want a shower, quick meal at Dennys even a swim in the pool. Hotel shuttle leaves every half hour.

Clean room near airport with 24 hour shuttle to airport
Free breakfast using budget hotel standard (don't expect 5 star hotel breakfast)
I don't hear any airplane noise at night or I'm so tired after long flight to US :)
The only downside is public transportation for those stay more than 1 day (mine only 1 day transit) as there is not much option, the only good option is take bus to aviation/lax metro station from intersection where metro will take you to other part of LA
If you are looking for a trendy and unique hotel, you should stay here. The staff is very friendly. Great service !
Checked in before a early morning flight rooms were very clean beds were comfy bathroom was clean airport shuttle took me right to the place I wanted to go I will stay here again.

Stayed here on business for 2 nights--definitely would not return. Rooms cramped, sparse and uncomfortable. Terrible bed. Poorly appointed bathroom. Just not good. 
I get it: it's a hip, scenester spot. Doesn't make it a good hotel--look elsewhere.

review_title: More than what you pay for!
review_text:
The staff is extremely friendly and helpful, with special props to Fred. Valet parking is complimentary, the location is great for all the tourist attractions and places you'd want to visit. 
Breakfast is in the hotel lobby, but that didn't bother me. There's more than enough to start your day off. 
I would definitely stay here again. It's not a 5 star hotel, but you get the 5 star service!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Royal Palace Inn & Suites

review_title: Extremely nice and very clean, the best hospitality in los Angeles. Would highly recommend!!
review_text: The lady at the desk was the nicest we meet on our trip, the rates were very reasonable, the room was super clean and nice. This was the best room we stayed in on our trip to Los Angeles. Give this one a try!!!!

The hotel is ok. The room needed a better cleaned. The problem that we had wad the people at the front desk wasnt polite. I was doing my laundry in a locked room and when i came back, my clothes were all over the room. Someten at the frontdesk gave the spray key to 
other guest and he/ she took my cloth away from the washer machine. Then while i was waiting inside the lobby some couple came in, but they didnt looked like a loving couple, it was more like a kittens were all around.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Royal Palace Inn & Suites

review_title: Goog deal for overnight stay at LAX
review_text: Not so far from the airport, plus they provide free shuttle, operating every half-hour. The rooms are big but a little dated. Free breakfast. Free internet. Overall - not bad for 69 usd (tax included).

Estuvimos 1 sola noche y esta muy bien ubicado a 5 minutos del aeropuerto. Si quieren salir a cenar pregunten por el troli. Los lleva a Manhattan beach. Excelentes restaurantes y los regresa cada hora al hotel.
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel at Los Angeles Airport

review_text:
This is a great find. Only open 10 months, the beds are MY BED quality and you feel like a princess sleeping in exceptional style. Rooms are HUGE, glass window/door ultra modern fridge,rainwater dump shower but the best of all is the service. The staff make you expresso cappuccino for free, the breakfast is 24 hr and they even gave me a vitamin water for free (I left my wallet in room). Exceptional personal service - best I have EVER experienced in USA (travelling from
Australia). Walk to universal studios and highly efficient metro - 1 stop to Hollywood on the red line. We got a rate of $138 with tax on Internet. Incredible value.

This is a great airport hotel. It's quiet, very clean, decent rooms and price is not too bad. Easy to get to on free shuttle. Very little aircraft noise. Service at reception was a bit slow and buffet breakfast not the best but overall recommend this hotel.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_title: Very nice hotel with loving personnel
review_text: I was just their last week and I loved the hotel they have caring and helpful personnel who know the city very well and can give you exact location of were ever you need to go the bar is very nice and everyone in front desk are very polite and the housekeepers are nice and friendly and if you need anything they get right to it

review_title: Ottima posizione, ottimi servizi per un motel
review_text:
Situato a 5 min di macchina da hollywood e beverly hills. Zona tranquilla con un ottimo bistrot appena fuori l'hotel per fare colazione.
Camere abbastanza spaziose con un bagno immenso!
Le uniche pecche:
la poca pressione della doccia;
Mancanza di ascensore (ma Ã¨ un solo piano)
Wireless gratis!!
Insomma ottimo rapporto qualitÃ  prezzo!!! Consigliato

We reserved this hotel through Hotwire and after reading reviews, I was apprehensive, to say the least. However, we had a very pleasant one night stay before our flight out of LAX. The bellhop who carried our luggage both on arrival and departure was cheerful and efficient. We were also pleased with the speed and courtesy with which we were checked in. While our room was obviously not yet upgraded, it was spacious and clean. I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_text:
Nothing extraordinary about the hotel, kinda dated.
 I bidded for a room on three different occasions and each time was given the same room on the 5th floor at the end if the hall. I don't know if its specifically reserved for 'bidders' but it seems to be.
Imagine my surprise the first time I stayed there to discover a $12 plus per day parking fee. So what I thought was a great deal for the room wasn't really.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_title: Good for the airport poor for quality
review_text: This hotel is great for connections to the airport, unfortunately that's all the positives done . The hotel needs upgrading - as a crown plaza goes this hotel is very tired- the rooms are large - bed linen is clean but looks like it needs a boil wash. The club level - lounge - very poor - infact no comfort - weekends not open, so no point in paying extra for club facilities . The air-conditioning is the old fashioned units - you have the choice of hot or freezing - unfortunately the aircraft taking off outside produce less noise than these ac units - before checking here please check alternatives around the airport.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_text: Close to airport, fast friendly checkin,clean rooms. This is a great hotel that is close to the airport. The shuttle service is a common use shuttle used by many hotels, so they stop at every stop. If you are in a hurry and don't mine a little exercise, I would walk from the airport to the hotel. The rooms are well appointed and have flat screen tvs and many outlets. Would stay here again.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_title: Good hotel for priceline. Would never pay full price
review_text: Gotta pay for Internet 10.95. Parking was over 13.50 a day. Nice hotel but they don't offer anything.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_text: The service was awesome! The staff was friendly and helpful. It was so late when i checked in. I did not have a reservation, but I was accommodated. The room was fine, but there were old soda cans and a used bar of soap left in the room. It could have perfect if not for those small gross things. I was way too tired to complain. I'm sure it was just overlooked and you would have all 5 from me otherwise. Again awesome service! I would definitely stay here again and recommend this hotel.
Tony in the Permier Club Lounge 16 th floor took good care of us after a long day. Must go see Tony
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_text: We didn't realise how far it was from main LA and taxi's would have been a nightmare however they organised a town car to take us everywhere and fetch us when ever we wanted! We felt like stars if that doesn't sound too cheesy, ha! We only stayed 4 days but everyone was lovely and very helpful. We spent the days sight seeing and investigating LA and we always dined at the restaurant at the hotel as 'outside' can be abit scary at night apparently, the food was lovely. The only bad experiences we encountered is that everyone in LA asks for money all the time! Which becomes very annoying. I would recommend this hotel to everyone though!

review_title: Pay a few bucks more for a renovated room
review_text:
I stayed here a few months ago in an old room and it was dirty and the bed was uncomfortable.
Anyways, I got a renovated room this time, and it was one of the most comfortable hotel stays I've had. Very clean, high floor, beautiful TV, new bed, and clean bathroom.
If you stay here, pay a few bucks more for a renovated room!!
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_text: We had a view to a wall directly from our window. There was a noisy AC outside the window and outside the door so we had to use earplugs every night. We expected to get a balcony, but found out during check-in that only about 1/3 of the rooms have a balcony

review_title: Double the price it should be.
review_text: Unless you need to stay at this exact location keep looking - you'll better and cheaper. Key cards repeatedly failing, stale breakfast offerings, car parking so tight I pulled a muscle squeezing out of my car, indifferent weary staff. Overall the actual value was nearer $68 not the $168 I was charged. Buyer beware!

review_title: The hotel is good but, the handicapped parking could be improved.
review_text: We loved our stay but they need to add more handicapped parking spaces. We were told that there were more spaces on the upper floors of the parking structure there were not. We had to go back down and park on the ground floor where we originally were.
Excellent Stay Can't complain about anything, always clean and very helpful staff when inquiring about thing to due & how to get there, about a 2min walk to the walk if fame!,,.. Overall great

review_title: Great location but I wouldn't go back.
review_text:
Stayed here for 3 nights and that wad enough. If it wasn't for the location we would of considered moving.
Can't fault the motel too much for the issues we had though....
First night there was a bunch of people having a good time in hot tub which was right outside our door (which hours are meant to be 9am-9pm) It was about 10pm so I just took a sleeping pill and popped my earplugs in but about 3am i think i got woken up by the LOUD chatter going on so politely opened my door and asked them to be a bit quieter. This did not work-so i rang the office and asked them to sort it out! 
This in turn ended up with the girls calling him a 'beep beep'for telling them off and slagging me for calling him and my so my husband had to pop out and stick up for me.
Not a good night. 
Day 2 was much the same, people in the hot tub past it's curfew and SLAMMING the gates to get in and out!
But the main issue was someone had moved into end room above us and the floor is so thin it honestly sounded like they were purposely stomping around like elephants all night.
And this continued on the 3rd night.
We are a young couple on a round the world trip for our honeymoon and hd f been driving California so have been choosing cheap accomm for this leg of the trip but I'm not sure being sleep deprived is worth it. 
Cannot believe how inconsiderate some people are!!
So back to the motel- it could 
Definitely use a new coat of paint, furnishings and carpet but it was clean and the staff always said hello.
The pool was freezing and they could use some new sun loungers but again, location and price was good.
If you choose to stay ask for a room on the top floor AWAY from the hot tub area!!

Un hotel al estilo de las pelÃ­culas situado en Sunset boulevard, entre la parte segura e insegura de estÃ¡ parte de Los Ãngeles.
Nada recomendable para caminar cuando ha oscurecido, pero a unos 45 minutos andando del teatro Kodak.
TambiÃ©n tiene una parada de metro cercana y sitios de comida rÃ¡pida.

review_title: love to find these clean nice little hotels
review_text: check in was easy, clerk was very nice. didnt really care for parking behind hotel, but was ok. hotel grounds appear to be well kept. room was more than expected, shower is dated but clean. remote on tv didn't work real well. will stay here again!
Front desk was poor, food was bad, hotel not clean enough. Good was they have a parking lot.

review_title: A Great alternative to boring, cookie cutter hotels.
review_text:
It used to be that traveling meant experiencing something new--unique stays, foods, shopping. As our culture has become more and more homogenized, that seems to be less and less the case. 
The Hotel Fig is a great, notable exception. We stayed for two nights, and LOVED the quirkiness, one of a kind furnishings, fun/funky vibe, beautiful pool/bar area, and easy access to LA and Hollywood. 
If you prefer mid range chain hotels, this might not appeal to you. If, however, you are looking for a cool, unusual Oasis in or near downtown LA, don't hesitate.
A beautiful, if small hotel. Unless I looked up at the skyscrapers, I would have thought I was in Spain, not the middle of LA.

Just finished attending a meeting at this hotel. The meeting was a success in great part to the terrific service we received during our stay. New rooms,good food but most of all great attention to detail by all the staff.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_text: This is the dirtiest hotel I've ever stayed at in my whole entire life. All the negative reviews are dead on. At least most people who reviewed had a reduced rate through priceline. I paid the full rate of more than 120 for the night while traveling for business. Carpets were not just stained, but down right filthy..you could see the dust piled around the edges of the carpet..stained comforter.. dirty and peeling wall paper. Behind the mattress there was a later of dust and random hair on the box spring..yes I was checking for bed bugs. I complained to the manager but all she kept doing is offering free parking..free drinks..all I wanted was a clean room. No matter how many drinks you feed me I will still know my room is a dump. I should have checked tripadvisor first but put too much faith in the crown plaza name. After I checked in I read the reviews on here and was floored to see the offered renovated rooms to some priceline guests for an extra 20 bucks! Meanwhile I'm paying far more than that and that wasn't offered. I will be sure to warn all my coworkers and colleagues to never step foot in this hotel. We also ate in the hotel restaurant which was low quality and expensive. Are you seeing a trend?
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_title: Priceline should hang its' head in shame... Is not a 3.5 star hotel!!!!
review_text:
We named our own price on priceline and paid $75 for a room so that we wouldn't miss our early morning flight.
I read the reviews of this hotel on my iphone the whole way from calimesa, ca to LA. 
My husband and I were so disappointed at hearing about the bad experiences people had that we almost booked a room somewhere else; but opted to save the money.
We should have booked somewhere else. This hotel is a complete and total dump. It is old, filthy, and smells like raunchy stale cigarette smoke in our NON smoking room, and the headache inducing stench permeates every fiber of the room from the disgusting drapes to the worn, horrifically stained and dirty carpet, to include the DIRTY nasty duvet cover on the beds. We have two young children with us: 3 and 8 years old. They were coughing and crying tonight until they finally fell asleep. (I am writing this review from one of the two skanky double beds that come standard in their rooms.) The receptionists are incredibly rude and disrespectful. The Crowne Plaza parking is $12.00!!!! Ridiculous. The Internet is $10.00 per day. There is no complimentary breakfast. The room with two double beds is very small; no mini fridge. No frills. I suspect that the majority of this hotels' revenue comes from displaced passengers, flight crew, and the hapless victims of pricelines' very off base opinion of the star quality of this hotel. I will most definitely be writing to complain to any CP personnel that will listen. Huge disappointment for our last night in CA to be spent in a downtown equivalent of a motel 6. Please take note that the management of this establishment does not respond to any review of their hotel on tripadvisor. That's going to be a red flag for me from now on. Good establishments have management who cares and who go the extra mile to read and thoughtfully respond to peoples concerns.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_text:
Se state cercando un albergo a Hollywood, continuate a cercare.
Lo sconsiglio vivamente, la foto della piscina Ã¨ ingannevole rispetto al complesso della struttura. 
Fortissimo odore di disinfettante per moquette (credo) nelle camere, fatiscenti condizioni di tende, lenzuola e asciugamani. Abbiamo trovato macchie sulla moquette e sulle poltroncine della camera, non vale la pena secondo me di spendere qui i propri soldi (peraltro non pochi).
Di positivo c'Ã¨ la posizione centralissima e il servizio lavanderia all'interno. L'uomo alla reception Ã¨ stato gentile e comprensivo quando abbiamo chiesto di cambiare la prima camera assegnataci e inoltre ci ha consigliato gentilmente un ristorante nelle vicinanze che ci ha soddisfatti.
Tuttavia non consiglierÃ² questo hotel a nessuno.

Very clean, but the staff was less than helpful. Additionally, there was a line of 6 people at check out at 8 AM and only one clerk. It took almost an hour to get through the line and checked out. Restaurant had a great breakfast buffet but it was very pricey ($18). Room overlooked LAX, which I enjoyed. We watched planes fly in. Very quiet for it's proximity.
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles International Airport Hotel

review_text: I booked this hotel for a night stop over in Venice because it watoday accessable to the airport. I had read reviews on tripadvisor and was so impressed with the service from the moment we walked in.. We arrived at 9am and they let us in well before our check in time and allowed us to have breakfast. Which was perfect after a 15 hours flight. The rooms were spacious and very clean. A lovel walk to Venice beach and a little further to Santa Monica. I would definitely stay there again. 10/10 and value for money.

review_title: Great hotel close to Venice attractions and Santa Monica
review_text: For a first trip to Venice, this hotel was great. Easy parking good proximity to the beach and Venice canals. Amenities at the hotel were also nice (robe, in room coffee and continental breakfast). I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again!

We stayed here for a one night stay..it was very clean....riom was nice...only downfall was no nearby fastfood and the parking garage was a little scary...it was free which was nice but if i had not been with an adult man i would have felt a little untimidated in the parking lot. It was a nice stay though and is great for someone needing to stay before cruising
hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Los Angeles Harbor Hotel

review_title: Excellent customer service at the desk as well as at the bar/restaurant, the rooms were nice, great pool area, convenient airpor
review_text: As a person in the profession of hospital management, I have high expectations for customer service & the staff truly exceeded my expectations & made for a very pleasant start to my vacation. I ate at the bar/restaurant and had excellent service & meal. I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Los Angeles International Airport

review_text: I enjoyed my one night stay at the crowne plaza, room was lovely and clean, bed was nice and comfortable and they staff were very helpful and as I am a young female traveler who at the time was traveling on my own I felt very safe at the crowne plaza. I ordered room service and it was delicious just what I needed after 24 hours of traveling in several planes to arrive in the USA. Only thing was during the night I was awoken by banging on the roof above me and at 4am it sounded like a helicopter had taken off in my room it was the heater/cooler system boosting up or something. but the free Internet was excellent and it allowed me to stay in contact with my family definitely a plus! And also the free hot apple cider was delicious!

Stayed 2 nights & was happy overall with my stay. Room was a decent size with a fridge, desk & plenty of towels in the bathroom. as others have said the walls are very thin & could hear the people in the next room. 
Breakfast was bagels, toast, pastries, cereal, fruit, juice & coffee. But came down at 9:30am and there wasn't much left & wasn't refilled either. 
Less than 10min walk to Hollywood Blvd but Sunset isn't the nicest area. Ross across the street is awesome for clothes bargains.
Overall I would stay here again & recommend it to those looking for a reasonable priced place close to attractions.

We stayed here 1 night after arriving late at LAX. It is nothing fancy but exactly what you would expect from Holiday Inn Express. Clean, comfortable rooms and a decent free breakfast in the morning (I particularly liked the pancake machine that rolls out a hot fresh pancake on a conveyor belt in 1 min. Fun!) Free WI-FI and a welcome bag with a bottle of water and granola bar in it were nice touches! There is a pool (we didn't use it...not sure if it's heated) that is right beside the parking lot. My only concern is that it was pretty noisy and I'm not usually sensitive to noise but I certainly noticed. We were in a room that faced the street so maybe ask for one on the other side?
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Los Angeles-LAX Airport

review_text: Stayed here for 10 days, overall happy with hotel. Staff were friendly and rooms were kept clean and food was good. Hotel in a good location, not far from rodeo drive

I stayed for one night in October to break my journey from America to England. We arrived at the hotel at about 8am in the morning after a long flight. Our room wasn't ready (wasn't expecting it to be that early so it wasn't a problem) but we were told to go and help ourselves to breakfast and housekeeping would get the room ready ASAP. This was great service, as technically were weren't eligible for breakfast till the following morning. Once we got into the room and had a rest, the bell desk arranged a tour for the following day (we had a late flight) and were offered a ride to the bus stop so we could go to the mall, and to phone when we were ready to be picked up. This was another great service offered by the hotel. 
Some other things to note: Food wise - breakfast was great with lots of options. For dinner etc. there is a sizzler next door, Denny's, burger king and a couple of other places are bit further down W. Manchester Ave (turn right at the corner). The hotel is a bit isolated being at the far end of airport boulevard. I probably wouldn't walk the streets at night, but for service and value would have no problems staying here again!!
The staff were wonderful, friendly and the beds were comfortable and the shower was hot. Really, what more do you need for one night.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Los Angeles-LAX Airport

review_title: Get what u pay for... Dated, but clean, tidy, safe... Staff lovely...
review_text: Look, it's getting on but for the price it was good... Location was walkable for us to get around, staff were very helpful.... Room clean and tidy.... Don't expect the Regent Beverly Wilshire.... Would stay again, lots of locals (Aussies) there...

I am a Platinum Elite member in the IHG Priority Club Rewards program and spend more than 60 nights a year in hotels. This particular hotel is in a great location and the staff is VERY friendly and helpful. 
The rate was quite expensive for the overall quality of the hotel. I may elect next time to pay the extra $75-$100 difference to stay in a five-star Beverly Hills hotel instead. Though I would go back if I got a good deal. 
Don't waste your time in their on site restaurant. Being so close to Beverly Hills and Hollywood it is worth a walk or taxi ride to a great restaurant. The hotel concierge gave me a great recommendation for a mlediteranian restaurant just off Rodeo Drive which was quite reasonable and very delicious. 
I was charge $16.50 for overnight self parking, not the $15 as mentioned by the front desk manager in a recent comment. I must say though this is very reasonable in comparison to the other hotels in the area. 
The rooms are a bit dated and the bathroom lacks the esthetics and space of newer hotels. 
I would suggest this hotel for one or two nights for a family on a budget seeing Hollywood for the first time or a quick business trip.

We recently stayed at the crowne plaza Beverley hills for 5 nights and were very happy with our stay there. Don't always believe the bad reviews it was not like the reviews I read before we booked. The staff were so helpful and friendly and should be commended on that! It is no trouble for them to even tell you the buses to catch...
Close to rodeo dr a very short walk in fact. Buses run from around the corner to all the major sites to see.
The rooms were great too. Bed huge and comfortable. Yes the bathrooms may be a bit outdated but seriously who spends that much time in there? Even the cleaning staff greeted you daily!
The gym is also great with fantastic equipment.
My only advice would be to double check you get nonsmoking at the desk before you go to your room because even though we'd booked this ours was not and we ended up with smoking and I thought too late to change once unpacked?? I'm an avid nonsmoker so we had to air the room out daily!
But overall a great place to stay!

review_title: They where there when we needed them

Many foreign children and parents had the patient help of the entire staff in keeping toddlers from escaping as parents checked in/out or struggled with more than one child. Not luxurious by any means, but a very unexpected surprise.

review_title: Good overall stay, some let downs, no deal breakers
review_text:
An oldish hotel, the Crowne Plaza has recently been given a facelift - which shows. Fittings and trim is new but the building shows its age. Omissions in the upgrade include the lack of safes in rooms. This facility is available via lock boxes at reception, but this is a pain to use after a while.
Location is OK, 20 minute walk to Rodeo Drive and a main bus route passes by the hotel.
Avoid rooms near the elevator as hotel management has placed soft drink vending machines at these points and they make OUTRAGEOUS amounts of noise. We asked to have our room exchanged for one further away.
If you intend to spend a lot of time in your room or at the hotel, then look elsewhere. If you're out and about and need a place to crash - this serves the purpose.

review_title: Older style hotel on edge of Beverly Hills offering great service.
review_text:
We have just spent 5 nights here and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. While being on edge of Beverly Hills may be a disadvantage it is walkable distance to supermarket and CVS parmacy (5 mins uphill on W Pico Blvd) and coin laundry (5 mins walk left on W Pico Blvd), restaurants along S Beverly north (10 - 20 mins) - breakfast at Beverly Liz was fantastic or dinner at The Cheescake Factory. Bank with ATM next door and bus stop outside main entrance. Concierge services cater very well for tourists giving advice on tours, transport etc. We took the Starline Hop On Hop Off 48hr Double Decker Bus - be prepared to walk 30 mins at moderate pace to get to bus stop where it commences. Tour ok but commentary via pre-recorded voice was hard to hear most of the time. Work out bus and subway if you just want to go to Hollywood or Santa Monica and save the $. Concierge organized hotel transport to and from Universal - while costing $15 pp each way you got there straight away and didn't have to shuttle from hotel to hotel. The driver gave us a mini tour on way back of Hollywood homes with bit of humor which was a bonus. 
Highlight of stay was the fantastic service in the bar lounge from Luis and Jesus! We ate 3 nights out of the 5 as the food was so good, reasonably priced and finally had some veges! These guys welcomed us and other guests too like old friends every night, checked on how we were going and topping up our drinks with a bit of a chat. They are a real treasure for this hotel as they make everyone feel so welcome. Crowne Plaza is a great place to stay especially for us Aussies. We will leave with some very fond memories!! Thank you

review_text:
Location: excellent, close to the LAX airport.
Free shuttle service to and from the airport.
Accommodation: Basic. The rooms are clean with a fridge, hair dryer, bottled water. There is no safe. Just hanging space for clothes. No drawers, just boxes for putting clothing into. Unsightly but functional.
WiFi: Free, in room and throughout hotel.
Meals: Buffet breakfast was reasonable for US$15/- plus tax. American breakfast was US$12/-. There was an in house cafe that served burgers, sandwiches and the usual food. Room service was also available. If you are ired of the food in the hotel, then there is Burger King diagonally across from the hotel.

My mate and I flew into LA at the start of March this year. It was the first time in the states and we were a bit jetlagged from the flight. We hired a car and proceeded to head to the hotel. The hotel was very easy to get to. We were able to check in around 11am which was fantastic for us since we had just been flying for 14 hours. The rooms were fantastic and the staff were really nice. The hotel restaurant and bar were also good. I would advise anybody staying here to become a priority member (it's free to join up) we received 2 bottles if water and 2 free drink cards because I joined up prior to check in. Recommended for any traveller

Once we arrived in the hallway of our room, we were hit with the smell of marijuana and the inside of the room had a sour musty smell. Another thing is that the room they put us in was very tiny and set up like a Motel 6 with a large glass window next to the bed facing the enclosed hallway! You can tell that this area of the building used to be a outside balcony that was enclosed after the renovation. The room was dirty and did not have a safe feel to it! We checked out the next day and went to another hotel.

Funny how when a hotel provides 2 free bottles of .50 cent water, you feel as though they really care about you! Love the free wifi and free airport shuttle. I arrived at 9:30pm and the place was BUSY. Lots of flight crews stay here. The shuttle at 5:30am was packed! If you need a place to stay near LAX, I recommend this property, but pay under $100.

review_text:
I was reserving this hotel using miles, it was one of cheaper options for 3-4* hotels.
It had Sheraton in its name - how bad could it be?
Pretty bad. The common areas are nice but once you take an elevator you end up in something more like a motel. Mushy smell in rooms and hallways, room windows facing hallway (!), smaller than average bathroom.

review_title: Good location for visiting NBC Universal
review_text: I stayed here one night before meetings at NBC Universal. Hotel is just outside Universal. Hotel is a little on the older side, though still quite comfortable.

Steps from Universal Citywalk and the similarly named adjacent theme park, the Sheraton Universal is arguably the most convenient hotel in the San Fernando Valley. Â A subway station for the Metro Red Line which is a 10-minute walk down the hill to Cahuenga, grants quick access the Hollywood attractions and downtown sports venues. Â If you care to park on the freeway with 10,000 of your closest friends, the 101, the 134 and the 170 are close by.
Universal Citywalk has some great family-friendly restaurants like Wolfgang Puck, Tony Roma's and the Hard Rock Cafe. Â And, you can catch Jay Leno filming the "J-Walking" segment of the Tonight Show Â right around dinnertime here.
Â Â  Â From the exquisitely polished brass handrails on the exterior walkway to the Zen-inspired front lobby, the hotel welcomes the weary traveler with a aura of sophistication and serenity. Â I have only been to a handful of other Sheraton properties but this is the nicest by far. Â 
The people who work here rock! Â Every staff member we encountered was completely capable and Sam, one of the managers, truly went above and beyond with regard to getting us an extra room for a co-worker at the last minute so we could all be at the same property.
I had a very nice room with a view of the Cahuenga Pass. The room was cleaned well with the somewhat troubling exception of pubes in the bathtub.
Â The Club Lounge was stocked with an ample supply of snacks and beverages and the host and hostess ensured the food items were well presented. Â 
Sadly, this is my last stay as a Platinum member before losing status with Starwood next year. Â "Thank you" Sheraton Universal made it great!

review_title: Great hotel, especially for the location but it did have some downs.
review_text: We traveled to universal studios and decided since we have a baby it would be great to walk to a close hotel and we chose the Sherwton Universal. The location is excellent and only about a 5 minute walk to Universal Studios. We had 6 adults staying with us and my baby and we were put into an executive suite which I was told it had one bedroom and a queen size bed in the living room area and a couch that would fold out, and about 600 sq ft of space with balcony When I heard this it was perfect especially for the price I was quoted. I walked n and was very pleased with the room only to find out though that there was no bedroom for me and my husbands privacy and the couch did not fold out. I thought where would we put all these people?! Went downstairs thinking they gave me the wrong room but no they said that's only the presidential suite. So I thought why would I make up what the room is the lady told me over the phone. Of course I was upset the only thing they did was offer me one cot free of charge which I accepted but the other adult slept on the couch. Over all the hotel is nice inside and clean, staff is nice. But with then knowing I had 6 adults they should have told me to either get two rooms or upgrade. I asked how much for the presidential suite they never provided me a price and I didn't get the other cot until 4 hours later I had to go back downstairs and ask for it. I would stay here again but make sure the room u get is the correct one just verify it with the rep. My overall experience here was good despite all the adults in a smaller room. We stayed on the 11th floor in room 1109. :) have a great stay!!

We stayed here on a mini trip to the park. I think it's def overpriced for the quality of the hotel. The people there were great and the drinks at the hotel bar were very cheap at happy hour! The hotel is very close to the park so that's nice. The bed was not so comfy and the room needed a little updating. We called at night for a robe and slippers and they brought it right up. Good hotel.. Yet overpriced!

review_title: I wrote the review 2 mo ago that was titled "stay at the Hilton"
review_text: 2 mo ago we had an unfortunate experience. My husband and I decided to give it another chance and boy did the Sheraton redeem themselves!! Extremely clean room, nice and quiet, everything in perfect working order, staff was professional, friendly, and extremely helpful, club lounge was clean and fresh, our overall stay was a 10 out of 10! Everyone deserves a 2nd chance and I'm glad we stayed there again, so happy with the hotel we will be coming back in October with our children to attend Universal Studios again!!! Thank you Sheraton for going above and beyond, see you next month!!!

Clean, close to attractions, nice view. The lobby was beautiful and the rooms were nice and clean. The beds were comfortable. Universal Studios and Citywalk within walking distance. Would definitely return.

The good: the staff and the location. The ok: room amenitites and decor. The not so good: this is an old hotel that's been renovated. The rooms are evidence of this. The bathroom was tiny, the light switches barely worked, stuff was just a bit rundown. The restaurant was really expensive ($14 for oatmeal, juice and coffee?!) and $7 a day for Internet.

I told him my complaint and he surprised me by saying "well, we will look into that because we want to make you a happy customer". review_title: A unique airport hotel that celebrates the airport.
review_text:
I just completed my first stay at the Custom. My flight from the East Coast was due to arrive late in the evening, and at the last minute I decided I didn't want to drive home. Hotel Tonight featured this hotel for a great rate, and I had wanted to visit it. And so the deal was struck.
I read the various reviews, and both good and bad are largely spot on. Your perception of the Custom will depend on your needs and expectations. Do not stay here if you want cookie-cutter sameness or generic wall art or a bed you have to climb up into. This is an older hotel that has been recently remodeled with a hip new style. The age of the hotel still shows through at times, including the musty smell, and the hip decor won't appeal to everyone - like the stark walls and low bed.
All that said, I enjoyed my stay very much. All of the staff were very friendly and went out of their way to make me feel welcome, from the complimentary airport pickup, to the very helpful Gerald at reception and Tomas at checkout. The public areas are great - an open lobby was a cool gathering place and the site of a very good buffet breakfast for under $10. I wasn't able to enjoy the bar, restaurant or pool, but they looked to be nice spots to enjoy with friends. There was a mixed crowd of guests, with many apparently visiting from Europe.
The room was simple, but clean and with many amenities. Wifi was available throughout the hotel, and its being complimentary put this place a notch above standard airport hotels that charge in excess of $10/day. The bath products were by Lather, and the bed linens were very comfortable. There was a dock for iPods and unique LED lighting that functioned nicely for mod moodlighting as well as a night light. The desk mat explained how to use all the room features, and provided interesting information about its past (it was designed by Weldon Becket, same guy who designed Hollywood's iconic Capitol Records tower, and I might add a host of other recognizable buildings, including the Cinerama Dome at the Arclight and Disney's Contemporary Resort A-frame)
What I'll remember about my stay at the Custom versus my many stays at more nondescript airport hotels is that this place actually celebrates its next door neighbor, LAX. The LED lights evoke the color-changing pillars at the airport entrance, and the double-paned windows allowed me to enjoy watching the flights arrive and depart, without the annoyance of their noise. I slept very well. Almost every floor has a common area in the center core, from the "Duty Free" vending area to the game room to the art gallery. My favorites were on the "elevated" level - one resembles an airport lounge, complete with screens showing arrival/departure info and a computer you can use for printing boarding passes. The surprise treat was discovering the Stratosphere lounge on floor 12 - this peaceful cloud-themed lounge boast two massage chairs. My 20 minutes relaxing in one was absolutely incredible.
It's hard to strike a balance between value and luxury, but if the Custom continues to deliver comfortable accommodations with a wide set of amenities at a decent price, I'll be back. And not just when I'm at the airport.
