My clue to skip this place should've been the â€ No Refundâ€ policy on bookit.com. There's no refund because they would go out of business if they had to refund money back to all the unhappy customers who were lied to about this hotel.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Los Angeles International Airport

review_text: I greatly appreciate cheerful and efficient hospitality. Associate Estelle Estrada of the Sheraton is both.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Los Angeles International Airport

review_title: Service was amazing and enjoyed out stay.
review_text:
To whom it may concern, 
My boyfriend and I stayed in late March at the Custom hotel. Hotel was very clean and upscale for the daily rate. Customer service was amazing down to valet to the very helpful man at the front desk (Tomas). Tomas went out of his way to make our stay enjoyable, asset to the company and I will return and refer other travlers to the Custom hotel cause of him. 
Thank you!!
Will return shortly. 
Ashley

If you are staying in Hollywood for a few days or even longer, this hotel is in a great location, is clean, is value for money and the staff are wonderful, my husband and I will definitely stay here again next year

I missed my connecting flight at LAX due to our flight being delayed by 5 hours... And of course the airline, which shall remain unnamed, did not put us up for the night. I got a last minute room at the Westin and was very pleases.
Pluses:
- free airport shuttle which I waited for no more than 1 minute to catch
- super comfortable beds
- less airplane noise than I was expecting
Cons:
- mainly the limited/expensive dining options if you get in late at night

review_title: Great fun, lots of atmosphere, big LA 'scene' going on!
review_text: This is a bustling hotel, which is a fun and affordable place with a real LA 'scene' going on. Every night there was a party where the beautiful people turned up in drones, but the good thing is that I never got disturbed. Rooms are lovely and v.comfortable. They stock kiehls amenities which are luxurious and they are clever to put a night light in the bathroom as to not wake you at night, I liked that! The hotel had a rock n roll feel to it and a sense of history that is often missed in LA. Really great stay but not for young families. Prepare for posing by the (beautiful) pool. Only annoyance was lack of free wi fi.
hotel_name: Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel - A Thompson Hotel

review_text:
We took one of the larger rooms which included living room and kitchen. Had no problems whatsoever.
Good value and a great location. Ideal for first timers to Hollwood.

review_title: Crowded and a bit noisy, but clean,fun and a great value!
review_text: Nothing can beat this location if one is headed to Universal Studios and the whole tourist thing in LA. For such a large hotel the employees and services were pretty darn good. Room service was efficent n well priced. Kids and teenage sport teams abounded, yet finding a semi-quiet adult bar area was simple. Lots of dining options,easy park access, and little shops make this Shearaton a nice option, especially if you have teens who want to go back n forth. It's also nice to be able to eat or drink non-park(rip off)items in the room or hotel.

review_title: Friendly staff, super helpful, great location.
review_text: This was an unexpected suprise. The hotel was super friendly, willing to please, and go out of the way to help. I would totally come back and stay.

review_title: Great place to stay when getting ready to fly out of Lax or returning from a long trip. Shuttle will pick you up or take you to
review_text: The staff was very friendly and helpful. The beds are very comfortable and the rooms are set up nice with a work station for business and a nice flat screen TV for relaxing and watching your favorite program.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Los Angeles International Airport

review_text: As a regular traveller (and luxury hotel lover) I have stayed at a number of hotels in this area but nothing beats the Four Points. Friendly staff, great service, clean rooms, easy parking, convenient location and great value for money!
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Los Angeles International Airport

review_text: Best value for money in Hollywood. Minutes walk to walk of fame, staff extremly helpful and friendly. Would stay again for sure.

I stayed at the hotel in October 2011 for 5 nights and found the following:
Pros: 
-convenient,central location to Hollywood boulevard,easy, quick walk
-continental breakfast included
-free wifi (reasonably fast) in the room and free computer with Internet in the lobby
-large room
-free parking
-mostly friendly staff although housekeeping could give a smile back when they are given one,only had contact 2 or 3 times with front desk staff, that includes check in
cons:
-strong overpowering cleaning product smell in the room,it didn't clear even after 5 days and our clothes reeked of it 
-bed only had one bedside table
-the floors in the hallway is not carpeted so every footstep or luggage being wheeled is extremely loud (we were on the ground floor). 
overall though we liked the location the best, I would consider staying again for this reason.

We enjoyed a short stay at the Crowne Plaza Beverly Hills in early April and were struck by the high level of service provided.
From the moment we walked into an ornate lobby a friendly and helpful staff catered to our every need. The girls at the front desk were always there and polite and helpful. The bell boys were never short of advice or a helping hand.
Our room was small but very nice and featured a comfortable king sized bed and massive HD television.

review_title: Consistently good value and very convenient if need to be in and out of LAX
review_text: Stayed here twice this week, had stayed here several times before. It continues to be very well run, and extremely good value. Seems that it is priced much lower than several other major hotels which are just slightly closer to the LAX terminals. It is well with the extra few minutes on the shuttle or in your rental car, since it is comfortable and very good value. I will continue to stat here whenever I am in LA and need to stay near the airport.

review_title: For a short visit of Hollywood and Beverly Hills, it is a great Location.
review_text: Hotel is located great to visit Hollywood and Beverly Hills. Low standard Hotel. Free Parking. WiFi was availible, but did not work in our room. No restaurant, but many availible in walking distance. Rate ok for summer and the great location.

Needed a hotel near LAX due to an early flight. Check in was easy, valet was very helpful, room was nice. I am platinum with Starwood so I don't know how that factored in, but I would definitely return if I needed a hotel near the airport.

This airport Hilton is one of the largest in the world, but it doesn't suffer in quality or service because of if. Many of the floors have been refurbished and I like the upgrade. The beds and linens in the newer rooms really are some of the most comfortable I've experienced. The only downside is the stale restaurant and bar. They could use major remodeling, especially with the nice places at the neighboring Marriott and Westin.

review_title: Expensive but a great location many attractions in walking distance.
review_text: Service was good rooms clean but very pricy. The staff was helpful but cab service to area locations is also pricy. Make sure to ask for a room with a view of the Hollywood sign.

review_title: Good place to stay near airport
review_text: I stayed here before my parents flying back home. And it is clean and near the hotel. And I reserved it from Hotwire about an month ago and the deal is pretty cheap. Only concern is the hotel is kind of old, but it is pretty clean. Nice by the way
We stayed here for two days between flights ok overall certainly not westin brand quality more 3 1/2 star but extremely well priced just don't expect too much

Moreno Bonechi
I love this hotel. Beautiful rooms with Internet access and car parking included, perfect location (Kodak Theatre, Hard Rock CafÃ© Hollywood and Walk of fame in 2 minutes by walk), cool staff and great price. If you are planning you journey in Los Angeles, Hollywood Celebrity Hotel is a must!!!

I stayed at the hotel for a conference and it was comfortable and the staff was very helpful. I especially loved the cleaning crew grade A. The room service food was very good and quiet timely in delivery..The first thing you realize as you enter the hotel was the heavenly smell...I so loved the bar area a cute bar fly location.. The bed was huge I kept rolling and rolling in my California King bed...It was comfy..Only bad thing was the lack of a view I was smack dead insight of the Hotel parking lot...but overall great bang for my buck...keep in mind transportation is expensive so factor that into your trip if you want to sightsee or club hoop..:)
When arriving on the floor on which my room was located I felt that I was on a service corridor. However the room was standard Hilton. The hotelneedsto upgrade the public area on each floor.

review_title: Nice clean rooms and the service is outstanding!
review_text: Fanstastic staff! Cleam rooms, comfortable bed and an ice cold a/c. Not too much more that you could ask for.

Be careful the wesitn might just charge for standing in the lobby. Why not, they charge you for everthinvg else. I almost payed more in fees than I did for the hotel room. Here are just a few of the fees: $22 to self park, about $30 for valet, $ 12 for the Internet . Now to be fair all of the hotels along that strip proably charge you for parking and Internet, but the hotel staff seem to be so callus and indifferent that it made you angry to pay the fees. The shereton is a much better deal, it has a Starbucks right in the hotel and they don't price gouge you. And not to mention the drinks at the bar are way too expensive. So if you can get past all the fees then the hotel is pretty nice, clean, and beautiful.

Greay location for quick access to the airport. The hotel is older although it is kept clean. Public areas are showing some wear and tear - especially carpets. I echo the other posters who say rooms are small and drab. Bathrooms are positively "tiny" and poorly appointed. Televisions are tube-type. Few electrical outlets at the desk. 
Concierge lounge is very nice and very spacious.Staff is friendly.
There are better options nearby at compatible price.

After a hellish flight that included our four year old being violently ill, the last thing we needed was hassles at the other end. Fortunately, the Westin LAX represents all that is good about the service culture in the US.
Check-in was quick and pleasant and we were offered an upgraded room. The beds were amazing and the room was huge. Concierge could not have been more helpful in the morning, helping to arrange a limo (amazingly cheap!) to Anaheim when we couldn't face taking the shuttle with a sick child.
We would highly recommend the Westin LAX.

This hotel is dated, dark and seems to exist on spin alone. Dark and dirty corridors, tiny room and pay $4 to make coffee in your room (no fresh milk included in the $4.) Not a safe area for a lady on her own. Met two English ladies who went home 5 days early due to the seediness of the hotel and location.
hotel_name: Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel - A Thompson Hotel

review_text: I stayed there for 1 night during the week. I checked in and felt like I was checking into a hotel that rents by the hour. The front desk agent was nice, but even though I confirmed a room with 1 king bed, she said the didn't have any available and could put me in a room with 2 double beds (smoking) I told her that was unacceptable and that was not what I confirmed. She immediately gave me an attitude and then miraculously found a Handicapped room, non smoking with a king bed, but she then wanted me to pay more! I refused and she finally gave me that room at the quoted rate. Not my idea of fun. The parking lot was also pretty bad, small spots and I had to park far away from the registration area. Then haul all my luggage through the parking lot, on an elevator and down a long hallway.

review_title: Another Decent HIE, Good West LA Location
review_text:
This is a standard HIE, but has a good location in West LA, right on the 405 (i don't like that road). Rooms seemed nicer than most HIE's, but a bit smaller.
The one negative that they didn't have their signature crack cocaine,... err, I mean, cinnamon rolls, and assuming I was only there that one night, lied and told me the would have them tomorrow. The next day, no cinnamon rolls. The lady that sets up the breakfast, who barely speaks any English, gave me the exact same line (she seemed to know that sentence in English quite well, like she's said it many times before). I approached the front desk and was given some excuse about a hurricane (yep, BS), but recognizing that when someone doesn't want to do something, one excuse is just as good as another, I voiced my dismay and moved on. But seriously, if your marketing campaign hindges on billboards advertising huge pictures of cinnamon rolls, then you better have some @#&$! cinnamon rolls!!! (you see, it is like crack cocaine,... not that I would know).
Other than that, I'd stay there again. One of the cheaper, decent places in that area.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express West Los Angeles

review_text: Stayed here from 3rd Sept for 4 nights, Our travel agent stuffed up as we were suppose to stay in hollywood not in West LA. Deciding to make most of it we were impressed with our overall experience, nothing was to much trouble for Grissel and Sharon on the front desk, all the other staff were also very pleasent, the rooms were neat and tidy, the shower was excellent after a long day of exploring, the continental breakfast was a great way to start the day, the beds were also fine. Subway is across the road next to seven eleven, with star bucks just up the road, and the bus service at the door for your short bus ride to Santa Monica Pier, I must say I was some what surprised at some of the negative comments on trip advisor. Thanks again Grissel for all your help we had a great stay.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express West Los Angeles

review_text: Love this place soo much! Staff were very friendly and could not do enough for you. The service we received was the equivalent to the service you receive in a five star hotel. The hotel was full of character and the staff added to it's ambience! The rooms were very unique although the bathrooms were very small which is our only complaint. Will definitely be back here!

This hotel is smart, tidy and in the process of being renovated.
I have stayed here 3 times in the past year and never had any major issues, my only complaint is the lack of security safes in the rooms.
Within the hotel is a hertz rental car desk and there is a frequent free shuttle to the airport,

Enjoyed the 3 nights we stayed here. The rooms are clean, beds are great but the decor in the rooms needs updating. It is a non smoking hotel but the colour on the Walls looks like nicotine yellow! I can heartily recommend the room service burger which was the best burger I have ever eaten! The airport transit bus is great, runs frequently and is close. Recommend getting out to manhattan beach which is lovely.

review_title: A motel on Hollywood blvd. Good value for money
review_text: It's a motel right behind kodak theatre. What more can one ask for. It's clean, simple, no frill, has a 60s feel to it and hs good service. Breakfast is served in the main lobby and can be taken to the room itself. Rooms are decent size as well. All in all, good value for money if you want to see Hollywood attractions but don't want to spend a lot.

Stayed there one night in
August and i am sorry to say that if you are looking for a hotel near the airport then it is just what you need ...now if you are looking for a nice comfortable and modern place to stay just try a different one...foubd the furniture,carpet and bathroom outdated and that is just not what i waz expecting from a westin

Other reviews accurately depict the poor quality of the rooms and service. I agree that this is a dumpy hotel with the Westin brand on it. What other reviewers have not mentioned is the exorbant prices for things like parking ($24), wifi ($12.96), etc. You are kind of stuck here without other options. I usually never spend on incidentals and I am SPG Gold. I picked the property due to the name and low rate but will never return. After reading the positive reviews it is clear that the management is somehow affecting those. No reasonable human being could look at this property and think it was good.

review_title: Best Hollywood experience a family could ask for.
review_text: The staff were amazingly friendly and helpful, location is brilliant. I stayed in alot of different accommodation during my three weeks in USA including five star in las Vegas and it's the hollywood celebrity hotel which was my favourite.

It has all the convenience associated with Residense Inns (kitchen area, breakfast included, spacious) but overpriced due to location.
They didn't clean our rooms during entire stay (one day they offered to do so at 5 PM, but we didn't want to have to leave the room then...)
The place is gloomy! And for being in Beverly Hills, it makes you sad to go back inside your room at the end of the day!
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Beverly Hills

review_text:
stayed here one night after an 11 hour flight from New Zealand (and nearly as long through LAX immergration!) The shuttle drivers are extremly helpful and friendly (top marks to them!) check in was efficent and the rooms simple but comfortable and the beds excellent. (As a person with serious back issues this is of utmost importance to me) The rooms were also quiet......no noise from neighbouring rooms and that is such a pleasant change and no aircraft noise to speak of. We dined in the hotel resturant and were pleasantly surprised by that as well as hotel food is not our favorite....the Tuscan Chicken was very good.
We are extensive travellers and though not posh it offered a very good nights sleep after a moderately long journey.

review_title: All the Good and Bad of a hotel in the 80s
review_text: A big hotel near the airport with a regular shuttle bus. Check in was fast and efficient. Everyone is friendly and smiling. Great coffee maker and toiletries and everything was clean. But they forgot to remove a used ear bud left conspiciously on the table. Nice lounge and room overlooking the airport.The decor is old and the bathing shower switch was anti-logic. The ceiling is low and the big CRT TV hung around like a decor, much to my amusement. The lift cranks crazily up and down but I understand that an upgrading is underway. Some aircraft sounds still permeates into the hotel but is ok for me. The club lounge is so so and no free internet despite booking a Towers (club) room. They wanted $12.99 a day for that. Overall an ok hotel for its price but don't expect a sleek wait-on-you-hand-and-foot Asian style hotel.

review_title: No problems grand but expensive for what u get
review_text: The hotel was probably the place to be in the 1970's and 1980's but it has become very outdated. The rooms are good as is the service and the staff, they charge for wifi which is a no no in the 21st century. It is well located for access to the metro.

review_title: I always stay here when I go to LA, best ever!
review_text: I love this hotel. I always feel like a VIP. You're met at your car, luggage taken care of and valet is great value. The lobby is beautiful and the concierge is always available to assist with ANYTHING. If you're a newby to LA they can assist you in finding tours that pick up at the door and return you after your tour. The pool area is beautiful and the jacuzzi needs some TLC but I dealt. The heavenly beds are truly heavenly and the free toiletries are good, soap was great (the simple things). I would recommend this hotel to anyone wanting to stay in luxury for a fantastic price.

I always try to stay at Marriotts when away from home, but this was my first time at a Residence Inn. My wife and I were very impressed with the over all experience, from check-in to check-out. The Beverly Hills location is centrally located for the areas attractions, but is still easy to move in and out of. The staff was very patient and pleasant, even during the free breakfast rush hour, which would distroy a lesser person. The rooms are amazingly clean and organized. They have a modern feel, and are spacious and comfortable. We really enjoy the idea of a kitchenette so there is not always the need to leave to find food. Overall our experience was outstanding, this has become our new weekend get away spot.
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Beverly Hills

review_text: We stayed fire couple of days. Room service was good. People who worked there were polite. We could really enjoy the stay because of the patio. We had a really good time

We needed a nice place that was close to the airport. It has a good restaurant in the lobby but can be pricey, so nearby is Denny's, taco bell and Carl jrs. You can also catch the number 3 bus from Carl jrs to Santa Monica pier. 
The kids loved the pool. They also have a free airport shuttle to and from the airport. 
The rooms were clean and linen fresh.
We liked our stay.

review_title: The staff and service were excellent
review_text: Hotel and staff were great. Really loved the beer selection at the bar
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Los Angeles International Airport

review_text: Really liked this hotel. About 5 minutes of lax in the free shuttle bus. Didnt even feel the airplanes! Personel was friendly and kept our luggage for some hours free. I wish they had some cheaper place to eat in hotel.

This was my second stay here this year. The staff, management, and valet are courteous, which all makes for a pleasant stay. Again the hotel is perfectly situated for West Hollywood, Beverly Hills, and really anywhere in the LA area. You are walking distance from Beverly Hills shops and restaurants. Also near the hotel is a supermarket which is convenient as the rooms are suites with kitchenettes. Located on the corner of Pico Blvd., can take you anywhere in the LA area if you want to avoid freeways. But the 10 to the coast and the 405 to the airport or the Valley are also nearby. Made to order omellets and a full breakfast is served everyday. Every night there is a complimentary buffet dinner with red and white wines as well as soft drinks and beer. You're also less than 5 minutes from the West Hollywood nightlife and shops and short drive to the Beverly shopping center and the Nordstrom center. Also a short drive to Hollywood sightseeing, or the thrilling hike at Runyon Canyon Park which makes for a great workout. Free wifi in the rooms and hotel computers with printers for guest use. What more can I say!? I absolutely recommend this hotel.
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Beverly Hills

review_text: Hotel is in great location not to far from Beverly Hills shopping. Very professional and courteous staff!
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Beverly Hills

review_text: The hotel was great and was in a great location, but a bit far from where most of our sightseeing was. Factor's Deli across the street had awesome sandwhiches, but a bit pricy though. The free buffet in the morning really helped us save money and made my stay a whole lot better! But it also has a Ralph's which is about a two minute walk from the hotel where you can get all of your groceries you need. The only bad part about the hotel was the sleep. About every 20 minutes the air conditioning would come on and it was loud. The first night it kept waking me up and I couldn't get to sleep. The second night I decided to sleep on the pull out bed in the couch. It was a little bit better but you could still hear it and it was not confy at all. The third night I decided to sleep on the pull out bed again but put it on the floor because I thought it would be more confy, but I was wrong. The forth night I decided to sleep in the bed that I slept in on the first night because there was nothing I could really do about it. In all of the hotels I have stayed at in my entire life, I have never had a worse sleep than that - they have to fix it! If you don't mind about the air conditioning then this would be an awesome hotel for you, but if you do mind, then don't stay here. I gave it a four out of five because of the good location, clean rooms, free buffet etc.
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Beverly Hills

review_text:
The only downfall to this hotel was paying a different price each night for the room. The most being $129.00. If I have to make another trip to LA I will stay here the entire trip. I was at each destination(Hollywood, beaches) within 15-20 minutes. 
Service, good and gift shops were superior and parking garage was good too.

Really liked my stay. Staff was very good, no attitude. Everything worked. The lobby is being redone/upgraded. Friends ate at the lobby restaurant ("Daily Grill") and gave it rave reviews.
Noise #1- air traffic. Obviously comes with the territory. My room was on the north side and had only a hint if noise. I noticed more noise when on the south side that LAX was using for takeoffs . ( these runway pattern change, i assume, so don't bank on them.)
Noise #2- the noise from the next roon was substantial coming under the floor gap in the adjoining door. Only an issue if the next room is noisy when you want to sleep.

I really like The Hilton chain but was disappointed on a couple of fronts here. The room wasnsupposed to be non smoking but smelled very bad upon entry. I was too busy and could not change rooms. The front desk staff on both check in and check out just didn't measure up. I had about 16 rooms and documentation previously sent could not be found. On check out I was forced to check out rooms individually as opposed to a group reservation which I was told would not be an issue to provide. Wasted a lot of my time. May consider another property until this one gets it together...

Until we moved to LA we stayed in this hotel several times a year for 5 years. Since then we have had visitors stay at this Residence Inn. I assure you that this hotel is VERY clean, well maintained and has comfortable beds. Our main concern is cleanliness and you won't go wrong here. The management is wonderful, caring and the manger has gone out of his way to help us many times. Stay here when you come to town. It was indeed our "home away from home" whenever we came from NY......BigMetsFan
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Beverly Hills

review_title: Nice lobby old rooms but a great deal
review_text: Stayed for a night when we were going to Anaheim. Rooms are old and not very clean, no specific complains but some renovation could help. Very nice lobby, great breakfast. Great value if staying for a night.

review_title: Great Experience. Very clean and elegent room.
review_text: Great stay. Comfortable bed and very clean. No noise from airport considering I was only across the street from airport.

review_title: Arrogant manager - terrible customer service - stay somewhere else
review_text: This hotel is below average despite there claims of a refurbishment. Gym is tiny and has a strange smell. The "manager" Robby, is possibly the rudest Marriott employee I have ever come across, extremely arrogant and unhelpful when I questioned charges to my bill, and contradicted everything his staff had told me, and then said "well we did give you a free upgrade" - that was not out of the goodness of your heart Robby, that is because I have stayed 38 nights at Marriott hotels in 2011.
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Beverly Hills

review_text: I stayed here in May & June 2011 and will stay here anytime I am in LAX. The rooms are great, the beds are more than heavenly and the staff is outstanding! I have nothing bad to say about this hotel at all! Location is great and the $5 round trip trolley is a great bonus! Every single staff member I encountered was friendly and would do anything to make your stay pleasant!

My 13 month daughter and I stayed her in late July. We had a great stay, From Sonny and Christopher getting us checked in quick and easy, to Maria cleaning up after us in the tower lounge for two days and always smiling, security always posted in the lobby ready to answer any question you have, thx Sonny,Christopher,Maria.

I am a loyal Starwood Preferred Guest and was definitely not treated as one. They did not help me in Preferred Guest line, barely made an effort to help at all at the front desk. My room was half cleaned, it just felt dirty all around so didn't even do any good to change rooms. The workout center was also dirty. They charged me for the refreshment center in my room because something was missing when I arrived so they restocked it the next day... I didn't even touch it! All around worst Westin I've stayed in.

review_title: A nice hotel with crappy ammenaties
review_text:
I stayed at this hotel because the airlines screwed up and gave me a voucher to spend the night while they sorted out their problems. Having stayed at embassy suites before I expected the same level of service I had received at their location in Tyson's Corner on Northern Virginia. 
The hotel is clean with a great location and a shuttle running to the airport but there's a few things that don't sit right with a hotel chain such as this. The hotel requires that you pay for your wifi, a simple aspect of your stay that even the crappiest of roadside motels gives you for free. In addition, only about half if the channels on the tv were clear. Normally these are things I would t care about but airport hotels have nothing near by. Especially of you are a pedestrian. A working tv and free wifi are not a lot to ask

review_title: Dated but good hotel in dead part of downtown
review_text:
Great place if you're having a conference there or nearby but not if you want easy access to tourist spots.
Pros
- great public transport access to different buses & metro
- good room size
- quite helpful concierges
- take any of the 4 areas of elevators to access your room - the yellow ones were used in the 'true lies' movies
Con
- takes forever to get to anywhere 
- dated decor
We scored a deal with priceline for this stay. Took supershuttle from airport. You can also access free wifi by picking up a nearby signal at the flower St entrance.

review_title: Excellent hotel really made my trip to Los Angeles amazing
review_text: I stayed here for 11 nights and have not got one bad word to say. From day one the staff at reception were extremely helpfull, one person even let me use their mobile when my phone wasn't working. Rooms were lovely and house keeping was emaculate. Beds were comfy , had a nice tv in room aswell . The hotel had many restaurants so I always had a nice breakfast and dinner . Nice pizza place in there as well which was cheap. Hotel was really close to everything aswell was only a 5 minute walk to the metro and was only 15 minutes from Hollywood. Eveything you needed was on your doorstep here. I thought the hotel looked amazing , the design was really great. was really nice to walk into a nice friendly clean and really cool looking hotel after a long 10 hour flight! I would most definatley stay here again when I come back to LA )
Hotel is nice with new remodel rooms and lobby looks good and staff is friendly. Nice hotel to stay.
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Beverly Hills

review_title: Convenient location to airport with free shuttle and breakfast
review_text: Good as airport hotels go, very clean and spacious. Breakfast buffet is free and offers a good selection of items. No soy milk.

Like many other Embassy Suites we had a great breakfast, friendly hotel staff, very nice common areas. The room we had was facing the airport. It sounded like the jets taking off right under our window! It was the noisiest room I have ever stayed in!

review_title: Excellent staff! Jasmine made my stay!
review_text: I don't even know where to start. The staff is so amazing especially Jasmine! She handled all of my crazy request and didn't complain when I asked for more!! Everyones so nice and so helpful from valet, to front desk, to the bellman! I love this hotel!

review_title: Day stay in transit at LAX
review_text:
I arrived at LAX after a 13hr flight and with a 10 hr transit. 
I walked out of the terminal and hopped on the first free hotel shuttle which happened to be the Hilton's one. 
I was offered a room for 8hrs with no hassle. $79. The bed was extremely comfy and the room clean as expected. It was the perfect way to have a 6hr snooze, a shower and refresh before continuing on the next part of my journey. Will definitely be doing the same thing when I pass through again next week.

Stated here for a quick overnight trip to LA. Found the property to be very clean & what you'd expect for an Embassy Suites property. 
Our room was recently refurbished with contemporary decor which was very attractive. My only gripe was that the walls, both interior & exterior, seemed to be made of paper, hence the overall rating of "3.". We were on the fifth floor & could hear every bit of traffic...thank goodness we were in the back of the building! I can't imagine being in a room that was facing onto Century Blvd/the airport! At 4 a.m. I was awakened by my next door neighbor's wake up call. 
All in all, I would probably stay here again, however, the Embassy Suites in nearby El Segundo (also near the airport) is quieter.

review_title: Even for an airport hotel this was bad
review_text: We had a short overnight stay, and a 45 minute wait to check in is unacceptable for any major chain hotel. If you are getting charged a full nights stay for just a few hours rest, and a chunk of that time is spent in a queue in the cold lobby, you are better of staying at the airport. Rooms were clean but dated but the service and staff attitude was hard to look beyond. I left a comment card, no response thus far.

The Embassy Suites LAX airport north is a very nice property. The lobby is very clean and comfortable. The elevators are the fastest I've seen at any Embassy Suites. The room was modern, spacious and comfortable. I ate in the restaurant and the food was good. The staff was very friendly. My only complaint is the Internet service. As an Hhonors Diamond, I get free Internet. Internet service in the lobby was painfully slow. Equally slow in my room on the 7th Floor, and in the bedroom I got no wifi reception at all.

review_title: Great place for coming and going from LAX.
review_text:
We have been here a few times over the past few years and love it. 
Convenient for arriving and departing for Cruises with free shuttle to and from the airport. 
Rates reasonable for the quality.
Lobby has free WiFi which is a nice touch.
Their breakfast buffet is the best I have ever had at a hotel. They had something for everyone. and the mattresses were better then the others we stayed at in ge area ad well.
I thank the staff at the LAX Westin for making me feel so welcomed and looking forward to my next trip into LAX. I will never stay elsewhere when I travel to the Los Angeles area.

review_title: Decent hotel, Not the greatest neighborhood.
review_text: Stayed here in between international flights. Shuttle service was great. Room was fine. Service in the in-house restaurant was great. If you go for a walk, the neighborhood wasn't the greatest but don't let that stop you from staying here. If you park on the premises, it should be fine. Thrifty rent a car is next door if needed. Very quiet - I would stay here again.

review_title: Close to the airport. Far from everything else.
review_text: I liked it, but I wouldn't stay there again. The service is ok, but not very helpful. The rooms were nice, but don't ever get sucked into upgrading it to a larger room to also include breakfast. The standard room is just as good and you're better off having breakfast down in the restaurant. It's close to the airport and the Hilton provides a free shuttle service to and from the airport, but it's far from everything, in terms of entertainment and shopping.

review_title: Top Notch Service at a Top Notch Hotel!
review_text: This hotel did a perfect job taking care of me as their customer! Clean, nice and a great experience!

review_title: So So hotel - not as good as I hoped
review_text:
The location is central hollywood and the Service is excellent - but the rooms only so so. The furniture a bit IKEA which is fine just not expected at the W
I was not impressed and checked out after 1 night

review_title: Old rooms but cheap and all you need for an airport hotel.
review_text: The lobby and bar are nice and spacious but the in-room bathrooms are in desperate need of an update. We stayed at a different LAX hotel with the same star rating a couple of weeks prior that was far superior for the same price.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Los Angeles International Airport

review_text:
Although we only stayed one night, our experience was excellent.
The valet was so helpful and getting our car the next day was super fast.
Love the hallway decor in this hotel, soothing and the paintings and lighting make it a nice walk to your room. 
The bathrooms are really big, the beds very comfortable.
The pool looked amazing, we didn't have time to use it. Hope to return again soon.

With a prime location on Hollywood Blvd, this hotel is definitely a place for partygoers. If you're not (like me, when on a business trip), well, go somewhere else!
First things first, I was there on business during Halloween weekend. The place was crawling with party animals... Both inside and outside! For some unknown reason, my room turned out to be very quiet even with in-room parties just Ã  few doors down the hallway! Travelling on business is very diffÃ©rent than travelling for leisure!
But the thing than bugged me the most is the HEAVY in-room mercantilsm! The rooms are mini-malls! You are afraid of being charged to use the soapbar in the washroom!
If you are a party animal with unlimited financial resources with a craving need to see and be seen, this is your place! If not, consider other options! As the tag attached to the spare roll of toilet paper says, you need a 
"back up plan"!

review_title: No customer service & Lots of attitude. Not worth the price!
review_text: I have stayed at many hip hotels. (Dj events, loud music, young & fabulous) such as hard rock san Diego, Mondrian LA. This hotel the staff act as if they are running a night club. The concierge has alot of attitude. No one says hello to you when you walk in. My phone in my room was not working. I had to call from my cell to have someone come up to fix the phone. Someone came up at 1am was in my room for 40 minutes, couldnt fix the phone. The next day I had to actually ask the bouncer(concierge lol) to send someone up to fix the phone. I got ALOT of attitude. The room was dark and very gloomy. The reason I fly to LA is for the sun. This hotel is not worth the price at all. No customer service and lots of attitude.

Hard to access, turn from 1 way street; hidden $25/day parking fee automatically added. Pretty lobby; good access to LAX. Burger king across street(6 lane blvd). Lots of walking, staff seemed undertrained, no free food ammenities, pay for everything. Very, very expensive, room fairly basic.I really expected more.

Il y a un supermarchÃ© en bas de l hÃ´tel, un diner et divers fast food et restaurant pas trop loin. Le restaurant de l'hÃ´tel est cher et pas trÃ¨s bon. This Embassy Suites property is one of the best! The location from LAX 
 can't be beat. Its only about a 5 minute ride on the hotel shuttle to the
 terminals. The property is clean, most rooms have been renovated, and
 the staff are nice. Also, this property offers a few extra items at
 breakfast which I don't notice at other ES hotels. Managers reception
 is good and the fitness center has good equipment.

review_title: The parking and Wi-Fi are expendive
review_text:
Stayed in this hotel for two nights last week. Generally speaking it is a nice hotel of good value, and the employees are trained very well and friendly. 
The overnight parking fee is high: $23 per night in the basement level, also there is no Free Wi-Fi as most of hotels are offering of this class. It is $9.99 per day for wireless Internet service.

I have just spent 3 nights at this hotel and I will stay here everytime while in LA. I had no rental car but the Lax transit center is just a short walk away so I was able to catch a bus every where I wanted to go. It's nice and close to all the beaches and offers a free shuttle to and from the airport. The staff were friendly, the room was very nice and if you needed to rent a car, they are all in walking distance of the hotel. Not much to do in the area but only a short cab ride to get anything you want.

Stayed one night at start of tour. Free shuttle bus from airport. Rooms large and beds really comfortable. Bathroom well stocked. Best breakfast ever. Carrot juice shots and freshly made omlettes. Free wi fi in lobby a bonus.

review_title: Great location, big room, helpful staff
review_text: Big, clean, spacious room. Bathroom is a little tight. Valet parking. Location is great for the Beverly hills area...not so much for Hollywood.

This hotel is wonderful. It is a true 4* property with excellent service and attention to detail. I was fortunate to win it on a Priceline bid for 60% off. All rooms have balconies and ours had a decent view. Bed was comfy.
X Bar had good happy hour specials and the bartenders were fantastic. John G remade my wife's blueberry mojito because it was watery and the second one was excellent. John from Venice gave us lots of great tips on restaurants. Can't remember the other guy's name but he was awesome too.
It is $36/day for valet parking. The so-called self parking is a 3rd party lot that is $24 with no in-and-out, according to the valet. Assuming that is true, valet is the only realistic option. The valets did a really good job and would bring the car out quickly. Hyatt also only charged me for 2 "nights" of valet parking, while some hotels would have tried to charge for the 3 calendar days. 
WiFi is free in the lobby or $10/day/device in the room.
Highly recommended!

review_text:
La cama tenÃ­a el colchÃ³n vencido solo estuvimos 2 noches alojados.
A nuestro criterio el hotel necesitarÃ­a una renovaciÃ³n en el mobiliario y la decoraciÃ³n.

We stayed in one of the "Fabulous" rooms, I think it was called. I loved the modern feel of the room and the whole hotel. The bed was awesome and really comfortable. The complimentary coffee the next morning was fantastic! We were however, very disappointed by the pool area. We went up to enjoy a drink and the view and ended up sitting there for about 15-20 minutes without being acknowledged once. The guy who was working up there made eye contact with me at least three times and still never came over to us. We ended up going downstairs and enjoyed drinks and appetizers in the outside area. The Kobe cheeseburger was amazing! My boyfriend and I still talk about it! Overall, we enjoyed our stay at the W and hope to enjoy it again sometime soon.

review_title: Terrible hotel - poor service with staff too busy managing functions to even notice they have hotel guests
review_text: Great pool, just a shame that they sell tickets to use it to the general public- makes it almost unusable for hotel guests! We had to sit on the floor because there were no seats by the pool

Hotel nelle vicinanze di Rodeo Drive, ma la zona offre ben poco per chi vuole vedere la vita di los angeles. Prima hotel. Op dit moment zitten ze in een verbouwing. Hier heb je op zich geen last van. Alles wordt blijkbaar strak en minimalistisch. De Lounche en bar is al klaar en ziet er netjes uit. Kamer zijn compleet; douche, wc, wasbak, koelkast, schrijftafeltje, bureaustoel, stoel en kluis. Een koffiezetapp. Ontbreekt. Aan de bar beneden is tot laat koffie of drankjes te halen. Auto parkeer je via de mannen voor heg hotel. Dit was bij onze reservering incl. Achter het hotel is een supermarkt, ook wel handig.
Qua locatie zit je aan de onderzijde van L.A. voor trips zal je dus veelal minimaal een 20min. naar boven moeten rijden. Vliegveld is afhankelijk van je kamer duidelijk te zien; leuk! Geluid heb je ziet zoveel last van... af en toe stijgt er een vliegtuig over, maar die vliegen niet over. 
Personeel is aardig en behulpzaam.

review_title: Thoughtful and friendly staff in a lovely hotel.
review_text: This was not my first stay in a Renaissance hotel, and we usually stay in a three or four star when we travel, however, this is the first time I have felt strongly inclined to leave a positive review. Upon arriving at the hotel, we were pleasantly greeted by the valets and directed to the front desk where our reservation was quickly found by a smiling young lady. Everything about our stay was welcoming and convenient, from the quiet elevators, plush furnishings, updated technology, and consistently friendly staff. The thing that stood out the most to me was the good nature of everyone we encountered. The valets were especially nice, as was our waiter in the hotel restaraunt and the woman working in the gift shop. Some may find the aircraft noise to be distracting, however considering the proximity to the airport, I doubt that the rooms could be made much quieter. As a matter of fact, the air-conditioning made louder noise than the incoming aircraft and is probably my only complaint about the room. Also, one time that housekeeping cleaned our room, our empty fast food milkshake cups were not removed and our lovely water glasses that we had been using were replaced with paper coffee cups, even though we didn't once use the coffee machine. Those few quirks were very minor and all in all we had an excellent and enjoyable stay. We were never bothered by the housekeeping and the entire staff that we dealt with were very hospitable and thoughtful. Highly recommend!

review_title: Classy Hotel all the way around....
review_text: This is my second stay here. This time, it was a layover to our honeymoon.....great service, gorgeous room....I highly recommend.
Funky hotel in a great location. The bars and restaurants are awesome, the staff are great and we will definitely be staying here again!!!
This hotel has a fun energy and cool decor. The staff was wonderful, helPful, and friendly. Maybe it's just LA, but the rates seem very high for what you get.

Parking sucks... Can you believe valet is cheaper if you need in and out and it is $36 a day... Crazy
Self park is $3 per 15 mins and max out at $24 with no in out privilege plus is a bit of walk and there is only stairs. Everything is extra including mini fridge.
Beautiful rooms and common areas. Service was excellent in all areas. Pool area lovely

review_title: Don't book this hotel if you are travelling as a family
review_text:
Please read carefully all the other traveller reviews.
This is not a hotel - it is a conference centre.
We stayed for 1 week and had only 1 day that was not disrupted by conferences. The first was a 3 day "remax" conference that took over large parts of the hotel and closed of many of the communal areas.... The second was a 3 day party organised by playboy for 400 guests and, this meant that the pool and outdoor area were off limits to regular guests - totally unacceptable when travelling as I was with small children.
None of this was mentioned by my travel agent and I was not offered any satisfactory form of compensation.
Otherwise the hotel is good, but please check with the hotel prior to booking that you won't suffer a similar disappointment / inconvenience.

I'm a Diamond member with Hyatt and this hotel was not up to standards of other Hyatt's. Our suite appeared very dated - old furniture, stains, etc. Cleanliness was poor too. There were hairs on the floor in both of our bathrooms. The Regency Club is very lacking in its offerings. Oh and they are extremely stingy with the honor bar. The attendant literally comes over and immediately asks for you to fill out the room charge slip. Even if you are planning to have another drink. Very awkward if you ask me. Parking for $36 is ridiculous and the walk from the self park $25 is long and very dark at night. Service standards need major improving...I walked up to the Front Desk and the clerk was chewing gum and literally popped a huge bubble right before saying "can I help you". All in all, there are much better places to stay while in LA.

review_title: Spacious rooms, good location& good value make up for the noisy environment
review_text: We spent Thansgiving weekend at this hotel and were generally pleased. The room was Huge and nicely appointed dual sinks, marble bath, big flat screen and fun memorabilia. All at a great price. I'd rate it a five but we were on the Franklin ave side and there's a lot of street noise. Nothing the room a/c doesnt sort of drown out, but you definately dont want your windows open Try to get a room on the opposite side away from the street. Finally- not much to recommend the downstairs coffee shop. Walk east a few blocks to The Oaks on Bronson fo awesome coffee and gourmet food.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Hollywood Hills Hotel

review_text: This hotel is located a few streets away from Hollywood Blvd and easy walking distance, but we felt unsafe walking home due to the beggers around the Blvd in the evening. The hotel was easy to find just off the 101. The rooms were very clean, LCD TV and coffee making facility's in the room. The beds were very comfortable and the bathrooms very nice with double walk in shower. Nice coffee shop attached to the hotel. We were charged 15$ for over night parking.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Hollywood Hills Hotel

review_text: If you are staying at the streetside of the building....it s sooo noisy I really couldn t sleep at night...it really was too much. They schould invest in soudproof windows....for the rest rather friendly ...lucky they are next door to the 101 coffeeshop ...fresh food,good service,no problem;otherwise getting a descent meal or breakfast seems to be hard to find over there....fast food no problem....but after a few days I've had enough hamburgers for a year....
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Hollywood Hills Hotel

review_text:
Pros- drais, living room, outdoor lounge are great to hangout. Great decor in main areas & rooftop pool is nice!
Cons- rooms were not as great as I was expecting from a W. We could not get into drais unless we bought a bottle. They did not stamp the guys & then two of our guys could not get back in. Drais staff are incompetent. 
Overall- I would say this is a great place to stay if u wan t to party all weekend.

review_title: Best hotel I have ever stayed in.
review_text: Great location! Very friendly... Beautiful room...

My 3 teenage girls and I stayed here for a couple nights. It is beautiful and will stay here again (normal hotel of choice has always been The Roosevelt.)
A+ valet service - very nice, professional and fast!
A+ front desk service - friendly & welcoming!
A+ room service
Beautiful hotel, rooms, restaurant and pool

review_title: Sufficient for an overnight stay, but needs renovations, especially carpeting
review_text: Only stayed one night for a business trip. Front desk was ok, but upon discovery of my Hyatt member status, they became friendlier. It was immediately noticeable that the carpeting needed to be thoroughly cleaned, or probably better yet replaced. The room was moderatley updated, but I would say other Hyatt Regencies have better upgrades. I didn't get to use the vouchers they gave me for free coffee , as there were 20 in line with the same vouchers and only 3 staff working the stand. Overall suffucient for the stay, but could use improvement. I wouldn't want to stay for an extended period as is.
Great little fine. Best value for money. Great location, excellent service, stayed here for 4 nights and had no issues at all
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Hollywood Hills Hotel

review_title: A gem still exists in LA Land
review_text:
On my travels and always staying at Hyatt I have stayed at this property several times over the years. I always feel like royalty driving up to valet. Great location.
The rooms are spacious and great for business travelers like myself. High speed Internet is excellent and business center available as well. Excellent location with a large mall around the corner and just centralized enough if most meetings are on the west side of town.
I can't say enough about the wonderful staff. From arrival to departure and everywhere in between attention to details and courteous friendly attentive staff makes this a great hotel.

Arrived very late on way to family Christmas. Shuttle from airport got me there efficiently. Easy checkin all as expected. Heavenly Bed is heavenly! Slept til wakeup call then easy checkout and on our way

review_title: Lovely hotel, but unfriendly (Platinum member review)
review_text:
This is a beautiful hotel, glamorously refurbished with stunning spacious marble bathroom and balcony. The receptionist checking us in was very nice and moved our room to one with a view of the pool and the MGM building which we appreciated. Â The location is great. Right next to upmarket shopping centre with excellent restaurants, Rock Sugar being our favorite.Â 
The pool area was great, the lobby gift shop and Starbucks were well stocked.Â 
Luis carried our luggage to our room and provided us with a charming introduction to Century Plaza. The bar staff in the lobby were very good but i have to say the Concierge staff were quite unfriendly, no smiles from any of them.Â 
The bellhops on the day we checked out were also unfriendly and really quite rude when we wanted to get my daughters jumper from a bag they were storing.Â 
The Concierge desk recommended a tour company called El Dorado which we booked for their 2.5hr celeb homes and Hollywood tour. It was very disappointing. I would definitely not recommend it. Of all the tours we did in Washington, Raleigh and Warner Bros, this was very disappointing. They don't seem to have a presence on Trip Advisor or I would have reviewed them there.
However I would still recommend this hotel overall for the rooms, the location and most of the staff and will stay there again when next in LA.

review_title: Don't complain about gas prices after paying parking fees
review_text: I just finished a stay at the regency. I'm a platinum member of hyatt and this hotel is a strong 4 diamond.the staff was very helpful and pleasant. The lobby bar waitress was preoccupied with herself and ignoring the customers. Could not get service. I think the name hyatt should be more visible as you don't even know it's a hyatt you just think is "century plaza hotel". The rooms were clean and everything was working. The tv should be larger. Great location just outside Beverly hills. The was over $30 per night. I think it the hotel should raise the room rate and advertise parking free. I loved having a balcony which you don't find in a lot of hotels these days. I have stayed many times at this hotel and would come back as it is a good value.

review_title: Best staff professional and extremely accommodating
review_text:
We checked in today to a very very busy hotel. No double beds were available as I had originally booked a king. With the kids it was very cramped to say the least. Esmeralda at the front desk was an angel sent, set us up in a room and promised me that by evening we would have two double beds as necessary. It is amazing to me that in a very booked hotel she was able to find a room. The valet Javier and bellman Jonh are also excellent professionals. I'm a gold passport member and will continue to honor Hyatt for many years to come. Their service and client treatment is unparalel . We have another 4 nights to go. Will definitely recommend to anyone and hope to return soon.
Carla Lacerda

Dont be fooled by the new renovations. The rooms look nice but the walls are paper thin with no sound proofing. I could hear the guy next door brushing his teeth. I also heard him with the friend he must have picked up at a bar. Even the tv couldn't drown out the noise. The staff here is very nice, I don't want them to be get a negative review since Luxe properties did not fix a problem I assume was inherited when they bought this old Holiday Inn. When I went downstairs at 3am and asked for a room with no one on either side they gave me a new key immediately. So disappointed in this stay.

review_title: Good choice for a clean, comfortable airport hotel.
review_text: While its a little dated and in need of modernization, this hotel is a good bet if you're looking for a clean and comfortable hotel at LAX. The rooms are very clean and quiet and, for an airpory hotel, it's fairly upscale. I wouldn't necessarily recommend it for a stay of more than two nights as the furnishing tend to be a little beaten up. For example, the desk in my room was wobbly.

Im a platinum Marriott member and this is one of the best properties I experienced. Especially happy with the treatment received at check in! Warm welcome and very quick. Can't figure out why Internet is free at budget properties and outrageously expensive at upscale properties.

review_title: Nice spot to stay when traveling through
review_text: Good location for layover. Great service and clean, comfortable rooms.
I dis like the 3 resturants in the lobby! Starbucks as well! Rooms clean quiet and add 25.00 for parking and 15.00 for internet!

What can I say, this hotel came at the end of a wonderful Highway 1 road trip for my wife and I. We got a great deal on price, but having stayed in hotels of this (apparent) standard before, we had certain expectations. Many of these were not met, so here's a summary of them.
Location: a hotel of this standard would be expected to be in a nice location. Don't be misled, the W is not in the cleaner, nicer West Hollywood area, but in the run down area of Hollywood Blvd, about a mile from the main Hollywood bustle. If you're into smoke shops, 'adult' shops and tattoo parlors, this is for you. If not, you may not (like us) enjoy the area so much. Surprising therefore that a 'designer' hotel would be located in this part of the city...in fact, we did not like the atmosphere outside of the hotel complex after dark.
The hotel complex: nice restaurants and bar areas (if you're happy to pay $15 upwards for a drink) but full of wannabe types and those who reckon it looks good to be seen in this place. We were unimpressed by this. Compared to hotels such as the Gamercy Park in New York this one seemed to try too hard to be something it wasn't. 
Rooms: nice room, not massive, but had a nice look and feel, retro-futuristic design. We really liked the room. We had a courtyard view, which was nicer than the view onto a parking lot or the rather run down hollywood and vine area. Also this aspect meant it was quiet at night,so we got good sleep.
Cleanliness: we couldn't honestly say whether our room was actually serviced or not. If it was, it was certainly a rushed job!
Overall, nice rooms, wrong location, a hotel which attracts wanabe A-listers, but tries too hard to be something the location won't allow it to be. A good 3-star hotel at best, with some good price deals at the moment. Just don't expect the same feel as Sunset Blvd or West hollywood here!

review_title: Good hotel near LAX value for money
review_text: Recent trip to US from Sydney stayed at LAX Marriott for 3 nights. Free shuttle to and from airport. Nice rooms with good views. Modern facilities pool gym etc. Free wifi in foyer area. Sports bar few restaurants. Done universal studios and hollywood LA tours great service pick up from hotel. Service was excellent. The hotel has nice ambience and surrounds. Plus comfy beds. Highly recommend.

Nice quiet room near lax . Staff was very nice and helpful. Rooms nicely decorated. My only complaint is the self parking fee of $27.50 there is a couple of parking places a block away for $11 a day The parking spot is one.

review_title: Never book a suite here if you need to sleep
review_text: It's 1:32am and the walls and bed are vibrating here on the 11th floor. I can deal with the Ed Hardy mainstreamers that this place caters to but my god. I have the fan on full blast and the water in my glass bedside is vibrating. Just awful.

review_title: If you want to get any sleep don't stay here.
review_text: I travel to LA about 6 times a year for business. This was my first stay in Hollywood. I frequent the W Hotel in Dallas so I decided to try the Hollywood location. BAD IDEA. I walk in on a Wednesday night to check in and had no idea what I'd gotten myself into. The lobby basically turns into a club at night full of a bunch of Hollywood wannabes. You can hear the music on the first few floors. I was put on the 11th floor in a room right next to the fitness center. All I heard all night was the sound of people running on the treadmill, and worse...the sounds of people dropping weights. It was so loud it sounded like someone was throwing bowling balls at our wall. Mix that in with the party goers outside yelling on the sidewalks and you're sure to get no sleep! I'm actually a young partier myself...but this was ridiculous. Its apparently the hot spot for locals to hang. I am a stylish woman with plenty of money yet still felt out of place and uncomfortable to even walk in the lobby. The staff was rude. The atmosphere is pretentious and snobbish and the locals make you feel unwelcome as a guest. The location is blocks away from any attractions or shopping on Hollywood Blvd. Overall...unless you want to party like Charlie Sheen or Guns N Roses don't stay here. Its not worth the money.

This was perhaps one of the most upscale hotels I have ever stayed in and it was an absolutely amazing experience! I have no complaints what so ever and I cant wait to be back in LA to stay at my favorite W again!

review_title: If you don't mind the long shuttle bus wait time and poor bell boy service upon arrival, this place would be excellent.
review_text:
Arrived at LAX after a long 16 hours flight/transit and had to wait 40 minutes for the shuttle bus to arrive. During the wait we saw Hilton shuttle bus passed us by 3 times. 30 minutes through the wait, we call the hotel but were plainly told there should be one coming. We were told that the shuttle bus usually takes 30 to 45 minutes. When the shuttle did arrived, there were so many hotel guests that wanted to get in and some just couldn't because it was full. Unfortunate for those that couldn't get on, they would have to wait again that 30-45 minutes. 
Upon arrival on the hotel, there was no bell boy at sight or any on standby to greet us to see if we need any assistance. We had to go for a hunt for one. Most guests just unhappily haul their own luggages.
Except for the two services mentioned above, all other services we experienced were excellent. The room was clean even thought it look old. The breakfast was way above excellent. The waitress was extremely helpful and friendly. We were very impressed. The fitness room was well equipped with ample supply of fresh towers.
Overall, we love this hotel as a great rest stop that's close to LAX if only we could ignore the lengthy shuttle bus wait time and poor arrival greetings.

review_title: Quite close to living like a local
review_text: I stayed at Venice on the beach with a friend in November 2011 and I lived it. The location is just unbelievable. No sign of cars and the only thing between us and the beach was a walking path running along the beach, a stone throw away from the canals and some really cool little restaurants. It dud feel like we were part of the community and not tourists. For me this is the best asset of this tiny little hotel. On the down, rooms are on the small size but functional and with personality. The owner is a great chap willing to help in ant possible way and made us feel welcome and relaxed. A small tip for the area: every Tuesday night there is live music at the Brig on Abbot Kinney blvd. The band we saw was a fantastic contemporary blues gang that improvised everything they played. The crowd was also cool and very friendly and talkative to non locals.

review_title: Fantastic hotel after a long flight.
review_text: We stayed at this hotel as it was one of the nearest to the airport. from Leaving our house to getting to the LA hotel was 24.5 hours and all we wanted to do was sleep. Pity that's all we did as the room or suite should I say (we only booked a room through Thomas Cook at Â£58) we could have stayed all fortnight. It was one of the best rooms I have ever stayed in and the freebies in the bathroom were ace. I would recommend it to anyone.

review_title: Typical Marriott, to thrills, but no bad surprises either.
review_text: If you're used to full-service Marriotts and need an LAX airport stay, this may be a choice for you (but check adjacent Renaissance first!) - all you can expect from the chain, at sometimes high prices (location). Stayed there many times and prices can jump up and down, unless you've got company rate. Overall, very decent choice around LAX.

review_title: Don't sleep in a room next to the elevators!!
review_text: We (2 adults and 1 child(2years) got a room (1210) direct next to the elevators!! Result was: al night hard noise from the elevators. It is so loud that we could not sleep (because of early flight we had to stand up at 5 am). It was better if we kept the 130 dollar and slept on the airport.....

review_title: Good location close to Beverly hills and great shops
review_text:
Check in was quick and allowed early check in at 10am which I was very grateful after long haul flight
Rooms comfortable and clean. 
15 min walk to Beverly hills and bus stop outside hotel for Santa Monica line. Westfield shopping centre next door with great shops
Would recommend this hotel

We had a pleasant 3 day stay and enjoyed the location and proximity to restaurants and it was a short walk to bus no.1 to Santa Monica with a stop near the visitors centre. We had the use of computer and printer also appreciated the free wi-fi. Tea, coffee and chocolate were available at all times along with fruit and rolls.

review_title: A hidden treasure with amazing views and a friendly atmosphere
review_text: Location was great - close to LAX airport but not so close that you hear airplanes all day and night.. Quite the opposite! Lovely quiet end of the neighbourhood which somehow manages to feel private but still right on the beach, next to a lively set of shops, bars, and restaurants, and only a short walk to Santa Monica pier. No problems parking our hire car in the hotel spaces and we loved the location. The bed was so comfortable with a tempur style mattress, and the hotel manager Greg was great; really friendly, always available, and made sure that we had everything we needed for a great stay. A selection of bagels, fresh coffee, tea making facilities were available all day and the roof terrace was such a nice place to sit and watch the world go by. Room was clean and ready on arrival. We just wish we had more time to stay there!

I stay here all the time because my company books me there. 
The hotel is really pretty nice all on all. It is difficult to communicate with alot of the staff because of the language barrier but overall it's clean and comfortable. 
The shuttle service is a 
subcontractor called Destination Shuttle Services. They are the weak link. It can take from 25-45 minutes for a 10 minute rude to the airport or back. You can call the hotel all day and they'll just say " 10 more minutes" 
I would stay here if I hada rental car or alot of spare time
Allow an hour to get to the airport if you don't want to be rushed.

Marriott LAX was great location. Very centrally located. Was there for a conference at the LA Convention Center. Free LAX shuttle. Used local car service as apposed to renting. It was cheaper than rental and parking. Staff was friendly and Comceirage Lounge was well stocked and had a great breakfest for MR customers.

Stayed in La Petite Suite which is small (as the name would suggest) but perfect for two.
We were able to check in early for a small fee which was welcomed after the long flight.
The bed is one of the most comfortable I have slept in, and the whole place is clean with good use made of the space.
Located in a residential area, and a short walk to the Hollywood Blvd and close to public transport.
This was far better than a non descript hotel.
Comfy, homely and great value in a good location. It was a pleasure to return to each day.
Highly recommended and would stay here agian without hesitation.

Stayed in the petite suite on 9/10 for a night after watching a concert at the Greek Theater. Very small but cozy & cute. Perfect for 2 people. They have a binder set up with nearby attractions, taxi services, maps & take out menus. It's like having your own little apartment in the city. Very highly recommended, I wish we would have stayed longer.

After a cross-country flight, all I wanted was to snack on Pringles and soak in the bathtub. Pringles were tasty but there were several black hairs in the tub so I didn't want to use it :( Everything else about the room was great.

Veramente un ottimo brunch! Servizio cortesissimo, soprattutto i parcheggiatori. Le camere sono normali, abbastanza piccole e dotate di un bagno abb scomodo.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Hollywood Hills Hotel

review_title: Good location, great staff, dated property
review_text: Good location for business, and the staff are great. The rooms are kind of institutional though. Fairly large but old furniture and finishes. The furniture is a bit banged up, but fine. Just not a super high end experience. Fitness room is ok -- I'd say 8-10 cardio machines and a few weight machines. It overlooks the pool and hot tub area which is clean but unfortunately looks out over a parking garage. Breakfast was good and on time and the delivery guy great. There is a mall about a 10 min walk away with several restaurants and lots of stores. Hotel bar is not great for single travelers -- more of a lounge with lots of tables. They do a nice happy hour thing with food and some music though. All in, nothing negative to say, just doesn't quite live up to the intercontinental image.

El hotel es decadente. Pense Que solo por dos Dias estaria bien hospedarme ahi con mi familia. Lei las critics de Tripadvisor y lo catalogaban bastante bien pero no se lo recomiendo a nadie es malisimo
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Hollywood Hills Hotel

review_title: A beautiful hotel with a warm and welcoming staff determined to make your stay a special one.
review_text:
From the moment your vehicle pulls into the driveway of this beautifully designed and very well managed hotel, you will know you are truly a guest and not merely a customer. Parking attendants, bellmen, frontdesk personnel, housekeeping staff, the telephone operator -- each, it seems, wants you to know that this is a happy place and your happiness is the objective of his or her work. Perhaps this is most obvious in the dining areas, where each staff member offered a cheery welcome 
and courteous attention in an elegant room where Assistant Manager Laura Vezan seemed ever present to offer cheerful oversight of the service of highest quality food and drink. In every way, this luxury hotel is committed to making the classic hotelier's mission its own: "to invite someone is to take charge of his happiness while he is under your roof." Five stars all the way!

review_title: Funky, smaller hotel in a great location.
review_text: We booked via expedia and got a great deal on rates. Big, comfortable bed and good size room. Convenient location, and the Tart restaurant attached was great for breakfast and dinner. The Grove shopping complex is just across the road. The staff were friendly and helpful and the place had a good atmosphere.

I was very pleased by the service, the info, the place, everything just great, from the moment I gave the keys to the valet parking guy to the moment I checked out. The people at the front desk greeted me awesome, and I even got an upgrade to a room with a very nice view to the city. And after a long day visiting around I came to the restaurant and the food was great and the service even better. In all I will say staying here was a great choice. Staying here again in my future visit to the city.

review_title: Great location, good hotel, to be recommended but pricey
review_text:
We stayed with our two kids for 6 nights in the hotel. We re
Ally appreciated the service by the staff and the location of this hotel is ideal. With fairfax, melrose and beverrly arounf you cover shopping, eating out and sightseeing without too much effort. Framers Market is on the other side of the road and a great solution for breakfast, lunch and dinner. 
Rooms are on the expensive side but ok in comparison to other hotels/motels around. Why such a high parking fee in the automobile xity par excellence we haven't understood but parked our car less than 5 minutes away on the street.
The pool is very small and not heated, as wel as in the shade but good enoughnto cool down. Rooms are fine even for four people. 
We willc ome back here, especially forma price around USD 200 which would be fairer than the USD 269 per night we paid.

Excellent location and some delightful staff who are genuine and kind. Some staff probably need to be reminded that they have a job there as opposed to own the place but this is a handful. Excellent quality food, great variety and probably best hotel food I have eaten worldwide.
Great size rooms, but they are in need of refurbishment.
Walking distance to Rodeo Dr - excellent open air mall Westfield 10min walk. Open air tourist bus stops at front door.
I would stay here again in a heartbeat! The best value and excellent service.

What a horrible experience ranging from the customer service of staff to the rooms! Rooms were dirty and ripped sheets, stains on walls and floors..rip off parking charges an wifi charges..staff were rude and unpleasant totally ruined my stay and will NEVER stay here again!

I stayed here recently with my family and would highly recommend the Intercontinental to anyone staying in the Century City area. 
Service was top-notch from the valet on arrival to the desk staff at checkout.
We took advantage of the complimentary car and driver ( a beautiful Mercedes) to enjoy dinner at nearby Westfield Shopping Center.
The room and view from balcony was also well appointed and clean.

review_text: Eine wahnsinnig tolle Hotel Lobby-sehr prunkvoll. In unserem Chicago Urlaub zwar das kleinste aber wirklich aller bequemste Bett insgesamt. Sehr freundliches Personal. Badezimmer sehr klein. DafÃ¼r eine riesige Badewanne und tolle KÃ¶rperpflegeprodukte. Ein schÃ¶ner Schreibtisch im Zimmer. Begehbarer Kleiderschrank. Das nutzen von Internet wird auch extra abgerechnet. Es kann sein das im Hotelflur ein Loch in der Decke ist und Wasser von der Decke tropft!

Before makin my trip I read some reviews about the angeleno, and was expecting unhelpful staff,,, but that we encountered was extremely helpful, polite, chatty, friendly staff in all parts of the hotel!! It was the other guests being extremely rude, ignorant, and nasty,,,!! I don't think I heard one guest thank the waiting staff for the food,, which I find really rude... The hotel is clean, fresh, extremely modern, the pool area is great with ambient music drowning out the noise from the freeway, excellent place to chill and relax,, food and views are amazing in the west bar on the 17th floor!
Even the freeway is extreme and loud as soon as the door is shut you can barely hear it. All in all a fabulous start to our holiday and a big thankyou to the angeleno staff for your hard work,,, keep it up :-)

review_title: The most fantastic place you can stay at!
review_text: My stay at Howard was the most amazing. Their service is very welcoming! I felt comfortable. They attended to all my needs. I am definitely going back!!! I recommend it to everyone
