review_title: Great location just a drive away from Santa Monica...
review_text:
Everything was exceptional except the air conditioner was noisy! Immaculately clean and big spacious rooms w amazing beds and fab bathrooms.
I would stay again for sure.

Stayed 4 nights in room 104. Room was a good size with a fridge, tv and nice bathroom. Hotel has been recently renovated so it is all modern. Free car parking. Area seemed safe. Spa was closed due to maintenance. Foyer area is very nice and breakfast was adequate. Staff are very friendly and helpful. We had a car so transport downtown was no problem. Not sure what the public transport is like in the area but LA does lack in that department compared to other large cities in the USA. For us clean is important and this hotel ticked all the boxes.

review_title: Wasn't on holiday was the only draw back
review_text: My company paid for me to attend a conference in LA and they picked a cracking hotel great food great staff great room just a shame I was working will be going back but this time on holiday

I stay here once a month even though I live 10 minutes away because I treat myself. It's so cheap but so clean. I'm shocked how cheap it is considering they have excellent facilities. I highly recommend them

We're loyal Marriott clients but were lucky to find this hotel on Hotwire. We came in on a weekend to catch our daughter's musical at UCLA.
The staff is genuinely friendly and aims to please. Access to UCLA is the best.
Shower head could use some improvement. 
We requested a room away from highway 405 and had no trouble with noise.
Would use this hotel again in a heartbeat.
Stayed here one night. Great deal in a good Valley location. Two blocks to Topanga Mall, many dining locations in walking distance.

This hotel is great if you're visiting UCLA and the surrounding areas. The pool area is great way to soak some of that southern california sun. It has all the amenities the W chain has to offer, although this one is one of the older properties. This W is quieter than most, as it is situated in a neighborhood and not in an urban area like the others.

review_title: Nice, affordable and clean with a friendly, accommodating staff. My third stay while moving my son in and out of his first year
review_text: The staff is really friendly and courteous. The rooms have always been very clean and comfortable. Had an issue with noise from an adjoining room during this stay that was quickly resolved by the front desk. Well worth the affordable price.

review_title: What a great place to stay this is
review_text:
I stayed here for 8 nights and im so glad i did. I felt very safe here.
The staff here are very friendly and amazingly helpful.
Its in a good location.
The only downfall is the rooms have no safety deposit boxes but dont let that put you off staying here, you wont regret it :-)

review_title: Nice but not my first choice for a family with kids.
review_text:
The hotel is tucked in an industrial park and I was kindly greeted by the valet team. These guys were great and helpful! 
If not for the fact that I had 2 family members in a wedding party this would not have been my first choice to stay with 3 kids. This facility doesn't have a pool and the standard double bed rooms only have full size beds. I was able to upgrade at a fair rate and the accommodations worked out nicely. 
The room was clean, the hair dryer did not work, and the beds were not as comfortable as I thought they should be..but all that aside this is a beautiful hotel with a great staff.

I have stayed at this hotel several times over the past two years while traveling for business. Each time I am greeted by friendly valets and front desk staff. The rooms are always very clean and well serviced, quiet and beds are comfortable. Overall this is one of my favorite Hilton properties mainly due to the staff. They are professional, friendly and helpful. I would like to provide special thanks to Rosie in the exec lounge who goes the extra mile to help you relax at the end of a long day. Also to the morning crew at the the restaurant they all so attentive and helped me start each day with a smile. 
As an HHonors diamond member I stay at alot of hilton properties and as I said this is one of my favorites. Kudos to the management for employing such a great team of people.

In and out for a quick business meeting, overnight from NYC en route to Boston.
This place is fabulous. Wonderfully accommodating staff, hi-tech rooms with all the latest. Plenty of plugs. Great wifi connectivity. Quiet, comfortable. I can't say enough about this new (to me) Starwood Preferred Guest hotel.
I'll be back...
ATBster

Atul and Sheela Vanmali are ultimate hosts which was reflected in the natural and effortless hospitality they and their staff offered to this weary traveller. The overall experience and accommodations were great -- thanks Andy, Sheela, night and morning front desk, and housekeeping!

review_title: Okay, but plenty of other hotels better!
review_text:
On checkin, the front desk did not explain parking other than saying, yes you can self park. We ended up paying each time we exited the first day and were charged $8 on top of the $14 a day charge. When we asked the desk how this was supposed to work, they said they should have set us up for self park & they were sorry they could not offer a refund. 
The hotel has no pool, which is odd.
Upon checkout, the front desk lady was not friendly & acted like she didn't care for her job. I don't like giving poor reviews, but when a few negatives add up, I will. There are plenty of other hotels to choose from.

Abbiamo pernottato in questo hotel per 2 notti al nostro arrivo a LA. Nel complesso la struttura e' imponente e molto curata nelle aree comuni. Le camere rispetto al contesto generale sono poco curate e poco pulite. Il personale e' alla mano. Ls colazione internazionale scarsa per il prezzo alla quale e' proposta. Servizi generali buoni. Location comoda soprattutto all'arrivo.
Excellent customer service. Very large comfortable suites.
Great hotel nestled near UCLA. This hotel does a great job with a unique location. The pool area is great, the room service awesome. It's my favorite hotel in Los Angeles. Very helpful staff.

review_title: Mediocre Hotel with trendy aspirations that fails to deliver.
review_text:
Stayed for four nights. I travel extensively (globally) and have normally loved W hotels. Not this one. Place looks great, but they clearly don't keep it in good condition. I have never written a review before, but I felt very strongly that others should know. Here are a few highlights: air con controls did not work, so only way to control room temp was to turn off completely then wake up and turn on, then off, etc. First morning order breakfast, and they send wrong order (not a big deal, happens) but the coffee mug they give me had dirt, old oatmeal and lip stick stains. I send back. They bring me a new pot (but no cup). Hmmm. Come back to room second evening after all day meetings, and room had not been cleaned. I was told short staffed--really, on the busiest weekend in LA with the Emmys? Phone near bed didn't work, and I advised them first day. Was never fixed entire four days. Noticed that lobby area near bar and the hallways were not cleaned often. Normally, could care less, but it was very unpleasant to see the same used martini and wine glasses in the lobby and the food trays sitting outside people's doors for days on end. And the hotel could use a better vacuum. Now with all of these minor nits, I did politely raise concerns with front desk etc. Each was met with a lovely smile, a knowing head-shake, and some charming lne about "whatever we
Whenever, what is your wish" or something. Sadly, nothing was done. At check out, I again expressed my concerns and I think they really do care---but I would suspect nothing was done. They still had old wine glasses piled up near the bar from the night before. 
I will not be staying there again, and will return to my normal LA hotels of the Four Seasons and the Beverly Hilton. Even the century Plaza was better.

review_title: Excellent hotel for business travelers at LAX
review_text: This is the best hotel near LAX by far. Service is excellent, as is the food. Rooms are good size and well kept. The only downside is the parking. Self parking is a bit of a walk - and I did not feel comfortable walking that far alone at night. So I had to use valet parking, which was very prompt, but expensive.

I have a "love/hate" relationship with W Hotels. I have stayed in at least 10 of them around the US and they are either absurdly cheesy and rank pretentious (Atlanta Mid-town) or Fun Funky and Friendly (New Orleans French Quarter). 
I have discovered another kind of W in Los Angeles, one of refinement and cool class - without a shred of cheese, W Westwood. It is still dark with groovy lighting and chill sounds, but the welcome is more understated. The staff is inviting and unpretentious, treating you like a guest and not an annoyance (unlike the W Buckhead). 
The rooms are super large and beds are amazingly comfy. The typical W minibar I well stocked and tasty. 
I love to be surprised by a new hotel, as most of the time I am disappointed, and the W Westwood exceeded my expectations.

Even though hotel has had a makeover in lobby the rooms are still very dated and VERY dark. Otherwise it's a conventient airport hotel- leave time for shuttle as it stops at another hotel first one way to airport

Stayed one night before catching a flight the following day to Vegas. The hotel has a great bar and really nice pool. $20 taxi journey gets you a nice night out in Marina Del Ray.
Courtesy bus to and from the airport was effortless.

review_title: Modern, beautiful, perfect location, clean, fun. What else to ask for?
review_text: I live about an hour drive away from this hotel, but my family and I love it so much that we stay there almost every weekend! It is fun, exciting, beautiful, and everything and more in a hotel. I have chosen to have two teenager birthday parties there and a 40th birthday there, and it was definitely one of the best birthdays yet! Must go :)

review_text: I would not normally choose an airport hotel, but he convenience and value of this one wins he day. Great service, friendly attitude and nice hotel.

I was impressed with the excellent customer service provided by Diane Cheek and Merlee Pickett. They attended to my every concern and need swiftly, effectively and with a most cheerful attitude. This hotel is lucky to have such impressive employees.
loved it as was very nice convenient to lax and reasonable price

Facilitated a Seminar at the Sheraton Gateway, we have been at this location a fews times in the past weeks. Excellent service by the hotel staff today! Begining with Sean from presentation services. Sean is invaluable to this Hotel. He is courteous, friendly, and efficient. The Food and beverage team included Estela Estreda, Jose Monroy, Robert Carrillo were all so efficient and courteous. The Banquet Captain, Moises Tamayo I have worked with for many years at a different Hotel and ever so pleased to see him here. He is always helpful with everything and anything he goes beyond to meet our group requirements even if he is not in charge of our meeting that day! Another invaluable employee.

Loved this hotel. Good things: location is convenient, rooms are amazing, service is excellent and we saw the cast of Glee there! Things that could improve: noise of air-conditioning is loud, walls are a bit thin & no free wireless.

review_title: If you like mildew you will love their showers!
review_text: Overall this hotel was fine. However we were shocked at the huge amount of mildew in the shower. Not a spot here and there but major mildew everywhere. We stayed on the pricier Club level, so can only imagine how the lower cost rooms are maintained. On a positive note, we had a surprisingly excellent dinner in their Italian restaurant with outstanding service!

review_title: Very nice Hotel at a very nice location.
review_text:
We started our 3 week vacation at the W in Westwood. Easy and fast to reach from LAX airport this place is great to settle down after a intercontinental flight. The rooms are nice, had a suite which was great as we travelled with our 11 month old son. Rooms are stylish, staff is very frieny and always helpful. The Pool and Backyard bar are awesome, prices are for rooms and food were reeasonable. Very convenient location to go to Santa Monica, Beverly Hills and Hollywood. 
We loved it, will for sure come back and can only recommed this Hotel to other travelers.

For a one night stay it was decent. The ambassador was as nice as can be. He was down to earth, kind, great smile. The front desk agent, Gabriel, was super pleasant. Got us checked in quickly and had a wonderful attitude. 
Two major cons: 1) $35 valet. 2) Thin walls. I could here the person upstairs urinating, that's how thin. Then the pipes knocked around for 15-20 min.

review_title: For celeb siting ... The place to be.
review_text: My initial impression was great... I was in the elevator with robin Williams! Great suites with large living room areas. Big enough for a small party with girl friends for a night on the town. Pool is great. Chefs walk into the pool clothed and hand out grapes, smoothies, and other refreshing treats. Loved the entire stay.

Hotel ideale per sosta breve tra un volo e l'altro oppure per noleggiare auto e visitare Usa. 
Navetta gratuita dall'aeroporto.
Hotel bello, nuovo, pulito. Camere molto grandi, bagno bello con ottimi prodottipulizia (non di marca Hilton).
Piscina esterna riscaldata (apre alle 6 am) e 4 Jacuzzi, palestra sempre aperta. 
Internet a 13 usd in camera, gratis nella hall. 
Parcheggio a pagamento, sosta breve (10- 20 min) gratis.

It is a good hotel preaty big i just was a little desapointed because notting is included in the rate the internet is extra there was no complementary water etc everything had a charge, and to be honest I stayed in the four points that is from the same chain and it was much better

Hotel pulito e confortevole, i punti a favore sono sicuramente il parcheggio e la colazione, buona la posizione per visitare la cittÃ  in mezz'ora si raggiungono i punti piÃ¹ interessanti. Personale molto gentile e disponibile

As a frequent traveler, I have grown accustomed to those little things hotels do for you when you are staying at the property. For example, when you forget your tooth paste you can always count on the front desk to have it ready for you. Apparently not at this property. The reason they "ran out" of tooth paste, as I found out later in the conversation was because they were selling it for an inflated price of over 5 dollars or just about 500% of what you would get anywhere else. Also, the food in the restaurant is terrible and over priced as well. Oh, did I mention that they are charging $12.95 for wifi access and more than $20 for parking. So please be ready to be nickled and dimed at this property and all for terrible service too.

Modern hotel, modern restaurants, outstanding front desk and restaurant service, fantastic gym with about 10 ellipticals, nice pool area with cabanas, and last but not least nice, new and clean rooms! Perfect experience from start to finish. The upgrade to huge corner suite didn't hurt either. Not the stereotypical airport hotel, although you can still get it for 3,000 starpoints. Great job, Sheraton.

This is the best hotel I ever stays at, and I have been to many. The rooms are perfect. Great decor, very. Clean crisp updated rooms. There is attention to detail for everything. My favorite part is the spa with the sauna and steam room, amazing. The steam room has this incredible fragrance and it super clean. The pool is amazing too. Now for the service, amazing also. They go out of their way to help with whatever they can. Treat you like royalty.

Absolutely loved our stay at the SLS. My own bed at home is a high end incredibly comfortable bed and yet I slept like a baby. (I NEVER sleep well at a hotel. )
The service was top notch yet low key and welcoming. The room was well decorated and inviting, as was the large private terrace (worth it). 
The same magic that general manager Thomas Meding brought to the Parker Palms Springs has followed him to the SLS.

First time at the Trump! Everything we expected. Best room in years, service awesome, great location and great views! Pricey, but worth it!!! Most comfortable bed I have slept in, in years. Absolutely will come again!!!

review_title: As close to perfect as possible!
review_text:
First class from the moment that you walk through the front doors! The staff is pleasant, courteous and helpful. The rooms are large with a plethera of modern amenities including two flat screen tvs, a gas fireplace, a b&o iPod speaker system and even a tv mounted within the mirror in the rest room. 
Only room needs improvement was a slow drain the the shower! If you haven't stayed - would definitely recommend!

Our first stay at Trump Chicago...In the past 2 years, we have made a dozen trips to Chicago and have stayed at the Westin, Peninsula, both W Hotels, the Wit, Palomar, to name the highlights. We like the modern, contemporary hotels. Well, Trump was our favorite hotel stay in Chicago by far. We felt so at home and comforted by the surroundings. Our Spa Room was quiet and we never heard outside or hall noise. Looved the Kohler fixtures and Lutron light controls. We are building a new home and felt really inspired and comforted by the room at Trump. Service was perfect- goes without saying for this caliber of a property. Understated luxury yet not pretentious- in every aspect. We will be back on our next trip to Chicago!

For a LA hotel my expectations were high. I have stayed at better hotels in less expensive cities. The phone did not work and the faucet was loose. Though the shower provided plenty of hot water and the bed was comfortable, I was kind of let down. 
Additionally the meal from the bar was good and good portion size but it was so expensive $16 for a sandwich. A food pantry would have been a better offer.

Whenever I'm in LA for business I stay at the Gateway. It's a comfortable, convenient hotel. I attended a meeting there for work and Estela Estrada was super accommodating. Sometimes the prices are a bit much when it's busy, but I would highly recommend it.

review_title: Had a great experience at this beautiful hotel
review_text: Stayed for 3 nights recently and had a wonderful time. The staff were very friendly and helpful and assisted us with directions and with making reservations at a restaurant. The decor is beautiful and elegant and the room was spacious and had everything you would need. The spa was lovely and had a facial and massage that were excellent. The restaurant sixteen was fabulous-- did the 5 course meal with wine pairings and breakfast daily. The views of the skyline were beautiful. The location in the city was great--within walking distance of many attractions like millennium park and the magnificent mile and also close to train station. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it.

Nothing but problems on my stay at the SLS! They messed up on my room reservation and it took them three hours to correct while I waited in the wrong room without any communication of what the problem was from the front desk. The rooms are so dark, the ironing board is so small you couldn't even iron a sock in it. The shower leaked all over the bathroom and the sliding glass door to the patio took mass might to open. I Called the conceriege for a club reservation and they said they were too busy and to call back. The pool attendant is a complete rag and puts reserved signs on all the chairs even though they never ended up being used that day. 
I give this hotel a 3 only because of its location, comfort, and design. 
If you like this location stay at the sofitel down the block or if you are looking for similar style and "scene" in a hotel stay at their other hotel The Redbury in Hollywood.

Having read a few positive reviews on the Elysian, I decided to make reservations during a business trip to Chicago. To say I was pleasantly surprised, would do no justice to this hotel. My whole experience was an absolute pleasure. From the time I checked in I was aware of a professional but warm and friendly disposition of the staff, the very well appointed rooms, the location. I cannot fault this hotel in any way. For me this hotel offered very good value for money too; I have stayed in establishments that would charge double and still not leave me with the level of satisfaction as the Elysian has.

I am in the middle of a 4-night stay at the Elysian. After reading all the great reviews before booking, I was expecting one of the best hotel stays...& up to this point it has been a disappointment. 
It started with having to wait a very long time for our room to be ready. We did arrive early so we understood having to wait until the 3:00 check in time. However, we were quoted another 45 minute wait but we wait at least another hour & a half before finally getting into our room at 4:30. 
We were told at check in, the tv in the bathroom wasnt working but that they could fix it right away that first night while we were at dinner. They ended up forgetting to come that night and then when they finally did come, we're not able to fix it. They offered to change our room, but it really wasn't worth it for just a bathroom tv. 
We've also had not the greatest experience with other members of the hotel - it just seems as if our requests aren't followed-up on. I'd expect much more for the price we paid!
The last con (for myself anyway) is the location of the hotel. It's in more of a quiet location and I would've liked tO be at a hotel closer to the shops on Michigan ave. 
My favorite part of the hotel so far is that the spa/gym is very nice and the workers there are very friendly!

review_title: Great hotel, location, and housekeeping did a great job.
review_text:
Anniversary trip with my wife. Great stay. Many Benz's and better in the parking lot. Quite a bit of Beverly Hills attitude in the bar with posers trying to someone they're not.
The hotel itself was great. Great location, very accommodating staff and good service. Rooms are pretty dark and need to be brightened up with better lighting. Wife says bathroom was definitely designed by a man.
Great place. Daniela in housekeeping was top notch!
First time staying at the Elysian. Great service, fantastic room, convenient location.

hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Los Angeles International Airport

review_text:
I must first begin by thanking Estela for going above and beyond expectations. Her warm smile and friendly attitiude were a welcome sight for a business traveler. Her attention to detail, presentation and the needs of her guest were evident throughout the day. She was truly a pleasure to have met.
I would recommend this hotel and it's business services based on this very positive experience.

review_title: SLS stands for slow luxury service.
review_text: My first impression of the hotel staff was great. Everyone was very helpful and was truly there to give me great service. Until the next day when I ordered ice for my room right before I went out and I ended up waiting a whole hour just for them to bring it out to me. I had to call three times to check to see when it was going to arrive and they kept telling me 15 min and that someone was already on there way. Because of this it made my night less eventful since I wasted a whole hour just waiting on something that should be so simple to get. I can only imagine if I would've asked for more. Which I did when I arrived back from being out. I ordered in room dining from the kitchen. I ordered two WELL DONE cheeseburgers but instead got plain hamburgers and then not cooked thoroughly. It wasn't even cooked at all. It was undercooked and when I informed the kitchen they said we ordered hamburgers and were only sorry for them not being cooked. Yet still made me sign the bill for it. The only good thing is that the next day during check out I informed the front desk and they took care that issue for me. Which only meant they gave me awful food for free. Nothing else. I wouldn't Really recommend to anyone to order in room dinning service since they just don't seem to know what they're doing there.
As soon as we walked in the door Yolanda greeted us and made us feel welcomed. As well as Diane Cheeks Thank you sooo much for great service

review_title: Received amazing service from Diane Cheek
review_text: Diane Cheek at Sheraton Gateway in Los Angeles, went above and beyond to provide us with exceptional customer service. We will continue to use this hotel again and again! Thank you Diane! - [---]

Can not fault the Trump, service amazing, staff attentive, rooms spacious and well kept. Walking distance to virtually everything and the Architectural boat tour starts in front of the hotel (highly recommended!)
I think Trump is perceived as being expensive but on comparison is often cheaper than the likes of the Ritz Carlton / Park Hyatt and the rooms are twice the size. Great value for money

review_title: Great Beverly Hills location, convenient to Beverly Center
review_text: Modern, hip hotel with excellent dining and nightlife. Rooms are comfortable with everything you would expect in a high-end property. If planning on working, the lighting is a little weak.

I stayed here one night while in the LA area for business, my first stay at SLS. There are many things to like: great restaurant/dining, cool decor, amazing BMW 7 series hybrid as the in-house local car service, huge walk-in shower and fun mirror/TV in the wall. Some of the things that lowered the review are minor (but important to me): the miniature ironing board was very hard to iron shirts and pants on (and kept folding down), the room layout made it feel cramped since I was always trying to squeeze by some piece of furniture, my room on the second floor had a view that was mostly an external wall, and the the overall value (what I paid for what I got) just seemed a little out of skew. If they fixed a few of these things, it would be 5 star!
This hotel frOm it's decor to the restaurant theme to the mirrors oozes sexy!

We had an excellent stay. The hotel is terrific. The staff was very attentive. Unfortunetly, there was a charge on our bill for the bar inside Trump Hotel called Rebar. We never visited Rebar. I thought this would not be a problem. I would just tell the front desk of the hotels error on our bill. I was wrong. I had to make 3 phone calls. Each time I spoke to someone I was told someone would call me back. No one ever did. I spoke to staff members from the Billing Department who were not always friendly. They finally gave me a credit a couple of weeks later and after I did not let it go. I was told someone would give me a call to let me know when my credit was issued. Once again, no one called me. I was annoyed and sent an email to the hotel and no one bothered to respond to me. The experience after we left the hotel made me not ever want to go back.

Yolanda (Front Desk) should be commended for her above and beyond customer service skills... She definitely makes you want to stay at the Sheraton Gateway... Thanks for you bubbly attitude and great customer service... Would also like to commend Diane (Guest Relations) I loved her honest interest in making my stay and needs spectacular... Thanks Diane for the person you are....

review_title: One of the most functional, good food, friendly service & beautifully decorated hotel in the last two years
review_text: Need to try it for once in a life time experience. Fabuloushotel.

review_title: If you have to be stranded during a hurricane on the east coast, this is the place to strand.
review_text: 1st, I'm going to list the amazing people who turned what could have been hell into a nice SoCal extended weekend. Front desk, Paul piÃ±a, guest services Dianne cheek and marly Pickett. Bartenders/waiters @ Paparrzzi, Joe Stiteler & Mario, gift shop clerk Adrine. Every single person was amazing. I know I don't have all your names, but all of you combined are the definition of hospitality. Thank you all for turning what could have been a horrible experience into an 'unexpected extended weekend' Best wishes, Nela

My sisters and I splurged and stayed in this hotel on a recent trip to LA. It had very unique decor and a happening atmosphere. Be sure to check out the Restaraunt downstairs, are to die for!! The pool is good, they do an interesting job of camouflaging the fact that they are in the middle oh a concrete jungle. 
There is a great mall within walking distance, and the Grove is not too far either. The gym is well appointed and the concierge was great at recommending local eateries, & hotspots. We had a snooty waitress at the downstairs lobby eatery :-(
My only complaint would be that the rooms were a bit tight and could do with an extra light, but it was a luxurious hotel regardless. I may not stay here again ($$$), but I will recommend it as a place to check out.

review_title: Trendy, hip, chic hotel in Beverly Hills
review_text: Ultra trendy hotel. Extremely helpful staff. Good location. Nice pool. Good restaurants and bars on site. Only negative - complimentary car service doesn't start untl almost 11am.

First time stay. Chose the Trump since they had rooms with two queens vs typical two double beds. Room had a stunning view of the lake and the city. The staff was extremely helpful and competent. The restaurant service/food/ view was particularly good. There were some stains on the furniture at the foot of the bed but otherwise rooms were clean. The bathrooms don't separate the toilet from the rest of the bathroom which is inconvenient with multiple travelers. I had a massage in the spa as part of our AMEX package. The therapist was very nice, but not very good--my only disappointment with the stay. I would stay here again, but Four Seasons would still be my first choice.

Simply put, the hotel was amazing. Loved the fact that nobody accepts tips at the hotel. When we tried to tip it was the same response: that's not necessary. And always with a smile. Loved the complimentary car service. I believe that the hotel car (a VERY nice Lexus) would drop you off (drop-off only) within 1-2 miles of the hotel. They took us to Navy Pier one night and even made a stop at another hotel to pick up our friends. the driver mentioned that you can also pay an extra and they have a few different cars that you can "rent" during your stay. Rooms were very nice and clean, modern without being overly so. Had great service in the bar one afternoon. Highly recommend if you're willing and able to pay the high price. We got a great deal by taking advantage of a promotion the hotel had thru jetsetter.com.
You rock! Thanks for your help.Had a great stay, and plan to return here when I visit my son in college.

I have been fortunate enough to stay in some great hotels in my day. This is the best service I have ever experienced. From the maid service to the front desk staff, the Elysian staff are incredible. 
PROS - everything. The workout facilities and spa are out of this world. The brunch was exceptional (don't order the French toast). The bed is heavenly. 
CONS - French toast at the brunch. 
Honestly, other than my experience with 'French toast' everything was perfect.

review_title: Best hotel I stayed in chicago
review_text: You get what you pay in this hotel. Very modern, clean, nice bed and the bathroom is to die for.pricey but worth it...

Loved the SLS! Would definitely stay again. Very unique hotel - non traditional and very cool.
Ciel spa is amazing - had incredible massage/facial/hair/makeup services.
The bazaar restaurant in the hotel is also unreal. Best meal I have ever had. be sure to try the Philly cheesesteak and the picadillo pepper dishes!
Loved loved loved this hotel! We stayed in a signature suite - great layout, lots of room.

We had an excellent stay at the Chicago Trump Hotel.
The staff was wonderful , courteous
And very helpful.
The hotel and building are visually stunning. We had a lake/river view suite that had breath taking views of Chicago's amazing skyline,
We will stay here again for sure !

review_title: This is hotel is ghetto chic.
review_text: So I am here during memorial day weekend. The hotel is not in the heart of Beverly hills it's about a 10 minute cab ride from that area. Not thrilled about that. The pool area service sucks and the pool itself it not that great. Not as pictured. The original adjoining room arrangements were not met. They couldn't even put us on the same floor after all. The restaurants in hotel are just average. The room itself is ok girls no good lighting for makeup smokey mirrors cover the room very dark feeling. Linens are just basic not as plush as I had hoped. I would not stay here again.

Super hÃ´tel a 25 mn L.A!!!pas loin de l'autoroute qui vous emmene a tts les points touristique. Bon quartier ,plein de resto a cote !! Chambre avec frigo et piscine ,jacuzzi extÃ©rieur!!petit dej correct !! TrÃ¨s bon service a l'accueil!!(caserne des pompiers en face mais pas gÃªnant car la fatigue est prÃ©sence):-)))

We spent several days at The Elysian, it was absolutely wonderful. The hotel is beautiful and fresh but the people who work there make it stand out among Chicago's top notch hotels, and it has a few! 
Every accomodation was made for our 1 1/2 yr old daughter which made staying there Soooo much easier than at other hotels we have visited. Valet and check in were a breeze. Our bags were about 2 minutes behind us. 
This place has an endless supply of fresh ice and gratis cold Evian. 
The rooms are luxurious and have everything you need and the linens towels and toiletries are the finest. The very best thing about this hotel though, is that they are excellent at anticipating guests needs and their timing is ALMOST perfect. I only say almost because due to a malfunction on our do not disturb bell (it kept turning back to green when we set it to red) we had a few untimely doorbell rings by turndown service and bar stock/check while our daughter was sleeping.
It was fixed immediately. 
Ahhhh, peaceful and quiet inside and lots of action right outside the front door, we walked all over the downtown hot spots. 
Amazing hotel, amazing service! Loved it!

We are just returning from a four day stay at the Trump Hotel in Chicago. We have stayed at many 5 star hotels...Ritz-Carlton, Four Seasons, St.Regis, etc. None compare to the amazing service of the Trump Hotel! From check-in to checkout service was exemplary. Keep up the good work. Thanks!

We took my inlaws for their 60th birthdays to Chicago for memorial day weekend. 
We booked the hotel based on feedback from trip advisor and you were all right it was amazing. 
We have stayed in hotels all around the world and this is one of the best nothing is too much trouble and all of the staff have to be commended. 
We stayed in a suite and the room was spacious and well equipped I particularly loved the giant tub which i spent many a happy hour in there. 
We had all never been to Chicago but will go back for nothing else but the Elysian. 
The hotel has a level of class that outshines the larger 5 star hotels but also tries to make you feel welcome and at home at all times. 
Go you will not be sorry.

I thought that I would spoil myself for my birthday and it was worth every penny! The interior of the hotel is amazing and the service is fantastic. The concierge, Casey, deserves particular mention - he went out of his way to make the stay one to remember!
A few bits of advice... Book a table at Bazaar for dinner when you check in. It's super busy and all those damn celebs make it tough to get a table late in the day. Breakfast at the hotel (Tres) is spectacular but a little overpriced. Eggs should be included in the buffet. They can't make a latte to save themselves but their granola and yoghurt was incredible. Service was A+.
Overall this was a fantastic stay and well worth the money!

Expensive for the kind of place it is. Several issues here that you may want to be aware of. During my first 3 night stay here, night 1 went by just okay as I was exhausted after work and checked in late. Night 2, coming back from work..I noticed the room TV turn on and off by itself, as much as once every 2 minutes. 
Called the front desk and they were helpful to change my TV. 30 mins after it started happening again and this time they changed the satallite receiver box. Once again it started turning on and off when I called the hotel staff and they gladly put me in another room 1/3 the size of my original room. Was the old room inhabited already? The hotel only told me that this place was a 1880 property and anything could be possible.
Night 3, some serious rumbling and cutting noises in the walls. Called the front desk and they said someone was taking kickboxing classes and would pack up soon.
Bedcovers removed to sleep..noticed it spread out on the used bed as is and the bed not even made up! Shocking!! This place is unacceptable.
I must also mention the location. Not suitable for the faint of heart. The place is flooded with homeless right outside the door and you'd see them for as far as your vision would go. Cant think of taking late evening walks outside.
However, the only single positive experience I had here is the good quality breakfast. Without a doubt, this was good breakfast that most hotels may not offer free.

review_title: Beauty and Luxury, hip, chic and romantic
review_text: My husband invited me to join him in Chicago for a few nights while he was there on business. We moved to the Elysian from the hotel where his meeting was being held, boy was I glad we did! I booked some spa treatments during his meeting time. What a beautiful place, the spa is luxurius and I really felt pampered. It certainly put me in the mood for the romantic dinner we had planned for the evening. Our room was richly appointed with large bath, soaking tub, seating area with fireplace, luxury linens, the works. We loved our stay and will certainly be back the next time I return to Chicago.
Stayed here for 2 nights in the yacht club suite. Amazing! Enjoy the many fitness options plus the happy hour.

I do noy understand the high praise this hotel gets. I only booked here due to the rave reviews. First of all if security is at all important to you, stay away. Interior doors are wooden. Our room had the safety latch removed, so we wedged a chair under the knob. On the first floor, rear there's a back door that remains unlocked most of the time. You can hear everything going on in the other rooms, including slamming doors at all hours of the night.
There's also no parking lot, so you have to take your chance on the street and this is not an easy thing to do.
They do offer a breakfast off the lobby, but it's awful! Also, the seats in the dining area were filthy.After complaining upon checkout the best they could do was 10 percent off.
I was so disappointed in this hotel and it has shaken my faith in Tripavisor reviews. Please do not be fooled as I was.

Our stay at the Elysian was perfect! There was a slight wait for our room upon arrival but only because they were upgrading us to a larger room. And the wait was well worth it. The room was spacious, clean, and wonderfully decorated. The service all around was amazing. We had a slight issue and were locked out on our 24th floor balcony due to a faulty door lock. We had no phone and were very lucky there were workers in an apartment balcony on the next building over. After only 20 minutes the hotel staff rescued us and were highly concerned with whether or not we were okay. Everything was fine and once we returned later that evening the staff had left us a card and a bowl of fresh fruit appologizing for the inconvience. We were highly impressed with every aspect of our stay and the Elysian is our new hotel of choice in Chicago!

OK room for the price, but was heralded as an "upgrade"; room (206) is next to a very noisy kitchen,where loud equipment operates until 2 AM and starts up early. They say they will move us today. Let's see what happens

We have stayed at the Luxe twice now and really like it. Both room we've had have been very quiet, extremely comfortable bed and all mod cons.
The location is perfect if you want to be partway between the coast and inland attractions, although a car is needed. You can easily drive down to Santa Monica or Malibu but just as easily go into LA, Beverley hills, downtown etc.
Restaurant is great, particularly recommend the pancakes for breakfast !!!! 
Overall would definitely recommend the Luxe.

Very clean, comfortable, and covenient stay for my 20 year old daughter and I. Loved the free continental breakfast and free parking. It is NOT a party/glamorous hotel and that's what I truly liked the most. When I return to L.A. I will stay here at my home away from home.

review_title: This is the best experience I have had in Chicago.
review_text: The staff is welcoming and very attentive. Absolutely luxurious accommodations at an exceptional value. Thanks to all staff for making our five year anniversary stay one to remember.

Bad experience. They didn't warn us in advance of our booking that the hotel was under major renovations. I don't mind that or the dust etc. but the hammering and drilling that woke us up at 7am was horrible. I wish they had at least placed us away from the construction.
Even worse? I filled out the hotel comment card in full and made this issue known upon checkout. No follow-up ensued, nor apology. That's why I'm writing this.
I expect some tardy online apology will follow now from the Orlando but shame on them for ruining our stay and not doing anything about it until being called out.
If this is the way the Orlando operates, beware. A decent hotel would warn you in advance about noisy renos that are underway. Boo!

review_title: I had a nice telaxing nigh!!!
review_text: Diane cheek was. A wonderful helpful advisor ...she made our stay easy and relaxing .... thanks Sheraton Gateway /Diane cheek

review_title: Clean large room, but parking and breakfast leave a lot to be desired.
review_text:
We stayed here because it is close to our daughter's house. The room was large and well kept by housekeeping - good. Now the bad - parking is on the side streets o my, so you may expect to walk a bit from your car -especially if late in The evening. And the breakfast was a real problem. On our first day, it had been picked over at 9:00, and no one was replenishing it, even though breakfast runs until 10:00. We finally went to the front desk to get someone to replenish it. 
There are no tongs to pick up the bagels, rolls, muffins, etc. So people just pick through them with their hands to select the one they want. The yogurt, when present, is just set on the counter without ice to keep it cool, and the coffee pots looike they haven't been cleaned in some time, as the glass is stained brown. 
The final problem was several children, presumably the owners', as they would come and go through the kitchen door. They came in with bare feet, and would go up to the serving table, and since there were 5 of them, no one else could get anything as they stood there, pouring cereal, getting juice, etc. And once they arrived each morning, the ability to have a conversation disappeared, as they were very loud.

Cette cet hÃ´tel est situÃ© en bord d autoroute mais si vous demandez un chambre sur le cotÃ© opposÃ© cela s avÃ¨re supportable. L emplacement est idÃ©al pour se rendre sur sunset blvd, ucla, hollywood, venice. Nous avions une sympathique vue sur le Getty center. Si vous Ãªtes cotÃ© freeway la vue sur tout LA vous permettra d oublier le bruit. Le service de voiturier Ã©tait gratuit surement une nouveautÃ©... La piscine est sympatique et le personel poli et souriant. Petite surprise dÃ©sagrÃ©able a notre dÃ©part, des conso du mini bar mis a tort sur la facture, erreur rÃ©ctifiÃ©e sans sourciller, bizar... Nous recommandons cet hÃ´tel si vous tombez comme nous sur une bonne promo.
Excellent service and fabulous room. Used the spa. Kate was exceptional. Spa service was great as well.

review_title: Weird hotel prides itself on valet parking??
review_text: Staff great and chef. Offered a pool side room and ended up with a car park view with all the noise and exhaust fumes too boot. Looks terrible from the outside but better on the inside, Walls are made from paper and can hear everything from next room. Valet parking $25 per day plus tax, all cars parked against guest rooms first with doors banging, car horns and their phone ringing most of the night. Hotel seems to be trying to be something it's not. Caters more for outside functions than paying guests.
Nice quiet place. Staff is very friendly, like a bed and breakfast location.

So far service has been fantastic...
Thank you to the gentleman that got me the fridge and bible so quickly and thanks to Diane for her customer service and cool humming... Lol

Se andate al sofitel dovete prenotare tre mesi prima sul sito dell'hotel la best available rate quella che poi non vi rimborsano nulla se non andate ma e' il solo modo per avere una piccola tariffa x un grand hotel... Hall molto di design pervasa da mille profumi e sensazioni , il concierge sa sempre consigliarvi il meglio! Camera all'ultimo piano ovvero il trentaduesimo vista sulla hancock tower e il lago un sogno! Grande luminosa in bagno i prodotti dell'occitane en provence wow! Un sogno! Posizione centralissima bellissima nella water tower ...unica pecca non ha il wi fi gratis per cui dovrete usare io business center che e' gratis ma ha pochi pc e forse manca un terrazzo vista grattacieli e una piscina! Comunque ci torneremo!!!

review_title: I strongly suggest you stay somewhere else
review_text: This hotel was a dramatic let down. We paid a premium to stay here for the New Year weekend thinking it'd be worth it given the boutique style and decent reviews. The first thing we noticed was the smell--in the halls before even reaching our room, it was like death masked with loads of air freshener. The second thing we noticed was blood and other stains on our drapes as we began settling in. We requested a room with a second bed or pull-out and they gave us a room with a couch (not pull-out) then tried charging us $15/night for a nasty roll-away, also with blood stains on it. As other reviewers have mentioned, the ice machines were broken, air-conditioner was broken, safe was broken, wireless was broken. Lastly, the staff was unaccomodating and absolutely not qualified to run a hotel. When we called to have some of these issues dealt with, the managers did not return phone calls as promised, they were slow/ineffective with repairs, and not once in 4 days did any of the desk staff ask us how our stay was or offer to compensate us for the time we spent dealing with room problems instead of hanging out with our friends and family. This place is a total armpit albeit with a convincing facade. Absolutely not worth the money--stay at your own risk.

review_title: Beautiful Rooms, Avoid Rooms Near Elevators
review_text:
The rooms are beautifully renovated and are very spacious but the soundproofing could be be better. We were unfortunately placed in a room near the elevators resulting in disrupted sleep throughout the night and early morning from guests coming and going and from the maids ramming their carts in and out of their storage area. Strangely enough, we only heard the planes coming and going at night but not during the day.
Service was great however! When we mentioned to housekeeping that we couldn't find a lost item, they rummaged through their trash and found it for us!
Valet parking only at $20/night. Would probably be best only for airport travelers. We got a great deal on Priceline so we can't really complain for the value. Just be sure to ask for a room as far from the elevators as possible!

review_title: Great place to get away from your life and relax.
review_text: Modern and majestic modern hotel with amazing amenities. Very friendly staff. Great pool, gym, and spa. Very high quality food in retraunt. Overall excellent experience.
This Courtyard is especially reasonable on weekends, $99. Big rooms, flat screen, attractive. The only thing that is free is the shuttle bus to LAX and some coffee. Otherwise, very pleased.

review_title: Great place to stay for an early morning flight out of LAX
review_text: Comfortable rooms, shuttle to airport, walking distance from many rental car returns.

review_title: Nice, clean, modern hotel. Well located for LAX.
review_text:
3 nights on a business trip, the hotel is very close to LAX wit a comp shuttle running back and forth to airport every 15 minutes. The lobby has a fantastic arrangment of small work desks complete with power sockets so ideal for small meetings. The bedroom was well appointed, spacious and modern, the bed was one of the best I had slept on for a long time. My only 2 complaints would be that my room did not get serviced until very late in the afternoon also the hotel lacks a restaurant, there is a small deli serving limited items along with Starbucks coffee but I found this was only useful for breakfast, lunch and dinner I decided to visit the hotel next door.
Overall a good stay and I would deffinatly return.

review_title: Trendy bar and restaurant in Lax!
review_text:
Back at the Gateway. Still the best LAX hotel in my opinion.
Very nice hotel staff! Great pool. Like the new chef at the restaurant, though i definately miss some dishes!
Like the bar a lot!

Have just spent 5 nights at the Erwin, excellent friendly hotel and room was spot on in all respects. Room had a lovely balcony with great sunsets each evening and views of the mountains to the north and east. Would recommend to anyone who wants to spend time exploring Venice.
hotel_name: Hotel Erwin, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text:
Booked as a mystery deal on expedia. They couldn't find our reservation, quickly sorted it out and upgraded us to a suite for the inconvenience :) clean big suite. Friendly door and reception staff. 
Check out time of midday is awesome. Check out the rooftop bar too. 
One block from the beach and we even walked to Santa monica. close to Venice canals. 
Great if you wanna get out of down town la.
hotel_name: Hotel Erwin, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: My hubby and I were traveling from Singapore. We chose this hotel because of their location, a decent 5 minutes walk to the Universal Studio. Good location to the theme park and the metro station. Rooms were clean. Rates were affordable. Staff were not too friendly though, or maybe we are Chinese..?!

review_title: Gorgeous property, exquisite rooms, friendly and helpful staff
review_text:
I stayed at this hotel in December for one night before catching a flight to London. I got a great rate and when in arrived the staff was friendly, helpful and offered me an upgrade to a suite for a nominal amount. 
The rooms are AMAZING -- beautiful furniture, lighting system, fireplace, great balcony with a view and truly luxurious bath -- I felt like I was in a private spa!
The staff was very friendly, courteous and the bellman refused my tip! He told me tips "were included in the Elysian experience" wow! 
I cannot wait to stay here again!!!

Very handy location for the universal studios. Free regular shuttle bus or 5minutes walk. 10 mins from train station $6 ticket got me to the walk of fame approx 10 mins on train. We found hotel staff very helpful. Hotel pool was nice to chill round with free sunbeds and towels. Would stay again
car park on site but not free.

review_title: Our family's stay has been wonderful, the staff, rooms, and location are amazing!
review_text: My family held our 97th family reunion at the Sheraton Gateway. As a large group checking in was a breeze, the rooms were clean, and the staff was friendly and helpful. Estele Estrada took wonderful care of us. I couldn't have asked for a better experience.

Stay in the heart of the Venice boardwalk. Me and my husband love it here! We try to come at least once a year! Venice is such an awesome place we love it and the hotel is the best!!!! A California must do! Doesn't get more LA than this
hotel_name: Hotel Erwin, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text:
I stayed here on arriving into LAX from Melbourne, and was a great option before I continued my domestic sector the next day. 
Shuttle service was easy and convenient, room was ready for me despite an 8am checkin, staff very friendly (particularly Gabrielle in the bar). Very spaciou room, clean and comfortable, great pool area. Starbucks was handy to have for a quick coffee. 
Overall, very good and will continue to stay there on future trips. Oh, and it's only a 25 min bus ride to Santa Monica. Perfect!
Simply the best place to really get the Venice Beach experience.
hotel_name: Hotel Erwin, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_title: Best service I had in a while
review_text: I stayed for 4 nights and could not believe the friendliness and great service! An absolute delight. Also very convenient location for trips to universal studios. Rooms were very good and great beds as can be expected from a Hilton . Would recommend it .

review_title: Diane Cheek was very prompt and helpful.
review_text: Check-in began with Anza who was very prompt and helpful. Then in the morning we had requested water and Diane Cheek was incredibly prompt and had water delivered within a few minutes. This is the perfect hotel stay for all of your LAX travels.

review_title: You pay for the cool. The smell is free.
review_text: It's a hip place, no doubt. Room smelled old and musty. Restaurant was good, but like everything else pricey. The fitness center is a closet with a treadmill and tv.
hotel_name: Hotel Erwin, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Average hotel by London standards. Helpful staff but not the slickest of operations.
Diane was the best!!! Helped us with everything we needed from directions to in room services! Really a top notch place to stay that is close to the airport. Just ask for Diane!

review_title: Good location for Universal Studios and Universal City Buard walk !
review_text:
It's a nice Hilton business like hotel . The rooms are nice big size and the concierge is helpful . The pool area is quite good and is open till midnight ( is heated as well ) 
Close to Umiversal City board walk

I love this hotel and I promise I am not affiliated with them in any way. Just an overwhelmingly positive experience has led me to writing this review.
My fiancÃ© stayed here in October 2010 and after hearing about his experience we had to stay together. 
I had the pleasure of staying here for 11 nights. We stayed in a king suite in the main building. 
The staff at this hotel actually love their job and enjoy making people (no matter who you are) feel important & valued. Valet, Bellmen, Front desk, Concierge, Restaurant, After hours managers and security all go above and beyond everyday. I've never stayed at a hotel that the staff are so consistently good. 
The king suite is spacious & clean with a comfortable bed, good wifi and nice touches like a welcome drink & fruit; turn down with chocolate and daily newspapers. 
The noise from the 405 is well screened by beautifully landscaped gardens. The area is safe. The only negative about the location is the off ramps/bridge area can be congested at peak hours but leaving 5-10 minutes earlier resolves that. 
After a 6 week holiday in the US, this was a perfect way to end it. U can't wait to stay here again next year.

review_title: Sad I brought my gf here for valentines day...not happy
review_text: I am still actually staying here. I agree with everyone else that said its very noisy at this hotel. Its halfway through february and I read in another review that they planned on fixing it sometime in february. I really hope they do. I brought my girlfriend here for valentines day and really wish I hadn't wasted my money bringing her here. We arrived today feb 13 at around 3pm. expecting a welcome package since that was part or what I payed for as a suite package. It is now exactly 10:20pm and I am still waiting for it. I have called the front desk 3 times and they have reapetedly said it was on its way. Im still waiting. Another big setback was that the television was all blurry for about two hours until it "warmed up" and then it finally cleared up. I was going to update to the vista suite and the front desk lady first told me it would cost me $80 then a couple minutes later told me it wuld cost $100(come tolater find out they really only cost$ 40 to upgrade). Very unhappy w my experience I have stayed at hotels that are cheaper than this place around the area and have had way better experiences elsewhere. I am only 23 years old so im not super picky or hard to please. I just really expected alot more. I work really hard for my money and really feel dispointed about the way my experience was at this hotel. They could have at least compensated me a little bit for all the trouble I had but the people at the front desk really didn't seem to care. If manegement reads this and feels a need to hopefully somehow make things right I can be reached at [--]. if not oh well I guess that's how you guys like doing business and it sucks for a hardworking guy like me.

Having stayed at this hotel about a dozen times over the years, it has become one of my favorites -- and I spend about 75 nights a year in hotels around the world year after year. As in any property, there are some operational problems from time to time, but they are always dealt with promptly and well. The Executive Suite rooms are spacious and extremely comfortable -- and a great value. I particularly like the rooms facing the pool in the upper part of the hotel. They are quiet and it is like being in an oasis of calm. Walking down the hill to the restaurant area is only a two minute effort, and if you don't want to walk back up the friendly and courteous staff quickly provide a ride. Unlike most hotel restaurants, the restaurant cuisine is excellent and it is a quiet place, a delightful place for a business breakfast or dinner -- with no need to yell to be heard. If you are looking for a boutique property in an unusual setting, the one is a winner.

Everything was good. We loved those comfortable beds. Very nice and serviceminded staff. The food was great. The location was good. Close to Santa Monica and Venice beach and not far away from Hollywood. Peace and quiet even if you could hear the freeway, but that wasn't a big problem.
It was a little bit expensive to park the car.
We surely stay at this hotel again if we return to Los Angeles

This hotel is great if you want to go to Universal Studios but the nearby metro makes the hotel convenient for visiting sights like Chinese theatre etc. There are lots of good restaurants, shops and bars within walking distance and the hotel staff were really helpful with directions etc. All in all we had a great stay!

I stayed at this hotel with friends at the end of my travels. It was a great hotel. Admittedly the view if you looked down into the alley did not amount to much, but the view of Venice Beach was great. The room was get clean. The rooftop bar has to make the hotel perfect. We happily sat and watched the world go bar. It had great music abd excellent staff. The staff were very helpful throughout, offering us sone great restaurant recommendations. I would definitely advise asking them. We were also walking distance to the canals which are a stunning walk. A great place to stay in the middle of Venice Beach!
hotel_name: Hotel Erwin, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_title: Have stayed in this hotel about 10 times in the past couple of months and I can't recommend it highly enough.
review_text:
The service is excellent. Special mention needs to be made for Jonathan at the front desk, Merly who is in customer care and Maria in house keeping. Their outstanding service will keep me coming back.
Very convenient location for business in both LA and OC. A block from LAX makes it especially convenient and only a 20 min drive to the Santa Monica beach. 
Awesome rooms. Very clean and very comfortable beds.

Stayed here for one day at the end of May in transit. Waited 10 min for shuttle bus, and the bus is shared by one or two other hotels. I got on in international terminal, by the time it arrived the other domestic terminal, it was full.
The lobby looks stylish, and provided kiosks to print boarding pass. The room is not as new and stylish as the lobby but looks nice enough for one night stay. Check-in line was long, and I waited like 7 min to check-in. 
Overall, nice experience. I used 3000 starwood points and think it is value for "points".

Although they provide a shuttle bus it's just as quick to walk as you are right by the entrance. Rooms were plenty big enough for 4 of us. As with most chains extras were very expensive so breakfast & wifi were the most we have paid on our trip

review_title: Five star price-one star everything else!
review_text: Don't let the price fool you into believing there will be anything nice about your stay! Alot half of your time for waiting for their tiny ancient elevator-and the other half for waiting for whatever single person is running the entire hotel. I do love the location but would much rather stay somewhere it is possible to shower without receiving second degree burns! Don't bother having friends or family meet you in your room either-if you aren't paying for a room-you re not welcome there. There are no creature comforts at this hotel let alone benefits-I hate to rant but what a rip off!
hotel_name: Hotel Erwin, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: We stayed at this hotel last year and the service has changed since last year. I have emailed the hotel and as yet have not had a reply. We ordered room service , was read back the order and when the order was delivered one item was missions. When we phoned room service we was told quite rudely that we hadn't ordered the item , I said I had and was told rudely again I could have the item delivered but have to pay room service again which I refused.we asked for the mini bar to be opened twice and it never happened.!! I booked the room on the Internet and booked a senior rate but was charged more on the final bill. The bar area was laid up early evening for meals so you don't feel comfortable having just a drink. It's a shame because last year we had a good time at this hotel. And I don't think we would stay there again which is a shame.

review_title: Best place to stay near LAX.
review_text: Everytime I'm in town near LAX I stay at the Sheraton Gateway. They have great service, a great lounge, a great bar in the lobby area, and a great breakfast in the AM. I recommend the Sheraton Gateway for anyone needing to stay around LAX.

There are some nice things about this hotel. Its location - right on the edge of LA Live is amazing. We have a Junior Suite - a bit of a splurge - the view from the 17th floor is - how can I describe it? - massive - we can see for miles and miles and ... but on second glance the hotel is strange. Low ceilings in the halls and the distinct feeling that the decor is from Target and Urban Home. The bathroom is also huge but NO tub! Boo! But if you want to be near the action, this is e place
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_text: Devo ammeter che l'albergo e' molto bello e lussuoso, la piscina molto carina, camere curate con unica pecca nel servizio di housekeeping: entrate nel bagno, nel wc c'era una deiezione coperta da carta igienica e wc intasato. Come e' possibile che un albergo da 300 dollari a notte accolga dei clienti con un wc intasato e pieno di escrementi? Vuol dire che la pulizia non e' il loro punto forte.

review_title: Comfortable and elegant. Wish I had a longer stay.
review_text:
Stayef here one night for a meeting on site. Arrived late in evening and had to leave by 1 pm the next day. While my stay was short, sometimes you can tell how good (or bad) a place really is. 
Location is right next to Staple Center. While I didn't get chance to venture outside it looked like there was a lot there. Check in was smooth and when I asked for a room with view, they gave me choice and ended up with small upgrade to executive room. Room size was awesome, very spacious though to be fair, I am not sure how a standard room would be in size. 
TV was a big flat screen, bed was exceptionally comfortable. Had room service since everything was closed by the time I checked in. Food arrived on time and burger was better than most, as was the soup. Bathroom was also spacious and great shower. Checkout was smooth. Meeting rooms were a short indoor walk to attached building. 
Overall experience was so good that I wished I had a longer stay.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_text:
My husband and I stayed for 2 nights this past week. 
First the positive:
Front desk and concierge service is top notch. Rooms are spacious and clean. The location Is great if you are attending an event. 
Areas that need serious improvement:
The service in both the lobby lounge and the mixing longe is absolutely terrible. On a Monday evening we went to the mixing lounge and sat at a table (the bar was full but the seating area only had 8 people seated) and waited for approximately 10 minutes to order. There were 2 waitresses working but seemed to be more interested in talking to each other than serving customers. I finally went to the bar and ordered. In the hour I was seated at a table not 1 of the staff asked if I would like anything else or even approached me. this is unacceptable particularly when you are paying top $$ for cocktails. The lobby bar is not much better. 
I was also really disappointed in the housekeeping service. I left my room at approx. 1 PM and saw that housekeeping was servicing the adjacent room. I returned to my room at 5PM and the room had not been cleaned. I spoke with the front desk and they acted like it was no big deal and they would have someone service it. I'm sorry but at $300+ a night it was a big deal to me. 
The gym is great but he again the staff really need to work on their customer service skills. Too long of a story to bother with...
For $300+ a night there should be free internet service for all guests in their room. 
Also, be aware that overnight parking charges are ridiculous at $40 per night.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_text: Le camere sono molto pulite e ben curate, unico appunto il lavabo era separato dal bagno e trovavasi in stanza da letto. Personale molto disponibile. Ossessione pulizia...alle volte ti svegliano al mattino o ti entrano in stanza per pulire... Le chiavi magnetiche a volte si bloccano e vanno risettate... Comunque a parte questo ottima qualita'ad un prezzo contenuto e discreta comodita' per muoversi in citta'.

Stayed as a family at the end of november.great spacious rooms.brill location.excellent value.
Nice touch.staff arranged helium balloons & gifts for our anniversary & hubbys birthday

review_text: This hotel is great. Big rooms, great service, friendly staff. The only thing I could say bad about this hotel is that unless you are planning to spend most of your time at universal studios (which you can do in 1 day) it's just a bit further out of Hollywood then I expected but that's my own fault for not doing my research thoroughly enough.

First review ive been written; checkin was very smooth, ive been granted a room on top floor on my request while my hhonors profile stated low floor. My complimentary fruit was brought afterwards, very nice.
Nice staff and excellent location. Love the panoramic view from the room and everthing is facilitated. I do however find the placement of the refrigerator a bit strange, it isnt really part of the room interior, but hey, who cares :)

Valet service and the fancy lobby are misleading. There were holes in the ceiling from water damage on our floor. The light in the bathroom was installed crooked, shower head was crooked, ton drain drained slow and toilet also had drainage problems. I was not impressed with this place.and would not stay again.

Stay at this hotel for 2 nights. The rooms were fine and the pool and sauna were lovely. 
We had a hire car and we had to pay $15 a night to use the car park? Complimentary car parking should be the case saying as we are staying there?
Staff at breakfast buffet were unhelpful. Asked for tomato sauce 4 times and im still waiting.. It wasnt even busy! Never mind, part from that it was ok!

review_title: Worst hotel stay ever - Avoid this hotel!
review_text: I was kept awake all night from loud music in the ballroom followed by loud guests in the halls, and the hotel did nothing to remedy the noise. I paid for a night's sleep but received nothing but a headache. The paintings on the wall were literally rattling from the music - it was a horrible experience.

I found trip advisor Diane Cheek very helpful with my stay! Diane provide useful information that made my stay very comfortable. Please hire more staff like Diane and I will return time after time and recommend the Sheraton Gateway to friends. Thank you Diane.!

review_title: nice rooms, boring lobby, good service
review_text: If you want to be close to LAX this hotel is a good value for the high caliber rooms. The lobby and bar area is pretty boring and nothing great is within walking distance, so be prepared to drive a little. Diane was super helpful by sending up a mini fridge to my room, free of charge, so I could keep the food I brought cold, as I am on a strict diet. Thanks Diane!
The beds are only full not queens. It was very uncomfortable for our family of 3. The location and service was excellent.

review_title: WOW. Terrific. This hotel is amazing.
review_text: This hotel is situated in downtown LA. It's close to the staples centre and nokia centre and that's it. It's about a 20 min ride to anywhere where you'd want to be. The hotel is new. Absolutely gorgeous. Awesome, modern rooms. Large. Very clean and staff is nice. The pool is on the roof and is to die for. Nice poolside seating and towels are supplied. Pool side service if you wish as well. Staff is very honest. I forgot my safe unlocked with a lot of cash, iPad and passports. Came back, nothing was touched. This hotel is amazing and prices are great for what you get. Will definitely stay here again. One of the nicest hotels I've stayed at.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_text: We booked this hotel after receiving a great rate for 5 nights. At first I was a little worried about the location, I shouldn't have been worried at all! It is so easy to get to Hollywood, there is a subway or a bus stop right out front of the hotel! Facilities are great. There is a huge Ralph's food store a few blocks down. I'm really happy we stayed here and would recommend anyone stay here and make sure you visit universal studios!

review_title:
Don't Stay Here; They'll Steal From
You!
review_text:
How my relationship with this hotel was very disappointing; when we arrived we thought it was a gorgeous place with great spacious comfortable rooms and a great breakfast which was included in the price. 
The location isn't great as I think we'd have suited a hotel downtown more as we are two girls in our mid-20s but there was nothing physically wrong with downtown it just wasn't perfect.
Saying all that, i still wouldn't stay there again if you (ironically....you'll see my point next) paid me. 
The hotel took over $1,100 from me "by mistake" on top of the final hotel bill. It took four phone calls to four different people to get the money back. It is now a week since I made the first complaint that they had taken all this money without authorisation and I am still waiting for the remaining $500 to be returned to me. 
As a tourist on holiday from England I have saved up this money and they have taken it from me and only after speaking to four different people has it been returned to me. It has never been fully explained to me why this money was taken or for what purpose. After the first complaint I gave my mobile number and was told that I would be contacted when the problem was sorted. I was never contacted and I had to check my balance myself to see if the money had been returned. 
Don't stay here if you cannot afford for them to steal over $1000 from you.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_text:
I'm a long time lurker on these sites and I always try and do a little research here before going somewhere. I felt compelled to write my first ever review about the Hilton Universal City. I've stayed at many hotels, some famous, some not, some expensive, some cheap. Â I believe you get what you pay for and set my expectations accordingly. Needless to say, I expect a lot of things from a Hilton hotel. I will try to keep a simple, straightforward format in all the future reviews I write.
-dirty rooms- the first room we checked into had popcorn under the bed and under the chair and ottoman. I requested another room on a lower floor and this room had an empty water bottle under the bed. Â It was late and I didn't want to try a third room
-no military discount- If a discount can't be offered, maybe a food or parking voucher
-parking fee- I expected free parking or at least discounted parking for registered guests
-less than friendly staff- checked in late after a day at universal studios and the man who checked me in was not rude, but not friendly either
-unavailable shuttle- the shuttle to US ends service at 4:30pm. The park closes at 7pm. At least run until the park closes
-Internet fee- seems like a lot of high-end hotels charge for Internet while a lot of low to mid-level hotels offer free wifi. I never could understand that
I still have 1 more night here, but like I said, I felt compelled to write my first review. Proximity to the park earned this hotel another star, but this hotel disappoints as part of the Hilton chain.

review_title: Great location not as nice as excpected for a JW...for close too $300 a night.
review_text: Great location for us as my daughter was attending the Taylor Swift concert at th ec Staple center. Hotel was nice but not as nice as expected for a JW and the rate of almost $300 a night...I know Marriott has worked hard to build this brands reputaion. I was agrivated that they still charge for WiFi in this day and age I know the revenue I big marriott...but get a clue...its 2011 and most properties dont charge! To me tgis is not a trivial matter. I wanted to use my droid with a nic ec fast connectio. I know about hotels with over 21 years in the biz..
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_title: Best option for visit Universal Studios
review_text: Good hotel with nice & helpfull staff. Tula restaurant is good quality. Rooms are nice though a little bit noisy beacause of the freeway and Bob Hopen airport.

review_title: The best family accommodation on our entire trip of 5 stops
review_text: Very clean, great facilities including a small playground. Fantastic restaurant which also accommodates kids brilliantly. We happily booked and paid for an extra night due to a late flight out and we're very well looked after.

My husband was on a business trip that took us to LA. Â It was my first time to this part of California and I didn't know what to expect for a downtown location. Luckily I really liked this hotel.
The check in/out desk is right as you walk in; the lobby is beautiful and has a very smooth flow to it. Â Valet parking was quick and easy and was also right at the front door. Â 
There are a lot of places to eat within walking distance. Â LA live is literally right beside the hotel as is a Starbucks that opens early! (which was great if your from the East coast)Â 
The room we had was a corner suite that was just lovely! It had super cute furniture and a very large bathroom with great decor.Â 
The staff was friendly and seemed very attentive. Â The hotel is clean and maintained.Â All in all, hotel was very pleasant.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_title: Location is not everything.. Book the Ritz instead!!
review_text: Don't stay at Marriott. Online booking price totally misleading. $40 parking. $25 rollaway. Doesn't include a pillow and blanket. Front desk a d manager really do 't care. Rewards member since '91 and they just don't care. Just book the Ritz who will charge you but will give you great customer service. Manager took 4 hours to call and didn't leave much of a message. Guess i will call tomorrow and see if they care. Next step i will call the GM. Marriott is BAD,BAD,BAD.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_text: Friendly staff, nice pool, relaxed vibe, free shuttle to universal (drivers can also book you onto a Hollywood tour), clean rooms, decent restaurant. If you don't have a car then it's expensive using taxis to attractions other than universal. There's an efficient public transport bus service for a fraction of the price.

review_title: Great new hotel on the south end of downtown, near the Raleys market. Take a walk north to see the LA Architecture
review_text: Stayed here for a convention. On the south end of downtown now re-named South Park. New hotel. Very clean. Comfortable bed. Choose the rooms facing the LA Live to avoid the street noise. Walk to the nearby Raleys Market for great in room food and beverage. Walk to the Y or Golds Gym for a full service gym. Walk north to see the great LA arcitecture. Skip the high end expensive chains near the hotel. Yes, LA Live with its huge neon billboards is bizarre and annoying. But as a finnicky traveller, I liked everything about this hotel and the staff was very accomodating. Convention rate no bargain but I like new and clean.
