Even walk of Fame is an easy drive. Hotel is old but everything works. Food was consistently good at the only restaurant. Worth staying for visiting Holliwood area.

review_title: Fantastic place to stay for the Aussie tourist!
review_text: A great hotel with great service from reception to ground staff & the guys who manage the shuttle bus. After a long 14 hr flight it was a pleasure to reach the Beverly Garland. The rooms were clean and comfortable, service amazing & staff helpful & approachable. A relaxing place to stay. Great pool area & brand new laundry facilities on site. Convenient location - close to universal studios & shuttle bus is brilliant. Will go back for sure.

The Ritz Carlton at LA Live is world class. The hotel and it's staff are simply the best in Downtown Los Angeles. Check out WP on the 24th floor. Outstanding F & B..... 
I will be back in January.

review_title: Service now tops for Ritz Carlton
review_text:
I read the early reviews of this hotel and hesitated some before booking a club level room at the terrific (less than JW Marriott) American Bar Association rate. Upon arrival, I found that the facilities were excellent, as advertised. The club level lounge was the most visually appealing of any RC that I have booked. My upgraded executive room was very large, and the corner location had spectacular 23rd floor views.
The surprise was that the level of attention to detail, the friendliness, and the availability of staff not only met Ritz Carlton standards, but exceeded them. In fact, I would rate the service level as similar to those of the top Hotels in Asia.
For example, when I asked how to get to LA Live, the front desk person not only walked me to it, but provided free Grammy museum tickets!
On the first night, I ordered a second top sheet, which was not only delivered instantly, but was refreshed nitely. 
The lounge staff could not have been more friendly or helpful, and my request for 2pm checkout was honored.
Dinner at WP24was expensive but exceptional.
For those who found the service level initially lacking, I recommend a second chance.

We stayed here for 3 nights after returning from 5star hotels in Hawaii and las vegas.We were on our honeymoon and the beverly garland treated us better than either of these hotels. The Beverly Garland was the only hotel to bother recognising that it was our honeymoon with a beautiful gift in our room on arrival. 
A super, well run hotel at Universal.Thank you!
Great! Especially the Paparrazi lounge, with Horacio, love him! Great service, attentive, and just great

Arrived early before our check in time. The staff went above and beyond to get our room ready for us. Kids suites are spacious and clean. The restaurant offers a great selection of food and wait staff were also very friendly.

We stayed a Thurs and Fri night in early April. Staff was great! We were upgraded to a junior suite which was huge! The concierge lounge was very nice and the pool was fantastic. We ordered a roll away bed which was promptly delivered. Staff even called to double-check that it was delivered. Parking onsite is only valet at $40 per day. 20% discount for hybrid vehicles.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE

review_title: Great location, friendly staff, clean, nice facilities
review_text: Can get almost anywhere in LA quickly from here. Staff very helpful. Facilities are good, gym is a bit small but a nice outdoor pool. Rooms nothing special
Diane Cheek, with guest services at the Sheraton Gateway was extremely helpful throughout our stay. What a pleasure to get such great service! Be sure to ask for Diane when you stay there!

I would recommend a stay at the Beverly Garland. 
-rooms:
The rooms are comfortable and clean. The room was nicely decorated, however the wallpaper was coming off in the bathroom (which was really not an issue.). The bathroom is smaller than we are used to, only big enough for one person at a time. The patio is tiny, and the freeway is loud. But if the door is shut you don't hear the noise.
-pool:
We had a great time at the pool. Very relaxing atmosphere. At its deepest it is 5 feet so perfect for my daughter.
-service:
The front desk was extremely helpful and friendly. Staff on site always offered a smile and hello. The restaurant (Tula's) had good food and service - the best service was given by our waiter Pedro- I have never had a better waiter anywhere!
-location:
I think this hotel provides the best location if you will be touring Universal or the Walk of Fame. There is a free shuttle to Universal or the Metro (subway.) the bus picks up right across the street. There is a grocery that you can walk to. We enjoyed the quiet at the hotel after our busy days of sightseeing.

Excellent hotel. Outstanding staff. The service is the best I have ever experienced in any hotel, anywhere in the world. Particularly housekeeping and concierge. Bar staff offered me suggestions on what to see in LA in my spare time. Completely refurbished June 11 and is immaculate and furnished to a very high standard throughout. 
The West Pico boulevard runs next hotel (and the outdoor pool is on this side) so there is some traffic noise, but this is not too bad.

The hotel is wonderful you can't beat the location Really close to rodeo drive but in an quiet neighborhood in Beverly hills 
Everybody is very professional and nice - great concierge ( Salomon ) 
Would stay again !

We stayed on the 4th floor facing the road in a standard (deluxe room). The rooms are very nice, hardwood floors, very clean, extremely comfortable beds, good size rooms, 42" tv, iPhone charger, complimentary bottled water, nice balcony.
The staff are very polite, the concierge was particularly helpful.
Yes there is a bit of road noise With the street facing rooms but the balony door are very effective and it didn't effect our sleep.
Being located on Pico boulevard it easy has access to the Big Blue Bus which takes you to Santa Monica Pier (no.7 bus). Walking distance to restaurants, pharmacy across the road, supermarket 200 meters down Beverly Dr
I got a great deal through Expedia paid 40% off which made our stay great value, I didn't use the restaurant or pool during our stay

I stayed here for my honeymoon, as j was Checking in, the lady at the desk congratulated us and iformed us that our room was upgraded. She also arranged us a town car for us to go on a private tour which we enjoyed very much. When we got to the room there were balloons that was tied up to a little gift that had a pivture frame and some chocolates. In the morning we received a personal wake up call from the same person that checked us in the day before and and she also made sure that everything was ok with our stay. A few hours later they called our room and told us that our driver was here, before we left the ladies at the desk gave us some bottled water to take with us on our trip. Everyone at the hotel was wonderful. Everything was perfect with our stay, I had never felt so relaxed and worry free. They confirmed our shuttle ride to the airport the next day.

Arrival is very pleasent and welcoming - Rooms have a special layout with a mini closet ( wie had a Studio Suite ) - Balcony is fine, but blv traffic 24/7 - Swimmingpool is a joke - Restaurant is decent but Way overpriced - ASK for rooms located 7th Floor and up - go for a king bed - queen is tiny - skip breakfast and stop by starbux ( 35$ will buy you a lot at SBX

review_title: Good hotel, however very noisy due to poor windows
review_text:
This hotel is very nicely decorated, the service is impeccable, and the location is very good. 
However, we had a room on Picco Boulevard, and the floor-to-ceiling windows are very inefficient in terms of noise-proofness. We have spent the two nights with earplugs as we felt we were sleeping on the boulevard. 
I suppose if you take a room facing Beverly Hills, this is not as much an issue - this would be my recommendation if you want to fully enjoy the nice hotel and beautiful new furniture.

Fantastic service at this hotel. 
Rooms are clean and spacious, but the bathrooms lack ventilation. 
Downside? Noisy and lack of soundproof doors. That is a problem that shouldn't exist at a 5 star hotel. 
Wifi system is also so slow and unstable. Need to be upgraded to fit a hotel at this level. 
Location is really good, but the pool is microscopic for a hotel that has 5 stars. 
Restaurant is good but overpriced. 
Will be back if I get a good deal.

review_title: Wonderful albeit slightly out of town
review_text:
We stayed in a deluxe room with views of Beverley Hills.
The staff were excellent from start to finish, welcoming,warm, professional and friendly. On arrival we received a delicious complimentary Belini and everything was taken care of.
The rooms were fantastic, large, bright and very well furnished with quality Italian products throughout.
Some members have raised the food as an issue but we thought it was well presented and tasty with excellent staff, both for breakfast and dinner.
We will return asap!
Thanks for a wonderful stay

We have changed three rooms in three days. We did not get the two dbl beds requested. One of us had to sleep on an uncomfortable roll away. Our keys could not work, the "engineer is unable to fix it". The next day we were sent to another room with a rollaway. The three of us slept in a king bed. Tonight i checked in for the third time into a dbl bed room. Where's my luggage, i don't know. The staff has no idea what they are doing. There's no one over 30 working here. They're playing games on their phone and oh the concierge is gone for this evening. Mr. C needs to come personally and get a seasoned staff for any hope of this hotel to last.

One of the best hotels in the U.S. The service is the shining star of this hotel. Of course the food is fabulous and the rooms superbly appointed. The location is tucked away in a quiet area but close to wherever you need to be in Beverly Hills. A wonderful hotel.

I spent 4 nights at the hotel either side of my recent trip to the US. The hotel is in a good location close to Universial Studio's and about a $16 cab ride from Hollywood BLVD. Hotel Is very clean and comfortable. The rooms are spacious and the hotel facilities were good other than the WiFi not working in our room. The resturants served great breakfast and dinner and very well priced for hotel food.

review_title: Jerry and his wife went out of their way to help us!
review_text: What a fantastic find. Great value for money and location. Will stay here again when we come back.

review_title: Great location, great service and top notch rooms.
review_text:
The best thing about this hotel is the value for money. The rooms are new with a flat screen tv, microwave and fridge freezer. There are two sinks one in the bathroom and one outside which is very convenient when staying with friends. 
The staff are really helpful and are always willing to help and give advice on where to go etc.
The location is pretty decent in harbour city with access to long beach and the rest of LA via many roads so you can navigate the traffic using a well organised tomtom!
All in all would 100% stay here again on my return visit to LA
hotel_name: Rodeway Inn & Suites Pacific Coast Highway

review_title: Excellent price for centrally located hotel
review_text:
Stayed here for a couple nights in LA very centrally located to downtown LA and very easy drive to universal studios..... The free parking is a definite plus..... When we turned up at night I was a little skeptical of the neighborhood looked a little sketchy but definitely had no problems.
Service was good and friendly and rooms were clean, can't ask for much more for the price and location

The motel itself was clean and cheap with free parking, flat screen, safe, free wifi microwave and fridge. The location is convenient. Easy to find and get places from (downtown, santa monica, hollywood etc). The area however is a bit run down and I would not walk around after dark. That said I think that's true of a lot of LA.

Not only is this not in Beverly Hills It is pretentious and overpriced and obnoxious. They got their friends to come on opening night and they will never have that kind of crowd again
Beware. False advertising!

Good place for stay any night... 
Near to LA Downtown and near little Korea...
Very recommend for low price and fast checking. 
A typical Motel of crime films...

Our second and third stay at the Rodeway.. As before service was excellent and rooms as clean as ever.. Our second visit was uneventful, we brought a third person with us managing to get a roll away just about in room, owner is extremely obliging offering to remove some furniture to make room.. The third visit was marred by noisy guests up till 5 am talking loud in the car park and on the balcony. I lightly sleep so had difficulty drifting off.. And can only assume got the wrong room after drinking as were trying key card in our door.. Luckily I have my sons with me.. Had I been female and alone I'm sure it would have been rather frightening. But you really can't blame the owner for his guests getting drunk and eating pizza all night. 
If you're looking for a no thrills but very good value stay I would highly recommend this Rodeway, it's clean and area is safe.
hotel_name: Rodeway Inn & Suites Pacific Coast Highway

review_text: Everything was great just wished the beds were queen and not twins. I would remove small table for more space. But good for a quick weekend trip.
hotel_name: Rodeway Inn & Suites Pacific Coast Highway

review_text: Great location, clean, great parking no fee. Great Indian tea in the morning. Will stay here again for sure!!!!

review_title: Stylish comfortable stay on a busy LA boulevard.
review_text:
We stayed at the Brentwood Inn for one night while visiting friends in Santa Monica. 
Pros:
- Rooms are small but well appointed, clean, well laid out, and comfortable. Several touches, including pictures, high ceilings, furnishings, give the rooms character and style that seems unusual.
- Price. For LA, the Brentwood seems like an excellent value.
- perks. Cookies and milk at 4pm. Bottled water in in-room fridge. Breakfast (Costco pastries, fruit, yogurt, coffee). 
Cons:
- noise from Sunset. If you're a light sleeper, this could be a problem. 
Overall, we will be back.

Das Hotel ist sehr gut gelegen. Sie erreichen zu Fuss alle Sehenswuerdigkeiten von Beverly Hills. Shoppen am Rodeo Drive und Kaffe wie pretty woman im Beverly Wilhsire Hotel. Das Hotel ist mit erlesenen Designermoebeln eingerichtet, alles vom feinsten. jedes Zimmer hat seinen eigenen Style. Viele Mitarbeiter scheinen von einem Hochglanzmagazin zu kommen. Schoener Pool mit bequemen Liegen. Das Fruehstueck ist sehr teuer. Gleich die Strasse runter gibts das Urth Kaffee, sehr empfehlenswert.

review_title: Cosy, nice location, friendly staff, good value for money
review_text: Brentwood is a nice neighborhood, upscale houses, close to santa monica, twenty minutes from hollywood boulevard and very close to the beautifull Getty museum. As mentioned in most other reviews very friendly staff, nice rooms, reasonable prices. Will stay here again!

Stayed after the new renovations. The exterior is the same but the rooms have been updated. The rooms have a great tv with ipod hookup and the remote controls all lights and a/c. The only issue is that the bugs still need to be worked out with the electronics. The staff went out of their way to help however. The food was great and the overall experience was very nice. The occupancy was not up to the previous levels but should be soon.

review_title: Good place to stay for a value price.
review_text: Clean rooms, decent location, good value. There was some music playing late at night from the apartments next door, but it didn't keep me up. The location is pretty close(@15 min. drive) to Hollywood blvd, downtown, & dodger stadium if there's no traffic.

It is located in Harbor City, it is a good choice for visiting L.A. Â The room was very clean and nicely furnished. The breakfast was essential. The owners are kind and polite and are always available for any information.
hotel_name: Rodeway Inn & Suites Pacific Coast Highway

review_text: We arrived at LA at the end of our west cost road trip, had picked Jerry's because of the reviews on tripadvisor and if was all true. Jerry was very friendly and provide us a great service. The room was very clean and location was good if you are doing tourism. We were really happy with our choice!

Good location close to city centre and union station where my train travel around the states was starting. Jerry's wife welcomed me with wonderful cooking smells eminating from her kitchen. She generously offered a serve of the pasta she was making. My room was very clean and comfortable. On checking out Jerry offered to drive me to the station. Wonderful hospitality.
Stayed here for one night with my family after a long journey. Had the best night sleep so far on our travels. Good location and plenty of amenities nearby. Would definitely book again.
hotel_name: Rodeway Inn & Suites Pacific Coast Highway

review_text: This was my 1st time staying at a Kimpton hotel and I was very pleased. Our room was clean and of course had the kimpton touch! Animal print bathrobes, interesting decor and cool furniture. No gold fish though. I loved the complimentary 5:00 happy hour (just vino) in the lobby and coffee and tea in the morning. Great bar/lounge area in hotel for late night. Very fun place to stay!

review_text: After reading the reviews here, I was a bit surprised when I checked in. It's a small hotel with few amenities. The staff were incredibly friendly: no complaints there at all. The wine and cheese reception is nice. The "suite" I stayed in was small: hardly what I would call a suite. No exercise options that are convenient at all. The computers in the business center lacked any software to work with MS Office documents. It's not really that convenient to Hollywood or the airport, either. There are some restaurants in the area, but not a great selection.

I stayed at the Palomar while on a business trip in the Los Angeles area. I have stayed at Kimpton hotels in the past and was looking forward to staying at another one. Everything was fine except for two things: they only have valet parking which is to be expected for hotels in the Westwood area along Wilshire Blvd, but personally I always like parking my own car even if it's a rental. The second thing that came up was when I checked into the hotel they had already checked someone in under my reservation who had a similar name (different first name but his middle name was the same as my first name). The front desk clerk supposedly fixed the problem but I knew there would be issues when I checked out. First there was no receipt under my door when I woke up in the morning. As a frequent business traveler, I hate having to stop by the front desk when I check out and for business reasons I have to get a paper receipt. Additionally when I checked my AMEX charges before leaving my room I saw a $313 charge (not an authorization but an actual charge) from the hotel. As I feared they charged the person's charges who originally checked in under my reservation to my credit card. The front desk staff was helpful in trying to resolve the problem including giving me a credit, but I'll have to wait a couple of days to see how everything turns out when I try and do my expense report.

review_text: Excellent hotel. I must give cheers to the staff especially the front desk. They are the definition of good services! I also like how the rooms are super close to your parking. The only down side is the noise. I stayed in the room closest to the road so you can hear a little bit of traffic noise, but it wasn't a big deal. Keep the windows close and you will be fine. All in all what a great hotel!!

Again this was a trip advisor based booking and it was really good! We stayed for four nights, the rooms are basic, but the location is great, close to Metro buses (straight forward to reach Santa Monica/Venice beach) & subway (one stop to Universal Studios) and right next to the Hollywood Blvd/Chinese theatre etc.
Also for the low price the free extras of wifi Internet & breakfasts were great. But above all the customer service while checking in and answering any queries we had during our stay was excellent.

review_title: Wonderful location and very friendly staff
review_text:
We were not sure what to expect of this place as it looked like an old rental complex in the online pictures. The hotel is situated
In the perfect location. You can walk a few hundred feet and be in the midst of all the action. There is even a large, very Nice mall in the same complex. The suite we stayed in did cry out for some updating but the big screen tv and kitchen area were great. Nice breakfast and a very friendly staff mAke this place a winner. The parking was easy too but the spaces are small. Folks, make sure to do your homework and plan your trip well. LA is very spread out with lot's of fun stuff to do. I was amazed that so many people that were staying there knew little about the attractions except for the obvious ones. Check out the Getty museum and the aquarium in long beach beach, must see's.

review_title: Great location, very clean,includes breakie has good wifi in rooms
review_text: The short review says all ! This hotel is well priced for the great location. Right next to a big shopping mall and in the centre of all the action.(1minute walk) Older style place but well looked after and very clean. Basic typical breakie. The room we are in now has a full kitchen.

If location is what you look for, then this is the right hotel. It is literally 3 minutes walk from Hollywood Walk of Fame.
If you look for a great service, instead, you might be disappointed. Rooms are spacious but a bit dark.Â 
I had asked for a quiet room not facing N Highland Blv and, at first, I was happy that it faced an open corridor below the pool. However silence was not guaranteed at all! At around 5 am a continuous noise started. At first it sounded like someone was banging above us. But it was not a noisy neighbor! I later found out that we were located on the third floor next to the hotel laundry so the noise came from the washing machines.
Breakfast was also a bit disappointing as the room was too small and people would queue to wait for a table.
In short I don't think it is worth the price we paid but I understand options are very limited in this area anyway.

review_text: Everything you would expect from a leading Hotel. The staff were exceptional and always on hand. The concierge helped plan our stay and arranged our excursions. No plans to return to LA yet, but have booked at Sofitel's for forthcoming trips.

Stayed at Sofitel after Mandarin in Vegas which in all probability has raised expectations unfairly high. 
Pros:
Good location. 
Great staff. 
Very good beds! I need a firm bed and it was much better than the one in Vegas which was way too soft. 
Cons:
Not sure if it's the standard in LA (or most cities in the states) but the standard rooms were rather small and cramp.
Wifi charges is based on each device. I have a personal phone, a corporate phone and an iPad. Do I really have to choose which to use? 
The shower is really weak and is designed poorly as water always gets out and wets the entire bathroom. 
Overall, average hotel.

review_title: Our home away from home on LA
review_text:
Besides the great value, the breakfast and the wine and cheese; it's the friendly service that sets this small gem of a hotel apart.
The location is great especially if you know to take LaCienega right to LAX. We come from the east coast several times a year to visit our son, and this is THE place for us.

My wife and I stayed here during a recent vacation to LA. Centrally located near Beverly Hills. Very modern feel to the hotel. Stylish pool area. Also has a very hopping nightclub. Overall a great stay!

The best position you could ask for! 20 metres from the rear entrance to Hollywood and Highland. Suite 300 is a large, older style one bedroom apartment with full kitchen facilities. Breakfast is rudimentary but sufficient. Excellent value for the price. Alas the wifi only worked for a few hours of our five night stay.

For anyone who has watched Fawlty Towers you know exactly what I'm talking about. If not then YouTube it! Rooms are very average, however you can't beat the location. If you expect the worst then you will be pleasantly surprised. The lady on the front desk is Marlo and she's just the best. So friendly and helpful. My mum and I just Adored her. If your used to staying in 4 and 5 star hotels (like my mum and I) it will be a culture shock, make sure you bring along your sense of humor....
Our toilet got blocked with feoces floating in it (neither of us had done a number two) we were told by front desk to come collect the plunger and attend to it ourselves. Mum was disgusted however I thought this was just hilarious. They finally sent a plain clothed man to fix it who looked like someone they pulled off the street. 
On our second last day here the front desk man got drunk on the job. Some guests weren't impressed but mum and I were so used to the abnormalities of the hotel by then. This really made our stay at orchid suites, I've never laughed so hard in my life. 
Overall I highly reccommend this hotel and have friends who can't wait to stay here to have this experience. Do yourself a favor and only stay here.

review_title: Good place to stay in Hollywood
review_text: This hotel is really a good place to stay. Great location. Walk to many attractions and restaurants. If you are driving it is difficult to get out of the hotel because of traffic. The parking should be free but the valets are very helpful and quick. All of the staff were excellent. The breakfast was good but certainly nothing fancy. The double queen room was very large, clean and comfortable. Make sure you see a concert at the Hollywood Bowl. Take a picnic there before the show. Best part of our trip. Note that because of the breakfast buffet there will be mostly families at the hotel and the breakfast room is packed. Get there early. They do keep it stocked.

review_text:
As mentioned by others this is an old apartment block converted into a hotel. Overall I would stay here again as the location is FANTASTIC. 
The Good: location (right behind Kodak Theatre), very close to red metro line stop, good basic breakfast included in price (cereal, bagels, croissants, fruit, juice, muffins), laundry facilities, good pool, reasonably priced vending machine (eg. 1$ water), 24hr reception, friendly staff.
The Bad: the hotel is older (60s maybe) which is fine for the price, however the air conditioner was older and very loud and positioned 3 feet from the bed at the same height as the bed so I either had to chose between no air conditioning (a bit hot and stuffy with 3 people in the room) or near arctic conditions blowing on my back all night. There was a strong smell of air freshener which was overpowering when we arrived. The carpet felt dampish, and I thought it must have been cleaned prior to our arrival, however I noticed that after walking on the carpet in bare feet there was a black film all over the soles of my feet-a little off-putting. We also had to keep asking for an extra towel as we had booked the room for 3 and only 2 were replaced each day, which was not a big deal but a bit annoying. 
Overall, I would return based on the great location and other positive points I noted above.

The bathroom was also a decent size. It was also in a great location, about a 5-10 min walk to Hollywood, where all the action happens. We also had free breakfast included and free wifi which was a great plus, since other hotels rip you off for wifi. Definitley stay here in LA, ut's great!!

Everything in the hotel is very clean and beds are comfortable. This hotel also has a great gym. The rooms are a bit small but that isn't a problem for me when visiting LA as I would rather be outside. A definite recommend if your wanting to stay in this area and be close to all the best that LA has to offer.

review_title: What else is there to say, other reviewers have captured it!
review_text: A great stay when in los Angeles! Rooms are very large, modern, full amenities, comfortable and clean. Very friendly staff and easy check in. Great location. Try to eat at cleo when here, awesome! I have stayed at many hotels in the area and this takes the prize! Will be back!

The Redbury Hotel is outstanding. I'd say the Redbury gives its closest competitor (aka The Roosevelt Hotel) a definite run for the money. The Redbury, for as cool/hip as it is, seemed to have a less pretentious vibe. Not to mention (but I will) I thought I might miss hanging out by the pool, but to be honest, not having to be reminded that my body was less than perfect was a nice change of pace (as the Redbury is without a pool). In place of a pool, the Redbury offers "The Library"...a great indoor/outdoor lounge. Finally, the rooms are amazing! The washer/dryer and turn table are nice touches. The rooms feel as though you're staying at a friend's cool condo, downtown (as opposed to a typical hotel room). I will definitely return to The Redbury.

review_text: I stayed here on a business trip back in July and again in November. Both times we were upgraded without asking to a 2 bdrm suite. Good location for restaurants and nightlife, as well as the tourist spots if that's your interest. Service great, especially the concierge services for nightlife suggestions and hookups. Will definitely return.

This hotel is very well located. The service by the receptionist Mickey was truly 5 out of 5. We were upgraded to a king room, the hotel is clean and the beds are comfy. The pool area is small but cute. The walk of fame is just a short walk away and you can see the Hollywood sign if you look up to the left as you leave the hotel. review_text:
While this isn't the Ritz Carlton, it is a fabulous find. Bed room huge along with full kitchen and bath. Beautiful rooftop garden where we had our cocktails. 
Location, Location, Location. You just walk out the door and go 1/4 block into the entrance to the Kodak Theater Mall, which has some great restaurants or walk out the mall and you are on Hollywood Blvd. Great place to people watch as they gaze at the Grahman Chinese Theater or the Hollywood walk of fame.

Great Place & Location if you want to be in the heart of all the action. Rooms are phenominal and very large. Decor is unique,modern,retro & simply put;SPECIAL!! Did not feel like a hotel at all. More like a great flat in the villiage of NYC! Restaurant Cleo's def one of the Best places I've ever eatin. Service was great.

review_title: A quiet elegant haven on Upper East Side.
review_text: The hotel is inconspicuous from outside, which I consider a plus in a place like Manhattan. The first look at the Lobby gives a feeling of modern traditional hospitality, no frills, consistent. This sensation is utterly confirmed when entering the room, with all the right things in the right places. The recent refurbishing offers an updated range of features, from HD tv set, to top notch wi-fi connection (complimentary). The bar at the Lobby is lively at happy hour, haunted mostly with New Yorkers. If you're looking for something different than the upscale International hotels available worldwide, this is definitely a place to try.

This was our 3rd stay in LA and 2nd time at the Sofitel (1st stay at four seasons for honeymoon). We stayed in the opera suite and found the suite to be very spacious and clean.
We were travelling with our 1 year old and the staff went out there way to make sure we had everything we needed and felt very at home.
The location is excellent for both shopping and sight seeing.

The location is absolutely amazing. Right on Beverley across the Beverly center. My first room had no electricity... This was unfortunate due to my late arrival. Housekeeping took approx 45 minutes to bring shower gel in the am. No coffee.

review_title: Great location, attentative staff & walking distance to everything you need!
review_text: I read the reviews. I don't understand the negativity. Its a "botique" hotel experience. Its a lovely hotel. They allowed me a late check out. Staying here for a week. In the center of WeHo. Safe area. I walk every night by myself & I am a small statuted female. The staff is super nice & accommodating. Only valey parking but this is WeHo you know. The reviews stated the rooms were small. Ok so they are, but unless it's more than 2 people staying over well I just don't see the problem. I would stay here again & my comparisons are based upon being very well travelled.

The location and vibe are perfect! Obviously very connected to the city and the neighborhood. Great place for extended stays. The company also owns lots of cool restaurant which is really cool and a big benefit.

The Redbury is an amazing place to stay! Rooms are fully equiped with everything you need to survive a weekend in LA. There is ample space, including a kitchen and living room. The hotel is at Hollywood and Vine - prime location for all that is happening!
There are 2 venues to eat within the hotel. Both were great. Saw a few stars during dinner at Cleo, and the "Library" has an amazing outside lounge and bar.
Valet staff stand out, very respectful and helpful, as well as Jeff one of the hosts. Jeff provided us with LOTS of ideas for things to do in LA. Overall this was a great experience and I will definitly be returning!
Only other thing I would add is that as a mother of 4 kids I would say this is more of a non-kid hotel. The Library boasts music until late night, and while it didn't disturb us, it may disturb young children.

My boyfriend and I LOVE this hotel! We've stayed here 3 times now and always enjoy ourselves. The staff is always great and even remembered us from prior visits, which made us feel good, like we're not just random faces they have to help as part of their job. They rooms are so uniquely designed (the whole place is really). I love the living rooms and kitchens so you can stay in and make something if you want. There's a Trader Joes right down the street. My favorite part is the record player and vinyl records. Every room has a different selection. That's the first thing I check when I get in the room. My only complaint would be the lighting in the bathroom. It's pretty dark and makes putting make up on kinda hard, especially if you're trying to dress up at night. The restaurant in the hotel, Cleo, is good. But we really like Katsuya, which is only a block away. Try them both if you get the chance!

Great Westwood location. You have to drive anywhere you go in LA and this hotel is easy to navigate from to Beverley Hills etc. 
Rooms are boutique in style with zebra dressing gowns and fun decoration. Newly decorated and well kept. 
Free Internet and $10 mini bar credit if you sign up to Kimpton rewards. 
If I stayed here again I would try to get a room on a higher floor as there is some traffic noise - but let's not forget this is a busy city and noise is not uncommon.
Breakfast is simple but service needs a little attention. The valets and concierge were excellent. Why don't we have valet parking in England? what could be nicer than after sitting in LA traffic than hoping out of the car right outside the hotel door and going straight up to your room to crash out!

review_text:
Stayed here for 6 nights on my first trip to the USA. 
If you want to see Hollywood this place is perfect. It's right at the kodak theatre and walk of fame. Easy access to train line and freeways
Free wi-fi breakfast and parking were a great inclusion
The hotel is a bit old, but can't really complain about that, it was clean and spacious,
Would stay here again

In short an amazing experience.Â 
We stayed three nights at the Sofitel Los Angeles and were really impressed from the moment we arrived until our departure.Â 
The hotel had a perfect location for us, located close (walking distance)Â to the bars and restaurants of West Hollywood and an easy drive to the sights of Hollywood and Beverly Hills. Â 
We hired a car and found our way to the hotel easy from LAX. Friendly and efficient valet parking is available for US$32 per night which we found reasonable for the area. Â We were greeted with a stylish and modern lobby and were hugely appreciative of being able to check into our room even though it was only 10am. Service was really personalized and efficient. Â The receptionist on completion of checking us in actually walked us over to the elevators and pointed out and explained all the services of the hotel. We found this very thoughtful and helpful.Â 
We had a room on the 8th floor and were extremely happy with it. Â It was a good size with an amazingly comfortable bed. It had a small Juliette balcony and a spacious bathroom with large walk in rain shower. We slept really well and the corridors were very quiet.Â 
Wired and wireless Internet was available in the rooms for a charge but there was also four Mac's located in the lobby complete with a printer that guests could use for free.Â 
There is a small pool and sun deck as well as a spa and a gym. The gym is quite simply one of the best hotel gyms I've encountered. A large facility with a full range of cardio, free weights, weight machines and more. There was also a spa but we didn't have time to use any of the treatments.Â 
We didn't use any of the food or beverage outlets within the hotel as we were pretty much constantly out and about and there is a huge range of dining venues within walking distance of the hotel.
If I had to find any 'could do better' points of the hotel it would be to provide tea and coffee facilities in the rooms (there are none) and to extend the gym opening hours or make it a 24hr facility. The gym is not manned and access is gained with your room key. I noticed that a lot of guests were from Australia/NZ/Asia and on their home time zones and the gym was starting to get busy at 9pm (morning time in those time zones) so it would have been great to have extended use of the facility.
But all in all a fantastic and beautiful hotel that I would highly recommend. And provided I could get a competitive rate with them again I would definitely make it my hotel of choice in LA.

The Mark is everything a hotel should ever strive to be. Perfect location, perfect size (more than
Boutique without being mass Market) perfect rooms, perfect staff, perfect food. I honestly did not want to leave. I stay in 5 star hotels on average twice a month and have never experienced such a painfully perfect hotel. The staff know who you are, the GM makes a point of greeting his guests. Even as a first time guest I was welcomed like an old friend. Coupled with Jean Georges fantastic restaurant The Mark is simply the only hotel in New York worth staying at!!
Amazing service. Amazing decor. Excellent restaurant. Loved everything about it.

I just stayed at the Sofitel in LA and experienced an amazing and helpful staff, plus great food at Simon LA and neat and clean rooms with suitable business amenities. Highly recommended. No one said no to any requests! They really treated my collegue and I so well.

review_title: Quiet elegance at its best...a memorable stay
review_text: I have stayed at the mark twice and have love it! The service is outstanding and extremely accomidating. The breakfast in the resturant is well worth the stay. Everything is up to date with remote control ability of the shades and lights. There is even a built in tv in the mirror of the bathroom. It is a short walk to central and other places of interest.

We had a sunset flat suite with a rollaway bed in the redbury. This place is very elegant and nice. The staff is very friendly and it is located right nice to the main attratives of Hollywood! It was a peaceful paradise in the middle of a busy tourism district! We loved it! The only thing we don't like is that we dad to pay for the Internet. 10 dollars for 24 hours. In the morning when we were about to check out, we lost our access to the internet although we havent used up 24 hours.
Beautiful! Great service no problems no hidden charges ... Will be staying here from now on...

I really like this hotel, quite rooms.
breakfast is good.

Large room

review_text:
Fantastic rooms, great service, good location. Plenty of restaurants nearby, and the Beverly centre across the road. 
Staff were welcoming and genuinely helpful. Will definitely stay here again.

Hotel is ideally located to all of the major sites (within walking distance) of Hollywood. Walked to Hollywood Bowl, Hollywood sign, Kodak Theatre, Chinese Theater, Walk of Fame, etc. And all within a few blocks. Rooms are very nice and clean. The staff is amazing! Especially Marletta in the breakfast room. She delivered coffee and water to our room at 4am when we couldn't get our coffee pot working. THANKS AGAIN. Free breakfast and free wifi are appreciated perks.

review_title: Nice hotel but not very good location
review_text:
Overall the hotel is nice the conceirge was so helpful, we asked for universal adapter because our phone charger input is different but they didn't have one. The location is not good but they offer you a very good service which is a car drop you any where u want with in a 3 miles and when u finish u can call them to pick you up back to hotel. 
I would go again but it will not be my first option

review_text:
Family of 2 adults and 2 teenagers from Australia stayed for 4 nights mid January. Last stay of month long holiday and hotel made it very hard to leave. Staff were extremely friendly and patient with our many questions, they had great advice and tips, went to a Lakers game and gave all metro info etc on that. Used car service to transfer us to LAX driver was wonderful, full of info and very personable. Room were huge which more than accommodated our 8 suitcases! 
Only fault is we had a room facing road which could be noisy during night and early morning but that is unavoidable and not fault of hotel. Breakfast was a nice bonus and stocks and breakfast room well maintained by diligent lady. 
Location was excellent being minutes to Hollywood Blvd and Metro station, will definitely choose again.

review_title: The Omni has been revamped and upgraded decor since my last stay, while the once bleak location offers many more activities fro
review_text: I was hoping to get the Westin Bonaventure as a Priceline bid, and the Omni was where I ended up. It turned out to be a blessing in disguise. I noticed a great deal of minor improvements in the decor + amenities, and helpful staff and free Starbucks coffee available in the lobby helps a 6am departure along. The neighborhood around the hotel was way more poppin' on a Friday night than a couple years ago as well. Not only was there the Disney Concert Hall, but free live performances at the California Plaza, and a couple punky dive bars just down the hill. Aside from the once lonely California Pizza Kitchen nearby, the food choices were better, ranging from hipster restaurants with outdoor cocktails, Asian to Pizza.

review_text: Very happy with our stay. Nice rooms. Beautiful hotel. Great location. Complaints were: AC did not remove humidity in room and as a result the room felt clammy. Parking mid week is horribly expensive. Half as much on weekends. Also I hate bathrooms with no ceiling vent/fan. Steamy shower added to the already "moist" room. Minor complaints. We would stay again.

It's a great hotel with great people, another Omni success, keeps us coming back to this brand above all the rest.
Only negative is that the area is downtown... Come to find out that isn't really near anything you want.

review_title: Wonderful and beautiful 5 star hotel in a great location.
review_text:
Had the opportunity to stay at this great property for a couple days last week. It feels brand new , the staff is extremely nice. Public areas are beautifully decorated (bar/lounge , lobby , outdoor garden , restaurant). The rooms are very clean and tastefully designed. Nice size room and large windows. 
I only had breakfast in the hotel restaurant but it is very nice , staff is very attentive and food was excellent. 
Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone wanting to stay in soho area of new york , eventhough it is a bit more expensive than other options.

The Crosby Street Hotel (Firmdale Hotel) is a real trend setter hotel where every details is important. From the warming welcome arrival to a very updated and very well informed concierge. Apple computers everywhere. The area is very nice. I had a 11th floor de luxe room with ceiling window and a fantastic overview on Manhattan. Wifi everywhere. And you feel at home, all staff is gently and smiling. They care you all day. Breakfast impressive for the quality more than the quantity of the food. Definetely will come back next time in New York. High value high price but you get really quality in this hotel.

review_title: Fabulous; a treat of a place well worth paying for.
review_text: Relaxing with attentive, but not suffocating service. A class act who have translated their successful London formula well in NY.

review_title: Perfect location, excellent rooms, awesome staff.
review_text:
We just ended a 5 day stay here and we had a prefect experience in every way. The staff was super helpful, efficient, and friendly. The location was absolutely perfect. We were within walking distance of the best New York has to offer. And just a brief walk to the subway for more distant attractions. 
This was our first family trip to New York and the staff at this hotel, combined with the location, made our apprehensions fade and helped us have one of our more memorable vacations. We will definitely return and won't look to stay anywhere but The French Quarters. 
Thanks to all the staff!

This is one of the best hotels I've ever stayed in - if not the best!
Service was top-notch right from my late post-midnight arrival. Decor is fantastic. Remarkably quiet. Great bed. 
You really get the sense that they want to go the extra mile here. The complimentary minibar and (loads of) snacks is a brilliant detail that means more than you'd think. 
The rooms are "rustic" with part wooden floor and part old furniture, but it's all been refurbished as e.g. the beautiful old closet had lights installed. 
Bathroom was just a work of art!
And don't even get me started on the restaurant. Best. Pasta. Ever!
Definitely coming back as soon as I can defend the slightly elevated price on my expenses.

review_title: Great location - small hotel big personality
review_text: We are a family of four ( including 2 teenagers) who stayed here for 5 days in August. Overall this was an excellent choice for us. The location is fantastic - on restaurant row. We had a 2 bedroom suite (room 501) which had a fantastic rooftop terrace. The room was really nicely decorated and the beds were incredibly comfortable. The only problem was a lack of space to put 4 large suitcases. Because we were at the top of the building we heard no noise from the bar below but did occasionally get some early morning street noise - but this is NY so to be expected. The breakfast was adequate - they did occasionally run out of things and it would have been nice to have it available until later. However, when our teenagers couldn't cope with rushing for breakfast, the breakfast staff very kindly sent food up for them. The bar downstairs had a really nice atmosphere although the one meal we ate there was decidedly average. The staff were friendly and helpful. A great stay.
