review_text: This hotel is clean and has large rooms in NY terms, BUT when the temperature reaches the 90s you want to be able to control the temperature from your own room. Not here - management controls it! And the breakfast is terrible, I am not sure why they bother serving it. But the rooms are large and comfortable and clean, your decision...

review_title: Best place I have ever stayed in NYC
review_text: This is a rave review. The service here is beyond outstanding, the rooms are beautifully decorated, the beds are comfortable, it's all well appointed, immaculate. And the location for this theatre-goer is perfect. Good and reasonable restaurants are plentiful and within easy walking distance. And they are calling a town car to pick us up for an early am flight. The owner here got everything just right.

review_title: I cannot find enough positive adjectives to use!
review_text: We just spent an absolutely superb 4 days at The Crosby. The hotel is perfect in every way from the location smack bang in the middle of everything to the service which was 6* to the absolute splendor and beauty of the place. Having stayed in several hotels in New York now I cannot recommend this one highly enough as probably the best hotel I've ever stayed in, anywhere.

review_title: This should be rated the no.1 hotel in New York
review_text:
There is no other place to stay than this one. The location is perfect! Very close to times square but away enough from the noise, perfect location close to all the broadway shows and right inside Hells Kitchen surrounded by all of the best restaurants in NYC. This is not a hotel with 3000 rooms so the service is personalized and first class. French Quarters is a Manhatten gem and we will definitely be staying here again and again. As for the people who complain about street noise, it's New York! what do expect a quiet country town?
Best Hotel
Best Management 
Best staff
Best location 
Just the best.

review_title: Ottimo, soprattutto perfetto per appoggio aeroporto
review_text: Abbiamo soggiornato la notte in cui siamo atterrati a LAX per il nostro tour della California, Ã¨ stato l'unico hotel prenotato dall'Italia. Ottima posizione per chi come noi Ã¨ di passaggio, servizio navetta da e per aeroporto, utilissimo; belle camere spaziose e pulite; promozioni sulle prenotazioni via internet; ma la cigliegina sulla torta Ã¨ la colazione...speciale! Tant'Ã¨ che il giorno del nostro rientro in Italia abbiamo soggiornato in un altro albergo ma abbiamo preferito fare colazione allo Sheraton!!

This hotel definitely deserves the credit it gets on Tripadvisor! It's not cheap...but then again what is in Hollywood? This is a fairly small hotel that makes you feel like a guest not just a room number. From the warm welcome where they personally walk you to your room and the tray of cookies and cider in the lobby to the complete and complimentary snack list (i.e. you want a coke and a kit kat just ask!) this place takes care of your every need. The rooms are spacious we had a 1 bedroom king with a large flat screen and pullout that was perfect for the kids in the living room. The bathtub had jets to make up for no hot tub but the heated pool was great and is open 24h. Really close (1 block walk) to Graumann's Chinese or Kodak theatres) so its nice to leave your car here (my only complaint is $11/d parking charge). Kudos to the hotel for the nice cupcake and balloons they arranged for my daughter's birthday. All in all so much good any complaints are very minor details that certainly don't take away from how pleased we were with this hotel.

HÃ´tel rÃ©novÃ©, bien tenu. TrÃ¨s beau lobby, bar et piscine. Parfait pour une Ã©tape avant/aprÃ¨s un vol. Chambre spacieuse. Wifi gratuit dans lobby. Starbucks sur place. Excellent service navette vers l aÃ©roport (compter 30 minutes). Attention parking payant donc laisser votre voiture chez le loueur (trÃ¨s content du rapport q/p de la sociÃ©tÃ© Entreprise.)

review_title: Tres bon sejour passÃ© en plein centre de LA
review_text:
Apres une grosse de journÃ©e, bel hotel accueillant avec une tres bonne literie!
Pas d'avis sur les services et repas

In una cittÃ  che in realtÃ  assomiglia a una regione con diversi punto d'interesse situati a distanze importanti l'uno dall'altro scegliere una posizione strategica per soggiornare e' indispensabile. Con camere comode e ampie, 2 piscine aperte fino a sera inoltrata, e con gli studios e citywalk a 2 passi, l Hilton universal rappresenta una comodissima soluzione per visitare los angeles
Consiglio vivamente

We arrived early this morning from a long flight from Australia. The staff at the front desk made us feel very welcome & let us have breakfast as well as a room to freshen up in until our room was ready. They gave us some advice on getting around as we wanted to go to Santa Monica Pier. We returned in the evening to be welcomed with some beautiful home made lemonade. When we got to our room there was a welcome card and chocolates. We we given a list of complimentary snacks and drinks (very well received by my teenage son and husband) and a list of free DVD's we can borrow. We are looking forward to the rest of our stay.

Our 2br was ready even though we arrived early 10am after a long flight from Australia.The rooms are very comfortable and all 5 of us had ample room.(lighting can be improved)Service by all is second to none! Thankyou! Some comment that it is a 5 min walk to Hollywood Blv but it's hardly a 2 min walk.So positions perfect.Would not hesitate recommending this hotel.

review_title: Big rooms, good location, great service. Rooms are a tad old though...
review_text:
Stayed here for a couple of nights and all was good. Only gripe was tt e rooms though big, were a little old and showing its age. Creaky cabinets, chipping paintwork, tt sort of thing. It's not wheelchair accessible either, so dun lug huge and heavy luggages here, lest u get rooms on e 2nd or 3rd floor. 
If you r into shopping, might wanna consider staying near the 3rd st promenade instead. More buzz, shopping and dining options there. Could get a night's stay in e holiday inn there at a lower price too... Better value, IMHO.

Awesome little hotel tucked away behind the bustle of Hollywood Blvd. The rooms are comfy, a little run down, but service makes up for anything you can find wrong with the rooms. Great breakfast in the mornings (highly recommend the chocolate chip scones). Fantastic saltwater? pool, free snack bar at the front desk, which I fully enjoyed. Highly recommend this gem to anyone wanting to stay in the LA area!

We booked Magic Castle on the back of TripAdviser reviews and what a find!
We stayed 21st Sept through 25th sept. Arrived after a long flight, parking was easy ( and cheap). Were welcomed with a glass of cold lemonade, great check-in. Got to our room to find balloons, a card and a fresh backed cake wishing us 'all the best for our 25th anniversary'.
All staff are fantastic and sincere, the position as said before is pretty much um-beetable.
If you are planning a trip yo L A book this place you won't regret it.

We arrived at 3 to check-in and found that we had to wait 15 minutes for our room. To compensate for this we got a free upgrade to a one bedroom suite for our stay! It is all the "little" things that make this hotel stand out. Free drinks and snacks throughout the day, free breakfast, but mostly very very friendly staff. On the day we had to leave we could also extend our checkout time to 2pm.
The location is very central in Hollywood. The beds are very comfortable. And the place just looks adorable (reminded me of the show Melrose Place). All in all, you won't regret staying here.

Love this place here on our honeymoon ,arrived to a glass of bubbley and cake ,friendly helpful staff ,nice pool , and right bang in the middle of hollywood , spacious rooms , would defo stay here again

A street away from Hollywood Boulevard and the Wallk of Fame, Chinese Theatre and the Kodak Theatre. This hotel could be taken straight from a 1950s movie. We had a very spacious top floor 1 bedroom suite with a balcony overlooking the pool. The only drawback was the stairs (no elevator). Customer service was great and the complimentary breakfasts, drinks and snacks were a real bonus.

review_title: This is the place to stay during your get away.
review_text:
This hotel provides a warm friendly atmosphere from the moment I enter till the moment I left. The service was great. 
The hotel maximizes the limited amont of square feet provided in the rooms and regarding the room size, that's to be expected living in New York; but I didn't feel cluttered or cramped, it was a great room design. The beds are extremely comfortable. The thermostat was a bit noisy and kept reseting to a pre-fixed temperature but it didn't bother me although it could for some. Besides, the ceiling fan worked so well, I didn't really need to use it to regulate the room temperature. Lastly, the provided slippers were a nice addition.
The location is easily one of my top reasons why I liked this place. Very close to little Italy, Chinatown, Soho, and to a subway station for further locations.
Overall great stay.

I research very carefully as cleanliness is very important to me. We arrived very early a though our room was not ready they offered to call me when room was ready. We happily received a phone call a couple hours later. The room was very decent size (especially compared to other hotels) and very clean and comfortable and the staff was very friendly, remembering me on sight. It was a one night stay but it was very pleasant and relaxing. PROS: size, new, quiet, clean, helpful staff, 12 pm checkout time, location, could open windows. CONS: a little pricey, broken elevator, continental breakfast nothing special, unattended maid cart left outside door for 24 hours. Best hotel stay in NYC. Would definitely stay here again.

review_title: Cool vibe, especially if you like glass and concrete.
review_text: Best thing about this place is the friendly and engaging staff. The location is a little off beat, but fun. Good skyline views from the upper floors. Be sure to grab your camera and check out the views from the roof deck.

review_title: decent new hotel with a few issues
review_text:
The Nolitan is just two months old and visually appealing, but has a number of issues to iron out. It is a solid place, but not the luxury hotel it claims to be.
First off, most staff members (except for one guy at reception who seems pretty self absorbed) are nice and helpful. Welcome and introduction to the room felt genuine.
Rooms feature a clean, tasteful minimalist design but are very small, even for New York in this price category. Very generously stocked mini bar at comparatively reasonable prices.
However, several technical malfunctions made the stay hard to bear at times: Heater barely heats the room, but has the noise level of an airplane taking off. Main lighting frequently turns itself on in the middle of the night, probably because of a shared remote control frequency. Wireless internet is slow and requires re-entering of password several times a day. Noise level in room is high, not only from heating sytem, but also from street and hallway (no sound proofing whatsoever).
Overall, The Nolitan is a nice contemporary place, but there is better value for money in this category in New York.

Granted it was a last minute choice, we requested a room with a street view but got "upgraded" to a 2nd floor handicapped room with no view but a patio (facing a brick wall). Breakfast was average - what you get at a comfort inn across the country - but no waffles. Not worth the expense.

review_title: Good value for money at a good location
review_text: Friendly and helpful service at a location close to the main sights in Hollywood. Older style of hotel, but arrangement of rooms around the pool provided a clean & open environment. Room was quite large for two of us so had plenty of room to spread out. Kid friendly and plenty of complementary snacks for around the pool of for the drive home.

review_title: Not the place for a good night's sleep
review_text: This place is definitely stylish. And location is pretty good; right on edge of trendy Soho scene. Rooms are cute, albeit very compact. I stay in NYC a lot for work and have basically stayed at most downtown hotels. It's also very new, so that's nice. BUT I stayed here on two separate occasions and it is the noisiest place I've ever slept in NY. It's on a relatively busy street and theres a fruit store that apparently starts receiving deliveries at around 4 am -- honking, truck engines, garage door opening ... Too bad, because the place is stylish and feels much cleaner and newer than Soho or TriBeCa Grand. Not nearly as luxe as Trump Soho, though, which is where I would recommend staying if you can afford it and want to be in this area.

Stayed for 5 nights in sept. Room was very clean, dark and quiet so great for sleeping.
Breakfast would have been fine if pastries were fresher but most tasted stale. Need more cereal and healthy options, eg more fruit.
We loved the location and porters were excellent but felt the front desk staff could be friendlier.
Great new hotel. Nice restaurants and bars and metro within walkable distance. Great view from the nice and quiet rooftop. Staff manage to let the guests feel welcome and take their time.

review_title: Un des meilleurs rapport prix / emplacement de LA, mais tres bruyant.
review_text: L'hotel se trouve juste derriere le Kodak Theater et le Walk of Fame, avec le metro a 2 min, ce qui est appreciable. Les chambres sont vieillottes, mais spacieuses. Service tres aimable. Seul veritable bemol : la nuit la clim (de l'hotel, mais aussi des batiments voisins) continue de faire un bruit important, mais supportable

We were surprised to be escorted to a separate building from main hotel building &" taken up an unsecure back stairwell to a room we named the "overflow" room. No bedskirt, old damaged furniture, and bathroom with mildew. When we asked to move we were told the hotel was full. When asked if the room we were staying in was the the same as the recently renovated hotel, we were told no, but since we had a king bed the price was the same.

This hotel really lives up to the reviews. Great location for Times Square, Broadway, central Park, 5th Avenue and the subway. Lovely big bedroom with a huge comfortable bed and spotless throughout. All staff very friendly and helpful from the doormen to the reception staff and concierge to the staff in the restaurant (small but very adequate for continental breakfast.) free wifi - well done for this. A big plus where other larger chains look to rip off clients. Overall a great hotel with great staff and excellent value. I'd highly recommend.

My family and I were excited about staying here..we saw good reviews overall. The front desk was very friendly and helpful upon arrival. The place is older..dated in appearance with a few attempts at modernizing the decor...example being the lobby which you have to go through to get to your room. I asked how old the place 
was..staff said it was an apartment complex built in the sixties but 
rennovated to be apartments in the
Seventies. Upon entering our "suite" it 
was a fairly sizable accomodation but did look like a seventies apartment with attempts at trying to modernize it. The couch was worn and musty and the carpet appeared dingy and stained.
After settling in later and upon closer 
inspection, we questioned how clean the 
bathroom actually was. There was hair on 
the sink... on the showerwall...and when
 we wanted to bathe our child, the tub 
seemed to be plugged. Oh..let's not forget
 some splatterings on the wall above the
 sink. It looked like someone had bloody 
gums and splattered it while brushing 
their teeth and the paint job was peeling 
in the shower.
Icalled the front desk..told him our 
situation..there wasnt any maintenace
until tomorrow He would put on some gloves and take a look...why? When I mentioned the hair..he asked if it was mine..you gotta be kidding me! He wasnt rude..but I think he either didn't know what to say at the momemt or management has told staff to play dumb in these situations. 
Pros: beds were fairly comfortable. Staff acted professionally.

Cozy rooms with homey, refreshing interiors and a wonderful sky window. Not too spacious but clean and comfortable enough for two. Staff immensely friendly and accomodating - we were late for dinner one night and they still allowed us to eat our chinese food take out in the restaurant. Situated in the heart of chestnut hill, a historic locale and a very close walk to all the quaint shops.

review_title: Excellent and I will be back!
review_text: After a nightmare at another midtown hotel, The Pearl saved my work trip. Clean, modern, comfortable, quiet, convenient, relaxing, easy. Nothing missing!

We stayed here last weekend for two nights having read great reviews in tripadvisor. The hotel itself is tiny but in a very central location. It's very expensive for the poor standard of rooms provided. The hotel provides complimentary breakfast in the mornings however it's served in their small reception area. Basically grab and go food. Basic but it did the job. Dont expect anything fancy. We stayed in Ballys in las Vegas prior to this hotel for a lot cheaper rate and it was of superior quality compared to the magic castle. We stated in a suite for five people and we were informed by the receptionist that our room was recently renovated!! When we entered the room we were overcome with the smell of must and dampness. The kitchen stank and there were cobwebs everywhere especially in the kitchen presses hence why they wrap the delf in clingflim. It's also a very noisy location if your traveling with young children. No soundproofing in the hotel. Overall the staff were excellent but I would recommend elsewhere as it's badly in need of a total overhaul. Too expensive for what you get there is better value elsewhere.

review_title: What a great hotel, staff and location!
review_text: Got the recommendation from someone who had just seen this new hotel from the outside. The inside was even better. The style is very cool and modern. The lobby, bar and restaurant is very inviting and the rooms are small but extremely well designed and practical. Small things that just makes you go "how clever". The staff on all levels are very positive, proud and professional. The location, close to SOHO, Little Italy etc. is great for recreational as well as business purposes since the transportation is easy to and from the rest of Manhattan as well as LGA and JFK.

review_title: Perfect location, super comfy beds & the most amazing food & fab staff!!
review_text:
We returned home yesterday & I miss Chestnut Hill so much already! The location of the hotel is perfect - right in among the fab boutiques of Germantown Avenue! 
We were with a very large wedding party & we pretty much took over the hotel... It was perfect.
Nearly completed their referb, the Hotel is now very stylish but relaxing & cozy at the sametime!
The food, is fabulous... You must try the Brie & pear chutney board, spicy Asian shrip salad & the fried coconut ships! Magical... & a bottle of the Rex- Goliath (or 2!).
We have all had an amazing time!

review_title: A wonderful boutique hotel in heart of mid-town Times Square.
review_text: Excellent! All around pleasant Hotel, for comfortable accommodations, good furnishings, and excellent lighting. Loved the bath & shower, amenities & robes. A good value all in. Well recommended., and will stay again soon.

review_title: Good location, good restaurant, terrible service
review_text:
The location is great and the XIX restaurant is worth for a visit. However, the service provided by the hotel staff was very disappointing.
1. Bellboys were discussing loudly how much tips the previous customer(s) gave them on 28th Dec.
2. When we tried to ask for extending our stay on 29th, the front desk, after looking at the info on the pc screen, just said we needed to wait and speak to the manager. it's ok if the hotel was full but we were not sure why it couldn't be told right away. We were then told by the manager that the hotel was full but when we checked on the Internet (hyatt website & booking.com & hotels.com) - all indicated that several room types were available during the period we requested.
3.The front desk manager (Christine) yelled at us when we were trying to use the luggage rack on 31st dec as there's no one to help. She dashed from the front desk to the elevator and just yelled 'sir, what are you doing here?' and raised her volume real high. The guests who were in the elevator with us were also surprised why she had to yell like that.
We have been staying over 10 nights in different hyatt hotels in Dec and could not believe that this is the service we got from this one in Philly. We won't return to this hotel.

review_title: The one hotel for the hard to please!
review_text: Just had the best weekend in NYC not only because of the city's (SoHo) flavor but because of the excellent accomodation at The Nolitan Hotel. I have been to hundreds of hotels around the world, including the newer botique hotels in Europe and I must say that The Nolitan has just become my gold standard. Yes, the fact that it is very new is a plus. Yet, the rooms have the natural feel of class -- hardwood floors that hopefully would never have the look & smell of old carpeting; modern bathrooom fixtures; and a glass-encased shower area separate from the toilet, which makes for a refreshing & relaxing hot shower. The room gives you that feeling of being in your own CLEAN bedroom at home! The bed, pillows & blanket were pure softness & comfort -- just what you need after a full day of enjoying the neighboring enclaves of good food & world class shopping! Clean, Cheerful, Convenient, Comfortable, Classy -- The Nolitan has it all! A highly recommended hotel for the discriminating travel who wants everything in a hotel. Thanks to the Management & friendly staff for a great stay.

review_title: In the heart of it all
review_text: A intimate boutique hotel that is close to times square , theatres, and great food.Close to subway stations and shopping.Very clean in every area and the mattress was the best we ever slept on(stearns and foster).Free breakfast was great, wine and cheese hour daily , and free Internet(hard to find in NYC hotels).Was the perfect place to celebrate our 25th anniversary.The free bottle of wine was a nice touch .
Did a mini staycation here and loved it! The staff are very friendly the rooms and hotel is brand new. Red flower amenities in the bathroom!!!!

review_title: I fled this place 2 yes ago but 'I'm back!' hate to let the secret out but spot on renovations have raised the low bar 2 a delig
review_text:
Hate to share the good news since it may make it competitive 2 get a room but alas- good work should b rewarded. Well done chestnut hill hotel! It was a shameful dump in an desirable location that deserved a touch of class. 
 Clean, comfortable beds, light / modern decor, duvets I wanted to linger under for another night.happy 
Greeters/greetings from the get go. I'll
B back. Troy-save me a room!
My all time favorite hotel in Philadelphia. Best staff, best location, beautiful rooms, restaurant on site. Just heavenly!!!! I can't stress enough how great this Gem is!!!!

We just returned from our second stay at The Bryant Park. We enjoyed a short stay in NYC to enjoy some cold weather, see the department store Holiday windows, see the Rockettes, shop, etc. location is fab....walking distance from Times Square, 5th and 6th Avenues, Rockefeller Center. Hotel is very clean. Friendly, attentive staff. Across the street from Bryant Park, which is converted into a winter wonderland with ice skating and a pop-up village. Highly recommended!!!

review_title: Every silver lining has a touch of grey
review_text: Joy the one who helps you book the rooms is excellent at her job and is more than just a person on the other line...check in was good we were early and they got us in by 2pm....then I got a text from chase that they put a 150 dollar hold on my debit card I think I should have been told at check in especially since it was a debit card....the room was awesome, really clean modern and fun. They even refreshed the room while we were out for dinner but the slamming if the door next to us by the help was unprofessional though I must note it was during the day and they did not start again til about 830am again.... The staff though were really nice and helpful but we came back to hotel for a drink and asked the bartender if he was still serving and then the night doorman came running after us and said no bar is closed and he was not nice at all no smiles no help no jokes and took care of traffic up the street better than hotel guests but the day doorman I think Felix was amazing and delightful. The only other issue now is my entire stay was credited and I have no charge so before work tomorrow I have to go to chase and find out what is going on....I would return because it was sooo clean and location and day time staff but I will book with third party like hotels.com and then give credit card for their 150 dollar hold since the billing is obviously screwy........But it was one of the nicest places in nyc

Though we usually prefer to stay in the various neighborhoods NYC has to offer, this trip prompted a Times Square stay. And rather than staying in the generic big name boxes, we opted for The Pearl. It turned out to be a great choice. Incredibly clean, exceptionally quiet, very nice and responsive staff, adds up to a great 3 nights.
If you need/want to be in this area of NYC - this hotel is highly recommended.

review_title: Very Expensive For what you get!!
review_text: We stayed here for 5 days at the beginning of December arriving tired at 5.15pm to be told their was a private event on in both the bar and restaurant, we had nothing to eat or drink. They should have mentioned on the booking that this would be the case. I phoned reception for more hangers due to the length of our stay and they never brought them up. It is very very noisy in the park view front rooms at this time of year you can hear all the music etc going on in the park. The hotel is however very nice, young and trendy but we would not stay again.

Amazing location. Style is less modern and more Victorian/early America...may be a bit stuffy for young people. Service is fantastic, the restaurant is superb. Rooms are large and spacious, perhaps antiquated in style but not old or aging. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would recommend to others, although it is pricey.

Our stay at the Nolitan Hotel was an experience like no other. The attention to detail from the face of the structure to the toiletry packaging, was impeccable and first class. The hotel itself has a modern, clean-cut feel while still feeling like a cozy home away from home, with small touches like a red absolutely divine and smooth to the touch throw, daily NY Times delivery and a bowl of fresh, crisp apples waiting for you at the front desk. We just melted into the bedding and pillows at the end of our eventful day strolling through the streets of Nolita. It was the kind of sleep you can only dream of. From the before dinner relaxing on the balcony of our room, taking in the amazing view, to our midnight rendezvous up the elevator and out onto the rooftop, allowing a panoramic view of the midnight NYC skyline, the scenery and unique views from the Nolitan were truly an amazing treat.Â 
We were treated like royalty from the moment the door man let us into the hotel, introducing himself and shaking our hands, to the deligful front desk check-in and tour of the amenities in our room and amazing turn-down service, including a card left on your pillow hilighting the weather forecast for the following day-another example of how the staff strives to care for your every need, leaving only one job for you-Enjoy, relax and truly experience the life of a Nolitan!!

You have the comfort and amenities of being at home with a super bonus. . . an awesome staff!!! Darren, Jason & Marcus were the best!! This place is great if you have kids!! DVD's you can borrow for your room with a bag of microwave popcorn, a pool complete with not only towels, but toys for the kids!!

wow what a great find! brand new hotel that has clearly had a lot of thought and effort gone into it. very cool without being pretentious, really high spec throughout which makes it feel quality and views fromthe upper floors including the roof terrace are tremendous

Honestly, this is the nicest large chain hotel we have ever stayed at. The staff was wonderful, the rooms were beautiful, the hotel was just nice. I wish I could rate 10 out of 5. It was a wonderful experience.

We stayed here for three days in august 2011 and liked it very much. The staff is extremely friendly and competent. The location is absolutely brilliant, walking distance to all major sights and the old town. The rooms are a bit old but charming and clean. It is next to a major street, but the windows are well insulated and we were not disturbed by the noise, but we would have liked it even more if we could have opened the window. The only negative point is the breakfast which had only a very small selection. A few times, they ran out of coffee and plates and it took very long until they were filled up. Would stay there again.

Great location across from the lovely park with skating rink and retail stalls right now. Close to 5th Ave too for shops and offices. Standard room was okay but poorly lit and no view apart from a brick wall. Shower was amazing though and Molten Brown toiletries were nice. However, No coffee maker or nice touches you get elsewhere in this class of hotel such as water and fresh fruit. Paying for wifi on top of the room rate always disappoints me too. Bar is cool though and staff are attractive, helpful and polite.

We have tried several high-end hotels during our trips to Philly but keep returning to the Bellevue as they offer wonderfully large and well-appointed rooms. The beds are super comfortable and the location is great. Valet and self park are available and the train is right outside too, which is convenient when we're in town for a concert or game. Yes, it is an older hotel with signs of wear in the hallways. Yes, in those hallways it kind of reminds me of the hallway in the movie The Shining, but no evil twins encountered thus far so we shall continue to frequent.
 My only complaint has been noise levels in the hallways. The doors are loud when they shut. And you can hear EVERYTHING in the hallways from your room.

Front desk service is very attentive, responsive and friendly. A pity that the restaurant on 19th floor doesn't share this. 
Great health club. 
Parking is convenient next to hotel. Save yourself some money by self parking rather than valet.

review_title: Not charming--Next to a bus station!
review_text: While charming from the online photos, the hotel is located directly next to the highway and a bus station- the worst of both worlds. The rooms seemed especially noisy at night and the television was about 12 inches and a picture tube. If you want a convenient hotel in Olde Town- opt for the Best Western or Omni.

We arrived later then we thought so decided to stay another night. They booked us right away even at the same awesome price we found the first night at. Very helpful at the front desk, explained the whole place to us. So much there...shops, restaurants, great bar upstairs. Good location for bars...little bit of a walk for historic Philly.

This hotel has one redeeming feature - it's location. The rooms are pleasantly decorated but have no coffee making facilities, not enough towels and are very noisy due to proximity to highway! We paid $2.50 for a coffee brought to us by room service then were charged extra for gratuity when we checked out, I had already tipped waiter! They did refund us though, but no 'goodbyes' or 'thanks for staying' as we left! 
Breakfast was a disappointment given how much we had paid, no bacon or sausage or scrambled egg (you could boil an egg), a waffle maker that wasn't that good, weak coffee and only orange juice. No selection of muffins and though there was fresh fruit we felt it wasn't a good enough breakfast for price if room.

Pas grand chose Ã  dire, c'est conforme a ce que nous avion Lu . La chambre Ã¨tait spaciuese et trÃ¨s bien situee. Le service Ã¨tait impeccable. Le petite dejeneurs Ã¨tait trÃ¨s variÃ©, succulent! Un trÃ¨s bon choix avec un rapport qualitÃ©/ prix excellent ! Je recommande cet hotel et nous retournerons.....

Stayed for five nights late November 2011. Great location if that's the end of Manhattan you need. Liked everything about the hotel including the food in the bar and the restaurant. Staff couldn't have been more helpful. There's some free stuff too which is a nice touch.

We just got back from NY and the Pearl is an excellent hotel. The staff is super friendly. The hotel is conveniently located to Times Square and the Theatre District. The subway is located a block from the hotel! The hotel is very clean!! Loved this place and will definately be back!!

review_title: Great place to stay. Expensive but you get everything you paid for.
review_text: Extremely friendly staff who met every need. Rooms were clean and modern. Location is fantastic for sightseeing. We would stay here again for sure.
Veru nice. Rooms very modern and comfortable. If you are working downtown very good place to stay. A quick train ride on the 23 gets you to time square and all the shows.

Stayed with my daughter for 3 nights in a Jr suite. The room was spacious with 2 queen beds, 2 chairs, sofa, coffee table and desk. Very modern and very clean. Beds were super comfortable. Fabulous large bath with deep tub and separate shower. Robes, slippers placed by the bed at turndown was a delight! There's a umbrella in the closet along with a safe large enough for a laptop plus all the other stuff.
As nice as the hotel aesthetics are it's the staff that makes the Bryant Park a great hotel. Nicole at the front desk,Eric at the bell desk and Erik the concierge were just a few that stood out. Everyone all the time were efficient and friendly.
Location was good easy to use the subway, nice easy breakfast options very close by and if the weather cooperates Bryant Park is a good spot to enjoy your coffee or sandwich.
Stay at the Bryant Park you won't be disappointed.

review_title: Amazing location - customer services need a bit of work
review_text:
This place is a real gem - great place, great location, great value. When we went they still hadn't had there grand opening - were in the midst of their soft opening so breakfast area wasnt done. 
I would definitely stay here again. 
Biggest issue were some of the staff - the concierge was just lazy and didn't even know how many people you could legally get into a cab and made us pay twice as much for a private cab to the airport. In addition, she wouldn't help us just after 5 pm because she said she wasn't getting paid overtime!
This aside I still think for the money this really is a gem and when in NYC how much time do you spend in the hotel!

The staff was extremely friendly and helpful with all of our needs. WE chose to valet are car (expensive), but we could walk everywhere from location. Marquez greeted us and took us to room, very pleasant and friendly. Room service was prompt and good. Gina was wonderful and accomadated our needs. Upon checking out we noticed we were charged for refreshment center, which we did not get, charges removed without hassle. Lauren took care of us and answered all questions. Thanks for a nice stay!!

review_title: Not bad at all. Very close to convention center. Large rooms.
review_text:
Stayed here for six nights for a conference. The staff are very friendly, the rooms are big and clean and the location is good. 
The breakfast isn't amazing though free. Most of the hot food is processed (cheese omelettes, sausage patties) and you can get a lot better in the area. 
I paid higher rates because the city was sold out of hotel rooms because of the conference and it probably isn't worth the mark-up but it's fine and a comfortable stay.

This place is great. We got "stuck" here by our bosses and we ended up saying if we come to NY again this is where we'll stay, always. Service-great
Rooms-clean & well appointed
Price-for NYC Great!
Finally- complimentary lattes. Enough said!

My first trip to NYC was made by this hotel. Location-quiet and out of the mixer (times sq, 5th Av etc) yet only a 20 min trip in $2.50 subway to the classic sights. Trust me, you don't want to stay any closer, the peace that this area provides is worth every penny. Staton island, pier 17, city hall, Brooklyn bridge and many decent bars and restaurants are easily walkable. 
Staff-ultimate professionals. Will reserve and recommend places to see, eat, drink and how to get there. Will give email links, print outs, hand written notes or show on iPads. Nothing is too much. 
Rooms-spotless, massive beds, great views, iPod dock, wooden floors, wet room black tiled bathroom, automatic blackout blinds, huge cable tv. Free wifi and sift drinks in mini bar. Proper cool and quirky, perfect retreat from the manic city life! 
Mornings and evenings-free tea,coffee, fruit, cookies, juices, water availible in a lobby full of relaxing sofas and ultra modern leather arm chairs, we stopped here for 30 mins each morning to check maps, get advice and plan our day, it's very relaxed, loads better than having to sit in a breakfast room. Assisted self serve basis. After our days out there is free wine and all of the above, we again took advantage of this and discussed our day in similar surroundings. 
Bar seven five is a smart manhattan type bar and is decent for a basis to start the night. 
Basically this place is quality!
X4 guests, late 20's but caters for all ages easily. You cannot fail to like this hotel.

A very high price for a nice spacious, clean room, very modern. Downsides: very limited storage space for such a large room, very subdued lighting everywhere including the elevatators. Friendly desk and door staff. For this price I expect Wifi to be included, although they did agree to two devices for the price of one. Nice location. No wow factor at all really.

The good: decor, location, price, and a great restaurant recommendation from Scott the Concierge. 
The bad:
- Perhaps the most uncomfortable hotel bed I've ever experienced
- $38 valet parking is ridiculous for Philly
- No free wifi?!
- 'minimalist' furnishing feels a little cheap. Only one chair. Ditto the tech - what's with the $5 alarm clock?
- City View room looked out onto the wall of an adjacent building. We could have asked to move, but were only there one night
- only 3 towels
Others have commented on the area. It's great for the convention center, less so for tourism, but this isn't the hotel's fault - do your homework! Equally the family next door to us were shouting and crashing around at 1am, but that's not the hotel's fault either.

review_title: Excellent staff with clean contemporary rooms
review_text: We stayed here for the Thanksgiving day parade & the location was perfect. Hotel has a fabulous staff, clean comtemporary rooms, and a great view of the amazing city hall building. Surrounded by amazing old Phili architechture across the street from the hotel. I would stay here again.

review_title: Larry Johnson made the Westin feel like a private resort, not just a hotel.
review_text: Larry works the hotel entrance. Not only did he know the names of each of my associates whenever we passed by him, but he spent hours searching for a lost shipment because he knew it was important for us. Larry makes the Westin a fantastic place to stay!

If you get a deal, steal it. Wonderful comfort level. Complimentary snacks. Genuinely courteous staff. Shower you never want to leave. No breakfast in plan? You really wanted another hotel breakfast? Coffee and fresh donut await outside for 1.50$.

A very funky stylish hotel on Wall St. You get checked in via iPad and we were persuaded to upgrade for an extra 30 dollars. It was worth it. Our room was huge with a lovely big bath. There was a window between the bedroom and bath so you could see the tv as you bathed. Nice powerful shower and lovely big comfortable bed. The free soft drinks and snacks in the room is a great idea. There was free wine served in the lobby between 6 and 8, though I have to say no one was there to serve us (I think bad timing on our part). My only criticism would be the air conditioning, which was not as cold as we would have liked. We explained this on check out and told we should have said something as they could have maybe changed the settings/provided us with a fan. Overall we loved this hotel, would definitely return and loved staying on Wall St, lovely and quiet at the weekend and in good reach of the shops at South Street Seaport and a brand new TJ Maxx just around the corner.

This Westin has older bones but remains stylish. Rooms well furnished, marble bathrooms were clean and acceptable. Central location easy to find. Valet parking was fast and efficient. 
Bar and lobby area of hotel are enclosed with no outside exposure, a bit of a miss from this older design. 
Fridge in room was not stocked but was on. Went to Di Bruni Bros a half block from hotel, an excellent local grocer to stock a few drinks. 
Breakfast service does not list cereals, an odd omission. See photos for king room pics and breakfast order card.
Just stayed at the andaz hotel service second to none, staff friendly and helpful, nothing too much trouble, room emaculate

This was my second stay at the Andaz Wall Street and it did not disappoint. I was in town for the NYC marathon. The location is great to get to the Staten Island ferry for the start. It is very close to the subway, too, to get back after the finish. Plus marathon finishers get to ride the subway for free. Thanks for that NYC!
Rooms are large and immaculate. It seems that they have fixed the lighting issue in the bathroom area. It was much brighter than I remember from my prior stay. I had requested a feather free room due to allergies and that request was fulfilled without a problem. I appreciated the free snacks and nonalcoholic beverages in the room. 
The restaurant is excellent. I enjoyed breakfast twice and loved the spread. I ordered room service the morning of the marathon and it arrived promptly and the order was correct. I also ordered a pasta dish the evening before the marathon. It was good, but could have used a bit more pasta for carbo loading the night before a long run. Maybe a special menu could be offered the night before for the many runners who were staying there?
The hosts are friendly and vey helpful. They welcomed me as a repeat guest. They make a great cappuccino at the complimentary coffee bar which also offers water, juice, iced tea and small snacks to nibble on. 
I love this hotel and look forward to the opportunity to visit again. I recommend without reservation.

We stayed here for a long weekend, it's not the cheapest but it is definitely the best placed. Everything you need is a short walk away.
It is the perfect location for a shopping weekend with modern quirky but very comfortable rooms. The square literally on your doorstep is a hive of activity and interet from ice skating to restaurants and cafes to curio shops.
Thoroughly recommended on location alone

review_title: Great location - next to Macy's and picturesque City Hall
review_text: Location, Starbucks in lobby, free wifi. Reading Terminal market is just behind the hotel and a fab eating option instead of hunting for restaurants!

review_title: Awesome place to stay in the Financial District
review_text: Great hotel with an awesome staff. Super close to NYSE and good dining on Pearl Street, subway is within a few blocks with easy access uptown. Perfect for the ferry to Staten Island.

review_title: Needs need new housekeeping staff immediately
review_text:
Starwood members used to clean, fresh rooms will be very disappointed in the quality of cleanliness here. The housekeepers we encountered, including the supervisor, could basically care less. We had to ask multiple tines to vacuum, clean the toilets, carpets, change sheets and wipe glass mirrors. Truly disgusting. And that's so sad because the location, the valet staff and the concierges are truly terrific. Starwood needs to come in and do an overall on housekeeping and refreshing the hotel, rooms and gym
Which are getting dated

review_title: Nice hotel, pretty good location, not all but most of staff friendly
review_text: We stayed here on vacation using HHonors points. It is right down the street from China Town. It is a 10-15 min walk to the historic district....which was fine, never felt unsafe as Market Street is a really major street. The front desk staff and bellman we always nice and helpful. One of the servers at breakfast was really nice and the other one was sooooooooo rude! She was so bad my husband talked to a manager. Breakfast was good and they usually had cookies in the lobby. The little dinky convenient store across the street sells really good ice cream.

review_title: Mixed overall, some great aspects, some things very disappointing.
review_text: Great service, very polite and professional, but disappointed a few times. The room was clean, very modern, but the bed sagged in the middle. And the room looked out on an alleyway--where a bell/alarm went off all night! Expect more from this chain. Not bad, but there are better choices in this price range.
Hotel was beautiful,super clean with a great location in midtown. Service was great. Every staff member was helpful and friendly! There should be no other choice but that of the Bryant Park Hotel.

The location of this hotel is great if you are looking to check out the Reading Terminal Market, Chinatown or if you have business at the Convention Center. The service is awesome, everyone was very nice and extremely helpful. You are right next to City Hall, and that building is magnificent.

review_title: There's something to be said for good service!
review_text: During a recent visit to Philly for a convention, my colleague and I opted to stay at the Westin instead of the Marriott because of the price. What we got was so much more value for our money. The service alone is enough to make me come back...especially Ms. Gerri Diggins, the amazingly helpful concierge. She knew exactly what we needed before we even asked and was extremely friendly. Can't wait to come back and visit!

Stunning hotel in the perfect location pretty much in the middle of every where, empire state a few blocks away, time sq up the rd, and the subway on the corner that will take you to central park and statue of liberty. If your looking at going at Christmas time as we did the park outside the hotel is great as it has a Christmas market and ice rink. The hotel it's self is really friendly and calm, rooms are big,clean and bright. We didn't try the restaurant as there is so many places to eat. All in all we loved it and would love to be going back this Christmas.

On arrival the valet were friendly and continued that way throughout my 3 day solo business stay. Check in was smooth. Room service was great and I do not have anything negative to say about the hotel. 
Valet parking was a little steep at $38 per night, but I am not familiar with other hotels in Philadelphia as it was my first time. I do not know if this is standard or high for the area. Considering in LA I pay around $25-30 I thought it was higher than average.
The room was clean and had good decor and ambience. It wasn't the largest of hotel rooms but they used their space well and it did not feel cramped. The bathroom was spacious, it had a shower only which suits me fine.
I had breakfast once in the restaurant and room service once. Room service was perfect. Amazing food, great service, it arrived in 20 minutes. Breakfast in the restaurant wasn't so great. They mixed up my order and then brought the wrong style eggs. I wasn't in a hurry that morning so wasn't a huge problem. They were apologetic and resolved the issue, and also brought some complimentary fruit. 
Overall the stay was good, perfect location walking distance to stores Macy's etc, and an efficient valet service. Make sure you call for your car before time if you are in a rush aanther say it can take up to 20 minutes although I always got mine in 10. The hotel also gives you a $10 credit if you go green and do not have maid service that day which is also a bonus. 
I loved the outdoors in feel they have in the corridors with the exposed bricks, and they have lovely elevator music. I would stay again.

review_title: Great hotel close to lots of wonderful spots. Notes on parking.
review_text:
I have stayed at this Westin several times and always have a great experience. Friendly staff, clean quiet rooms and great location make this hotel a nice choice.
I would say the only downside is the parking but it's not bad enough to stay somewhere else. Valet parking is $47 a night. Self park is $35. When you self park you will need to take an elevator out of the parking garage, then walk through an indoor shopping area, find the Westin door, take another elevator to the lobby and then another to the rooms. It's not as bad as it sounds but should be noted if you have a lot of luggage.
Close to lots of restaurants and in a safe area.

I stayed in a king room which was surprisingly roomy for an older building. The decor actual had personality blending traditional and contemporary touches. It was quiet and comfortable in the center of the city. I had two catered meals ar my meeting and the food was very good. Note that parking was very expensive.

review_title: Great location but a bit jaded...
review_text: Stayed here for business. Rooms decent size but bathroom spilt in two made no sense. Furniture and decor looking very dated but the bed was pretty comfortable. Very slow wireless and wired service didn't work despite attentions of hotel tech support. Wouldn't be my first choice in Philadelphia...

review_title: Ultra modern rooms, great service, nice amenities
review_text:
We enjoyed a fun weekend at Andaz. The decor is ultra modern, too cool for school hip, everything black, white or beige, glass & mirrors, electronic blinds & lighting system. Not our personal style but totally fun for a weekend stay.
The room is spacious with high ceiling. The bathroom area is almost as large as the rest of the room. Bed and comforter very comfortable, air ventilation system quiet and effective. Furniture, fixtures, bed linen, towels, personal care items all of high quality.
Mini bar items, except for booze, are complimentary and generous with sodas, juice, bottled water (still & bubbles), Â terra chips, Dagoba chocolate bar. They replenish the items every day which we found impressive.
The best thing about Andaz is the complimentary, throughout the day cafe service in the lobby. From morning to evening, you can get coffee, cappuccino, latte, tea, cookies, candied walnuts, fruits, all served by friendly staff. Â Wine & beer in the evening. We truly appreciated this amenity.
Wifi Â is complimentary and easy to connect. Frankly, we are morally opposed to paying outrageous hotel charges for Wifi.
On our first day, we asked for extra towels and pillows and they were delivered promptly.
Location is worth mentioning. Downtown in the heart of Wall Street. We didn't care about not being close to the main tourist sites in midtown, but if that's important to you, Andaz may not work for you. Keep in mind subway stations are nearby and public transport is generally good in NYC.

It's not that I was unhappy. It's just I would have been happier with "normal" courtyard things. There was no coffee (forced to use Starbucks in lobby), limited cable tv, smallish rooms. I understand why, being the location, but when you see the courtyard name, you expect certain things. This did not deliver most.

review_title: Some niggles but a great place to stay in New York away from the hurlyburly
review_text: We took a suite at this hotel that is designed in that retro modern way most hotels favor these days. The room was comfortable and well proportioned - felt like a small apartment. It has nice touches like ambient controlled lighting and blinds. New York can be notoriously noisy so staying down near Seaport/Battery Park is very sensible if you want a quiet nights sleep. Admittedly this means quite a lot of yellow cabs to get the action but it's worth the effort. A few things didn't quite gel. The bathroom has a wet room and Buddha bath together but this hasn't been designed on a slant so it is common for water to flush out to the sink area. The safe is quite temperamental (we had to get a man up to fix). Breakfast 'bar' is included but this amounts to cookie and a coffee with additional charging for muffins and the like. You can use the in-house restaurant but this food isn't that exciting for the usual hotel price. Service is ok but they dont hit the heights of making you feel valued and that nothing is too much trouble - yep - sometimes it is a bit reticent - but then again, it s NewYork! Value and location are good and I would stay again but It just falls short of delivering 5 star.

What a pleasant stay we had at Andaz! The hotel was very luxious and the staff really friendly. We booked a double room which was very spacious. The room had a big and very beautifull bathroom.
The hotel is situated on Wall Street close to the NYSE and the main metro lines so it is easy to travel uptown. 
Next time we will visit New York we will definitely stay at Andaz!

review_title: Love this westin! Great location, great staff!
review_text: Have stayed at this westin for many years now when in Philly. Love the location, access to lots, good gym, good little bar and late night food. Nice rooms and the front desk staff always remember me and treat me well. Good choice!

review_title: Fantastic - the most memorable stay in a hotel we will ever have
review_text:
An absolutely brilliant stay in a beautiful hotel. What made this holiday stay at The Bryant Park the most amazing break was without doubt the staff. Everyone we met could not do enough for us and truly did go the extra mile to do all they could to make our stay special. 
The location is spot on and within close walking distance of the major attractions in mid town. The rooms are simple and elegant, with great views if you are looking over the park and all its hustle and bustle - great people watching! The exterior of the building is also magnificent, and in case you didn't know (and what sold it for me) it was featured in Ghostbusters!
The bar downstairs is great and while we were there had a free bar for an hour every weekday! 
The events organisors and concierge recommended some brilliant restaurants, bars and clubs getting us guest list for places we wouldn't have otherwise got in to. 
Darren and the team regonised we had some celebrating to do (I proposed to my girlfriend and it was my birthday) and really made it special, we felt they were sharing in our experience. 
I have already recommended this hotel to friends and family, and will definitely be staying again. Thanks once again to Darren, Rob, Luis, Eric and all the rest of the guys - you were all brilliant.

This hotel is well located but not well kept. We were initially shown a room with unwashed sheets, enough said! When we requested housekeeping, the front desk told us it would be easier to change our room. We were moved much smaller room ( you would think they would have made a small attempt to make us happy). Unfortunately this room had peelin wallpaper, moldy bathroom and generally unvacuumed feel to the carpet( needless to say we kept shoes on) as I was too tired to tussle with the front desk again. We were there for a pleasurable memorial day getaway, so I didn't let this experience put a damper on our trip...but, I would not recommend this hotel until they get a handle on their housekeeping and spruce up the rooms

review_title: Refreshing Addition to Philadelphia hotel lineup
review_text:
As a native Philadelphian I must say the Le Meridien is a welcome addition to the sea of hotel choices in the area. I moved to NJ, but frequently return to the town I hold dear - mainly for the nightlife, culture and of course Philly sports. 
I've stayed at a number of hotels, but this hotels customer service and atmosphere (not to mention pricing!) far surpasses many other hotels in Center City. The decor is modern and hip, the lobby bar has a great social scene, and the staff ate pleasant. Rooms are spacious w great mini bar. Location is right next to City Hall and subway lines. Short walk to entertainment on broad. By far, favorite within Sheraton family to date. You have option to Valet (38) or self park in public garage. Valet service is good.

Been here on a one week trip to new york. For us it was the perfect spot to endeavour the city. Free wine in the evening was great. 
Go to stone street which is almost just around the corner for a drink in the evening.

review_title: Very nice hotel and I'm a real discriminating traveller
review_text: Lovely hotel. Stayed in a Jr. Suite. Lots of space. Very modern and clean. Easy checkin. Great open minibar. Very nice lobby setup with access to lattes and pastries.
#NAME?
Hotel is in a great location, rooms are nice, pretty clean. Great fitness center, nice staff.

This is easily the most beautifully designed hotel I have ever stayed at. Not only is it pretty to look at, but its comfortable as well! 
Check in was easy and friendly, an my room was upgraded to a large room with a wonderful view of the city even though I booked through priceline and got an amazing deal. 
Bathroom was gigantic! Full tub and shower. 
I love this property, will definitely be back for pleasure rather than business.

review_title: Being well-taken care of while here for a conference.
review_text:
I'm here right now (09/18/11). Arrived yesterday and leave tomorrow for a total of 3 nights. The customer service has been OUTSTANDING at every instance, beginning with the very pleasant and accommodating Barbara when I checked in. Due to the conference, I actually had 2 separate reservations and was supposed to move rooms. Barbara cheerfully fixed that for me. Other desk staff have been so, so polite and genuinely friendly. Restaurant-to-go staff, including the chef who warmed up my cranberry muffin started my day perfectly with their cheerfulness.
Housekeeping staff were so helpful and pleasant and made sure I wanted for nothing.
This location is GREAT for downtown action - walking distance to lots of places including great shopping and great food, including the Reading Terminal Markets-wow!

review_title: Great hotel, great service, great stay!
review_text: My husband and visited New York for the first time last week and chose the Andaz as our hotel per trip advisor reviews. We asked if any complimentary room upgrades were available upon our arrival and they were happy to upgrade us. All the freebies were very nice as well, from the cappacinos and wine in the lobby (which they aren't cheap with) to the snacks and drinks in the room. I wouldn't recommend the room with the tub upgrade for people who aren't romantically involved because you can see everything through the glass window leading into the room. The staff was very helpful on telling where the hotspots were for nightclubs and restaurants. You are a cab ride or subway ride away from everything by choosing to stay in the financial district but we didnt mind because it was way more quiet in the evening. We dined at Wall and Water (located in the hotel) on our last night and we were pleased with our food and great service. All in all great hotel, we'll def stay there on our next trip to NYC. Great value for this caliber of a hotel!

Bellissimo hotel nel cuore finanziario di los angeles....camere spaziosissime e pulite. Unico neo il quartiere.........molto bello ma molto scarico di attrazioni. Il sabato e la domenica poi ancora peggio perchÃ© gli uffici sono chiusi quindi ci sono solo barboni......l' unica cosa che potrete ammirare sono i set dei film che girano nelle strade del quartiere il fine settimana.
hotel_name: Omni Los Angeles at California Plaza

review_text: My husband and I stayed here a recent Friday night. The staff was excellent and very helpful with any requests. Everyone was very friendly. The rooms were clean and modern. We never heard any of the other guests. The price per night is a deal in comparison to many of the other hotels in the area. There was even a parking lot right around the corner, since we drove into the city.

review_title: Great hotel, great service, great location
review_text: The Loews is a great hotel, very well located, friendly attentive staff made the stay. Rooms are large if a tiny bit dated. However the staff were really great. The only issue as a tourist is that it's near the convention centre so there are alot of delegates in the hotel but that didn't bother us. Overall great, would recommend.

Stayed here for a night with my family of 5. Very satisfied with the choice. Rooms are standard Courtyard but the overall building is old and lovely. Gracious service. Only a block from Reading Market and convention center. Really cool Macy's across the street in another great old building. Ipod dock in room. Beds comfortable.

Was there for a technical conference. Had a nice room on the 20th floor. 
The hotel's Internet is a bit spotty, but that may have been due to high loading from ~600 network geeks attending the conference. 
Room service was good, prompt service and tasty food.

review_title: Andaz Wall St. is one of the best hotels that I stayed in!
review_text: We stayed here for three nights and it was one of the best hotel experiences I have ever had. Upon arrival, we were greeted by a hostess who invited us to sit on a comfy couch while she checked us in using a handheld device. Overall, the hotel is very trendy and inviting. The hotel offers lots of freebies including small snacks and drinks in the lobby and in the room (note: there is a charge for alcohol in the mini-bar) and wireless Internet. The location is convenient as it is walking distance to more than one subway line. As well, there is a bus stop right outside the door. There is also a 24 hour drug store right across the street. There is also a gym but did not check it out. (too many things to do in NYC that I did not have time to work out). The room we had was a decent size and clean. A bathrobe and comfy indoor slippers were provided. Check out is typically 12 noon. However, our flight was at 4:30 pm. The hotel kindly allowed us to check out at 2:00 pm at no extra charge! I will definitely be staying at this hotel when I visit NYC again.

We spent a Saturday night here to do some sight seeing. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The concierge recommended great places to eat and see. When we requested extra towels and water (free!) it arrived very quickly.
The room was comfortable and clean.
The hotel is walking distance to the historic sights and rittenhouse square.
Our rate included free valet Parking. We called down a few mins before we wanted to leave and the car was waiting for us.
We would definitely stay here again next time we visit Philadelphia.

We stayed one night at Le Meriden and we would definitely go back. Room was nice; bed comfortable. Safe and mini bar refrigerator in room. On the plus side, parking and breakfast were included. Breakfast is an entree and beverage. I had an omelette- delicious! My husband had eggs over easy with potatoes and toast- he enjoyed all. We paid $204 including tax. Excellent location too. 
Things we didnt like: We did not like the door to the bathroom. It was a sliding door that could not be locked. I like privacy when I'm in the bathroom.
Although there were 2 of us - there was only 1 washcloth; 2 hand towels and 2 large towels. Not a big deal. The front desk did not have change for a twenty to tip the bellman. That was annoying. We asked that the car be ready at 11. It did not arrive til 11:20. But these are all very minor issues. 
Clean and trendy, this hotel is a good find.

I read the reviews on TripAdvisor and was expecting great service, lovely furnishings and a good experience. Instead, the room was furnished a la Ikea, with the world's least comfortable sofa, cheap desk and bookcase, and melamine closets. The drapes only opened partially and the roller shades were frayed at the edges and not in good repair. Even the orchid on the coffee table was plastic!
Worse yet, the walls are paper thin, even on a floor of all suites. I heard every word of the rather quiet conversation the gentleman next door was having with a business associate. I resorted to using the earplugs they conveniently provide in the thankfully lovely bathrooms.
Honestly, I've stayed in MUCH nicer mid-range chain hotel rooms!
My almost $30 room service breakfast of oatmeal and coffee was average at best, and when I next tried the whole wheat waffle, it was like eating cardboard (albeit VERY expensive cardboard). 
On a positive note, my lunch at Koi (the hotel's restaurant) was quite good!
Any hotel where there is such a scene that hip looking employees ask to see your key before you can enter the premises and loud music deafens you at the front desk is a dead giveaway that they care less about their guests than their image, and that is all too true of the Bryant Park Hotel. 
For a comparable price, I much prefer the Mercer, the Trump Hotels (near Columbus Circle or in SoHo), the SoHo or TriBeCa Grand Hotels, and the Thompson or Hudson Hotels.

review_title: An excellent hotel with excellent service
review_text:
I stayed at the hotel recently. The hotel was centrally located right next to the Bryant Park. The check- in was quick and efficient. The room was clean and airy with a view of the park. 
What really made this hotel stand out for me were the staff. Right from Darren the director of the front office down to the cleaners the staff were professional and very polite. I am treated as an individual and not a body in room 1501!!!
I would highly recommend BPH to anybody travelling to NY- Santosh

review_title: Best hotel experience I've ever had
review_text: Stayed at the Andaz for a week in November and the place was amazing. From checkin with Adam to the coffee bar to the room to the gym, all was top notch. Got a complimentary upgrade to a suite and couldn't be more satisfied. The complimentary chocolate and granola bars and the sodas, tea, and OJ were 'sweet'. Tons of great restaurants within a few hundred feet and the 2,3 j,z and 4,5 lines are a five minute walk up Wall. Not a sight of a wall st protester either. A+++

We received great service from every staff member during our stay. Our rooms was clean and comfortable. We especially loved the attention to service given at breakfast by Richard - dining room attendant. He was very friendly and attentative to the bussing of the tables and the offering mints. Nice touch. We were acknowledge by every employee encountered throughout the property. Never seen this level of service at ANY Hampton Inn. Well done!

I am sending this email because I would like to recognize the concierge Gerri Diggins because of her professionalism, etiquette and excellent customer service. She shows passion and dedication for what she does and it makes us feel like we are at home. We as guests are enjoying this wonderful hotel for all amenities and the excellent professionalism.
Kind Regards,
Mr. Javier Curras-Hernandez
Miami Children's Hospital
Division of Preventive Medicine

Upon my arrival I was welcomed by Adrian,Khalil,Marquez and Eric. They were very helpful and respectful. I enjoy the service I had there and I will recommend my friend and family to stay at the Westin in Philadelphia.

review_title: Sophisticated and comfortable hotel in a fantastic location.
review_text: A beautiful, modern hotel in a gorgeous old building. Great staff, perfect location for walking. Centrally located--1 block from City Hall, a nice walk to museums on the Ben Franklin Parkway, the historic district, and shopping. Very comfortable rooms with cloud-like beds and nice views. The light fixtures are amazing--especially the ones in the restaurant. We would stay there again in a heartbeat.

I stayed 4 nights at Andaz Wall Street and this was the best 5 star hotel during my 1.5 week NY trip. Although it was located downtown, it was highly accessible as the subway was within walking distance. What impressed me was the ever-helpful and cheerful service staff in the hotel (especially the concierge). We stayed on the 7th floor and greatly appreciated the serenity of the room. The room was clean,spacious, high ceiling, well-lit with modern furnishings (especially long vanity table). Though I have been using the Tripadvisor forum for years, this is the first time that I am impressed enough to write a review.

review_title: 5 star service, but needs just a little refurbishing.
review_text: From the time we arrived to departure, the Loews staff couldn't have been more accomodating. We were here during the hurricane, and the staff and management couldn't have provided any better service. From Steve at the front desk who upgraded us to their club level, to all the bellmen who helped direct us around town, the service was first class in every aspect. We were even provided with a complimentary breakfast voucher in the main restaurant on the morning following the hurricane. You also can't beat the location here. It is a one minute walk to transportation hubs, restaurants, and the Reading Market was about 3 minutes away. The corner view room was worth the few extra dollars. What a view from the 30th floor!!!!!!. If there is one thing for improvement, the public area carpeting needs replacing, and the room furniture though not bad, just needs "refreshing". The many elevators were quick and prompt even with a full house of approx 500 rooms. Overall it was a fantastic stay and I can't thank the staff enough for taking care of this special occasion for us. Next time we are in Philly, there is no doubt where we are staying, The Loews Hotel Philadelphia.

Service was great and friendly to kids. The location was central to the sights we wanted to see, Franklin Institute and Independence Hall. One mark would be the attention to detail in cleaning. There were items left behind from the previous people.

Ottimo hotel ad un passo da Times Square e comodo per i teatri di Broadway. 
Ristrutturato di recente, e' moderno e con personale professionale e disponibile. 
La stanza e' confortevole. 
La prima colazione e' buona, ma a volte se si sbaglia l'orario, la saletta e' sovraffollata e si rischia di 
mangiare in piedi.

review_title: A Gem of a Hotel in the Theatre District
review_text: Very plesent stay a the pearl. The location is perfect for uptown exploration. The subway is close by, tons of choices for food, and theaters within walking distance. We will likely stay here again on future trips into the city.

Cannot imagine a more perfect location for sightseeing. Is so convenient to everything!! Every staff person we dealt with was friendly, helpful and polite. Was delighted with the service. Restaurant was so wonderful we ate there several times. Plan to go back next time I am there.

I loved this hotel. Great location, rooms, and style. I did get it on priceline so I can't comment on the value of normal rates. Hotel also had small indoor pool which I didn't expect at all in a downtown high rise.

Let's just start with The fact that I am so impressed I Am writing the review before I have Even finished the holiday, I Am that confident in this place!
The Andaz was recommended to me by a friend and what a recommendation. The welcome by the hosts is friendly, courteous and deficient, all the staff are knowledgeable and happy to help with anything, they all provide all services. The lobby is immense, beautiful and welcoming, The free tea, coffee, fruit and biscuits is a nice touch. The rooms... well the rooms ..... big especially by nyc standards - we have stayed in three others in nyc including a much more expensive hotel and this is the biggest. The decor is clean modern tasteful and beautiful. The tv is massive, the electric black out blind and different light settings are a very nice touch. 
As for the bathroom well.... no bath but who cares! It's sleek, spotless and has a shower bigger than my own bathroom! The location is good, quiet, very little passing traffic and very near stone itsedt with several good restaurants and bars. The south st sea post is a few minutes wall and there's a very nice duane read over the road for supplies. The gym is well stocked and air conditioned, room service not too expensive for nyc either.
I really cannot fault this hotel.

Treated like kings and queens on arrival. They asked us if we would like a room with a view. Amazing service. Hotel in the heart of philli! We will now book Loews all the way if the service is that good

review_title: Huge hotel, generic feel, clean enough, good location, easy stay.
review_text:
We stayed just one night, having gotten the room for under 100 bucks on priceline, and it was fine. If we had paid retail, I'd say it was over priced. I think it's a stretch to call this hotel 4 stars. Other reviews are correct in mentioning the hotel needing a bit of sprucing up, though the important details were clean enough: sheets/bedding and bathroom were spotless. But there were dusty corners and banged up walls, finger prints and food stains on furniture. The color scheme of the hotels (dark and grey) added to this feeling of beat-up dinginess. Sadly, thought the building is historic and impressive as an architectural monument, the interiors are rather generic, though the room have tons of light from the nearly wall to wall windows. Views are great from high floors, but the windows are not sound proof.Â 
The location is great - near the fabulous market, many restaurants, transportation. However be prepared for lots of street noise. In fact, sound is major issue for this hotel. We could hear thing ringing of the elevators all night, and our neighbor sneezing in the adjacent room. I'm not that sensitive to sound so it didn't bother me, but for supposed 4 stars, this is a huge minus.
We did like the bathroom- a huge tub and spacious. The room was also large enough with amenities. Though our toilet intermittently clogged.
Staff was nice, we didn't have any reason to deal with them much, and check-in check-out was a breeze
DO NOT use their overpriced valet parking unless you enjoy spending extra money. Less than a block away is a 17 dollar a day city lot that was so easy. In fact when we pulled in we could see the hotel valet line of cars backing up around the block and we were very pleased to have chosen the budget parking option.

review_title: Brilliant hotel , great location, complimentary breakfast was a nice touch. Recommend .
review_text: Having been to New York on 7 occassions , we found this hotel to be fantastic. Great sized room, very clean and very high standard of room fittings and decor. Included in the price was complimentary continental breakfast which was great and started the day off just right. Would highly recommend this hotel.

review_title: Great service - really welcoming - great location makes up for slightly tired rooms
review_text: Great family hotel with small but adequate & safe pool - really good service culture amongst all staff -nice breakfast - good recommendations for evening meals - onsite secure parking - easy walking distance to Hollywood Boulevard & Hollywood Bowl

We stayed at the Andaz for 6 days for our first time in New York and the hotel was an amazing experience....our room was absolutely beautiful, spacious and modern with all the amenities. Everything in the room is free (except for the alcohol), free wifi, huge TV, a single control centre that manages the lighting modes for the entire room including a black out option and an amazingly huge shower! Also get free coffees, cookies, nuts and wine in the lobby... The hotel is in a beautiful location but if you are tourist it may be a bit far if you would like to come back to your hotel to freshen up during the day, but the metro is close by and I think that the hotel is so amazing that the location doesn't really make a difference! Once again, a spectacular stay!

I booked my room a month and half in advance. I was placed in my desired room king size bed. Unfortunately, it was right next to the elevator. The sound was unpleasant. The room was small The website did not make it very important for appointments for Breathe . I could not get a massage because it was over booked. The location was not perfect. Overrall, I wish I had a better experience.

review_title: VIP TREATMENT ALL THE WAY. Amazing.
review_text: Last weekend, my husband and I celebrated our 15 years anniversary. The staff was tentative and very professional. Our upgraded room was beautiful with aview to match. We were treated with a gift basket, a bottle of wine and chocolate covered strawberries. They made my stay very special.

Booked the hotel through Priceline so I received an excellent rate. I had a tough time actually finding the hotel. Spent five minutes circling the building. Once I found the entrance I wad blown away with the initial service. Check-in was a breeze. I was surprised that the snacks and beverages were free. Room was beautiful, bathroom spacious and the bed was very comfortable. If you luck up and great an excellent rate, please take advance.

review_title: If you want an incredible staff and amazing value we found it!
review_text:
The Distrikt- quite, almost zen like ironically, just a quick walk to Time Square. Five day visit, did not want to leave our new home away from home! 
Thank you to the Manager Will, and his staff, our hotel experience was refreshingly innovative and exceeded our expectations! 
Sincerely, Brian M

Had a wonderful stay at the distrikt hotel. The staff went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. The room had a keurig coffee machine, and also a ihome music player. Looking forward to staying here again.

review_title: Great! A lovely boutique style hotel!
review_text: A lovely small and friendly hotel. Excellent customer service. Not the 'perfect' location but very central, close to times square and subway station. A dodgy 'adult' shop just down the road and close to the parole office but caused us no problems and located near another busy hotel so never felt intimidated. Distrikt went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. Would recommend.

review_title: Everything you could wish for in NYC accommodation.
review_text: Can't say a bad word about our stay. The rooms and hotel in general are extremely clean and smart. The room was spacious and extremely quiet - unusual for NYC! They offer some nice touches and the service is brilliant from all staff, reception through to cleaners. Plus, we had a booking issue with Expedia, and although it was no fault of theirs, they sorted it out for us for no extra charge. As a result our engagement holiday was magical and I can't recommend them enough.
