review_title: A completely unnecessary mess at every turn!
review_text: We arrived the day after Christmas all excited for the stay. We get to the room on the 20th floor and the traffic noise is very loud. We call she says no other 1 bdrm suites on higher floors. I said excuse me but we are paying for a DELUXE 1 bdrm. She checks says you are right we will move you room not ready. After 2 hrs we get moved! At dinner no prices on the kids menu$30 for 2 bowls of pasta with butter! Turn down opens the door @ 9:40pm without knocking and do not disturb is on door! Next morning house keeping walks in at8:34 with do not disturb still on door. We call housekeeping and say come in 1 hour. We leave for the day come back soaking wet from rain and taxi shortage. Room key doesn't work anymore! Finally get into room and it was NEVER cleaned!! Housekeeping comes up and now All wet and tired from rain and walking we have to leave room for 45 minutes! We get completely tasteless and expensive room service. Order gluten free salads and they send up a plate of cookies with gluten and card to apologize!! Decide to leave a day early too unpleasant to deal with aggravavation like that for several hundred $$ a night and they have another guests luggage loaded into our car!!! Absolutely pitiful!!!
Great location, staff are nice, rooms are cleaned twice a day, bathrooms are good, bed is ridiculously comfortable and views are beautiful. Wonderful except very expensive.

Es la primera vez que me he alojado en un trump pero tenia muchas ganas y ha superado mis expectativas totalmente.
El edificio bien ubicado a mano de toodo! La gente maravillosa, te tratan como a reyes.
Tienen mil detalles y bueno la habitaciÃ³n por favor con esa baÃ±era en la cristalera mirando al downtown, esos muebles maravillosos, y q decir de la cama! Con ese colchÃ³n ! De lujo! Es como doble!! Yo quiero uno asÃ­!!
Ese recibimiento en el lobby con copita de champagne y fresas y mashmelos de choco!!
Bueno en definitiva q no os perdÃ¡is esta experiencia si vais a nueva York
Merece la pena!!! Y volverÃ©, sin duda!!!

review_title: Perfect for anyone seeking a new beautiful, hip yet comfortable place in NYC
review_text: We have been all over the world and have never taken the time to rate any hotel. We really feel Trump Soho deserves to be recognized! This place is perfect for a NYC getaway

review_title: Soho location is great - hotel has a boutique feel.
review_text: The Trump Soho was an excellent experience upgraded to a 1 bedroom suite - worth the the extra $119 per night from the standard room. Need to check the floor plan as some of the rooms have a poor layout with the bed right near the door - don't want this. Location is great - so many restaurants within a 5 minute walk, subway 2 minutes and all the shops you could want very close by. Usually stay uptown - definitely more fun in Soho.

review_title: One of the nicer Holiday Inn Expresses.
review_text: Not usually a big fan of Holiday Inn, they don't always have the consistent quality of say a Marriott, but this hotel is the choice for my business trips to Philly. Prices are reasonable, rooms clean, staff pleasant, and a great location. It's a couple of blocks from Reading Terminal and plenty of other places to eat. Cab fare $28.50 from airport.

review_title: Excellent location, great price and delivers on all levels
review_text: Just returned from 5 night stay and can only compliment everything at this hotel. We didn't use the bar/ restaurant as we chose to see the city. Room was decent size, very clean and nice touches added daily such as turn down and pumpkin pie left in room as gift on thanksgiving day. Would highly recommend this hotel to all you will not be disappointed. Only 2 minutes walk to Times Square.

I hav to say form the time i walked up to the hotel. I was grossed out. There were prostitutes walkin around n drug dealer everywhere. I walk in and see no difference. The service was the worst n i didnt feel secured at all. I felt as though when i was in my room i shud have brought my gun. Over the night somone tried to break in my room and my girlfriend got bit by a strand bug. To sum it up.. worst hotel stay ever...

review_title: I felt really welcome and taken care of!
review_text: The friendly and professional staff made me feel right at home. I had a very comfortable room with a beautiful view. Although it can be crazy on the street below, my room was very quiet.

review_title: Best city hotel in the world?
review_text: Everything about this hotel is jaw dropping amazing, except when you get the bill, but what do you expect from 5 star luxury and probably the best city hotel experience you can have!

review_title: A bit old but nice and spacious
review_text:
Rooms are a bit old, but quite large and otherwise good. Could have used some bedside power sockets.
Pool was great in the hot weather.
Breakfast buffet was horrible. Don't bother with it.
Reasonable location, not noisy, no real complaints.
We have been to NYC many times and came to SOHO for a quick anniversary getaway. Every aspect of this hotel was great.

This is a great hotel for a summer stay, especially with children. It have on the premises an outdoor pool that goes up to 8 feet, a kiddie pool, playground, sand volleyball court and picnic tables along with lounge chairs. The continental breakfast is also good.

Just got back to UK after spending 4 nights in one of the two bedroom suites on the 42nd floor, had a fantastic time and would definitely stay again. I will and have recommended Trump SoHo to friends and family. 
Mr Thomas Ross

review_title: You get what you pay for
review_text:
Stayed here for 4 nights while visiting Sesame Place and Philadelphia. We had a room on the 1st floor with a double bed at $63/night. 
The location was just okay. It was very central to Sesame Place and PHiladelphia but wasn't real conveniently close to either of them. The road has 12 lanes of traffic broken into groups of threes and is very tricky to navigate.
When we got to the room I checked it over for any potential problems and cleanliness. Everything looked okay except the wall near the bed had old soda splash stains all over it. When I ironed a shirt the ironing board wouldn't fold back up and the cleaning lady never dis it for us either. The hotel entrance us not secure at all and the lock is broken. 
The 1st day things were okay but day 2 was AWFUL. I put the card on our door for the room to be cleaned. The options on the card are "sleep in" and "freshen up" I made extra sure it was on "freshen up". We led for the day and when we returned at 9pm our room had not been touched AT ALL. I called the front desk and the woman was INCREDIBLY rude and said there was nothing she could do because housekeeping had all gone home. The best she could do was bring us some towels. I was irate. They should have someone on duty to take care of problems like that. What angered me most was she seemed to think I was lying that my card was on "freshen up" as she claimed the housekeeper reported it as "do not disturb". Things were okay to that point but that put me over the edge. I was a GUEST. when you are far from home and living out of a hotel with a toddler you need to have things like the trash done EVERY day. Her attitude and unwillingness to help was UNACCEPTABLE.
when we returned on our 3rd day everything had been cleaned (except the soda stained wall). 
The bed was hard as a rock and the rooms smelled musty. The hall was hot and stuffy and smokey and the breakfast was stale and bland. The pay phones (not for me but still) were both out of order. The one computer "business center" was also out of order. We never saw the pool.
I would bit stay here again simply due to the ridiculously small rooms, hard bed and rude staff. Next time I will go somewhere closer to my destination as well.

Spent 2 nights in this amazing hotel! We loved it a lot - the view was incredible as was the service. We paid for an upgrade to a suite for a view of the Empire State building and it was worth the extra. 
Special thanks to Angel at the front door who was fantastic! If you can afford to pay for this high end hotel, then do it as it's worth the money.

review_title: The best hotel I have ever stayed in
review_text: Let me tell you this hotel is TOP NOTCH! My husband and I stayed here for 10 days on our first trip to NYC. This hotel was so clean and so nice. The person at the front desk apologized for our view but we had a great view. If you look to the right we had a beautiful view of the Empore State Building. The housekeeping staff was so great. They would leave us slippers and other little surprises. The doormen were so friendly and helpful. The rest of the staff was fabulous as well. We had the time of our lives on our trip and a great part of that is because of the staff and the hotel itself at Trump Soho. One last thing, you can hear no street noise AT ALL. Great hotel!

We stayed here for one week in September and it really made our week in NYC fantastic. We got upgraded to a big one bed suite on the 40 th floor, with views from the living area, bedroom and bathroom - and the bathtub! - of the Hudson, downtown NYC and Jersey. Bed was really comfy, and had many a bath after a lot of walking with a glass of wine watching the view. Hotel was beautiful, very modern and clean, very stylish. Good cocktails in the bar! Fab location, there was a subway two minutes walk away and very easy to get uptown in a short space of time. Soho and surrounding areas full of great shops, bars and restaurants and within easy walking distance, away from the hustle and bustle of midtown. Spa also fab. Staff very friendly. We would return!!!!

I am a regular here and I must say it get's better every time.The staff is always attentive but this time around I was greeted by a new face. The new front desk agent Tiffany was extremely courteous and professional.I've never encountered such amazing customer service.She genuinely cares about what the guest wants and I must say she is a great addition to Trump Soho.My room was amazing and I will continue to come back here.

review_title: Good value in the city-was treated GREAT by Xin
review_text: Forgot my wallet at home, flight delayed until 11pm...needless to say I had a bad day-luckily I had my passport. Unfortunately I had no credit cards. Xin made sure my night didn't get worse- made sure I checked in without a problem and was able to charge a meal. Against the manager's suggestion...MR. Chasen please make sure Xin is recognized for taking the extra step to take care of a guest. I'll be back because of him.
Average room, very limited and over priced restaurant.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Philadelphia Airport

review_text: This place is awful. My father was in the ICU at HUP so we stayed here for convenience (2 min walk to hospital across sky bridge). If we hadn't been in a life or death situation, there is no way we would have stayed. I realize that you're not going to get a 4 star hotel for $150 a night but I've stayed in cheap motels that were a lot nicer. The staff was rude and unhelpful, the ceiling in the bathroom was caving in, wallpaper was peeling, sheets were worn and stained, and they only bothered to replace or towels and make our beds 3 times in our 8 night stay. Most of the people staying here are in crisis mode and it is sad that they are being taken advantage of by this hotel.

review_title: Stay only if you need to be near the hospital!
review_text: My father had open heart surgery and mother and I are not familiar with Philadelphia, so we opted to stay here for the night of his surgery. The hotel itself is located on Penn Hospital grounds, so it was very convenient but you pay for that!!!! I've stayed at some less than three star places, but this was probably a two star in my book. With a three star price tag per night. Location gets you a stay for over $150 per night. I know it's not a vacation destination, but that's literally highway robbery! Rooms and decor were straight outta the 80's and the beds were not comfy at all. Bathroom was kind of dark and moldy and the water was not hot at all!!! Warm if that. Stay only if you must.

review_title: Nice inexpensive place to stay in Philadelphia.
review_text: We used a coupon from Roomsaver to book this hotel at a great rate and I wouldn't hesitate to do it again. The location is great, parking is free, amazing view of the city, and it was clean. The service was good and pleasant. It's not a brand new hotel with a bunch of bells and whistles, but to me it was great.

The staff here is really exceptional.
- I stayed here for two nights. On the first night, my room was on the 15th floor. The first thing I usually inspect are the sheets because I'm allergic to fragrance and detergent. No sign of either, awesome.
- The room had a faint smokey smell, probably from smokers from years past. It was so faint I didn't think it would be a problem. And it had been so long that I'd been around smoke, I didn't think I was allergic to it anymore. But at 5:30 am, I had a flare-up so I requested a new room.
- Immediately, I was assigned to a corner room on the 11th floor. Wow what a difference a few floors makes. The 11th floor smelled fresh, the a/c unit was newer, the carpet was newer, I breathed much more freely. Later that day, the staff checked up and asked if everything was fine. Totally unexpected. 
- Breakfast was great. Eggs, sausage, cereal, fruit, yogurt, juice, cinnamons, etc. Best part? The breakfast lady. So kind and warm. Even remembered the repeat guests the next morning!
- And here's where I'm totally floored. Rushing out of the hotel (late check-out no less), I forgot my coat. The next day, I asked if the hotel could ship it to California for a fee. Their response? No, they'll ship it for free. What???
I have to say this hotel's service (genuine, warm, kind) is wonderful. I'd definitely stay here again if I'm in Philly.

Like most visitors we like to look on tripadvisor to get a balanced view of potential hotels before we stay, we ignore the worst (in this case there wasn't one) and ignore the best (usually "carlos behind the bar was really friendly"). The Distrikt Hotel was everything we could have wanted, friendly courteous staff, a clean, warm room and the 'wow factor' room 2703 a view of the Empire State Building. This hotel has a small footprint, not a 5th avenue grand frontage, it is down a side street but 5 mins walk toTimes Square and theatres, next to bus terminus, close to Hells Kitchen area, plenty of eateries close by. The desk staff are only too willing to give advice on getting around.

Elevators were slow,but they were vintage, breakfast was suprisingly good,but the rooms absolute BS 
Hard as Concrete beds 
Primitive cable no twc btw,
and decor that hasn't left the 1950s
YUK!!

review_title: Gorgeous boutique hotel with amazing service!!
review_text: We stayed here from 29th oct for four nights and I cannot recommend it highly enough. Fact. There were 8 in our group and we all felt that the service was second to none. The staff at front desk couldn't have been more helpful, printing off restaurant recommendations, giving directions and weighing a lot of ladies suitcases to allow redistribution of weight!! And the daily spiced apple cider is now legendary!! Rooms immaculately clean and warm, location ideal for exploring downtown and we really felt well looked after for the duration of our trip. This really was the icing on the cake for our once in a lifetime big family trip to NYC!

review_title: Excellent hotel but needs to move a couple of blocks
review_text: Just returned from 4 night stay at The Distrikt. Couldn't fault it other than would have preferred it to be a couple of blocks east. Not a particularly nice walk back when dark. Wouldn't stay again but only due to location.

As pleasent a staff as you are going to get, considering it is after all Philly. Convenient walking dist. To everything but penn landing. Ask for higher floors if you don't want street noise. Valet parking pricey but average for Philly. Had trouble with thermostat but staff was helpful

review_title: Great rooms, super friendly staff, perfect location
review_text: I reserved this hotel on Hotwire and was actually very surprised at how nice it is for the great rate I got. The frog desk clerk (I wish I could remember his name) was so friendly- he joked around with us and chatted away as he was checking us in. The room was fantastic. HUGE space, and the bed is actually a Sleep Number, which I had never seen before in a hotel. Not to mention being right off of Rittenhouse. We went to the Forrest Theatre and it was only a few blocks away, as well as all the access to the bars and restaurants. I would definitely stay here again.

review_title: Good value in a great location
review_text: Very comfortable hotel in a great location in downtown Philly.

Can't say much about the room because I was pretty out of it, but I didn't get any post op infections so it must have been very clean. My behind looks better now then when I was 18, would definitely come back for a tummy tuck. Just wish it wasn't so close to the airport.

I just recently disco verde this hotel.
Despite the peak season near Christmas Time the rate is more than acceptable. The hotel is located downtown in a nice area and easily accessible. Rooms are wide and beds are very confortable. The hotel is overall quite clearing and staff is doing a good job. I would recommend it to italiane visiting Philadelphia , such a nice city.
By the way the officiai rates do not respect the reality. Check with the hotel directly.

Stayed here during the hurricane. Was upgraded to a one bedroom suite with excellent views of the Empire State.
Service was great, staff very friendly and helpful. Although we hadn't really intended dining in the hotel we ended up doing so because of the weather conditions. The food was excellent although a bit pricey!
I would definitely return.

As pretty frequent travellers, my boyfriend and I thought we had to leave a review on this hotel. 
We stayed at the Distrikt Hotel for 1 week in September for my 21st. They kindly upgraded our room for my birthday, the room was clean, modern and comfortable. We were on the 39th floor and had an amazing view of the empire state building. 
The staff were all very friendly and helpful. We ate in the hotel twice, once for breakfast and once for dinner, the service was flawless and the food was very nice, the bar/restaurant area is small but comfortable.
My boyfriend and I agreed that the little touches to this hotel really made it. Handwritten notes to wish us well, leaving chocolates on the pillow, giving us a card with weather forecasts on them etc.
Location wise, it was a pretty good. I noticed some reviews mentioned the street. I would say the street could be nicer but at no point did I feel unsafe.
All in all we had a fantastic holiday, and Distrikt Hotel definitely helped to make my 21st one to remember!

Great location within walking distance of the shops. Room was basic, had issues with hot water, room safe and bath plug. A friend was unable to leave messages for us in the room as there was no facility to do this! (it is 2011 isn't it?). Pleasant atmosphere around the hotel and the door staff were excellent. Relatively good value right up until the point where I settled the bill by cash then got home to find my credit card debited too! If you want a reasonably priced bed with reasonable amenities then go for it, but if you are looking for quality go elsewhere.

We have been here for 5 nights. Our room is on the 31st floor we can c the Empire & the Hudson in either direction. We have been spoilt with roses for our 30th wedding anniversary & hotel staff r polite quick & very helpful. We think the position of hotel is excellent just nx to Port Authority walk to Time Sq & everything so so close. Great te thanks to this hotel

review_title: New management seems to be making a difference
review_text:
We've not stayed here before, and I was a little apprehensive after reading the emphatic low reviews. Here is what I found: 
1. The building is obviously not new. But it is not in bad shape.
2. The lobby is smallish and sparse, but is clean and in good repair
3. We had no problem with the desk staff
4. The elevator is small and old. We used it and had no problem.
5. The breakfast area looked newly redone. While we were there they tore up the floor and began replacing it. I asked why, as it looked new. I was told it was new, but was uneven in a couple spots (I certainly hadn't noticed) and they called the contractor back in to do it all over. This is hardly the sign of management that doesn't care. The breakfast has a waffle station, cereal, yogurt and fruit and bagels and muffins. There was plenty there for us.
6. The room we had was quite large, nice high ceilings. We liked the big new flatscreen. Also a microwave and fridge. Again, this is not a new building, but the room is clean and in good repair. Our room faced the street and the noise from the street makes it in the room pretty well. I don't know what the hotel could do about that, though. Our two beds were quite comfortable. 
Overall: this is a VALUE hotel, not a LUXURY hotel. That being the case, we found it to more than adequately meet our needs. Maybe those awful reviews were legit at the time, but its not what we experienced. They have new management, and it seems to be making a difference.

review_title: Hotel Palomar...a great place to stay while in Philly
review_text: We scheduled a weekend get away down in Philly. We booked a suite (room 1010) at the Hotel Palomar. Our two daughters stayed on the very comfortable sofa bed. They loved the huge Fuji soaking tub with the bath salts. The hotel staff was extremely helpful & attentive. This hotel is in a great location; Ritten house sq, Avenue of the arts all of the best resteraunt's & shopping. We had a great weekend and the next time we stay in Philly we'll stay at the Hotel Palomar.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
We stayed here for 5 nights because of the very good reviews. I choose our hotel based on cleanliness and service. This hotel met our expectations. There is a 2x/day housekeeping service. There is staff everywhere that will cater to your needs. The rooms are new and 
spotless. We got an upgrade to a 1-bedroom suite and the room is big with a city view and a view of the Hudson river. The only complaint I have is that the water temperature of their lounge pool is very cold. The hotel is a little bit of the center of Manhattan but it is very accessible by train. We would stay here again.

This hotel is located right next to the port authority bus terminal, so if you want to go the woodbury common outlet for some shopping it's perfect. Also 2 blocks away from times square. The hotel is a very thin building with 4 rooms per floor, which is a great alternative to those massive American hotels . The room was excellent very well decorated and modern , also unlike what's usual in new York . The reception staff was ok , was not very impressed with their customer service . The best customer service at that hotel was given by the 2 doormen , who were always polite, professional and treated you as individuals . Breakfast although not included and we paid for it as extra was very inconsistent 45m to an hour before closing time , there was never healthy cereal or brown bread and no stock , every day they would run out of it! Staff seemed more interested in talking to each other then making sure quality and quantity of food was consistent from beginning till the end , as the price charged was the same . But still a good hotel!

review_title: High end, achingly cool but a little self conscious in good location
review_text: Finished our trip to NYC with 4 nights in the Trump SoHo. Booked through a discount website, so good price. Felt distinctly underdressed on arrival, with lots of glamorous 20 something's coming and going. Had booked for two adults and a teenager, but room, although lovely, too small for this, so after a somewhat frank discussion we were upgraded to a suite with sofa bed. All support services -housekeeping, front desk, in room dining, in room entertainment absolutely superb. Room spotless, bed magnificent. We had a shower and a full size tub Gym adequate, business centre a little small. Only quibble was that bar shut on Sunday night at 10 30 due to rain!! Great location for SoHo and TriBeCa. Near the subway and cabs always available.

review_title: Great location and very clean hotel!
review_text: This place was great. Central location. Close to subway and since it's fairly new very clean

review_title: Was everything you would expect from a Trump property
review_text: Everything was excellent - exceptional room size in a great location - Living up to all of Trumps standards - would an will return for sure

This is a great hotel. So often design hotels are form over function, forgetting to do the basics right, whilst being too busy looking good.
This hotel, however, has no such problem. Beautifully quirky but very functional at the same time. The funkiest bathrobes ever, deep baths ( for US) excellent Internet speed. Restaurant good, front desk very friendly and efficient.
One word of warning though - watch the valet parking (a separate company I add) I had my rental vehicle dented and scratched twice in 24 hours! 
Despite this small aberration the hotel itself is almost perfect, and I look forward to returning (perhaps on foot!)
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Wonderful hotel but service is somewhat lacking.
review_text:
Just checked in today for a 3 night stay. Did get upgraded to a wonderful 1 br suite for our anniversary. However, since we have walked in and out the building now 4 times, not once has anyone even acknowledged our entry to the building. Even when we arrived from the airport with our luggage. Check in was quick, but again no mention of anyone helping with luggage. After coming back from dinner, and again being ignored by the bellmen, we did get a nice welcome letter and a bottle of wine, however no turn down service as our room needed cleaning. 
Overall, beautiful room and amazing views of the Empire State building, however it is the service and attention to small details things that make a true 5 star hotel.

review_title: Great in every way! Will certainly come back here!
review_text:
Great rooms, super comfy beds, lovely staff and an overall wonderfull stay. We stayed for 3 nights in a Deluxe Double on the 29th floor. Great view of the city and the Hudson. Quiet, hardly any noise from the streets unless you open the window. Free Wifi and 3 iMacs in the lobby to use.
Very close to Times Square, Subway and accros from the Port Authority Bus terminal.

review_title: Ratings are not always to be relied upon....
review_text: This Thanksgiving holiday we spent two days in DC in a hotel rating 80 and received much better service than we did from this number one rated hotel...when we arrived for our four night stay, I almost had a fully involved asthma attack because of the pet room they placed us in. We were moved and the new room was much better. However, we just felt ignored by management and the front desk staff. The housekeepers and bellmen were awesome but the "faces" of the brand really turned me against staying here. I remember standing at the Sofitel being jealous of those staying at the Palomar. Boy was I mislead! Needless to stay next time we visit the number 1 hotel in the city will not even be considered.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Convenient 4 the arts, do not expect room to be cleaned tho
review_text:
Very convenient hotel for the kimmel center, and other venues on avenue of the arts. However, getting your room cleaned appears to be not so convenient - as it did not happen for us (and the do not disturb sign was not on the door). 
Average hotel - nothing flashy.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Philadelphia Center City

review_title: Nice and modern without the overbearing hipness
review_text:
Hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Philadelphia. Close to excellent dining and sites. 
I love that it has a modern feel without sacrificing warmth and without trying to be hip. 
Nightly wine reception is a nice touch.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: It's the little things that truly matter
review_text: I am currently staying in the hotel as I write this. Having stayed at many fine hotels throughout the world I felt compelled to write a review. When I checked in our room was not ready which was fine as we were early anyway. They said they would call me when it was ready so we went and had some lunch. We came back around 4pm to get into the room and everything was all ready for us (although I never received said "call" from the reception staff to alert me that the room was ready). The room, a superior, is very large by NYC standards and well appointed. The bed is by far the nicest at any hotel I ever stayed. Ever. There is a thick down pad on top of the pillow top bed so it's like a cloud. Absolutely fabulous! The expresso machine is easy to use and convenient. The bathroom is very nice and spacious. There is no iron and ironing board in the room so I called guest services. They brought one right up. We left to go to dinner returning around 10:30pm. They had come in for turndown service but this was a notch above. They organized our bathroom accessories and refilled the expresso tabs for the morning. Also, put some nice music on and had the room in a nice "mood" lighting. Plus the usual of remaking the bed and the chocolate on the pillow but also included big bottles of water on each side of the bed. It's little things that make a difference. There are many other things too but I'm writing this on my phone so I'm giving the bullet points. The staff is very friendly and gracious. Always acknowledging you and greeting you. One blip was we waited over an hour for our luggage to be brought up. A little inconvenient as we just wanted to laydown and not be bothered but having to wait that long my wife fell asleep and was then awaken by the bellman. So if you have the opportunity, stay here it lives up to its reputation and then some. And I've stayed at Mandarin too in midtown(presumably a competitor). It's not even close. Trump is hands down the better. Well done. I'll be back.

Came here on my anniversary with my husband and we had a great time. Room was beautiful, clean, great views, and very romantic. Hotel pool is small but lots of fun. The cocktails though expensive are fantastic.

review_title: Great location, but not very clean
review_text: This hotel has great staffs and great location. However, the room is not very clean, especially the bathroom. It also took 15 mins for the hot shower to come out. Other than those, service is very good and there are a lot of great restaurants and clothing stores nearby. It would be a great place to eat and shop. I would rate it an average 3-3.5/5

What a fantastic hotel! I absolutely couldn't fault it! My sister and I spent 10 days in NYC. The trump was the perfect place to stay. Soho is so pretty and I would definitely recommend this end of town over the busy,noisy,dirty times square. 
From the first moment we were impressed. A beautiful lobby, wobdedul staff it was a seamless checkin. 
The room (only a standard on the 13th floor) was very large with a large beautiful bathroom. The bed was a mixture between sleeping on a cloud and a marshmallow! Amazing! 
Everything was clean and all the finest products. A very strong hairdryer (two girls with long hair needed it!) excellent aircon and electronic equipment provided. 
The staff at this hotel were exceptional. Especially the bell boys. The temperatures when we were in new York reached as high as 48degrees celcius. It was never too much trouble for the to stand in the heat to hail us a cab and always with a smile. 
Quattro is an excellent restaurant. Well worth visiting just for the desserts. They were some of the best we have ever had. 
Used the pool a few times. Again a lovely experience. Tended to be a but overcrowded with 'plastic' bodies on the weekend. With the heat it was no surprise it was crowded but we only waited about ten minutes once to get a lounger. 
This hotel is well worth every cent it cost. Truly an excellent experience in a fabulous city! Well done Trump Soho!

It is hard to fault the rooms at Distrikt. Very clean, comfortable. The location is handy to times square and the port authority bus terminal metro station is close by and has lots of connections. On the downside, the location itself is on a fairly unattractive street. However it offers good value for money for nyc.

Just returned from a one night stay at Trump SoHo! This is a beautiful hotel, in a great location, whose staff caters to your every need! The hotel is impeccably decorated with modern furnishings, the rooms are large and clean, the bathroom is pure luxury! And the bed? The most comfortable thing you will EVER sleep on! We arrived several hours before check in and the Trump SoHo staff quickly worked to get us a room. The bell staff explained all the room features in detail, offered suggestions for local restaurants, and answered any question we had. The hotel has a comfortable lobby and has a great pool bar offering fantastic views of the city! The only thing missing from the Trump SoHo is free wifi! The hotel is located in a vibrant, hip neighborhood less than 2 blocks from a subway station, 3 blocks to the Hudson River Park, and just steps from great restaurants and shopping! SoHo is a great alternative to the hustle and bustle of Midtown Hotels!

Right in the middle of the action I was very impressed by the Doubletree. Room was spacious but part of a 3 room suite with 2 connecting doors. One morning the people in the adjoining room were very noisy but until that time I hadn't noticed. Breakfast buffet and bar were moderate but it's so close to the centre of things I didn't give them much of my cash. Tried room service one night. pizza was almost cold but as it took 45 minutes to deliver I couldn't face complaining and the wait for a new one. The 2 empty beer bottles and the ice bucket were not cleared from the room in 3 days though.
So overall great venue but the service could be improved
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Philadelphia Center City

review_text: We states here for two days. From the beginning to end, our experience was wonderful. When we arrived we were greeted with fresh apple juice. Room was small but clean and modern with all the amenities. We made a reservation with a restaurant where we had to bring our own wine. We asked the front desk where to get wine on a Sunday night. He was gracious enough to provide us with a bottle of house red. We got pointers from valet on places to see. We were greeted with great customer service. Location is convenient and safe. I could say this stay was one of my best experiences.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Do not believe any negative remarks about this hotel... We stayed there for what was initially 7 nights we asked to extend our stay another 3 nights and the exceptional staff were not only willing to oblige but also gave us a discounted rate, this on top of the free upgrade we received upon our arrival. The room rates were extremely fair considering New York was inundated with United Nations delegates, we cannot say enough of the extraordinary friendly service from ALL the staff it has a "true" New York City location 10+ stars

We stayed as part of a group (40 rooms) for a week in August, love this hotel! Firstly, we were performing across the road at the gorgeous Kimmel Center for the Arts so it was super convenient!
But as far as the hotel itself, the rooms are the nicest of any Doubletree I have stayed at, and really offer everything you could want in a hotel. Modern, stylish, clean, comfortable beds, great bed linens, plush towels, great views!
Elevators were fast.
I'd say breakfast was just ok, there are many better offerings just a short walk away in great little cafes.
Something I would recommend, walk towards the town hall and go into the Hyatt building, take the elevator to the 19th floor, this is one of the most beautiful places you could go to dine, right out of a movie! There's a fun trendy bar in there too.
The only downside of the Doubletree is the staff were just ok, you feel like they kinda wanna help you but are just tired? Slow moving perhaps.
I would recommend this hotel, I've stayed here four times now, it's busy, the lobby often feels like a train station, but I love the rooms, they are peaceful and great. Awesome location especially for theater, shopping, a weekend in center city.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Philadelphia Center City

review_text: Very clean hotel right in the center of everything. Spent one night for a getaway weekend, and throughouly enjoyed it.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Philadelphia Center City

review_title: Absolutely fantastic hotel, hot tub/bath to die for- didn't want to leave!
review_text:
This was the third hotel we stayed in for our Honeymoon this August. The first two were 5* hotels in NYC so Hotel Palomar had a lot to live up to! It's been voted the second trendiest hotel in the USA and fifth in the World and it really does live up to these awards! My husband organised everything as a complete surprise for me so I was overwhelmed we arrived here. 
When we checked, they gave us two complimentary cocktail vouchers for their bar and told us every night they also have a complimentary wine hour with wines from around the world! Heaven! We went to this during the last night of our stay here in Philly - it was so classy anc the wines were fab!
Anyway! We checked in and arrived at our room to find they had set out a bottle of champagne and a note congratulating us on our honeymoon! 
The hot tub/bath was unbelievable! Literally, if you sat on the floor if it, water would be over your head- literally the best thing ever, I'm a shower girl and I didn't use it once! 
I hope this helps you decide to choose this hotel- it was absolutely fantastic and at the best location. 
Ps - my husband actually booked a cheaper room and emailed them to say it was our honeymoon - they upgraded us straight away! Literally the best hotel ever!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: A lot better than most of these reviews...
review_text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for one night while attending a concert downtown. I read reviews that made it sound like a horror but I couldn't cancel so I hoped for the best. Yes it was old and the decor was def. outdated but other than that it was perfectly fine for a short stay. Our room was 1506 we had a nice view of the jersey skyline and it was clean. We ripped apart the bedding to check for bedbugs and did not see any sign of them. Toilet was really junky though. The Pennrose Diner across the street is awesome.

Having stayed in a Kimpton property in San Francisco (Harbor Court), the Hotel Palomar was my first choice for a weekend getaway in Philadelphia. The location is ideal: many of the city's best restaurants are a five minute walk from the front door, Rittenhouse Square is several blocks away as are the many shops on Walnut Street, and Suburban Station is two blocks from the front door. We stayed in a Spa King room, which was wonderfully appointed. The Fuji soaking tub was the highlight, but the amazingly comfortable bed came in at a close second. Staff was friendly and attentive and the entire hotel is spotlessly clean. I can't wait to return!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
A very friendlly and helpfull staff, very nice rooms, great location right next to the port authority station which is both a pro and a con. The hotel has a nice bar/restaurant with OK food and reasonable prices.
The hotel lobby is really small so it's not really suited for business. When staying in the south wing of the hotel, don't expect a view except the ajesent building.
A good value for money if you are looking to stay at the center of NYC

I stayed at this hotel and It looked ok in the front but beware they have a roach problem!!! I had to tie my bags up extra tight so I wouldn't take none home.When I told the front desk they just shrugged me off and that elevator had me saying the last prayer it had me scared.Ice machine loud as hell and don't work no water in a dirty pool(it was summer)I could go on and on Here's my advice don't do it!!Â¡!!!
Staff great rooms clean no loud noise even though its right at airport.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Philadelphia Airport

review_title: Quickly becoming a big fan of the Palomar
review_text:
They're hip, they've got great service, delicious tea and coffee in the morning, free wine in the evening. Almost all postivites, except for a niche issue. One of the reasons I was excited to try this Palomar specifically was because they have free bicycles. It turns out that their bikes are great if your day job is bike messenger. Hipster single gear, low handlebars, skinny seats, skinny wheels. The seats aren't adjustable unless you have a bike wrench and the hotel staff didn't offer to adjust it before they walked away. I usually ride on the street in Manhattan and I had some trouble staying on that lovely white skinny bike. The bike really is goregous, but they shouldn't give it to tourists. It is a real safety hazard. I'm surprised that they didn't stock some nice Dutch bikes, which would still be cool enough for their image, but easy for everyone to ride. 
The hotel is great, I highly recommend it. Be careful with the bikes.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Awesome Hotel in NYC with impeccable service
review_text: Awesome hotel in a great up and coming New York neighborhood. Completely renovated and new throughout! Couldn't recommend this hotel more given price, service, location and quality!!!!

review_title: Someone threw up in our room before we arrived.
review_text:
Someone threw up in our room before we arrived. First of all, I'd like to note that the hallways looked a bit tired & our door looked like it had been kicked in upon arrival, but we got a good deal & were not at all bothered by either fact, to be honest.Â 
However, when we walked in the room, immediately, we could tell that someone recently threw up. It clearly had been cleanedÂ but there were red stains all over the carpet & it smelledÂ 
HORRIBLE/UNBEARABLE. We called
downstairs and a) the clerk did not seem at all surprisedÂ b) he said there was no way he could possibly move us c) that he would send someone from housecleaning up.Â 
Needless to say, no one came, we left the windows wide open for two days, went through a whole bottle of air freshener that we were forced to seek out & still spent most of our long weekend with scarves over our faces.Â 
I understand things happen but I can't in good conscience give a good review of our experience or the service at The Radisson. No follow-up from the hotel after our complaint the first day & no extra cleaning. We were completely ignored.
Location, however, as noted in other reviews is great.
Nicety situated walking distance from Philadelphia center. Spacious, clean and very comfortable. We slept very well. Nice and cozy. Front desk professional and polite
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Philadelphia Center City

review_text: Teeny, tiny rooms. Not enough toilet roll for only one night stay. Teeny tiny bathroom. Extremely comfy bed.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Philadelphia Airport

review_title: Super ruhiges, tolles Hotel in guter Lage
review_text:
TOP, nur 2 Minuten von der Subwaystation 2/3 (Wallstreet) entfernt (5 Minuten bis zur 4er-Linie) - Super ruhig, 2 mal am Tag Roomservice, sehr nette Mitarbeiter, sehr sauber und tolle Ausstattung. Eines der besten Hotels die ich jemals bewohnt habe !!!!
Man ist in 12 Minuten per Subway am Times Square, in 5 Minuten zu Fuss bei der Staten Island Ferry.....
Ãœber der Strasse ist das Pier 17 mit den Shops und dem South Street Museum.
Also auch in der nÃ¤heren Umgebung ist was geboten !

We stayed here for 1 night in order to attend a family function. The hotel is in a great location in the arts area. There are numerous fine restaurants in walking distance. While this wasn't our purpose this hotel is well located for sightseeing and enjoying the city's culture. 
Service was very good but the room was a little tight. I suppose a samll room is to be expected in a city hotel. 
Our room included the breakfast buffet which had some cooked foods and the usual array of fresh fruit bread and juices. 
The attached parking garage was convenient and reasonably priced for hotel guests. Public transportation is nearby if you don't want to drive around.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Philadelphia Center City

review_title: Not bad, pretty good, can't complain
review_text: Tight street approach, no pullout, quick transfer inside, pleasant but fairly small lobby, nice bar and restaurant, crowded wine tasting on Sat but well served. Paid extra for view and higher floor, got a city view. Active street scene on weekend night, felt safe. Close to Rittenhouse sq, pet friendly,but we did not hear barking except in hallway. Overall I'm not sure it's #1, but a nice hotel.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: I stayed in this nasty hotel a few days ago first of all the services they advertise are untrue like a pool with no water,broken elevater,ice machine broken, and house keepin service sucks my room was not clean at all my carpet was not done and my drapes had holes in it ,and to top it off no internet. Yes folks i did say something all they did was write it down and i did takes a picture of the bugs. So my advise stay at your own risk
Staff and hotel were top notch. They could not have been more helpful. Mr Trump does know how to do it first class.

Perfektes Hotel, prima Zimmer, super Service, Mitarbeiter sehr freundlich. SchÃ¶ne Lage, etwas weit weg vom Zentrum. U-Bahn um die Ecke. Aufenthalt lohnt sich auf jeden Fall. Selbst eine Evakuierung wegen Irene war kein Problem und ging reibungslos. Wurden in ein Hotel der gleichen Kette umquartiert. Konnten nach zwei Tagen wieder zurÃ¼ck. Hier gab es dann leider einige Anlaufschwierigkeiten wie zB kein warmes Wasser! Ansonsten war alles in bester Ordnung. Das Hotel ist recht neu und auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen!

review_title: Great location and bonus wine hour!
review_text: Excellent hotel in a great location-lots of shops and places to eat nearby. Wine hour every day and complimentary tea/coffee each morning. "like" Kimpton hotels on Facebook and watch out for special offers or secret passwords. Very clean, lovely decor and friendly staff.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Some of you people must be some rich, stuck up people. I find nothing wrong at all with this hotel. The service people were really kind, especially the cleaning people. It was not in a questionable part of the neighborhood like someone said. There was actually NO bugs at all, and no bed bugs. I know a special place to check for them and there wasn't any. The shower was so nice and relaxing. There was a lot of little nice shops close by. Just turn left leaving the hotel and drive down a little and they're there. The main reason I stayed here was it was cheap, and I was here for the Phillies game. If you turn left leaving the hotel, and drive straight for five minutes, there is CBP! Yeah, there was a little bit of stains on the floor, the elevator was slow (NOT SHAKEY), a couple holes in the blanket, and there wasn't a shower curtain when we got there, but ladies and gentlemen, this isn't the Ritz Carlton. Overall, this was a nice hotel to stay at.

Super nettes Personal, grosse Zimmer, flat fernseher, internet hammer FrÃ¼hstÃ¼ck. bagels zum toasten, frÃ¼chte, waffeln, mÃ¼sli, cream cheese, cereal usw. Super Lage mitten im washington district und toller Preis. Insgesammt etwas alt, und horror lift, welcher aber renoviert wird, ansonsten Top! Nichts fÃ¼r hohe ansprÃ¼che. GemÃ¼tlich freundlich. Jederzeit wieder.
My stay at the Palomar is quite memorable. The staff is extremely friendly & helpful! I would definitely go back & I highly recommend it, to whom is looking for a hotel in that area.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: First of all the elevator was broken when I stayed and I had to carry my luggage up 7 flights of stairs. The shower only ran freezing cold water. Also the cabinets were falling off and there were bed bugs. The lights were flicking and I did not feel safe. The bed did not feel clean and the whole hotel smelled like cigarette smoke. At any price this place would not be a good deal it was disgusting.

1) Feces in toilet uppon arrival. 
2) Pillow had some one elses cologne on it.
3) Hair in the bed.
4) Cigarette burns on headboard
5) Cigarette ash in the draw.
6) Running, noisy toilet.
7) sticky, dried up drink in the common area.
Without a doubt the most disgusting and vile place i have ever stayed. Switching places immediatly.

Only stayed for a very short period during a overnight airport connection. Rooms are of a typical US motel standard but are clean and comfortable for the price. We left on the 4am shuttle but the staff encouraged us to take coffee muffins and cereals from the breakfast room even though breakfast was not officially until 5.30. Minivan driver and night staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Word of warning - unlike every other hotel at PHL airport you have to call to get the free courtesy transport - we waited over 30 minutes before we called assuming it would just circulate!
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Philadelphia Airport

review_text: Not sure if it was blood spatter or vomit, either way, the rooms are gross and have your own security if you plan to stay.
Disgusting is too soft of a word to use to describe this Pitt of a hotel.I'm not sure ho any body could have a good experience here. To the holiday inn we go.

Arrived at the Skyview after being stranded at the Philadelphia airport. The shuttle driver provided some much needed entertainment, as we drove around and around the airport. I was checked in quickly.
When I entered the first room, it smelled of bad perfume, but the toilet was dirty and would not flush. I requested another room.
Room #2- Was freezing and had puddles of water all over the bathroom floor. When I called the front desk, they said they would send someone up. About 15 minutes later, a knock on the door. It was the shuttle driver with a mop! He cleaned up the floor, but could not find the leak. I requested another room.
Room #3- there was a do not disturb sign on the door. After I went back down to the front desk, they assured me that the room was empty. I entered the room, and everything seemed fine. Until, I saw the cockroach crawling across the ceiling! I immediately insisted that someone bring me back to the airport. They agreed to this. But when I asked about a refund, I was told only management could arrange this and they were gone for night. And they may or may not refund me.
On the drive back to the airport, the front desk called the shuttle driver. When he told them that he was trying to drop me off at the correct terminal, he was told to drop me off anywhere and to NOT go "the extra mile" for me. 
When I called about the refund in the morning, it was not a problem. The manager listened to the problems and apologized.
So, the shuttle drivers and management were great. But I would never go back and I would deter anyone from staying here based on the lack of customer service at the front desk and the rooms because I never want to bring any bugs home!
Great location about 10 minute walk to Times Square and close to subway station and walk to circle ferry. Staff are only too happy to assist with your requirements. Great value in heart of NY

review_title: Fantastic place to stay in Manhattan!
review_text:
My family and I stayed a week at this hotel and thought it was great. The staff was very friendly and helpful. We got great recommendations for dinner each evening from the front desk. 
The location is almost perfect. You may feel a little uncomfortable walking down 40th to get to the hotel the first time but there are several hotels there and lots of traffic. 
Our only bad experience was at breakfast in the hotel. I would recommend going to one of the diners on 9th instead.

We stayed at the Palomar in Philly for our 10th wedding anniversary. The staff is wonderful and helpful. The staff even congratulated us on our anniversary. The hotel is placed within walking distance of the highlights of Philadelphia. You can also get a pass for the phlash (the purple bus). I highly recommend this hotel. If possible I would give the Palomar 20 stars. It's a beautiful hotel and extremely clean. The housekeeping team even came in and fluffed the pillows while we were at dinner. At first it frightened me because I didn't realize why the pillows were all standing up. It felt like a poltergeist was in our room. Then we realized it was another one of the reasons the hotel Palomar is a step above the others. The hotel pampers it's guests and treats you like royalty. If you are staying in Philly, stay at the Palomar!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Everything was perfect. Will stay there again next time ill be in ny.amazing service from the staff

review_title: Many small issues add up to unsatisfactory stay
review_text: Next to a church populated by homeless. Suite was quite small. Amenities minimal. Pull out sofa mattress was not fit for a dog to sleep on and it took multiple calls to reception to have it made up. TV did not work for some time due to satellite outage. Towels rough and thin. Room was pleasant enough but noise from the street woke us around 2 am.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Our new favorite spot to stay in Philadelphia
review_text:
We come down to Philly for a night every summer to visit with friends. In the past we've stayed at The Rittenhouse (excellent but a nit formal/stuffy), The Sofitel (very nice), Penn's View (like sleeping in a doily, totally not our style) and this time, The Palomar (loved!)
The Palomar is in a great location near Rittenhouse Square, has a very friendly and genuine staff, and the decor is cool, feels new and light-hearted without trying too hard (like say, The Viceroy in LA). The room was not large but was in excellent condition, the bed was very comfortable, fluffy white towels, modern bathroom, large flatscreen TV, and everything was spotless. We will stay here next visit without a doubt!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Friendly staff at quiet appealing distrikt hotel
review_text: The Distrikt Hotel is located on 40th between 8th and 9th ave. A good location in the theatre district for fine\moderate dining. The only drawback is the bus station that is directly in front of the hotel, thankfully juust the side wall and not the main entrance. The front desk and lobby are quaint with personnel that are extremely polite, informative and helpful. There are 3 MAC computers available to access the internet, e-mail or to print off a boarding pass. Safety is important. You cannot ride an elevator without a room card. Rooms are very clean and large enough for a king size bed. Washroom has a shower, magnified mirror and bright lighting. Had many good night sleeps in the comfortable bed and did not hear my neighbours at all. Starbucks, Dean and Deluca nearby for quick brekky and favorite restaurants Becco, Amarone and Southern hospitality just a short walk away. Once you've eaten, you can catch a show at the nearby theatres.

review_title: Staying at the Trump Soho was by far the best part of our trip.
review_text: The door man Merick was very helpful and friendly. He made sure we had a great time by making great sudgestions for dinner and places to visit.

Great base from which to explore Philadelphia - everything in walking distance. especially close to the gay neighbourhood. 
Decent rooms, beds comfortable. Breakfast a bit disappointing - have to pay extra to have hot breakfast with voucher for continental.
Bar area smallish.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Philadelphia Center City

review_title: Best hotel in NYC from a fussy Londoner...
review_text:
Just got back from five days in NYC. Having stayed in numerous hotels in NYC over the last few years this was certainly no 1. 
Location - amazing. A few mins walk to the centre of soho - great restaurants, bars, bloomingdales, boutiques. 
Room - larger than average. Beautifully appointed. Clean and the bed was so comfortable. Even checked the bed bug register of NYC and the trump soho was free of the bugs.. Also the room was well maintained, always clean and put back in perfect order after a day out. Too many towels, comfy pillows, great shower and huge bath...! 
Staff- friendly, helpful and not the least bit narly like most of the new yorkers. 
Just book it you won't regret it. I am so fussy.:)

This was our 1st time staying at a smaller hotel and we were not disapointed. The staff always greeted you with a smile and an offer of help if needed. The room was comfortable and spotlessly clean. We will definitely return in future visits to New York.
Um dos melhores hotÃ©is que jÃ¡ fiquei nos EUA! O serviÃ§o e excelente!

review_title: Great hotel near everything you need!
review_text:
We loved this hotel. Rooms were a good size - for new york! Although breakfast is expensive there are loads of places to eat on 9th avenue (do a right out of the hotel and first left) that serve a great breakfast! The hotel is on the same block as a subway entrance which is good when you need to rest your legs! It is only 2 blocks from times square and broadway, which means you dont have to go far until you are in the middle of the action.
The staff where helpful and friendly and could not be faulted.
Overall, this was a great hotel that I would happily visit again!

Housed in the Architects Building, this is a stylish and hip hotel. Stayed here with my family and it was fantastic! Great location, great staff and great service. The rooms are spacious and modern and the hotel is LEED certified. highly recommended!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Distrikt hotel was soooo great! Everything was perfect, specially the staff so kind and attentious all the time! I loved the room size and comfort, the awesome breakfast at the cozy restaurant, and everything else! The location is also great because you're just few blocks away from times square but not actually in the middle of the crowd! Congratulations for the great service, I would sooooo recommend this place to everyone!

review_title: This hotel should be no. 1 on Trip Advisor!
review_text:
Even before our trip began we were excited about staying at this hotel, it's not like stardard hotels!! Get on Facebook and like their page, keep an eye out for their updates!! 
All of the staff are lovely, we keep saying 'they are so 'real' here' refreshing change, not pretentious or unhelpful, but friendly and fun, stress free. 
Our room was a good size, 4 adults in doubles for 9 nights and we didn't fight at all. Clean, well serviced and fun details left in our room from time to time. Perfect location!!
We would all stay here again when we return to NYC

My wife and I go to Philly 2-3 times per year for a nice overnight without the kids. In the past, we stayed at the Ritz. Since the Palomar opened, though, we switched and never looked back. Great location, walkable to anything you'd want to do. Rooms are well-appointed and comfortable. Very sleek without seeming cold. The hotel has a great feel, almost an energy, that is created by the decor and supported by the wonderful staff. We've never been disappointed.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
We stayed here on 10th till 13th may, we flew from new York to las Vegas for 4 nights and the staff where more then willing to help us and we where allowed to keep luggage till we returned. 
On arrival it was superb, all the staff are so friendly and approachble, and always willing to help.
Our room was fantastic, it was facing the Hudson river, and new jersey.
The room was very nicely laid out and had a separate living area and toilet, a lovely sized bedroom and then a very spacious bathroom.
The detail to all aspects of the decor was just brilliant.
This hotel is a fantastic place to stay, all the staff make this hotel one brilliant place to stay, and I would like the thank them all for making our stay so special and with so much ease. I would definitely stay here again as it is worth every penny.
Absolutely wonderful hotel and service. I've stayed in many hotels in the US and Mexico and this is by far in the top 3. Exceptional service, lavish rooms, and great location in Soho.

review_title: Wow! Beautiful hotel, thoughtful service & amazing views!!
review_text:
After a long flight, we were greeted by friendly staff in the very sophisticated lobby. Without any prompting, we were given a free upgrade so that we had a better view from the 30th floor.
One of the most rememberable moments of this first trip to new York was walking into our room - we were blown away. Kitchette, large comfy bed (like sleeping on a fluffy cloud!) gorgeous sofa, huge bathroom & tub next to the window.Great quality gowns & slippers too!
After a long day exploring, each night we'd return to find that bottled water & chocolates had been left at our bedsides, and classical music on the stereo.
Fab location, only a few mins to the subway. For pizza slices, you've gotta try Ben's.... Fir delicious seafood, aquagrill was a-mazing!
Can't wait to get back to new York and without hesitation, I'll book here again!

I am a Marriott Platinum member and travel quite a bit. Used Marriott points to stay with the family. 
We were given a room upgrade which was nice, but boy the rooms are small. Asked about concierge level, but they wanted to charge $150 for access. So basically being a platinum Marriott member means very little at a Marriott owned property, The Ritz Carlton. I know the city well, since I live here. The Four Seasons beats this hotel hands down. Furniture looks beaten up. 
Won't be back and I question why I stay with Marriott.

review_title: Horrible property with the most unprofessional staff
review_text: This is a typical ritz property which is very hit or miss (Dallas being a hit and Philly being a complete miss). The hotel is a poor carbon copy of a 1970's Marriott. The walls have multiple layers of paint which have been painted over many times, the carpet is filthy and mildued and furniture beaten up like a group of rock stars had a week long party in a room. the staff is rude and inexperienced, which is putting it nicely and could not even suggest a single restaurant to get a bite to eat
The staff was nice. This place, however, is a dump.
Top-notch desk staff= very helpful. Good overall service. Comfortable beds & good breakfast.

It was convenient for an early morning flight but I'd rather stay at any of the other airport hotels next time I go. The tv didn't work and they didn't have anyone around to fix it. Then in the morning, I was showering and a huge centipede ran down the shower curtain! They told us a manager would follow up with us and one never did.

review_title: Comfy bed, wonderful services, great location !
review_text:
Have stayed at this hotel for 1 night only. Enjoy our stay so much. There's so much to explore in the surrounding areas (Times Square was the highlight), so we haven't had enough time to enjoy our so comfortable beds. Highly recommend this place, esp if you want to explore Times Square. However subway station is nearby so no problem to go anywhere else. 
One little problem was only due to the size of the room, for travellers with many n big luggages like us, would find it quite difficult to maneuver inside the room. Overall, happy with this hotel.

This was a 5 star hotel in a great neighborhood for waking, dining and shopping. The employees made this trip very exciting by treating us like VIP guests from the moment we arrived until they loaded our car with the bags as we left. First class from start to finnish, would highly recommend.
Best deal in ny, clean, great staff, close to all the sights. Great little restaurant/bar, we will be back for a longer stay in the near future

The exterior looks a bit dated. The interior however has been updated. Nice, clean, quiet rooms at a good price. Down/feather pillows were a nice touch. The front desk attendants were welcoming and friendly. What more can you ask for?
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Philadelphia Northeast

review_text: The staff was friendly, and the management was attentive to my concerns.

Clean, comfortable stay that wasn't super expensive. Make no mistake, this isn't for the budget traveller, but if you travel for business and need to be located near downtown Philly, and have business in the suburbs as I did, the location is great. 
Room was a good size, quality bed and great water pressure in the shower. Staff was curteous and when I had a minor problem with my bill they resolved quickly. 
Lobby bar was cozy and well appointed. It is just what you want after a day of travel. A quiet place for a drink with a fireplace and ESPN on. 
Speaking of tv, they offered a dozen sports channels on the HD tv in room. NHL, MLB, NFL networks plus the four ESPNs and the Big Ten Network. 
Charge for parking, Internet, but they do offer package rates that include both for a reasonable charge.

Not surprised as all kimptons are great! Walkable to most stores and right by rittenhouse square. Restaurant great and the standard kimpton wine happy hour was a little better with snacks and sangria. We used a discount voucher and that process was a nightmare. Wont do that again.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: It's hard to go wrong at the Ritz.
review_text: Excellent stay. Made a last minute decision to stay the night after going out in Old City. The staff was great, the room was on par for the Ritz and the complimentary breakfast was amazing. I suggest the French Toast, you won't be disappointed.

review_title: Great front desk staff, updates to hotel needed. Clean
review_text: Wonderful front desk staff.hotel is a bit dated. Old television in room rca about 21"no flat screen, broken tile in bathroom. In need of updates but clean decent cardiovascular equipment in gym.

I was so impressed with this hotel! It was my first time in the city and the staff was helpful with dinner recommendations. The location was very convenient, directly across the street from the Convention Center. The rooms were clean and had a modern feel with the hardwood floors. I usually can't sleep when I'm away from home, but I had the best sleep ever! Stay at the Four Points Philadelphia City Center!
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Philadelphia City Center

review_title: Mixed feelings - seems a little shady and beat, but is better than first impressions.
review_text: This is a place you stay at because you have reason to be in the area, it is not for a family on vacation. It's acceptable. That's not a backhanded compliment, as the hotel is reflective of its price range. It's a Four Points, not a Four Seasons. Align your expectations and you will be fine. It's on a highway next to an airport, so we are talking vacation stays, but for business or visits It seems to be the best in the immediate area.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Philadelphia Northeast

review_text: The hubby and I stayed on a Saturday night. Price was reasonable and the breakfast buffet was delicious. The sheets were clean and the mattress was soft and cozy. Perfect for snuggling.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Philadelphia Northeast

review_text: I have stayed here now 5-6 times, almost always with Club Floor access. It is a beautiful room on the 30th floor, the usual Ritz Club food/wine, but great staff and beautiful views of Philadelphia. It is generally peaceful and a nice place to read or to spend time between activities. The lobby scene is hectic, particularly at night, but also fun if you are in the mood. Rooms are of Ritz quality, great beds and bedding, and nice bathroom amenities. For the first time had dinner in the hotel. Nice (Jen from Top Chef is the exec chef) choices, all well done. We keep returning.

The bathtub drain was clogged and I did not enjoy standing in ankle deep water while showering. The elevators were stuck and the front desk was slow to respond. The restaurant food was quite good. The hotel is clean. Other than the maintenance issues it was a pleasant stay.

This was out 4th stay in a year. The front desk staff was by far the friendliest yet. First impressions do matter. The valet parking was fine, wish we could have avoided the fee, but no street parking available this time. They gave us the room we asked for and it was clean with a great view. We had a refrigerator, which I used. As an Hilton Honors guest we were able to have breakfast in the executive lounge. One of the best I have been in, the young man in charge was friendly and helpful. The food was great, especially the coffee. Best stay yet, will return when in Phili.
Really disappointing for Sheraton. Long time to register. Bland rooms. Not cleaned, hardly neatened each day. Breakfast was good, service nice, but accommodation overall was poor
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Philadelphia City Center

review_title: Tired and mixed service for the Renaissance brand.
review_text:
Surprisingly the Renaissance Philadelphia Airport is a step below the typical Marriott hotel rather than a step above. 
The hotel is close to the airport, but twice I have had 15 minute delays in the shuttle leaving as scheduled. So this is not the place to stay if you like to cut it close. 
The staff was very kind, but not very fast or as sharp as I typically find at Renaissance. The responses to the late vans were polite brush offs about business as usual or blaming it on airline crews. 
The real complaint is that for a premium hotel I was surprised at the tired condition of the rooms, the lobby and restaurants. This obviously is not the staffs fault, but it contributes to a mentality that it is okay for instance to leave food trays and piles of used towels in the hall for two days. 
I stayed at the Marriott Philadelphia Hotel the prior week and was much more satisfied. And that hotel is attached to Terminal A & B. 
My hope is that the ownership will upgrade this hotel soon. It has the potential to be good.

review_title: What a fantastic stay with Kimpton at the Hotel Palomar!
review_text: I cannot rave enough about the Hotel Palomar Philadelphia. I stayed two nights on business and was treated like a rockstar from start to finish. I didn't want to leave! From the handwritten note from the manager at check-in and the well-appointed rooms to the nightly wine happy hour and delightful restaurant staff, I was wowed from start to finish. My mother and father recently had a similar experience at a Kimpton property in Boston, which leads me to believe that, in addition to the Hotel Palomar, Kimpton is a quality brand. I frequently travel for both work and play and will look for Kimpton properties whenever possible.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: It's a good hotel for the price, the corner is not a very good one walking in direction to the nearest subway station.

Nice clean room. Really nice bathroom. Bed great. I was coming back from a run and doorman stopped me saying he had something for me. He went into a closet near the door and out emerged a cold bottle of water they keep there just for people who have been out sweating. Very impressed!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: The hotel over all would've been ok had it not been for the stench in the room. There was this weird smell of sewage or something water related that had me dreading going back to the room each night. That alone ruined my stay which contributes to my low marks.

review_title: Hip, chic, in a great location.
review_text: Spent 2 days at the hotel and found it to be a great value. The location was unbeatable with exceptional service and design. The rooms and baths were a little small but functional. We had breakfast at the hotel and it was just ok but read a review about dinner that was great. Lots of fantastic restaurants nearby. We would definitely return.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Philadelphia - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: I've stayed here several times this year and have always been pleased with the service and the rooms. Nice hotel with convenient shuttle service. Only two complaints: pillows are too soft and restaurant is too expensive. But there are several restaurants that will deliver.

There are a number of negative reviews about the RC in Philadelphia, but wage lobby is a restored incredible old Bank, whose lobby is a huge rotunda - the size of the Pantheon. Beautiful entrance, bar and cozy breakfast area to the side. 
The rooms are nice, although we were upgraded to a suite for a special occasion, nice move by the check in team. Add a glass of champagne during check in and it was a nice start.
We went to the spa, which is completing renovations. Enjoyed a very nice massage, although there was street noise evident during the spa stay. Sound proofing the rooms should be a priority for the Spa management.
I would not say this is the nicest Ritz I have stayed at, but the location is prime, and the historic building impresses.

I stayed in room 517. There were several large stains on the chair. All the walls had marks and were dirty. Most of the lights did not work with the wall switches and the coffe maker didn't work. The grin desk is not friendly or helpful for any information as to places to eat near the hotel. It seems they work hard to make you stay and eat there.

review_title: Convenient, spacious rooms, great location, easy street parking.
review_text: We stayed here after securing a great deal through priceline. Love the location a 6 buck cab ride from cc philly, in between 2 campuses. Free internet with pc in room if needed. Free parking on street from 8 to 8am.. A Def go to when staying in philly.

The location is great. Close to downtown, restaurants and 30th street station. The rooms are old. My walls were peeling. Free internet was a bonus, but that is becoming the new trend anyways for hotels. They offer a desktop computer for your use in each room.
