I don't want to sound dramatic. Perhaps my stay was very .... Unique? But I won't be back here ever. My wife and I try to avoid bad experiences by staying at nicer hotels. This is usually done by way of priceline bidding on high stars. Anyway here are the facts of my stay. Upon check in we entered the room only to find used soap and shampoo containers in the bathroom. We called the front desk and they were going to fix it right away. We got dressed to go see the city. In our room on the floor we found another nice surprise. An empty box of condoms. Now I'm worried about what else wasn't cleaned. I put it next to the shampoo so the staff would take it. We headed out for the day and on our way to the elevator we ran into the staff going to our room. I reported the condom box and he chuckled(let's assume in disbelief). So we scoot around Philly all day long, get back and nothing is corrected despite running into staff just feet outside our door who said he was going into our room. I called the front desk back and they sent a cleaning crew right up who trivialized the situation. She didn't understand that if I felt like they missed this big stuff what else did they miss? The sheets, shower, etc... So now the problem is fixed. My wife and I climb into bed for a romantic evening. About an hour later we get a knock at the door. We choose to ignore it because of our attire. The knock continues. Five Knocks over 2 minutes. I go to the door and see it is security through the peep. I said I couldn't answer the door and to go away or call. This is no exaggeration. He rudely demanded that I open the door immediately and showed me a universal card key machine. I didn't want my wife busted in on so I opened the door in my underwear. He said he needed to do lock work since I reported someone in my room. I explained that I hadn't reported that and in my underwear he made me reexplain. I got frustrated to him to go away and leave me alone, locked the door with chain and went back to bed. I called the front desk and they were apologetic. The manager couldn't believe it and insisted that he get priceline to refund my purchase. (side note I have not yet seen that refund, but let's give them the benefit of the doubt and assume the check is in the mail). 4 am the next morning we are dead asleep. The fire alarm goes off and says to go to the stairs and evacuate. Okay I like fire alarms to work, but here is the failing. Someone comes on the PA and says they are investigating the alarm. People are emptying out my floor. I called the front desk & they had no info at all. So we throw on clothes, and walk down 14 flights of stairs at 4am. Once outside the fire dept is there. Certainly there is hotel staff with an update right? Wrong. No one to be found. So do you go into a potentially burning hotel to figure out the problem. After a good wait that is exactly what I did. The staff again very casually expressed that it was false, someone played with the extinguisher. The fire dept was there by alarm. There never was another pa announcement until someone else told the manager you should make an anouncement and I said you have people waiting outside. We went back to our room climbed into bed shut our eyes and then guess what.... That's right the security anouncement! Just to wake you again. Even with a potential free room, I'd chose a different spot. The location is great though. By the way I was there for 2 nights.

review_title: The Place to Stay in Philadelphia
review_text: Swanky Euro-modern hotel with great bar and well-appointed rooms. Location is prime for business and leisure. Staff is attentive.
Very friendly welcoming staff. Very good service all around. Location is the best. Everything is walking distance. At the same time rooms were very quiet.

I'm writing this on my iPhone because the premium wifi service ($17 a day) is so painfully slow. The room is ok - newly renovated. I hear the other guest doors open and close. There is no concierge and the guy behind the desk couldn't find the hotel on map - no joke. He'd never heard of highly rated restaurants in the area. So you're on your own here.

review_title: The place to stay in the historic district
review_text: Last minute deal via booking.com for 209/night midweek in large suite of carriage house. Family of 5, paid extra for the kids but sofa bed large enough for our 3-5-9 yr olds and a seperate room for us. Upon late check in, host/concierge was very helpful and made us feel welcomed and comfortable. Continental breakfast was so-so but it was free so no complaints. Short walk to all the major historic venues. A perfect place to stay for history and comfort!

Absolutely no complaints about my stay (for an in house conference). Large room, large bathroom. Very helpful front desk and concierge. Central location. Oh, one thing ... I overlooked dirty rooftops - no outlook at all but this was not a big deal as I didn't spend much time in the room.

What a superb hotel.
From the start to the end of our stay here everything was first class!
Room was magnificent, staff were superb and breakfast was world class.
The position was great to, pretty much walking distance to anywhere.
Highly recommended. Made our Philly experience even better!

review_title: Excellent place to stay in Philly
review_text: Service and rooms are wonderful. You can't go wrong if you stay at the Rittenhouse!

Our stay was very brief, arriving early evening and leaving before breakfast but it felt a lot longer. 
From the moment we stepped out of the cab till the the time we left the staff were friendly and helpful. The rooms are a reasonable size and the beds are very comfortable.
The hotel is situated in the heart of university district with cafes and restaurants dotted throughout the area. 
The location is near metro stations to the city and regional train line but only a $10 cab fare.

review_title: Great hotel on a wonderful location
review_text: We loved this hotel- friendly, great location, wonderful room, nothing wax too much trouble. Local French resteraunts were great.

I have to say the coplimentary bottle of water bedside was a nice touch. Also the little individually packaged nail files it makes you feel at home. Room was average sized, bedding was soft and cozy.. Toiletries were premium and the staff friendly

This is a very nice four star hotel. The rooms and bathrooms are large and clean, and the hotel is gerally quiet. What little service we required was very good. Ate breakfast at the hotel, which was fairly priced-- the croissants were excellent, as should be expected from a french hotel. I would return.

I write this review as I lay in the BEST bed EVER! it's like sleeping on a cloud. We came for our anniversary and had a fantastic stay. Location is great- lots of moderately priced restaurants mixed with your higher priced ones. We stayed in a Jr. Suite and the room was amazing. We even left and came back to a small tray of pastries in our room! We definitely will come back next year for our 9th anniversary if possible !!

review_title: Very nice stay in their renovated hotel
review_text: Hilton inn at Penn has done a very nice job with their recent renovations. From their energy conservation efforts to comfortable linens to their spa-inspired bathrooms - our stay was enjoyable!

I stayed here september 13-18th. As a hilton employee, the inn at penn exceeded my expectations! The front desk staff was very kind, as well as the bellman helping us with our luggage and calling taxis. the property was gorgeous. The room was the highlight! Very modern, with the lighting system and the ipad in the room. The ipad was very convient with ordering room service or extra amenities. The hotel is very close to the university and surrounding neighborhoods. A short cab ride from center city. Overall the inn at penn was an amzing hotel and I will be returning!

What a gem this hotel is! I booked one night here not knowing anything about the place except its high ranking on Tripadvisor. It did not disappoint. From the moment you pull up to the curb to when you check out, everyone is courteous and professional. Our room was spacious and nicely appointed. The location is perfect - near shops and reataurants for convenience and with a park across the street. I can't say enough great thing about it. Next time I'm in Philly, the Rittenhouse will be the only place I would consider.

â€œIf you like bad service this is the place to stayâ€
My 9:30am check-in went well and I was directed to a refurbished room on the 9th floor (with a cheery "donÂ´t forget your luggage sir" - i.e. we are not going to take it to your room for you.
Breakfast: only tried the breakfast buffet one of four mornings during my stay. Cold food and pretty average service.
Minibar: What minibar!
Laundry: "sorry - you need to have it in by 8:30am to get it back the same day", "oh I am not sure why we havenÂ´t returned it"... I eventually got my laundry back on the day I left.
Newspaper: Only delievered two out of the four mornings I stayed here.
Noise: Lots of people running up and down the corridor making a lot of noise until 2:30am on Saturday morning.
Maid Service: Came in to the room three times on Saturday morning (the first at 8am) despite a do not disturb sign on the door. On the third occassion, when I compained and told the maid that it was totally unreasonable someone should knock or come in to the room three times despite the sign, she left and started grumbling very loudly to her colleague in the corridor that it wan't her fault and that I ought to have checked out 20 minutes ago (in fact I had arranged a late check-out).
Late Check-Out: I had arranged a 3pm check-out but my key card would not let me back in to the room at 2:50pm. The security guard who happened to pass by was very helpful and let me in.
If you can stay somewhere else - do!

We were here in August 2010 and it was nice, but they remodeled/updated all the rooms in March 2011. It was a pleasant surprise for this trip! All the rooms have iPads with Internet, a media center, cozy robes and refrigerators. The showers (instead of tub) have the nicest shower heads, too. It's very clean and the staff at the desk and valet were excellent. The location was perfect for our trip to Cafe Live or U Penn. My one complaint-and this is a pet peeve to me...why does housekeeping pound on the door at 9:00 am on a Sunday? Do they really need to clean the bathroom while I'm in bed?!? Maybe housekeeping needs an iPad to let them know who's checked out vs. Sleeping? Overall, highly recommended hotel.

review_title: Doesn't meet expectations for a $300/night room
review_text:
I design high end hotels for a living so i will be critical (and I had just had a great experience at the Alexander Inn at $119/night the night before) I dont see value for the money at the Morris House Hotel. Granted, I had the last room available for new years eve, which was probably their "safe room" which means its the least desirable room reserved in case of problems with other rooms. The historic building main public rooms were beautiful but I felt like 2nd class in this low ceiling room
(under 8 feet) on the top floor accessed through a staircase in the back business office. For $300 with tax you expect more. The tv was tiny and nearly on the floor. The remote really didn't work well even after instruction from the front desk even though it was the same remote from previous hotel which worked fine. No refrigerator or other amenities. Their was a mechanical system hum from outside and a very noisy heating vent directly above the bed. A wakeup call and cab arrived as scheduled, but the staff did not tell me how to get out of building since all of the gates through the main entry were padlocked. It was easy enough to find the operable exit but staff could have saved me the "locked in a cage feeling". It's the little details that make a difference.
There are so many other great hotels in Philly why stay here?

review_title: A quiet location in the heart of Philly
review_text: Great staff-helpful, personable, great location-rittenhouse square, Curtis, Verizon Hall, Academy of Music, comfortable rooms-windows that actually open to let in fresh air b-fast was good- a little carb laden though. I wish that they hD an exercise room but would stay again in a heartbeat

Good quality - excellent beds but noisy airco units ( stayed in room 612 ). Breakfast is good. Service is very friendly and personal. The entire hotel can best be qualified as solid, a bit stuffy, dated, but comfortable. Location at square is nice. Can recommend but get a good price.

review_title: Great location for taking care of business in the University City area
review_text:
Great location for taking care of business in the University City area. Â Clean and updated rooms, courteous hospitality staff, everything I look for in a hotel. Â The rooms were recently updated and the furnishings are nice. Â My room (although a little small) had an reading nook furnished with wonderfully comfortable chair and ottoman. Â Thomas Peter Roth toiletries were nice. Â Good riddance to that Crabtree and Evelynn stuff. Â  Â iPad in each room, you can order room service, put in maintenance requests, explore the area, etc... nice touch ;)
I was a HiltonHonors diamond member for more than 5 years, and recently decided to move away from the brand because Hilton hotels have been one disappointment after another. This hotel renewed my faith in the Hilton chain of hotels. Â Will definitely stay here again.

As a monthly visitor to Philly, I usually stay at the courtyard on Juniper. I thought I would try the Marriott for $10 more. Bad decision. Rooms are very outdated, there was no washcloths or shampoo in my room. Breakfast was cold eggs which tasted like metal. the courtyard on Juniper is one of the best experiences in Philly. Avoid this hotel until it undergoes major renovations

review_title: Quality for the price of quantity!
review_text: The Independent Hotel is a quiet home away from home but better! I took my husband on an overnight stay for his birthday just to escape from home and the staff and cleanliness of this hotel by far exceeded my expectations. Beautiful rooms to say the least, spacious and comfortable and not your average decor either I had to remind myself that I booked it for such a low price, I mean CLASSY! Hardwood floors? Yes! Thank you for such an ellegant night and the restuarant you suggested was amazing as well!
It was the perfect getaway for a weekend in the city. Great service and my room was posh yet comfortable!

The hotel was Ok, the lobby nice but I expected a tub in the bathroom And it had a normal shower. The beds were confortable and I went With my 2 kids, the problem was there was only one kids channel on the tv, cartoon network. In general its a nice hotel, very polite And nice people At the lobby willing to help.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Antonio Northwest

review_title: Good hotel close to the airport.
review_text: This is a very nice hotel with a very nice continental breakfast. Rooms are nice and spacious. Only negative was some of our towels were old and smelled really bad so we had to get some new ones.
Management & staff do an excellent job at making the guest feel right at home. Would recommend this Hotel to anyone.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Antonio Northwest

review_text: My nicest stay in San Antonio so far.The room was awesome and the staff is very professional.

I recently stayed at the Country Inn and Suites and was very impressed. The room was spotless and beautifully decorated. It felt like a much more expensive hotel. Staff was friendly and helpful and the complimentary breakfast was first rate. With its close proximity to the airport, I highly recommend the property particularly if your traveling on business to San Antonio.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson San Antonio Airport, TX

review_title: Highly recommended place to stay in the area.
review_text:
The room was up to date & contemporary with the furnishings. We had a king bed with a sofa bed & there were 2 TVs! Everything was clean & comfortable. There were plenty of towels. (remember if you want fresh, throw your dirty ones on the floor before they clean the room - we didn't know this, but the lady at the front desk was really nice & gave us fresh when we asked) & there was plenty of hot water. The pool & hot tub were nice, although the pool was smaller than the picture appears. The workout equipment was great - bring your headphones! (each machine has its own tv) The full breakfast was good, but they had a hard time keeping the buffet stocked. It may help to beat the rush, but we slept in both days - & it was on the weekend. The rooms were pleasantly quieter than we expected being so close to the airport.
We'll most certainly stay at this location again.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson San Antonio Airport, TX

review_title: For business near the airport...this is it.
review_text:
Hampton Inn great stay again! The whole hotel is immaculately clean! The rooms are great...stayed in a large king with sofa bed... The room was VERY large. The bed was oh so comfortable. Although near the airport....no plane or traffic sounds. However, one should know that the building is all wood frame construction, so the odd foot step can be heard in the room above you.
This is a definite must stay hotel.

review_title: Wow!! This country inn is AMAZING!!
review_text: A little more edgy and modern than the other country inns I've stayed at, but WOW WOW WOW!! The room was incredible...very high tech and modern, and the bed was INCREDIBLE!! My Fiance and I decided we'd like to live there if we could. Couldn't find a thing we'd change. Very impressed, we felt like we were staying at a resort...all for an amazing price. Wondering if you should stay here? Y E S...don't miss your chance! This is a real gem!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson San Antonio Airport, TX

review_title: Fabulous place to stay and play with kids, close to Sea World!
review_text: My husband and I, along with our three kids, ages 3, 6, 7, had a wonderful time at the courtyard. It was extremely clean (#1 priority for me), new, very kid friendly, and fun for grown ups too. the pool was great for all ages... splash areas and fun for all! The shuttle service was so convenient. The entire staff went out of their way to accommodate us whenever we had ANY requests. The shuttle driver, William, was amazing. He was so friendly and informative. Our daughter loved him and looked for him every time we rode the shuttle. he made a big impression when he handed out cold waters on our return from sea world! Overall, we loved it! The only thing we didn't absolutely love was the food. It was okay. Thanks to all the staff for giving us a great vacation!

review_title: Outstanding hotel + Outstanding service all with the customer in mind.
review_text: My wife and I, along with our 2yr old son stayed here for several days and this comfort suites was by far one of the best. The rates were great, the hotel was extremely clean, the management and staff were super friendly and it was conveniently located around everything (highways, attractions, etc...). I'm not big on writing reviews but we were very happy we found this one! Btw, MILITARY/LE friendly as well-Def a plus in my book...
hotel_name: Comfort Suites San Antonio NW Near Six Flags

review_title: Liked this hotel better when it was a Cambria Suites by Choice Hotels.
review_text:
We started staying at this hotel for it's convenience to our destination. At that time it was a Cambria Suites, a higher end Choice Hotel. The rooms were well appointed with lovely duvets, nice draperies, nice art work, Bath & Body works products, plenty of soft large towels. When you entered the hotel you were greeted with a friendly smile and they shared information about the hotel. Upon departure they thanked you for staying. The public areas were well kept and free of debris. Cambria catered to attracted business people and professionals. They were also family friendly.
Now this hotel is a Country Inn and Suites . The cost of the room was the same as before. The room was clean but didn't have the stylish decor as before. The room was cleaned, they made the bed and put in fresh towels but didn't empty the trash cans or replace the bathroom items which are now Vaseline brand. I had to ask for coffe to be left in the room. they didn't clean the coffee pot or empty the grounds. The registration desk personnel was a not as friendly as before. When we checked in they didn't offer any information on the hotel. We had heard about the free breakfast and had to ask the service times. In the lobby area there were holes cut in the ceiling, which was a little unsightly. We came back in the evening and wanted a frozen margarita, but the bar wasn't open on weekends. So we had to go someplace else. This hotel now caterers to a different clientel. 
Our next visit we will stay someplace else.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson San Antonio Airport, TX

review_text: I came in at the last minute hoping they had room and they did. I told the front desk lady I was military and she said, "thank you for your service. Tonight though you would get a better deal with what the hotel is offering." she was right and it saved me 10 bucks. The room was really clean and the bed was super comfy. The hotel was easy to find. The breakfast in the morning was decent. I would recommend this place to anyone
hotel_name: Comfort Suites San Antonio NW Near Six Flags

review_text: Great stay, helpful staff and very clean spacious rooms! They also have a great covered outdoor area with a fireplace and nice seating. The only downside with our stay was that we were right next to the elevator and the noise was a bit annoying. Overall, would stay there again!
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Antonio Northwest

review_text: Nice hotel, small rooms although they are suites. Very well organized And Good breakfast. Polite service At the lobby, staff tries to help if posible. Free parking, chilis restaurant Just across the street.
hotel_name: SpringHill Suites San Diego Rancho Bernardo/Scripps Poway

review_text:
Arrived at 10pm on a Fri night and Nicholas was more than helpful checking us in. He even escorted us to our room since we had to change elevators on the 14th floor! He as well as the front desk staff went out of the way to answer questions on the local area. They a provided a Gaslamp district map and directed us to a great Irish pub "Stout" up the street.
The room was clean, modern and comfortable with all of the standard amenities. Great location, great hotel. Will stay here again next time I am in town. 14th floor was quiet.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Downtown

review_text: We got a great cyber monday deal here, which made the huge room even better. The staff was genuinely nice, and the location near restaurants and balboa park was fantastic. Our room was away from the street and noise wasn't an issue. There could be some more decoration on the walls--the place looked a little spartan perhaps because of its size. Other than that, it was a great stay in an ideal location.

I ant even begin to tell you all of the little things that were done to make this stay special. First, we stayed in a very upscale hotel a few days prior and they couldn't touch the service or the accommodations that this Courtyard had. I was pleasantly surprised by every one of the staff members I encountered there. I took the time to tell the general manager, Jodie, about my experience and she was so kind and appreciative. So much so that a gorgeous piece of chocolate cake and a very nice note was sitting in my room waiting on us when we got back in for the evening. I'd love to co e back and stay here again. If you do, make sure you ask them to give you a tour of the rooftop. It's an amazing view of the city.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Downtown

review_title: I feel like I am at home when I stay at Sommerset Suites!
review_text: My husband and I love this hotel! We are from Cabo, a tourist destination with 5 star resorts and we love to travel to US cities like Vegas, San Diego, LA, etc! We visit San Diego 3-4 times a year and we love staying at Sommerset Suites! The rooms are very spacious, like your own 1 bedroom apartment. It includes a daily continental breakfast, go visit Martha for breakfast, she is so sweet and friendly and remembers since the first time we stayed there. Martha is now like family to us!! The value for your money is fantastic! At $100 a night for a full kitchen, dining, living and bedroom with spacious bathroom is fantastic. I wish I could take this hotel with me to every city I visit! We visited Toronto in September and we paid over $190 a night for a hotel room half as nice and half as big! Sommerset is close to everything: shopping, pharmacies, supermarkets, several restaurants right across the street, the airport, down town gas lamp, Fashion Valley mall, Mission Valley mall, the 5, 8, 163 and 805 freeways, the harbor, and minutes from the beach, Zoo, and Sea World!! Is also perfect to stay at when you are going to Gualcom stadium!! We have stayed at this hotel over 6 times and I wouldn't think of staying anywhere else! Try their fresh fruit waters and fresh chocolate chip cookies in the lobby, they are delish! Enjoy this fantastic hotel!

review_title: Clean, good service with history thrown in
review_text: If you're an architecture buff, or just like buildings with a story to tell... This one is for you. A standard Marriott hotel (clean, neat, all the mod cons) in a converted bank building. Make sure you do the tour of the bank vault. Location is good.., walk to the main restaurant and nightlife area, and Westfield!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Downtown

review_title: Excellent,clean,friendly,and good value place to stay in San Diego
review_text: Very impressed with the suite, service and value for money. Staff were friendly, and helpful. Great location for the gay traveller and close to the Hill Crest scene. Pool and outdoor spa area clean and sunny. Self service laundry facilities great as well!

review_title: Great service in a great location
review_text: There was a power blackout all over southern California during the second night of my stay. The staff did a fantastic job taking care of its patrons, giving them bottled water, snacks, etc given that there was no running water or power from 4PM on through the next day. They were calm and cool in the face of a challenging situation!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Downtown

review_text: This hotel is an old bank building. Gorgeous structure. Staff is very helpful friendly and really responded beautifully in the blackout. This was also one of the only downtown hotels that had good emergency power. We still had an elevator, lights in lobby, stairs and corridors. It made surviving the outage much easier than it might have been otherwise. Lower level rooms have better sound proofing from street noise. Third floor was quiet. Room right above on 12th floor had more street noise. Negatives would be the $30 a day for valet and small standard rooms. Very small. And no wi-fi in the rooms, only in lobby. That was disappointing.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Downtown

review_text: Staying here with family, infant included and what a pleasure! Everything is amazing ! Rooms rock and the Christmas feeling is great ! Highly recommended.

review_title: A diamond in the rough, this well-maintained mid-century motor lodge is a great find in a fabulous city!
review_text: We stayed at The Pearl for two nights in September and really enjoyed it! The staff was friendly and genuinely wanted each customer to be comfortable and satisfied. Check-in was easy ... and because it was 8pm, we moved immediately to the bar for a yummy signature cocktail and cheese plate. The bartender was jovial and attentive and the music was great ... love the vibe. Our room (don't remember the number, but our fish was "Willy") was very clean and spacious - a sofa and king-sized bed. The lounge offers delicious coffee in the morning ... we enjoyed it by the pool with free wi-fi. When we forgot an item in our room and didn't realize it until we were back at home, the staff located and sent it to us. Love The Pearl ... we'll be back!

I stayed here for a week because a family member was in hospital behind hotel...did not need car to go there ...just a walk across lot in back. But could not leave windows or doors open for air as traffic and ambulance noise was quite annoying. No exercuse room...small pool (in shade) and only luke warm jacuzzi a definite disappoinment. Breakfast was typical... waffles and hard boiled eggs a plus... My kitchen suite did not supply a toaster and only had 3 teeny tiny bowls and 3 reg. plates and no hot pads...or cookie sheets...a regular size coffeemaker would have been nice also. Cupboards and drawers in kitchen and bath are old and stick a little.. Beds were comfy. Neighborhood is mixed...as I saw a few homeless drinking and with can carts out back ...but felt safe walking in Hillcrest. Good eats...Saigon and Broadway Pizza...and Choc-a-lat on University.

The Pearl Hotel was recommended to me by a friend a while back. So when I needed a place to stay I stayed at The Pearl Hotel. It is super cool with a strong emphasis on the aesthetic while still inviting and fun. The room I stayed in was super clean and comfortable. I only wish my wife was with me On this trip.

review_title: Great atmosphere & service for awesome price
review_text: Stayed here for two nights!! The bar is AWESOME!! Great drinks and food, sweetest bartender Emily! Great mid century look through out the whole hotel..Tamara was so helpful at the front desk with suggestions for things to do in San Diego. Would definitely come back again!

review_title: Must see hotel and location for anyone looking to have fun in the Gaslamp area.
review_text: The hotel is converted from an old bank which still has the original teller windows. The marble detail all around the hotel is beautiful. The rooms have high ceilings with good views of the city. The hotel has a feature to text for valet service. Nicolas was more than helpful with our bags and made the short wait for our car that much more enjoyable. Abdi brought the car much sooner than anticipated. We are already talking about planning the next trip here.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Downtown

review_text: After checking in we went to the lounge for a glass of wine. The host refused to sit us at a table we requested. He motioned us to the back of the lounge but we wanted to sit near the pool. Again, I pointed out a table and he said "there are only two of you" and I pointed out that everyone at the other tables totalled only two and further asked if he was capable of counting past two. Why we we discriminated against.? edlderly white couple moderately dressed?? Our room was a 15x15 box with a mattress on the floor posing as a "platform bed", lumpy one side and totally compressed on the other with matching lumpy pillows. Hard and soiled Berbar carpet. A "desk" was bolted to the wall with a set of matching plastic metal leg chairs. The bathroom had vintage cracked tile complete with ants and leaky faucet. Free WiFi; no fridge or microwave. Music and crowd noise on Saturday night continued until 1am. CAUTION: The hot water will scald you. If you have young children, do not let them turn on the water. We notified the management but to no avail. The Pearl is conveniently located within walking distance of 3 liquor stores, tattoo parlor, and a Pyshic palm reader. This hotel is not handicap accessile to the second floor. If you are looking for cheap, well you found it."
We enjoyed our stay so much! We are going back for our Anniversary in October!

Lovely staff, very friendly and helpful. Hotel is odd configuration as you have to exit the lobby to walk to separate building where the rooms are housed. Disappointed to no wireless in rooms. Rooms are very well laid out and clean. Not a place to stay if you like walking, it's next to highway. But driving distance to old town etc.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Mission Valley

review_text: We recently stayed at The Pearl and it was a great hotel, location was great and we were able to walk quite a few places. The hotel was very clean and can't beat the H20+ body products!

review_title: Beautiful hotel, very rude waitstaff in dining area.
review_text: The hotel was very nice and in a great location. Everyone was very nice until we went down to the bar one night to grab some food and the lady, I believe Heather, was very very rude. I was very offended in the way we were treated. We may stay at the hotel again, but will defiantly stay away from the dining area.

I stayed recently @ this acclaimed highly rated hotel. Much to my shagrin, I left feeling abused, taken advantage of & lied to. 
While the property itself is quite elegant of lush trees, golf course, spa & pools, im thinking those stars should be given to the workers who upkeep the property.
The front desk staff, to which a first impression is made, are full of ego and dishonest. They act as if everyone staying with them is rich and if you are not, you should not be staying there. They take great liberties with your credit or debit card not fully disclosing what is actually being preauthorized from your account and when confronted after you were originally told nothing was being done with the card, they act as if something was wrong with you! Quite honestly the worst experience @ a hotel. There staff need to be trained on courtesy, compassion, kindness, and HONESTY.
On to the room... the beds were hard, pillows stiff and crunchy, and the construction is OLD and not well kept. There is a constant sound of pipes in movement and adjustment, leaks in the room & bathroom, and old matted rugs.
I had a better experience at a Crowne Plaza in Irvine, and much nicer staffer there.
Overall, my experience @ Rancho Bernardo Inn was sadly dissapointing.
They need to get with the program and realize they are dealing with people and not just a number.

review_title: It's Simple And Does The Job
review_text:
Be a little wary of which room you get as the walls seem a bit thin and we spent our first night awake due to stomping above us then were pleasantly woken by the cleaners and vaccuming at 5.20am
The second night was better, but spend a few extra dollars in my opinion

Nice, affordable place to stay (we got a deal for $99 per night!) in a great location
The only negative is the bathroom door in the rooms; doesn't fully close
Treated us well and took great careof all our requests.

review_title: Reluctant to say I love it so it stays a secret
review_text: Very hip, great bar and food. Ruins surround bar so be prepared for some noise.
Stayed here and went to the Packet game. Could not have been more pleased. Rooms were nice and clean. Food was good. Free breakfast was great. The staff is friendly and helpful
It's a little hotel with a good service and very clean. Great price.

Choose this hotel because of the reviews on TripAdisor and it was great. We stayed in a family suite and the room was huge. It had a little kitchen with a refrigerator and a microwave. Too bad we didn't bring any food as we could have used it, especially since the hotel is in an isolated area in Old Town San Diego. Not too many shops or restaurants around so I advise you to research for places to eat before your arrival here. Great pool and continental breakfast. Super close by to Sea World which is why we stayed here. I would definitely come back.

Friendly, helpful service and very comfortable rooms with views of the marina and yacht club. Delicious breakfast buffet is included with the room! Our family has been staying in this hotel for several years. Anyone giving this place a bad review is just too hard to please! We only have great memories!

What a great spot: right on one of the nicest beaches around, wide boardwalk out front, the views are fabulous. Pacific Beach is a student area with a lively nightlife and plenty of restaurants, grocery store, pharmacy, liquor stores and transit near by. Hotel itself is looking a bit faded, but they are upgrading some of the rooms (can be noisy), the beds are good and the complimentary breakfast is fresh and plentiful. Ask for a west facing room to get ocean views. While not the most luxurious place around, this hotel is solid value for the area.

We had a lovely 2 night stay at the hotel to end our 3 week holiday in America and to celebrate my Birthday, the staff was very pleasant, the room was a great size, lovely and clean and the view over the Marina was amazing, also the complimentary breakfast was fab, anyone being put off by the pictures of the hotel looking dated, don't be, it's not the most modern hotel you will go to but it is clean, tidy, friendly, with a great pool area and lovely views and for a really good price, we would defiantly stay again and recommend it.
Nicola and Mark.
England.
October 2011.

review_title: Good location but overpriced and outdated
review_text:
Stayed at the Bay Club Hotel & Marina for 3 nights during August 2011. I shared a 2 queen double with 2 friends. The location is great, nice view of the San Diego Bay and no noise of landing jets on Coronada Island at all. The Room was spacious and even had a balcony.
BUT the Hotel is really outdated and definitely needs some refurbishments! We even changed the room after our first night, because the room smelled badly (Yes, it was a non-smoking Room).
The breakfast was super basic and not worth the money at all. Given the relatively high price I wouldn't stay at this place again. Rather I would look for accommodation directly at Mission Beach.

The hotel is a great place to stay for families. The suites are a good size with a kitchen. You can grill your own food outside next to the pool on their large gas grill. The breakfast and evening hospitality buffet are a nice addition to your stay.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Mission Valley

review_title: The most amazing stay for the price that you will NEVER find anywhere else.
review_text: I didn't see the Rancho Bernardo inn before I reserved my stay. And did I ever get a pleasant surprise. My wife and I literally felt like royalty our entire stay. There is no reason for you to leave during your entire stay. To be honest I'm not sure you will want to.

review_title: Still the best in San Diego
review_text:
I just had to suggest that anyone with a small event, especially if you or many guests are from out of town, book the breakfast room here and have your guests stay. This met all our needs for my daughter's recent college graduation. We live about 5 hours away and she wanted her local friends and co- workers to help celebrate, and it was perfect. We got our own food and decorations and left it in the same clean condition we found it. It is lovely too, outside are restrooms if needed and it is reasonable. The staff, as always, went out of their way to be accomodating and local guests plus those staying 
over at the hotel enjoyed a very special event.

This hotel was perfect for both conferencing in San Diego as it just around the corner from the convention center, as well as holidaying as its in the gas light area. The hotel has more character than a chain hotel and is smaller so the service from the front desk was great. The decor was cosy and a little bit querky. The room had everything you need including a safe (essential), ironing board & iron, hair dryer etc.This hotel feels like some thought has been put into everything to make your stay go well. I will definitely consider staying here again next time I visit San Diego.

review_title: Spa VERY OVERPRICED for the poor service I received:(
review_text: Stayed there for 4 nights. Thought I would relax at the Spa but VERY over priced. I was more stressed when I came out because of the POOR service I received. I need my money back. VERY disappointed!

review_title: DON'T use their Spa. WASTE of your money.
review_text: We stayed there for 4 nights. Was looking forward to their spa service. Turned to be TOTAL waste of my money. I could have received better service for 1/3 rd of the money I paid them plus it would have lasted longer. Horrible! Wish I could get a full refund. But other than that it was ok.

I found this hotel on Trip Advisor and booked for Friday and Saturday nights. Great location, comfortable room, million dollar views. standard fare for free continental breakfast; made my own waffle. Fruit in lobby along with Halloween candy. Friendly staff recommended restaurants for dinner. Lots of food choices but none were very upscale. Pool area was very clean. Nice wicker lounge chairs around the heated pool and spa. My only complaint was a pounding bass from a local club at night.

My wife and I are really picky when it comes to hotels and service. We booked this hotel and wasn't sure because most of the reviews are good but some are not. I can tell you that this hotel is so nice. We got a 3rd floor room with a king bed. I think the 3rd floor rooms are the rooms with really cool vaulted ceilings. Balcony overlooked a "garden view" with a few fountains below and it was a great location. Room was very clean and updated. Did not look worn or old at all. The room was also huge. Much larger than the standard hotel room. Service from every staff member that we came in contact with was first class. Guests need to pay extra to use the Spa pool, but they have 2 other pools that looked great. You do need to drive down a residential street to get there but its only about a 1/2 mile drive, better than being right off the freeway. My wife and I came here this time but i would not hesitate to bring our children next time. I would highly recommend this hotel.

The rooms were clean and nicely decorated. Concierge was friendly and helpful. Location can't be beat. Room service breakfast was nice but a couple mins late ( I am a stickler for time ). :). Would definitely go back thank u San Diego and Omni you were so kind!

review_title: Stayed here 5 times in 6 years for a reason
review_text: This is my wife and my favorite hotel. We love SD and this hotel has no frills but a location that can't be beat. This review for an overall 5 is because of the excelent views. I've written a review on this hotel before but not since the remodel. The rooms and hotel are very clean. Get a full ocean view room to get the spectacular effect of the beach and ocean. And best of all enjoy the beautiful so-cal sunsets. The hotel is centrally located within walking distance to restaurants and bars. The rooms are remodeled with a new flat screen tv (like you would ever want to watch tv). The staff is very friendly. If you want a deal get on their newletter and they run pretty good deals. We will be back to San Diego and we will stay at Ocean Park Inn. AGAIN.

Will never stay anywhere else in San Diego again. Helpfuo and friendly service. Great downtown location. Many restaurants within walking distance. Lovely rooms with either bay or marina view. Good breakfast. Free wifi.

review_title: They try really hard but they can't make up for the poorly constructed hotel in a less-than-ideal neighbourhood.
review_text:
Pros:
1. Super friendly staff
2. Clean rooms
3. Free basic wifi in some rooms
4. Free parking
5. Free breakfast
6. Free upgrade given to make us happier
7. Free HBO
8. Great Inn-siders guide to the neighbourhood
9. Great pool
10. Great DVD library
Cons:
1. Super noisy rooms. You can hear aeroplanes every 3 minutes. The neighbour's plumbing sounds like a torrential downpour. You can hear the woman in high heels walking back and forth to get ice from the machine. You can hear the train whistles. You can hear the freeways and the traffic on pacific highway. You can hear the trash truck at 4:30 in the morning. You can hear the neighbour's TV and conversations. You get the idea...
2. WiFi never worked in either of the rooms. We even spent an hour on the phone with tech support. The wifi signal just isn't strong enough. 
3. The wifi is limited to 3mb for the entire hotel. That means no netflix, no YouTube, no updating apps, no downloading, etc. Only basic web browsing and small emails. 
4. Dodgy neighbourhood. We had a man linger about outside our room, peer through the windows, and even knock on our door to ask to speak to a fake person. We called front desk and they escorted him from the property. Also, you're only seconds from psych facilities and there are numerous homeless around because of the proximity of health and human services, the central transport depot, etc.
5. They never did fix the wifi despite three conversations. 
We probably won't return. It's just too noisy. And we really like having a hotel with unrestricted and working wifi during a long stay. However, we really did appreciate the room upgrade and some of the efforts made to make us happier. Without those efforts, we would have left after the first night. Thanks for trying.

review_title: Great, nice atmosphere, verry nice staff!!
review_text: So nice, great breakfast area, sweet swimming pool, near the old town. You can borrow dvd's which is nice, you can get tea or coffe from the common area to your room. You can BBQ at the pool in the evening. Clean rooms, good shower. Would absolutely go there again!
Outstanding top-end hotel on the Riverwalk. Excellent service & facilities, ranging from room to rooftop pool & fitness center. Centrally-located to most RW features & Alamodome.

Stayed in a family suite strangely with my family on a San Diego zoo excursion. It was wonderful to have so much space refrigerator and amenities top notch two televisions each with DVD player made for easier night, recommends pizza place was fast and passable. Overall great stay. One negative is also a positive central location is central to all sorts of other stuff. Ran over to wal-grens for a forgoten prescription and realized this was a bad neighborhood. Two blocks from adult stores and the airport. Hotel wonderful nearby a bit scary. Good staff and safe feeling oasis-like grounds made it a recommend.

review_title: Awesome hotel for young married couples
review_text: My wife and I stayed here as part of our California trip for four nights. The staff was great and very accommodating. The location is tremendous as the gas lamp district is great for good food and late drinks. The pool is awesome. We considered other places, and we definitely made the right decision!

We have a mini family reunion every year the wkend before thanksgiving and have always stayed at the Westin next door. This year they were booked for that weekend so we had to scramble to find a new hotel. Well we found an AMAZING one. From the time we walked in we knew we would come back here for years to come. From the lobby to the rooms everything was outstanding! Rooms are very spacious and priced right. I didn't care about what view I had of the city cause when u walk out the back you are on the Riverwalk!

review_title: Great stay for a great price !!!!!
review_text: Stayed two nights and we had a great time. Valet's were accommodating, allowing us to park our Harley's under cover by the front door. Staff was great, especially in the lobby bar. Only complaint was the cleaning crew did not remove used wash cloths from the tub.

review_title: If available, this is definatly my first choice for my next SA trip, :).
review_text: Didn't know what to expect at first, but from the time the bellman helped with our bags I was at ease. My parents accompanied us on this trip and stayed at another hotel, but our room was spacious enough for them to have stayed with us. The location is great, and I honestly don't have a single complaint. The bed was comfy, could see the riverwalk and the Tower from my room. Not good with names, but all staff that we encountered were helpful and never got any attitude. Loved my stay here. :)

review_title: Fantastic service that takes all worries out of vacation!
review_text: Ocean park inn went above and beyond our expectations. We arrived 6 hours before check in and they offered to hold our luggage and to use any of their services until our room was ready. In addition, the staff at the front desk was extremely accommodating and friendly, even offering us their own beach umbrella to use for the day. Our room was perfectly located, overseeing the pool and beach, and you can't beat waking up and falling asleep to the ocean waves. The hotel was located within walking distance to restaurants, shopping, and public transportation to take you into downtown san Diego. Ocean park inn definitely made our stay unforgettable!

The staff at the Omni need to be congratulated for such friendly and efficient service. Always welcoming you with a smile, chatting with you and going that extra mile to ensure you leave thinking "I wasnt just another guest". If I had to suggest anything to the hotel staff I would say upgrade the lifts, they can be a bit slow during busy times in the morning or evening.

review_title: Greatness all around: rooms, service, food, location
review_text: This hotel is probably San Diego's best kept secret. Location is just perfect, very beautiful, serene. Great views from everywhere. Since its only 2 stories and spread out you feel like you are at a fine resort. Furnishings very soothing, rich. Large slatted plantation shutters instead of curtains. Duvets instead of bedspreads. Comfortable beds. The restaurant could be a 4-star. Food is fabulous. While we were there they had a $3 special on entire selection of local beers. Staff extremely friendly and efficient. The hotel is immaculate. Will definately go back!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_text: my fiance, 4 y.o. Daughter, and I stayed here on a completely unplanned roadtrip down to SD. We had just gone on a trip a few weeks prior so we werent looking to spend a lot of $. Anyway, gave this place a call and booked a room for ninety bucks which was a king bed and a rollout for my daughter... The room was nothing fancy, pretty basic, but they do have some ammenities which make it standout. They let u check out dvds as well as games from the lobby. This was great for my daughter who I played a game of jenga with and watched shrek before bed... Also the location is within walking distance to old town, which is one of our favorite attractions in SD. also the breakfast was pretty decent. Bagels, waffles, hard boiled eggs, toast, fruit, oatmeal, cereal, coffee, juice... Other than that I did notice the pool which we did not have time to jump in..plus I noticed they have an arcade game down by the lobby which was pretty interesting. The front desk lady was also very polite so no issue there. Now the only problem was that the motel was apparently renovating the rooms to be non smoking, but ours did smell pretty strongly of cigarette smoke. that was the only minor complaint and will hopefully be fixed in the near future. Overall, I would definitely recomend.
My company booked these rooms - beds were lumpy, noisy and uneven. I'm glad I live within 20 miles and will probably sleep at home tonight. Totally unimpressed from the minute I sat on the bed.

review_title: Great hotel for boaters or vacationers!
review_text: Our room was in the newer Casa Marina Building. Clean, comfortable rooms with tasteful decor and a balcony with beautiful views overlooking the marina. By far the nicest Best Western I've ever stayed in---the Best Western "Plus" designation seems fitting. Recently renovated pool and whirlpool area near the water and overlooking the marina was nice, too.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_title: The absolute worst, most uncomfortable bedding I have ever experienced in a four-star hotel, er scratch, make that any hotel.
review_text:
The grounds are lovely, the service is fine. But I lost a whole night's sleep tossing and turning in a bed with lumpy, hard pillows and a lumpy, polyester UNcomforter. No help in the sleep department due to zero sound-proofing. Could literally hear the people in the room above turn over in bed -- which thanks to the awful bedding they did frequently. 
And I agree with other reviewers that $10 self-parking in a residential neighborhood 25 miles from downtown is audacious.

I recently stayed in one of their conods for my 28th Bday and I received the best service ever!! The exquisite treatment first started when I sopke with the reservation specialist Tori. She really understood that I wanted it to be special and made excellent suggestions and recommended what room type would suit my needs. Once I checked in, Natalie and Astrid worked the front desk and they were both awesome ensuring all details and requests were handled in a professional and timely manner. I would definately recommend this hotel!!! Thank you Tori, Astrid, Natalie :-)
hotel_name: Palomar San Diego, A Kimpton Hotel

review_title: I'd you're really sure you want to stay in the Gaslamp Quarter and willing to sacrifice Sleep for location, go ahead and stay at
review_text: Bottom line, Hotel Solamar was not a great choice for us. We were in SD to run the AFC half marathon and were unfortunately staying in a room next door to a wedding party. Nothing could be done to quiet the crowd. The hotel did comp us the night, which was nice of them. I chose the hotel because I love their pet policy and their Fire and Sky resort in AZ. Solamar is no Fire and Sky. As a downtown hotel, it lacks the same grounds and amenities. Service was ok. We were stunned to find that the gong rate for parking was $36 per night and were told by one valet that they would be really busy on Sunday, when we were checking out, due to a ballgame. Not sure what he expected us to do about that. Again, it is the location. If you aren't in the Gaslamp to party, I'd recommend another area and another hotel. If you are there to run a race, seriously consider another.
The pictures on the web make this place look like a 5 star, which it isn't. However it is very clean and the views are very impressive. Would definitely stay again.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_text: Stayed in San Diego for a long weekend and needed a hotel close to the convention center. Hotel Solamar was it and I couldn't have done better. We had a suite and it was perfect. The hotel is in the gaslamp quarter, so easy access to all the restaurants and a minute walk to the convention center. The pool on the fourth floor is a bit small but who needs a pool when you have the ocean.

First of all, the hotel is very nice. The staff were very professional & polite from the front desk, bell boy, valet, security & engineering. The rooms are amazingly beautiful & clean, their beds are comfortable. They have wooden/tiles floors which is great for a pet friendly hotel. 
However, they have some small kinks that they need to fix before I can give them 5 stars. They only have 3 elevators. So, if you come late at night (fri-sat) expect for a wait since the pool party is on the 4th floor. We waited close to 15min for an elevator. I would also avoid staying on the fourth floor if you want to rest. The tv & iron in our room didn't work so we had to call engineering to fix it. Besides that, our overall stay was pleasant. I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_name: Palomar San Diego, A Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Kimberly Hawkins did a superb job of taking care of my family of 12. She made accommodations for all of our needs and is an outstanding asset to your organization. Thank you for all that you did for us.

review_title: Great people, great location, great amenities.
review_text: This was a family Thanksgiving vacation and greatly enjoyed! Kimberly Hawkins provided very good service by coordinating three families, six rooms, 12 people and finding rooms that would accommodate all of our vacation needs. Kimberly's customer service focused attitude was very pleasant and greatly appreciated!

Thanks so much to your very knowledgeable Front Office Agent, Jose Rosales at your Hyatt (Losoya) location in San Antonio, TX. He ensured our stay was a pleasant experience.
Thanks again!

We enjoyed our stay it is an excellent hotel at a excellent location.
Jose Rosales was fantastic at the front desk as well as the entire valet staff.
Hotel should never charge for wi fi or water. Just raise your rate 10.00 
I will stay there again but it is adsurb for such charges
Tony janca

review_title: Great modern hotel with great service and all facilities we wanted.
review_text:
We had a great suite. Service was great - eg we asked at the front desk for some hot water to make tea, it arrived only a couple minutes after we'd got up to our room. Staff weren't entirely knowledgeable on the area (got a supermarket location a block out) but wouldn't hold that against them!
When we left we asked them to call a cab for us, they brought round the courtesy car to drive us to the airport for free instead! 
As an Inner Circle member we got all the snacks and treats we had asked for. 
All in all, it was just fantastic.
hotel_name: Palomar San Diego, A Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Excelent hotel. Very convenient. Staff makes every effort to ensure your satisfaction. Staff was prompt with requests. The bar is very nice as well.
First time staying here. Stunning place and service was top notch!! Can't wait to return!
Everyone was so friendly and helpful. It was onlyna two block walk to the hot spot of the riverwalk and if it wasent so hot it wouldn't have big a big deal. Overall beautiful place!

review_title: Extortionate pet fee. Cannot compete with westin river walk across street
review_text: When hotel supervisor saw our small chihuahua dog, he immediately said it was a whopping $50 per day extra for the dog. Nothing said when reservation made. Expensive valet $28per day Needs new management We moved to westiin riverwalk across strret Bellboy took 1 hour at checkout. Valet another 20 for car

review_title: Stay away...worst service... Loud pool party at night that prevents you from sleeping!
review_text: As my boyfriend and I are sitting in the hallway after a full day of kayaking... He finally exclaimed that this is the worst hotel experience ever. I agree. This was my bday present to him as well so I feel really bad. I am writing this review while laying in bed at 11 pm at night on the 7th floor that feels like I am in the middle of a club from the pool party downstairs. Why were we in the hallway at 10:30pm? The cleaning lady didn't clean our room. Also our first night upon arrival... No glasses or cups in the room. First time ever this has happened. At breakfast, there was not a hostess and we sat ourselves waiting for five minutes. We left. This is a shame bc the hotel is part of a luxury hotel collection... We stayed at ojai resort last week which is the same group and we left exclaiming how wonderful the service was. I got this hotel on a travelzoo deal and at half the price, it was not worth it. If i paid the full $200+/night deal... I would even be more livid. This experience is pretty horrible and a waste of a weekend...and especially a special one at that. Pls stay away as far away as you can.
hotel_name: Palomar San Diego, A Kimpton Hotel

review_title: A pleasant stay in a lovely location
review_text:
The hotel is a Best Western. They are generally good, decent hotels and represent good value. Go there with this in mind and you'll be happy. The rooms are good, not great. I personally thought the beds were vert comfortable. 
The two pools are nice. Good loungers. Very limited parasols. 
The staff are excellent. There was an immediate response to our phoning reception to explain that our room had not been cleaned on one of the days. The staff at reception are very helpful and knowledgeable.
The location on the waterfront / marina is excellent. It is very quiet. Providing you are prepared to walk there are certainly 4 good restaurants within 1km or so. I'd also like to give a special mention to a place called The Wine Pub which is near the above mentioned restaurants. It's a lot like a wine bar with some decent beers and they get some good musicians in there. 
We hope to return next year.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_title: An elegant hotel with a great location.
review_text: A perfect location with a streetcar stop on the corner and on the riverwalk. In a tranquil area with shops and restaurants a short walk away. Staff was solicitous and very helpful with special requests. Food and music in bar was very good. Refreshing mint and cucumber water to drink in lobby. My only complaint is they don't recycle.

Jose who checked us in, asked if we were there for business or pleasure. We told him it was our 20 year wedding anniversary. He had champage and fruit sent too our room. We are so appreciative too him and the hotel staff for making our weekend a wonderful experience. Thank you again Jose.
It was my first stay at this hotel. It was very enjoyable. The staff was very great and helpull.
hotel_name: Palomar San Diego, A Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Wonderful time! Job well done, from service to cleanliness, couldn't ask for anything more!
review_text:
I was personally welcomed by the head doorman, Gilbert and by Jose who checked me in. They personally made me feel like I was royalty!
Danny from concierge knew the inside and out of the city and helped me with everything from restaurants to entertainement!
We had a wonderful stay and look forward to coming back soon!
Right on the Riverwalk. Close to everything, staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Will stay there again on next trip.

review_title: I will be staying elsewhere the next time I'm in San Antonio.
review_text:
There was blood on the toilet seat. The manager moved us to another room later that night after having a late dinner.
The nice lady over housekeeping brought the kids cookies for the inconvenience.

Great location & fabulous staff; never wanted for a thing the four days of my stay. The valet met us as soon as the car stopped, Gilbert was so very helpful & took care of all our needs even with a mountain of luggage & equipment! Jose was so very pleasant....even with hundreds of people coming at him all at one time. These guys were just as wonderful at checkout, too. We will be back!

I stayed for three days and three nights. After the first night, I was already contemplating staying again in the future. The service is friendly. My room was spacious and clean. You can exit the back and step onto the Riverwalk. Overall, it was a pleasant experience.

In San Antonio for business meetings, was set up by travel coordinator at Hyatt Regency on the Riverwalk. Nice hotel, a little pricey but good location to Alamo and all San Antonio locales. Room was very nice and looked as if it was recently redone. Elevators were a little off and ballroom area was under construction so no restrooms on ballroom floor. Good hotel but a bit over priced.

review_title: I travel across the Country and the service here is wonderfully remarkable!!!
review_text: Special mention to Anthony Vogt-..Yasi Hafezi-...and Steven Lopez...they are a commendable asset to your fine organization.

Right on the quieter side of the riverwalk, which is much more peaceful than the areas closer to the malls. The suites are great, and very roomy with a lot of ambience - doesn't feel like a hotel. The pool is nothing spectacular & housekeeping didn't replenish shampoo etc till asked were the only drawbacks. Valet parking seemed pricey @ 30 per night, but that's probably pretty standard for this part of town

The hotel is in a great location and has a cool vibe. However, the walls are very thin and we could hear hear the folks in the hallways and the rooms next door partying all night. 
They charge $30 for a rollaway bed and $35 for parking. 
Much better values and quality elsewhere in SD.

review_title: Great hotel, great location, beautiful view.
review_text: Stayed here for a week with family and truly enjoyed our stay. We had a beautiful view of the city, had no problems with noise. The location is great, right on the riverwalk.

Last night of our stay. Arrived Sat 7/16 excitedly expecting our double room with cityview, only to be told they where giving us a King room with riverview. Who wants to deal with a sleeper sofa for 6 nights. Stupidly I had even called the day before and had my room reservation confirmed. Told by manager that someone had decided to stay an extra night....I hope she really didn't think we are stupid enough to believe that lie. Given free breakfast for only one meal. Called early am about coffee maker not working and then had to call again late that eve. Waiters in restaurant snobby. They make you feel as though you are not good enough to eat in there. Loved our last stay here but will not choose this place again!!!

This was a return visit for my husband and I. His company had their Christmas ball here last year (2010) and we were excited to have a weekend to ourselves. There were discounted rooms available, but we opted for a more special experience as we did last year and booked one of the Rock star suites. We incidentally had the exact same room last year so we knew what to expect. The room was $300 more per night than the company discounted rooms. We of course expect there to be some noise as we were above the club and things did quiet down around the expected closing time. Although I am trying convey some positive aspects, I feel compelled to tell the public what terrible customer service we received when we complained about a basic necessity. We stayed for two nights. The first night, our speakers and Tv remotes weren't working so we had a technician attempt to fix things, which he did, but never came back with the remote. When they did bring one back, it was the wrong one. We had lukewarm water that only became lukewarm after running for over twenty minutes, including the bathtub. But the worst part was that for the remainder of our stay we had no hot water (freezing cold only) despite having service technicians in the room while we were trying to get ready, and then being told it was fixed when it clearly was not. We were offered a new room at 11:30 pm Saturday night and were checking out the next am. When we very politely complained about the hot water, we were offered a comp at breakfast before checkout. In addition, there was a large party on the balcony room below us....loud, but expected. However, we had to call security to have them stop a fight with someone attempting to jump from the balcony. The bottom line is that we were more than willing to give you our money for a more "rock star" experience, but were given a small deduction from our total bill, that a true rock star would have never tolerated. If the company party is here next year, unfortunately I will tell everyone I know to stay at neighboring hotels.

The staff was awesome and the hotel was extremely clean. My only gripe is the size of the suites. They are about half the size of a la quinta suite. Also, the fridge and wireless internet ARE included w/ the room.

We had a good ending of our california trip in this hotel. On arrival unfortunatelly our room was not ready (5:45 pm). But after waiting another 30min we received an upgrade to a suite. fantastic room. Service overall was ok, when not special. Staying at the hotel is definitely a great experience. location is great as well, but don't expect the area to wake up until later in the evening. During the day it seems a bit deserted.

review_title: Great value and location for Sea World.
review_text:
We enjoyed our stay there. Clean rooms, nice breakfast to start our days, wondered staff,and 5 minutes to Sea World. 
The area around the hotel is so so. I wouldn't recommend walking outside, and the parking stalls are a little tight. The underground parking could use security gates or a guard, but we didn't see any problems during our stay. But I wouldn't leave any valuables in your car.
Very close to many restaurants. 
Overall a very nice experience.
I would stay here again in a heartbeat.. My 11 yr olds words when we walked in was- "wow richie rich people stay here."

Fantastic staty! Beautiful boutique hotel, large rooms with plenty of counter space, comfy couch, and view. Rooftop pool wasn't huge, but it didn't need to be. You wouldn't think this hotel is child and pet friendly by appearance, but it is. Happy hour was delightful! The only thing that seemed out of character was out room service breakfast. Poor presentation, and incorrect description in the menu. Does not meet what contessa standard seem to be. Park across the street for $15/ day. Lastly, talk to Rosie the concierge! She's great!
Quality staff & facilities, exceptional operation.

I would like to tell everyone that everything about this hotel is amazing. We stay here every year for our ann. This year we r unable to due to major medical and financial problems. But if it weren't for that wed b there, this hotel should be visited by everyone atleast once. We will never stay anywhere else again. Every time we have gone we have been remembered by name and that means a lot. Amazing.

review_title: Great location, but not family friendly.
review_text:
Stayed at the Hyatt Regency Riverwalk for a business trip. Great place to hold a meeting, but noting for kids at the hotel. I had my family with me and our kids were bored the whole time. The TV's had no kids channels....no Disney or Nick. Only way to get childrens program were to rent movies for a fee. Rooms were clean and service was as exepected. If you are looking for a place to relax by the pool, this is not the place. The rooftop pool is very very small. Room for about 15 people max. 
Location was nice as was right on the heart of the Riverwalk. I would come back for business, but not for a family vacation.
