review_title: perfect place to stay something for whole family
review_text: beautiful location. Great accomadations. Great food and drinks. Staff very polite and helpful. Awesome view from any location. Sergio T. was a great host and helped out with all our needs. We will be back again,wish we could have stayed longer. Now back to the world and saying goodbye to paradise.

We stayed here for a weekend. The guy that checked me in had no clue what he was doing. There was another lady working there that appeared to be the manager but had no clue what she was doing, she couldnt even make room keys. We asked for a crib and we were told they would bring one up. About 2hrs later we still had not gotten it so we went down and they said they now didnt have anymore. Our keys stopped working and when we went to the front desk nobody even apologized. we had no toilet paper and after asking for some, we NEVER got any. They had no clean towels. Elevators broke. Parking was expensive. Upon checking in, i asked if i could pay cash and i was told by the manager that i could but it had to be when i checked out. I tried paying cash when i checked out and a different girl said i could not cuz they already charged my card and that i should have done it at check in. Nobody knows what they are doing and they are very rude. My husband called the manager after are stay and NEVER got a return call. My husband works at a hotel and we are not picky but this place is ridiculous. Not worth it even when we had a cheap rate. Worst experience ever!

review_title: Christie at the front desk is very welcoming.
review_text: I stay at this hotel often because I travel alot for business. The location is nice and convenient since I work alot in the downtown area but hate staying in the downtown area. I also do some work over at the navy sub base which is very conveniently close. Anyhow, upon checking in, Christie at the front desk immediately acknowledged me and welcomed me by name. I was pleasantly surprised at such a welcome I had. I was impressed that she remembered my name and the exact location of the hotel I enjoy staying. I dont stay that often, but often enough to know which view and part of the hotel I like to stay. Christie seems to be a great asset to this hotel because all the times I walked past the front desk, she acknowledged myself and others passing. One day I did have an issue with the heater in my room. The first gal I spoke to, Jessica, said she would send up blankets and send the maintenance man to check it out, it was not done. Later, I spoke to Christie and she was able to immediately have a nice gentleman named Robert replace the unit with no further problems. I also want to commend Joseph in the restaurant who is friendly and checked on me during my meal. He recommended a few other places for dining that i never heard of since coming here which was very good. Excellent service! although, the rooms are a little old, I would come back because of great staff like Christie, Joseph, and Robert. Thank you all!

review_title: Some good, some bad, needs improvement.
review_text:
I came to San Diego for a quick getaway before all the holiday madness began. I checked in with a young lady who seemed confused and seemed like she didn't know what she was doing. It took at least 20 minutes for her to locate my reservation once she found someone to help. After waiting 20 minutes, I was told the room was not ready. She asked me to have a seat until the room was ready. I waited almost 40 minutes in the lobby watching people come in and out getting room keys and not be acknowledged. Had I known it was going to take over an hour I would have left to enjoy the city since it was a nice Sunday afternoon. I asked if my room was ready and she looked aggravated that I was asking. I then asked to speak to a manager and she went somewhere in the back and came out and said the manager was in a meeting and not available. When I asked her to have the manager come speak to me after her meeting she said "if she's still here, I'll have her come out." I continued to watch her give keys to other people and even watched a shift change in agents. Finally, I could not handle the frustration, I attempted to see the front desk again. I asked her again and she told me it would be 45 minutes. Im not one to complain but after seeing so many other people get rooms I had to say something. She apologized and said to have a seat and she would help me in a bit. 25 minutes later, I saw the young lady run off with her belongings to leave. I tried to remain patient after being so upset, when the new agent who arrived Crissy, saw me waiting. She asked if I was waiting on a room and I explained my situation about waiting and how the manager was surprisingly unavailable. Instead of waiting the 45 minutes, Crissy immediately found a room for me and even offered a full view room at no additional charge. She was very pleasant and friendly and a complete turnaround from the gal before her. Crissy had suggested a few things to do while in town and even had great suggestions on some sales for shopping. After speaking with her, I was really excited to go about my day and had forgotten about the negative experience I had first encountered. 
Later that night I encountered another issue when trying to order room service. I was unable to reach room service as the phone just kept ringing. Another 45 minutes later and numerous attempts to call, I went downstairs to the restaurant and saw no one there to help me order. I waited 10-15 minutes and saw not even one worker so I decided to go back to the front desk to see if I can find help. At the front desk I saw Crissy helping a line of people and she was the only one helping. This hotel must be short on staff because with a line like that, I would assume one would be highly overwhelmed. Apparently, after eavesdropping, I gathered their flight or plans were cancelled. I thought my day was bad until I heard some of these peoples horror stories of not having a decent meal since 7am! Watching people venting frustrations and upset people taking out on her, Crissy maintained a polite and positive attitude. Finally, her back up came and they managed to check everyone in within 10 minutes. When she finally noticed me standing there she asked me if I was ok and I explained my issue regarding room service. She and Patrice seemed apologetic and they took my order and walked it over to the kitchen. They said it should be half an hour and my food came in less than half an hour qt that point. Thank you Crissy and Patrice! 
The grounds seem like it has alot of potential, surrounded by water with amazing views, however, it seems dated and can use some renovation. The hotel has a Hawaiian theme however the buildings (according to the hotel map) are named after Mexican cities. Cabo, and cozumel, cancun? Doesn't make sense. The furniture in the lobby and in the rooms seem old fashioned and I don't understand why or how it fit the hotel motif if it even had one. The bed was an older bed and felt like it had to be 20 years old. The hotel definately needs some updating and renovation, once that is done I'm sure the hotel would be a great resort. Also, if the staff is more trained and anything like Crissy and Patrice, I would come back because they seemed very sweet and helpful. Until then, if i were in the area, I would probably go to another one of the 4 hotels in the area. I just hope someday the Kona Kai does decide to remodel because the land around is do beautiful.

I booked a room at this location back in nov 2010 for a stay this June for the rock & roll marathon. When I called today to 2 of the 4 nights, Paul the person in reservations totally screwed up and changed the dates (he didn't say anything about the change while on the phone) when I got my email confirmation, within a minute of hanging up the phone, I called right back and was told there were no rooms available.....WHAT?!?! When I told them THEY screwed up the said "so? What do you want me to do about it?" and "well just cancel then" so now I will be driving 12 hours with no hotel to stay at the night before the race. THANKS PAUL!!!!!!!

I read a lot about this hotel before we went. My girl friend was optimistic and wanted to try it regardless of the reviews I told her about that I read on this very site. Needless to say, the negative reviews are all correct. 
Parking - the parking in this facility is absolutely terrible. Extremely small and you can never find a parking when you come back at night. They offer addtional parking underground, but it is anything but convenient. 
Service - The Lobby personnel are terrible. Management was very disrespectful to my girl friends parents when they had issues with accessing their room. Both of our refrigerators in our rooms never worked. When we called to complain, they said nothing could be done about it. So don't plan on having a working refrigerator. 
Laundry - it is on the 3rd floor outside and there are only 2 of each at $1.25 each. No soap is sold or offered anywhere. 
Room - the room had a musty smell to it. Our couch had stains. As I mentioned previously, our refrigerator did not work. Half of our wall did not have any lights or outlets working. Basically, no power. We never called to complain, we just dealt with it. Everything else worked. 
Noise - I read a lot here about the thin walls, folks, don't think that's a lie. I thought we could cope, but this was the worst I have experienced by far. You could hear every single person that walks by and it is almost if there feet were amplified. You can hear everytime anyone's door who is remotely around your room. You can hear when your neighbors shower as well. My girl friend slept horribly. 
The maids - the maids kept the room clean. No complaints about them. 
Location- althought this may be close to sea world, don't let that sell you. It is in the ghetto. Very bad area. Bums everywhere. So bad that they do not have an open lobby at night. You have too talk through them through a glass window. They also have security all night which depending on how you look at it, could be a positive. There is a strip club right next to the hotel. 
I would not recommended this hotel anyone. Even though it is cheap, you get what you pay for. We stayed July 24rd - July 27th 2011.

review_title: Scary location and not worth the price.
review_text: DO NOT STAY HERE unless you are looking to score crack or hook up with a stripper from the strip bar across the street. We booked this hotel not knowing the location and liked the price. We had booked 3 nights and stayed 1. The only night we stayed we got no sleep for fear that someone was going to break into our room since the dead bolt was ripped off our door and the strip bar across the street and people of questionable backgrounds hanging out outside our door all night. We ended up checking out and staying at a different hotel the last 2 nights. Strongly advise not staying here.

After reading horrible reviews we were worried to stay here. However, we had a great stay. The staff were helpful and friendly. The room was clean and safe - remember this is an old hotel so it's a bit worn. However it's cheap, and close walk to old town and trolley. It is near a strip club - however we had no issues with people around the area. Would stay again. Thanks to the staff who made our stay enjoyable.

This is a nice hotel right by the ocean. Let's talk about some of the concerns. Homeless folks..a few here and there but they don't bother anyone (compare to the drunken college kids at mission beach who can be horrible). I guess if I were homeless, I'd live by the ocean. San Diego overall has a huge homeless problem.
Never felt unsafe here,
Rooms - a little worn but super clean (and i'm a clean freak) and spacious. If I stayed here again I'd do 2nd floor ocean view so I would have balcony. Bed was comfy and did a thorough check for bugs, none! 
Noise-right by the beach walk so active til about ten. No matter where you stay you get the rude loud people, slept good here.
Parking-it's Cali so always short but we found a place and stuck there. There is a lot of cafes and restaurants within walking distance, including a Starbucks and grocery store.
Staff was very nice and helpful, especially Jesse at check in. The ice machine was out but they kept ice in office so I always could get some.
This is a nice hotel on the ocean away from the party scene. We really liked it here and would stay again.
Room dirty, bad service, loud, breakfast horrible, miss this place!

review_title: Nice room. No frills but clean.
review_text: Small room but adequate. Somewhat overpriced but that's because of the area. Overall pretty clean and staff was very friendly. Very convenient location, decent parking. Would stay here again for business but not a destination by any means.

Stay here 3 nights and really had no major issues. It is located in a business area and car is needed if you don't plan on eating at the hotel restaurant. If you are accustom nice contemporary this is not the place for you. This hotel was formally an office building and you can tell that remodeling expenses were kept to a minimum. The rooms are located in an atrium theme that looks just like an office building. So much more could have been done to jazz the place up!!! If you are not going to spend alot of time in your room then this is an ok hotel at tops. We stayed gone from 11a-8p so it was really just a place to shower and rest overnight as we took the kids to LegoLand about 35minutes away and Mission Bay Beach about 20mins. Mission Bay Beach was nice and has a small amusement park for kids and free parking. All in all for under $110 a day it was an ok stay, but being accustom nicer hotels I wound not stay again. Hotel did allow for a early checkin and a late check out that was appreciated. Save on $$$ here and miss out on all the nice finer amenities at hotels priced $160 above. My recommendations stay near Hotel Circle or Carlsbad.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Diego

review_title: Front Desk Agent wouldn't help me
review_text:
I was helping my family look for a hotel by my apt and saw that this hotel was very closeby. I walked into the hotel and was surprised to see how nice the lobby looked. The outside looks like an old office building. I walked to the front desk and asked to see a room really quick just to get a feel for it. I was afraid of how the rooms might be since the reviews were so bad. 
The agent refused me and told me to come back earlier in the day. I explained to him that I work during the day and couldn't come during the better times. He still said no and told me to come back around 2.
I will definitely have my family stay somewhere else since the front desk was so unwilling to help me
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Diego

review_text: Keep up the good work and also love the prices. It's wonderful to know that you offer AAA discount and only wish others were able to accomodate like you have especially with the economy as it is. We need to get away every now and then and want to do so more often if prices were reasonable like your hotel. Thank you and hopefully we can afford to get away soon. Good work and great job on everyone there.

review_title: Advertised to be cute, but more or less a motel 8
review_text: I booked this hotel through an iPhone app and it was advertised to be a cute, chic boutique at the heart of little Italy in San Diego. The lobby was about the only thing that was cute. The rooms are small, hardly any walking space, no space on bathroom counters. The room that we were in had the strongest musty smell that it made sleeping quite difficult, even after using half a bottle of perfume, it was still there. The noise was the worse. We were told that there was some "Disney on Ice afterparty" up stairs. But upon reading these reviews, I now realize that loud noise is probably a regular occurrence. I didn't like that the rooms were open to the outside; it felt unsafe especially with the droning of the loud AC, with that and everything else made me feel like I was in a dingy motel going to get slaughtered by an outsider. Also, valet is way overpriced around $30, found a parking spot on the street. Positives: staff is friendly and there is free wifi. However, I will not stay here again not even if it was $50 a night.

review_title:
Pros:staff is friendly & courteous!
Cons: dirty room & noisy
review_text:
Greetings again! Here's my review on the Porto Vista hotel in San Diego which we chose from the Hotel Tonight app. Let me start by saying this phone app rocks! If you use my invite code: dstanert , you will immediately have $25 credits to use ( I just checked & the Stratosphere is listed on the HT app today for $23! Yeeks! free room in Vegas)anyways back to my review:
Pretty lobby but that's it. Room doors faces the outdoors. With noisy ac unit under window. Carpet had white stains(large palm size). Tub leaked. Red spots on comforter. Lots of noise at 3am. Sounded like a party next door. Front desk said it was due to people returning from downtown bars, probably true however the other hotels we've stayed at in the Gaslamp district were quiet....

We stayed for a family vacation. The price was a good deal. The room was a good size, but no microwave or fridge which are important when traveling with kids. No elevator, either, which I would've liked to have known for my elderly parents. There was mildew in the shower, and they wouldn't leave more than 3 towels even though we had 4 adults & 2 kids. We had to ask for more towels every day. On 2 of our 4 mornings, landscapers were chopping trees and backing up trucks literally outside our window by 6:45! So much for sleeping in on vacation. I put out the card for new sheets, as our little one had gotten chocolate on the bed. That nite, the sheets had not been changed. Overall a disappointment.

review_title: I liked the price and clean bed!
review_text: I used the pool often and it was generally good to swim in. When something was broken the staff expressed concern and took action. There was no question about the cleanliness of the bath area. Comfy bed, heater and air-conditioning. It was pretty close to Seaworld and the downtown area.

review_title: Clean rooms, great staff perfect for us!
review_text: We had two joining rooms in July, we stayed there 3nights and let me tell you, I have have no complaints! The rooms I inspected right when we got there and found nothing wrong. Our rooms were comfortable, clean and the staff was helpful that is good enough for me! We will absolutely stay here again on our next trip to SD!

review_title: Filthy and noisy and WAY over priced!!!!!
review_text: Tired rooms with filthy carpets inside and mouldy ones on walkway. Airconditioning too old and dusty to dare turning on. Noise unbearable from those rooms who have the ac on during night. Ruined last 2 nights of an otherwise great stay in San Diego!

review_title: DONT COME HERE! TRUST ME! THIS PLACE RUINED MY ENTIRE TRIP!
review_text: Ehere do i start...ok well first we get there @ 1030pm wet frm seaworld, cold & tired...they tell me they booked the wrong room & i got 1 bed instead of 2 w/3 kids & 2 adults but they'd give me a cot! Then they say they dont hv a pool which i was told they did...then they said the $50 incidental was only accepted by credit card.i even offered him $100 cash just to get my kids to a bed...he said no so we drove around @ 1130 looking for a visa prepaid card...finally found one he took it & when we finally got to the room we found 1 big brown spider where my kids were suppose to sleep..then i take the covers down off my bed & find another! Then sitting on TOP of the dresser was a makeup sharpener! Even if the maid wiped down the room half way she wouldve seen that! Gross! There was fingers prints all over the wood furniture & in the morning when we went to check out of the hell hole they said they couldnt refund the gift card cuz once it was taken they cant put it back..after a fight they agreed to give it back

review_title: Cheap rates, good location but dubious cleanliness and wretched service.
review_text: Stayed here for a wedding weekend. Looked great from the outside and on the web. Sadly, it is basically a flea bag with some new paint when you get to the guest rooms. Stained carpets and bedding...gross! If the staff of the horrible restaurant hadn't been so slow and mean - the price and location may have outshined the shabbiness, but they really left a lasting impression.
Not bad for the price, location.. All other hotels/motels were sold out. If you find yourself in my situation this place will fit the bill nicely..

Stayed here for padres game. Trolley right there. Large room 2 beds. Pool small but this is the type of hotel you dont plan to lounge about This motel is fine for the money. Only complaint is the busload of kids on a trip roaming around the halls but have noticed it has stopped at 11 pm. Not bad!

Keys didn't work went down got another didn't work waited on the open balcony cement floor for 15 minutes before someone came up and switched our rooms. The guy who let us in was the only person on staff who looked like he was working hard and actually gave good service. We were promised a free breakfast through email for booking through the hotel and then found out because we booked through a wedding party we did not qualify. While others in the party did receive this. Our special rate for the wedding party was the same price mind you as everyone else was paying. We had to ask the front desk 2 times why they didn't care or even tried to recover it wasn't until the bride called the manager that we got what we were promised but only two for the one day. I could go on with more problems moldy ceiling dirty counters and glasses. Promise a balcony if you call the indoor outdoor walkway of a motel a balcony. Apparently this hotel bates you with overpromising and underdelivering. We left 3 days early and got a hotel that was $20 a day cheaper and 100% improvement on service room qaulity and experience. I wish the staff would have been sympathetic like the manager but they were just flat out rude. I never complain but I can't help wanting to warn others.

The hotel is within walking distance to the beach, very close. It sits on a neighborhood street with beach houses and apartment complexes. It was very quiet during our stay. We walked to the beach at 11:30 at night and there were a few people at the the bonfire pits, couples walking the beach, and a few homeless sleeping on the benches. Saw a cop drive through the neighborhood and around the parking lot at dog beach. People said hello as they walked by. The hotel room was clean and comfortable enough for my average middle class family. We even broght our dog and there was a shared yard in back for him to do his thing. There is a dog wash, a laundry room, snack machine, free parking at the hotel and a free breakfast of yogurt, cereals, fruit, breads, juice, coffee. We had a good stay at ocean villa inn. If you are used to upscale accomidations this place is not for you but it is good for the average joe and his family.

review_title: Location, location, location (especially for dog lovers)
review_text: Great place for dog lovers whom want a vacay with their best friend. Staff was wonderful. Dog beach was just around the corner. Had a great time. Only complaint is the beds (very uncomfortable) and the rooms are "ok". Definitely not a 5 star hotel. More like two or three. But considering they know dogs will be trashing the place and your using their towels on the dog... I can see why they don't go decorating crazy. If they ever do... They'll double their prices (which I prefer they not). I still plan to use them in future. It was a wonderful doggy vacay.

review_title: Don't stay in a room on the dog run
review_text: Supposed to have dogs on leashes our dog was attacked by a saint bernard . Staff was nice ,bring your own towels .get to the breakfast 10 minutes after it opens or there maybe nothing left. You REALLY have to love dogs to stay in the dog run rooms....outside of that not too bad.Great location
I stayed with my wife and two boys. Rooms are small, but well appointed and comfortable. Staff were very helpful.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Plus Cabrillo Garden Inn

review_text:
First day missing service items. Second day big black spider in one of the towels. At night loud noises outside.
Will not stay here again.

review_title: Friendly staff, free breakfast, exceptional view from rooftop patio room.
review_text:
Paid avg room rate online, single night stay included two breakfast vouchers for restaurant. Friendly staff upgraded to rooftop room on check-in. Courteous even with a late night call to our room about our noise level. Mini fridge missing, but didn't need it for one night, the elevator was unusually slow for 5-floors, and ice machine in the lobby.
Decent size rooms, comfy beds, large bathroom had sliding glass frosted door, good if you don't need privacy. Ample towels and above avg toiletries..
Rooftop view exceptional, lounge happy hour good, not too many choices but drinks well poured. Generous appetizers and my burger prepared as ordered.

The overall appearance is that of a eastern-block building. The rooms were clean yet nondescript. The breakfast was less satisfactory. On our last day of 5 we lost our breakfast tickets and the front desk told us we would have to buy our breakfast. This was after having to listen to a loud wedding reception outside our window the night before. If I were you I would find somewhere else to stay.

The overall appearance is that of a eastern-block building. The rooms were clean yet nondescript. The breakfast was less satisfactory. On our last day of 5 we lost our breakfast tickets and the front desk told us we would have to buy our breakfast. This was after having to listen to a loud wedding reception outside our window the night before. If I were you I would find somewhere else to stay.

review_title: Love the look, not the planes.
review_text: Stayed at this property for 3 nights from the 7th of May. Check in was quick. Rooms clean. Great selection of channels on TV. Only issue I have is with authorization. The hotel took a authorization upon check in, 3 days after check out They took their final bill total also, effectively over $1000 total. I do not accept this. After this hotel we stayed at two Travelodge properties, in Palm Springs the authorization was removed once the final amount settled. In San Francisco, they simply charged the full amount, no authorization. Location to Little Italy is excellent, however the roaring engines of planes landing at the airport was just horrible. Our room also faced the freeway, awesome. The hotel emailed me asking for an opinion & review on TripAdvisor following our stay, I responded with my comments, was not surprised not to receive a reply.

This place is a find! Clean rooms, reasonable parking, free breakfast. It's not a frills place, nut clean and comfortable. I would stay here again no question. Friendliest staff I've encountered in the last five years!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Plus Cabrillo Garden Inn

review_text: I will never stay there again! I have never had such a horrible hotel experience. First of all we booked with a wedding party and we were supposed to get a special rate, we paid the same rate as on the website. Then our keys didn't work, we went and got new ones and those didn't work either! They said they were sending someone up, 15 minutes later someone finally comes up and moves us to a new room. There is a nasty, kind of moldy stain on the ceiling and no balcony like we were promised on the phone. The room is small, counter was dirty and there were no toiletries. Then we went to bring the car in, there was no one at the valet booth so we decided to park ourselves, the guy yelled at us, told us to go back around and he would park the car. The closest garage door did not open so we turned around and went outthe way we came in. The guy yelled at us again and told us he meant to go out the garage door, he told us to "exit the vehicle" and he would park it. The next morning we planned to go get breakfast because we got an email saying complimentary breakfast for two, it also said on the website that there would be complimentary breakfast for two. The rude guy at the front desk told us that since we were part of the wedding party we did not qualify. My friends getting married brought all the business here and we don't get the perks other people do? We are checking out days early!

review_title: Hotel barato que cumple con su funcion.
review_text: Me aloje aqui una nocge ya que iba a un evento al Vepalley View Casino Center y pude ir andando hasta alli sin problemas. El barrio no es el mejir, pero esta lleno de restaurantes donde ir a comer a pie. La habitacion del hotel es muy grande y las camas muy comodas. La limpieza pues lo normal, las habitaciones se ven algo viejas ya eso si. El precio es muy barato.

First of all, I was impressed before arriving by both their website and by the pre-arrival message I got. They have lifestyle concierges that help arrange anything you like. I'm fact, they arranged an amazing birthday dinner experience for my girlfriend at Cafe Sevilla. The room was phenomenal. High ceilings, modern decor but with the infusion of classic elements like brick, and natural elements like a rock garden with live cactus. The rain shower with no doors was very cool. Hip music playing when you arrive. The chais lounge and other seating by the windows made it easy to people watch 5th street. And they have a chic lounge and restaurant too. I would recommend this hotel to anyone and would definitely go back. We literally didn't want to leave.

review_title: Camere spaziose, molto pulito e nuovo
review_text:
Le camere sono spaziose e pulite, la SPA Ã¨ davvero una chicca dopo una giornata da turista in giro per la cittÃ . La colazione non Ã¨ inclusa, a differenza di altri nitrose la stessa catena. C'Ã¨ pero un risorantino dopo poter fare una "sana" colazione all'americana! Urgh! :)
 L'albergo Ã¨ molto vicino alla old town, dove trovare tanti negozietti e buoni ristoranti messicani. Unica pecca: molto vicino a una autostrada molto trafficata e rumorosa.

review_title: An average hotel. Better ones out there!!
review_text: The staff here are not very friendly and helpful. (some are more then others). Location is not the best a bit to far from the downtown/gaslamp area. Walkable but far and streets are pretty dark. Taxi rides can be expensive to and from. Rooms are very clean but very small. And weekends people from other rooms have party's and go out etc and it is very noisy had I to ring down stairs to ask them to tell others to be quite however they already knew this and neighbors were still very loud!! Breakfast was very ordinarily not much choice we didn't eat there once didn't look very clean. Overall I think there are better hotels closer to downtown/gaslamp area for around the same price and probably with better service!!
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - San Diego Downtown

review_title: Great value hotel. Consistently good every time. Excellent for family trips to San Diego.
review_text:
We have been staying at this hotel 2 or 3 times a year for the past 6 years, and every time it is great. Of course don't expect 5 star luxury, it is comfort suites after all. But the rooms are a good size, enough room for my family of 6. Always clean and well maintained. Good sized swimming pool and jacuzzi. Friendly staff, and a pretty good Free breakfast. Which Is a lifesaver with Teanage kids.
Location wise, it's a little bit out of the way I your wanting downtown San Diego, or mission bay. But weighing up value / distance, it's well worth the trek. And the reality is, it's only 15-20 mins from downtown and maybe 30 mins from sea world.
Overall a great value family stay. Highly recommended...
Where are rhe washcloths? The open showers are a hazard. Noisy and cold. Poor service.
Can't say enough...the breakfast was good. Delivers as promised.

review_title: If you expect to stay in a clean room go somewhere else
review_text:
Very very disappointed in our stay here. We reserved a room with a kitchenette and sleeper sofa along with the queen bed. From the moment we opened the door it went downhill. It stunk yet the room had "just been cleaned". Everything in the kitchen area was dirty including the fact that there was only two forks, one which was broken, two plates, both with dried food on them, two spatulas- also dirty, and one frying pan and one medium stock pot. This is all. The fridge was a small dorm size fridge with a leaking freezer. Oh and did I mention when we arrived in the room we wiped the floor with some cleaning wipes we had and they were filthy after. 
On the plus side the fish market is close and the only one still alive is the Point Loma Seafoods one. The cafe is nothing special though. Trader Joes and Vons is only one mile down the road and Sunset Cliffs is about 5 minutes away.

Rooms very clean and modern, including LCD tv, free coffee making facility's and WI FI in the rooms. Location close to the interstate 8 and close to two shopping malls.The Sheraton offered a large free carpark.
hotel_name: Sheraton Mission Valley San Diego Hotel

review_text: Check-in was easy check out was easy however you are charged 14 dollars a day for parking and you need your room key to get in and out of the parking lot. When you check out however, they take your room keys. You then have to wait at the gate, continuously press a button, and wait for someone to open the gate for you, ridiculous. When looking to place an order at the restaurant in the hotel, I ask the waiter if they had some kind of nacho plate, he looked at me with an arrogant smile and laugh and said no and walked away. He then argued with me that a dish I seen in my room menu did not exist. Other than that my shower drain clogged, my toilet barely flushed, and the room was just okay
hotel_name: Sheraton Mission Valley San Diego Hotel

review_text: This hip restaurant is in a great central location. Room are modernly designed. Only downside is the street can get a little loud.

review_title: The gym is a steam room with 3 sets of dumbbells
review_text:
The gym looks nothing like the picture--there was literally moisture in the air it was so humid. 3 sets of weights. Terrible. 
Fluorescent lights in all the rooms. Energy efficient, yes. Relaxing, not so much. 
The lobby area was totally re-done and looks fresh and modern... But I don't spend all my time there!
I will stay elsewhere next time in San Diego.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Sorrento Mesa/La Jolla

review_title: Wonderful, family friendly hotel. Great value!
review_text:
My family and I stayed here for the weekend, and it was clean, affordable, and comfortable. All major attractions are only about a 15 min. drive from the Hotel. There was free parking and the location was quiet and peaceful. 
We got in late and I needed milk for my baby, and although the hotel restaurant was closed, they were still able to get me a sufficient supply of milk for my baby (what a life saver)! In addition to the restaurant, theres also snacks, drinks, and sundries for sale in the lobby. 
We have stayed at aeveral 5 star resorts & this hotel did not disappoint. Would definently stay here again.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Sorrento Mesa/La Jolla

review_title: You get what you pay for..in a good sense
review_text: Well i put in this hotel while on government travel and i have to say it was quite nice. The breakfast was quite pricey most hotels ive been too give u a complimentary breakfast, although it was an above average buffet. we were not informed if the 16 dollar a day parking charge, that was a suprise bill upon checkout for sure. But the military paid for it so worries. Still think it should be advertised on their website or something. Overall though thebstaff was very very friendly pool was nice even enjoyed the gym a couple times. The only truely annoying thing was the person i assumed was sneaking into the hotel to put menus under every door every day. The menus stopped around 3/4 the way through my stay so i assumed they got caught. When the maids came to clean each day the menus never got picked up off the floor(because i never picked them up from being slipped under the door). So approx. 9 menus stayed on the floor even on the day i checked out..i hope they got picked up b4 the next person checked in! But overall it was a very nice experence if i had the money to spend on a vacation to san diego i would have no problem selecting this hotel
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Hotel Circle

review_title: This is the best hotel in San Diego A+++
review_text:
The Sheraton Mission Valley was the most enjoyable stay I've ever had while being in San Diego!
The cleanliness of the hotel was pristine and the professionalism of their Front desk agent Rhys O'Connell was far and beyond my expectations. I have traveled the world extensively and found Rhys to have fantastic local knowledge and professional communication and interacting skills for my wife and I. 
As I return to San Diego I will without hesitation stay at this beautiful property.
hotel_name: Sheraton Mission Valley San Diego Hotel

review_text: Stood for one night on July 15th. Even though the parking garage is not attached to the building we still had a nice stay, so if you book this hotel just remember when you park in front have someone in your party grab a luggage cart while someone else does the check-in and start unloading your stuff, we were lucky and had a room on the first floor:) The customer service was nice and the nice warm cookies were yummy! After we put our stuff in the room we were all exhausted from our day at Sea World so we decided to eat at the restaurant in the hotel, the waiter was a little slow but realizing his hands shook a lot and he was older we overlooked how long he took, he was a older man trying to make a living and obviously with a disease that effected his nervous system and since I have MS I give him props!! Now the food was GREAT! We all had cheeseburgers and my daughter had gnocchi and a salad all the food was hot nice portions and for five people including beer was $75 which to me was fine since it was ten at night and we were all to tired to drive around looking for food. After dinner we showered and slept in some VERY COMFY beds:) Would definitely stay again.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Hotel Circle

review_text: Crack pipe wrapped in tissue was found. Woke up with bed bug bites. Will not give a detailed receipt. Bathroom smelled of mildew. Ice machine is a quarter and you get flecks of black mold in it. Fridge has water pooled on the bottom. Sink leaks. Not worth it at all. Prices are different from advertised!!!
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn Loma Lodge

review_title: Quite good overall! Enjoyed our stay
review_text:
We had originally booked the Hilton San Diego for 10 nights and were hit with the collapse of 1800 hotels, losing our booking and cash. Unwilling to pay an additional 1700 euro, we settled for the cheaper option. When we first arrived we were given our cookies by the friendly front desk staff and given our room key. The room was nice enough but had a thin locked door separating our room from a noisy family room. Not willing to put up with this on our relaxing holiday, we asked the front desk to move us. They were very understanding and arranged for our bags to be moved while we went to the pool. 
This area was nice with a hot tub and little fire pit. Spent a couple of lazy days here. There are some restaurants around the block including a tgi's and a little Mexican place next door which looks bad from outside but serves lovely food and great cocktails quite cheaply. Food in the doubletree was quiet nice, decent choice if a little more pricey. Dinner was pretty good, no complaints. 
All in all we would definitely recommend. If you're the type of person who likes to analyse the paintwork/ceiling cracks in a hotel I would suggest you avoid and; 1. Stump up the cash for a proper Hilton. 2 Get a life, you're on holiday!!
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Hotel Circle

review_title: Yes im ticked about their happy hour.
review_text: The hotel isn't that bad but the happy hour absolutely sucks. it's advertised everywhere about low prices on happy hour drinks but they don't honor it. Holidays dont count but it says that no where. You order a white wine and they give you an $8 glass because you didn't ask for the cheap stuff. And thier beer isnt half price on anything but one variety and that is never mentioned. Barkeep blames it all on the manager as his ipod ear piece is in his ears while he waits on customers. Hotel is fine but stay away of bar and resturant.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Hotel Circle

review_text: From the beginning to the end of my stay I was made to feel as if my needs were very important. We were checked in by Nicholas and Rhyes and they were extremely professional and very welcoming. The room was very clean and the bed was really comfortable. Alice at the restaurant was personable and robert at the front desk excellent. Mel the bell captain was helpful as well. Would go back anytime. Great value
hotel_name: Sheraton Mission Valley San Diego Hotel

review_text:
Le Pension is a great value in a perfect location. Smack in the middle of Little Italy, it's walking distance to everything. Rooms are very European (small and sparse, but liveable). Beds were a smidge hard, but that too is a European standard. Lobby is pretty cool with a chic fire. Loved the water feature in the courtyard.
By the time we checked in at 7 pm, underground parking was full. Street parking is hard to come by, so we had to find a pay lot...another $5 until 6 am....$10 more if you stay later.
Our room opened to the courtyard where there was a large dinner party. Kinda loud, but we were just changing clothes to go back out, so it was ok. By the time we got back (around midnight), it was quiet.
Overall, it was a nice stay in Little Italy.

review_title: Great location but rooms very tiny
review_text: Great location in Little Italy, in walking distance to fab restaurants, the Embarcardo, Downtown and Balboa Park. Was disappointed with the room though was very tiny and had zero character. Good price though! Would look elsewhere when staying in SD or ask for a better room. Parking next door handy too.

Great hotel in a fantastic location. Rooms are clean, hotel receptionist was nice and friendly. Located right in little italy, perfect for the bars and restaurants. Close to the San diego old town trolley tour bus stop too.

I stayed here for a conference on the Bayfront which was a thirty minute walk away. My room was small but clean and everything worked. I noticed the train but it didn't bother me too much. The staff were there and helpful when I needed them, which wasn't much. I enjoyed the atmosphere around the hotel especially on Saturday morning with the Farmer's Market. Very good value much cheaper than all the other hotels the conference guests were staying at.

review_title: Good value, best pool in the area
review_text: The rooms and restaurant are unexceptional but the service is friendly, the courtyard is lovely and the pool is better than hotels where we've spent quadruple the rate. Worth it just for that.

The hiotel is clean seems very modern ashame its just the surface. The staff is rude and very unwilling to be helpful. There's no wifi or even in room LAN connections. The pool was dirty and was over chlorinated. I even had a member of the staff tell me to be quiet when I was explain why my wife and I were in the 24 hrs hot tub after 10 pm. Over all from check in to check out it was a horrible experience. An over rated motel is all it is. Thanks for the memories that have been burned into my mind Seven Seas.

review_title: Convenient location, quiet, good nights sleep and good breakfast buffet.
review_text: We enjoyed our weekend get away to San Diego. Walking distance to Little Italy. Just a short walk to the baseball stadium. We will stay here again.

review_title: Great location, jewelry left in room returned!
review_text: We took our daughter and grandson there for a 3 day weekend. We especially enjoyed the delicious breakfasts and the location that is so convenient to the zoo and other Balboa Park attractions. We were especially impressed with the response from the hotel management when our daughter left several expensive jewelry items in her hotel room. When she got home and called the Doubletree, the staff located the jewelry quickly, and it was shipped to our daughter by mid week. We will definitely stay there again!

review_title: It has now been 5 weeks since we stayed at this hotel 1 night but were charged for two! And I still don't have my money back!!!!
review_text: During our stay there, the front desk was so rude! They do not have the continental breakfast that they advertised either!
hotel_name: Ramada Inn and Conference Center Qualcomm Stadium

review_text:
We booked rooms at the hotel for a group of more than hundred people. Given our keys, we went to our rooms and found out that there were people staying at the rooms that they had given us. When we told that to the reception we had the second shock. The staff at the reception desk were extremely rude and were not helpful at all (aa if it was our mistake). They told us that all the rooms were booked! It took them over an hour to sort it out and some of us had to share our rooms. 
It is a nice hotel with large and comfortable rooms but because of the staff I'd say I'd never ever stay there again.

We were able to priceline this room and got a great deal. The room was clean and nicely decorated, I wish it had a fridge but we lived without one. Just like previously stated reviews the parking garage is a nightmare, insanely narrow turns and tight spaces, was glad to be in a car. Parking was 22 a night which is typical in a city like this. But the service was good, we had no issues. The little Italy Market was right outside on Sat. Mornings and that was a lovely surprise. For the price we paid we would definately stay gain.

Stayed at the Doubletree for 6 nights. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The location was great. Our room was very quiet and clean. We prepaid for our room and got a great rate and free breakfast (which was very good..hot and cold buffet). I would definitely stay here again.

Given that I stayed only for 1 night while on a business trip...I don't think there was anything special about this hotel. parking is $12 per night and the basement spots are really tight! The really annoying things are trains that pass by at night (with loud horns)

If you like a smaller more intimate hotel instead of a mega convention style hotel, this is a great option. Right there in the gas lamp district so walking to all the restaurants and shopping are at your doorstep. Convention center is right across the street And you. An hear the trolley drive by outside your window.

Isn't California the meca of information technology ? So why only wifi in the lobby ? And the cable internet is not Vpn friendly. So I lost a day of work, but i was able to discover the gaslamp district. Well located for that purpose.

If you have no choice in hotel, squint your eyes, and stay out of your room as much as you can, this hotel will be just OK. The room was very small, spartan, and just had the feeling of not clean. They give you a rack on the wall to hang cloths, because the closet is the bathroom. The mini sink is a joke, and when you bend down to rinse your mouth, your back side hits the wall or pokes into the stall they call a shower. You can not get out of the shower stream, note no tub, even when the temp does it's random changes from ice to steam. I could not soap below the waist without getting out of the shower. The bed was a bit short, which it needed to be, because all that was left in the room was a walkway around the bed. The elevators are very quaint and historic. Which means small. They also require two hands to deal with the spring loaded doors. Lots of fun with luggage.

review_title: Best place we have lived/found since the beginning of our road trip
review_text: Our host, Jayson, did a great job. We have appreciated his advises (restaurants to go, must-seen in Diego, etc.) and his kindness. He was answering all our questions with a smile. Thx to you, bro.

Stayed here for convention which was conveniently located across the street. The Gaslamp quarter is fabulous and the Hilton is well located for great adventures in shopping and eating . Wonderful service and the housekeeping staff exceptional.
The downside for me at this hotel was its location next to the train tracks. Earplugs (provided) didnt help. Also pets are allowed in this hotel. There were some barking issues my first night. Lastly , the fitness room was not big enough for a hotel this size. 1 stationary bike, 2 treadmills and an elliptical, and weights. If you like to run, no problem as the outdoors around here is beautiful. So be well informed if you stay here. It's a great location and lovely rooms. Just know there are other factors to consider.

We stayed here for 3 nights recently. Hotel is approx 20-30 mins walk to Gaslamp Quarter but overlooking the bay opposite the maritime museum (a lovely sail boat). Rooms are clean and well maintained with coffee making facilities and daily maid service. Continental breakfast was included as was a shuttle service to the airport. Staff extremely friendly and willing to help out. Nice pool and mini gym. Would definitely recommend to others. Would be even better if it had a bar!

We stayed at this hotel for 6 nights during a tennis tournament. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Our room was comfortable and clean. My only complaint would be the room and bathroom were a little small. Unique to the hotel are the twin elevators from 1913 and the amazing 360 rooftop view of San Diego!

review_title: Friendly hotel walking distance to many San Diego areas
review_text: We have just left Hampton Inn Downtown after 5 night stay and other than a hiccup at checkout ( could not find paperwork that showed we had prepaid room so going to be charged again) our visit was great. This hotel has the friendliest staff - Nate on front desk as well as another lovely lady who caught up with us at end of each day to see how we were going. Hotel is walking distance to waterfront, Little Italy, Seaport and Gaslamp Quarter. Hotel shuttle can be booked for airport transfers and zoo. All free - Chuck the driver is such a lovely guy and very friendly. Hot breakfast every morning - range of cold and hot food (loved being able to make own waffles!) 24hr coffee in breakfast area (with hazelnut or French vanilla flavored milk) and microwave available once breakfast over. Chocolate chip cookies are served on front desk each afternoon. Train noise as stated in previous reviews is noticeable but you do get used to it and ear plugs provided. To be honest we were so busy walking and seeing San Diego that we were very tired by time we got to bed anyway. Great choice of restaurants nearby - try Petrini's for great Italian at very reasonable prices and fantastic service. This hotel offers a personalized service to its guests with reasonable rates and great location.

review_title: Great, historical hotel in a great neighborhood.
review_text:
Pros:
- charming old school historical hotel. Check out the lifts! 
- centrally located in the gas lamp district where most of e tourist attractions are (within walking distance). The San Diego zoo is just 5 - 10 mins away by car (not walkable). 
- the restaurant (brians 24) is great. Check out their weekday mega breakfasts man. Otherwise, head a few blocks down to Richard walkers pancake house
Cons:
- parking's super expensive: 20 bucks for valet. Street Parkin is difficult to find and expensive as well. There are various private garages around e hotel that offer differing rates but it all works out to be more costly than e hotel valet. 
Overall: would definitely stay again. We have no complaints about this hotel. Staff were all very friendly and helpful too, which is more than I can say for a lot of hotels with a similar star rating.

The rooms are not very well insulated and not well maintained. We could barely close the pocket door to the bathroom with 2 people and the faucet handle was loose. We were able to hear people walking by the room and talking. The parking spaces are small and tightly spaced. It's very difficult to park a full size truck. Not worth the price just to be close to Seaworld.
hotel_name: Wyndham Garden San Diego near SeaWorld

review_text: El sitio esta ubicado en una zona tranquila y no esta mal de precio. Tiene necesidades bÃ¡sicas cerca: Gasolineras, 7 Eleven, etc. AdemÃ¡s se puede dormir tranquilo, tiene parkig propio, y cine de verano. En San Diego es una buena Opcion.

review_title: Looks good till you look a little closer
review_text:
Just the fact that I'm writing a review is an indication that there is a problem with this hotel because I have never before found the need to review a hotel. 
Overall I suggest you look elsewhere to stay of you can afford it and want a quality hotel. 
The first day at this hotel after taking a nap I get off my bed only to have the frame collapse, leaving the bed displaced. The nicer of the 2 tvs did not work at all so it must have been just for show. The working tv had bad reception. The tiles in the bathroom were loose and the drain looked horrific. The sinks water stopper was closed and the button to raise it was missing so I had to pry it open. I had asked to move to another room after all this was noticed but they were sold out so they could only offer to send maintainace for the sink. 
The only pros to this place are yay they at least had a small fridge and microwave. 
The only reason I can imagine people stay here is they it's cheaper then the other nearby places (for a reason).
hotel_name: Wyndham Garden San Diego near SeaWorld

review_title: Amazing stay with stellar customer service!
review_text: We arrived slightly early but Nytsa was able to readily accommodate us in the loft jacuzzi suite we had reserved. The suite was very well appointed and spacious. The setting provided us with a great street view outside. Unlike others who complained about the train noise, we slept peacefully and weren't bothered at all by any noises. Would definitely recommend this place and it will be my "go to spot" in San Diego from now on!
everything was great except my kids were cut on their feet from the swimming pool. otherwise it was very relaxing

I am a frequent business traveler and prefer Hampton Inn and Hilton Garden Inn. Great amenities for the price. This location was consistent with my expectations, except the train noise cannot be ignored. There are sound abatement options this hotel should consider. I don't know if I'd stay again. The staff was very nice, though.

review_title: Reservations do not mean anything to the front desk employees at mission plaza hotel and suites
review_text:
Missed a connecting flight to san Diego, so I immediately contacted the hotel letting them know that we would be arriving later, we booked the room as a packaged deal with Expedia.com. they told me that since the room was already paid for I could check in at anytime. When I arrive at 9am I was told that our room was given away, and the next available room would not be ready until after 3pm.
The cleanliness of the property is sub par, though the lobby does look nice.
The staff was disinterested in my concerns, and borderline rude.
I will be letting wyndham know that this location is definitely not indicative of what I envisioned that brand to be.
hotel_name: Wyndham Garden San Diego near SeaWorld

review_text: I have been staying here both during business trips and in private and this hotel is perfect either way! Staaf is skilled and polite, rooms are nice, free internet, complementory breakfast and nearby the sea, trolleys, buses and walking distance to Gaslamp District. I highly recommend this hotel

The convenience of the hotel from train, shops, restaurants is fantastic. But...I would never spend that amount of money on the hotel again (unless there was a deal). If you expect an amazing spacious room with a large bathroom, you're in for a disappointment. The room is very plain (putting it nicely), and the bathroom is no bigger than a closet. Please look at the pictures from the hotel and you'll see what I mean. If you're simply staying for conferences then i'm sure this hotel will "suit" your basic needs. But if you're a 30's couple like us who enjoy a nice comfortable hotel, then don't waste your time. The bed was king size and very comfy. However the maid service will only change your sheets every 4 days or when you check out. If you require more frequent change of linen, then don't forget to leave the card on your pillow. 
I do have to say that the front desk/
concierge service was great! They were very accommodating when I asked for a room facing away from the convention center/train. The train goes by very often at night and it can be hard to sleep (they do provide you with earplugs, but this won't help unless you're a deep sleeper. We were celebrating a romantic honeymoon/getaway, and were warmly treated by the staff! Thank you! Other than that, the hotel is just average. If you're expecting the same level of quality and style as from other hilton hotels, you're going to be disappointed. I would spend the extra money on a sheraton 4star hotel and get the impeccable level of quality hotel service/hospitality as you would staying at a fairmount hotel.

review_title: Great Location with no service and trains blowing horns
review_text:
Loved the location of this hotel. That's about it. 
The room us ok. But the trains run right next to the hotel all night blowing it's horn. When we checked in they didn't have any doubles so we politely asked for a roll away bed. We called 3 times since the first request and 3 hours later we still didn't have it. 
Honestly, we pay so much, how hard is it to get a roll away bed when you couldn't accommodate our request for doubles. If I were paying less than $150 per night, this would not be a problem but it's not the case.

For perspective, I spend around 100 nights per year in hotels and Hilton gets just over half that business. 
The Gaslamp is directly across from the San Diego convention center. It's a two minute walk so if you're in town for a convention the location is ideal. It's also on the right side of harbor drive, in the Gaslamp district, and within just a few blocks of many Zagat rated restaurants as well as nightlife hotspots. 
I stayed at the Lofts which is next door to the main Hilton. The Lofts are a little weird in terms of getting in/out. From the main lobby you must go up one floor then outdoors across a courtyard then into a second elevator then inside again and down the hall to your room. The Lofts rooms/suites, however, are excellent. Some have a nice outdoor terrace overlooking the courtyard and convention center. The Lofts has the feel of an upscale boutique hotel and it's a quiet respite from a long day conventioneering. 
My only complaints here are the lack of a gift shop or other place one could purchase water, soda/beer, and sundries. The room rates are also rather high, but in line with other high end hotels in the area.

review_title: A good Hilton property in a great location
review_text: I'm sure most people who stay at this Gaslamp District hotel are conventioneers for an event across the street at the San Diego Covention Center. My wife and I came for a holiday break between Christmas and New Years. It wasn't crowded, but was pleasantly busy. Our room, 637, was recently remodeled and had a comfortable bed. My only complaint was the lack of wireless Internet in the room. Nearby railroad noise was not an issue for us, but if you are sensitive to noise, ask for a quiet room.

review_title: Very convenient hotel to convention center.
review_text: This hotel is located across the main entrance of the conv. ctr. Cannot more convenient than that. Overall a good hotel. I stayed there during a conference I was attending. Breakfast was provided due to our co being a hilton honors gold member. Good breakfast, but not really worth the money if you have to pay for it. Rooms were acceptable and clean. As for the noise from the train many prior reviewers have complained about, it all depends on the individual and if you are a light sleeper. It did not bother me at all and I did not use the ear plugs.

Stayed here for a quick 3days Christmas getaways with the kids. Amazing location from San Diego Zoo, Sea World, down town. There's also nearby restaurants to choose from if you dont want to eat in the hotel. 
The staff from the front desk, the bell man, housekeeping were very courteous. Always had that smile that welcomes you back.

Das Hotel befindet sich Herzen von Little Italy. Zu FuÃŸ nach Downtown / Gaslamp benÃ¶tigt man ca 20 Minuten. Empfehlenswert ist die Route am schÃ¶nen Hafen entlang zu nehmen, so kommt man zentral am Convention Center in Downtown an. Die Zimmer sind leider etwas klein, ansonsten aber sauber und in Ordnung. Beim Buchen muss man sich bewusst sein, ein Stadthotel zu buchen - LÃ¤rm ist da nunmal normal. Parken = 10$/Tag in der Tiefgarage.

review_title: Great location for convention center attendees
review_text:
Positives: location, fast room service, comfortable bed, soft sheets, friendly employees
Negatives: no minibar in room, wimpy shower pressure, poor selection of channels on tv, no wifi

review_title: If you have small children, be prepared to pay for a refigerator to keep their formula/ milk cold.
review_text: First off, I have stayed at several Hilton Hotels, and this one is the worst. This hotel charges for every single thing! They have ample self parking and it's $16 per day or $20 for valet. If you want a fridge (shouldn't it be standard at "Hilton" hotel?) it is $10 per day. If you have small children, be prepared to pay for a refigerator to keep their formula/ milk cold. There is free wifi in the lobby, but if you want to use the Internet at the convenience in your own room, there is also a charge for that. The night staff was appropriate, but they weren't accommodating enough to provide customer satisfaction. So after spending three nights here, my total alone for the extra amenities without tax was $78(not including wifi and tax). One would assume that if you're paying $129 plus tax a night for a three in a half or four star hotel, parking, refrigerator, and wifi in the room would be included. I guess not for this Hilton. Next time I'll be sure to read the fine print of amenities included, but for sure, I will not be returning to this hotel.

i've stayed at this hotel twice. each time the hotel staff, including the bar staff were wonderful. room was always clean. i do agree the cost for parking is high but majority hotels charge the same rate or higher. i will definitely be back.

There are great places to stay in Mission Valley but this is not the one. As a gold Hilton member normally some perks are provided - not here. 2 cups of coffee in the morning $6! They use to provide to hotel guest for free. Lots of parking in Mission Valley but they insist on charging $16 for self-parking. They told me they would wave the fee but low and behold it showed up on the bill anyway. Rooms are nice but a very bizarre layout. Must have been designed by someone who does not stay at hotels. Back to the Doubletree a block away we go...
Very nice place to stay. I would rent a car taxi to high! Would stay again.

review_title: Don't expect good service in the bar
review_text: Stayed seven nights for conference. Got a nice room with a view west down the valley. Got brekkie and lunch and tons of snacks for our breaks - all very good. Only complaint is the really poor service in the bar. It seemed that one drink was the limit and food not something the staff was interested in.

The place to stay if you are going to a CHARGERS game! The stadium is two stops down on the trolly line. Check in took 45 seconds, friendly staff, good breakfast and best of all the Chargers won! We will definitely stay there again.

My family and I enjoyed this hotel. I booked two rooms, one king room and one double room. The rooms were very clean (as they should be). The sinks are outside the bathroom which is kind of motelish but I didn't mind. We loved the balcony! We had a view of the pool. The pool area was loaded with families and at night they played a movie poolside. this is great for families but if you're single or on business you might not get to enjoy the pool. Since we booked early I got a good price with free full breakfast included so book early! The only negative is that not all rooms have a fridge so you must request it! Overall pretty good. I had no problems. Parking is $14 this expected and the closer you are to the city the more you will pay!

We've stayed here twice while in San Diego to catch a Charger's game. It's the perfect location for football fans. The trolley stop is right behind the hotel, which makes it convenient to leave your car in the hotel parking lot to head to Qualcomm Stadium, Old Town, Gas Lamp District, or anywhere else the trolley stops.
After a game, you can skip the long trolley line and walk back to the hotel, which is less than a mile and a half from the stadium.
We wouldn't stay anywhere else on a game weekend.

review_title: Bad management! Shame to Hilton Hotel
review_text: NO AIRCONDiTION on my room! And supposedly it is not. Enough reason for them to transfer me! So what, if you dont have available room? You have to compensate better for your flaw! The rate i paid is for a room with A/C not with a fan. Since you are not meeting the expectation, you should do something abt it! I was sweating!!!in a Hilton Hotel! My car is even cooler than the room! Very bad management! I didnt come here for the food so no need to offer the breakfast! I paid for a nice room not a room with MAlFUnCtIon aircondition and a NOISY electric fan! So demeaning!!!

review_title: Okay..but poor location if you don't have a car
review_text: Rooms felt a bit outdated and coffeepot was dirty and not usable, you can't really walk to anything from the hotel so unless you have a car, not a great location. Service was friendly though!
Hilton in Mission Valley is my second home away from home. Very accessible to freeways and shopping malls and restaurants. The hotel is clean and staff are always friendly and helpful.

review_title: Mislead with information from Hyatt Sutterfield
review_text: I reserved a 1 room suite and when I arrived, I was told by manager that guest who stayed night before wanted another night when hotel was sold out and California law forbids them from removing someone from room. Relative is GM of a hotel told me that not law, that I was bumped because I was on travel agent discount rate and they were paying full rate stay for holiday weekend. I was bumped a handicap room and WAS NOT comped for it, instead half off room rate and points. I drove 500 miles and had guests who had to have their kids sleep on floor with no pillows!!! Also, kids running up and down halls and when I spoke to someone about it, I was told that security was there to handle it but I never saw security during my stay. Sunday breakfast room was understaffed. I saw manager( yes the same manager) working the floors along with maintenance personal. Coffee, plates and silverware were constantly being waited on. As an independent travel agent as well as a regular visitor to San Diego to see family, I couldn't possibly recumbent this hotel to family or clients. 1st impression is a bad one.
Ok for solo biz travel but neither inviting nor accommodating for family.

We stayed in this Hotel for four days and my Kids and we loved it. The Swimmingpool and the jacuzzi were very clean. We loved the absolutly gorgeus soft beds like sleeping in a cloud. The fitness room has new machines. It is very close to the beach. Parking is 18 Dollar.

review_title: Nice hotel for static comforts but no warmth
review_text:
Staff is not courteous
Taps do not provide warm water which is a major concern
Service staff throws away all that is used and kept outside without questions, so beware of what is kept on ur tables of ur rooms
Breakfast is shallow for a star hotel
San Diego es un ciudad muy bonita y este hotel no lo hace ver tanto. No estÃ¡ muy bien ubicado y no es nada bonito. Existen muy buenos hoteles que les harÃ¡n tener un viaje distinto
Terrible, don't know how they got 3 stars, the guy who gave it to them must be high on something becoz this is a motel not a hotel and there was construction during our stay which made it worse!

We stayed here for my 40thbirthday because the Bar we had my birthday at is across the street, no drinking and driving for us. We rented 9 rooms and we were all satisfied. Great breakfast in the morning. Old Hollywood greats used to
Stay here back in the day, frank Sinatra, Ava Gardner, Bon hope, marylin Monroe. Newly remodeled!!!

review_title: Bien situe avec la qualite Best Western...
review_text: Bien que l'acceuil fut tres moyen, les receptionnistes du matin furent par contre tres sympas. Hotel assez imposant et avec beaucoup de chambres qui le rendent assez bruyant. Pas de PDJ inclus dans le prix comme dans tous les BW ayant un restaurant. Je vous recommande vivement le petit resto famillial tout pres pour le petit dejeuner ou le diner qui est tres bien et a 500m de l'hotel. Bien situe entre downtown/Sea World/Zoo le long d'une Interstate, donc facile a trouver. Bon rapport qualite/prix.

La nostra camera aveva una serie di problemi la prima sera in cui siamo arrivati.
La manopola del water si staccava e le lampade vicino al letto(entrambe) non volevano spegnersi.
Detto questo in reception ci siamo trovati il giorno successivo con la manopola del water malamente riattaccata e le lampade portate via senza nemmeno una in sostituzione.
