We booked the hotel because the price was reasonable ($89) and the picture made everything look amazing. Who wouldn't want to stay in a hotel that looked like it was taken from a plantation in the South and transplanted in San Diego? That was far from what it was! The hotel is right on a main road in the middle of "the ghetto". They were under construction so the entire front was covered in scaffolding. The room was musty smelling. The beds were horrible. Like sleeping on a box spring. There were burn holes in the bed spread (and we were in a non-smoking room). The pillows were old and lumpy. The bathroom was the worst part. Toilets that hardly flushed and the faucet leaked when you tried. I expected much more for almost $100.

L'hotel Ã¨ ottimamente posizionato e frequentato da una clientela molto giovane amante della musica e dello svago\ sballo.
Abbiamo assistito a sciami di giovani che presidiano semi ubriachi la piscina e le zone circostanti e che tra una vodka e l'altra passavo il tempo impedendo un normale fruire di questo spazio comune preso d'assalto il venerdÃ¬ sera da scalmanati ventenni alla ricerca di divertimento le camere belle il wifi perÃ² a pagamento obbligatorio nel pacchetto servizi dell'hotel.
Tuttavia l'ambiente festaiolo e il mare di San Diego ben si addicono a passare qualche giorno in questo hotel

Molto soddisfatta della sistemazione! Albergo situato in una posizione centralissima del quartiere gaslamp vicino a bar pab e ristoranti e negozi! Albergo in stile retro' con Camere pulite con ottima visuale al 9 piano. Personale molto gentile sempre pronto ad aiutarti! C'e il wifi in camera cosa non da poco. PiÃ¹ navetta gratuita che ti porta all'aeroporto!

review_title: Nice place for a short stay.
review_text: I just stayed here for 2 nights. The location and view are great. The rooms are small but clean and they do have balconies. The beds and pillows are mediocre however. They do have good prices though and a fun pub with good food and prices. The pool area is small but clean. I wouldn't stay here for a week but it's good for a few days.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Diego - On The Bay

review_text:
Third time staying at this hotel and it just needs a clean sweep. The hallways and room carpets are quite dirty and stained so I suggest bringing a pair of flip-flops.
Pro's:
Great location, nice restaurant/bar with happy hour and a great patio, front desk staff is knowledgeable about the area.
Con's:
Elevators are unreliable, carpets dirty, no desk in the room only a round table with no outlets, sink drainage problems, very tired room decor and balcony doors don't seal so noise and air rushes in.
In summary if they just spent sometime taking care off the place it would be a pretty good hotel.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Diego - On The Bay

review_title: If it wasn't for the personnel...
review_text: Smells bad, as if the pipes were rotten, or stink water is everywhere in the corridor and room. It's noisy with pipe "clink" sounds and neighbors bathroom. Personnel is great, and that is why I don't put a 1 but a 2. I would't repeat for the third part it's cost.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Diego - On The Bay

review_text:
Stayed two nights with and enjoyed the area although a little seedy at night. Beds were comfortable and living room was extremely cramped with the tv strangely positioned by the rooms door. First morning the shower didn't work! It just dripped water!! How could nobody have noticed this??? Engineer came right up but took 40 min to fix and we had to run shower-less.
Zack and Shasha in the bar were awesome!!! We stopped by to see them every evening and really put a positive spin on our stay.

It's a budget hotel but this one is exceptionally bad. No safe , no fridge and no ice bucket in the rooms. It's old and run down, from door locks to the lift, everything is falling apart. If you're on the side that's facing town then expect none stop train and traffic noise all night long. Lots of young party goers who cant afford a proper hotel in town stay here. They come in and out of the rooms in the middle of the night and you can hear every word they say because of the paper thine walls. 
On the plus side, they offer free shuttle to the zoo, Gaslamp District and the airport. They also have free wifi which is very handy I have to say. 
But overall it's half a star at best. For the same price stay at the Hilton Gaslamp District, save yourself trouble from dealing with unhappy staff and slow moving queues at the lobby, and to have a good night sleep with real pillows.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Diego - On The Bay

review_title: Excellent service, rooms are comfy but worn
review_text:
Stayed here twice in a week: once for a pre-conference getaway with my husband and once for a conference. 
Pros: excellent service; comfy room (loved the couch!); great views, and overall pretty well appointed; great robes (if you get a new one); great access to the local train.
Cons: room is very worn, especially around the shower the drawers in the bedroom, which were falling apart; old-school tube TV in the bedroom, so when I switched from the OFF in the LR, the picture quality looked all the more worse; the only gave *one* robe in the club rooms, so my husband and I didn't get our own...WTH? Finally, I hate the Sheraton gives you glass drinking glasses in the living room, but plastic in the bathroom. Be consistent!
Last comment: after you check out, if the send you a survey about your stay, don't bother doing it. They sent one to me and I shared all my comments above and I haven't heard one peep.

review_title: Good suites hotel, except housekeeping needs improvement
review_text: We reserved 2 rooms for 3 nights. Both rooms were comfortable & well appointed, concierge services were friendly & knowledgeable, valet services were courteous & efficient. Convenient location to Balboa Park, Gaslamp district & freeways. Wished that housekeeping was better. Carpets were not vacuumed adequately, empty water bottles from the previous guests were never taken away, used beverage glasses were left by the door, bathroom was not dusted, etc.
Large very roomy suites. Great price for AAA members over $100 off. I've stayed before and will come again.

We were there just for four days before boarding our cruise so ,we didn't want to spend a lot of money. For only $75 p/night we got a nice room with a view to the marina. The location was perfect (ten minutes driving to downtown or the old town, twenty minutes to La Jolla, less than ten to the airport, ten to the cruise terminal, etc) People were very friendly, always smiling and helping you with everything you need and with the continental breakfast included (coffee, fruit juices, cereal, yogurt, toasts, bagles,etc) you don't need anything else. But if that is not enough, you have coffee for free the whole day in the reception area. If I have to be in San Diego again, I'll be here again. Even the parking is included!

We had a view of the bay because we were on top floor overlooking bay Hotel does not sit on the water it is accross the street from the Harbor The breakfast was good. I thought the bed was hard, fluffy pillows. We were caught in the 12 hr blackout, the staff was very helpful it was not a bad stay, but probably would stay on one of the islands

From the time we arrived I felt like I was inconviening the staff. We arrived late on a weeknight & the person behind the desk didnt even stand up to welcome us he sat the whole time while checking us in. We went to our room the last one in the hall & the lock was broken, I did not feel safe with my children with a broken dead bolt, Not to mention I couldn't sleep because I felt like I was sleeping outside, the traffic noise was non stop. I mentioned this to the front desk & asked if I could be moved away from the street 
& they said they could move us 6 rooms away I even offered to pay more for an upgrade but was told there was no room . When we got back to the hotel We were told they could only move us 2 rooms away. This is not what I was told & expressed concern but the front desk did not seem to care. I usually have no problems with Best Westerns, but this one I will mot return to.
Staff clueless. Beds small (queens? Don't think so). Near nothing. Beach just a jetty really. Rooms older, missing things. Room service failed us more than once. Not a 4-star experience whatsoever.

Small rooms, old single pane Windows, noise from the street as well as room above made it really hard to sleep. although the Pub next door offered free food for kids, we did not like the food. We checked out a day early.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Diego - On The Bay

review_title: Thanks umit, zach, esmerelda, Terese, lauren and Gustavo
review_text: Excellent service. For an older hotel once a marriott property, guests can take advantage of large rooms, largw flat panel TVs and an excellent bar.

review_title: Decent and cheap but way too noisy
review_text: The hotel was okay and the price and location were great, but there was an incredible amount of noise coming from the street and the airport, and the design of the hotel really exacerbates this issue. I really can't recommend staying here unless you're a very sound sleeper.

review_title: In the end a decent stay
review_text: On arrival we were given room 208 which was in the far corner, we put our bags in the room after a long drive and decided to head into San Diego for something to eat. Returning later I decided to close the curtains ready for bed but noticed the window had no lock and the outside panel had been tampered with, my immediate thought was somebody had been in but luckily that was not the case. I demanded a room change as we did not feel secure and to the hotels credit they eventually upgraded us to a better family size room with no extra cost and we went on to enjoy our stay in a great city.

For starters we booked this thru expedia as a myhstery hotel.so we got it for 37 bucks a night.that's the good part. This hotel is a step above,or below a motel 6. The normal rate is in the 70's.if you stay here don't pay this. The location is pretty good.close to mission beach airport and places to eat. Rooms are small and BR is smaller then a closet in your house. My wife did find some trash by the night stand.the mgmt did give our family of 4 dinner on the house@the restaurant. The waffle spot for breakfast was good a little pricy but it hit the spot. All in all its an old motel that hasn't been updated in a few decades

review_title: Cheap price for a road trip.
review_text: We went for a road trip to San Diego coming from L.A. For the weekend stay. Staff were friendly and helpful. The rooms were cosy. Bathroom were small. Im a wide advarage man and Had to lean to the side for the door to open due to the toilet bein right next to door. Need to upgrade for a bigger tv but didn't complain due to having cable. There's not alot of power outlet to charge you phone, computer, camera, ect. Room was clean but had a old smell like Trappicana from Las Vegas good thing I brought my scented candel. The pool was great and as well as the jaquzi. Might have to bring your beach towel. The pool towel are a bit rough. Make sure you eat at the waffle spot for breakfast. The Kigns in was a good place to stay at. Not to far from the city. If your looking for a 5 star hotel you have to Search for something else but if your looking for a decent price to stay in San Diego for that weekend road trip this is the place for you.

review_title: Pretty nice looking aged in places, expensive parking, slow internet, no HBO
review_text:
Hotel consists of a tower and some condo style rooms. Stopping in building 500 we have a top floor condo room. Room itself is very nice, fridge, microwave, large flatscreen tv, balcony with garden view. Seems strange, but no HBO - i guess they want you to spend the $16 on a movie instead.
The walls in the hallway could do with a touch of paint in places and the tiled floor areas at both ends of the building were dirty.
There is no buffet for breakfast and the coupons are good or a continental breakfast which is very limited in what you can get. Otherwise prices seem to be standard.
Hotel grounds are very nice as is the pool area. It is heated, but all that really means is that it is not cold, so its too cold to be using this time of year.
Happy hour at the olive is great, cheep drinks and food too. The pizza we had last night was good and was much larger than expected for the $10.
Parking: i dont know why they are charging people so much for parking... Its not like people are going to come here witout a car - just seems like a hidden fee. This s why they get a low rating in value for money.
Overall, nice place and would come back again.

review_title: Best value in SD- Good location, newly renovated rooms, free breakfast, free parking!
review_text:
We stayed over Memorial Day weekend 2011. 
Great place to be in San Diego if you have a car. Will certainly come back here for a weekend getaway.. 
We arrived at 7:30 pm and were delighted to see ample parking free of charge, and were greeted with coffee in the clean looking lobby. Attendant lady hurried to finish up the other traveler so she can help us - great work ethics despite the hour of day.
Hotel looks like it was recently renovated - overall clean outside and in with bright hallways and convenient laundryroom (not sure if on every floor) . Room has comfortable beds, modern decor with both fridge and microwave, and bathroom was ok. We stayed on second floor room 201 facing the parking partial harbor view. It's kind of noisy but after a long day full of activities we had no trouble sleeping at all. 
Breakfast - continental plus fresh do-it-yourself waffles. Two waffle makers but lines can be long. There's a big juice machine and variety of coffee. I like that the breakfast time here spans from 6 am - 10 am - very nice.

TC and William front desk agents very helpful and professional. Give them a raise. Room attendants were very acommodating as well. Restaurant service was just ok. Food was excellent but very limited menu. Loved our room 503 with great view of mission bay and Sea World. I will recommend this hotel to family and friends. Thank you.

This was a top of the line hotel....about 15 years ago. Good location, close to everything, parking is $30 so plan accordingly. Small pool and hot tub. Nice staff, but this is a better hotel for business and not for taking the kids to Sea World.

review_title: This is a run down "resort" and should not be a Hilton.
review_text: We stayed here on points (120,000+ for two nights) and not do that again. A waste of points as other Hiltons in the area are less expensive. The room was dated and had an odor and this was a higher priced bay view deluxe. Thd patio screen door was falling off and thd patio curtains were falling off. There was trash and left over room service in the hall for days. I had to call at 4 because my room was not maid up. The pool area was unmanned and no where to get a drink or lunch at the "resort" pool. The chaises were mostly broken and pool towels were never available. I've stayed at both downtown Hiltons and they are much better quality and service. I left here and went to the Hotel Del Coronado. Now that's a resort. I wish I knew better as you do now do I didn't waste my valuable points!

We originally booked two queens (only room available upon booking) with the hopes of getting a king upon arrival. The staff was awesome, offering us a suite upgrade! Thanks T.C.! You were the cherry on top of our romantic weekend! Would definitely return.

review_title: This hotel would not be my first choice.
review_text: Upon check in there were no cribs avail. The room did not come with a mini fridge as stated online, it was a mini bar that u couldnt store food in. We had to call and request a fridge. The wall paper was was out dated. There was also a tube tv in the bedroom.
Patricia in the gift shop went out of her way to help us

This resort is absolutely fabulous. From the resort itself to the staff everything was perfect. Ideal for a family vacation or my romantic getaway with my wife, I was very pleased with the special help of the manager Mr N. Villarino. Thanks for is extra care and kindness our honeymoon was a success.

review_title: Who rated this dump so well?
review_text:
I don't stay at many Sheratons, however the ones I have stayed at have been outdated, including this one.
The suite I had needed new paint and bathroom remodel. One TV was a flat screen and the other a big box old TV.
Stay at Hotel Indigo for less.

review_title: Great hotel with great service a few minutes outside of city! Need transportation to see sites.
review_text: I would go back when I have children because it is a close to zoo and city at same time making it easy to accommodate parents and children

As a business traveler, I look for a good location, nice comfortable room, food and service. This hotel has all the above!
I forgot my credit card and left for the airport. The Manager contacted me and drove to the airport to deliver the credit Card! This was above and beyond and I would highly recommend this hotel to business and family vacations!

review_title: An amazing stay, very friendly and helpful staff
review_text: We arrived and were warmly greeted by John at the reception desk. He was very helpful and put us into the 'honeymoon' suite which was very kind of him. Throughout our stay he was very helpful, he told us of places of interest and printed directions for us. We have had a great time in San Diego and have seen things we may have missed had it not been for his fantastic local knowledge. Thanks John!

We stayed 2 nights, overall had a good experience for the price paid per night $107. Some drawbacks no WIFI in the room, there is only complimentary WIFI in the lobby. Gaslamp quarter within walking distance. Great service, they called our cab for us and answered all our questions regarding restaurants and directions. Liked that computer stations in the lobby allowed you to print and the complimentary map was helpful. We used the valet service which was efficient.

review_title: Excellent value, location, & customer service at Comfort Inn Gas Lamp!!!
review_text: We had a great time at Comfort Inn Gas Lamp! It is an extremely convenient location for easy highway access to attractions & beaches as well as walking distance to local bars, restaurants, shopping, etc. The staff was consistantly prompt & friendly with us for the duration of our stay (5 nights). Parking is an additional fee, but with the affordable room rates it's still a great value. Rooms are not huge, but offer a fridge, microwave, free wi-fi, a nice size flat screen tv, & free hot breakfast daily. Overall we had an awesome time & would happily stay again in the future! We are very happy to have found such a great spot for first trip to San Diego.

I have had the pleasure of staying in lots of nice hotels. The ones that stand out the most are the ones with a caring and appreciative attitude from the staff. William at the front desk, has impeccable customer service skills and knows how to make guests feel welcome and want to come back as a repeat customer. Every time, I have visited, I have been fortunate enough to receive his excellent customer service attitude. He is kind, courteous, accommodating and very positive. 
Next time you are in time, stay at this resort and experience Williams gracious attitude!!!

review_title: Fantastic Customer Service and very relaxing
review_text: If I could give a 6 for customer service I would! Since we first walked into the door William the hotel supervisor has done everything he could to make our stay as easy and relaxing as possible. Mid way through the stay TC the concierge was able to set up our car rental and truly made it feel like a one stop shop. We just needed to show up and sign the papers.. This was my wife and I's 1 year anniversary and we couldnt have picked a better hotel to celebrate it in. To add to all the great service was that the hotel was kept up very well. There seemed to be no window left uncleaned or carpet left unvacummed. I could go on and on. So simply put , this hotel was a fantasic choice and I would recommend it to anyone !

A young lady named andrea who attended me she was very nice and helped me very well in the markt place. Even though she didnt talk spanish she helped us. She was friendly ,nice, loveable, attendable. If all the employees were like her this would be the best hotel of all san diego

review_title: Spend time in the area NOT the room
review_text: Spent one night at this hotel, upon arrival we were not greeted instead given a look of disapproval. Following check in we were told the paid parking was in the public carpark across the road without surveillance even though there were still spots available all night in the hotel carpark. Room is clean but very small basically there is only a foot around the bed available for moving around. Breakfast was included but we missed it as we were not informed it finished at 9.30am not the usual 10am industry standard. Checkout service was non existent, she was on the phone the whole time. Location is an A+++, shame about the service!!

review_title: Good place to Stay in San Diego
review_text: What I like of this Hotel is the service! The rooms that have been just remodeled and I like the decoration, the location and the breakfast ( Includes Do it your self waffles, cereal, pastries, juices, coffe and tea! The rooms facing Rosecrans street are noisier than the other rooms! You can walk to some restaurants, coffee shops and the marina! Also the price is lower in weekdays but I think is a fair price!

review_title: This resort is fun for us with adult children and for those with kids grandkids!
review_text: right from the start TC @ front desk was welcoming and went the extra mile. It took awhile for our room to be prepared... But it was worth it. Kudos to TC!!!!

Great stay at this hotel. It was a very very very small room compared to what I normally have but it was so clean, comfortable beds, friendly people and a very nice included breakfast.
I was very happy with my stay here. I think this staff is fantastic.
Spent 3 nights at hj great location close to sea world and zoo staff very friendly great Mexican resturant upstairs and would stay again
hotel_name: Howard Johnson Inn - San Diego Sea World / Airport

review_text: Loved everything about my stay. Went to sea world with the family and glad we ended up staying here. Free breakfast, which includes waffles, fresh fruit, pastries, yogurt, toast, oatmeal, and cereal. The rooms are very nice. We ended up staying on the third floor balcony looking at the harbor. Nice place to drink a cup of coffee in the morning. Checkout was fast and the nice gentleman was very helpful with our needs. Will be returning.

review_title: Best summer for family vacation in San Diego
review_text: We come down to this hotel twice a year. It has great service, clean large room and awesome location for family with young children. Bay or garden view in every room. Every room has a patio or fire pit. During summer we enjoy fireworks at SeaWorld which you can see from all hotel grounds. Daily activities for entire family to do. The marina has all the water sports for all ages. Kids spend every day on the beach which is less than 10 steps for some beach front rooms. Ask for TC when you check in, she is the BEST! Location and service are the reasons we keep coming back. Ask for TC at check in, Ryan at Marina and Ronald at the restaurant.

review_title: Great customer service (Alyssa) very pleasant resort when with kids, great restaurant (acqua)
review_text: We are frequent travelers (diamond) and have stayed in many Hilton resorts. The customer service by Alyssa at check-inn was outstanding. So went beyond and above to help us move into a great room for ourselves and our 3 little boys. And she did it with a big smile and never gave us the impression we were difficult. The resort has many amenities (tennis, spa, pool etc) and great activities (s'mores at the beach, movie night at the pool etc). The location of the hotel is close to sea world, balboa, zoo, gaslamp; but we actually spend quite some time at the resort itself because it was so pleasant and 'easy. We had a wonderful time and will for sure come back. And thanks Alyssa!!

review_title: Hilton San Diego Resort: Better than home, it's our Hawaii on the Mainland with GREAT service!
review_text: Our stay looks and feels like being on Maui except it's cooler and more relaxing. Why you ask? Because in Hawaii we always feel like we need to be out and about seeing things. At this resort Hilton we have it all - great rooms, our own fire pit (s'mores were good last night!), watching fireworks last night-from our patio, tennis this am And outstanding service from William at front desk - so helpful with all the details - thanks W!) And Jeffrey the bellman remembered us from previous years even calling my son by name - most impressive! At Hilton on Mission Bay... it's better than home!

review_title: Could be nice if it weren't one of the noisiest hotels I've ever stayed in.
review_text: Super inexpensive for the location. Updated, big rooms. Comfy beds. But the walls are PAPER thin. We heard absolutely every toilet use in the hotel and were woken at 4 am by commercial trucks backing up in front of the hotel and sounding that "beep, beep, beep" noise they do. We were also treated to a violent screamfest on the part of the person in the room next to us. We heard every single curse word and insult he lobbied at the person in the room with him. Lastly, the room service food was terrible. Cafeteria quality, at best.

We arrived, my wife, 2 year old daughter and myself, after spending 5 nights at a Sheraton hotel, and we initially impressed. Although we were not on their books, the front counter lady checked us in with no hassles. Room was nice, garden view villa. Very disappointed when we were asked to get out of the main pool as apparently children 4 years or younger are not allowed - yet this was not signed or advised by the Hotel when we booked ( and they were aware we were traveling with an infant) This took much of the 'shine' off our stay as spending most of our time in a pool with 1 ft of water in 30 degree heat isn't much fun ( for both the kids and the adults) I would suggest this is made much more obvious, particulary for families with young children - or don't bother allowing children to stay.

This was our 5th stay at this proptery, but the first in many years. We arrived and were given a room key, but never told that the room was on the second floor and there was no elevator. We had to phone the hotel to finally get assistance with luggage. At the time, the staff seemed clueless.
The next day, after learning that it is prohibited to bring even water bottles to the pool, we vented and our complaints we're immeditely given to the hotel manager, who came over to us. The manager, Greg, apologized, offered a free lunch, but more importantlynmade it clear that the situation would be addressed.
After that, the stay was beautiful. The staff treated us wonderfully, the facilities were excellent, although we know they can't install elevators. We scheduled and and a bellman at checkout, and overall had another wonderful visit. We will return, and this shows how making a complaint can be invaluable in getting a situation resolved and in learning how well we can be treated.

Great: The front desk was exceptional and I want to make the point that William the front desk supervisor is friendly, and knows his stuff. His personal attention to my needs made may stay enjoyable and we will definitely be back.
Additionally, the bar, Acqua, pool and beach personnel are all worth mentioning.
Okay: my wife's experience at the spa was okay. She wants to be pampered at a spa and she was left on her own and forced to fend for her self at times

My family's stay was fairly pleasant. There wasn't anything special about this hotel but the location. It was close to everything. You are about 7 miles from the zoo, 1 mile from Sea World, 7 miles from La Jolla Cove, 30 minutes from Legoland, 30 minutes from the best outlets Las Americas and about 10 minutes from downtown. Restaurants were also very close. The only two negative things about the hotel was the $25 a night parking and the dirty toilet in our room. It was filthy in places people can't tell unless they really look. Breakfast buffet was $20.95. I think that is a bit pricey for eggs. The grounds were lovely and the weather was pleasant. Tip: skip the zoo if you have a zoo at home. It is just like a regular zoo, nothing special. La Jolla Cove is a must. It is not far and it is beautiful. You are able to view seals. Don't forget your gps. You will never get lost.

Hilton San Diego Resort grounds are beautiful... The 1st room we had for my husband handicap accessibility was kind of small...he could move around to well in his wheel chair...I went to the front desk and talked with TC the counter clerk...she is an awesome "LADY"....she relocated us to another room which was bigger and she made sure my husband had a bath chair for the shower plus a higher toilet seat to help him get up without extra struggles... for it not to be handicap "TC" help turn it into ONE for the comfort of my husbands needs!!! I rate her a 5 star...everyone at this hotel was very nice...thanks also to the other clerk who gave us a discount on parking...

Nel complesso ottima sistemazione. Pulito, centrale e provvisto di parcheggio. Colazione classica dei motel californiani: caffÃ¨; thÃ©; muffin; cereali ecc, perÃ³ in piedi nella piccola hall. La posizione Ã© comoda nei pressi di down town e con la vista del museo marittimo. Pulito e camere accoglienti sempre in relazione al prezzo. Solo un Po rumoroso a causa della vicinanza alla stazione e all'aeroporto.

review_title: Great family getaway but room was lacking in the details
review_text: We enjoyed our experience at the Hilton as a family (kids 11 & 7). Pool is good, fun enormous checkers games, beach and yummy mojitos. Ate at the resort and food was good. Our room, however, looked nice as we walked in but after spending time there, noticed that the table was pretty beat up, the upholstered headboard had half the brass studs missing on one side, the closet was the old closet doors only with updated handles. It's a nice resort but I think lacking when you consider it is a 4-star with a $250/night plus $25 parking fee.

We are staying here at the moment and have stayed in quite a few in the area over the last couple of years and cannot believe some of the bad reviews written we have found the staff courteous and helpful the room is spotless fantastic shower in the room with lovely fluffy clean towels breakfast is good and good location what more can you ask for???
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn San Diego Mission Valley

review_text: The front desk people are liars! First we booked thru the web and never informed us of the parking fee for $25???? So we talked to one of the front desk lady and she told us she'll Just charge us $25 for 2 nights We just complied and out of trust we nod. When we checked out, we were surprised to see that they still charged us 25/night! We talked to this guy WILLIAM at the front desk and told us he'll call the lady that we spoke to about the discount and he just acted as if he was calling but actually did not!!! Please stay away from these LARS!!!

Stayed at Days Hotel Circle for 3 nights, I didn't need to rent a car because they have an excellent hotel shuttle service and very informative and professional drivers to take u to Seaworld, the zoo, and other attractions near by. Old Town Trolley tours stop right in front to pick u up for your tour or you can catch the #88 bus to Old Town which is the transportation hub to all the major attractions. Our room was clean when we arrived, and plenty of towels, and mini fridge and coffee maker. The only thing we found strange was the curtain situation in the room, we couldnt figure out why the main curtain could not be closed, so we just used a scrunchy to close them. It can also be ko
Kinda noisy if u are on the upper floors. The check in process may take a little time but they are friendly so it didn't bother me. I would definitely stay again.
hotel_name: Days Hotel - Hotel Circle by SeaWorld

review_text: Stopped for 1 night which turned into extra night due to unexpected vehicle problem but chose to stay here rather than seek another place. Very friendly desk staff.
hotel_name: Days Hotel - Hotel Circle by SeaWorld

review_title: They have rules, but are not willing to enforce them. They have policies, but don't abide by them.
review_text: I have traveled extensively the last 25 years, throughout the U.S., for business and pleasure. I usually stay at similarly priced establishments. This is my third trip to San Diego, and the one and only time at this Days Inn. My daughter-in-law made the reservations because she heard it was an ok place to stay. I can tell you that in all my traveling, averaging 23 trips each year, this is the second worst establishment (a motel in Alvin, Texas, being the worst), that I have ever had the displeasure of staying at. We were told that check-in was 4:00 p.m., but when we arrived at 3:40 p.m., we were greeted by a line of 12 people, some of which were already checking in. My daughter-in-law asked for first floor rooms,but upon checking in, they said all the lower rooms were taken. The persons who clean the rooms are not consistent with their duties. We stayed three days and nights, and only on the day we checked in, did we have sufficient towels and washcloths (one set per guest). One night we chose to go to the pool for some relaxing time with my son, who had graduated earlier in the day, from U.S.M.C. Recruit Depot San Diego. When we got to the pool, at 9:15p.m., we counted 22 children, and 4 adults in the area. On a sign mounted by the hottub, it stated that persons under the age of 14 were not permitted in the hottub. When I contacted the front desk, they did not know there was a sign, let alone an age limit. They stated that it is a family oriented motel, and were not willing to enforce their own rules. Definitely not a place I would recommend to any friends, or people who would like to relax.
hotel_name: Days Hotel - Hotel Circle by SeaWorld

review_text: I stayed here for 5 days for a conference I was attending across the street. Rooms were great and very clean. Parking was $16 a night which I felt was expensive. My room rate was very fair. Bistro in lobby had excellent quality food, though at hotel prices. Will definitely stay here again when in San Diego.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Mission Valley/Hotel Circle

review_title: Grat value, great service good location
review_text: Great budget hotel,free wi-fi, free breakfast . Rooms were kept clean, fresh towels and the shuttle drivers especially mike were so obliging. Area surrounding did not offer many options for food or entertainment, although fashion valley mall is only a10min walk.
hotel_name: Days Hotel - Hotel Circle by SeaWorld

review_title: Nice hotel. I would stay here again.
review_text: Nice hotel, good location, and very clean. I would definitely stay here again when I'm here in San Diego.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Mission Valley/Hotel Circle

review_title: Clean, very convenient, staff Should know a little more about the hotel.
review_text:
I checked into this hotel late Tuesday evening or I should say Wednesday morning. I was checked in by a lady who works the overnight shift. As someone who works in hotels your first impression should come with a smile! She did not seem like she wanted to be there. I mean I know it's San Diego and you'd probably want to be out! But that was NOT how you welcome a guest. I had no eye contact with her what so ever. Whatever question I asked I felt stupid. I understand sometimes its the same questions. But Cmon this was my first time in California (my dream since I was 5 ) not impressed. 
Finally after checking in with my brother we walked into the room...a lot better than I expected. I got an amazing deal for this place and the rooms were absolutely beautiful! Very clean and new. My room is on the street side of the hotel. You can't hear any noise and the view is very pretty. 
Parking for the hotel is $16 a day. Not bad at all!! I understand some places offer free parking but this was a bargain!
The third night I was there I stepped on a bee by there pool. I had the stinger stuck in my foot for about 15 minutes while I STRUGGLED to get it out. REASON: hotel does not offer a first aid kit. Only band aids. I was practically in tears from the pain, and I was told to go down the block to a liquor store and "maybe" they had something. Very disappointed. I finally got an alcohol wipe from the restaurant. 
Let me say "pricey or not" I would go to the hotels market EVERYDAY. They are so friendly and helpful! I asked them for recomendations in the area and they had plenty! They always had a smile on their face and are so happy to be there. By the way, it's hotel food so you can expect it to be pricey. But seriously it's not that bad. Complain when you go to New York! 
I would definitely come back. This is my first time in California and won't be my last. I loved it...thank you to the market staff for your reccomendations! I did a lot thanks to you!! Wish you worked the front desk =( 
I would also like to thank housekeeping for keeping my room so clean everyday! You rock!
Love, Jersey!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Mission Valley/Hotel Circle

review_text: I chose this hotel because I needed a property that fell within a particular price range (business trip) but also had to be a Marriott (needs the points). It wasn't convenient for me with respect to where I was working, but for most people the location would be good. The lobby and rooms have been renovated so it's nice. Bed is good. Bathroom is nice. Tv is flatscreen but on some channels the reception is spotty. Parking is for a fee which I disagree with but we will let that factor slide. They have a cool lobby set up with the bistro and bar which has drinks and good food but they don't have room service. My real issue with the hotel is the air conditioning and the service. I am one of those people who needs their room cold- like arctic cold. And I also am one of those people who believe that if I'm paying for the room then I ought to be allowed to make it as hot or as cold as I like. Well, as soon as I got in, I cranked the digital wall control down to 60. I woke up at 2am thinking it was warm and looked at the wall control only to then notice the fine print sticker on it which says that the AC will not go lower than 68 and if you need help contact maintenance. Alright, so the next morning on the way out I called the front desk and asked for maintenance to come fix whatever limits they had set on the control so I would get cooler. I came back from work 12 hours later and no one had come up. The room was 68 although the thermostat was set to 60 all day. I called maintenance again. 20 minutes later the maintenance guy shows up. I ask him to please make it colder. He looks baffled and essentially fiddles with the wall unit and the actual AC by the window and then unplugs the AC then plugs it back it. He then proceeds to tell me he reset it so it will be better. I tell him the system is clearly set with a limit on how cold it allows you to make it and that there must be a button sequence or something to lower it. I know this is true but I also know it because otherwise there wouldn't be a notice on the wall saying call maintenance if you need it colder than 68. He doesn't know how to do that and insists he fixed it. I let him leave and sure enough 10 minutes later the air turns off again. Room temp is of course 68. What do I do? I proceed to take the condenser by the window apart and google the manual for it and then change the dipswitches on it so it now works as a standalone unit (sans wall controller). I turn the AC itself down to 60. And what do you know? It gets down to 60. I am writing this from my room right now which is wonderfully cold, no thanks to maintenance. All too many hotels these days are doing this- limiting your ability to control your own environment because they want to try and cut costs. Well eff em. I want it cold. And if you do too, almost every AC that is "limited" has a way to "unlimit" it. Most models are online if you google it. If you need help, message me. So yeah. Nice hotel, BS air conditioning.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Mission Valley/Hotel Circle

review_text: We spent a long weekend, stayed in the back by the pool. There were plenty of towels but they were short. Shampoo and stuff not great. The service from their staff was excellent, very informative with good local tips. The onsight restaurant, PamPam was outstanding. I accessed this through my timeshare so I can't say much about value.
hotel_name: Days Hotel - Hotel Circle by SeaWorld

review_title: Another nice stay at the Courtyard
review_text:
Updated rooms, great functional lobby, and nice staff. We stayed at the Courtyard while in San Diego for our daughter's wedding. The room was nice, nothing fancy. The bed was comfortable, and flat screen tv worked well. The wireless internet was easy to access and the speed was ok.
We really liked the new lobby design. Lot's of comfortable chairs. The food at the lobby restaurant was good and the prices were reasonable. There is free coffee in the lobby every morning.
The staff was pleasant. Extra towels and hangars came quickly. Location was convenient.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Mission Valley/Hotel Circle

review_text: Right in the middle of hotel circle this newer hotel has everything a business traveler needs: cleanliness, comfort and an adequate gym.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Mission Valley/Hotel Circle

review_text: A very nice Marriott. Nice, friendly, informative staff. Clean, quiet room. I loved the water dispensers in the lobby: one with fresh cucumbers, another with fresh strawberries. Delicious! I could not find one thing wrong in my stay here.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Mission Valley/Hotel Circle

review_text: We were in the suites, which were comfortable but dated. The bathrooms in particular need new fittings and decent towels. In the winter the building was stark with howling winds ripping through the corridors but it is probably lovely in the summer. The location is great if you don't want to go anywhere - there is no shuttle into town and the taxi service locally was very expensive - we ended up hiring a car because it worked out cheaper. I stayed at the nearby Hilton years ago and thought it was better value.

review_title: Don't be fooled by a false sense of security!!
review_text: I recently visited the San Diego area with my family. We chose this hotel because it was close to areas of interest to us like: San Diego Zoo, Sea World, USS Midday Museum, etc. The overall stay was ok. Staff was very courteous and helpful. Prices were reasonable; except the ridiculous $16 overnight parking fee. They claim they have "security" that roams the hotel grounds and have signs posted that say there's video surveillance. However, my gym bag and road side assistance kit were stolen from inside my SUV on the FIRST NIGHT we were there. I dismissed it as an accident at first thinking my wife had left my bag out by the car earlier that night when she went to retrieve some other things. Well turns out that the night before we checked out someone had gotten into my car once again! This time they took my daughters Gracco Play Pen and a second road side assistance kit I had in the SUV. How the hell does that happen not once, but TWICE!!! So don't think for a minute that your belongings are "SAFE" just because they claim to have security cameras, security guard walking the parking lot, or the "gated" access to the hotel. I was parked in both the front and back side of the hotel when my belongings disappeared.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Mission Valley/Hotel Circle

review_title: Good for business or personal travel.
review_text: This is one of the nicer Hyatt's I've stayed at that is near an amusement attarction, in this case Sea World.

Stayed back in July or August. Very clean. Seemed like it was new. Perfectly located near Mexico border as we went to Tijuana. About 30 mins drive to San Diego. Rooms were spacious. 
We did get plenty of breakfast even though there was a girls softball team there.
Yes would definitely stay here again.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites San Diego Otay Mesa

review_text: Stayed October 27 for three nights with my wife and two children. The staff was very friendly and our room was perfect. We stayed in the tower on the club floor and had a great view of the ocean. The kids gave the pool and slides two thumbs up while we give the resort an "A" for cleanliness for the rooms, pool area and grounds. The afternoons were a little breezy at the pool each day when the on shore ocean breeze picked up. I'm sure this was just a result of the current weather pattern. The pool area was calm in the morning until after lunch and we had a great time enjoying the sun and water.

I've been lured to horrible hotels by good prices before but, this had to be the worst experience I've had. We got into the hotel about 3 a.m. and were absolutely exhausted. The guy at the check in was pretty cool. He didn't charge us for the pet we had and got us set up quickly. Not a bad experience. The rooms were a different story. The rooms were nowhere near the size they looked on the website. The bathroom was minuscule with barely any light reaching into the shower. Unfortunately, the heat in my room refused to work, so I was forced to room with my friend. Because she had a pet, we had to get her a pet friendly room which just meant that she had freezing cold stone floors. It took forever for the heat to come on but it finally did. The only thing I liked about the rooms was that they had nice flat screen t.v.s. But even this weren't great due to the fact that they a satellite t.v. and the channels were constantly cutting out. The free internet wasn't too bad. The next morning, I go back to my room to shower and get dressed and guess what I find on my suitcase? A roach. I was completely disgusted. I went through my entire bag, re-packed it, and went back to the other room. I was ready to go, but my friend felt that, because of the time it would have been impossible to find and move to another hotel and still make it to our engagement on time. Instead I went to the front desk to check out of that room. I explained the situation to the young lady and informed her that instead of just leaving that I did not want to pay for the room I didn't even sleep in. She was very uncaring and unwilling to until I asked to speak to a manger. Instead of the manager coming but to speak to me, she went in to speak to him. She came back and told me that she could take 10% off of the room. Are you kidding me?? I flat out told her no and that that wouldn't do. She tried to tell me that that would be fair instead of charging me another day. I asked why they would be charging me another day if it wasn't even check out time, yet? Instead of answering my question, she went back into the office to speak to her manager. She came back and told me the best that they could do was charge me $35 for the night for occupying through room. I wasn't going to argue the fact that they wouldn't have rented the room, anyway, considering we didn't even show up until 3 a.m., but we had to hurry on our way. Later that day, we had the pleasure of witnessing the police answer a domestic dispute 4 doors down from us, got yelled at by one of the hotels many long-term guests (tenants) about my friends service dog and about how he has to clean up after all of the dogs, and we were locked out of our room on three separate occasions, one of the times being so they could inform us that "one if the guests" had complained about our dog. All-in-all, just a horrible place to stay. Use my experience and, PLEASE, save yourself!

review_title: Corner Suite upgrade delivers spectacular view(s) of bay and ocean.
review_text:
Booked on priceline for $96 (thurs/fri/sat) and was offered an upgrade to corner suite for $25. Eighth floor, three views, balcony, seal or sea lion spotted daily , kayaks and boating sunshine spectacular views"experience" combined with 4 star sophisticated suite. 
Parking was $20 however it did not seem crowded and street parking seemed possible. Complicated but easy access to everything. Red Marlin restaurant pricy however great food and atmosphere. Good cheap fish and chips next door at marina. Highly recommend!

We stayed here for 2 weeks in October and there is absolutely no complaint whatsoever! The rooms were cleaned promptly and properly, new towels each day, bathroom and toilet was bleached every morning and the cleaners were so friendly! The pool was clean and tested regularly!
Reception staff were accommodating and understanding and had more patience with my daughter who has ADHD and special needs than I expected! The restaurant staff were great especially Louis. My daughter loved his cheese grills every morning!
We had such a great time we are going again next year for a month!
I would recommend this place to singletons, couples and families! Basically I would recommend this hotel to anyone!!
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Padre Trail Inn

review_text: We were able to check-in early. The room was beautiful but we like to sleep cool usually 67 degrees. The thermostat wouldn't allow us to go lower than 69 degrees. I'm all for being Eco-conscientious but NOT when it comes to my sleeping comfort. They should have told us this up front. The king bed had 4 small not even STD pillows that my head would roll off of. Elevator was SLOW. Restaurant was good and free drinks with priority club membership. Free WIFI -AWESOME!

review_title: A "Reactive" Customer Service Mindset In An Attempt To Compensate For An Aging Resort-Style Hotel
review_text:
We had a poor experience, given the rating and class of this property. Items that did no work or were unsatisfactory included a broken A/C (forced move to room on edge of property), poor reception on TV, stray human hairs stuck on bathroom ceiling above shower, very low wireless signal and inoperable Ethernet jack (staff worked on but could not fix either, very annoying due to need to work from room), repeated requests for items missing from room, like binder containing property information and bath towels ( only 3 total on check in for 3 adults and child).
Staff did what they could, seemed as if comping people was SOP for the hotel's many weaknesses. Will not return.

I was given a room in the Bay 2 building on check in, told that my rate (Corporate) was only for rooms in that building, not in the tower. The building was motel style with open-to-the-outside doors.... Kind of creeped me out. The room looked ok, decor-wise, but was dark and very musty. My co-worker was spot-on when she said that the smell of my room was like a basement. ew. I requested another room (less musty please) and finally given a room at the very bottom of the tower. It smelled far better and did not have the damp-dark feel of the Bay building. Be sure to AVOID the Bay buildings. I am pretty sure those are the rooms that are generating all of the bad reviews on here.
Other items:
Swim bar was great place to hang out, casual, great for football watching, cool bartenders (this is a bar BY the pool, not a cheesy swim up bar)
Red Marlin food and service was great! Enjoyed a nice breakfast and dinner there, very enjoyable, significantly betterr than most hotel restaurants.
If you like to run, ask the concierge for a map. They have little cards to take at guide you on 3 and 6 mile routes.

review_title: Relaxing place! Next time we're bringing the kids.
review_text:
This HI was a nice little surprise! Booked online for a spontaneous but cheap 4 day weekend with my husband. 
First night we had one of the older rooms but we didn't check in until 11PM so no surprise there. The next day we asked for a different room and got a poolside room. Wonderful space right on the putting green. 
The restaurant was good and the vouchers we received were an extra bonus. Restaurant staff is very friendly, as is the evening desk clerk. 
Pool is nice and wasn't that cold (even in March). Never went to the bar area but it looked clean and was rather busy. 
Had a wonderful stay and will be bringing the boys next time!

review_text: This hotel is magnificent. The rooms are outstanding, the staff was exceptionally accommodating. Excellent!
Rooms are nice big screen tv and decent coffee. Plenty of amenities. Only con is parking. You may have to walk a short distance

Anyone that has enjoyed their stay and has been satisfied with the rooms at this Hyatt property has made poor choices previously in hotel selection.
I booked through British Airways and was placed at the far end of the building. The room I was allocated led directly out to a communal walkway with open ceiling structure and direct access from the street with no security. This in my opinion would class this as a "Motel".
It is difficult to describe how poor the condition of the "Motel" room that I stayed in was. The smell was intoxicating, the cleanliness was unacceptable. The front desk blamed the smell on being located close to the bay.
I booked a four night stay and left after one. Don't be fooled by the Hotel websites advertising and pictures because their interpretation of contemporary furniture is poorly constructed flat pack units made of chipboard and vinyl covering.

review_title: Meh, ive stayed at a lot better hotelz
review_text: When you first see this hotel you get the feel of a very nice and clean hotel. The valet parking is kind of rude, its better to self park. The lobby is very cold, and cold feeling as well. Everyone there is very high class and a little snobby. The staff was okay, one of the receptionist was very welcoming but another one was quite rude and kept staring at us as if we didnt belong in this "high class" hotel while we were waiting to get picked up by a friend. The rooms were okay, nothing amazing, seen the exact same rooms at 2 1/2 star hotels. All in all very mediocre. There is a huge selection of nice hotels in san diego and la jolla, i wouldnt recommend this one.

review_text:
Siamo stati tre notti al padre inn all'inizio della nostra vacanza e l'abbiamo trovato ottimo sia dal punto di vista del prezzo che da quello della qualitÃ . Ã‰ perfetto per visitare San Diego ed in particolare Old Town e Downtown, Ã© tranquillo e le camere sono spaziose e pulite.

review_title: While pretty on the outside, we ended up with a two and a half star quality room, with a four star price.
review_text:
We had stayed in another Hyatt before, so therefore had higher expectations.The room was comfortable, but lacked the luxuries of seperating it from a basic courtyard Marriott room. We have actually stayed in courtyard Marriotts for less money, that were just as luxurious. 
It was unreasonable to be asked to pay $25.00 a day for hotel parking, or be given the other option of parking on the street, which was a hassle. We wish we had read a disclaimer that decent parking for a four day stay would cost an extra $100.00. 
Overall, this hotel was overpriced for being a four star.We could have saved money and stayed at a 3 star hotel in the area for the same amount or less since there was a lack of luxury to our room.

I stayed for a week on business although I would agree with previous posts the rooms are comfortable but slightly tired, however , the service is 5 * and beyond nothing is to much trouble . Everything I asked or enquired about was sorted out immediately with a smile :) MANAGER AND STAFF WERE EXCELLENT

The worst hyatt hotel I've ever been to. We are hyatt vacation club owners so we have been to several hyatt resorts. By far, this is the dumpiest room we have ever stayed in. My girls are very allergic to mold, mildew and their allergies acted up during our stay. When we complained, front desk said there was no room avail. Mold on shower curtains and room smelled horrible! We will never stay here again and will not recommend. Front desk not helpful when we complained about my kids allergies acting up. He said sorry no rooms available. Very noisy at night. Check in was bad. Waited 1 hr (room not ready) poor customer service. Bell hop took 1 hr to bring luggage to our room. Front desk insensitive to our kids allergies to mold. Very bad experience!!!

We stayed there with our 9 month old and we felt we were at home. Our room had minor plumbing issues and we realized there wasn't a small fridge in the room when we arrived. Before the conversation was over on the phone with the front desk, there was a knock on the door and we had the engineer at the door with a fridge in hand and his tools to fix the drain. We ended up switching rooms without any hassle. The next day when we returned to our room, there was a wine and cheese spread waiting for us with a nice note from the manager and the front desk representative. We will be back again and look forward to it! Thank you for all you did to make our stay very comfortable and enjoyable.

review_title: Amazing value business hotel for Rancho Bernardo
review_text: Stayed here on business last week, its super close to the Sony campus which made it very convenient. Service was impeccable, the front desk went out of their way to accomodate with a last minute airport shuttle. The Internet access was very fast and let me stream hd Netflix even while working on files across our company VPN. I will definitely stay here again and highly recommend!

We were disappointed that the room lacked basic items like a microwave or fridge. Parking was ample but a long walk from the room and $20 per day is more than we've paid anywhere. Stayed at the Marriott down the road the last time we were here and liked it more. My husband and I agreed there was nothing else about this hotel that compelled us to stay here again.

review_text: I stayed at this fantastic hotel in October 2010(I know that this review will say 2011, but there was no selection for Oct.2010. I have to say this-all of the people complaining about the noise from the trains are not worth considering. Unless you don't have access to a map, there are multiple train tracks right behind it. What did you expect? Sure it's loud, but you get used to it, and the fact that the train tracks are right by the hotel are not hidden from you! I had great service from the staff. If you get good or bad service from this or any other hotel, by all means leave a comment, but complaining about the noise is pointless with this hotel.

review_title: Perfect stay, one of the very best hotels we've ever stayed at.
review_text: This hotel gave us a rare 100% perfect stay. The room, pool, restaurant, staff, maid service are all top-notch. The location is perfect for walking to Sea World, driving a short distance to Mission Beach or Old Town San Diego, or catching I-5 to the Gas Lamp, Balboa Park, or Coronado. We really enjoyed our stay at this hotel with our two young children, but also know that we would have enjoyed it in our pre-kid days. This hotel really made our vacation wonderful. Big thanks to the wondeful staff!
Room was great with very comfortable bed. One elevator was out of order making each trip to and from room painfully slow. Carpark was tight fit to navigate small vehicle.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express San Diego Downtown

review_title: Complete rip off. Stay somewhere else and save money and heartache.
review_text: Complete rip off. The reservation lied to us and sold us an ocean view room. When we got to the room it was facing exactly opposite way. No sign of the Ocean. When we confronted the manager she was very rude and blamed me for not reminding her that I had an ocean view room reserved. They were more than glad to charge me $20 for parking even though there was no parking on the property. Had to park across the street and walk back to the hotel in the rain. They ruined my weekend getting away don't let them ruin your holiday. Stay somewhere else.

review_title: Good but not great. Mixed signals as it relates to kids.
review_text:
For some background, I am a top tier 'diamond' frequent guest for Hyatt and I have been for many years. I see a lot of Hyatt's for both business and for family trips. 
The checkin process was easy and the staff was very friendly and accommodating. The front desk was also helpful when i asked for a disposable razor for my wife. We used the concierge shuttle once and were extremely pleased with the vehicle - clean, easy to seat 4+, driver was super nice. The concierge was also helpful for their recommendation of a place for dinner. 
This hotel is older but ownership has attempted to refresh the property. The lobby definately looks great but the rooms didn't quite get the same attention. The rooms are good but not great. The bathrooms are unnecessarily small as there was room to expand them during renovations. The shower head was installed for a very short person as the head is placed about 5 ft high. The pillows are not king sized - not a huge deal but are comfortable. Tv is smaller than other Hyatt's I stay at. there is a fridge in the room which is nice touch. 
The pools are decent and have water slides the kids like a lot. 
This hyatt gives the impression that they are kid friendly but sends mixed signals - ie. the kids are forbidden ( and the staff will remind you - way too strict and for no good reason in my opinion. Maybe after 8pm but not 5pm) from the regency club starting at 5 pm and they advertise s'mores being available via TV and signs but when we inquired we were told it was $8 per 'kit' that you use on your own. Really?!? At other properties such as: lost pines & hill country this experience is included as a part of the overall experience and is managed on by the staff. It is a great experience and is cheap to host. 
The regency club is just 'ok'. There is not an automatic coffee machine as there is in every other RC Club I visit and we ran out of coffee this morning. The food selection is average to below average compared to other hyatts. Another patron shared my views about regency club in a conversation we had this morning while waiting for the coffee to be replenished. 
The spa is nothing special and not on par with other hyatt spa's. We did not use it this trip but I did on a previous stay and thought it was worth mentioning here. 
Overall, I think this hyatt is just 'ok' and I really don't see coming back with my family or on business again because there are some other great Hyatt's nearby. 
We do like seeing and hearing the sea lions outside! That is definitely unique!
Over the years Hyatt has elevated my expectations wuth regards to service and product. While the Hyatt at Mission bay is not on my list of best Hyatt's it is still a nice hotel and would definitely offer great service still likely offer a better product than the other properties in the immediate vicinity.
The staff here is very wonderful.Very friendly and so very helpful. Rich is excellent shuttle driver. Gives great tips. Would stay here again.

LOCATION -
Located next to the interstate 8
APPEARANCE -
You can't miss this hotel with it's huge sign outside. the hotel is split into different buildings
RECEPTION - extremely friendly and helpful lady on reception when we arrived she found us 2 rooms adjoining and helped us with lots of information regarding sea world and the zoo
ROOM -
We stayed in room 405. Room was very clean with 2 large beds which were extremely comfortable, lots of power sockets including sockets in the table lamps. A good sized tv although the tv had terrible reception. A desk with a lamp with power sockets. The room didn't have a safe. The bathroom was on the small size but still very clean. And the air con was on but even when set at 20 degrees it wasn't very cool.
BAR - bar area is very open plan. Located near reception.
RESTAURANT - very good food at a reasonable price.
MISC - big car park so no problem with parking you need a security pass to get in and out of the car park however what they fail to tell you is they charge $8 per day to park. Another downside was that they charge $10 per day for wifi. However they do provide a free shuttle bus to San Diego zoo & sea world.
OVERALL THOUGHTS -
while I recommend this hotel and had a pleasant stay I would suggest that they reconsider their wifi charges as this was the 3rd hotel I had stayed in on this trip and the only hotel that charged for their wifi. And I found it deceiving that I was not informed about parking charges especially when the car park was less than half full.

This hotel is absolutely amazing! I cannot fault a single thing. We had spent nearly 24 hours travelling from the UK to get here and when we finally arrived we were greeted with nothing more than the most curtious lady. She sorted all of our things for the room so we could go down as soon as possible and sleep. She explained the breakfast that was included in our package and off we went. Before we left we had ordered the San Diego 3 - in - 1 pass which allowed us unlimited entry for 5 days to the San Diego Zoo, Sea World and Safari Park. It was only $129 per person so amazing value. We went to the zoo and sea world and transport to those are free with a shuttle supplied by the hotel. And the driver, well, he was perfect. Made us feel very welcome and explained everythong we could and should do while we were staying so if you see him and want advise... Definitely ask! And although we never got chance to see the Safari Park the zoo and Sealife centre were amazing so would definitely recommend. The breakfact was continental so we werent expecting much, and although it was basic they offer a huge range of items that they bring out with a huge pile of fruit... Im sorry i didnt always eat mine, i had an ulcer! But apart from that it was lovely and the waiters an waitresses are very accomidating. We had dinner when we got back from the zoo at the Postcards restaurant and we couldnt have been happier. Portion sizes are perfect and your given a basket of bread which is a lovely touch. We had starters and mains and it only come to $39 which we think is phenominal. I would like to thank micheal who helped us book the shuttle from the hotel and showed us other places we might like to visit and explaining the tram situation, which everyone should try and go down to the Gaslamp District! We saw some crazy things there. And that all important thanks to the driver who couldnt have been more helpful an who i cant remember the name. So many thanks to all the staff, you really have made our holiday worth the travelling and look forward to coming back!!

review_title: Fantastic Staff in a great hotel!
review_text: My wife and I chose to stay there for 19 days for our first big trip together. Sure it's near the trains and the airport, but we got used to it right away. The staff was exceptionally helpful, and the shuttle service was a plus, particularily to Ralph's! We reserved a room with a kitchenette, which saved us a lot of money, and made it seem like home. Also, our room had a separate bedroom from the living room, each having it's own tv, which was a thoughtful touch. Hats off to Rudy and the rest of the staff and management for giving our vacation that special touch that I'll never forget. We will be back(in the same room!).

We chose this hotel from the good reviews and it's location. It is only a 5 minute drive to the zoo, and some great restaurants. The check in area has the breakfast area attached but no where to eat so you take it back to your room, which has a table and chairs. The bed was comfy enough, the shower and toilet are in a smaller room and the sink is in an alcove off the main room. 
We were so happy with the room and what we paid for it. There is ample parking and great wifi.

This is a family hotel through and through with a motel feel.
Thehotel is relatively small, the reception feels as though you're in a conference annexe to the main building. Staff polite and helpful.
The pool area works well as a children's play area - lively rather than peaceful. The Reef Pool Bar is fine, service good, decor tacky to say the least!
Security doesn't feel good - many room doors open onto open air stairways - anyone can walk into the Hotel, literally! No elevators so prepare to hump your bags around!
The location for access to San Diego is poor. Cabs to the Old Town cost 13 dollars each way, 17 dollars to the Gaslamp area. The nightlife and restaurants are best in the Gaslamp area which is why I would recommend a large hotel ( Marriott or Manchester Hotel in the downtown bay area. Cab drivers usually do not know this hotel.
The hotel website boasts free transport into town - this ended at 5.00pm and I saw no evidence of it in any case. The on-site Postcards Bistro is uninviting, I didn't try the food though. Also be aware that some of the poolside 'rooms' are used for external group meetings and conventions.
This is a well meaning hotel but it really doesn't cut the mustard for a city such as San Diego. Personally I'd look elsewhere and not be taken in by claims of easy access to the main town areas. The hotel is linked by a fast moving motorway to the town areas - driving is a nightmare especially during rush hour.

The room was nice and clean. Second floor balcony was nice and private but I never had time to use it but I liked the amount of natural sunlight. I expected car noise but people talking on their patios and sounding like they were on your patio was disturbing. I kept looking out the window to see who was out there. 
Then I noticed that the bathroom smelled like ant spray. When I used the shower the smell got worse until it washed out. 
At night I kept trying to turn down to the tv only to find that the walls are paper thin and the tv sound was from the next room over. Paper thin walls also caused me to experience more of the neighbors more amorous adventures than I wanted at 2am. 
Disturbing Sleep. People hanging out in the parking lot. Thin walls. Slow service at restaurant.

review_title: Great place to stay with complimentary transport to seaworld, zoo ,beaches & downtown
review_text: This is my 4th stay here. The rooms are great & the staff are excellent. The complimentary shuttle bus, with Jeff & Rich, will take you to the zoo, seaworld, beaches & downtown daily. The new grill bar is a good place to get a snack & Susie is brilliant. Fashion Valley shopping mall is only a 10 minute walk too. Will be looking to book again in 2012 too.

Fantastic hotel with very clean rooms.Pool was huge and well layed out.Continental breakfast was good.The thing that amazed me was the fantastic service.From desk clerks to the maintence staff,all were very friendly.Shuttle service to local attrctions were fast and prompt (thanks Jeff).I highly recommend staying at this hotel if you're in SanDiego.

review_title: Beware of extra Fees added on to the rate.
review_text: The hotel is decent. It's what you'd expect from a 3-star chain. The problem is the consistent fees these types of hotels charge. The Internet is $10/day. I've stayed at three other hotels within a few miles that all offer free Internet. Breakfast is also $16/day.

I frequently stay here while on business in San Diego. The hotel is comfortable and quiet. There are many good restaurants and stores within walking distance. Also some good trail runs or a walk/run on the beach nearby. Also has a decent workout room and nice pool area. 
A good place to stay.

A nice hotel, clean and comfortable. this hotel recently completed a renovation. An older property the remodel was done well but the rooms are small. they were clean and well maintained. The grounds are well done but I saw cigarette butts and beverage bottles in the flower beds. Front desk staff were warm and friendly. I had a problem with the programing of our room keys. After the third time they sent maintanence and he came promptly and fixed the lock. Housekeeping staff were friendly as well. The event staff was less than friendly. While every business must make a profit, this hotel charges for everything, wifi, parking, they even try to charge $4.00 for a bottle of water in the room. We were not left a new bar of soap. 
one sm bar for 2 for four days. Over all a nice hotel but over priced.

review_title: Great place to stay in San Diego
review_text: The Handerly was a great place to stay and very close to most major attractions. The hotel staff was very friendly. They were very attentive to our needs and responded to them immediately. The only down side was a Happy Hour at the pool where the restaurant lost our food order and did not return to see us. Perhaps the vents in our room could be vacuumed. Aside from that, we were very pleased with our stay.

Stayed one night on business in a nearby location.
Room pricing was excellent and with the included breakfast as a HH Gold - it was a real steal. Breakfast was better than average with cooked to order foods.
Room was very comfortable with the beds having adjustments for softness.
The workout room was well equipped, and machines felt well maintained.
Pool was small, but a nice area to catch some rays.
Only negative, depending on room location, it can be a very long walk to the lobby.
Bottom line, great choice for price and comfort - negative a but of a schlepping into San Diego proper
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn San Diego/Rancho Bernardo

review_text:
Stayed for 6 nights in May. Very nice hotel, we didn't eat there so don't know what the food was like. Location was fine if you have a car, about 20 mins to town. Only downsides were that one day our rooms were not cleaned until 4pm and they tried not to do them at all. Also we were disappointed that we weren't allowed Hilton Honnours points just because we booked through a third party.
Overall a nice enough hotel though. Pleasant stay. Little noise.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn San Diego/Rancho Bernardo

review_text: After searching for a good place to stay in San Diego for couple months, I found this hotel. The hotel seems like a very good hotel to stay. The nitely rate was just rite for me and my family. We had a package that include free parking, internet and a continental breakfast. This hotel has no valet or bellman. The rooms is small and so is the bathroom. Also, the pool and fitness center. About the room, I had to call the maintenance person twice because the mini frig didn't work and the bathtub didn't drain at all. Next time I will try stay at another place.

review_title: Clean, awesome service, plus movies by the pool!
review_text: We went to San Diego for a wedding and stayed at the Handlery. The hotel isn't fancy but the service is the best. We had questions before we left and they responded to all of them. The hotel and pool were both very clean. The beds were very comfortable and even with staying right by the pool it was really quiet. We took advantage of the free shuttle service. Thanks Jeff! The movie nights at the pool were a lot of fun. In all, we felt like it was a good deal.

The resort was clean and staff helpful, food was expensive. On booking this hotel we read that the hotel shuttle bus took you back to the airport but when we asked they said no. So make sure you book a shuttle when booking holiday as cabs work out expensive ! Would highly recommend a tour around the Midway aircraft carrier, excellent! Value for money lasts about 2 hours. Also San Diego Zoo. We found it easy to get around using the blue and red line trains. Went to Mexico on day trip but was dissappointed az we were taken to a strip of shops for 3 hours !!

review_title: Average room no issues needs facelift
review_text: Pretty standard stay, booked premier room, looked no different to basic room, staff friendly and helpful, short wall to bus and Reilly stop to downtown SD. Pool and tub clean. Overall average value, age of rooms let's it down.

He estado en otros hoteles express de esta cadena y sin duda este ha sido el peor. Ubicacion, lejos del centro, desayuno malo(nunca vi el queso ni el jamon, solo un dia vi unas escasa manzanas , no habia leche calientey todo el resto parecia plastico y era envasado. Uno tenia que atenderse solo, no habia a quien preguntar nada en la hora del desayunopues tampoco vi camareras a la hora del desayunoMala aislacion acustica de las habitaciones y el piso crujia. A este hotel no volveria
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express San Diego Downtown

review_title: Get to the restaurant, fantastic food
review_text: Had read some negative reviews prior to arriving but this place is really good. Staff extremely friendly and helpful and possess a sense of humour. The restaurant is first class, casual but the food is amazing. Free Internet and parking a real bonus. Overlooks downtown San Diego on one side and the Marina on the other. Thoroughly recommend this hotel. It's close to Sea World and the Zoo.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_text: Stayed here during my recent vacation, great place views of the water across the street or the marina behind the hotel are amazing. It was quiet and peaceful. We were able to walk down to a small beach less than 5 min walk away. They have fire pits on the beach and we had a Bon fire every night down there. We bought wood at the vons a grocery store about a 5 min drive away. It is literally a short drive to just about everything in San Diego. I had read some reviews about noise from helicopters that take off and land from the airfield across the bay. I never heard them in our room unless the door was open. Long story short staying here is a very good choice.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina
