review_title: Outstanding Stay in San Diego at the Solamar!!
review_text:
We arrived in San Diego on May 09 and looked forward to a wonderful stay at the Hotel Solamar, a Kimpton Hotel. We are still here, with another 4 nights in which to enjoy this amazing hotel in this amazing city!
We have stayed at a number of Kimpton hotels in the past and have never been disappointed! We read Trip Advisor reviews before choosing this hotel and were very excited about our visit 
From the moment we arrived, having the door opened for us upon our arrival and a very warm welcome at check-in, to the present, we have been SO impressed with the level of service from all employees at this hotel! We actually think this is the BEST service and value for our money we have ever received. (We have travelled all over the world from Alaska to Russia, and Europe to the States. )
We chose a Virtuoso King Corner room for our accommodation here. The room is wonderful and quiet. The staff were able to accommodate our many requests re room specifications here. 
Every time we leave and return we are greeted warmly with a huge smile from the staff. No request is too much trouble. They have gone above and beyond the normal level of service offered in a hotel. When we asked about shipping some items home to Canada the wonderful young lady at reception personally asked the gentlemen at the doors what we needed to do and returned with forms for us to complete and return to them. They would do the rest! Not to worry!
My husband got ill (nothing serious, but he did require medication) and we asked where we could go for medical help, not only did we get directions to Urgent Care printed out for us, but our wonderful Erica called the office for us to let them know we were on our wY, making sure they would still be open for us! 
Upon our arrival at this hotel, we were very warmly welcomed by Kyle who answered all of our questions, making sure that our room requests were met! 
When our luggage was delivered to our room, James took the time to explain for us the wonderful places we should visit should we rent a car!
Dining at JSix was also a wonderful experience! Our servers have been excellent with consistent service each time we have had breakfast or 
dinner. Our servers have been:Kristen, Jamie and Josie. The Maitre'd is amazing, recognizing and welcoming us each time we arrived. 
The nightly wine tasting is also a really nice touch. We've enjoyed sitting around relaxing as well as bringing up our wine to enjoy in our room
We cannot say enough wonderful things about the staff and the hotel property itself. The location is excellent with us being close to major attractions and amazing dining options
We have absolutely nothing negative to say about the outstanding service we have received during our stay here. What is especially nice is that we get to enjoy another 4 nights here to be well taken care of and pampered!
We HIGHLY recommend this hotel as being an excellent choice for accommodations in San Diego! We would come back here in an instant. The level of service that we have experienced from housekeeping, to the Front Desk, to dining in JSixakes it extremely easy to recommend that any guests who choose to stay at the Hotel Solamar will not be disappointed!

I am lying in bed at the Grant, writing this review while I'm still here because I don't have much else to do at 5 am with an aching lower back and the rest of my family sound asleep.
It's a beautiful place and everything is just lovely, but....despite being swaddled in luxury linens that feel like butter, this is just about the worst excuse for a pillowtop mattress I've ever endured, and I've been up half the night. At home, I sleep on a cloud-like Beautyrest mattress and sleep like a baby. I'm wide awake here, stretching and rubbing my aching back and praying for morning!
If you are like me and need a really, really good, soft, fabulous mattress, think again about staying here. Try The Ritz because I loooove their mattresses and I am really, really wishing I was there RIGHT NOW!!! :(

Good clean hotel, location was close to transit and harbor. Did not find location very noisy on city side. The pool was warm enough to swim in eventhough it was not sunny and the beds were really comfortable! We did not find the elevator was a problem, we never waited long and the one that worked was new. Room was clean and looked updated (could use flat screen tvs though). Breakfast was ok but lacked fruit & meat. 
Website does not mention that you have to call for airport shuttle to pick you up, it didn't take too long once we did call.

We spent 2 nights here on our road trip down the coast.
Excellent hotel, great location very near the gaslamp quarter and very attentive customer service.
No complaints at all and would recommend this hotel to anyone staying in San Diego?
If we return to San Diego I wouldn't consider staying anywhere else.

Highly recommend the US Grant in SD. Not only is it historical it's classy, clean and luxiourous. The bed is comfy, bathroom is gorgeous and make sure you get the grand delux with the jet jacuzzi, totally worth it. Also the view on the 11th floor is amazing! Definitely a romantic small weekend getaway. Walking distance to all the major restaurants and the mall at gaslamp.

Located in the Gas Lamp District, this hotel is sometimes overlooked. 
While not as new as others, it's been fully renovated and combines old world charm with modern amenities and decor. 
This very elegant hotel features marble floors in the lobby, ornate wall decor, fine restaurants and nicely updated rooms with wood floors and lavish bathrooms. 
While the room we had was relatively small, the bedding, electronics and decor was clearly top shelf. 
The restaurants and service were superb...five star....but I give the hotel four stars large due to the small room. 
Wasn't a great value but competitively priced and the location was great. 
All in all, it's very unique and upscale and certainly worthy of consideration.

I was skeptical staying here since it was pretty low price for a family of 5. We got a suite, a room of two double beds seperated with another room containing a sofa bed. The room was tight but it was clean and the beds were comfortable. Bathroom was clean but small. The sink was separated and was located nextto the beds which i thought was a little weird. It was nice that they had free breakfast even though it was a basic breakfast with average to low quality ingredients but with kids that pick at food it worked for us. Overall the place was a good value for how much you are spending. Its no luxury hotel but its clean and hotel staff was nice. Great place for a family on a budget.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn & Suites Zoo / SeaWorld Area

review_text: Spent 4 nights in San Diego and really pleased we chose this hotel, lovely location, friendly staff and we got an upgrade to the new rooms which were just lovely!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_text: Room was small and the carpets were dirty. No tub to soak in and this was considered an upgraded room. Hallways were dirty with stained rugs and trash outside rooms.

review_title: Nice hotel-event could have gone better
review_text: Stayed at hotel recently for planned event- nice rooms, excellent housekeeping and room service staff. Event was nice but could have been better- expected more attention to detail for $$ we were paying. Would recommend for weekend getaway
I stayed by myself and it was great. The food was good, not great. I spent time in the complimentary beach chairs and got a spa treatment.

We booked the kids suite, i was a little unsure from the reviews but it was the only hotle close to sea world with kids suites avaliable. It was perfect having two kids. There was a room with bunk beds and tv for the kids with sliding door leading from the main bedroom.
We arrived late with the kids and needed something to eat, the hunters resturant next door was perfect for us
hotel_name: Comfort Inn & Suites Zoo / SeaWorld Area

review_text: Great location on the bay. Front desk staff friendly and eager but need training in service and operations. First floor room in tower old and wet. Second night no fitted sheet - training or sheet shortage? Restaurant great location looking out at bay but staff again eager but needs direction. Grounds beautiful but seem a bit tired, not maintained as they once were. Stayed here several times, and it just seems to be graying and sliding away.
Coupon rate was $60@night. Very comfortable accomodations. Location a little difficult to get to.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn & Suites Zoo / SeaWorld Area

review_text: I rated the value a 3 because I dont know what my employer paid for the room. I was SO comfy at this hotel except they didnt have a coffee maker!!! The robe, slippers, wine cork, linen napkins, lighted hand mirror, and spaciousness of the suite was just what I needed after a long flight. The in-person service was impecable but I didnt get my wake up call. Also, they were supposed to have a fridge and microwave waiting for me but I had to call for it. Comfy beds! Great room lighting. All in all... A beautiful stay.

review_title: If the kids are happy, then mom is happy!
review_text: I recently stayed 2 nights in the family suite with my two kids and my husband. We upgraded to the room with bunkbeds thinking my kids would have a blast. On check in we were greeted and checked in. I would say that the employees here are very friendly. We were located on the third floor. The room seemed tight but very clean and lots of drawers so your stuff can be out of the way. The walls were so thin and the neighbors above and on the side of us seemed inconsiderately loud. I didn't get much sleep because of the loud noises. Other than that we really enjoyed our family trip. I paid $125.00 a night for the room whic seems a lot more expensive than other people have paid for this room. Next time I might consider coming back if I could be guaranteed a room on the top floor to illuminate a little noise and if I got a better deal.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn & Suites Zoo / SeaWorld Area

review_text: After much researching we decided to stay here because the usual resort we stay in was all booked. We tried checking in at 2:30 and our room wasn't ready and the staff said they were sorry but their wasn't anything they could do because the rooms were still being cleaned. We came back after 4:00 and found short curly hair in our bedding sooooo awful! Then my two year old wanted to use the restroom and found the toilet seat cover had stool smeared on it. I called to speak to the manager he said he had nothing else available and that he would send someone but no one came. I called the manager again and finally at 8:00 pm we got fresh sheets.I felt so badly for my poor baby who had to wait around past his bed time for clean sheets. Will never stay here again
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_text: My family booked this hotel through expedia based on it's reviews. We got to the room and what a disappointment! The carpet looked 20 years old with stains as well as the bedspread. It felt dirty and disgusting! We were in the tower and although the view was nice, I couldn't get passed the gross room. The sliding glass door wouldnt shut properly and the plantation shutter was broken and wouldn't shut. Honestly I am baffled at the good recommendations and I would never stay here again especially for 200+ a night! Yuck is all I can say!!!

review_title: Great Historic Hotel with all the Modern Ammenities
review_text:
Our deluxe suite was beautiful and the service was great. Although a small thing, we appreciated the free water that was offered us routinely by hotel staff. We were celebrating our anniversary and the hotel left special treats in our room with a personalized note.
San Diego lost power during our visit and the staff worked tirelessly to keep guests comfortable and well fed in the lobby. When we wanted to climb the stairs to our 11th floor room, one of the staff, Brock, personally took us so we wouldn't get lost in the maze of hallways and stairs.
Although we cut our visit short due to the power outage, we want to go back and stay at the Grant again!

My husband, son and I stayed here for a conference my husband was attending. We first rented a house in La Jolla for a few days before staying here. 
By the time we had the car unloaded, all bellman knew our names as well as the front desk clerks. It was early in the day so she helped us get our luggage ready to go up after our room was ready. Since it was only 11:00 we knew it would be a while so we went to the consierge's desk and spent about twenty minutes basically receiving a complete history of San Diego! The desk clerk came to us and told us our room was ready, (the exact kind I had previously requested) as well as the fridge I also requsted when I called. Our luggage was already in our room.
Every time we came down, walked through the lobby or out to get a cab, they acknowledged us by name. 
After finding out that my son was homeschooled, Leann, I think was her name, printed out multiple activities for us to do that involved the history and founding of San Diego. 
The rooms were spacious, spotlessly clean. Turn down service included ice in the ice bucket, bottled water, chocolates and soft music on the radio every night. 
Walking around in the Gaslamp disrict was easy and safe. Plenty of restaurants. We walked all the way to the water to catch the ferry to Coronado on a Sunday and the streets were teaming with people. We walked back through the huge marriot complex and I was so glad to be where we were. Quiet, refined and understated elegance. I would not hesitate to stay again.

Just finished our stay with the US grant and was extremely impressed with the level of service that the hotel service provided. From check in to valet service, the service was always top notch. My wife and I were most impressed with the attention provided to all guests during the infamous blackout. Because most stores were closed, the hotel provided constant updates, food and beverage to all guests of the hotel. Included in the food were chips, sandwiches, candy etc and for drinks, pop and water. Although it wasn't a five star meal, it was certainly most appreciated and were thoroughly impressed by their high level of service. We will definitely stay with them again during our next visit to San Diego. I should also mention that the hotel is in a decent location across from Horton Mall and just one block away from the gaslamp quarter.

Really nice place in fantastic location. Some of the rooms need an update but nice atmosphere on week days. Weekends for LOUD partying! We had a good deal staying for 4 nights but would not have liked to have paid RR! Happy hour food & drinks really GVM. A little bit DIY, car parking ect. but most facilities & sports.

review_title: Great location & large rooms but a little dated
review_text:
We spent five nights here at the beginning of June.If you are looking for a relaxing location outside if central San Diego this is a lovely location.It is directly on mission bay & across the street from the beach but there is no view of the beach.When we first arrived we were a little sceptical of the surrounding area but there are a number of reasonably priced bars & restaurants including saska which serves fab steaks.Thanks to Mick in concierge for some great advice
Hotel, pool & on site ducks & parrots create a lively feel.The rooms are spacious with a separate bedroom & lounge but with very dated interior.The room was clean but would definitely advise a bay view room to avoid disappointment.
Overall standard dated accommodation on the outskirts of San Diego but friendly staff & close to beach & bay.

We stayed at this hotel for four nights this week. Service was friendly and prompt. I had to request the feather bedding be changed and it was done quickly and with no hassles. The valet service was quick and we were always offered cold bottles of water to take on our outings and asked if we needed directions anywhere. The location is fabulous. Walking distance to the mall across the street, many many great restaurants and movie theatre. We will definitely recommend this hotel and stay there again. We found it very convenient for our activities.
The hotel has not been updated in decades. For the price I was amazed at how I was nickled and dimed. No coffee in the lobby and $13 for self parking. Try something else.

review_title: Nice Stay, convenient but shady location
review_text:
I stayed there for 3 nights and the room was nice and contemporary. The room seemed very clean. The staff was nice and it seemed as if the bar/restaurant was pretty hopping. It is located near the Gaslamp District and an easy walk to the Convention Center. I was told by many that if you are out at night to walk on the main roads (I was traveling alone). I was kind of surprised to see how many homeless people in the area. 
I would stay there again only if I was with someone else to walk around with at night

Great staff. Expensive parking ($30 night) shower wouldn't drain. Noisy air conditioner. Windows wouldn't open, so no fresh air without racket. Towels not by shower, minimal amenities. (1 soap) sex toys available. (?) tiny tiny room.

review_title: Very nice with an eye to details
review_text:
Cons: 
- Not a great location. Not the best of neighborhoods. Far from the beach and the convention center
- Tiny regular rooms. And I mean tiny ...
Pros:
- Great service. Very attentive and friendly
- Beautifully furnished rooms with an eye to details. Have been to other so called "boutique" hotels and most of the times I found them lacking. Not the Sofia.

My husband,13 year old son and I stayed at the US Grant July 9-12. This was our first visit to San Diego. The US Grant is located in the Gaslamp district. Great shopping and dining were only a few steps away. This hotel was absolutely beautiful inside and out. The rooms were well appointed with the softest linens and the most comfortable beds. The turn down service was appreciated-my son especially enjoyed the chocolates on his pillow every night. The staff was extremely polite and very helpful. The concierge assisted us in planning our daily activities. Housekeeping did a great job cleaning our room on a daily basis. We rented a car and used the valet parking. The young men that assisted us with valet were very polite and personable. Overall I would highly recommend this hotel when visiting SanDiego. You will not be disappointed. It is close to all of the main attractions.

Stayed here one night to be in town and near the airport for an early flight. Considering the incredible luxury and prime location next to the gas lamp district, it was a good price. The hotel is a perfect mix of history and modern ammenities. Walking through the hotel provides a glimpse of early 1900s opulence. Yet, the facilities and rooms contain modern luxury like slippers, robes, glass showers, and even stationary!! You can walk to most downtown attractions. Service was outstanding. My bedspread had some shoe stains, there was no mp3 connection, and the bath window couldn't accommodate both privacy and natural light - but those are nitpicks given the other luxury. You will enjoy it and the incredible lobby.

A great hotel, right in the heart of san Diego gaslamp district. Customer service exceeded all our expectations; we really felt like royalty and loved every minute of it. We booked the hotel through expedia; great rate- better than hotel could give us. Parking is $32:(
Hotel does not have a pool but one block away is their sister hotel Westin where u can enjoy outdoor pool and jacuzzi. Starbucks across the street / panera bread with great sandwiches also very close. What I loved about the location was the easy access by foot everywhere. From Horton plaza, gaslamp district to little Italy and seaport village. Super clean beautiful hotel with great personnel. Everyone were very helpful and welcoming. I hope I can return to this hotel very soon.

review_title: Great historic hotel. Fantastic restaurant. Great beds.
review_text: Ask for a courtyard or 3rd Ave view. 4th Ave is noisy and has a view of dilapidated buildings.

review_title: "Wonderful romantic experience with my husband... We couldn't have been happier!"
review_text: My husband and I went for a quick weekend trip for his birthday and found Hotel Sofia online. I had seen some "iffy" reviews online so I was a little worried, by as soon as I was greeted by the staff when we walked I the door I felt like royalty. Even though I accidentally booked the wrong night online, the staff was so helpful. Not only did they give us an upgrade in a better room, but it ended up being cheaper than my original booking price. We then went in our room and it was just beautiful! Down feather comforters and pillows on the beds, a beautiful view of the city, and soft large towels for the shower!! Not only did we have a romantic stay, but included in our room was free bike rentals. We took a little stroll to Little Italy and down the coast and had an amazing first trip to San Diego. Thank-you hotel Sofia for the incredible rate for such a luxurious experience! Oh and a shout out to the Valet-man Austin and front-desk man Brian!! You guys made our trip more special than I could have imagined!!

review_title: Nice people clean definetly amazing veiw and definetly would go back.
review_text: Amazing in soooooo many ways. They had marshmallow roasting on a middle floor outside overlooking the water with a huge fireplace and pool. Do not forget the hot tub!!:-)

review_title: Negativo su quasi tutti gli aspetti..
review_text: Ho prenotato in questa struttura per 2notti leggendo le recensioni,beh ho soggiornato a San Diego in passato in altre strutture e nn mi pare che questa meriti..Struttura oramai antiquata e il prezzo nonostante la buona posizione e' eccessivo..bocciato,in piu' si sentono in continuazione gli elicotteri che controllano il confine che sono molto fastidiosi..da evitare

La chambre Ã©tait convenablement Ã©quipÃ©e et la literie Ã©tait correcte, ainsi que la Sdb.

The Manchester Grand Hyatt is the perfect hotel if you are attending a conference or want to be close to the Gas light district. The foyer of the hotel is beautifully decorated and in December they had a spectacular ginger bread house display. 
Rooms are clean, beds are comfortable, and service is good. Room service entre selection is a little limited but the food is good overall. 
I had a room on the 25th floor with a view of the city, it was truely spectacular. 
Front desk service was excellent. This is a great hotel choice, can't go wrong. Definetely stay again when visiting San Diego.

this massive hotel in the San Diego Marina, is a great hotel not far from gas lamp district, great spa, had an awesome massage, really worth it, the pool somewhat small.
hotel needs some upgrade but still very ni

This was our first time here and were delighted with the hotel. The location was very good, near many things to do and great restaurants. The service, from the housekeeping to the concierge to the front desk, were all very nice and very efficient. I called ahead to have a bouquet delivered for my wife's birthday and we were stunned at the arrangement for the price. We splurged on breakfast in the room and had a great time (not cheap, though). I'd stay here again if we visit SD.

review_title: The Best of Old Meets New
review_text: Beautifully updated historical building located in the lively Mission district. The hotel is charming and elegant. The bed was extremely comfortable and though the room was small, it had enough storage space and a view. It was very easy to walk a couple of blocks into the main area filled with restaurants, bars and nightclubs. The restaurant at the Sofia was delicious and service was fantastic. If you're looking for a hotel with character and service, the Sofia is it! I would absolutely stay here again!

Went for buisness so happy i didnt pay out of pocket. Relatively clean and food is good. However all rooms have paper thin walls and and plumbing is quite noisy. Reception/bar is often busy with people making it noisy as well. 
Really annoying, the way to the restaurant through hotel is blockef off so hotel guests are forced to go outside in the cold and take street entrance to have breakfast... Not cool.
Internet is 14.00 dollars for 24hrs which i personally find to be a ripoff..
The SPA was closed down, the so-called pool is more like a tub, and the "beach" bar on roof was maybe cool a long time ago, but now resembles an adult sandbox....
Anyway, think there are enough choice of hotels in San Diego to avoid this one.....

The service and accommodations at the W are top notch - I have stayed at this hotel since June and every visit has been an incredible experience - kudos goes out to Spiro, Susie, and the rest of their staff - in particular These are just a few of the great people that work there - Patrick, Mia, Adriana, and Goleta - that's just to mention a few - they know what it takes to go the extra mile - again, excellent people excellent customer service!

review_title: What a wonderful resort! Adorable rescued seal pups live on property, too!
review_text: Stayed for 6 days over Thanksgiving in a bay view mini suite on the 1st floor. Exceptionally large and clean room with full kitchen and beautiful view. Our daughter enjoyed walking right out the huge glass door onto the grass that led to the quiet beach each evening for a stroll. What a lovely tropical property. Props to the Bahia for excepting responsibility for the care of those seal pups, it's nice when a company steps in to help animals. Would never stay anywhere else, and the location was so close to everything!

This place is in a great location, the bar has a great view, and the pool and game area are very nice. However, I was very disappointed with my room and the outrageous prices. We had peeling wall paper in our very dated room and there were a number of body hairs scattered on the floor in our bathroom. Gross. Parking was very expensive, as well. We won't stay here again. We will stick w/Marriott and Hilton.

Lovely location but lousy rooms and horrible customer service. I paid $270 for a suite that was so not sweet. It would be a nice view but there were was the free beach parking in the way. They did not clean the room until after 4, if it all. And when we left at 3, they had the nerve to charge an additional night on my credit card! When I complained, they refunded half. They never returned my calls when I asked for the other half ($135). Finally my credit card company got the other half refunded.

You will be treated like royalty here! Beautiful lobby and rooms with great customer service. We had forgotten a couple things from our car and they got it for us and brought it to our room. We also forgot our iPhone chargers at home and they let us borrow one! We were facing the street with a beautiful view, however if you want complete silence then I recommend a room that doesn't face the street. I didn't mind it, the whole experience was great! We will come again and recommend to others.

W San Diego was so nice! The staff are polite like unbelievable polite!! There rooms were so nice and clean! I loved it! Down Side it's expensive! $35 each day for PARKING! But hey it's california! Right? I recommend staying there! ONLY if you have money! Final Word: it's super nice GO! :)

review_title: Perfect Location, nice decor and great views
review_text: I stayed at the Grand Hyatt for a business conference. The views were phenomenal. Kelly's restaurant had fabulous american cuisine. The hotel decor was reminded me of Disney in a good way. The staff was super friendly and the hotel was very clean.

I am a little disappointed the how 'old' the room is and feels. The furniture and decorations leave a little to be desired, especially in a $300 a night room. The location is just about perfect though (walking distance to the beach) and the staff is very nice.

If the harbor seals are happy it must be a nice place to live. Our bayview studio was incomparable.. perfect room! A small apartment on a private beach, beautiful view of mission bay & the many boats docked at the Bahia. Kitchen has a microwave, bigger than mini fridge, electric stovetop & oven. Plates, bowls, utensils, cooking pots & pans (small shallow pan for oven) and sponge are available. No napkins, no cooking spices (think ahead if you will be cooking) but the ice trays were full & everything in spotless order.
The room has loads of floor space, walls that are not paper thin (did I even have neighbors?) small pull out sofa & plenty of closet & drawer space. King bed was very nice, fresh smelling linens (not the typical industrial wash smell) soft sheets & extra pillows & blanket for getting super cozy.
Joseph at check-in was very kind, obviously enjoys this property and not in a rush to hand me my key, which I appreciate while checking in, as it was a romantic early holiday not a practice for San Diego's quickest check in! He gave me clear directions to my room, pointed out some areas of the resort (seal pool, pool & hot tub..) and let me know who would be available to answer any questions once his day was done.
I regularly stay at hotels around San Diego, 2-3 times monthly, this was my first visit to the Bahia, it did not disapppoint, I'm already looking forward to my next overnight. If I have called any other property my "home away from home" I still mean it, but the Bahia is now my chosen staycation spot!l

review_title: Stay Away - unless you like noise and bad service!
review_text: Where do I start? The front desk staff are rude, concierge was no where to be found, keys stopped working on day two. I didn't receive the room I booked, gardeners started early both mornings - including cutting down an entire tree right under my balcony. Housekeeping tried to enter my room three separate times while the do not disturb sign was posted. Beds are hard and linens are old and scratchy. Waited for 20 minutes in the bar, which was nearly empty, and saw no server - gave up and left. I could go on, but you get the point. Stay anywhere else.

I stayed at the W a few weeks ago. The hotel was wonderful. Service was always on point. Ashley at the front desk was helpful, and the young lady who cleaned my room did a great job. So sweet. I can't wait to come back.

Overall I liked this hotel. We got a decent nightly rate and were close to the Gaslamp District. The rooms were very small, but the decor was nice and the beds were comfortable and clean. Overall I would recommend this place I'd you get a deal like we did. Hotels for less than $200 per night are a find! Hightlights were the Currant Restaurant food/happy hours, location, and comfortable beds. Lowlights were small rooms (small shower) and parking ($30/night and you cannot easily access your car unless valet brings it out for you).

Wir waren eine Woche im la Quinta und es war toll. Super Service, super sauber und suesses old town! Trolley Station nur 7 Minuten fussweg entfernt. Von dort aus war alles zu erreichen. Start der trolley tour sehr empfehlenswert fuer interessierte Touristen. Sogar der Pool war sauber und das alles fuer den preis. Sehr empfehlenswert wirklich!!! Wir kommen hoffentlich bald wieder her.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn San Diego Old Town / Airport

review_title: Very nice hotel in a great location.
review_text: Beautiful hotel, outstanding fitness facility. The only problem I had with this hotel is that the restroom in my room could have used a little more attention. It wasn't dirty, but it could have been cleaner.

review_title: Beautiful hotel and very well located.
review_text: Very luxurious with beautiful lobby, very nice rooms, excellent swimming pool, good bars and restaurants and all you can expect from a 5-star hotel.

Once you look past the fact it is next door to the Court House and Greyhound terminal the hotel is very lovely.
It's in a great location close to the shops and the rooms are very clean, although they are super small. 
If you were here for a extended amount of time it may not be the best but a stay of 1-3 days is perfect.

To sum it all up, this hotel is above average. I loved the roof top pool area where I order a few Golden Bears thanks to some friends we so happened to meet :), I also enjoyed the timely manner in which room service can overall we enjoyed our stay very much.

My family of 5 stayed here for a week during our vacation. Being from southern Cali we know how many wonderful things San Diego has to offer.
As soon as we pulled into the hotel parking lot, my husband was ready to leave. I told him to give it a chance; I wish I hadn't. 
We payed for a junior ocean view suite, which consisted if an old pull out couch & a bed that has springs that you can hear crackle every time you turn. My back hurt every morning. The small kitchenette had dirty dishes & no supplies. The bathroom was old, tiny & dirty . The towel rack fell off every time you take a towel off. I actually wore shower shoes in the bathroom; yes it's that bad. When we called for more towels (since there was 5 of us) it took them an hour! They have no cartoons for kids & you have to pay to watch nickelodeon. The carpet is old and stained & I none if us walked on it barefoot. I think a
Motel 8 would probably been cleaner . They charge way to much for this place! The bay view consisted of an alley view, with a public beach where people partied with loud music all night. Nice huh? Alhough the waiters are pleasant, the restaurant had flies (alot of them) hanging out at the Buffett 
bar. Unfortunatley other hotels were all booked & We already had bought tickets to local theme parks, or we would have packed up & left. The only thing nice about this place is the pool ( it's big & heated) . Look elsewhere for your money. This hotel was so bad & filthy none of us wanted to go back to it at the end of every day.

review_title: Great place to stay! Excellent views!
review_text: Besides the $26 per day self park fee and the $10 per day internet charge this place was great! Beautifully apponited rooms with great views of San Diego. The breakfast buffet was delicious and worth every penny! The concierge was great and recommended a wonderful restuarant for dinner that was just a short $5 cab ride away. I will definitely stay here again my next time in SD!

review_title: Outstanding Service during a difficult situation / Great Management!!!
review_text: We stayed at the W during the power outage in San Diego. The electrical power at the hotel and all of San Diego, went down at 3:00PM and did not return until the following morning. The staff at the hotel did an outstanding job! It started with an open buffet for all of the guests, a visit to each room by the manager to make sure that the hotel guests were ok and gave each guest a glow stick, a letter from the manager in the morning aplogizing for the inconvenience and offering up a breakfast buffet. The hotel manager and staff really went out of their way to make sure that all of the guests were comfortable in what was an unusual situation that was created by something outside of their control. Nice job!!!

My husband and I booked this trip to visit the beach and see family and friends. We arrived late and noticed that the lobby/check-in had a live DJ set up. 20 minutes later when we headed back downstairs it was evident that this was a club- upon our return from the bar - it was a raging party. If you are looking to party, dress up, dance and pass out all in the comfort of your own hotel, this is the place. We were a bit too casual and felt out of place even walking to the elevator.
If you are looking to sleep, the music over labor day weekend was loud. Other than pounding music, street traffic and screeching girls, the hotel wasn't bad. Rooms were clean, sheets were soft, breakfast was filling and it is in a central location. 
We aren't old or fuddy-duddies, but usually I am the one that feels bad about making noise, not the other way around. If you are young, hip, and looking for a fun night vibe book the W. If you looking for a quite place for your family, I am sure there are many wonderful options.

After reading reviews we were not looking forward to our stay here. We arrived early and we had to wait until 4pm to check in. We are pleased to say our room didn't smell. We had a bay view studio which had two double beds. We later found that the sofa was a bed and already made up which helped sleep our two kids. It included a kitchenette area with a fridge and cooker and a sink with a tap that didn't work. The toilet also blocked on numerous occasions. The room was dated but was clean and the beds comfy. The air con was too noisy to have on overnight. The buffet breakfast was ok but didn't have much of a range and wasn't that tasty. We have had better ones as complementary in other hotels. There's nowhere in walking distance to buy supplies to make use of the kitchen area. We found one but didn't like the flies on the inside of the bagel packets!! We had dinner in the cafe which was better. 
Over the weekend the bay does get very busy and noisy. It isn't really private as anyone can walk around the place. Mission Beach is like Blackpool in the UK and not really our scene. We had a drive up to La Jolla and wish we had stayed there instead. From here it was a quick and simple drive to the zoo and the city area too. 
The trip on the Bahia Belle was nice. We were given complementary tickets and used them on our last night. We found you only needed to show your room key so would assume you could go on as often as you would like. 
Overall it wasn't the private, self contained stay we thought we had booked. At least the room didn't smell!

I'm staying here for a conference, the room is soo outdated. I signed up for the wi-fi and paid 33+ for 72 hours, used it and it's like dial-up connection!!! I had it cancelled the next day. I've stayed in a few hyatts and this is by far disappointing! I should have stayed somewhere else.

review_title: Staff was so delightful... Manager Bri was darling.
review_text: Our stay was great and we were greeted with the friendliest staff. Being from Indiana, it was great speaking with manager Bri who was just darling with those dimples. We had a great trip...

The hotel has a great setting on mission bay and close to mission beach.
The hotel itself is a wee bit dated but is clean and tidy. It is 2 mins drive from seaworld and 5 mins walk to the beach.
This is a great location and hotel for a family holiday!

review_title: Glad to hear you are remodeling!
review_text:
This is the third time I have stayed here and all three times was only because I was working a convention for our company. This is the second time I found SO MUCH haid (from the previous guest) on the bathroom floor and in the bathtub. How gross is that? I guess sweeping bathroom floors isn't on the checklist for housekeeping.
My friend said she could hear the guy in the room next door going go the bathroom. Housekeeping was in the room next to mine one night around 10 pm and she was making so much noise that I could hear through the walls.so I hope when they remodel, they add some type of insulation in the walls.
Food prices in restaurants are ridiculous! I saw one review that said he got a AAA discount on the buffet breakfast. Wish I had known that. If that's true, they should note that on the menu.
I wouldn't stay here unless someone else(as in my company) were footing the bill.

We had the best "Staycation" here!!
Great huge room, flawless views, great location, walking distance to
Petco park, gaslamp, seaport village. 
Definitly staying here again :)
Ashley was amazing at service at the front desk which my stay amazing however room service needs a little work
Got a great deal on this hotel - club room is worthwhile, with the lounge access on the top of the hotel offering great views. Rooms are fresh with a kind of beachy/nautical feel
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: First of all, their breakfast buffet on the ground floor is out of this world. Yum! The location; AMAZING! Close to the gas lamp quarter and everything else! I loved absolutely everything about this hotel.

After reading many reviews on here I was reluctant to stay here. But, I took a chance and I am so happy that I did!! We stayed four nights in a marina suite. Our bedroom was huge! We were able to fit 2 full sized cribs in our bedroom along with the king bed. The bed was comfortable and clean. There was so a large flat screen tv on the wall. The living room was also a generous size with another flat screen on the wall. There is a large L shaped couch which had a pullout couch. Our room was on the first floor, which I recommend. Especially if you have kids. I was concerned when I looked up to the second floor as the railings did not appear to be up to code & there is a large space where I could see a safety issue with a small child. We had a beautiful view of the bay. Our room was cleaned everyday and there was no issue whatsoever. The staff was wonderful & we received excellent service. Mike C at the front desk was so helpful. Great experience all around!!
Ashley was amazing at service at the front desk which my stay amazing however room service needs a little work

review_title: Recommended hotel by the airport with easy access to downtown
review_text: Stayed here for 3 nights in dec. Upgraded to room 1223 as a platinum member. Marina suite which is large and clean. The view of the city across the marina is nice.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Beautiful hotel, but mediocre food and a problematic shower.
review_text:
The US Grant is a gorgeous, historic hotel that I have stayed at before, but this time we got put in what seemed to be a more handicapped accessible room. The biggest disadvantage to this was the shower which was configured so that you can't help flooding the bathroom floor. 
We were also very let down by the pricey and frankly pretty bad breakfast we got from room service.

review_title: Excellent staff, but won't stay here again.
review_text:
When we pulled into the Bahia on a Friday around 3pm and there was a line out the lobby door with people trying to check in. Once I made my way to the front, the check in process was simple and easy. We drove down to our room, which was no easy chore because the parking lot was packed, and there was no place to turn around. Once you got to the end, if you hadn't found a parking
 space, you had to do a 3-point turn in the driving lane. 
We got to our room and as soon as I opened the door, I said, "Oh no." There was a dingy smell and when I flipped on the light switch, nothing happened. It was so dark. I was very disappointed in the room quality. 
We had a downstairs room facing the bay. On the patio
, the lawn chairs were dirty and uninviting. The bathroom was sparse and I just really was unimpressed. To make matters worse, when I got in the shower so I could get ready to go to dinner--there was NO hot water. And at times, the shower water was ICE COLD. 
I called maintenance and they "fixed" it, but the next day I had the same problem. I called maintenance again and they were going to fix it again. That night, the toilet ran ever 3-5 minutes. It woke me up at 1am and I could never fully go back to sleep. The next morning, I went down to the front desk and spoke with the manager. 
He immediately offered us a new room and also moved all of our stuff while we were out atthe beach for the day. His name is Scott and he was the best part of the hotel. He did not give me the "run around" and he did his best to make our stay more enjoyable. 
Unfortunately, the shower drain didn't work in the new room, and the toilet still ran... But we had HOT water. It
was very nice! 
All in all, I was disappointed in the place. It was Way too crowded--there were at least 4 weddings each day and there were numerous other activities...just way too crowded. Scott was great and I appreciate his hospitality. But honestly, I spent as little time as possible at the hotel because it was overcrowded, it had no "resort feel", and it just felt and looked dingy.

This resort has something for everyone, boats to rent with or without captain, guests received free ride on their Bahia belle to sister property, so great way to go to pacific beach without fighting traffic. Accommodations were comfortable and accessible (we stayed in a small cabana with sliding doors opening to the beach). I would definitely recommend to friends and family and will stay there again

This is a great place for drinks on the roof. Rooms are small and breakfast is limited and hard for on the run. Would stay there again if I had too. Would avoid checking in on Sat night during nightclub though.

We only stayed here one night, but this was one of the nicest places we had stayed during our trip. Staff were friendly and accommodating - especially Rick who worked in the Bahia Cafe. He gave the best service, was friendly, happy and did his job very well! Rooms were comfy and the view from our room was beautiful. Would definitely recommend to stay here.

review_title: Great location, great staff, just ok rooms
review_text: This was my 2nd stay for work, both times check in was a breeze, had a great view both times from my rooms. Every staff member I came in contact was excellent. The location is perfect, walking distance to the gas lamp district and sea port village, lots to see and do and eat! The rooms need updating for the price. It's a $12-14 cab ride to the airport. Room service was quick and tasty, as with check in, checking out was also quick and easy. The public washrooms were smelly even though freshly cleaned?

I will definitely remember the gorgeous view of the marina at night, sunrise, all day long. The free shuttle to the airport is great, and from there, you can catch the $5 all-day bus that goes all over the city. Being close to the airport is important, because this place is not close to ANYTHING else. Plan to bus or taxi everywhere unless you have a car. The taxis are not cheap in SD, and public transportation is slow and circuitous.
 There are several hotel restaurants, with about the same food in all. We thought the place was rather pricey for being so isolated, but this is an expensive town.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: I had stayed here for a business conference and was disappointed. I am EXTREMELY happy I had gotten a discount on the room, it was not worth what they ordinarily charge. First of all, this "resort" doesn't have anything but pools. They are all outdoors and only one is heated. The restaurants on the property are extremely expensive, which is to be expected, but the food is nothing special. I paid 9 dollars for a small plate of hash browns and coffee. One cup! There is a "Starbucks" in the cafe, but they were using different coffee and flavors but keeping the Starbucks prices and names. The line for the cafe went out the door and around the pool, they would only help one guest at a time and wait for their coffee to be made. Our room was extremely small with an old tv, and smelled like it was 100 years old. They need some fresh air. The nicest part of the "resort" is the convention area, which has been mostly renovated. The rest is a 60s flashback. There are no hallways and the whole place is motel style. You have to pay for wifi and the gym. There is no complimentary breakfast. All of the restaurants served on dirty looking cups/plates and smelled gross. Our convention had paid for breakfast, which was 25$ per person per day. I am very happy I didn't pay for it, all we got is hard sausage and watery eggs. Although the property is in bad condition, the guest service is very good. We were satisfied with the maid service and the bellhop was very good with driving us around. Although the guest service and conference went well, you can't put lipstick on a pig. I would not stay here. It is not worth your money. Needs a renovation badly.

review_title: Like staying in a beautiful, comfortable museum.
review_text: This is a beautifully decorated, luxurious, hotel located in the Gaslamp district. The room was gorgeous and the bathroom was large with a granite shower, lush towels and nice toiletries. The bed linens were the finest, with turn down service and complimentary water. The service was excellent...friendly and helpful. I didn't like the city noise heard from the windows...sirens, trash trucks, etc...and there were a lot of homeless men living in doorways next to and across from the hotel.

First of all, if you are reading these reviews, DO NOT BELIEVE the negativity!!!! My family and I are 3 or so star type of people. I dont need the Hilton on a vacation. The Bahia is all of 3 stars if not 4. If you are looking for beautiful grounds, AMAZING pool and GIANT hot tub, absolutely perfect location, the friendliest staff, and proximity to ocean/belmont park/mission beach park/pacific beach...the list goes on, the Bahia is PERFECT!!! The zoo, downtown, Old Town, USS Midway and Seaport Village are also within 10 to 15 minutes driving. Our room was #665 and had an amazing sunrise view over the bay. Furniture, beds, kitchen and all other details of the room were great! Cannot beat the sunrise view from balcony in this room! If you eat at the Bahias restaurant I reccomend the southwestern spring rolls! Yum! Also reccomend taking the 630 trip on the Bahia Belle, great sunset photo op while cruising the bay and sipping on a drink! Overall I would strongly advise anyone reading this review to IGNORE all negative feedback of this resort! I just left TODAY (4-6-11) and already miss it!

review_title: Amazing staff, nice hotel in nice area!!
review_text: We pricelined the room and got it fir $100 night. The staff was amazing!! We were on our honeymoon and they answered all our questions. Left us champagne with chocolate covered strawberries in our room witha personal note. Extremely happy and highly recommend.

The hotel itself is rather nice. The only bummer is location for tourists. To use public transport you first get the hotels shuttle to the airport and then transfer to the local bus which can be time consuming.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: They try, I suspect, to be more or less professional. The service is spotty at best. Room keys fail daily. Hallway continuously scattered with dishes that stay for days. In room coffee is good. Food, which is good but not great, would be a good deal at half the price.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: The staff was helpful printed park tickets with no problem, cleaning staff was fantastic. My son had 3 stuffed animals he sleeps with. The cleaning staff set them up on the bed as if the were waving welcoming us in. The microwave and mini fridge are very handy since there is a grocery close by. Pool area well kept and boats along walk way are beautiful. Across the street from park and very short drive to anything you want to do. We loved every minute of our stay.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_title: Nice stay, but nothing to write home about.
review_text:
When we arrived we discovered we were in the Bay Tower, not the Maruna Tower. We had no idea they were two separate locations and didn't discover it until bags were out of the car and lugged quite aways, after a 6 hour drive. The lady that checked us in was very nonchalant about it... We could take a 5minute walk, bags in tow or drag them back to the car and drive.FRUSTRATING! 
Our room was nicely decorated, beds were wonderful, all our contacts with employees was great! Our room could have been cleaner and they definitely should have changed the shower curtain (even the slightest bit of mold freaks me out). Overall a good stay, but I expect a spotless room for the amount we paid.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: Great value foe $100 a night. Great location, great pool area with fire pit to watch the sunset and feel the chill at night. Attentive staff at checkin and check out. Only negative is slight smell lf mildew in corridors and room. Probably due to a lack if humidity control with AC setting?
Loved the staff. They made my vacatihhhon. Very hospitable. Very clean too. No problems at all.

review_title: Might Stay Again, With Some Improvements
review_text:
The staff was excellent, especially Genesis and the night manager whose name escapes me right now. The hotel is in a great location, just a few minutes drive from the airport, Sea World, the zoo, and Gas Lamp district. Old Town is a quick walk away too. 
Breakfast was Danishes, cereal, fruit, yogurt, eggs waffles, etc. The food was good and plentiful, and the room had lots of seating. The pool looked nice, but I didn't venture in. The outdoor seating area was lovely, great for enjoying meals outside.
And that's where the fun ends. We did not get the room type we booked. Haven't checked out yet, but hopefully I'm not charged for the higher room I booked. I also requested a rollaway bed, but none were available. This was a bummer because, due to the room downgrade we now didn't have enough beds for everyone and someone had to sleep on the floor. Staff was great and provided loads of extra blankets for a makeshift bed, but still.....
This hotel is not great for business travelers. I couldn't get my iPad to connect to the wifi, and while I was waiting in the lobby to use their one computer (with a 10 minute time limit) I spoke with several other guests who were having the same problem. Internet access is incredibly important when traveling these days, they need to work on that.
The hair dryer was spotty which proved to be very frustrating and we were forced to spend a lot more time trying to get ready. When I was finally fed up and called the front desk it was promptly replaced with a brand new dryer.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn San Diego Old Town / Airport

review_title: Very accommodating, clean, right on harbor.
review_text: My wife and I have stayed here a couple of times during a business convention I had. Great location on the harbor. Both times, we got a room in the bay tower, harbor side, high floor. These rooms are equipped with balconies that overlook the harbor and the air force base. The sound of the helicopters didn't bother me at all during the day, but I did hear some people complaining about it. I found it very interesting to watch their training everyday. Nice rooms and very clean. Some need updating but clean nonetheless. Grounds are easy to get around on and there are little cafe's and bars and breakfast places within and around the hotel. The staff is very accommodating and prompt with special requests. Just a great place in a great city!
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: The first morning my wife wakes up and shows me a bite on her chest, the following morning I have a bite on my Arm and leg, so Saturday night we call hotel service, they send someone out to check for bed bugs, he find nothing and try to explain the possibility of it being mosquito bites, because of the waterfront being so close, we never see a single mosquito. The next morning more bites for both of us, we need alcohol to stop the itching. We check out and inform them of our concern and they inform of the experts they are bring in to check the room. Of course their expert finds nothing. Get home and the next morning more bites,did the mosquitos follow us home. You tell me what you think it is. My wife is going to see the doc today. One thing for sure we didn't have this problem until we spent the night at this place. What's next.

review_title: New W concept suddenly feels very old.
review_text: $32 parking, gym equipment that doesn't work, tvs not programmed to show more than 5 channels, pool the size of my bed, wake up calls that never happen. Let's just say that I was eager to visit the W but will never visit again. The W used to be cool and hip; now it feels like your visiting someone who still thinks it's the 60s.

review_title: I would not recommend this hotel unless your primary reason for staying here is to be walking distance to seaport village.
review_text:
The location is perfect. It's walking distance to seaport village. It's very close to gas lamp quarter. However there are many down sides! It's a rooftop pool and the two buildings creat a wind tunnel. Even in august it was really windy. We didn't get to enjoy the pool. The room is decent but not great. It definitely wad not worth the price. I would not recommend staying here. The grand buffet breakfast was excellent. We had paid for it while booking the room. We still got charged for it everymorning! Had we not noticed it on our bill when we checked out, we would have paid double for breakfast. They don't have many activities for kids. They had movie night on Saturday night but it was so cold that the kids weren't able to stay and watch. And the seats were the pool chairs that had been used all day by hotel guests and so they were wet. They had s'mores but you had to purchase them. We have stayed at many hotels that offer this for free. it's not the cost but the principle of it. After we complained about the room
View, which was supposed to be a full harbor view, they gave us $30 credit per night which was like getting parking for free. We were there gor four days and I could say that this was not how we wanted to end our summer vacation. Don't stay here. There are so many beautiful hotels in sam Diego area.

I have enjoyed my stay here for a conference. My room is a little plain, but quiet and clean. The service is very pleasant and helpful. Dinner at the Trellis was quite good. The grounds are pretty. I was very worried after reading recent reviews, but everything has worked out fine.

The rooms are very spacious. The bathrooms are a little small but still nice. Just two small things I noticed when we got to our room. There was silverware outside our room and a little hair in the floor and the side of the bathtub. A little more attention to detail by housekeeping would take care of this. Love the balcony with table and chairs looking out over the water. Overall a nice hotel.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Awesome place. 2 warm pools 2 hot tubs. Nice restaurant. Very friendly helpful staff.
review_text: We had room 203. Are room was a real suite with a full kitchen lots of free in room coffee Great view of the bay. We had a private little deck area. Nice quiet street more walkers and bikes and boats going by then cars. Feels like you are at a resort. Water on both sides. Seems like you are 10 minutes from everything in San Diego.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_text: I was booked here in early October of 2011 as I was attending a conference here. I checked in and while I was doing this, an elderly man walked up to the desk and said he just went to his room and it s unacceptable and he wanted his money back and did not want to stay here. I should have heeded his warning but decided to chck for myself. I go to my room which was in the newer "better" Royal Palms Tower. The room was probably really nice in the 1980s. Still had a crummy boxy picture tube television which did not have a clear picture. Room smelled bad and looked dirty. All this for $159 a night! I tried calling the front desk 3 times from the room phone and the call kept on not going through. Needless to say, I went back to the front desk and asked for the manager and told her about the room and said that I didn't want to stay here and wanted to know if I could cancel my reservation and she agreed to do it and even waived the one night charge for canceling the reservation. She was great and very accomadating. It really didn't seem to bother her too much that I wanted to leave and she was a pleasure to deal with. I'm sure she deals with this a lot. Bottom Line--- don't waste your time or money. There is an excellent Courtyard by Marriott across the interstate.

I was there for a convention. Never again. I'm sure at one point (say the early 60s) it was a great resort, but it's in need of a makeover. 
First the toilet seat was filthy. I wonder if any cleaning was done in the bathroom. The phone is so dirty that I cringe when I had to use it. The fluffy rug had remains from a previous decade.
But they had decent toiletries.
Even if I had to I'm not sure I would go again.

review_title: Great place from which to explore San Diego!
review_text:
We've stayed in a few W hotels, and this was one of the best yet. Much better value than most (we paid $179/night as opposed to $279/night at the Westwood W) but the experience was just the same.
The beach terrace with real sand was nice, and we got a good room upgrade. The chalk board in the room was great! This was our first time visiting San Diego and the location was great. All the waterfront front attractions were within easy walking distance.
I love the Acura experience at W Hotels. We didn't actually make use of it this time because we had our own car but the guy on the desk was so friendly and helpful, telling us where to go and what to look out for.
Highly recommended!

review_title: Great location downtown with stunning 40 th floor view
review_text: Ample swimming pools and hot tubs in excellent downtown area for exploring the gas lamp without actually being in it! Rooms are typically hyatt and we stayed for 5 days on business and really enjoyed sundowner drinks on the top floor bar. Recommended

This hotel should be a 3 star. The rooms, bed/linens/bathroom- everything are average. It felt like we were driving to the airport and bam -we were at our hotel. Yes we could see planes taking off out our window- so if you like planes this is perfect. I had to request a new room because our bedspread was stained and there was mold in the bathtub. Second room was a downgrade but at least it was clean and they gave us a breakfast voucher. Great bargain if you get it on priceline- but don't buy the rack rate. Overpromise, underdeliver. Btw- Coffee was stale in the room.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: stayed here 4 nights, service great, rooms comfortable and well appointed. Only problem is wall noise insulation. Next door room slammed door, our bed shook.pretty poor for this quality hotel. close to waterfront. nice margaritas in lobby bar.

review_title: BEWARE... please don't stay here you will ruin your trip to a gorgeous place!
review_text:
It is unfortunate that this conference was held at such a below grade place. San Diego is a gorgeouse place once I ventures outside this location. This place Is far from a resort, the grounds and rooms are dates and dirty.
They tell you to leave you plates from room service outside on the floor..street level outside (beware of movement thoughout bushe at this motel (resort)
The fact that they charge you a 50 dollar fee if you leave early is a sign to leave.
If you took the time to read this for your own good do not stay here I wish I would have known better before I arrived..I left early and paid there fee and I would never return or recommend this to even my enemy. 
Very sad and unprofessional establishment and they should be ashamed of the pictures they are representing on there website!
The photos on there website are no way close to representing this place up close in person.
It really is sad that this place ruined many guest stay at this large conference

This place is an upgraded Motel 6, in fact I would rather stay at a Motel 6. Its outdated and not welcoming at all. There were 2 miserable people at the front desk at check-in. The food presentation was nice, food was average. Restaurant and housekeeping staff were very friendly. The grounds were beautiful. Room and bathroom was awful. Not dirty, just old, musty, dingy. If you have a choice - stay somewhere else. The pictures are deceiving, and so is the name. This is NO resort.

review_title: Run down , dirty, OVER-RATED by 4 stars!!
review_text: Apparently they hand out 4 star ratings to anyone who applies! Filthy, run-down roach hotel!!! Skip this place for a 2 star!!!! At least you'll save some $!!

I can tell what kind of hotel
I'm in by the cleanliness of the elevator... Call me crazy, but it works every time. The elevator carpet looked like it had never been vacuumed, let alone cleaned. Combine that with the filthy sliding glass doors and popcorn ceiling in our room and you have a filth infested 5 roach special! Overpriced and run down. Do yourself a favor and try the Best Western on the beach! This place is disgusting!

review_title: relaxing, great views day and night time and wonderful service
review_text: really enjoyed our stay. the grounds are very pretty. small streams with waterfowl food is good at the restaurantS. wonderful prompt service. we personally like to be in the tower to take advantage of the views. having a kitchen in the rooms is a great way to save money.

Week long stay with four kids. Go early for breakfast!!! Parking is tight, but all of San Diego seems to be like that. Nice that there is a laundry room, but no where really to sit and wait. Our kids loved the pool and hot tub. Friendly, courteous staff....very helpful. love that there was microwave and fridge in room. We will stay here again.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn & Suites Zoo / SeaWorld Area

review_text: Stayed in this resort this weekend and found the grounds to be beautiful, the concierge desk very helpful and the rooms fit our needs. The only down fall was the Terrace Cafe, found their breakfast buffet to be pricey especially for your average food selection as convenient as it was to eat there would not do it again.
Stay here if you need an airport overnight. Nice location but not really anything else to recommenced it. Restaurants are either very expensive or a 'sports bar' which is bit naff!
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Excellent place to stay with your children.
review_text: My husband, 2 children & myself stayed there the last week of July 2011. It was very busy in the dining room that morning, and the hotel had run out of fresh fruit. Our 6 year old has several food allergies and that was the only type of food the hotel served that would be okay for her. I went to the front desk to see if they could put more out, if they had it stocked. Ashley O. At the front desk went above and beyond the call of duty. She took it upon herself to track down a couple of apples for our daughter & delivered them to our room herself. If that wasn't enough, she took her break & personally went to the store to get a banana too. This meant the world to me & to my daughter, because of the lack of availability of safe food due to my daughter's allergies. Ashley O. took our situation seriously as soon as she realized how fatal the other foods in the hotel would have been for our daughter. I'm very impressed with her commitment to her job and appreciated so much that she followed through until a resolution was reached. The words "Thank You" just aren't enough so I hope this review will bring her positive recognition with her employer. Thanks again for wonderful service!!!
hotel_name: Comfort Inn & Suites Zoo / SeaWorld Area

review_title: I felt like I was transported back in time
review_text: Ok, my wife had a conference here, so we decided to stay here for convenience. It is just like something out of the 60's. I will say that the staff is super friendly, just as all the people we have met in southern California. The room had a musty smell, and some awful blue carpet. The wifi, which is free, is pretty unreliable, and unavailable many times we tried to use it. The bed was comfortable, though the bedspread was old. The furnishings in the room were like out of grandmas house. There were three pools, but uncomfortable chairs to sit in by them.

They pretty much charge you for everything. You have to go through a gate to park which hardly ever worked and constantly had to get new keys made because of it. The parking is $11 a day which is almost more then any airport you go to just to stay there. Also at 7:15 we wanted to play ping pong and the manager there told us they can't give us any paddles because it's past the time. I clearly told him most of the people staying here don't get back till around this time and he refused to care. This was a great location hotel but not even close to worth it for the price. I rather have stayed at a less nice place for better service.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: This a a beautiful hotel right on the bay. Loved the location and tropical ambiance. What I didn't love was that the pool/ jacuzzi area was closed after dark due to a broken light. Unfortunately, this was not posted anywhere in advance. We ended up with a very unhappy child who had expected to finally get into the pool after a long day. The other issue was that we were charged far more for the room than the amount quoted over the phone. The staff eventually agreed to change the bill, after a fair amount of hassle. Make sure to take your email rate confirmation. Overall, a lovely hotel and they deserve another chance.

review_title: Great hotel lacking in customer service
review_text:
This is a great property and I'd definitely stay here again. Offers 3 pools and decently sized rooms with balconies. Our view of the marina was beautiful. Some reviewers complained about the location, but it's nice not to be in the downtown area(scuzzy, with lots of homeless!! --- I know they have to live somewhere, but when you're traveling with family you do not want to deal with that element.)Â 
My main complaint with this hotel would be the lack of customer service and their VERY STRONG air freshener. Certain people in my party loved it, but it was definitely not allergy friendly. It had me wheezing before I even completed the checkout process and I had a headache for the rest of our stay.
Got up to our room, we decided to order room service and relax before heading down to the pool. I called room service four times and called the front desk, but nobody picked up! I started pushing other buttons in an attempt to ask about room service or other dinning options, but again no answer. The only people that did answer were the valet and they had my car waiting for me proptly every time(good job valet! That was the best service we received while there)
I called and asked for two extra blankets, several hours later they never came. After making a follow up call(which AGAIN was not picked up) I went downstairs and requested the two blankets in person. Eventually they sent up ONE blanket.Â 
My room was also charged over $50 in minibar charges for items that were never removed from the fridge. Called to have it corrected, was told someone had to come check the fridge before we checked out, but no one ever came, we waited over an hour for a person to come up!! Finally went down and was told by the desk that they already reversed the charges... So why on earth didn't any staff member bother telling me this??? Because of the wait we ended up being late to our next destination.Â 
Great hotel, bad customer service!!
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: Gorgeous centralized hotel close to Gaslamp Quarters, little Italy and many more attractions. Our second time visiting and chose to stay at this hotel again. Staffs are very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended 5 star hotel!

review_title: Se si Ã© in macchina comodo funzionale e pulito
review_text:
Quando si arriva nell'hotel circe, rispetto agli altri hotel fa temere il peggio, invece, una volta entrati, Ã© una piacevole scoperta. Camere ordinate e pulite, struttura graziosa con due piscine ai cui bordi Ã© possibile consumare la colazione. Colazione continentale ricca con macchine per i waffles (anche se da expedia mi risultava colazione esclusa in realtÃ  era inclusa).
WiFi con password che prende bene, macchine per il ghiaccio.
Posizione molto comoda perchÃ© all'incrocio delle due freeways principali di San Diego, non mi sono informata sui mezzi ma, vista la posizione, credo sia necessario avere la macchina.
Unico neo personale forse non tra i piÃ¹ disponibili.

review_title: Awesome hotel in desirable Gaslamp with sweet military discount!
review_text: I love this hotel! The location is great, just two blocks from the convention center and a half block from 6th Street nightlife bars and great restaurants. The boutique style of the hotel makes it hard to stay in regular hotels. Nicely decorated rooms, the haidryers in the bathroom are real hairdryers, not the wallmounted sort that rarely work. Great mini bar with snacks in addition the drinks. On our second stay here, we were given a 10$ gift certificate to "raid the minibar," a nice touch. The pool area is super, making me want to stay there instead of wander the town. With attentive waitresses and plenty of pavillions and shade. The pool itself isn't huge, but it's the right size to dip into and cool off. With Government (military) and AAA discounts, we paid only $130+ tax. I had special requests - away from elevator and firm pillows- and they actually listened to the request. I think we will probably always stay here when we come to SD.

I read reviews of every hotel near Sea World/Mission Beach before booking our stay. There were so many scary reviews it was hard find a good place. My crucial criteria were clean, close and quiet - I'm really not that demanding. I have 2 kids, 3 and 13 months so having clean carpet and no scary critters were very important. This hotel was super clean. As for quiet, it was pretty good. We were on the pool side (as opposed to the freeway side) on the 2nd floor right above the pool and the noise wasn't too bad. It didn't bother my light sleeper kids. There was some noise from the hallway, the room doors always slammed shut and a fair amount of overhead thuds while trying to sleep one night. The room was large - 2 queens and sofa bed. I pulled the sofa bed out once for a nap, no way could an adult sleep comfortably on that, springy and noisy with every move. Sink area was tiny, but we managed ok. Bathroom was clean, no issues bathing the little ones. Plenty of towels too.
 Overall the hotel layout is goofy - placement of laundry, breakfast room, parking garages, and elevators. Just be aware. 
Breakfast was fine, as long as you were there early, they do warn you about that at check in. The room was large, there's just a lot of people staying there and it gets crowded. Good variety. 
There were lots of bad comments about parking, but we had no problem. The outside spots were very small, my minivan didn't fit well, but we always found a spot in the garage and the van fit just fine there. 
Freeway access was easy. Only 10 min to Sea World or the beach. 
Overall, we were quite satisfied with our stay.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn & Suites Zoo / SeaWorld Area

review_title: Looking at the lobby one gets excited about the rooms, BIG DISAPPOINTMENT worst Hyatt rooms ever 2 STARS
review_text:
I'm a hyatt platinum member, also a gold hyatt member, my family and I decided to stay at this hyatt on our 7 night vacation because of the location and the pictures on their web site.
We arrived and checked in with a member of their friendly staff, went up to the room only to realize that the place smelt like an "ash tray", with 2 kids 2yrs & 5yrs we headed back down to the platinum checkin desk.
We then payed more to upgrade our room which was on the opposite tower on the 24th floor.
Got to our 2 room apartment, to my discuss the once cream carpet was brown or maybe green, the bathroom tiles was cracked on the floor and the grout was mouldy and 
black, in the dresser cabinet there 
was holes to the side, I guess it 
was missing equipment, the phone 
on the desk was DEAD, the IPod 
doc did not work, the beds and 
sheets seems as old as my mother.
The only updated thing was the TV.
We arrived about 14:00 on a Monday afternoon, the kids immediately wanted to go to the pool, we changed and headed straight over there, it was a good chance for us to get the kids out of this ROOM.
After 10 min at the pool, my wife and I taught we will have a couple cocktails, only to find out there is no bar or restaurant at the pool side on Monday's ( we went back on thursday at 16:00 after the zoo and the said their temporary bar set up had closed) so I had to go 4 levels down a log back up 5 drinks + peanuts + chips.
On a better note service at the hotel and the dinner we had at Sally's was great also was the buffet breakfast in the hotel the next few mornings.
Room service on the other hand ..... After holding on the phone for over 8 mins the food was awful.
If you don't mind a 2 STAR hotel check it out, if you want better stay far away.
The only updated thins wast the flat screen TV

Having just spent 2 nights here, I have not a bad word to say.. Checkin was fast and efficient, rates were great, location is perfect (5 min walk to Little Italy, 10-15 min walk to the heart of Gaslamp Quarter and 5 min walk to the water), breakfast simple but plentiful, rooms great size and clean which include a balcony and parking cheap at $10 per night..... If u call the hotel direct they will offer you a great rate.. I shopped around and reviewed heaps of hotels and I think I found a gem.. Don't get me wrong, it is nothing over the top but location, price and cleanliness all factor into this great review.. Wifi works fantasstic too... Only problem was I didn't stay long enough in SD as it is a wonderful City with amazing, clean, pretty and so much history and sight seeing to be done.. Do yourself a favour and allow at least 5 nights..

review_title: Oops! I Forgot Some Wonderful People!
review_text:
I forgot to mention some azing staff at Solamar when I wrote my review last night. 
James brought our luggage up to our room when we arrived Monday, May 09. He spent time with us giving us suggestions as to what we should while in San Diego and where to head to if we rented a car!
In JSix we have had outstanding Waitstaff. Thanks to Kristen, Josie and Jamie who ensured that our meals and service were memorable!
We should mention that JSix has 1/2 price wine on Wednesday nights. What a deal! We had a bottle of Deutz Blanc de Blanc champagne!! What a bargain plus we rec'd 20% off our bill because we had had breakfast in the restaurant that morning!
All in all - amazing food, delicious wine and outstanding service. We have no hesitation in recommending JSix as a dining venue for a romantic dinner (plus breakfasts are delicious!)
The only thing we would mention is that it is a touch noisy, so ask for a 2 semi-circle booth or a 4 person booth. 
Enjoy and thanks Hotel Solamar!

review_title: Absolutely beautiful! Wish I didn't have to leave
review_text: I spent a week at this hotel on a business trip. It was a beautiful spot with lots of great people both working there and at the conference. During our nights off from meetings we had the very sweet seaport village to stroll along. Definitely would live to go back again very soon!
