PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE BOOKING...... PROS: Good location if you want to be isolated from just about everything. Few restaurants near by but for most part downtown area I hear is better for lodging. Yes there was only one good thing about this hotel. 
CONs: Initally everything seem to be quite nice. Shuttle personel was wonderful. Check in was very slow. We walked up with two ppl in line waiting 
took about 45 mins to get to us. 
Wanted to get a service performed from spa only to find that they didn't have a full time employee on staff who could complete my request. I was livid... Had to attend the Marine graduation looking not up to par with my norms.
The actual room was something you can see at a Motel 6( please no offense meant to that franchise). This goes for the hotel rooms in the Lanina side. The worse looking rooms I ever seen at a Sherton hotel. OMG please dont let me get on the pricing there. It is true they have a price on everything to have a refrigerated in your room of what you think is a 4 star hotel that cost is 15 bucks/ day to have handy. Prepostourus!!! 
THE HOTEL WILL NICKEL AND DIME YOU AS STATED IN OTHER REVIEWS. THEY PURPOSELY DO NOT HAVE VENDING MACHINES SO YOU ARE SOME WHAT FORCED TO DRINK FROM THE OVERLY OVER PRICED MINI BAR! JUST THINK IN THOSE LATE HOURS WHEN THE THIRST BUG HIT YOU YOU SHOULD MAKE SURE YOU HAVE EITHER A BOAT LOAD OF MONEY STASHED AWAY FOR THE MINI BAR OR STOCK UP ON YOUR FAVORITE NIGHT TIME SNACKS AND DRINKS BEFORE COMING BACK TO HOTEL PREMISES AND REMEMBER THAT FRIGs are 15 bucks/night to have in room!!! CRAZY RIGHT! same thing I said.
The front desk associates (one for sure) was totally clueless about shuttle times etc. At this point I am boiling over! 
The ball was def dropped at this Sheraton! Please do not let the location fool you! 
At any rate we didnt have to pay for a couple of nights for all the aboved inconveniences!
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Great rooms. Location just out of downtown. Lovely staff
review_text:
stayed in the bay tower.
Very close to airport and free shuttle available.
Lovely helpful staff. From reception to hse keeping.
Rooms lovely decorated and very spacious.
A fridge in room would be a great addition.
Nice pool and hot tub area.
Larger bay tower facilities available to use to all guests. Five minute walk away.
There is no bar and grill that is open all day in bay tower. Opens periodically in the evening.
Bus stop is a ten min walk and its only ten minutes to downtown.
15$in a cab to downtown.
The extras in this hotel are very expensive. Parking $20 per night,movies,mini bar etc.
Removing points for no wifi in each room and the lack of a always open bar/grill. Wifi only available in lobby.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: We decided to stay here because of the positive comments we read and it did not disappoint! We were impressed with the spaciousness of the room and my daughters (5 and 3 years old) immediately went out on the balcony to check out the view. I recommend requesting the Marina view in the upper floors. The only downside to this stay is the cost of parking which is $22 per day or $30 for valet. Also, we were here during the weekday and found it difficult to find parking so I can't imagine how it would be on a busy weekend. Overall, it was a fun family trip...pool was nice, clean, and warm. They have a fitness room and small gameroom for table tennis and pool. Oh, forgot to mention that they give you an option to be "green" by opting out of getting room serviced in exchange for $5 voucher which we used for Starbucks...totally worth it since you can call housekeeping anytime for more towels or amenities.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Awesome experience in the heart if downtown!
review_text:
We just returned from a fabulous stay at Hotel Solamar! From the moment we arrived we felt valued as guests and very well taken care of. After reading some of the views I made sure to call and request a quiet room since my husband and I were going to celebrate our anniversary. They put us on the top floor (no pets) and in a corner room with windows all around! It was absolutely beautiful! They even left a bottle of wine, a box of chocolates, and a hand written note congratulating us on our anniversary, such a nice touch! The only negative thing I have to say is that the tv was not working well while we were there. The shows would constantly cut in and out, but not a big deal to us since we aren't big tv people.
Overall we had such a great time and experience! We can't wait to stay there again!

I came to town and country for a weekend getaway and I arrived early in the morning and went straight to bed. The room was clean just the right size and set up nicely. I woke up and went outside it was beautiful. Flowers everywhere and tables and chairs to sit on. I loved this place and the feeling it gave off. However, when it came time to check out there was some problems and a huge misunderstanding but in the end everything worked out and next time I go to san diego im staying here again. Ooo and the location was the best. Not to far from sea world and the beaches takes bout ten minutes and shopping is like 3 seconds away :)))
-kayla

review_title: Well priced, great location and clean
review_text: Nice hotel right down the street from the airport. Very clean, great pool, right on the harbor. Free shuttle to and from the airport. Good value. I would stay there again. The only negative is the room was a bit small.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Great hotel, I can't think of a thing they could have done better.
review_text:
The hotel and facilities are first class. I didn't want to leave after my 4 night stay. 
This hotel is in walking distance of many great restaurants and bars. 
The only thing that was a sore spot was the parking. Their valet was way too expensive. I recommend the parking garage just across the street.

We stayed with our three year old for three nights. We ended up originally in the marina tower and decided to switch to the lanai section. I know some reviewers didn't lime this section but we loved it. We had a wonderful view of the water and were right next to the Pools but the best part was no elevators to deal with which was a treat with a three year old. Room was super comy and nicely decorated. Starbucks was right there which I liked. The only thing I didn't live was the cost of parking but the service and everything else was great.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Poorest Customer Service I Have Ever Seen
review_text: Bottom line, as a manager you have one job, take care of customer issues. This place had no concern for the guest. Out of the 8 rooms booked, 5 had issues with the type of room. Non smoking put in really bad smoking rooms. When we confronted the manager, we were greeted with, "that's a request, not a guarantee.". Poor customer service.

review_title: Outdated decor, dirty bathroom, young/inexperienced staff at registration desk.
review_text: This is my first time staying at this hotel. Our first encounter was at the front desk checking in. We were appalled to notice in plain sight (at the check-in counter) a 16-page document detailing names of hotel guests along with their room numbers and parking locations! When we let the staff know, she picked up the document and proceeded to move it to a different part of the counter (still in plain view). We finally had to ask her to remove it as it contains confidential information (!) Our room was outdated, with a tiny bathroom that contains a chipped tub, dirty caulking, and rusty toilet. The TV is old and has poor reception. $10/day charge for WiFi. The pool area is small and fenced in (think apartment complex swimming pool) which made it uninviting Not at all the "resort" it claims to be.

review_title: Made my trip from the east coast to San Diego worthwhile!
review_text: I stayed here a few weeks ago and I just could not believe this place. From the views of the marina and downtown to the hotel service it was great. When I come back this is my first choice of hotel. The island it's on is beautiful and not far from the hustle and bustle. Highly recommend this hotel to anyone.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_title: Top hotel with some of that old school charm
review_text: Love staying at this hotel. The staff is always friendly and helpful. Patti Muklevilz was very nice and coming in from a stressful flight and travel in general she made me feel right at home. Kuddos to the management and staff.

We planned a surprise family reunion for my mother this past 4th of July weekend. Our group had 42 people attend, though not all stayed. We did have 14 rooms booked, including a suite as our gathering spot. 
From the moment we checked in, until we checked out, the service at this facility was flawless. The hotel even showed a movie for all guests out on the lawn, including popcorn.
They have the BEST orange juice at the restaurant by the pool. I have never had OJ this good. The hotel is so conveniently located with a large mall behind it and the trolly to take you all over San Diego. 
We had the best time! Thank you town and country. I'll be sure to stay here again when I visit from Indiana.

I'm currently at the hotel. The venue I am attending is here and supposedly we have discount rates. Found cheaper rates on the hotel web site. But no matter. 
I arrived about 3p today and was 2nd in line. Only one desk person and she was fairly grumpy. Within 15 minutes the line was 10 deep. No one else came to help nor did she call anyone. Sherida was oblivious to the folks irritation.
Beware they charge $10/per device for each 24hrs!!
Found several white little bugs on my bed after removing a soil comforter . Glasses needed washing. Room way too small for 2adults and one teen. 
Next time we're staying at the Best Western. Less money, friendly staff, affordable meals and well appointed rooms

Get the corner king room. Windows from floor to ceiling times 3. The windows all open to allow the ocean breeze to fill your room. Large TV with real HD channels. There is a fridge in the room and a grocery store within 7 minute walk to save you money on beers, pops, and bottled water. It's a short walk to Gaslamp. Eat breakfast at Richard Walker's, it's a 5 minute walk. Cheaper and better than the hotel. I researched a lot before deciding on a hotel for this trip. This was a perfect choice.

I stayed at the Sheraton because an annual conference I attend had booked this place. It was not out of choice. The rooms did NOT have wifi. I verified this w people in both towers there for my conference. The hotel is also out of the way unless you have a car and then the parking card readers are shotty. When you call the valet for help you get an attitude as if the issue is your fault. Icing on the cake for me was finding my room door left open by housekeeping the final day there. When I spoke to the GM about that and my broken faucet he told me my bill would be adjusted. Not so much. Love San Diego but next time I will be at the Hyatt or Marriott.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: Got this room expecting greatness, unfortunately it did not meet my expectations. Elevator had rotting wood in it, paint falling off. Bathroom light wouldn't turn off, didn't have a fan, and had mold growing on the ceiling! Room was nice, but didn't have a fridge, had unreasonably priced items in a stocked fridge. Room service was unreasonably priced! Had to pay for parking @ the hotel - 22$ a day-to-day no validation. Bed was uncomfortable! Bed had plastic or something on the mattress that made us sweat! Only thing that was nice was location and view, otherwise poor place to choose!
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Very relaxing stay at the Grand Hyatt!
review_text:
Well first of all, when we got there for a scout conference, I was unsure about the hotel because of some of the reviews on trip advisor. I was in for a nice surprise! The check-in lady was really nice and pleasant, and the parking ticket wasn't as much as some of the reviews said it would be! I asked the lady if we could have a bay-view room, and she gave us one without even charging extra, and we
 had a perfect view of seaport village and the battleship! Besides that, the grand mall was only a 10 minute walk away! The pool was clean, and the jacuzzis were outstanding! Also, the poolside snack bar had awesome bartenders, and the waitresses were very nice! The showers were a little dirty, but hey, what can you expect from a shower that has been used before! The beds, were a different story, as for falling asleep on them was like sleeping on a rock! The restataraunts in seaport village were very pricy, but for good service and food! Back to the rooms, they were very nice, and there were no "stains" on the floor. The housekeeping lady provided good service and cleaning, as the same with room service! Overall, I would definitely recommend this if you want a relaxing stay in San Diego, California!

Booked a "garden room with patio or balcony" a couple months in advance.
Given a 1970's motel room with a view of a wall. The wall did have some ivy growing on it.
Nickel and dimed every time you turned around.

Rude people in every department from sales (promised things he didnt deiver) to Trellises manager. Ghetto. Disgusting filthy rooms (roaches), tasteless food, outdated decor, uncomfortable beds with scratchy bedspreads, ugly flowered patterns everywhere you turn, musty smell, loud noise outside and paper thin walls. Should I go on? Overpriced rooms, charges for net, gym, fridge, food should be free for the horrible quality. Seriously would rather sleep on the street than stay here again. This place will not survive much longer without a few million to tear it down and rebuild. Oh and, dont let them fool you into thinking you will get a flat screen tv in your room. They are very deceptive.

I stayed at the Manchester Hyatt for two nights to attend a business meeting at the hotel. I was checked in by a truly charming young man. My room was in the Harbor Tower; very nice view. The king bed room was spacious and clean and the bed was comfy. The location right on the harbor makes many restaurants and attractions walkable. The hotel food was excellent and the sushi at Sally's was wonderful as well. My only complaint, and it is minimal, is that the air dryer in the room didn't work, but it took over 20 min for them to bring up a replacement. Kind of set me back on schedule and promoted a bad hair day. These kinds of things are minor and I would definitely stay again!

review_title: As long as you have a rental car, great deal and location!
review_text: Stayed for a week with my 20 year old daughter. We stayed on the club floor which was nice especially for breakfast daily, and ability to get bottled water anytime we wanted. Although we didn't spend a lot of time at hotel, when we did we enjoyed it! Favorite staff member....Scott, the bartender at Tapatinis for sure! He was entertaining and pleasant. We took advantage of the "green room" choice and instead of housekeeping we received $5.00 every day under our door to be used anywhere in the hotel. We still asked for extras of anything we ran low on, and always received what we needed. Only complaint is that parking is a little high.....$22.00/night is exhorbitant! and $28/night for valet was out of the question for us.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Awful and outdated...be prepared to step back in time
review_text: I don't use the term "dump" lightly. This place has many different buildings...good luck if you get stuck in one of the older ones. If you are under 55 and travel at all, you will be disappointed. Some of the words I'd use are old, tired, outdated, unkept and in major need of an overhaul. Who charges extra these days for things like wifi and the gym??? Only places that are in danger of going belly up is the answer.

review_title: The place is old and creepy.
review_text: Like scene from a 70s flix. Kinda creepy if you stay alone. The art on the wall with the girl is trippy.
Just stayed at The Sheraton hotel in July. We loved the location, pools and great food!! Great Room Service!! Walking distance to shopping and other great places to eat!
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Overall happy with our stay; Cant wait to visit again!
review_text:
Great location, but request to be in the Harbor Tower if possible. It got tiring walking back & forth across the entire hotel. Sea port Village, Top of the Hyatt, & all the restaurants/shops are in or right outside of the harbor tower.
Our room was overall good. Amazing view of the city & water. The only thing was the bathroom didn't have fans to help with showers steaming up the mirrors so it delays you of getting ready or keeping the door closed. Very comfortable beds though, & very pleased with the new 40" TVs.
Best part was we got a killer deal on a room with breakfast included for $6 more a night. Very happy when we saw that it would've been $60 for two people every morning at the impressive breakfast buffet at Lael's BUT we just told them our room number :)
Can't wait for an excuse to stay again!!

I would not stay here again even for a conference. The food on property is very low quality and expensive. We asked about local restaurants and nobody seemed to know where any were located. Our last night in the area we found a shopping area with numerous restaurants about 1.5 miles away. I really can't believe no one at the hotel knew about that area. As far as the rooms, they are reminescent of a failed motel--old furniture, woren fabric, and uncomfortable beds. The service was average to below average.

review_title: Best value for the price! Georgeous lobby, splendid views on the bay!
review_text: We booked this hotel with priceline. I never knew of this hotel before an would I've been expensive otherwise, but we got lucky and got it for $90 per night. This is a super nice Vegas style hotel. Would highly recommend to anyone!

review_title: Had a real good time we LOVE it there we go every year for the past 4 years for christmas....
review_text: Looking forward 2 our next time out there again. Also will be inviting more friends out there 2 visit and enjoy it like we do.

By far the worst atmosphere we have ever stayed in. Rooms smelled, there were bugs crawling around, staff was horrible. If I could give 0 stars I would. Not worth the price at all, could have stayed at the motel 6 and received better service.

Overall we had a pretty good time. With the exceptions of a few things. The first night we were woken up by people next door that were partying then soon turned to fighting between the hours of 2 am-4 am. The hotel staff were very accommodating and we moved rooms the next stay. The beds were not that comfortable and need to be replaced. Staff was friendly and helpful.

review_title: Un hotel bello in un posto bello
review_text: Siamo stati dieci giorni in questo hotel e ne siamo rimasti molto contenti. La posizione Ã¨ molto suggestiva ed Ã¨ vicina a tutte le attrazioni di San Diego.. Praticamente tutto Ã¨ nel giro di 10 km. La stanza era spaziosa e confortevole e soprattutto pulita. La struttura conta, tra la'altro, due piscine ed un idromassaggio... Il personale Ã¨ molto gentile e disponibile. Nel caso ritornassimo a San Diego ritorneremmo in questo hotel
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Island Palms Hotel & Marina

review_text: They completely screwed me over. Overcharged, gave us a cheaper/smaller room than we paid for due to overbooking, parking lot took a half hour to exit from due to broken equipment, they lost our registration info, tried to say we didn't have club access, forgot our free breakfast, tried to charge us $300 for a 28 minute phone call, tried to charge us $160 for minibar use (I didn't touch it)... And had snotty attitude to boot. Just go elsewhere.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text: I love this lush, tropical, beautiful place so much, we stay here every time we come to san diego. They have so many activities, love the bungalows on the bay, all the pools, feeding the ducks, the outlook tower... the bell staff is AWESOME! It was raining when we arrived and they escorted us with umbrellas right from the car to the entrydoorway! They are there in a heartbeat if u need help starting your fire in the pit on the bay, or a ride on a golf cart to the bar n grill or poolside. Keith the bellman was super-extra helpful, everyone is so friendly and accommodating!

Impressed with the staff. Always accommodating, helpful and eager to please. The campfires on the beach were great, the grounds are impressive, the food at Barefoot good but pricey for the atmosphere but understandable for the convenience. We ordered takeout twice which was great. We stayed a week so we also stopped by a Trader Joe's to get some fruit, yogurt, drinks and snacks for breakfast etc.
 The lobby needs to be spiffed up it looks like they are going out if biz... Needs fresh flowers, plants, books, magazines, games, a guest book, comp coffee, music, it's way to stripped down... Makes a bad impression ESP after the beautiful drive in! Culinary garden seems a no- brainer come on it the new millennium!Sustainability peeps! the bungalows are great but for the paper thin walls! Did I say paper? I meant onion skin!
Loved the spa and the sweet lady that did my nails. The fitness center is great too- bright, airy, lots of equipment.

This is an average property on a busy street in the Gaslamp District of San Diego. The thing that set this place apart is the tremendous staff. They are the best. Their attentive to needs and very fun. They were almost friends after a weeks stay! They r a great reason to come back here.

Estuve 1 semana con mi familia, el servicio fue excelente en todos los aspectos, Aaron nos atendiÃ³ en todo momento y siempre resolviÃ³ todas nuestras necesidades. Las habitaciones son muy grandes pero desde un inicio nos lo dijeron, pero mas que suficiente para lo que necesitamos. Definitivamente lo recomiendo y volverÃ­a!

review_title: Quaint Inn in a great location
review_text: Unknowingly we booked a trip to San diego during Comic Con and found all hotels had jacked the price up. This little inn was the exception but we were leary. Since the location was so good (right next to Balboa Park) and down the road from my sons house we said what the heck. We are so glad we did! The staff was excellent, the rooms were awesome! Fireplaces, comfortable beds, and a courtyard so pretty I didn't want to leave. I will be returning to the Balboa Park Inn.

We spent two nights at the Sheraton over March Break. Terrific location. Easy access to the airport and the city. Beautiful views. Nice lobby, nice restaurant,great staff. We enjoyed the ping pong tables in the leisure area. Nice internet lounge in the lobby. The pool area looked very nice.
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_title: Clean, nice up to date rooms with great service.
review_text: The rooms are nice and modern. The free breakfast was satisfying for adults and children. The pool was nice and fun, larger than most. Hot tub was spacious, felt very nice after a long day of walking. It is about 25 minutes from downtown and other main attractions but it is great value and our family would stay there again.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express San Diego-Sorrento Valley

review_title: Posizione ideale, personale sempre col sorriso
review_text: Bellissimo hotel: ottima posizione per muoversi vicino ai negozi e con molti locali la sera. Comodo ai mezzi pubblici. Comunicante con Petco Park. Personale molto disponibile: ci hanno addirittura indirizzato al parcheggio pubblico che Ã¨ giusto di fronte all'hotel e costa la metÃ ! Wi-fi gratuito se ci si iscrive alla loyalty ( iscrizione fatta in recepiton) e ci hanno anche offerto una bottiglia di acqua in camera. Ci tornerÃ³ sicuramente!

Stayed here for 3 nights...rooms were huge with fridge and micro, bed soft and nice modern decor. Closet is open and small...if it had doors and were wider it would have been better. Bathroom was spacious but shower was overly strong with no adjustment avail. There was a nice sized flat screen with lots of desk space. Pool looked clean and there was a laundry facility which was 1.50 per load. Parking and Internet were free! Breakfast was great with eggs, bacon, muffins, bagels, cereal, cinnamon rolls, yogurt, milk, juices and coffee...well worth it! There is also a gym with limited equiptment. Overall very nice for a Holiday Inn...and on the newer side. Closest grocery is Vons a few miles up the road and there are a lot of eateries in the same mall area. Directly across the hotel is a Chili's. Would stay here again! :-)
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express San Diego-Sorrento Valley

review_title: The beauty of the location takes your breath away
review_text: It's sort of like club med 15 min from the San Diego airport! I was at paradise point for a conference. What a class act it is! The only downside was my room: it wasn't the cleanest ever. The corners were dirty & there was a general sense of not quite clean. Having said that, I rented a bike for the week at their boutique (where I also bought 3 beautiful dresses) & rode all over paradise point, enjoying the views and the weather. We're going back next year for our 2nd annual user's conference.

We stayed here 3 nights for a quick romantic getaway (we have a 2 year old and this would be a great family vacation too!). Disregard the negative reviews - the grounds are spectacular, the restaurants very good, rooms very clean and updated, and the service has been exceptional. Also extremely quiet and peaceful. I travel a lot and have stayed in many nice hotels and have nothing bad to say about Paradise Point.

First off it's on an island!! Love the setting and the overall feel of the resort. The lady at the front desk upgated our room to a suite for our anniversary for free. This would set the tone the rest of our very enjoyable weekend.

review_title: Good location at an affordable price
review_text:
We have stayed at this hotel for four nights previous to our cruise. 
Our room was very nice and had a small kitchenette. Breakfast was simple, but enough to start the day.
The hotel had good flyiers with information on activities and restaurants in the neighborhood. I love crabs and there was a very good restaurant which served crabs cajun style. They were really good.
Shopping was at walking distance. Also at walking distance was a stop of a tour bus. 
We found the location ideal, the hotel was a good choice, San Diego a lovely city with good food. We will come back for sure.

We stayed for two nights at the Gaslamp Plaza. Greeted by a enthusiastic front desk girl named Merry. She was a lot of fun and handled our check in swiftly. Rooms are nice and large. We had a one bedroom suite. Room had two tv's and a mini fridge and microwave as well as plates and silverware. Parking is 28 a day but the valet service was excellent. The ONLY drawback is that at night when you are ready to hit the sack, the noise from all the people that are partying can be overwhelming since the hotel is located right in the middle of all the clubs. But you can get free ear plugs at the front desk. Or better yet just go party with the rest of them and then hit the sack!

We would definitely stay here again. The location is very convenient, close to many restaurants and Horton Plaza Mall. We didn't rent a car and were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. The room was immaculate and very comfortable. Noise was not a problem, but we were on the 10th floor. Our view of the harbor and Coronado Bridge was beautiful. My only criticism was that they didn't have any king beds available, but that was a minor inconvenience. The bed was very comfortable. We loved the historic restoration of the building. The lobby is very small, but don't be fooled, it's a great place to stay.

This is a great place to bring a family or a couple's getaway. The rooms are nice and clean. It is a bungalow style type of room with modern furnishings. The staff are super nice and accommodating. My top favorite things here are the following:
1. The spa is just fantastic. I went on a Thursday and I had the whole place to myself. I selected the loma spa treatment and I have to say it was 2 hours of heaven. Well worth the price.
2. The facilities. There are several pools located throughout the resort as well as the beach area where you can lay on the beach or relax at night in front of the fire pits. They also have a wonderful pond area with birds and fish. you can sit with your book or iPad and just relax for hours! They also include free wi-fi, another added bonus.
3. The location. The resort is only minutes from Sea World and other destinations. A really convenient place yet you still feel separated from the city.

Stayed here en route home and needed to be near airport for a 6 am flight.
Arrived late, area didn't seem very safe and wouldn't have walked around alone. Hotel slightly jaded, room fine but reception area and restaurant shabby. Food indifferent, wine expensive, 
Shuttle service to airport only runs from 6 so no good for me. Was told a taxi would be no problem but in the event had to wait 20 minutes and ended up running!
With retrospect I'd rather have paid a little more and stayed in a better hotel where I'd have felt safer, enjoyed the evening more and got a taxi with no problem the next morning
hotel_name: The Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina

review_text:
Paradise Point in a very good choice for your stay in San Diego. I got the best rate by calling the hotel directly... Better than all the many websites I tried on line. There was a special autumn package or something like that.
The grounds are well maintained and really quite beautiful. The location is great, too. It's on a bay, not the ocean, so don't expect waves and other oceany stuff. The rooms are far better on the inside than they are on the outside. The architecture is really quite unfortunate: cheap cinder block construction. But the rooms themselves are modern, updated, clean, and comfortable.
The service was friendly and earnest but not very knowledgeable about restaurants when we asked. I think the nice young lady was looking at Yelp recommendations behind the counter. Good for her .... She got us an answer and we ended up at a nice place in Little Italy.
All-in-all it's three star quality with a five star location. To me, that's a good deal, especially considering the fair price we paid and the spacious, comfortable room.

review_title: Great place to stay for family trip to Sea World
review_text: The grounds are really beautiful at Paridise Point, the rooms were nice and clean. They had great accomidations on site and we took advantage of the jets I rentals. The Barefoot Grill was over priced and service was horrible. I would stay here again only if the trip was centered around Sea World, otherwise I would stay elsewhere in SD.

review_title: Great location, but somewhat dated exteriors
review_text:
This place has been here for quite a while. The rooms have been updated but the resort itself might consider a facelift. Outstanding location with nice meeting rooms, even if the halls were awfully crowded. 
Great service and staff throughout the resort.

review_title: Lousy beds and a resort fee for a business hotel...never returning here.
review_text: Most guests could care less about your antiques and want a comfortable bed, free wifi, double sinks a shower that is my above waist level, ice machines available without calling and tipping room service. We checked out after our meeting and went to the Hilton Bayfront for a lower rate that blows this hotel away. Come to think of it most Courtyards would!

This is the second time we've stayed here. It's a beautiful, older hotel that's elegant and feels european. The rooms are spacious and classy. It's so great to be walking distance to so many wonderful restaurants, bars and live music. It's just a short block away from shopping - Horton Plaza.
Shrada (sp?), the concierge, is a gem. She knows her stuff and has consistantly steered us towards fantastic restaurants!!
Maybe because it's an older hotel the walls are thinner? But we were 'entertained' multiple times a day by our hotel neighbors - we're guessing newlyweds or a couple that newly met?? Let's just say we nicknamed her MONA - if you get my drift, haha! Noisy, noisy!!! :)
Anyway - fantastic hotel, we're sure we'll return!!

This is an excellent hotel, well located in the downtown area. The interior design of the lobby and rooms is traditional and elegant. My room was well-maintained and comfortable. Service was impeccable. I asked the front desk for theater recommendations, and within a few minutes an envelope was delivered to my room with numerous suggestions, printouts and directions. Highly recommended.
Designed in a French style the rooms are beautifully appointed and much larger than average. The service is fantastic and the location is very convenient.

I didn't get to use a lot of the resorty stuff from the hotel, so I didn't really see the benefit of the hotel. It was really easy to get lost around the hotel and it is more for families than couples.

My husband & I stay here often as we are Charger Season ticket holders. Its the perfect location to hop onto the trolley & head to the game. The Valet is exceptional & the rooms are beautifully renovated in clean modern lines. My only complaint is on our last stay housekeeping forgot to clean our room. :(
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_text: This is my first time using trip advisor, and wanted to let everyone know about my stay. It is an Amazing place for families! Not sure the reason for all the negative reviews. But My family and I stayed at Paradise Point a few weeks ago. We visited from Arizona and had a pleasant stay. My kids enjoyed riding the surreys every day, we even rented a jet ski ! The resort has 5 pools! We only enjoyed the main pool, the food at Tropics Bar & Grill was DELICIOUS.. Also, we took a trip to SeaWorld which is right across the way from the resort, we rode the water taxi. My kids had a blast ! Celleesha (forgive me for the spelling) remembered me each and everyday, addressed me by NAME & my kids adored her! Seeing her smile was enlightening each day. She shouldnt be working out at the pool, she needs to be working some other department. Such good manners!!!! We stayed in a bayside bungalow!!!! Very nice and worth the extra money. Overall GREAT STAY ! We WILL BE BACK!!!!!!

This place was a grower with us ....on arrival being charged to park next to your accommodation $28 per day is just daylight robbery ......and then the drive up to your challet to find the outside with peeling woodwork was not great. What was great was the location - so close to sea world and 10 mins by water taxi to a private entrance was fantastic. However the beach bar was expensive $21 for a main course of meatballs and again drinks expensive and service lacking!!! by the end of our 4 day stay we quite liked it and sitting on the jetty watching sail boats with thes sun setting was great.

My husband and I are currently here. We have been here for 5 nights and I can't wait to check out Monday Morning. The hotel staff seems very nice and willing to serve. My main problem was how loud the hotel is. We can here everything from the people in the rooms next door, in the halls, and even outside. If you are looking for a place with peace and quietness this is not the place for you.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_title: Totally wonderful experience!!! They treat their Hilton Honors members with class.
review_text: My family and I stayed here while my husband had work. It was rainy and gloomy outside, so we weren't looking for a hotel by the beach. This location was perfect for us, as we could walk next door to the movie theater, Starbucks and Applebees. My husband is a Diamond Platinum HH member. Since the hotel wasn't very busy (mostly business travelers), they upgraded us to the Presidential Suite, for a minimal cost. Such a treat!!! We added a roll away bed to the King room and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The chocolate chip cookies at check- in are always a delight. The staff was warm and attentive. Anytime my husband has work in SD, we will definitely be back. He comes here often and I can see why!!
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_text: This is a great hotel. The staff was friendly, the rooms were clean and nice and its in a great location. The hotels located nearby, in Hotel Circle, seem run down and this is a nice alternative while still be near the shopping and restuarants. I'll definitely stay here again.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_title: A Grand Hotel in a wonderful city!
review_text: I have stayed at this hotel on many occasions for business and once with family on vacation. If you are watching your budget, this may not be the hotel for your next trip. This is a hotel from a bygone era. Don't let the modern facade of the building fool you. As soon as you enter the hotel and make your way to the reception desk and see the vaulted ceilings and furnishings, you can feel yourself going back in time. The front desk staff is most attentive and often have people from all over the world working there. They are quick to help and guide you on any question or concern. The location is right in downtown San Diego. You can walk to most anything. Shopping, eating and site seeing can all start from this location. Restaurants abound at all prices, cuisine and ambiance. Shopping is nearby and again in different price ranges. When you step off the elevator and circle around to your room, you know you are in a very nice hotel. Each two rooms share a single "keyed" entrance to an anteroom. Then you enter your own room. Spacious is the word. The decor is beautiful. Everything in its right place. The bathroom is as big as you will see. Comfortable bed and heating/air-conditioning. I haven't used the hotel eating facility, because of the large number of choices nearby. I would recommend Maria's Mexican Restaurant at 1011 4th Avenue. It's a hole in the wall, but the people are very nice and the food is quite good. The workout room is well maintained with good equipment. The USS Midway is a "must see." There is a showroom with restored cars (for sell) in the wonderful gaslight District that is well worth visiting. I would not hesitate to stay here for business or pleasure.

review_title: Paid extra for a king, no kings available
review_text:
After a long day at Legoland and downtown San Diego, we drove 20 minutes to get here. It was 10 pm and we couldn't wait to get to bed. Because it was just my wife and I with our two year old, we had previously paid close to 20 dollars more to ensure a king sized bed. With the two of us to surround our son, he would have a smaller chance of rolling off the bed in the middle of the night.
When we got to our room however, we found two separate full sized beds. A call to the front desk yielded a kind and understanding gentleman that could not find us any rooms with a king with it. He did take our parking fee off the bill, but that should not have been there in the first place. It's not like the hotel was in a high demand area.
The bottom line is: if a hotel is going to accept a reservation for a king sized bed at a higher price, then that hotel must offer more than simply the cost differential back when the originally reserved room is not available. An upgrade to s suite and or free access to the wifi would have been a more reasonable gesture for this inconvenience.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_title: The place to stay in San Diego
review_text: A beautiful bungalow style resort, the Paradise Point was the perfect stay for my wife and I on our anniversary. It's located on the water of Mission Bay. You feel removed from the hustle and bustle but are very closely located to all the attractions that San Diego has to offer. It would be great for families as well !

review_title: Bon emplacement mais hotelerie vieille et sale prix 450$ injustifiÃ©$$$$$$
review_text:
Notre dernier Hotel de notre pÃ©riple et ce qui devait Ãªtre le rÃªve ne s'est pas rÃ©alisÃ©. Hotel trÃ¨s bien situÃ© sur la baie, nous avons pris une "suite" pour 5 vue sur mer. PremiÃ¨re impressions la chambre est petite avec une chambre 2 lits doubles ( environ 9metres carres, un salon avec un convertible miteux et une petite salle de bain. Nous avons rajoutÃ© un lit sur roulette rÃ©sultat plus de place pour bouger. 
Les draps sont sales et usÃ©s avec des trous, moquette sale, odeur de renfermÃ©. Voila pour l'hotelerie. 
A part cela belle plage, mais l'eau est froide, piscine convenable avec de nombreux transats snack bar, buffet petit dÃ©jeuner moyen Ã  13$. Je pense qu'il y a mieux avec un tel budget qui ne se justifie pas.

Hotel is right next to transit we never had to drive for 3 days
Rooms were recently renovated and large, very clean
2 pools indoor and outdoor meant there was always shade and quiet
Parking garage was large
Staff very helpful- and the cookies, as always, great
Slightly pricey but worth it
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_text: Stayed here or one night. Room felt recently renovated. Bathroom was clean and nice and bed was comfortable.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_text: Designed in a French style the rooms are beautifully appointed and much larger than average. The service is fantastic and the location is very convenient.

A friend and I stayed for three nights at the resort and can hardly wait to stay again. It is beautiful, restful, and they treat you well. It is clean, quiet, and the views are amazing. We got a great deal too. And from the hotel itself. No booking company needed. The you will love it.

review_title: A unique location which is great for families
review_text:
-great island feel with lots of beach access and views of mission beach
-lots of different pools for kids including an adult only one
-good access to everything if you have a car; not so good without
- rooms were clean and modern though the buildings are older so everything is not in perfect condition such as our weaker ac unit
-good food at barefoot grill though a touch pricey
-a very expensive foodstore and rental place so bring your own stuff
-a good family vibe; safe and contained
-careful with paying for upgrades as prices can get steep with little benefit; we liked the north cove because it's shielded from the wind though closer to a public, less secure beach

review_title: Rip Off Point Resort on Tourist Trap Island.
review_text: This resort would be great if it was a low budget all-inclusive holiday destination, but instead it was outrageously expensive. For exemple: more then 100$ for 2 persons breakfast, 500$ a night for an outdated 2 person bungalow with very poor ameneties, $22 for a smores kit + $15 for the wood to make them,...

Just checked out and have very mixed feelings about this place. 2 adults and 2 teens we had 2 rooms. Room with 2 doubled nicer and bigger than king bedroom. Clean resort in fact the gardeners are very enthusiastic with their power tools. This is a great place to stay to chill and relax several pools to choose. Good resort for younger kids, it's safe and quiet at night. Not the place to stay if you want to explore the city but getting to the city is about 20 mins in a cab or takes about an hour on a number 9 bus and then catch the trolley at Old town. The city of San Diego is fabulous cheap easy to get around and has great weather. Old Town is fascinating, little Italy has great food, Phils BBQ is outstanding, downtown, harbour, seaport all wonderful. The jewel in the crown is Coronado. 
Food at Paradise point is very good reasonably priced and the staff are very helpful.

review_title: I called the hotel directly, by-passed Hotels.com and they waived the per person room charge. Great hotel.
review_text: Newly Remodeled. Super clean and spiffy. Nice pool and pit fires at night to sit around. Warm cookies when you check in. Great location to down town, mission valley...beware of the parking fees. $15 a night...OUCH!
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_text:
We stayed here for 5 nights in Nov, we stayed in a newly renovated room and it was nice, clean with a large bed, the pool area is nice, we had breakfast in the morning at the restaurant very nice views, I ordered a continental breakfast and all I got was toast and a coffee for $9.95, when I questioned if I ordered toast and coffee separate it came to $5.00 I just got shoulder shrugged off the waitress and told that's how it is. 
There is a bar with live music every night which has a good happy hour and some good live music.

We weren't too sure about this hotel. Many people wrote wonderful things about it and others did not, but since we had booked on princely we had no choice but stick with the hotel. And we were so glad we had! We weren't surprised by the 36 dollar a night parking charge because since its right smack in the middle of downtown, parking can't be free. We had read about the extra charge for a double bed room, but were very happy that they waived it for us since we explained we could not fit our whole family on a king sized bed. And yes they do charge 15 dollars a day for services you might not use, but we made sure to take our water with us and my husband enjoyed the gym. We would give this hotel a 5 star rating if it wasn't for all the hidden fees. Will surly stay here again.

review_title: Great location... staff could use a little help
review_text: We stayed here for a couple nights while my wife had a business meeting in town. Our room was very nice and our check in was quick. However, we got a parking charge when we didn't have a car. When we asked to have it removed I got a bunch of drama from the staff. They said they have to check with a valet and, essentially, called me a liar. So it's a great location at a fair price but not the customer service I've grown to expect from hilton.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_text: Came to see a Billy Idol concert and completely fell in love with this hotel/concert venue! Loved it so much we booked the follow week for the Gavin DeGraw/David Cook concert! Not only is there not a bad seat in the concert venue the hotel room that we got had a balcony facing the stage!! We got there early and got to hear and see the sound check for each show. Jen, who works the front desk is super helpful and has customer service down to a tee!! I'd hire her for my own business!! The suite we were assigned was clean, comfortable, huge and PERFECT! The restaurant is great, lots of food choices and excellent staff! Everyone was so great there...I would highly recommend this property! Great views, fun location, awesome staff! Pure perfection!!
This us a nice hotel with a good restaurant overlooking a marina. It's a few minutes drive from downtown San Diego, feels like a special place to stay but isn't really close to the action.

Very private but centrally located. The rooms have a beach town feel and the bathrooms are a litle date but very clean. The home run is the setting and the privacy. 
It's a hideaway with very nice amenities

I stayed here last week and for the price it was great. I had a corner room (slightly bigger) overlooking the harbor. A hot breakfast every morning and happy hour every night inuded in the price. Your near the convention center, the gas lamp district where you will find a plethora of great food and shopping within walking distance as we as being close to harbor village, walking/bike paths and the Middway. The rooms are clean and best of all the windows open to catch a nice sea breeze. I love hotels where the windows open, some times hotel rooms can be stuffy when you spend enough time in them. The bed, pillows and linens were more very comfortable. I had a nice firm pillow with a nice scruntchy one to smoosh however I wanted. We also had a great view of the parade of lights from our room, what a nice end to our stay.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_text:
Stayed 2 nghts on the 4th of July wknd. Checked in late and thought we were gonna get the leftover rooms but they upgraded us to a premier rm on the 16th floor. Breathtaking views of downtown SD and only occasional sounds of sirens. Rooms were very clean and very ornate old world charm. Loved the lil room separating the shower/toilet area from the bdrm. Great quiet area to get ready while kids are still sleeping.;) 
Great location! Will definitely stay again! $32 for valet parking and $15 for facilities fee per day but ok if you go in knowing.
Lovely hotel, very friendly and helpful staff, in a great setting, close to sea world and San Diego zoo. Restaurant was lovely with harbour views at breakfast.

So my wife and I took a trip to San Diego for Memorial Day weekend. I booked the hotel through Pricelind and got a good rate. Upon checking into the hotel though I forgot to account for overnight valet parking ($30 per night). Which I thought was ridiculous as they should offer hotel guests a discounted rate. They also charged a $15 per night facility fee, which includes wifi internet, and fitness room access. Having the wifi was fine but why the heck do you need to workout in San Diego on vacation is beyond me.
Anyway, our room was nice and the service was okay. We kept on getting walked in on by the staff as they were confused about the "do not disturb" sign. Everything else was fine.
My overall impression is that if you plan on using Priceline don't expect too much savings when your staying in downtown San Diego because parking is always going to be expensive. I would say that for the amount ofoney you end up paying, you're better off with a three star hotel or even perhaps staying in La Jolla. Afterall, we spent most of our time on the beaches.

We reserved a junior suite bay side ( no other room available). We have rarely seen such a small j suite. Except for the flatscreen their has been no major refurbishing since it's building (must be beginning 70's) But must of all without any excuse is the cleanliness, hair an old overseen towles in the bathroom, sticky floors and hardly cleaned windows and so on. Just not worth the money, a San Dego Motel will do better for a sixth of the price!!!

The weather wasn't great for us but we had a wonderful stay. The pools were lovely and the food at barefoot was delicious although expensive. Good location but you need a car; highly recommend green flash to eat up the road at pacific beach. Would highly recommend pacific point, lovely!

review_title: Everything amazing EXCEPT the room itself
review_text: Location is awsome, nice area close to a fancy mall and 100 ft from a sports bar. Building is beautiful , staff is super nice. Lobby, hotel bar, fitness room, and two pools are gorgeous. Now that bad part. The rooms themselves are old. This hotel has got to b less than 10 yrs old, but the rooms look A LOT older than that. Ripped carpet, peeled wallpaper, scuffed/stained furniture, tube style tv, slow drains in bathroom, mold. There are posters in the lobby and flyers in the room announcing a remodel is coming very soon. You can tell any room maintenance is probably put off in preparation for the remodel. These rooms should have been remodeled YEARS ago. Do yourself a favor wait for the remodel of rooms THEN book here. I will stay again, prob this December.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel San Diego - Mission Valley

review_title: Half Moon is a Full treat..
review_text:
Splendid property! Check in was friendly & quick, but not rushed. My room request found me in a Jr. Suite on the second floor with a nice view of the bay and clear sounds of the concert which was a bit of an unplanned surprise. Brian at the bell stand got me on a sweet pink beach cruiser (complementary!) For an hour long ride around Shelter Island & into Point Loma. The putting greens looked well maintained although I didn't make use of them. The pool & spa area are very pretty, very tropical setting, perfect for relaxing or playing table tennis.
Junior suite has a seperate seating space~ table & chairs (slight wear & tear on upholstery) sofa (pull out sleeper? I didn't check) coffee table, reading lamp & big flat screen tv. Balcony was clean, 2 chairs & small table. Cool feature in the room was a bar area~ microwave, sink & fridge. Bathroom was well lit & ventilated, nice massaging shower head, soft but small towels. Washroom was outside of the shower/toilet, not a fan of that design feature, but no points lost for it. King size bed had great big fluffy pillows, extra blankets & pillows in the closet and another flat screen tv. Thank you Humphrey's for getting rid of the ick hotel comforters & having only fresh white sheets~ I always appreciate that. 
Parking is available, will fill on concert nights and is a little tight if you are parking a larger vehicle. Getting on/off property during concerts means you are walking through ticket only areas, but we were never stopped or asked to go in a different direction. Hotel staff & security were clearly visable & available to help get around during the show. Cigarette butts litter some areas of this nonsmoking property, shame, and the same room service dish sat outside my neighbors door from my check in at 5pm to my checkout at 8am. The guest room was very tidy, no complaints there.

review_title: Loved our stay at Humphreys! Hoping to return next year! :)
review_text: My boyfriend and I spent 2 nights at humphreys half moon inn and suites after a crazy week in Las Vegas. It is the perfect hotel for relaxing and enjoying our time in San Diego! On arrival we were upgraded from a standard room to a tropical room which was a nice surprise. Our balcony lead out onto the private pool for hotel only guests and hot tub which were fab! The pool area is beautiful, larger than it looks on pictures, and is surrounded by palm trees and tropical wildlife, including parrots and koi carps. Rooms were large and spacious with a very clean and modern bathroom. We didn't want to leave, loved our stay and will definitely be back in the future!

review_title: I'll be back for a 3rd visit soon!
review_text: I really like this hotel. It feels like it's in a little neighborhood in spite of being walking distance to everything. I was at the Convention center for 4 days and it's quite perfect. I had a nice breakfast daily, a cup of Starbucks to go, and hit the managers cocktail party most nights. Good view of the bay, and the window opens! Comfortable bed. It wAs my second stay and I look forward to next time
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_text:
Got the hotel from Hotwire so we didn't know the exact hotel before booking. Valet fee is $32 overnight and they charge a mandatory $15 fee for Internet, coffee, and newspaper. We used none.
Hotel was very formal but felt old and tired. The room was actually very large and the bathroom was spacious. 
If I had paid the going rate online ($179+) and the $48 total for valet/Internet it would have been more disappointing. But we paid $110 so that made it feel better.
For the money, find a newer hotel downtown like the Westin.

review_title: Lousy service and wait 4 hours for room
review_text: 4pm checkin is rule . We arrive early-noon. Told they will do their best to get room ready earlier. Come back at 3pm- we are told that the room next to ours is almost done - ours will be next. Why would they clean rooms down a line when guests have been waiting for 3+hours? The room next to us may not check in until much later?!

Remote & because of that they charge exorbitant prices for everything.
Cleaning is haphazard to say the least.

Abbiamo passato una notte in questo hotel. Ci e' piaciuto molto.. Bella camera, posizione incredibile proprio nel quartiere Gaslamp, e personale molto gentile e disponibile. Siamo molto felici della nostra scelta.

review_title: Good but have stayed at better.
review_text: We have stayed at a few Embassy Suites, this Embassy is a little older and not as nice. The lobby is great buy the room was just ok. The bathroom floor was dirty in the corners and the cabinet and furniture was scratch/worn. Only one remote worked and they did not replace our towels even though I put them on the floor. Great breakfast and cocktail hr and a great location.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_text:
Everything was fine except for the fact that they did a lousy job cleaning our room. I called the front desk and said they would send someone but they never did. 
The next night I ordered some of the overpriced food they offer (dont have the pizza or wings) left the everything outside the door and it was there for hours!!
Other than that everything worked out, breakfast is good (a little early)
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_title: Nice location, convenient to downtown area, breakfast included.
review_text: This hotel is good if you have kids--since the rooms are suites the adults can have a little privacy and stay up later. The included breakfast is nice. The added parking cost (nearly $30 a night) seems outrageous, although it's similar to other local hotels. Pool is fine, but was very noisy since it is indoors.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_text:
Good hotel, good location. Tough to find street parking but possible. Don't park right across from hotel where homeless village set up.
Hotel charges $29 for parking. Big rip off!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_title: Terrible service undermines this hotel positioning itself as European luxury
review_text:
Big rooms in an old fashioned style but the worst service Ive experienced in the US - especially surprising given the high cost of this hotel. 
I was unable to get any attention at breakfast & left when my order was not taken after 25 minute. 
I asked the concierge to return my call/ arrange something 4 times & they never got back to me. 
No coffee machine in the room encourages a personal service approach but a 1 hour timescale for a coffee is unbelievable. Room service claimed 20 minutes but was never delivered below 45 minutes.
Stuffy ambience. 
Definitely not worth the price.

review_title: Tropical, nice place for families too vacation with lots of activities!
review_text:
My husband and I stayed here during his convention. The buildings are al one story and ha e been renovated. Many units are on the beach, others are throughout the grounds that are very lush & tropical. There are several pools with hot tubs and fire pits for the evening. There is one Adult Only pool, which I found very relaxing & quiet. 
There are 2 restaurants, one is a casual & one that is open evenings that is more expensive. We seemed to have consistent issues at the casual restaurant...from bringing the wrong order, forgetting to put the dinner tag in and waiting an hour to be served, to serving us and never returning. Good news is there are plenty of fabulous places to eat nearby!!
Loud, small, dark and dank rooms. Uncomfortable mattress and scratchy sheets. Lots of hype but little comfort. A HUGE rip off! Stay away!

My boyfriend and I booked a room for my birthday. We are San Diego locals and although only a few miles away at Paradise Point we felt as if we were far away in the tropics. Gino at the front desk was super helpful and made our arrival as smooth and welcoming as can be. Hospitality and service was above and beyond! Highly recommend this place thank you Gino!

This hotel had everything I was looking for and expect from an Embassy suites. The room was a good size, clean and the bathroom was updated. The location was great for doing anything downtown. The seaside village, Gaslamp Quarter, and the heart of downtown were all within walking distance. The breakfast buffet food was good although the atmosphere itself could get a bit chaotic. The pool was a good size and the valet service was very quick. Although it was annoying to have valet be my only parking option, I never had to wait more than 5 min for my car. I would stay at this hotel again if I had the opportunity.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_text: Arriviamo in quest'hotel extra lusso dopo aver fatto un tour del centro america. La nostra agenzia aveva spacciato quest'hotel come "vicino al mare". In realtÃ  per vedere il mare occorre percorrere almeno 3 km in qualsiasi direzione perchÃ© l'hotel Ã¨ sul porto. La stanza di tipo standard che abbiamo avuto Ã¨ grande, pulita e con balconcino che affaccia sulla piscina dell'hotel. La piscina, altro punto dolente dell'hotel. Dispone di 3 vasche ma sono troppo piccole per la quantitÃ  di persone che ogni giorno usufruisce di esse. Molto spesso sono stato costretto ad aspettare molto tempo solo per avere due lettini. Inoltre chicca finale, il personale della concierge Ã¨ burbero e manca delle regole base della gentilezza. Ultima nota Ã¨ il pagamento di 20 dollari al giorno se ci si arriva (sempre se si trova posto) in auto. Insomma Ã¨ un hotel che non consiglierei a nessuno.

review_title: Hotel molto carino, moderno e confortevole.
review_text: Ottimo hotel, con camere spaziose e pulite. La posizione Ã© decentrata rispetto alla zona storica di San Diego, ma comodo per chi vuole essere vicino al mare ed alla costa. C'Ã© una bellissima piscina, il personale Ã© gentile e c'Ã¨ il parcheggio gratuito. A San Diego i mezzi di trasporto sono piuttosto cari, specie i taxi, quindi l'hotel Ã© sconsigliato a chi vuole visitare il centro da qui, da dove Ã© quasi d'obbligo muoversi in taxi!

review_title: Wow! Wow! 5 star really is there such a thing as 10star!! Resort is an amazing 10 star hotel!!
review_text: The staff at this resort are more than just amazing!! We had friends visit us for the day, when tragically their 12 year old dog ran away from their vehicle on arrival. The resort staff worked so well together and found and returned her in less than 7 minutes . Remember this is a 44 acre resort !! How amazing and kind for them to respond to our friends pet as if it were someone's child. Bless everyone who helped!!! Return a Childs bestfriend

Stayed for one night on our way back to Dallas from the rose bowl. I have stayed at many other embassy suites, this one is one of the better, cleaner, newer, updated. Our room was harbor view, nice to watch the cruise ships come and go. You can also see the Navy yard across the bay...pretty cool, the uss Reagan aircraft carrier was parked there. Our room was updated, had new furniture, managers reception was great... No hassles. No line for breakfast, which was excellent as usual... Not a long walk to some great restaraunts, the uss midway, and the gaslamp district. We walked over and toured the uss midway, then ate dinner at "the fish market" on our way back to the hotel... Check my review on "the fish market" restaraunt... Excellent food! Hotel cost $29 to valet park, but there were no other options on parking...wasn't a problem for us. I would reccomend this hotel to anyone, embassy suites rarely let's us down!!!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay - Downtown

review_title: Beautiful resort-feels like somewhere in the islands!
review_text: We had a one bedroom suite for for nights. My wide and I and our three kids, 14, 11, 8. The previous three nights we had stayed in a standard (but nice) hotel room, also in the San Diego area. It was so nice to spread our in this huge room. Kitchenette, dining room, living room, bathroom, bedroom...huge! Go the grounds are very lush, you feel like it's a small resort on maui maybe. Decent pool and hot tub area. Wonderful restaurant on the grounds. Easy access to everything San Diego had to offer, we did all the touristy things. By the way, if that is the reason for your trip, do yourself a big favor and purchase the Go San Diego Cars...you'll thank me. Overall, big rooms, very comfortable, especially for families. Very relaxing base of operations.

review_title: Strong Potential, Great Stay, Recommended Impovements...
review_text: My wife and I recently spent four nights here celebrating our 1 year wedding anniversary. Upon arrival we were greeted by friendly staff who were eager to make our stay special. After a short conversation with the woman who checked us in, we were given a generous upgrade of our reserved room, and managed flexibility with the parking fee. This left us with a good initial impression of the resort. The young man who showed us to our room was also very friendly, and extended himself as a resource during our stay. We were quite impressed with the aesthetics and location of the room, as it sat facing bay with two Adirondack style chairs on the linai. There was a small private beach with fire pits, and while we didn't use them, we did benefit from the smells of the fire enjoyed by the other guests. Overall we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The food was above average, as well as the service. The only aspect that we could offer some constructive criticism towards is that there seems to be some lacking in the attention to detail. For example, doors were difficult to open, fireplace in room had very low flames, beer can left on linai from previous guests filled with ashes and cigarette butts, somewhat non-thorough room cleaning. We only say this, because we feel this place has too much potential for these kind of things to be overlooked. We really thought the staff and grounds were wonderful overall. If something was not to our liking, we have to say they were responsive and wanted to correct any problems. We would return and recommend a stay without hesitation. Plus we were sent a bottle of champagne to celebrate our special day, and this was very appreciated.
Have been here several times - love it. The restaurant service is slow but food was good. No complaints!

review_title: We loved every moment at Paradise Point Resort and Spa!
review_text: From the moment we stepped out of our car to the moment we left we were greeted with kindness and open arms. We had an amazing experience. We played, we relaxed and we enjoyed every second. Paradise Point had everything we wanted as newly married couple. We rented waverunners, bikes and dined eating great food and awesome service! Paradise Point is great for families too and retailed about bringing our family some day! Loved it there so much and was sad to leave, but excited to go back!

I found it hard to stay here for more than one night, and not because the weather is bad, but rather it was not worth my time or money. My wife and I felt like it would be a paradise escape of sorts but instead we were stuck in murky mission bay with overbearing employees and restless families. I took my business elsewhere because for that price, even though the food and drinks were great, I can get a room twice that size with a fantastic view and much better people around.

The view from our room was fabulous! We overlooked the bay and had a private beach to lay out. The staff was courteous and the stay was well worth it! The room was beautiful and we were able to lay by the pool before check-in. All around a great stay!

I was scared for over a year to go here because some of the reviews I read. I took a plunge when the kids wanted to go to seaworld!! They want to go back NOW... right this very second!!! The place was amazing!!! Absolutely GORGEOUS!!!! Nothing like you will ever stay at!!! They have everything there to do & the beach is amazing!! I recommend jet skiing!!! The food is to die for & the service was out of this world!!!
the resort was very beautiful and the staff was very kind and helpfull

review_title: Overly priced and poor service resort, which should be rated no more than two and half stars.
review_text:
My husand and i stayed there for my marathon run during the rock and roll marathon. We first got to the garden view room we booked. As soon as i got there i found there is a big dust with hair ball in the room so i didnt even want to unpack. Then we turned on the shower which i got an headache right the way because it made such a loud noice. The next day, i complained to the front desk, who quickly offered to upgrade us to a differet room. 
This quick update was the best service during our whole stay. They dont clean the room unless you put the service request out or even though they "clean" it there were still empty beer and water bottles left where you left them or the sticky bathroom floor due to spraying sun lotion would remain sticky after the clean.
Finally, your bill would have extra 50 or so extra per night due to 25 parking fee, 15 resort fee and some misc fees. You suppose can park at your own parking spot but if your room is close by the restaurants or conference room like ours, poeple woundnt know that as there was no sign about that rule. As a result we always need to look for parking. When i told the recepionist when i check out about the parking situation, all she said was "ok". 
I would not return to this resort even though they upgrade to the president suite.

The hotel is very clean and well furnished. I flew into San Diego for a business meeting and needed a good night sleep for a long day. I couldn't have checked into a better hotel for that. I have stayed in maybe 200 hotels during my life and this was the most comfortable bed ever. To top it off, they gave me a 2:30 late checkout, so I was able to attend my early morning meeting and then come back and take a nap before heading back to the airport. If I visit San Diego again, I'll definitely stay here again.

I would have ranked this hotel higher than 3 overall normally. Positives: location is great, facility is dated but clean, and staff seemed-responsive overall. Negatives: dated, any kind of food is over priced, and they don't have a 24 HR front desk. I walked out to my car without my room key and walked around the building to the front desk around 2 am. No front desk, rang the buzzer multiple times, then used my cell to call my wife and she came down and let me in. Disappointing.

review_title: Great property with not a lot around it
review_text: This is a great property! Beautiful and comfortable rooms, free parking and ample space, on site dining, workout and pool facilities, etc. My only complaint is that I wasn't impressed with dining options near the hotel. Be prepared to drive to any attractions, shopping, or dining. I did find the onsite dining to be good and priced reasonable.

review_title: Excellent place to vacation for romance or family fun!
review_text: Hotel staff from check in to check out were exceedingly helpful and friendly. Housekeeping and groundskeepers are doing a wonderful job. We had a wonderful time and will happy to come back to stay!

review_title: Paradise point is the most amazing, relaxing beautiful resort ever!
review_text: My husband and I and our 11 year old son just got back from a 4 night stay at Paradise Point Resort in San Diego. First off let me start by saying our son has Asperger's (high functioning autism). We were really wanting a vacation since it had been over five years since we'd taken a "real" vacation. Our son likes places that are nice and quiet and not too noisy. After doing some research on the Internet I thought that Paradise Point sounded like a perfect fit for our family. I had read some negative reviews on here before we left so I have to admit I was a tiny bit apprehensive but let me put those fears to rest for you. Paradise Point is the ultimate resort! They have everything!! They have five amazing pools, two awesome restaurants (with gorgous water views), and a beautiful private beach that stretches all around the property. They have firepits all along the beach as well and you and your family can make schmores there at night. The room we had was absolutely amazing!! We were steps from the beach and we had a beautiful room equipped with a fridge, king bed, computer table, nice dressers and two big screen tv's! We were thrilled!! We had a beautiful deck equipped with patio chairs that we sat in every day. Our son loved the fact that there were ducks wandering all over the property and was ecstatic that the same group of three ducks came to our door everyday!! You can buy some food at the gift shop and feed them. Very reasonable price at only $1.50 per bag. Now I mentioned before that our son has high functioning autism so we found this resort to be perfect for children with special needs because of the serenity of it all. Definately not overstimulating and noisy. I have to also mention that I believe this resort is perfect for ANY family!! I think kids of all ages would love it! We are already planning our next trip back!! The customer service is impeccable and all of the employees go above and beyond to meet your needs. They can pick you up in golf carts at any time to take you and your family to one of the pools or dinner..etc. Did I mention there is an awesome store there with everything you could possibly need? My husband and son bought me a beautiful bracelet for an early mother's day gift! Oh and so many activities.... Bike rentals, mini golf, basketball and more!! Not to mention the onsite marina with boat and jet ski rentals. This was the most awesome vacation we have ever been on and I want to spread the word!! Go to Paradise Point for your next vacation!! The location is perfect too!! Two minutes from Seaworld!! Last but definately not least the manager Pat is really awesome! He makes sure everything is running smoothly and that your happy. We love Paradise Point!!!! :) oh forgot to mention the cleaning lady we had was extremely friendly and efficient. Our room was spotless everyday.
