Il resort si presenta bene, ma all'arrivo scopriamo che la camera appena assegnata non era stata riordinata! Ottenuto il cambio di stanza, la situazione non si Ã¨ presentata meglio. Pulizia approssimativa, arredo vecchio e maltenuto. Sembra affatto curato. A San Diego c'Ã¨ sicuramente di meglio per quel prezzo.
Nice clean room great location for the price, right on the beach. I would definitely recommend it to everyone.

review_title: LOVE THiS HoTEL greAT serviCe aNd loCATion !!!!!!!
review_text: Every time I got a chance to visit San diego we go to this hotel, thE sTAff has ALWaYs been niCe and frieNdly. AnD theres reaLly good plaCes to haNgout nearby. Highly Recommended.

review_title: Such a home like environment nestled in the unique area of San Diego
review_text: I got the privilege to stay in this unique corner of the grand San Diego Metropolis. With beautiful views of the ocean across street, and an enclosed courtyard, the Ocean Beach Hotel is definitely a place you need to pinpoint on your map. Why? From the phone call being so pleasant, to the check in process being friendly, to the small details of making our interaction with the hotel staff comfortable, I would go again to this hotel soley on the fact that the employees will do their best to help you feel at home...at least for a night.

We (Family of 5) were greeted at the door by wonderful staff including the Resort host -Mr. Quick. Our view from our room was like a screensaver on my computer that I sit and dream about all day. Beautiful wooden floors, flat screen tv's and 10 min after settling in, we were greeted once again by magnificent staff who were delivering milk and cookies for my children. Being 30 ft away from the ocean is a plus, watching my kids play in the sand while my wife and I relax on the patio furniture and enjoy the sun.... Priceless! Room service was great, resort store was clutch (milk for my 1 year old) and the all around hospitality was well above par. Couldn't ask for a better and more relaxing time. Thanks,

My husband and I stayed 2 nights at the resort. All I can say is wow from check in to check out it was fantastic. The property is beautiful and more than I expected. It's close to downtown, Seaport Village, and many other places. We ordered room service each morning and breakfast was delicious. Our room was very nice and clean. The gift shop was great and the employees were very courteous. I highly recommend this hotel. We plan on coming back with our children and are considering having our anniversary party here.

review_title: A Staybridge Jewel if your on the top floor.
review_text: My wife, twin boys and I selected a 2 bedroom, 2 bath suite for our week long stay. We were there for a National swim competition for our 15 year old twin boys in early August. The location is perfect. The grounds are kept pristine. The staff is the best. Only complaint was the family of gymnasts above us that kept us up for two nights. Management was very helpful and considerate even giving us a gift basket.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Diego Rancho Bernardo Area

review_text:
SUMMARY
With stunning wrap-around bay views (from inside and outside our room), and plenty of comfy, plush space inside the room to enjoy it, we will surely be returning before too long. 
PROS
1. Your backyard is literally the beach- making sunrise/sunset strolls a breeze.
2. Rooms are spacious and tastefully decorated.
3. Located near Pacific Beach strip- good for going out- and Seaworld.
4. Restaurant is excellent, albeit pricy (approx 100 for 2 ppl w/alcohol, entrees approx 30 each)
5. Service is great. We requested more towels, more wine glasses, etc and each request arrived within 10 mins.
CONS
1. It's a bit large and impersonal, so if boutique hotels are your thing, you may be put off. The size of the resort necessitates a car to drive around it- not nec a problem- but something to be aware of.
2. The pools, funnily enough, have no ocean views, and are a rather bland affair (but v warm in december- that was nice)!

If looking for the best in San Diego coastal, here it is! I've stayed at Bahia, Catamaran and in my opinion, this tops em all! Kid friendly, but perfect for a quiet romantic getaway. Sea World is next door, but we never had to leave the property. The only downside is the restraunt / bar is a little pricey. But I guess that's expected for this quality resort. All and all, 5 stars!

Hotel is right off freeway and in a semi-industrial location, very convenient to Hwys 163 and 805 and lots of shopping, little restaurants, and fast food nearby. Accommodations were clean and quiet, bed was very soft. Pool looked inviting but it was cloudy & cold during my stay. Hot breakfast was good, and staff were friendly. Downtown San Diego, beaches, & area attractions were a short drive away.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn San Diego - Kearny Mesa

review_text: What can I say-on the beach in PB? It's not the Ritz, but for a quality room, AWESOME LOCATION, good customer service, and comfortable night's sleep-this is the place. No, I wouldn't spend all day in my room, but its San Diego-why would you? Microwave, fridge, nice shower, comfortable bed, and you can fall asleep listening to the Pacific Ocean with the next morning's surf session waiting for you!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Blue Sea Lodge

review_title: Our Family Stay on Mission Bay
review_text: The Dana was less than expected for a few very good reasons. Although the location was excellent, the bay beautiful, the service, food, and amenities were lackluster. Our room was so below our expectations as we paid four star prices for nothing better than what an economy hotel would offer for half the price. Other than the heated pool and courtesy shuttle, we wished for better food, service, and a big enough room to fit both ourselves and our luggage. The restaurant service was slow and the food was bland. The breakfast was Denny's quality and the menu very limited. We ended up eating in Old Town each evening. Also, the noise level was that of college dorms late into the evening. They do not enforce quiet hours, nor do they police the grounds. We saw public drunkeness and other nonsense at night-not exactly what I would call family-friendly or romantic. It was definately econo-lodge with a view of a pretty marina. We will not be staying here again. Our extended family fared better at a three star. Dana needs new management!

review_title: If you like fraternities then this place is for you
review_text:
Stay there at the end of September. The room was dirty.
The hallways smell like urine & pot. Sparking of pot , smelled it every nite. It's a young roudy crowd that stays at the Best Western. The room next to me had a blow up doll on the balcony. The area is very dangerous at nite. Much better to stay close to downtown where its safe and plenty of things to do. 
This place is a dumpand they got the nerve to charge 172 a nite. Lol. You can find a nice hotel downtown.
You have been warned !
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Blue Sea Lodge

review_title: Great place but look out for upgrades
review_text: Beautiful compound, wonderful service. Only complaint is I was "upgraded" from a marina view to a bay view...of the public bathrooms/homeless persons camp. Luckily I was too busy to spend much time out on the balcony.

review_title: Difficult to justify price paid! Far too many negatives...
review_text:
We stayed in the 2 bedded presidential suite, and although most would think this review is not applicable to them, my comments would relate to general things...
On the positive side, the rooms are pretty clean and have most things you would expect, minus great views, even on the top floor. 
On the negative side, we felt that the accommodation was not worth what we paid...
The USP of embassy suites is the cooked to order breakfast, and frankly it was a bit of a disappointment with limited selection... And I can't believe that a hotel that caters to tourists can have breakfast finish at 9am! We had to get out of bed just to have breakfast, after not having had enough sleep, which in a way ruined the rest of the day... We could see many others who were half asleep during breakfast, or come in their bathrobes!
For an all service hotel, I would expect that a pack of batteries that they had would be delivered to the room, especially when we are paying for it... We were asked to come down and 'sign for it'... Not to happy!
Parking is quite expensive at $20, and as explained in earlier reviews, is quite tight for space, especially for a 4wd...
To summarize, I would definitely not recommend the 2 bed presidential suite @$500/ night, but if you need to stay in the area for a couple of days for business (thereby having to wake up early anyways), a standard room here at a much decent price could do...
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego - La Jolla

review_text: Enjoyed my stay at blue sea lodge . Rooms were small but very clean , plus who stays in the room it serves its purpose. Its in a great location little bit of this and that all around it,food and things to do. Beautiful beach in front of it.i would stay again .
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Blue Sea Lodge

review_text: Staff friendly, location great everything else terrible. vending machines didn't work, room was dirty, only two buildings have bay views the rest are parking lots and even when you request a bay room that doesn't mean they will accommodate.. loud, can hear your neighbors like they are in your room. Renting bikes is so expensive considering they offer for half price across the road. Take it from other not so wonderful reviews...besides the nice staff and the nice location its not worth your money!

For $200 a night, we expected a room that didn't have a window air conditioner that tripped the breaker every few seconds. Our first room stayed about 80 degrees so we moved to another room. This room at least had a working window unit but took several hours to cool down (and remove the musty warm smell). Dinner at Blue Pearl was pretty nice, breakfast (after the SeaWorld rush) took about an hour and a half to two hours. They were very sorry though. Definitely not worth the money overall.
Loved their Happy Hour, great breakfast.. Lots of options. All and all a great place to stay!!!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego - La Jolla

review_title: Good value and a good breakfast!
review_text: The staff at the omelet station were always patient and friendly. They replenished the buffet often. The rooms were clean but a bit dark. One day housekeeping skipped our room entirely, but they made up for it and had someone come fairly quickly to clean the room. Their outdoor bar area is really lovely and we really made the most of it. My only disappointment is the pool area. Guests left their food and drinks on the table, which wasn't cleaned up for hours. The indoor pool itself was very VERY small. It was good enough for the little kids though.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego - La Jolla

review_text: This was our 2nd stay in 3 a month period. We were very excited but were disappointed in the sincerity of the General Manager. We had a legitimate complaint but it was taken as we had planned it. The hotels best feature is LOCATION LOCATION but next time I'll pay more for LOCATION and stay in a resort......
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Blue Sea Lodge

review_text:
Very large, comfy room steps to mission bay. Nice bathroom, updated fixtures, small kitchette with microwave, small fridge, stocked cabinets had plates, bowls & utensils. Bedding was very nice, used pool towls were left on patio (possibly from a neighbor as everything else was very nice & clean) Did not use pools or spa areas, but they looked nice and are open till 11pm. Parking is limited and filled up quickly. 
The room overall was impressive in size, my opinion, one of the largest standard rooms on the water. Beautiful location on the bay with grassy park setting & gorgeous views of sailboats, jet skiers and sunset. It was had a wonderful home feel with shutters, sofa seating area, small table & chairs and hd tv.
Check in felt a bit rushed even though I was the only guest in the lobby. Great value for family, friends & locals..

review_title: Great location. We will be back.
review_text:
Just spent labor day wknd here. Stayed in newer section of hotel. Had bay view suite. Spacious two room. 2 queen beds in one room. Couch, tv, table in other. Large corner patio. Small frig, coffee maker, counter space. Nice shower tub etc. Great value for money. Kids enjoyed pool. We did not eat at the grill by the pool as there was a wedding reception going on. Didn't bother us. Ate in nearby little Italy that night. 
Used shuttle to go to sea world. 
Rented jet skis from marina just steps in front of hotel. 
Overall a fantastic experience. My kids didn't miss the waterside at the hyatt one bit. 
Recommend room in newer section. Older section looked smaller, older and closervtogether.

Really enjoyed the stop here and one of the best Best Westerns I've been to.The room was excellent,fantastic view and it was cleaned well every day.The location is also fantastic right on the seafront.For the money it is far better than the over priced and snobbish Catamaran across the road.Would definitely stop here again!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Blue Sea Lodge

review_text: We love SD!! We have stayed in many hotels 3-5stars but we finally found the perfect hotel. The best part was the location:) The room was nice nothing spectacular but CLEAN. Walking distance to shops and restaurants. We will be back very soon:)
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Blue Sea Lodge

review_text: We loved this hotel. Perfect location for sea world,easy walking distance. Room was fine for the 4 of us with 2 big beds. Both pools are lovely. Both the on site restaurants are very good as well.
Excellent service, location, very nice rooms, free breakfast. We loved this place.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego - La Jolla

review_title: Excellent location, excellent service, happy hour, excellent breakfast, excellent restaurant. This was an excellent hotel.
review_text: What a joy to find a hotel that actually lives up to it's promises on their website. I'm usually at least a little, if not terribly disappointed when I arrive. But in this case I was anything but disappointed. the staff was outstanding! The location was excellent, close enough to I-5 to get anywhere very quickly. Situated in beautiful LaJolla, with many restaurants and shops within walking distance. Just close enough to the airport to make it very convenient, but without the airport noise. We will definitely stay here again. The only negative thing I can think of is the $20 per night parking fee, but there is plenty of street parking!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites San Diego - La Jolla

review_title: Awesome place to stay right on the bay.
review_text: Stayed there to escape Arizona heat last two summers. The bay view rooms are awesome. Very pleased with the service and cleanliness. Could not be better unless it was right on the beach, but being right on the bay was great. A special thank you to Jennifer K. Plan to return every summer.

Found this place via reviews on Tripadvisor and couldn't have been happier with our choice. Although it wasn't slap bang in the centre of San Diego, the location was perfect for our short visit to the city. Only a short taxi ride into town, but we preferred being by the sea. There are also lots of things to see and do on the doorstep (seaworld very close, as well as a worthwhile drive along the cliffs to the nearby national park area).
Our room was a bit on the small side, but the bed was large and very comfortable and the decor was contemporary and very clean.
By far the best thing, however, was sitting on the deck watching the incredible sunsets - spectacular!

After a 14 hour flight from Australia, this hotel could not have been more perfect. Complimentary drinks and snacks to recharge, and the most comfortable king bed I've ever found at a hotel. The staff were super friendly and helped me with directions.

This hotel is okay the rooms are just not what you pay for. Everything is old, the ac is on the floor and your breath blows harder then it does, bathroom so tiny. We stay here one night, and then moves to pacific Terrance now that's the place don't waste your money because its in the bay, just not worth it.. promise. Shuttle was nice to sea world front desk girls they act like you are wasting their time..

review_title: Might be the best hotel I've ever stayed at!
review_text: From the bar to the restaurant to the elevator and especially the room this hotel is top tier all the way. Our room was on the smaller side but gorgeous. Have every intention of staying here again.

review_title: I felt rich and trendy while staying at Andaz :)
review_text: Loved the bathrooms, food is FANTASTIC, rooftop bar is beautiful & has a great view of skyline & Petco Park.. Staff very friendly & accommodating. Location is smack-dab in the heart of Gaslamp. Your within 0-3 blocks walking distance of tons of bars, restaurants, clubs, shopping. Loved it!!!!!

Andaz is the new Hyatt brand of hip/trendy boutique hotels. Similar to Starwood's W chain this hotel is aimed at the younger crowd with money.
This hotel is beautiful in it's look and feel and the staff is overly attentive. Free wifi and water/pop are nice touches that most higher end hotels gauge you for.
Rooms are spacious and are visually pleasing.
Now the bad part:
If you have an exterior facing room and it is the weekend, bring ear plugs. The street noise from the club crowd (Ivy Nightclub is in the hotel) is not only loud it feels like it is in your room. Fights, curses, hoots and hollering go on until well past 3am. Plan accordingly, or be one of those revellers.
All in all a positive experience.

The hotel has some nice features like a rooftop pool and modern architecture but when the nightclub is open it is very noisy in certain rooms, and my room was pulling in smoke when the air conditioner was turned on.

review_title: If you are going to Seaworld with kids, this place is worth the inflated price.
review_text:
There is only one reason to stay here and its Seaworld, otherwise its a run down and tired hotel with expensive and crummy food. One saving grace is the pool- its
 Beautiful!

review_title: Great location! Cool staff and shuttle to seaworld!
review_text: I always try to stay here cause everything is so convenient I dont need to rent a car and the view is killer. Front desk, shuttle drivers and house keeping are all super friendly.

We were really happy with our stay here. We stayed in one of the older rooms facing the pool. It was a little on the small side, but we were travelling with three little kids. We have a lot of stuff and we weren't in the room that much. It was very clean and the beds comfortable. The location was wonderful, easy access to everything and the most beautiful views. We would definitely stay again.

review_title: I'll Be Back to The Bristol :)
review_text:
Amazing service, especially Ahmad at the front desk. Friendly, knowledgable, helpful. Just awesome.
The room was slightly tight & difficult to move around, but the decore was gorgeous & we didn't really care because everything else was just great.
The hotel is walking distance from everything: great food (I recommend Cafe 21), the Harbour with the Maritime & Midway museums, and if you're willing to walk a little further, to Little Italy.
Yup. I'd do it all over again.

Hotel staff were very friendly. Very good central location. Checked in Tuesday night, and all was well until Thursday night around 9 p.m. when the music started on both the first and rooftop levels. I had to ask hotel staff for earplugs which made absolutely no impact. Tip if you are not into the party scene: ask for an INTERIOR room. One of my colleagues stayed on the fourth floor, I believe room 401 and their room was very quiet even Thursday evening.

review_title: Superior location, great service, just a few quirks
review_text: The location was awesome for getting to/from airport and public transportation, it was always easy to catch a cab or walk. The service was pleasant and rooms were clean. Only quirks: gym wasn't impressive and the bathroom had a pocket door that never entirely closed. If you're sharing a room with someone else, you may also be sharing the full sensory experience of the bathroom.

review_title: Awesome location but a 3 star hotel rooms!l
review_text:
Enough can't be said about the beautiful location of The Dana. It really can't be beat! The hotel is situated right on the marina with many rooms facing the waterfront. It's a 15 minute walk to SeaWorld and you get a picture perfect view of the fireworks from the marina! The only downside are the age and wear and tear of the rooms. We were misled by false advertising on the Internet because all of the photos on the website are of 
the new wing of the property. A majority of the rooms (8 buildings worth) are older. They were recently updated, 
but essentially they are an upgraded version of a motel 
room. They are tight and extremely small for any family
 with kids. Our room was also noisy facing the road and parking lot! My kids woke up several times due to garbage trucks and utility trucks backing up into the property. People could be heard talking loudly in their rooms and outside. You will most definitely be booked in the older
 rooms if you book through any of the discounted websites like Priceline or Hotels.com. I believe the only sure way to secure a new room is to book directly through the hotel and pay the premium rate. Also be aware of the $18 daily parking fee. That said, my family and I thoroughly enjoyed the grounds and especially the Pool facing the marina. It was absolutely beautiful, well heated, and an infinity pool so the water (salt water) lapped up onto the sides of the pool. This was a nice and luxurious touch! Overall, if we got an excellent deal again we would stay at The Dana for the location and pool experience.

I stayed at this hotel for five nights because of a conference at the Convention Center. The location is great, a 10 minute walk to the convention center and near restaurants, pubs and shopping malls. The Gaslamp is a very lively area. Nice quiet room and very friendfull staff.

review_title: We walked from Bristol Hotel to mall in 3 mins.
review_text:
Another quality choice provided by Hotel Tonight. Rate was great & I will once again invite all of you with smartphones to download the Hotel Tonight App. Enter this invite code on the app for your $25 in credits: dstanert
Then you will immediately be able to use your credit towards bookings & after your stay, the app will provide you with more credits after a brief survey. Can't beat this app! 
We have stayed at many hotels in downtown San Diego. Both Gaslamp & Bristol. Both are clean, friendly & within walking of stores/restaurants Really within walking. No need to drive. Both hotels have paid parking& never had a problem with tampering of our car. I will also post my review for the Porto Vista Hotel soon. Sadly, we had some concerns there.

Had a 2 night stay here , it is a very nice , typical 'business/corporate' hotel . Rooms very nice, good location - easily walkable to seafront/ harbour area , gas lamp quarter , little Italy and balboa park for zoo etc . Only draw back is it doesn't include any form of breakfast, not even token cookies/pastries which some other similar hotels do, and also the valet parking of a steep $26 a day - both of which obviously adds to the overall cost.

This hotel is great. It is right in the gaslamp quarter with easy access to everything. There is a couple of negatives. The hotel will hold $150 per day of your stay for incidentals and there is a $35 per day valet charge. The staff is amazing. In your room you have free water, cokes, juice, snapple lemonade and ice tea, and the room has a Kureg coffee maker with the pods. The pool is on the rooftop and has amazing views.

review_title: Hawaiian style vacation in Southern CA
review_text: Wow! I was so impressed and delighted by The Dana Hotel! The day after I checked out, I was already checking my schedule for another stay there. I loved the tropical landscape and decor. I have lived on Maui and this place reminded me of the island hotels. The view of the Bay and Harbor is gorgeous! it has a nice path for walking skating or biking. I love to kayak so I was thrilled with the easy access to kayak and other water toys and bikes right beside the hotel. My room and bed was so comfy and the maid service was excellent! I enjoyed the food at the restaurants on the grounds of the hotel. The Dana is right next to Sea World and just a short drive or about a mile and a half from the beach. I can't wait to get back there for a longer stay.
Location is ok, valet parking. Service good. Breakfast I dont recommend. Rooms ok. Clean.

review_title: It just lacked the Andaz panache
review_text:
I visited this Andaz with high expectations. I had stayed at the Andaz at the wall street location where I was overwhelmed by the hospitality and service there. The San Diego Andaz paled in comparison.
Firstly the staff was unenthusiastic
Secondly the rooms were noisy and I heard broken glass at 2 am, and noise from the street.
Thirdly, the boarding pass printer didnt work, and no one on staff cared enough to even try to fix it.
Finally, the restaurant breakfast was expensive.
When I was there the gym and pool was great but the adjacent bar area was under renovation.
I know they can do better. Even though this coast's Andaz had the wine and amenities - it needs a

review_title: More of a college dorm than upscale boutique hotel
review_text:
Do not even think of staying here the nights the night club is open. 
The reviews are very true.
The music pumps into your room until 2am, and then you hear the drunken club goers screaming throughout the hotel and you gear them screaming outside of the hotel.
The staff, however, is very kind and apologetic, and will refund your room charge, as comp for you not getting any sleep

This is a beautiful hotel, in a great location, with wonderful service. The hotel was spotlessly clean. The bathrooms were a bit small; but overall I enjoyed our room. It didn't have that neutral "hotel look" that many rooms have. I would stay again in a heartbeat!!!

review_title: Great room easy access to gas lamp fun
review_text: Stayed here for a couple of nights while in town for a conference. Let's start with positive and work our way down. Rooms were great. I stayed in a king deluxe. The room was large clean and very sleek. The bed and pillows very comfortable and the windows do open so fresh cool air is always available. Bathrooms are also nice and contain a very roomy shower. Down side to the rooms are that since the hotel is across the street from the greyhound station, there can be a lot of noise. That being said te rooms which are the most important consideration one makes when choosing a hotel are comfortable and a good value. The hotel is overall very clean. Down side to this establishment is that there is very little available in terms of service. There are no bellman to assist with bags. I also noticed that the front desk attendant would sometimes be absent leaving a cue of people awaiting their return. The gym is lacking. There are a couple of cardio machines as well as a muti use weight machine. There should be more dumbbells and more machines to make this gym more user friendly. Since three people were already there working out I was unable to do as all machines were in use.

review_title: Its refreshing to encounter such great customer service nowadays!!
review_text: Just left d hotel n cannot rave how great our wknd was! D staff extremely attentive and friendly! The location awesome d hotel was perfect! We live by la n will def b bak

I have stayed at a lot of hotels for business and for pleasure. This stay was for pleasure. 
We had a king size bed asked for a high floor. Our room was not on a high floor and was above the night club which we were not told. We heard the night club all night long. 
The tub and shower were in the middle of the room encased in glass. The shower leaked all over the floor and I slipped. When checking out informed the front desk and was told oh yea we know that's a problem.
They claim to have a complimentary shuttle. We waited for 30 minutes on a driver who never showed up and were late to the Padres game. We called ahead to be picked up after dinner and the shuttle never came. 
All in all our stay was horrible and NOT worth the over 200 a night we paid.

review_title: Nice convention hotel, some tweaking needed
review_text:
This is a large hotel adjoining the convention center and their rates are surprisingly reasonable. The good - clean, large rooms, fairly soundproof. Front desk is efficient but not particularly friendly. Some bell staff made up for that lack.
However, be aware the port side Coronado view rooms overlook a working container port and ships are loaded mostly on Sunday through Tuesday. They are supposed to stop at 10 PM but were going till 2 AM our first night. Bring your earplugs. Although the hotel works well, because of it's size, there can be lines for the elevators, and meal facilities.

review_title: Our stay at Bristol Hotel in San Diego was one I will remember for a lifetime.
review_text: The first impression of a hotel is everything. Not only did Bristol exceed my expectations, but the staff went above and beyond to make our stay a memorable one. My favorite part of our trip was the hotel bartender, Bob. He was the nicest guy, and gave us so many tips on cool locations to visit that only the locals really know about. Thanks Bob!

I actually checked out of the hotel today. I was there for two nights. The hotel is very clean and nice. The hotel is less than a min away from the convention center. U can basically walk to the gaslamp distict. The room has great beds. The bathroom was very clean. The room was carpeted. The parking was a little expensive, its $27.00 a night. I booked thru Expedia, so all the taxes and everything was taken care of. I def would recommend and come back to this hotel.

review_title: Excellent hotel with the best location ever
review_text: Great location... Only 3 minutes walk from Gaslam str. And downtown... Exactly beside the convention center.. Clean rooms, very comfortable pellows and beds..great view .. Excellent food and room service.. I strongly recommend this hotel...

I was at the Bayfront for a conference this past week and it is a great business hotel. All the amenities you need during a conference - large rooms, nice bathrooms and walking distance to the Gaslamp district. 
The best part besides the great service is the large array of TV channels (awesome when you are away from home) and a Starbucks that opens at 6am. 
The hotel has a resort feel so I can imagine it would be great for vacation as well!
Always stay here when in San Antonio. Great place and very convenient. Recommended!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites San Antonio The Dominion

review_title: Good for families for short stays.
review_text: We have stayed in several Drury Inns and this one is like the others, but I was a little disappointed in a few things. The check-in was super easy and super fast...important for families with small children. The hallways had a weird musty smell to them and there was a faint smoky smell been though we were in non-smoking rooms. The shower was missing a shower curtain and the bedspreads had some nasty stains on them. Breakfast was well-stocked and fresh. Overall, a little disappointing from our previous stays at Drury Inns.
hotel_name: Drury Inn & Suites San Antonio Northwest Medical Center

review_text:
Stayed at this hotel for 1wk and loved it.
Great location, as it is not too far from downtown and not too close either. 
It has a quite of places to eat at close by, and also is not far from shopping malls or attractions.
The hotel operates a shuttle service within I think it was 3-5mile radius of the hotel itself.
It is about a 10min walk to Drury Inn and Suites, of which there is a bus stop that if required you can get a bus to the mall and even downtown. 
Close to us, there was a pool hall/bar restaurant.
Very hot during the summer Months San Antonio. About 106-109degrees in the day and max round the 90s at night.
I would certainly reccommend this hotel in terms of value for money and location.

We always stay at Hampton Inns, but our original plan was to stay at one of the historic hotels downtown. Then we looked at rates! At $114 a night with free breakfast, wifi, and parking, this was a deal! I was a little nervous about the location but it was fine--a couple of blocks to the Alamo and RiverCenter Mall, maybe 3 blocks to the River Walk. The staff was excellent and always had fresh coffee and fruit-flavored water available. Breakfast was fine except for the rude travelers who dumped their large suitcases in the middle of the areas between tables. The room was fairly small, but well-appointed and had a great bench for luggage. Although we were on the side near the interstate, we didn't hear any noise. The hotel does provide earplugs which is a nice touch, but we didn't have to use them.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn San Antonio Downtown (River Walk)

review_title: Free parking, free hot breakfast, free wifi, and close to convention center & river walk
review_text: If you are looking for a hotel that is close to the river walk, the Alamo, etcetera and is good value for money, then consider this place. Best feature is free parking if you have a car. Parking in most riverwalk hotels is over $20 per day. This Hampton inn also features a nice hot breakfast buffet which is free and free wifi. They have a couple of terminals in the lobby too. It also has a fitness center and swimming pool. Rooms are large and well maintained. Only downside is proximity to I-37. If you have a window facing the interstate, the road traffic might disturb you at night. So ask for a room not facing that direction. Rivercenter mall is a block away. My rate was around 110 a night.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn San Antonio Downtown (River Walk)

review_text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS HOTEL. BOOKED IT FOR A SATURDAY NIGHT. $115 taxes included. Perfectly located near River walk, mall, The Alamo..etc. staff was great, very helpful. Room was very clean, elegant, professional. I felt important. Bed was very comfy and the room was a nice size which came with 32" flat screen. Highly recommended.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn San Antonio Downtown (River Walk)

review_title: Extremely clean and comfortable with above average staff.
review_text: For our two night stay in San Antonio, we wanted a clean and comfortable room for a reasonable price. The accomodations and staff definitely delivered to provide a stay that warranted a positive review. We will stay here again next time we're in town!
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham San Antonio Airport North

review_text: Excelente opcion en el gas lamp quarter. Buen servicio, hotel boutique-minimalista. A unas cuadras de la zona de restaurantes y de la Horton Plaza. Algunos productos del minibar incluidos, wifi gratis, dock para ipod, etc. A partir del jueves la terraza de la alberca se convierte en uno de los mejores antros en la noche. Lo mejor es que como huesped tienes acceso vip a la terraza, al wine bar, y al nightclub !

review_title: Brand-new business hotel by the water, but otherwise uninteresting.
review_text:
I stayed here at the Hilton Bayfront for one night for a business convention. The Hilton is conveniently located right next to the convention center, and the Petco Park baseball stadium. It's also fairly close to the gaslamp district, though I'm not sure you'd want to walk there, especially at night.
On the plus side, the hotel is located right on the water so there are some great water and sunset views. Unfortunately, there's a big container ship harbor right in front as well, so the view was *dominated* by a giant cargo ship. The hotel is also brand new, so the rooms are modern and feels totally clean. The pool and jacuzzi deck also looks like a really nice place to hang out. The decor is modern, with lots of white ... but it just feels quite cold.
This hotel ultimately is really just a nice business hotel. It's clean but pricey, relatively convenient but lacks personality. My point of reference is always "would I pay to stay here for leisure". I think there are much more interesting places to stay for leisure in San Diego, but if you have business at the Convention Center, this is a great place to stay.

could not reach restaurant to make reservations. Called front desk asked them to reserve. Operator assured us she would contact resturanr to set table for 7. We arrived 20 min later. Very rude hostess Chyenne ststed she never heard from operator and we would just have to wait. There were at least 10 empty tables... But we waited over 30 mins. When we inquired about when we could be seated... Chyenne said I don't know, I had other things to do. We waited another 10 mins & finally one of the waiters pulled 2 tables together for us. Very disappointing as we had invited guests for this dinner. Could it be because a food critic was seated on our patio & all attention was directed toward them? Then, their appetizers were delivere to our table. When we looked puzzled, the waiter returned and wisked the appetizer away & tookit over to their table. Really lousy service for a supposedly upscale resort restaurant!

We stayed here on a Thursday and Friday night. When we checked in on Thursday it took forever for our room to cool down. It wasn't until middle of night till the room was at a comfortable temperature to sleep. then Friday morning when we got up our AC made a funny noise but was still blowing cool air so my family and I went to saw world. When we returned that night our AC was completely off. We called downstairs to complain because it was so hot. They sent a guy to look at it. He said a breaker was flipped but he got it blowing cold air. It took hours of cooling back down and making this awful noise all night long that it was hard to sleep. Then that morning it quit working again. It was only blowing hot air. I wanted to speak to manager that morning but she wasn't available to this afternoon after we were gone. She couldn't do anything for us because we booked with expedia and not through them. All she could offer was half off next time we stay. Umm I won't be going back. She also blamed us for not reporting noise it made Friday morning. I'm not an AC repair person. It was working when I left so I didn't report it. Pay a little more and stay somewhere else where the AC works properly and doesnt take hours to cool off.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham San Antonio Airport North

review_text: I go to San Antonio regularly and no hotel offer such a great price Plus great staff
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham San Antonio Airport North

review_text: We were very impressed with the hotel our room and our stay. The staff at the front desk was very friendly and helpful along with housekeeping being just as outstanding. Who needs to go any where else when you have everything at Microhotel.................thanks again we will be back! !!!!!!
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham San Antonio Airport North

review_text: I stayed at this hotel while attending a trade show at the convention center. The location is right next to the convention center and they also have a pedestrian bridge that leads to petco park and the gas lamp district. The hotel is very modern and the lobby area was immaculate. As for the rooms, they are average size, clean and spacious if you have a king room. The view we had selected was Coronado bridge/port view, most of what you see is the dole port with containers everywhere, but the other portion is the Coronado bridge and the bay. an associate was staying on the other side of the hotel and his room had a view of the convention center and the boat harbor with nice yachts as well as the bay. I highly recommend selecting that side. The service was overall good. the room type I had selected was not initially provided, but another employee was able to correct when I went back to the front desk. Lastly, the breakfast buffet at Vela is great and worth money, one of the best I have had at different hotels.

Loved this Hilton. The view was absolutely stunning, looking out over the water and the city.
Tried the spa, the massage was good, but I have had better.
Nice cocktails at the bar.
A nice walk over to the gaslamp quarter, or a short cab ride. Not far from a sweet outdoor shopping mall either.
Very nice outdoor pools. Good quality internet speed. I would definitely return to this hotel.
Amazing views, great sports bar and walking distance to Gaslamp District. Will stay everyone I visit San Diego.

We stayed here for five nights and felt very happy with our choice. We loved the fact that it is a little out of the main centre (but within easy walking distance) and right on the bay. We upgraded by 20 dollars per day for a better view over the bay and city skyline. Nice room, great view, clean and modern with comfy bed. Didn't use the pool but it looked lovely. The only let down is the service which is patchy. At the bar in Vela the staff were disinterested, gum chewing and unprofessional. The staff in the restaurant were pleasant enough but there were not enough of them. This was a pity as the food was good and deserved service to match. This was also true of the concierge service which was very hit and miss. Check your bill. We had a "fall fun" package which included 35 dollars per day spend which had not been taken off our bill. Take a Flagship harbour cruise early on in your stay as it is well worthwhile and is a pleasant way to get orientated. Also do visit USS Midway for a fantastic day out. Overall a great stay in San Diego.
Good location. Friendly staff. Mattress not the best. Nice fitness room & pool.

Walking into the Hilton Bayfront you are greeted by a modern, soothing aquatic theme. This property boasts amazing city and bay views and an awesome pool. 
The good:
-friendly staff
-good sized rooms 
-tasteful decor
-gorgeous views
-comfortable outdoor spaces
-great pool 
The bad: 
-the bar (overpriced, understaffed, ran out of ingredients for signature drinks)
Highly recommended!

We spent 2 nights at this hotel and I only can say it is a very good hotel. Wonderful view from 29th floor, excelent service, clean, nice food, although they charge $34 for valet parking, wich I think it is very expensive. But for the kind of hotel, and the fact that I was using crutches at that time, it's was woth the price. Search for a good deal that includes brakefast, the buffet was very good.
The location was perfect. The food was great as well as the service. I had a nice view of the riverwalk and lights. Everything was in walking distance.

review_title: Forget the Gaslamp stay at Bayfront
review_text:
The hotel has a wonderful location on the Bayfront. You are able to walk along the harbour for a couple of miles yet you are only 5 minutes from the Gaslamp Quarter. 
Hotel appears to be new, room are clean & comfortable. No free wifi in the hotel but this is available from Starbucks or the Fox Grill which offered good casual good. 
We didn't experience any noise in the evenings which has been mentioned on several occasions for those hotels in the Gaslamp. All in all a quality hotel in a good location

I love it! I will definitely be back(: 
Its close to the zoo, beach & downtown.

We will be back to River Walk, and our family of 5 will definitely stay at ES again. The rooms are so large, the kids were able to enjoy downtime during the day while we sat on our balcony or watched TV. Breakfast was incredible.

At $4.95 for a small bottle of water I am sure if there had been a mini bar I would have jammed it shut! The staff could not help you without making it look like it was a chore. The concierge gave out duff information constantly including the opening times of the emergancy medical centre, So when a straight brandy was ordered and one on the 
rocks was delivered it hardly surprised me that their solution was to take it away and scoop out the ice and bring it back. I still shudder at how it was scooped out.
.... Oh and if you want fast, reliable Internet it's not to be found at this hotel!

This hotel is one of the best we have stayed in. Great service every time we stay, the price is fair, and Great location! Plus it's close to our favorite sushi restaurant: Tsuruya Sushi. Well defenatly continue to stay here.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn San Diego Airport / SeaWorld

review_text:
My husband and I stayed here after a day at Sea World. It was about a ten minute drive from Sea World. The gentleman at the desk was very informative. Without us asking, they had upgraded our room. He also recommended some good places to eat in the area. 
Parking was a little tight but the hotel was very busy for Labor Day weekend. It is also in a bit of a weird location as it is surrounded on all but the main street side by industrial buildings. 
The lobby is beautiful and the rooms looked newly renovated with flatscreen TV's etc. 
Overall a nice place to stay for the price.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn San Diego Airport / SeaWorld

review_text: We just returned from a trip to San Diego staying at the Bayfront. It started out bad because when we arrived at 10:30pm our room was not ready, but we got called within 20 min. After that, every part of our stay was great. The rooms, location, hotel amenities, this was one of the best hotels we have ever stayed at. My family wanted to extend our visit. Get a city side view, it is worth it.

review_title: Lousy bathroom, but decent rate for a room with two beds and a sleeper sofa.
review_text:
We had to wait for our room, so they knocked $50 off the room, which was nice. Hotel may be only a few miles from everything you want to do in San Diego, but it's not in the best area. There's a strip club a block or two down the street, but the hotel parking lot didn't feel that unsafe. There is a dive hotel next door.
The AC doesn't run unless there's someone in the room, which is annoying because it was always too warm and stuffy when we returned.
But the most annoying thing was the poor lighting in the bathroom. A single 65w light covers the whole room, including the shower. There's an old fashioned heat lamp too, but it heats up the little bathroom so fast that if you have more than one person showering, the room gets unbearably hot.
So, if you can find something nicer for the price in the area, go for it. But this hotel is an OK value if you can't.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn San Diego Airport / SeaWorld

review_text: This hotel is perfect! Not a single bad thing to say about it. Looking forward to Visiting soon.
This is my new favorite for a stay on the Riverwalk. Convenient, comfortable, clean & good value.

My husband and I normally stay at Marriott properties, however, his company reserved several rooms at this hotel. The rooms were absolutely beautiful and well appointed. The breakfast was free. There is a restaraunt on site. The hotel is located to all main attractions. We enjoyed our stay. Great hotel!

review_title: New hotel a little far from Convention Center.
review_text: While on the Riverwalk hotel is about 7 weeks from Convention Center. When I arrived as Honors member tried to get balcony room and was told "upgrade not available". When tried to get late check out was told "hotel full that night" couldn't get late check out. As an Honors member felt staff really wasn't tring to be accomodating. They seemed more interested in "the rules". Nice new SA hotel but service could have been more responsive.

review_title: Too expensive! Bad parking! Great customer service!
review_text: The good: its close to Seaworld, clean, the employees are kind, close to restaurants and that's about it. **** The bad: the parking is terrible, its too expensive, they have old style box tv's, they gave us a room next to the parking lot and it was very loud, the refrigerator in my room did not get cold, the shower was either too hot or too cold, the heater stinks... The list goes on and on. We will not be back. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. Go somewhere with enough parking spaces that costs less and at least has flat screen tv's. (again the people who work the front desk are very nice and professional)
hotel_name: Hampton Inn San Diego Airport / SeaWorld

review_text: We actually went to San Antonio to visit everything but Six Flags. But we found that the hotels close to Sea World could not meet all of our needs: right price, room for five, indoor pool, full complimentary breakfast and a central location. This hotel is brand new and still looks and smells like it. If it was full we couldn't tell. The only reason why I gave it 4 stars and not 5 was that the service wasn't perfect. We had a room that clearly sleeps 5 but we only had 4 towels? We waited a very long time for that 5th towel because the manager was the only employee at the hotel and he didn't have keys to get into the housekeeping closet...???? Check out time is at 11am and we were gearing up to be gone by 10am. About that time housekeeping knocked on our door just dying to kick us out and clean. And, the complimentary breakfast was so popular that they kept running out of stuff and it took a long time for things to get replenished. I think more than once my husband had to go into the kitchen himself to get more plates, etc. And their fridges in the rooms are more like freezers so beware. But seriously these were very minor issues. It was a pleasant stay and perfect for us. If we ever come to San Antonio again we'll be staying here.
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites at Six Flags

review_text: This was a great place to stay when going to Six Flags Fiesta Texas. It was very close! The rooms were nice and clean and the breakfast was good.
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites at Six Flags

review_text: The staff were very accommodating and nice for handicapped traveler. Excellent continental breakfast and nice pool. Too bad there was a railroad close by, but overall very nice Hotel.
hotel_name: Pear Tree Inn San Antonio Northeast

review_title: Clean, 5min walk to Riverwalk, light breakfast
review_text: Room is clean and beds are comfortable. Light breakfast included: waffles (make your self), cereal, muffins/bagels. Unfortunately, thin walls and hear everything. Nightclub music heard in room (4th floor) until very late. Not for a light sleeper.
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites San Antonio Downtown/Alamo Plaza

review_text: I stay here 3 times a week. The hotel is always great and the service is always the best
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn San Antonio Airport/North Star Mall

review_title: Excellent stay in downtown San Antonio
review_text: My wife and I just spent 4 days in San Antonio and we stayed at this hotel because of its location. Close to the downtown and Alamo area and also close to highway 281 that services the airport. We rented a car so it was perfect. Hotel brand new and great staff. Would stay here again.
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites San Antonio Downtown/Alamo Plaza

review_title: Good Hotel... needs a bit more cleaing.
review_text:
Stayed at this location due to Sea World trip.
There are hotels closer, but didn't want to stay right on top of Sea World.
Pros
Kevin at the front is very good.
Ana in the morning for a great breakfast, if you like, was great and her personality A+.
Lots of breakfast selections, if you want.
Quiet room, quiet hotel, many restaurants near.
Cons
My biggest....
Room and common areas could be much cleaner, especially the bathroom.
For the $ and upgrade to a suite, can't harp too loudly.
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn San Antonio Airport/North Star Mall

review_text: Since the time we walked in we knew we made a great choice I looked for a hotel for hours online and this place was the best of them all.... the staff here are so friendly and helpful.... I would highly recomend this place to anyone that trying to save a lil money by cooking they have everything you need at this place....get choice so happy we got to stay....
hotel_name: Candlewood Suites San Antonio NW Near Seaworld

review_text: Stayed there on a weekend and it was horrible. The club next to hotel made us feel like we were in the club too. As you check in immediately they tell you that they are not responsible for damages to your vehicle while parked at the hotel. I wonder why would they be so worried about that and soon as the club started getting full that when the patrons from the club were all over the hotel parking lot. One of the hotel guest found his vehicle's side view mirrors damage when he was packing his vehicle for check out.
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn San Antonio West Sea World

review_title: Very clean great location, rude staff and very crowded!
review_text: I once again stayed at thr drury after I said I wouldn't, hoping my experiance would be better . I will say the room was very clean and neat and the ac worked wonderful in this texas heat. But the lobby stayed crowded I constantly heard chaotic kids running through the halls and the pool well you couldn't squeeze another person in there even if u covered them in oil! It was definitly over capacity but don't you dare mention it to the front desk bc they will jus roll their eyes and ignore you. I called the fd from my room asking for a toothbrush and the fd clerk said "what you don't have one" I am very disatisfied with the staff and crowd control, other than tht was a great stay, maybe drury should consider a job fair and maybe they should hire some adults not young immature rude kids.
hotel_name: Drury Inn & Suites San Antonio Airport

review_text:
We got off course on our trip and ended up 3 hours behind. I called the hotel directly. Was assured that our rooms would be waiting. Arrived at the hotel around 4 am. We booked 2 king rooms and requested a rollaway since that's all that was available at the time of booking. There was a little confusion at the desk but it was all straightened out. The rooms were clean. Bed slept like a dream. Staff was wonderful. We walked to the Alamo and back to the hotel before departing. Clerk advised that we would have been able to do a 2pm check out. Will keep that in mind for future tip. 
There was a discrepancy with valet parking price (optional) but I am Hoping to get that straightened out.
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites San Antonio Downtown/Alamo Plaza

review_text: The van driver was not careful and three my bag on the ground and my laptop bag fell off and slammed the floor causing a dent on the corner of my brand new Apple mac laptop. When I told him that was my laptop, he yelled at me and said that I should've held on to my laptop bag. I am so upset and will be waiting to hear back from someone more professional about it.
hotel_name: Drury Inn & Suites San Antonio Airport

review_text:
This was our first stay here to visit family in the area. The room was nice and large with a very comfortable king bed. There were 4 small pillows to share. This is a Leed's ecofriendly hotel with a two option toilet and power saver shower head. They provide shampoo, conditioner, & soap from Bath & Body Works. Free WiFi Internet and in room coffee. 
The negatives were: the room smelled of mildew when the air conditioner was off, probably due to the humidity of SA, a cover was missing on a bath wall sconce, and no bath fan. There wax no continential breakfast; breakfast at the restaurant was $12. Pretty much a standard hotel room. Quiet given it appeared to be a family oriented hotel; probably because SeaWorld is close.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Antonio NW - Seaworld Area

review_text: I stayed here with my family and knew that I wasn't going to be the ritz but was expecting clean accomadations. First off the carpets were dirty. I was afraid to take off my shoes. The bathrooms were dirty and the towels were frayed. We had a non smoking room but the hallways of the non smoking rooms smelled of smoke and curry. The breakfast was sub par. The part that set me off was when I came to realize that there was a blood stain on both of the beds sheets. We went down to the lobby to have them changed and the manager simply said there was no on on duty to change them so we would have to wait till tomorrow or we would have to do it ourselves. I would not reccomend this hotel to anyone as there are plenty of other hotels in the area which are cleaner and of better value.

Last minute trip and arrived late. Nearby hotels already booked (and pricey). Made a call to HIE on Spencer and they delivered in a big way! The little things made the best impression - such as bottled water and a newspaper at no extra charge. I so appreciated being treated as a welcome friend and not as a victim of highway robbery!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites San Antonio

review_text: We were on vacation for a week in San Antonio and stayed at this hotel. The location, room and service were excellent. We were also greeted at check in with 2 bottles of water and a granola bar. Would definitely stay here again if we were in the area.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn & Suites Near Medical Center

review_text: I stated here in April 2009. It was clean, friendly and everything was big, except the fitness room. The hotel was pretty busy with people on business, the Internet in the rooms was free, but didn't work on my iPhone. I had my laptop so it worked on that well. Nothing spectacular but close to the motorway and river walk. Free parking was nice.

review_title: Pleasant staff, safe bike storage, good location- walkable to Market Square
review_text: This was my second stay at this hotel. Note: The actual address is 318 W. Cesar E. Chavez Blvd, not Durango. Rooms have been renovated, bathroom nicely done. Wish they offered double queens, instead of seemingly tiny double beds. I appreciate the lovely live oak trees on the property anf ample free parking; this city seems to charge for every foot of curb space, even evenings and weekends.

I stayed 2 nights, they allowed early check in (by an hour) the exterior of the hotel is a little dated, and the hallways are creepy and long especially if you're alone. The rooms were nice though, very clean, and comfortable. Bath and body works toiletries. They first sent me to a room that hadn't been cleaned but corrected it and got me another very quickly. The staff was very friendly and helpful. It's a good hotel for what you pay! I'd stay again!

I along with my family of 4 came down to Texas to be with family. Money being scarce we went ahead and booked a week stay at Motel 6. I can tell you that my stay was out standing. The rooms were spotless making the overall hotel AMAZING. We made a couple trips to the pool and with a single call to the office we obtained fresh towels to our room. This will be a hotel that We will return to. From the personality of the staff to the cleanliness this was a great hotel.

review_title: Shame in the name of Holiday Inn
review_text: It would have been better to stay in a travelodge rather than here. If they have renovated it recently, I cant even image what it must be like before.

I arrived at the hotel and was treated very rudely by the desk attendant. When I finally got up to my room, and the floor was dirty, there were dead cockroaches all over the bathroom and by the sink. The tv needed to be plugged in to turn on and unplugged to be shut off. The refrigerator also had a dead cockroach inside. When I tried to see if I could just get my money back and leave, I couldn't reach the front desk. When I went to the desk, no one was there. I ended up staying. The next morning I was bringing my bags to the car, and when I went back to grab my last bag, and the cleaning lady was inside. I told her about the bugs, only to realize she didn't speak any English. After leaving I realized I hadn't grabbed my 200 dollar sunglasses off the desk. When I called, they said they hadn't been found, and they would check the room and call back. 3 hours later, no call. I went back. Sunglasses were long gone and bugs STILL in the exact same spots after the room was cleaned! I will never stay at a deluxe Inn again. Worst hotel I have EVER stayed at.

review_title: NOT less than a mile from the main Lackland AFB gate.
review_text:
First of all, management are dishonest about the distance to Lackland AFB's public access gate.
 The gate that visitors must enter is over FOUR miles away. That said, it is a simple drive, about 10 minutes away. Not sure why they'd persistently try deceive the public when the property is still reasonably close to the base visitor gates.
If the renovation was in July, 2008 (according to management comments), I wouldn't have known, as our room stay was in March, 2010, and there is / was no way it was renovated under 2 years prior. If it was, they renovated with 10 yr. old furniture and bedding. 
We stayed for 4 nights with 4 people, and the room and bath setup was so small that another night would have driven me crazy. 
The stay was marginally acceptable but I would have to assume that nearly 2 years would be enough for the property (all rooms) to have been fully updated.
The staff were friendly and the on site laundromat was helpful. 
In short, there are tons of motel choices and when I come back to Lackland, I will likely be staying elsewhere. There are several choices along the expressway that leads to the AFB, all within 10-20 minutes distance.
Sorry RedRoof, I don't go in for deception~ both from the location and room condition standpoint.

My wife and I did a 5 night stay. Overall it was a good stay. I do have a couple of complaits about our stay. When we arrived our mini fridge was broken. It took them until our 4th night to replace it. Also the swimming pool was green. However the manager, Sean, arranged for his guest to attend the fitness center next door which has an indoor pool. The breakfasts there was incredible. Every morning there was waffles, biscuits, sausage, pastries, coffee, and juice. This motel also offers discount tickets to six flags and seaworld.

Do not waste your money...this place is horrible!!!! Torn carpet, holes in the sofa, paint missing from the baseboards, crack in the entry door big enough for all kinds of bugs to crawl in, roach motels stuck everywhere and the linens that they charge extra for stink....STAY AWAY!!!!!!

review_text: Booked through Hotwire.com and was nervous after reading these reviews. Ended up being a decent hotel in a bad neighborhood. Room was clean enough and had fridge, micro, etc. wouldn't stay here on a vacation but for a one night stay you can't beat the price!
Nice! I like it a lot. Staff is awesome! Gggggrrrrreeeaaaatttttnessss

review_title: Awful place. Nver coming back here!!!
review_text: Room smells moldy. Door chain broken. Shower tub dirty. Shower tub knob broken. Shower tub sink not draining build up mildew on toilet bowl. Stain on bed sheet. Bed matress dusty and smells moldy. A fly was buzzing around the room upon entry. Dirty carpet. Passed by a storage closet for materials in the motel - trashed, dirty and unsanitary with a stench emanating from. Bad customer service. Requested for room service - no one came to replace towels and clean thr room. Not worth staying at.

review_title: Beautiful hotel in a beautiful location
review_text:
The Marriott Riverwalk hotel is very nicely run, and is in a prime location in San Antonio. On the west side, rooms afford a view of the riverwalk area, which is sort-of a combination between a park and a large outdoor eatery (dozens of restaurants line the river). The rooms are kept very clean, as is the rest of the hotel. The only thing that really needs upgraded is the wireless in the hotel. With more and more people carrying iPads and smart phones, there needs to be quick access to wireless. I have on several occasions over the last two days given up and used the 3G signal, which eats up my data package. 
Basically, it seems out of place in a hotel that is otherwise so superb.

review_title: The hotel staff saved my husband's life.
review_text: My husband was visiting family in San Antonio. He was enjoyinig the continental breakfast at the hotel and suddenly collapsed and fell unconscious. The hotel staff promptly came to my husband's aide and called 911. My husband was having cardiac arrest and was very close to death. EMS arrived promptly and were able to save my husband's life. He was then taken to Methodist Heart Hospital and is now doing fine. The entire hotel staff are kind, caring, and provided us incredible customer service. The hotel is not a 4 or 5 star - but I would rather stay at at hotel where the hotel staff sincerely care about their customers.
hotel_name: Baymont San Antonio Wurzbach / Medical Center

review_title: Not what was expected....but its o.k if you dont plan to spend alot of time in room

The ups- beautiful room with the most comfortable bed, sheets, pillows and comforter. Great location with bar, restaurants, and a Starbucks on site. 
The downs- valet parking was $33/day, hotel staff less than enthusiastic and restaurant over priced for a breakfast buffet. Also, service in bar was poor.

For the amount of money I spent I would have rather have spent an extra $20 to stay at a five star hotel instead of a two star. left for another hotel. Oh, no coffee and a computer from the 70s. Don't

We are staying at the Mariott Riverwalk since it is the host hotel for a convention that we are attending.
We checked in last night and although we had reserved a king-bed room, were given a handicapped-accessible room with two double beds. The gentleman at the front desk last night assured us that we would be switched to a king-bed room today, at noon.
When we returned to the hotel at our lunch break around noon, we were told that there were no rooms available. When we told the young woman at the front desk that the gentleman from the night before had told us there would be, she suddenly was able to find a room, but it wouldn't be ready until 2 or 3 pm. 
We then returned to the hotel during our afternoon break at 2:30, hoping to finally change rooms, and were told by the same young woman that the room now wouldn't be available until 4 pm. Really? If this is indeed the case, I am unsure why we weren't told 4 pm initially. I can't wait to hear what she has to say when we return shortly.
Not once have we heard "I'm sorry", or anything remotely similar. Rather, it seems as though we are inconveniencing her. We're not asking for an upgrade, just for the room that we reserved, and paid for, months ago. 
I'm extremely disappointed in the way we have been treated thus far and expect more from Mariott. This is a hotel that claims to be a 4-star hotel and yet treats its guests in this manner. 
We travel extensively, and can assure you that if our travels bring us back to San Antonio in the future, we will not be giving this hotel our business again and will be thinking seriously about staying at any Mariott again. We will be sure to tell our friends to steer clear of this hotel as well.
Shame on us for not doing our research on trip advisor prior to booking.

review_title: Over priced and not convent to get in and out.
review_text:
We stayed here May 21st-May 29th.
We can't complain much since all but one day was free because we used reward points. 
The room was clean and seemed modern but you could tell you were in a lower grade Marroit. Paper cups, no refrigerator, no microwave, and motel 6 type towels. The towels were small and like sand paper. The bed was hard and the pillows even harder. It was very hot the week we were there and it was nice we had a room with a great AC unit. 
The free breakfast buffet was not very good. The boiled eggs were like rubber, the scrambled eggs were dry and the breakfast sandwich was dry. Limited fresh fruits or healthy food choices. The breakfast attendant was nice and friendly and was always checking on you. 
The Only thing that made me not recommend this hotel was that an Izod polo shirt was taken from our room. We had a lot of clothes and I assume the person that took it assumed that we would not miss it since we had 30 more. The hotel said that I must have left it at another hotel since I checked in on Saturday and I was bringing it up on Wednesday. After that we started counting our clothes and taking pictures befoe we left for the day. The second point for not suggesting to stat here is no safe in your room. The hotel has boxes at the front desk but they are in open site and since no one stands at the counter, it would be easy to walk off with the entire rack of boxes. 
I don't think I have stayed at a hotel that had limited staff working the front desk. When we checked in we waited 5 minutes and then I called the number on the wall in the lobby and a guy came out of the back. We walked in almost every day without seeing anyone at the front desk. All in all the main reason I would not stay here again is no in room safe and it's hard to get in and out of the hotel. So much traffic
