review_text: We've stayed at this hotel several times over the years. It's always been clean and comfortable, and the staff's always friendly. The location is convenient to Fiesta Texas and to downtown. Sea World is probably 15 minutes away. I definitely recommend it.

First off they do not even greet you when you walk in the door, they are too busy with their head stuck into the computer. The lobby is in bad condition and needs cleaning and decor. They need an overhaul in staff. The guy working the.front desk is one of the rudest people I have meet. There is only one good thing I could say and that is that theAC was COLD!! I read other reviews and thought it would be ok but think again. The pool was green and we were insured it was ok and then the next day it was closed. No apology, just a head shake. I will definitely speak with the management and corporate if possible. Cheap...yea...but at what expense?

review_title: The perfect hotel for a romantic San Antonio getaway!
review_text: My husband and I just returned from a weekend getaway at The Fairmount in San Antonio. We had the most wonderful experience - we drove up to the beautiful hotel and hoped it would be as wonderful on the inside as it was on the outside but it exceeded all of our expectations. The room was lovely, the service was exceptional and we also fell in love with the hotel's story as well as its canine-atarian (yes we made up this word) efforts - especially with their director of pet relations, Luke. We will be back for sure - I can't think of any other hotel I'd rather stay at than there - it is very close to all the right tourist favorites downtown, but just far away enough to relax and have a peaceful stay.

Older hotel, but it was OK. I didn't see any bugs, and the sheets were clean, which are really our only requirements. Nothing spectacular by any means. My in laws also had a room near us and they were unhappy about a few things.. Dirty carpet, bad bathtub, and a severly used couch to name a few. I truly think it just depends on what room you wind up with. We were in San Antonio for AF graduation and were so busy we just needed a place to sleep at night. This hotel did the trick.
hotel_name: Days Inn San Antonio/Near Lackland AFB

review_text: After a lack of availability on the Riverwalk, we chose this for one night of a long Hill Country weekend. The staff was incredibly helpful and kind. The rooms were well maintained and it was very reasonable. A real bang for the buck.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites San Antonio-Downtown Market Area

review_text: My husband and I stayed here five nights during Thanksgiving week while visiting family. Our experience here was great. Room (king suite with couch) was clean and spacious (though the bathroom was a little tight). The hotel is close to the Riverwalk and downtown area, though I wouldn't walk. A selection of hot and cold items was available for breakfast, and there was more variety than the average continental breakfast. The fitness room is small but adequate (a treadmill, elliptical and bike). We found everything very good for the price (less than $100 a night after tax). We would stay here again.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites San Antonio-Downtown Market Area

review_text: Dirty!! Carpets hadn't been vacuumed-we actually hunted down cleaning crew to borrow the vacuum cleaner to vacuum our own room (seriously what hotel do you have to vacuum your own room?!). The tub had red soap drippings down the side, so needless to say it hadn't been cleaned. Cleaned that ourselves as well. We happened to overhear that the terminator was spraying. Since I didn't know what chemicals or if it was safe for you g children, I asked the front since my 2 year old has some allergy issues. I was told they are drilling holes only on the outside to put pesticide, not going in the rooms. HOWEVER, when we came back after a tiring, yet fun filled, day at sea world, we could clearly see the hole in the wall that had been drilled...on the INSIDE of our room!! The icing on the cake was when our air mattress got a hole in it (the 2 year old will fall Where u at?!off the bed w no side rails, so we put an air-mattress on the floor). It was late, so we pulled the mattress off the bed & put it on the floor...mistake!! The stains were unbelievable! Found dried, crusted food there also. The sheets had things between them-an earring back, a piece of wrapper from candy. Dont normally sleep between the sheets of a bed in a motel, usually sleep on top of the comforter & bring our own pillows & blankets. This was absolutely, hands down, the most disgustingly filthiest place we have ever stayed!!

Basic old marriott. Location is odd between 2 freeways - traffic can be heard from rooms. Front desk staff is weak at best. Attempted to get a breakfast rec but was looked at like I was crazy - finally just left and found a place on my own.
Dirty.. Dont bother. The only reason we stayed was the two king beds in one room.

Nothing to rave about but really nothing to complain about. We stayed here our last night in San Antonio and pretty much just needed somewhere to sleep for a couple of hours after going out on the Riverwalk and then catching our plane at 5 AM. Hotel is not fancy but comfortable. Location is great.

review_title: Very nice for a quick business stay...
review_text: Very nice hotel, beautiful lobby and. Lounge...Excellent service everywhere in the hotel...very nice pool...very quiet and safe...wish the rooms were little bit bigger but other then that no complaints...

review_title: The front desk girls made my stay ...( Brenda , Danielle , crystal )
review_text: Tv's ate old and suckie but the hotel made up for it ... I was there for 14 days and it was just great
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Antonio International Airport

review_title: Great location, great rooms, and most of all, great staff!
review_text: My father and I stayed at this Super 8 for five nights during our summer vacation, and we loved everything about it! My father doesn't speak English so well, so he asked me to write a review about this magnificent hotel. It is centrally located, 10 minutes from Sea World, Fiesta Texas, and also the airport. Even though my father barely speaks any English, the staff still responded to his needs such as fresh towels everyday without asking. There is complimentary breakfast with great food like make your own waffles, donuts, milk, juice, etc. I would definetly recommend this to anyone!

I have stayed at several super 8 motels before and this one was by far the worst. Check in was less than a min, but it just consisted of handing my key and no customer service. Hallways and rooms stink, and need to be cleaned. Overall would not recommend this hotel to anyone even If you are tight on a budget.
Not on the Riverwalk, but close. Their rooms are quite dated, but very clean. Friendly and helpful staff to make it a nice place to stay.

We've been traveling across the US for weeks and this is by far the worst place we have stayed. They charged us $106 a night. We got a cheaply renovated room with an ac unit that barely worked. The wi-fi didn't work and, when we mentioned it to the jerk that was working the front desk; he told us to call Time-Warner. I've been in RV washrooms that are bigger than the one in our room. Just to put the icing on the cake, I ended up with bedbug bites all over my arms and legs.

I stayed in mid June for one night and found the the a great place to say. 
I checked in around noon and had no problems. I got to room and it was very clean and cool(which was good because it was a 100 outside. The room had a nice king sized bed, a couch, desk, and nice flat screen. I was was happy the there were plenty of outlets which is good because I hate having to unplug the clock to charge my phone.
There is a pool nice pool and almost the whole time I was out there somebody was cleaning it. Jets do fly over occasionally and they're loud so they do interrupt conversation.
It's definitely a business hotel so I wouldn't really recommend for a 
family stay.
There is plenty to do around the hotel and the shuttle will drive to 
restaurants, the mall, and a bunch of other stuff nearby. 
I would definitely stay here again.

This particular super 8 hotel staff is what super 8 hotels or hotels in general should model. The staff wasn't just friendly, but caring and made sure you had all the comforts away from home. When meeting Ken at the front desk, it made you feel like you were important and not just a customer at this establishment. The cleanliness of the rooms were above and beyond all standards I've seen in hotels. This hotel has made a big impression on me, it must have because I don't even write reviews. The stay here was a wonderful experience. Now when I stay at other hotels they will have big shoes to fill. I'm glad I chose this super 8 hotel.

We had an enjoyable experience. The rooms were nice and clean. The service was excellent, people at the desk were very polite and helpful. The price was right. Laundry services on site. Despite the remodeling, it hardly interfered with our stay. Somethings that needs change? Our coffee pot didn't work. There wasn t a iron or iroining board, and the room was really small. And the TV was missing its power button. We stayed 3 days.
Room was fine. Staff was courteous. Decent gym, nice breakfast buffet.

We needed a last minute hotel after SeaWorld and booked The Alamo Inn for it's price. Don't let that part of town or the outside of the building fool you, both the service and the room were great. We will definitely call again if we need a San Antonio hotel.

We stayed here with friends for the San Antonio marathon. It was walking distance to the starting area, although we had to take a cab back.
Overall this hotel needs updating. It was the lowest quality of Doubletree hotel I have stayed in before. We tried to use the computers at the business center and one was broken and the other wouldn't print. The room had a huge tear in the carpet. In the bathroom they had repaired a hole in the wall but never painted it.
We did use the pool to cool off after running, it was clean. There is no hot tub though.
Housekeeping finally came to clean our room after 5pm when I was all tired out from the race and sleeping, so I opted not to have them come in and clean. I have never had a problem before this with housekeeping coming this late.
The bar and restaurant had good food and drinks, but they seemed very disorganized, almost as if nobody was in charge.
San Antonio isn't known for having the highest quality of anything, so it's probably par for the course. They ought to do away with their slogan "it's the little things" at this particular one.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton San Antonio Downtown

review_text: Stayed for two nights. Overall the hotel was very nice and clean. Room was comfortable with sleep number beds. Didn't particularly care for the pocket door on the bathroom. Pool was warm but was disappointed when hot tub wasn't working. Great location with shops nearby.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton San Antonio Downtown

review_text: Wow- where to Begin. Dirty Place, nasty food, non functioning AC, bogus charges on the bill and no water one evening during a recent visit all lead me to say stay away. Perhaps if they weren't over a hundred a might I would not be so bent! Motel 6 is better than this place. So very surprised to discover this is a Hilton property.

review_title: Great price spacious rooms wonderful service and quiet!!!!
review_text: To start id like to say the young lady at the front desk was sweet and very helpful she faxed my papers for me at 6 in the morning with no problem she smiled she was just really friendly and you don't find that often! The breakfast was light and yummy! The room I got was a king suite it was very clean and spacious even had a fresh smell, the pool was relaxing and quiet there weren't a lot of kids running around the halls where quiet it was relaxing I think I definitly found my regular place in san antonio.
hotel_name: Travelodge San Antonio/Near Fort Sam/ATT Center

review_title: This is not a hotel. This is a motel.
review_text:
We've stayed at La Quinta's before and they're not typically like this. First off, this is a motel. Your hotel room door faces the parking lot. As a female, I did not feel safe. The neighborhood is sketchy, it's noisy and I could hardly sleep.
The bathroom was moldy and not bathtub was scary. Seriously, I thought twice about taking a shower. The front desk girl was really friendly and nice. 
However will never stay here again.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn San Antonio I-35 N at Rittiman Rd

review_text: Worst hotel in San Antonio. Horribly disgusting and horrible staff. Do not stay here EVER. if your sole reason for staying here is because it's dog friendly, please find somewhere else.
hotel_name: Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham San Antonio, E Loop

review_text:
I stayed here Aug 20-21 2011 with my mother in law. 
GOOD: clean room, clean sheets, flat screen tv, fluffy pillows, clean bathroom, free samples- shampoo & lotion, average free breakfast-waffles,oatmeal, juice,cereal,coffee-
NOT SO GOOD : its a motel- the doors are exterior,and slight motel smell BUT I always bring LYSOL with me and I only used it when we got there ...no smell after that ...
Overall, for the price and good location...I WOULD STAY THERE AGAIN...
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn San Antonio I-35 N at Toepperwein

review_text:
I always love the courtyard. It is consistently great. Beds comfy food very good. This one is next to a restaurant that was highly recommended by a local. I don't remember the name but it's right across the street. They are known for amazing breakfast. 
Staff was great at this hotel and we enjoyed our stay. Close drive to a flea market that was very nice. Metered parking at the Mkt and they are quick to issue tix so be aware.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Antonio Airport / North Star Mall

review_text: My family and I had our reunion here, and overall it was great. There were a few problems, but the Hilton staff really went out their way to fix them as soon as we brought it to there attention. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone planning a event. Their staff really makes it easy to do.

review_title: Okay, but probably won't stay here again.
review_text: Average hotel, nice employees, clean hotel, regular rooms. They only thing we didn't enjoy was the breakfast buffet, the price was too much. The fairfield next door has it for free.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Antonio Airport / North Star Mall

review_title: Old and dirty - service to match
review_text:
This place is a dump. Service is worse. I'm a Hilton Diamond member. On arrival I waited 15 minutes for someone to appear at check in desk. It got worse from there. 
No room upgrade. Old smelly room. Next to elevator. No way to get a cold water, soda, or anything else in hotel after 11pm. No working vending machines. 
Next time in San Antonio stay at motel 6.

My boyfriend and I staid here for our anniversary. We were pretty surprised at how nice it looked for the price we paid thru expedia for it. The service was really good nobody was rude during the small time we did speak to them. First problem we had was the iron. It didn't get hot and just wasted a lot of our time. Next was the WiFi which we assumes like most hotels we've been to woudl be free but wasn't. It was ten dollars a night! Then the ac had to be the worst thing. This is Texas and it is hot! For our room to only get to 74 is ridiculous. Im naturally a cold person but this room was to hot for me. On top of a hot night tossing a turning we woke up and not really remembering if the hotel gave complementary breakfast or not we were very disappointed to see it was twelve dollars a person. Boy does this place nickel and dime you as much as possible. I've been in some dirt cheap hotels in my life that have only been 30 a night and still they gaven a complementary breakfast and free WiFi. On top of all that its a Friday night our first night here and drinks to relax would be lovely but of course the bar is closed! At eleven o clock on a Friday night!! I could understand any other day of the week but really a Friday that's just sad. This hotel tries to pull you in with good price for the room and clean rooms but tries to get as much money as possible from you so in the end you pay just as much as you would at another hotel that might have had a better view and be in a better location. Next time ill defiantly bit the bullet and go to the Marriott like usual.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton San Antonio Downtown
