review_text:
I have stayed at the HH SA Airport twice in the past 6 months and highly commend it to anyone looking for a hotel with easy access to the airpor (under 10 mins door to door). Very well presented and equiped rooms and excellent beds.
Staff are incredibly friendly and hospitable especially Joe who drives the airport shuttle bus. 
Lots of air crews in and out and good sports bar and restaurant. Good breakfast buffet. 
Small gym and a good size out door pool - didn't get to use either but nice to have. There is a small shop in the lobby carrying a wide range of bits and bobs, I even found a business belt as I'd left mine at home. Shopping malls on the other side of the freeway and a short walk (10 mins) away. Texans are the nicest people on the planet btw. 
My only grumble is wi-fi access, which is chargeable (something like $10 for 24 hrs). I kind of expect in this day and age it should be free.
All in all, a really well run and very comfortable hotel.

Kimberly was horrible. Snobby is a understatement...she does not know how to make a proper drink. I asked for a margarita with only lime juice and soda and she made it with oasis margarita mix which is ONLY for frozen drinks. I felt like I was at a hole in the wall bar. I think she might have said two words to me. VERY VERY POOR SERVICE AND NO BARTENDING SKILLS.
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_title: It wasn't the best hotel, but it was decent.
review_text: The hotel was a decent and clean place to stay. They didn't hesitate to give my aunt another room when her refrigerator was leaking. The staff was very cooperative. The rooms are nice, but the decorations were trash. The menu for the pizza parlor was outdated. When I tried to order delivery they said they moved and no longer deliver to the hotel. The breakfast was just ok. I've had better. The parking lot needs to be changed so that it can be accessed from the exit without having to take the turnaround to get to the hotel.

review_title: Muy bueno por la ubicaciÃ³n y precio
review_text: La ubicaciÃ³n fue excelente, el precio fue acorde con lo que dieron a cambio. La limpieza y desayuno normales. El estacionamiento fue seguro y ademÃ¡s la wi fi fue rapida. En fin, solo para dormir pues todo el dÃ­a te la pasas en la calle

Room 120 . . . nasty, nasty, nasty carpet throughout and our first observation. The whole room felt sleezy thereafter. Abandoned Suburban caked with dust (and "For Sale" sign inside windhield) in the parking lot. Older property that is obviously not well maintained. We won't be back!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn San Antonio Vance Jackson

review_title: We really enjoyed our family vacation.
review_text:
Great pools, water slides, lazy river, landscaping and kids activities let's you feel like you're really escaping for a weekend. You're a bit far from the city center but that's what you want here.
We arrived late night as we do with most hotels. Our only complaint is that the reception desk was empty and security had to show us to our room.
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_text: I'm a Wyndham Owner & I made last minute reservations for one day at this "resort." it's not pretty, clean nor conventional. To sum it up, it's a really old building in an akward location. Keep the old charm, I don't even mind the upstairs downstairs layout, but please make it clean! They do however provide vouchers for parking.
hotel_name: Wyndham Riverside Suites Hotel San Antonio

review_text: This Hilton needs a facelift! Although we got a reasonable group rate, it was not worth the money. The breakfast buffet was horrible. The parking was very inconvenient. The heater didn't work. The shower was dirty. We expect more from Hilton.

I traveled to San Antonio on business on the eve of a snow storm. I reserved a King room on line and when I arrived, I was given a handicap room with 1 full size bed and no tub. When I went back to the desk to request another room, I was basically told that there were no rooms and I would have to wait until the next day to be accommodated. On my second night, a snow storm hit. On the morning of my departure, all roads were closed and most fights were cancelled leaving from SAT International airport. I called the front desk to request a late checkout and was told absolutely not. I would need to extend my stay or check out. Give me a break, who would be checking in with the roads closed??? I have Silver status, but I will not be staying at any other Hilton Properties. please learn to value your customer. Kicking your guest out in extreme weather with closed roads is certainly a deal breaker.

review_title: Great hotel on the westside of San Antonio!
review_text:
Hilton hotel with a spa provided much needed pampering for a busy traveler. The hotel lounge around the bar in the lobby served guests both cocktails and dinner. On Tuesday nights, manicure services were made available to guests in lobby and lounge area. I was on need of a pedicure - and manicurist arranged for spa to stay open for me to get pedicure after closing 8 pm. 
Room was good. Only one minor complaint - hotel front desk staff placed me in a room near ice machine & mechanics room and I could hear some noise in bathroom. 
The great customer service from bar , restaurant and spa made up for some noise in bathroom!
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_text: Great location and great room features. The hotel is a stone's throw from a large shopping center with great restaurants and shops. Very spacious and loved the decor. Breafast included is a definite plus!

You walk into a very nice lobby and you are already impressed before you go any further. Then when you go to your room it's very nice with plenty of room. There was a big TV in the center of the room stretegically placed to where you can see it no matter where you are in the room. Friendly staff. All around very nice.
A little gem, staff are brilliant, great place. Great location near shopping mall, airport and half hour from downtown. Great food nearby

review_title: Convenient location, Very poor cleaning, I am an operations manager at a hotel, so I know what I am talking about.
review_text:
When I made the reservation I requested a quiet room away from any housekeeping closets, elevator, employee entrances and ice-machines since we were traveling for the first time to a hotel with our 1 year old baby.
1. Can you guess what happened? Well, the Room (322) was not quiet as requested- we were put next to the ice-machine and the housekeeping closet, contradicting exactly what I had specifically asked. I must say that your staff does not know how to behave in Â Guest's areas, like rooms hallways- at 9 am, they started the room cleaning and they started shouting at each other and complaining how many "checked-out" rooms they were assigned to clean, using foul language. Kept slamming on doors when in and out of rooms.
2. After letting my kid crawl around the room while we were getting ready, we picked him up only to find his hands, knees and feet blackened by the filth and dirt in the carpet, quite disgusting for a parent, and disturbing for a hotel operations manager.
3. Around 12 noon I requested the front desk to ask housekeeping to wash/shampoo the carpet, knowing that it takes about 30 minutes to perform that duty and around 5 hours to complete the drying, I knew we had enough time since we were not coming back until 9pm. Surprise, the carpet was still wet, the room smell so musty and it was so humid that for the first time in 6 years I had to use my asthma inhaler.
Quite disappointed since this hotel is so close to my sister's place, there are many other hotels close too, we were trying a different one, but there is nothing deterring me from going elsewhere.
4. Front desk staff was nice (shall I say they are assigned to many different duties). Â The automated check out machine is BULL Cr@p! I tried using it for check out and when I selected the option to Change Credit Card it prompts you to Continue with Check Out, as if it registered your request, so I pushed Continue only to close the bill with the wrong card. So, I asked the person at the FD to reverse the charge and close it with the correct one, it took 20 minutes. If a Manager On duty can't assist the FD, he should stay away from it. He was nice, but sometimes what you need is assertiveness.

review_title: great hotel but the pool was "tired".
review_text:
My family stayed here for a week and were very impressed with the room we had. I understand the hotel recently went under an upgrade, we found all the public areas and our room very tastefully decorated. 
Our ownly disappointment was the pool. That obviously wasn't refurbished with the rest of the hotel as it looked very "tired" and the water was always quite cloudy and not inviting.
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_text: The Hilton Hill County was a fantastic hotel. We loved that it was so close to SeaWord, and they had fun activities for the kids in the evening. Staff was very helpful and professional. My only complaint would be that we couldn't stay longer. I would recommend this hotel to anyone.
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_text:
I would like to start by saying that spend alittle more money and go down the street to Hyatt. This Hilton is not a resort by any means. We had a suite which was not as big as the other suites in this class. When asked to switch, they prepared a room for us which was the same size which was not useful for us. 
When speaking to the manager again all he said was we are at capacity and I can see what we can do. Not good enough Brotha! Our fridge was broken which they knew about. When the the guy came to swap it out, he told me that someone came earlier before we checked in and knew it was out of service. So then replace the damn thing!!!!
The toilet exploded in our bathroom after going only #1!!! Whole bathroom was flooded. 
Their pool sucks! My community pool is better than this piece of [--]!!!
My friend asked for a fridge and the hotel said they would provide one or them and they never recieved it. 
They have no restaurant dinner service at night. Really????
We didnt stay at hyatt bc it was $175 a night more. I regret that now.
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_text: My boyfriend and i made reservations over the phone through hotel finder an hour before we arrived.we received a confirmation number and got to The hotel to check in only to be told we didn't have a reservation .we tried calling the place we went through only to be hung up on several times .the manager came over to us asking if he could help .we told him our problem and he not only gave us a room he gave us a suite for our troubles.we will def be back here .
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_title: I will never stay there again
review_text:
We arrived at 2:30 pm. Check in time given by priceline was 3 pm. They made us wait until 4 pm for check in. They told us priceline did not know check in time, but in a hostile way. In no moments they try any courtesy. The pool is very little. No towels at the pool, the washer and drier were not working. It took them more than two hours to bring the luggage to our room. We had to go in person to the front desk , and ask for our luggage . They did not try to apologize, or made any effort to assist us in an effective way. At the next day, we realize we did not have a single towel in the room. People in the front desk very rude. 
This is not a Hilton like hotel. It was even better 4 years ago when it use to be a ramada in. I will not recommend or ever go back to this hotel. Better to stay in the competence, courtyard Marriott .
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_text:
We stayed here 5 nights this past week. Our room was never cleaned! They do make your bed daily but that's it! The didn't vacuum. They didn't wipe down anything! TOWELS! What towels? Housekeeping left us a not 4 of the 5 days we were there saying they were out of towels and to call the front desk! WTH? Really?!?! One out of 5 nights there were towels at the pool. So my recommendation is if you are going to stay here, take your own towels! 
The check-in staff was rude! The maintenance men were extremely nice and helpful! 
I will not be staying here again! I was not impressed! Several people I spoke to nightly by the pool said the same thing, "We won't be back!"
Last year we stayed at the Marriott! It is awesome! The only reason we didn't stay there again is because the were booked!
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_title: Great location, not up to Hilton standards
review_text:
We stayed here while visiting SeaWorld, then stayed the weekend. I used HHonors points for part of my stay, which cut down on the cost.
Pros:
- great location with a convenient shuttle to SeaWorld
- friendly front desk staff
- three pools, a nice courtyard, outdoor fireplaces, play area 
Cons:
- unfriendly restaurant staff
- no kid TV channels (eg Nick Jr)
- dirty/cloudy pool water
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_text: Nice hotel, but too many kids for a 'spa' feel. Would have been nice if the lap pool was not a kiddie play area. The rooms are nice and very modern.
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_title: Okay place to stay in a great location.
review_text: Right on the river walk within walking distance of everything. Rooms are just average along with everything else about it. But compare the pricing to others in the same location and it is a real value.

review_title: Perfect location best value for money
review_text: Right on the river walk and away from the noise of all the night clubs and cafes. Easy walk 1 minute to all the restaurants on the river walk. We had a king size bed room with a balcony on the fourth floor. We got fantastic views of the river. The rooms were clean and spacious. Having the balcony meant we could sit out there and relax and enjoy the view of the river. The bathroom was a good size and well lit. I will always stay at this hotel if I return to San Antonio. Great value for money.

My family stayed here for 4 nights. We stayed in 2 other hotels while in Texas and this was my favorite. My bits are 3 and 5. This hotel was great for kids. The kids pool was amazing, Smores around the campfires were great. One night there was even a kids dance party outside with a dj. I had read reviews on here about it being dirty. It was very clean. They were even replacing carpets in the Libby while we were there. I booked on priceline so we got a smokin deal. I highly recommend this hotel!!!!! Staff was great!
hotel_name: Hilton San Antonio Hill Country Hotel & Spa

review_text: We stayed here for 4 nights. The hotel was absolutely filthy! The lobby, elevators, hallways and rooms were visibly dirty. There wasnt even a microwave available for use. The front desk receptionists lied to us repeatedly. They quoted us a price for an extra room then changed it at check out time. I will NEVER stay here or holiday inn again. Don't waste your time or money! The only good things about this Hotel was the very nice and professional valet staff and coffee shop lady!

review_title: Older hotel but clean, comfy,nice pool, I would stay here again
review_text: I pricelined this room and was a little worried when I read reviews BUT.... It was a clean, comfy room. Nice pool area, decent breakfast, very close to seaworld. Friendly staff. I would definitely stay here again

Great location & for a 3 night stay I really had no complaints... 
The room was clean & for the price it was a great location!! We had a 25th High School reunion & most stayed at the hotel with the same positive experience.
Great location, rooms are okay, typical hotel room, rated a 2 on cleanliness due to smell (smoke) in my room. Overall not bad.
My room was not ready. Stuck me in a handicapped room with a huge lockeroom bathroom, and tiny bed. Does being a priority club member include getting the poorest possible rooms?
It takes forever to get car from valet or room service order. Slow check in, not impressed by anything this place offers for the price.

We live about 75 miles from San Antonio so we frequently stay at hotels prior to early morning flights out. We've tried several near the air port and found them noisy, run down and having hard, old mattresses. The Hyatt Place is an exception. Nice bed, great room, quiet and comfortable are how I describe this hotel that offers free shuttle service to and from the air port and lets us leave our car in their lot instead of having to pay high air port parking fees. Our second stay was when we were invited to an evening wedding at the Argyle and we did not want to drive back to the ranch after dining and dancing. This is a super location in a good neighborhood.

Very dirty! First we arrived to find on the first night a dirty toilet;dirty floor, and the most disgusting pillows I have ever seen! We called front desk and they did send someone to clean it but didn't replace the pillows ,we had to go buy our own. The second night we found not one clean towel in our room,instead we find again dirty floors and a dirty towel on the corner of the room. We called front desk and explained everything that was found on this day and prior day. The lady said she would leave a note to manager to inform her. We knew booking this hotel it wasn't going to be a modern updated holiday. Inn but was at least expecting a clean comfortable room,instead it was the worst dirty hotel! I Do NOT recommend! Unless u don't mind dirtyness.
hotel_name: Howard Johnson San Antonio/Near Balcones Heights

review_text:
My friends and I had booked a room one week prior to our trip to San Antonio. We made the reservation over the phone and left the credit card info along with the name of the card holder. Come to find out, the lady working the desk typed in the last name of the card holder incorrectly... Last name ended in an "m" but lady typed an "n".
When the payment didn't process through correctly, the lady simply 
cancelled our reservation without alerting the card holder. All along, 
we think our room is reserved, per 
our conversation with the desk lady
 - but the day before heading out to
 san Antonio, we called the hotel just to confirm that everything was still okay with the reservation (being that we were never emailed a confirmation number). 
After spending 40 minutes on the phone getting transferred to numerous employees, having to wait for them to call us back, and continue to transfer us to different contacts, we were finally able to get through to the manager. 
The manager was extremely rude. Although one of the previous employees we spoke with was able to look up the "cancelled" transaction in the system (this is how we found out that the name had been typed in incorrectly), the manager flat out lied to us, claiming that she had no record of it in the system and that unless she had record, she did not believe our "story". She claimed they were completely booked and that my group "would have to find another hotel on our own.". It wasn't their problem. 
By the way, she was not saying these things in a nice tone.
Needless to say, all other hotels were booked up for the night we needed, and we ended up having to sleep on the floor of a separate group of friends that were also going to San Antonio with us.
It's a beautiful hotel, but with management so rude and disrespectful to their customers, this is not a place I would recommend anyone giving their money to.

review_title: Location great, tv not so good....
review_text: The service was pretty good, they let us check in early and any requests we had for extra towels and blankets were handled quickly. The tv in the room lost signal a lot and the tv was hard to change channels.

They claim the non-smoking rooms are smoke free rooms, NOT SO! Our room although had a no smoking sign in front, smelled like an ash tray. Don't set up a wake up call as you will never get one. Parking is an additional $18 a day (valet is $26 per day). Room walls are made out of cardboard or so seem as you can hear everything in the next room. The staff is very nice but they can't make up for a poor property.

When I stayed at this hotel with my family I was not impressed. The lobby has a disgusting odor in the air, and the initial service was not what it should have been. 
For how much you are paying for a room you also have to pay $18 to park everyday and you have to buy breakfast. It seems as though nothing is complimentary, not even a cup of coffee. 
It also took the staff until 2:00pm to make up our room, and when we informed them of a broken vending machine that was dispensing hot sodas and water, we had to inform them a second time before anything was done. 
I would never recommend this hotel to anyone. Yes the location is great, but there are plenty of other hotels on the Riverwalk to choose from.

review_title: Convenient location, terrible in every other aspect
review_text:
Although this hotel is conveniently located on the riverwalk, it lacks in every other area. Not only do you have to pay daily to park, there is no complimentary continental breakfast or coffee. 
During my stay my room did not get made up until 2pm, and it had an awful smell throughout he lobby and restaurant. On top of everything, the drink machine on my rooms floor had extremely hot beverages coming out of it. When we brought it to the front desks attention nothing had changed by the end of that day. It was still dispensing hot beverages. We had to let them know a second time, maybe after that they decided to fix it... No, but at least they put an out of order sign...kudos for doing your job. 
Overall, I would never recommend this hotel to anyone. For the price you are paying to stay here it is extremely under par.

review_title: Great location with a great value.
review_text: We stayed here over Memorial Day weekend. Very clean, GREAT location for the Riverwalk. Pool was the perfect temperature. Rooms were clean, spacious, nice amenities. Bed was comfortable. Very reasonably priced for the location. The only negative was I left an expensive shirt and jacket in the closet (my favorites too, just my luck that I'd forget I hung them up) and called when we got back to see if they had found them. I was told they would ask housekeeping and call me back, but I never heard anything. :( Other than that we had a nice time here.
Would like to thank the hotel for a wonderful stay. The room was outstanding and would love to comes back soon. Front desk ladies Vanessa, Amy, Amanda were more thank helpful our entire stay.

review_title: Very good value. A good hotel for the price range
review_text: I went for a one day trip to San Antonio. Got there at midnight and the recepcionist was very helpful and courteous. Service was excellent!!! The room was very good. Very clean and did not smell like mildew or old like other hotels I've stayed. The bed was a little hard but would definetly recommend this hotel and will definetly come back and stat here on my next trip to San Antonio.
hotel_name: Howard Johnson Inn & Suites San Antonio

review_title: It is ranked in the 250's for a reason. Not family friendly
review_text: This place is horrible. Very rude check-in and would not accommodate a family of 4 with double beds with 3 cars in the parking lot. I have been to hundreds of hotels and this is the first that would not change. Stay somewhere else!!

review_title: Don't ever stay here, worst service ever.
review_text: We arrived at the hotel after a long flight from germany. We had been travelling for over a day along with our dog and children who were hungry and tired. When we went to check in at 7p.m, the room was not ready and we were told it was going to be only an hour waiting time but we waited an extra 3 hours to get a room. There were only 2 people working and they god not have the courtesy to tell us what was going on with our room. The staff roils make personal phone calls and did not have any ice or mill. I am never going to stay at this hotel ever again.

My husband and I tried this hotel for 1 night, as a staycation. Location is ok. Staff are friendly but not very intelligent and move slowly.
Our in room safe did not work and no one in the hotel could fix it.
Our breakfast was served with plastic silverware and no napkins, because they ran out (and restaurant was not nearly even full!). Kind of strange.
Beds are ok, pillows small. Loud toilet made noise all night. Didn't sleep well at all.
I wouldn't stay here again, it wasn't repulsive but there are better choices!!

review_title: Very very nice and trendy hotel close to everything you'll need!!
review_text: Very nice clean comfortable and trendy place to stay!!! This hotel is a perfect place to stay and still very new! I booked my aunt and uncle here and then my mom and I stayed here after my apt was flooded. I would stay here again and I live in San Antonio :)

My wife and our young son stayed for 4 days in a king suite. Very nice and clean. Hotel is still new so still working out small issues. Pool area is incredible. Breakfast is very good each day. Also well lit parking garage under hotel which is very accessible.

Overall the stay was fine. We were here for 3 nights. It took 3 reminders for them replace my broken coffee maker. The exercise room is atrocious. The rooms are clean, the beds are comfortable, parking is great, and it's very close to the riverwalk.

review_title: Extraordinary Tony the best HOST EVER ALONG WITH HIS TEAM. 50/50INC.
review_text: My best vacation ever I personally recommend it to anyone coming to San Antonio hands down the service, room, scenery, everything ask for tony he the man ,')
hotel_name: Howard Johnson Inn & Suites San Antonio

review_title: Usually reliable Marriott in need of a redo.
review_text: We have visited San Antonio over 3 dozen times in the last 8 years.and we always stay in Marriott brand hotels. We stayed here in 2003 and this was a really great property. We chose the location on this trip due to the closeness of the hotel to our son's house in South Town. My wife's first words when entering the room was, "This room could use a redo!" Its not that it is dirty or broken, just tired. The lobby is done in the latest Courtyard style, but the rooms are a generation behind, nice when new...several years ago. With two other Courtyards in downtown (both are commercial buidling rehabs.) and a new Springhill Suites and a new Fairfield Suites, both located just behind the River Mall, this may be the last time I stay here...next time I come will be after the hotel description reads "all new room decor."
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Antonio Downtown/Market Square

review_text: Nice experience in San Antonio. Hotel is well kept and in nice location at the SW corner of the Riverwalk. Rooms are good size and bathroom seemed newly renovated. Only complaint is $13 per day parking charge.

My wife and I flew in to San Antonio and stayed here for 1+2 nights. The location of the hotel was excellent and the restaurants, Alamo and shops were within easy walking distance. The rooms were clean, comfortable and a reasonable size. However, a minor safety point the hotel should ensure things like the extraction fan above the showers are properly fixed to the ceiling. I had concerns about water splashing on the exposed electrics from the shower.
On our return to San Antonio we stayed for a further two nights. Avgain the room was clean and seemed in a better sate of maintenance than before so we were pleased. A negative again was that we had been put in a room opposite the smoking area. At 3am you do not appreciate people standing around outside your door talking, shouting to their mates, running up and down the landing. I told the young girl the next day on reception and she apologised.
The computer they have for public use is not fast and struggles to process things like checkin for flights and cannot print flight tickets - to be fair they did let usbuse a computer and printer in the main office to checkin and print offnour boarding passes - not sure if the receptionist would be willing to let you do this late at night or early in the morning when they are by themselves.
If you take note of the above you should have a good stay.
Stayed for four days while visiting seaworld. If I ever return to San Antonio,I will surely stay at this hotel again. Great price, value, and location. 15 - 20 minutes from Seaworld.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Antonio Downtown/Market Square

review_title: Not luxurious but on the river
review_text: The rooms were clean but tiny.the bathroom could use a pocket door so you could get in it better. Every other room had a balcony on river side. It is on the river but yoy can't access the river from hotel because parking garage us below hotel. Go across street and down stairs to river. Our only problem was not enough people working front desk. Wr waited to check in behind two others then check out was bad. You have to go to front desk to check out. I wish they would slip a receipt under your door around 3:00am so you could just leave. We waited about 25 minutes just to check out! People in front of me just started laying keys down and leaving. But room and location were ok for the price.

review_title: Rooms could use an update, but overall we were pleased with this hotel.
review_text: We thought this hotel was close to seaworld. It was 12 miles away, but took us about an hour to get there. We had to get on 4 interstates to get there. Once we finally got there everything was great. Staff was wonderful. The rooms could use an update but were very clean. The breakfast was over at 9:00 am. Since we were on vacation, we missed that. We did eat dinner there at resturant, and it was very good. We would stay there again.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel San Antonio Northwest / I-10

review_text:
Whole family enjoyed it. We where able to spread out ( kids in one area of the suite, adults in the other) and relax. Pool is great and staff us quite helpful. 
Beds were comfy. Like home.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel San Antonio Northwest / I-10

review_text: If you travel solo, then maybe it's worth the stay; BUT if you're with family, I would not recommend. The parking garage is, as another review stated, "a nightmare!" the front desk had my reservation for the wrong month, the pool was yuck...the lurking maintenance man didn't help. We stayed one night n packed up the next morning. Ended up forking up an addtl $50/night for the Westin Riverwalk. Ahhh totally worth the expense.
Loved the fact it was near our destination (six flags), hostess wasnt very nice or professional, but hotel and pool were overall decent. Would come back again since we did enjoy our stay. :)
This was one of the best getaway's me and my wife have been on yet. The staff , the service and the overall experience was great. Will return in the future.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay during fiesta. Right from late check in due to flight delays through to checkout, we had a memorable stay. This charming historic hotel is close to all the major sites and the riverwalk. We could walk everywhere. We even spent an evening in the bar and met really interesting fellow travellers with whom we visited a deer ranch.
The rooms look new and are well equipped with all modern amenities. Unfortunately, room service was not available the one night we stayed in. The front desk manager was more than obliging to order in for us.
Thank you to all the friendly staff. We shall be back with our family soon.

review_title: Really nice motel in 1970, really bad hotel in 2011.
review_text: The worst bed ever in a motel. The towels are as old as the motel with as many stains on them. Hot shower is very sporadic at best. I purchased this hotel through a travel site and it was listed as a 3 star. This hotel would be stretching a 2 star rating. The tv was twenty years old or better but it did have good cable service. Do not stay here if you prefer a hot shower, clean towel, or a comfortable bed.

review_title: I expected more for the price.
review_text: Not your moneys worth!! I expected a really nice hotel but the tv was old and room looked old. Customer service was not good either.

The Bayfront us located on the dock near the convention center. Vert nice hotel, elevators work beautifully, rooms/bathrooms are nice. The pool is functional, but the view from the pool is basically an old rusted Dole ship, but we kne thy coming in. My biggest complaint was Sunday breakfast, party of 6, Fathers day, my wife wanted to sit outside. Big mistake, service outside was not very good. We ordered the breakfast sandwiches and it took 45 minutes.

review_title: Hilton trying to get every dollar possible.
review_text: My family and I stayed at Hilton SD Bayfront June 2011. The room was large the beds were comfortable and the bathrooms a good size. However, parking is $36 a night. And they charge $7 an hour for WIFI. Overall we liked our stay here but wouldn't come back because of the extra unnecessary charges.
We walkes around san antonio for most of our stay, so being next to the riverwalk was great. Rooms were clean, front desk was very helpful. We are low key and didnt experience any issues.

review_title: Beautiful hotel nice family get away!
review_text:
We stayed here for a family three night get away. We have 4 kids ages 9-14 and "The Big E" as we call it is about the only hotel we find where we can all "fit" without having to purchase the second room. So we frequent them as often as we can and the complimentary cooked breakfast is a huge plus as well.Â 
We arrived late on a Friday evening or early Saturday morning about 1:00. The hotel only offers valet parking for $27 per night which I had read previously no surprise. There is a parking lot across the street that is $20 but no security. We did valet, we had lots of luggage with a large family so I asked for a cart and he said he couldn't just send a cart with us he would have to go up as well but didn't really seem as though he wanted to so we carried it all.Â 
Our room was beautiful!! Nicer than most Big E's we have stayed in! Â Room was very cool, and stayed that way our entire stay, which is great in early July in Texas. Beds were very comfortable. We had a room with a view of the riverwalk and the pool.Â We were walking distance of the main part of the riverwalk, and the Alamo.Â 
Breakfast the following morning was packed. My husband actually had to stand to eat, which I do understand it was July 4th weekend. The food itself and selection we didn't feel was as good as what we are accustomed to with the Embassy but still good and plenty of it. The second morning it wasn't near as crowded could have been that we went much earlier. We didn't eat with them the last morning.Â 
We didn't take advantage of the evening reception.Â 
Valet on the morning we went to Seaworld was quick, we called from the room and our car was waiting when we got downstairs. Valet was very helpful asked where we were headed and even gave us printed step by step directions on how to get there!! Nice!!
The morning of departure we called down to get our car and they had a message saying we couldn't call down we had to come down. Once we turned in our tag for the vehicle we had to wait 15 minutes for our car. People were coming down and getting their cars right away and we still waited...I asked one of the guys why we were still waiting and he said it is coming..,no explanation as to why it was so long. It wasn't Â crowded at all so I wasn't sure what the hold up was.Â 
All in all I think this hotel was wonderful just a few things I think could be worked on.

review_title: Managers were amazing food and beverage staff were rude!
review_text: The hotel is nice and clean my only problem was with the food and beverage staff. Upon check in the front desk staff moved quickly and told us evening reception was still going on it was 7:10pm I walked over to the bar and was told the reception was over it was now 7:13 correct me if I'm wrong but embassy suites advertises evening reception until 7:30 not me! After a slight altercation I received my cocktail no big deal. Next day we shopped and showed up just in time for evening reception well this night the cut off evening reception at 7:10 again I wasn't having it found the manager she quickly handled the situation. The big problem came when she walked away the bartenders were complaining loudly that they didn't owe any if these f-ing people anything at that point my husband spoke to the manager again informing her about the lack of professionalism from her bar staff. My biggest problem came in Sunday night we were exhausted and decided on room service we placed our order at 8:36pm and they informed us it would be an hour which was fine we ordered 3 salads without dressing and 3 sandwiches and 6 ice tea's it took the full hour which was not a problem, the food arrived teas lacked ice, salads had dressing when I informed the food runner he said sorry kitchens closed f&b people closing early again. After sitting down to eat my soggy salad I couldn't help but notice the black rotted lettuce, I walked down to the front desk I laid out all the rotten lettuce on their desk so they could be sure to notice how awful it was! Again the managers fixing the f&b mess ups. And last but not least the cost of parking is absurd.

I travel a lot with my job and I have stayed at many embassy suites and this one on the riverwalk is great the staff is awesome and the rooms are very clean and fresh the housekeepers take pride in there work its nice to see supervisors take time to assist as well I left yesterday I was on the 10th floor and the young lady was going back and forth busy cleaning always had a smile I only wish the embassy suites in san marcos and the one on I 10 west had housekeeping staff like this

I Booked this hotel through a Groupon deal, but was highly disappointed. The rooms are very small and old. Our room smelled musty upon arrival. We share a balcony with the room next to us so they can see/hear us and We can see/hear them. 
WHen I pulled back the bed sheets, there Were yellow stains on them. Gross! We called the front desk and they were replaced. 
The breakfast buffet was included and it was more like a continental breakfast you see at the Best Western. There was even hair in The eggs! Double gross!!
This hotel is deceptive bc it says its on the River Walk and pictures show the lively part of the RIver Walk, however, they are on the River, but It's a good 25 minute walk to the main stretch of the River where all the other hotels, restaurants, and bars are. 
I do not recommend this hotel at all and I will not be staying here again.

I order room service only to NOT receive it. When I called to inquire, the manager from room service lied and mentioned she called me back about my order. Instead of her being accountable for their mistake, she chose to come up with a lie. I despise liars!!!

Great value! Perfect location, newer hotel, complementary breakfast and cocktails that no other hotel I've found offers. These are two definite perks when staying with at an Enbassy. Service was great, valet was prompt and the rooms were great! Clean, spacious andbeautofully decorated. Valet is a little pricey for the area especially since there is a $10 lot right across the street. Only down side with the parking lot there are no in and out privileges. We would stay here again.
Bed was really hard. Th elevator was really loud. But their service was great!!
Great location on the riverwalk, loved the taxi boats

We found a great deal at El Tropicano on Groupon and decided to try it out for a short getaway. This hotel was on the recently expanded part of the Riverwalk, so it was away from the noise of the restaurants and bars - a plus for us. It is a long walk to the restaurants, but the trolleybus and river taxi stop right at the hotel.
We stayed in a riverview room which was quiet. The king bed was quite comfortable. Bathroom is small, but fine for two people. Only negative for me was the A/C was a bit loud.
The Groupon included parking (uncovered, usually $18 per day) and breakfast buffet (usually $14). Food was better than some hotel breakfasts I've had, but I don't think I would have paid extra for it if it hadn't been included for us.
What made this stay great was the staff! Luke at the front desk was wonderful! Our room was not quite ready when we arrived, but he compensated us with free drinks at the bar. Dina in the restaurant at breakfast was fabulous! She welcomed us with a smile and kept my coffee cup filled.
I would definitely come back, especially if the breakfast is included.

review_title: Excellent service,rooms, too far to walk to restaurants on riverwalk
review_text: Excellent service here . If you go to market square don't walk....too far, taxi is only $6. Valet parking is 28.00 but worth it, comfy rooms but no refrigerator . Great stay. Thanks for the excellent service!

review_title: The outside design does not do the inside justice.
review_text: I have never stayed at a hotel with such a beautiful atrium. Although all rooms open onto the atrium we did not hear any noise while in our room. The room was more than enough space for my family of 5. My only complaint is that the hotel could have invested in queen size beds rather than doubles. The housekeeping staff were very thorough in their cleaning of our room. However, they did run out of face towels during our stay but we just simple used the larger towels to wash off. I love the indoor heated pool which makes swimming for the kids a delight year-round. Plenty of towels in the pool area so no need to bring any from the room. Staff was always helpful and polite. Did enjoy the breakfast. Much to choose from and delicious. Pancakes,eggs,bacon,omlets cooked to order,sausage links, oatmeal,yogurt(individual sealed cups would be better choice than big bowls),fruit (cantaloupe,watermelon, etc.) pastries which included muffins,doughnuts etc. Toast and bagels. Oj and apple juice. What a way to start the day! However, as enjoyable as the breakfast is, the manager's reception could use some work. The salsa was not very good that accompanied the tortilla chips everyday. The popcorn was pretty tasty as well as the trailmix. Although I was not expecting a full spread of appetizers, I did expect more than was served. However, if you are a drinker you will be pleased to know all alcoholic drinks are on the house. We will definitely stay here again should we come back to San Antonio.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel San Antonio Northwest / I-10

review_title: If you're traveling to enjoy sights of the riverwalk then this might be a place to stay.
review_text:
This is a typical hotel. Nothing stands out as extraordinary but the location on the river walk was nice despite our Texas heat. The hotel was up a good walking distance to
the restaurants and such which made our walks very peaceful. If you want to be near all the restaurants this may not be the location you'd desire. The only
Down fall to the stay was that parking cost 23.95 if you park
In self park a 1/3 mile away from check in desk or $28 in valet. You take your pick. I wasn't thrilled that parking wasn't included with the room price. None the less the stay was nice!

Very small rooms No refrigerators available in rooms either. Our room smelled very bad. Had to use perfume as air freshener !They need to purchase an ozone generator to get rid of odors!!!! Had toothpaste splattered on mirrors when we got there. location is great. I should of followed my instinct on past reviews others had wrote on this hotel. When they said small rooms and we need a frig too!!

Room 1612, 2 queen riverview. Â Nice quiet riverwalk location, especially for the price. Â If you do not want to walk, the river taxi is close. Â Our room was clean, great view, with comfortable beds. Â 
The laundry facility (on 4th floor) came in handy when one of our children spilled something.
Their breakfast buffet was excellent! Â Our family loved having fresh made to order omelets, pancakes, waffles, and fresh fruit.Â 
Even though we did not take advantage of their room service, if we visit again (without our children) we definitely Â utilize this option.Â 
The work out room was great!Â 
Nice large pool and hot tub! Convenient pool towels!
The $28 for valet parking was worth the extra expense. We did not have to walk across for our car, having it brought right to us was nice.Â 
No complaints!
The hotel has very bad customer service!The manager Robert Garcia was actually very rude and didn't try to help us with our problem.The beds were so uncomfortable I would never stay here again.

Stayed at this hotel as a package I purchased thru a fundraiser auction. Wasn't sure what to expect considering some of the other reviews. The hotel staff was ALL very helpful including when we asked for extra linen and everytime we called valet for our car! The pool area is very clean and entertaining for the kiddos! Downstairs bar was convenient with excellent staff! The bed was very comfortable!! Soaps are usually poor quality drying my skin however we noticed even this is better quality:) The location wasn't a problem to us, it is on the river walk however they were very honest letting us know how far to walk before we reached the busy part of the river walk. So we loaded up in the car and drove a bit anyway since we had the kids:) thank you to the staff for your courtesy to me and my family!!:):)
First time in san antonio river taxi to all bars and food clean rooms great staff. Will be back

Hotel trÃ¨s propre, chambre trÃ¨s grande, trÃ¨s bon accueil placement parfait. Seul petit problÃ¨me bruit des soufleries ( maivaise isolation des fenÃªtres )
Les prix sont un peu plus chÃ¨res que l Hotel Sofia (a 100 m) mais la qualitÃ© est lÃ¢. Je n'ai pas tester le restaurant ni le petit dÃ©jeunÃ©

Not bad prices for room but they get you on parking.
Staff very rude, I originally said I would stay 1 night possibly 2, on second day they called me several times asking me to pay the additional night. I explained that I was out and would pay as soon as I got back to the hotel, shortly after security was sent to my room and they started harassing my fellow traveler who was sick in bed. Very disappointing

Stay at the Hilton or Hyatt. At least there you know what you are getting. Checking in was easy, but when we got to our room it wasn't what we had reserved. When we went to the front desk to ask about it, they told us that booking online (even though it was the Menger website) doesn't reserve a room type, it's only a "request." we had paid more for another room and had to argue with them to get the rate lowered. Then we realized that they had put a $400 hold on our debit card, not $100 as we were told. On top of all that, the room smelled like cigarette smoke. Then in the morning, the manager told us they needed us to change rooms because they had given us the wrong one the night before. We said forget it and checked out. What was supposed to be a fun, relaxing weekend ended up just being stressful because of this hotel.

review_title: Great experience and a perfect location
review_text: I have stayed here many times over the years. This is a very nice hotel that is perfectly located. There are so many fun places within walking distance. My favorite place to stay in San Diego.

review_title: Get nickled and dimed, but don't get any sort of accommodations.
review_text:
Parking was valet $28/day
Coke machine out of everything
Ice machine broken 
Pool key didn't work
No vent in bathroom
Asked for two extra towels I never got
Pool was third level up and vibrated, view was of buildings

Booked with a group for shooting venue. Cleaning, comfy rooms. Good pillows & towels. Coffee 24 hrs. Fine breakfast. Gas station/C store adjacent. 2 computers for use. Would stay there again in a heartbeat !
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites San Antonio SeaWorld/Westover Hills

review_title: Loved the shuttle service...HATED the mystery stains on the bedding!
review_text: I stayed here with my mom and sister for a weekend trip to seaworld. First impression was GREAT....lobby was nice, free Internet access, great shuttle service with an awesome driver, & complementary breakfast with WAFFLES!! But as we were getting ready for bed we pulled down the bedding for the pull out couch which was sooooooo incredibly uncomfortable... But back to the bedding it was in the top of the closet in a zippered bag, like the kind that a comforter would come in. I pulled it out and had a fitted sheet top sheet and a comforter. As I shook out the comforter to place on the bed I saw it....BROWN SMEARS!!!! I have NO clue whether it was chocolate or...well you know! But I wasn't about to sniff it to find out! I immediately had my mom call down and ask for a new one the lady said sure that she would send housekeeping up with a new one....45 min later they show up with a top sheet NOT a comforter....so my mom calls back down and is told that it must have been a mistake and that someone would be up in a min...another 45 min later and still NOTHING!!! so I called down myself and she tells me that they do not have any extra comforters but she would send someone up with a thick sheet....THICK SHEET REALLY?!?!? Then she told me that if it was cold enough to need 2 comforters then maybe I should turn up the air...by this time we had waited well over an hour for a comforter that was nonexistent and I was beyond pissed... I finally had to threaten to bring the comforter with the poop like substance on it down to the front desk and show every person i saw on the way down for her to offer to call the courtyard ( which is owned by the same co. And is literally 20 ft away) to borrow a comforter...I don't understand how a "hotel" doesn't have any extra blankets or comforters... Even if they were completely book their should be extra for cases like this... And next time we will be staying at the courtyard...which still offers the same amazing shuttle!
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites San Antonio SeaWorld/Westover Hills

review_text: Beautiful pool/lagoon area with a great location. Rooms are a little small but nice, worth paying extra for a room with a patio.

Our stay was awesome! The staff was wonderful and the rooms were clean and pleasant. The night atmosphere was great as well our bartenders at the Xyz bar were great, and Heather at the front desk was very helpful and informative. Overall we had a very relaxing weekend and will continue to stay at the Aloft hotels.
Nice, funky hotel. All amenities were as expected from W. Would definitely stay again. What about free coffee in the lobby in the AM?

review_title: Nice installations but mind the noise.
review_text:
I stayed at Aloft this last weekend for two nights in room 225. The lobby bar was packed and noisy when I checked in Friday evening, but the room appeared to be ok. Fittings and amenities were fine and cozy, altho the in-room safe did not have batteries.
But once I laid down, I realized the problem with the room. Outside is the elevator machine room, and one elevator in particular made deep, loud groaning noises every time it activated. This went on all night and woke me repeatedly. As I had already unpacked I decided not to complain to avoid the hassle of moving my stuff, but by all means avoid staying in rooms close to the elevators until they manage to fix this problem.

This hotel is adjacent to the Convention Center and the docks, and within easy walking distance of downtown. Room decor was relatively new and pleasant if undifferentiated. Nice touches included a "snooze" setting on the fridge (I often unplug fridges in hotel rooms because they are so noisy) and an occupancy sensor on thennight-light in the bathroom. Front desk staff were helpful and well-informed. Recommended.

I booked a room here for my parents 25th wedding anniversary. The staff was very helpful over the phone and extremely accommodating. My parents loved the room and the view. Beautiful location. They were even treated to champagne and strawberries as a surprise. That impressed me the most.

This our company's No. 3 "preferred" hotel for the San Antonio airport. I hope it doesn't elevate to No. 1. 
We start with an hour wait for the courtesy van. We were at a private air terminal at SAT, and supposedly the driver wasn't familiar with it. But an hour?? The real insult comes when you you're placed on hold and are forced to listen to their advertising which touts how close they are to San Antonio airport, and that their van makes it "easy-peasy" to get back and forth. 
Upon arrival I found the staff to be uber friendly (Marquel is awesome...) but even her warmth couldn't overcome the stark (hip??) look of the concrete and warehouse look of the lobby. I did not find it at all inviting. 
The rooms look to be furnished right out of an Ikea store. Cheap laminates, cheap carpet. One of my co-workers noted during dinner that upon entering his room, he felt as if he had walked into his coffin.
With the hope of enjoying a Monday Night Football game on the nice 42" flatscreen, wouldn't you know it the only HD channel that DID NOT WORK was ESPN HD? (several other HD feeds, including ESPN2, worked just fine). Darn the luck. 
Still, with hopes for a good nights rest, I adjusted the AC unit and shut out the lights. Like too many properties these days, in their zeal to be "green", the AC is on a motion detector. Several times during the night I awoke too warm only to hear the unit turn on when I stirred. So no good rest. 
Perhaps this boutiqish property appeals to some, but I hope I don't have to spend a night here in the future.

Stayed for 4 nights during a conference at the convention center. Location is optimal. Staff is friendly though some verge on obsequious which seems fake. Get a room above the 10th floor because it can get loud around the multiple lagoon like pools and hot tub. Busy when arrived and my room wasn't cleaned as well as it probably could have been. Fine for a business trip not sure about a vacation. Beds were comfy.

review_title: Nice hotel but too big for its own good.
review_text:
Stayed here a few times for business mostly due to location and the view. Really a good place but its sooo big. Service is not as great due to this. Just lots of litttle things. Parking is trouble and came back several nights to see parking full and was forced to valet. Valet is pretty bad service. My coworkers car came back without a mirror and it took three days for them to admit it was their fault. Hotel management handled this the worst I have ever seen. It was after this that my team decided to move to another hotel.
Pool is beautiful and the rooms are clean. I am platinum elite and travel all the time. I have seen much better management of hotels elsewhere.

review_title: Luxury with out paying for it.
review_text: This hotel was fabulous! It was very welcoming, clean, exciting. It is in the perfect location, you can walk pretty much any where you want to go from here. The pool area was awesome, it did get crowded because it was 4th of July weekend so you needed to get there early. The restaurants at the hotel were very good, but alittle pricy. There was a cabana restaurant/bar by the pool with fire pits and live music every night. I have nothing bad to say about our expericene here. We had a marina view it was beautiful and great for seeing the fireworks!

We stayed here for a week. Were a little reluctant because of the great deal we got. But we were delighted. Rooms clean. Location couldn't have been better. Trolley service right outside. Had a not so good experience at a red roof in Santa Fe but this one was great. Jonathan at the front desk had more customer service than I have seen in years. That's what its all about. Making the customer happy. And that they did.
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn San Antonio Downtown - Riverwalk

review_text:
Staying for my third night. First, the negatives 1. The a/c in the rooms seems to barely cool the rooms. 2. Misquitos in the room is troubling. 3. I had a package shipped to me at the hotel, I have not been able to collect the package for two days as it is being held at the business center, which has limited hours and I have been in meetings all day at another site, when I leave in the morning and return in the evening the business center is closed. 3. Everything in the hotel is absurdly overpriced, we at at the restaurant in the South Tower lobby for breakfast and it cost more than $50.00 for two, and was uninspiring. 
The positives: 1. The location has to be one of the best in SD - on the water, but easy access to gaslamp district. 2. While I did not use the pool, the pool area looks like fun.

This was a very good hotel in an excellent location with great facilities. The bars and restaurants are nice. The rooms are great and pools amazing. It is just the service was inconsistent to poor. There was always a line at the check in/out areas, the bars always closed too early (family friendly?) and some of the staff were grumpy. However, the waitresses, waiters and concierges were generally fantastic.

Really couldn't ask for any more! This hotel was within walking distance to Seaport Village, the Gaslamp District and Petco Park, which saved us a ton of time from having to park the car. Although the view of the Bay is beautiful, we had a city view and it was great as well!

En realidad el hotel se be muy Lindo pero. El problems mayor.fue en. desayuno... deverian poner puertas en. Area del desayuno para q los clientes puedan tener un buen servicio ... no hay suficiente desayuno aunq t levantes temprano....
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites San Antonio Medical Center

review_text: I would never chose to stay there but it was a work trip so my job picked it for ne due to the fact that is where the work conventionwas held. About 28$ ride from the airport in a taxi but there's a shuttle which is cheaper 19$ If i renember correctly. I think the prize for this place is something around 130-160$? Are u kidding me! I got the keys to the 3d floor ... The stench of mold in the hallway was overwhelming. The room wasn't much better- bathroom was nasty- dirty shower curtain, mold, yucky floor And toilet. I asked for a different room. I gor 2nd floor with a smoking neighbor. Bathroom was a bit better minus someone's hair in the shower. Gross! The location was good- near the mall and riverwalk. Got a fridge in the room and microwave, flat screen tv. Free breakfast which consists of waffles, fake scrambled eggs, sausage links,oranges, oatmeal, toast, bagels. Better than holiday inn. But I would never ever pay even100$ to stay there! Overpriced. Locations really the only good thing about it.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites San Antonio Convention Cntr

review_text: Despite being the conference hotel it appeared overwhelmed by the recent conference I attended. Rooms were still not made up at 4pm, towels had to be asked for, cleaning the room was reduced to making the bed. Not really satisfactory given the price. It is very conveniently located but dont stay here if you are attending a large conference. The Crockett across the road is cheaper, cleaner and has a better buffet breakfast!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites San Antonio Convention Cntr

review_title: La Quinta Inns & Suites convention Center San Antonio
review_text: Great hotel. Easy Walk to the Riverwalj without Riverwalk hotel prices. Clean comfortable rooms. Excellent service
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites San Antonio Convention Cntr

review_text: Check in was easy, everyone including maintenance staff were very friendly and helpful. Stay was very quiet and will stay here again with no hesitancy. VERY RECOMMENDED
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham San Antonio/Near SeaWorld/Lackland AFB

review_title: Horrible service- room wasn't cleaned when we tried to check in at 8pm!
review_text:
We arrived at the hotel at about 8pm... The hotel lobby was full of people and their luggage the people behind the counter said nothing to us for about 10minutes while helping other customers. When the woman behind the counter finished helping the family she said "do you have your reg card" in a nasty rude tone. We were confused and asked what he was talking about and throughout the whole interaction with us she was snippy and rude. She persisted to tell us that our room wasn't ready and wouldn't be till at least 10pm!!! When we asked why since check-in was at 3 she simply said we had people not come into work, she was completely unapologetic about the inconvenience. 
When we came back at 11 to check in again the man behind the counter was rude when we asked if we could get a credit since the room was ready 8 hours late and said "well at least you have a room" 
This hotel is filled with disgraceful employees who have no idea what customer service is. Ne
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio NW near Six Flags Fiesta Texas

review_title: This place is fairly new and staff still is learning.
review_text: Tub had a slow drain, put do not disturb sign on door and cleaning staff still came in room, garbage under bed, needs better pillows and breakfast was good.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio NW near Six Flags Fiesta Texas

review_text: I couldn't be more impressed with this hotel. For a pet friendly one, it is immaculate. Round the clock cleaning, amazing food, comfortable environment. And the service here, I could go on about for days. I've never met kinder people, so willing to answer any questions you might have. I would recommend this place to anyone visiting San Antonio.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio NW near Six Flags Fiesta Texas

review_title: ok but prices are high for what you pay for
review_text: The staff are nice but the pet friendliness is alright...there were pee stains in the second room we were moved to after our first room had a floor leak. The 3rd room was stuffy so the hotel gave us our money back and we moved to the Staybridge Inn off Stone Oak and 1604 which was so nice and clean!
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio NW near Six Flags Fiesta Texas

review_text:
The hotel is located about a 10 minute walk on the riverwalk from restaurants. The area of town is a little sketchy afte dark and I have been approached several times by panhandlers during the day. 
The rooms are showing signs of age. I was in a room for a multiple day business conference. The size of the room was nice with a king bed and nice couch. The tv was old school 32". No high def. The bathroom sink was cracked. Water pressure and temperature was not a problem. The fitness area is at least 20 yrs out of date and multiple weight training machines were not functional. 
On a positive note, the staff were very friendly and helpful. The hotel really needs some physical improvements.

review_title: Nice and clean hotel, friendly staff, good location.
review_text: The ONLY negative thing I have to say about the hotel, is that when I booked the room online, it implied the hotel was on the river and that I was renting a room with a 'riverview'. Nonetheless, there was a 'riverview' from my 8th floor balcony which was pretty far away and only a TINY stretch of the river between two buildings. Anyway, the Staff was very friendly and helpful. They had a hotel parking lot with a guard and surviellance. The pool area was very nice and clean.

review_title: Great location, good quality large hotel
review_text: We had a 5 night stay with 2 rooms on 16th floor of the North Tower with both a ( partial) harbour view and a city view. Check in late on a wednesday evening was a quiet pleasant experience, but seeing the long lines of a Thursday Friday and Saturday afternoon check in made me glad we arrived mid week. The rooms are spacious and Marriott standard which means perfectly clean and comfortable. Elevators took forever over the weekend but I suppose that's inevitable with a busy hotel. We used the DW restaurant for 2 meals and found it perfectly acceptable and reasonably priced, Starbucks in the lobby area was always busy and the free wifi in the surrounding area attracted lots of holidaymakers as well as conventioneers. The hotel wifi available in the rooms and elsewhere in the hotel is payable but I wouldn't bother as free wifi is everywhere outside of the room/hotel. The new pool area is nice although too busy over the weekend so we avoided it. Great location for the marina and city, and although trains do pass by frequently, they weren't disruptive to us on the 16 th floor. Overall a good hotel and a good sta.

The Menger is a grwat piece of history. Decorated in the era and really has an old time feel. The lobby area smells of frankenscense and cigarette smoke, but otherwise is quaint. The room is clean and looks newly renovated. The bathroom is average. Fabulous location across from the Alamo. The concierge staff is not overly friendly but get the job done. The cost was below $100, and thats a great deal!

We stayed one night here and our experience was fine. The biggest problem was the wifi didn't work in our room and we had to go into the lobby. No big deal. Drinks in the bar were very pricey but that's to be expected. The walk to all the restaurants was pretty long and the neighborhood does not appear to be the greatest but the outside patio is very nice with comfortable furniture. Next time though I think we'll stay closer to all the shops and restaurants as you'll pay about the same price. The rooms were clean and nicely furnished. No major problems.

Great hotel. Clean. Good food. Fantastic and friendly staff. Very pleasant. Only down side of hotel is outdated televisions in the rooms. No bad just not of high quality. Other than this minor issue, hotel is a 5 star!!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel San Antonio International Airport

review_text: Direct access to the riverwalk, though you do have to walk a little ways to get to the bars and restaurants.

I stayed there last Wednesday evening. When I woke there were flea droppings all over the sheets. I told the clerk upon checking out, and it was if she wasn't surprised or didn't care. 
I am a gold member and spend 4 nights a week in hotels.

review_title: Beautiful Lobby and outside but ugly rooms
review_text: The location is spectacular. The lobby exemplifies the history of the hotel and San Antonio. The staff are friendly and professsional, but in a weird way. It's like professionalism is not in their nature so their demeanor seems forceful. The price is average. The room we stayed in is run down. The bathroom has old fixtures (shower head is spritsy, the toilet is rusty, the tub is small, and the water doesn't drain well) and there's no ventilation. The pool area seems decent. Pool is a nice size 3-9 ft deep. I like the idea of it being outdoors, but enclosed, I'm not that crazy about the fake grass; having that outdoors in a wet environment invites bacteria and communicable diseases in my opinion. Valet parking is a rip off $22/day. All in all, I've experienced the Menger and downtown living, but I wouldn't do it again.

review_title: Do NOT stay here for your family vacation.
review_text: Horrible customer service and even worse resolution. When we reserved our stay we advised we were traveling with two small children and an infant, and requested adjoining rooms. On the day of arrival we made a point to contact the front desk to ensure the reservation had been noted and they were aware. Upon arrival they gave us two rooms on the same floor, however in separate wings! The first night no one slept as the five of us were in a king room. When we followed up in the morning, they ensured us it would be corrected and a refund issued for the unused room that first night. After checking with the front desk twice for our new room key, I gave them my cell number to call once the room was ready. They never called. It took interrupting our sightseeing to finally track down our new room keys. Upon check out, we made sure they refunded one room for the first night. What a disappointment Marriott! No customer service at all! We will not choose marriott for our future vacation or business trips.

review_title: Unknowledgable staff, unsecure, but the room was clean.
review_text: Unknowledgable, seemingly untrained staff. My vehicle was broken into in the parking lot. There are a total of 4 cameras in the parking lot, the entire lot was not covered by them. For the amount you pay for a room, the security should be better. The rooms were however very clean and everything was fairly new. The staff seems disenchanted by the task of giving me the number to the San Antonio police department and in fact gave me the number to the fire department. The location was great, easily accessible, but I will not stay here again solely based on lack of security.
Rooms r big! Pool area huge staff friendly! Love this place !

Unfortunately didn't see thar pets were allowed in the hotel. Housekeeping didn't do proper job cleaning room and was bit by fleas [or yuck-BEDBUGS] all night. View from room was sad, a Giant TV broadcast antenna.
 If I had slept better, I would probably return. Also parking Not free.

A very good experience overall. I chose it based on location/price/other reviews. After 2 nights, I couldn't sleep due to noisy neighbours in adjoining room. The desk clerk was extremely courteous and helpful in giving me another room, which turned out to be very peaceful, though overlooking the Plaza. During the move I left behind a favourite skirt. Didn't miss it until packing a few days later. Another desk clerk was helpful, but it was late Sat night, and couldn't retrieve it. Next morning a 6.30, the Loss Prevention man was very helpful and I was reunited with my missing skirt. I would only question the hotel's guest database as I was there for 3 more days after the skirt was left behind.

review_text: Horrible customer service and even worse resolution. When we reserved our stay we advised we were traveling with two small children and an infant, and requested adjoining rooms. On the day of arrival we made a point to contact the front desk to ensure the reservation had been noted and they were aware. Upon arrival they gave us two rooms on the same floor, however in separate wings! The first night no one slept as the five of us were in a king room. When we followed up in the morning, they ensured us it would be corrected and a refund issued for the unused room that first night. After checking with the front desk twice for our new room key, I gave them my cell number to call once the room was ready. They never called.
