What a disappointment Marriott! No customer service at all! We will not choose marriott for our future vacation or business trips.

review_title: Bugs in the rooms! Shoes missing, but the rooms are pretty!
review_text: I'm @ the hotel now, I have been here for 12 nights on business. Just noticed a pair of my shoes are missing! The hotel staff is not able to offer any help because their is no manager on duty. This is not the first problem I had during my stay. I had a bug problem also, as did my co-worker who is also staying here. The rooms are pretty but for the price, I feel like their are better options on the riverwalk. This hotel is on the "dead" end of the sidewalk.

This is a excellent hotel!! We loved it here! The lady in the front desk is kind of rude though. But the other staff is extremely super nice! I wish the had a bath instead of just a stand alone shower for my 2 yr old but it did. The rooms are extremely clean, the hotel areas are clean. Everything is just nice! My husband and I forgot out iPhone charges and they have a charger/ iPod radio in the room! I was so surprised! I definitely recommend this hotel. We are from Dallas and were here on vacation to take our kids to Sea World! When we come back we will come here!

A very good experience overall. I chose it based on location/price/other reviews. After 2 nights, I couldn't sleep due to noisy neighbours in adjoining room. The desk clerk was extremely courteous and helpful in giving me another room, which turned out to be very peaceful, though overlooking the Plaza. During the move I left behind a favourite skirt. Didn't miss it until packing a few days later. Another desk clerk was helpful, but it was late Sat night, and couldn't retrieve it. Next morning a 6.30, the Loss Prevention man was very helpful and I was reunited with my missing skirt. I would only question the hotel's guest database as I was there for 3 more days after the skirt was left behind.

review_title: Nice stay, could have been better
review_text: Very clean room but needs a few more amenities i.e. refrigerator. The staff was helpful with any need and we would probably stay here again.

My family and I had a great stay at The Menger. The service was excellent with the exception of an older man that sat at the lobby under "public relations" sign. Officer Lerma went out of his way to provide help upon arriving. Lerma was couteous and resourceful not like the old man that sat in the lobby very unapproachable with an attitude when addressing him. Thank goodness for Officer Lerma. A second person that should be recognized is Mr. Torres. He knew what to do when another clerk was having trouble with my check in. Soon after my check in,during my stay, Torres made me and my family seem like we had a personal attendant and went beyond my expectation. We didnt feel like a room number. The location was great. Just as expected. The rooms were clean and quiet. Roomservice responded within minutes. The pool was great, clean and stocked with towels and emergency gear. Parking, yes, does cost but for the location, try walking after maybe finding a space near the hotel. The valet attendants were courteous and prompt. I don't remember having to wait for my vehicle. This hotel is at "The Best" location in town. The only dissapointment for my kids were the lack of ghosts that are said to haunt this hotel. Overall thanx to the staff members, location, price, and room service we will return to this hotel. It was recomended by a co worker after telling him him i was picky. I highly recomend this historic hotel. We had a great stay.

review_title: Not a pleasant stay this time
review_text: Stayed on the night august 12th and didn't get her name but she was the only blond one there. She was extremely rude! We were a young crowd who just came from the river and were tired so we were dressed down a bit ans she just seemed annoyed by us being there. Our room smelled like urine and the carpet was dirty and sticky. We stay here all the time and loved it every time except this one.

I booked this room to visit my husband while he was stationed at Fort Sam Houston. With neither if us knowing the area, I booked the decently priced Best Western near him. When I arrived I found it to be on a busy street, with a couple of fast food locations near by. I was a little nervous to see the inside based on the out side surroundings. But it was wonderful. The room was well taken care of, way beyond my expectations for the price. I dslr safe and welcomed inside the hotel. We never ate the breakfast, never got up in time, but Cracker Barrel was right behind us. I suggest making sure you bring a gps, as the area can be hard to navigate. 
I would stay at the Windsor Pointe location again.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Windsor Pointe Hotel & Suites

review_text: We had a pleasent experience and recommend this hotel.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Windsor Pointe Hotel & Suites

review_text: Estuve en este hotel dos noches, puedes caminar al riverwalk 5 minutos, , tiene una parada de river taxi en el hotel $5 una Ida y $15 dolares 24 horas. El hotel esta bueno, tiene desayuno buffet Los fines de semana, una barra en el lobby, en el tercer piso esta el gym Es 24 horas, piscinas y jacuzzi. Lo recomiendo.

New property, friendly staff, close to Seaworld, the hot tub was filthy and out of order, very small pool. 
I would stay here again
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Antonio SeaWorld/Lackland

review_title: The rooms are too expensive to not be fully furnished.
review_text: I had a double queen room. There was a very compact fridge and no microwave in the room. For the price I paid I expected a little more luxury. You also have to pay for breakfast, nothing free there
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Antonio SeaWorld/Lackland

review_text:
Purtroppo uno viene negli Usa e da quello che hai visto nel sito ti aspetti quello che hai prenotato. Paradise tanta forma, ma scarsi argomenti, intanto stanze sporche (c'e l hanno anche cambiata...) servizio modesto. Bella l ambientazione non v e' dubbio, tanto verde ben curato (cartacce spesso per terra...), ma complessivamente il rapporto costo servizio e' nettamente negativo.
Decisamente da sconsigliare !
Very clean, very friendly, room service was good, nice pool.....will stay again!!

My bed is super comfortable. I have a great view from both of my windows! Everything is so neat and organized! The pool is great. They gave us free milk and cookies. I love this hotel and so will you!

Purchased on Hotwire as a 3 star which this place is not. "Business Center" is a computer and restaurant is a mediocre breakfast you serve yourselves. Place smells of heavy chemical use. Windows are extremely thin even though it's next to a highway. Outside side door stays open which is a safety risk. Feels very cheap all around Had to request a rebooking because of safety issue with door latch not being fixed. Expect a quality inn experience which happens to be next door.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites San Antonio Northwest

review_title: Good location, nice rooms. Would recommend just until the newness wears off. Then it will be just average.
review_text: The hotel is good. The location is good due to being close to downtown without the price. Close to the river walk. I would recommend the stay here for maybe the next year. After the newness wears off I could see the hotel not being that great. Every time we walked in, the lobby is tiny and there was never any one there to greet us. We always had to ring the bell and wait. There was an odd smell in the lobby but it's ok once you get out of the lobby. There is no elevator so they direct you to take the stairs to the second floor. They tell you the front door will be locked at ten, but when you come in after that to use the back door. The rooms are decorated very nicely, very cute. Best part of the hotel. The ac worked great. Beds were comfy. We drove a block down and parked in a parking garage and walked right on to the river walk. We did the tour which you have to walk about ten minutes to buy tickets to. $8 for a thirty minute tour. It was worth it. Headed to sea world tomorrow. Over all I would recommend this hotel if your looking for a good price for a hotel right by the river walk. We paid $67 per night. Very worth it. Again, after the newness wears off, not sure how it will be then. They keep the hotel very warm too. Hardly any breakfast. There's water and chips for sale for .75 by the desk.

What a treat for teachers and their families. I booked a Teacher Appreciation Package through the hotel's website and was so pleased with everything offered. I would have given five stars for everything if there hadn't been a hiccup at check-in. The room was almost perfect (a sippy cup had been left on the floor from the previous tenant.) My children loved the pool area which came stocked with noodles and balls to play with. I loved the quiet of the room and the comfort of the bed. Breakfast was wonderful in the hotel's restaurant. Thank you Omni for the allowing this teacher's family a chance at staying in a hotel we normally wouldn't have thought we could afford...but will definitely check into again.

We wanted a place close to Lackland AFB. The Holiday Inn Express that is closer is not in a very good nieghborhood and the Staybridge(also a Marriott property) had too many small children because some of their suites sleep six and is close to Seaworld. We stayed there one night and hardley slept because of the screaming,running children and some one buffed the floors in the entry at 1:00am. Courtyard is one exit north and quieter. Nicer cleaner rooms. A bit older and no comp. Breakfast but slept all night and a beer and wine bar in the evenings. Also the pool and hot tub were nit full of too many small kids. Close to many restaurants and a movie theater. 10 min. To Lackland
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Antonio SeaWorld/Lackland

review_title: Wonderful hotel and excellent staff and facilities.
review_text: This was my first stay at this hotel and this will definitely be one that we frequent when we travel to San Antonio. My wife and I celebrated our one year anniversary here. I had called in advance to see if we could add any amenities and surprised my wife with gorgveous red roses, bottle of champagne, chocholate covered strawberries and last but not least rose petals on bed with single red rose too! Great and relaxing facilities with excellent staff. Absolutely loved this place!!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Antonio SeaWorld/Lackland

review_text: We visit San Antonio at the end of each summer for an easy vacation before school starts. The separate bedroom and pullout sofa makes it ideal for families. Hotel is very clean and the pool is well maintained. If you are going to Fiesta Texas then you should strongly consider this hotel.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Antonio Northwest

review_text:
I stayed at the Hyatt Place San Antonio/Riverwalk for a business convention. The Convention Center is walking distance, as are all of the restaurants on the Riverwalk. 
Inside, the hotel could be any Hyatt Place across the country. They do a great job with consistency in their brand. The rooms are large and clean, and the facilities are great.
My only complaint here, and it's minor is the location. Though it is close to where you want to go, it's in an area that some people might not feel comfortable walking around at night. I don't think it's unsafe, just older and not that nice. Walk three blocks though, and you're on the riverwalk... so not really a big deal.

review_title: Good value if you get a deal
review_text:
This hotel is identical to every other Hyatt Plae I've stayed at. Service personnel extremely helpful and positive. Seven to ten minute walk along the Riverwalk to the main area. Walkway between the downtown hotels and restaurants to this hotel is extremely quiet and isolated at night. However, if you can get a deal here it could be a good value.
As with Hyatt Places, the rooms are large and clean, though the bathrooms tiny. In addition, while breakfasts are free, offering could be improved upon. The big perks...free wi-fi and free parking.

This location is under construction so there was some noise but we weren't there most of the time so it didn't matter much. This location was very expensive so we were expecting something a bit fancier but it was an average hyatt place. You are paying for the location. 
The breakfast was all cold items except for some gluey oatmeal. Not good. Coffee was so burned we couldn't drink it. 
All in all, if being on the riverwalk isn't important I would advise staying at a different location. The othr hyatt place locations in town were much cheaper.

review_title: It's noisy, dirty, and the staff goes back on their word.
review_text:
I came in town for a marathon and was told I could have a late check-out and when I got there, their story changed and I had to be out by Noon at the latest. I managed to negotiate 1 pm with the manager after putting up a fight. 
Other issues:
Bathtub too big for bathroom. It was poking through the walls. 
Window sills not clean. There were bugs all over them. 
Very noisy. I was up every hour due to the street noise or maids in the hallway speaking Spanish to each other.

review_text: The rooms were very spacious and clean. Really appdeciated a shower head I didn't have to duck and use when I'm only 5' 9". Only suggestion would be for an expanded breakfast selection along with more food selections like sister hotel embassy suites provides.

review_text:

Wish there was more variety at the 5pm buffet, but for extras it was ok.

review_text: Our family of 4 stayed 2 nights to go to Fiesta Texas. The hotel was close to the park and had many restaurants close by. Staff was kind and helpful. Staff worked hard to keep the hotel clean with many kids enjoying the amenities. we would stay here again.

review_title: Not my choice, away from Riverwalk.
review_text:
My Agency chose this hotel for a course that I attended. 
The bathtub was stained and patched with caulking all over. housekeeping missed the room one day. Had to request bath soap and toilet paper because staff did not replenish during the day.
Hotel is a 10 minute walk from the Riverwalk. Area close to hotel gets dark at night, unsafe to walk.
Hotel parking charges $23 per night. No open parking nearby. 
Internet in the rooms is $12.95 per day but free at the lobby. Business center is OK.
Room did not have microwave oven or fridge.
No complimentary snacks or breakfast.
Gym facility was good, however, they did not carry the earphones thar they were offerinng whwn using the machines.
If I were to choose, I would hace selected the Residence Inn.
Great hotel, really cool pool area. I agree with the other reviews that there are a lot of extra expenses like parking and wifi but despite that I would definitely stay here again.

As I write this, we are still staying at the Crockett hotel having slept here two nights and have two more nights to go. 
I read all of the reviews before I stayed here making sure that I knew what was in store for me and my husband. 
We arrived around 2am on Saturday morning, obviously tired and ready to sleep. Despite making my reservation through an already paid in full website, the front desk clerk was quite accomidating. I asked that we be put in a room not near any children or loud people. Well he definitley came through with that. Not to mention the amazing view of The Alamo from our room window. 
The rooms are small as you may have already read, but of you are a couple this should really not effect your stay, aside from that look at the year the hotel was originally built and remember that you probably did not come to downtown SA to stay in the hotel room the whole time. 
The bed is comfortable, the bathtub has been repainted with bathtub refinisher and is showing signs that it really should just be replaced, the toilets are new, and the room is clean. I think where they could save some space would be getting rid of the armoire and older television and switching to flat panels. Also, if you enjoy having a darkened room, you might not like the fact that the room has custom wood plantation blinds. Also the fan is loud enough to drown out any excessive noise from people walking outside. But all in all for getting a deal of $57 a night, not bad at all. 
The pool is very small and is not heated which is dissapointing since we happen to be here on a weekend that is cooler than normal (upper 50's lower 60's). 
The breakfast is sort of sad. It's the typical make your own waffles, scrambled eggs, Danishes, and bagels. It's definitley nothing to write home about, but if you are watching your pennies or if you have kids, this might be OK. I just feel that more could be done here. 
Like I said, for the price it isn't bad, for the location it's great. We walked on the Riverwalk last night and that is where the expensive hotels are, but that is also where the loud and obnoxious people and a ton of traffic is to, I'd rather have the quiet. 
And one last thing, since the website for the hotel does not explain this, and I found it on another review, parking is $20 a day. Unless you plan on driving outside of the main Riverwalk area, don't bother renting a car, you don't need it. Take a shuttle or a taxi and then use one of the several trolleys or the double decker bus if you have a hard time walking. We walked everywhere, and we normal don't walk anywhere. We saved $150 doing this.

Location to the riverwalk was great but kinda seedy the other direction. Fading but clean historic hotel. This is your typical very noisy old hotel. Loud slamming doors. Very very little insulation between rooms. Bed not comfy. Small tv. Tiny bathroom but clean. Plaster coming off wall near air vent.. Hotel needs some upkeep to keep charging such a high rate. Beautiful at Christmas.
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

review_title: 30 dollar parking... sorry didn't realize this was new York city.
review_text: No choice for parking but 25-30 dollar options. Terrible customer service... hotel mostly empty but wouldn't move my wife and me to a single king size versus two queens on our anniversary! Rewards member who's always at Marriots for business but will never stay here again.
Stayed one night here midweek. Room was clean, spacious, and comfortable. Within walking distance of many area attractions. Staff was friendly and accommodating.
Nice hotel for a family. It was quiet and clean. It is a beautiful historic hotel. We walked everywhere with no problems.
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

review_title: Historical hotel near the river walk and Alamo
review_text: Historic hotel within easy walking distance of the Alamo and the Riverwalk area. Grand lobby with pictures of the rich and famous who have stayed at the hotel in the past. I had a room over looking the park which was decent sized and had a comfortable king sized bed. The tv was older but I didn't travel to Texas to watch tv. Elevators and hallways also showed signs of wear and tear. Overall a good value for money, great location, helpful staff and decent rooms. If you are looking for perfection it won't be found here but if you can overlook a few imperfections and appreciate some of the architecture and history this is a good option.
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

review_title: Great location, next to Alamo and close to the Riverwalk
review_text: We were there two nights and got a good room overlooking the Alamo...might have been upgraded as arrived early and designated room not available. Complimentary breakfast not great and all throw away plastic...even though we were asked to recycle everything into different bins in the room. Good base for exploring and would definitely stay again.

review_title: Beautiful Hotel in a perfect location!
review_text: Stayed in the large and beautiful Jersig Suite. We had great views, wonderful service, an easy walk downtown, and could not have asked for a better stay on our honeymoon! Thanks Crockett!

I have never experience such bad service as I did in this hotel. First when we arrived the room was not ready, then they gave me the wrong room,when we finally got the room as I enter that room I notice the carpet being really dirty, the linen on the bed was dirty, as I enter the restroom the mirror had water stains everywhere, there were hair on the floor, the shower curtain was dirty and I can go on and on but the thing is that I mention this to the housekeeper crystal when she came to check the room after it has been clean, she said that she would make sure the room was clean next time, but the next day the room was dirty again. Then when I inform front desk nothing was done. The noise that come from the hall every time someone is getting ice. Never the less my experience in the hotel was awful.

review_title: Yet Another Wonderful Stay at the Crockett!
review_text: We stayed here a couple of years ago for a quick weekend trip & enjoyed it. We just returned today from our second stay, a 4 night mini-vacation from Houston. I can not think of ONE bad thing to say about this hotel! We arrived early, & a room was ready for us. When we asked about an upgrade, we had already been given one (queen standard to a king)! Eduardo, who checked us in, remembered us by name throughout our stay... Room was large, bed comfy, bath spotless! Our windows were on the interior, overlooking the lobby, so that was a bit different- not bad, just different. Lights & AC noise did not bother us as some have said. We also had a HUGE closet, which was great, as we could spread our clothes out comfortably. Breakfast was pretty standard, but a nice (free!) perk. Valet parking was good, no problems- yes, you pay, but...you would pay for parking anywhere around this location! One morning they were very busy, so we just asked for the keys- they totally understood, & we were out in 5 minutes. The pool area was perfect- a great way to relax for a bit before heading out to dinner. Never crowded, always shaded, & towels provided quickly if you had to request them. The bar, Ernie's, has limited hours, but again is a great place to relax & have a drink either before or after dinner. The young gentleman bartending is very entertaining, has lots of stories to tell if you let him... As I said before, I can't really think of a complaint to share! The Crockett is officially our "go to" hotel in San Antonio, & I would recommend it to any of my friends!!!

Stayed with family of four in a king-size suite - toddlers slept on the couch bed for about 3 hour of 3 night stay. I would consider this hotel good for the money. It is at least a half-hour away from Seaworld and the Riverwalk. The bathtub did not drain, and the room decor left a lot to be desired. However, it was very clean and the breakfast selection was good. Ryan, one of the hotel attendants, was very personable and helpful.

review_title: You get what you pay for
review_text: The room was clean, no view. The elevator is tiny, but works. Staff was helpful. Breakfast was limited ( plan on a Belgium waffle shaped as Texas. Pool is in a strange location, not a leisurely experience. Don't book for the pool.

review_title: Great hotel to stay in if you are visiting Lackland Air Force Base and downtown San Antonio.
review_text: We stayed at the Best Western Atrea the end of Nov. 2011. The hotel is pretty new. It is very clean, and the rooms were spacious, and modern. The staff was polite and helpful. I had a package delivered there the day before I arrived and they called me when they received it. We were looking for a hotel near Lackland Airforce Base, as my son was graduating. This hotel is VERY convenient to the base. It was only a little only a mile from the Valley High gate which is the only gate that is open 24 hours, and close to the sqaudrons. They also have an indoor pool which is a plus. I was very happy with my stay at this hotel. There were other hotels fairly close to this one, and were a little lower priced, but I spoke to various people that were not as happy with their accomodations. just an FYI. In the ammenities it states there is a lounge on site, and this is true. But, it is open limited hours on select days. The hotel is within a 15 minute drive of downtown. Make sure you take a navigation device though. Getting around San Antonio can be a little challenging.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Atrea Hotel & Suites

review_title: Best service for a hotel in this category we have ever experienced.
review_text: From check in to drive out the staff at Drurt Inn and Suies Riverwalk in San Antonio was one of the friendliest and most helpful we have experienced. It is a few blocks from the Alamo and Rivercenter, but the elevator takes you right to the Riverwalk. The breakfast was a real breakfast. The 5:30 Kickback offers you three free drinks of any sort (if you're in the mood for conversation, people become amazingly friendly) and a rather strange but filling jumble of nibbles. I highly recommend this hotel

Though it's at a farther end of the riverwalk, it is right on the river which is fabulous. It's also within blocks of The Alamo & La Villita-also a huge plus.
We got a two room suite for 3 women on a girlfriend getaway, the room was spacious and clean and nicely decorated. 
The BIG negative, parking. Ridiculously expensive, over $15 dollars a day and it's self park not even valet. The biggest problem with this is that the entrance to the lot is a small alleyway basically and of course the side door to checkv in is there so people park all haphazardly, blocking the drive making it impassable for people who have already checked in to get through. There's a security guard out there but they don't direct anything. 
The spaces in the lot itself are big enough for a smart car so there are all these empty spaces between cars that no one parks in because even if your car fits you can't get out of it!
All in all it's a good place to stay, they just need to hire some Valets!

The Drury Inn is located at the famous Riverwalk. This is truly a wonderful place for strolling and taking a boattour. The hotel has pleasant rooms and a nice atmosphere. Breakfast is complimentary as well as free drinks and food in the afternoon. The food however is of poor quality, the drinks (3 per person) are netter, including wine and cocktails. From the hotel you can walk easily to historic spots such as the Alamo. There is also a good mall, the Riverside Mall.
Al lado, del rio, y un paso de todo lo que hay que ver en la ciudad.Desayuno muy completo, habitaciones espaciosas,servicio super atento.

review_title: Ok, would choose somewhere else next time.

So many hotels to choose from, I would never go back to this one. Close to everything , but so are tons of other places.

The whole hotel is very clean and well maintained, the service efficient and friendly. Enjoyed it tremendously.

review_title: 1909 Wyndham historic hotel... Right by Alamo and riverwalk...
review_text: Amazing stay! The hotel looks awesome for a 1909 hotel. Grace Kelly once stayed here with the Prince. They have done a nice job with the renovations. Could have more outlets for our phone chargers... parking is crazy expensive to park at hotel.. so if u r pinching pennies.. there is a great spot next to st johns church for $8 or public garage for $12... They have large pool on top if hotel... Great location very clean would stay here again..
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

review_text: My husband had a quick business trip to San Antonio this Labor Day weekend. Again, the valet and hotel staff service was par to none. Our room overlooked the river. It was clean and quiet. We have stayed here twice and will do so again! So far the Marriott hotel chain has definitely lived up to our standards when traveling.

What a wonderful place for that special getaway. Rooms with riverwalk views are the perfect thing for treating that special person in your life to a great stay. Convenient location to the beautiful riverwalk,the Alamo and close to many great eateries and bars. Id highly recommend their Sunday brunch, take your time to sit relax eat and drink your Sunday away. High end in price but well worth every penny

This hotel was terrible! Not the relaxing experience one hopes for when on vacation. The management tries to blame the tiny bathrooms and dingy decor on keeping "historical charm." I'm not buying it unless their idea of "historical" is a 70s motel. I've stayed in many historic hotels that never his behind their status as an excuse to put guests in dark, crowded rooms with heavy, industrial metal doors to the balcony. Breakfast was convenient, but the tables were dirty, sticky and neglected. Pool was decent, but when we were there some trade high school was having a trip so a huge number of pushy teenagers was hogging the water and screaming. Same teenagers ran down the halls on our floor shrieking. Called desk and asked for manager. Was told no manager was there at that time. (always on duty, hmm?) Front desk told us there were a lot of people from that group, and only three of us, so it shouldn't come as a shock to us that they were going to prioritize the needs of the school group over ours. And, you know, everyone else on our floor or that wanted to use the pool.

I loved this hotel! The room was huge! We got a superior queen with two beds. We had two bathrooms which was extremely helpful since we also had out two kids. The pool on the roof was great! The bar has happy hour 5-7. The margarita's wernt that good, buy for $3 you can't complain. I will be staying in this hotel again.
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

review_title: Old hotel near Riverwalk. Great value!
review_text: I stayed at the Wyndham in Easter weekend while attending a conference held around the corner at the Hyatt. I love the charm of an older hotel so the Wyndham was right up my alley. The lobby is gorgeous! My room was fine. Some of the fixtures were a little haggard, but the room was spacious and the bed comfortable. I loved the older style bathroom fixtures but if you are a clean freak you may mistake the age for uncleanliness. My one real complaint is that the doors adjoining rooms are regular doors and let in a lot of noise from your neighbor.
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

review_title: Great value with an excellent location
review_text: Hotel is two blocks from the riverwalk and just a few blocks from the Alamo. Beautiful scenery and very comfortable beds! Parking is a little expensive ($19/day) but in a secure lot right across the street. Only disappointment was a very small pool and no hot tub. Would definately stay there again.
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

Overpriced food, snacks and valet which is nearly non existant on weekends forcing guests and visitors to park in public garages blocks away.

I remember this place from back in the day as a child. Very nice with classic feel and look. But that's about it. The rooms have a dated feel, small and with only a few pulgs for your electronics. The service was good, nice pool but on the small side. Overall it's a nice place but I remember it much nicer and prestigious as a child. You can find a better place for your money elsewhere.

review_title: Hip hotel with great fast free wifi. You need more?
review_text: Amazing location downtown. Very fast (how unusual!) free wifi. Hip hotel. Great staff.

review_title: Beautiful Lobby & lounge, but not so beautiful rooms!
review_text:
The hotel is a beautiful grand looking old hotel with the 1909 feel (its year of establishment). The lobby, ballrooms & lounges make you feel as if you're on the set of "Titanic" movie or somewhat to that effect. It really is gorgeous if you like that sort of character (which I appreciate). HOWEVER, upon making your way to your room, you then feel as if you've been transported from "Titanic" to "The Shining". Its hallways are dim & creepy looking. Then you open your room that has a doorbell on it & you realize the antique look is not that charming after all. There's a difference between these old hotels that are "restored" to capture their former beauty & then there is the St Anthonys where everything has been "maintained" as much as possible. 
Our room was extremely small; the bed & furniture took up the entire room. The furniture which was pretty @ one point; but all the handles on the drawers were missing or falling off. The bathroom was beyond small & very old. (I had to ask for a plug for the tub so I could take a bath). The structure reminded you of an old hospital room that was turned into an old hotel room. The food from room service was terrible. Housekeeping did Not refill the coffee/sugar or soap/shampoo when they cleaned up!! if it is something that is being used, you think it would be replenished. We had our 3 year old with us & its not what you'd call a kid friendly hotel.
Now I booked the room from Priceline for $55 a night so I guess I got what I paid for. I somehow did enjoy my stay; it wasn't a roach motel or anything; it was just old & small. I would have been upset if I had paid the normal $103-225 prices. Maybe the larger rooms were bigger & more updated. I enjoyed walking around the lobby & lounge area immensely. The hotel staff was very friendly & helpful when asked for assistance. 
The hotel is surrounded by an area where there is a lot of homeless & we got a lot of people asking for $ but it happens.
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

review_text: I checked into the hotel today staying for a total of 4 nights, but I will be checking out in the AM. The room is a corner room with a balcony to no where. I politely called the front desk to see if they could accommodate their guest with a better room and was told they didn't have anything availabe. You mean to tell me this big hotel can't accommodate guest staying more than 3 nights. I will check into a better hotel that can accommodate my request. Hotel was recommended by a previous guest who obviously had a room with three balconies overlooking the Riverwalk at the same rate and I can't even get one balcony overlooking the riverwalk.

review_title: Couldn't ask for a better stay
review_text: Offers military discount. Great price. Convenient location. Extraordinary service. Beautifully decorated.

review_title: Great location, good value, poor restaurant
review_text:
It's located a couple of blocks from the train station and within walking distance of the Gaslamp district, the marina, Little Italy and the fabulous SD trolley and bus service. Good value for what you pay (used Travelzoo to get best rate) and Diane at the front desk was wonderful in suggesting a good restaurant that could accommodate my dietary needs. The hotel restaurant left much to be desired, but her recommendation to go to the Karl Strauss 2 blocks away, even phoning them to confirm turned an otherwise disappointing experience into a memorable one. Thank you Diane. Great service!
P.S. The beds are amazing!

Stayed only one night here, visiting San Antonio for the weekend while in Houston for business. Great location you can't be any nearer the riverwalk action! Room a good size, loved the exposed brick wall. Bed super comfortable. Hotel pool was great to relax in a with a cold beer after sight-seeing on foot round San Antonio. 
We used the hotels valet parking service... Made life super easy... Hotel very easy to find... Even for a couple of very non locals!
Wonderful place, great staff, lovely courtyard, beautiful riverwalk views!!! Would recommend it to anyone.

review_title: Very elegant, clean, and efficient way to travel.
review_text: I thought everything was GREAT, EXCEPT for the girl at the front desk when we checked in.... She was NOT helpful at all, had a bit of an attitude, and have an overall aura of either, apathy or superiority. Either one, she was not very pleasant at all. And it was NOT the welcoming two people who just drove a good 3 hours at night (we checked in at 10pm) should have received. I work in customer service and this girl definitely needed some work.... Maybe you can figure out who she was? I can't remember the name tag BUT she was about 5'9", dark hair, pale complexion, and worked the night shift of December 14th, 2011 (my girlfriend's, who was present at the time, birthday). Thank you.

review_title: If I could rate them higher than a 5 I would!
review_text: Absolutely perfect! Excellent service, wonderful clean room, upgraded to river view for no apparent reason, ideal location. Would love to go back again!

We hold this hotel close to our heart after getting married here in 2009. If you're looking for a bright and airy hotel, this isn't it. It's contemporary style lends a dark, warm and cozy feel. Must pay a visit to the courtyard. Only thing is that fountain is not always on which is disappointing. Citrus has a phenomenal chef, Jeff Balfour. V- Bar is pretty but crowd and music can get a little rough. Recommend going early to beat this.

Outward appearance-fine, character & the appearance of charm-sure, comfort and rest-not a chance. Stay anywhere but here. 1. Someone's socks/razor left in the room. 2. Non-smoking room smelled of cigarettes. 3. Bed squeaked LOUDLY every time I moved, kept waking me up. 4. One post of four poster bed broken and wobbled. 5. TV remote not working properly. 6. I had work on the morning of checkout so my husband was planning to stay in the room until noon checkout. He was repeatedly harassed by phone from 10:15 onward to check out of the room so they could "fix" the bed. He finally got sick of them calling literally every 5 minutes and left at 11:00 feeling forced out the door. 7. Parking $19 or $24. The $9 parking quoted to me when I made the reservation is for the day only. (not a huge issue, just an FYI if you're seriously considering it). When I complained the only relief I was offered was for someone to come to the room to spray a room deodorizer. I've stayed in everything from hostels to five star depending on the purpose of the trip. I have a list of places I love in all categories and places I wouldn't ever stay in again. This one is on my NEVER AGAIN list. I didn't have unreasonable expectations, just a normal amount of comfort and courtesy for the price I was paying. I didn't find it here!!!
hotel_name: The St. Anthony Riverwalk, A Wyndham Hotel

review_text: Residence Inn are now my hotel if choice when I am looking for a large family suite and don't require other hotel amenities. Each if the residence inn I have stayed at have exceeded my expectations and the rooms are excellent value. You feel like you are getting great deal. This property is in an excellent location, quiet, no traffic noise, near to the parks and malls. The staff as always are happy and helpful. The one bedroom suite is well laid out and te furniture and linens are nice and the rooms and property are clean, safe and secure. I will most certainly be back and will recommend to all my friends! Thanks!!!
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Antonio Six Flags at The RIM

review_text: Very nice building, chic atmosphere, only area of improvement would be they staff's personal touch. Service was very good, but very business like, not quite the "go-above-and-beyond" attitude I have found in hotels of the same class/price range. But overall a nice stay.

The first floor including the front desk area was a construction zone. The front desk was on fold up tables. I felt overcharged for the $32 cost of parking. Because of the shape of the building the rooms are oddly shaped. The tv was about 15' from the foot of the bed. Room was very clean and they had Starbucks coffee in the room. Short walk to the harbor and gaslamp district.

This is a great hotel!! Its located in the rim with so many dining and shopping options. The palladium imax is also just right there!!! The absolute best part of this hotel is the breakfast! The best breakfast I've ever seen at a hotel EVER!!! Everything you could image they had for breakfast! Will for sure stay here again!!!
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Antonio Six Flags at The RIM

review_title: Great location, Good Room. A bit overpriced however.
review_text:
My wife and I are ere for two nights, staying in a river view room. Here's the breakdown: 
The good stuff: 
The location is on point. Right by the main hustle and bustle of it all, but still pleasantly quiet. The rooms are clean, a bit old, but clean nonetheless. Great balcony view of the Riverwalk with all the people and bands and such. No worries, things shut down around 11 and the quiet takes over. Good location and a nice staff for sure. These guys care, but to be honest, hood service only gets you so far.
The bad: Its older, smaller, and over priced. Got to room at 5:30pm to open the door and find a maid hanging out in the dark, surprised her, then she left. Doubt this will happen to you, just had to mention that... The place is older, the rooms/bathrooms are very small, and the balconies are shared with other rooms. Valet is $32 per day. 
Tips: I've stayed in San Antonio many times at the major hotels here. For the price, I'd stay somewhere else that has a better value (ex. free breakfast, bigger rooms, cheaper valet, newer more modern accommodations). Try Contessa, Valencia, even Drury plaza (great value). This place has older, less modern accommodations that just fell short for me considering the price. Won't be staying here again simply because j can pay less and get more somewhere else. You can park across the street for $9 each time you exit.

review_title: Clean,great location,hotel contemporary but atmosphere very dark ,valet parking $29/night and beds uncomfortable
review_text: Clean,great location,hotel contemporary but atmosphere very dark ,valet parking $29/night and beds uncomfortable.
Outstanding service and courteous staff. Great and prompt room service. Delicious food. Will stay there again.

I am not sure if we could have found a better hotel for our vacation! Everything about the Omni la mansion exceeded our expectations in every way. The service was great, location was perfect directly on the riverwalk, and certainly the cleanest. We haven't had to move our vehicle once, were able to walk to everything.

We have been staying at Hotel Valencia on the Riverwalk for for our weekend getaways for about 3 years now, and we just can't stay anywhere else!! The service is fantastic and the rooms are amazing! If you look at the website they almost always have special offers. And if you enroll in their VVIP program they will always leave a complimentary gift upon your arrival! The past few times ours has been two beers on ice which is great!!! They also have a really nice bar and restaurant! I highly recommend-- you won't be disappointed!!

review_title: Nice hotel but needs a pool
review_text: Everything was nice about the hotel except it did not have a pool. It was extremely hot and a pool would have been nice.

I stayed here for 4 nights with my husband. The pictures were amazing and I was super excited! I've never traveled and never been to san Antonio. When we got there the valet guys were great. The guy who helped with our luggage was awesome and the girl who checked us in was so sweet. Everybody was really welcoming. The room was so cool and very different than other hotels. My husband purchased some romantic package with our stay and the staff really made everything magical. The restaurant is AMAZING! The bar was fun and happening. The same girl at the front desk always seemed to be there when we looked. Chelsie was very helpful. I definitely recommend making friends with this girl bc even if she can't answer your question, she knows where to direct you. We definitely got the most out of this stay. It's so relaxing with the courtyard and balcony. If you want to see the river get a lower room on the river. Just a heads up, there's no pool but there's so much more to do. You can go to the pool at home so I didn't mind at all.

Great location, walk out the bar onto the riverwalk. Room was spacious, nice little balcony on the courtyard, but with only one chair, not a place to sit and social. Loved the room itself. Service was very nice. Only knocks, valet parking was a bit expensive, would have been better if I used the in/out whenever feature but I literally just parked my car for the night. Lobby's a bit dark, and the service desk was located on the second floor, had to hunt for it. And I found a jelly bean and plastic utensils right under the edge of my bed. Thought it was a bug. But the personnel were exceedingly nice and I loved the close access to the riverwalk. I'd stay again in a heartbeat!

Hotel Valencia, WOW words cannot Express how Impressed my boyfriend and I was from the time we arrived to the time we departed from your hotel. The entire staff was friendly, professional, and very accommodating. There was such a great ambiance about the entire hotel I would definitely recommend it as a Romantic Getaway. Yes, we have made future plans to return soon.

Great price offered. Now I know why. We haven't been able to sleep since 4am. Very annoying noise and when we called the front desk to complain they said it would soon stop. "Construction from a nearby restaurant" finally stops at 7am. Apparently the hotel staff is surprised that we have the audacity to want to sleep in the hotel room. Love the hotel, but don't stay on the street side. Ask for only courtyard.

I stayed here for a conference overnight in october. I walked to gaslamp one night and little italy the second night. The food at the hotel was really good and the staff were very friendly. I was able to check in early and have a late checkout. I was very pleased overall!

review_title: An oasis in the middle of a busy tourist area.
review_text:
It felt like home. Families come back here every year...and I know why.
Rooms are like private homes. Everything you need except food. And they have a program to deliver that too. But there's an heb grocery & walmart not far, so I recommend them first.
Quiet, a lazy river w/ movie nights & cone anytime cabanas at no charge scattered throughout the river. Indoor/out door pool w/waterslides at both. Your chikd will need to be about 6yrs old to use them.
Walking paths, smores nights, craft times, and free shuttle to hyatt hill country up the road makr this placeone we will return to again.
This was our first visit to Wild Oak but it won't be our last. We had a 2 room condo. It was bigger than I expected. Clean, great amenities, perfect for us! This place is super family friendly.

Service staff were uniformly prompt, courteous and service-oriented. Our late arrival was handled flawlessly. Everyone seemed interested in making sure our stay was comfortable. Cable TV intermittently failed (an issue for those of us needing a CNN fix in the morning) but technician arrived nearly instantly. Same with housekeeping when bathroom supplies ran low. Room was listed as no-smoking but smelled faintly of poorly-masked stale cigarette smoke. Otherwise would have been a perfect grade. Will stay here again!

review_title: Looks great from the street, but the rooms are similar to a rehabbed HoJo
review_text:
I was excited to visit San Antonio in one of it's new hotels. After staying at the Menger one too many times, I was ready for a change.
The exterior and lobby are really great and unique for the sleepy downtown. But the rooms in this hotel, leave you wishing for the comforts of the Hyatt, Gunter or anyother downtown hotel.
I will not return to this hotel. I felt a little duped.

So we show up at midnight, and we can't find the front desk, or the elevator. We call out. Place is dark! No one answers. We carry our luggage up some stairs, and there is the desk. Ok, I'm game. Room was large, bed comfy, food was very good, and staff were good, once we find them in the dark! Would go again, place made me chuckle, don't know if that is what they were going for, but it still all worked for me. Also, is kind of on the end of the river walk, was a good location for me.

The hotel has a calming and serene feel the minute you walk in. They put aguave cucumber scent in the vents making the whole place smell great! The rooms are luxurious and upscale. The service is the same. It's just a block from the main part of the riverwalk making it close but not too close. I highly recommend this hotel!

We have stayed here at least 4 times and the last time we stayed was the.only time we have ever had a problem. The ac was not working as good as it should have. The front desk was EXTREMELY polite and we were given another room immediately. Our stays at this LQ are always pleasant. The rooms are huge for the price!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites San Antonio Downtown

review_title: Great stay, friendly staff, easy walk to Gaslamp Quarter
review_text: I always enjoy my stays at Westin hotels and this was no different. Front desk, concierge and housekeeping staff were very nice and helpful. The housekeeper, Maria Guerrero, went out of her way to keep us stocked and always with a friendly smile.

Checked in at the Westin the day of the great power outage... After fighting traffic for 1.5 hours to go 8 miles. Got there and no power but plenty of friendly staff to help you along. Flashlights, glow sticks, snacks, and we were in for the night. Wake up in the morning to order room service and Nate 'the great' Nichols makes sure the food comes with smiles and entertainment for our young ones. It's this great service that will have me back at this hotel when I'm in SD for business. Nice work Westin you've most definitely earned my business!

review_title: Great Value close to River Walk
review_text: We waited to arrive to book a room because of all the mixed reviews of hotels near the River Walk. We were fine with the location it was near the river walk so we could walk but it was also quiet. The room was clean and since it was a suite also had a fold out love seat. Nice pool and complimentary breakfast. We got a great rate by just walking up so felt like it was a good value.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites San Antonio Downtown

review_title: Great stay, except for one thing.
review_text: Came out for a fitness seminar my husband was attending and for a mini vacation. My 2 yr old had a blast at the pool and overall it was a pleasant experience. The only problem was when I made reservations, I asked if we could reserve a refrigerator, and the rep stated she had it noted. Upon check in, the counter person called to see if one was available (it wasn't). We were put on a waiting list, but during our stay, we were never contacted about one being available. This was to keep our daughter's milk cold.

Everything was handled great, no problems. Staff was very courteous and quick to please. Our breakfast was delivered to our room right on time and when they forgot my wifes milk, they were back in no time with it. We will definitely be back for another visit.

We stayed in late April for 4 nights with 2 boys 4 and 8 in a 1 br condo. We had such a good time the boys did not want to leave to go to seaworld nor the riverwalk. Beautiful grounds, very clean, condo was gorgeous. For the price and what you get - lazy river, large pools, slides, etc we thought it was a good deal.

review_title: Perfect place for clean freak@ at a cheap hotel price!
review_text:
Ok, let me start by saying I hate hotels bc of all the stuff you see on 20/20 withthe dirty sheets and what not, so when my husband and I planned an I spur of the moment trip to San Antonio from Dallas, I cringed at the thought of staying at a hotel.
Long story real short, on the drive, I looked up hotel in San anontio on trip advisor and stumbled on this beauty at a GREAT GREAT GREAT RATE! I could not believe it, and it's SECONDS WALKING to the riverwalk and the alamo. One word- FANTASTIC! and it was trendy, new, and CLEAN. only down side is parking which, if you valet, is $30 a day, or you can go to a very near by parking garage for $17. In San Antonio I will never stay anywhere else no matter what!

When I arrived I was amazed on how everything looked.. It was the nicest hotel that I had everystaryed in.. And if you can splurge a little bit get the river balcony room.. The view from the room was just awesome.. If you every get a
Chance stay at this hotel!!

Very nice staff, very helpful and always polite. Our room was very nice, loved the decor and everything was clean. The hotel was a little farther out from the hustle of the riverwalk but within walking distance of course. Our stay was awesome and we will stay again for sure!

I am do happy I stayed here over the Christmas weekend- the hotel is of excellent standards, a great location, and staff were pretty helpful with all kinds of things. The 24 hour store in the lobby has
good options for small snacks if you need. I loved being able to walk out the door right to the River Walk. I'd stay here again.

review_title: The hotel is beautiful and the staff is very friendly!!
review_text: A great relaxing hotel right off the Riverwalk. The Staff is very friendly and helpful. The atmosphere is outstanding!!

Guest services is always friendly and helpful.. One employee in particular, Giana Johnson went out of her way to make me feel comfortable and welcomed. She is warm and very hospitable. Giana is a valuable employee to the Westin.

Although I am a local, sometimes I just need to get away from it all & "exhale". The Westin San Diego is the place where I do just that. The rooms are great, the price is right and the people at the front desk take customer service to a different level. One person who stood out the most was a young lady named Giana Johnson. She was very friendly & helpful...especially when I mentioned that I had forgotten my bodywash & needed to purchase some. She gave me some & asked if I needed anything else. She's also very pretty.Again...I will stay here again!

review_title: Excellent ambiance, amenities and atttitude on the San Antonio Riverwalk.
review_text: Dodd Mitchell interiors invite to this upscale retreat on the newer, quieter, and prettier part of the Riverwalk. Well managed and great for all, from families to reception holders.

review_title: A fine stay in a good location
review_text:
I stayed for 2 nights in August and the funny thing is I'd been there before I just didn't remember until the cab dropped me off! 
Pros
- Good location, walkable to the shopping mall and convention center
- free airport shuttle
- nice view, from bay room
- they have a great list of forgotten items that they will give you if you forgot something, from shaving cream to nail polish remover
Cons
-At 2 pm housekeeping still hadn't come
- a bit noisy
- there was a hair in my shower, and it wasn't mine
Overall this was a fine hotel, got a good nights sleep and was only 10 mins from the airport.
After informing front desk of a hair in the shower and trash under night table only thing removed was the trash

review_title: Excellent location. Great service. Neat rooms.
review_text: Great stay. Would stay here again. Beautiful view from our room. Very helpful staff.

The title pretty much sums up
My feelings about the place. I will say that the location cannot be beat if you are a tourist. Valet Parking is expensive and the free parking is inconvenient, but that is to be expected in a city center. Since they were giving the place a facelift, we got a good rate
Very clean hotel, friendly staff and walking distance to a lot of great and fun locations :)
I surprised my wife with a trip to San Antonio and we stayed at the Valencia. The hotel was great for a romantic weekend.

Saved through Priceline. Gorgeous room...bed just a little firm for my liking but slept well. We spent two nights and were absolutely blown away that a 4-star hotel like this did/does not have pay-per-view movies??? That blows my mind.

We stayed here for two nights and we love this property...have stayed here several times in the past and they will always have our business!!
The Grand Club service is so awesome from the service attendants to the food served!! Highly recommend upgrading for this service!!
Used the mobile web check-in which was so fast and easy as well as check-out the same way!!
Our breakfast was included with the room rate and the buffet is definitely worth it!!
This is a beautiful property and customer service is great too!! 
Loved the stay fit gym used it both day's!
Can't wait to go back next year!

review_title: Top notch, a bit pricey but worth the royal treatment from the workers.
review_text: Location, location.. A bit expensive but location to the river walk and Down town San Antonio is priceless. Walking distance to the Alamo. The hotels Resturant is on the river walk. U can't beat the view from the balconies. The rooms are a bit dated but still very nice. The front desk was always willing to help

What a GREAT location! I am not sure if there is a more centrally located hotel on the Riverwalk! You just walk out the door and BAM, the Riverwalk is there. Some of the best places are right there. You walk across the bridge and you can catch the Riverboat tours. Even on the street level, you just walk to the corner of the property and catch the Trolley which will take you to ALL of the attractions. The Trolley is $1.10 per person and you have to have the correct change. You can go to the visitor center which is a couple of blocks away and get an all day pass for $4.00. 
The rooms are very clean and nice, we booked on priceline and were given one of the older rooms, which slightly discouraged me but it was nice enough. The hotel is under renovations so during the day it is noisey which we didn't really mind because we were gone most of the day. I will say tho, you can here the racier traffic at night and all of the emergency vehicles. If you are a light sleeper that might be a problem. Our shower was stuck on near scalding but when reported, they had it fixed within an hour. 
I would stay at this hotel again. The parking is a tad expensive. Hilton has the 7th floor and up on the parking garage. It is a in and out rate which is nice feature. Be prepared to pay $22 per day for self park and $35 per day for Valet. You will not have to pay that tho until check out. A Division of the SA Police Dept is in the same building which gave me a sense of ease. Overall, I will stay again. Maybe at that time, renovations will be complete. :o)

review_title: Be sure you're on a high floor
review_text:
Hilton Diamond Hhonors member with around 100+ nights per year in hotels and more than half at Hilton branded properties. 
This is one of the nicest Hiltons yet as for the renovated rooms. I was on top floor and heard/saw no trace of construction underway. The rooms are excellent with private balconies (try to be on riverwalk side), Grohe plumbing fixtures, LCD tv, great bed with reading lamps, motion sensor lighting, multimedia connections, etc. 
I saw an un-renovated floor when the elevator door opened - you really really want a newly renovated floor and the higher the better. 
Downsides: $35/day valet parking!!! Weak wifi signal (too weak for iPad or iPhone but my laptop connected). Very loud if there's a riverwalk festival. Overall value is fair compared to other riverwalk hotels. 
There are a lot of nice riverwalk hotels, but if you are a Hilton program member you can't go wrong here in the brand new rooms.

The hotel is undergoing renovations and hopefully they will get to the lobby soon. The new rooms are gorgeous and I had a balcony overlooking the river. The service at the hotel restaurant leaves a little to be desired, but service every where else in the hotel was excellent. The location cannot be beat!

review_title: The difference between hotels and extended stays.
review_text:
I on the road for 2 weeks now and state is in very nice hotels best western and holiday inn express. I checked in at the Staybridge San Antonio Seaworld hotel yesterday and for the first time I felt like I was at home. The hotel, staff and amenities are awesome, but the room with it's kitchenette was the icing on the cake. 
I highly recommend if you're staying for more than 2 days that you check into this Staybridge during your travels.
Steve Lewis
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio Sea World

review_title: The place to stay for Sea World
review_text: Highly recommend. Great value, nice staff, large rooms and shuttle to Sea World. Made taking a mid-day break easy.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio Sea World

review_title: Ok hotel. Parking way overpriced at $32 night.
review_text: Great area. Could use some updates in lobby. Overall nice. Won't recommend though because of insane parking fees.

review_title: Don't get caught on the hide-a-bed!
review_text:
My backs killing me as I write this! Admittedly, we were supposed to check in on Thursday. We were renting a block of 10+ rooms for the Equine Show (everyone else was there on Thursday). We showed up on Saturday and the only room left (according to the Front Desk) was a suite without a bed. We slept on the queen sized hide a bed. The manager offered a food/beverage credit, free Internet, and reduced parking which did smooth us over (somewhat). We asked housekeeping to make up the hide a bed, the linens were lousy and thin and they only brought one pillow! My advice to the hotel is to not offer that room. It's a nice room but the "bed" is a joke.
I didn't like the front desk, but the rest of the staff was awesome! Loved the girls at the lounge. Guacamole was yummy!

As I'm sitting in my bed here, at this hotel I'm very disappointed. We had made arrangements months ago since we're takin part in the marathon. We had booked a standard double room. Well, while checking in they told us we had the "hospitality suite". Thinking we got an upgrade the room turned out to have a nice kitchenette, dining table, and living room, only thing is - NO BED! (was not given discount). Worst experience was they said we had to be checked out by 11! Are you kidding me?! They apparently have some event? It would have been nice to get some notice in advance! Last year it was different. This year, however, will be the last at the Hyatt. Other people as well are calling it the last too as everyone is angry.

review_title: Nice hotel in downtown san diego
review_text: I stayed at this hotel over the fourth of july holiday and was very satisfied with this hotel. I got in to san diego late and went to the hotel after I got my rental car. I checked in around one forty five in the morning. The valet attendant was very helpful even at this later hour. I went and checked in and the clerk was also very courteous and friendly also at this late hour. The room I was given was on the twentieth floor at no additional charge with a view of the bay. Also the valet that park the vehicles were very eager to help I even saw one run across the street to get a vehicle and I was impressed by his willingness to give prompt service. The parking charge is a little steep at thirty two bucks a day but what are you going to do and I doubt the other four star hotels in downtown are much cheaper so is not that big of a deal. Also the dual shower heads are a nice touch. Also I got the price on priceline for one hundred ten so I was very satisfied especially over the forth of july holiday. I definatly would stay here again. One other thing it is kind of a pain to get here if you are following a gps because you have to go around the block to get to the valet parking but this is not the hotels fault

I got the chance to stay at the westin san diego and I was very pleased. When I arrived at the hotel I thought this whole trip would be a disaster being that I realized upon check in that I was at the wrong westin. How many Westins could there be in a few block radius I thought? Turns out there's two. As you can imagine I was a bit frustrated when I arrived at the correct hotel. That quickly changed. Katie and melissa at the front desk assured me that it wasn't just me who made that mistake and quickly got my mind off of it and eased my troubles away through casual conversation. They both recognized me the rest of my stay and went out of their way to say hello each time they saw me. If this is how service was all the time, I would stay at hotels much more often. Thanks melissa and katie!

review_title: A night that you won't regreat!
review_text: The place was great, we spent the night there for v-day and everything was great, it's right on the river... Overall it was great , stay here if you have the chance and if there's a room open

As they say location is everything.
You can't go wrong with the Grand Hyatt. Rooms were decent size. Very very quiet. Ask for upper floor.
Bathrooms were clean however seemed to be a constant shortage of towels and we had to request more. I would stay again. The staff really make the difference here, they are very kind and helpful. A few items that could be changed, bottom fitted sheet never stayed on ,wake up in a tangled sheet every day. Other people in our large group had same issue. Also a map of where pool is, and basic hotel outline in room would be helpful. Finally I used Starbucks across the street for free wifi. Seems crazy to charge for Internet on rooms anymore.

review_title: Run, Do Not Stay until they Finish their Remodel
review_text: Worst stay ever! Go only if u r desperate as every room in SA is booked. I spoke directly w the hotel before making reservations to confirm that the renovations they were doing wouldn't effect our stay. Woah! The first room they put is in the front desk clerk said we would never hear the jack hammers- wrong! So before unpacking we asked to be moved. They work 9-7PM which is fine I suppose if u r trusting. The next room provided was over the top when a 3" long Palmetto bug ran out from my side of the bed at 8:30PM and right in front of my toes. If u have not seen one they look like a German cockroach on steroids. We killed it, put it in a plastic bag and I delivered it to the front desk, where they were duly mortified. They offered a discount (I did not have to ask) & I asked for housekeeping to come up to the room & check to see what else was under our bed. He told me nothing but I slept w my clothes on, could not get out of there fast enough!! When the bill came, they had overcharged me for parking, that had to be adjusted and there was no discount for the palmetto bug even tho the note was in the system. That had to be adjusted. Overall cleanliness of the hotel was not there. The hotel restaurant closed the day we arrived (for remodelling to the kitchen). Honestly, the whole place is a mess. When they asked me if I opened the door to my balcony on the 11th floor, implying that the Palmetto bug flew up 11 stories and came in our room exactly at the one time I opened the door for less than 1 minute, was a little insulting. The place is under remodeling with a LONG way to go.

It's a nice hotel. Valet is a nightmare. A 30 minute wait to park the car plus a $30 a night charge. Very contemporary decor, cozy, clean and simple. Customer service was not great but tolerable for the price.

review_title: Stay if there isn't anything else
review_text: The rooms are clean, well-sized, the maids are friendly, but the front desk staff is not up to the level necessary for a hotel at this price range. We were there for 4 days and each day there was a problem with our room keys. Even when we went to have them changed, only 1 out of 3 ever worked. I saw a hyatt close by, next time I'll go there.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio Sea World

review_title: Nice stay at the Grand Hyatt
review_text:
My wife and I just stayed at the Grand Hyatt while I attended a nearby conference. Overall it was a good stay, with some pluses and minuses. On the positive side the room was very clean, the maid service was very good, tv was good ( but in a strange location), the lobby coffee shop had a good selection, and the exercise room was well stocked with up to date equipment. On the negative side, room service was poor (over priced and not great quality), our room had a strange set up with the tv on the left side of the bed instead of in front of the bed, and the pool was small. The location of the hotel was great for my conference but several blocks from the busy part of the Riverwalk.
One big plus for the hotel was the quality of the staff. The front desk staff were quick, efficient, and friendly. The room service and maid staff were friendly. Everyone said "good morning" or "good evening" when we walked by them. 
Overall a good quality hotel!

We booked two twin rooms to visit San Antonio with my family and parents. The hotel is in an ideal location with views of the Alamo and also the Emily Morgan Building. The Alamo is immediately across the street and the Riverwalk is about 5 mins walk via a number of different routes.
What I particularly liked about the hotel was that it is not a standard cookie cutter design. The hotel is located in an old building and retains many of the original features including tiled floors in the hallways, old drinking fountains and elements of the original elevator. This has all been done in a way to retain the original charm but ensuring a modern, comfortable stay. Rooms are not all identical and fit round the deisgn of the building rather than being standard boxes.
Hotel staff were excellent - helpful and knowledgeable.
The restaurant was ok - but not great. But you are spoilt for choice within a few minutes. However, the breakfast buffet was good.
Valet parking only.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: Great hotel and love the staff
review_text: Would like to express a big thank you to Corey that went above and beyond to locate my sons blanket that he left in one of the drawers in the room. He was most helpful when we called in and even went up to the room to see if in the drawer. The location was great and just a hop skip and jump to Seaworld. I couldn't believe how clean and new the room was and made it great that there was two tv in the room for the kids to watch tv. Would recommend to anyone....Great hotel
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio Sea World

review_text: Really pleasant stay and worth the extra $ while attending a convention. Eliminated stress of traffic and center to everything downtown. Will stay again!

The hotel is minutes away from the Riverwalk and literally minutes from the Alamo. The rooms are spacious and beds very fluffy, overall a beautiful hotel and worth every penny. The only thing that was a little uncomfortable was the valet price, but the the valet drivers are very nice & took great car with my vehicle. I had left some money in the front seat of my vehicle accidentally once, & when I had my vehicle returned every single bill was still where I left it. Can't wait to return!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: A lot of charm and history
review_text:
I love visiting the Alamo and you can't get any closer to it then this hotel. The Riverwalk and other attractions are also very close.
The building the hotel is in has a lot of charm nd history. It was built in 1909.
Most importantly though it is a quality hotel and one I would stay at again.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: The guys that clean around the hotel god bless them they do a awesome job.
review_text: The hotel is very clean nice staff they always attend to smile and make me feel welcomed. Through the whole day I was in and out of the hotel and I always saw workers cleaning every time they were either cleaning the mirrors or moping also valcuming they kept the hotel clean. I like hard workers like that and keep everything set ill be back in may can't wait to stay again
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio Sea World

review_title: Too many children, no leaded coffee with breakfast. Buffed entry floors at 1:00am????
review_text: We stayed here because it is close to Lackland and because some of the suites sleep 6 there are too many small kids. We hardly slept because the kids were never all asleep at the same time and then they buffed the floors at 1am. Are you kidding?? If you expect any privacy within your room forget it both the toilet and shower areas have frosted glass doors?? Like having no door at all. Nice looking rooms but when we moved the next night to the Marriott Courtyard one exit north the beds and room layout was more comfortable and quiet. There were still children but not as many to each room and they were asleep early. Pool and hot tub not as crowded. I am sure that this hotel gets a lot of kids because of the free breakfast that by the way only had decaf coffee??
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites San Antonio Sea World

review_text: All the staff were great. I traveled with my 8 mth old, 3 yr old and wife. Everyone was awesome. Kelly Norton in the dining room took extra special care for the kids at breakfast all week! She was incredible. Thanks to her and all the staff.

review_title: Best hotel I've ever stayed at in San Antonio!
review_text: Very clean! Very friendly! Very professional! Valet parking was a plus!

review_title: We loved this hotel even though only for a night.
review_text: We got a great deal through priceline by bidding quite a low rate - and somehow we scored this amazing place! While there was also a resort fee and quite high parking costs (standard for the city), this hotel was still great value. Quite central in San Diego, amazingly maintained regal style hotel with great service and large beautiful rooms. No complaints.

This is a newly converted hotel that used to be an office building. Great location close to most major downtown attractions. Helpful staff and very clean rooms. A little noise from the streets can be heard in the rooms. The rooms are all converted offices and the floors are the original wooden floors. Great change of pace hotel.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: Great value for a nice hotel.
review_text: My family and I enjoyed the rooms, room service and eateries in the hotel. We stayed the weekend of the UTSA inaugural game so the place was hopping with activities. When we went up to our room to relax my daughter was mesmearized by the lovely view from our 21st floor room. Everyone from the front desk, to the servers and the Valera were friendly and kind...but of course this is SA and everyone always is. The only down is the 2 double beds instead of perferable queen beds in the room but they were comfy. I have started and the grand hyatt in San Fran, NYC and Miami and San Antonio location can hold it's own.

The hotel is in a great location, the hotel restaurant has great food, good prices. Rooms are very clean and well kept, very nice soaps etc. 
only cons are the parking off site, andd cost involved in parking. Recommend taking shuttle in, car not needed.

review_title: Great Hyatt on the river walk
review_text: Great Hyatt but the kicker is an excellent restaurant and fitness center. Perfect location if you're at a convention at the convention center.
I don't like hotels who leave bottles of water in the room with a 5 dollar price tag. Come on a bottle of free water per room would not kill you. no free wi fi and a poor breakfast on offer.

review_title: Concierge service here was spot on!
review_text: Our stay was completely changed by the concierge here! The hotel itself was nice, but not extraordinary enough to come back to for it's personality (I would have liked more outlets in the room and free internet) until we started asking Sophie and the concierge staff for reccomendations. They set us up with an amazing reservation at Panevino, breakfast at Richard Walkers Pancake House, and reverse happy hour at Urban Tavern all which were delicious! Sophie even surprised us our last night with champagne delivered to our room because it was my birthday weekend. I'd come back and stay here just to see what else she and the staff reccomends!

sehr gutes Hotel. Sehr freundliches und zuvorkommendes Hotelpersonal. Gute moeglichkeiten im Hotel zu essen, auch zu guenstigeren Preisen. Nahe zum Gaslamp quater. Dort koennen alternativ Restaurants oder Bars besucht werden. Das Hotelrestaurant bietet aber auch sehr gutes Essen und ein gutes Fruehstueck gegen Aufpreis. Ruhig und mit Blick auf den Hafen. Nahe zum Konferenzzentrum. Fuer Geschaeftsreisende sowie Urlauber eine sehr gute Wahl.

This boutique hotel is across from the Alamo and a block from the Riverwalk. It appears to be newly remodeled, with spacious baths, thick towels, luxurious bed linens and high-quality furnishings. The on-site bar/bistro offers a reasonably-priced and appetizing selection of breakfasts (the only meals we ate there) as well as a selection of coffees to please Starbucks aficionados. The exercise room had the standard assortment of exercise machines. Staff was friendly and helpful. Free wi-fi was fast and reliable. The conversion from an office building was done with architectural sensitivity.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: They overbooked me and booted me--- do not stay here they cannot be trusted
review_text: They overbooked me and booted me out--they sent me to a sister hotel that they said was same star rating-- can't be possible this one was trashy. They were also supposed to be give us enough points to stay another time equal to what I paid for that would be emailed to me after check out. I paid for three days but checked out early due to my experience and when I checked the points I had enough for 2 and a half days. What can I do with a half a day. Do not stay here-- they are incompetent and can't be trusted
The service was great the rooms were awesome, but breakfat was great.

I experience great service at this hotel.
I booked through expedia and I got a great price and great value, the front desk staff specialy Julie was fantastic...
I recommend this hotel
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Antonio Downtown

review_title: Strong design, location, service but a few minor misses on amenities.
review_text:
This was my second stay, about 18 months apart. I was able to check in early without hesitation from a friendly front desk staff. Overall I received friendly service and acknowledgements. Although one can find some oddities from the historic nature and some less than perfect renovation quality control (paint, tlie etc.) I did not experience any cleanliness issues that other reviewers spotted. On both visits my loyalty membership bumped me to a larger king room on a corner. It was pleasantly appointed and good sized. The only minor drawbacks I've seen is the lack of a refridgerator, the oddity of nowhere to hang towels near the sink in both rooms, and the noisy and ever-running AC in both my visits.
The location is within a short walk of the convention hotels and center as well as the riverwalk. I had no noise issues with the adjacent streets. I have not eaten at the hotel on either trip so I cannot comment. Their parking cost while ridiculous, is in line with the other downtown hotels.
While this hotel might not always be my first choice I enjoy the lodging and would have little hesitation in returning or recommending the Hotel Indigo at the Alamo.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: Bad customer service w/ broken facilities & thin walls.
