review_text: Great reasonably priced space. Bathroom facilities that do not work. Plumbing is very loud, every flush or shower your neighbor makes echos through your room. You can also hear, thanks to very thin walls, your neighbors going to the bathroom. You will have to be an early riser or a hard sleeper to stay here. Also parking is another $16/day. Stiff bed with overly stuffed pillows resulting in waking up with a stiff back & crick in the neck. Bed so stiff that when your partner rolls over every movement is transferred to shake you awake while sleeping. Do yourself a favor, spend a little more and stay somewhere else or stay home.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Antonio Downtown

review_text: The valet service at hotel indigo was top notch. They were very careful with my car and very polite. I would definitely recommend. Don't know why anybody would say anything negative.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: Hotel is really nice great location! Rooms are great and comfy! The staff and bartender Michael were pretty awesome! My one complaint and urge anyone staying there, to be aware of there valet service they charge 25 dollars to park your car in a open lot 2 blocks away in a bad part of town, our car was broken into windown busted, radar, GPS and radio stolen! And of course no one told us of the unsafe location our car would be parked in! Instead we were informed that our car would be safer and watched over with the 25 dollar valet service! we survey the damage made police report! All on passenger side, and then told now they would put it in a secured parking garage with cameras and security! Really? Why wasn't this done before. Also they failedto mention in these open lots they move your car to the worst and unsafe Parkin lot 2 blocks away so the near by church can have parking.sonthey are moving your cars back n forth! They did clean the glass which was nice! But upon checkout, we discover our drivers side mirror had been hanging off cracked with paint apparent that the valet hit something before bringing it too us! And of course it was blamed on the theft funny we checked it out that night and it wasn't that way!! The hotel said nothing but sorry! I told them they should explain the valet better! I know if I'd known where my vacuole would be parked, I'd have park next door in the public lot! Very disappointed in the way the handled this, at least there was no charge of 25 for valet, yet my trip there thanks to the horrible valet cost me a ruined sand stressed vacation and 800. Dollar to replace my belongings and window! Unwound have thought the GM would have contacted us and at least gave us a free stay or comp for their horrible service bit not even a call from GM to say sorry! Ruined my vacation!! Thinking of taking this up with the owner or president! Beware.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: I Couldn't have asked for a better place rooms amazing staff is wonderful love the pool area exercise room open all night beds comfy i would definitely Come back,four points rock
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Antonio Downtown

review_title: New, clean and lots of stuff nearby
review_text: Let's get the negatives out of the way first. And they are few. No continental or free breakfast. A pretty small, but nice, pool. They have a very nice restaurant and bar. All modern and new decor. And get this: we arrived after 10 on first night, noticed room fan didnt stay on continuously (helps with noise, especially when neighbors are, well, being very friendly with each other at 4 am). I inquired the next day, and the manager had our a/c fan unit fixed promptly. Good service here. Got a good price. 20 minutes to downtown SA. 10 min to airport. Yes, we would stay here again.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Antonio North-Hill Country

review_text: I'm usually a low maintenance guest, but on this trip I had several special needs arise. The entire staff was very helpful and met every request. The only drawbacks were a loud ( but effective) air conditioner and I did spot a few ants. Right next to the Alamo and convenient to Riverwalk and convention center.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: We stayed here last night after making spur of the moments reservations at 8pm and arriving after 1am. The hotel was vert clean with great modern decorations. The pool was already closed but there were towels laying around the poolside but by the time the pool opened again they were picked up. The rooms were average sized hotel rooms but the selling point is the incredible beds! They were by far the most comfortable beds I've ever slept on and our entire party of 4 agreed! It was a great, new, clean, well-decorated place to stay out of the downtown area but in great safe neighborhood. Would recommend any day to anyone. The only downside is no free breakfast :(
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Antonio North-Hill Country

review_title: Location is great, stay was comfortable and easy.
review_text: Staff was really nice and helpful. Mario who works the concierge/valet was a super nice guy and really helpful. Get the valet package when u stay if u plan on doing anything away from the riverwalk. The only way to beat the location is to find a hotel right on the water but add 50-75 bucks more for the kind of room we had. Hotel is in the corner of Alamo plaza and 2 blocks from some of the best restraints in San Antonio, next to the mall, and Alamo.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: The restaurant is The Best In Town
review_text:
I could not believe why this place wasn't packed to the rafters. Having eaten in at least 20 other establishments during our stay in town, we came back here three times, and it was spot on... And not nearly as expensive as some of the cruder, but supposedly fancier places on the river walk.
Service was exemplary, food utterly lovely and beautifully cooked and presented, and even the wine was great and reasonably priced.
We didn't stay in the hotel, but would definitely stay the next visit..had the charm and personality that far outweighed the massive conference-barn hotel we were at!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: Checked into room and there was pee in the toilet. Dirt on the bed sheets. Received no room service. As we checked out, they told us the room we stayed in was vacant in their system. They said we were booked for another room. Our belongings could have gotten stolen or possibly another couple could have walked in. This would explain the no room service and pee. We got nothing in return. This is the worst place I have stayed at. I have children as well. I woul not recommend this hotel to anyone. How embarrassing that a 2star can do better than a Hyatt!!
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

review_text: Our stay began with an unexpected, exorbitant fee for valet parking in their lot! We were given a room in which a smoke detector battery was dying and making a constant yip. Their restaurant was out of basic food items. And upon returning to our room after dinner, we found the door card key access broken, the smoke detector still yipping, and it took an hour before the maintenance personnel arrived to repair it. They compted us only for breakfast which they grudgingly brought to the room.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Antonio Downtown

review_text: Great new hotel. Clean. Friendly. Nice part of the city. Only 15 min from downtown. Recommend.Nice part of the city.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn San Antonio North-Hill Country

review_title: Boutique hotel in an excellent location with old world charm
review_text: Gunter is an historic boutique hotel that carries the Sheraton name. If you want cookie cutter hotel fare, this is not for you. From the charming lobby, friendly front desk staff, excellent downtown location (literally 75 steps or 90 seconds to the Riverwalk), to the clean, quirky rooms, the Gunter is a reasonably priced strong value. I booked on Hotwire and did get upgraded to an accessible room. This offered more space which for me was worth the minor inconveniences. I will stay there again.

If my sons and I could give the Hotel Indigo a rating we would give it a 10. Kudos to everyone, especially to Leonard Johnson, always there to lend a hand, no questions asked. Also, Alex Prado thank you for making it memorable for my sons. We would definitely go back.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: Beautiful grounds, rooms and public spaces. Friendly, helpful staff. Pool area is wry ice, something for everyone. The nature trail is a nice feature.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

review_title: Amazing place to stay in downtown San Antonio
review_text: Beautiful, historic boutique hotel. The staff is amazing, especially Mike the bartender, who is extremely knowledgeable about the history of the hotel building, the alamo and many other San Antonio attractions. I would absolutely recommend this hotel to friends and plan to come back and stay here often!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: Beautiful historic hotel near all the action in downtown San Antonio.
review_text: While not on the Riverwalk itself, the Gunter is within blocks of it,The Alamo & other downtown landmarks. Make sure to grab a bite at the Gunter Bakery - the chocolate croissants are epic!

review_title: History, class and location! Best place to stay in SA!
review_text:
This hotel is amazing! Such great history surrounds this building and the feel of the rooms is modern but honors the historical background of the building. 
You MUST visit the bar and ask for mike the nationally recognized bartender and try his amazing signature ginger pear martini! He has won many awards for drinks and has published drink recipes. He also knows a lot about the area and can tell you the history of the building and it's location!
You can't beat the indigo! Right across from the Alamo and walking distance to the riverwalk and much more. The best place to stay in downtown San Antone!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text:
My sister and I stayed here for her birthday celebration. We chose it for the price, location and reviews. It is clean, very nicely decorated and close to everything downtown. In fact, we could see The Alamo from our room, it was great!
There were only two minor things to take note of to make your stay the most pleasant it can be. 
1. Bring your own pillow (theirs are very fluffy... Nice for decoration, but not so great for sleeping.)
2. Keep the A/C turned to on rather than auto and just turn the temperature up to a temp you can handle feeling all night long. The air in the room tends to get quite still when the air isn't running making it quite warm.
Other than those minor, simple to fix, things, our stay was outstanding.
We were greeted by Janet's, the valet's, smiling face. She was so friendly and offered to help with anything we needed. Thanks for the very nice greeting!!!
Beth, at the front desk, was so helpful! We loved talking with her while we were there and really wished she would have taken us up on our offer to go out with us. Haha!
Michael, the bartender at the beautiful bar, makes a great drink! He made me something which tasted exactly like a watermelon Jolly Rancher! Yum! It was so refreshing in the heat of San Antonio. We loved redeeming our free drink coupons for having joined the rewards club. 
Overall, you can NOT go wrong staying here. It exceeded our expectations! The staff was friendly and the rooms were very nice and comfortable. Especially when you take into account the great price. Enjoy your stay!!!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: I stayed here for a few days while visiting family and loved it. Great location - it's near the Riverwalk, Alamo, and lots of shops, restaurants and other attractions. The rooms are very clean, comfortable, and eco-friendly, which I loved. The service was great too. The staff was kind and accommodating and seemed to really care about your comfort. Can't go wrong with this place!
hotel_name: Home2 Suites by Hilton San Antonio-Downtown/Near the River Walk

review_text: Neat hotel in a cool historic building. Bed was comfy, but I did ask for extra pillows. When booking be sure you book at Indigo Alamo, not Indigo Riverwalk. Also ask for a corner room, they are larger.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: This was my first visit to San Antonio, and I'm glad I booked the home2suites. The hotel is very clean, and the location is great. It is 2 min to riverwalk and 10 min to Alamo. We had a problem with the AC in our room it was extremely noisy, but the staff sent someone up to check. They changed our room with no problems. The staff was extremely kind,always greeting my 3 girls and my wife with a smile. They also loved to talk and ask how our day was going. The valet parking is a little pricey, but that is offset with the price of the room. The breakfast was limited,but with a suite you can buy stuff for the week. If your looking for a great hotel in San Antonio, this is it.
hotel_name: Home2 Suites by Hilton San Antonio-Downtown/Near the River Walk

review_text: We spent a one night romantic getaway at this hotel on the Riverwalk. It is a great location and allows for an excellent experience on the Riverwalk. I woul definitely recommend it. The room was slightly smaller than usual but well appointed and clean. It was very well decorated. Give it a try.

review_title: Haven't seen so much body ink since Sturgis.
review_text:
Dining room floor at lunch was so filthy with food crumbs from the breakfast buffet even at 12:30 we almost couldn't find a decent place to sit. Pretty irritating since 4 staffers were jawboning around the empty buffet. But the salads were very good.
The room was excellent as expected at $350. 
The grounds and pot plants were badly suffering from the 103 temp and extended drought which is inexcusible for a resort like this - hire a kid and give him a water hose. Pool was packed. Never seen so many tattoos - looked like a biker convention. If that's your crowd fine but I'll be heading over to the new JW Marriott resort next time.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

review_title: The best staff at a hotel in San Antonio1
review_text: Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. From the time we got there, the staff was very helpful and welcoming. Great service, great location, clean rooms. Good coffee, and the manager Cruz was excellent. I highly recommend staying here.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: Retro hotel wrapped in a chain name. Great rooms fun place. Great location and a wonderful barkeep michael. Go see him.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: Of you love historic places stat here!
review_text: We truely enjoyed our stay here. It is close to the riverwalk and all the action. I read other reviews so I knew what to expect with parking and small bathrooms. I was not bothered by either. There is self parking across the street so that was easy. As for the rooms they are large and I loved the tall ceilings. The baths are smaller than average but the hotel is 100 years old so keep that in mind. The bellman Thurston was very helpful and courteous as was the front desk. We loved this place and would recommend it of you like stepping back to an elegant era.
Multiple rooms on different floors had no cold water from the sink. Also multiple rooms couldn't get ABC or NBC.

Trendy boutique hotel right by the Alamo. The front desk staff and bell staff were very helpful and friendly. The brightest spot is the resident restaurant...1909 Bistro. The manager is so welcoming and personable, and the food is delicious! It is all good!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: The staff treat you like royalties and like if you were the only guest there .
review_text: The staff made are stay incredible . I recommend this hotel for any tourist coming to san Antonio cause its in the middle of downtown and close to every attraction you want to see downtown . I also say for fiesta its the best place for you to stay and party and for chairs to see the parade are right in front of the hotel so you don't have to go far .
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_title: Nice hotel, good location a bit over rated
review_text: Good hotel. Expensive but you get what you pay for. Great location. Beautiful lobby

We stayed at the Marriott Rivercenter for two nights in October. The room was very clean and large enough to easily fit a crib without us feeling cramped. The hotel staff - to a person - was outstanding! The hotel has a Starbucks in the lobby and small restaurant/bar. The lobby has plenty of seating. The hotel is convenient to the SAT airport. It's located right off the interstate and there is plenty of onsite underground and surrounding daily parking options. The hotel is within walking distance to the Riverwwalk and Alamo. In fact, the Riverwalk is right out the back of the hotel. There are several nice hotels in the immediate area, including the Marriott Riverwalk across the street. If we ever go back to San Antonio we will certainly stay at the Marriott again. The only bummer was no comp breakfast. Perhaps that's available at the Marriott Riverwalk?

review_title: What a deal this place is!
review_text: I'm not a person who writes reviews, but this places requires a response. First the few negatives... I found that the AC was a little loud. It was a simple first day fix though. I just turned the fan to low, and problem solved. Secondly, and finally, the rooms let in a little noise from the hallway. No big deal to me though. You will get over that when the positives become apparent. Positives, the place is a great price, location is wonderful, staff is helpful, good bedding, and the room service is amazing for the price!! FYI, I stayed in room 803 which had a kingsized bed and was tucked away in the hall which cut down the noise in the hall. I got a peak of the queen rooms, and I wouldn't stay in one of them. They are significantly smaller and will only save you a few dollars a night compared to the king. Overall, trust me! Great spot even if I paid $25 more a night.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Antonio At The Alamo

review_text: The girls (7 & 4 yrs old) loved the camp & activities, & of course the lazy river & beach area. The wife enjoyed the margaritas & the service. This can, however, get very expensive. Overall very nice 5 day vacation. Definatly a family resort. Many activities for the kids. Would recommend but only if you are willing to drop mucho dinero.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

review_text: Me and my boyfriend stayed this past memorial day weekend. It was the nicest hotel I had ever stayed in- very roomy and clean. The only thing I would have changed was the positioning of the air vent. It was right by the window facing the wall and not towards the main area. We like a cooler room so the vent pointing the opposite way of the bed didn't allow the air to circulate throughout the room and so the room didn't cool off as well. Besides the air vent- it was perfect!

review_title: Service was either great or terrible.
review_text: I received help from two different concierges. One, Luke, was unorganized and rude. Laura was sweet and very helpful. It is funny how people in the same department can have such different levels of effectiveness.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

review_text:
Soft sound of water falls, birds singing, smells of s'mores over the campfire and Texas native flowers blooming, these are just a few of the sounds and scents that will greet guests! 
I just made it home from my first visit and I'm ready to plan my next trip! I have wanted to go here since this property first opened! I was not disappointed at all! Everyone went out of their way to make me feel special and welcomed! 
From chillaxing by the pool, to floating the river all equal heaven in the hill country! 
You will not be disappointed with this special resort!
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

review_title: Family Vacation of 4. Loved all the kids activites. Hated the unkept beach and no response from management when my 5 yr old was
review_text: Our family spent 5days & 4nights at this hotel. My husband, myself and our 5 & 7 year olds did nothing but stay at the resort the entire time and relaxed. Their food at their 2 main restuarants, Antlers Lodge & Springhouse Cafe, was great; the pool side bar, Papa Ed's, and club house, Cactus Oak Tavern, not so much. There is a mini fridge in your room so I would suggest heading over to Walgreens and load up on drinks and snacks. You can also go to the General Store for breakfast breads, muffins, cereal, milk, coffee, ice cream etc. Enough about food....The kids activites were great. There is free bike rentals for adults and children, even a tricycle and ones with training wheels. Everyday was something new. We did a photo scavenger hunt and the kids got trinket prizes at the end, which made their day. They had free face painting, free arts and crafts, even movies under the stars on Friday and Saturday nights. The hotel provides big blankets and free popcorn. They also have a fire pit to roast free smores nightly. My husband is an avid golfer. He played golf on Friday morning. It was $145. He said it was not worth that dollar amount. He just came back from Torrey Pines so that might have something to do with it. The pools and river was fun but really dirty. The first night there I grabbed a pool cleaning net and scooped out about 5 lbs of tree seedlings and caterpillars. I never once saw the pool skimmed while there. I am well aware that because of the natural setting that nature will get into the water but it should never get to that point. I assume it is skimmed before opening but it really needs to be done a few more times during the day. The river was very cold but fun. My kids loved it. I was REALLY disappointed in the beach. There was more leaves than sand. It was never once raked the entire time we were there. Everyone around us was complaining. There is a playground for the kids but carpenter bees everywhere so no kids were playing on it. Carpenter bees are not aggressive but the females do have stingers and will sting if you disturb their nest. (which are perfectly symmetrical holes in wood) The staff was very curteous until the last day. My 5 yr old who weighs not even 40 pounds grabbed the makeup stool from under the sink and stood on it so he could brush his teeth. The stool broke and he came crashing down on the splintered wood and hard tile. No one used the chair previously and even if I did I am 5' 8" and weigh only 145 pounds and my husband 155. My husband, who is an Emergency Medicine Physician, checked him out and luckily he had some minor scratches but a huge bruise has developed on his hip. The poor baby started crying and aplogizing to the chair. My husband called down to the front desk and the woman (Sunday 10th) said she wod let the manager know. I was expecting a call or knock on the door but nothing. I went down to the front desk and the desk clerk said she reported it and acted like I was inconviencing her. No apologies from the Hyatt.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

review_title: Above the high standard for a Marriott
review_text: I selected this property based on Trip Advisor advice. I was Not disappointed. The room was commodious and clean. The fitness center was adequate but everything was operational. Breakfast was hot and well-prepared. The staff are typical Marriott-trained and very courteous. I will definitely stay here again.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: We booked this because of an extended stay in San Diego and wanted a kitchen. The location can't be beat. And the staff were wonderful and friendly. We ended up not really using the kitchen since space was limited. We'd like to also be able to open windows and our temp in our room was never right no matter how much we tried to adjust it. We would also appreciate a hot tub in the pool area! If you just need a hotel room and want to be in Gaslamp you probably can't beat this.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Solid choice in gas lamp quarter
review_text:
Good location -short walk to everything, good size rooms & very good service. 
A couple of areas the hotel could improve on are (1) buffet breakfast. The room resembles a mess hall rather than o hotel restaurant & thefood was just edible. At least it was included in the rate.
(2) TV - dominated by news & sport channels, very difficult to find something to watch. I can only assume that this hotel is mainly servicing a business clientele.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Great place to stay in the Gaslamp
review_text: Stayed for one night. Super clean room. Seemed brand new. The sink was oddly placed but that's just a nit. Very comfortable bed. Delicious full breakfast buffet, 'til 10 on weekends! Free Internet. Highly recommended if you want to be in the middle of the fun in San Diego. Near the ballpark as well.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Super pour la visite de la ville trÃ¨s bien situÃ©
review_text: Hotel bien situÃ© pour visiter san francisco , chambre spatieuse , grand standing, trÃ©s calme, sauf quand il y a des travaux la nuit mais bon c une ville c pas la campagne . Nous avons passÃ© un bon sÃ©jour dans cet hÃ´tel , je le recommande. Les commerÃ§ant de san Francisco sont d'une courtoisie extraordinaire , toujour bonjour c gÃ©niale .

This place was absolutely amazing. I've never met a more friendly staff. The valet were quick and courteous. Daily breakfast is included with your stay and its REAL breakfast. Valet is the only option for parking and its a little pricey ($35) a day. My family and I were there for a month and we had NO complaints!
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: This hotel is amazing, our house flooded and this is where we ended up staying. Best choice ever!!! Close to everything in downtown!!! From the moment we arrived everyone was so helpful and courteous (we stayed a month) service was impeccable from housekeeping to the buffet style breakfast, to the valet guys, who were super courteous and always had your car out in no time. So sad to leave it truly was like being at home but in a hotel!!!
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: Delusione totale. Arrivati al check in pur essendo Gold member Hyatt e avendo espresso preferenza piani alti mi hanno messo in un piano basso inoltre pagando avevo diritto al grand club che si trova al 23 piano e per arrivarci devo cambiare ascensore, assurdo. L'hotel e' rumoroso. L'architetto che ha fatto la piscina e'un idiota, infatti tutto attorno c'e' pietra con un temperatura assurda non si possono togliere le scarpe, pazzesco! Non consiglio questo hotel pur essendo un frequentatore della catena Hyatt, il peggiore Hyatt di sempre. Dimenticavo la rata e' altissima non vale proprio la pena. Da dimenticare.

If you're looking for a great place to stay near the Convention Center and PETCO Park, this is a good choice. My wife and I stayed here 8 nights for a conference and were very pleased. We had a good room rate that incuded complimentary breakfast and WiFi. We were greeted by staff every time we came in, and they kindly took care of any requests or provided information about local businesses. 
The rooms are mini suites with a fully equipped kitchen, nice bathroom, very comfortable bedding and large flat panel TV. Climate control in the room worked well and was very quiet. They take security rather serious here, and you must use your room key card to make he elevator go anywhere except the Lobby level. So, don't forget your key card when you leave your room. 
The breakfast area on 2nd floor is nice and they offer a decent selection of foods, included in your room rate. But if you want to pay for a big breakfast, go right across the street to Broken Yolk. 
The pool on 3rd floor is rather small, and there is a fitness center next to the pool. But, I did a lot of walking each day and didn't want to ride a bike to nowhere or walk on a conveyor belt on this trip.
Yes, I'll definitely try to book a room here next year.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Why would you stay anywhere else?
review_text:
I had a FANTASTIC stay! The staff was incredibly friendly and really helpful from the warm gentleman who checked us in (and was kind enough to move us when we weren't comfortable in our room) to the delightfully helpful woman who helped me figure out parking at Sea World and the Zoo and then checked us out while checking in on our conversations from the morning before. 
We felt incredibly well taken care of and the morning breakfast was delicious! Who doesn't love steel-cut oatmeal? Well...I might be the only one who loves it, but they also had a full spread of eggs, fresh fruit, waffles, a variety of yogurt, a variety of cereal, tons of beverage options and probably a bunch of other things I'm completely forgetting. 
The building is quite nice, great design and a perfect location close to just about everything. 
I highly recommend this location (so much so that I'm writing this from my phone as I'm heading back home!)
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Great stay for Petco, convention center, or Gaslamp.
review_text: Just got back and had a great time. The rooms are very nice. Hotel very convenient to the local sites and is a block from the trolley. The staff was fantastic as well. Only downside is the parking. $38 a day is pretty tough. The bar on the roof is a great hangout.

review_title: A little noisy but excellent value!
review_text: Everything was great. Excellent views, customer service and value. The only drawback was that the area is noisy---very noisy. We heard fights on the street, sirens were a constant, and the walls were somewhat thin. Bottom line: definitely will return!

review_title: What you pay is what you get!
review_text: I visited for my first time San Diego and my gf and I picked this hotel mainly for the location. Tower 23 has everything a modern hotel can offer. Nothing special or extraordinary but enough to make your stay enjoyable. Staff was very helpful, restaurant and bar were great as well. The view from our balcony is all the money. Finally the bed is one of the most comfortable I ve ever slept!

Hotel is very well locate for tourists. Easy access in and out of town to major attractions, plenty of restaurants and bars to choose from locally, and gaslamp is relatively quiet for a large city. 
Be careful with parking (valet), $35 per night. I found a multi-storey car park 1 block down and across the road that was only $8. 
Overall though, good hotel.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: Spent three days here during our spring break vacation.Great location. Very accommodating and pleasant staff across the board. Good comp breakfast every day. Small but functional fitness room. Rooms were clean and spacious enough. If I had any "complaint" ( and I really don't), perhaps the daily parking at $35 a bit steep. But that goes with being in the city. I'd stay here again in an instant!
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: Great bed, great bedding, peaceful and quiet refuge from the street. Staff was attentive, friendly and helpful. Super location by PETCO park. We parked in a garage around the corner, because we wanted inexpensive access to our car, but we ended up not needing our car at all. Everything was in walking distance, including the tram.

We were here for a weekend over Christmas. Very modern and clean hotel. We had an emergency which required us. To extend and have some extra attention. The desk managers on all shifts were very accommodating.
I love Indigo properties as a rule , but this one is the top!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: We had requested two joined rooms as we were coming with 3 adults and 2 children under the age of two. We also told the hotel that we would need two cribs. When we arrives we were told our rooms did not have a door connecting them but were near one another. Life goes on so we went to the rooms to find one was still being cleaned at 4:20pm. We had come from the east coast and really needed to get the kids to bed. we had to take everything and everyone down stairs to get different rooms, much to the annoyance of the front desk staff. The cribs were not in the first set of rooms so we requested them again. When we arrived at the second set of rooms, one had a crib while the other did not. Upon calling the front desk we were told the hotel was out of cribs. Prior to our arrival we had rented a baby swing and some other gear, the front desk informed is that they has not received any deliveries, after calling the company we rented from, they told us it had been delivered and was in a closet by the front desk. Suddenly the front desk was able to locate the swing, etc. We were told room service began at 5. We called at 5 to get some milk for the kids and no one picked up and we kept being transfered to the front desk. The "resturaunt" only had one person working. The front desk suggested we call back in 15-20 mins. After the long, difficult day we had had, we need to get the kids in bed. We had to make our way back downstairs to get the milk. Clearly not life threatening, but the whole check in experience was a nightmare.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, San Diego North

review_text: Speedy check-in. Location is fine if you have a car - parking is free, bonus! Great complimentary breakfast, must try the waffles and the scrambled eggs. There's also coffee to go on offer! Room was clean and spacious. One evening there were some complimentary freshly baked cookies in the lobby - nice touch and delicious!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, San Diego North

review_text: Stayed at hotel Indigo, whilst at a conference in SD. A little boutique hotel, with attention to detail, great service and tasty food without the hyperbole and stiffness of most 4 star hotels. The rooms are luxurious, elegantly designed, spacious with a home like feel. Centrally located witin walking distance to gaslamp, convention etc. All staff are very helpful with a smile in their face I would not think twice about choosing indigo whilst in SD.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: This hotel was such a pleasant experience to stay at!! Its a very boutique-y hotel and I absolutely loved the room decor! We had a handicap accessible room so the shower was big although the shower head could have been a little better. And the counter at the sink wasn't very big to hold ur stuff. Other than that the bed was comfortable and the pillows were great! Our room had a Kurig coffee maker and iPod dock but our wasnt working just right , luckily we brought our own! The bar downstairs and lobby was very cute but we never made it to the terrace bar. The staff was very friendly as well. I was concerned we may have been too many blocks over to be in a good part of the city but it was actually perfect!!! Would definitely stay again and again!!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Great central location to see many sights in San Diego area.
review_text: We really enjoyed our stay. Great, plentiful breakfast buffet, friendly service and comfy rooms. Location is not good if you're interested in downtown, but we visited many areas, beaches, hiking trails and downtown easily.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, San Diego North

review_text: The room was beautiful! Love the King suite option, great when you have teenagers with you. Breakfast buffet was amazing and added to the experience. Free wi-fi in the rooms an added bonus! Looking forward to trying another location sometime soon!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, San Diego North

review_text:
After a 11 hour flight all we wanted to do was go to sleep. A straight forwardvrequest for an expensive hotel you would reckon ? The first 2 room we had were next to ice machines that were powered by merlin engines and the bed in the room next to it vibrated. Our only choice was to upgrade, which we only found out later was to upgrade the view. This room was on the top floor but we were kept awake all night by music form the bars and traffic noise. The windows might as well have no glass in them. There is also a bar terrace halfway up the building just to make sure you cannot escape from the noise. If you dont plan to sleep in the room then this is a perfect hotel as it is clean and modern, next to petco, etc, etc.
The staff are well aware of the noise issues and have excuses to the ready. Pity i prepaid via trivago otherwise inwould have left straight away. Try omni or the marriott.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: It was just okay, not worth the price. Can't trust housekeeping.
review_text: We stayed at the Indigo for three nights. The location was good in that it was walking distance to the main streets and places in the Gaslamp. The room was small and we expected more in terms of design. While the staff were friendly, there was a strange lack of knowledge about nearby restaurants, wine bars, etc. The worst part was that I left my fedora hat on the bathroom counter and housekeeping never logged it in nor turned it into lost and found. And the gentleman who wrote me an email to inform me of that fact never bothered to respond to my response to his email. Over the years, I've left things in hotel rooms that have always been returned to me. This was a first. Not being able to trust housekeeping when they are in your room every day is a big problem.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Good location, but lots of negatives
review_text:
My gf and I spent 3 nights here over the long 2011 4th of July weekend. We loved the location, but there are several reasons we'll stay elsewhere next time.
First the good:
* Location - Only 1 block From the southern end of the 5th street Gaslamp district. Loads of restaurants & bars nearby and within walking distance of Balboa park (a bit of a walk, so likely not good for small children or older folk).
* Cleanliness - Very clean & reliable maid svc.
* Toffee - Big ol' bowl at reception that my gf couldn't get enough of.
* French Toast - Mighty tasty French toast that comes w/ an otherwise average bfast buffet. However, skip the buffet unless it is included w/ your room rate. You can find much better for the $18 they otherwise charge.
* View - We had a 17th floor room that had a decent view of the water and the unexpected fireworks on Fri, Sat & Sun nights. However, if on a lower floor, your view is likely to be of the neighboring building's windows (i.e. keep your drapes closed).
Now for the bad:
* Mattress - It was one of the oldest, most uncomfortable ones I've slept on. The mattress & springs were ancient & they simply tried to improve it w/ a 1" think mattress pad. Needless to say, it didn't work & made the bed not only too soft, but also lumpy.
* Toilet - Mot only was the bathroom quite small, but the toilet flush was extrely loud - both from within the room and from neighboring rooms (both on the same floor & above). Both my gf & I were awoken several times by it. There is absolutely no way to sleep through it, especially if your partner needs to use it in the middle of the night.
* Age - While marriott does a good job of keeping it updated, it is getting older. From the tiny bathrooms to the thin walls, the infrastructure can't be changed.
* Valet - Luckily parking was included, otherwise it would've been something like $34/night. Plus, they left my car door ajar for 2+ nights such that my battery was completely dead, required a jump to leave (which took 45+ minutes), and had to be replaced when I returned to LA. Not reasonable for a battery/car that is less than 2.5 yes old.
* Management - My gf and I were a little bored & wanted to leave a day early to spend a night in Temecula. I'm a Mariott Elite who spends 30-40 nights a year in Mariott hotels. When I asked if it would be a problem tocheck out a night early, the day manager went into contract mode and stated the hotel's non-negotiable $150 early departure fee. When I simply asked if there was any way this could be waived for a good customer, she pulled out my signature on the reservation form, pointed to the fine print and said "see you signed in agreement of this fee when you checked in". I was taken aback as I was not being the least bit argumentative and ws simply asking if there was leeway. She couldn't care less and was quite rude.
Amyway, the hotel is decent, but there are MANY, MANY, MANY (did I say many?) more options in the area. I'll most definitely try another (non-Mariott property) next time.

review_title: Business class at a coach price
review_text: From the moment I stepped into this hotel I felt like I was at home. Fresher baked chocolate chip cookies, gluteen free breakfast items, EVERYONE spoke english, the room was big, and spacious and beautiful and quiet!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, San Diego North

review_text: Spent 2nice nights here in early November. Hotel is in a good location, within walking distance of the many bars and restaurants in the gas lamp area. Modern rooms are good, although soundproofing is not good. Having said that, we were not disturbed at all through the night. The 9th floor bar is great, with good views of the city. Breakfast was both nice and good value for a lage hotel. Would definitely come back.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Something for Every Kind of Traveler
review_text: Nice, very modern rooms. Located at edge of Gaslamp, so close without all the extra crowd noise. Super friendly staff.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Great hotel....location ok for business...not so much for recreation
review_text: Clean....new....upgraded..big suites...great breakfast...what else do you need. Can be a little pricey sometimes...but love this hotel
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Diego/Del Mar

review_text:
My fiancÃ©, son and I stayed at this hotel for a long weekend while I was out in Arizona for work. We got in just as dinner was ending on the first night and found that the location of the hotel did not have a great deal around it to choose from or stock up. The front desk clerk only offered up information for 2 pizza places in the area that delivered.
The location of the hotel was convenient to the 5 which was good for the rest of the stay. We drove up to Legoland one day and down to San Diego Zoo and Balboa Park the next with no issues. The location was also very convenient to the Scripps Aquarium in La Jolla.
The rooms were average to slightly dated. There was unfortunately no wireless Internet available in them so we tethered to our cell phone. Beds were comfortable and air conditioning worked well. There was a full size fridge which worked out well when we finally found a Walmart and Target a few exits down on the 5.
Breakfast was nightmare and the most stressful part of our day. This place seemed to be the hang out for EVERY family vacationing in the area. The breakfast area was cramped with little seating available inside and out. Just as we were leaving on our second morning they decided to open up one of the conference rooms for additional seating.
All in all, it was an average Homewood with a location that was convenient to the highway and not much else.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Diego/Del Mar

review_text: I stayed at this hotel while traveling for work. I was amazed by how pleasant and accommodating the staff is, especially the late night person, Dan. I had spoken, casually, about a destination I always meant to see in SAN, but never had. The next morning, there were directions to the location under my door. Very nice and thoughtful. Everything else about this location is pretty comparable to other homewood suites, but the service gives it the edge!
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Diego/Del Mar

review_text: This is THE most uncomfortable bed I have EVER slept on. It is now 3am and my back hurts and my skin is raw from the sheets.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn San Diego Del Mar

review_title: Hotel kinda sucks but looks cool
review_text: I rated the value a 3 because I dont know what my employer paid for the room. The restaurant, bar, and lobby look great. The breakfast was average... The dinner was awesome. The rooms are spacious but kind of ugly. My color scheme was blue and red. I couldnt turn up the heat past a certain degree, there was a coffee machine without any cream or sugar, and the bathroom didnt have a vent. Other than that it was alright. Room service was affordable.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: This hotel is classified as a 3 star and I understand why based amenities but I give it 4 stars for a rating. Our room was basic but spacious and clean. We loved the breakfast the fitness room and the pool. Not luxury but not far from it. Nice staff too. We got our room on Priceline very cheap ($50/night!) well worth it. :)
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, San Diego North

review_text: Stayed here 7-10 Oct 2011. Got a King room on the 12th floor and it was very modern and clean. We had cupcakes in our room when we arrived which was a nice touch. Very close to gaslamp and close to shopping and restaurants.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Good place for your family trip to San Diego attractions.
review_text:
Our family of four (kids 4 yo and 6 mo) stayed here for a recent trip to Sea World. The hotel is close to the freeway to make trips to attractions easy. We made the mistake of trying to go to Sea World on the same day as the San Diego Rock-n-Roll Marathon, however, that turned a 15 minute trip into an 90 minute trip. 
Check-in was easy. We had a double queen suite, that was a good size and generally clean, but not spotless. The in-room refrigerator is more than large enough for a few days of food. The kitchen included plates and utensils. Call housekeeping for dishsoap and a cleaning sponge. They also brought us a crib for our little one. 
You can stock the fridge with food from the grocery store that's only a couple minutes away, by car. The breakfast is great. The gratis dinner is NOT served on the weekend.
There was supposed to be free wi-fi in the common areas, only; but even there we were never able to get on the network. The front desk personnel were unable to help us with that. They just directed us to the business center. While the computers there are functional, they could probably use some updating. I specifically recall at least one sticky mouse that made navigating the Internet frustratingly inefficient. I think you can pay for a plug in or wi-fi in your room.There were a few eateries near the grocery store, but most of them closed by 9pm.
The jacuzzi had a less than clean appearance, we were told, due to age and nothing else. It would fill with foam when the jets were running. The pool is small, and unless you get there when towels are first stocked in the morning, you may have to bring your own from the room. I understand that they may be improving the pool and jacuzzi.
Parking was free and ample, but not covered.
All things considered, I would go back to this hotel with my family, but not for a couples getaway or any special occasion.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Diego/Del Mar

review_text: My family spent 4 nights at the Homewood Duites over March Break. The staff was terrific. The hotel clean and well appointed. The breakfast and dining area were well staffed so it was a great start to our day. I just wish they had free wireless in the rooms. Highly recommended and I would happily stay there again.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Diego/Del Mar

review_title: One of the cleanest, quiet hotels I have stayed in during my 30 years of travel with great breakfast very friendly staff.
review_text: Great place to stay and would definitely stay there again if ever back in San Diego.Front desk staff extremely nice- great breakfast inlet- fresh fruit, great service. Heated pool which was very clean. Room clean and quit. Quiet location but easy Acess to I-5.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn San Diego Del Mar

review_text: When we arrived, the valets were really helpful and we had a very speedy check in. The room was very modern and clean, with a huge bed which was very comfortable. The hotel is quiet so we had a very restful night. The breakfast menu is limited, the fruit options were definately nicer than the bacon and egg choice (looked microwaved). All the staff were very friendly and the hotel has free wi-fi. Very pleasant stay and would definately return / reccommend.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: We were so pleased with our stay at this hotel. The breakfast buffet and complimentary welcome meals were very good. They had waffles, eggs, potatoes, cereal, oatmeal, and of course all the breads that go with a yummy breakfast. Also, the rooms were very clean. We liked the king suite so that our kids stayed in the living room and we had our own room. It is a surprisingly kid friendly hotel, with a good-sized pool and jacuzzi. The location is about 15 minutes from Sea World. We drive to Old Town and dropped out car off and took the trolley onto downtown. There is free parking there And the kids loved riding the trolley. Service is great at this hotel and it feels very secure and safe, and its quiet.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Diego/Del Mar

review_text: This is the place to stay! From the time we called with a last minute reservation until we left every staff member was awesome! We got to the hotel around 6 pm and were told they were having a complimentary taco bar including beer and wine, something they offer every Monday through Thursday! The room was spotless, I may never stay in another hotel type again!!!
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Diego/Del Mar

review_title: Super value, great, friendly and clean
review_text:
Staff is super friendly.
Rooms are pretty nice, super clean.
LCD TV, large nice bed, good comfort for a super price!
Why stay elsewhere when you re on a short stay in SD?
Only inconvenient is that you hear the noise of the street sometimes. But really not a big deal to me.
Stayed 3 nights in Dolphin motel. Staff and owners were friendly and very helpful. Location is also great. Highly reccommended.

review_title: Great hotel in SD gaslamp area
review_text: This is a great hotel in a great area! Also, I believe the value for money is generally better than other hotels in the area. Two caveats: 1) the hotel is dog friendly, which I love but others might not, 2) other reviews complained about noise from some younger guests. I had no problem with noise and loved the hotel.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Great location and an excellent value
review_text: I stayed for two nights an was very pleased. The room was a little small and a bit spartan but the location is wonderful. It is a short walk from many restaurants and the marina.And for $55 it can't be beat.

review_title: Great hotel in the heart of San Diego
review_text: Modern, New, Stylish and central to San Diego and the Gaslamp area. Rooms are modern and the showers are huge. Ask for a room overlooking the Ball Park as you can see the games out the window. On the 9th floor there is also a rooftop deck that you can sit in sun loungers and see the baseball games. Also recommend you take a late night walk to 5th St and go to the Ghradelli chocolate Store and get an ice cream!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Don't judge a book by it's cover
review_text:
Driving into the car park of this place I had that oh no feeling but I was pleasantly surprised.
The rooms as pointed out are a bit small but if you want extra space book a room with a single bed and a queen which makes a big difference for not much more cost.
The room was clean and made up every day.
The location in point loma is great and is ideal if you don't want to be in downtown but still close enough to everything.
Staff were very helpful 24hrs a day. The rooms closest to the road can be a bit noisy from the traffic so choose wisely. The walls are also a bit thin but if you have noisy neighbors call the reception who will gladly come and tell them to shut up like they did for us.
You will struggle to find better value for money than here. It ain't luxury but it fits the bill.

review_title: Familiar Courtyard Design in Beautiful, Convenient Spot
review_text: We expected to arrive on a late flight and were looking for convenience, but not right at the airport. A few minutes away, this fit the bill. When we missed our connecting flight, we had to delay our arrival, leading to momentary confusion at the desk. They recovered nicely and found us a 4th floor room with harbor view. Location was great, parking free, staff friendly, and breakfast buffet with omelet bar a delight. Abuts park with beautiful harbor walk past site of old Navy Training Center. Also recommend the walk across the parking lot to Oggi's Sports Bar.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text:
Hotel Indigo is in a great location downtown. You can walk to all the shopping and nightlife in the Gaslamp District, and other SD attractions like the zoo are just a short drive away. The rooms are comfy but modern and the bathrooms were huge. The best thing about Hotel Indigo was the pet loving atmosphere. Even though we didn't have our dogs, we appreciated that there were no restrictions on pets and you can tell they were treated as family members. Guests were even allowed to bring their dogs to the rooftop lounge! The service was excellent and the people working there were so nice.
Tip: look on expedia for deals on this hotel. I booked this hotel through that site and received about a 50% discount since I looked at the right time.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text:
Small, clean, and perfect. No frills. The rooms are small, the hotel is small, and the staff is awesome. I've stayed at many hotels around the world and my stay here was definitely the most unique. 
My wife, 3year old daughter, and myself shared a 12 by 12 foot room (approximately). No desk or work area but we took our savings by staying here and spent it at the zoo and Seaworld. This is the first review i've ever written because I was so happy with the value and hospitality offered here.

Amazing service, the owners were make you feel at home. They help you with EVERYTHING!! We were amazed with how wonderful they are. Also the place is near the Marina and in a very nice area. You have many restaurants in walking distance. Highly recommended :)

We really enjoyed the stay at Hotel Indigo. The rooms were very modern and stylish and we liked that it was a green hotel. We ate at the restaurant off the lobby and had room service and the food was excellent. We also had drinks at the 9th floor rooftop lounge which has a great view. I used the fitness facility and it was nice but not a lot of equipment. It was very clean and I liked the small meditation area outside. The hotel is in a great area, in walking distance to restaurants and nightlife. The hotel is extremely dog friendly which was fine with me as I like dogs but be advised they are welcome everywhere in the hotel:)
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: Indigo is in a perfect location a few blocks outside of Gaslamp. My husband and I came here for 4th of July weekend with our pup. This hotel was great for us and our pup, it's incredibly dog friendly & so is the staff. We have an 85lb. Retriever. Check out the roof deck bar, that's a must!! Surprisingly got an awesome deal for the stay on hotelplanner.com. We thought being a holiday weekend we would pay high rates.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: Fun little motel. Very clean. Small room with great TV with lots of channels. Good value. Fabulous staff.

The white walls, bed linens and towels make the room and bath feel clean and crisp! Free WIFI, breakfast included, and it is the perfect place for BIRDERS & FISHERMAN going on boat trips across the street at the Fisherman's Landing Marina. Small family owned motel is well run. Personal service is amazing. Awesome restaurant suggestions. Great location and really inexpensive for the location!!

This is a great hotel, the service is the best. Super great value if you get the breakfast included in your room rate. The staff at breakfast is great!! Our room had a great view of the water and the pool. They have a great "quite" time starting at 10pm!! And the parking is free!! Great hotel!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text: My wife and 4yr old daughter stayed at this hotel back in April when we visited San Diego on vacation from UK. The comfort and convenience of this hotel genuinely made our stay more memorable in San Diego. It ticks all the boxes from being clean, decent size room, guest services and location. The free ample parking also gives this hotel the thumbs up. Close by is a quaint shopping centre and an inviting park for families. The nearby walks are soothing and the hotel has a charming swimming pool which our little girl just loved. Getting around San Diego from this location is good and all in all it is value for money. We would 100% definetly come back on our next visit.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text: Paid $60/night. Stayed for 2nights. Friendly service,however, I gave it 3stars for service because the water was shut off half hour before check-out.Clean room. Modern tv and a fridge.

We stayed here after realising how expensive San Diego hotels seem to be in summer! The staff are excellent, extremely friendly and helpful. The room was small, which didn't bother us as we were out and about all day, and spotlessly clean. There are plenty of places to eat and drink nearby, and downtown San Diego is a five to ten minute drive away. We took a taxi one night and it didn't cost much. Breakfast is good. We enjoyed our stay here and thought it was great value for money. Can't praise the staff enough- excellet customer service.

Pleasantly surprised, A+ hotel service from the valet runners to the front desk. They always had a smile and was ready to assist anything. The room was great, modern and clean, a definite change from my normal sheraton and marriot. Wished we stayed in a better room with a view. Only downside I can think of is no rooftop pool for this hotel.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: A good San Diego Wedding weekend
review_text: Stayed here for a close friend's Navy wedding. Wedding was at the Naval Base across the street, rooms were nice, not cleaned very well in between our stay though. Our second night the fire alarm went off at 6 in the morning, because of "smoke in the kitchen". Overall had a good time, surrounding area is nice, places to go, things to do.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text: We recently stayed here. It is in a great location, close to everything. But we git what we paid for.......hard beds and uncomfortable pillows. I asked the front desk for more pillows and they were delivered by a housekeeper. Upon her arrival I told her we didn't need stay over service and she said ok. We left for the afternoon to find that they in fact come into our room and gave us new towels. My husband said that at the front desk there is a sign that states they come in every room every day. And that just makes me slightly upset. I work in the hotel business and when a guest states no room service, we do not enter their room under any circumstances and I expect that to be upheld at any other hotel. With that said it wasn't that bad but I def wouldn't stay there again.

IdÃ©alement situÃ© au nord ouest de Syn Diego. HÃ´tel bien entretenu et personnel sympa. La piscine est un peu petite et peu de places autour de celle-ci. Le restaurant est convivial et nous y avons trÃ¨s bien mangÃ©s ! Parking gratuit et jonction autoroutiÃ¨re Ã  proximitÃ© ! Wifi gratuit et fonctionnant mÃªme Ã  l extÃ©rieur
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn San Diego Del Mar

review_text:
This is a very nice motel, conveniently located in La Playa area in San Diego and run by professional and friendly people. We paid $104 (taxes included) for a 2 beds (1 queen and 1 singl), which is a pretty good deal.
I would definetively recommend this place to my friends, even the picky ones :)

I wish there were more places like this!
My boyfriend and I spent 5 weeks traveling around America and of all the placed we stayed this was by far our favorite, better than the 4-5 star places! It's not luxurious but who cares they have so much more to offer!
The staff were the best I've ever come across in any hotel, ever! (In America or Australia)
They are so kind and welcoming and will go above and beyond to help you with anything you need.Â 
They made our stay in San Diego even more wonderful than it already was.
We didn't have a problem with the size of the room, it was the perfect size for the 2 of us and our luggage! We stayed in places that cost more and had smaller rooms.Â 
There was plenty to choose from on tv, the bed was so comfy and the shower was great, and so clean!!
And it doesn't matter that there's no pool, you're only a few minutes drive to some of loveliest beaches America has to offer!
Breakfast was great, it was so lovely to sit out in the sun and enjoy a muffin and an orange juice with the staff always there to say good morning, offer the newspaper and make sure everything was ok.
We absolutely loved this place and I just can't say enough good things about the Dolphin Motel.Â 
WeÂ can't wait to get back to San Diego and stay here again.Â 
I would recommend this place to everyone. Awesome staff, great prices, great rooms!
Safe area, clean rooms, helpful staff, free parking, and good location for getting around sd
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text: Perfect, quiet spot for our "Daycation". Less than 5 minutes away from one of the best dinners we've ever had (Island Prime). Loved the free coffee, and they made connecting to the Internet super easy (both wifi and wired). Everything was clean and the staff was friendly and helpful with local recommendations.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text: Has everything you would need. Although a little far from every where in San diego, it is worth the money.
hotel_name: Residence Inn San Diego Scripps Poway Parkway

review_title: Great place to stay, will definitely go back!
review_text: The location is good. The staff is very friendly & helpful. Clean rooms with all necessities, no frills, but quiet & relaxing atmosphere. The rooms are small, but who goes on vacation to stay in their room? Highly recommended! Great price. I stayed in 5 hotels during my week & a half trip @ California and this was by far my favorite.

review_title: Great home base for our family.
review_text: Super-clean, really comfortable beds, quiet and friendly. Near to great views, a variety of restaurants and sites. Totally pleasant stay.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites San Diego Airport - Liberty Station

review_text: I am incredibly disappointed with my stay so far, we arrived yesterday after an 8 hour car ride and were checked in by a very uncaring, unsmiling girl at the front desk who said only one of my rooms was ready - at 3pm?! That's unacceptable. I reserved a room with a bay view and got first floor, looking at the pool. I would not recommend this hotel - terrible service
hotel_name: Homewood Suites San Diego Airport - Liberty Station

review_text: Will stay here again! Great modern decor. Clean. Great breakfast and cafe. Good hot tub. Great location.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text:
This hotel was perfect for our family. 
The highlights:
-Amazing esplanade trail with park along the trail that our kids loved, and mom loved jogging along every morning
-Balcony overlooking pool was very relaxing and great views
-Staff were all very friendly
-Pool and outdoor fireplace area were great
-Trader Joe's and Von's grocery stores super-close for beach supplies and groceries
-Starbucks and restaurants right in the adjoining retail area
-breakfast buffet was also delicious with friendly service. Omlettes made to order, waffles made to order, oatmeal with all the fixings, and fresh scrambled eggs and bacon etc... 
- the bar area was also very nice. 
-close to all the attractions, as far as freeway access and main street access. 
Cons: 
- maybe the airplanes were a little noisy, it didn't bothder us at all... But it is close to the Airport
-the elevator was slow. We ended up taking the stairs most of the time which isnt a bad choice. 
Overall a really friendly, convenient, nice hotel GREAT for families and other travelers. By far the nicest Courtyard I've ever stayed at. Stay here!!!!!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_title: Personalized attention in a remarkable setting.
review_text: The Hotel Indigo exceeds the expectations of travel goers. A fun and captivating modern atmosphere exists throughout the hotel. From a heavenly bed to a chic bar overlooking Petco Park, this hotel is sure to please all, including guests' four legged friends. My fiancÃ© and I couldn't imagine staying anywhere else! One particular individual, a bartender named William, who works there made our trip especially memorable by providing individualized attention combined with a friendly attitude to everyone in our group. After the experience he provided us with, we look forward to returning to the Hotel Indigo!
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: My husband, 8 year old daughter, and I stayed here in early July and really liked it. It was extremely convenient to the zoo and Sea World, and was near a very pretty park on the water. We did not notice any noise from the airport, and it was very nice to have plentiful, free parking. We stayed in a suite, which gave us tons of room, and our daughter loved the pool and hot tub. The beds were comfortable, and we liked the cafe downstairs for Starbucks and a quick breakfast. My only complaint would be the restaurant. We were very tired the first night, so we ate downstairs at the restaurant. The service was incredibly slow. I was a waitress in college, so I am usually very understanding when it is busy, but there were only 3 tables that night and our food took about 45 minutes. And it was not very good when it arrived. We ordered hamburgers from room service the following night and they were much better and quicker. Overall, a very nice place to stay with helpful staff.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text: Was going to Naval Medical Center San Diego and this hotel was highly rated and close by. The hotel looked a little dated but the room was clean and tastefully decorated. Although a bit small we would take the value over size any day. Breakfast the next morning in the courtyard was simple and generous. The owner regaled us with stories of their simple beginnings and told us all the good spots to see in town. This is a jewel hidden away among the big hotels. It almost felt like a bed and breakfast. Go stay with them! DO IT!

My boyfriend and I stayed at this hotel last week and overall had a great experience. When we arrived at Hotel Indigo we were greeted by Ellen, a helpful and friendly front desk employee. We were upgraded to a suite but when we arrived in the room there were a few issues that became somewhat of a hassle to get resolved. First off, I went to take a shower & the water temperature was basically luke warm. The water temp was rectified after one phone call to the front desk. We came back after a quick walk through the gaslamp quarter and found that the problem with our shower was fixed but now the toilet wouldn't flush, again with the phone call to the front desk & another maintenance visit. With all that said, everyone was extremely helpful and understanding about
how frustrated we were & they did
everything in their power to correct
the problem. From then on we had
a fantastic stay in a beautiful room
with great staff. The happy hour on the rooftop bar was great and Adriana in hotel lobby bar was friendly and warm. We will definitely
be back even though our stay started off rocky because the staff made up for all the initial inconveniences. Thank you guys for really making our trip special.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: Elegant, modern, and relaxing place to stay!!!
review_text: A friend and I stayed here and could not have been more pleased! The rooms were stunning and the service was great! Dieter took amazing care of us and I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel to anyone.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: The only negitive feature with this hotel is the walls seem a little thin.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites San Diego Airport - Liberty Station

review_title: Nulla di che ma sufficiente per passare la notte
review_text:
Le camere sono ampie se siete fortunati con frigo bar,la pulizia non Ã¨ il massimo,abbiamo trovato una macchia sulla tenda della doccia che sembrava essere sangue.
