hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Hollywood Walk of Fame

review_text: The Hotel Indigo is an awesome place to stay. Not to mention that they are a pet friendly hotel as well. The staff is exceptionally nice and very helpful. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who is looking to stay in the Gas Lamp District.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: Twice a year we stay in this wonderful little motel in Point Loma right along the sportfishing waterfront. Rooms are meticulously clean. The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. They really made us feel like old friends. The motel owner and his son checked with us every day to make sure everything was as good as they could make it. Definitely THE place to stay!
Excellent. Clean rooms, friendly service, fantastic location, reasonable prices

Clean hotel. Has an outdoor pool for the kids. Located on the water with a nice walking path and park out back. On weekends a company comes and gives free paddle board lessons to hotel guests. I had a room on the first floor, much less noise than the upper floors. Keurig in room was convenient. Hotel also offered free coffee and tea bar in lobby along with refreshing citrus waters and juices. Was able to walk out back and watch three different firework displays on the fourth. Friendly staff, remembered our names. Would definitely stay here again. Also we had the breakfast special with room- great food! Omelets to order, waffles, oatmeal, cereals. Just a wonderful place, very family oriented.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_title: Nice property with superior customer service.
review_text:
Modern and outfitted with conveniences like free Internet and in-room coffee this was perfect for our overnight after visiting relatives in San Diego. They kindly offered a free razor and shaving cream when I discovered I'd forgotten to pack mine (a service I didn't expect from courtyard). 
Only problems we encountered were rock hard foam mattresses and poorly insulated rooms which allowed us to hear screaming kids, slamming doors and drunken partyers in adjacent areas.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_title: This is the place to stay!!!
review_text: My husband and I came for the weekend. We are originally from San Diego so we wanted our hotel to be central. We were VERY happy with our stay. For the price ($131)it was a real value. We had a bay view, beautiful walking trails, very nice looking hotel (you could have a wedding here)tasty breakfast, and a junior suite. Liberty station is a nice little town that needs to be seen by taking a walk. There are too many hidden away places. The hotel is just off of a plaza with a few very good places to eat. The Thai & sushi places are very good. There is a free shuttle to and from the airport but I'd recommend renting a car if you want to see the rest of S.D.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites San Diego Airport - Liberty Station

review_text:
Stayed four nights after a similar period in Anaheim. Proved to be an excellent base from which to explore San Diego and a relaxing contrast to our Anaheim accommodations (HoJo).
The hotel is well located if you've got a car but wouldn't be practical without one and the 300 odd acres that comprise the Liberty Station project is a lovely mix of parks, water and developed space.
Check in was swift and easy and the suite spacious and clean as a whistle. Very practical set-up, though another one of those hotels with a decent size kitchen area but without a toaster. 
Did the toaster manufacturers offend someone in the hotels caper at some stage?
The Darling Wife rated the gym as pleasant and knucklehead free and the kids enjoyed the (outside but heated) pool. The adjacent spa helped with my increasingly sore back and was hot enough to build up a mild sweat.
Th complimentary breakfast is useful (if somewhat rudimentary) as were the "welcome home dinners. Quiet observation of the waffle bar confirmed suspicions as to root cause of the rate of diabetes in the US.
Having been on the road with two kids for a week, a bright, clean laundry room was a welcome sight and a boon for the traveller with the long itinerary.
Only con for me was that the beds were very soft and by day three I as waking up with a nasty back ache.
Overall, a great base for a family with wheels to base themselves to look around San Diego.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites San Diego Airport - Liberty Station

review_title: Great customer service! Talk to Melissa at front desk.
review_text: We booked the hotel room for my sisters 30th BDAY. Right from the beginning the staff had great customer service, however to help us further they asked if our stay was for a special event and I expressed it was for her 30 th BDAY. At no cost they up graded our room and asked if we wanted to bring any champagne in for them to place on ice for her arrival. Melissa at the front desk staff was the most helpful, however everyone was very friendly and helpful. The building is gorgeous and we enjoyed our stay greatly! We will absolutely come back.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text:
I really enjoyed my stay at the Dolphin Motel ! Very friendly and helpful people, great location, clean room, free wifi... and nice price !
Thanks a lot for this great week in San Diego !

review_title: Do not accept handicapped rm unless you must.
review_text:
We found the inn via trip advisor and disregarded the review that discussed the handicapped room assuming we would be informed if we were getting this room and could decline.
We were surprised and very disapointed to find that we were in this room. While it has only a full size bed they charge more for it than for a queen room(which is not only unethical but possibly illegal, it would be in NY where we are from)
This room is tiny, loud, dirty and the bathroom is downright shocking. There is no lip at all for the shower so water covers the entire bathroom when you shower. It is terribly slippery and oviously makes it hard to keep clean as it was dirty(mildew/mold) and made me long for shower shoes of the type I wore years ago while backbacking in SA on a shoe string budget.
Unfortunatly this was not $10 hostal where such a thing would be 
expected.
While the hotel itself was clean and the location was conveniant the room is something they should mention on booking.
When I suggested this on checkout and expressed my shock over the bathroom, strange overcharge (why would a full cost more than a queen?) I was laughingly informed that the bathroom in the handicapped room is one of the,"better,larger" bathrooms in the Inn!
We wanted to like this Inn but felt taken advantage of and then further mocked when we politely suggested they inform clients of the style of this room we were forced to leave with a bad taste in our mouths and profound surprise at the shocking lack of any sort of customer service.
If you like elements,aloft,W or Hyatt place give it a try. Hotels aren't cheap in SD but this is reasonable and if you are in town to see a Padres game you can't beat the location.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_title: For the value, nothing comes close
review_text:
Normally, for the rates we've paid at the Homewood Suites for the past 3 years, we'd expect to get something far less clean, pleasant, and professional. The rooms are impeccable. The grounds are gorgeous - right on the water with a beautiful esplanade for incredibly relaxing strolls. The staff are friendly and extremely helpful. The pool is always crystal clear and clean. The included breakfasts (7 days/wk) and dinners (4 nights/wk) are a great way to save even more money. Full kitchens in the rooms. Location is perfect - beautiful and serene, not noisy or in a sketchy part of town, but within 5-10 minutes of downtown, balboa, mission bay, etc... 2 minutes from the airport. 
We've stayed here for the past 3 years with our family of five and have zero complaints. We stay for 3 weeks at a time and have never had a problem. We checked in late this year and so got the slim-Pickens on rooms, but the manager was very understanding and helped us find a bay-view room above the pool the very next morning. One night the people across the hall were being noisy until 1am, so I called the front desk because my kids couldnt sleep. Within 5 minutes, two security guards were the escorting people out and there wasn't another peep. 
We've thought of staying at another hotel/resort in San Diego, just to mix things up, so that the kids don't get bored with the same place year after year. But everything else I check either costs at least twice as much or is not nearly as nice and clean and perfectly located. You can't go wrong here! For your money, there is not a better value in San Diego.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites San Diego Airport - Liberty Station

review_text: I stayed here with my husband & our two children, ages 2 & 6. The purpose of our stay was to visit Seaworld & the beach. I was pleasantly surprised by this hotel. The rooms are modern, the room/bathroom was clean and the staff is wonderful. Even the two restaurants and Starbucks coffee bar were excellent! I highly recommend this hotel for business or pleasure.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text: Great choice, everything was perfect !! Go phillies !!

I had a great stay here - the hotel is in a beautiful old building but has been restored/renovated so it's very clean and orderly.
The room was quite small but very well organised with everything you need - table and chair, tv, extra pillows, storage space etc all fitting in nicely.
The location is great and traveling alone i felt safe in the area.
Staff are friendly and breakfast goes late on the weekends, finally a hotel that gets that part!

review_title: Can't wait to return to this amazing place!
review_text:
I scheduled us for a weekend trip to PT to include a renewal of our wedding vows on 11-11-11. Our fabulous weekend started with the assistance of Angela from PT. She was a great help in getting the "ceremony" put together. The entire staff went above and beyond make this a most memorable trip. Then you add the quality of the hotel and the location right on the beach, perfect!
I have never had the level of service and attention to detail from any hotel, ever!! We can't wait to come back!!
If possible, do get a 2 or 3 floor room as the views are amazing. I also found the new expanded breakfast very enjoyable.

The service here is great. My husband and I did not rent a car we thought we would just use taxis. We wanted to eat somewhere local so we asked the front desk to call us a cab. Instead they offered us the use of the shuttle. When we were done eating we called the hotel and the shuttle picked us up right away.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott San Diego Airport/Liberty Station

review_text:
Stayed at this hotel for one night. Staff was really nice. Hotel was really nice, room was very large and was very clean.
Valet is pretty pricey but there are lots local and there is also street parking. Would recommend that if possible, that's what I did.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text: Wow, what a nice hotel. Really exceeded expectations. The staff were so helpful and the rooms and pool were clean and comfortable. Can recommend.

At first arrival, we were surprised at how tiny our room was, but it certainly had everything we needed. Updated and very clean, they do a great job using what space they do have.
Everyone was soooo friendly and helpful!! Breakfast was pretty good with plenty of choices.
Awesome rates, great value for a hotel.

review_title: One of the best hotel & service in our California trip
review_text:
The location of the hotel is great, right in front of the beach, with only a pathway in the middle. 
The pool and jacuzzi were a pure delight for our two kids and ourselves.
The personnel is extremely attentive to all your needs, all without exception are smiling and greeting you with a positive energy.
The room was nice (we got uograded to family suite), very roomy and equipped with all that's needed to enjoy lunches or breakfasts in the privacy of your room.
We can only recommend that hotel!

review_title: Excellent property with a Resort feeling!
review_text:
Thank you to Duncan & the staff for making our stay in San Diego a fun & relaxing time! Excellent service! We look forward to visit again.
P.S. Love the breakfast waffle makers! 
The PATEL's
hotel_name: Homewood Suites San Diego Airport - Liberty Station

review_title: This is heaven and the nicest Hotels that we have ever stayed
review_text:
This Hotel was selected by us bSed on the trip advisor ratings and comments from trip advisor members
Before we stayed here we sent a simple request to the Hotel regarding a venue for ourselves Nd our teenage children for New Years Eve.
The response from John (the General Manager) and Jason from Guest Services (obviously a GM in training) was nothing short of exceptional with details, transport, menu and an introduction to a beautiful restaurant where we are currently sitting enjoying a beer as we count down to Midnight here in New York
This is the ONLY hotel that we have ever provided maximum ratings for and if there were six stRts they would have received six!
The only small recommendation would be to consider soft drinks for teenagers for the hAppy hour drinks in the bar of an evening
Seriously this Hotel is all that it has been reported to be and is certainly value for money!

review_title: Couldn't do enough for you, couldn't be a better location
review_text:
We stayed in New York City for six days in December. We stayed in the Hotel Elysee for the entire trip. There was four of us in two rooms. A twin deluxe room and a suite.
Both rooms were suprisingly spacious. The suite was HUGE! If you don't mind dated decor and furniture (it seemed to just be the theme of the hotel) then I could not fault this hotel.
Almost everywhere we went (in winter!) was walkable. Cabs that we caught were not long journeys nor expensive trips. The service from all staff was exceptional especially, in my opinion, the front desk. 
From making car and restaurant reservations to booking tickets for tours, theatres or american football they could just not do enough!
Overall our stay was incredible and i would recomend this hotel to anyone. I garauntee I'll stay at the Elysee again!

review_title: The pacific terrace pretty much sums it up,love to open all the doors , take in the tremendous view and fall asleep to the sound
review_text: We love to stay here when ever we have the chance and we live right down the street. We have stayed in many of the rooms and the are all great. The Kingston suite is my favorite,the best part of the stay is the incredible staff!!!

I've ben to this hotel twice and they've over booked my room both times, but with that said they were very gracious and helpful they upgraded my steady both times. The location could not get any better right in the center of pacific beach and inches off the ocean. The staff is wonderful and the rooms are comfortable and modern. I would recommend this hotel to anyone staying in the PB area.

I came on a long weekend trip with my sister and our parents. We had 2 rooms so we were able to enjoy a room with a street view and a quieter room. The hotel staff was amazing and didn't even have to be asked for help...they did it all. We loved that all the rooms are unique and the hotel was very intimate and charming. We also met others that have been coming here for over 20 years and wont stay anywhere else in NYC.

review_title: Depends what you are looking for
review_text: I had high expectations based on the other reviews and ended up somewhat disappointed. The Service was Fantastic - but the hotel itself is small and out dated. The rooms are decorated in old decor that reminds you of being in England in the 80's - complete with VHS machine as entertainment. Bathrooms are tiny! You hear all of the street noise from the front rooms, difficulty sleeping. Now on the plus side the staff is very helpful. Breakfast and wine party are pluses. Overall I would recommend this hotel if my grandma were visiting the city because I know the staff would take good care of her. The hotel seemed to appeal to a lot of Europeans also. For the price though there are many more interesting modern hotels in the city.

review_title: Gorgeous botique hotel w/ impecable service and cleanliness.
review_text: Gorgeous view of petco park and easy walk to gaslamp district. Extremely dog friendly. Rooms are always impeccably clean and staff is most inviting. Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone staying downtown. Showers are large and great water pressure. Beds are out of this world comfortable and nice, big flatscreen. Menu is simply amazing in restaurant and room service equally as enticing. Have stayed at least a dozen times and always been satisfied.
hotel_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Gaslamp Quarter

review_text:
Booked a spontaneous visit for our anniversary, partly on recommendations from friends. Nice area and neat old building, but otherwise a huge disappointment--and this is normally just my kind of place: quirky and unique.
Problems:
We noticed a few days after booking that they were running a fall special. However, they insist that we have to keep the rate as it was when booked--about $50 a night more. Bummer!
After reading reviews about noise downstairs, I requested by phone when booking a 2nd or 3rd floor room, and was told I was booking a 2nd floor room. We arrive, and guess what? First floor close to the entry, and all other rooms booked.
The bed: AWFUL! I have a 12 year old cheap mattress at home--this thing is like sleeping in a hammock. Super saggy. 
I also find the decor really lacking in charm and warmth, bur that's just personal taste. However, don't bother with a suite--the furniture and lighting are such that I have a hard time imagining anyone using it... ?
Seriously considering moving to another hotel for our 2nd night. Big disappointment!

Way too expensive for what you get!! No restaurant, charge $20 for parking, didn't even clean the room our first day, the lady came to do turn down service, we told her it hadn't even been cleaned yet. She did a few things but didn't clean, no fresh pool towels and did not replenish the coffee. Normally not a big deal but when you are paying close to $400 a night it better be perfect!!
Free breakfast could use a boost, but the people and property were perfect!

review_title: Lovely hotel and delightful staff but desperately in need of sound-proofing.
review_text:
If they'd sound-proof the rooms a little this hotel would be great.
I could have put up with the singing from the piano bar across the street but the middle-of-the-night trash trucks kept me up for an hour.
The clerk at check-out didn't seem at all surprised by my noise complaint. I suggested they warn people in advance or offer a fan as white noise but he basically shrugged and politely said to call the front desk when there's an issue. But at 3 am it's already too late. 
That was awkward but the staff was wonderful. My spacious room was immaculate. Carb fans will appreciate the free breakfast (no eggs/meat). Free wifi in the room and throughout the hotel. No view but very good location.

review_title: Perfect boutique in the heart of new york
review_text: We have spent many short stays at the elysee and find it to be a home away from home. The staff if necessary will go out of their way to help and the breakfast area on the second floor is a great find. The location is great whether for shopping or the theater and they have one of the finest restaurants right there, the Monkey Bar. Try it, you will like it.

review_title: So Romantic, but stay on the 3rd floor!!
review_text: My husband took me here for our anniversary after I read amazing reviews in a magazine. The first night we stayed in room 31 which we loved, no one was above us so we didn't have all that creaking floor noise. We visited the attached restaurant Ocho, great service, but a little overpriced for mediocre food, but still enjoyed the conveniance. The bar was dark and romantic if you can find a couch to sit on, and it seemed like a fun hang out for groups of friends as well. The second night we got a suite on the second floor. Nice, but we liked our first room better, and the first room was cheaper. We went to the riverwalk, and as said before by others, 10 minute walk tops, but walking back at night can be a little scary cause the last 3 blocks are away from the crowds and you have to pass locals that I didn't necessarly feel safe walking by. Overall great stay for a unique romantic hotel that I would definitely do again, but in room 31:)

review_title: Outstanding. Customer service is clearly their highest priority.
review_text: Every single person I enteracted with, from the front desk to the maintainance guys to the maids, everyone was absloutly delightful. Everyone said hello to you with a willing and genuine smile. They were there to answer questions when you had them and make arrangments for you. The hotel is beautiful. Excellent location. It was a delight to stay there. A+

review_title: Spanish Colonial with class and cool, for over 50 nights since July 2010, Hotel Havana San Antonio is my home, resort, retreat,
review_text: The staff are gifted and responsive to every need. The rooms are filled with class and comfort for the world traveler. This exquisite property will impress any 5 stÃ r snob or the precious spirit that seeks high value rest and comfort in an amazing historic property located on the most beautiful part of the San Antonio River. All who work at the Havana seek to please the guests and the owners have given the staff the tools and leadership to make pleasing possible.

review_title: Relaxing and comfortable with family of 4
review_text: I been reading searching which hotel to stay at. It was between Del or pacific. We are so glad we choose the pacific. The first step you wall in their hotel you are treated so kindly from hotel front to bell man to the guy ay the pool. The rooms are beautiful and large enough room for two kiddos. The view is breath taking I would suggest if you already going stay and not sure if you want to pay extra for the view. I would say do it. It's worth it. We stay in pool until 945 at night, our kids where hungry went down stairs to see where we can walk to get them bite to eat they gave us a packet and said these people delivery. This is wonderful hotel we will be back. The night before we stay at their sister hotel The Dana that was a waste pacific terrance all the way

review_title: A truly wonderful place to stay in New York City!!
review_text: My husband and I stayed at Hotel Elysee earlier this month. While we have visited New York City many times before -we love the city - this was our first time staying at this hotel. Our stay was wonderful! It exceeded our expectations!! The hotel was lovely, our room was spacious, and the staff were very friendly and welcoming! When I booked the hotel online I informed them we were visiting New York to celebrate our anniversary and when we arrived in our room a bottle of champagne and chocolate were waiting for us! It was all very romantic! The hotel was very well situated within walking distance of theatres, shopping, and great restaurants. We will certainly recommend Hotel Elysee to our friends and we look forward to staying there again on our next visit to New York City!! Wonderful, wonderful hotel!!

Service from the staff was outstanding. Were willing to provide any help needed, and were very friendly. Great location, although tough to get a cab out front. That said, the doorman walked us and our luggage 1/2 block to Park Ave and immediately got us a cab. Very professional and courteous.
Excellent service. Staff was wonderful. Beautiful property in the perfect location. Very high class.

My husband and I just spent
three lovely nights at the Hotel Elysee! We have stayed at other NYC hotels in the past but chose the Elysee this time around. It is a smaller intimate hotel and has a very relaxed feeling which we enjoyed. It is located in the heart of Manhattan and was within walking distance to most of the sites we wanted to see. We found the staff very helpful and the Club Room was a great bonus for breakfast, afternoon snacks and wine/appetizers on the weekdays. We hope for another visit soon!

review_title: A tropical escape divulging guests in superior quality, personal attention and the most eloguent guestrooms including grounds an
review_text: i have returned to Pacific Terrace five times in a year. I have never been treated so well, had solice and my needs personally met.

We had a wonderful time in NYC in this brilliant hotel. Great location in a slightly quieter but still vibrant part of town, plenty of good places to eat locally and very helpful friendly and effective staff. A great base to discover the joys of NYC from.

review_title: Perfect place to stay in new York
review_text: It is the perfect place tp stay away from the hussle of the city but only steps away from everything. The rooms, services and breakfast were exceptional. Loved it!!!

My husband and I stayed at the Pacific Terrace Hotel in September for 4 nights. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The room was clean, beautiful view of the ocean and conformable beds. The location is also great, good restaurants, shopping areas, and at walking distance. I will definitely be staying here when I return.

This boutique hotel is the epitomy of good taste and impeccable service. Every staff member--and I do mean every--has been trained to provide the friendliest and most accomodating service. The beauty is this is not a pretentious hotel, but is comfortable and genuine. What it lacks in size and overall amenities, it more than makes up for in location and room comfort.
This is a good hotel in a location with easy access to Riverwalk & Alamodome! Good service & comfortable rooms completes this package!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Sunset Suites - Riverwalk

review_text: The service was impeccable. The grounds were gorgeous. The spa was excellent. If you're trying to pick between here and sanctuary (like I was), trust me choose here. You'll love the cozy & romantic aura.....and yes they know you by name.

An exceptional hotel with great views. My only complaint is that there is not a bar in the hotel. I guess I got by on the mini bar in the room. I would definitely stay here again but I promise you I'll have my own bottle next time
Stayed sept 2011 great hotel helpful staff, room was cleaned everyday, around 15 minute walk to times square with good access to the subway. Had a great time great city great hotel x

Took my wife up to ny for her 30th. This place did an amazing job getting our room ready. Balloons, Prosecco, cupcakes, and chocolate were waiting for us when we arrived pretty late at night. We had a great time here and hope to be back soon.

Hotel Giraffe is a great choice if you need two beds, which can be very difficult to find. This hotel caters to mainly to business clients and is an excellent value. We are repeat customers and find the hotel to be upscale and at mid-scale prices. The staff are friendly and the complimentary continental breakfast is nice if you are in a hurry. There are plenty of good restaurants nearby and the lack of a hotel restaurant is not really an issue.
Outstanding facility for pleasure as well as business meetings. Very warm and friendly staff, cozy atmosphere but all the amenities of a large luxury hotel.

This was our second stay at Hotel Giraffe. This time we brought the kids. Convenient,clean and a great staff. The Giraffe is located near the subway in a neighborhood that is away from the hustle and bustle but full of great restaurants and near Madison Square Park.
The staff of the Giraffe go out of their way to make sure you have a great stay. The suite with the separate living room was a great place for our family to gather for watching our SEC football and relaxing when we were not at the US Open.

We stayed for 5 nights. The free bike usage, the half price breakfasts, the promptness of staff and service and the location as well as a nice, large room, including large private patio made it worth it's price. Pool and hot tub are nice! They have pool service for drinks, etc but also have free ice tea, lemonade. Free warm cookies in the evening, turn down service in the evening with chocolates on pillow. Nice robes. All the little touches added up to a very nice stay. We rode bikes everyday, keeping the bikes all day one day. Very prompt valet with both the car and the bikes! Our room was very quiet as I requested and even though they said we had a non- view room, we actually had a peek of the ocean! We didn't have to look at a parking lot or wall!

review_title: A place like home - didn't feel like leaving
review_text: I had a fantastic stay. Very good,knowledgeable staff.I stayed in a petite single room - just right for me. The room was great with romantic lighting. The reception area on the second floor was homely. The staff was so helpful and smiley. I stayed for 8 days and actually felt I haven't enjoyed enough when I left. The location, close proximity to the skating rink in Bryant Park made holiday shopping convenient till late at night. My only choice of a hotel in New York city.

review_title: Won't stay anywhere else in SD
review_text: This place defines excellent service! I have honestly never stayed at a hotel with more accommodating staff. Everyone was very pleasant and asked what more could be done to improve my stay. Heated pool and hot tub were clean. Great location on beach. Breakfast was tasty but a little expensive.

This hotel was great. Tastefully decorated and very clean! There is a trolley/bus depot right across from the hotel. You can get anywhere you need to go on the bus. They have a wonderful cooked breakfast. There is a small charge for adults $3.50. Kids are free. Breakfast items included ham, sausage, eggs, potatoes, waffles, biscuits, cereals, fresh fruit, yogurt, and more. It was well worth the small charge. Parking is free. You won't find that downtown. There is no pool. They do have an exercise room. No complaints at all. We had a wonderful stay!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Sunset Suites - Riverwalk

review_text: Nice hotel choice and great location. Rooms are smaller due to location but it has everything you need for a nice stay. I was Appreciative of the complimentary water bottles in the room as well as the wine/cheese and continental breakfast each morning on the 2nd floor. The staff seemed genuinely friendly and was responsive to my needs.

review_title: Beautiful hotel , awesome location resort like atmosphere friendly staff!
review_text: Once we got to pacific beach we were expecting average cheap hotels once we checked this one out there was no denying it, beautiful location gorgeous hotel and the staff was so friendly .. couldn't have asked for a better hotel in pacific beach, was within walking distance of the popular night life spots and even dinner and lunch places .. the rooms were so clean great patio and the bathrooms were unreal ! The pool and jot tub area was wonderful too , right over looking the pacific ocean and beach. Could not have stayed in a better hotel. Would absolutely recommend it to anyone , families ,couples, friends.

I had the pleasure of staying at this lovely little hotel for two nights October 6-8. I found it to be excellent with one small exception. For the first night, I experienced a great deal of overhead noise from the room above, so much so that I was awakened at 3:00am and was unable to return to sleep. Given the fact that one of my reasons for choosing this hotel was to rest, that issue was a bit disconcerting. Fortunately, the party above me checked out on the second night, and all was well. I highly recommend this hotel, but if you are sensitive to noise as I am, you would do well to ask for a second floor or single story accommodation. Other than that, the hotel is delightful, and I was well pleased.

We stayed in this hotel for part of our honeymoon and it really exceeded expectations!! First of all the manager of the hotel was so helpful and accommodating! All the staff were so polite and always smiling. Our room had the most fantastic view overlooking the beach it was just amazing! Rooms are really big and so comfortable. Bathroom was moderne and nice. One day when we hot back to the room there was a bottle of champagne in an ice bucket waiting for us! That was so nice of the staff to do that for us! Location is really good right next to the beach and near the shops and bars. Also breakfast in the morning was very good lots of food to choose from. The pool also was brilliant with a fantastic view of the ocean. All in all I highly recommend this hotel and will definitely be returning in the future!

This is our 8th visit to this resort!
It's like coming home!
Every one is so friendly service is excellent!
Jose poolside is a treasure and so obliging - as are front desk valet Jason bar chef and Chef Lee - combined with a first rate spa make this the ideal chill out
Cleaning staff need to be a little more vigilant on closing patio doors firmly - Although the hotel has excellent security our doors have on several occasions been left slightly ajar - the hotel has as always compensated us for this mishap
Look forward to another restful stay next year

Confortable rooms, nice breakfast, and great location. People were very polite and the glass of wine at the end of the day(included as the breakfast) were very good. Could have wi-fi in the rooms, but even not haven' it, it was just great.

I stayed here with my husband and two grown daughters this week for 3 nights, and we all absolutely loved it! The entire staff is exceptional. The rooms are spacious and extremely clean. We had no noise issues, and were on the seventh and fourteenth floors. Location was perfect for shopping and dining, and a quick cab ride to tv tapings and Broadway. This is definitely our unanimous choice for future trips to NYC. No more hassled big box hotels for us!

Planning a further trip -my third stay in this hotel & noticed your review of 2nd August re the missing money. My experience could not have been more different. The first time I stayed here I accidentally left money (euros) in the base of the safe; the safe was on the top shelf of the wardrobe & I couldn't see in properly. A family member who lives in New York was contacted the afternoon I checked out and told that I had left some money behind. I really appreciated the honesty of the staff member who found it.

In today's world, great customer service is rare. The Royal Palms is truly a rare find. The only time you hear the word no to a request is in there signature reply- "No Worries". Service is top notch throughout the resort and all take the time to not only remember your name but incredibly anticipate most of your desires. The real standouts here are the pool staff. Jose and Matt go above and beyond every day and greet any request with a genuine smile. They make sure each guest has a relaxing stay. I also have to send out extra kudos to the valet staff. Never once had to wait for my car and they were also ready with any directions you might need. Finally, please check out the Alvadora Spa. I got a 90 minute massage and truly melted on the table. This was our 3rd stay at Royall Palms and am already anxious to return. A big Thank You to all the staff for making our week long stay an incredible experience.

My husband and I stayed about one week, loved the convenient continental breakfast in the morning, cheese and wine hour was good although wine not to our taste..., turn down service nice, cute balcony bar, small DVD selection with some good titles.. we thought the staff were helpful, furnishings nice and good quality, large bed, rooms a little small eventhough we had a suite but very clean. Right near the subway. Would stay there again!

review_text: Great location & wonderfully worked literary theme. A quiet restful ambience conducive to reading, writing and reflection. Well done to all invalid for the welcoming service.

review_text: Wonderful locale, very friendly and helpful staff, nice continental breakfast, and reasonably priced. Only small complaint would be the street noise - ask for a room high up or in the back.

We chose the Hotel Elysee based on Trip Advisor reviews and we were not disappointed! The service couldn't have been better. Everyone was pleasant and very helpful. Our room was located on the 7th floor in the back. Though we had no view, we also had no noise, and the room was spotless. The location was perfect for us, between Madison and Park. We were able to walk to MoMA, Rockefeller Center, the theater district, and Central Park and were surrounded by shops and 
restaurants. The subway line was two blocks away. If you want a great take-out lunch, try the deli right across the street-it's filled with locals at lunchtime (always a good sign). During our four nights there we enjoyed the weeknight free wine and cheese in the evenings, and the breakfast of fresh bagels, muffins, fruit, juices, yogurts, and cereals, with wonderful service. 
We met a world traveler from Holland, who also found this hotel on Trip Advisor, and we all agreed that the atmosphere (more European) was much preferable to the large "famous" named hotels in NYC. On future trips to NYC we will certainly be staying at this hotel. Our 14 year old daughter can't wait to go back!

review_title: THE best service and breathtaking scenery
review_text:
One if the best hotels we have ever stayed in. Stayed here over labor day weekend and cannot get over how charming, cozy, and beautiful it was. All the good reviews could not be more accurate. The service staff was the most consistently great staff we've ever encountered. This can't be a fluke or good luck, must be part of their business plan! 
Weeks before we arrived, concierge Mona helped not just with suggestions but made arrangements for every detail from hot air ballooning to horseback riding to spa appointment. She kept in touch through email and phone calls to clarify details of our trip and to remind us of all sorts of things (like don't plan any outdoor activities between 9a and sunset during the Arizona summer! - thank goodness she warned us!). Upon arrival we met the quickest and most courteous valets in the business. While we were still pulling in looking lost at 11p trying to make sure we were in the right spot, two valets appeared, one on each side of the car and gently whisked away the car keys and our luggage and took care of everything! Everytime we needed the car they had it waiting for us outside in what seemed to be under 60seconds and every time we returned we were always greeted with two valets to help escort us and our baggages out of the car. 
At the pool was a staff of one gentleman (jose) who was unbelievably efficient, friendly, and ran the operation like a well oiled machine. It was scary how he always seemed to anticipate our every need well before we even realized it. Before we realized we were parched he was right there with large cups of lemon ice water - and refilled it well before it ever reached halfway empty. If we looked a little uncomfortable from a towel that was too wet, before we could decide what to do Jose was there with a dry towel...and he provided this degree of excellent service to every guest at the pool!
We loved how well this resort seamlessly blended indoor and outdoor space. Very classy and comforting decor all around. We stayed in one of the designer casitas. Very cozy and clean, but was disappointed that patio doors opened up to communal walking path and there was no view of the mountains. Will try for a balcony suite next time. Room may not be as spacious as other resorts, but decor very unique - they even had some classic books laying on ledges around the room which was a nice touch. 
Spa massages were okay, and once again decor and use of indoor/outdoor space made it worth experiencing. 
Planning our next trip back already!

review_title: Lovely bolt hole with wonderful team to make you welcome
review_text:
A terrific hotel in a really handy location. The rooms are very small (as you would expect) but very nicely done and without any 'cheese'. 
We arrived in the middle of the early snow storm and the hotel felt like such a haven, especially the reading room. 
The team makes it though and all seemed perfectly hand picked for their roles. Jessica on the front desk is charming but with enough personality to not be bland. 
The guys on the door all get the job just right and the ladies at breakfast & wine time remember you & make you feel like a friend after your first visit. 
We loved it & would highly recommend to anyone. A smashing little hotel deserving of it's rating.

review_text: The service at Grand Del Mar is impeccable - you will not find better. The grounds are beautiful, the food is great and the golf course is nice (the caddies will impress you with their knowledge of the local vegetation). The only downside that I can think of is that the hotel is about 15 minutes to the beach.

review_title: Best SAT airport hotel, tried many of them
review_text: The rooms here are your typical for this chain, kitchenette, medium bedroom with couch and desk, separate bath. What makes this hotel stand out are the staff. I travel 200 nights a year, and the staff here are outstanding. Friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable about the area. I stay at this hotel EVERYTIME I stay by the airport.

My fiance and I stayed here for our anniversary trip to SA and we really enjoyed our stay. The hotel is nice, and the pool is awesome. The free hot breakfast is great, and our room was nice. The bathrooms are designer so it feels more like a four star hotel rather than a three. My only complaint is that my bed at home is more comfortable than the one in the room, which I guess is probably my own fault lol. I got a new one not too long ago so I'm a spoiled sleeper. Wasn't uncomfortable tho. Room was very clean (actually the whole place was, the staff was always cleaning) and hotel was quiet for being so busy. Location was perfect for us because we went to the zoo the next day. Great place to stay, and rooms have a sofa bed so you can get away with four to a room if you need to.

After trying 5 different hotels last night that only had full size beds we found TownPlace! They knew what a Kong bed we! Www were starting to think that San Antonio did not I've queen or full beds! The front desk was so helpful and kind. Best breakfast on our trip as well! The entire family had a great sleep and even went for. Swim in The morning! We are very pleased.

Charming hotel in a perfect location. The staff is wonderful, great breakfast in the morning and wine reception in the afternoon. The room was a good size for NYC the bath was a bit small but adequate and nicely designed. We will always stay here when in NY.

from the moment you are greeted by name at the lobby to the last second you drive out the grand drive, you will be pampered in a veritable lap of luxury. This hotel has few peers (the Ritz Carlton Naples may be one). This is a hotel that spared no expense in any public spaces, whose guest rooms are simply gorgeous, and whose staff are as attentive and friendly as any I have ever seen. My wife and I spent four days there, and were sad to depart from the exquisite pools, the stunning grounds and golf course, and fine food and friends we made there. Simply amazing.

A heavenly little oasis in a hellish environment. The temperatures in Phoenix are 110++ during July and August, but rooms are cheap and you can score a weekend at a five star resort like the Royal Palms for a fraction of the normal price. the Royal Palms is an elegant old world property with lots of beautiful little courtyards and gardens, a delightful restaurant and lounge, and a beautiful pool. It's quiet and secluded and luxurious and totally relaxing. The service is wonderful and everyone makes you feel welcome and completely pampered.

You can't beat the location. Just two blocks away from Grand Central Terminal, which can pretty much take you anywhere in NY. I would recommend taking any of the shuttle busses from Laguardia or JFK to GCT. You will save $$$. The hotel rooms small, but really does that matter? It was clean, staff was great! Reading room was nice to have, water and fresh fruit available 24 hours a day. I won't stay in any other hotel when visiting NY!

review_text: This hotel is a magical find in Manhattan. The wine was a special touch in the evenings after a day of touring the city. The breakfast offered in the library area is a relaxing way to start your day. The location is perfect. This hotel does an outstanding job of making you feel as if you were in Europe..

Great service...very accomodating.
We were here in mid September, it wasn't crowded but there is plenty of property if it were.
The three walking paths offer light, medium or strenuous workouts. If walking is not your style, there is a fabulous gym. 
The rooms are luxurious with grand bathrooms and inviting beds.

Outstanding service - staff is very professional and caters to guests needs. Very personable. Facility grounds are beautiful. Rooms large and comfortable. Food is fantastic. Golf course is also outstanding.

This hotel sets the bar for all hotels. Luxurious rooms, excellent service and the food at the hotel restsurant was delicious (something that is unusual for a hotel restaurant). This property is pricey but worth every penny!!

review_title: Another great stay at the Elysee!
review_text: This was a return trip for us to the Elysee and again we very much enjoyed our time there. The small niggles over wi-fi access have all been sorted out and the level of service was high but not overdone in any way.

Excellent location, nice room, helpful staff, delicious breakfast.
Would recommend the hotel elysee to anyone.

review_title: This is no Holiday Inn Express
review_text:
From the minute you walk in the door and receive towels for your face and hands this place is an amazing hotel. It is not cheap however it is worth every penny of your stay. If I were to pick three places on this earth I might want to spend my final days, this would be in the top three.
It is a resort for families as well as for people without children. There are two separate pools. One pool is for families with children. And there is an adult pool for people who do not wish to visit with other people's children. And believe me, I brought my children and also spent some time at the adult pool.
The restaurants on site are very very good. Again, they're are choices for families as well as folks without families.
Service is absolutely impeccable. From the valets, to the restaurant staff, to the bellmen who help you with every aspect of your trip.
There are multiple fire pits, pools, and the grounds are absolutely beautiful. I did not get to play a round of golf, however from what I could see the golf course was one to aspire to.

Stayed here June 2011. Had a beautiful room with a lovely terrace. Rooms are a very good size for new York. Hotels just off 5th avenue which is perfect for shopping. Service was excellent. Would definitely reccomend this hotel to others.

review_title: If I go back to New York, this is where I'll stay!!
review_text:
Great location, central to attractions and interests. Staff very friendly and helpful. This hotel is set apart from the rest as you do get a continental breakfast which is not often offered in most hotels. Lovely touch is the complimentary wine and cheese late afternoon, which can be enjoyed in the wonderful reading room. Escape can be had in the open rooftop bar or enjoy a lovely meal in the Madison and Vine restaurant on the ground level, I definately recommend the Roasted Diver Scallops together with the Newton 2008 Chardonnay. 
Rooms are smallish but this is to be expected in NY but very clean and nicely furnished. I love the theme of this hotel, they have gone along way to make it unique. The reading room really works as you can escape the rush of the city without feeling you are sitting in a hotel. It is definitely one place I will return to if in NY again.

review_text: stayed for 8 nights for a summer holiday. We've stayed at some truly fantastic resorts around the world and this rivals our experience at the best of the Four Seasons. It is a very nice facility but this is all about service.... Which was superb! Pool Service superior to all! They were kind, cleaned our sunglasses, freshened our drinks and even offered my son goggles for swimming. Fabulous. Decent food, nice rooms (we booked a suite) and nice separation from adult relaxation pool to kids/ family. We loved it and will go back. It is expensive all around, but you get what you pay for. Little shops could have more selection but coffee shop is great and valet service superb. A bit of a drive from San Diego, close to attractions. We even saw a few celebrities. Check their FB page for specials. FAB TIME!!!!
So romantic it was a perfect choice for my honeymoon.every thing was beautiful

review_title: Don't look anywhere else, your search has ended.
review_text: This place is beautiful. The rooms are amazing. Huge bathrooms with tubs you can't help but take a bath in, wonderful shower, tv in the bathroom. Shutters open from bathroom to bedroom, which is a good size. We had a good size balcony with comfortable chairs. The pool was nice and warm. It was very quiet and relaxing. We were there for our anniversary and they definitely made sure to congratulate us many times and give us different treats on occasion. The service here is beyond exceptional. The only thing I wish they had was some "normal" food so that we didn't have to leave the hotel so much. I love a really good steak and appreciate good food, but really fancy food is not for me, and that is.really all they offer. Their simple offerings are really very limited. The pancakes were excellent and the sugar cookies were sooo good. The spa was again service wise excellent, but I do spas a lot and the price was steep. I love the facilities, but really the treatment was overpriced. Get something that you can't get at a regular spa so that you don't compare prices, maybe then you will enjoy it to its fullest! the spa was wonderful, just overpriced.

i wAs currious whether all these positive reviews are true. they trully are. me and my wife have spent 3 nights in the hotel. it felt more Like a visit at a (very very) rich friend. the staff (Julia and the porter from puorto rico come to my mind), the rooms, all the excelent small things starting from intrnational plugs to flawless wifi connection were there.imagine a flawless hotel and than add small things that make it even more flawless. :-)

review_text:

review_title: Great hotel with very friendly staff
review_text: A lovely hotel with very helpful staff. Rooms are a good size and the one bedroom suite was great for a family of 4. The sitting room had a sofa bed. Breakfast was excellent, as was the evening wine and cheese. A little walk from the shops on 5th Ave etc but well located for equal access to all other parts of Manhattan.

review_title: Outstanding in Every Way! Deserves to be Ranked #1
review_text:
I've stayed at this hotel's sister properties and The Giraffe is the superior property. Everything across the board--without fail--was perfection. From the locale to the accommodations to the amenities and the "extras," this hotel does not disappoint. 
What really sets it apart, however, is the unsurpassed customer service. The desk clerk greeted me by name and made helpful recommendations. The reservations department is excellent, truly second to none. They bend over backwards to work with you. The maid went above and beyond as did the room service delivery person. The entire staff was personable, eager to please and helpful.
The Giraffe is a lovely respite from the hustle and bustle outside and a person couldn't ask for anything more. This will now be my hotel of choice in Manhattan; frankly, I can't wait to go back!

Yo reserve el hotel despues de leer las criticas en tripadvisor tan buenas... Y si es buenissimo!! Muy amable los empleados, cama comfortable y limpia, tele grande, baÃ±o bueno y limpio! Para parquear el carro gratis y vigilado. El sitio donde esta queda cerco de muchos comederos y tienditas. El centro queda lejos pero en carro queda cerca. Si regrezo a san diego reservo de nuevo en el dolphin! :-)

review_title: Cozy and close to it all
review_text: Huge room with large picture windows with panoramic views. Beautiful wood floors and comfortable bed with nice linens. Across the street from the riverwalk (could see it from our windows) and the action of downtown. With only 17 rooms you get warm reception and staff on hand to help with any need. Nice breakfast (wasn't expecting w/rental) and lemon aid cookies and wine after 5pm. Have stayed all over the riverwalk. This is my favorite stay.
I was very impressed with the coziness and charm of this hotel. Highly recommended.

Close enough to all the riverwalk has to offer, yet it is surprisingly quiet. The rooms are very comfortable with a lot of character. The beds were a little too soft, though, and the parking situation is a bit inconvenient.

The wife and I wanted a weekend getaway to S.A. 
We decided on the river walk vista due to it's high ratings and we were not disappointed.
The rooms are cozy with an antique rustic feel and very clean, the a/c will get way down so you can cool off after you return from the river walk which is just steps away.
Patty is amazing and she makes the best egg SoufflÃ© in Texas, so bug her to make it and she might give you the recipe.
We will definitely be returning ASAP!

We went for a weekend adults-only getaway, & we could not have selected a finer location! Bathrooms were lovely, wonderful toiletries provided, fluffy robes, a bed that we did NOT want to leave... But if we had stayed in the room, we would have missed the outstanding breakfast, wine & cookies happy hour (comp), & the entertaining & knowledgeable company of the staff! I really can't think of one bad thing to say about our stay here... All of this in a perfect location right off the Riverwalk (& no, the street noise @ night was not bad at all)...& with a "pet" (fish) to boot!!! Would live here if I could!!!

My boyfriend and I travelled with my 2 girls to NYC for a weekend show and I was very excited to be trying another of the 4 HK hotels in manhattan....we had previously stayed at the Elysee hotel and fell in love with the presentation as the cleanliness, staff, evening wine and cheese, breakfast and attention to guest importance was overwhelming. Not so at Giraffe! We had paid for a superior suite and at the 3pm check in time the room was not ready.....this saga remained ongoing for the next 1 1/2 as were were repeatedly told 15 more minutes....we needed to use a bathroom and get reAdy for dinner before the show and this setback threw everything out of sinc....we never got dinner before the show and the staff could not understand the delay stating only repeatedly that there were new and not as familiar people working on things...also my reservation had not been prepaid as requested and understood by 2 staff members when I had booked it; upon arrival I was told that inexperienced people took my info and should have told me that the only way to prebook was on line....it placed a large monetary hold on my card and terribly inconvienced us....but even after being frustrated...no one seemed to care....we were offered wine and cheese which all the hotel guests receive at 5-8pm. I then called the corporate office when we got home and they placed it back to the hotel manager who keeps being out of the office every time I try to contact him....it was such a let down and I think the mission statement of HK hotels is fake.....it's a business and they want your money and they don't care at all about making your stay " magic" and hiring people who love to help people

review_title: Fantastic boutique hotel, right on Madison
review_text:
After arriving from Australia we were impressed to immediately access our room and freshen up.
We stayed in a junior suite which was approx $400 before taxes. The room was enormous by NYC standards, we were impressed with the homely, yet modern feel. Large LCD TV (if thats what youre into), and all the modcons, including international power points.
If you're a light sleeper, a couple of minor noteworthy points. The air conditioning unit is quite loud (you can if course turn this off, but it was running 95 deg when we were there). Also, the curtains/blinds are not blackout, meaning that the room gets quite light early in the summer months.
The wifi is extremely speedy, and unlike many hotels, it just works! You could access it from anywhere without silly passwords etc, even at breakfast we used our iPad to plan our day ahead.
The locations is the best of both worlds, about 10-15min walk to Central Park, only 5-10min walk from Broadway and literally 2min from Grand Central... Really handing for a 15-20min stroll up to the Met, Natural History Museum or MOMA. The high class shopping starts virtually on your doorstep, from Madison at 43rd-58th.
If you want downtown, villages or SoHo or TriBeCa it's only a cab away, but it's certainly not in the thick of the funky and hip urban areas.
It was my 2nd visit to NYC and this hotel was comfortably located, reasonably priced and exceptional service. We would stay again.
Enjoy your stay, we did.

Possibly the best hotel I've ever been to. Yes it is expensive, but well worth it. A great place to relax after three weeks touring the USA. Would highly recommend

review_title: Excellent hotel that does exactly what it claims
review_text: I stayed here for 4 nights in early June for a wedding. Well located which was important as it was my first visit to NYC. Staff friendly the room was small but was classed as a petite room. It is however spotless and well set out. Nice free breakfast and free wifi. Overall an excellent hotel I would use again

review_text:
I will admit I am a bit of a travel geek, and I did alot of research before picking this property. I'm not at all disappointed. I didnt want to stay at some large chain property , but was looking for a good boutique hotel. My only caveat to others might be: the rooms are small. For myself, that suits me well. I booked the smallest single room and find it cozy and well laid out rather than claustrophobic. The rooms are nicely decorated and well thought out. The breakfast on the 2nd floor is very good and the room light-filled, which is nice to wake up to. There is a bar/lounge on the rooftop 14th floor, with an outdoor area and glassed in (and air conditioned) conservatory, so it works in all weather. 
The staff are also both friendly abs professional. When I checked in I found the sink leaked, I told the front desk person, and they promptly fixed it. Good service is something one is unlikely to get at a larger hotel in NYC.

review_text:
We were positively surprised when we checked in. Very spacious and tasteful lobby, helpful staff, parking garage (shaded car in SA heat) and wonderful rooms.
We actually booked this hotel by mistake, but ended up staying 3 nights instead of 1 night. 
Breakfast area -very unusual- is actually big enough to hold all guests. Breakfast offers a decent warm and cold selection and juices. Real China and metal flatware rather than plastic. We really liked that. 
5:30 to 7 pm warm snacks and soda for every guest, 3 alcoholic beverages per adult buest complimentary.
Pool deck located on top of parking garage offers a lot of space to sit, one small pool and two jacuzzis. 
Wifi was the fasted we ever had in any hotel and was -like parking- complimentary.
If you don't shy away from commuting 20+ min to SA downtown, that hotel is the best bet.

review_text: My mom and I stayed for one night and we werent to pleased. The decor is modern and upscale, and the staff is e very nice and caring. The rooms are well designed. Everything seemed good until we went to go to bed. The sheets were stained and full of hair. Not just a hair but hair balls. We called the front desk and told them and the staff was up in just ten minutes to change the bedding. We were given 25% off an already great price to make up for the beds. It may have been just an incident that our room wasn't cleaned well, but its grossed us enough not to come back.

review_title: 5 star boutique hotel that delivers on everything.
review_text: Stayed for 4 nights as a treat for my girlfriends birthday. Booked it solely on the reviews of trip advisor. Was not disappointed one bit! Superb rooms, location, facilities, staff and cleanliness. Bookmarks cocktail bar is a hidden gem, however judging by the clientel it is well used and a chic hang out for ny business people. Breakfast was lovely and wine/cheese on the evening felt very sophisticated. Try to avoid the smaller rooms as my room (fairy tales) was a nice size however any smaller wouldve been cramped. Little touches such as bottle of prosecco in room as birthday gift made it so memorable. Id never stay in another nyc hotel + thoroughly recommend The Library hotel to anybody but especially couples. It oozes style and although not cheap was well worth the money!

We stayed at The Library 2 years ago and it was definitely one of the biggest reason for returning to NY. Sadly the unexpected upgrade we had received last time wasn't repeated but our Queen Deluxe was more than adequate for our stay. In fact the stay was great and only really less than perfect because the hotel was so much busier than the first time we visited. This meant arriving at breakfast often included a slightly embarrassing loiter for a space to sit. The only other downside was that the people staying in the room next to us seemed to relish letting the heavy room door slam at every opportunity! 
All in all highly recommended though possibly in danger of becoming too popular!

review_title: 2nd stay in less than a year
review_text:
This is our 2nd stay this year - we stayed here in April also. We stayed in the same type of room both times - corner 2 room suite with 2 queen beds. The room is nice size for the price we paid. And I like the fact that it has a full size refrigerator and a mini microwave. Came in handy. The free breakfast and 5:30pm kickback is a nice bonus also, although we didn't take advantage of it this time. The staff is very nice and friendly.
Great location - you come out right on the Riverwalk downstairs.
The only thing stopping me from giving them 5 perfect stars is the $19 per day parking fee. Despite that, would stay here again, especially if I can get the corner room for the right price. :-)

review_title: Amazing resort with access to nearby attractions and great waterpark on property
review_text: We stayed here with my parents and all had a great time. The water slides and lazy river on property are great vthe food in cibolo moon was great at all meals and there were many other restaurants and stores nearby if you wanted to go off property. Easily drivable to the river walk and to sea world and the airport. The free self parking got crowded but was manageable and we had a really great stay and hope to go back again one day soon for a relaxing long weekend.

review_text: My family and I have been coming to this hotel for a few years now. This last visit was our third visit in a year. The hotel is centrally located between the Alamo and the Market Square with everything within walking distance. Did I mention it is directly on the Riverwalk? This hotel also offers free breakfast and an evening snack/finger food buffet with free alcoholic beverages. What more could you ask for? What about a rooftop pool/spa with an amazing view of the surrounding area and for cold days, the indoor heated pool/spa is excellent! Making this experience great is the very friendly staff. For a great resort style experience, I recommend the Drury Plaza Hotel Riverwalk. Enjoy!

The Drury family of hotels is always great but the location here as well as the building itself is over the top. The Drury took over the old Alamo bank building----a wonderful old building now housing another great Drury hotel---
Nice hotel, a block or two from main riverwalk area, and great service. Heads up with the $19 valet parking fee. Valet was very courteous and professional.

This place is amazing! Water park for the family with a very impressive layout. We were able to enjoy it even in November as they heat the water. It is amazing how peaceful and quiet it is out here. Great retreat for the family. And yet not too far from Sea World and other great things San Antonio has to offer. We only went to SW and then enjoyed the resort the remainder of the week.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_title: Great, rececently built hotel in a good spot in downtown San Antonio.
review_text: I have stayed at several different properties from different hotel chains in downtown San Antonio. The Townplace Suites is definitely a GREAT value for the services, location and overall quality of hotel. The rooms were super clean, the amenities are modern and the mini kitchen and medium-sized refrigerator are great. If you need last minute items that you may have forgotten, there is a WALGREENS like two blocks away. If you are staying for an event at the Majestic Theatre...If you want to be right next to the heart of the Riverwalk and the Alamo?? This is the perfect hotel!!!! There is also a great Brazilian restaurant..Texas De Brazil...one block away!...and a Starbucks..like three blocks away...Awesome place...I definitely recommend it to anybody! Whether its a family..with kids...a couple w no kids...whatever the case may be!!!

At first I thought, oh the room is not very big and the place will be noisy due to being a old building. Wrong! Nice and quiet, slept like a log on the comfy king bed. Our view wasn't great but we got 2 big windows. The roof-top pool(22nd floor) was fabulous, views in all directions!!! I wish it was open until 11:00 @ nite, especially since the security guard came around every 15 min from 10 on with a countdown( control freak) spoiled the evening. The breakfast buffet is just fine and included and so is the 5:30 kick- off. Free drinks. Wow. And free wifi,late check out no problem, umbrella loan if it's raining.THESE GUYS AIM TO PLEASE!
Hotel has great location on the riverwalk. Clean hotel with friendly staff. Free breakfast and evening drinks. Great rooftop pool. Good for kids and adults

Beautiful hotel located far from the center of SanAntonio. If you want to play golf, use the spa and pool the JW is for you. If you don't have a car your options will be limited outside of the hotel as everything is a significant cab ride away. The hotel itself is lovely, great rooms and good restaurants. There are plenty of staff who are anxious to help you enjoy your stay

review_text:

 I stayed with my two daughters ages 26 and 29 for 2 nights during the AT&T Golf PGA tournament Oct 14-16. The service was excellent especially Mario (front desk) and Paul (valet). Every single employee went above and beyond their necessary duties to provide superior service.

review_text: Modern, new, clean and great staff! Stayed here for a convention and it's located conveniently to downtown and near the Alamo.
Have stayed at several Hyatt place hotels. This one did not disappoint. Friendly service, clean rooms and convenient to all area attractions.

We stayed on Saturday night for a great getaway. Great rooms and very friendly staff. The weather was very bad but we enjoyed the "frost" activity setup. We were pretty much the only ones bearing the weather and the staff of frost made us feel incredibly welcome! Thank you to Cody, Rick, Miguel and David! You guys made our stay memorable and we will definitely be back!

review_text: Immediately satisfied with the front desk host. I checked-in in the late evening and he was both Very welcoming and friendly. He gave me a tour of the place explaining that there was a 24 hour kitchen open (which was reasonably priced) a indoor pool, fitness center and even a bar serving beer and wine till midnight which is a definite plus for some. Not to mention starbucks coffee available which is a huge plus for me. I stayed on the first floor in a corner room and it really felt like a home away from home. Had a great king size bed and beautiful walkip-in shower. I only wish i got to lounge around in my mini living room longer. Overall great stay and can't wait to return!

My husband had another business trip in San Antonio. The Marriott we normally stay at was booked. I read the reviews for the Town Place Suites and made reservations for the week. I was totally impressed. The room was great. Clean,quiet, the kitchenette was very functional. The location was close to all of the main attractions. We will definitely make this hotel our first choice whenever we are in San Antonio. Which is quite often.

review_text: I was at a four day conference and it was the best all around experience I have had at a large resort. The rooms are we'll appointed and comfortable. I wish I could take home jars of the salsa from High Velocity. The pool was nice and relaxing although the poolside service was very slow. Overall it was a very relaxing, enjoyable stay. I did not try the spa but did enjoy the fitness center. My only recommendation is they get smaller diameter free weights since they were very cumbersome.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: Happy hour is the best, free breakfast also a plus. Highly recommend

review_title: Wonderfully friendly staff and very lovely rooms!
review_text: I had a wonderful stay here at this hotel. The location was great and the service was excellent. I would definitely say here again.
Hotel is great; perfect location on Riverwalk. Beautiful lobby; lots of extras with full breakfast and afternoon snacks. Rooms are nice.

The resort is relaxing and an enjoyable atmosphere. The rooms were quite nice, and the staff extremely helpful. We enjoyed the music in the evenings and especially the lazy river. My only disappointment was the food at their restaurants, which left much to be desired. Overall, we would definitely return but eat our meals off-site.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_title: Away from the river and in the woods
review_text:
If three hours on the Riverwalk is enough for you, or you want to skip it entirely, this may be the best place in San Antonio to stay. The hotel is on the outskirts of town. It's getting old and some parts of the facility are due for a renovation. 
If you don't valet your car, prepare for a 1/4 mile uphill walk from the lot to the main entrance. There are vans to help with the trek, but its just weird. 
Food is average. Hotel bars are lively. 
Gym is dated. Pools are nice, but there were flies everywhere. 
Overall a nice place. Not worth more than $200 a night in my opinion.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Best of family place in San antonio
review_text: Nice water park, good, affordable restaurants, scenic, great activities.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_title: Perfecte service in een 5 sterren+ bed and breakfast.
review_text: Op 3 augustus jl belandden wij (vader, moeder en 2 kinderen van 10 en 12), in Rittenhouse 1715. We waren op weg van Washington naar New York en gebruikten 'Phillie' als tussenstop. Gewend aan hotels in de categorie Four Seasons, hadden we niet al te veel verwachtingen van Rittenhouse 1715. Maar deze verwachtingen waren zeer onterecht. Het persoonlijke onthaal door de eigenaar en zijn personeel, de met veel gevoel voor detail, smaakvol ingerichte kamers die van alle moderne gemakken waren voorzien, het uitgebreide ontbijt met verse sappen, smoothies, verse wafels enz. enz. in de eveneens zeer toepasselijke en smaakvol ingerichte kelder. Het was supertop en we kunnen het iedereen die naar Philadelphia en niet in een groot onpersoonlijk hotel wil verblijven, aanbevelen!

If you are looking for a unique hotel experience in New York City that is luxurious and enjoyable, look no further. 
My girlfriend and I stayed here two nights - we found the hotel based on other people's reviews on TripAdvisor - and loved every minute of it. The hotel staff are outstandingly fabulous (in every sense of the word) and the Hollywood themed rooms are unique and a ton of fun. The location in Chelsea is fantastic, right in the heart of NYC. 
A few caveats to be aware of - the hotel does not appear to be handicap accessible in the least. There is no elevator, so if the idea of climbing stairs to get to your room is a problem, you may want to see about a ground floor room. It wasn't a problem for us and (in my opinion) added to the charm of the place. 
Also, be aware that the hotel has a resident cat. A wonderfully friendly one who, if you allow it, will happily hang out in your room for a bit. Again, we loved this but could see where this may be a problem if you are a person with allergies. 
I highly recommend taking your breakfast in the greenhouse area - it is beautiful and relaxing. 
I would absolutely stay here again and intend to the next time I am in the city.

review_title: Beautiful property that offers the Ahhhhh!
review_text: Enjoyed two nights on the club floor, Elizabeth & Paulina were wonderful hostesses! Every aspect of the property was beautiful with scenic views, pools, health club, dining & shopping so close. We'll be back!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Overbooked us and sent us to a Courtyard!
review_text:
We booked a room 2 months in advance, drove 4 hours in the car with a 4 month old and a 2 year old for a weekend stay at the JW. When we arrived at 7 pm on Friday they told us they had overbooked and did not have a single room available to us (not even an upgraded suite that we would have gladly paid extra for.). Our friends checked in 2 hours before us and were offered an upgrade though so they in obviously gave rooms to people who walked in without reservations in the two hours before we got there since there was NOTHING left for us. I had even called the day before to confirm. 
They sent us to a Courtyard 15 miles away for the night - not even a comparable hotel!! Having to go 
through all this and move hotels 
with 2 small kids was awful. This 
hotel is the worst experience we 
have ever had. The front desk was 
not even apologetic which was what really made us mad. They told us they would have a room ready for us on Saturday by 11 or 12 so we got there at 11 and of course there was not a room ready yet. Our 2 year old wanted to swim but it was 105 degrees this day and we have an infant so we asked about the cabanas since we didn't have a room still. The concierge told us they had fans in them so we paid 
almost $400 for one and we got out there and no fans in them and barely any shade so don't waste your money on those! The wait staff at the cabanas was very good though - bast service we had at the hotel. The pool area is really nice, definitely the highlight of the hotel. The reviews about the food being bad were right on. It was the worst food I have had at a nice hotel.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: I recently went to the Westin resort for lunch after my round and experienced excellent customer service from both the pro shop and the clubhouse staff. Stephanie and Christina provided excellent service and were very charming. I expected nothing less from a four star resort and it is a course any golfer must visit.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text:
We had such a good time this weekend, I want to Thank Paulina CastaÃ±on for her great service @ the lounge on the seven floor
Keep it that way!
My daughter had an awesome time @ kids club too!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Little interest in return. Waited for tubes on lazy river, 30 minutes to eat dinner anywhere on property with no service by the pool. The property is scrub brush land with quoted nature trails. Maybe it is a Terrible (big T) Texas thing. At 400 dollars per night give me Residence Inn for the dollar
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: We stayed here for a weekend and at first were extremely impressed with the place. After checking in we found out the resort had NO wifi. We found that rather strange. Our rooms were ok, but we expected more. We had connecting rooms and one night our teenager and friend had a disturbance and they phoned security at 5am. We were asleep in our room and had no clue. At 7am our teenager woke us up and we were surprised security would go into a room with two minors and never bother to wake up the parents next door to inform them of the disturbance. I thought that was very unprofessional of the staff. We also received a letter in our room telling us of a special rate we were being offered...which included free cans of soda. When we phoned about our cans of soda they told us they were on their way to our room. 12 hours later we ohoned to remind them and they had no clue what we were talking about. It seemed there was no communication between any if the staff. The valet service was strange as well. The valet employees would just stand around and wait for you to approach them if you needed help. They seemed standoffish. We were celebrating a birthday and phoned to have forks and a knife brought over and after 2 calls to remind them and an hour later we finally received them. The breakfast was overpriced and not that great as well. This place is nice looking and has a great location, but definitely not worth the money.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Very nice relaxi g hotel/resort for both work & pleasure.
review_text: Quiet, secluded, relaxing. Staff is wonderful & attentive - especially Paulina C. @ Royal Hacienda Club.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Summer fun for the whole family
review_text: This is the second time staying here in the summer and it did not disappoint. Lots of fun activities for the kids, loved the dinner buffet at Cibolo Moon that had an earlybird discount, kids loved all the water slides and pool fun. Will definitely be going back!
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_title: Great value hotel right on the Riverwalk
review_text: This is a great value hotel. Free breakfast and evening kickback. Central location. Rooftop pool, lovely during the day, but packed with kids at night. Gym has 4 treadmills, rower, dumb bells, leg machine and is very clean with cold water and towels. Coming from the UK San Antonio is "nice" and twee, but lets face it apart from the Riverwalk there aint much to do. If you don't have a car you're stuffed. You willnbe bored after about 3 hours. I'm here on business. The hotel is fine if you are on a budget.

review_title: A beautiful setting in San Antonio
