review_text: We enjoyed staying at the Westin for 3 nights. It is a beautiful hotel and we enjoyed going to the adult only pool everyday. The front desk staff gave us a late check out because we had a late flight that afternoon. Our highlight of restaurants was eating at La Francesca at sunset. We Both had a wonderful meal and I would highly recommend getting the filet of beef dish. The service was great and the food was wonderful.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Excellent service, friendly staff, close to city activities, room clean. The only problem is it is close to the freeway which might cause issues with light sleepers.

review_title: Family fun with a fantastic location and endless activities
review_text: What a pleasant surprise this was. It was 105* and I never once felt hot. The location is on a hill and there was such great air flow that at night you would get chilled getting in and out of the pool! The water park was fantastic and had fun for everyone and there was never a line and this was over a weekend stay. The absolute only negative was the bed. Given the price of a room, I expect a luxurious comfortable bed. I could feel the springs as I sat in bed - rm #4131. We watched a movie while in the pool! The restaurants were good, especially the sports bar. Each booth had a private TV just for you. What a life saver! Absolutely loved this place,planning another trip once we save up!
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: If you want a family resort- this is the best one! They have a miniature waterpark for the kids/ adults. The property is gorgeous! Will go back this year!
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_title: Wonderful resort, attentive staff , great location, great golf.
review_text: Stayed for the weekend. Staff was wonderful, concierge lounge was very nice. Close to attractions, shopping, and dining. Great weekend!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Shawn at service express was very helpful with our event! He went above and beyond to help load, unload, and set up. During the event he made sure that we had everything we needed and if there was ever a problem he took care of it with a smile! We will be back next year! The location and everyone we came in contact with was a joy to be aroundShawn at service express was very helpful with our event! He went above and beyond to help load, unload, and set up. During the event he made sure that we had everything we needed and if there was ever a problem he took care of it with a smile! We will be back next year! The location and everyone we came in contact with was a joy to be around!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Send the Entire Staff to JW Customer Service 101 Training
review_text:
I write this review from the lobby bar having just checked in a few hours earlier. 
I have spent more than 1,300 nights at Marriott hotels (every brand top to bottom, but mostly Marriott Hotel brand) totaling around $300,000 so I have experience to offer a fair opinion.
Checkin: I Am traveling with my family for a 5 night stay on points. Since I am using points my expectations are even lower because....after all I am not paying hard cash out of pocket. 
I was greeted by a early 20's kid that had the early 20's attitude - let's just say it's not what you expect at the JW Brand. I am typically offered an upgrade uon checkin due to my 1,300 + nights with the chain. I was not offered an upgrade nor even offered an apology that an upgrade could not be provided at this time. The kid was about as uninterested in providing good service as I've ever seen. I have seen better welcomes at the Detroit Airport. F- Fail for checkin 
Room - tiny, cramped and...did I say small? If I paid for a room I would ask for my money back. I connect the iPad to the HDMI connection on the tv so my kids can watch their shows. This hotel actually disabled the HDMI port on the tv. F - for the room
Pool - the best part of this resort and makes up for the small irritations somewhat. Pool = A
Sports Bar and Lobby Bar - this hotel is staffed entirely by 18 - 20 something with obviously no training on how to deliver JW class service. 
If the convention business ever slows down this place will probably shut the doors. If your company is picking up the tab for you and your family then you will have a good time. If you are looking for service and JW class experience then skip this place and look elsewhere.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text:
I took my family to the JW for a quick weekend getaway. We quickly became huge fans!
It is a little out of the way but well worth the effort in getting there. The JW Marriott is a destination in and of itself...and we rarely left the property.
The pool area was incredible. We were told at checkin that they were at 98 percent capacity, I never felt the pool was too crowded. There were rarely lines for the slides, and when there were, they were short. We took another reviewers advice and brought swim shoes for the kids, the concrete was hot in places and I believe this spared us some grief. 
We had lunch at the restaurant by the pool one day...food was really good, far better than expected, though a bit on the pricey side (as expected), though it sure made things easy that day.
We missed the rubber duck race in the morning, though that would have been fun for the kids. We did however make it to the zoo animal presentation in the lobby, which our kids loved! Seemed there were lots of activities to take advantage of for kids, we just didn't have the time for all for them.
Our room faced the golf course, not a bad view, don't know that I would upgrade to the pool view. The rooms were spacious and nicely decorated. The pullout couch was perfect for my 5 and 2 year old boys and the refrigerator was perfect for storing drinks (milk for cereal in the mornings), etc... The bathroom was huge with walkin shower and a tub. Afternoon turndown service in addition to the morning one was a nice treat and the chocolates they left were great! The only thing I wished they had was in room movies.
We have visited both the La Cantera and the Hyatt Hill Country, and though those places have their highlights, this place, in my opinion has them beat.
Overall, it was an incredible experience at one of the best Marriott properties I have ever stayed at.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: The hotel is one of the smaller ones in New York which gives you a much better standard of service as they get to know you over your stay and can give you more personal service. From a suggestion sheet of places to go each day to tasty breakfasts I would recommend this hotel very highly!
We've stayed here twice. Beautiful hotel, great location, very nice rooms, excellent free breakfast and dinner. All for a great price. Worth checking it out.

Scince I've been here at the Red Roof Inn in west Phoenix, I've been very pleased with the hospitality of the staff here!
The management here is great to be around, if I needed anything such as a clean room, fresh towels, hot coffee, they made sure I was accommodate!
Kim the manager here is great to be around! She is great to be around in the lobby and makes me smile whenever she works!
Really enjoyed our stay of 5 nights with our church youth group. The front desk worker named Kim made eveything a breeze and really impressed all of us with her attitude and professionalism.

We reserved a king bed suite for two nights. The room was promised to have a balcony with river view. What a joke! We have a view of Pay Less shoe store and a busy street. Can I see the river? Yes, but just a bit is visible from under a bridge down below. The front desk informed every room has a similar view. Call me crazy but when I am told I have reserved a room with a balcony overlooking the river, I kind of expect what I was promised. Very disappointing. Worth the extra $ to stay in a nicer hotel with the same view!

review_title: Top Notch Hotel in San Antonio
review_text: One of the most cleanest, neatest and hospitable hotels I have ever stayed in! Absolutely loved it!
The rooms are worn out. Jeez, the door knobs barely work... staff is young and attractive but utterly clueless. Not a clean or welcoming hotel.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Phoenix Airport (University Drive)

review_text: My family went for a golf tournament. It was so nice. The service, restaurants were great. The restaurants and the food was awesome. And tte swimming pools were great. My children want to go back. It was a great getaway!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Huge rooms, good value, paid parking?!
review_text:
This was one of the most impressive rooms on our two month trip to the states. The suites were actually suites- huge! Breakfast was a notch above the standard fare at chain hotels. The afternoon drinks/snacks was a great touch. The location was pretty good- walking distance to the Alamo and river walk.
So why only 4 stars? Two reasons... First, the front desk service was pretty unfriendly. It contrasted to the friendly service in the restaurant. The second reason is the charge for parking. Although relatively accessible to downtown, this is still fundamentally an off freeway hotel. It doesn't have any major space constraints. Most other places I came across in similar situations had free parking, I found it a little galling to pay $10 a night for the privilige.

review_title: I was given an unkempt room and poor service
review_text: too expensive! For the same value you can go to another hotel. It was too crowded aswell and I had to ask for towels. Plus the sheets smelt like women's perfume.

review_title: Clean rooms, good breakfast, safe location
review_text:
Although the stay started with a bump - no wi-fi & their internet went down - so there was a bit of a trouble finding a decent place to eat & things to do, it's a good place overall. 
They have a decent room service, the place is very clean, & the outdoor jacuzzi that stays open until 11pm is VERY nice. There is also a great place outside the entrance called "The Waffle House" - we got a great cup of tea & pumpkin pie there.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Phoenix Airport (University Drive)

review_text: Stayed here twice and loved it everytime.. The front desk staff is amazing, kind courteous. I would recommend staying here the prices are cheap everyone is more than friendly. The rooms are clean. I've never had a problem here and will stay here anytime!

Stayed for 5 nights. Staff very helpful. Small and cozy. Clean. Good area. Walking distance to all interesting places in SoHo and Greenwich Village. Only stairs, no elevator, so its for the young and able.

I loved everything about the Westin, they had everything, from the things adults can enjoy to the kids activities, I have 3 kids and they all loved it, I think it was called discovery journey, they couldn't stop talking about how fun it was and there new friend they meet which happened to be a fantastic employee named Laura, my children loved it which made me as a parent feel comfortable knowing that my children are having a better time than I was, the hotel itself was a beautiful location and the service was amazing, You can be sure that every time I come back to San Antonio, I will stay there at the Westin LaCantera.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Chose this hotel based on other Tripadvisor reviews and loved it. The lobby is historic and beautiful. The location is right on the River Walk. The happy hour is generous...3 free drinks and lots of food, and the breakfast is equally good. Saves $ for more great food at Rosarios...good recommendation from front desk. Drury Plaza is a good value and wise choice.

I have been coming to the Mokara fka The Watermark since 2004. The spa is one of, if not the best I have ever been to. The staff is amazing. From room service, especially Jesus and Larry, to housekeeping to the bell staff, valet and front desk they all do their best to make every wish come true.

review_title: The hotel was a wonderful Labor Day vacation
review_text: The venue itself coupled with exemplary service made this an ideal place to spend Sunday and Monday. The personnel were very accomodating and added immeasurably to our "staycation". We live in SA and I'm glad we chose this resort vs our other options.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Great location, super friendly staff, quiet rooms, beautiful decor, wonderful spa. Can't say enough good things- we will be back!

review_title: Great location and hotel for the money
review_text: We stayed three nights while in town for a ballgame at the Alamadome. It is conveniently located within a nice stroll to the Alamadome and the Riverwalk/downtown area. The room was nice and spacious and the decor and furnishings appeared fresh and new. The business center was very spacious and open not small and cramped like many others There were also a couple of oversized leather chairs and flat screen tv in there as well. The breakfast area was well stocked and clean and the two friendliest ladies I think that I've ever encountered at a hotel. We did not use the pool but the outside area had a nice patio-type seating area that was very attractive There is also a shuttle to major areas that is operated everyday except Sunday. We used it twice but just walked mostly. If you want to pay for a view, stay on the Rverwalk but this is a great place to stay while in San Antonio.

Last 4th of July we stayed here with a small crowd. This 4th of July this place was packed! Still a wonderful place to be, quality and service are excellent! 
They controlled access to the water areas with wristbands issued for the number of guests per room up to 4. Still had to search a bit for tubes ( and then hang on to them) during the afternoon. About 4:00, this is no longer a problem and the lines for the water slides disappear about that time too. 
Really enjoyed the family activities such as stargazing and s'mores. Everyone always makes us feel so welcome and waited on!
Love this place!
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: Beautiful hotel in San Antonio with great potential. Everything in the hotel is fairly new and upscale. Then you open the armoire to an old 24" TV. Really! They spared no expense on the furnishings and decor then stick old TVs in the rooms. The rooms were ok clean - remote control had white crusty stuff on it as did the night stand. The phones in the room were also quite filthy. Somewhat dusty also.

This was just such a great find. I was in San Antonio to see family and just so pleasantly surprised to see this unbelievable resort. The pool area was unparalleled and I loved that they had an adult infinity pool too if you wanted to get away from the children. Lately I have been very surprised about the lack of adult pools at luxury resorts and this hotel thankfully had a great one. I loved the restaurants and was really surprised at how moderately priced they were. I ate something like four meals in a row at the southwestern one and they were all fantastic. The biscuits (free!) were to die for and the servers were all so nice. My only complaint is that something really needs to be done about the wireless internet. It only works for a few minutes at a time before disconnecting you and then you have to completely repeat the login process. Trying to get any work done was VERY challenging. Hopefully that will be an easy fix.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: Best in San Antonio! Fabulous rooms, lobby, restaurant and service. Will be my new home base in San Antonio.

review_title: Amazing service, clean and large rooms at a very good rate!
review_text: Read some good reviews about this comfort suites and i am absolutely amazed. They treat me like a 5 star hotel would. Rooms are great, staff is super friendly. The owner actually came and personally asked how our stay was. Feel very comfortable at this hotel and highly recommend it. Will stay here from now on!

We stopped in on a cross coutry drive based on trip advisor score. Affordable friendly free happy hour with.food, huge room, putting green, free shuttle to river walk and alamo, small but private pool, worth so much more than we paid. Tempted to stay a second nigjt :)

review_title: Wonderful Surprise For Us In Texas!!
review_text:
My husband and I attended a convention in San Antonio. Our friend booked our hotel for us. We didn't know what to expect. I was pleasantly surprised. It was beautiful!!
The drive from the airport to the hotel is okay, it's around an 1/2 to 45 min away, but well worth it!
It's tucked away on a hill surrounded by trees. 
The staff went above and beyond for us from the moment we checked it until we departed. 
I always admit in my reviews I am hard to please, let's take a moment to give my husband some kudos, lol, and I was totally satisfied with the staff. 
We had a room in front with a balcony. Nice view of city from it. 
I decided to take a day off of the convention and took a spa day for myself. This was one of my favorite days on vacation. I had an amazing massage followed by dips in the pool and whirl pool all day. They serve good food by the pool by good servers who actually enjoy their jobs. I wish I could remember her name but it escapes me at this moment. I invited her to new York city that's how much I liked her. It was a great me day, a perfect stay!!
I am thinking of going back to San Antonio just to go back here!!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: This hotel was one of the nicest I've ever stayed at! Updated, clean, gorgeous!!! Great service. You get free appetizer food & alcohol at 530 & free breakfast. amazing location on riverwalk.

Great standard hotel with everything needed! Spent two nights here and found a most of the staff kind and knowledgeable. Only one staff member seemed distracted when talking to us. It is located near Mill Ave. which has tons of places to eat. But be warned; it is a college town! Overall, however, it was just what our family needed.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Phoenix Airport (University Drive)

review_text: Right on the highway. Quiet, clean, nice staff, breakfast included. This was just an overnight stop over and it was perfect for that. Definitely priced right with a nice breakfast offering hot items as well as normal continental selections.

I was pleased with the photos of this property, but was disappointed for many reasons on arrival. 
Even with our GPS we had difficulty finding this property. The road leading to the front office looks as if it is leading to a parking lot for
an adjacent apartment complex. It is a one-way road. Upon arrival we were informed that the room we had reserved was not available as the people who were in it previously had not left. We had booked a two night stay. There were no similar rooms available. We were then given what they call an 'upgraded' room. I respectfully disagree. Although it was also a two-bedroom two bath unit, it was facing the freeway and was upstairs in a two story building with no elevator. It was also at the furthest point from the main house and pool area which we had requested to be near. I called the front desk to complain and was told there was nothing they could do unless somebody in one of the other rooms we wanted checked out. We had booked the two bedroom two bath penthouse with loft with a much more open floorplan. This room was more like what you would find if somebody converted an old hotel and just joined three regular rooms together in a row placing the living room in the middle. The next morning I went to the front office and voiced my concerns about the room again. I was once again told that I should be happy since it was an 'upgrade'. I was then told to pack up all of our belongings and place them in the middle of the living room floor. That way if somebody did check out then they would send maintenance to move our belongings to the new room. I was so displeased with the room we were in that I was glad to do at least that. When we returned we found that indeed we had been moved. I was pleased with the accommodations the second night that overlooked the pool area. 
The breakfast area at this hotel was lacking. Not nearly enough food and some weird spices were used to cook some of it. I would expect more consistency throughout the chain than this. I did witness the front desk clerk yelling at a homeless man who wandered in and began to eat. 
Overall it was just ok. I would personally not choose to stay here again.

A clean and convenient property. Great value for the money at under $40 a night. New mattresses and quiet AC units made for a good nights rest. The two factors which were a disappointment were both related to staff not having the knowledge they needed and making false statements. I had only two specific requests at check in. First that I needed internet access. Second that I wanted to leave my suitcase after check out so I could attend a nearby meeting without dragging my luggage along as I was using public transportation. They said yes on both counts. However, the internet wasn't working and evidently hadn't been in some time. At check out , the manager in duty said in fact I could not leave my bag which created a huge problem for me.

Very out dated inn but great for the poor college student--it's clean but definitely not pleasing to the eye. There are some close by restaurants--nothing really fancy. Although there is a Savers near by and I found a lot of treasures!

My family and I drove down to San Antonio for the weekend from Round Rock, and I had been here before but never with my family. I was surprised how the hotel could accomodate us so last minute and on a weekend no less. 
There were many activities to keep my boys entertained and my wife relaxed. The food on site was amazing especially the Brannons breakfast which we went to every morning. To my surprise the boys loved the pool, but were more entrigued by the other activities held. Especially the game room, which had several various game systems and games to keep every age group of kid entertained. Stephanie, the attendent in the room was amazing with my boys. She helped them, made them feel included and was very down to earth. She was able to keep them in good spirits even while playing with them. This Is just one of many of the great staff that really made us feel like we were at our home away from home. 
Money well spent for a quick weekend get away.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Wow had a great time here!
review_text: The rooms were amazing and the service was great. We Had top notch service from the food and beverage people, especially at the bar called steinhemiers. Hannah was the best. Can't recommend this Westin enough.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: My family and I were here for a CMAA conference and we spent most of our time at the pool. For most of the time I was on the slide having fun with Sadie.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Stayed 4 nights, wife and 2 boys 13 & 8. We were never let down by anyone. Food, was great, hands down the service was outstanding. At poolside our vote is Samantha McClure. Great attitude, very professional, very kind and warm. Her spirit alone made us feel great. Not saying the others were poor, which they weren't, Samantha just stood out!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Terrific, new, clean resort in San Antonio!
review_text: Loved our stay at the JW Marriott. Is not far from our home but really felt like we were away! Great service at concierge, front desk, bar, and restaurant! We were upgraded to a fabulous suite as a Marriott Rewards perk. Also loved the spa and massage services. Live music in the lobby bar with great fireplaces. Will definitely stay here again!
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: I stay here everytime I come to San Antonio (which is alot) because there are no surprises and I am always treated like family. The staff here is amazing, and I am never dissapointed. Georgia provides an excellent breakfast, and the front desk makes check-ins fast and easy. The rooms are always clean, and the beds are extremely comfortable. Ray, the general manager, who I have met quite a few times, is always pleasant, and reassures me that my stay will be a pleasant one. COME STAY HERE, and see for yourself.

I stayed here for two nights on business. The Internet connection set off every security alarm my computer has, the checkin fellow treated me like I was a thief off the street because the address on my drivers license didn't match the one in his computer, and also helped himself to the breakfast in the morning, eating all the scrambled eggs without replacing them. The room itself was fine, but the door wouldn't close without an active action on my part. Most hotels have self closing doors these days, and this wouldn't even be worth mentioning if I wasn't already down on this place. The coup de grace was waking up at 4:30am to take a shower before my flight out, only to find both the toilet and tub backed up (standing, dirty, water had come up through the tub drain). The only nice thing I can say is that it is very close to downtown. In short, though, stay away.

We had a large group staying, and our service at the adult pool was excellent!! Nicole took care of us for 2 days in the 100 degree heat, and was so friendly and attentive to all our needs. She ran nonstop taking care of everyone's food and beverage needs and always had a smile on her face!! If was a wonderful stay!!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Fabulous RESORT! A one stop shop for an amazing family getaway!!
review_text:
We chose this resort based on trip advisor reviews. We wanted a nice hotel, with a pool, outside of the riverwalk madness, but still close enough to visit all the San Antonio attractions. First of all, I can't say enough good things about the Westin hotels. They are consistently great quality, but this was quality on a whole new level!
I'll keep it simple. I'll list the pro's 
and con's. Please be patient, there 
ALOT of pro's! 
*Hotel property is outside the 
madness of the city, yet close enough to visit all the high points!
*The property has everything you need. There's seriously no need to leave the resort. It's all here!! Huge family pool (which is open 24/7!), adults pool, poolside bar, poolside restraunt, buffet breakfast, poolside grill, all-day activity schedule (which is concluded every evening with a kid friendly movie on the lawn), kids playcare, a pre-teen/teen facility for evenings, 
sports club/lounge, 4star restaurant, spa. I'm a little out of breath, but you get the point. 
*Starbucks!! That's right! Located just inside the main entrance. 
*incredibly helpful concierge.
*BEAUTIFUL scenery!
*3 golf courses (2 of which are located onthe property.)
*Upscale mall about 5 minutes away.
*Fiesta Texas is about 2minutes away.
*Sea World is about 15-20minutes away. 
*Riverwalk is about 15minutes away. 
The Con's
*There aren't a ton of restaurant options off property, if you'd like a change.
*If you go during the winter the resort may not have as much to offer, since the pool and lawn activity is the major draw. 
*The food and drinks can be expensive at times. 
*Our check-in experience was not the greatest, even with us being Starwood Preferred guests. (We were charged twice for our room, and we had to stop in at the counter 3 times to straighten it out.)
As you can see the pros far out weigh the cons. It was an overall fantastic resort! We've already recommended it to several friends, and we intend to go back. I wish there were more of these type resorts in Texas!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Staff was very nice and helpful, but the place is very run down and dirty. If you want to save a few bucks, it's OK. I wouldn't stay here with kids due to the other guests this place attracts. Vans full of magazine "salesmen" were there obviously drunk or high. Cigarette butts and beer cans littered the walkways and parking lot. We felt unsafe and did not sleep well.
hotel_name: Extended Stay America - Phoenix - Airport - E. Oak St.

review_title: I can't imagine a better place to hang my hat on a NYC visit.
review_text: The Chelsea Pines surpassed my expectations. Loved all the extra little touches: from the daily newssheet to the breakfast and backyard patio. Friendly, always-helpful people at the front desk to chat with. Excellent overall service. I would love to stay again.

I stayed with my family over the fourth of July weekend and I had the time of my life! The rooms were very nice and I loved the restaurant selection. The Palmer course was amazing and there was even a kids club for my children while I played. The pool was fantastic and a special thinks to Sadie at the pool for her service. I will definitely be back next year
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: We had such a lovely time here. Great value, central and really nice, helpful staff. The lounge area for breakfast was great and relaxed and our room was really nice. Small touches such as wifi in the rooms and a daily newsletter of suggestions for the day, as well as the great people that work there really added to it.

I heard about the grille at the golf club recently and stopped by for an early lunch. I chose to sit at the bar since the restaurant was empty. Christine was my server and carried on genuine conversations with me after recommending different items on the menu. The food was incredible! Chef Henry was even kind enough to come out and greet me. After having a taste of chef henry's amazing meal, christine recommended I visit the Palmer grille. She arranged for a shuttle to take me over there and it arrived quickly. As I looked around the palmers gorgeous views Jennifer, the bartender, offered me dessert. The bread pudding was great and if I wasn't so full I would have tried their other dessert options! Thanks Jennifer for the great recommendation! Overall great experience, amazing food and staff
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Bedbugs. AC barely functioning. Then the run-around where management never available to answer 4 phone calls & 2 letters.
hotel_name: A Victory Inn & Suites Phoenix North

review_title: Nice, newer hotel close to riverwalk
review_text: The hotel was nice and new. It was a little pricey but not too bad. It was within walking distance of the riverwalk. The hotel offered a free shuttle service to take you from the hotel to where you wanted to go. It ran on the hour till 9 pm. Drop off was easy and quick, but there was confusion one night on where we were supposed to wait to get picked up. It took 30 minutes for the shuttle to get there. The breakfast was good, as well as the wine reception in the evening. Rosa worked both the breakfast and the wine reception. She was very nice and came around and talked to everyone. Her service was excellent. The room was good sized. The bathroom was dirty, and the hair dryer broke and the bathroom outlet did not work and was not a GFI issue. We gave the hairdryer to the front desk and they said they would fix the outlet. That evening, they fixed the outlet, and after asking again gave us a new hairdryer. The mattresses were fine, but the air conditioner kept turning on and off throughout the night keeping us awake. Overall, I would recommend this hotel.

A basic hotel and we didn't feel it was in the best location. Alot of police about and people hanging around on street corners? I wouldn't walk around at night! It is only a 15 mins drive from the airport which is why we stayed there. The hotel it's self was OK. standard room and you do get a breakfast from 6-9am bagels, cereal, toast, fruit and muffins, nothing amazing but mucj better than nothing. They do have a very nice looking pool, unfortunately we didn't have time to use it. We didnt have hot or even warm water in the shower. However so hot it was nice to cool down.
Overall if you're staying more than a night I wouldnt pick the hotel or area but for one night before you fly then it's ideal with free parking and WIFI.
hotel_name: Days Inn Camelback Phoenix and Conference Center

review_text:
I have been lucky enough to get to stay here twice for conferences and it is amazing!
The valets, doormen, bellman, and front desk staff all greeted me with smiles upon my arrival. Check in was very fast and my room was beautiful for both stays.
Hotel staff always made eye contact and greeted me, and several people offered to carry my computer bag for me on my way to a meeting room. I later heard a woman telling a friend that when she went to Starbucks in the morning, several hotel associates in line stepped aside and let her by.
The banquet staff is so meticulous and they set lovely rooms. I watched two men carefully setting water pitchers on tables, lining them up perfectly. Later I noticed that they take the same care lining up the legs of the tables.
Every restaurant item I tried was wonderful. The golf course looked amazing, ( I didn't get a chance to play) and all the public lounge areas were comfortable, inviting, and relaxing.
I love this hotel and hope to visit again soon.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_text: If your staying here, then you are a lucky son of a gun, because you got Trent to take care of ya. He's the man!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: The best place to stay in San Antonio TX.
review_text: Here on business and working hard, but the staff made my evenings wonderful. Nicole Burnstad was amazing at the adult pool and we missed her when she was off. The bartender at the front lobby was the friendliest of all and made sure our drink orders were taken care. Wish I knew her name, but she's off. The best hotel I've stay at so far. Thanks Westin LaCantera.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Great 4 Star Accomodations and something for EVERYONE.
review_text:
We went with 3 families during Spring Break. Kids ranged from 6yrs to 9yrs old. The Westin had a play area located near the tennis courts that included a basketball court, "jump house" water slip & slide among other activities. Every station had a Westin employee to oversee it. Awesome idea. The adults could lay by the pool and the kids had lots of fun on their "own". Not sure if this play area is setup year round or just during Spring Break. 
Pros:
Rooms are nice and cozy. Very clean. Housekeeping always greeted us in the common spaces and asked if we needed anything. Our room was on the ground level near the tennis courts so we got a grassy area that the kids could go and throw the ball around. The patio door opened directly onto the grass. 
The property felt very secure. 
My only complaint was with the restaurant. Took way too long to be seated. They worried way too much with setting up the table and not enough about feeding our VERY hungry group. The food was mediocre. Service at dinner was mediocre. Breakfast was the best. Great buffet. Bar food at the pool was better than the dinner in the restaurant.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: How could someone enjoy this place? It looks nice from the outside.. Inside, no. the room is clean..but lacking. One pan, 3 plates, & one bowl in the "kitchen". The stairways are gross. Overflowing trashcans in the halls. Smells odd. Internet speed is a joke. No storage space to think of. Keeping a lookout for bugs.. The towels are crappy, bed uncomfortable. I thought I paid to stay at a hotel, not a homeless shelter. Never again!

First off- its infested with drug addicts. The management is horrible. I lived here for 8 months. They switched mngmt more than i do socks and in the end they entered my unit and stole my property and bullied us out of there leaving us defensless to do anything about it. I recommend steering clear of this mess. And keep your children safe by always knowing your neighbors- and here its a 99% chance they will be a meth head. I highly advise u keep lookin.

I've stayed at this hotel several times and never had a problem till today! I left my camera there went back 4 hours later and its missing. They were rude to me. They down played my camera acting as if it had no value at all. I will never stay there again!

review_title: Cheap and comfortable, therefore I'd go again
review_text:
It's an affordable option in the outskirt of Phoenix, it was clean, cheap and big room. The breakfast was just ok.
The service is rude, but you only speak with them 5 minutes, so doesn't matter.

We got to the hotel at night and it looked like there would be a drug dealer around every corner. The manager was nice, the room wasn't terrible, the a/c was whipping the curtains around, but the location was terrible. Wouldn't ever go again!!!

Very dangerous location, dirty, felt completely ripped off! Should not have the name Days Inn. Should be called Crap Hole! Don't book here! Airport shuttle dude was sleeping and rude when we called and crappy van was smoked in. Disgusted!
We are frequent patrons of the hotel. For many years we have enjoyed the family friendly atmosphere. We can always count on Carlos to greet us and take good care of us during our stay.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Pay a little more, this place sucks
review_text: First of all, we got on at 1:30 am and have to leave at 6 am. When we got in the room there were only 3 towels. We had four in our party. I went back to ask for an extra towel, the person said " sorry no towels". I asked if they could give a liitle continental breakfast at 5:30am. He said " no" it's from 6-9am. Then when I went back there to use the lobby computer at 5 am. He wouldn't let me in. He came out the back room, hair messy, eyes red, like he was sleeping in the back. I asked what time the manager comes in. He said" I'm the manager". That was the end of it. Will never stay here again. For those of you looking just for a cheap stay, this is not one of them.

We stayed here for 3 nights during the San Antonio Fiesta week and I must say I don't think I've every stayed anywhere, especially in the downtown area of a large city, where we were pampered so much. The Drury is a beautiful building, the staff is extremely friendly and helpful, the amenities are amazing and the rooms very nice and clean. Free WIFI throughout the hotel, free hot breakfast, free evening buffet and three free drinks per person per evening--wine, beer and mixed drinks. If I ever return I would definitely stay at the Drury.
I travel 36 weeks a year, I've had an amazing professional experience at the Spa. Go see Tina, she is just great at taking stress level down.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: My wife and I stayed for six nights on our honeymoon. The resort was clean and the service was excellent. Jordan and Cody from the gentry performed beyond expectations and Tommy from Brannon's cafe was our man for breakfast. A great resort for some R&R.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: My friends and I played at the La Cantera golf coures and we had the best time thanks to Bailey Bowling and Yvonne Avila thank you girls !!!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: I loved the attitude of service And politeness from the girls at Starbucks specially .
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Minnesota family felt at home and the southern hospitality
review_text: I decided to tag along with my daughter on her business trip with my grandson. Although we didn't have access to a car and did not want to rent car while my daughter was in her daily meetings, I was surprised how many activities the hotel provided for my 8 year old grandson and I. The game room they have was god sent and the employees working in it were excellent with kids. Stephanie was an absolute doll and was able to help keep my grandson entertained and sharing with the wii! Her and I had an hour long convo just about texas history, she was wonderful! Recommend, very family friendly. And location location location!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: My wife and I stayed for six nights on our honeymoon. The resort was clean and the service was excellent. Jordan and Cody from the gentry performed beyond expectations and Tommy from Brannon's cafe was our man for breakfast. A great resort for some R&R.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text:
I stay in hotels about 80 nights a year for work and often need to stay in Phoenix. This by far is one of my favorites in Phoenix. 
The neighborhood is definitely in the hood, but even as a single female, I always felt safe and secure. 
This is the cleanest hotel I've stayed in all year. The dishes and silverware were immaculate. Last year I stayed at a high end kitchenette hotel in Scottsdale and the dishes were so dirty it made me not want to touch anything else in the place. 
Small workout room but the free LA Fitness down the street makes up for it. Just show them your hotel key. Breakfast is a feast of eggs, fresh fruit, yogurt, oatmeal, cereal, bagels, bread, waffles and sausage. Free. Free wifi too.
Beds are heavenly. Truly, the best nights sleep. I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

We had a great weekend at the westin. The Hotel is beautiful, and the service was outstanding. The staff was very helpful, especially Trey Garcia. Trey made us feel at home, and went out of his wayto help us. The entire stay was great, and I wouldnt stay anywhere else in San Antonio!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: The best service ever! Trey Garcia and staff made us feel special and welcome from the moment we arrived!
review_text:
Four families stayed and we all had a great time. 
Trey Garcia made us feel special. We are coming back real soon. Will recommend highly to family and friends.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Stayed for 3 nights. Everything was great. Elizabeth greeted us at check in and made us feel right at home. She checked on us everytime she saw us. Vicki at the pool bar handled lunch and dinner for us several times. She provided great customer service and made sure everything was perfect. Even gave the kids an extra cookie which made their day. Location was great for Fiesta Texas and Enchanted Springs Ranch. Will definitely be coming back.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Awesome stay, great secluded location. Except for one thing...
review_text: I had the best 2 day stay I've ever had at any resort until... It started with check-in, the service desks were helpful, attentive, polite and speedy it literally took 5 minutes to checkin. She upgraded our room as we celebrated a birthday, she Â gave us the room keys, activity sheet and directed us to the elevators (5 stars). I noticed every employee held a door open for you, stepped out of your way and greeted you with "Hello" or "Have a good morning sir" (5 stars). The room was clean, smelled fresh with complimentary water, chocolates and free wired internet. The outdoor areas and activities for children are amazing, from the jumpalots to the inflatable waterslide to the huge outdoor pool equipped with a theme park feel. The Westin Kids Club also provided lots of activities like puppet shows, coloring, painting, legos, wooden train set and chalkboards all while playing current children's movies overhead. This resort is great for kids and adults alike, with an adult pool hideaway parents can feel at ease from the noise as they offer a "daycare" at 9$/hr. Parking was a breeze and many golfcarts offered you rides to the front lobby. As previously stated, everyone on the property followed high standards...from the Â employees offering S'mores to the attendant giving out pool towels. EXCEPT, the Castle Rock Health Club offered the worst service primarily because of just ONE rude employee. Keep in mind all other spa employees were top notch but Tracy, a spa attendant made myself and guests feel unworthy of entering the facility. We had used the free lockers provided in the locker rooms to keep our electronics safe from damage. As we entered the facility, we received the rudest glare from anyone in our 2 day stay. Walking past the desk we received no greetings or smile, almost passing her demonic presence she yells "Can I help you?" at the most inappropriate time. Â After gathering our items, leaving the spa, she looked down without recognition and gave no exit greeting like every other employee. In my honest opinion this employee, Tracy, from the Castle Rock Health Club should beÂ reprimanded/terminated for leaving the worst sour taste for the whole resort. For that, I don't recommend using any of the resort's spa services. Overall, I'm satisfied but upset how Tracy approached myself and guests. I hope she gets removed before I return for a great time.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Shhhh! Don't tell Anyone! Best kept secret in Phoenix!
review_text: Spent a week here while at a conference and doing some charity work. Staff was Awesome , Friendly , helpful, accommodating, and willing to go out of their way to look after you! If you don't mind buying your own linens and cooking utensils and supplies , then , this is the place for you! I felt comfortable and at ease the entire time I was there.Parking and community is gated, locked at night,and video monitored. I sincerely enjoyed meeting some of the other residents who were friendly and interesting! But please , don't tell everyone, because I want there to be vacancy when I return next year."The extra mile is never crowded, but I know from personal experience , it's one that Mary and Michael (our hosts)have travelled many times!" Life styles of the Rich and Famous?NO...but an awesome Budget minded comfy place to Stay... Absolutely!! 2Thumbs Way Up!

When I arrived at the hotel, I was helped by Klint Alberthal who helped with my check-in and took me and my wife up to our room. When I told him it was our Anniversary, he had the room upgraded to a junior suite, which made my wife and I very happy! During the stay, everything just got better! I was contacted by the night manager, Ismael Mendoza, and when I told him I was taking my wife to the spa, he said on behalf of his departmentand the hotel, it would be an Anniversary gift, AWESOME!!! That night me and my wife had planned to stay in and enjoy our night together, which turned out to be outstanding! Marques Williams brought a dessert up to the room and wished us a Happy Anniversary! His professionalism was remarkable and my wife couldn't believe how much the hotel was catering to us and how great the customer service was! Our night couldn't have been any better! In the morning we were in the room and while I had gone to get some ice, I ran into Trey Garcia in the hallway! He asked how my stay was going and I couldn't say enough about the hotel and the staff! He went out of his way and stopped what he was doing and helped with our luggage and called for our vehicle which was in valet. It was an awesome end to the most wonderful stay at any hotel we've ever been to. You may ask how I remembered the names of these employees, when you experience what my wife and I did, those names stuck out with no porblem. To the staff and hotel, THANK YOU for making our Anniversary so memorable!!! I would absolutely recommend this hotel to any and everyone!
Thank you,
Javier Gutierrez
Very happy and satisfied guest!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text:
My company put me up here while I was in orientation for four nights.
I found a bobby pin on the floor when I checked in ... The caulking around the tub needs to be redone ... The shower is for short people (5') or under! I still had to bend at the knees to get my arm pits under the water, and I'm only 6'1".
I was in room 236 which is on the back side facing McDonalds and the fire station which was fairly quiet, but then there were no fires either!
This is an older motel with outside doors, not a central hallway. The bed was a bit softer/worn than I'm use to ...
Breakfast was modest but filling.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn Phoenix Thomas Road

review_text:
We stayed four days at Westin La Cantera.
The overall service was good, but we want to congratulate
Doorman Carlos because of his excelent service and
Support he gave to us. Beside the excelent service he
Gave us, he was the only person in the whole hotel
(Front desk, security, waiters) thet could help us.
The waiters at the breakfast buffete were excelent.....the "la cantera hamburguer" is really good
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Your comfort is their first concern
review_text: Clean attractive rooms with a great pool and restaurant. Managers Wendy and Darrell were super helpful to us with transportation,info on restaurants, and going above and beyond just working a job! the location is great and we had a great time. We will choose this hotel again

review_title: Better than your typical Embassy Suites!
review_text: This Embassy Suites is more of an upscale resort hotel on a golf course than my standard image of the tired Embassy "atrium" experience. The staff was wonderful and the room is clean and large. Great value for the price!
Nothing spectacular but a solid choice. Nice pool. Great free breakfast and happy hour. Convenient location. All for a very reasonable price

review_title: Best hotel in the Hill Country!
review_text: The Westin La Cantera is delightful! We have stayed at this property many times, and it continues to be my family's favorite. The setting is beautiful and the accomodations, truly "Heavenly"! The staff of the hotel is unsurpassed. They are the friendliest, most welcoming group of people you will ever encounter. Carlos greets you as family when you arrive. Norberto and Collen ensure that you are efficiently cared for at check-in, and Vicki and Bobby at the new Gantry bar, make sure you enjoy your time by the pool. The club level at the hotel has a great breakfast and cocktail hour, where Monique will spoil you with service. If you get a chance to play the resort course, be sure and stop in for a snack. Sarah greets you with her sweet smile that makes your day! We love you La Cantera......see you soon!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: The pictures on HHonors were clearly done by a pro. The amenities are decent and the rest is to be expected of an Embassy Suites. The location, however, was not so great. I live in Minneapolis near a not-so-good neighborhood and I wouldn't venture into this neigborhood at night. It would appear that many local gangs like to leave their call sign on every wall. Carl's Jr. across the street was no exception. Stick to a more northern hotel and you will be fine. If you need to be "close" to downtown, you won't have much of a choice than to stay in sketchier areas.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Phoenix Airport at 24th Street

review_title: Don't Stay Here - It is that simple!
review_text: Instead of business travelers and tourists, this location caters to the local populace. The result is alcohol fueled non-stop noise late into the night, disregard of hotel rules and common courtesy and abused facilities in a poor state of repair. Our non-smoking room reeked of cigarette smoke from the previous occupant.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Phoenix Airport at 24th Street

review_text: This is our home away from home. When we need to get away and relax you cannot beat all that the Wesin La Cantera has to offer. I love their pools, cleanliness, and their outstanding staff. I have been to other resorts in the area and their SERVICE cannot compare to that of the La Cantera staff. We have been going for over 10 years and it's always like a breath of fresh air. Great way to relax from the spas to the poolside beverages. Did I mention the great service and food.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: I recieved a distressed traveler voucher from us airways that embassy suites refused to honor. The employee on the phone put me on hold for a very long time after I was quoted a rate 3 times the rate of the voucher, then referred me to another hotel. When I called the number she gave me I was told all the info I was givin was completely incorrect. I was obviously blown off! I'm also a little upset with us airways for promoting such a recognizable bait and switch. Because of this incident I will never stay at another embassy suites again. I would rather stay at an honest motel 6!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Phoenix Airport at 24th Street

review_text: We come here every year and get a really good rate because we pre-pay.IT is really good value for money,LOcation is great ,with many restaurants nearby, Staff are awesome ,.Cooked to order breakfast usually by Lorena who is a real star,Any thing she can do for. You and she will.I think it's often the staff that make any stay in hotel great and this one has a great team ,.The new manager is striving to make your stay a perfect 10 and if there is a problem she wants to know about it before you leave ,. wE will be back next year for sure .

Functional hotel but rather tiered looks and decor. No sleep number bed in my room which was noisy overlooking the outside bar area. 
Staff helpfull enough but will not be on my list for any return business trip.

review_title: Best Hotel on our 3,000+ mile Trip!
review_text:
This is 5 star all the way. If u haven't experienced the Embassy Suite hotels then start here. I'm not sure how they do it for the price but they do. We've stayed at the Phoenician before when in Scottsdale but this nite we'd read the reviews on this Embassy Suite & it was in the exact location we wanted to be. Do based upon recommendations we gave it a try knowing we could always move if we had too. We ended up staying there all 3 nites. It's situated on a golf course (ask for a room overlooking that). It was quiet and relaxing. Breakfast is pretty amazing considering it comes free with the room with cooked to order omelets too! There was a business group there having a function, there were families w kids- all blended well. The staff was discreet & helpful. Our room, the public areas, even the laundry room are immaculate. All this for $101.00/nite w our AAA discount. We were so pleased w every detail. Did I mention location? There is a Whole Foods around the corner, a fabulous mall the opposite direction, and a terrific local neighborhood restaurant named Floyds on N.Tatum, also around the corner. All the food is fresh, fresh, fresh- 
relaxed atmosphere & the price is right. A real find. Go- ENJOY! Thanks Embasssy Suites!

review_title: Great price, great rooms, great stay
review_text:
Having to move out of our house while some significant repairs were undertaken I was looking for something to "live" in. Perfect hotel.
Rooms are suites with a nice living room, kitchen, and bedroom. (Microwave, fridge, coffepot)
Price was great and they take AAA discount. Breakfast was both buffet and made to order. Very good. Nice bar area with specials and food every night.
Nice pool, great views and balcony. Golf is right next door - walking distance.
However, internet is not free. Only in the lobby. Do not get a room near the elevator (even 3 rooms away) or you will hear it all night. Also try not to be above the pool or you'll hear kids having fun past your bedtime.
Very kid friendly hotel. We stayed all week and enjoyed it.

review_title: You get what you pay for.
review_text: You definitely get what you pay for here. The TV is on the left side of the room and the bed is on the right side. How difficult would it be to put sheets on the bed that actually fit? The bottom sheet was a flat sheet that was meant for a queen size bed and we wrestled with it all night. 25 cents fill your ice bucket? What hotel charges for ice? Neighborhood not the nicest place. Don't leave the hotel after dark and definitely don't go for a sunset walk. Otherwise not to bad.
Nice service and large hotel room. The front desk staff are very polite, they processed my check in and check out fast and

review_title: Near perfect stay near public transportation
review_text: This hotel has it all. Clean, quiet, friendly staff, nice furnishings, great climate control. Local shuttle and easy access to light rail. Nice restaurant, lovely lobby. Can't name anything that didn't exceed expectations

review_title: A good place to spend a night when on business
review_text: The hotel is clean and nicely designed. A small but adequate gym and bar area. Rooms are large, each room is a suite with a bedroom, living room, nice sized bathroom and two televisions. Midtown phoenix goes to sleep at night so not much to do nearby, but light rail can take you downtown in minutes which isn't much better , but with ballpark and basketball arena downtown some places stay open later. Overall a nice place to spend a night when away on business.

review_title: Funky, fun and free of pretense.
review_text:
Stayed here for two nights for a girls weekend- loved the cool vibe!
Walking distance from the metro- great lobby with a wonderful, authentic restaurant- food straight from mexico city. Yummy maragaritas and excellent guacamole. Rooms are nothing fancy- but are comfortable and well thought out. Ask for a room that faces the pool area- be sure to check out the great views from the rooftop. The front desk folks are extra helpful- feels like they actually like their job. Check it out!
hotel_name: The Clarendon Hotel - Phoenix's Urban Retreat

review_text: Goed hotel voor 1 nacht! Ontbijt stelt niets voor, maar wat er is is wel goed! Zwembad ziet er ook lekker uit maar geen gebruik van gemaakt! Hotel ligt langs de grote weg door phoenix, maar geen last van lawaai! Ongeveer 15 min van PHX

The whole hotel is unique..from thefunky artwork on the walls to the soothing saltwater pool. The attached restaurant serves delicious meals...and the bar/lounge great cocktails. I used the complimentary PC also.
hotel_name: The Clarendon Hotel - Phoenix's Urban Retreat

review_title: This hotel has charm, history, location, and a very attentive staff and we will be back!
review_text: I've been meaning to make it over to this hotel again after staying here about 13 years ago. What a difference the new ownership has made. I had seen the pool area remodel over the years, and now after last nights stay, I got the full flavor of revitalization. As a lover of the boutique experience, I enjoy the retro charm and touches in the lobby. I was booked in a Junior Sweet, and had no expectations when I walked through the door. I was greeted with soft classical music (a wonderful touch, by the way), a clean room with adorable furnishings, and a wine fridge. The staff, from the owner to housekeeping and the front desk were warm and welcoming. I loved every aspect of the hotel, pool area and the fabulous roof top patio. The only two suggestions I would make (actually, my partner would make), is to have a more convenient smoking area, as the hotel front and roof are quite a trek at 3am, AND have some fun in decorating the brick wall view from the glass elevator. Great job guys! Had a fantastic Staycation and didn't want to leave...hence the late check out :-)
hotel_name: The Clarendon Hotel - Phoenix's Urban Retreat

review_text: Rooms have wonderful design and amazing pool. Great place for local romantic getaway and excellent service
hotel_name: The Clarendon Hotel - Phoenix's Urban Retreat

review_text: The room, pool, and the employees were wonderiful! The beds are heavely. We will be going back to your hotel!!! It's a 5 star in my book!!!
hotel_name: The Clarendon Hotel - Phoenix's Urban Retreat

review_title: Unique boutique hotel with a great energy killer pool fantastic restaurant and best rooftop in phx!
review_text: Can't say enough great things about the Clarendon. If you are looking for a unique phx experience with great energy you've found it.
hotel_name: The Clarendon Hotel - Phoenix's Urban Retreat

review_title: Our experience was unforgettable and relaxing.
review_text: Our experience at The Westin was one I will cherish forever. My daughters and I relaxed by the pool and enjoyed forgetting about our everyday routine and responsibilities. I spent time talking, and playing with my daughters as well as with my baby nephew. The Westin staff was hospitable and very polite. They sure made our experience even better. I would like to recognize these attentive workers for their professionalism and their eagerness to maintain guests delighted with their vacation. We are planning our next vacation to The Westin very soon. Thank you Ismael Mendez, Marques Williams, Klint Alberthal, Victor Hernandez, and Amanda for making our stay at The Westin just wonderful.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Our stay is worth it! The location is stunning! The entrance is well maintained. My husband is so amazed, he actually wants us to spend our holidays here:). The customer service is wonderful! From the front desk, to the valet, the restaurants, all excellent service! Everybody was smiling and greated us everywhere we go. Our room was clean. I was picky when it comes to the cleanliness of the bathroom, but wow! This is the first time I did not say any negative comments but all WOW! You even beat cleanliness of Hyatt:)!! My son loves the place! The pool, the room and he loves our balcony overviewing the city and the Six flags and fireworks every night! The restaurants serve good food, my son loves Brannons cafe. We ate there thru out our stay. But our last day, I was turned off by our server. She gave our check while we are still eating. Then she where nowhere to be found when we wer ready. We couldn't wait any longer so I stood up and bring the check to the receptionist. She apologize and I still manage to smile, give tip, and say " Thats okay". for five star hotel, no customer should feel that way, especially if you are paying for $16.00 to $19.00 a plate. Overall we love the place and will definitely come back!
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text:
Very convenient hotel for staying at during the winter and for seeing family.
Hotel is located close to shopping and the rooms are also very nice.
I would stay again

I like this hotel now because they just installed all new motion sensor switches to help conserve electricity. Any hotel that helps the environment is an 5 star hotel for me. Not to mention that the rooms were clean and the service was terrific

review_title: Get what you pay for, and probably even less. Not a good deal
review_text: Nothing fancy. Beds were NOT comfortable. In 6 night stay didn't get a good night's sleep. HVAC has issues. Warm never got cool, and it was NOVEMBER. had to wake up clerk one morning to open breakfast room. Two juices were not working. Poorly maintained breakfast on weekend. Will NOT stay here again.

We stopped for three nights in the Safari suite which was pleasant, clean and situated right by the pool. Doug made us very welcome.
A car is definitely needed especially to get to the various bars and restaurants. I've never drank so little alcohol on holiday with the need to drive! Enjoyed it though and I'd recommend it for a short stop over

review_title: The hotel is ten minutes from Sky Harbor with free shuttle service and free continental breakfast.
review_text: This is a nice, clean hotel. J. at the front desk was very helpful as was the shuttle driver. I owe them much gratitude for their assistance. The water in the rooms (like everywhere else in Phoenix) is heavily clorinated so I suggest bringing bottled water.

The room was large and clean. The AC worked wonderfully and was very quiet. I thought the bed was good but I didn't like the pillows. Do not - repeat - do not accept a room on the first or second floor on the south end (I think) of the building near the stairway. Very, very noisy at all hours with people coming and going and the exit door slamming. There are restaurants within walking distance and a Denny's and gas station across the street by the freeway entrances. The desk clerk was very sweet and friendly but even though she knew that my friend and I had been traumatized by an accident and that we needed a safe and quiet place to stay, she stuck me with the noisy stairway anyway. Go figure. Read the info sheet you fill out at check-in as there is a $ 1.50 charge for the safe that you can request to have removed. My friend and I stayed there because we took a wrong turn and the road deadended at this Red Roof Inn. Next time I would request a room that is not near the exit stairway. I just didn't know better when we checked in and, frankly, I was too wiped out and traumatized to complain. The coffee served in the lobby was excellent with flavored creamers available. I would recommend this hotel with the above written caveats.
hotel_name: Red Roof Phoenix North - Bell Road

review_title: Clean & perfect location but conference services and parking situation is pretty bad
review_text: We've had an extended conference session at this hotel and I am disappointed in the services, some of the attitude, and the poor parking situation. Wifi isn't designed for high usage either. We've been having issues everyday. For the most part, staff is friendly, although there have been a few that seem jaded and cold when asked for help. The limited free parking is behind the hotel, and a $10 per day lot is up front. Hotel refuses to validate when free lot is full, even after booking two conference rooms for 5 or 6 weeks. They also don't like to share coffee, or refill waters very timely. I am sure the rooms are great though, and as I mentioned the central location is ideal. But, if you want to earn repeat business from a local business owner, try hooking us up with some free coffee, on the spot water service, and some free parking.

The location of this place is hard to find and trying to locate their parking lot is not any easier, especially when you pull up to the hotel and one of the employees just stares at you and your car and doesn't even ask of you need help. 
The front desk person who checked me in was very unfriendly and had 0 personality and was frankly unwelcoming however works in hospitality which is ironic. I stayed in one of the Non-Cabana rooms which I had to walk through the hotel and outside to get to. The lobby and meeting room areas where fill of junk and messy. The hotel is basic in everyway possible and the bathrooms remind me of a motel 6. Granted you should know that I'm a diamond hhonors member and they should at least true try to give me a decent room that doesn't overlook the street parking and power plant.

review_title: Front desk staff rude need to learn customer service.
review_text: This was a one night stay over at a hotel staffed by rude front desk employees. Considering how empty the place was you would think they would appreciate custom. The renovations are still underway so forget about the pool etc. They are a long way from the supposed close restaurants. The location map they give you is a work of fiction. The only pleasant staff they had were the ladies serving the dreadful overbooked breakfast that we finally abandoned.

I stayed here for 3 days whilst visiting friends. Probably the strangest hotel I have ever stayed in. Spread out massively I needed to drive to breakfast. At check in they allocated a casita. It was awful. Ugly decor. They put me next to a casita where they were doing major work. Basically meant you could not stay in room as so loud. I was too jet lagged to complain. But when I got back at night I was welcomed to what one could only describe as a frat party in casita attracted to mine. I guess that is why hotel is cheap. Never again a ghastly hotel.

This was one ofbthe best stays I've ever had. I would go back if I had to. I wasn't to happy with the location but it was fine. For breakfast there was only coffee. The was a convieniet location for a McDonald's right across the road. 
I would deffinetly recommended this motel t anyone out there.

I wasn't sure what I was going to get when I booked at the Clarendon but I decided to give it a try after reading the reviews. I was still a little unsure when I entered the neighborhood, not much else around but I was determined to keep an open mind. The lobby of the hotel was nothing much but the person at the desk was very helpful and offered me a bottled water or soda. This is an example of the small nicities that make this hotel unique. The rooms of the hotel are arranged around a central courtyard containing a decent sized swimming pool and huge hot tub. There were many lounge chairs, outside speakers playing music and a cool water wall at the far end. This pool area is open to midnight, which is cool considering the heat of Phoenix makes outdoor living after dark a must. Because this hotel caters to a more adult clientele there is not the mad chaotic pool scene that is often found at the chain hotel's pools. The only thing missing was a poolside bar but the restaurant bar is not far from the pool and are happy to put your drinks is a platic cup to be enjoyed poolside. Also several times when enjoying the pool area the manager walked by and asked people if they would like a water or soda. 
The rooms were spacious, the bed was comfortable, the room had a refrigerator and a 42 inch LCD TV. The bathroom was clean but nothing special and the room was a bit dark. 
There is also a cool roof top deck that had tables, comfy chairs and large umbrellas for shade. This is a great place to enjoy a drink, surf the Internet and watch the sunset. 
top Pros of this hotel: service of staff, great on site restaurant, roof top deck, people watching, covered parking, large TV, free wi-fi throughout the property, location close to many area attractions.
Top limitations of this hotel: wi-fi spotty at times, no poolside or roof top bar, one small elevator makes using the stairs the preferred method, $15 a day resort fee.
hotel_name: The Clarendon Hotel - Phoenix's Urban Retreat

review_title: Really cool hotel with a "south beach FL vibe" and very inexpensive. Great staff, rooms, and restaurant. All ages :)
review_text: Really unique hotel for downtown Phoenix. Beautiful pool area, plenty of different style lounge chairs and palapa poolside beds. Great rooftop for intimate couples and big parties. Rooms are big, clean and fun with a funky retro decor. Restaurant is fabulous, everyone is super. Fun, professional staff but not stuffy.
hotel_name: The Clarendon Hotel - Phoenix's Urban Retreat

review_text: This was our third stay at this property, and it was exactly as it was the previous stays. Two earlier reviews stated they had encountered bed bugs here, but we found no evidence of them. Also management said they had thoroughly gone over the property so that gave us a tad more confidence. We like this place, dark rooms are a plus in hot-as-hell Phoenix, and the breakfast buffet is fairly nice. It's comfortable and large enough to spread out in, except we couldn't find luggage racks so used two chairs instead. We like Lafitte's, the onsite restaurant as well. We would definitely stay here again.
Friendly staff. Good value. Breakfast buffet was great offering hot and cold items along with made to order omelets and waffles. Would definitely stay again.

Noisy because the hotel is so closed to the airport and light rail station, plus the bus and the parking area. The hotel gives guests ear plugs and eye mask, I think maybe due to the noise and its half window curtain. The smell of the hotel is bad, and the room is old. I should've looked the reviews before I came. But I canceled the rest of four days reservation and moved to Hilton Suites, Phoenix, which is still the number 1 for me.
Generous two hour Happy Hour and cooked to order breakfast. Front desk people very friendly and helpful.

I would not recommend this hotel. Our air conditioner was not working in the sitting room. The suite was very outdated and very small. There was lots of loud banging going on and a lot of kids. The place reminded me of a run down apartment building. The elevator was also broken. Don't let the professional hotel photos fool you. The patio was tiny and the view was of the parking lot.

review_title: Overcrowded with daily use local guests
review_text: Great rooms- great kid activities. Overcrowded with locals that spend $20 to spend the day. Especially unsupervised teens.

review_title: best service and hospitality for the money value in the Phoenix area
review_text: I travel for a living, the staff and facility at the Clarion Hotel at Phoenix Tech Center are just a joy to be around. Great location great amenities for the money spent. What a great value for the price.

review_title: Back around to Arizona. Had to go to the pointe Squaw peak.
review_text: Kids loved the river ranch and hole in the wall. Too much fun. Great value water park and a room for less than price of admission at other water parks. Don't miss the prime rib dinner on Thursdays at hole in the wall. Ask for Tatum she's a gem.

review_title: Nice hotel if you bring kids.
review_text: Water park is excellent. Room service menu very kid friendly and food was very good. Might not be the best choice for romantic weekend. Price was right so was excellent value.

Was stranded in Phoenix last night, and got a great rate ($60). Very comfy bed, very clean, friendly staff, great breakfast buffet, fast airport shuttle. All in all, totally with it for a great night's sleep.

review_title: Normal place to stay next to the airport
review_text: As we had a very early flight, we tried to find the place near to the airport. Econo Lodge is that place. Free WIFI, free breakfast starting at 4.00 am and a very reasonable price. Clean and big rooms, parking next to the door. So, nothing wrong about this hotel.

review_title: Close to PHX airport and excellent staff...
review_text: I had flown into Phoenix without making reservations, and I had to call from the airport, but the staff was very helpful in getting me a room and also giving me the right directions in order to take the shuttle to and from the hotel and airport. I stayed for 3 nights, and my room was always clean and quiet. Breakfast was good, but after two days of bagels and coffee, I wanted hot breakfast, but the front desk guy referred me to this breakfast place called Over Easy, and breakfast there was amazing. I would recommend this hotel to everyone who want to stay close to the airport.

We booked this hotel because we were coming in late in the Phoenix area. They have free shuttle service but make sure you have the hotel number because it is not listed as an option at the airport. (Management - this is something that you may want to fix for the convenience of guests) We did not have to wait long, once we got the number. The bar at the lobby area has good food. Tacos are good, I ordered chicken instead of beef. (a tip for the nonred meat eaters) the salsa is a little too spicy for my liking, though.
If you are a Hilton Honors member, book a room at the concierge level. The extra money you pay I think is worth it for the free breakfast and drinks/soda.
The rooms are nice and clean. Beds comfortable and bathrooms clean with nice toiletries. (not the cheapo generic ones)
There is a Hertz rental car option but when you book,make sure you specify to pick up the car at the hotel. It saves a lot of time because you can easily waste an hour if take the shuttle again to the airport.

review_title: I wouldn't stay here if I were you.
review_text: Bathtub and toilet were dirty and covered in hair. I asked to change rooms and the second room wasn't any better. The front desk's response...."we clean our rooms someone must have been in there since." Hmm....I think we have a bigger problem then if someone else has a key.

Beware this place is in the seediest part of town. Even though it was close to the airport there was no amenities except a gas station nearby. Felt frightened to leave my room (never felt so unsafe before...in Asia, Europe, Australia etc.)
Do yourself a favor pay an extra $15 and stay in Tempe.

We enjoyed the room and the onsite restaurant Rico's BUT unfortunately the quiet weekend away was not possible at this resort. If you have kids you will most likely enjoy this facility - beware that the use of the water park is not included in your room (ridiculous). The resort does not limit access of any pool or hot tub to adults only so we often found ourselves being climbed on, splashed, kicked, hit with a flying toy while trying to relax in the hot tub at 10:30 pm. Really if your kids are wearing floaties the hot tub is not a safe appropriate place for them! Stay here if you have children to entertain but if you are looking for relaxation keep looking.

We live about 40 miles from the resort but we stayed over night for a wedding. The service and staff were exceptional from arrival to departure. The wedding was amazing from the ceremony to the reception. Included in the wedding room rate were 4 water park passes which we used the day after the wedding. We had so much fun we ended up staying until closing. Overall I cannot wait to return to the resort for another family staycation.

Stayed for one night. Waited 50 minutes for free shuttle which never arrived. We ended up paying for s taxi to the hotel. 
Check in staff scruffy & unfriendly. We requested them to refund our cab fare which they agreed to. However this didn't happen & an unhelpful & rude manager called Kirsten declined to assist the following morning. There is clear lack of communication between the staff & their customer service towards their Hhonors members is poor. 
Rooms fine - basic but clean

Happy again for 4th time at this resort. It is great for younger kids although my husband and I are always happy here too. Enjoyed the pool near the lobby this year compared to other years. They have very comfortable chaise lounges at that one. 
I would eat elsewhere as the restaurants are mediocre at best. Hole in the wall is consistently just ok food with bad service.
We always go to Aunt Chiladas down the street, love sitting outside there. We also liked Sauce(drove) and of course Tommy Bahama in Scottsdale is awesome.
We also went to Rawhide for the first time. Just ok. Money maker is all.
All staff is sooo friendly. All said hello anytime they were near us. Manny was awesome. Actually ALL at the door were the best customer service I've seen. Made us feel pampered immediately, much better than some very expensive resorts we've been at. Great team.
If i were to complain about anything it

review_title: Wonderful resort amenities in a convenient location
review_text:
We came to visit our nephew a college student. The location is great about 15 minutes from airport and immediately off the baseline exit of hwy 10.
