 We stayed in a king suite room with a pullout sleeper Room extremely clean quiet. The grounds landscaped beautifully with fountains. Pool and hot tub very nice. A nice gift shop , concierge services and restaurants
I stayed here for a work retreat and was thoroughly impressed with the amenities, service, cleanliness, and overall environment.

review_title: Amazing resort that is a getaway feel that is around the corner
review_text: I love that my family can visit a beautiful resort at an amazing value that is located nearby. The staff was very professional, attentive especially the front desk staff. Very clean and very comfortable beds!!

We are currently staying at AGR and there is nothing resort about thus place!! We are a group of 7 women who wanted to escape and lay by the pool, well what they don't tell you us that their main attraction (the oasis pool and waterpark) is only open on saturday!!! So here we are without a car and there is only a "family pool" open! So that means no service, no snack bar no drinks nothing!! To top it off the sign in front of the watermark say they were open from 11-4 today a gate was open and so we went in then a security guard came in and told us we were trespassing!!!!! Choose a different resort if you are looking to relax by the pool!!

Room type was a Junior Suite w/king bed.
Very spacious room. Well furnished with attractive decor with subtle southwest flair. Plenty of seating. Larger bathroom with separate tiled stall shower and large, oval jetted tub. Granite vanity with expansive mirror above. Granite wet bar w/refrigerator and coffee maker. Large, well lit work desk. Furnished balcony.
Adequate fitness center. Comfortable Hhonors Club Room with good selection of food and beverages offered. Well stocked gift/sundries shop.
Hotel staff very friendly....was even greeted by housekeeping in the hallway, "Welcome to the Hilton". The was an overcharge error of the room rate which was corrected immediately.
Would definitely stay here again.

I traveled to Phoenix on business a brought the family. We really enjoyed the water park. The rooms were nice and clean and reasonably priced. We didn't have a chance to use the athletic club on this visit, but I have been up there before and it was excellent. 
If you have the kiddos with you, request a room near the water park. Also, there are lots of good rates available in the summer since it is hot and off season in Phoenix.
Food and drink is typically expensive in the water park and you can't bring your own.

Typical courtyard, clean, good room, easy checkin,
 spacious room etc etc.. Will stay again

review_title: A typical upscale resort. Great experience.
review_text:
My wife and I stayed here during early summer for 5 nights. This is a beautiful resort. The grounds are very well kept. Rooms are clean and spacious. Loved the typical desert architecture of the hotel rooms. There are some water rides as well which unfortunately we could not check out. There is a fabulous Mexican restaurant on the property grounds that is a must visit for real Mexican taste. 
Over all great place

Nasty. Was probably very nice 20 years ago. Rooms need major over haul. Pool Oasis was cool, but it was over populated by 200+ people. Felt like we were ona dirty, low budget cruise or summer camp. 
So many nicer places to stay, like Camelback Inn, Intercontinental, Marriott Desert Ridge, hyatt Gainey ranch, etc. Will never go back.

hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Just spent a great 2 day stay in a lovely spacious Cassita - all the staff from check-in, conceige, computer technician to Lobby Shop were kind, thoughtful and helpful - great level of service! Will book this hotel again when next in Phoenix.

review_title: R and R - rest and recreation
review_text: The most relaxing resort for my friend and family with a yearly tradition to venture back for more fun each season.

review_title: Stayed previously and would stay again.
review_text:
Property, service and location were great. Restaurant service and food was good (restaurant in lobby). Each unit is spacious. The in room refrigerator was difficult to use for our own purpose because it was already filled with resort provided convenience snacks and beverages. Wish the suites had a microwave for re-heating dinner leftovers.
Fitness center was the largest and most impressive I have seen at a resort and was included in the mandatory daily resort fee.
Water park was another way for the family to stay cool in the summer heat, though the pools were nice as well.

review_title: Not as nice as I expected
review_text:
I had high hopes for this resort. However, upon checking in and getting to our room, I was very disappointed. The room was tiny, though it said that it sleeps five. My husband called the front desk to see if we could switch rooms or upgrade and was told no since we booked through a third party (travelocity). The desk clerk mentioned third party numerous times...to the point of upsetting my husband. He offered no solutions or resolutions to our sleeping arrangements.
The whole hotel was not very clean, it seemed a bit outdated, and the staff not very friendly. The waterpark area was nice though, and enjoyed by our three kids.
I would not be in a hurry to return to his hotel.
Good value for your money and a central location. Hot breakfast available each morning. Guest laundry available.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Phoenix I-17 MetroCenter Inn

review_text: Clean, updated rooms with an excellent staff and amenities. Located right on the river walk within a few minutes walk to restaurants and the Alamo.

review_title: Awesome place for the whole family to enjoy each other and their surroundings.
review_text: Very friendly staff. Extremely clean rooms. Excellent service and accommodations. Excellent place for families.

review_title: What a great place to stay!!!
review_text: What a cool place to stay, even in July. Our room was really nice. The view from our room looked over the water park with a mountain range behind it. The water park is a fabulous place to take the family. The service was great. The bar tenders and waiters were prompt and friendly. The whole park was clean and well maintained. The restaurant had great food with nice atmosphere. The service was excellent. I played golf at a top notch course that wound thru the mountain. The last hole looked over the entire city. The service was nice on the course but the golf pro wasn't. I don't like when management disciplines is employees in front of its customers. Overall the room was. Great! The water park was amazing! The restaurant was excellent. I will be back when we visit. That you Arizona Grand.

This place is great! We spent the entire weekend at the Oasis water park. The park was very clean. Service staff was great and lifeguards were very attentive. Literally, every 20 feet.....another lifeguard. Rooms were pretty nice. Overall, the service was outstanding! Even though it was crowded, we enjoyed this property immensely. We will definitely be back!

This was our second annual Father's Day trip to the resort. Both times we paid with Marriott Rewards and we have sworn to earn enough points (30K per night) to be able to return each year! 
The hotel is always so accommodating- we checked in early, I was given a choice of 2 different room locations, our room was ready 4 hrs ahead of check-in time! We went straight to the pool while our bags went to our room- they were there when we got back. 
The waterpark is what sets this resort apart from the many others in the area. It's huge, gorgeous and extremely well-maintained. Staff are everywhere, are diligent in lifeguarding, but also very kind and friendly to everyone. 
Our family travels a lot (hence the many points), but this resort is our favorite because we truly come home from our vacations here feeling pampered and rested.
hotel_name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

review_title: The service shines at the Westin La Cantera!
review_text:
I live in San Antonio and I like to take my kids to local resorts for weekend getaways. I actually live half a mile from the JW Marriott Hill Country Resort. What sets the Westin apart is the service.
From the moment we walked in, we were treated with fantastic service. Every employee went out of their way to make sure our needs were taken care of. We spent the weekend by the pool. Cody made sure our drinks were filled and our lunches were hot and fresh. Pete, the chef in Brannon's Restaurant, made our Sunday Brunch buffet, one of the best we've had. From his delicious omelets to his wonderful smile, he made it an adventure for the kids. The hotel has so many activities for kids, from smores by the fire pit, to the outdoor movie and arcade, my 8 year old son was in heaven. Anna, who works in the kids center, stayed in the arcade and played with my son for hours! She is now his new best friend. 
The shuttle service to the mall was great. We were able to go shopping and have dinner without worrying about the car. The entire resort was beautiful and the rooms were relaxing. 
Sure, we could go to the Marriott by our house, but I would rather drive 30 minutes to get the service at the Westin.
We will definitely be back for another weekend getaway!
Michelle Williamson
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: Booked with a travel zoo promotional price and we sure got our money's worth! Excellent staff, great service and beautiful grounds, would have stayed longer if we could've afforded it... For what you pay though the value is through the roof! Dining is resort prices, but the food quality is above and beyond - special thanks to Pete at the bomelette bar in Brannons Cafe, very friendly service! Dinner in Franchesas At Sunset exceeded any expectations we had for a birthday dinner, and who knew Bread Pudding could be so good?
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_text: May family and I wanted to have one "End of summer" trip before school started so we decided to try the Westin La Cantera. I was very pleased with the resort overall. From the time we arrived at the property we were treated superbly. The guard at the gate was helpful and welcomed us as if we had known her forever. The valet was awesome and took care of our things while I checked in. Front desk staff was amazing. Check in took 2 minutes and I was headed to my "Casita" we stayed in the Casitas which are small villas on the property separate from the main hotel. A valet named Chris took drove us to our room and assisted with our luggage. We were also issued a golf cart to use around the property. The rooms were clean and the beds were fantasic. A young man named Victor Hernandez I believe, seemed to be assigned to us by the service express department, because every time I had a question or needed something he seemed to be right there to assist my family and me. This type of excellent service will keep us returning to the westin. Room service was top notch. Our breakfast was delivered warm and with everything we asked for, not one mistake on such a complex order. We also ate in two of the resturants on the property where the service was first rate and the dishes outstanding. The pools and activities were so wonderful we only left the hotel once the entire weekend. They offered everything we wanted and more.. Overall this hotel rates as my favorite place to stay in San Antonio, I will never stay anywhere else when I vist. Thank you to the great staff and management at the Westin for one perfect last summer getaway.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Full free breakfast, free wine, extremely clean and great service!
review_text: This place really understands that the little things matter. Full FREE breakfast included self made waffles, a rolling toaster, and fresh muffins. Free wine and cheese on tues, wed, and Thurs. The entire hotel appears new and extremely clean. Our room was very spacious for our family of 5. The pillows were so soft we purchased one. The pool was very inviting and relaxing with the waterfalls and lighting. The hotel had a shuttle to the riverwalk and gave us a free desert coupon to the Resturant we ate at. Only draw back is the area seemed to have a few homeless people. However once we were got to the hotel, it wasn't an issue.

review_title: Free rooms with points -- not unless you argue
review_text:
This is a great resort, especially for families. So it is unfortunate they are trying to add a "resort fee" to rooms billed as free nights, a cost of $20 oer night per room. Since it is added without regard to use of additional services, it is really just additional room rate, stated as an add on. They did remove it after an argument, but it leaves a bad taste, especially after the cowardly way of informing you about it - a little card tucked in with your room key, explaining it covers internet and other resort amenities, never mind that you did not bring a computer.
That said, to the resort itself.
It is what you would expect in a Westin, nice room, big pretty public areas, several dining venues casual to upscale priced accordingly. However, this is really set up for kids to enjoy. There are daily activities such as Dinosauer George who came with a huge array of fossils and a very entertaining program. Smores on the patio at night, etc., all at no charge.
The pool is great, one has a slide. We spent a whole day there. There is an adults only pool if you are single or a couple with no kids.
KIDS EAT FREE if they are 5 and under, even at the pool. The pool service was good, and so wax tne food. We brought some drinks and snacks of our own poolside with no problem.
Breakfast on Sunday we went to the cafe for the buffet, $22 adults, $12 kids over 5. Menu selections at lower prices were also available. The food was really good and service was friendly and prompt. The kids loved the loony tunes characters who went table to table and posed for pictures.
We really liked this resort and hope to return. One family told us they come every year because of the programs for kids.
Have kids and want free time or a quiet meal? Use kids club. It is not cheap, but they charge you half with a hotel restaurant receipt. We did not use this, so I cannot comment on quality.
hotel_name: Westin La Cantera Hill Country Resort

review_title: Blood stains, smoky rooms and police raid.
review_text: If you like to stay in drug ridden hotels, this is perfect! The first room has the stinch of smoke and dirt along with what looked like a huge blood stain by the front door. The 2 nd room they put us in was not much better, as we woke up to a huge police raid and coroner in the room directly above us. The woman at the front desk dismissed it as "not our fault". This is not a place for families or 8 year olds as ours got a real education. STAY AWAY.

The first thing that impressed me was the price. Booking cheaply online is always a little bit nerve-wracking, and you can't always believe reviews online. I've never stayed at a La Quinta this inexpensively, so it was a shock to arrive last night and find the hotel actually quite lush & upscale.
Checking in was a breeze. Liz was very friendly, despite being swamped with phone calls, and our special needs: paying cash by-night and keeping the reservation held on my debit card, as we would be working a convention until the following evening. She made all the proper notations on my account. I had received a package, and she made sure to let me know immediately upon checkin. Normally, I have to ask if an expected package has arrived.
The room (2 doubles) is huge. The a/c was already going at a comfortable temp. The room included a micro/fridge, coffee maker, desk, and a 32" flatscreen TV (with tons of channels, including Cartoon Network and Nickelodeon!). Good water pressure in the shower, and it's easy to regulate temperature. Everything is immaculately clean. 
There are Coke products available in the vending areas, which are located all over the premises. I believe there are multiple ice locations as well.
The hotel offers laundry facilities.
Breakfast fare is slightly above average: cereal, bagels, muffins, waffles, oatmeal, fruit, hardboiled eggs, yogurt, coffee, juice. The coffee is a tad on the weak side.
The pool is smaller, but very nice & well-maintained. It's also open much later than many other hotel pools: 11pm!
All this has been grand...then Natalie happened. She called this morning to inform me that we hadn't paid for our room and that we would need to come into the office immediately to take care of it. I explained that there should be notes on the reservation about our paying in cash by-night, but that there was simply no way either of us could leave work when payment arrangements had already been made. She was not at all polite about the situation - not exactly rude, but her tone and wording made it clear that she wasn't interested in providing service: just getting paid. She curtly said she'd have to talk it over with her manager. I replied that was fine, and that I've never had a La Quinta (or any other hotel chain) refuse to work with me, and that I expected her manager would be willing to accommodate our special needs as well. She said she'd call back, and we hung up.
She never called. I gave it a couple hours and called her back. She answered in a very friendly voice, "La Quinta Phoenix North, this is Natalie," and when I said who I was, her voice fell immediately, and she said only, "Oh." I'm never impressed when a customer service agent projects disdain, but instead of getting rude, I simply asked if she'd heard anything from her manager. She really didn't give me a clear answer, just muttered something about how it was being held but that we would have to pay for the room today. I said, "Well, naturally. We'll have to come back and sleep tonight, so of course we'd have to come in and pay first." 
Natalie then said, "but you'll HAVE to pay for the next morning before you leave that day." Admittedly, I hadn't yet told her that I intended to pay for the rest of the weekend tonight, but her attitude in the "HAVE to" statement was really unneccsary. I asked for the remaining total, explaining that we'd be taking care of the total amount today. She put me on hold, got the amount, I thanked her, and we again hung up.
The overall exchange tells me that either a) she was unsure of handling an unfamiliar situation and reacting in frustration or anger, or b) just unpleasant in general. I'm choosing to believe the former, but it doesn't exonerate her from handling the situation with such a bad attitude. It didn't have to be difficult - all she had to do was read the notes made during checkin, and treat it as a reservation. There was no need to call, prior arrangement had already been made. Instead she wasted a great deal of everyone's time, and talked to me (a valued customer) like a child. That's inexcusable in any profession.
BUT. We will not allow the antics of one employee to ruin a good weekend at a very nice hotel! I encourage you to give this La Quinta a try, and with any luck, miss Natalie was just having a bad day, and will give you a better time than she gave me. I expect good things from the rest of our stay.

We took our 12 year old son and his friend and had a fantastic time. The boys enjoyed themselves at the water park, pool and even dinner. We ate dinner and breakfast at the main restaurant and the food was great and very large portions. The atmosphere is beautiful. Its also very close to shopping. I wish we would've stayed longer.

Based on reviews we chose the hotel for it's location and amenities. The Oasis Water Park for hotel guests was a pleasant surprise. We found ourselves winding our way down the lazy river the very first night we arrived. The lush mature landscaping was a welcome reprieve from the dusty dry desert and with several pools from which to choose, it was easy to relax in comfort after undergoing a 52 million reno, the rooms were well appointed and spacious. Overall, the hotel was a bit worn with stained walkways and uncollected cups and trays, but a fine family retreat.

This hotel is great for families with children who are old enough to enjoy the water park. The water park has wave pool, lazy river, slides and tot play area . If you are a guest the pool size snack & drink service is convenient but a little pricey ($8-$12 for snack bar grade food). Near the bar they do offer free cups of water, which is great. Also the use of their towels.
The hotel itself has beautiful grounds but is starting to look worn down in places. Our room was large , comfortable bed, nice deco but housekeeping was not the strongest. Our minibar was half empty and had stuff in it from the last guest. We had to call 3 times before someone came ( the next day)to fix and inventory it. Also our coffee maker was unwashed and had spilled sugar ( along with sugar ants). The bathtub too was looked unwashed.
But those little things aside it IS worth it IF you are needing a hotel anyway and will take advantage of the water park area.
Quite nice. Â The private water park is a blast for kids and keeps kids away from the other pools which is a blast for adults.

review_title: Nice location much different from the airport
review_text: Stayed five days asked for a high floor. The clerk said second floor and I said no. A fourth floor room facing the pool was assigned. The room was very spacious, small area to the right, living room and bedroom was suite like. The tub and toilet were separate from the sink. The light dinner was ok, but the beef was that mystery meat you had either at a school cafeteria or dining commons. And the school stuff was better!! Salads and chips available. Slept like a baby, did not hear a thing. Breakfast was ok, the ladies work very hard to keep the place running. One morning, someone must have called in sick cause a lady in a black frilly dress with heels and painted toenails worked the breakfast room. If she was at the sports bar across the street, I would have tired to talk her up to my room. Anyway, one glitch was my last day, I had cleared my room except for some cereal boxes and items in the fridge. I get back at 10am and the bed is made, everything cleared except for milk and juice in the fridge. I didn't mention that to the front desk, just thought it was unusual that the room was made with towels and bed done before I checked out. Good safe location easy access to and from locations, except for the mystery meat.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Phoenix - Biltmore

review_title: Clean, comfortable suites with great food & staff
review_text: My family made a stop here on our way to California. The suites were very spacious & comfortable & the food was excellent. The staff made us feel welcome :) we will be back!
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Phoenix - Biltmore

review_title: Very good but not a value pick
review_text: Superb location by the riverwalk. Our room was unfortunately not on the river side and it was a bit noisy due to traffic. Internet is free only in the lobby. Go there only if you have a discount on regular price.
Man it was awesome everyone was extremely helpful. It didn't matter if it was the lawn guy or the front desk. Everyone offered to take us directly to our suite!
Well trained staff, clean accommodations, moderately acceptable fitness room, decent breakfast offerings. Tyical Marriott site.

Super clean. The staff were always more than accomodating. Pool area was really clean and enjoyable to use for a family with younger kids. One of their "happy hour" type events had food and beverages for kids and adults. Saved us from having to cook dinner after a long day. Breakfast was great. Plenty of seating and more than enough food. A much nicer area than most. A short drive on the interstate from Banner Good Sumaritan Hospital and a much nicer area!

review_title: Resort showing signs of age but great water park and restaurants.
review_text:
The water park is the center piece of this resort and it is a fantastic facility, ideal for families of all ages. The hygeine and level of service is good, and the food and drink is reasonably priced too. We ate at Aunt Enchiladas and Rustlers Rooste, both of which served great food at very reasonable prices and we would highly recommend. 
The lobby grill which served breakfast isn't as good as the other restaurants and is way over priced. 
We booked through a Living Social deal which was great value at $169 per night incl breakfast and $50 spa credit.

There is a reason people go to chains, and this is a good example of why. Everything was just right at this Residence Inn and I would definitely return there when back in the area. Reasonably priced too.

We stayed one night to be close to the airport after a weeklong stay in other parts of Arizona. Kids loves the waterpark. Clean and plenty of seats and lifeguards.
Room was a nice size but outdated and sheets and towels were dirty. We didn't like being in the room at all.
Price included the 100 resort credit which was nice. Dinner at lobby grill was good.
If you are paying a 30 resort fee wifi should be included!

This property is nice enough... unfortunately, judging from the prices for the rooms, food, parking, et al, one would think that the hotel were a five star palace in Paris. Worse yet, after paying an arm and a leg you are forced to wait ad infinitum to have anything in the way of customer service. I waited 2 hours for my order! The biggest joke of all is the "express service" button on the phones, one of which worked. The only thing that is delivered with any promptness is a scripted "we are sorry for your wait, let me find out what happened". If you have more money than sense, and plenty of time to wait you might be more satisfied than I was. If you are a normal human being, that expects to get what you pay for, look somewhere else. Options abound on the riverwalk.

Bellissima struttura, enorme...
Le camere sono bellissime, una doppia equivale ad una stanza con 2 matrimoniali king, con salottino e dotata di tutti i confort...
La colazione e' a pagamento, ma almeno una volta e' da provare perchÃ© e' eccezionale... Ottima la posizione come il prezzo. Consigliato a tutti!

The hotel is super clean and comfortable. The staff is friendly and efficient. Kevin, the GM, was extremely helpful this morning when I was trying to extend my stay by one night. He accommodated my request quickly and made it simple. The breakfast is excellent quality and everything looks fresh. The equipment in the fitness room is very modern. The location is perfect and I will come back here with the family next time I visit Phoenix. Thank you Kevin and all your staff!

review_title: Great hotel in a perfect location!
review_text: I really enjoyed this hotel. The rooms are nice and the bed is very comfortable. I was there for a comference and did not have personal transportation but this hotel is located in the center of everything. The glass elevators provide a great view of the city. The hotel staff was very friendly and helpful all the time. I really enjoyed staying there for a whole week!

We had a great time at this distinct and special resort, but there's some room for improvement, specifically:
 - No free morning coffee, in fact a small coffee in a paper cup cost $4.10
 - horrible self parking options (e.g. long walk with bags) 
 - no ice near hotel room (guests must call room service and wait long for delivery)
 - fitness room too small/ crowded
 - no ability to make tennis reservations prior to arriving at resort
 - lots of reserved signs on poolside lounge chairs that never got used (at least 20%)
 - significant daily resort fee
Even with the above issues, it's stll a really nice resort: 
 - buildings, grounds, fountains and artwork are top notch
 - service was professional, efficient and friendly
 - food at Frank & Albert's was very good
 - loved sitting by firepit and fountain
 - free 18 hole putting course was fun and good way to enjoy grounds
 - nice tennis courts
 - comfy beds
 - lots of pools

review_title: Great family hotel with water park
review_text: Stayed here with a two year old. Huge pool and waterpark with dive in kids movies. Location far from stuff but why leave resort?

review_title: Everything is great except the rooms.
review_text:
Our family of 5 including two teenagers and a ten year old booked a week at the Arizona Grand. Overall everything is wonderful, food, service, the watermark- all excellent. We stayed in a deluxe two queen suite which also includes a pull out queen sofa bed. We've stayed in many hotels previously and had our teens sleep on the sofa beds but this one was particularly uncomfortable. So much so that we ended up taking turns on it just to make sure every one got a chance at a good night sleep. Basically I spent two nights sleeping on a couch during what was supposed to be a relaxing vacation. Twice I asked management for a solution but was told we would have
to pay an additional $300 per night for an additional room. All I can say is that the "suites" do not comfortably accommodate 5 people as advertised. Not getting a good night sleep put a huge damper on the whole trip for all of is.

review_title: It felt like home, clean and friendly!
review_text: The room sizes are very generous, lots of space to relax. Everything was very clean and well taken care of. Breakfast was great, with a good variety. We Loved the firepit and the easy access to shopping and restaurants. The free shuttle and the staff are the best.

review_title: Talk about a ripoff. Don't get the Terrace upgrade.
review_text: Terrace door stuck. Ice maker broken. Tub doesn't drain. Cigarette butts on the terrace. Cheesy little bar fridge with a lock and no key. Sounds like a Days Inn but its not. Its a shame. Don't even get me started about the less than flexible spa staff, dirty carpets or the noise at night. This place will overpromise and under deliver...and overcharge.

review_title: If you want to stay in luxury, this is the place to stay.
review_text: I was fortunate to have the opportunity to stay almost a week here. The hotel is very historical. The grounds are beautiful, and well maintained. I don't even think I had a chance to explore all of it. I especially enjoyed sitting out on the patio, by the fire pit at night enjoying drinks. This is not a place to worry about $$$. Everything is very expensive here. But for a once a life time experience I highly recommend it. Where else can you stay at the same hotel where almost every president has stayed. Very Cool.

In September 2011 I spent 11 nights in this hotel. There's not much to see in downtown Phoenix, but you can get easily to Mill Avenue and Scottsdale and other good places by light rail or by bus. The hotel itself is great - clean rooms, large LCD tv, couple of good restaurants... If I ever visit Phoenix again, I will choose this hotel again for sure!

Our stay at the Grand was delightful though it was shortened by a family emergency. But in our brief stay, we quickly came to love the beautiful, well-maintained grounds, the plentiful accomodations and most impressive, the warm & friendly staff. In particular, Conierge Tim Watkins went above and beyond to
help make our stay as pleasant as possible. His service alone was reason enough to bring us back another time in the future and to recommend this resort to others.
Thank you Tim!!!

The rooms were very nice, comfortable beds, nice flat screen tv, spacious bathroom and room overall. The area and hotel itself is well maintained and very clean. There is a pool and jacuzzi with a very pretty patio that has an outdoor fireplace. They have a full bar available and offer free breakfast, but I was not impressed with breakfast. They had a few options but nothing too good, on our last day they actually started cleaning out the food area before 10 am when breakfast is 7 to 10. A couple of other things that bugged me were that the room did not have the hotel information such as how to access the internet or pool hours, I had to call and find out. The next is, when our room was cleaned we didnt get more body soap, shampoo, or lotion. I would reccomend it, we got a deal on it so it was worth the $ but I would not pay the 150 regular price per night.

review_title: Nice place for a short stay
review_text:
We stayed for nine nights in March 2011 to get away from the Midwest winter. The staff was excellent at all times. The rooms were two room suites and were clean. However the bathroom was very small especially for a suite. The insure watermark is fine to visit for one or two days.
The food was very good, but limited for a 9 day stay. We had the deal for $35 extra per day we had $100 per day towards food. Room service was very good and prompt. Note the room service kitchen is separate from the restaurant! For the two egg breakfast I received 4 slices of bacon at the restaurant and 2 pieces for room service? Prices are typical resort prices. Great view of the golf course from the restaurant was excellent. The resort is next to the south mountain park which has some very good rugged hiking.

We had high tea in the lobby next to Frank and Alberts. It was so delightful, the tea was scrumptious as well as the food. The best was the service from Kevin. I love when people love what they do and he is a prime example. He took the time to explain the ingredients in everything and what would taste better with certain food. What a great experience!

My husband and I had our wedding at the AZ grand resort November 2010 and it was absolutely wonderful. Our guests could not get over how beautiful the view was and our wedding planner Melanie really kept things together making our wedding a night to remember! Our guests are still talking about it. The rooms were a bit pricey and they did charge us for more guests than we had which was a complete misunderstanding, but the overall atmosphere was so fun. Thank you AZ grand for making our wedding the best!

review_title: Great customer service & large comfy rooms!
review_text:
The customer service was exceptional at the hotel, in particular from Erin at reception. She was sensational and an example of what customer service should be! My entire experience at this hotel was great. As a priceline customer i was expecting to be given a room & not have an option, I got to choose where in hotel I would like to be & after requesting a king high room I was given a massive room on the top floor of hotel w/ amazing views! Was very happy they didn't discriminate how I booked and I had a great stay. Room was very clean, lots of amenities and housekeeping were very fast! Only problem was having to pay for Internet in the room & again downstairs if u wanted to print, turns out there is a computer to print boarding passes which I didn't see till I had paid to use computer in business centre. 
Ate at sports grill networks & my veggie burger & fries were great & value for money if u don't want to leave hotel. Directions from staff were clear & accurate, they know the area well. Would not hesitate to stay here again or recommend to people.

review_title: The Westin Hotel on the Riverwalk is an amazing hotel with a fantastic staff, deliciious food and the most comfortable beds.
review_text: When we arrived at the Westin we were greeted at the door so warmly. Destiny helped us at check in. She was wonderful and so gracious. She also has a beautiful smile. Our rooms were so clean and the bed so comfortable. If we needee anythhing all we had to do was ask. We met the general manager Mr. Bill Petrella. He was also so warm and welcoming. He made us feel so at home and he was genuinely interested in our comfort. He made us feel at home. The food in the resturant and the small snack shop was delicious. We plan on staying at the Westin again.

Because of a mix up with my company...my group was moved to the Arizona Biltmore at the last minute. I did no research on the property..and felt like we were getting the short end of the stick. To my surprise - this Waldorf Astoria location was even better than any story I could have be told.
I felt like we were staying in Hollywood in the 1950's. The Frank Lloyd Wright inspired architecture is too cool for words.
The staff was great and I could not have been luckier!
Save up and make your reservations here...I promise that you will not be disappointed!

I stayed for 4 nights for business. Pros- great service, big rooms with refrigerators, pretty landscaping/grounds. Cons- you are stuck at the property if you don't have a car and everything is very overpriced, from the rooms to the restaurants to the $8 bottles of water! Plus, there are a lot of fees -bellman service (which I didn't use), maid service, plus a $30/day resort fee.

Stayed here for a mini staycation in downtown Phoenix and concert at the Comerica with my boyfriend. Best thing we could have done! I got a great rate on Priceline and thought it would be adequate. Boy was I surprised! Awesome location to all the venues downtown!!! Service was great, everyone was really friendly. Rooms were quite roomy and clean. Typical Hyatt rooms, nothing to write home about but very nice. Surprised this is only rated 3 1/2 stars. Make sure you eat at Networks...great food and our server Kristin was one of the best servers I've had! We enjoyed our first night so much we extended it another night even though we only live 10 min away! We will for sure be back!

review_title: Love the Westin Riverwalk! Very friendly and helpful. Joe is the best!
review_text:
A great visit. Will definitely return. 
The food at the restaurant was excellent. The valet service was very helpful, especially when our car locked with the keys inside. loved to visit the coffee shop in the morning. And Joe, at the door, was like our good friend. We felt at home.

review_title: The Westin Riverwalk was very accomidating, friendly and professional.
review_text: I was recently attending a conference for work at the Westin Riverwalk. Just before my trip, I had an accident where both of my legs were broken so I had to use a wheelchair during my stay. I was immediately given a handicapped room without my asking. Additionally, the banquet staff went out of their way to help me. One banquet employee, Luis Salazar even went out of his way to come find me when the buffet was about to close to see if he could get a plate ready for me since I would be missing it due to a business matter was tying me up. Having two legs stuck in casts was a challenge, but thanks to the outstanding service I received from the Westin really made it an enjoyable trip!

review_title: En san Diego nos sentimos en el Paraiso!!!
review_text: Realmente este hotel es mÃ¡gico. Las comodidades son 6 stars y la atenciÃ³n al nivel. Mis amigas jugaron golf cada dÃ­a y comentaron el nivel de las instalaciones. Es un deber ir!!!!!!!!

Was going to Phoenix for a business conference that was scheduled at the Biltmore, made my reservations early which turned out to be good because others in our group didn't and ended up having to stay off property and drive in or take shuttle buses. When I arrived at 1:00 told twin rooms were available or could wait for king. Opted to wait and because a smoker asked for a balcony room. Took about an hour and found a spot to make some calls and do some work, when I got to the room big room with large alcove work area, double balcony and large sitting area. Room was well appointed and looked over garden area, with small hilltop just off the grounds. Walking to the meetings each day was very enjoyable, just long. It had nice outdoor sitting areas throughout the grounds where you could eat, drink or just visit, that in this day of smoking police let you smoke cigars in comfortable surroundings. Had good wifi in room and conference had the $29 daily resort fee comp but could not get wifi in meeting areas without meeting room code. Food was good in meetings, baquets, room service and restaurants. While staying on beautiful grounds with many resort options, frustrated I had too many meetings and could not enjoy. Because of the location and meeting schedule didn't get off the campus so did really get to see Phoenix either.

I love the Biltmore. This was my fourth stay and will definitely visit again. This was my first stay in the main building and except for not having any outdoor space with my room I loved it. Vist the history room and get a feel for the places history. There are also some excellent pictures throughout the public spaces in the conference area. Worth a visit.

review_title: Just a hotel room. Nothin special.
review_text: It's a hotel room. I appreciate that it is smoke free. It should be. I asked to be upgraded to a riverfront room and was told it would cost me $60? Forget it, I was here on business and would not be looking outside that much. The room didn't have a frig or micro wave. What's up with that. Even the Holiday Inn Express provides that! I think I'd prefer to stay next door at La Contessa. Its definitely a step up.

review_title: Arizona Grand Resort is a must for a family vacation or staycation!
review_text: Its has become a family tradition to go the AZ Grand Resort each summer. Great water park and family friendly atmosphere. Clean rooms and amazing resort packages.

review_title: Nice newer hotel; not much else in the area
review_text: Two-day business stay. Very new hotel and very clean. Limited restaurant offering and very few options within the general area. Hotel is in an area targeted for growth, so should become more attractive in the near future.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Phoenix North Happy Valley

review_text: This hotel lived up to all my expectations. The hotel was very clean & the rooms comfortable. The fitness room had more equipment than I had previously experienced. My midnight arrival was no problem

review_title: Emiliano benitex and the entire catering staff
review_text: Westin hotels are always an exceptional traveling experience and the San Antonio Riverwalk exemplifies Westin's goal of exceeding the hotel experience. I want to personally point out Emiliano Benitez for his quick attention to my requests and providing beyond that. The entire banquet facility staff is professional, make it happen and friendly people. I highly recommend any company to host their functions here beside the beautiful San Antonio Riverwalk at the Westin.

Traveling to San Antonio and had many options of where to stay. Narrowed it down to three and then the choice became simple, Westin, I love the beds! Checked in to an upper floor, nice room, went down to lobby and asked Destinee at the front desk if I could upgrade our room Explained that we were celebrating our 30th anniversary. Without hesitation she moved us to a room on the fourth floor that had a large furnished balcony, only five rooms like it in the hotel. Overlooked the Riverwalk and was lovely and quiet. Had a wonderful three days and felt so rested when we left. Would recommend the friendly Westin to all!!!

We stayed here for 5 days in october and had a few problems but first I don't understand why you have to pay a $20+ per day fee to use the pool or gym..I know it included wifi but when we were there the wifi didn't work until the third day we were there. One night I decided to check my folio on the tv and found that there was a $30 charge for the minibar which we never touched anything from in, I called down to the front desk and they reversed it. So got the invoice on the last day and then today we checked our credit card statement and it was more than what the invoice said, so I asked the hotel to email me an updated invoice and that's when I noticed another charge for the mini bar that we never used. I contacted the hotel and so far no response from them.
A hint for you.. They do not have coffee makers in the room so you must go to the cafe onsite and pay $5 for a brewed coffee.
Also the hotel is far from anything unless you don't mind walking 1/2 hour to anything.
The grounds really well looked after so that's was a plus but the pools were freezing.

Westin Riverwalk Hotel made my 1st trip to San Antonio amazing!! Very nice, clean and the bed was soooo comfortable! The staff was very friendly and accommodating. A special thanks to Yari Ramirez for her awesome hospitality!!

Fairly new construction; rooms clean; better than average "continental" breakfast for a budget hotel. Great location near airport & major freeways. Their in room movie vendor was being changed, but some of the staff didn't know, so first day I asked they told me erroneously that it must be my remote, and that they would call me back, but never did. Had to inquire again NE t day, and got the "real" answer.

review_title: Delightful hotel in the heart of downtown
review_text: Beautiful hotel on the riverwalk. Peaceful yet in the heart of downtown. nice for women traveling alone. Safe.

review_title: Noisy! Go elsewhere if you want to get ANY sleep
review_text: This is without doubt the noisiest hotel I've ever stayed in. There is zero sound proofing from the traffic noise outside. You'd get more sleep if you put a bed next to a grand prix track
Our room was nice but you could hear everything in the courtyard and parking lot. Everything additional to the accomodations cost a fee.
The staff was really professional, especially our Bellman Chris. He made our stay exceptionally well with all the great suggestions. Super clean and superb location in the heart of the city.

We visited this resort this holiday seaon and had a blast. The weather was beautiful and the resort had everything you could ever want. The spa was great for the girls and the golf was perfect for the boys. Service was very kind, remembered our names daily and always offered assistance. Overall, a great value and highly recommend this place for families.

Stayed at this iconic hotel for four nights at the end of August. The hotel is beautiful and the communal areas are maintained to a very high standard as of course are the rooms. My only moan is because it is the hotels low season that over the weekend of my visit the hotel was absolutely packed with families and groups there for the weekender special deal. As a consequence the pool areas were packed to the rafters and any sense one had that they were staying at an exclusive beautiful hotel quickly evaporated. It was more like staying at Butlins). This sense was further underlined when a significant delegation of tattooists arrived to commence their conference. Lol.

I stayed here for the first time this last week for a business conference. My stay was enjoyable. This hotel is not what I would call a typical traditional hotel. There is a sprawl of rooms set out over a large area but the grounds, rooms and general meetings areas were all clean and nice.

review_title: Great experience combined with great golf.
review_text: I recently stayed at this resort to golf at this property as well as others in the area. Great location near tons of courses and easily accessible highways. Fun course and the service was perfect all the way from the proshop to the front desk. Well worth it.

My family and I recently visited this hotel for a reunion and were so impressed with the high end service, wonderful amenities and perfect room. It made our trip so enjoyable and the employees were so friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a great time.

review_title: Fantastic pools and very friendly staff.
review_text: Came for a conference, arriving a day early to have a mini vacation. Pools are amazing and very well maintained. Cabana bar offers up delicious food and drink, perfect for relaxing with a book by the pool. Rooms are very large and comfortable.

review_title: Best HI Express we've stayed in
review_text:
Wonderfully clean & new.
Great location for ballpark & convention centre and just 10 mins from airport.
Fabulous service, lovely pool, excellent breakfast....shame the room was $40 more than I would have liked.
Definitely where we'll stay next time we're in Phoenix

Das Hotel liegt im Zentrum Philadelphias. Broad Street, Rittenhouse Square (10 Minuten) und Independence Hall (15 Minuten) sind zu FuÃŸ erreichbar. Wir bekamen fÃ¼r eine Nacht ein Zimmerupgrade und hatten so ein groÃŸes und gut ausgestattetes Zimmer mit Sofa. Das Hotel ist sehr groÃŸ und sollte gemieden werden, wenn man keinen Trubel mag. Wegen der Lage ist auch der VerkehrslÃ¤rm nicht ohne. Der Service ist freundlich und effektiv.

I have stayed here several times and each time I am blown away at how great the staff is! They really try to even call you by name!
It is a great hotel for Business travelers and I would highly recommend it! 
They will not say no to any request! They even have a box of phone chargers behind the desk that you can borrow. 
Ask for Samantha at night! She is the best.
Took a quick stacation at this courtyard and absolutely loved it. Beautiful room, all the amenities and a great staff. We wouldefinitely stay here again.

review_title: Outstanding - Big hotel but boutique feel
review_text: I stayed here for two nights on a business trip. The hotel is beautiful. Even though it is a large hotel, the design makes it seem very friendly and intimate. Service is outstanding. Check-in was easy and friendly and the chocolates for afternoon snacks were a nice treat. Live music in the lobby and in the restaurant was very nice. Everyone always smiled and asked how they could help. The setting by the river was beautiful and only about a five minute walk to many riverside restaurants and bars. It was maybe a ten minute walk to the mall and the Alamo. The only downside I saw was a small pool and a very small workout area, but in general I cannot say enough good things about this hotel. I would return in a heartbeat.

Good: nice looking hotel and good location. Bad: sinks pumped up yellow liquid with black flakes and didnt drain. I called the front desk and had them send someone up in 1 hour since i had guests till then, he arived 10 minutes later, i was embarressed. We made plans for an engineer to stop by at 3 pm, he got there at 6 pm, again when we had guests, after 3 days it still hasent be fixed. The front desk offered to downgrade me to a different room. Every 15 minutes the TV goes to channel 00, kind of annoying when your trying to watch football.

For a "four and a half star" hotel I was sadly disappointed. The rooms were extremely dirty. Not dusted with spider webs above the door and a very dirty toilet! Also had a centipede in our entry way which was absolutely disgusting! But even past the dirt the worst part was NO WIFI! They do offer it in the lobby but the signal is awful! It's 2011 get your guest wifi in the rooms!

review_title: Nice grounds and pool, however parking, food prices, and room noise from air conditioner ruined the pleasant atmosphere.
review_text:
We rented a pool side cabana with a friend, it had it's own bathroom and refrigerator. Outside food was not allowed, so we indulged on free chips and salsa that is available on Sat. Afternoon by the pool. A bucket of 6 beer ran us $32 a bucket and an appetizer was $17.50 (yikes). The parking was the worst, even if you use valet. The rooms looked great, until you were woken up every 45min by the air conditioning noise. It sounded like a cement drill. Last but not least, no coffee pot in room, and a sm coffee ran you $4. 
, an appetizer was

This was about my 10th stay at this hotel and I have a sense that it's on the cusp of going downhill. The rooms -- all large suites -- remain well appointed. There are two flat screen tvs, a fridge, microwave, bath with a shower/tub. The bed is very comfortable. Where things are moving in the wrong direction: bathroom amenities were not always replaced when finished breakfast food quality seems to have gone downhill along with some options. My views may also have been affected by the fact that fire alarms went off fourbtimes between 4and 6 in the morning due to a problem with the swimming pool and very bad weather.

review_title: San Antonio was a great weekend getaway
review_text: Concierge David Swift at the Westin Riverwalk was outstanding. He suggested the best restaurants and must see sight in the area. He helped plan our days. He made our trip outstanding. We have stayed at many Starwood properties over the years and David rates as one of the best concierge.

Stayed two nights for business. The hotel complex is aging a bit and could use some updating but overall it was fine. Large layout means lots of walking and elevators to get to lobby and breakfast if you are placed in the back. Would suggest this one if location works well. Could not get a room at Biltmore for this trip.

review_title: Chef Eugene Schlaff, personally makes sure that the hotel exceeds your expectations.
review_text: I had certain dietary requests. I called a few days to my arrival and spoke with Chef Sclaff. He went out of his way, even on his off days to ensure that everything was perfect.

I don't know the official star rating of this hotel but it is a solid 2 and nothing more or less. The staff is super friendly, but the rooms are drab and really put the Hilton name at stake. Homewood suites is definitely the lower end line of Hilton but this proves that and that's not really a good thing.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Phoenix-Metro Center

review_text:
This is Not a good hotel. Beds are Horrible, there are cleanliness and Hygiene issues. The Location is ok. But wireless is Hugely expansive. Overall this is Not good Value for Money. I rarely Write Reviews, but this hotel Annoyed 
Me.
The minibar is also locker and the service unreliable
If you can stau at the Grand hyatt much netter.

review_title: Fantastic hotel for families with young children!
review_text: The rooms were spacious and allowed for the little ones to sleep behind a closed door while the adults stayed up later to watch TV. The breakfast was exceptional with a full buffet of hot food, fruit and cold cereals. The staff was welcoming and cheerful!

This lovely hotel is located on the Riverwalk in the heart of downtown San Antonio. The rooms are spacious and well appointed, but the service here is excellent. The staff bends over backward to help you - from ensuring that you have the meal of your choice in a speedy manner even though your selection is off menu, to providing map of jogs that can be had within the vicinity of the hotel. Special thanks to Okau for his assistance with breakfast. Definitely recommend this hotel.

My wife and I travel extensively for business and wanted somewhere in driving distance for a bit of a break and some downtime.
All in all just an average hotel, nothing special on the room side of things and nothing to differentiate on the service side. However the restaurant was spectacularly bad, I always judge by the Veal Scallopini. Wow, excessive capers and prosciutto crudo the sheer amount of salt was mind boggling. Add to that shoe leather veal made this one of the most laughably bad meals I have ever had. 
My wife had a simple cream based pasta, about 30 seconds away from being al dente so it had that raw 
gummy texture - outstanding. The seasoning can at best be called heavy handed, you know that it is cooked and never tasted in the kitchen.
We had a coffe in the morning, they forgot to rinse out the urn cleaner - belch!
A below average hotel in a beautiful location, what a shame.

I would definitely recommend Zocco at the Westin in San Antonio. The food was great and portions were very generous. My brother and I both ordered pannini's and they were great. The staff was constantly floating around to ensure that our every need was met. Visit the Zocco for great food and great service.

The biltmore is a nice hotel in metropolitan Phoenix. Easy access to anything in the area, which is a plus. Even though we came in the summer, conventions were going on, so I can understand several of the previous posts- be prepared at peak times.
The rooms are pretty standard for an upscale hotel. The setting is nice, but in June it's a little hot to wander around. I thought the scheduled activities were interesting and well-planned. Note that in summer the pool is bath water hot.

because of the challenging terrain, which is also the allure of the location, this resort is for active and energetic people. We had a great value for Christmas weekend. About $120 for suite with view and breakfast coupons (good for $12 toward breakfast.) Nothing luxury about the rooms, but very comfortable, well kept. we had two televisions, although only one had digital cable. short hike down stairs to the sunset pool. just past the tennis courts, a hiking trail leads across the street to miles of easy to hard hiking choices. Excellent location for travel to other golf courses, Scottsdale, other parks. Very good service all around and very good food and menu choices at the main restaurant.

review_title: Gluten free glory at the hotel restaurant.
review_text: Exec chef Jeff Foresman at Zucca provided a custom perpared sandwich with gluten free bread. It was incredible. He made it clear that his restaurant is gluten sensitive and caring.

Entire hotel is immaculate and the service overall was great. Couple of negatives: $36 per day valet parking - really? There was a long wait to pull in front of the hotel on a Friday evening, so I swung my car across the street to the self park garage where it's $18 per day (with no in-and-out privileges). Also the entry area is very narrow with lots of hubbub, walking and vehicular traffic. If you have young children, you need to be especially careful that your kids don't get knocked over by sone text zombie, a bell cart or a car! Overall, very nice!

Rooms are nice, clean and spacious. Many rooms are partially underground so not a great view. The property is old but well maintained. The ISSUE is the parking... A mess. Everyone can park in front of their room, but what a challenge. One way narrow winding hilly streets that dead end with very tight turnaround opportunity. If you are not a great parker..you better not stay here.

review_title: How many ways can you say fantastic?
review_text:
We stayed here for 4 nights and were amazed by everything!
We used Hilton Points so our room was free!
Hilton upgraded us to suite 2101, which was gigantic, had a great view of the mountains, falls pool and equestrian center. Granite countertops throughout, large flat screen tv's, private balcony, black out drapes, lots of windows, comfy couches, chairs.
The bed was amazingly comfortable. Feather pillows with down comforter added to comfort. 
Great hiking trails were on site. Pool was fantastic, very lively although there was an adult only pool also.
We didn't eat at the restaurants for dinner but did have lunch and cocktails at the pool. Yum.
All documents indicated a high cost for wi-fi. We called the front desk and they gave us the password. Not sure if this was because we were in the Presidential Suite ...
We love this hotel and would return again, and again.

Ottima accoglienza; personale capace, cortese e sempre disponibile. Posizione perfetta e comoda a tutto. Junior suite spaziosa, con meravigliosa vista su Madison Avenue e sulla Public Libary!!...Rooftop bar molto carino e ristorante "Madison & Vine" da provare! La nostra prossima volta a Manhattan sarÃ  sicuramente ancora qui!!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Phoenix-Metro Center

review_text: Loved our stay at the Embassy Suites. Warm welcome when we arrived were given all the information we needed right at the beginning of our stay. Great service, even late at night with the washer. Rich free breakfast in a nice atmosphere. Overall a very well managed hotel.

review_title: Watch out for the extras, but can't beat the October weather and central location
review_text: They have a extra package that includes for $2.50 a day you get access to the workout facilities? Never paid extra for this! Must pay rates for Internet access about $9.95. Seems more for families than couples. Do not recommend area for handicapped. Outside stucco deteriorating in places especially on steps. General Area economy outside the resort not so good.

review_title: Very Nice... Really nice classic Hilton property.
review_text: Great property, quick check-in, very nice and large room, nice amenities. Great bed, clean, beautiful location.

I had heard nothing but fabulous things about the Biltmore and was so excited to spend a night there for a friends wedding. My boyfriend and I got there and went straight to the pool. We were shocked at the number of people smoking cigarettes and cigars by the pool, it stunk of an ash tray. Pool side service was fine. In the morning we ordered room service, and our meal came incorrect twice. The man was very apologetic, but it was unfortunate that the meal wasn't correct the first time (especially considering the price). Starting at 8:00am, we had a maid knocking on our door asking if she could clean (even though we had put a do not disturb sign in the key slot as directed). After breakfast when we went to brush our teeth before checking out, I was greeted by a nice small cockroach climbing out of the drain in the sink...not what I expected! Needless to say, I was very dissapointed with our stay, and it was not worth the $400 (room plus food) we paid.

review_title: The most luxurious embassy suites ever!!!
review_text: This hotel is just wonderful for couples and families with kids. There is a beautiful huge outdoor pool, work out room, mouth watering steak house, delicious and healthy free breakfast buffet, luxurious rooms, the hotel looks like an oasis inside, koi ponds, and very friendly staff. The best part about this hotel is it's location because it is only 10minutes away from Scotsdale, is right next to a mall full of designer clothing stores and grand restaurants, and is about 10-15minutes away from downtown Phoenix.

review_title: Very nice hotel, great location, good service
review_text:
First time staying here, will likely stay again. We love the location-close to Scottsdale, only about 15 minutes front the airport. It's across from a nice mall with Macy's and many other stores and restaurants. My husband's family lives there so we visit often and have stayed other places that were mediocre. He had stayed at the ES Biltmore years ago when it was something else, and it was fabulous then. So, we gave it a try knowing it was at least 20 plus years old and hopefully renovated. we stayed four nights. 
Our room was typical ES but updated nicely-LR, BR, one bath,granite throughout. The coffee maker, MW, and fridge worked fine. The beds were in good shape. bath was clean, though the inside door frame had a little rust on the bottom. 
So the first night we were there (thurs), loud music played in the bar area until I don't know when; we fell asleep at 10pm after travel from the east coast. ES rooms open up into an interior courtyard. The other nights were quieter. 
The food in the hotel restaurant Omaha Steakhouse was delicious! The place was deserted, but I think this was a slow period. Other reviews is had read of itwere good so we tried it and weren't disappointed. We also ate the free breakfast twice and were satisfied. 
All in all, I was happy with what we got for the money.

review_title: Great hotel, great experience- will come back again and again!
review_text: I traveled recently with my family (consisting of a 11 year old and 8 year old) to Phoenix. When we got to the hotel, the staff was friendly and polite. The manager actually upgraded our room to a room near the pool (a huge plus). Our room was clean, and you could see the water slide out the window. We spent most of our time at the pool. However, when we wanted to see the Grand Canyon and other attratctions, the concierge actuall helped us accomodate, and gave us many suggestions. For food, there was a poolside restaurant, a regular cafe, a grill, and a fancier place. We loved the poolside restaurant, since it was right near our room. Also, there was an outside mall right next to the property, which gave us somewhere to go if we wanted to. All in all, we loved the Arizona Biltmore and will come back whenever we go to Phoenix!

review_title: Friendly, clean, helpful, convenient and a good time.
review_text: Thought it was relaxing and a great location to do other sight seeing activities. Everyone was helpful and friendly and the facilities were beautiful.
Stayed here one night before an early flight out the next day. Room nice & clean.

review_title: For the money this is My favorite course to play
review_text: I think this course is generally one of the most consistently well kept in the city. I enjoy the course and on days you don't want to play a round the driving range offers great opportunity to sharpen your skills. There are higher end courses that cost a lot more that I have played that I just don't enjoy as much as this one. You have to try it.

review_title: It's not any just another place...
review_text: The charm and architecture aside from it's location are only made better by the staff. This review goes out proudly to Christian, from in room dining that saw to my morning coffee promptly arriving at 5:30 am every morning. His courteous evening greeting assuring me of prompt service should not be overlooked or taken for granted. Thank you to you and your staff!

review_title: This was such a beautiful hotel with wonderful service!
review_text: What an amazing hotel in a great location! We were easily able to walk everywhere from the hotel. All of the staff were very nice and helpful, particularly JR. He recommended Zinc wine bar and Budro's on the Riverwalk and they were amazing! We really appreciated that he seemed to genuinely want to help the guests. He definately helped us a lot! Service like this and such a beautiful hotel will definitely have us returning! Thanks!

My in-laws stayed here and I wish they hadn't wasted their money. They put them in a room right next to the pool that was getting resurfaced so every morning they awoke to construction equipment and workers yelling. The room was overrun with crickets and when we asked for maintenance to spray they said they only do outside. The customary workout room is not provided so you better have a gym membership and drive 6 miles if you want to workout. Your guests might as well take a cab to visit you because of very limited parking. The garbage disposal reeked with sewage stench. This place and the staff were very disappointing. Avoid this place at all costs!!!

My husband and I and our two small children stayed in a one room condo and loved it!! The condo was spacious and clean. The bathroom was wonderful with a huge shower and a large jacuzzi tub. The employee's at the resort were just wonderful, when we would call for anything we needed they would be at the door injust a few minutes. They have alot of activities for the kids which they enjoyed. The pool is large and not crowded the only thing with the pool is from most of the buildings you have to drive to it but we got used to it. We would definatley come back, we enjoyed every minute :)

Not as nice as I was expecting... Hotel was at low occupancy and we got a room overlooking a parking lot. Â The waterslide pool during the day was nice and not too crowded. Â  Â The rooms are sizable and the beds comfortable.The family pool at night was loud and crowded. Â Internet was for one computer only... Nickel and dimed.. Even cost $ for the Gym. Â Sad when a family goes to have a well deserved break at a place they imagine to be relaxing and it's just more stressful at the end of the day.

review_title: Nice for business but not a resort
review_text:
This hotel was top notch, excellent service and very clean. They did charge me twice for an included breakfast, however, they remedied that.
This place is not setup as a resort, but more for business. If you here for leisure I would pass on this hotel an go for a resort on the area. For example, the pool and spa isn't that impressive.
This is a decent location as the Biltmore shopping and restaurants are right across the street. As always, prepare to pay Ritz prices!
Everyone was extremely helpful and very friendly. Great pool, great views, but very tricky to park and drive to the rooms off the beaten path.

Got to the Westin on Saturday June 18th at noon and our room was ready. I told Farrell at the front desk about our 1 year anniversary and he upgraded our room to the riverwalk side with a furnished balcony overlooking the riverwalk. The room and balcony was outstanding and really made for a great anniversary. Farrell gave us outstanding service when we checked in to the hotel. Melissa at the front desk let us get a later checkout and was very nice. The service was outstanding and we will be back every year for our wedding anniversary. Westin riverwalk is the best hotel on the river in San Antonio.

review_title: A good way to get away from home.
review_text: I had an overall wonderful experience! The Suite was of good quality for the price, and was located next to one of the many pools. At The Falls I had a great poolside experience. Ron was an excellent and friendly server, while AJ made an awesome strawberry Daiquiri. However my best goes out to Carri, who was a very kind and hard working employee. She had enough hospitality to fill one of the pools and you could tell how much she truly enjoyed taking care of the kids in Kids Korral.
Great views, superb service, great rooms. Perfect for a romantic getaway

review_title: Wonderful location! Phenomenal service! Highly recommend!!
review_text:
My husband and I drove in from Austin for a quick 1-night anniversary stay. The location is awesome - SO close to all the Riverwalk excitement but also quiet. You can walk anywhere! The pool is a bit small if you plan on swimming the whole time, but we certainly didn't! There is SO much to do in the area. The rooms and restaurant are beautiful. 
The in and out valet service is prompt and absolutely worth every penny! I sort of bawked at the $30/day fee but all parking down there is pricey and it is really convenient!! We went out at midnight to drive over to Mi Tierra at the market for some pastries and we were back in 10 minutes :). The valets are so professional and kind.
I want to commend everyone at Westin Riverwalk, especially Doreen Patino who is director of group sales. We chatted with her at the concierge desk about dinner options. After learning why we were there, she gave me her card and said to let her know if we needed anything. Later that night, we got back to our hotel to find an anniversary card and bottle of champagne! The hotel was already perfect, and this was the icing on the cake! 
Anyone wanting a beautiful place to stay right on the Riverwalk - this is your place!
Ms Roslyn Ramirez provides exceptional and unequivocal service at thr Westin bar. . . Highly recommended!

review_title: Wish I could have stayed longer
review_text:
Great stay! Only wish we could have stayed longer. The room was bright, comfortable and clean.
The riverwalk as a whole is over-priced so the price is in par with the other hotels in the area. We got a river side room and only went on the balcony once so I recommend the city side if you're looking for a better price. I will definitely stay here again!
I'm horrible with names so unfortunately can't remember any but the staff as a whole was great; from the maids to the valets.

review_title: Never been disappointed by a Holiday Inn!!
review_text: The last night of our vacation we needed a room near the airport in Phoenix. Holiday Inn...perfect!! Staff - professional and friendly. Service - love the 24-hr shuttle from the airport after dropping off our rental car and back the next morning for our flight. Lounge serving complete menu - welcome after a long day of driving. Room - big and classy. Bed - fabulously comfortable and again welcome after a long day of driving. Checkout - easy! Expectations - always exceeded! Thanks Holiday Inn!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Phoenix Airport

review_title: The room was beautiful & the service was exceptional!!!
review_text:
From the moment we arrived we received nothing but the best of service from the valet, doorman, Farrell Sledge ( associate) & Chris who escorted us to our beautiful room and was very informative. Had a great time and made our experience with the Westin hotel the BEST!!!! THANKS AGAIN Farrell Sledge for making our 20th anniversary one to remember.
Glen & Aicha Anderson
Stayed here for 1 night after a 20 hour trip from Australia. Nice hotel good clean rooms very well priced and great room service. Perfect for a stopover. Will stay again on my next trip to Mexico!!

It began with doors being opened for us, first taxi, then hotel. All done with smiles not boredom. Thanks to Rachel who checked us in and asked over and over if she could help in any way. She did. Beautiful hotel..harp playing bonus in lobby. On quiet part of Riverwalk but steps away from all the action. Bonus. Easy walking. Felt safe. No car needed. $25 Taxi ride from airport.
Staff is great. Offered Priority Club amenities. Room was large and comfortable. Great night's rest.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Phoenix Airport

review_text:
This hotel was awesome, just like the whole vacation in San Antonio! Well except the horrible experience at the Chart House restaurant at the top of the Tower of the Americas. Stay away from there. 
The hotel staff was top notch and the location was perfect; close to the fun but not in the middle of it.

review_title: Great place to vacation with the family
review_text: Very nice king suite hotel with kitchenette and jetted tubs. Great breakfast (charge) and good restaurant. Friendly staff and nice but shallow pool. We love this hotel. While not the fanciest its a good, solid stay every time.

review_title: Such a fantastic place to stay!
review_text:
I have spent quite a bit of time in the area and this property is second to none to anywhere I have stayed in the country. 
The breakfast and evening food provided is such a great luxury to have. 
Everything is very clean, the rooms are huge and the staff is always willing to go the extra mile if you need anything. 
With a locaton just across the street from Tempe Diablo Stadium this is the perfect place to stay for Angels Spring Training!
Not only was our room priced right but the level of service was outstanding. The entire staff made us feel welcome and at home. We will definitely revisit this hotel when we return to Phoenix.
Stayed here using points, service was excellent, employees were all very friendly and went the extra mile to help; rooms were clean and comfortable, and breakfast was good too.
Stayed for 3 nights on business. Location was ideal. Very clean. Customer service was great. Full service. New build. Price was fantastic. Would stay here any time I am in Phoenix.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Phoenix Airport

review_text: We just stayed for a few nights on business. The location is very good. Small pool. Rooms and bathrooms are average. I do not understand why several ritz properties do jot update their bathrooms. A 5 star hotel should not have a dingy shower curtain and rust on the tile. We have recently stayed at ritz in laguna niguel and had the same problem with an ugly bathroom. The ritz needs to do something about their small, old bathrooms. The four seasons has separate showers with nice shower doors and is first class.

I was pleasantly surprised by the hip decor and construction of the lobby area and the bar. It wasn't very large but everything was situated perfectly, with a pool table in the bar area.
There was a Grab n' Go section in the lobby for quick eats for sandwiches, salads, snacks and hot breakfast in the morning.
The rooms are small but the configurations were so perfect that we never felt cramped. No bathtubs but large showers w/bath gel and shampoo/conditioner dispensers.
There was a universal audio/video connection box on the work desk, So that you could connect your iPod, iPad, computer or whatever to view on the flat screen TV.
We requested a late check-out and the answer "Sure, how about 2pm". 
The decor was very mod/hip. Blackout shades too.

review_title: Convenient place with a bit of a hip factor
review_text:
Aloft Phoenix
The Aloft hotels are a great concept - standard, efficient accommodation in handy locations at a good price.Â 
They're for the people on the move: from an Aloft you can easily get to where you need to be.Â 
But unlike several other hotels of this kind, they are not those anonymous and depressing places. On the contrary, Aloft hotels are young, vibrant, with a catchy design and all the services you need. Including a cool bar (xyz), a good fitness room, and a nice lounge/lobby which is actually pleasant and warm.Â 
The smart thing about Aloft is that all hotels are basically identical. Once you've been to one, you know how they work and you easily find what you need, without surprises.
The Aloft Phoenix is very close to the airport; a free shuttle will take you to/from the airport or any other place within a couple of miles. It's also next to the train stop to downtown Phoenix, and a few buses stop there too. So if you don't have a car you won't be disappointed.Â 
The staff is very friendly and efficient; the rooms are like all other Alofts: smart, cool and just perfect to crash after a long day or a long flight.Â The bed is very comfortable, one of the best for this class of hotels. The pillows though are a bit hard - the must be foam, and as already noted they're not the best you can find. The bathroom is cleverly designed, with the sink in an open area and the shower and toilet area can be closed with a sliding door. It doesn't offer full privacy though, but nevertheless it can be shared with a travel companion if you need to. Bliss products are a nice touch, and in your room you will also find free bottled water, a coffe/tea set and some cool recent magazines (like Wired).Â 
This Aloft has also a nice outdoor patio with swimming pool. Nothing fancy, but just perfect to relax outside and cool down.Â 
The fitness room is small but good - a few treadmills, a multi functional exercise machine and a few other accessories (weights, balls).
In the morning there are also hot breakfast item to buy at re:fuel, the "grab and go" food concept of Aloft. Other items are available 24 hours so no matter when and how you get there, you won't starve.Â 
Â 
So if you need a place close to the airport where you won't feel depressed the Aloft is a perfect choice. Add the friendliness of the staff and the hip factor which Aloft has inherited from the W hotels and you're all set!

review_title: Nice clean rooms, short on everything else....
review_text: Clean rooms, lobby and breakfast area was hot, lady working in breakfast area was not very friendly or helpful. Had spilled milk on floor and did not bother to wipe it off. I almost slipped and fell. she kept bending over and could see her thong, not very pleasant when you are trying to eat. Restrooms were very dirty. Had to use mens restroom because the womens restroom was unusable.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Phoenix I-10 West

review_title: Exquisite customer service and a beautiful hotel
review_text:
I can't believe this place! I travel for a living and get to stay in the best places but some of them don't stack up to the service at the Westin Riverwalk. I have a food allergy.
