When I mentioned it to the waiter at Zocca he took it very seriously. The chef's came out to my table - that's never happened before. Thank you Chef Eugene and Chef Jeff!
The rooms are comfy and new and everyone is nice. (A rarity). We've stayed at other Riverwalk properties but the Westin Riverwalk is the best.
The banquet manager Arturo Santa Cruz went out of his way to ask me how things were. Excellent Service

Gave this brand a try out because the Hilton site crashed on me so many times trying to book that I gave up- and I'm glad I did. This place is refreshingly hip and modern and you actually feel like you're walking into "somewhere" not just someplace you'll be sleeping. Nice change, I must say, and although feeling a little underprepared without a glow stick as I walked past the funky WXYZ Bar, into the electric blue elevator with the Euro trance bumping, my concerns were subdued upon entering my room and finding a huge flatty mounted to the wall, a tricked out room design with big walk-in shower, and a desk complete with full-on power station. This place not only caters to the business traveler, but today's Gen X/Y traveler (hence the bar name I'm assuming who's looking for something with a little more edge, while addressing both aesthetics and convenience necessities. The only knock I'd give this place is location- the area is not great and their limited food options would be fine if there was something beside Ruby Tuesday around. And the rail system being so near would be great for commute but somewhat challenging to sleep near. I'd still go back though- you could say that I'm a fan.

review_title: Fab stay at the Westin Riverwalk
review_text: We just came back from our quick weekend wedding trip to San Antonio. The Westin Riverwalk was a wonderful homebase - excellent location, impeccably appointed lobby/rooms and great service. Basically, everything I expect from a Westin. Steven at the front desk made us feel welcomed and took care of all the logistics.

Hotel is not in the best neighborhood! Nothing is close by except a circle k which didn't look safe to walk into. Hotel is in a business park. Not a place for kids, the walls are very thin. I have a 3 yrs old and his fighting his sleep at 8pm got security called on him. Listen to those thin walls after a couple had a little to drink at the bar down stairs. Again not a place for kids

I stayed here the evening before flying out of sky harbor. The staff is beyond professional, the bar and restaurant are awesome, and the pool and spa were lovely. Great for the traveler and also the tourist looking to explore the Valley via light rail. There are a lot of airport properties. Go with this one, though, and you won't be disappointed!
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Phoenix Airport North

review_title: We come here every year (5 years straight) and love it.
review_text:
This trip was great as usual. We stayed in the 3300 block next to lizard lagoon, I was a little concerned since I had read you can hear traffic in Tatum Blvd., but I never heard anything! Although for next year I think we'll stay closer to the main pool, our kids are getting older and are liking the deeper water vs. the kiddie pool. 
We enjoy the various resort activities they offer, such as Iron Chef competition between guests, popcorn tasting, hula-hoop competition, seems like something for every age. We look forward to next year.
A few negatives I'll mentioned that bugged: over at the JW on busy days like Fridays, the lazy river had a lot of drunk adults and who knows how much alcohol they spilled in it (not loving that with my kids around)-that water was murkier than it should have been! They have suspended bus service between the villas and the JW to only once an hour from every 15 minutes last time we were there, but it turned out ok since I discovered I liked driving over more anyways. There also seems to be a lot of Mosquitos in the room (5 or 6, but mire than there should be) I don't know if it's because of the water feature in the room or it was monsoon season as well. Like I said these are nit-picks. We love it here! It's one of our family traditions to come every summer.
Traveled with 3 kids, ages: 7, 4, 8 months

Stayed last June for a week as exchange though interval international, big resort and although it was full, it never seemed crowded. Plenty of parking, we had a car and Harley, and location is great for day trips. Shopping mall across road is great (I am Canadian and can't get enough of DSW).
We had a 1 bedroom unit and it. 
 was clean and comfortable. Our unit was close to Tatum blvd but did not notice any excessive noise.
Shuttle bus to jw Marriott was convenient, beautiful hotel, great restaurants and fun lazy river.
We exchange our timeshare frequently in US and Europe and this 
Was one of our top picks. We would absolutely return.

review_title: Best hotel on the riverwalk. Professional service and help from Rachel Garza.
review_text:
We regularlly stay at this hotel and have always had an enjoyable experience. 
We will stay there again in the future and would like to thank one of the hotel superstars - Rachel Garza. She has helped us a couple of times now and is always extremely professional, courteous, and thorough in her support. Thank you.

review_title: Stay here for early Phoenix flights
review_text: New Hilton hotel is clean and convenient. For early morning phx flits this is the place to stay. Great for business travelers" free wifi, business center and gym. Inouse restaurant is good for breakfast. Only a short shuttle ride to Mill Ave. near ASU
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Phoenix Airport North

review_text: A small group of us stayed here while in town for work, and everything was just right. Rolando in sales took great care of us, the new rooms were spacious and very clean, and the staff (except for one guy) was fantastic. The location was great for us as well, since we were working in Tempe, Chandler, and Phoenix. I will definitely stay here next time we are in town and highly recommend this hotel!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Phoenix Airport

review_text: I stayed a few nights for pleasure and was very satisfied. The room was very clean and the bed was so comfortable! The staff was very helpful and friendly!!! Would stay again!
Perfect spot for a romantic weekend. Riverwalk is gorgeous at the holidays. The building across from our room has a lovely light display to look at.

review_title: Very comfortable and quiet hotel outside Phoenix central heading North.
review_text:
We loved the spacious room with frig and microwave. We enjoyed the large flat screen tv from the spacious room comfortable sofa. Bath had good quality soaps, shampoo, conditioner, and lotion. The two queen beds were amazing! Pillowtop mattresses with double sheeted douvets and various pillows of different softness made for a sound night's sleep.
Breakfast was ample with cereals, waffle, hard boiled eggs, omlets, sausage, yogurt, biscuits and gravy, juices, fruit, etc.
Our only complaints were the lack of wireless connection for our laptop in our room and ethernet wouldn't work either, but we could connect in the lobby (management hopes to correct this soon) and the hot water was slow and volume slow in our room.
Several nearby restaurants had delicious take out (Dara Thai) and Roberto's (Mexican) delivers.
How can you beat a new hotel, free wi-fi , hot breakfast . Just immaculate hotel. Super happy

review_title: Great place for one night or even a week!
review_text: Stayed one night only, wish we could have stayed more. Very clean, well appointed. Great location. The staff was great. Breakfast was more than just muffins and coffee. We will definitely be back for shopping trip or sports event soon.

review_title: Small lobby, but very nice. Consistent with Westin.
review_text: Lobby is not as big as the very attractive lobby at the Sheraton a couple blocks away, but the elegance, smell and music just make you feel good. The rooms are beautiful. I got a corner suite and having the tub on the corner overlooking downtown was a huge plus. Only thing disappointing was that they give you a luxurious tub and view, but when I called room service for bath bubbles and salt, they didn't have any, nor did they offer suggestions. I ended up calling back and having to ask for additional body wash to create bubbles. Another downside is that there is no self-park available so you either pay $27 valet or park at the Phx Downtown metered parking which is only free from 8pm-8am. Other than that, the consistency in level of service, the staff, and cleanliness are a plus. Club lounge is nice too. They don't offer full breakfast and dinner, but the little they serve is delicious!
You have to pay $27 parking to stay over night... Workout room looks smaller than regular room... Nothing to do other than staying in the room and watching tv.
This is a nice homewood. The room I was in looked remodeled from the photos currently posted. Nice location for downtown and market business. Beer and wine at night!!!
We stayed here for 3 nights on business. Comfortable beds, nice linens. Nice pool and hot tub area!

review_title: Great location for airline travel - nice place!
review_text: We stayed at this hotel because we needed to return a rental car and fly home the following day after a vacation. The facility was far nicer than expected, with many amenities. Iced water with lemon slices in the lobby, lots of toiletries, free internet service, comfortable bar and happy hour, ample and easy parking, friendly and helpful staff, upscale desk chair, dreamy bed, free all-hours shuttle service (which we used twice). The location isn't great for any walking sightseeing, but is worth the money for airport convenience. There's even a view of the airport or Camelback Mountain to choose from. I joined the Carlson Club I was so happy with this stay.

review_title: Sets the new standard for Westin hotels.
review_text: I have to echo all the positive comments below - this hotel is exceptional for a Westin. Excellent service from arrival to departure, where every associate we came across genuinely seemed to care and came across in warm and friendly way. Great recognition as a frequent Starwood guest with an upgrade to a superb corner studio suite - it had fantastic bathroom with a view. Nice Club lounge and well equipped gym. Had dinner in the hotel on the patio which was very good with attentive service andinteresting food. This is way above any other city Westin I have stayed in the US and I look forward to returning.

The hotel is less than 10 minutes away from sky harbour airport, with a free shuttle running every 20 minutes. Too bad we missed it in the morning and had the receptionist call a cab for a charge of only 10 dollars.
Our room was huge and very Â clean. Beds featured "Sleep number", a remote control which makes your bed harder or softer according to your preferences. Widescreen flat TV had many channels.
Our room was soundproofed and air-con was working very well (outside temperature was up to 115!).
Breakfast buffet is reasonably priced at about 14 dollars each although the variety of items on offer is quite limited.
The swimming pool was bigger than usual business hotel pools and clean.
All in all, a great value for money.

review_title: Luxurious, spacious, minimalist chic accommodations in the heart of the valley.
review_text:
Check in was a breeze... Good service both outside and at reception. The rooms are more like studio apartments than hotel rooms. They feature beautiful hardwood floors, the best bed I've ever slept in, stunning views from floor to ceiling windows, a nice television 
and a gorgeous and highly functional bathroom complete with rain shower.
Food in the restaurant Province was unique, well executed, and well prepared. The club lounge is a nice place to relax and rehydrate in the evening.
While I may not have had immediate neighbors above me or on my floor, I have not stayed in a quieter hotel... Major bonus points for that. To say I thoroughly enjoyed it would be an understatement. 
Food

I appreciate the clean beddings and pillows in the cozy room. I also enjoyed the spas. However, I did not use the outdoor swimming pool that appears dirty and unchlorinated. The hotel is not within the close proximity to Downtown Dallas. Nevertheless, I would recommend this Omni Dallas Park West for the quality and clean room.
hotel_name: Omni Dallas Hotel at Park West

review_text:
Beautiful hotel, brand new but service was terrible in the restaurant. Over two hours one night and over an hour for breakfast. Also the pool is still not open which is an issue when there's really nothing going on in downtown Phoenix on a weekend. 
Service from the staff was excellent tho from the valet to check-in everyone went out of their way to be helpful.

review_title: You can't go wrong with Omni Dallas Park West!
review_text: The Omni Hotels are customer service, quality and value all wrapped into one . The Omni Dallas Park West never disappoints me and I've been staying there for 10 years
hotel_name: Omni Dallas Hotel at Park West

review_title: Brilliant position but sloppy housekeeping.Would recommend but check cleanliness.
review_text: Stayed here for 3 nights at start of a road trip. Hotel obviously a motel bought by BW and upgraded and in really good location for State Fair and downtown (park at McKinney for free and get free tram) breakfast good but bed linen dirty and didn't get changed after first request. Safe didn't work either and not fixed despite asking twice.

review_title: I would like to check in please.
review_text: Let me start by saying that the hotel was not awe inspiring, but it was nice enough. That wing said, I tried and was turned away three time for check in. The tell me check in is t until 3:00 (this is at 2:50) I say okay. I go back at 3:00 and they say no I'm sorry check in begins at 3 so it will be anothe 30 to 45 min. I try again at 330 and no still not ready. When it is time to pay it is up front and to the right, but apparently when you has paid and they no longer feel it nessesery it is at their leisure. This is unexceptable. The bar tender was nice durning the wait.

review_title: Great hotel, surprisingly great priced too.
review_text: This hotel has obviously been recently completely renovated and redecorated, everything new and sharp. The location is right downtown, staff is very friendly and helpful. Rooms are large, with a living room and very comfortable bed. Really nothing but good to say.

We checked in Late, and the paperwork was ready. Easiest check in ever. The room was huge, and it was the basic room! It was also well appointed with a super comfy bed. We especially appreciated the extra late check out time. This hotel is a great Find.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Dallas Addison Galleria

review_text: This is a nice Inn & Suites. My room was clean, breakfast was good and the staff was very friendly and helpful. The neighborhood is great, lots of restaurants you can walk to.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Dallas Addison Galleria

review_title: Fairly priced excellent hotel with a heavenly bed.
review_text: $100 got us a plush queen size bed, side room with couch, tv and chairs, microwave, fridge and coffee maker. Great shower, free shuttle to/from area activities and very friendly staff. Aveda soap products! Room service was timely and the food was great. Nice attention to detail in the sunny day decore throughout the hotel. High quality furnishings and accessories.

Good hotel for the price. Location is okay about 45 min from DFW ( in Texas everything is about an hour away!)Only problem is no airport shuttle.
Staff was very friendly and rooms were large and clean.
Hotel food is expensive ( I spent $140 for lunch for 3 Ouch!)
Ask front desk for shuttle to local eating joints! Shuttle driver is a great guy and knows best places to eat.
Overall a good stay. I would highly recommend this hotel if you are traveling to Dallas!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel Dallas Love Field

review_text: The hotel itself isn't the most amazing thing I've ever seen but the beds are to die for!!! They call it sweet dreams package and it is!!! Crisp sheets nice pillows and I mattress I wanted to take home. The food is good but pricey. Room service is fast. No balconies on rooms or on any floor - if you smoke you have to go all the way outside the front door. Bathroom is odd - sink and vanity look new/updated while the tub/shower looks dated. Overall - the room was very clean and nice for the price

review_title: Nice hotel but don't eat here
review_text:
Stay was for a conference. Facilities were fine. Conference food was ok. Ate dinner at "Chefs Table". Steak was over done. Ordered rare and came medium to medium well. Never saw waiter until he brought me the bill and asked why I didn't eat the steak. 
Vegetables and potato were GOOD but not the entree!

review_title: Beautiful Hotel and very nice staff...
review_text: I visited the Indigo Hotel Sept. 25... When I arrived at the hotel the only thing that threw me off was the parking... You had two parking options to pay for valet which was 20 buck or the option to park in the garage which you had to pay for Everytime u entered and left....valet was a better option for me. So I entered the hotel and it was like a breath of fresh air...vibrant and intense colors were everywhere...the hotel staff were very nice...the rooms were beautiful but the bathroom was kinda small...which really didn't bother me because the shower was really nice...I will mos def be returning to the indigo hotel for future visits!!!!
Great stay for the price!!! It's clean it's nice it's decorated beautifully and the rooms are gorgeous. The pics don't do it justice.

Stayed for 2 nights on a stop-over. The staff are VERY friendly & helpful. They will do anything for you. Courtesy shuttle to take you within a 3 mile radius of the hotel. Free wifi, computers in lobby lounge. Lovely lounge in lobby which was handy when u have a late flight - comfy chairs, computers, tv, wifi. Will also store bags after check-out. Can't say enough about the lovely staff.

Came in late evening around 10pm, brought kids, reserved a corner suite with a connecting room, checked in at front desk got room keys go upstairs only to discover the rooms are very far apart! Go back to front desk to get it rectified and they send us back upstairs with new rooms only to discover they are 2 double rooms ( one is handicap)! Go back to front desk AGAIN....get 2 NEW rooms that were connecting but not a suite and one was STILL handicap!!! We settle after trying to check in for an hour and a half!! Then found hair on toilet, hair on the bed, and hair in our room service food!!! I called front desk before ordering room service to insist they pay for our dinner, and the mgr. Maria said and I quote, "How many people we talkin about". I said the same four you sent back and forth 3 times! Unwilling to pay for the whole dinner, she did give a $50 credit, but with hair in the food I don't know how big a favor that really was!! Anyway, service extremely poor, we are preferred guests who travel internationally and we have NEVER had this kind of service before by Westin!! #absolutelyridiculous

The hotel lobby opens into the mall, making it an ideal hotel for those who love to shop, and anyone else during the holiday season. Restaurant in the main lobby closes early (10pm) but upstairs bar is open late and has a decent menu.

review_title: This is a fantastic hotel with a great view from the unique window seat in the room.
review_text:
I especially love the huge panoramic window in the room with a cushioned window seat allowing me to gaze on Dallas' splendor. The rooms are spacious and the bed super. My favorite part was relaxing in the window seat looking out over Dallas at night with all the city lights. 
It was also convenient to be able to walk directly to the mall for a diversion (without having to go outside or atch a cab). Direct service from the airport by super shuttle makes it very convenient as well as 2 superb restaurants that offer gluten free options.

Stayed at this hotel for a week due to my husband being in a training class in Dallas. Hotel was clean, service was good, and location was great! Breakfast service had a great variety and as was mentioned by another reviewer, it was fully stocked right till the end of the morning. Staff is very personable and efficient. On a Tuesday morning, the lady preparing omelets was alone, no one assisting her, and the line was very, very long. She just kept smiling, greeted each person, took their order, and proceeded to do this until every last one was done. Her omelets were great and she had such a sweet disposition. One morning I forgot my travel coffee cup on the table and when I went down to see if they had it, one of the bus boys said he saw that I forgot it and had set it aside for me, kmowing I would be back for it.
Overall, a great hotel, right next to Love Field, close to Lake Bachman if you want to go for a jog/run, NorthPark Mall is a few miles east, along with great restaurants and access to several highways.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel Dallas Love Field

review_text:
Hotel is nice, staff friendly and rooms are clean. Only problem is bar is pricey! Spent $110 for lunch!
Ask for shuttle to take you to near by places to eat and to the mall.
Overall very nice stay. I will return!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel Dallas Love Field

review_text: The girls at the front desk were helpful. The suite was roomy and clean. Made to order omelettes werr nice. Location is close to airport. Shuttle every half hour. I will stay hrre again.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel Dallas Love Field

review_text: Friendly staff, clean newly renovated rooms, right on top af a nice shopping center. The only downside is the dark room I had. I did get a corner room but if you work at the desk the whole day then the room is to dark.
We got this hotel stay for $36 per night thru hotwire. Rooms are a good size. Housekeeping is good. Breakfast selection excellent. Starbucks and restaurants close by. Fridge and microwave in rooms.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Dallas/Stemmons Fwy(I-35 E)

review_text: This is a pretty good location if you need to be in the Park Central area or if you want a fairly central location between downtown and the northern suburbs. Easy access to the Central Expressway. The hotel is an older one but is kept up nicely. It's probably the only Embassy Suites I have ever been to where the parking is beneath the building and the room elevators go directly down to the garage. I like that. The indoor pool & hot tub are small and I thought the pool water might be a little bit murky, but it was ok.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel Dallas - Park Central Area

review_text: Here for 2 months. Friendly staff. Some cleaning staff issues, only cleaned every othet week, when payed for weekly. Biggest issue, be sure to watch your clothes wash and dry. I left to grab something out of my room, 2 doors down to 2 weeks worth of clothing stolen. Not impressed with how staff handled it, nothing came of it. Therefore, out $300+. Had to buy other kitchen things, as it was not provided will not recommend this at all!
hotel_name: Extended Stay Deluxe - Dallas - Market Center

review_text: This is an excellent place to stay. Excellent features with full size kitchen, study desk, good lightinng, laundry and gym facilities. Staff were excellent. Very helpful.
hotel_name: Extended Stay Deluxe - Dallas - Market Center

review_text: This hotel has nice rooms and great service. Very helpful. It's a good location in that it's only 3 miles from the airport. This is the best place I've stayed in Dallas and I'm there frequently on business trips.
hotel_name: Extended Stay Deluxe - Dallas - Market Center

review_title: Great stay, clean, and service was prompt when more pillows were needed!
review_text: I thought this hotel was great-close to many fun places to go, close to the airport, and a comfortable bed with nice linens! Parking is all in front and very accessible, and the staff was very friendly. Also, this hotel is kid friendly, however, we never heard any disturbances and the room was quiet and comfortable. This Embassy Suites also has a little snack hour around 6:00 p.m. which is nice too.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel Dallas Love Field

review_text: friendly valet. somewhat incompetent front desk people. rooms are clean with comfy beds. the suites are just two connected rooms. it doesn't feel like a suite, especially with the absence of a bathtub. disappointed.

If you are just flying in and out and need a bed to stay or wanting to see Dallas this is a great place to stay, the staff are friendly and helpful and the food it fantastic well worth a visit.
The total package starts when you are picked up by the free shuttle bus to take you to the hotel ( our driver was Bill) so helpful talking about the hotel and happy to help with any questions that we asked also remember our names when we came down stair later in the day a great asset to the hotel.
As we were staying in a quiet time of the year we also were luck enough to be able to have ala carte breakfast at no added cost very nice.
We had dinner at Aces lobby bar both night we stayed it was great we were served by Ron another good employee for the hotel. The food was fantastic.
The hotel also has a Starbucks coffee available. 
So all round we had a great stay, why do you give it a go next time you visit you will no be disappointed.

review_title: Close location to highway and easy walking distance to restaurants and grocery store.
review_text: Easy parking deck on site with easy access to hotel, fairly clean. Nice hot breakfasts...I didn't stay for weekday dinner. Fairly close to a Cheesecake Factory and a Mexican food place (forgot name)...and a grocery store with wine shop (Tom Thumb store). Only drawback was loud blower in wall for heat/air. It rattled on and off...finally just turned entire thing off. Loud guests out in courtyard were, very quickly, quieted by hotel staff. That was appreciated. Maid service not that great.

review_title: First class service for a reasonable price
review_text: Had a great experience at the Hyatt Regency at DFW. The shuttle picked me up at the terminal and it was a three minute drive to the hotel. In that time, the shuttle driver explained all the amenities offered at the Hyatt and the shuttle schedule. The hotel had plenty of helpful staff waiting to help or answer any questions. I took the shuttle into Grapevine and there are plenty of shops and restaurants to choose from. The price of the shuttle pass is $5. Had a king size suite and it was clean and modern. As many past reviewers stated, the shower does not have a door and a little water does splash out on the floor. I had a towel on the floor so it was too bad. I had lunch and breakfast at Jacobs and both meals were good, especially the Texas French toast. I will definitely stay at the Hyatt Regency again

We had to stay somewhere for a week between two weekend events we were in Dallas for. We chose this place after reading other reviews here. It really delivered. Despite it's proximity to the Love Field runways, we never heard a single plane take off. It is so quiet. Excellent place for professionals.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel Dallas Love Field

review_text: Me and my daughter just stayed there last night and woke up to bed bugs biting us in our sleep. When we got out of the bed we could see tons of bugs all over the bed sheets. The office refused to give our money back only offered us another bed bug infested room. On top of that they are very very rude and noisy. I don't recommend this motel to anyone unless u wanna lie with bed bugs. They didn't even remove the mattress out of the room so the same condition was given to the next person that rented it.

review_title: In the words of Madeline Kahn in Blazing Saddles, "How owdinawy!"
review_text: I am accustomed to the Hyatt Regency brand applying to a moderately upscale hotel. This one, however, was a basic concrete block with the ambiance of a well-maintained Econo Lodge. Entirely surrounded by the Dallas-Fort Worth airport, it features breathtaking views of three parking structures. There is noplace to walk other than these structures. Clean and well-staffed, it is the perfect hotel to stay in before an early flight or after a late one. And it is ideal for anyone who is coming to Dallas and wants to avoid seeing Dallas.

review_title: We didn't even bother asking for a refund
review_text:
We booked this room on expedia.com for $46.
Upon arriving, the scary non-American owner treated me like a criminal because he saw me smoking outside. I asked for a non smoking room and he said "I saw you smoking, You are not going to smoke in the room are you?"
I was like uh, I woulda asked for smoking if I planned on that.
Smoking woulda helped the stench of death in the room... And there were cigarette burns all over the comforters, carpet, dresser, and sink area.
Found crusty brown stuff on the toilet seat, little curly hair all over the restroom, grime on the curtians, door knob, bed table... Everywhere. E coli city!
We called expedia, who tried for forty minutes to call the front desk. After how I was treated upon checking in, I was actually afraid to speak to the manager again. 
Expedia gave us a fifty dollar coupon toward another hotel do I payed thirty more bucks and we got a great room elsewhere.
Didn't even speak to the hotel people. Oh, the pool (heavily advertised) was locked up and greener than the water in the toilet!

review_title: An Oasis in the Middle of the City
review_text:
Definitely one of the nicest hotels I have ever been to. The room was beautiful and quite comparable to some of the 5 star hotels in Hollywood and Beverly Hills. The staff was really friendly and helpful and made us feel as special as anyone else there. We had dinner at the restaurant there and it was perfect. The servers were so nice (even when we used a Travelzoo coupon) and the food was delicious. The next morning I had a massage in the spa and that was one of the best massages I have ever had (ask for Mac). 
All in all a perfect romantic getaway.

There's something rotten going on at The Stoneleigh. Good news: they've nailed the first impression with great doormen who very nicely open doors for guests. Fabulous. Spectacular.... And then?
The carpet in the elevators rival the stains of a college dorm room. The smell attracts one's attention to the disgusting carpet. 
Breakfast at the Bolla bar rivals the La Quinta with lukewarm food. The packets of empty sugar used for my coffee were allowed to pile up. I had to request them to be cleared after an hour. And again, the carpet in the Bolla needed a quick vacuum from the night before. I had to weave my way around crumbs and debris. 
Check out. WOW. Here's where things get funny. I found a $97 charge for dinner. I did not have dinner here. The lady next to me at check out remarked, "Oh! That happened to us too!" Interesting. Suspicious. Rotten? Possibly. The checkout girl had no explanation, but did tell me to contact my bank regarding all those "pending charges" they added to my bill. Nice. Is Hospitality an online college course these days? Because some communication skills and customer service skills are lacking. Yikes! 
The Stoneleigh is trying hard to be upscale, and sadly falling short.
Helpful and friendly staff. Room comfy, quiet, and spacious. Room service quick. Only complaint is the lack of soy milk.

Having to travel for business is usually very run of the mill when it comes to staying at a hotel. But not if you get the chance to stay at The Stonleigh. It us such a wonderful landmark hotel in Dallas. It is completely modern and relaxing. Rooms are so comfortable and decorated very nicely. The bar in the lobby is a highlight and is quite lively in the evening.

review_title: Friendly staff and nice room for the money
review_text: Stayed here on a lay over and was expecting a basic room for $90 per night. Very surprised and love the room. Nice decor, friendly staff and a comfy bed.

review_title: Pleasant stay on a hot weekend
review_text: Stayed at the Westin Galleria for two nights for a family event in June 2011. It was a very pleasant, comfortable hotel. Room was large and clean with a very nice window seat, perfect for reading. Bathroom with large, walk-in shower, also very clean. One small criticism, the design of the shower and bathroom doors don't give you many places to hang up clothes or wet towels. Also, I didn't see an available outlet near the bed, making it difficult to charge a phone and use it as an alarm. But these are minor issues. Health club was clean and had towels, water, and headsets as well as yoga mats and exercise balls. common areas were very nice, with modern decor. Pool area is a bit barren, surrounded by tall buildings on all sides, and with little to no landscaping. Staff was pleasant and helpful. The hotel is attached to the mall, which is very convenient if you don't have a car, giving you access to some dining, shopping and entertainment options. The weakest link I experienced might have been the food, both the free afternoon snack in the lobby and a brunch held in one of the meeting rooms. The food was OK at best and not as good as I've had at equivalent hotels.

We had the expedia rate so I will start by saying it was good value. However, this is not is not top tier, they renovated this hotel and ran out of money, as evidenced by the skeleton on an extension attached to the hotel and the swimming pool that has been a work in progress since 2008. We had to move rooms because they could not fix the wireless on our floor- but found out at 2am that it was to where the wedding party was going on -with a 1yr old it wasn't ideal. We then moved again (at2am) to a different room! Moving back in the morning. No appologies, no discussion. In every room we were in I was fixing the drawer handles! On one occasion I left them on top- but it was left by house keeping until I fixed them. Good management would have handled all problems -particulary the room switches. A shoe string operation. Would we go back? Depends on the rate i think. The restaurant and staff (Bolla) are fabulous, as the valet personel and security -it's really front of house and housekeeping that needs the tune up!

Where do I start? No tub in the bathroom. The bathroom door didn't latch and the sink didn't drain. Also our wake up call was 15 minutes late. This is pricelines 4 star in the area. Don't waste your money!

We showed up after a 3 and a half hour drive ready to take a break and settle in before visiting family. At 7 pm we were told our room wasn't ready and wouldn't be ready until 9pm. We came back at 11 pm and our room STILL wasn't ready. We ended up having to cancel entirely and make a different reservation at 11 pm to find somewhere to sleep... Wtf.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Dallas - Campbell Centre

review_text:
First lets go over the positives. Excellent location if you want a hotel near the airport. Their airport shuttle runs every 15 minutes. Sound proof windows, so we never heard the planes. Comfy bed. Reasonably priced. Has a bar and restaurant and a pool.
Now the not so good part. Let's talk about the shower or lack thereof first. Whoever thought it was a good idea to have a open shower with no door should be fired. Half of the water from our showers ended up on the bathroom floor. We used all our towels cleaning up the pool of water every day. But the most insane thing about this hotel is the way their employees try to hustle their guests. Instead of calling you a cab they will pressure you into taking a car service which just so happens to have three lincolns sitting out front. DO NOT BELIEVE A WORD THE CONCiERGE/DOORMAN TELLS YOU about the car service being the cheaper option. Tell them to shutup and call you a cab. They are clearly in cahoots with thiscar service company and flat out lied to us that the car service was cheaper than the cab. SHAME ON MGMT for allowing this type of behavior. THEN, while we sat in the bar having a drink, we were approached by an older man who said he worked in the hotel restaurant. He tried to pressure us into cancelling our dinner reservations at Pappas Bros claiming it was really far away. THIS IS NOT TRUE. Pappas Bros is 10 miles from the hotel. We eventually had to tell him we were meeting friends there just so he would leave us alone! Extremly unprofessional and annoying. 
I was disappointed at the dishonesty by the employees. Instead of being helpful and honest with out of towners they preferred the hustle approach. Won't stay there again.

review_title: Nice but not the nicest. No working vending
review_text: Stayed here on trip involving SMU campus. It was close but u had to know where you were going. The hotel was ok. Adequately clean. Satisfactory room. Because there are aspects to the hotel that are aging one day when I came back in the evening I found my room door not shut all the way. I think it was the cleaning crew. Nothing was missing. Easy enough to have happen if you don't slam the door shut. More or less what I would expect out of this type and caliber if hotel. I was disappointed that I could hear what was going on in the hallway very clearly but my neighbors quieted down quickly and mostly were passing.g through. Also no working vending machines. One lady in our group finally found 1 working. I never did.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Dallas - Campbell Centre

review_text: To be a CHOICE HOTEL this place is NASTY !!! Dirty Dirty Dirty!!! The reviews I have read are all true.Elevators are dirty and so are the hallways .Carpet looks old and dingy.Rooms are out dated .Hotel hallways smell musty and all around Filthy Place.DO NOT CHOOSE THIS HOTEL

The Hyatt Regency DFW was a great hotel - clean, good service, good food options. The room was great, spacious, and had everything I needed. The desk on rollers made it easy to turn into a dining table when a friend brought me takeout for dinner. The meeting rooms were also very nice. It's hard to get anywhere since it's by the airport, but considering the location it was quite nice.

review_title: Save $100 per night and stay at the Marriott!
review_text:
Booked online for a weekend trip. I never received a confirmation number or email. Worried me a bit so I called and they provided me the number over the phone. 
When we arrived the air in the room seemed stagnant. We didn't worry about this at the time.
Our first morning, we ordered room service for breakfast at 8:30. The committed to a 20 minute delivery. After 40 minutes we called back and it was clear they had misplaced the order. The staff member found the order (after a few minutes of asking questions like "who did you talk to?"), and promised to rush it and have it there in 20 minutes.
The second night we had stagnant air again, and struggled all night with temperature control. They also removed some of the bed pillows from the room on that day. Flat down pillows, which were terrible.
Booked spa appointments for a party of 4 for the second day. Received a call 2 hours prior to appointment indicating that one of the staff didn't come in, so 2 of us couldn't get our treatments. When the other 2 tried to cancel (hello, party of 4), they were informed that it would be a 50% cancellation fee. They went to the appointment instead of paying the fee, but the spa was running so behind that they were able to get out of the appointments.
Same issue again on the third night, except now the bathroom smells like mold. When we reported this, the staff seemed unconcerned.
Positives: excellent valet staff, convenient to great restaurants.
Definitely not worth $260 per night. Stay away.

review_title: Great rate through hotwire at the last minute
review_text: The Hyatt Regency exceeded my expectations. Usually hotels near the airport aren't the best. The decor of the lobby and the room as well as the cleanliness was excellent. The front desk staff were friendly, professional and efficient. Great price and great stay.

review_title: Needs updating but the staff is great
review_text: Stayed here on a business trip and am unlikely to return. When I first entered the room, I was greeted with a stained carpet. I understand hotel rooms are used by different people every day - but I don't want to be reminded of that when I stay in one. There was a stain on one of the towels and for a minute I questioned whether the room had been cleaned after the last guest. The positive thing I can say is that the staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Dallas - Campbell Centre

review_text: Perfect location, comfortable and clean room, quick and friendly shuttle service. They do offer a discounted rate for parking, but since you still have to take a shuttle you might as well stay off airport and get free parking.
This hotel is two doors down from an adult video store.......DO NOT STAY HERE!

After my previous stay here which wasnt enjoyable, I returned to this hotel to see if any of my previous issues had been addressed... Well, I didnt expect them to have remodeled the entire facility but the attitude of the staff was remarkably different improved! I had one issue during my 10 night stay that was immediately addressed by management. They were responsive and very attentive to my needs. If the entire hotel staff is able to maintain that level of attentitiveness for every customer this hotel will be on the way back to prominence! Thanks to every one for making my stay comfortable and enjoyable!

The bedroom was a nice size and the living room allowed for a few visitors. The bathroom was way too small. The toilet was right next to the tub. My family liked the breakfast buffet. I don't eat from any buffet so I cannot comment. There were restaurants, shopping and theaters within a reasonable driving distance.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Hotel Dallas - Park Central Area

review_title: Hard to believe this is an airport hotel (in a good way)
review_text:
Stayed here one night between flights, and was impressed. It is an older hotel but has had a very nice renovation recently. Rooms are large and modern.
Bed was comfy and quiet (always good at airport hotels). 
My rate included breakfast, and I had the very complete buffet. 
Quick friendly shuttle service is available to all terminals, but you can walk to C if you don't have bags. 
One of the best airport hotels out there!

If you don't care about maid service, TV channels as advertised, the local shuttle service, finding anything to eat or drink during advertised hours of club lounge or helpful management and staff not to mention a restaurant we warned against eating in by other guest! Then go ahead and book your stay at this hotel.
I had a fun weekend in Dallas; however, next time I travel there I would not stay again

review_title: Room was clean service was good, just a few problems that will keep me from going back
review_text: Rooms were clean, but we stayed on 10th floor and it took 4-5 minutes for hot water to get to tub, toilet wouldn't flush contents. Air conditioner was old style mounted in window. Took me a few minutes to find the light switch that powered the ac
hotel_name: Springhill Suites Dallas Downtown West End

review_text:
Just stayed here on business - rooms have a "beach" feel, color scheme etc so that's a little different but overall I enjoyed my stay. Very friendly service at the desk, bell stand, and breakfast. Free shuttle within 3 miles - very convenient. Great feature - the 
bellman has a contact with a car service. Driver waited 20 minutes for me running late from a meeting.

I have stayed at this hotel many times. It happens to be conveniently located near our office in Dallas. The staff is very attentive and the rooms are comfortable. The workout room is quite small but has both aerobic equipment and weights. The hotel is very close to Northpark Mall where you can find several restaurants and shopping.

As you expect from Marriott's Springhill Suites, good rooms, reasonably clean and an average breakfast buffet. Close to Market Street and some decent restaurants, but heading south of Lamar after 3pm is not for the faint of heart.
hotel_name: Springhill Suites Dallas Downtown West End

review_text: I stayed at this hotel in Sept. The parking is across the street from the hotel. The hotel was VERY CLEAN, very nice helpful staff, awesome location, near many restaurants, big spacious rooms, hotel shuttle bus...If your visiting the aquarium u can practically see it when you walk out the front door and it's right across the street. You also have plenty of other museums surrounding you!!! Loved it!
hotel_name: Springhill Suites Dallas Downtown West End

review_title: Nice hotel. Great location. Excellent value.
review_text:
Stayed here for business April 2011. Overall the hotel is an excellent value for the money. It is clean. Great for biz with Internet and spacious desk. Located close to restaurants and bars an many office buildings. I didn't need a car. Pleasant staff that offered a guests reception consisting of chili,chips, beer, salads. Nice touch. 
Only minor complaint is that the A/C unit was too close to the bed and didn't work that well. It was loud and kept me awake until I got up and turned it off. 
I will likely stay again the next time that I am in town.
hotel_name: Springhill Suites Dallas Downtown West End

review_title: Older rooms but ok. I like that all 5 of us can fit comfortably.
review_text:
This ES seems a bit old but it was pretty clean. The ventilation did not work in our suite. The bedroom had heat but the living room was freezing. My poor brother froze on an already cold night. Staff was nice and my dad enjoyed the breakfast. Close to the basketball stadium if you are going to a game. The bathroom was not too small but not large. There is a sink in the bathroom and the bedroom which is good if you have a large family. The tv was horrible. There were fewer than 20 stations and some numbers were skipped! Overall, I would stay here for a night or two if I didn't plan on being in the room much. 
The vending machine took our money but the hotel "couldn't" refund it. I thought that was poor customer service.

review_title: Watch out if you valet! BEWARE!!
review_text: They steal stuff out of your car! Take your kids items then take no responsibility for their employees actions! It may seem like you are getting a good deal but you may have to consider stolen items into the cost of your stay!
hotel_name: Springhill Suites Dallas Downtown West End

review_text:
Decent place for the money. Breakfast was very crowded for a weekend. Took an hour to get an omelet. Line was looooonnnngggg.
Place could use an update but still decent value.

review_title: Stay in the gold club floors. Fantastic service and amenities. Internet worked great. Fantastic shower
review_text: Stay in the gold club floors. Fantastic service and amenities. Internet worked great. Fantastic shower.

I stayed there for 4 nights and have no complaints. The staff were great. The rates were very reasonable. The room was clean and well appointed. The food was good. The pool was nice. Overall a really nice place to stay in Dallas.

Hotel fairmont Dallas was the light at the end of the tunnel after a long, exhausting flight from Australia. Service upon arrival was exceptional, and this trend continued throughout our stay. Breakfast a highlight in 'Pyramid' restaurant, where staff were pleasant, friendly and food on offer high quality. For those aussies that love value, good service, and the most comfortable sleep, this is the place. It is in the ' arts' district, so don't expect retail outlets in the vicinty, however a $20 cab ride will get you to ' Northpark' shopping centre, where every brand imaginable, plus Macys, neiman Marcus etc are at your disposal. All in all a great experience, and we look forward to our next stay in Dallas. Aussie hotels, lift your game!! This is the benchmark all hotels should aspire to.

review_title: Great service and accomodations, excellent location for price!
review_text: Was at a convention down the street and it was the most affordable hotel providing convenient shuttle service for my event. My room came equipped with a microwave and fridge making it easy to store my leftovers. Quiet place, comfortable beds, and great service from the staff. It was so close to all the restaurants and bars around the American Airline Center. The staff gave me great recommendations on local places to eat and check out. Will stay here next time for future conventions.

review_title: Nice big clean room but whole property could use an update.
review_text: Service was friendly and property was clean it just needs some updating.

review_title: Luxery on a whole new level.
review_text:
Where to begin. Pros- superior customer service, all employees are super friendly, beautiful Dallas views, the rooftop pool is absolutely wonderful. We had room service one night, my husband said the bone in ribeye was one of the best steaks he's ever had, gold lounge is awesome, breakfast, drinks all day,appetizers in the evening.... Must have a keycard to access room levels. Starbucks in hotel lobby, shuttle.... Oh man. This place was seriously awesome! 
Cons- the pool closes at eleven, the nighttime views from the rooftop pool is so cool. And valet parking. Which is only a con b/c to get in your car they gotta bring it down to you. All in all it was a wonderful stay!

Stayed at the Intercontinental for about 4 days. Rooms were spacious, clean and generally comfortable.
Service at the front desk was efficient and friendly. The restaurant served a decent menu that gave value for your buck.

We got our room on priceline for a very cheap rate, so I can't complain about that. I have to say I have been disappointed with our room. AC will not cool room. Shower has absolutely no water pressure. Towels are limp & dingy & threadbare. Mattress is hard & pillows are lumpy. 
We slept in, so maid service skipped us. We left hotel by 10:30 am. I've never stayed at a hotel that didn't come back & make the room up. We got back this evening & 
had clean towels (which I requested) but the dirty ones were still piled on the floor! Bed was not made either! Wow. I would NOT classify this as a 4 star hotel!
Clean and modern interior and rooms. Free parking. They have sleep number beds and fluffy pillows. We had little bags of gummy bears on or pillows and a rubber ducky in the shower. Great deal!
hotel_name: Park Inn by Radisson Dallas-Love Field

review_title: I've NEVER had an issue with the Intercontinental Dallas.
review_text:
I've stayed at this hotel twice before and will stay there again next weekend. My rooms there, and I book four at a time, have always been immaculate. The staff is friendly and helpful. No wifi! Give me a break! If you don't have mobile 3G for your devices then your behind the times. There's wifi at the Lobby level and it's free. 
No the restaurant is not 5 star, but then your not paying 5 star prices. It's perfectly fine for a meal if you can't get out. And with the FREE shuttle service and the multitude of restaurants in the area nitpicking the on site restaurant is stupid. 
I love this Hotel!!! For the price and location it's great.
The night front desk worker Andrew is more than beyond rude!!! I will never stop at this Marriott again horrible location and a very old style room for the price.
hotel_name: SpringHill Suites NW Hwy at Stemmons/I-35E

review_text: Well we had reserved a room a week ahead of time an they had gave us a decent price through the phone for a one room 2 bed room...so was pretty excited to stay there but as soon as we got there they changed it up on us an wanted to charge us like 20$ more, me an a friend had to share a bed which really deispleased me an our lights didn't even work so that got me ticked...But other then that are microwave worked an mini fridge work an the AC was nice an cold, we tried getting ahold of a manager when we were there but was never there when we would call. But other then that was a ok night to stay

review_title: Not worthy of "intercon" brand - don't expect multistar from this property
review_text:
were do i start --
--no wireless internet ... that means no ipad, ipod, iwhatever and your bounf to your desk with ur laptop--- wakeup mgmt its the 21 century....
--executive floor ... ha what a joke the super 8 breakfast is better ... again missed opportunity by the mgmt to take go that extra intercon mile
--the food ... terrible no words describe terrible including the "fake" starbucks...yes a store that call it self starbucks and brews horrid coffee. ... good service there and decent goodies but cafe was not starbucks quality
---should i go on ... no simply put the management has missed capitalizing on what is potentially a great location... don't be fooled by the lobby pictures ... i had a hard lumpy bed layered with a foam/feather liner to give it some extra years and my old tube tv never cooperated with my remote...in my executive floor room
...i have to say the workers tried hard with what they had .. cleaning ladies were great,

For the price of 59 a night, it is a great value. This is my second stay this year. Very quiet on a sunday night. No problems with front desk. Negatives- pool is out of order. Non smoking room has a hint of smoke.

It's 3:15am and wth am I doing awake at this hour?! I mean nothing good happens after 10 right....well idk if its the loud prostitute and her pimp fighting across the hall or the AC in my room that BTW:literally sounds like one of the militarys finest "Blue Angels". Just bc it sounds like a jet doesn't mean its running like one! It's hotter than HELL in my room, I've called the front desk they were suppose to send someone hours ago, I'm scared to leave my room what if the pimp and prostitute decide to jump me?! Why didn't I read the reviews....I'm lying here wondering how many windows in my car may need replacing when the sun comes up! Im dwn for a two night stay however, I'm chkn out a day early!!!!!

Had to stay a few nights for business. Pillowcases were stained with penmarks, brownish-unidentifiable marks, black scuff marks like someone stepped on them. Sheets and towels were so thin they felt like gauze. The light-blocking curtains don't draw all the way making sleep past 7 am impossible. Asked for a quiet room but got one right next to the elevator. Food was ok. They had some kind of computer upgrade going on when I checked out and could not give me a receipt right away. An itemized receipt was to be emailed to me, but 3 days later nothing from the hotel. Location is good, right on the Dallas tollway & beltline.

review_title: Average Fairfield Inn, but somehow feels tight.
review_text: Very comfortable bed. Smaller than average room with some niceties missing that other Fairfields offer. Tight eating area with average offerings. Front desk offered assistance when requested, but nothing was done as they said it would be....follow up was poor. However, it was clean and well maintained. Front door is challenging to find....signage needs improvement. I will stay again if the price is right, but not for over $100. Dallas has better options.

Everything seemed made to cut costs, but what it lacked in extra amenities, it made up in cleanliness, location and a fast, warm staff. I'd be staying there again within the next 6 months, definitely.

The guy at the front desk was really nice I think his name was David. Anyways I thought the breakfast had a nice big selection and was very alert that some of thier food may contain food allergies. Very very impressed! We were planning on staying at a comfort suites but we had an awful expierience in San Antonio a couple of days before. So glad that we stayed here!
hotel_name: Ramada Dallas North Hotel and Conference Center

review_text: Where to begin..Arrived to this "pet friendly" hotel to be questioned about having my yorkie in tow..?? Staff member said, 'ok she can go ahead and stay'..?? Got to 1st room- AC not working, trash on floor, used rag in bathroom, soap open, blood on towel..!!! Complained to very friendly staff, moved our family- child and baby included, to another room.. Which had empty beer cans on balcony and dirty night stands and sticky floors:/ oh, the hallway floors were stained with black residue and hotel reaked of smoke:///
hotel_name: Ramada Dallas North Hotel and Conference Center

review_text: The only employee I encountered was harshly judgemental and unwelcoming. She accused us of smoking and tried to talk to us like children. We didn't even stay an hour and left. They even charged us a $25 "incident fee."

Stayed for three weeks. Location is great. Price per week great. Compared to the sister Homestead up the street needs work. Management is in the process of redoing rooms. Grounds are kept clean. Front desk staff very helpful and WiFi was great.
hotel_name: Homestead Studio Suites - Dallas - North Addison - Tollway

review_title: Very nice (after all, it's the Ritz), but...
review_text: But they took over an hour to seat us for dinner, even though we had a reservation. I think they get too busy for Christmas, but the hotel part of it all was typical Ritz

Got to hotel late at night, valet parking doesn't exist, had to park in dodgy parking lot, surprised my car was still their in the morning. Room was disgusting, toe nails and hair on bathroom floor.
Thank god I was only their for 6 hrs. Any more and I think I would of gone crazzzzy
This is the second time since July that we've stayed at a Wyndham hotel (1st was Denver). If given a choice, I will always choose Wydnham from now on!!! Thanks for a great stay.

review_title: It's like a fresh piece of stool covered in glitter and sprayed with air freshner.
review_text:
I am a chiropractor and I was here on buiness. I stayed in a suite. I was with my mother and they do NOT offer suites with 2 beds. This is strange from my past traveling experiences. 
Our first night the old AC in the room made clatter all night because this place is poorly renovated. They make it look nice but old equipment is still here. The light switches are coming out of the walls. The next day, the AC, cable and Internet all went down for the day. We had to use stairs all day. The luggage carts get stuck due to poor wheel construction so plan to just carry your stuff to the room. On the last day the manager, Mr. Dutt Patel, told my mother and I, he was sorry but he could only offer one free night for the poor conditions and inconvenience. Mind you, many people left in the 4 days we were here but I was on business so I had to stay because it was close to my convention. I guess 2 nights would add too much to their loss. I will say the front desk girl Tab was very nice at least. But she had her hands tied. 
Overall, don't waste your money. This place needs new management and they need to renovate the mechanics of this place, not just the aesthetics. Look elsewhere. Dallas has better places.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Dallas I-35 Walnut Hill Ln

review_text: The website noted that the hotel's lobby was being renovated. But there was no mention that Noise could be heard even on the ninth floor. Hotel staff couldn't believe that the noise was intrusive until I recorded it on my phone. Stay away until construction is complete or you'll have phone calls and sleep interrupted.
hotel_name: Dallas Addison Marriott Quorum By the Galleria

review_text: The consistent goodness of Hilton Gardens. Perfect location. Quiet comfortable room

Beautiful hotel and the staff is beyond compare. From front desk, sales, banquets and restaurant staff the emloyees are customer service focused. Immaculate rooms with awesome adjustable mattress makes sleep a pleasure!

Great location! Free shuttle at our disposal. Had dinner at Oceanaire at the Galleria. Absolutely rocked. Beds great, the double room slept 3 women---the huge kitchen/dining/lounging area was perfect. Large sectional made another bed. Perfect. Will stay here again. I'm a huge fan!

Upon arrival our keys didn't work to get to the self parking which on book it it says free parking but in actuality its 12 a night. Room is spacious and nice but our night which I remind you its cold in Dallas we had no hot water so we had to take cold showers. Secondly we found make up on one of the pillow cases. The next day I called "at your service" which is there logo. For them to come change our sheets and bring us extra towels while we were out, we return to hotel at 9 pm and nothing was done. So I calls for extra sheets so I can change the bedding myself and there was blood on the mattress itself. FREAKING DISGUSTING! AVOID AT ALL COST! I STAYED IN NOVEMBER '11
hotel_name: Dallas Addison Marriott Quorum By the Galleria

review_text:
I was there during Christmas weeken and due to that reason everything was slow and quiet. The hotel is located right next to convention center as well
As ASU. However, the hotel is not located near many stores, bars etc. this area is mainly a business district. The room was very clean. The bed was very nice. It was very comfortable. I had a queen bed, the sheets were clean and soft. The room was carpeted. The bathroom was very clean. The room had complimentary water bottles. Has a fridge. Self parking per night was $17.00. If i ever go back to Phoenix AZ I def will stay there.

review_title: If you like trains, this is your hotel!
review_text: Hotel was clean, rooms vey nice and roomy. Restaurant food was very good and excellent value. Wait staff was superb. The hotel is situated between 2 train tracks. The train runs all day and most of the night. Whistle blows are extremely loud! Even earplugs didn't work and sleep was intermittent. Ask for a room on the back side of the hotel and you will only get a few trains during the night. The track on the front side has trains about every 30 to 45 minutes. The diner next door is excellent as well. I would not stay here again due to the trains. Otherwise the hotel was very nice.

review_title: This hotel would not be my first choice in the area..
review_text: I felt like the staff could have been more friendly..The rooms seemed fair..The breakfast was good..

It's not bad but not as clean as I would have liked. The bath mat was dirty and their were random hairs in the bathroom and on the sheets. There are lots of hotels in this area so I probably would not suggest this one.

review_title: Great clean hotel in a good location!
review_text: Close to food and the freeway. Marcus at the front desk was very helpful. Our dog Lucy also enjoyed her stay and the walk in the parking lot!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Dallas North Central

review_text: Sam in the lobby bar was awesome. Thx for making our stay fun

review_title: You will love this place has it all!
review_text: Great location. We loved our 79 rate we got a hot breakfast that had it all. We ordered room service that was excellent. My wife complimented on the accent wall. Beautiful place.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Dallas Hotel & Conference Center

review_text: This is a hotel built many years ago..I would have preferred a bigger bathroom..Overall the stay was reasonable..
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Dallas Market Center

review_text:
Spent four days there for US Open Volleyball tournament. The team was sceptical but having stayed at multiple other hotela in the chain before I knew we were in great hands. 
Everything was excellent. The rooms spotless, restaurant great, bar was just what the doctor ordered after a long day. The staff was very accommodating and always with a smile. The shuttle service proved invaluable with the drivers going out of their way to help. 
The location is not close to many food choices but I found a gem right across the road - Bucks Prime barbecue. Owned by an asian family - very pleasant, great prices, tasty food. 
To frame this review, I was a 100% business traveller for two years and have stayed in countless hotels. Use this to judge whether you think I know a decent hotel.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Dallas Market Center

review_text: It was good, good food , good people, good location, I requested a room with a view and they got me just that, it was good!!

review_title: Older hotel that has good service and good rate.
review_text:
We stayed here during the last few days of business travel. 
The good...
Location is pretty good if you need to get on / off I35. Centrally located. 
We got extra points for our stay. 
Staff was friendly. 
The bad...
Hot. We were on the top floor, big room. Unfortunately, Dallas is in the middle of a crazy heat wave which made our west facing room hot. 
This is an older hotel. As such, expect some things to be dated

Huuby & I brought our little Maltese puppy with us for our stay Jan 14-16, 2011, during a martial arts conference. We enjoyed everything about our stay, especially the friendly staff, who were always ready with a smile as they saw us strolling through the lobby with our little pup. We were pleased to note that our dog was widely welcomed & we felt quite well accommodated. Our room, while a bit dated, was clean & tidy; we enjoyed a lovely view & the quiet of the 20th floor made coming in at night feel relaxing. Staff were all quite helpful & friendly, though we had to call & check up on our laundry service in order to ensure timely delivery of our clothing for our next day's activities. Excellent value for room, amenities & service, overall. The hot tub was an especially nice amenity for my husband after he'd had a long day of training on the mat, & was looking to soothe sore muscles. This represented our first stay as Proirity Club members, & we are excited to book our next trip with the Crowne Plaza family.Bravo to the Market Center Staff; we look forward to staying with you next year.

review_title: Not the best, but not bad
review_text: Nice lobby with pleasant staff, but few things that were annoying. I ordered room service and after 1 hour I called to find out the chef "was confused" and forgot my order...now it would take 20-30 more minutes. Had I not called, it would have not been acknowledged. They should have called about the problem. Instead of apology, I was told it was busy (excuses instead of owning up) but I was given a free beer. Another thing was I heard the doorman and shuttle driver referring to "them Koreans" which I later learned was the staff of Korean airlines who stay there. While not horrible, they were making comments that could be interpreted as derogatory had they heard. Overall ok, but not great
hotel_name: Omni Dallas Hotel at Park West

review_text: Typical courtyard would return if in area I like the new F&B concept
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Dallas Central Expressway

review_title: Next to Strip Club, not for kids!
review_text: We tried to stay here when my niece was getting ready for a long hospital stay and had a lot of appointments at Children's Hospital in Dallas, which is only three miles away. However, every night we tried to swim there were either inconsiderate people smoking by the indoor pool or TOPLESS in the hot tub! Management could do little about it. It was also very loud with all the drunk truckers coming in from the strip club next door at 4-5am! Breakfast in the mornings was also x-rated with all the truckers talking and showing off their phone videos from the club the night before! DO NOT STAY HERE IF YOU HAVE KIDS!!
hotel_name: Wingate by Wyndham Dallas / Love Field

review_text:
I stayed here on business. The neighborhood is not so great. (strip clubs and "cabarets" are plentiful) They are very understaffed and the phone rings for a VERY long time before it gets answered. The rooms have a chemical smelling air freshener in them. The staff tells you NOT to walk in the area. 
Do Yourself a favor....drive two exits farther and stay somewhere nice.
hotel_name: Wingate by Wyndham Dallas / Love Field

review_text: Okay, so maybe I got the wrong room. I was put into a room with a giant conference table with 12 chairs without any warning from the front desk. Very odd. Then, no room service menu, no ironing board (yet there was an iron), no coffee pot, and a view of the HVAC system on the roof. Maybe the house cleaners just didn't do a great job on my room?
hotel_name: Omni Dallas Hotel at Park West

review_text: My husband and I stayed here for our anniversary. I called in advance to let them know of my down feather allergy and requested down alternative. They asked me the reason for my stay and I told them. When we arrived we were upgraded to a junior suite. Much to my surprise we had chocolate covered strawberries and champagne. Our stay was fabulous! I feel let down at any other hotel because we were treated so well. We are select guest members and frequent Omni's often, but Omni Park West is by far our favorite! :)
hotel_name: Omni Dallas Hotel at Park West

review_title: Service was poor, never received clean towels/linens, etc, lights too bright outside for sleep, ants in our room along with some
review_text: When we arrived, our reservations that we made a month in advance had been cancelled and instead of trying to fix it they kept blaming others for the mistake. Once the issue was resolved, our credit card ended up being charged twice. One of the rooms we reserved had no hairdryer...although we called down for one in the morning, had it not been for us having another room we didn't receive the hairdryer until late in the afternoon. One of our rooms requested that they not clean then housekeeping called waking up the kids that were napping. That night we requested clean towels and washcloths and never received them. The next morning we found ants near the bed and someones used empty toiletries in our bathroom. We normally enjoy staing at this brand of hotels but will not recommend this particular one to anyone.
hotel_name: Wingate by Wyndham Dallas / Love Field

review_title: As a flight attendant for 25 years, outside of Europe, this location is hands~down the best location in our system.
review_text: Excellent location, beautiful rooms, staff is SO accommodating and personal attention is given in a comfortable yet professional manner. From front desk to restaurant staff~ Especially Tracy Simmons in the restaurant...top notch!
Valet and bellman were excellent !! Front desk needs refinement and training.

My family and I traveled into town for a football game. We had a reservation at another Holiday Inn (Arlington) but they had cancelled our reservation and had no room for us, so 500 miles away from home with nowhere to sleep, we were told this hotel had one room left for the weekend and was the only one within a 30 mile radius, so we decided to take the room. Best decision ever! We arrived here and couldn't have asked for a better location, hotel, or staff experience. Valmarie is great! Staff is very friendly and professional, rooms are clean and good value for the money. I highly recommend this hotel if you need to stay in the Dallas/Arlington area.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Dallas West

review_title: Rude staff.. bad manager(raj).. barly knew english.. small rooms.. expernsive rates.. bad area..beds uncomfertable.. tv unreliab
review_text: Stayed at the hotel a few times all of which where very crappy.. took 25 mins to check in.. then the key did not work.. had to get another.. the front desk agents did not know good english aruged with me.. bed was not made..maids came in without knocking barley knew any english.. aswell.. when I came to hampton in 2008. There was a nice girl at the front desk knew good english named angel if I remember correct.. the manger was very mean and rude to her.. they really need a new manger... besides that the food was okay prices are a bit high for such a bad neighborhood..bums hang out outside gentlemens club very close not much of a choice of food..rooms are small..the staff talks another launage when u ask them a question. Rooms are outdated and smell of smoke.. the only good thing I can say is the happy hour was free...
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Dallas North / I-35 East At Walnut Hill

review_text:
Checkin was a breeze and we had reserved a big 2-bedroom suite which has a full living room and kitchen in between. Each bedroom has a door and a King sized bed along with a private bathroom. It really is easily a 2 couple or family room. We had 2 kids sleep on the pullout couch and it went fine.
The front desk wasn't answering a few times when we called. The hot tub was barely luke warm but the pool was okay. No towels provided and there was a stack of used towels that had been ignored all day. 
Good value for the price we paid including breakfast and afternoon snacks.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Dallas - Park Central Area

review_title: It's an old hotel being run on a shoestring....
review_text: We drove in late from San Antonio but never expected that a Sheraton Hotel would not have any food whatsoever! We had a suite and it did not have a minibar. Our first warning should have been when the person on duty told us that the back entrance from the parking lot did NOT lock ever...and it was unattended! Low ceilings, Small rooms, old fixtures and furniture the place is definately dated....we will never stay here again.
hotel_name: Sheraton Dallas Hotel by the Galleria

review_text:
Really poor room service: ordered cuban sliders...got 2 slices of salami with a few slices of pickles. (missing ham, swiss cheese, pork). ordered soup and they didn't give me a spoon.
at breakfast, dishes and utensils were dirty
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Dallas - Near the Galleria

review_text: The hotel needs an upgrade! My mistake was booking this hotel because of the location (close to the galleria mall). The pool was smaller than expected and the jacuzzi was full of kids and dirty(one of the kids vomited on the outside of the jacuzzi and it was just sitting there). The room was "motel-ish" and both my daughters who slept on the pull out sofa had bumps on their arms, back and neck which was later confirm as bed bugs by their PCP....never again!! No call was returned from management
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Dallas - Near the Galleria

review_text: Great hotel we booked on hotwire so I felt it was a great value for what we paid! Wish the WiFi had been free...that would be my only recommendation for this hotel.
hotel_name: Sheraton Dallas Hotel by the Galleria

review_text: Service was fine, staff was friendly but rooms are very small and lots of freeway noise on the side they placed me. I am in Dallas again and this time chose another hotel.

review_title: Bring your bulletproof vest! Terrible location, manager is rude!!
review_text: My family and I planned a few days in the Dallas area a week before our stay. I have a friend who works for the company who gave me the friends and family rate before she left to go out of the country. I made reservations online with that rate, received a confirmation with the special rate. when my family arrived at night, the manager proceeded to tell us we had to have a form to fill out to get this rate. Long story short, he didn't budge. Total jerk! I couldn't get a hold of my friend, because she was out of the country. No where was it written on line that I'd have to have a form to get that rate. I would not have stayed at this hotel if I wasn't getting a good rate. Here's why- when you pull into the hotel, there are signs everywhere telling you to take in your personal belongings. Barbed wire cover the top of the fencing around the hotel, and to make matters worse, most rooms are not located inside the hotel. (outside entrance). It must be a very dangerous area, because the gas station across the street has bulletproof glass around the workers! If you are considering this hotel- reconsider!!! Go down the street a few blocks, and there are more hotels in better locations!! Lots of places to eat too. What happened to the customer always bring right?! This manager hasn't heard the end of me!

review_title: Friendly staff who go the extra mile to help you.
review_text:
Having read a so many great reviews we decided to book the Belmont for our two night stay in Dallas and what a delight it was. From the moment I called to book the friendly, can do attitude of the staff was evident - they couldn't do enough for us! The hand written welcome note from the general manager with recommendations on what to do based on my booking conversation was a really nice touch. 
The hotel is a restored art decor place, whilst it is close to a busy intersection you don't hear a traffic sound in your rooms. Great value - you dont need to worry about not being down town the free shuttle service was beyond our expectations - luxurious and of course friendly and helpful. Even got to see the NBL trophy on display at the bar with the city views behind in the distance one night. Would certainly recommend the Belmont.

I felt compelled to write a review. I stay at Sheraton so often and only seldom get a chance to move up the brand. This Hotel is fine, don't get me wrong. But it's amazing how Westins in general don't do nearly as much for preferred guests. The average is higher but the delux club level isn't much better than the general room. This hotels lounge was free of amenities beyond chairs. Come on Westin shape up and be upscale. How is it that I would rather stay at Sheraton than get average treatment for more money with you.

Stayed here for three nights last week. The temperature outside was 108 but the rooms were super cool. Stayed in a little bungalow with a terrace overlooking the road. Loved this place, it's quirky and the clientele were equally lovely. Staff were very friendly. Great city views from the pool. If you fancy something different from a Marriot type chain, this is the place.

I stayed here for two nights for a business trip. The staff was very helpful and room service was great. Heavenly beds were comfortable but my room was a bit dated and the shower pressure was not heavenly. Wifi signal to my room was weak which made it difficult to do work.

review_title: For the hip scene of Dallas
review_text: This place is completely different from the chain hotels of downtown or the over-priced "boutique" hotels of Up-Town and North Dallas. It's fun, funky and a great place to meet friends for a weekend getaway. The bar is one of the best in Dallas with the most incredible view of the Dallas skyline.

The hotel lobby is nice enough, staff friendly, but food is overpriced & just ok. Parking charge when every other hotel that practically borders the property has free parking. Internet charge...but the worst charge came when I went to get a soda out the refreshment center that my hotel provided book says every room has in the armoir. No refreshment center...so I called front desk & they knew...asked about vending machine but Westin hotel doesn't have vending machines. Long story short, no other choice, I had to order room service. A can of sprite cost me 4.42.

After a 4 nite stay, my family was very happy with the staff (yes Grace is a doll) and the facilities. We felt safe and welcome by all that were working at this well appointed hotel.
