We loved having the kitchen and the pool. It is close to great restaurants and shopping. Breakfasts were fresh. Public spaces were clean. We would return without hesitation.

review_title: Nice hotel, not near a lot of stuff.
review_text: Hotel was your basic Courtyard. Nothing to write home about. There were lobby renovations during our stay, but we knew that going in. Staff was nice. As long as you plan on driving to dinner and other things, not a bad place, but not very convenient to all Dallas has to offer. Will recommend based on hotel and cost, not location.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Dallas Market Center

review_text: If you haven't stayed in a Westin Heavenly Bed, get ready. It'll be hard to stay anywhere else after that!

The Hyatt delivered exactly as Hyatt brand has that great tendency to: spotless, huge rooms with comfy sofa, great beds, spotlessly clean everywhere! We had a king studio which had it's own kitchen and even a walk in wardrobe- which after 2 weeks on the road were an absolute joy!!! The manager obviously keeps a tight ship here and we really loved our stay. The fitness centre was great with really good machines which allowed us to keep up marathon training despite the insane heat! 
But what made our stay a really happy one was the staff who proved that first class service does not have to be stuffy and characterless! Grace the front desk girl just makes everyone's day that much brighter with her sunny disposition and just obvious enjoyment of her job. She makes you feel as though you really have a friend as soon as you land. She really is a diamond in the hospitality world! 
All in all a great stop off on Dallas!

We had booked a queen room (and paid for it). Get to check in... We don't have that room available but we have a roomwith 2 beds. We didn't have a choice but to take it. My partner and I are not big people bug even we had to sleep in the separate beds as they were way to
Small! The front desk staff seem to be people thu have just pulled from
Anywhere. Nothing professional about them at all..not even a uniform. We were only here for one night for the basketball final and thy had a shuttle bus to take us to the game so that was an advantage. Overall if I was to come back to Dallas again I wouldn't stay here.

I had recently written a review on this hotel and it was a bad experience, but the manager, Ana, contacted me and gave us a free night and free breakfast. The room we were in was renovated and was very nice. Our stay was definitely more pleasant and relaxing. The breakfast was awesome!!! Thanks Ana for making it a wonderful evening.
Stayed for a conference and found the hotel clean and a good value and well set up for meetings

review_title: Comfortable, clean & quiet. Great for business.
review_text: Friendly staff, clean comfortable rooms. Bathrooms looking a little tired.the junior suites are very spacious though the couch looked like it was stained with something (i prefer not to think what). Parking is $12 a night and you can use your room key to get in and out of the garage which is attached to the hotel.
Great hotel for a business trip with a great vibe for the casual traveler as well. Good rooms and close to so much.

This hotel has a nice proximity to all sorts of restaurants which is a really good thing, since the restaurant onsite isn't much to talk about. It has some pedestrian fare, but with so many steakhouses and italian restaurants close by, it's better to get the hotel shuttle to give you a ride to where you want to go. The concierge was very helpful with recommendations. The rooms were nice, although I stayed in a suite on the 12th floor and it smelled like paint pretty strongly (couldn't really figure out why since nothing appeared to be painted fresh). The rooms were clean and big, beds comfy, with all the stuff you need. The staff throughout the hotel was very friendly, and will greet you almost everywhere you go. The bar was nice as well, although the only food choices are standard fried bar fare. The internet connection through the hotel seemed inconsistent through the 4 days i stayed there, was good signal in the bar, ok in my room, not so good in the conference center.

review_title: For the price it was ok.
review_text: I have stayed in a few Westin hotels in my time, and this one was a little less modern than the others I have stayed in. The lobby and restaurant were great and so was the service. No complaints there. The room was a little dated. Bathroom was older, but not bad. My room overlooked the roof with old tennis courts with ac units sitting on top of them. I would stay there again, but not at the price of a newer Westin.

review_title: Great value for a good hotel
review_text:
This is my 5th stay this year. Not a new property but priced accordingly and the staff have gone out of their way to be accommodating. 
In response to some of the critics:
1) The breakfast is priced the same as comparable Marriotts and the quality is good
2) The hotel is clean.....
3) On the comment it should be a Sheraton:What doctor do you use?

I was staying here for work. First, I want to say that the lobby is nicely done. That's where it ends. I checked in and was given a double room (I booked a king). Additionally the room smelled musty and old. I called to have my room changed and I was moved to a king room. This room was equally bad! It smelled like someone had been smoking in the room. The light in the bathroom didn't work and there was no refridgerator in the room. Both of these horrible rooms were dated and old. I called to have the light fixed and an air purifier added. They fixed the light and sprayed air freshener in the room ( this did not remove the smoke smell). Overall, I would never stay here again!

review_title: Very nice stay during a corporate meeting
review_text: Stayed here for 3 nights for a training session. Very nice beds but di understand the rooms are undergoing a refreshing this summer. Location us pretty convenient for travel with a large mall minutes away. Food quality was above average for our buffet offerings each day. Very nice and welcoming lobby area that really comes alive with guests in the evening. Wish the pool was heated, but still worked well for some laps.

review_title: I thought this hotel was nothing special!
review_text: This hotel sucked! I expected such a nicer hotel experience with the name "Hilton". My room was nothing special at all, just standard. The bathrooms were old school & they charge you to park your own dang car! What a rip!

Stayed here for one week. Not anything like every other Westin I have stayed at - except the bed. There were dead cockroaches on the floors of hallways for multiple days (not cleaned up). The breakfast buffet was outrageousely priced! Seriously!? $20 for yogurt, fruit, eggs that don't taste like eggs and bacon that is low quality. Customer service left a lot to be desired. I wouldn't choose to stay here again.
All the desk reps are great, especially Arturo and Jackie. They both helped me with special arrangements I needed.

review_title: Very clean great service and we are going to return
review_text: The staff was very nice and very helpfully at any time day and night we are going to come back very soon

review_title: Old and tired, much like the staff.
review_text: We selected this Crown Plaza based on our experience at another Crown Plaza in the Dallas area where we stayed on another vacation. A great illustration of how different two motels in the same chaincan be. This location is right in the center if Dallas which means lots of heavy traffic. Unless you need to be in the downtown area, this place is hardly worth the trouble.

This is our third aloft property to stay at and most interesting building. Rooms are very constant thought chain. Try to stay on lower floors. Hot water problems. We moved from 9 to 3 some what fixed problem of not having hot water in shower. Just takes along time for water to get hot. Staf chalked it up to being old building but, I have been in a lot of buildings it's not building being old. It's poor plumbing design. But at least water does get hot. Great stay friendly staff. And love little blue soap in bathrooms will be back to aloft again.

This hotel is in an easy access area which makes it easy to get around the city to all attractions. The lobby is upbeat and fun. The bar also attracts a good crowd. Rooms are clean but we found the bathroom area a bit cumbersome for 2 people. There is no room service and very little in the way of extras so if you need something you can buy it at the stand in the lobby. Overall I think if you want a single this is a good choice. If you are a couple keep looking.

review_title: Hotel is average for under $100. Horrible parking!!
review_text:
Pros: 
Friendly and helpful front staff. 
Good downtown location. 
Nice lobby / fountain with average restaurants. 
Beds are nice. 
We have stayed here a few times and each time was $100 or under. So it is priced pretty competitively. 
Cons:
The parking situation is horrible. First the nightly fee is $23 and you have to valet. We stayed for 3 days and our average wait time for our vehicle was 45-1hr in the rain and cold. Doing this with an infant compunded the situation. They even lost our keys one day. Completely disorganized parking system and when the hotel is busy the guest suffers. Make sure you check if there is an event at the hotel. If so, I would recommend not staying for this reason alone. 
Rooms are showing thier age. The bathroom had mildew on the ceiling and mold around the bath. Pretty unclean for the property type. Doors, walls, carpet and furniture were all pretty beat up. 
Overall, I like Hyatt and will continue to stay at their properties. However, I will probably not stay at this one due to the parking and that there are better kept properties for the same price in the area.

review_title: Really cool revamp of a warehouse type building, helpful staff, and great location.
review_text: The rooms are rustic brick walls and original warehouse windows. Beds are comfortable, neat accessories in the rooms, and a great and very helpful staff. The one way streets can be a little tricky, but all in all it was a great place to stay. Walking distance to where JFK was shot and other cool landmarks.
We stayed at this hotel for the all star game. Loved the hotel but not the location. Not ideal when going out in Dallas.
This is a very busy hotel and yet they give the impression that you are the top priority for the time you need assistance. They follow up to see that all is well and you received what you need.

Can you say BED BUGS. The hotel is beautiful. So are the rooms. but during my stay was bitten several by bed bugs. I did not have them before my trip. And now have seven bites on my chest back and legs. Have had to decontaminate my clothes and luggage. Travelers beware. Stayed there november 1-4 2011 rm 719

review_title: I was Extremely satisfied with our stay during the week we were there!
review_text: As a mom and teacher I was very satisfied with the cleanliness, assistance from the staff, amenities, and location in relation to the Dart, west end, and other downtown dallas sites. Great experience for my students, family, and myself.

There are good things to say about this hotel - great lobby, nice location, interesting rooms that go beyond the standard Aloft room that you'll find in other Aloft properties. The front desk service is actually very good and other hotels could learn from their helpful and friendly attitudes. 
But this place has one glaring problem that the front desk staff cannot fix. The wifi does not work. 
Now, let me state up front that if you do not care about wifi and you like a cool, quirky vibe in a hotel at a reasonable price....absolutely stay here!
But the demographic that they seem to be trying to attract is exactly the one that wants and even demands wifi. 
Tried 2 different rooms for reasons unrelated to the wifi issue and neither had consistent wifi that anyone could possibly use. It will work fast for about 30 seconds and then die for long periods. I tried it late in the afternoon, again after dinner and even at 4 am when I'm pretty sure the. volume of users would be low. But no luck. 
I'm not that technical but would think it wouldnt be that difficult to set up a wifi system that works on this building. 
Previous reviews warned of this but I did not listen. Other than this issue...it's a pretty nice place. But for me that is a must and therefore, unfortunately would not return.

I wish they had a "Comfort" rating option. This hotel has great style and some cool amenities but I slept TERRIBLY. It is noisy (not loud neighbors - just walls so thin I could hear every normal outside sound), the curtains never blocked the light even in the middle of the night, there is only one light switch so if you wake before your spouse you have to sit around in the dark, and the worst was the bedding. I had a choice between a tissue-thin sheet & 4"-thick down comforter (in a Dallas August). Would have been fine if it was 5-10 degrees warmer or 30 degrees cooler but instead it was just a whole night of waking up hot & cold. It's also a little ridiculous that there is NO included breakfast of any kind. Everything is a la carte & expensive.

Read what all the others have said about this place. I should have, but didn't - so I was terribly disappointed in my stay. It's a VERY busy hotel, long lines for everything! Front Desk staff are hit or miss in terms of knowledge of very basic inquiries. I'm a Diamond member and this hotel does not offer a Regency Club. The worst part was the rooms.... O U T D A T E D!!! You can tell some of the employees go out of their way to provide good customer service. I think the hotel thinks this makes up for the poor rooms - dirty furniture, mold in the showers/bathroom, stained carpets, stale odor smell. The first night I had a long dark hair in my bed. You can do far better at other hotels for the same price.

This Aloft Hotel is a renovated military uniform factory and each room is unique as are the beautiful art-inspired common areas. The customer service is terrific -the staff will assist with whatever you need. They go the extra mile n

review_title: Best wedding anniversary ever! What a treat!
review_text: The hotel was so amazing. A walks distance to the West Village and the Magnolia Theatre. We ordered room service and the lamb lollipops and mac'n'cheese were amazing!
We stayed 3 days had a wonderful time. The entire staff were very accommodating and friendly. Great location lots to see and do.

review_title: The ONLY place to stay in Dallas!
review_text: Once again ZaZa never disappoints. What a wonderful experience from the start of our stay until check out. Reservation Manager John Martin is the absolute best. Efficient, professional, accommodating - ZaZa is lucky to have him. At check in Shaun and Michael were welcoming and fun. Every ZaZa employee was attentive and friendly. The Last Czar Suite was amazing - totally luxurious. From linens to bath products this boutique hotel has only the best. Obviously the management plays a vital role with motivating employees and holding high standards in superior customer service. We live in Dallas but stay at ZaZa to celebrate special occasions - we don't even entertain other hotel options. Keep up the excellent work!
It is perfectly located, you will probably have to get your baggage to your room. We had a room with an AC filtration and the carpet was wet. Good breakfast with all common options.

We had an very good deal for about 400 dollars for 3 nights, with a high level room with great view on the downtown skyline of Dallas. This hotel is huge and modern with beautiful rooms, a large atrium and elevators on the outside. Location is excellent for exploring downtown. The sixth floor museum is very close and gives an very good overview of the assasination of JFK. Disadvantages are parking (best use valet for 20 dollar/day), expensive breakfast and the noise of the elevators at night. Get a room away from them! Overall a fine experience.

review_title: Stylish and attractive hotel. The noise from the pool bar was the only downside.
review_text: The room was spacious, clean and stylish. The hotel has a funky vibe that works. Our only major issue was the noise from the pool bar. The music was cranked till 1AM and was very loud in our even numbered room. If you are there for the bar scene then it is likely not an issue. If you want to sleep before 1 am, bring ear plugs or get an odd numbered room on the opposite side of the hotel from the bar.

We stayed here (7-month daughter and I) with my husband (who stays here 1/month) while he was here for business nearby. 
It was a very convenient location across from galleria and Starbucks a block away. We used their crib and luckily rooms are very large and can easily accommodate our family. 
The interior is an odd style, all rooms fave inward towards bar/lobby so we could at times hear lobby noise but really not bad. 
I found housekeeping to be a bit slow (left room at 1030a, back at 445p and not cleaned yet) but did a nice job each day. 
We enjoyed saltwater pool and hot tub one day.
hotel_name: Le Meridien Dallas by the Galleria

review_title: So THAT'S what's under the ball in Dallas.
review_text: Great location downtown, a short walk to the convention center. Spotless hotel with amazing service. Their restaurants, bar, and coffee shops were expensive and had limited hours. We enjoyed the atrium view toward the open middle of the hotel as well as the Dallas city view from our room. A light-rail station sits just across the street.

Great hotel. They did a great job even though it was very busy with a 
Anime convention. 
Rooms were very clean and housekeeping was fast and through.
We stay here everytime we go to Dallas! Always a great experience.

review_title: Perfect stay for a girl's trip!
review_text:
After looking for a nice hotel for a girl's weekend, I stumbled upon Le Meridien. For the price, I was very impressed. 
Our suite was very spacious and had plenty of room for all of us to be comfortable. The beds were extremely comfortable. 
The location of the hotel is great for shopping at The Galleria, but it is a little drive to downtown. However, it was in a nice area and we felt safe at all hours. 
The service was just okay. Nothing spectacular, but not terrible.
The atmosphere definitely caters to women (pink, black and white- feminine decor). It's modern and has a sexy vibe. We enjoyed the look of the hotel, the location and comfort. Overall, it was a nice weekend stay.
hotel_name: Le Meridien Dallas by the Galleria

review_title: I can't think of a detail that was overlooked the entire time. A great stay
review_text: what a great property. We got a great deal, and we also had a great stay. I just can't think of anything negative to say. I wouldn't say the place is modern, but I enjoyed the classic charm more than the newer hotels I've stayed in.

review_title: Nice but not Gaga over zaza
review_text: I Guess I don't get it. or maybe at 50 I am just getting old. the rooms were nice . the staff was nice. nothing overwhelming. just had a feeling I was paying about 50 percent too much. our theme suite wasn't as much eclectic as it was kookie. still I kind of liked it and maybe would go back if I had a good deal.
Great for a weekend away from reality, plush accommodations and rock style environment. Pool is small, but you are not really there for the water.

review_title: Always the best hotel stay experience.....perfect every time.
review_text: The Adolphus Hotel is by far the best overnight experience I have had in Dallas. The Hotel is elegant, and the staff is very nice, really polite, and extremely helpful. The rooms are always super clean and the beds and pillows are soft and comfortable. The Afternoon High Tea is to die for and the restaurants all offer excellent food...including 24 hr room service. The Adolphus offers World Class service and a high class hotel experience.
Could not have had a better experience! Very nice, clean, and excellent service! Will stay again!

Rooms are ok, clean and comfortable. Older, but obviously remodeled and nice. I love the coffee shop because you can get breakfast but you can also grab a quick dinner there and take it to the room. They have made to order pizzas and prepared sandwiches, cheese and fruit trays, desserts, salads and more. Perfect for grabbing, taking to the room and getting some work done in the evening. The valet can get a little backed up in the morning, so go early to get your car.

review_title: Nice location for a day shopping experience
review_text: We have stayed at this hotel several time. Although we enjoy our experience most every occasion, service is a little lacking due to inadequate staffing during high traffic periods at the bar in the evenings. Not only was the staffing short in the bar, it must have been a problem in housekeeping as well since our room was not touched all day while we were gone. As a result, a phone call to the front desk for refreshed towels and linens was made. Don't get me wrong, the hotel is quite nice and they always upgrade our room. However, it's the little things that keep you coming back.
hotel_name: Le Meridien Dallas by the Galleria

review_title: Great location, beautiful hotel, great price, will stay there again.
review_text: It lived up to everything that it advertised. Beautiful hotel in downtown Dallas. Only took us 20 minutes to get to Arlington for a Dallas Cowboys game. All sorts of restaurants and bars within walking distance. We will stay there again.

review_title: Don't stay unless you enjoy getting nickeled and dimed!
review_text: While the hotel is nice and the location is great, I would not recommend this place unless you enjoy having to pay extra for EVERYTHING! parking is outrageous- you either choose valet for $19 a day or walk 1/4 mile for $10 a day and no in/out privaleges. Plus, our last night, the parking lot was full, so we had no choice but to use valet- extreme rip-off. We were charged $40 for a roll away bed- no mention of charges when I asked for it or I would have asked for extra bedding and used that for my 2 year old son. Wireless Internet is not included. No continental breakfast included- instead you can choose from items like $3.50 for bacon slices or $8 for a bowl of oatmeal. We will never consider this place again the next time our travels take us to Dallas and would not recommend it to friends or family.

review_title: First class accomodations in on the edge of downtown Dallas
review_text:
The Crescent is a fantastic hotel. I have lived in Dallas all my life and stayed at a number of local hotels and resorts, and this one easily ranks in the top 3. The rooms are well-appointed and very comfortable. The common areas are gorgeous. The location of the hotel is perfect - still in the hustle and bustle of downtown but just out of the way of the traffic. The service here is what sets it apart from other places. The staff did everything they could to make sure my wife and I enjoyed our anniversary.
Negatives: Internet access is $9.95 and you'll have to shell out $24 for valet parking.
Don't miss: the pool! It's beautiful, and the number of guests is kept to a minimum. Luxurious.
Breakfast at The Conservatory was also very good. See if you can book a package that includes this. It's served til 11am, so you can sleep plenty late!

review_title: This is my most favorite hotel in the US
review_text:
This hotel provides a unique boutique experience with the speed, selection and style of a major facility.
The staff and location are the obvious highlights. The rooms are very comfortable and the bathroom products are second to none.
The spa and workout area is as good as you'll get anywhere.

The location is the heart of downtown. There is a train station accross street great for commuting but cityview rooms are noisy on the lower floors. Rooms are dated but clean. Service staff is wonderful.

L'ubicazione e' buona, anche se fa pensare a una zona poco sicura, ma vicina a tutto.
Un grosso problema sono le serrature a scheda magnetica, che non funzionano regoralmente.
Molti servizi presenti nell'albergo come la piscina e il bar, gli abbiamo trovati ad uso di privati. Per il resto ottimo, specialmente per il servizio del parcheggio (6 piani).

We stayed at Le Meridien for my husband's birthday weekend and loved it! The service was wonderful and Barbara, the bartender, was knowledgeable about both the area and Dallas in general. And she makes a mean espresso martini! Definitely recommend Le Meridien!
hotel_name: Le Meridien Dallas by the Galleria

review_text:
The major issues here have been housek
eeping. Two days in a row we have placed dirty towels and robes in the bath tub. First day they were left there second day they had picked them up and just dumped them on the bedroom floor. Our fridge was unplugged and phone didn't work, we had to ask twice to get these fixed. When we got to the room our mirror had two handprints on it and what looked like dried 'body fluid' on it , 2 days in its still there. Generally when u stay in a W you expect something special , this is like a high rise La Quinta

There is no where to other than the parking gaeage across the street, which is not owned by the hotel. The valet and parking garage are pretty much evenly priced. The hotel is next to the basketball arena, but seems not be close to anything else or walkable distance. The elevators are slow to arrive. The rooms are contemporary and had a view of outside dallas. The ghost bar is okay. There is no seating in the inside unless you pay for bottles. There is seating outside unless you want sit in the heat if there are seats available. The music is typical of a club. The crowd is mixed of ethnicities and starts at 21 to older. There is no fee for women but an outrageous fee for males. The hotel continues to be a club during the night. The pool stayed open after hours with no guard. The view in the pool was spectacular.

Staying approximately 140 nights per year in SPG hotels the W's are usually my favorites. 
Most probably just had bad luck at the W in Dallas. Did not get a room upgrade as I usually do, close to my room was a strange high-frequency tone and even dow I was able to shut off the AC the fan was still running and being noisy the whole time. Service at the Craft restaurant I'm sure would be able to be more friendly even on a Sunday morning. Travel long a lot to Dallas in the future I will give it another try, can only become better.

If your looking for an "old rich" hotel, this is for you. Nothing has been updated in years. Clean hotel, but way too dated for my taste. I had an issue with only having scalding hot water in the shower and called , but no one fixed it. Big room, but you couldnt see the tv from the bed, strange...
Have to imagine there is better in Dallas

Beautiful hotel in a quiet part of the city. The room was very big, clean and modern. Comfortable bed and great shower. No smoking hotel so great for non smokers, not so much for smokers (have to go outside to the front of the hotel).

I thought this place was really nice. They have a shuttle car that will drive u in a 2 mile radius which is helpful. Trolley is a short walk away and takes you to the West Village a little boutique area of shopping and food. Pool here was very nice with beautiful views and bliss products are very nice.

My wife and I were looking for a relaxing weekend in Dallas. If you want to shop this is a great location; however if you want to relax, not so much. The valet parking always seems understaffed here because it is mandatory. The room was as clean as to be expected, but the bed was harder then what we like. The restaurant/bar's waitress seemed less then happy to be there and the food is nothing to brag about. Our room service breakfast was on time, but cold. Who wants to eat cold eggs and English muffins? The indoor pool is tucked away at the bottom corner and gets to a max depth of about five feet.
hotel_name: Le Meridien Dallas by the Galleria

review_text:
I blew off the not so great reviews and decided to book here anyway. The location of the hotel is great, within a short walk to taxi ride to all the hot spots in Uptown / Downtown. The exterior of the building is beautiful and steeped in history, as this hotel is a historical property. We arrived at around 6:45pm, well after the 3pm check in time. Parking is $24 for valet, so skip that and park in the parking garage north of the hotel where it's only $6. 
Checking in at 7pm, guess what? Room is not ready. Told by Aaron he would call housekeeping to check on the room, and in 30 minutes he would call me and let me know the room is clean. Guess what? An hour later, no call. Walk to front desk, told still not ready. Unacceptable! 4 hours after check in and my room is not ready? Unacceptable. 
Realizing we were not happy, a lessor room located on floor 4 was given to us, as well as a $50 food/beverage allowance. This was cool on their part, and we used this quickly in the bar.
Overall the place is ok. It's quite dated inside, and there are many quirks to the place. I will likely think twice about booking here again.

review_title: My hotel stay was the best you could get out of a hotel in Dallas.
review_text: The hotel was designed beautifully and still felt like home. I would defiantly recommend anyone to stay there.

review_title: Hate to say it, but "too spacious"!
review_text:
Overall, this property is an above average Hilton experience. Food, nightlife and gym services are exceptional. If I were to critique anything in the negative area... It would be the mere size of the facility. It's set up like a couple of individual hotels that are connected by a grand walkway. Even the entrance and lobby area's are separate and individualized... Meaning you may enter into one lobby but your room may be in the other facility (which seems to be forever away). 
Advise that I would give to anyone setting up to stay this hotel:
1. Call ahead and find out what part of the hotel your room will be in and work it out on the phone the best place for you to enter the building at, and which lobby to use to check in. 
2. For Diamond members- the Excecutive lounge is on the 25th 
floor of the Towers side of the hotel. The desk (even though your a Diamond member and have access to the executive floors) may put you in the Atrium part of the hotel. This means a 15 min walk to the Executive lounge and the work out facility in the morning. My advise, ask to stay in the Tower side. The rooms are just as nice, if not better.

review_title: The worst service I have ever had!!
review_text: The manager could not give us a straight story on why the pool on the 16th floor was closed. She would say it should open soon, but never did. The the employees at the front desk were rude and not friendly. The rooms are way over priced and some of the outlets and lights did not work as well as the mini fridge was broken too.

Good parking, friendly staff, a little 80s interior, ok rooms, good beds, small but sufficient bathroom, rooftop pool and gym above average standard, nice dinner at Asador (the hotel restaurant) but remember you will have to pay extra for continental breakfast, and a little extra on top of that again if you want warm breakfast (no I'm not kidding).
All in all an ok stay but nothing more. Would be 3 star in Europe.

W hotel-exceptionally disappointing
Let me start off by saying this was my 1st experience at a W hotel & I was so excited & looking fwd to the experience!
The lobby etc was nice & the front desk staff were attentive at checking us in. When we reached our floor there was a cow hide sofa plonked outside the elevator that looked completely out of place...ie in shape & colour. Secondly there was certainly no wow when we entered the rm.the colour palette was plain-neither comforting, soothing or overly appealing from an interior design perspective.
The cleaning of the room left a little to be desired.on opening the refrigerator there was a dark sticky stain all throughout the bottom of it...which the cleaners obviously ignored. Likewise with the do not disturb sign-it had a big grimy coffee stain splatter all over one side. One morning I even left the sign on the bench (grimy side facing up) & the cleaners still chose to ignore it & put it back on the door still dirty! The towels were thin & 2 of them had rips on the side salvage! Certainly not acceptable for such an expensive, supposedly luxurious, quality establishment as what you come to expect of the W branding!
The room service charges were astronomical-some 20% feeÂ + 18% gratuity & then an additional $3 for delivery...give me a break! The Tavern a couple of doors down did the trick as did TGIF & hard rock cafe just a 5-10 min walk away. By the way there is also a gas station within 5 minutes away where u get snacks from too.
One positive was the free dropoff service somehow linked/sponsored by Acura. The most challenging part of the experience reserving the car was getting some help from one of the female W staff...ie a city map, directions, local information, DART details etc....overall the staff could have been a little more consistent accomodating the guest & just generally being helpful & friendly!
All in all a really disappointing experience.

I enjoyed the hotel and all it had to offer. However, the front desk staf that I dealt with was very curt, condescending, and less than friendly. I didn't receive the wake up call and housekeeping wasn't notified of the late check out I requested. In fact, everything we requested seemed to be a bother to the desk staff.

review_title: Overall good stay but widely varying price vs quality situation
review_text: Overall I do really like the Anatole. I've stayed there a number ofbtimes and for a hotel its size it's amazingly well run. I've only stayed in the tower, but overall the rooms are clean, large, and the showers have good water pressure. I appreciate the toiletry selection. Value at this hotel varies widely. I've gotten a room there for as low as $120 a night- breakfast included- to my last stay- $270 for the exact same room, and the exact same breakfast at the terrace restaurant. Annoying that there's such a discrepancy. Also annoying is the $17 per night self parking (!!!!!!!) charge. Extortion. Overall, though, the hotel is convenient, food good, the Asian art interesting, and comfortable surroundings.

review_title: Huge top notch hotel, but no verizon cell service in the room!
review_text:
Awesome, huge , luxury hotel. Great fitness center!
How about boosting that Verizon signal in the hotel? It would make it perfect!

review_title: This was the best hotel ever with a perfect staff
review_text: This was 1 of the most pleasant hotels srays that I've ever had in my 45 years experience in working and traveling.

review_title: Not what it used to be
review_text: My husband and I stayed here before about five years ago and had a much better experience. This time when we arrived they gave us a deluxe room instead of the suite we paid for. We called down to the front to have our room changed and they said they would send up a bellhop who never arrived. We finally moved ourselves because we had dinner reservations. Once we got to the new room we found two burned out lights. The ac could never get the room below about 72 and the sink and bathtub poured very hot water no matter whether you turned on hot or cold. We stayed here for two nights for our anniversary. Overall it was a very nice room for a good rate but the little things added up to a disappointing experience. Most of the staff was very helpful with the exception of the registrar who blamed us for the room issue because she said we said yes when she asked if we had a "king" room. Apparently a King room is a room type not a bed type at the Adolphus

review_title: I am very picky and I love this place!
review_text: In a nutshell, this is an all-around great place. Rooms are very modern; mine has double queens with triple sheeted quilts, really nice sheets along with 3 great pillows each. I have a coffee maker, iron and spotless ironing board, two laundry bags, good quality plastic sealed paper cups, flat screen Samsung Tv with HD (!) and tons of channels. Large work table with leather chair, lamps with outlets, really nice phone, very nice fridge and microwave, big bathroom with granite counter, lots of very clean smelling towels, and new modern furniture, art and a really nice carpet. AC works very well in this crazy heat, windows have both nice shears and light blocking drapes, and the beds are really, and I mean really good. Indoor pool and hot tub are modern and perfect temperatures, large clean and locking laundry, ice and vending machine rooms. Lobby and breakfast area (serving hot breakfast including eggs and sausage) is really well appointed and modern. Good location just down from a ton of great restaurants like Papasitos and 15 min from a great mall Northpark center, off racks and outlets. Staff are amazing - they get to know you by name and cannot do enough for you. Steve welcomed us and was very attentive, and Sunita Bhikha cannot make us happier. I highly recommend this hotel but please leave a room for my next visit!
hotel_name: Baymont Inn & Suites Dallas Love Field

review_text: Wife and I spent a weekend for our 30th wedding anniversary. To start with upon checking in the hotel manager had a very nice plate of chocolate dipped strawberries and cookies delivered to our room with "Happy 30th Anniversary" written in chocolate. This was a very nice surprise to both of us. The room we booked in this 1912 historic hotel was very cozy Jr. Suite with a awesome view that was priced at about $120. AMAZING! A suite for $120. That's unheard of. We asked to say on the haunted 21st floor. However, no ghosts that weekend. The hotel is located in downtown Dallas close to numerous restaurants and the Westend. I have spent many a night in Dallas for work and pleasure. When I was a kid and went to the OU-texas game I always wanted to stay at the Adolphus. It looked so glamerous and ritzy. The decor is breathtaking. When I stay downtown Dallas again I will definitely go back to the Adolphus.

The rooms are quite large, nicely appointed but the hotel is quite old and has old infrastructure, for example when I turn on the cold water in the sink hot water comes out. The room has a musky smell. Overall the place is fine, staff is professional and nice. Building is beautiful, it just seems like it must be a struggle to maintain high standards with such an old building- staff probably has to work extra hard.
 The area surronding the hotel is very very quite on the weekends.

We stayed at this hotel for 4 nights at the suggestion of a friend. It is conveniently located close to market and downtown Dallas. However, after paying $185 per night, I was shocked to pay $17 per day to SELF park. Although the food at both the Terrace and the Media bar and grill was good, it was horribly overpriced. We'd packed drinks and snacks for the kids, only to find we had to drag our cooler to the room to because the fridge was automated only (which also meant nowhere for leftover meals). All 3 pools were also under construction at the SAME time, which was awfully disappointing. Gym membership was 40 bucks for 3 days!!! They nickel and dime you to death. Also it was very hard to control temps in the rooms. Great for conventions or planning an event, but not for the vacation traveler. We aren't on a budget by any means, but I've gotten better accommodations for the money many times.

review_title: Unadulterated luxury, great staff and huge amazing rooms
review_text: Stayed here for 3 nights and right from the beginning I was treated like a VIP! The hotel is gorgeous and had such class. The staff were beyond helpful and bent over backwards to make my stay so memorable. My room was huge, as was the bathroom even though the bellman assured me it was one of the smaller rooms they have. It had a huge bed, a whole separate seating area with sofa and desk with chair and also an easy chair. The hotel provides a sedan service within 3 miles and was an incredible service with a fabulous car used it to go to Hoffbrau steakhouse in the west end which was a really good meal and the 6th floor museum, about jfk and assassination was done very well. Thanks to all the staff for such a great stay.

review_title: Pleasant surprise. Great hotel for the money.
review_text: We found this hotel on Trip Advisor. It was a great value. The hotel staff was especially friendly and recommended the adorably Texan Papas BBQ down the street. Great stay!
hotel_name: Baymont Inn & Suites Dallas Love Field

review_title: good hotel, insanely great food, but out of towners might want better location
review_text:
This is a beautiful hotel. We stayed in the tower. Concierge floor has WONDERFUL food, as does room service. You would not need to eat out...the food here is as good if not better. Yummy guacamole, steak sandwich, spring rolls, seafood alfredo pasta. 
Rooms are nice, flat screen, attentive maids.
If your room key stops working be prepared for a long walk (if late at night) or a very long wait for another one. The tower front desk not open late so you have to go to atrium. It's a HUGE hotel.
Decent location but not the best. During rush hour traffic is the pits to go even 15 minutes away.

review_title: Beautiful historic hotel in a great location!
review_text: Had a great weekend stay for LSU vs Oregon and shopping. Scored a $99 rate on hotels.com. Large room with full size sofa and sitting area. The building is beautiful. Fun bar area, and lots of places to sit, sip coffee, surf the net, etc. If you're an early riser and your spouse is not. Did not make res for French Room, and high tea was sadly on an Aug break. Plan to return to do both.

I came here for business, so I had no other option for a place to stay. The pricey rooms are due to its central location and service. Guest service is great , however I was disappointed that they charged even for wired Internet. The rooms themselves are dated and would benefit from remodeling. It's centrally located, so don't expect a quiet night, you will hear city sounds thru the night (cars and sirens), but it was a welcomed change for me. Many small restaurant within walking distance. Overall, good stay, and they tried very hard to make it so.

Where to begin... The property is amazing with tons of photo ops! While it sits on over 7 acres and is easy to get lost, friendly staff are literally around every corner to guide you in the right direction. The staff welcomed my family who are a bit on the sheltered side, and not used to luxury accommodations, while making myself and my domestic life partner accepted. The valet staff was amazing and knew us on first name basis. Tonya and another, whos name I cannot recall, gave us the attention that is expected at such an establishment. While the prices may seem overwhelming, you get what you pay for; attention to the smallest details and a wonderful carefree experience

First, it is a beautiful large hotel, not unlike the Las Vegas hotels. The restaurants looked fine and they have a good coffee bar for your morning espresso. Just be aware that overnight parking is $17 and 24they hours of internet is $13 to $15. Breakfast cost at least $15.
Nice historic hotel. Huge suites good value. Would be better hotel with better concierge service.

review_title: A trip back to the seventies, with bad service and a worse smell to complete the package!
review_text: I stayed in this hotel for business with coworker and one of the reasons we chose the hotel was because they would allow us to split the bill on two credit; however upon arrival we learned they had charged one for everything in advance and would not fix their error. The very long trek to our room was filled with a stale smell and horrible decor. The room itself seemed to be partially updated, but the shower curtain an carpet fit in with the seventies design in the hallway. The beds were tiny and horribly uncomfortable, and we had to call to ask for a maid to clean the room. Next time I'll save myself the money and stay at a motel 6...a much better choice than this hotel.

My family stayed here for my birthday weekend! We are from Oklahoma and came to Dallas to go to Medieval Times. I found the hotel online and booked it because they had an indoor pool, with kids this is very important! Having never stayed at a Baymont Inn and Suites before, I wasn't sure what to expect. Therefore I was pleasantly surprised with the quality of our stay. The staff was very friendly, breakfast was satisfying, the pool and hot tub were a great bonus, and the rooms were clean! We have 3 kids including an infant and we all had a blast in the indoor pool! Couldn't brag enough on the staff who made us feel like we were right at home! Great place to stay, can't wait to go back! :)
hotel_name: Baymont Inn & Suites Dallas Love Field

review_text:
Overall, we had a very pleasant stay at the Anatole for our best friends wedding festivities. It was just the four of us and we had a nice time. 
Whatever you do DO NOT I repeat DO NOT give your bags to the bell boys. They took our bags and did not allow us to take them to our rooms ourselves as that was against policy, we did not get them back for over an hour which would not have been a big deal if they were busy or short staffed. Neither of these were the case and after calling down from our rooms two times and letting them know they were going to make us late to our dinner reservations we finally received our bags with 10 minutes to get ready. Upon check out we over heard other guests getting mad and not even handing over their luggage because urgency and good guest service is definitely not their motto. 
The rooms were beautiful, however we would have enjoyed staying in the terrace side versus the towers because there was more to offer. Dinner at Nana's was delicious, but I do wish they would have let our friends cut their wedding cake (which we brought from outside) and listen to us when we told them 10 times this was wedding rather than assume that this was a first year anniversary dinner. The music at Nana's was nice, it did not create a ambiance of romance like advertised however and the music in Media Bar did not exist. This is a great hotel to sleep while your in town, but you definitely won't want to spend all your time on the premises. One night was more than enough for us.

My girlfriend and I were looking for a night away from the kids and didnt want to go too far. we stumbled on the Warwick Melrose on a list of top historic dallas hotels. I am extremely happy we chose this hotel. Everyone that worked there was extremely friendly and it was great. Having to pay for valet parking was a little off putting at first, but after making a trip or two downstairs it was worth every penny, never had to wait and the parkers were always in a dead sprint. We skipped eating at th hotel but wish we would have. the Libary bar was fantastic, it had everyone from people in tuxes to people in hawiian shirts, and they were all treated equally! the live entertainment was phenomenal and she was not only singing but also working the audience and posing for pictures. If your looking for a romantic night away this is it!!!

review_title: Awesome Hotel, Great Food and Very Professional Staff!!
review_text:
I recently stayed at the hotel as a traveler and NOT attending a convention. This was one of the best hotels my wife and I have ever stayed before! 
It started the minute we walked in and were greeted by the friendly front desk staff to the very last server at our dinner at Media. The food was outstanding and the atmosphere was fun and upscale. 
The next morning we had a great breakfast (in room) overlooking downtown Dallas, swam in a beautiful pool and worked out in a huge fitness gym. The grounds around pool and workout area were immaculate and well groomed. 
I would definitely go back to this hotel and stay every time I go to downtown Dallas. Everything was perfect!

Excellent service, from Jonathan in valet to Enrique delivering my luggage. Everyone was very professional. Comfortable nights rest and breakfast at the Terraces Restaurant was delicious. I would definitely come back and recommend this hotel to my friends & family.
Loved the room. Front desk staff late night left a bit to be desired but overall a great experience.

review_title: Thoughtfully appointed boutique hotel in a central location.
review_text: The Melrose is a beautiful property surrounded by interesting shops and restaurants. The spacious room was spotless and clean. It had the modern conveniences needed without being overly frilly. Very comfortable bed with an excellent HVAC system that managed the August heat wonderfully. My favorite hotel in Dallas and I am here monthly.

review_title: Overpriced and lack of interest from the staff to address problems
review_text:
Would not return to this hotel .
Old shower design required you to get in the shower to turn it on and no hot water available for 10 minutes. Staff said that we would just have to wait for the water to heat up . No apologies were given. Just that "it was an older building" . We have never had to wait for hot water.
Went to Happy Hour and the house wine was $17.00 dollars A GLASS!!
A dog across the hall started barking at 7:00 am when the owners went to breakfast. Finally enough people complained to the 
front desk that they took the dog downstairs.
We will not be returning to this over rated Dallas landmark...
.

review_title: Melrose Hotel is a pristine, first class, unique hotel with old school grandeur and timeless charm.
review_text:
Hi, 
My name is Lori Henegar and my husband and I always consider it a huge pleasure to be able to stay at the Melrose. We love the cozy, setting the hotel rests in when we drive up to the valet to stay. Service is first class from check-in to incredible gourmet room service selections!!! My husband loves to have a martini in the chic' Library Bar and for myself a glass of French rose' from an impressive wine list! The rooms are richly decorated and spacious. We love the size and cozy retreat of the Melrose and would not stay anywhere else in Dallas for the accommodations and the price.

Words can't express how wonderful the complete experience was. The value was our greatest reward, which is saying a lot because the staff were amazing. I felt as if the way we were treated there was as all people should treat one another. Heavenly. Respectful, courteous, caring, attentive, and qualified. 
The staff was prepared and delivered exceptional service. It was my wedding weekend, and I saved precious time as they assisted in letter printing and delivery to some of our most special guests, picking up selections at Nieman's for me at the last minute, and the Chef made the most delicious caviar and oyster treat for my wedding party. 
I can't wait to try their Rosewood Crescent Hotel next. We will treat ourselves to their spa experiences and soak in the service they provide so well at The Rosewood property. 
All I can really say is "Heavenly to all the senses."

review_title: Top hotel in the south mabey the country
review_text: I stay in 5 star hotel at least 10. Nights a month and this is my favorite! The terrace suite is amazing. Pricy at $2000 a night but amazing!

Service was perfect. The hotel manager sent up a bottle of champagne and chocolate covered cherries on the house at the mere mention of my reason for staying....3rd wedding anniversary. This is a very nice boutique hotel. The King Corner Suite is the way to go.

review_title: Cool old hotel, wish someone would dump some money into this place
review_text:
It was certainly not a splurge, as the rate for my room was very inexpensive.
The hotel, was old and neat looking downstairs. I'd always wanted to stay here.
The room was old, but not in a neat way, it needed to be updated and smelled a little moldy.
I really do wish this place could get a rehab, it's got great potential.

Overall not bad except the showerhead was leaking out of the side spraying all my cloths etc. Went to tighten it and it swung around hit my head and got the entire room soaking wet. Maintanence came and fixed it though. 
A little overpriced but the French room made it worth the stay. Would not recommend for the price go to the ritz or the w. French is it's only saving grace.

As a Platinum member, I have stayed in many locations, but this Marriott by far has the best staff and customer service. Greeting you at the front door is Big John - with a big smile on, a friendly handshake and warm welcome back to Stephen with my keys ready to go instead of waiting in line at the desk all the way to my favorite spot - the lounge where Kristen and Erin make you feel right at home and welcome. 
The room service menu could have a wider selection for those that visit quite often. 
Just minutes outside downtown and with the customer service experience, the hotel makes for a very good option

This is my favorite hotel for Dallas market. The rooms are large and comfortable with a sink area in the bathroom and just outside it - perfect for two ladies getting ready. It is close enough to market to walk, or there is a regular market shuttle that runs to the hotel. Good room service and free parking. I usually stay at the Anatole, the Adolphus, the Stoneleigh, or the Hyatt during market and the Reniassance is the only one of that group that you can self park and not have to fuss with valet, which is always nice but can really slow me down and cost $30 - $35 a night at other locations between hotel charges and tips.

Hotel is huge. At nearly $20 per day, parking is rather expensive considering the hotel is not downtown. The location is central to much of Dallas, but not near any attractions in particular so a rental car is a must.
There are two or three connected buildings that make up the hotel, and the rooms are different. When checking in, go to the Tower side so that you get a Tower room. They are much more modern than the Atrium side. If you check in at the Atrium side, you are likely to get an Atrium room, which is a basic Hilton room, showing a bit of age. It seems strange that there would be such a difference in the hotel rooms, but the hotel has something like 1700 rooms, so two check-in desks is a good idea (you just have to be sure to go to the one in the Tower side!). 
Overall this is a generally good Hilton property. It is apparently a convention hotel with most travelers on business during the week. We got an unpublished fare for this hotel, so the value was good overall. However, the parking was expensive since the hotel isn't centrally located. The other hotels (like the one next door) have free parking, so paying nearly $20 per night for self-parking seemed absurd. Nothing is within walking distance, so a rental car is a must.

Great I loved it very clean and friendly staff. Very easy to find and to get a room late at night. Quite place to rest eventhough it's right on a main street, you won't even notice the traffic passing by.
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - Downtown Phoenix

review_text: As a tourist I would rather stay in Scottsdale. We had a nice big king room in the best value motel. No breakfast, only coffee and fruit. Nice help at the front desk
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - Downtown Phoenix

review_title: Great value the title speaks for itself
review_text: I loved it would stay here again. very comfortable beds.
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - Downtown Phoenix

review_title: Great atmosphere and the owners take a since of pride in there Inn and love to go out of there way to make you happy.
review_text: This Inn is everthing and more. The rooms have been newly remodeled. Each room as a 42in LG flat screen! We gave the cleaning ladies some cash and they organized are stuff that was laying around and washed are dishes, what more can you ask for! I work for the Union and they usally put us in a place that is nice and clean for a good price and it seems that's the case here. GREAT PLACE!
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - Downtown Phoenix

review_text:
The good:
Excellent staff--very helpful and friendly.
Beautiful building--fun just to explore the hotel and enjoy the interior design and antique furnishings that are everywhere.
Location--in the heart of downtown and within walking distance to many hot spots, museums, Kennedy memorial, etc.
The bad:
The rooms are quite uncomfortable--hard to control the temperature. The door to our room let in so much light from the hallway that we couldn't sleep. We shoved towels around the bottom and were still bothered by it. (We're not picky--this is a first for us.)
The restaurant--excellent food; terribly slow and terrible service. We ordered a continental breakfast with a bagel with cream cheese and a cup of fruit and it took 20 minutes! 
The parking: $24 / day with mandatory valet is a bit rediculous
The amennities: no pool
Other: not kid friendly at all. If you have kids with you, go somewhere else.

I stay at America's best value inn Phoenix I enjoy my stay , I feel like home cuz Sam and Jessica give us outstanding customer service at front desk.Moreover , the room is very clean, neat and bed are very comfortable. If I will visit Phoenix again I will stay at this motel.
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - Downtown Phoenix

review_text: Guest service is fantastic. Rooms are roomy and always clean!
This hotel has such history and is so beautiful. The accommodations were great. Rooms are nice and big. The French Room is excellent.

What used to be such a beautiful hotel is being squandered by miserable staffing and no air conditioning in the rooms! Find somewhere else to stay and don't fall for the hype. Walk thru the lobby on your way to somewhere else to stay!

review_title: Excellent hotel that is improving every day
review_text: I am a platinum Marriott member and have been staying at this hotel for about 2 yrs. It went through a major renovation that has been rocky with a new restaurant. Service has been getting better but has a way to go. The Club level lounge is nice and Hostess Erin is a bright spot.
I had a wonderful stay with my mother here. The staff was wonderful, the food waS great, the room was lovely...

review_title: Vintage hotel, but service sadly lacking
review_text:
While my wife and I were looking forward to celebrating our 10th anniversary at the Adolphus, we were shocked the second night of our two night stay. The room assigned upon checkin was neat, clean, tastefully decorated, spacious, and comfortable. Staff was welcoming and friendly. We had a wonderful first night. The second night, however, was completely different. 
When we returned to the hotel at 3:30 pm after a day of shopping in Dallas, it appeared housekeeping had started to service our room, but had left. The bed was completely stripped and apparently nothing had been done. I thought they just hadn't finished, and it was still relatively early. We left to attend a baseball game without a concern given the attention we recieved earlier.
Returning from the game around 11:45 pm, we were shocked the room was as we found it earlier. Bed was stripped, linens and bedding wadded up on the sofa, nothing else touched. Not what I expected from a hotel of this caliber. 
I called the front desk and was told our only option was to move to another room. At midnight. The front desk manager said housekeeping was gone but she offered to move us to a suite which we agreed to. Well, the bed in the suite was also stripped and bare! We were then moved again to a room that was clearly intended for another couple. There were items commemorating a special occasion for this couple. I was told by the manager they were in another room.
It seems to me, based on the number of guests complaining at the time I was trying to get our issue resolved that somebody on the previous shift abandoned the night shift woefully undermanned. The desk supervisor the next morning assured me I would hear from the front office manager personally. That has yet to happen. 
The property is indeed lovely and a reminder of the glory days of vintage hotels, however, if management isn't aware of the service that's being provided on their property, this hotel's days will be numbered.
They treated us like royalty without paying royalty prices. It was an awesome experience!!

For the money, this is a great deal. The furnishings and design are modern and sleek, and the room looks very tidy. The TV is a nice LG flatscreen, and the air conditioning works great, albeit a bit noisy. The floor looks clean, but walking around on it barefoot makes your feet dirty- bring flip flops so you don't end up tracking the dirt onto the clean white bedsheets. Good walking distance to ASU downtown and Arizona center. Front desk guy really nice although he seems like he is annoyed.
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - Downtown Phoenix

review_text: Right off the bat the staff was pleasant and warm. The rooms were beyond expectations and met my high standards. Tod the pool bartender, Nikki, Nicole, Maverick the servers and I cant forget to mention Andrew the driver were very kind, helpful and professional. Next time I visit Dallas I know the Joule will be my Hotel.

I often stay at great hotels, but the staff at the Joule Hotel made our stay awesome beyond belief!!! Nicole, Nikki,maverick, Todd, and Andrew made our stay memorable! I'm so grateful for they're amazing service!!! When in Dallas stay Here!!!

Walked into hotel and right away Ms victoria greeted us and walked us to the front desk and helped us check in very nice and i Loved the pool staff Nicole Nikki Todd Maverick they are so fun and great five star service from them

I came to visit from california stayed at the Joule and i must say that i really enjoyed the stay. The pool staff Maverick, Todd, Nikki, and Nicole were amazing they treated us so well and interacted with us so well and made sure we were well taken care of. Also, Ms. Victoria whom i believe is a security guard is very nice as well always would check on us make sure we were satisfied i could not have asked for a better experience thanks to the amazing staff that i listed.
It started off with Virginia the security, to Tod, Nikki, Maverick, and Nicole in the pool bar. I'm still recovering from the party last night but it was DEFINITELY worth it. :D
Loved every moment of my stay! Best pool party and private party for pride weekend! Nicole, Nikki and Todd were the best!!! Made our trip awesome, fun and fabulous!!!

review_title: The staff at the pool makes this hotel worth staying!
review_text: The hotel is nice but what made it fir me was the pool staff. Nicky, Todd, maverick, and nicole are the best. They are attentive and even changed the music to our taste

Great hotel interiors, dark moody decor in rooms. We stayed in a Junior Suite and it was well equipped. The actual floor space is less than other hotels, but still sufficient. Having said at, the bathroom was big, and really nice. Dark and moody still.
The concierge was very helpful with organizing assistance and cars etc, by email before we arrived. The actual service at the front desk seemed a bit patchy, depending on who was there.
The staff for the cars, porters and in the pool bar were all friendly and helpful. The guys dropped us at some shops, and also organized the rides too and from the hotel (with an external provider you pay direct).
Overall, the hotel is good value for money, in the higher end range.

We loved our stay at Hotel Palomar. The staff is wonderful, kind and always willing to help in whatever you need. The free wine hour every day is a wonderful little bonus. The property is gorgeous and rooms were spacious and very nicely decorated! The location is perfect near everything you could possibly need and very close to highway access for anything else. The hotel is in a very nice part of dallas and is near many high class shops and dinig. I highly recommend this place and will definitely return when I'm back in the Dallas area
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Hung out at the pool and Maverick was a great not just bartender or server, but a great personality. Looking forward to a return swim.
Loved our wknd at the Palomar! Great location, incredible service, nice room! We got a special rate on the website and it was a great deal. I will be back again, no question!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Very good hotel but be aware the rooms are very small.
Just spent the afternoon at the pool and Nicole my pool side bartender was amazing. She made sure my entire goup was taken care of and we never had to ask for anything.
The pool and room were amazing and Nicole was an awesome server! We will definitely be back!

review_title: Steven and Todd at the pool deck bar make the hotel worth it
review_text: Rooms are smallish, don't stay in a round bed, but the pool deck and in particular Todd and Steven makes this our goto DFW hotel.
Excellent. Such a fun and upbeat hotel . Loved the coffee/hot chocolate bar and of course the wine reception.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Love the Joule, Love the Poule!
review_text: Had the most amazing time celebrating my best friends 30th Birthday! We experienced first class service at the Poule from Todd, wouldnt have been the same without him. He treated us like VIP all weekend. Defintely coming back!!!
This was our first stay at a Kimpton hotel. We loved every aspect of our stay. We will definitely be booking with Kimpton again, not only in Dallas, but in other locations as well.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: The Joule Dallas changed my life!
review_text: I came to The Joule with a friend for my 21st birthday and had an incredible stay. Besides the carpet being a damp when we arrived it was perfect! Service was wonderful and the grilled cheese is to die for in room service. You must lay by the gorgeous pool as well. Most definitely the best hotel in Dallas!
Great place to stay. The hotel is new, spacious, and clean. The staff was courteous and very helpful.

We were upgraded to a junior suite from the double room that we booked. The hotel is gorgeous, from the lobby through the hallways to the guest rooms. The concierge and valet staff were fantastic-they gave great recommendations to restaurants and helped us book the hotel car for several excursions. We ate excellent food in the Bistro, where the service was prompt and cheerfully friendly. Overall, an extraordinary experience that I highly recommend and would love to repeat. (The Travelzoo fare deal made it all possible!)

review_title: We crossed the us and this is , hands down, the best choice!
review_text: Since the second we walked in we were in such good hands. I've never seen people so polite and kind and making such a big effort to make us feel home. Excellent motel.

review_title: Be warned! The hotel pool is open to the public on the weekends!
review_text:
We were staying only one night and were most looking forward to lounging leisurely next to the beautiful pool on Sunday afternoon. When the elevator opened on the floor of the pool, we could already hear and feel the bass from the LOUD music and crowd. The pool was completely packed with drunk, tattooed twenty-somethings like spring break in Daytona. None of these partiers were paying hotel guests, but they were definitely treated better than any of the guests we saw there. We immediately left.
Later that night we returned to the hotel patio and wanted a simple meal. Since the squid and quail eggs on their menu did not sound good, one of our group walked across the street to order some Food and bring it over. We were barked at by the manager twice for bringing in outside food eve though we were buying their pricey drinks and paying for rooms there. They finally were ok with the outside food once they realized we were NOT moving it and were still quite unhappy about the pool situation. 
On a side note, the executive chef of the restaurant did come out to see us and was the only pleasant person we spoke to. While we will still never return to this hotel, the chef did make that evening a bit better.

review_title: The best hotel in Dallas. But the bar tenders at the roof pool are basically the bomb. Todd and Steven!!!
review_text:
So I travel seven days a week around some of the best and worst destinations. When you get a good stay in my business you rejoice. When you get a great stay you wish you lived there! This place takes care of you in a boutique VIP way that puts the Ritz to shame. If you want to experience the ultimate, go to the pool and let Todd, Steven, Maverick or the manager Vincent take care of you. If you want to party, mark downstairs at PM takes VIP to next degree. 
Hope you like it!!

review_title: Would stay somewhere else next time
review_text:
Location is good. Room was nice, minus the bathroom door which is hard too close and allows no privacy. Water pressure was bad as well. Also, make sure you don't get a room next to the highway, it's loud! Internet is $10 per day, seems steep to me.
The worst part of the trip is that we had a gold fish put in our room. The fish had no air ventilation and was in a tiny square vase. He was vibrant the first day and then on day two ye would barely move. It was completely inhumane. We called the front desk to come get the fish because it looked in bad shape. No one came. We stopped by the front desk and asked again, still no one came. Finally after contacting them for the third time they came and got the fish.
 I wouldn't stay at a Kimpton again.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Wonderful experience I had at the Sheraton Dallas
review_text: Le Vaughn Parker was very friendly and helpful, made my experience very pleasant, thanks!!

review_title: awesome hotel le vaugh Parker gave us the best service
review_text: Thanks Le Vaughn Parker for making our experience wonderful

The first several time we stayed here beginning 5 years ago it was wonderful!! Each time since then its becoming less about quality service & more about keeping up with the the Highland Park trendsetters. Everyone has their pets with them & you have to watch your step for "accidents". I witnessed 2 separate doggie disagreements. No one on staff ever apologized or offered assistance. The staff was void of personality & costumer service. We visit this area several times a year but unfortunately we wont stay here.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Every person on staff was very professional and clearly dedicated to ensuring our stay was enjoyable. I strongly recommend it.

review_title: Nice, but I miss a few things...
review_text:
I can't wake up without coffee, however there is no in room coffee; had to go to lobby for coffee or order room service for an instant fix. Second, no clock! I wake up all hours and I would to know the time without looking for my watch. 
In addition, I have a small child who is used to travel and nice hotels, but I would not come here with family. This is a very nice business hotel or a nice couple getaway.

review_title: A property that made me feel special! Genuine service!
review_text: I decided to stay ay the Joule for my birthday! Best decision I've made in a long time, considering I celebrate the whole month. Valet greeted me and asked what my name was, he then passed me on to the bellman he then explained the hotel. When I went to the front desk they all wished me a happy birthday and thanked me for staying there. Everyone from Todd at the pool to Enam and the staff at Charlie Palmer. This was truly an amazing birthday! Something like a palooza of fun! I can't wait to stay here in the near future.

Very comfortable stay . Loved the wine hour in the lobby. Super friendly staff. Kristin at the front desk was great! The valet staff was courteous and fast. Make sure to set your alarm - the beds are incredible! Will be back.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Great location, cool rooms, great hospitality!
review_text: Everything was great! Rooms current, clean and cool. Great weekend Staycation for a local couple.

Superb 4 Star Hotel. Stayed for a week on a business trip. Check in was quick which was great after such a long flight. 
Concierge and the guys at the door were first class , they provided the hotel courtesy car on several occasions. Pool area was quiet maybe due to the 40+ temperatures.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: I stayed here for a huge event last weekend. The rooms were so clean and the bathrooms were remarkable. I was amazed by the television in the mirror. This new hotel is a great addition to the surrounding area. I tried to book a room for new years eve, but they are already full!! I can't wait to return!

review_title: Very nice hotel if you need to stay in downtown Dallas.
review_text: Wonderful hotel. Very beautiful. The suites are awesome and the employees are super friendly and helpful.

review_title: Omni Dallas New But needs help!
review_text: We stayed two nights at the new Omni Dallas thinking it would be a great place to experience. We stayed at other Omni Hotels and this one did not compare to others. Service if you can get it ,staff need a lot more training and they need twice the staff and I hope your bath room gets cleaned. I will say the rooms are nice and maybe they will get it together soon. They did apologize and offer an up grade the next time we consider staying in Dallas Omni.

For this to be a hotel only opened for two weeks, we were not impressed. For starters, we checked in at 3:00pm and had to wait over an hour before the room we reserved weeks in advance was ready. The front desk personnel was nice and attempted to accommodate us which was great. 
We decided to stay a second day and OMG were we disappointed. We went out for breakfast and came back and there were several Valets around but we did not get assistance. My husband had to circle back around before anyone came to over to our car. 
Later that night, I ordered a hot dog from room service. It was cold and the bun was toasted so hard that it had broken into two pieces. Also, that night the people across the hall were having a party. The walls are so thin and we could hear music and every conversation. Security came and we could hear their conversation with the loud party. Even after security left, the music was gone but we could still hear talking. We noticed that we could hear people walking by the night before but didn't think anything of it. Needless to say, we ended up leaving. The hotel again, did attempt to accommodate us but it was too late. We were done!
The rooms were clean, the pool very nice and relaxing. Everything was hassle free, and made for a great stay

review_title: Affordable yet upscale business hotel with excellent servive.
review_text: Well located in center of town. Palacial interior. Very well run. Staff helpful. Food and menu were good. Will return

Pros
Good location 
Walking distance to restaurants
Clean room
Great desk for office work
Nice breakfast
Friendly staff
Good fitness room
Cons
Could hear people next door
When I left hotel did not have anymore to go breakfast bags
That being said, I have stayed here many times. Solid and good.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Jacksonville JTB / Deerwood Park

review_title: Business 3 day; clean, convenient, great value.
review_text: I was in Jax for a training. Selected this Hampton for location and Hilton rewards. Very clean, comfortable rooms. Friendly, accommodating staff. Decent hot breakfast. WiFi throughout hotel. Stonewood Grill directly adjacent with a Publix and Target within walking distance. Only issue, some intermittent A/C glitches; however, I keep the room COLD.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Beach Boulevard/Mayo Clinic Area

review_text: Really like coming here for a couple of nights. Big but, not loud-busy. Roy's Restaurant is really good. Resort also has a good steakhouse in Meritage
hotel_name: JW Marriott Desert Ridge Resort & Spa Phoenix

review_text: My partner and I stayed here for 2 weeks whilst visiting friends who lived nearby. This was one of the closest hotels and was a very good experience overall. The hotel had free wifi that we used a lot - we had problems getting it to work initially but the lady at reception helped and it worked fine for the duration of our stay. The buffet breakfast was nice: cereal, fresh fruit, Quaker oats, waffle maker, hot drink machine, yoghurt, muffins, doughnuts, bagels, spreads, juice and a selection of hot breakfast items. I found there was plenty to eat. The bedrooms were spacious and comfy.

What was once a real nice Fairfield is now an OK one.
Rooms are showing their age.
AC very noisy. Carpet worn. Shower head doesn't spray correctly. Poor wi-fi connection. Bed sagging. 
Simple things that add up, especially when Marriott is revamping so many Fairfields. I'll stay at FI West until this one is fixed. However, the staff here is great. As for the breakfast, powdered eggs, mini dry biscuits, and funky looking "sausages". But the staff is nice.

Christmas day stay...usually the worst service day of the year. Staff was pleasant and helpful. Forgot my toothbrush and the clerk saw me loooking at the full-priced toothbrushes and offered me a free one.
Hotel advertises a Continental breakfast but they had eggs, sausage,cheese, hot oatmeal, Belgian Waffles,fruit,and lots more including very welcome little touches like Tabasco sauce, and Craisins, walnuts, and DARK brown sugar for the oatmeal.
But the best feature...the cleanliness! Everything appeared spotless. We'll be back next time thru Jax.

This wa an overnight stay on our way from Georgia to Orlando. After reading several reviews we decided to stay here. The decor is impressive and the hotel very clean. The hotel is on my list as a great stop over the next time we make this trip!

I always thought of Fairfield as being a little more elite. This one was ok. There was some mildew in the corners above the shower. Bed ruffle was dirty. Found popcorn by the nightstand. Pictures and mirror tops had not been dusted anytime recently. Handle on nightstand was falling off. Lamp shades were falling apart and torn. 
Just a lot of stuff that was from lazy cleaning and poor maintenance. Seems like the manger either doesn't ever check the rooms or takes no pride in their inn. 
There are other hotels that are a better value and nicer in the immediate area.
Convenient to airport. Definitely where I stay when traveling to Jacksonville. Great value. Great rooms.

Our family found this hotel on TripAdvisor and the reviews steered us well! We needed a room for one night on the way home from Disney and the Staybridge worked great. We comfortably slept four adults and two kids in a two queen suite with sofa bed, and the rate was just $80 for the night. Rooms were well appointed and the decor pleasant. The breakfast offerings were standard but well executed, including several hot and cold options. The only complaint we had was the towels were very thin and rough. Otherwise we would recommend highly.

We took extra steps to ensure our reservations would be just right for the family over Thanksgiving.
