From the beginning things started to go wrong; our tee time was mysteriously cancelled, on arrival the room was not what we had been assured we would receive, they were not able to grant a late checkout later than noon. When I explained the late checkout was in order to keep a spa apt which concluded at noon, they still would not extend checkout to 1:00 pm. So, I cancelled at the spa. After realizing the room was incorrect, they moved us to a hospitality suite, which had all the charm of a conference room. The bathrooms needed updating and the towels looked like they were 10 years old. House keeping arrived at 8:00 am the first morning (Thanksgiving) and breakfast was our next big disaster. I phoned to inquire about breakfast, and while they could inform me that the lounge was the only place open, no one could confirm if it was buffet only. When we arrived and found that it was, we were erroneously sent to the spa for a full menu breakfast. Back to the room, ordered room service breakfast an hour later, late and starving...our soft poached eggs arrived hard boiled and the hot chocolate came in a packet with hot water. I can't list all the misinformation, the incorrect room service orders, the disappointment with the restaurants, but I can say that all we could do is laugh after a while. What went right: Amanda realized how bad things were and tried to make things right. The golf course was beautiful and that cart gal made a great bloody Mary. I can honestly say that with all the other terrific resorts in Scottsdale that we will not be back.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Desert Ridge Resort & Spa Phoenix

review_text: My husband and i unexpectedly were stuck in jacksonville for two nigts and this place was a lifesaver......very low rate and fazli (night manager) was the best. Room was a lot nicer than expected. Very clean and a step up from "motel motife" .......wood floors in the bathroom even :-) no its not the w hotel but for the cost of a olive garden dinner......its well worth it. I was surely surprised at how nice it was for so cheap........and was even more impressed with how helpful and friendly fazli was......
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn Jacksonville - Orange Park

review_text: The resort is really nice and it is great for a convention. Lots of room, great bar, and several different restaurants. Great golf course. Plus the service was amazing. I had a cough and the front desk gave me a hand full of cough drops when I asked if the gift shop had cough syrup. Great star and great location.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Desert Ridge Resort & Spa Phoenix

review_text: It's what you expect when you book a hotel. Very clean, rooms comfortable, and breakfast was good. We will go back and this is from a guy who is very picky in deciding where to stay. This is a safe and great place to stay. Choose this hotel.

review_title: Absolutely excellent service! A wonderful stay!
review_text: I had an absolutely wonderful stay at the Red Roof Inn! From the very beginning of my stay, to check out, I had a fantastic experience. The reception desk workers were very kind and greeted me immediately with a smile and a warm hello. I checked in with ease and with no problems. The workers even helped me find some great restaurants in the area. The rooms were absolutely spotless! The beds were made, and the room looked and smelled very clean and fresh. The housekeeping staff had absolutely no problem delivering extra sheets and pillows to me and did it with wonderful speed. Overall, I had an excellent experience and would come here again. I definitely recommend this hotel!
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn Jacksonville - Orange Park

review_text: First time ever staying at a Microtel, was very impressed with the condition of the hotel. But when I pulled the sheets back there was hair all over the bed and pillowcases were stained couldnt really tell if they were cleaned or not. With that aside the bed was very comfortable, I just laid a towel over my pillow and went to sleep. They do have free breakfast, bagel, muffin, cereal, grits and oatmeal. I believe in second chances, I would stay again.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Jacksonville Airport

review_title: Best $60 per night motel I've been to!!
review_text: We stayed here on our way north on I-95. Midnight check-in, I called from the road to see if they would match the rate that I'd found online on Kayak. They did, and Jamie the overnight front desk was very friendly and helpful. I've never stayed at this chain before, and my husband was reluctant to stay as he prefers Hilton hotels. But since we were literally just sleeping there, he agreed. The room reminded me of European rooms, modern but functional. Nice linens, comfy queen beds, flat screen TV (with sleep timer...a must!), granite vanity, decent water pressure, etc. Continental breakfast was decent: pre-packaged muffins, cereal, bagels, oatmeals, yogurt, juice & coffee. Not great, but fine for the kids. Again, for the price, can't beat it! We didn't use the pool, but from my window above it looked nice for the kids.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Jacksonville Airport

review_title: Great place but too far out of town
review_text:
Went for a conference (BroadSoft Connections) and place has great conference facilities, food was especially good considering that they were catering for over 1000 people. 
Room (4526) was standard for this type of resort if a little smaller than some.
Lazy River is a great place to relax but stay away from the CLEAR rings (not flattering!). 
Resort charge includes WiFi which is available everywhere and surprisingly fast and reliable. Great to avoid ludicrous roaming charges.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Desert Ridge Resort & Spa Phoenix

review_text: My husband and I stayed over before a flight. Sean at the front desk was pleasant and proficient. We felt very welcomed by him. We checked in at a busy time. He was efficient, concise, and detail oriented. The room was quaint, cozy and the bed was plush. The property was new and clean. The breakfast was good. Microtel maybe a budget persons hotel, but the customer service was top notch!
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Jacksonville Airport

review_text: Just attended the SHSMD conference at the Marriot Desert Ridge and it was a fantastic hotel! Staff were there to direct you and serve you everywhere! And they were so friendly! They really seemed to love their jobs! And the hotel was beautiful!
hotel_name: JW Marriott Desert Ridge Resort & Spa Phoenix

review_text: This was our first stay at a Holiday Inn Express. I chose this originally because of the location, needing to stay north of Jacksonville for an early morning drive north. The service was excellent and the rooms clean and modern. We had such a good experience we chose to stay at the Holiday Inn Express in St. Augustine on our way back.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Jacksonville - Blount Island

review_text: Auf unserem roadtrip war dieses hotel unser erster halt in Florida. Sehr gÃ¼nstig (45dolar/Night) und fÃ¼r den Preis okay. Direkt an der 95 gelegen, macht man nicht viel falsch. Die Zimmer waren ebenfalls clean, wenn auch etwas antiquiert. (Bad, TÃ¼ren, Gardinen). Dennoch: hier macht man nichts falsch!

Well once again our truck ended up in a shop and here we are again at the Comfort Suites in Jacksonville and once again our stay was outstanding. Everyone went way above and beyond for us. The manager Bill managed to aquire a truck driver discount based on our last stay and he took excellent personal care of us. We have decided to take some of our home time and spend a night or 2 broken truck or not just because of the service. Thanks Bill for being the wonderful manager you are. The rooms and food were perfect as always and we recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a great nights rest. And 5 stars to the whole staff u guys are the best. See you all on our next trip.

Our family has stayed in this hotel on four occasions over the past two years. The highlight of the hotel is the quality of the staff. We have always received excellent service and find everyone most accommodating. If one of the kids does not like what is on the menu for dinner, the kitchen has gone out of it's way to prepare sandwiches or grilled cheese. 
The rooms are clean and roomy. My only problem has been a lack of wifi signal in my room during this most recent stay.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Jacksonville-South/St. Johns Ctr.

review_text: This is a great place to stay, great price too. Will be back if I'm in Jacksonville again.

review_title: Service quality of the staff @ Holiday Inn Express - Berlin Rd
review_text: Want to make a note that my husband and I are typically resort vacationers & when we use hotels it's usually a Hampton Inn because of the comfortable bedding & breakfast. I must say that of all the resorts & hotels that we've stayed in th customer services from your staff was first class! Sheila was so helpful from the time we walked in th front door. She invited us to a bottle of water, checked us in quickly, helped us sign up for your rewards program & made sure that we got to our cruise ship early. Once coming from th cruise she greeted us with a smile & took us to the airport all done with a smile & the best of customer service. I just want to thank Holiday Inn Express for the wonderful staff (especially Sheila). Because of your customer service we will be back! We are now Holiday Inn Express customers! Thank you!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Jacksonville - Blount Island

review_title: These other reviews might be bogus....
review_text: I made a reservation at this hotel based on its rating as the fourth best hotel in Jacksonville, according to tripadvisor. There is no way this hotel is in the top 50! First off, the locationis 100% industrial! When we arrived at the hotel, we noticed some of the second floor windows were open (in July!). The very helpful desk clerk put us in a room on the second floor and as soon as we got off the elevator we were met worth the obnoxious smell of cherry deodorizer and the sound of a dehumidifier in the hallway. We could not stand the smell and immediately checked out of the hotel. I must say the desk clerk was more than understanding, helpful, and courteous . I stay in the Comfort Suites every time I travel to Dallas Texas, but beware of this locationi n Jax.

Our truck broke down and for 5 days we felt as though we were home with family with the old fashioned style rooms, quaint country breakfast, very friendly staff, it definitely made being stuck a great experience.

review_title: One of the best Hotel I have stay at . I travel a lot with ny job. And I stay a lot in Hotel,s . Price was good very clean sta
review_text: Super nice Hotel very Clean .great location . I was so pleased with my stay here .

review_title: One of the very BEST places to stay!
review_text: We were so surprised. The hotel was great we had our dog and in other pet friendly places, you don't usually get a very decent room. Here the room was unbelievably CLEAN! Sheets, pillows, bathroom/tub, right down to the window sills. Not that I always check sills. (I was opening curtains). The staff was very polite and friendly. The free breakfast had everything you could want and all was fresh. Room rate very fair. Great place all around.
Quick stay on way south, staff was great but some help appeared to be right off the st. This scared my lovely partner so I suggest all staff wear uniforms. Fresh fruit at breakfast would great

review_title: Great stay for a great price!!
review_text: I booked this room on priceline (name your own price). Everything was clean...staff friendly...great price. Quarter of a mile from Dave and Busters. Would highly recommend!!

review_title: Being treated like a king in a mansion.
review_text: This historical mansion is a great retreat where service is supreme. You are always greeted in such a friendly way. The mansion is well maintained and organized. Thry have a large fitness and spa center. You are lord of the mansion here

Our family had arranged a trip for my twin brothers 26th birthday. We had a blast. The hotel wasn't around the landing which made for lower rates. It even had it's own little bit of history which was also a plus. The fact that we got free breakfast on the weekend mornings added to the pluses. We are already talking about revisiting and booking at this hotel again.

review_title: Very nice hotel, be prepared to walk
review_text:
Recently stayed at the J.W. Marriott Desert Ridge for a convention. The hotel is very nice and the surrounding area is beautiful. 
The hotel is very spread out, so be prepared to walk quite a ways to get to various locations, including the pools and meeting spaces. 
The rooms are very nice, with very large bathrooms that include a separate glass shower and bathtub. 
The location, however is the only negative. There are plenty of on-site restaurants, but they are pricey. There is a nice outdoor shopping mall across the street, but it is about a 10-15 minute walk (not recommended in the summer heat). You can take a car for $5 one-way, which is worth it.
hotel_name: JW Marriott Desert Ridge Resort & Spa Phoenix

review_text: The value was great. VERY clean. One of the best things my wife and I was surprised with was the breakfast!! Fabulous!!

This hotel was a disappointment after reading the good reviews. We checked in without problems, but our room was very warm. We turned the AC down and waited for over an hour and the room never cooled. We called for maintenance, and we were told they would be right there, but they never showed. Hot sweaty and miserable, We went back to the front desk, and we were told that they would give us another room and the front desk staff would check the room personally, so we needed to wait. We had to put all our luggage back in our car and come back later that night for the keys. The second room was as dated as the first, but the AC worked. The room's bathroom had chipped and broken tile, and the sheets had a stain. This hotel is farther from downtown then google maps indicates with the bay area traffic. I can see why people would use it to go to Monterey because it is 22 miles from Gilroy, but it would still be a good drive with traffic. There aren't any restaurants nearby except the hotels. The nearest Starbucks is in a Safeway.

Great place for a Romantic getaway!.....gorgeous place hidden from hustle and bustle of Downtown !......you feel like you should have paid three times what I got the room for!....which was only $70 on expedia!......I've stayed @ many 4 star hotels but none with better value than this!.......if you stay here!......you will return!....

review_title: This hotel was soooo trashy and dirty and front desk was so rude I would never advise no1 to come here at all
review_text: this is our 1st time stayin in this drug infested hotel Wen we arrived we were given a key dat didn't even work the hallways were dark and scary cats popping out wen walking to room trash cans were filled to the top it was so disgusting wen I went to ask for a refund I could not get my money back so I decided to stay but never again this is last time I would love to get this. Place shut down this is no place to be prostitutes and drug houses dats all this flithly place is plz don't come here

This is one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in. The rooms were top notch, the food is great, and most of all, the staff is friendly and courteous. I would recommend this hotel to anyone staying in the Jacksonville area.

After driving up from the Keys.. We were in dire need for a clean comfortable place to sleep, and we got just that. Comfy bed and a great shower.. Really what more do you need. Contental breakfast was as good as a continental breakfast could be. Coffee was good and hot...def recommend to stay
Not in the downtown area, nut close to my relatives. If you want something different, try put this historic location (accommodations are in new facilities. Great for Sunday Brunch.

As a HHonors Gold, I frequently stay in Hamptons, and this one had the same quality rooms and linens and toiletries, but the cleanliness left something to be desired. Maybe it's because I was travelling with my mom who smokes and I was in a smoking room that maybe isn't used much, but there were cobwebs in the corners, dirt and cobwebs hanging off the corner of the desk, dark blue lint all over the white curtain, and carpeting that was dirty and damp. In the bath, the fixtures were seemingly clean, but the hot and cold were reversed, and they knew it because the red/blue markers were switched. Finally, just a little thing, but the tissue box under the plastic cover wasn't opened. The sheets and linens were clean, though, and there was a minifridge and microwave. Plus, it was $20 cheaper than other HIs in the area.

Great customer service, great location. I gave the rooms a 4 because it was a little small, but the beds and linens were so comfortable. We slept like a baby. Good quality and loved the robes. Dolce Hayes Mansion gives the feeling of being home. Highly recommend it!

Well dont make the mistake of thinking this is a decent hotel! Well first off the rooms are non refundable. They are filthy, it has roaches, and you are surrounded by crack heads and drug dealers. The only plus about this hotel is that you are near town,half-way decent staff,and its cheap. Overall you get what you paid for which is crap!!!

review_title: If abuse is your thing this is the place to go!!!!!
review_text: The old lady at the desk is very abusive. We saw the ad on the Internet and called about booking...she wouldn't allow us to book in phone must do it online. We booked online...then we get there give her the confirmation and she denies having it. One of the maids walked in while we were in the lobby and spoke to us , the mad woman behind the desk screamed don't talk to her. We checked in anyway,against better judgement. review_title: Dated, Not Easy to Find or Get Back on I-95 but quiet and good value.
review_text: For a night's sleep in a quiet place this Hampton is Ok. There are not restaurants nearby and a navigation system helps when getting back on I-95. Breakfast is basic Hampton vituals. Price is Ok but for a few $ more you can do better elsewhere.

Spiders dead laying on the bed. A seis pool that i was told was a "lake" were the last things i saw before i started running. To sum up my stay I only stayed 2 minutes. All of which could be compared to purgatory on earth. Mrs. Harris the front desk attendant is the worst customer service representative I have literally ever encountered. The only thing pleasant about the experience is that I left so quickly. With no refund and the old hag still ranting about how she didn't understand what was going on. Ugh. Run!!

We checked in and left to go eat. When we got back and used the toilet it wouldn't flush. Called the front desk from cell phone and was told other rooms were available...when told him my room no. that we needed new room with wring toilet he then said ge gas no other rooms...he sent some woman up to the room who played with the toilet and finally got if to flush. It still continued to run non-stop. When asked for another room she said no...we also weren't allowed extra towels but the desk clerk refused...this after handing customer in front of us towels. When we confronted the woman who came to look at the toilet she said we could just leave. I forgot to say she told us to go to the lobby if we needed a toilet. Told her to refund my money...called the best western across the street...was immediately given a better room,extra towels and a working toilet this was at 11:30pm.
hotel_name: Howard Johnson Inn and Suites Jacksonville

review_title: A very smelly, bug filled, dirty hotel room.
review_text:
The rooms smell very bad, there are tiny little bugs that resemble fleas on the bed and sink. I killed on that was on me and apparently it was drinking my blood.
The shower has crappy pressure and goes from hot to cold and back again.
All around it was an awful experience.

The customer service here is AWFUL. Never returning. Roaches crawling up the walls, flat pillows, stained sheets, and absolutely HORRIBLE service. I came here by myself with a broken hand and I was refused extra pillows, it took them two days to fix my television, HBO doesn't work like advertised, they're stingy with the free breakfast, and everyone there is just plain rude. If you must have a hotel room, try the La Quinta next door.

review_title: Not a Hotel, more like a cheap motel!
review_text: This hotel is filthy. As we walked down the hall to our room, the carpet is nasty. Stains galore! I have never stayed at a hotel where you had to take your dity towels to the front desk yourself to exchanged for new ones. When I did take them down, they then told me that they didn't have anymore clean towels at this time. Great value, but remember that you pay for what you get. I will never stay at a Hoestead Hotel or affiliate ever again. This place sucks!!! #onedissapointedcustomer

Ok let me get this out the way. This is not the Hilton, Hyatt, Marriott or anywhere else FANCY. This is Kings Inn. Now having said that, the hotel is overall very average run of the mill Bates Motel knock off. The rooms for the most part were clean and cost efficient. Of course it doesn't have all the bells and whistles as a five star but it is somewhere safe, clean and reasonable to lay your head if you are in a money crunch. 
NOTE: Please be aware that this motel offer a very resonable weekly rate and some people call this place home. So if this is not the right surrounding for you, please go somewhere else.

We've stayed here every year for a decade for the FL/GA football game. It is a good hotel, clean, safe & convenient. 
Staff is friendly & accommodating.

review_title: Nice hotel, trendy but needs some polishing
review_text: I have always expected a lot from these hotels but was surprised on how some features showed some serious wear. The beds were comfortable, but didn't like the bedding material - need more then one blanket/comforter.

review_title: I I had a good stay.
review_text: I was there in April for a Masonic Conference. The management team took very good care of us for four days. J was very accomdating and kind to us. This will always be my place to crash when I visit Jacksonville. The breakfast in the lobby really was good.

review_title: Filthy, the old outdoor Hampton inns were better
review_text: I stayed here thinking it would be better than the near by home woods suites I paid $40 bucks more than the Homewoods suite and it was terrible. The room smells. The couch has stains all over it. The bathroom floor is filthy. This place needs a major upgrade. Do not stay here.
$79 got us a clean, newly renovated double room with comfortable beds. Perfect for a good sleep on a road trip.

review_title: The steak house was great. Hotel needs renovations the pool was dirty and most of hotel lacks general mainttenance
review_text: It overall was poor in cleanness and service steak house was great though

review_title: Not the usual standard of Red Roof Inns - avoid!
review_text: After staying at several Red Roof Inns in the past I didn't hesitate when choosing a place to stay near Jacksonville Airport. Unfortunately this RRI was nothing like the others I have experienced and I was wholy disappointed. It was more like a very budget motel, needed a renovation and was overall quite grim. I would not go back nor would I recommend this place. Its overpriced for what it is : a dingy motel!

review_title: Great Staff, Awesome Rates, No place Like Home but this stay was Close. Only Hotel in Jax. For my Family.
review_text: Thank You to the Staff and Management. Our Family lost our Home to fire in April. We Feel we were Blessed to find the Quality Staff that made us Feel at Home for Over a month here at the Best Red Roof Inn in Jax. Looking Forward to our next stay. God Bless and again. Thank You All for making us Feel Like Family.
It was okay, liked the pillow :0) clean and the only thing was the noise of a/c. Weird the restroom had a timed light not cool.

Corniela and Leon were very friendly, helpful and professional. The room was clean, and updated. The beds were a bit firm, but overall a good value was offered for the cost. I would most certainly stay again.

review_title: Great location! Good choice for the money.
review_text: This hotel is an older hotel and could use a little updating (tube tv's) but all in all it was great for the money. We booked through priceline.com. Staff was friendly, location was great. It's about 25 miles from both Fernandina and Jacksonville Beach.

review_title: Great location if you are going to the Mayo Clinic
review_text: This is the first time that we have stayed at this location. We normally stay at the one on Lenior Ave. I made my reservation on December 19th & this location was just $3.00 more. When we arrived, there was no record of my reservation. I had my confirmation #. The staff was very helpful in getting it resolved. It took some time, but we were given a room any way. I give your staff a 10 for customer service!! I was also able to get a late check out. We come every 3 months for testing at Mayo clinic. We would stay there again!!
hotel_name: Wingate by Wyndham Jacksonville / Mayo Clinic Area

review_title: Great deal but without the excellent service of most Starwood hotels
review_text: I decided to try out the new Aloft for business travels to Jacksonville. I love the Starwood family of hotels and it's my preference whenever I travel. I got my great corporate rate so it was a good deal...I liked that the hotel was pet friendly with no additional charge, there was in room free bottled water and free wifi. I will say that the service at the front desk was so relaxed that it was truly lacking and not very helpful really (unusual for Starwood no matter what level of hotel you are staying at). The hotel has a great location close to major highway and St John town center for shopping and food. The room was great for the price of the hotel. I really hope their front desk service improves, I don't want to find another hotel in Jax since I will be here 1 wk a month! (also I will acknowledge that other staff was friendly)
Love the new decor and central to everything. Very clean and Great staff. I will be back.

Stayed a number of months in the spring. When I knew I was going to stay awhile I negotiated a quiet room. Hotel handy to a great mall, a city library and not too far to the beach. Common areas well maintained. Used the grill a number of time. Only issue I had was internet speed especially in the evenings. Desk staff generally helpful when they had time. Breakfast OK. Rarely ate dinner there.

review_title: You Could Do Better at JAX
review_text:
On the positive side first, the hotel is located in a row of hotels very close to JAX airport. There are restaurants nearby including a Ruby Tuesday and a Longhorn right next door. There is a nice little basketball court and a nice pool area. The breakfast area seems adequate. The front desk man was quite pleasant.
Now for the negatives...the hotel is in desperate need of a housekeeping upgrade. My room was simply dirty. There was literally a nose remnant on the wall of the shower. The carpets did not look they had been vacuumed. There was noticeable loose dirt on the couch. The refrigerator was dented with a large scratch across it. The air conditioning unit was awful and made loud clicking noises at all times when on. The decor of the room was dated and in need of an upgrade. The televisions were small.

review_title: I hope they don't realize how good they are- they might raise their prices!
review_text:
This is a gem of a hotel!! I stayed for one night and am very pleased with its value. I suggest it if you are looking for a below $80 room and don't need a flat screen or business center.
Outside was clean and modern, with a new paint job.
Location is good with chain and local restaurants all around. Safe area.
Check in was smooth and pleasant.
Room was a king with a sofa, coffee table, and microwave/fridge combo. No flat screen. 
Very clean and quiet. Smelled great and the AC worked great with normal sounds, nothing to keep you awake.
The only complaint (minor!!) was the bathroom was a little tight. The door comes within two inches of the toilet bowl. No problem for me as I travel alone.
Breakfast was no better or worse than any other Choice Hotel. Hot bar and standard cereals and fruit.
I am definitely staying here from now on.

review_title: Not the newest hotel in the area, but very convenient and friendly service
review_text:
I stay here quite a bit because of the Mayo Clinic. While the hotel is not new, they did a great job in renovating it. The new lobby is very nice, however the new "Bistro" concept is not to my liking.
The greatest thing this hotel has going for it, is their wonderful staff and exceptional service. THEY CARE! They go out of their way to make you comfortable and are always ther to help, if needed.
I will continue to stay here while at the Mayo. While I know there are other newer hotels in the area, the Courtyard, makes me feel welcome and safe.

review_title: Good price, but there are closer hotels to the airport if you are just there overnight.
review_text:
The hotel is well kept and on-site security made the place feel safe. Wi-Fi in the room was great.The local number was hard to locate and even after using Google, I was only given the reservations number. They finally gave me the local contact. I found out the airport shuttle only runs from 9am-9pm. 
The continental breakfast was typical; offering apple juice or coffee, bagels or toast, boiled eggs, cereal, bananas, and waffles. 
I understand from a local cab driver that it's only about 10 minutes from town, so for a longer stay, this hotel would probably work well.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn Jacksonville Airport North

review_title: Our stay was quiet and tranquil.
review_text: I would highly recommend this hotel and is an A+ in my book. Check-in was quick and easy and the staff was helpful. Our room was on the first floor and poolsidev absolutly beautiful and very clean. My husband and I sat out on the porch after dinner and enjoyed some adult beverages listening to the tranquil sounds of the night.

My wife and I stayed here when visiting my in-laws for Christmas. Working on Christmas is not the most fun but we could not tell. The front desk staff and the bellman were extremely friendly and inviting, like we were coming home. The room was very clean and the bed was comfortable. The hotel lobby was beautiful and my only complaint was we only stayed for one night! Would stay again without question.

I was in town for a Monday night football game. All the downtown hotels were booked and I was familiar with the south side area. I was looking for something different than your normal hotel and I hit the right spot with Aloft. Super cool modern hotel in the heart of everything from restaurants, bars, and shopping. Quick access to JTB and I-95. The room was clean, simple, and had everything you needed; even a connecter for any kind of phone charger you can think of. We hung out at the bar in the lobby while waiting for the cab to head downtown. This is the only hotel I'll stay at from now on when visiting Jacksonville.

review_title: Excellent location off of 95 for stay over!
review_text: We found this hotel with the coupons. After reading the reviews previously, we were hesitant; however extremely tired. As you read, it used to be a Rodeway Inn, which is evident by the layout; however it truly exudes the Quality Inn status. Very clean and big rooms. Front desk was very efficient and speedy. While there is not much around (so not the best for longer stays) it suited us very well. Would absolutely consider staying here again if we ever travel again down 95.

review_title: Don't prepay for your room you may want your money back.
review_text: So my husband and I stayed 3 nights for a mini vacation. We are young hipsters so we enjoyed the trendy lobby, but I wasn't thrilled with the service when we checked in. The desk attendant was dismissive and preoccupied, foreshadowing things to come. The first morning while brushing my teeth I smelled the faint scent of boiled eggs. I was puzzled, but eager to explore the city we left. However, when we returned that evening the smell overwhelmed the room, boiled eggs also known as sulfer. Called to report it and they sent a staff member with carpet deodorizer. Why didn't we change rooms? Well our valuables where stuck in their safe and no one on staff had access to the master key. By the time the maintainace worker returned to the property to open the safe (3 hours later) all of the rooms were booked. We were told that we would speak with the manager first thing in the morning and that our rooms would be changed. We received no call the next morning and instead of the Assistant General Manager, we had the pleasure of speaking with the Sales and Beverage manager. We asked for our money back for the night and all we received was the offer of snacks from there "snack" area. She was no help at all and had the audacity to tell my husband that we had a choice and we should have chosen to leave our valuables in the safe and change rooms. Really? 2 laptops , a digital camara, and an external hard drive...Really? We decided not to let that ruin the trip, and went on about our day. We did get a new room and guess what, the phones did't work. I will never stay at the Tapestry Park property again, although the night staff and maintenance worker were helpful. The area itself is amazing with a variety of restaurants, a movie theater and is 20 minutes from the beach. There are also a number of reputable hotels in the area.

The Omni Jacksonville is a good place to stay for the price and location if you want to stay in downtown. 
I have had issues with staff banging on my door at 9:00 am to check the mini bar or housekeeping barging in around 10:00 am. If they could fix these issues I would highly recommend the Omni, for now I can only give them an average recommendation.

review_title: A nice clean new hotel with a hip vibe!
review_text: Fabulous hotel! I loved it! Nice change over the traditional stuffy hotels.
Minus our request to have help with the 'oh so easy' tv hookups being ignored, great room, price and staff.

review_title: Another great experience at a beautiful Omni.
review_text:
I try to stay at Omni hotels because I'm a memer of their rewards program and I really enjoy the benefits, like double upgrades to my room and free bubbly!
So, know that my review is including these perks. If you aren't a member of the rewards program ymmv, but I assume you'll still get great service if not a spacious room with a nice view as well.
Anyway, I didn't plan on staying at this hotel. I was provided a free room at another Jacksonville Hotel for a conference I was attending, but the hotel room provided me was disgusting and reaked of carpet cleaner. I could not spend the night, let alone an hour in that terrible room so I called Omni and asked for a room immediately. They had a room for me right away and the service was excellent.
When I arrived the valet was prompt and courteous, think it was $18/night. Inside they seated me in their comfortable waiting area and provided myself and guest with som sparkling water since they hadn't quite gotten the room ready yet - understandable considering I gave them no notice of my needing a room.
The hotel is beautiful and my room was no exception, there were fresh strawberries waiting for me and a bottle of champagne - excellent.
And the view of one of the bridges was incredible. One wall was all window and it was very nice to fall asleep watching the cars traverse the bridge in the distance. It was a fantastic experience and I recommend this hotel to anyone in Jacksonville.
The location is not the best, but hey... it is Jacksonville.
Excellent service, excellent room, excellent sleep, all modern amenities, coffee delivered on time and the right newspaper in the morning (you'd be surprised how difficult that can be for some hotels.)
Thank you Omni Jacksonville. I was easily able to attend the conference and be well rested!
I wish I had some photos, but this was before I started writing reviews on tripadvisor. Take my word, you won't be disappointed here, especially if you have the rewards program.

I went to Jacksonville for pleasure to checkout the Landing. This location is fantastic. If your not in a Hurry, take the bus from JAX and it drops you across the street from hotel for $2.00. Cab is $25. Lobby is clean with Newspapers and bottled water. Room had a great view of the river. Rooftop pool was a little small. Pillows and bed were not impressive. The best part was the Breakfast made to order with mimosas. Next time go to the Hyatt.

Very good location and fair rooms. Limited number of usable TV channels (mostly news and sports) but this is outweighed by excellent pool and (average) gym. Nearby (average) restaurants within walking distsnce.
Parking nearby open lot ($10) and garage ($12).
Lastly, place had a persistent smell of garlic... very strange.

review_title: We got what we paid for
review_text: The serviceat the desk was horrible and slow. The design of the hotel is very modern chic but as I went to the public restroom, one stall was clogged and the other was dirty. Then the hallway and the room smelled like paint. It was new so the price was lobbing you get what you pay for.

During my stay, we crossed the street to go to the Landing(a fun night spot downtown). In the entrance to the hotel I was assulted. The hotel has not help me or the police catch the assailants. In fact they potected them! They stated they did not know who did it. Come to find out they are guest of someone working at the hotel. Barry sanders the GM has yet to return my phone calls! He told my mom that it was my FAULT I was beaten because I had been drinking!

review_title: Nice hotel, friendly staff, liked the little touches...
review_text:
Great stay! I stayed there 2 nights for a business meeting. I joined there loyalty program after Iade my reservations so front desk reception linked my loyalty number to my stay. This gets you free drinks each morning delivered to your room. I got orange juice and it was great. I also got the get fit package to take to my room for in room exercise. I asked about a running route. The route they recommend takes you across two bridges. Nice! I enjoyed it. And each time I ran that route, others were running it too so I felt safe. Not much life in the downtown area that this hotel is located, so I wanted to make sure what was safe before venturing out. One morning when I came back from the run, one of the guys at the bell stand gave me a bottle of water and asked about the run. Just a little detail I liked. You know how much bottles of water can add up to while you are traveling. One night, when I got back in from eating dinner, there were bottles of water and chocolate chip cookies waiting for me. Another little nice touch. 
The worst part of the hotel was probably my noisy neighbor that had the tv turned up to blaring levels when I was trying to go to sleep. However to counter that, the omni has a turn down channel on the tv. It plays soothing music and shows different nature scenes. I used this to drown out the tv noise from next door and it was great!
The rooms were clean. The staff friendly. On the business meeting floors, they put out cloth towels in the restrooms for you to dry your hands. No paper. Once you are done with your towel, there's a bin to toss it in for wash. Nice touch. 
I have never stayed at an omni before. I really liked this one. I'm ready to try another in future travels.

review_title: Great location, nice price, and awesome service. Pet Friendly!
review_text: Enjoyed a couple of days rest while seeing a few old friends. There is plenty of choices for dinner and shopping in this area. The hot breakfast was an awesome way to start the day.

review_title: Average hotel for business travel located in the burbs.
review_text: Dated property. Nice staff and dependable maid service. Hard to beat for around $ 100 bucks.
This was our second time staying at the Omni. Great hotel, location and the staff is always nice and helpful.

I stayed here a couple nights during a business trip and was very impressed with my accommodations. It's an older Residence Inn, but they were in the final stages of a complete renovation with a bright, modern decor and technology-friendly rooms. The lobby and dining area weren't quite done when I was there, but it looked like that area will be equally as nice. Plus, the service was great and probably the homiest of any chain hotel I've stayed at in awhile. A definite recommendation!

We stayed at this hotel last month and were pleasantly surprised. They offer a lot of amenities included in the price where you can get somewhere else for almost twice the price. The rooms are spotlessly clean. Staff is very helpful. This hotel is a thumbs up!!!

review_title: YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR...
review_text: Just a night's sleep....nothing more, nothing less!

Jacksonville Jazz Fest was awesome, and Omni Jacksonville was first class all the way!!! I love staying at the hotel: staff are hands down the best I ever dealt with, the Food and Beverage Manager Frederick Najem was very friendly and professional each time was saw him!!! I have to say I love this hotel because I am a sucker for great customer service!! The room was very clean, bed comfy, and everything was clean!!!

Had business the last week of March 2011 in Jacksonville and stayed at the Omni. Overall good experience. Came by taxi to and from the airport, so I did not deal with valet parking or the fee charged for parking a car at the hotel. The tip on the prior TripAdvisor review about joining their loyalty program ahead of time is good advice. For business, I have to move quickly and they had me checked-in fast so I could make a meeting. I was able to walk to my business meetings that week, just a block away at the BOA building. I had a room with a king size bed and the mattress had a comfort top. WiFi worked well from the room. However, they need to upgrade to flat screen TVs with a sleep timer. Friendly staff at the bar. Drinks were rather pricey. Front desk staff had a taxi waiting for me right at 5 am as requested so I could catch an early flight out. Recommend for business downtown.
I love this hotel. This is my favorite place to stay when in Jax. Its affordable, its decorated nicely and in a great spot. Dave n Busters is right across the street!

review_title: ...a "real hotel" and a delight to discover
review_text:
Although located in a corporate corridor, it has a distinct and alluring personality all its own. Â 
The grounds are inviting and the lobby is quite an amazing surprise architecturally. Â We found the hotel staff to be friendly and professional.
Our tastefully decorated room exceeds expectations and even includes a refrigerator and microwave enclosed in cabinetry. Conventional A/C (individually controlled) allows for more creative furniture arrangement and the rooms are decorated nicely.
An onsite restaurant and bar provides a convenient place to wind down and dine...or eat a great breakfast. Â We enjoyed the breakfast buffet and watching the chef prepare our special requests (you can also opt to order from the menu). Â 
The outdoor pool is open 24/7!Â Whether for work...or play, don't hesitate to enjoy this property.
Will certainly stay here next time in JAX. Very good service.

review_title: Clean rooms, friendly staff, comfortable beds, close to I95
review_text: Only drawback was the small parking lot, but the very friendly clerk helped us find a spot. We wanted to sleep for a few hours at 2 AM, and this place was perfect. The bed was very comfortable, which was the most important thing for us. They even have a light continental breakfast. We have paid far more for far less.
We are traveling to Cocoa Beach and stopped here for 1 night. Had a coupon so the price was great.

We were one of those many people who's flights were cancelled due to huuricane Irene. 
We had to drive a 100 miles to Jacksonville as that was the only airport that could get us home the quickest. We knew nothing about Jacksonville and nothing about the Hampton Inn chain. We only came across thanks to our sat nav when we got off the interstate. 
We thought it looked very posh from the outside and said we would just chance our arm and check the room rates for the three nights we were staying. The girl at reception was so nice and friendly and the prices she gave were very reasonable, we were staying. The rooms were fabulous for the price, very clean and the beds were comfy with white linens, nice. The breakfast was great too,self service and very plentiful, yummie, great start to the day. I also used the pool and had it to myself, that was spotless and sparkling clean.
We had a great stay and we were so very lucky to find such a lovely hotel, we couldn't have asked for anything better.
Very spacious rooms. Very comfortable beds. Standard breakfast. Great location near airport and right off 95. Would stay again in a minute.

For $60 a night it served it's purpose. Close to airport and places to eat. The room was ok, old carpet and comforters showed some wear. Bathroom was clean. Tube TV that actually impressed me with the amount of channels it offered. Free breakfast with make your own blueberry waffles was a plus.

Just checked in and I'm sorry we did. The hotel manager "greeted" us and was probably one of the rudest people I've met in quite some time. I understand the Ramada isn't a five star hotel, but acting clearly annoyed for no reason doesn't make a good first impression. After totally botching our reservation and asking how we were going to pay for a room we had already had payment confirmation for, rather than apologize, she walked away.

Very clean rooms, Nice bar, staff very nice. Location is a little ways from downtown, over the bridge but the price for the room made it ok. Only issues I have is vending machines on 3 different floors were empty and I had a $1000 incidentals charge for no reason. Called hotel and hopefully it will be taken care of.
Had rooms available on a busy weekend. Very modern and clean. Would stay again!

I am a diamond member so stay in a lot of Hilton owned hotels and also very very picky about where I lay my head down at night... And I am comfortable in this hotel- I come back every time I need to be in jax for work. It's clean and updated. Only negatives are that they do not offer room service for breakfast, staff never seems very friendly and they charge to park in the garage and tell you the lot next to the hotel is city owned and that you will be towed- even though right now there are about 30 rental cars sitting in the lot now... I have the feeling they just tell people that to make more money with the garage. Overall it's a good place though..

review_title: Great hotel, great staff, great stay.
review_text: Stayed here for one evening. Wonderful open atmosphere. Great staff. Nice hot breakfast. Great beds. No complaints.

review_title: Great overnight getaway, especially with Ruth's Chris right there in the same building.
review_text: Great location, great service, beautiful view. The one downside is that our room had a faint musty smell. But we'd stay here again.

review_title: Clean hotel, but loud with barking dogs
review_text: I stayed at this hotel for a week on business not by choice. The hotel is worn bit clean. There is a standard continental breakfast that is included, and is replenished. Everyone I encountered at the hotel was very friendly. This is a pet friendly hotel, and I was worried about allergies but I had no prolema whatsoever. My only complaint, is the hotel is SO NOISY!!! I was on the first floor, and all night long you hear barking/yapping dogs. I think they are yapping/barking when the owners walk the dogs down the hall. Always between midnight and 5am I was constantly woken up, and I am a deep sleeper so this was unusual for me. I did not get much sleep all week. If I would have been more prepared ear plugs probably would have taken care of the problem. No other complaints whatsoever.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Jacksonville Butler Blvd

review_title: Good hotel, good location for downtown Jacksonville business, Landing, and convention center.
review_text: The building has a few decades under its belt, but rooms have been updated to current standards. At least in my 10th floor room, the sliding doors to balcony need to be replaced with more soundproof one, to reduce city street noise, which was noticeable. Parking was good with plenty of space and reasonable price ($10). Easy walk across the river to the convention center.

review_title: La Quinta Inn & Suites Jacksonville Butler Blvd
review_text: The hotel had easy access to I-95 with a large parking lot and right next door to a Cracker Barrel. The breakfast was good, the rooms were clean and the front desk was friendly. The pool and spa were nice too. I love the firm pillowtop mattresses I find in La Quinta's.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Jacksonville Butler Blvd

review_text:
overall you cant go wrong. rooms are clean, staff is friendly.
stayed in room 203.
I would recommend this hotel, great hotel for the cost!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Jacksonville Butler Blvd

review_text: It is a bit tired. Cracks in the tile bathroom floor. Rust on the door base. Caulking needing to be done. Excursive room was nice. Up to date with treadmills and elliptical machines. I think room service and front staff were above average. Very nice group working there. It maintained Marriott standards with their bedding and pillows.

We stayed here to be essentially right on the river because we were using the party boat. Excellent service from start to finish. Not a brand new hotel, but super nice for an older hotel.... Besides we were just visiting not living there. Plenty of parking and restaurants close by. The room was very clean, the lobby and bar are nice and the convention center is pretty. While there are several other hotels nearby this was the best value. I would definitely stay here again!

A few tips, first try to get a room on the top 5th floor, they have open balconies. Second, do not pay to park, there is an entrance next to the hotel at the school board office that you can get in without a gate. Not sure why they charge $10 for parking when you can drive through the other lot. Third, do not expect much, the hotel is older, tube televisions that do not work most of the time. The bath room was EXTREMELY small, typical for an older property. Now the room was clean, and the bed was comfortable. I booked through priceline for a last minute deal, so I got what I paid for....lol. The location is on the south side of the riverwalk, most shop and resturants are on the north side.

review_title: The complainers are crazy - this is a nice place.
review_text:
Look...I understand that many of the folks who reserved rooms here are used to upscale hotels in DC or New York City. Is this hotel a four-star in those areas? No. Is it an extremely nice place with great amenities and friendly staff, all for a bargain price? Absolutely. 
My huband and I are still checked in, and have just finished our first 24 hours here. We were terrified during the drive, as I was reading these awful reviews and thinking we'd made a terrible mistake. Much to our pleasant surprise, we have been happy with everything. The staff is professional and ready to help; the rooms are clean and comfortable; the breakfast was affordably priced and very tasty; the pool was wonderfully refreshing and beautifully maintained; the beds soooo comfortable; and the hotel has been rather quiet, although very busy.
Specifics: we had planned to avoid the breakfast buffet based on the terrible reviews, but we looked at the a la carte menu and found a $9 All American Breakfast that includes eggs, home fries, choice of meat, choice of bread, juice, and coffee. A great meal for a fair price. Our server was sweet and attentive, and the dining room was clean.
Our room on the 10th floor is small, yes, but we're not throwing parties in there or anything. It is perfect for a couple. The flat screen TV is great (plenty of cable channels), the carpet appears to be new, the furniture is fine (appears to be a new desk chair), and the bed is out of this world.
The bathroom is also small, so prepare not to try to lay all of your toiletries on the counter, ladies. No big deal. The bathroom is clean, the shower/tub is fine, and there is plenty of hot water (immediate) and water pressure. There is no jetted tub, which people are probably used to in a four-star hotel, but we don't care. The fan is loud on startup but immediately quiets down and de-steams the room quickly.
The pool was bliss. It is immaculately clean and the water temperature is perfect. There is a shower nearby to rinse off, and the restrooms just inside are clean and nice. Pool towels are provided, which we appreciated. Deck chairs are plentiful and comfortable.
The location is good - just on the riverwalk and a water taxi stop ($3 fare one way). San Marco square is about a 1/2 mile walk. The view of the river is beautiful. Our room faces the city, but from the 10th floor, that view is quite nice, also.
No one has asked us to pay for parking yet - we just drove right into the lower covered parking spaces. The wireless is free - I am using it now, and it is fair reception. We had reception by the pool, also, but not in the dining room.
In all, if you are looking for a clean, comfortable place to stay, this hotel is perfect. We are very happy.
I have stayed here numerous times and have always had a great experience. Very modern rooms. Never crowded.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Jacksonville Baymeadows

review_text: Booked through priceline.com negotiator for steal of a deal. We had 2 double beds but they moved us to king and river view because we asked nicely! Great service great room with big flat screen. Plus we didn't have to pay to park! Awesome!

Stayed at the wyndham for 2 nights. Location is excellent. The lobby is nice. Has cool pool table and shuffleboard. But the rooms are so outdated. Walking in you think you are in a hotel from 1990. Musty smelling rooms.... Old old bathrooms. A tube tv! Things are rusting and molding. The hotel is very very loud. The walls are paper thin and you can hear people in the lobby all night long. 
Overall, if all you Want is location then stay here. If you want a nice hotel room then please stay somewhere else. (Wyndham you should be disappointed in yourself)

Hard to know where to start... We had 3 rooms here for 2 nights each during the Jax Film Festival.... Every one of us had to switch rooms for one problem or another... The pine smell sort of pine and a damp smell were in each room, it was weird. It for sure needs a renovate, the website pictures make it look alot better than it is. One room was able to catch one of the two bugs in the bed and take downstairs to show the night manager. It was not particularly clean and on one of the days we went back to the room 3 times and the next door room had trash outside the door which was not removed all day. At breakfast we had a glass with lipstick still on it, minor... But given all the other issues, just added to our overall disappointment. On the upside the valet guys were friendly and fast. The proximity to the city was good and the water taxi very fun with a gorgeous sunset.

review_title: A last minute reservation. Customer service was very professional and hotel extremely clean
review_text: This was a last minute decision to get a hotel for the wife and I. We were planning to drive all the way back to Tampa but decided to stay another night on our short trip. The staff was very professional and booked me with a GREAT rate!" No problem" they said. They saw that we were very exhausted and had to put us in a room! A Very clean stay definitely would stay here on the next trip.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Jacksonville Baymeadows

review_text: I'm a SPG member and I have stayed at this hotel numerous times due to its location, value, and comfort. I am very disappointed to say that last night I did not receive the customer service I should have for being a regular guest at this hotel. Before making a pre-paid reservation for a two night stay for 8/20-8/22, I called to make sure I would be able to check in if I came after 3am. I was told I could. This was my birthday weekend and I wanted a place close to crash instead of having to drive home. I arrived at the hotel at 3:45am to check-in and Demetri at the front desk told me he could not find my reservation and told me if I wanted to get a room I would have to pay $109 for that night. I refused to pay that because I already paid $169 for two nights. I wasn't going to pay more than the rate I originally booked. Anyways, he wasn't any help. He didn't apologize, he didn't offer me a room at the same rate I booked, he didn't do anything to help. I was very tired and I had to drive home that morning. When I got home I called customer service and they kindly refunded my money back. I received an apology through an e-mail but not from the manager, from the sales director. I am very disappointed and this might just be the last time I book with four points. Note again that this was my birthday weekend. An apology is just not enough.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Jacksonville Baymeadows

review_title: Great location, great value, great stay
review_text: Arrived on a Friday afternoon to find a carpet company taking up the parking lot on the north side of the hotel. Saw them removing old carpet from the hotel and taking new carpet in. Was a little apprehensive but decided to check in. Got to room and was pleasantly surprised. Room was nicely appointed, clean and comfortable. Breakfast was great. Didn't notice any noise from the adjacent club at night. Check out on Sunday was smooth.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Jacksonville-Southside Blvd-Deerwood Pk

review_text: We were quite pleased when we arrived to find a clean and maintained facility with large comfortable rooms. ...and as usual the extremely comfortable beds! Well worth the rate!
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Jacksonville-Southside Blvd-Deerwood Pk

review_text:
Visiting our son who attends Jacksonville University. Free breakfast and a special rate for JU and they give monies back to JU .
The oatmeal is amazing!

Older building but this place is the real deal. Quiet and serene despite Britney Spears concert right across the river, a family reunion and 2 weddings. Looks like this is the place. Worth every penny to be treated like a true guest by such amazing staff. From the front desk to the bartender, all were so nice. This my place for staying in Jax.
I booked this hotel based on the reviews on Trip Advisor and the rate. Very good experience. Very good hotel for the money. I would return for personal or business stay. Clean and quiet.

This is the best hotel I've ever stayed at. The staff is very friendly and helpful. They go above and beyond to make you feel at home. The location is excellent. You are pretty much in the middle of everything. I will be recommending this hotel to everyone.
The hotel lobby was nice but the rooms are smelly and dirty.

review_title: Only stay here if the price is right!
review_text: The carpet was a mess and the rest if the room didn't look that clean. The ice machine by the room was broke. Big name for a cheap hotel. The only reason I'm not mad about the hotel is cause it cost me $50 in Expedia and the location was pretty good.

review_title: Better than home I didn't have to do the cleaning.
review_text:
We began our stay wth a smile. The front desk personnel was friendly and seemed glad to welcome us. Loved the snack pack. Room was big and very clean.
Breakfast bar attended was quick to refill food and kept everything very clean. Great place , will stay again when in Jacksonville.
Edin Redzic was the best part of the stay! so helpful and pleasant! the room and views are fabulous. facility is clean, staff courteous, and it has been great stay!

Excellent staff
Excellent little extras 
Excellent service 
Excellent hotel
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
This hotel is so big they have banks of elevators for different towers and floors. Rooms are nicely appointed and the staff is very pleasant and helpful. 
The food is very Texas -- uneventful and generally unhealthy. The Kitchen Table has a breakfast buffet that is minimal in choices yet high in price. 
The location is central for Dallas, but there is no central shopping or entertainment are in the city. The main streets are dead compared to other large cities. Dallas is very low on my preferred city list. 
The food and nightlife compares low with other parts of the country. With that said, the hotel staff was very good especially a young man in concierge.

It is a very nice hotel, in downtown Dallas, near touristic attractions. Rooms are clean, staff are nice and friendly, food is great but very expensive at the hotel. So try to eat outside and do not make orders to ur room, they will charge u double the price.

review_title: Helpful and enthusiastic staff. Great location for runners
review_text:
I stayed at the Hyatt for a conference. The room was clean. No problems at all. Plus, even on the 4th Floor, I had a really nice bridge view. 
The staff is remarkable. Everyone is so happy and willing to help. 
The fitness center was great with plenty of treadmills and exercise bikes, but only 2 elliptical machines. I didn't go to the rooftop pool. 
If you run, there is a great path along the river and the bridges have footpaths. Very convenient location for runners

There are many SPG hotels in the Dallas area (I've stayed in most). This is one of the better ones for the business traveller. You have a good chance of an upgrade with the large number of rooms in the hotel. I was upgraded to an executive suite which is spacious, although the living room area has no windows making it feel more like a cave. This hotel has been renovated though the bathrooms still have an older style feel to them. The staff at this hotel are extremely friendly and helpful. For food there area a few choices in the hotel and lots within walking distance - we tried the sports bar but after waiting five minutes with a waiter standing no more than 5 ft from our table just watching the TV we left and tried the main restaurant - here the service was faster but the food only mediocre (especially for the high price). Outside tha main restaurant there is a pleasant seating area on the deck around a couple of gas fires ... A good place for a post-dinner drink on a warm evening. The gym is well-equipped. The SPG member lounge is in the central tower which means if you are in one of the other two towers you need to go down to the lobby and back up another elevator to get there. The lounge itself is well staffed, includes an espresso machine and complimentary wine and beer during the evening hours. Lounge breakfast is limited to continental (cereal, fruit, yogurt, bread and pastries). The is a parking garage right across the street or valet parking ($29/night if I remember correctly).

I stayed at the hotel for one night for a short business trip. Everyone from the parking attendant to the front desk was very pleasant and helpful. I ate ate the sports bar for dinner and breakfast at the main restaurant. The food and service was very good at both places.
The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. The view was not pleasant but I was only there for one nite so no big deal.
Overall, the place was fine for a short business trip.

We recently chose the Indigo for a recent family visit to the Jacksonville area, based mostly on TripAdvisor reviews -- glad we did! The rooms were great and the propert was new and clean. What really set this hotel apart was the service -- EVERYONE was smiling, cheerful and super helpful. A shout out to Anthony Michael Hall lookalike, Kevin, who had the patience of Job during breakfast with two families, one set of grandparents and four kids all in one party --he was great and helped entertain the kids!

review_title: Great boutique hotel in prime location, but away from it all
review_text: We live in Jacksonville and just wanted a one night get away. This hotel has a spa/beach atmosphere, casual, bright, yet serene. Very relaxing. Right on a lake with a boardwalk trail around it, and in the heart of quaint Tapestry Park. It's adjacent to Tinsletown and just a few miles from the Town Center. Service and the food in the hotel was great. Large, very comfortable rooms. Highly recommend this hotel if you are visiting Jax, have friends in town or just want a quick getaway.

review_title: Fantastic experience and superior customer service!
review_text: This hotel was formerly owned by another chain. Sheraton took it over and have done an awesome job refreshing it. The service was 5 star. Every employee we met had a great attitude and passion for service!!

review_title: Great place to just relax for the weekend and still be close enough to all the action.
review_text: Friendly staff an folks at the bar at all hours. Close to to some of the best restaurants and shopping Jax has to offer.

review_title: Nice boutique hotel jewel off the beaten path
review_text: Stayed for a quick overnight me retreat. Hotel was clean, loved decor & color palate & grounds. Relaxing vibe, not overcrowed , Pool and fitness were nice, but a little small. Near nice indulgent food spots within walking distance. Will stay again. Only thing missing is a mini fridge.
I love the Hyatt hotels however, I don't like having to pay for the children to watch cartoons. That would be the only negative, other than that everything was great!
Clean, neat and affordable with a perfect location.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Jacksonville - Bartram Park

review_text: It you need to stay downtown this is good choice, otherwise there are probably better choices. The property is dated especially by the usual Hyatt standards. The staff is friendly but otherwise this property disappoints.

review_title: You could pay more for 5 star service, but why when you can stay at the Palomar?
review_text: We stay here every time we come to Dallas (which is frequently with an SMU student in the family). We hit all of the top end favorites (Ritz, Mansion at Turtle Creek, Crescent) before we discovered the Palomar and now are disappointed if the Palomar is sold out and we have to go to one of the previously mentioned alternatives. Can't be beat on value, service (tops) and location.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Stayed here in early December on a windy, freakishly cold night in Florida. The howling wind could not even be heard in the room.
Accommodations were at the standard for a Courtyard. Very clean lobby and rooms. Staff were courteous and friendly. All-in-all, a good stay and exactly what I expected.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Jacksonville Flagler Center

review_text: I had the pleasure of staying here with a friend of mine for a girls getaway. What a perfect place! I cannot say anything bad about the place. If you are looking for a place in Dallas, stay here!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Great location, staff was friendly and the overall experience was fantastic.
Goldfish in the room was a cool touch
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Great hotel with great employes that offers great customer services in a great location in Dallas!
review_text: I stayed here on new years weekend and I knew that it was a good hotel. Every one was friendly and ready to make your stay as easy and comforting as possible. From the professional and friendly valet service all the way to the comfortable sheets and pillows in my bed room. If your coming to Dallas, for business or pleasure, adolphus is where to stay.

I was impressed from the moment we arrived and they delivered my children two goldfish for their stay! I loved the complementary happy hour as well. The pool area was very upscale, clean and nice. I can't wait to go back and stay again!
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar Dallas - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Matthew jones was a hero with checking in Tyler teachers.
Another great stay!! The hotel staff is amazing. They remember who we are each time we stay! The hotel is always clean. The beds are so comfortable that it is almost like being at home.

I was there for a convention that was being held onsite. The service and check in was friendly and fast. We had a king bed in the newly renovated north tower. Wasn't a huge room but still a good size (we were in downtown Dallas) and everything was clean and comfortable. The bathroom was a nice size and the water pressure in the shower was great. We got a great rate because of the convention but I think if you can get a room here for $110 or less per night you are getting a great deal. We even enjoyed the food and service in the restaurant.

This hotel has a nice breakfast and nice pool area. The rooms are dated and could use some updating but large. The internet was slow. I couldnt get wifi by the pool for more than 10 minutes at a time It was a comfortable stay and the staff were pleasant. I would stay here again.
Friendly staff and comvenient location. Nice room and quiet atmostphere.

Totally fine for the price. Not pretty, but Clean.
Nice neighbourhood.

We needed a room for one night near a concert we were attending. The desk clerk was pleasant, the room was clean, and there was an interesting bookstore and several adequate coffeeshops and eateries within walking distance.

review_title: Nice rooms, friendly staff and economical rates, what else one need...!!!
review_text: As I mentioned already... It worked very well for me.
theres lots to do within walking distance great service very plesent spacious rooms staff is very friendly and helpful.

I have stayed at a variety of hotels and I generally brave the smaller chains when I am alone or money is really tight. The later was true in this case, so the $69 rate got my eye. I was a bit leery when we drove up, but the hotel was clean and the room comfortable and quiet despite being right on the road. I would bring my family here anytime and I recommend this as a good value.

review_title: Don't bother,unless you are a prostitute or drug dealer.
review_text:
After finding out the the motel that we were originally going to stay in ( my mother, my husband, my sister and her boyfriend) was a complete dump, because my mom flew out a say earlier than us, we decided to quickly change the reservation. 
We chose this motel because of the central location and the fact that they said they had upgraded it. 
My mom only stayed one night after she saw the San Jose police knocking on doors, and the hotel clerk told her that there was no more toilet paper available. My sister and her boyfriend had to change rooms and found out that both were dirty, had broken plumbing, and also lacked toilet paper, they did not stay the night despite us getting in from an extremely delayed flight and having to check in around 4am. 
My husband and my room was ok, but the carpet was filthy, the bedding had a rip, and there was no bathtub. 
We discovered the next morning that people were living at the motel with there pets and the pool was being renovated which was never mentioned online or when I changed my reservation. 
We were there for a funeral and to say our goodbyes to a close relative who is going to pass away anyday. 
I was hoping to get better rest which was much needed, but in such a gross place, it was hard to do that. 
Don't bother staying here, it's not worth a penny of your money, there are much nicer and more accomidating motels and hotels in the area.

My husband booked a room here online, their website is completely false as far as the pictures! We got there and got our key, drove around and there were 4-5 guys in the parking lot drinking w/their music cranked. Once in the room the carpet was filthy, the bedding/decor was not at all what it looks like in the photos. I had to really use the bathroom so did so reluctantly and there were ants crawling all over the door, sink counter and floor! We put our bags back in the vehicle and left, but not before asking for a refund due to the room condition and were told no refunds after you check in. We got a room next door at Wyndham for $20.00 less! If you are looking to do a drug deal or getting a room at an hourly rate this is where you want to be. I cannot figure out how This place is rated more than 1 star!! It should not even be rated at all!!

review_title: Bed Bugs and very poor cleanliness
review_text: The hotel was generally run down and very poorly maintained. I checked in and found bed bugs in the bed. Immediately checked out and went to a different hotel.

review_title:
Quintessentially cozy and clean.
The summit of Fine Stays !
review_text:
Folks, the family owned Valley Inn, is the foremost Hotel, for Business men, contractors, families, and with the Jacuzzi suite, amorous couples.
The interior is semi spacious, utterly spotless, impeccably well appointed, in terms of amenities, for price. 5 Hbo channels, and a plethora of other premium channels. A built in guide allows you to simultaneously surf channel programming while watching, and set Reminders.
Good microfridges, ice machine and microwaves.
Wonderfully clean tubs with consistent hot water and avante garde hygiene products.
No Drugs or jaded activity, makes this, hands down, the best of San Jose.

I was reluctant to stay after reading some of the reviews of this place. But I was pleasantly surprised, not bad at all. The room was clean and the bed was nice. We stayed a week and housekeeping was superb. The television could use more channels, but we we're on vacation and mostly seeing the sights in and around town. Having a fridge and microwave in the room was a bonus. No bad experiences. We would definitely stay again.

This is a review about Clarion Hotel's Airport Parking. 
We were willing to park the car ourselves, but management insisted on taking our keys. The hotel staff parked the car next to an anthill, and as a result, the car became infested when we returned. 
The manager was rude and refused to go inspect the damage, deferring it to the shuttle driver, who was not present at the time.
hotel_name: Silicon Valley Hotel San Jose Airport

review_text: I chose this place based on price, shuttle service on demand and good reviews. The first two criteria were met but the actual accommodations were woefully lacking. The rooms were very small - could barely fit our luggage in the room with us. The carpet was old and smell. This was the worst place I have stayed in in recent years.
hotel_name: Silicon Valley Hotel San Jose Airport

review_title: Dirty, musty, cheap motel in the class of a motel 6....
review_text:
eeegads... what was i thinking?????
The carpeting was so dirty, i was grossed out..
the room was musty and smelly and there was some employee cleaning out his car and using the chemicals outside, it permeated the air around us.
The beds were made but the sheets were super dingy. 
I didnt want to lie in them,and got a contact rash on my arm for some reason.
I would usually know better, but on previous visits to sj we stayed at the fairmont and dolce hayes, so i was shocked at this place. we needed a pit stop onthe way to la.... and in a hasty decision, i booked this place..
On another note, we have learned the word "dump"......
As in "good morning! Now let's get out of this dump!"
Also, crappy spotty internet. Free.
hotel_name: Silicon Valley Hotel San Jose Airport

review_text: Great place but $21 a night parking fee, $5 bottle of water, a fee to call customer or guest services and a fee to have wi fi in your room when everybody else gives it free was a negative for me. The price to stay there already is high on top of that pay so much for what is normally free not good . And at night a bunch of drunk people roaming the lobby's not good.

I stayed in this hotel for 3 nights, tho I had planned to only spend one night.I decided to stay on at this hotel instead of looking for a "better " place for many reasons. First of all, the front desk clerk was extremely friendly and helpful on the phone when i called to check for availability around 10p.m after being on the road for 9 hours. When i arrived, he carried my bags upstairs for me..as they were heavy and there was no elevator. I really appreciated this. The room was spotless, and I am picky! There was a microwave and coffee maker as well as a midsize compact refridgerator...not the tiny ones u often find. Hairdryer in bathroom and toiletries. Quiet also. The other desk clerks during the day were courteous and anxious to help as well. maids were meticulous and friendly. As a woman traveling solo, i did not feel at all unsafe in this hotel..however I was in the main building. There was a computer in the lobby for guest use. Furniture in rooms was upscale and I was amazed at the amenities in the room and quality of facility for the price....much better than many hotels twice the price. I hated to leave and go to embassy suites for my last two nights as the price was more than double but i had reservations and would have been charged! Next time I am in San Jose I will stay here again with no hesitation.

Spent 3 nights at the hotel. Staff very helpfull at all times. Room spacious and clean. Bathroom clean. Nice bed size, linen and pillows. Very close to public transportation (LightRail) made renting a car unecessary for me as I could get very easily to anywhere I needed. Only con: someone in the room above walked with high heel during the night which made it difficult to sleep.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express San Jose International Arpt

review_text:
Very low end HI Express. Sparse rooms. Dated. Had to walk outside to gain access to my room. Noisy AC. Found ants in the bathroom
Only good things: close to airport, free parking, rate below $150.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express San Jose International Arpt

review_title: No Frills Clean Hotel Close to Convention Ctr & University
review_text: My sister and I stayed at this hotel while on a trip to see the Dalai Lama speak at the university and Convention Center. It's an average hotel when it comes to amenities and decor, but it is in a great location (about 5-10 minute walk to the university and 5 minute walk to the Convention Center). The price of the room was decent at about $70/night and the room was clean. Overall, this is a good value hotel if you don't care about the decor and fancy amenities.

review_title: Surprisingly wonderful for a Ginormous hotel
review_text: I booked 2 nights on a website that didn't let me see my hotel until I paid; my heart sunk when I found out that I would be staying at the Sheraton Dallas. I had never heard anything good about Sheratons; apparently the brand is definitely on the upswing. The Downtown Sheraton underwent a 90 million dollar facelift...and it shows.
