The staff was friendly and helpful; they always made eye contact and offered help if I looked lost (it is a very big property). The breakfast buffet is not included, but is plentiful, fresh and well worth it; service in the restaurant is excellent. The health club is the size of a regular gym and wifi is free in the lobby (they also have some computers and a printer for guests). I rarely gush in reviews, but this property far exceeded my expectations, especially for the price i paid. I would return a pay a regular puiblished rate.

review_title: Very Nice property I enjoyed my stay
review_text: I stayed there 4 days with my husband. We mad a bid on Priceline. i was a little bit worried when i knew we were staying there cause of the mixed reviews about That but frankly speaking, i had Ã  really Nice stay. we were there for my husband's work and the hÃ´tel was conveniently located close to airport and downtown. The parking is Free, staff really nice and helpful, housekeeking staff Very pleasant, room Very cleaned. Yes it'a Ã  bit old and outdated, but hey, I paid 70$ the night. I also stayed 1 night at the Four Points downtown and the room was more than double the price and I paid an extra 20 for the parking. so I CAN leave with lamps and TV That are not from the last trend... Ask for a room close to reception though. Building Is pretty big and thats where i was. Did not havÃ© a garden vies and That was still Very fine. If i could say just 1 thing about That property, Is That i sent 2 emails before my stay and did not get any answer. which, Being myself in the hospitality industry, I find not really sales oriented. But for thÃ© price I paid im Very satisfied. Would definitely go back on m'y next trip.

review_title: If you dont want any perks, stay here, nothing is free.
review_text: Check in was efficiant. they charged me 20.00 a night to park there. the elevator to the parking is tiny. parking is very small spaces. they dont give you free internet, you have to pay 18.00 a night to use it in your room. dont drink the water bottles, they will charge you 4.00 per bottle. they dont supply you with a microwave or a frig. the bed is not comfy. all in all the value was bad. they charged me 140 for a room that should have only cost 50.00. booked the room through travelocity and in the add for the sheraton no where does it say that you have to pay for parking and in room internet.

review_title: Do not be fooled by the rating!
review_text: This hotel is the worst hotel i have used. The place is old, smelly and roach infested. We got a deal from priceline; this hotel had a 3 star rating--- that is deceiving. This hotel should be rated 1 or below. We had a huge stow away roach in our luggage.

review_title: Gracious, welcoming hotel to a convention for weirdos.
review_text: I travel all over the country lecturing at anime and gaming conventions so I can say without reservation that the Sheraton Dallas went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable and convenient. With the exception of parking capacity, it was a perfect stay.

review_title: Stolen items, surcharges, and stairs, Oh my!
review_text:
I know how quick people are to blame lost items on sticky fingered maids, but when it comes my personal items I am like a hawk. I left a diamond ring on the counter when I went for a swim, came back and was surprised to find the room (somewhat) clean, and my ring nowhere to be found.
Needless to say I was treated like chicken little when I tried to get it back, and now I'm sure it's gone for good. I'd hate to point fingers, but the sheraton has had many incidents of theft and now I see why.
Wifi was $12.00, valet parking was $21, self parking was $7 and by the end of the trip I spent more money on my hotel than on my vacation! They will nickel and dime you from the start, so be prepared!
The elevators were clogged all day with teenagers here for a convention and when I did manage to cram myself into the screeching box of death they made me nauseous and dizzy for hours, I eventually gave up and ended up taking 14 flights of stairs to and from my room just to avoid the chaos of the kids and the macabre amusement park ride that was the elevator system.
All in all it wasn't worth the money, I'm missing a diamond ring, and my thighs are burning. Pick a better hotel!
DO NOT RECOMMEND!
Great catering services for conference! Awesome selection and variety of foods and beverages. Very attentive staff.

Checked in to attend a lecture held at the hotel. Rooms are obviously very old and have that old smell to them, at least my room was. I would not say the room was filthy but it did not smell clean. Bathroom was old and towels were questionable. TV was the old boxy type, heck, even holiday inn express has flatscreens! Also, tv was oddly placed. Was on the ground floor and could hear upstairs guests walking in their room. It's like sleeping in someone's old house, i guess. If they put you in a second floor room, there is no elevator! You would have to lug your stuff up the stairs!
Stayed one night. Service was great. The self serve kiosk for snacks was fun for the family. Rooms were comfortable and modern. Would definitely stay again.
Super fab! We love the great service and especially the COOKIES!

Last minute trip -should have asked what the charges were for my pet! They charge $75 for "pet cleaning fee"!!!! I figure that just cleaning the room would take care of anything my small dog might have left behind. Hotels shouldn't take dogs if they charge this exorbitantly!
Add to that the upstairs guests who came in at 11 pm, showered and tromped around, watched TV for a couple of hours, and then got up at 6!!!
Think I'll give this place a miss next time.
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites San Jose Airport

review_text: Stayed here for 2 nights. Was very nice, comfortable bed, clean and well maintained. Would stay here again.
Had a great stay, service was excellent. The staff went out of their way to ensure we were comfortable and happy.

review_title: Hands down the best hotel in Dallas!
review_text: Thank you jaclyn for making sure I had an unforgettable experience!

review_title: I will not stay here again.
review_text: The staff is great, but they can't polish up an old relic. The bathroom was so small that it is comical. The toilet is wedged into a small slot between the tub and the sink. There were plumbing noises in the wall all night. The bed was horrible. The bathtub fills up as you shower, so you have to shut it off and let it drain periodically. Don't do it!
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites San Jose Airport

review_text:
do I think it was worth $100/nt? No way! Here are the pros and cons:
Pros: clean, comfortable, friendly staff, [I had an issue and it was fixed within 15 mins], nice lounge, easy access to airport and freeway
Cons: sliding glass door in room is not meant to be open therefore no way to get fresh air, no in room safe, coffee pot is in bathroom, not close to any restaurant.
There is a bowling alley next door with a coffee shop.
My sleep number bed did work but was very noisy when changing firmness. 
This hotel did look a lot better than some other options around. Like I said it was clean and it fit my needs [a place to sleep] at the time.
Great Hyatt and nice location. Not cheap to get anywhere from here if you want to leave for dinner though.
No complaints. Nice room, Reasonable rate, we enjoyed the pool nd hot tub. Close to restrurants and the airport.
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites San Jose Airport

review_title: Entrance is modern, clean, nice decor. I'm not sure if this is the same hotel now that I walk in the room.
review_text: The gentleman that checked me in had a horrible attitude. Its not a good impression when I'm in town on business looking for places to reccomend to our meeting planners. When I walked in the room, it felt like I had gome back in time. The multi color bed quilt, box tv, stained green floor, all decor actually, came from a 1960s decorator and the lobby was designed by someone looking to the future. Very confused. Doesnt look like the pics online AT ALL! Its $150 a night so at least try to make it nicer. Wont be back and will not recommend.

Came forthe sharks game and were happily pleased!! The staff helped us fid grocery stores and places to eat. The room had a fridge and microwave so we could stock up on drinks and snacks for before and after the game! It's not a four star super classy hotel... But it's cheap it's clean and it's perfect for a night after the game :) very happy, will continue crashing here after the games!!
The place to spend the weekend. Service is top notch. Rooms are wonderfully furnished.
Just came back from a stay at this property. This is a great hotel - the rooms were very clean, updated and well appointed. Great sushi at the bar as well.
Staff unfriendly. Pool trash had vomit all over it. Trash in room behind couch. Remote missing.
Got 20ish bedbugs bites in one night! Nightmare! Clean the room inside out, PLEASE!
They have perfected the business traveler hotel. This is it. Bathroom with separate shower. Total control of lights shades and temp from bed. Fast room service. Could not be better.

review_title: Not a good place to stay
review_text:
I travelled across us for 2 months and this was the worst one I hit. 
The hotel is situated very near to tram why will connect to main mass transit station why can be used to travel to sfo.
The day I checked in I didnt get a goos room. The hall ways were stinking and the rooms were filled with noisy people yelling at each other. I had a long flight and needed good rest but couldnt get it.
The AC was like a generator in the room which made so much noise I have to use ear plugs.
The sheets were not cleaned and had stains everywhere. 
The bathroom is too small to fit a grownup.
Next day I requested for another room and they told it will be changed next day. Then I went to a friends place to stay as I will not comfortable.
then I read about the reviews in trip advisor about the hotel renovation and to choose newly renovated rooms, I requested accordingly. When they gave one I regretted my decision. 
The new rooms were stinking with some wierd smell, I contacted front desk and they told all renovated rooms are like this. Of course the generator AC is the same here as well.
The last but not the least, there is no free wifi. You have to pay. Howeve, I took for one day and there is no signal in the room, I have to browse in reception.
Suggestion: complementary breakfast and wifi should be basic @ this price

We just stayed here and the club-level rooms were just remodeled and very nice/modern/clean. The front desk staff was very helpful and friendly. The pool was warm and we had a nice swim with our 4-year old daughter. This is not a fancy hotel, but its a nice, comfortable, inviting property for what it is. Only complaint: the elevators were super slow.

review_title: A great, cozy, friendly hotel with the best downtown location.
review_text: Our family stays here every year for the Dallas Christmas parade. We love the reception in the afternoon, Santa in the lobby, cookies before bed, and then breakfast in the morning. This hotel could not have a better downtown location!

The Magnolia Hotel was absolutely delightful. My boyfriend and I stayed for 4 nights over Thanksgiving this past November and it was so lovely. 
The hotel, first and foremost, is extremely accommodating. Anything we needed, we'd call the front desk and it would arrive in our room in 15 minutes flat. 
The daily breakfast is great. Not just bagels and cereal. Hot foods as well, bacon sausage eggs grits etc. It was great to wake up every morning to it. And it was constantly being replenish too. 
The happy hour nightly was a good way to start off the night, 2 free drinks per hotel guest (house wine, beer, sodas). There were also complimentary cookies and milk (coffee & tea as well) that were brought out nightly. These great little perks really made my stay. 
We'd valet our car daily and even though it was a tad pricey ($24 + tax per night) but well worth it, valets were quick and generous. Starbucks is also right downstairs (I'd usually get a coffee while waiting for the valet, perfect timing!) and if you don't have a car to get around in, they offer a free shuttle service to anywhere within a 3 mile radius, very convenient. The hotel location is great too. In the middle of downtown, close to everything. Bars. Lounges. Restaurants. The Sixth Floor Museum is close as well, which is a must see if you're ever in town. Overall, a great stay! 
Except for one thing... My boyfriend and I had left a few important items in the room when we checked out. Getting in contact with the director of housekeeping (who handles the lost & found box) was a nightmare. I called over and over and over again, only to get his voicemail. I was trying to pick up the items before leaving for NYC but I could not because no one ever got back to me. Eventually, I got his email address and received the items 4 days after leaving Dallas. For a hotel who's customer service was impeccable while I was staying, this situation was a bit disappointing. I do appreciate the time taken to send me the items back, however I believe it should've been handled a bit more efficiently.
Still, I would recommend the Magnolia Hotel Downtown Dallas nevertheless. It's a fantastic little gem.
Great hotel, location, and good price. Newspapers are also provided in the morning and the staff was outstanding.

We booked this hotel for a night on our second year anniversary and I have to say I'm very impressed. The staff are amazing, very thoughtful and helping. I requested a room in a higher floor and we were given a corner suite in the 23 floor with an amazing view. The elevators are very fast, never had to wait even two minutes to get them. Very clean and very tasteful rooms. Their jacuzzi in the spa is amazing- especially in the winter months. I wills definately come back again

review_title: Best hotel I've stayed in Dallas!
review_text: Suite was huge! Loved the full kitchen, where I cooked my girlfriends wonderful birthday dinner. Felt like if it was our own apartment downtown, Awesome view. Even though we didn't take advantages of the hotels free amenities It was money well spent.

review_title: Great location, clean and friendly. Good value for both business travel and leisure.
review_text: Have stayed at this hotel several time for business and for fun. Great location, clean rooms, friendly service and fair costs. They are upgrading rooms, which should make it even better!

Thx. Magnolia Hotel (Dallas)...you made our 1st Anniversary experience monumental. Between the host/hostess, valet and all its staff...the hospitality they displayed was flawless. We didn't have to lift a finger for anything. Affordable, family oriented, historic, in a premium location in Downtown Dallas..."WOW" we're sold for life. "Good-Bye" to all you over rated/priced hotels and "Hello" to our home away from home...MAGNOLIA your the best. :-)
Has to be the best hotel I've ever stayed in. The service was excellent, the room was real clean and the fact that it's downtown everything is in such a close walking distance from da hotel.

review_title: A great way to stay in Dallas, surrounded by everything.
review_text: ...It was awasome and had all you could need right by the hotel. The breakfast buffet was awesome

review_title: The hotel has antique charm with all the modern luxaries.
review_text: The staff was friendly and helpful. The hotel is located in the heart of downtown that is undergoing changes for the better. It is centrally located to many area attractions and within walking distance to many museums and parks. The elevators are original to the building, which add to the antique charm. Be patient though- sometimes they are speedy, sometimes slow, and sometimes they take you up when you mean to go down, and vise versa. You just have to learn to appreciate them for what they are and smile about it. The cookies and milk are a bonus!

I stayed at the Magnolia Hotel during a business trip to Dallas. It was only a short walk to the office and was surrounded by several really good restaurants. The hotel staff was very accomodating and the bar staff on the second floor was very entertaining! We had a great time during the complimentary happy hour. Yes, complimentary!
Enjoy your stay...
Highly recommend this hotel if your staying in Downtown Dallas! Has nice amenities & excellent decor!

We had 4 star expectations for this priceline 4 star property but it's a 3 star in reality. Friday night we were looking forward to a 
4 star meal, only to find all restaurants closed. The hotel was overrun by hockey kids and their families, which came with hockey games in hallways @ 3 am, parking In red zones all around the property - very unsafe, and indescriminatr use of luggage racks without bell personnel , something unavailable to me . Not 4 star!
Great value and good service at this historic downtown hotel. I would stay at the Magnolia Dallas again.

Currently stopping here on a business trip - i am HH Diamond. Room was fine - standard DoubleTree room. Flat screen TV, but no fridge.
Executive lounge was terrible - consisted of trail mix, goldfish and cans of soda. No water - i guess that was why there was 4 bottles of water in my room with $2.50 and $5.00 price tags on them.
$18 per night parking charge - this is the most i have ever paid for parking anywhere. Seems more expensive than airport parking.
Hotel restaurants were pretty bad too - very limited menu, very expensive and seemed a little pretentious. Room service menu was a lot better, still seemed a little on the expensive side, but i guess 22% room service charge is the norm.
I may or may not stop here again if i was in the area. The rooms were crazy expensive ($1,200 for 4 nights + tax's) but it seemed that most of the hotels were sold out so there migt have been some event somwhere. Last time i was here i stopped in the Homewood Suites so might choose them next time if they are available.
Good staff and comfortable bed but noisy AC in the room, a lot of stains on carpets in the hall and could hear the next room's TV thru the wall.

We had to make a late last minute detour from santa cruz to San Jose when we couldn't get a room on the coast. The staff were so friendly and helpful even though we arrived at 10.30pm. 
The bed was one of the most comfortable I have ever slept in. Overall fab room, great staff and good location.

review_title: Great corp rate hotel with all the amenities on site
review_text: Love this hotel and personal service. They know me and remember the preferences I always ask for. Now I don't even have to ask! However without the great corporate rate, I would consider this a little pricey for the area

review_title: Book a room here!! Great experience!!
review_text: Aaaaaaamazing, a few rooms need kitchen and bathroom updating but bed was so sleeper friendly.. Ps elevators are like rocketships :)!!

Just spent a weekend here and was very pleased. Located right next to a Starbucks. Hotel offers free shuttle service, complimentary happy hour beer and wine and milk and cookies. Staff is very friendly. Property is well kept. Rooms are nice as well. Location is 10 minutes from American Airlines Center. 30 minutes from the Cowboys games. 10 minute walk to JFK museum. It's a good place to stay when in Dallas.
Has a fitness center. Small hot tub. Flat screen TVs. Spacious suites. Bar. Computers to use. Free wifi. Very pleased.

review_title: Do you know the way to San jose!
review_text:
Excellent location in downtown San Jose. Great lounge/night club. Great getaway for night out in San jo. Walking distance to many resteraunts and night clubs. Very comfortable bed with in room bar and snacks. Would definitely stay there again when I'm
In San Jose!
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton San Jose Downtown

review_text:
This hotel is beautiful, modern and well run. Our stay was flawless down to the last detail. I even left one of my favorite tops behind and when I realized this I called but I never expected to see it again. I was pleasantly surprised when it showed up on my door step a couple days later. It really shows when an establishment is so well run that they are able to take care of the little things that generally fall through the cracks. 
I would return to this hotel for sure.
Great hotel, location, staff. Beautifully decorated
Great stay. They upgraded our stay to a suite. Valet and staff was nice and courteous. Will definitely stay there again in the future.

Needs severe refurbishment. I have no idea how this hotel got good ratings. I live in hotels for work, and this one by far was the most uncomfortable creepy hotel. Everything was wet in my room. The towels were damp before I even turned on the shower. It clearly has a problem controlling the humidity so all the rooms had a very musty URINE smell. The only positive thing was the window could open to air it out.

I have been in San Jose on business for over 30 days in 2011 alone. I tried other hotels, but the Doubletree is my place. Rooms could need an upgrade but the HD flattv us a great start. Internet is ok and included in my rate but could be upto 13-14$ a day.
Parking is just to expensive. 18$ a day really adds up. For me that +350$ I have paid in parking this year alone could have been used for many fun things.

Got thisroom via priceline where it was rated as a 4 star property inthe same category as The Fairmont. It is NOT a 4 star property. Well maybe it was in 1985. 
Location: it is in the middle of office buildings and the airport. Nothing to do around it. For a great shopping/dining experience, head to Santana Row about 15 minutes away.
Staff: very friendly and cordial.
Rooms: very tired and dated and show significant signs of aging. Certainly not up to A 4 star rating. maybe 2.5 to 3 star. How this property was in the same category as The Fairmont is beyond me.

I travel about 20-30 weeks a year but have never experienced such customer focus. Literally, from the time I gave the valet my keys until I checked out, everyone was awesome. The staff went the extra mile to make our stay the best.

review_title: A nice haven while in midst of travels
review_text:
I stay at the Grand Hyatt DFW several times per year, either due to teavel mishaps(cancelled flights at DFW) or planned when I cannot get a late connecting flight but am still able to get to DFW and then I catch early morning connection. 
The hotel has always had great service along with great rooms. I say this because they recently renovated their rooms and while they are still very nice, personally I liked the older rooms better (they were not old to begin with). 
Service is exceptional. Front desk always with friendly interactions even despite the fact that many guests are sometimes "less then friendly" due to travel disruptions etc. I recently broke a bottle on my room floor and instead of coming to clean it, they came to move me to an upgraded room. Perhaps it was all that was available but it was more then I was expecting especially since it was my fault. 
Beds are exceptionally comfortable. Bathrooms have everything u need (even toothpaste). Their new electronic room controls for lights and window shades are nice and easy to use. 
All in all, it's a nice place to stay and sometimes I catch myself wishing for a delay or cancelation as an excuse to stay.

Wow, this is a convenient and awesome hotel. As a single, I went down to dinner and thought I would be stuck in a corner, instead they have some great bar type areas where the singles can have a great dining experience. The food was great, wine prices expensive, but oh well. I was very happy with the hotel and the restaurant
Connected to convention center, so conveniently located if you are attending a conference. Clean, nice rooms. Average service from front desk staff.

review_title: Awesome! Like being at home, but with room service
review_text: Friendly people, superb rooms, nice location... I'll definitely be back.

review_title: all the fluff without the doubletree substance
review_text:
I'm poor artist trash but a road warrior with 1,000,000+ miles logged. Love the doubletree chain.
Checked in here last minute because of s change of plans. When you do that, they screw you with the highest rates. Okay, as long as I can rest - had just driven all over the bay area teaching dance workshops. Just wanted a quiet room.
Want on the fewest side, but the staff were having a LOUD conversation outside my room early early am. There was a service door nearby and I think that was the one slamming all night long.
Check in service was personable and friendly. Check out serbice was valid and unconcerned with my lack of rest.
Ceiling in room had obvious water damage, and crumbling ceiling tiles. Drapes were stained.
Would expect this and be fine with it for a lower price. When I pay a premium, i'd expect a premium experience. Next time might stay elsewhere. Might be looking for a new chain for my loyalty programs since this is my second negative experience in a month

review_title: Like most Doubletree hotels this one is fantastic.
review_text: I love these hotels. The beds are fantastic! I appreciate the consistently good service, clean spacious rooms, and beautifully maintained common areas.

I state here one night on business and it was a great experience. The rooms were modern with all automated blinds and lights. Very spacious rooms with comfortable beds. Room service was good and fast service. The restaurant service was also great for breakfast.
No complaints about this Hyatt!!

I've stayed at the Manchester Grand Hyatt, the Fukuoka Grand Hyatt, and now the DFW GRand Hyatt and it is always such a pleasure. The rooms are modern, clean and immaculate, but the staff is what really sets these hotels apart. Friendly, attentive, thoughtful, you name it, they get it. There are enough stressors in a traveler's day without them becoming another one. For example, when I ordered room service they said it would take about 30 minutes, and when it showed up in 15 the person delivering it apologized for being early. That may seem trivial, but I had tried to squeeze in a shower between ordering and delivery, and when that shower was interrupted, the fact that the delivery person knew what time I was expecting my food, and thought too apologize for being early, meant the difference between my being irritated or my stoked to have my food already. Aside from that, use Fast Board, eat the food, drink the wine, get the massage, you won't regret a minute of your time here.

I very much enjoyed my stay there. From arrival the valet/ concerige staff to the front desk were wonderful. Anything I needed was very prompt and friendly. Room was very modern and clean. Loved the soak tub and Ihome BED WAS AMAZING! Will use them again
Tell them you do not want a room by the elevator. Very busy all night long
great hotel, daniel treated me like a king whenever i entered the lobby

review_title: Take it or leave it attitude
review_text: I booked a queen suite, and upon arrival I was given a room that barely fit the bed. Hotel manager didn't even have the courtesy to advise me. Attitude of hotel was too bad we don't have any more suites. Don't care you booked it in advance.

This was such a beautiful hotel. Stayed only one night, but would have no problem staying longer. We slept so hard after a very long day. Almost forgot we were in hotel. The complimentry breakfast was amazing. My only issue we found was none of the staff could assist us with directions. When in San Jose we found our Home away from home.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Jose-Silicon Valley

review_text:
Very nice hotel. Clean, spacious rooms with tasteful decor. We liked the use of wood throughout. Courteous staff. Didn't have time to visit the bar or make use of the billiards lounge, but the pool and hot tub were very nice. Our family of four was traveling with grandparents and we were able to get adjoining rooms. Seems to be in a nice area and there were plenty of options for food nearby. Walking/driving maps are provided by the front desk- a nice touch. 
Our only complaint would be that the $10pp breakfast buffett did not look to be anything special. We opted to go out to McD's. For the quality of hotel, something like the breakfast should be free. We frequent a Midwest chain called Drury Inn and for about the same quality/price, the breakfast buffett and evening reception are free. Those additions would make it truly top-notch.

Stayed at the hotel in late August. Took cab from DFW airport($50) and Carlos was waiting at the door with a smile to take our bags. We checked in around noon (2pm listed) and Carlos was waiting and took bags and showed us the room and amenities. Our room was a suite on a high floor and exceeded our expectations. 3 rooms.. Bedroom had closet with full ironing board with starch, flatscreen tv, and the best black out shades over blinds. batgoffered wonderful soaps and the hallway had a full size painting. The living area that a long couch, flatscreen, work area, coffee table. Oh, and all tge lights had plugIns.. I love that!!!
Our kitchen was full size kitchen just like an apartment. Utensils, pots and pans, and even a single cup coffee maker. Breakfast was hot eggs, a meat and French toast or other treats. They also had breads, yogurts, and fresh fruit... The best and every morning complimentary! There is also a happy hour with two free drinks(they do need a snack- nuts or pretzels) hot cookies and milk from 8 to 10 and they were yummy.
Amazing service, great amenities and nice pool. I highly recommend this hotel.

review_title: Nice decor. Pleasant surroundings. Absolutely efficient, friendly, attentive staff.
review_text: This was a great hotel. I would recommend it to anyone and will be back myself. Only improvement could be in quality of room service food and breakfast buffet. Not bad at all, but not great like other things in this hotel. Breakfast buffet could have some more variety.

The manager of thus location is very friendly. The suite we stayed in was very nice with a fire place and two bedrooms. We had difficulties booking room online also had difficulties getting the front dest staff to help us over the phone. When we arrived and finally had a chance to speak with manager he was very helpful and we were able to work out all issues at that time.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Jose-Silicon Valley

review_text: Enjoyed the comfort and size of the rooms. Staff seemed like they cared about how comfortable I was.
Ease of travel access accompanied by wonderful accommodations made for an extremely comfortable and personal experience.
It was a nice place. Has an Oceans 11 feel. Only complaints are they seemed to be doing some work in the next room and it was annoying and they could kick up the cleaning of the bathroom a notch.

Fairly basic hotel - was a little surprised at how plain it was. Location isn't near any major attractions. Having said that, the front desk clerk sent us to a fantastic sushi restaurant across the street.

I love this Hilton! Not the flashiest, but I've had the best sleep and best service here. The staff will go above and beyond. 
The wifi was a little slow but I had free wifi, so I can't complain. 
Great place!!
The rooms were clean and updated. The beds are comfortable. The staff was awesome! Very friendly and attentive. Claudia and Shana were fantastic! Would reccommend this hotel to all my friends.

Shana was our group's waitress on our last morning. She is everything you want a waitress to be: friendly, attentive and service-minded. Crown plaza is blessed to have her on staff. Great end to a great trip. Thank you Shana.

review_title: Beautiful historic hotel with outstanding service.
review_text: Loved everything about this hotel. The staff was so friendly and helpful.

review_title: A suite deal --kind of like a residence inn with extra (v)room!!
review_text: the hotel magnolia is nice. it's not as nice as my house but it's nicer than a residence inn. for 3 days I stayed in a 2 bedroom suite equivalent. A regular queen bed suite plus a 2 bedroom suite. The 2 bedrooms shared the common area. A full functional kitchen was present. the kitchen was nice. the service was excellent. the food was very okay ..like a pretty good wannabe frou frou restaurant you know? the restaurant and room service hours were somewhat limited. room service ended at 11 pm. Still better than the residence inn which has no room service. the hotel was very close to lots of good restaurants. I thought the hotel's location was excellent. overall I think the hotel is an excellent blend of value , class and comfortableness(not a word but you know what I mean). BTW ... the 2 bedroom suite was nearly 1000 square feet. I will go back.

review_title: Older downtown hotel building with lots of character, kept in great shape with modern comforts.
review_text: Granted, I stayed at the government discounted rate, but considering how nice the hotel was, it was a steal! From the nightly happy hour (really happy when its free!) to the friendly staff and good hot breakfasts along with a really comfortable room, this was an excellent stay. When I return to Dallas, I'm not looking anywhere besides the Magnolia. I definitely recommend trying the Iron Cactus restaurant next door also.

review_title: Very comfortable, clean, and very good service.
review_text: Very nice modern decor restaurant was excellent. Rooms very clean & comfortable.
Nothing bad to say about this hotel. It was clean and comfortable. I wish they had an airport shuttle.

review_title: Probably not the usual Hilton standard but no real criticism
review_text: We stayed for 3 nights and found the hotel perfectly acceptable. Most Staff were friendly, hot tub and gym were good. Room very clean.

I travel to the US from the UK every month, so I've stayed in my fair share of hotels. I stay at the Crowne Plaza whenever I'm in San Jose.
The location is great. Walking distance to a bunch of good restaurants and bars, and a $2 bus ride to Valley Fair Mall. 
The staff are great. The rooms are as you would expect in a 4 star hotel. Clean and spacious and comfortable. 
Breakfast is OK. The bar serves dinner. It's usually pretty quiet in there, and the quality of the food is not great, but it's ok for a beer and a sandwich. With so many good restaurants nearby, that's no real hardship. 
Over all a great stay (this time was 7 nights), and I'll keep coming back.

review_title: An alright stay on Santana row
review_text: Myself and himself stayed for one sat night in October. We found the hotel to be very outdated and noisy. The doors of the rooms slam loudly and our room over looking the courtyard was extremely noisy with a wedding going on. We also heard other guests complain upon checking out. Upon exciting the elevator on our floor we noticed the carpet didn't look like it was cleaned in a week. Our room however was spotless in the end but it was off putting. The breakfast was quite good however just be warned it wasn't as great as we had expected. Oh and also the roof top bar was closed at 630 which we weren't informed of while the weather was excellent.

review_title: Someone is always there to help you but no one is In your way...love the staff!
review_text: Great beds, fantastic breakfast each morning, perfect place to stay. I enjoyed my stay.
