review_text: I love the Farirmont hotel. It is so pretty at Christmas time or anytime but it was amazing. They had a real gingerbread house that you could go inside. It was amazing. If you go to San Francisco stay at the Farirmont hotel.
Always.i come here every six moths and always the bets experience, so far. One only complain. Room 552 has the bathroom which is really cold!

I stay at this legendary hotel at least once a year. This is my favorite hotel in SF. Nob Hill location
great suites and a outstanding sfaff. 
Make sure you you have the Pancakes Oscar in the morning.... They are the best....

review_title: Great hotel and a real San Francisco landmark
review_text:
I stayed at the Fairmont for a business meeting in November 2011. When in San Francisco previously I have usually stayed at one of the Fisherman's Wharf hotels but decided on this occasion to try something different. The first thing that hits you is the lobby- extremely grand. Check in was fast, friendly and efficient. My room was huge - on the corner of the 3rd floor with views out on two sides, towards the Bay and the city. It had two king sized beds, a walk-in wardrobe bigger than some hotel rooms I've stayed in and was spotlessly clean. Even better, it had an iron / ironing board (a personal gripe of mine is when hotels refuse to lend you one for "safety reasons" but will happily rip you off for ironing). When wanting to book a restaurant via the concierge, the guy at check- in spotted I'd been waiting for a while, called me over and did it himself. Great service.
Overall, I'd highly recommend this hotel when staying in San Fran, but be prepared for a fair walk down what felt like a vertical street to get to the city centre....

review_title: Very average room... Not best location
review_text: I was a tad disappointed with this hotel.... Lobby= beautiful... Actually stunning.... But to to room, which was supposed to be big enough to fit a portable bed if we decided we (friend & I) didn't want to share a bed, as they had no twins available... But getting back to room size, we could barely fit extra rack for suit case let alone another bed....as for Location, well it's a lovely view, perched on top of "snob hill", but makes exploring a chore because the road to it is soooooo steep (had to take heels off walking down as it's that steep!) so not a handy, easily accessible location.... I would have perfered bottom of hill near Union Square, cheaper, less impressive lobby... Service was ok but hardly worth the $$$ for the tiny room... Oh did I mention window in room looking at wall?

We just arrived at the hotel for our stay, this is the third time we have stayed at the hotel. We we arrived at noon the line to check in was 30 minutes long so we dropped our luggage and headed out to enjoy the city! When we came back to the hotel we were in great spirits and checked in at the front. The man checked us in (Scott) had absolutely no personality and was not amused by our excitement to be in the main tower of the Fairmont. Once we got into our room we got settled and went to get ice, however our ice bucket had water and a diet coke, which tells me the room was not cleaned properly. I called down to the desk and the lady was, once again not very amused and asked if I wanted to be connected to the house keeping manager.(really?) how about, "I apologize and will have that taken care of for you" strange. Now I sit here and a room service rep comes and doesn't know what to do with our ice bucket. I am just not impressed and hopefully out stay will improve. Wait it just got better! One glass in the room to make a drink! I suddenly feel that I am at a ramada inn.

Such helpful staff. Sent an email prior to our stay asking about family friendly travel alternatives to Oakland A's stadium & received very prompt and helpful advice. The room looked exactly like the photos on the Internet so there were no bad surprises. We have recommended this hotel to other Australians traveling to San Fran due to its service, superb location and cleanliness. Looking forward to staying again in September next year!!
The Grand Old Dame of San Francisco. Wonderful atmosphere, great service and excellent location! We will be back Fairmont!

review_title: Grand hotel but some things lacking....
review_text:
Firstly there is no denying this is a fabulous looking old style hotel.
A little away from union square and atop a large hill which is a tough walk but the payoff is the great views down the hill!
Downside for me was the service..... After travelling for 14 hours we found no-one at reception at 8pm to check us in and waited 15 mins to be checked in without an apology.... 
In addition service at the bar was slow as there was a large party in so we were almost last to be looked after.
The concierge and porters though were very helpful and knowledgeable.
Lack of complimentary wifi and tea and coffee in room also not great.

Extremely helpful staff. Was upgraded to premium room at no charge because they found out it was our honeymoon. All staff were kind and friendly. Beautiful rooms. Very clean. Extremely close to union square. We walked through north beach and to fishermans wharf from the hotel. Taxi rank around the corner with the cable cars also very close. Surrounded by retail stores. Location great!!! Would definitely recommend to friends and will return.

I travel a lot especially in the US I often try and stay in a fairmont as u until now have had excellent experiences. However at this hotel it felt like an inner city airport hotel in which we were kept awake all night with the noise! At over Â£300 at night I expected more won't be so quick to opt for or recommend a fairmont in the future. When I complained got the feeling they had better things to deal with!

I stayed again at the hotel for the second time in two months on business. This time I stayed in the older and more historic part of the hotel. The newer section has the premium rooms which are larger, you get free wifi and cost about $30 more. I actually preferred staying in the older part of the hotel.
The hotel is right next to Union Square. It is also next to the Tenderloin. So there are a lot of homeless people around the area begging for money.

On the first day we were placed once floor where all other rooms seemed to be used by people making a film. Unfortunately filming started at midnight and carried on until early morning. It was a struggle to change rooms. The rooms are small and the bathrooms are very compact and hard to negotiate. On one occasion we arrived back at 6pm to find the room had not been cleaned.

Had high hopes staying at this iconic hotel. Only stayed the one night on business (a Saturday) but let's just say left feeling very disappointed. The foyer and public areas of this hotel are indeed spectacular and are very well maintained. However when you get to your room (deluxe room on the 7th floor) you are cruelly let down with a room that has absolutely no view with minimal light. Disappointingly attention to detail also seems to suffer somewhat with the net curtain dirty and also significantly torn, and there were also quite a few areas in the room that had major cracks and flakey paintwork. It is clear that the hotel spend their money on maintaining the public areas and then cut corners on the guest rooms (certainly from my expeience this time anyway). I have stayed at other Fairmont hotels in the past staying at their Santa Monica hotel and the two they have in Bermuda. None of them really come close to the San Francisco site and location but all of them far exceed on the guest room experience by a mile! I guess the major question is would I come here again particularly with my wife and the honest answer is a resounding NO! For the price there are better experiences in San Francisco out there.

review_title: Gorgeous comfortable hotel - at the top of a huge hill!
review_text:
We stayed in The Fairmont for 3 nights in August.
This is a beautiful hotel right at the top of the very, VERY steep Mason St. Essentially you just need to make sure you get a cab there with your luggage and not walk up like we did!!!
The hotel is in a great location. Fisherman Wharf is at the bottom of the hill on one side, and Union Square is at the bottom on the other side. Check-in was fast and friendly. The girl dealing with us took the time to point some landmarks and good places to eat on a map of San Fran.
The room was clean and comfortable, with a good sized bathroom. The shower was fantastic! Breakfast wasn't included for us and was expensive to have in the restaurant.
The Tonga Room bar and restaurant was great. We had a couple of cocktails there each night before bed. There was a live band there each night of our stay. The food in The Tonga Room was very very tasty, focusing mainly on Asian-style and Polynesian cuisine.
All in all we really enjoyed our stay in the Fairmont and would recommend it to anyone looking for an elegant, well-located hotel in San Francisco.
hotel limp, pessoal super atencioso, preÃ§o excelente localizaÃ§Ã£o a melhor de San Francisco, tem tudo perto, atÃ© o bonde famoso, recomendo a todos
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites San Francisco Fisherman's Wharf

review_text: was very pleasantly surprised with this hotel, wasn't expecting very much but it really is lovely. Our room seem like one of the newer ones and it was nice, the windows and the like are a bit dated but it never bothered us, we were there to sightsee. Pleasently surprised that we got breakfast vouchers, we hadn't been expecting them and the breakfast next door really set u up for the day. Any of the staff we encountered where lovely and very helpful, housekeeping went out of their way to get us a travel plug and where in r room in minutes, I was expecting them to take their time, she even came in and helped me get the iron going, so hats off to her. Very central location for everything.

review_title: Nice hotel and good location in city centre
review_text: San francisco is a magnificent and friendly city and the handlery a good place to stay at! There is a swimming pool, quiet rooms and in san francisco it is really an obligation to cycle the golden gate bridge :-)!

There are too many choices in his area for this hotel to charge for wifi and for access to the fitness room. I travel to San fran all the time and I will avoid this one and go back to the smaller hotels with the same size rooms but I get free wifi and fitness access

My husband and I stayed here for one night. Very impressed. Great attention to detail, clean rooms, most important to me was the clean bathroom. And that's not expected from a hotel. Bed was super comfortable. Down side was no refridgerator in the room, no pool if your taking little ones, and no shuttle. take walking shoes ladies, not flip flops! Its a nice walk down to pier 39 but definently need a cab back up those steep hills. Taxi to union square is cheaper than the cable car. We paid $6 to get to the shops! Take an ice chest with your drinks. We will stay again, soon!

review_title: Great lobby but that's about all!
review_text: Booked for our honeymoon based on the Fairmont reputation. The room was average- no coffee making facilities, small bathroom. The shower was appalling, nothing more than a pathetic drip, as a woman with long hair it made washing it a nightmare! You could hear the hot water pipes banging from other guestrooms. I've stayed in many high end hotels worldwide with work for the last ten years, this was a let down. The location was ok if you didn't mind the 3 very steep hills back from union square- you do expect this inSan Fran but there are better located properties for the Union Square area.

The one thing that you expect from a hotel is that you can sleep and that's where the fairmont really fails. I could go on about the location and grand entrance hall but the bottom line is that my husband and I had 3 terrible nights here. The room was small, the bed was tiny (smaller even that our double bed at home) however it was the thin walls that were the real issue. You could hear people in the corridoor and the elevator sounds clearly. On top of this the walls between the rooms were so flimsy that we were woken up by the sound of the people in the next room turning their lightswitches on and off! We could hear every single word that they said to each other too which felt like an invasion of their privacy. Even with the loud air con unit we could hear every room around us the entire night. When we mentioned this at checkout the lady behind the desk was not at all fussed about our poor experience which was a real let down since it 
was our honeymoon. 
Save your money and go somewhere else. What is the point of a hotel if you can't sleep there? The fairmont is not fit for purpose.
Great exterior facade as well as for the lobby and outlets. The rooms are a dive; service is sh1t. Never staying here again ever!

review_title: Great base camp for San Fran
review_text: This hotel was situated perfectly to get around San Fran. It was clean and the restaurant was of a very high standard

Good location at union sq and the food at the daily grill is very nice and worth trying. We were on honeymoon and they knew this, even though we were there just for a few days I expected a better room, we had no view what so ever and the bathroom was in need of updating, it all seemed so dark and gloomy. I had no idea until we stumbled it that it had a pool! And the rooms around the pool looked so much better, strange that they didn't offer any of these, as I said we wanted a nice room. Other than that the hotel is ok for a quick stop over. We visited the intercontinental and that was amazing.

review_title: Great base for seeing San Francisco if you are a fan of grand hotels
review_text:
Honesty says that I should start by saying I am not a great fan on large, traditional hotels. That said, the Fairmont does the model very well and the staff were impeccable. It is a classic large hotel. The is little "shelter" for the normal guest from large corporate functions, which upsets some of the classic charm of the hotel.
That said, the prices at the hotel are very reasonable.
The franchised out gym was a real quality disappointment and the Hawian themed restaurant, an absolute disaster..but then I am sure most people will eat out.

Pour le parking de la voiture essayer de trouver une place dehors car les parkings sont a 30 -40 dollars les 24 heures !! l'entrÃ©e de l'hÃ´tel comme les chambres sont kitch mais agrÃ©able avec le style de l'hÃ´tel . Acceuil chaleureux . Deux lits mais vraiment petit . Une sdb avec baignoire . review_title: A great stay in the heart of San Francisco
review_text: Tis hotel is a gem in the heart of the city. We had a chance to stay in one of the pool side rooms that was like a little oasis. Being able to have a sun drenched afternoon poolside in the city was a welcomed relief from countless hours of sightseeing. The rooms were really clean but could use an freshening up to modernize them. The entire staff at the hotel were very accommodating and really helpful with our requests/questions. We'll definitely be back again!

review_title: Fantastic location, cute rooms, small shower
review_text:
I stayed here at the end of august with my boyfriend. We originally booked a petite room, but upon arrival we were upgraded to a bigger room with two double beds, which was a nice surprise. The room was really clean and very nice, but the shower was extremely small and it was difficult to take a shower without flooding the whole bathroom. We were given a room facing the street and it was somewhat loud at night. This didn't bother us at all because we're used to all the noise in NYC, but it might be annoying for people unused to city noises at night. 
The location was absolutely perfect for sightseeing, especially if you're a tourist without a car, and it was really nice to get back to such a welcoming staff and room in the evenings.

review_title: Hip Hotel amid all the action!
review_text: This hotel is really cool...great location where you can walk around and find great restaurants, unique and very hip shops, street stalls and food, music, people watching and more - Austin at its best! The staff is pleasant and accommodating. If you are looking for an opulant room, you will not find it here, but you will find an extraordinarily well-designed, well organized room with great linens, bath products, water pressure in the shower and a terrace/balcony for every room. We love this trendy, unique hotel and would return every visit. We didn't get to dine, but they have a great-looking terrace bar/restaurant that was appealing and popular.

review_title: Most unique, yet classy say in Austin
review_text: The hotel is a refab of an older hotel. It was executed in a minimal yet low-key comfortable style. You won't find the trendy trappings of a dance club or such but there is a bar and courtyard to use. It's hip without trying hard at all. If I had 3 thumbs, they'd get 'em all.

review_title: Loved the hotel but way over priced
review_text: The San Jose is an awesome hotel in a great area! Keep in mind there is NOT room service or turn down service (atleast not when I was there). The rooms are clean and beds comfy...It is a trendy hotel with zero fluff. Because its such a simple place is why I think its way over priced. $300 a night is steep for a simple room....just saying....your really only sleeping there. The rest of the time you're out and about. They do have a cool patio area and pool...Its the type of hotel you share with a friend if on a budget for sure...I've done 3 times now so I must love it. Lol

Great hotel in a good spot in Austin, just south of the cbd.
Staff were very good and the bar is very cool, plenty of locals like to hang out there as well.
Rooms were really nice and mine was away from the street and really quiet.

review_title: Good location but that's about it
review_text: We stayed here for 4 nights in early august 2011. Not being a native, driving in a big city was a bit daunting, which didnt help when told at the reception that although I needed valet parking I had to drive from the front to the back of the hotel, I would have assumed valet parking was what it said on the tin, apparently not. The concierge staff were helpful when we needed them as were the bell boys. The hotel is reasonably clean as was the room. The bathroom was too small and the room around the bed was limited. The hotel is in need of some modernization as it is looking tired. The only plus side is the location. Close to union square and all the main shops as well as Westfield shopping centre which is only 4 blocks away. The cable car turnaround is 3 blocks away downhill or it can be picked up on the corner of union which is about 150 yds away. 3 star is about right but having stayed in better 3 star city hotels, I wouldn't choose this one again

This hotel is one of many in a great location close to most things.
Having booked two double rooms three months ahead, on arrival only one room had been booked. They found this was an error on their part and unfortunately the other room they gave us had two single beds. Rooms were clean and serviced promptly.
The complimentary breakfasts were wonderful with only a short wait for tables. We had one evening meal on our last day in the dining room which was okay. Service in the dining room was prompt but all meals were slow in coming to the table. We also had to ask for water as this was never offered.
We had a lovely stay and would return if I could get a larger bed.

I'm surprised we weren't charged by the sheet for toilet paper used. if you thought Starbucks has expensive coffee try their cafe a mile from the room first thing in the morning and wait for minutes to spend $5 for mud.

My girlfriends and I stayed at handlery for sf 2011 pride weekend. We were given a small 2 bed room but the room was quite, the maids gave us fresh liens and towels when we asked and even the room service was amazing! We did have a noise complaint, we said our sorries to our neighbors who understood that my girl and I had just got engaged. The check in and out process was so easy and all the employees were extremly gay friendly. Thanks again for making june 24-26,2011 the best weekend of our lives. Special shot outs to the bellman, jose, for bringing out 200000 suitcases to our room and understanding that we had no clue ho to tip, he got a 20 though!

review_title: Excellent, wonderful hotel and wonderful service
review_text: Wonderful experience at this historic hotel. Everything was terrific, we will definitely be back!

review_title: Good value for many, great location, excellent service
review_text: We stayed at the Handlery with two small children and had a good room although with no view but quiet and comfortable beds. Service was excellent including organising a doctor and letting us back into the room after checkout because we forgot our travel documents. It was clean, the pool great for the kids. Only negative point is breakfast and food in general next door at the daily grill. The vouchers get you a very average breakfast, service is not efficient (impossible to get hard or soft-boiled eggs) and the dinner we had there was very average. If possible have breakfast somewhere else. Otherwise great location for tourism and shopping. We would go back to the Handlery.

review_title: Well located but noisyyyy at night
review_text:
Stayed there for three nights in august 11. On the good side the hotel is located few steps from Union Square which is the central point for a lot of things. The rooms was clean although a bit small. 
Our room was located on the 7th floor facing the west side i think. It was very very noisy at night, could hear everything in the street even if we were not facing any street. It didnt help that the window would close well...
Also the parking if way too expensive , they wanted to charge us $43 per nights. After driving around the hotel a little bit we found a parking for $25 per night just two blocks away, so if you go there park your car somewhwere else.

review_title: Amazing location, large room for city location and good value.
review_text:
We arrived there as the last leg of our honeymoon and were thrilled to find a bottle of sparkling wine, congratulations card and a bag of snacks waiting for us in the room. The location is fantastic with most attractions daily walkable.
The room was large given it is a central city location although the room could definitey benefit from double glazing as we were woken up early one morning by a protest outside and could hear a few sirens from the room.
Breakfast was lovely at the daily grill, however we always had to wait at least ten minutes to be seated even though there were some tables empty but set up for lunch.
I would however definitely recommend this hotel to anyone.

review_title: The best and charmy hotel ever
review_text: When I'm up to the Bay I always stop by at the Fairmont. Best one ever and the service it's just astonishing...

review_title: Well located, clean, comfortable, meals well priced & tasty
review_text: Having read reviews on this hotel we requested an inside room because of potential noise. That worked well for us, the room was quiet. The view was not particularly good - all back of building stuff outside but we felt better to be quiet. Good service from stall too

Stayed three nights celebrating 30th anniversary. Champagne and goodies waiting in room for us. Nice little spotlessly clean king room overlooking streets of S F. Yes, we had some street noise..no biggie, it's S F! Our last morning there when we were going to sleep in..The Frank Hotel directly across the street from our room, employees began the loudest protest that I have ever heard at 7am sharp! No sleeping in for anyone! They ruined our last day! It would have been nice if the front desk personnel would have apologized or at least mentioned it, after all I just spent almost $700 with them.. Oh well!
The concierge was very helpful and a true sweetheart. Front desk staff just average, typical get you in and get you out. Overall great location, clean, comfy rooms for average of $200 a night. Seems outrageous for this Texan but reasonable for the area!

When you consider what you get for your money this place is a gem! Located on bush street, 10 minutes to union square, Chinatown etc and 5 min walk to Powell street where you can get th cable car to fishermans wharf via crookedest street. Parking was free, as was breakfast and wifi - all for $103.95 per night Inc tax! We got a double room on 5th floor and didn't hear any street noise at all. This is an old building and they have kept it that way. If you like character then this place is for you. If you like standard hotel rooms like Marriott etc then it is not! Room was spacious and clean. Breakfast was not the best we have seen on our travels as no cereal or yoghurt. Was toast and eggs with some dry muffins and cookies so not great but does the job. Wi fi is again not the fastest but it does work at an acceptable speed. Yes the entrance to the car park is narrow, we had a Chevrolet Malibu and it squeezed in just fine! You might scratch your wheels if your car is any wider than this and you must have folding wing mirrors otherwise they will be damaged! Don't worry about the tenderloin area - this hotel is further from it than the Fairmont!

review_title: Value for money in central SF
review_text: We enjoyed our stay here which was great value for money given it's location, continental breakfast included and close to most forms of local transport. The room was spacious with city views n decent size bathroom. The staff were great as well! Overall a great stay!

Great location - great hotel - stay here and you won't be disappointed.
Eat at Lefty O'Douls on Geary St great value, great place, great food.

review_title: Old but clean, the elevator is antique, far from train station
review_text:
This hotel building is very old, it has a very old elevator which you need to open the door manually. The door is very heavy and very difficult to open. However, we felt that is the unique of this hotel. 
The hotel is old even their bedsheet. Their bedsheet had been worm out but other than that the whole room is clean and spacious. The room was very simple furnished. 
This hotel is a distant from the train station ( train from airport) especially when you are carry heavy luggage uphill. 
Overall, this is a simple small budget hotel, worth the value.

review_title: Good value for last minute plans
review_text: We decided to take a trip to SF last minute, and found a great deal here. We stayed on the 6th floor, great view of the city. Rooms are a little small, but since we spent most of our time out and about, it was perfect! If you're looking for a centrally located hotel, this is your best bet.
Nice room, wifi was easy to set up. Taxis drive nearby, some nice restaurants within walking distance. $15 cab to/from BART.
hotel_name: San Francisco at The Presidio Travelodge

review_text: Als erster Tipp, Valet Parking vermeiden! 58$ pro Nacht parken ist definitiv Ã¼berrissen, vor allem bei lÃ¤ngerem Aufenthalt. SchÃ¶nes Zimmer mit Aussicht auf die Strasse mit Cable Car vor der TÃ¼re. Sehr unfreundliche concierge, da wir sie am spÃ¤teren Nachmittag gebeten haben, die Zimmerreinigung aufzubieten, da es bis dahin noch nicht geschehen war. Lange Wartezeit bis das Auto wieder vor dem Hotel stand. Unbedingt vorbestellen, trotz unfreundlicher Bedienung.

review_title: Affordable hotel with great staff - free parking
review_text:
We arrived late morning and the room was already done. We could deposit our luggage and park the car without any problem. The staff was extremly friendly and helpful - one could see that they love what they do. The other plus is the free parking. 
The hotel is easy accesible if you arrive from north taking the golden gate bridge.
hotel_name: San Francisco at The Presidio Travelodge

review_text:
Me and my sister stayed here for a few days this past october.
Room was a bit snug, but was nice. Location was great.
Best part is the staff. Everyone was friendly and super helpful, tons of good suggestions for meals and tips for getting around.
hotel_name: San Francisco at The Presidio Travelodge

review_text:
We stayed for 4 nights in the Kensington and were really happy!
The Hotel is in the heart of SF - there are great restaurants nearby (ask Giovanni or someone else from the Concierge service) - so theres no need to provide an own breakfast/dinner service from the Hotel. Be aware that theres hardly no other City with so many restaurants as SF (1 restaurant for 18 inhabitants)!!
Rooms are charmful, the wardrobe is big, the bed comfirtable and the bathroom is nice. 
Staff is very helpful, we asked for Restaurants in walking distance and Giovanni recommendations were fully reliable-thanks!!
We were also asking for a guided winetour to napa/sonoma - the Tour with terrific Tour was the right decision.
If you like staying in the middle of the City, the kensington can be highly recommended.
Fishermans wharf (which we thought about) is a spoiled and overestimated area - we were very lucky that we did Not book there.

Charming hotel in a great location. Large rooms which could do with a bit of updating but perfectly acceptable and clean. Continental breakfast makes a good start to the day although it did get a but hiring after a few days with a limited selection. Overall extremely good value for money and would definitely stay again.

Stopped here on my travels up the coast with my kids. Hotels are quite pricey this time of year, buy we got a decent deal here. The staff was some what rude, and void of emotion. But, the rooms were clean, and while it was out of the way it wasn't too bad. I recommend this for quick travelers on the go.
We stayed twice in this hotel in 2010, we had a great time! Staff is lovely and very helpful, rooms are spacious, clean and nicely decorated. We would definitely go back to this place!

The hotel is in a great location near the cable car lines and the shopping for major dept stores. The rooms are older and bathrooms very small and not renovated. Nothing like the pictures on the website.

We stayed at The Huntington for the first stop on our honeymoon and it was amazing! We were upgraded to a suite on the top floor with panoramic views of the city. The rooms are really quaint and we loved the hotel - James the doorman is so lovely! It's located on one of the highest points in San Francisco so the walk up the hill is a nightmare - it's actually cheaper to get a taxi rather than use the cable car!
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_text: The Huntington was really nice. The staff was exceptional!! Very friendly, professional, and helpful. We took the advice of other reviewers and asked for a recently renovated room. Our room was huge! We were upgraded to a suite with a kitchen, eating area, and living area. Our room also had an awesome view in 2 directions. This hotel is on Nob Hill, so everything is downhill, which means quite the hike or waiting for trolley to get back. We paid quite a bit for our room because we booked last minute and availability around town was slim due to a convention. Overall, we had a wonderful stay!
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_text: This hotel feels like they really care about their guests. I love the fact they are still owned by one family and treat you as a member. This visit was my wifes birthday and they surprised her with a bottle of champangne, chocolates and a gift from the spa. We wouldn't stay any were else.
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_text: Rooms are spacious. Staff are friendly. Little touches like bottles of water in the room daily make a difference.
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_text: I arrived before the appointed check-in time. They unloaded our luggage and stated our room was not ready but they would show us an upgraded corner room that had 2 windows and better beds. It was a lovely room from where I could see Union Square. The desk clerk, concierge, and the housekeeping staff were very polite and helpful. Best of all there were no bed bugs! (I checked with bedbugregistry.com before booking and again before I left for San Francisco.

I stayed one night in this hotel earlier this week. I know this area fairly well and have previously stayed at many of the other hotels that are close by. Staying at the Huntington was a fantastic experience for me. As soon as I arrived i was greeted by a friendly doorman who helped me with my luggage. The staff at the front desk were equally friendly and accommodating as was the bellboy who gave me a few helpful tips about the area. The room I was allocated had a spectacular view, was spacious and was very tastefully decorated. Although my stay was restricted to just one night on this occasion I am a regular visitor to the city and will now look to stay here in future if there is room availability. From my recent experiences this hotel far exceeds the local competition like the Fairmont, Mark Hopkins and the Renaissance and for me anyway was very competitive on price.
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_text: As a family of 4 we spent 4 nights at the Huntington at the end of our California trip. We chose it partly for location (which is excellent) and partly because it is a SLH and we have had some good trips to others. Our rooms were nice but with limited storage space. Shame one was right next to the elevator and therefor noisy. The concierge was helpful as were other staff. We dined in the restaurant one night and had a lovely meal albeit a little towards the top of the normal price range for a US city. One really annoying aspect was being charged $10 per day for Internet which is unacceptable nowadays (the only one of 4 hotels on the trip to do so). Overall a nice stay but for the price we paid was nothing special.
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_title: Great value coupled with incredible staff.
review_text: I came to know of this hotel via some SF locals recommendations. I can't thank then enough as not only was the Travelodge a great deal, they made my time in SF much more interesting thanks to their incredible knowledge of the city. Even if you stay elsewhere, come to the front deal here if you need help with the city. The hotel was also very well maintained and is in a great location. The local bus stops make getting around a breeze as well. Will definitely stay there again.
hotel_name: San Francisco at The Presidio Travelodge

review_title: The best value for luxury in SF!
review_text: This Hotel is a dream. Responsive staff and excellent rooms!

review_title: Great place to stay, free parking a plus, excellent location and the staff is enthusiastic and helpful!
review_text: We stayed at the hotel for four nights and enjoyed our stay immensely! The staff went out of their way to make sure that we were happy and comfortable! Bruce and Nikki had some excellent suggestions about things to do in the city! It is a great value and location! We would definitely stay there again!
hotel_name: San Francisco at The Presidio Travelodge

review_title: Stay here not where your conference is
review_text: I had a wonderful 3 night stay at this hotel. It was a short 10 min walk to where my conference was being held. It's located in a great area near wonderful restaurants but away from the cable car noise and street traffic. My only complaint would be that I tried to go to the pool in the morning but the elevator wasn't running and the front desk wasn't very helpful. I just gave up and decided to go for a walk instead.
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_text: Allerbeste Lage, wir hatten ein komplett renoviertes Zimmer im vierten Stock. Aktuell wird auch der zweite Stock renoviert. Sehr gut ausgestattet, neues Bad, grosser Safe, herrliches Bett! Klasse Aussicht! Netter und sehr freundlicher Empfang, superschneller Check-in. Parkgarage direkt beim Hotel. Self-parking, teuer aber Ã¼blich fÃ¼r San Francisco und diese Lage.

review_title: Amazing service ,great place, coming back Forsure
review_text: Great customer service, front desk job done by Ana Vasquez was superb! Made me a believer that the client is always first here at parc55

I was intrigued by all the positive so I thought I'd stray from my usual downtown hotels and check this one out. It didn't take long to work out where the high scores were coming from: the rooms are modest--typical travelodge stuff-- but the staff are what make this a great value spot in SF. They really, really know the neighborhood (and the city) and they really want their guests to enjoy it. I needed a quick food reco, I got a map and the menu so I could decide what to eat before going. I asked about walking in the nearby park, I was give trail maps so I wouldn't get lost. When I enquired about visiting the submarine at Fisherman'a Wharf I was shown photos of the ship and provided with very clear bus instructions to save me walking in the rain.
hotel_name: San Francisco at The Presidio Travelodge

review_text:
We stayed at the Handlery as part of our honeymoon. The location is good, being close to the BART and of course Union Sq.
When we checked in we told the receptionist it was our honeymoon so he upgraded us to a huge lovely room with a decent view. The staff are very friendly and helpful and didn't hesitate to help out with anything we needed. We would love to come back and would not hesitate in recommending this hotel to anyone.

review_title: Hotel ok mais environnement pas terrible
review_text: L hotel est situe sur Fisherman's wharf avec vue sur Alcatraz. Les chambres sont correctes, propres et fonctionnelles. Elles ne sont pas tres grandes. Nous n avons pas testÃ© la piscine car le temps etait trop froid! donc l hotel est correct Mais nous avons Ã©tÃ© tres decus par Fisherman's wharf. Beaucoup de magasins a touristes sans interet. La prochaine fois je choisirai un hotel dans un autre quartier.

Det var noget dyrere end de andre hoteller vi havde booket til turen, og jeg synes det var her vi fik mindst for pengene. review_title:
Honeymoon visit.
Top class customer service, great rooms and a great place to tour San Francisco from.
review_text:
Stayed recently at the Huntington hotel. We were finishing our honeymoon with a 4 day stay in San Francisco. We had just settled in to our room when we had a bottle of sparkling wine sent our room. We also received a gift from the spa team. Very thoughtful and a nice gesture. 
The hotel offers top class customer service but in a subtle, old fashioned and discrete way. 
Overall we found it a wonderful experience and location is a great base for touring San fran on foot or by cable care.
Well done and thank you.
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_title: Fantastic stay-great location, rooms and staff are excellent.
review_text: Stayed for 2 nights through Priceline. We were upgraded to a corner suite. WOW. Everything about this hotel is great. Would stay here every time. Parking is expensive but BART is close to the hotel and other parking is also close.

review_title: A wonderful hotel right in the center of everything.
review_text: Just left this hotel and have nothing but the highest praise for the hotel staff. I was there working on a photo shoot and one of our colleagues became sick. The staff was so gracious and accommodating from the front desk allowing us to buy a half day extension on our check out time to room service putting a rush on all the orders. Housekeeping was also excellent and the hotel even provided a house car at a great rate on our return to the airport. I cannot say enough about this venue and all of the staff and management I met during our stay. Beds were awesome and the water in the shower/bath was really hot. The dinners I had at their restaurant were fabulous although not inexpensive.

Non all'altezza del none Radisson. Camera normale, non troppo spaziosa ma accettabile, bagno vecchio e piuttosto scomodo, abbastanza pulito. Posizione non delle migliori, Ã© vicino al Pier 17 ma non Ã¨ centrale, mal servito dagli autobus. Personale gentile, ci ha dato cartine e guida di San Francisco. Complessivamente non siamo rimasti soddisfatti, se dovessi ritornare a San Francisco cambierei hotel.

review_title: Convenient location, parking can be difficult sometimes
review_text:
We stayed here for 3 nights last week. The hotel is a decent business hotel. Check-in process was quick & we were even able to score a room 2 hours early. The rooms themselves are pretty standard - clean, but nothing exciting. The walls are a bit thin, but that's probably true of most hotels. The real draw is the location- you're right in the heart of Union Square.
I guess the only (minor) complaint is the parking at certain times of day. The hotel is on the corner of a fairly busy street, so it wasn't uncommon to find a line of cars trying to valet and, as a result, block the street traffic. Similarly, it made it difficult for cars leaving the hotel to exit the hotel driveway. Still the valet staff worked very hard & as fast as they could. They were always very polite.
If you want to be right in the middle of things & don't mind the hustle & bustle, this is a great place to stay. If you want a calmer experience, there are hotels 1-2 blocks away that are still close enough to the action without being too busy.
Club level with view was most excellent. Close to shops, dining options and mass transit. Chinese dim sum close by is good. Skip the sushi place Han Zen. It was awful. Beds very comfortable.

review_title: We enjoyed it last year and came back!
review_text:
We stayed two nights in semi transit to LA to return to Australia. This is a hotel we stayed at last year (see review of 7Nov10) and so we came back.
The hotel provides a great location to get around SF and once you know the Muni system etc it's easy.
The facilities are very good and rooms comfortable, although the smaller rooms can be little cosy.
We would have liked tea or coffee in the room or a central point at which to go for it. Instead our enquiry was politely dealt with by a referral to the kitchen staff to see if they would co-operate. We had a fallback plan!
WiFi was unreliable but we muddled through and maintained our holiday blog. 
Breakfast was a treat again. The server in the morning is so bright and cheerful that your day must start off well. Food is great and there is sufficient for a good start to your day. Listen carefully as the accent is a bit strong but then our accent is probably as difficult!
There are some good restaurant options close by if you don't want the 4 course option in Jeanne D'Arc restaurant.
The only killer is that walk up Powell St from Sutter to Bush!
We'll stay here again if we get to visit SF again.
We booked this hotel from jet setter and only stayed two nights. It wasn't clean. Only had two towels in bathroom we asked for more several times and they never came.
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_text:

Les sanitaires sont propres mais pas trÃ¨s modernes. Un peu bruyant, si le voisin se douche pendant votre sommeil, ou si des gens parlent fort dans le couloir, vous serez gÃ©nÃ©s.
