review_title: Quaint, with French accents, great hospitalty.
review_text: Love the food in the artful restaurant, Jeanne D'Arc. There was a violinist that played for us at our table, which was such a nice touch!

Hotel lobby was clean & spotless and staff were very friendly! 
Whilst checking in we were handed vouchers for free breakfast which gave you choice of 3 things on menu which was a bonus! 
We also inquired about wifi as we were under the impression you had to pay â‚¬9.95 a day, however we were given a voucher which enabled us to access wifi totally free!
The room was tidy and clean. Had two queen size beds and was quiet considering that the hotel is on union square. In the rooms there was a tv, free safe and fridge! 
The location of the hotel was great for shopping as it was located right on union square and a short walk to the mall approx. 5mins or shorter down the hill. You could also catch the cable cars from side road near hotel which would take you fisher mans wharf etc these ruEn till either midnight/2am and cost approx $14 all day. We also had the Alcatraz & all loops bus tours (city sight seeing) which picked you up outside Macy's next to the hotel. 
In all I would defiantly recommend hotel was lovely and could not fault! Will hopefull return in the future!

Parc 55 will do for me all I needed was a bed and earplugs. Stay here in November during thanksgiving week. I opted to get my own breakfast rather than hotel type. There was a donut shop on the corner of hotel with Bart police cars out in front that never seems to move. Maybe to ward of potential problems that may arise because the area is not too good. Got crackheads,prostitutes,pimps and thiefs walking around like everyday life. My advise is to walk with someone or if you must keep your hands in pocket or purse with thumb on pepper spray nozzle. Not trying to scare anyone just wanted you to get heads up of area.

Moderno e centrale con camere comode e curate, una hall non grandissima ma elegante. Consigliato per affari o per piacere.
La mattina si puÃ² gratuitamente prendere del caffÃ¨ e del latte prima di uscire.
Raggiungi in 10 minuti a piedi Union square e tutta la zona commerciale. Hai a un passo china town, Nob hill e lembarcadero. Per tutti gli altri posti c'e' il mitico trenino.
A San Francisco se scegli le meridien non te ne pentirai

Got a good rate through Priceline. The hotel is at the edge of a dicey neighborhood. Made a wrong turn last night and had to step over a dozen homeless sleeping in the street. Its also on the edge of a great area with world class shopping. 
Rooms for a four star are beginning to feel dated. Very expensive internet. Had to call desk to figure out how to watch tv that wasnt pay for view. That option is hidden. 
Not a service oriented hotel. Had to carry own luggage to room.
At 100 US is value. 
Cant wait until wifi gouging is a thing of the past!

The room are old and ugly. The hotel is very close from a bar of nude dancer. Not a good place for children. In our room (208), the bath was poorly maintened. (You can see it in the picture). Also, the restaurant, who is suposed to be a french restaurant, is not very good and the service is slow. We was suposed to stay 3 night but we cancelled 2 of them.

If you stay at the Parc 55 you will not be disappointed. The location is excellent for shopping and restaurants. The Front Desk Manager, Brett Leonard, made my stay AMAZING!!! He couldn't have been more courteous. I'm sort of a hotel snob and this is where I always stay and will continue to stay.

Wonderful old fashioned, plush leather, intimate bar with characters serving and a talented pianist.
Good room and great breakfast.
hotel_name: The Huntington Hotel & Nob Hill Spa

review_text: The hotel is located in a very nice area; lots of shops and restaurants nearby as well as some sights. The foyer is impressive and the bar looks great. In the morning the area is used for breakfast: this as well as having to pay for wifi are my only complaints: the breakfast I had ordered was of very poor quality (extremely greasy and cold) but great customer recovery as it was taken off my bill. The receptionists, restaurant manager and concierge are extremely friendly, knowledgeable and always happy to help: personal, polite service with a smile. I'd recommend staying here!

I've stayed here a couple of times and compared to other business hotels in the area parc 55 is great value for larger rooms with plush duvets and decent bathrooms. 
The room decor looked a little tired this trip, but quite adequate.
Great rooms and staff were very helpful. Had dinner in the restaurant and this was fantastic. Personally I love the location although some may find it a little busy

review_title: Chic with great service in the middle of all the Union square shopping.
review_text: I'm sure this hotel is pricey but since I bid for my room, which ended up having a fab view from the 20th floor, I was overally impressed. Very large and modern. Quick walk to shops and good dining. Also, there is a car rental place as well as a "Go Car" (these lil yellow death traps are a memorable way to see the city).

Another typical stay here. Better then my last trip in August however.
Room was clean, I had a balcony too which was a pleasant surprise even if it was about 2sq ft! I found every staff member to be pleasant and helpful. I asked for one of those Macy's Discount cards for foreign visitors and next thing I know the receptionist was getting all excited and letting me know about various sales that were on, I was DELIGHTED with her to offs cos I ended up getting half my Xmas shopping done! 
However I am still very concerned about the security access to this hotel! The ground floor has no staf so access to the lifts are open to anyone. There are a HUGE number of homeless people outside the hotel and they can easily gain access to the hotel and bedroom floors as the lifts do not require key access! I really wish they would address this!
Otherwise it was fine!

Spacious, clean king suite. Free wifi. Plenty of outlets 4 electronics & you can get 2 them without moving furniture. No sign of bedbugs :). Free happy hour & breakfast. Good value. Cheap toiletries but hey, u can't have everything.

This hotel is a bit older but well-maintained. The standard room was very clean but not spotless. Considering the breakfast and drinks/light supper, a good value. We have noticed at Drury Inns overall a sharp increase in pets. Having dogs at the 5:30 kickback where food is available is a personal turnoff. We will probably try a different hotel on our next visit.

review_title: Parc 55 is one on the best hotel values in San Francisco!
review_text:
After staying in the W for days , we thought the Parc 55 would be a downgrade - however we were pleasantly surprised. Great location , staff went over-and -above, and the rooms were spacious and clean. 
The only knock on the hotel is that the walls seem thin and your hear a lot of outside noise. 
I'll stay here again.

Just spent this past weekend (6-25/6-26) here. Hubby and I celebrated our 17yr anniversary. Believe it or not. Drury Inn was our first hotel when we got married back in McAllen Tx. And have been goin ever since. Staff is aleays wonderful to us. In any city we 
have stayed at. Rooms super clean. Love the free Breakfast n evening Snack time n complimentary mixed
drinks. Ooooh! We always feel at home when we stay here. Thank You Austin Drury Inn for The best service these past 17 yrs. Love u guys xoxo. U have customers for 
life. My little boy calls this HIS HOTEL :). He is 12 now n my 10 yr old just simply has a blast! Til nxt time!!

review_title: Awesome hotel-Just renovated, nice new carpet and bedding and friendly staff.
review_text: I love staying at this hotel. Friendly helpful staff and very clean. The work out roomhas all new equipment and it it easy to find a good restaurant closeby. I shopped and ate dinner at The Domain next door. I can't wait to come back to Austin.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Austin Mopac North

review_title: Great location but nothing spectacular in the rooms, and noisy.
review_text: Room is good, very large with a huge bathroom. Location is close to the convention center and easy access to mass transit. My only real complaints are the noisy streets below and the lack of a coffee maker in the room. I understand I'm in the city by my corner room is really loud, I can hear everything happening on the street 16 floors down. I also find it strange I don't have a coffee maker in the room.
This place is tired...the rooms were not clean, dated, and in need of a total remodel.

review_title: Convenient, large rooms, clean. Good value
review_text: Stayed here 2 nights - staff very accomodating arranging adjoining rooms with my senior parents. Rooms were very large & loved the sitting area & mini kitchen. My folk's accessible room was very spacious with plenty of room for their walkers. If your destination is The Domain, it is just across the highway & downtown on the weekend is a 10-15 minute drive away

La posizione dell'hotel Ã¨ ottima, a poca distanza da Union square e chinatown. 
Abbiamo fatto colazione in hotel solo la prima mattina, un po' cara, ma buona... 
Camera prenotata su internet ma non direttamente sul sito dell'hotel in quanto non avevano disponibilitÃ ... Ma trattamento eccellente nonostante questo (non come l'hotel a new york, recensione che scriverÃ³ presto)
Took the park and stay package which removed the car parking niggle. Used the club level. All good. Nice and central on market - lottsa bums, but that is market...

A 10 min a piedi da Union square decisamente hotel da consigliare.
Stile retrÃ², bello, pulito e silenzioso.
Il personale Ã¨ molto gentile e disponibile. Colazione continentale normale.
Attenzione che manca il fon. Biancheria pulita tutti i giorni sempre buon profumo di pulito.
Sicuramente straconsigliato!

review_title: Hotel location and lobby nice...rooms are okay
review_text: The lobby space of the hotel is great. The rooms were a bit of a surprise compared to the lobby. The rooms look about 20 years old. The real frustrating thing to me was being woken up at midnight to the sounds of a cleaning crew outside of my door. After laying there for over an hour and continuing to hear banging, I got up to see what was going on. Apparently, they decided to clean a series of rooms across the hall at midnight. It was loud and ridiculous and went on for over 2 hours.

It's a perfect location if you are into shopping and going to the famous places in San Francisco! The staff are friendly and very helpful if you need something from your room. Clean room, bathroom, great view also from our room when we stayed there! I'd definitely stay in the hotel again on my next visit!

review_title: Great location, great views, great service!
review_text: Stayed two nights for a family vacation. The hotel location is fantastic, it's within close walking distant to Union Square, Market Street and one block where you can get on the trolly car to go down to fishermans warf. Parked our car here it's $40 a day which is not bad for San Fran and once again the location. You can park your car and not have to worry about driving because of the location enjoy joy a little bit of walking and the trolly cars!

Stayed for 2 nights. Got a corner room on 19th floor. Circular outside wall that was all windows. Wonderful views. Saw fireworks that seemed to be over ATT Park. Friendly staff, good restaurant and we had the continental breakfast that was plenty for us before we left for Napa. Drawbacks - very slow elevators altho there were plenty and pricey wifi. Would stay again.

These people go 360 degrees out of their way to provide you with anything you want or need. Jennifer in the lounge is the most astute hostess I've ever seen. The concierge does not even know the word no.

review_title: Good location, clean, helpful, good value compared to others in the area.
review_text: We got a good deal on this hotel through Priceline and I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. The front desk was efficient and helpful. We didn't use any of the amenities so I can't rate those but the room was spacious and clean. The bed was comfortable. The street noise didn't bother us, we could barely hear it.

I have stayed here three times all on business. Love the location. It's a quick walk to union square shopping. And the rooms even the basic ones are nice. I always feel safe here. The Cobb salad from room service is to die for.

review_title: Best concierge service I've ever had.
review_text: The concierge service here was outstanding and I've stayed in many Intercons and they generally do concierge well. Nothing was too much trouble from finger nail repairs to fine local dining. Wil definitely stay there again.

review_title: Parking and breakfast and a great hotel for the single person in mind
review_text: So you are thinking about taking off and staying in San Fran. Intercontinental and the Marriott are a good choice. Both will be about the same price. Last night I stayed at the Intercontinental on Howard st. I'm single and just wanted to get away. I am also have a champaign appetite and a beer budget. Parking at the hotel will set you back $60. Next door at the mission garage is $32. But across the street is $20 for 24 hours. Breakfast at the Interccontinental will cost you$35 with tip. I might suggest you walk to the Marriott buffets or go a block away to Mels diner. Pools is nice and the gym is. Dry good. People are nice there. Enjoy.

Oh my god this hotel was amazing. On the day of our arrival we where lucky enough to be there on a day that they provided tea. Which was lovely and healthy jacket pot and salad. 
Breakfast every day 
Swimming pool great 
Gym nice 
Washing Mashine 
Staff lovely 
Lovely rooms big and your own kitchen. 
The one downside was the sofa bed was uncoftable. 
However I would deffeantly stay here again.
Woke up several times because of noise from the party goers on the street.

This is a pleasant hotel in an excellent location near to BART and other transportation. Perfect for getting in from the airport which on BART takes about 30 mins. 
We were on the 17th floor and the noise through the windows from traffic was still obscene. They give you ear plug in the room so that says it all. However, we wear ear plugs anyway on a night so used our own and weren't too disturbed. 
We weren't concerned about safety even though you can get straight into the lifts without seeing staff as the lobby is on the 1st floor. Wifi is quite expensive at $15 for a day but there is free wii at the strbucks just round the conner. 
Worth a stay, just bring your own earplugs.

review_title: Another business trip and another hotel
review_text: I popped to SF from the UK for 2 days, for work. Being English I got the BART from SFO to downtown. My US friends say I'm mad getting a train, but it's so easy (30 mins). Getting off at Powell St station, the hotel is just 3mins walk away. Simple. Reception great you and sort out the room Witt little or no fuss. Sometimes you queue but really this is just minutes of waiting, not a lifetime. Getting my room key I get one of the half dozen lifts and I'm in. Clean, spacious and quiet. After an afternoon walking about SF I sleep like a baby in a very big comfortable bed. In the morning I use the gym (big and lots of equipment) and go for breakfast. Breakfast is about $25, perhaps cheaper to book as part of the room but I didn't check. My only compliant was the hotel bar closing at 1am. I'm used to bars staying open later in hotels, bit maybe it wasn't a bad thing!!! The hotel is well located, by BART, next to a big mall, a short walk from the designer shops (union sq) and near a collection of food, drinking and other outlets. In comparison to other SF hotels, the location is perfect. You're not far from anyone. I'd stay again.

review_title: Great location but better choices close by
review_text: Stayed in Aug/Sept for a conference. The location is great. The room was large & the bed was really comfortable. However it didn't matter due to the all night extremely loud street noise that kept me awake most nights. Housekeeping was inconsistent. Dirty glasses stayed on the floor in the hall all week. Room service got my breakfast order wrong. Wouldn't choose this hotel again with all the choices within a couple blocks.

review_title: Great end to a bad start thanks to Parc 55
review_text: My trip to SFO started off bad as my original hotel (Nikko) somehow canceled my reservation. They sent me next door to Parc 55 and in was skeptical at first. Hotel staff at the front desk were fantastic. They upgraded my room knowing my experience at Nikko was bad. Room was excellent - very good sized for downtown San Fran. Breakfast was good although a little over priced. I would stay here again.
Overall excellent stay and value. Easy in and out and close to freeways. Be careful if you need to park - very expensive.
Worth every penny and serves any purpose with excellent concierge service.

I stay at Marriott Properties all over the country. I've stayed at every type of property as well and never had as bad an experience as I did at this property. The property is old and in serious need of a remodel. As I entered the room, it had a pungent smell. I was only there one night so I decided to just open the windows, turn on the air and get going....I was pressed for time and didn't have the opportunity to deal with room changes. I immediately left for a meeting and returned that evening. After further review, I noticed the carpeting was filthy and had several stains. The kitchen counter was also filthy as was the stove. When I attempted to shower....there was NO HOT WATER. I called the front desk to find out they were aware of the issue, were awaiting parts and did not offer any solution. They also failed to tell me this upon check-in which while wouldn't have solved the problem, I would have had an option to do something about it. While in the cold shower, I noticed mold on the ceilings and on the wallpaper in the bathroom. In general, I would say the property was filthy, the PC in the lobby was slower than my cell phone for pulling my airline web page, the dinner/evening snack is only served 3 days per week....this night had "deli sandwiches.". One of the worst experiences in a Residence Inn I've ever had. I will never stay here again.

review_title: Dated but great service, middle of nowhere!
review_text: Ask for a room away from the highway side. It is so loud all night. Also the auto temp regulator turns on the fan periodically, and it is so loud also, then it stops. Then it starts. Stops. Starts. But the folks w ho work here are awesome. If I could stay downtown, I would do that!

Inizio col dire che la guide de routard lo da fra i piu chic,l unica cosa chic e' il prezzo!!stanza piccola quanto uno sgabuzzino ,niente aria condizionata,i due proprietari francesi manco ti guardano in faccia,insomma una delusione!positiva la posizione e la colazione,anche se hanni il coraggio di chidere la mancia che non daro' visto quello che ho pagato.in assoluto il peggior hotel di questo coast to coast.i super 8 erano migliori!!!!lasciate perdere!
Rooms were a little small, but big enough. Staff were polite and helpful. Beds - very comfy!

I am a Marriott platinum member and stayed here with my team (normally stay at Full Service Marriott nearby) but although rooms need updating(same furniture as was here 5 yrs ago) rooms are clean and comfortable. A/C was great in the two weeks I was in Austin temps were 105-109 and I was able to keep room comfortable. They did upgrade TVs on my 10th day to newer 32" LCDs. This is a pet (Dog) friendly hotel and I was foutunate enough to be on the dog floor but I like dogs.

review_title: Definitely by far more than what we paid for!
review_text:
Staff=top knotch friendly, #1 in customer service! Always above and beyond (I travel often & usually stay at Holiday Inn)
Amentities=pool was a bit small, but was always clean and stocked w clean towels.
Breakfast & Social hour= welcoming and perfect way to begin and end our day. Mark was awesome and tentative to our children's request.
Location= easy access to interstate.
Friends paid >$2200 for a house rental during our week here and came to visit us

review_title: Nice hotel but noisy at night
review_text: Family of 4 (2 teens) stayed in 2 rooms. Check in easy rooms well furnished clean with good bathrooms. The hotel is well located to get access to shopping mall, BART, MUNI, street cars. It is also close to Union Square and unfortunately is the central point for SF's homeless community. Therefore expect to be asked constantly if you can spare any change in that area. The hotel restaurant served a great breakfast a la carte breakfasts were better than the buffet.

We had a great time staying here, the lady who checked us in was very nice and helpful and our room was upgraded to a junior suit without the extra cost. I think the suit would maybe be a little pricey but from what I saw, the other rooms were perfectly adequate. Clean and right in union square near plently of restaurants.

I usually love the value of hotel you get for the money with most La Quintas, but this one was a terrible value. It was just a mediocre hotel for our $161 a night price. One of our rooms even had a leaking air-conditioning. The breakfast was one of the worst as far as la Quintas go. I will never stay here again.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Austin Southwest at Mopac

review_title: The hotel is attached to the convention center and is sleek, clean and modern.
review_text:
Perfect business stay. Nice bed.
If you are in SF for a convention this is the place to be for ease of access and a comfortable facility.

Our basic room was quite nice with a lovely bathroom. My only complaint was the bed & the pillows but since I have a hard time sleeping anyway it could just be me. I understand the hotel restaurant is very good although we didn't eat there. In the mornings I walked to a local coffee shop while my husband was at a conference at the nearby Moscone center. Hotel concierge were very helpful in helping me plan my days in the city.

Hotel nella media degli Hilton in giro per il mondo. Enorme, ma tutto sommato, efficiente. Unico neo, la cauzione che bloccano al momento del check in non Ã¨ automaticamente sbloccata al momento del check out e del pagamento della fattura. Risultato una ingente somma bloccata per venti giorni dopo la nostra partenza senza nessuna ragione. Ãˆ assolutamente indegno che un hotel come l'Hilton si comporti cosÃ¬ con i propri clienti.

review_title: Aging Property in Need of Maintenance
review_text:
The property is centrally located in the Arboretum area convenient to shopping and restaurants, though not to downtown. The onside sports Bar has 30+ TVs and offers good ambiance.
The property needs a facelift, however. Peeling ceilings in my bathroom, and an elevator that had me stuck for 10 minutes will keep me from coming back. When I informed the front desk that the elevator was inoperable and I had been caught inside, I was told "it does that when it is cold." no other help or apology was offered.
There are better options nearby.

La cosa migliore di questo hotel Ã¨ senz'altro la posizione, vicina a negozi e mezzi pubblici ed a poche centinaia di metri dal capolinea del cable CAR. Per il resto nulla di eccezionale, camera piuttosto piccola,comodo lo Starbuck's interno, piuttosto caro il ristorante. Nel complesso una buona scelta, lo consigliamo!

review_title: Booked a killer deal here on priceline
review_text: I couldn't be happier with this hotel. Even if I hadn't gotten it for a steal of a rate I would still have been thrilled with the service and amenities. Great location too. I will definitely be back.

review_title: Contemporary, fun and reasonably priced hotel
review_text:
Great location with tons of high-end shopping and restaurant choices within walking distance. Room was immaculate with unique and contemporary touches. Don't expect a lot of "space" to hang out in your room, but just enough for a few nights...and with a large lobby with a small bar, TVs, cozy places to sit and a pool table, who wants to be stuck in the room?
We happened to be in this hotel on the night of the UT / Texas A&M football game (big rivals), and even on the 6th floor you could hear the excited crowd in the outdoor restaurant below us...but no blaming the hotel, it was a great game...and the next night proved that the location is generally quiet. 
Highly recommend this well priced gem in a higher rent area!!

This motel 6 was the last stay in a long move from NH to San Antonio-we stayed in them primarily because they all allow dogs and are everywhere. This one had recently been renovated, and was a nice surprise-sparkling colors,a cool little seating area built into the corner, scrupulously clean, and, in general, a really good, inexpensive choice right off the highway. The staff was friendly and helpful(and the fact that they cooed over my aging cocker spaniel didn't hurt). Would definately stay at this one again.
Flat screen TV. Non smoking rooms do not smell on cigs nor does the linen. No breakfast and WI-FI is not free. Worth the money

On May 28,2011, I had a room at this Motel 6. I was there a couple of hours and the adjoining room door opened and closed. I went to the lobby to tell the front desk what happened and the guy with tattoo on his neck told "Me" the guest to knock on the door and tell two male hispanics to stop. I went back to my room and they did it again. I went back to front desk and basically he told me to bad . I asked him to call his manager and I got the same response. I went back to my room 108 and left
My safety was not a concern

review_title: I paid 140.00 a nite for this!!!
review_text: Horrible experience! Room smelled like an ashtray!!! The closed breakfast down early on a Saturday morning! Manager was extremely rude! For this amount of money should have had nicer facilities. Should have stayed at Motel 6!

I visited this crap hole with my family. If the kids weren't so tired I'd never stayed until morning! Bath was nasty and water trapped under the plastic tube it a hazard. The water pushes up the tub, like standing on a waterbed. Very dangerous!!! The water that gushes up when you stand in the tub is putrid. Had to put a towel at the door to avoid the odor. Never again.
hotel_name: Baymont Inn Austin North / Austin Highland Mall

review_text:
Management...Below average
 Not friendly at all. No one spoke unless spoken too first.
Cleanliness...Way below average
 Black mold in the grout in the tub
 Stains in the carpet
 Musty smell in the rooms
 Hallways smelled like smoke
Simply put, I will not be staying here EVER again!
hotel_name: Extended Stay America - Austin - Northwest - Research Park

review_text: The staff is so rude and last minute changes gave us a dirty room brown towels and honestly I would never recommend to anyone ever!

The rooms were nice but a little dirty. The sheets felt itchy, my dog got fleas even though she had just been treated with k9 advantix, the shower was filthy with shower scum and we did not have shampoo or conditioner. The breakfast was not that great, and if it weren't for the waffles and coffee we would not have eaten anything that morning. Our price was $68 plus tax.

My husbands company booked us there because he had to work in Austin for a week but when we arrived with confirmation number in hand they said the room hadn't been confirmed and we had no reservation. It was midnight when we arrived from out of town and after 30 minutes of speaking with the manager on duty, he finally said he wood give us a room but my husband had to pay cash for a room that was already paid for by his company. We did just so we could get our little girls in bed but when we got yo the room the air didn't work and there was only one bed. My husband went to speak with the manager again but he had gone and the night clerk said he could't move us because we had only reserved a room wirh one bed. We made due with the room for the night but needless to say we moved first thing the next day. Also, with all the free wifi spots in Austin the hotel wants you to pay $5.00 to use theirs. Not very accommodating to business travelers. Maybe it is because we arrived late at night but there where very suspicious looking " ladies of the night" walking around the complex as well. Not good.

Do not recommend staying here. Their rooms are unhygienic and have bed bugs. But the worst part was managements vehement denial of the bed bugs and immediate dismissal of a pest inspection or refund. Their strong defense suggests I wasn't the first victim.

I tried to stay with my family for the weekend. After Friday night our floor smelled horrible and was covered in beef jerky trash. I go out with my family in the morning and 4 men share the elevator with us. Luckily they stopped talking about strip clubs long enough to race and see who could "pound" a four loko the fastest. We checked out a night early and went to stay with my mother-in-law.
hotel_name: Extended Stay America - Austin - Downtown - Town Lake

review_text: My husband and I were in San Francisco celebrating our anniversary and having never been there before we picked a hotel based on the reviews of others; boy were we glad with our decision! We thoroughly enjoyed The Parc 55. Each person associated with the hotel that we interacted with was professional and quite helpful. Although it was probably a little farther from Fisherman's Wharf than we would have liked it was otherwise fairly centrally located. We would definitely stay here again and again. If you are in town this is a must stay at place!

review_title: I would absolutely stay here again!
review_text: At first when we got to the hotel I wasn't sure if I wanted to stay BUT, I noticed the room was very clean and the beds were comfortable. The hotel isn't brand new but for the price it was a good deal. We decided next time we visit Austin we're staying at the same hotel. We were very satisfied with our room.

review_title: A park bench might be better!
review_text: Terrible service, gangs roaming the hallways, dirty room, no tissues, toilet paper or towels. We left the room for the day and when we came back they had given our room away! Thank goodness we didn't leave our stuff there too scared to!) Internet is spotty at best. If the whole town is booked except this place, you may want to consider sleeping in your car or on a park bench.

I stayed here for business due to it's location and price and could not have been more disappointed.
Check in took 20 min and we were the only guests there. While checking in, guests came by to complain of leaking water pipes, out of service toilets, etc.
A thick, recent coat of paint haphazardly covers all services and the hotel smells bad.
Spend $15 more and stay elsewhere.
hotel_name: Extended Stay America - Austin - Downtown - Town Lake

review_text: After a mix up at another hotel we ended up the InterContinental. We had no reservations but they were able to find us a room and we were checked in and in the room in 15 minutes. The room was very clean and bright and the bathroom was very nice. The front desk was always friendly and helpful and doormen always had a smile. It was my husband and my birthday and they sent a nice pastry selection to our room. I agree with the other reviewers that the parking fee is a lot and should be reduced for people staying at the hotel.

The hotel is located in a centralized location. 
The service at this hotel was horrible. I arrived half and hour prior to the 3pm check in time. The service clerk was polite and told me my room was not ready yet. I sat down in the lobby right in front of her. 
An hour later I checked again and was told my room was not ready and it would take 30-45 minutes. 
After an hour 2 hours of my original arrival and exhausted I checked again if my room was ready it, it finally was. Had I not asked I would of been waiting longer after two clerks saw me and was sitting infront of them waiting for my room. 
When checking out the clerk told me they had a big conference and guest checked out late. 
I was never offered another room, but was charged as if I had checked in at the regular time, and never got an apology just an explanation. 
I have had better luck with hotel service in Las Vegas on a busy holiday weekend than I have ever had at this hotel.

review_title: Worst place I have stayed in San Fran, they are rude, clueless about customer service
review_text: Bell men, front desk, restaurant, bar, house cleaning terrible rude worst I have seen or dealt with. If I come back to San Fran I will not ever stay here again hope this helps

review_title: Good value room...but expensive everything else.
review_text: Can't best a $130 room downtown sf, but parking $48 plus tax? Wifi 15 per day? C'mon! Dont get me wrong, the hotel delivered on the room and great view for the price, but getting nicked takes its toll. Great for shopping downtown and very clean, just wish the "extras" came down a bit to get it in five circle status.

Made a reservation for three people. A non-smoking room with two double beds! The hotel looks a bit old, but the valet service is cheap 13USD and the lady in the reception was nice. The room was big and both the room and the bathroom looked clean. All amendments were in the room, tv, coffee maker, desk, ironingboard and iron and so on. The part of this hotel is the location. 5 min walk to Capitol hill and 10-15 min walk to 6th street. Perfect to walk home. The hotel has free high speed wifi and continental breakfast. The breakfast was not very interesting, but they have Texas shaped waffles. 
For 149USD this hotel is a great offer, good value! We stayed at Hilton the last time we were in Austin. There we had to pay 500USD, and the room was alot smaller.

First time ever staying at PARC 55. Had a great stay. Easy arrival, used valet, yes it is close to 50$, but welcome to SF. Check in was great, very nice red headed lady (I wish I got her name) very pleasant and helpful, made us feel welcome.AMAZING room on 26 floor, very spacious, bathroom big too! Flat screen, and very very quiet. Drank at the hotel lounge , the servers in the lounge are VERY nice and attentive, I wish I had gotten their names too, lol. Clean hotel, modern looking. Good location , walking distance to LOTS of shopping and bars. I can't wait to stay here again! Only bad thing was the valet the next morning took forever, they did not answer their phone to arrange pickup in advance so I had to go down and wait in person.

review_title: OK hotel with nice restaurant and SPA
review_text: Service varied between OK to excellent. Room was good, but bath tub was disgusting, didn't even dare to use it, lucky me there was separate shower. SPA was OK. Club lounge was good value, most of the food served there was good, internet connection sucked.

Muy buen hotel. Buenas habitaciones y buen servicio.
EstÃ¡ en el centro de la ciudad, junto a buenos sitios para comer, muchas tiendas y acceso a los tranvÃ­as que llevan al muelle.
Un lugar perfecto para descansar tras el duro dÃ­a de un turista.

My wife and I would like to thank Hilga for getting us tickets to Alcatraz at the last minute and Shehan for the champagne for our 25th anniversary. This is the last of three nights and we will come back again. Rooms are very clean.

This Holiday Inn Express is not equal to the others I have stayed at. It's on the wrong side of Austin from the fun stuff do, and the beds are seriously uncomfortable.
The staff did not recognize my program memberships or give me "perks" they claim members get. Actually other than handing me a key and saying a room number I wasn't acknowledged at all.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Austin North Central

review_text: We stayed one night at this Red Roof. Nice clean property, close to lots of restaurants. The rooms are good, a tad small and basic but adequate. Hey were clean and the beds comfortable. That's all I really ask for in a cheap short stay.

review_title: You'll find every amenity in the rooms.
review_text: Great location next to the Moscone Center. Nice rooms w/ everything you need and more. Huge towels. Nice soaps. Robes, shower caps. Big TV, sewing kits, coffee maker, scale (who wants this?), magnifying mirror etc etc. Only hiccup was I had to call/visit desk 3 times to have dirty drapes cleaned over 2 days. I'd consider this a 4 star hotel.

review_title: Mr. Schreier and Red Roof Inn staff made my return back from Iraq a most warmth welcome like true caring individuals.
review_text:
OohRah,
A true American welcome.
First and Foremost Red Roof Inn Corporation can rest assure that their employees such as Mr. Schreier and staff from the Austin South Red Roof Inn made my return a true American welcome.
It's management and staff provided their most warmth welcome during my stay.
I would highly recommend this location representing Red Roof Inn to anyone whom is needing a room for a day or more.
Semper Fi,
Joe

review_title: Very basic accommodations, but room was as advertised.
review_text: The hotel was as advertised...affordable, clean, and quiet. GM was very nice in accommodating us with a 2 queen bed room, despite only being guaranteed 1 bed with priceline. There was a 1 million dollar renovation in 2008, and for the most part, it shows. The beds are great and the TV is a nice size for an affordable room. If the hotel just throws some tan paint on the walls and finishes the bathroom renovation, this hotel will be all set.

review_title: Close to down and really nice!
review_text: This hotel is close to downtown theres alot of food places close bye.the room was very clean every time we asked for towels they didnt have a problem giving us some I was afraid of stayin here from some of the reviews but over all it was good ill be stayin here everytime we come to austin

This was a nightmare. Expedia does not mention the $25 deposit and they made us sign something saying it was up to $75 depending on your card. We paid for a pool side room and had to walk all the way around because the gate was locked on our side. The pool had floating bugs and leaves and was nasty. Our room had dirty floors and smelled like mildew and stale smoke, not something a mom-to-be needed to be in. I didn't bother trying to change rooms because the desk clerk was rude and not the least bit nice.

i was here 3 nights with my family. the room was lovely and spacious, the beds and pillows very comfortable. the service was friendly and welcoming. the kids loved the pool! (though my son had some kind of allergic reaction to the pool disenfectant). the only complaint i have is the cost of all the extras and little "amenities"...parking is $53 a night, internet service in the room is $15 a night... the cost of items in the mini bar, and in the bar itself are ridiculous (4$ for a glass of milk!)... though i know almost everyone charges for these things, the intercontinental seems to charge even more!

review_title: Wonderful Staff, great Value, would stay at this hotel again.
review_text: My fiance' and I had to book a room on short notice and luckily found this Hotel on google travel. The price was exceptional, the room was very clean, the staff was amazing. We left behind a precious item in our room and realized after we checked out. The staff allowed us back into the room to look, but to our dismay housekeeping had already cleaned. Jenna at the desk called house keeping who had already brought the item to lost and found. I had read previous reviews and. was skeptical, butmy stay and experoenced showed me, Don't believe everything you read.

This hotel is quite nice but I really feel nickel and dimed after my stay. Upon arrival we were informed that there really weren't any good parking options nearby except to use the valet service at about $55 per night. Seriously?! $55 to park my car! 
When we finally made it to our room we were informed that wifi would be $15 extra and that if we even picked anything up from the minibar we would be charged for it and would have to dispute it to have the charge removed from our bill. 
All in all, it was a nice hotel but I didn't really enjoy my stay.
We were there one night. Nothing sticks out good or bad. A little far from downtown.
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn and Suites Austin - University Area

review_text: I took my daughter's softball team up there last month for the national softball tournament and we stayed at this hotel. I was not sure what we were going to be getting for the price. We were presently surprised. The rooms & grounds,were very clean. The pool is awesome. We had two cars broken into the first night there. They only have security on weekends. I guesss the thieves know this.

review_title: Very affordable, clean & family friend hotel.
review_text: We stayed here twice we were very pleased with the accommodations. Very affordable, clean & family friendly place to stay. It was easy access to all of austin attractions. We will definitely be returning to this hotel.

review_title: You get what you pay for
review_text:
Can't really complain for the price.
Very out dated hotel that is in desperate need of a make over.
Room smelt of mould, in fairness staff did offer 2 other rooms but they wernt much better. Should have security at night as very rough neighborhood, wouldn't recommend for families.
On last day staff where very rude, kept harassing me to check out even though I organized a late check out. They then said it will be an extra $3 and and kept chasing it, sersiouly wtf

review_title: Best value in austin for the price
review_text: I stay here everytime im in austin and I've never have any problems .Everybody who works here has always been super nice and helpful .
It was our first visit to SFO, and after this incredible experience at InterContinental with staff and service we are definitely willing to return (very soon).

We stayed here on a recent trip and we really liked it. The rooms were modern and fresh, the beds comfortable with nice linens. The bar and restaurant were very nice. We had the buffet breakfast which was pricey but in line with what you typically find at a hotel of this type. Parking was $60 dollars a night ( welcome to San Francisco!). We were within walking distance to shopping and restaurants.

The walls are so thin. I could hear every thing that was being said by the gentlemen in the room next to me until 11:30 at night. The other room next to mine was a young family with a baby that cried throughout the night. The parents in this room also screamed and cursed a lot. I dont expect people to change their behavior. I do expect not to hear it like they are in the same room as me. I travel quite a bit but this is my first stay at a Townplace Suites. I am guessing all of these properties have very thin walls. 
The room was very nice, well equiped and clean.

review_title: Lovely hotel & delicious Michelin star restaurant!
review_text:
Really enjoyed our 2 night stay which we scored a great deal with priceline.
Pros
- Not in the direct hustle bustle of San Fran but close enough to walk. Within a couple of blocks is Westfield (bloomingdales, nordstrom etc), cable car terminal & there on is downtown - Macy's, union square etc.
- Soft linen & comfy beds
- extremely helpful conceirge 
- must eat @ Luce, modern american cuisine & Michelin star restaurant 
- across the road is budget car hire so you can walk over & pick up your car then drive back to pick up your luggage & check out...super convineant! 
Cons
- bit of a wait for concierge 
- noisy fire truck sirens that go down Howard St
All in all, definitely would recommend it for comfort & convenience!

review_title: Nice hotel, great concierge & other service, OK location
review_text: The hotel was nice, loved the scent they use use in the lobby! We loved the help from the concierge service who helped us get Alcatraz tickets that were quickly selling out - thanks Bill! The hotel practically has everything you need. We forgot a razor and a toothbrush and they were able to bring both to our room. But, the only negative to the hotel is the location. This was our first trip to San Francisco so we weren't sure where to stay - but always heard Union Square is the place. The hotel is walking distance to the square, by there is not a whole lot of choices for dinner. We were disappointed by bad meals near the hotel and that the XXX area is just a few blocks away - with some pretty scary locals hanging around. With that said I would like to say that our favorite area was ghirardelli square & (all time fave) Chesnut Street - it has fabulous dining options and wonderful one-of-a-kind boutique shopping. Also, San Fran hasn't figured out a solution for their homeless population. We didn't have any issues but it would be hard with small children I think. And really sad to see :( Seemed like more here than in NYC. Recommendations: Alcatraz tour really is all it's cracked up to be... Great, nicely run tour. Top notch! Muir Woods, and absolute must is to walk the Golden Gate Bridge... It's absolutely breath taking!

Just had a large cockroach sprint across the kitchen floor, may have came in throu the vents. Apparently it is not an immediate issue because the front desk who we called repeatedly said they are busy at the moment.. Currently packing up and calling to find a clean, cockroach free hotel

review_title: Great views of SF in a spacious room!
review_text:
Ok, so this isn't your typical review of Parc 55. I stayed in a suite on the 31st floor. And let me tell you, the views are A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!! The suite was huge.. master bath w/ jacuzzi, enormous half bath, fax, sitting area, dining table, desk in room, mini bar/kichenette. There was 4 of us but you could easily sleep 8-10.
Pros: spacious suite, VERY clean, comfortable rollaway/cot (I didn't get to try out the bed), True Blue Spa (Bath & Body Works) products, =) I *love* the little vent thingie under the windows... can breathe fresh air any time.
Con: The TV remote didn't always work (may just need new batteries). Gets a little noisy even that high up. Expected tho since it IS downtown. Their solution.. provide earplugs! Awesome. =)
Concierge Lounge: Hor d'ourves -- soda, Starbucks coffee, crab cakes, artichoke/veggie dish, various cheese & crackers, fruit. Dessert -- lemon meringue cake, cookies. Slept in so didn't get to check our continental breakfast. =(
My favorite memory: Coming back from spending the day downtown and finding a box of Le Helge chocolate on the bed.... and on the dining table.... complimentary bottle of champagne and chocolate covered strawberries!!! =) HEAVEN.
I do have one suggestion though for the manager (should they ever read this): PLEASE invest in a full size mirror. It can easily go in one of the bathrooms or in the bedroom. Us girls love to do a head-to-toe outfit check before we head out on a night (or day) out in the town. ;)

review_title: Nickel and dime you after you think your getting a good rate.
review_text: Paid $200 for the room. Then $60/day for parking. Want Internet - extra. Extra bed- extra. Had a lotion called "grin and bear it" in the bathroom. That says it all. Won't be back here.

review_title: I'm picky and found my 7 day stay great.
review_text: I stayed here one night and was pleased, but then got a killer discount at a much more pricier place. I couldn't tell a difference other than the room is smaller. After my stay elsewhere (on lengthy business trip) I returned here for a week stay. Everything is up to date, very clean (coming from a germ phobe) and the staff are knowledgeable, helpful and soo nice. At $44 a night it's comparable to a $80 place. Only downside is it isn't easy to find and the entrance sign is tiny. If you're looking for a good deal, value modernity and cleanliness forget the red roof. It's by tons of restaurants and only a few miles from downtown action. The flat screen, pristine frig and microwave is a bonus as well as daily breakfast and by breakfast I'm talking waffles!

review_title: Stay elsewhere unless you like shabby rooms with a very strong smell of industrial-strength cleaning products!
review_text: Good price and friendly staff don't make up for shabby room that smelled overwhelmingly of disinfectant cleaning products. Breakfast was adequate at best- if you like cold cereal, canned fruit, or powdered eggs. "Gym" was basically non-existent- 3 cardio machines (1 of which was broken) in a box-sized room with poor AC (and the outside temp was 95, so inside was worse!) Better to stay elsewhere!

After having what can only be classified as the worst day ever we arrive in San Fran excited our luck is about to change.. WRONG.. After waiting 2 hours to even get to our room because President Obama is here at hotel, we get a room that is no where NEAR what I had purchased so they show me 2 other rooms one being handicapped, and I finally am so tired ( pregnant, business just burnt down.. Long day) I take a room and say screw it.. After all we still have the VIP club access to some very neat things so we can just head up there. Key doesn't work to gain access, go to front desk to be told nothing like that exists and we should be at Mark Hopkins and they can transfer our luggage there. We r so tired, frustrated, beat down, we say no.. Pay the 150.00 for dinner and come to find out that room does so very much exist. Chefs prepare food not on menu, food buffet, presentations, we missed all that bc the staff here is obviously not on the same page and untrained. I get the president thing I do. The 3 blocks we had to carry all our luggage down to even gain access INTO hotel was inconvenient but not there fault. This however is such a sad terrible experience when u intentionally laid over in SF to have a romantic evening and get this.. Patrick at the front desk was truly a gem.. I however would not recommend this place.

Great stay.the rooms are very nice and the service is top notch. Very close to union square and a great irish pub across the street with live music...service is poor...but who cares its a bar. The only complaints are that they are stingy with their internet connections and its about two blocks from the square..but close enough. a few blocks to the east it gets a bit shady, but if youre near the hotel its fine.
I am very fussy and was very pleased with the hotel it was updated with comfortable beds spacious rooms very clean

Spent 3 days here last week, had the last day free. A bit far from downtown but room was big and roomy, beds comfy, full kitchen. Liked the pool, and the staff were friendly and helpful. There was a free shuttle bus to downtown (you need to preorder). For the rate I paid It was excellent value and a little gem in Austin.

This was the second time I had stayed at the hotel. The first time I was happy for the price what we got and therefore booked with them another time. The room the second time had a hole in the wall and the wallpaper was peeling. Why wouldn't you just take the 30 seconds to glue down that paper? Anyway- I left a pair of jeans in the hotel room. For a month I called them always having to be transferred to housekeeping who I always got an answering machine. I left a message everytime with my number with specifics on what I was looking for. No one ever returned my call. Finally I left a message with the front desk hoping it would be given to management. All I asked was for a call back, even if they didn't have the jeans!!! -and I said that! No one called me back. It's too bad because I would've given them another chance if they would have responded.
Right smack dab in the middle of hipster central. Funky fun, but small rooms. Loved looking over the pool. You can be even more hip at the San Jose next door, but for a price.

review_title: Just what I was hoping for!
review_text: Very comfortable and clean. I read other reviews about it being dated, so it must have been recently upgraded because I did not find this to be the case. Nice flat screen TV in the bedroom. The staff was terrific, very patient and super helpful! Way to go Homewood. I cant wait to come back!
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Austin South / Airport

review_title: Clean good value hotel, but very noisy
review_text: Stayed there for one night on a biz trip, the room was of Decent size, clean, with typical amenity for hotel at this level, nice selection at breakfast buffet with both hot and cold selection plus self made waffle which was a staple at residence inn usually instead of fairfield inn. good value for money, that is if you are a deep sleeper and do not mind the almost hourly freight train during the night.

The hotel is in a nice location - just in front of The Domian. But there is a railway track behind the hotel and if you are a lite sleeper, then this is not the hotel - though you could request a room that is not facing the track. 
Good: free wifi, decent sized rooms, free breakfast, free parking, easy access to freeway
Bad: Noisy A/c, railway track behind the property,price/day for this class of hotel

This was our first time staying at an Embassy Suites and it will be the last! The carpets were absolutly filthy. Our son's legs and feet were black from crawling on the floor. We requested a room change. The second room was no better. Both rooms smelled like mold and body odor. We found a live roach in the bathroom and by the door, made me not want to eat the free breakfast. We were extreamlly disappointed. Would not reccomend to anyone!
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Austin - Downtown/Town Lake Austin Texas

review_text: I stayed here for a week while doing research at UT. I wanted an efficient, decent, reasonably-priced hotel near the UT campus. The hotel mostly fitted that bill. The room was a bit dark and noisy -- next to the freeway, and I didn't like the charges in the business center, or the slowness of the free wifi (I guess done deliberately to make you pay to upgrade). However, service was good (although the poor guy on the front desk was often alone and overwhelmed) and prompt; I had room service twice and it was efficient and tasty. If you don't have a car there aren't too many dining options in the evening-- Denny's next door, and then a fifteen minute walk through deserted streets to the very interesting East Village area. This hotel was thus decent enough, but nothing to write home about. If you wanted something clean, efficient, and near t the University, and you have a car, I'd recommend.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Austin - University Area

review_title: Decent downtown stay in this older Embassy Suites
review_text:
This hotel is older but is currently undergoing reservations (noisy). The rooms though we're well-maintained and were typical Embassy Suite layouts. The service was very good. 
My only negative comment is in the parking. Embassy Suites uses space in a detached parking garage. There is no covered pathway to the hotel so there is a problem in bad weather. Also, you can only park on the third floor and above. There is however valet parking for $20 (versus $14 for self-park). 
Overall a pleasant stay.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Austin - Downtown/Town Lake Austin Texas

review_text: Great value - a short walk to all downtown venues as well as to SoCo venues. Urbanesque feel ... Average but clean rooms ... Manager's reception is a plus
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Austin - Downtown/Town Lake Austin Texas

review_text: This isn't the most beautiful place I stay but it's a good value. If your going to go to downtown you can walk and take a peddle cab back(20$) you can't beat an evening reception and a hot breakfast. I just wish they would have said they would make pancakes on the menu! I've stayed here many times.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Austin - Downtown/Town Lake Austin Texas

review_text:
We have stayed here on and off for nearly 30 years. Just stayed with grand kids and overall just great. Great included breakfast with lots of variety. Only drawback is they are understaffed at breakfast by about 1 person. Breakfast is busy and many items need constant attention like coffee and milk. Hot breakfast has always been good. We didnt use happy hour much. 
Rooms are dated but clean. Saw model of planned room upgrades and it looks fine. 
Hotel well located for downtown activities. Bat bridge 1/4 block away.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Austin - Downtown/Town Lake Austin Texas

review_text:
Very clean, and a very nice and capable staff. However, I was disappointed with the internet connection in the room. Wifi worked in lobby, but only occasionally in the room. We returned late afternoon the 2nd day and found our room had not been serviced. Of course the staff took care of it, but...
The in-room coffee service was terrible. If you go, and like coffee, take your own Wolfgang Puck coffee pods (not the Keurig type).
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Austin - University Area

review_text: I stayed here for five nights while attending a conference. The hotel is in a good location, but does need some updating. The room appear in need of changes, but the sleep number bed was nice. Overall the stay was good, but could have been better.

review_title: Good location. Hotel is a little worn
review_text: The location of hotel is great for walking the lake and sitting out with a nice view. Our room looked down congress st and toward the state capital which was nice. The bathroom is small and a little worn. Okay for a nights stay..not for a long stay.

For the first time me and my family decided to go to Austin and see what's down there. We are from San Antonio tx. Let me tell u the hotel was awesome really clean n service was good I would recommend it to people and I believe will be back out there soon again to the same hotel. Thank u for making our three day weekend one of the best.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Austin - Sunset Valley

review_title: Great location, clean and spacious rooms!
review_text: I brought my husband here for his 40th and I couldn't be more satisfied. The hotel is in prime location, right next to the lake and trails, the Congress Bridge where you can watch the bats at night, and a short walk to 6th Street, state Capitol, and much more. We were able to walk to some great restaurants and bars from here. The staff was friendly and helpful. Also, it was convenient to have TGI Friday's and Starbucks in the hotel. The pool is not bad, and most importantly, our room was very clean and a nice size.
The Radisson Hotel was overall a great hotel. The only problem I had is that we had four people in one room and our room had one king size bed and a sofa bed, the sofa bed was so so uncomfortable.
Nice view from the room to town lake. Easy access from the airport but still centrally located. Features tgi and starbucks too.

This hotel was a little difficult to navigate to but once there the property was nice and clean and the staff was friendly.
There was not a fridge or microwave in the room, which I like to have so I would probably look for a different property next time that had those.

I recently stayed here for work and felt this hotel is a potential 5 rating for business or personal trip.
The lobby was under construction, but the rooms were finished. Even with the dust, the employees and contractors were very hospitable.
There's free parking and a satisfactory breakfast. If the distance from downtown is fine for you, and expectations are not for the Ritz, this on my personal top 5 in Austin.

Got a good rate at this hotel, relative to other hotels in Austin, but now I see why. The Internet is so slow that it's unusable. Even the Slowski's would get frustrated with it. When I brought it to the attention of the lady at the front desk, she was disinterested and even made a comment that led me to believe this is an ongoing problem.

review_title: Not super luxury, but quiet clean hotel, good value
review_text: Hotel room was clean & quiet. There was heavy road construction on highway, but did not really affect stay. Neighbourhood was nice immediaty around Inn. All facilities work & most important AC worked perfectly. We did not use pool, but several guest were and it looked ok. It was outside hotel & a little on small side. The bed was comfortable enough & showerhead was quality message type. Had very few if any complaints. Would stay again if in area. This hotel was the best value for the money we could find in South Austin area. Was fairly close to a great mall that was a few miles to west. NO noise from airport that was also fairly close

review_title: Nice room, good location, great price!
review_text: We got this room thru Priceline name your own price for $45! It has a king size Sleep Number mattress. That may seem small or insignificant to some, but my husband prefers a firm mattress and I prefer a softer mattress. That translates into everybody is happy!
Good hotel n accomodations, but it is far awar from center and there is not subway or easy transport. Not feel save to walk around after dark.

review_title: Excellent location and good value for money
review_text:
Just back from a long weekend in Austin, where we stayed at the Radisson. Despite some of the other reviews we found the hotel to be a good place to stay, only a few minutes walk from 6th Street. The staff were very friendly and the room was spotlessly clean. The maid service was also very good. On the whole well with staying here.
We used the Starbucks on site for breakfast and this was typical Starbucks, nothing special but good service.

This is a truly lovely boutique hotel. It is different from all the nice hotels I've stayed before. The room quality is to the level of Hilton or westin if not better! The memory foam bed is exceptional! The staff are friendly. I was in room 223 for my second stay at this hotel. I would definitely come back again and again.

review_title: Great trendy hotel with impeccable customer service
review_text: Definately recommend this hotel to anyone looking forward to a fun trendy hotel experience not too far from downtown Austin!

review_title: Nice room, newer hotel, free wifi
review_text: No surprises here--it's a courtyard. Good news is that it's a newer property in a generally good location--close to restaurants and you can walk to Whole Foods to stock the fridge for breakfast.

review_title: I love Austin and this is a good location
review_text: I had a business trip here and loved the location of this hotel. A couple blocks from 6th street. Good value here. I have stayed here a few times

review_title: Out dated but a good choice for a long stay.
review_text:
I was in Austin on business for seven weeks and I did not want to stay in a hotel. I read the previous reviews and I expected much less but I would stay again. The grounds are over grown and the location is in area that has seen better days but you can see progress. There are a few luxury car dealers within a mile and several bus stops and a metro rail station within walking distance. Yes there is a strip club and yes there is noise next door on the weekends but this was a better choice for me. 
The room was clean but very out dated and the fully stocked kitchen was poorly stocked and I ended up buying a peeler, sharp knife, baking sheet, colander. 
The house keeping staff were very nice and always said hi and always asked how your room was and if you needed any thing. 
The breakfast had good choices but for a long stay it gets old very quickly so I started making my own. 
The Internet is very poor and always seemed to go out and I really could not get anything done in my room.
All in all I think it's a good value for a long stay and better than a hotel room. Don't expect 5 stars and you will be okay.

review_title: Despite one loud night great hotel
review_text: My husband and I just stayed 2 nights (wed and thurs) . The hotel was in a great location not easily walkable to south congress location but that was not a night scene we were looking for. The hotel was good , the pool is pretty much non existent and the only downside to the ammenities. Overnight parking was 21 dollars a night non valet , which to us seemed reasonable. We came across a noisy bacherlorette party next to us on Thursday . Had to call down to the desk. While it was addressed by the security it continued including the ladies banging on our door after our complaint . Lovely. Maybe since we are a young couple they assumed we'd ve okay with the noise ? They weren't being that loud all things considering but the walls were thin. Not a good thing and happy we were not here for the weekend noise.

review_title: Can be better, but if you pay standard room rate, look for other hotel in the area.
review_text: Poor Internet, poor shower , good breakfast with excellent view. We stay with a good family rate but if you pay for standard rate, it doesn't worth it. Only worth $150/ day not more than that. Good location. TV channel not enough. I will stay somewhere if I visit San Francisco again.

review_title: Staff is wonderful we experience an issue and they turned it around with an upgraded room
review_text: Enjoyed our stay and looking forward for great evening with my wife

review_title: Clean however some amenities not working.
review_text: Rooms were very clean, however the pool, tv & guest laundry were not working during our stay. Therefore we a little disappointed since we were expecting to go swimming.

review_title: Perfectly suitable for a visit to Austin
review_text: Staff at the hotel were aggressively hospitable. Couldn't walk 10 feet without someone offering a genuine greeting. Onsite full service restaurant and Starbucks a great surprise.

I've stayed at this hotel several times and would definitely recommend if you can get significantly cheaper than the Hilton on 5 th street. Rooms are very clean and beds are great. Parking is very expensive, but garage across the street was $11/day. Pool is a joke, if that's important look elsewhere. Nice bar on top floor with great views. Location is excellent as 6th street is right outside your door. I like that only guests with room keys can access elevator.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Austin Downtown/Convention Center

review_title: Central location with efficient and excellent service
review_text: Great service with a restaurant and bar on site. Since it's combined with residence inn, some facilities like gym are shared. Valet parking is expense at $ 27/nite.rooms are clean and functional. Ask for rooms overlooking 4th street

I recently stayed here for a few weeks. I was able to negotiate a weekly deal before hand. In the end, I was quite pleased. The service was attentive. Heather was a great receptionist, the most consistent face I saw.
The rooms are your standard courtyard cookie-cutter type. The flat screen did not come in clear on numerous occasion. The showers were not fantastic either, but for business purposes, the rooms were fine.
I would recommend this place for any traveler. It is close to 6th street and good food just south. For families, the Residence Inn maybe more accommodating, even though you get 5 instead of 10 Marriott points per $.

review_title: Nice rooms though small. Good location.
review_text:
Rooms are nicely renovated but a little small. Breakfast was at top of hotel which had beautiful views of san Francisco. We love the view. 
Location is good, just a block away from union square where all the shopping is. 
Reception and bell service was good. However as we needed some help in deciding what to do, the service at concierge wasn't as helpful or friendly. The stay would have been much better if the service we encounter at concierge could be better. 
Hotel rates considered high for the room size. Would recommend if location is main consideration without regard for room size.

review_title: They hangup on you, they lie,and take your money worst service ever!
review_text: All I have to say is the guest service is terrible!!! I called today after a two day stay over the weekend to ask wen I would get my deposit back, and they said that I wasn't gettin it back cause we had a boombox and partied I'n our room which was not true at all we never had no one I'n the room and never had a boombox what so ever! All I have to say is that I'm pissed because wen I called the lady tells me she seen us do all this when im most certain none of this happened and hangs up on me. Some guest service they got, I've never been the type to even complain about anything but this was juss some BS! I don't recommend this place at all!!!

I recently attended a conference that was being held at the Grand Hyatt, so for convenience booked a 2 night stay at the hotel. I usually like to stay at boutique hotels for a more personal touch. I was a bit wary that the Grand Hyatt would be like a "convention center" type hotel, but had a really wonderful time. 
 The location is perfect. I was fortunate to get a room overlooking Union square with the Christmas tree and ice-rink in view. Macys, Saks, and Barneys are just down the street and so cute to see the SPCA dogs and cats up for adoption in the windows of Macys. It is a few blocks north of the Montgomery BART stop.
 The room was spacious, modern and bright. Instead of drapery, there was a button operated window screen. I felt so relaxed. The only thing that I disliked was that one could hear the wind, but I was so tired that once I fell asleep, it wasn't an issue.
 The restaurant on the 37th floor has panoramic views of the bay and city. Unfortunately the area reserved for happy hour is limited, so it was packed at 5pm. With so many great restaurants in San Francisco including those with Michelin stars, I ended up eating outside the restaurant.
 I am definitely looking forward to returning to San Francisco and a stay at the Grand Hyatt!

review_title: Grand Hyatt right on Unuion Square
review_text:
A very nice weekend stay at the Grand Hyatt San Francisco. The hotel is in a great location, next to all the major shopping in Union Square, most of the live theaters, easy walk to Chinatown, North Beach, Ferry Building and Fisherman's Wharf.
The rooms have been completely remodeled since my last stay two years ago. Very nice rooms, the higher floors have great views of the city.

Still here writing the review from out crappy room with no view. We are on our honeymoon and the previous three hotels we stayed in made us feel welcome and gave us great room one even gave us a bottle of wine. Check in was average guy was not friendly at all. The last thing you want after a flight from Chicago. This is our last stop before returning to Australia. We were hoping it would e the Best hotel yet. I think if the guy had have cared when we were checking in things may have been better. Our room is small with no view. Staff are friendly but don't go out of their way like the previous hotels. Location is great. The restaurant is ok for breakfast but I would not recommend dinner there. Overall a disappointing last stop.

I am going to start off by saying I have never written a review, much less a bad one but this experience deserves one. We try to go to a resort once a month.
 I would have to say it is not what I had built it up to be. The service was well below par. A little word of Advice do not go down to the marina the staff there are very unprofessional and the rental water sports are less than attractive. Not worth renting. The resort does not live up to the caliber associated with the price. I would have to say the only way I would stay here again is if it was free.

I've states here several times for work. The staff is very friendly and the location is perfect, just stumbling distance from the 6th street bars. I would give it a perfect score if it weren't for an incident I had the last time I was there. Not too long after I had checked out of the hotel and was out of the city that I realized that I left my book of DVDs in the room. I called several times to retrieve my movies only to get redirected to the housekeeping office voicemail. It wasn't til days later that the staff finally searched the room and said they couldn't find them. I know for a fact that I left the movies in my room and the Guy who stayed there after me probably took off with them. I recognize that it's my fault that I left the DVDs in the room, but I feel that if the responce was more swift I would have been able to get them back. Still love this place, though!
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Austin Downtown/Convention Center

review_text: This hotel has the worst customer service I've ever experienced in a hotel and as a business traveller thats saying alot. Kayla at the front desk was extremely rude and made no apologies for it. We requested a room for four people through Hotwire and when we arrived we were told there were no double rooms only a king with fold out bed. Kayla talked down to us like we were lesser customers for booking through Hotwire. The manager did nothing to accommodate us and said maybe next time don't use Hotwire. Perhaps they need to stop using Hotwire as their agent to sell rooms then. The fold out sofa has a 3 inch foam mattress that is horrible. They should not be allowed to sell these as "double" rooms. On top of that, there is a $26 per day charge for parking, yet you still have to wait 15-20 minutes for car retrieval each time you leave. If you're going to charge that much, make sure you have adequate staff for good customer service. Finally at 2:30 in the morning on the first night of our stay we were awakened by a full on brawl happening in the hallway with at least 8-10 people. It took several calls to get security to come up and when they did they just told them to "calm down and go to bed guys". Absolutely the worst hotel experience I've ever had which is a shame for Hilton.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Austin Downtown/Convention Center

review_text: We were brought to Lakeway Resort due to bad circumstances. We had to leave our home due to mandatory fire evacuations. Everyone at Lakeway Resort treated us like family. Taking care of everything for us. Showing genuine concern for our family. We can never put into words how much this meant to us. We are forever fans of Lakeway resort & will return.

A considerable dip in the lake due to draught, but still a beautiful view overlooking the lake. The adult only infinity pool was my favorite part of our whole stay! Pool bar is expensive, 1 beer and a bloody mary were $16 before tip. Room was standard, no bells or whistles. Bed was comfy. Dark hallways. Very curteous staff. A wonderful anniversary!

We got a great rate on Priceline for our room. The location is great and the staff provided us a 4 mile running trail map so we didn't drive to town lake. They even provided us a bottle of water when we returned. The room was nice but the walls are thin and a group that got to their room at 3am woke us up for about an hour. I like the aveda shampoo in the bathroom! overall if you want a nice room for a decent price I recommend this hotel.

We came to Lakeway Resort and Spa this summer for a couples geraway. Read the reviews, but thought we'd see for ourselves. Overall, not a bad place to stay but the difference between this resort and the others we have been to is the attention to details and service. We had a Jr. Suite that had lots of space, but lacked any comfortable seating, had bucks and scrapes in the furniture and the walls. The bathroom ceiling had been patched, the tile floor was cheap and dated...the only wow in the room was the lakeview. 
We spent our days at.the pool. They had a person whose job was to walk the pool and take food and drink orders, bit on each of our three days, no one ever stepped foot near the adult pool or asked to take our order. Staff was nice, just kinda lazy. If you asked they came to your service, but you definitely had to seek them out.
The pools areas are very nice. A large adult pool and a fun family pool area too.
Overall this hotel was fine, just not the level of service and attention to detail that we have received at other area resorts like Hyatt Lost Pines and the Four Seasons.

I really enjoyed my stay at the Renaissance in Austin. It was our anniversary that weekend and the staff helped to make it a pleasant one. 
We ate Banderas the first night and even though they're going through some reservation they still opened it up to my husband and I. Not sure if the information desk personel is having miscommunication with the restaurant, but they told us at first that we could not eat there. However we did, and the waiter was extremely kind and gave us discounts for having served the military.
Because my husband was there for busness we did not get to experience the hotels amenities to the fullest, but I can tell you that the lobby area was superb. I loved going down to study near the fish tank and sit out on the balcony. The cafe area is neat as well, despite the rude (tall heavy blonde) lady that served me my bland chai latte. I hope she was just having a bad morning.
The only real semi negative thing I can say about the hotel is that the carpets need better maintaining and the toilets and sinks need an upgrade. 
I would definitely stay again and I enjoyed the shopping area as well.
Right down the street from 6th. Great sports bar.

review_title: Hotel nice, Service not so much.
review_text: A few friends and I decided to stay here for a few nights to explore downtown Austin. On the first night, we caught a male worker looking through our window (which was facing an inside area of the hotel). I waved at him, and he moves down 5 feet and keeps looking. My friend had begun undressing when he stopped, forgetting about the window. The front desk claims that is a rule that workers have to "check out the guests" since it was Mardi Gras weekend. On the second day, my friends bra disappeared from the floor after housekeeping came in. Nobody knew how to help us. They simply claimed it was probably picked up on accident and was in the laundry that they were 6 days behind on. The hotel was nice, but the service was horrible and had no idea how to help us.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Austin Downtown/Convention Center

review_text: A great place to stay in Austin. Get a room in the Spa building that are newer. Don't miss the golf courses, which are among the best in Texas. The highlight has to be the breakfast buffet, which has everything from fruits to eggs and meats and pancakes. A special time to visit is December when the resort is lit for Christmas and has an outdoor ice skating rink.

My friends joined me for breakfast and were charged $16 for parking - more than in NYC, and Barton Creek is in the middle of nowhere. Breakfast should not close at 9 in a resort during the week. Wakeup call was late.

review_title: Overall VERY good, but location could be better
review_text: The service here is VERY helpful on every level, from the valet to the concierge. Extremely convenient to semi-upscale shopping and dining. The location could be better, however, in terms of Austin nightlife. Best suited for business travel or family visits, not so much for the "hip, young" crowd.

The service was slow in checking in, getting food, getting directions, and checking out. It was not slow because of lines, but because of disorganization. 
I will not stay here again.

Beautiful hotel and property grounds. Check in was quick and easy and customer service received from all was great!
