The room was larger than most, very clean, comfortable pillowtop bed with down comforter and pillows. I knew the hotel had an indoor pool and fitness room which were both very nice. It was a wonderful surprise that it also has a very nice dry sauna and 
jacuzzi. I stayed a couple of nights over New Years weekend. It's surrounded by a variety of stores, specialty shops and just about any type of restaurant you can think of from fast food to fine dining. I would definitely stay at this hotel 
again. 
again.

review_title: Great start to our first USA trip!!!!
review_text:
We are a family with 2 young children, so we decided to stay in the heart of this beaufitul city of San Francisco, as this was our firt trip to USA. We picked to stay at Grand Hyatt simply becasue it was affordable and after reading many of the reviews if was an easy decission. SO here is what we though about our stay at Grand Hyatt. Staff at the hotel was outstanding, very helpfull and always willing and able to answer all of out questions. Concierge staff we especially helpfull (one in partucular, from memory i think his name was Tom), he helped us organise our day tours and tickets to the Alkatraz. 
Rooms: We had a pleasure at staying in one of high flood rooms (2919) and we loved it. The view was just breath taking overlooking Union Square. Decor was modern and very sleek. Beds were very comfourtable which really help to have a good nights rest after a very long day of exploaring the city. Each morning we had our breakfast at the floor restaurant and the food was fantastic. Service was just as great. And the view amazing!!!! 
So thank you to everyone at Grand Hyatt for the start to our holiday to be one very unfogetfull and plasurable experience. If we come again to San Francisco we will definitelly be choosing Grand Hyatt as our accomodation. We loved every day we spent there!!!! 
Thank you!

The experience matches the expectation. You expect a great hotel, a great room and a receptive and friendly staff. 
You get all of this with a central downtown location. Modern decor and amenities in the refurbished room I had on the 14th floor including iPhone and USB ports on the bedside radio and lots of charging outlets. 
Will definitely be back!

Ok we stayed in room 616
Beds- comfortable, but small
(no bed bugs)
Food = good but overpriced like wow!
View was exceptional
Bathroom was out dated and looked as if it needed a touch up 
Walls in room were scuffed up and wall border was falling off, no fridge- closet door was broken-
When you pay 269 ( not taxed) for a room on a thursday night at a hyatt, in my opinion more is expected! I took pictures

Front desk staff very unaccomadating. We arrived 1hour before check in time, we were told there was "no way" we could get into our rooms early. The desk clerk suggested we contact Priceline, where we booked our rooms. We had to get ready for an event we were attending in the lobby restroom that was the "best" Intercontinental Austin could do for us.
It was a quite annoying the next morning at 8:00am when housekeeping woke us up, banging on all of the doors down the hall. 
Hard to believe there werent ANY clean rooms at 1:00!
I expect excellent service from this type of hotel, and it was awful!
We won't be back.
Great hotel! Amazing city views! Lovely room comfy bed! I will be returning!

review_title: A new touch of luxury in San Francisco
review_text: The location was very good because Union Square is at walking distance. People were very polite and the service was good and effective. The rooms all have a plasma TV (which is important for some people). The view was my favorite part because you had a view of the buildings of San Francisco and The Transamerican Building

the door to the room barely worked. The king bed I booked was two twins and was told there was nothing else available. The room was second floor and the view was ac units. The tvs are old. The pipes spit out rust every time you brush your teeth. There may have even been prostitution going on in the lobby but no way to be sure. At 90 bucks a night I expected a halfway respectable place but I was unpleasantly surprised otherwise.

Good location. Nice people. They have a serious problem with car break ins while car is parked in parking garage. Apparently, this week, they had two car break in...one being my rental car. The crooks break your window and steal your GPS. I would not park your car in the garage.

review_title: Location, Location, Location (aka you get what you pay for)
review_text: This hotel is pricey. Just like most luxury hotels they charge for everything other than your room- wi-fi, parking, in room movies, whatever. If you accept that going into your stay, chances are you will love this hotel! (if not, just look elsewhere, you will not be happy here.) I had a room on the 31st floor with a spectacular view...loved it. If you don't get a room with a water view, take yourself up to the 36th floor and splurge on a cocktail, breakfast, lunch, or even coffee and dessert. Worth whatever it costs - I particularly like breakfast, as you can watch the fog roll in/out over Alcatraz. Service throughout the hotel is courteous and professional...but be aware, this is not a small boutique hotel where everybody knows your name. It is huge hotel, and it may feel a little impersonal, but I thought I paid for excellent service and received it. For me, the location is all - easy to get everywhere, lots of fab shopping, great dining within a few blocks, EZ walk to Chinatown...I just don't think it can be beat. And when it is all said and done, that's what I am paying for - LOCATION. A helpful hint...price a room with access to the Club Lounge. It will cost, but includes breakfast, snacks, hor d'eourves, dessert and coffee, etc. There's even a cappuccino machine! When you add it all up, you may find the extra cost is more than worth it. An added benefit - the club is on the corner of the 32nd floor with 2 full walls of windows...spectacular view!

This past week was my second time staying there. Each time for business. Each time wifi was down for at least a day which is not good for the business traveller.
Will now be back.

I have just arrived at my hotel. First impressions, parking lot seedy and dirty, reception a bit misplaced. Hotel lobby appears spacious and grand but that is where it ends. Corridors to rooms smelly and old and not a welcoming feeling. Rooms tiny, and no safes provided which i find an absolute necessity for a business class hotel especially if you are travelling with valuables and electronics, passports etc. Option to safe valuables at front desk but what an inconvenience. On arrival it appeared that the bedding had not been changed as it was creased and duvet covers had stains, and bed covers seemed old and tattered. Lights in rooms were also confusing and arriving in the dark is problimatic as you have to walk across the room to turn lamps on. Matters were raised with the front desk but they were unable to deal with any of my issues. I normally give the establishment the benefit of rectifying problems but in this case nothing was done. I find this hotel to be of extremely poor standard and would avoid this hotel and and any other Sheraton in future if this is the standard to go by.
There are some nice rooms at the SFA but there are some lousy rooms. On my last stay I had a room that should have been refurbished several years ago. The hotel is getting long in the tooth.
Really nice place to stay. The service couldn't have been better. Very close to Union Square.
Enjoyed my stay here, very good hotel in good location. Would definitely recommend it to everyone.

We stayed at the Grand Hyatt for six nights in June this year, and had a fab time. Our room was on the 25th floor, giving us great views across the city. The room was spacious and had everything we needed. The Portico toiletries were replenished daily - I couldn't get enough of them! Bed was huge and there was a good selection of tv channels (if you can find time to watch tv!). My other half enjoyed playing with the electric blind on the huge floor-to-ceiling window.
The hotel charges for wifi, so if we wanted to check emails, etc we just went to the Starbucks across the street and used their free wifi while enjoying a coffee. 
The hotel is in a great location. It's within very easy walking distance of the main shopping area and Chinatown. We also walked to City Hall and Fisherman's Wharf (though this wouldn't have been as pleasant in cold or wet weather. Public transport is easily accessible from the hotel too and I don't think it's too far from the business district.
We ate in the hotel's restaurant on our last night, and had a beautiful meal which wasn't overly expensive. The views from up there are amazing.
Overall, I would recommend this hotel and would definitely stay there again on my next visit to San Fran.

I walked in and the service was good with valet parking but the bell hop took a long time to get to the room, the front desk put us in a room we didn't pay for and the rooms are very small and all the stuff you have to buy is double or triple regular price and there's no place to put stuff in a fridge because it's all taken up by the overpriced wine, etc. I would NOT recommend this hotel to anyone!

review_title: Good value, good location but could use some update in hardware.
review_text: Stayed there last night on business. The hotel was converted from a military command center, with an atrium in the middle and rooms around it, very nice layout of lobby, facility and rooms. Staffs are very attentive, very nice breakfast buffet, and convenient shuttle to the airport terminals. The downsides are: there is no auto mode on the air conditioner/ heater, so could be very annoying during night since it is really loud, the wireless Internet connection was terrible, just could not get on at all.

Located in downtown San Francisco, ideal place. Near Powell cable car line, at the base of Nob Hill.
Unimpressed with lobby, rooms are small. Bathrooms are adequate.
Good breakfast upstairs with amazing views. Service is as expected for this class of hotel. Prepared to pay over $300/night.
Location makes this a good choice. Bedding was good but the towels need to be replaced.

review_title: Trip ruined by rowdy college kids in pool and horrible service!
review_text: The last day of a really great conference I went down to the pool to relax and swim and within minutes was NAILED in the head by a football thrown by rowdy college kids. Imagine spring break. I had a headache for the rest of my night. What they don't mention is the resort is also a country club for the ill mannered wealthy spoiled surrounding families.

Hotel is actually on the airport grounds but separated from the terminals. They do have a shuttle from the terminal. 
Typical Hilton. Beds were nice and the hotel seemed clean. Nothing Wow about it but I would Definatly come back if I had an early flight.

review_title: Hilton, This Property Jeopardizes My Loyalty!
review_text: I've been Diamond level with Hilton for the past seven years but my time at the Austin Airport Hilton makes me question why? I'll give my 50+ hotel nights a year to another chain.

The front desk get a 10: Erin and Joshua went all out too make sure we had everything we needed, ranging from cold water to slaundry detergent and mint team. Erin went so far as to google places for us to try when we asked whether an yn restaurants offered lighter options. The fitness room is the size of closet but Fairfield guests have us rd. of the Marriot' s gym which is bigger. Its has 31st's elliptical machines, 3 treadmills assn do two bikes- all with th private TV sets. The Fairfield has a big problem with birds and bird droppings. The trees are filled with scores of birds (doves and others). Its is impossible to park under a tree and, as its happens, must parking spots are under a tree. Cars are splattered with droppings, the sidewalks are covered with droppings and the birds coo incessantly. This is the most disgusting Marriot owned parking lots I have ever seen. Moving back to the Fairfield's plusses, the hotel is centrally located, serves a continental breakfast each day and has free wi fi. There are guest laundry facilities too.
hotel_name: Fairfield Inn and Suites Austin South

review_title: Nice hotel, very basic amenities and no free parking or wireless Internet
review_text: The hotel is definitely average. I have been to nicer hotel for less the amount of money I paid for room. The carpets and furniture are stained which is not what I expect from a Hilton. The food has been surprisingly good but expensive. The staff were very courteous and professional.

I was initially surprised at how expensive this hotel was. But compared to the expense of staying closer to downtown this is a great value. Hotels downtown are twice as expensive and don't offer much more. Fifteen minute walk to 6th street or 2 minutes to Lady Bird Lake. Staff was very accommodating and friendly. Rooms are a bit small but why are you spending that much time in it anyway with so much to do in Austin. Breakfast was subpar and over priced but that's the only complaint I had. Seemed like a safe area. We walked just about everywhere at all hours and never felt unsafe. Seems like this city never sleeps. I would stay here again without hesitation.

I am a platinum SPG so felt compelled to stay here during a recent visit to Austin. 
Building and lobby were decent. Bar open late which is a plus. Rooms however were very average. The carpets in the hallways were stained and old. Was given a free breakfast at the restaurant due to status and it was awful. 
Parking is $18 a day and garage was empty. I wonder why?
I would stay at the Hilton down the street if I were to come back.

review_title: Not bad, not cheap, good view
review_text:
The rooms look old, the rates are high for what you get, but the view of Lady Bird Lake is awesome!
The hotel is busy but fun. Nice bar, great breakfast!
If it was 20 dollars cheaper it would be perfect!

review_title: Lovely setting, and a nice property for a convention.
review_text: We were here for two nights with a large group. The facilities for the convention were nice, and the view from our room was lovely. The resort is in a hilly area, but is not very convenient to downtown Austin. The rooms were clean and nice, and the food was pretty good. Overall, it is a nice resort, but it lacks the super luxury element.
The Sheraton downtown is a great hotel to stay at in Austin. It is clean, great service, and close to downtown.
The only issue We had is the wifi is not free ?!?! Really. ??? Ok but we loved it

Had an excellent three night stay here, the room was clean and quiet and all of my interactions with the staff were excellent. The floors are divided into four sectors or clusters of rooms so you don't get that oppressive long-hallway hotel feel, which is nice. My only complaint is that the room layout is a little weird but other than that it was recently redone with modern finishes and looked great.

Stayed july 2011. 
Excellent location if you want down town. wonderfully, relaxing rooms. Reception desk staff were distant and standoffish. Must see veiw from top floor restaurant/bar.
Messed up my credit card by charging too many things on one day so bank stopped it, then they charged me twice! Writing this on 11 oct and still no refund. Not impressed with the customer service either. Lovely hotel spoilt by people who work there. I will update this when I get a refund.

review_title: An excellent stay and would definitely return
review_text:
I stayed in a newly refurbished room. Very well appointed.
The concierge service at this hotel was wonderful. Like a private guide looking after your every need. Once the teamunderstood what experiences I was looking for, they never missed the mark. Restaurant recommendations and bookings in particular.
Thanks team, I'll be back.
This was a great hotel. Great service! Great rooms! Great Value! Great View! Great location!!! Will stay again at the right price!! Hehehe

This is a great hotel for a family. The rooms are spacious and the kitchen has everything you need which is very convenient. The hotel was very clean. There was no noise from the close freeway. The breakfast had a nice selection of cold and hot items. The staff was courteous and helpful. We will definitely consider this for our next family stay in Austin.

review_title: Poor representation of Hyatt name and city of San Francisco.
review_text: When an out of town guest tells the front desk that they did not sleep well because of certain situations in the room, the response should not be " wear earplugs" the staff not only represents the entire hyatt brand but also the city they are in. Grand hyatt San Francisco did a POOR job of representing the hyatt name and the city of San Francisco. Any guest who tells a hotel staff that they have a problem should be addressed " how can I make your stay more comfortable" or " I'm sorry you had a problem let me see what we can do for you" Not met with a Rude response. I, my co-workers, company, Family and Friends will no longer consider hyatt hotels as a viable choice of stay.

L'hotel gode di una buona posizione,a tutto il resto Ã¨ senza infamia e senza lode.. A noi non Ã¨ piaciuto, forse perchÃ¨ in luna di miele ci di aspetta qualcosa in piÃ¹ di in hotel paragonabile ad un nostro 3stelle scarso...purtroppo la ns agenzia ha deciso per noi!!! Se potete, scegliete altro che c'Ã¨ di molo meglio!!!

Stayed one night for a business trip as all other downtown hotels were full or extortionate rates. Staff were great. Room was spacious and clean. Furniture in the rooms probably a bit old but otherwise fine. Just off the highway but didn't take me long to get downtown by car.

review_title: Decent place to stay nothing extraordinary but quite serviceable - the 24-hour gym sold me.
review_text: Chose to stay here after a very disappointing stay at a local place not far away. The Embassy Suites cost a bit more but the place was clean, the towels were soft. The gym was adequate (with AC and working cardio equipment) and the staff was helpful when asked.

Attended a meeting here and enjoyed the food and service....rooms were very nice.
Lobby bar is a fun place to relax and walking distance to good music, nice dining

We paid the extra and stayed on the executive floor. It was more to do with the service you received. They had a separate section on the 25th floor where you had access to to go and have free breakfast, morning tea, afternoon tea and pre dinner nibbles and then later free deserts. There was a computer for you to use, a large tv with a comfy lounge and chairs if you wanted to watch tv in comfort. The drudges had bottles of water and fruit drinks for you to have. So like I said earlier it was the service that was the treT. The rooms all have views over the downtown. The rooms were large with a 2 seater couch and a desk and a king size bed. The rooms were very clean. You also had your bed turned down and chocolates delivered each night. We stayed 2 nights and it was great to be looked after. The staff at the front desk were the nicest we had come across throughout our trip through Texas. Super polite cheerful and had great advise on which restaurants to go to. We are not rich but this hotel made us feel like it.

Newly renovated. My room is on the 6th floor. A set of fresh doors opens up to an open balcony/walkway overlooking a spacious beautifully landscaped courtyard. Very comfortable bed. My room was cleaned each day before noon. Very quiet room. Front desk service was wonderful ... Far above the norm. The courtyard cafe had wonderfully prepared food. I am not in a hurry to leave.
I didn't need to stay downtown and this hotel fit the bill. Clean, friendly, and what you'd expect from a Marriott in any city.

review_title: Update this place and it'll be great.
review_text:
Service here is really good;however, the hotel really needs updating. TV's are really old tuned versions. Phone system is original from lates 80's (I'm guessing at age). The courtyard is really nice, but again, it needs repair. I'm sure this place is really profitable because I'll bet they haven't invested much capital here in a long time. 
Good hotel, but can really use updating to go with good service.

We stayed at the Hilton on 4th street for a business / pleasure trip. The hotel met all of our expectations. It is within walking distance of some outstanding restaurants, the convention center and the entertainment district.
IT is a typical high-rise full-service Hilton with all the amenities that you would expect.

review_title: Great pool, not so great location for leisure travelers.
review_text: We enjoyed our stay. The staff was great! The rooms were updated and the pool was excellent! The location is safe buy not ideal for leisure travelers. There isn't really any restaurants or entertainment within walking distance. The hotel is located next to a highway interchange.

As a former Austinite, I wanted to like this hotel. I didn't. The outside looks fair enough for a large convention hotel, but the inside is dreadful. The oversized lobby feels like a shopping mall, with art typical of what you see at Bed, Bath & Beyond. (Yes, I shop there and love it! But who buys the fake art? Now I know, the Hilton!) The rooms are Santa Fe light, and not what you would expect from a Downtown hotel in a self-proclaimed capital of hippness. I thought the rooms at the Hyatt were much more sophisticated if you can stand their equally tragic lobby.
Some of this could be forgiven, if not for the following. I was a bit hungover trying to grab a nap when some woman pounded on my door. I pointed to the Do Not Disturb sign and told her to go away. She started argueing with me! She said the room was dirty and supposed to be vacant. I pleaded guilty to the first, but it was their fault since I had been out all morning, but insisted that the room was not vacant in that, in fact, I was just trying to nap before she so rudely interupted me. Called down to management to confirm my check-out date, and complain, and got a very weak apology. A hotel that can not understand the sacred compact of Do Not Disturb should not be trusted.

review_title: Looking a little tired but in a great location.
review_text:
Stayed here for a conference. The hotel looks and feels a few years old. It is all ok, but not as nice as some more modern hiltons I have stayed in recently (times square, sydney). 
Had a bit of an issue with check in - I hate connecting rooms so when I was put in one I asked for a room transfer the next day, which was agreed. After waiting untul 5pm for the room to be ready I dumped my stuff - went to the reception for my conference and got back late to find out the new room had a connecting door! 
But having said all that the location is great and the rate was pretty low so all in all - a 4 star!
Very nice hotel in the downtown Austin area! I enjoyed my stay. Great for business travel.

We stayed here for three nights, great customer service and property!
On site restaurant was very good!
Clean rooms and great beds!!
Would recommend to everyone.

review_title: Great hotel near lots of restaurants
review_text: I went to this hotel on business and was very happy. The front desk staff is very professional and helpful. They have a big breakfast available and also small crepe place you can access from the first floor that sells a wonderful hot chai. The rooms were a good size and had a mini fridge. If I had a complaint (and it's a minor one) it's that the maid didn't make it to our room one day until 4pm. I happened to get off work early that day and had to go downstairs while she cleaned the room. But they have a free computer downstairs that I used to check some sites. We could walk to 6th Street from this hotel and it's across the street from some restaurants so there were plenty choices of food and fun.
Who needs a wake up call when u have housekeeping? Little surprised they don't go onto rooms that have already checked out first.

review_title: Big hotel with small town service.
review_text: Was in Austin for a business trip and really enjoyed my stay. Hotel has it all. Very good restaurant, bar area, coffee shop etc. Had to get some items shipped to me and they were very helpful. Stayed on executive level. Had view away from park, which was disappointing, but room wad great. Staff was very nice.

review_title: Don't ship anything to this hotel!
review_text:
I stayed at the Hilton Austin for a conference and left a personal item behind at home so it was shipped to me at the hotel. When I collected the package, I was told to get it at the hotel's UPS store. They charged me a $5 "storage fee". 
Let me point out that this package for stored for a total of maybe an hour and only weighed a pound. 
I have never been charged to pick up a package that was already prepaid and it repulses me that Hilton would do this to their guests!
What a scam!
Note to management: Don't bother with the onsite UPS store unless guests won't get nickeled and dimed by bogus feesm

review_title: very pleasant, but not the brightest and shiniest
review_text: we came to Austin for a family gathering. it was a UT football weekend, so rooms were hard to find. we ended up at the omni. the staff was very pleasant. for the most part, the hotel seemed clean. there were some parts of the hotel room that seemed a little shabby (the curtains and window area were dusty and pillows didn't smell very good). the staff in the restaurant were exceptional. they had a lobby bar and televisions which seemed to be very popular - and was comfortable the couple of times i visited with family there. the gift shop had VERY little selection for "forgotten" items. they had complimentary morning beverage service delivered to the room for preferred guests which was very nice.

I have stayed here before, and enjoyed my stay at that time. I requested a room as high up as possible and that is a good plan if you want to reduce noise from the nearby highway. 
Only one problem, with a happy ending. I ordered breakfast my last morning but it arrived 30 minutes late (and only after I called to inquire) and was cold. 
Upon checkout I was asked about my stay and I mentioned the breakfast. The desk staff kindly offered to remove the charge from my bill. 
So, room serviceâ€¦ not so good. Front desk staff (and all employees, really), an outstanding job working to make the customer happy!

I stay here once or twice a year while attending conferences. It is a great hotel. Often park and don't leave for the 2-3 days I am there. I have been to Austin enough I've seen the sights. Very professional. Always clean. Great restaurant!

review_title: Best hotel I've stayed at in a long time
review_text: This hotel was affordable and nice. The staff was very attentive to every need. The pool was great and the bed was AWESOME! The traffic noise was a little annoying, but tolerable.

review_title: Great location and acceptable accommodations equals excellent value
review_text:
The hotel was located right on the corner of bush street which connected to the main street that meads to the piers. The trolley and buses all have stops basically right in front of the hotel so it is extremely easy to get around. 
The hotel itself along with most places along the street, is not much to look at from the outside. Due to a homelessness situation in the city, most hotels have locks on their doors that lead into the lobby. The hotel can only he accessed with a key provided to the guests. Although I understand it's for the "safety of the guests" it's not a good look for the city. 
Inside the lobby and rooms looks old and boring, but this was expected as this is what this hotel aims for?
The service at the front desk was friendly but not at all enthusiastic, and the breakfast was little, hard to get(rarely refilled) but good enough for free breakfast.
I wouldnt stay here again as the wow factor and comfort was heavily lacking, but the location alone would bring me right back to the same area to try a different place.
hotel_name: White Swan Inn, a Joie de Vivre Hotel

review_title: Amazing stay and such a wonderful welcome
review_text: This hotel is a real gem! Perfect location and great service. We were the only British people in the hotel at the time we stayed, the rest of the guests seemed to be older people and all were lovely and chatty. The staff are fabulous with a special mention to Troy who was the most helpful concierge we have come across. Special place and good to support a worthy cause as they are a non profit making organisation.

review_title: Great location, super value and even takes pets!
review_text: Stayed here many times. Military rates are less and amazingly affordable! Just blocks from wharf and china town. Staff is pleasant and professional. Food is very good. Complimentary champagne evening receptions and morning breakfast buffet. Views from 12th floor dining room are best in the area.

Rooms a little small and stuffy. Great free breakfast and happyhour plus use of fitness club with pool. This hotel is mainly for servicemen and is more expensive for the general public but everyone was really friendly and the sense of history from all the memorabilia is great. Stay here of you have a respect for all things military and soak up the atmosphere

review_title: A sweet place with lots of charm and a staff that really wants to be helpful.
review_text: Was bit disappointed by the outside appearance, but from ourfirst encounter with staff we were totally charmed. Spacious rooms w/ all the amenities and lots of character. Healthful and delicious breakfast in a charming English Tea Room setting. I booked for myself and 4 friends (3 rooms) and everybody just loved it.
hotel_name: White Swan Inn, a Joie de Vivre Hotel

review_title: Lovely hotel, friendly staff, good location.
review_text:
I'm currently sat in the reception, using the free WiFi, eating their very tasty homemade cookies while waiting for our car. The White Swan Inn is a rather kitsch take on an English Inn which I rather enjoyed. 
It's a clean and comfortable hotel wirh friendly helpful staff. We had a delux king room with an immense and very comfortable bed. 
There are freshly baked cookies in the reception and a cheese and wine reception in the afternoons, both lovely touches. Also complimentary water and sodas in the room. 
The only thing I can think to say in the negative is the breakfast could have been a little better but still it was nice enough.
hotel_name: White Swan Inn, a Joie de Vivre Hotel

review_title: Not bad for an older hotel
review_text: It's an older hotel and the age shows in some regards (ie popcorn low ceilings). But it has been updated and is in good condition. Some of the bad reviews scared me so I expected the worse but overall it was a good night. The bathrooms have been updated, the beds are comfortable, and very friendly staff. Is it the 3 1/2 stars priceline claimed it to be? No (more like 3). But for $65 a night it was a great place to stay.

review_title: Nice hotel, pet friendly, but not perfect.
review_text:
I stayed at the Wyndham one night with my husband and my dog. The hotel is pet friendly and the pet fee is only $35, which was much more reasonable than many other hotels we called. 
We were upgraded to a suite, I'm really not sure why. We paid less than $100 and the room was huge. It had two entrances. One led to the pool and the other to the parking lot. We basically had two rooms: a bedroom and a living room with a couch, fridge, tv, microwave, and sink. We couldn't really ask for more, especially considering what we paid. 
The reasons I say it was not perfect include a towel with a couple of stains and blinds that did not completely close. There were two large windows right next to the bed. The blinds didn't close all the way so we had to duck tape them shut so that you couldn't see into the bedroom. We never complained because we happened to have duck tape with us and we were only there one night. 
We would stay there again!!!

review_title: a suite with no couch or even a chair. Sheets for a comforter. Waited an hour for room, @ 6:00pm.
review_text: I chose this hotel and paid extra for a suite so I could have a couch/common room. I was bringing dogs and @ the time of my reservation requested a sleeper sofa. I was driving 3 hours and knew rooms that allowed dog were limited, so I called just to verify that they got my special requests and that my room would be ready. Well, I waited for an hour for my room. Got, one free drink. Then my room didn't have comforters but sheets on top of the down. Also, the only seeting in the place is two stiff back wooden chairs @ the table. A tv but, no dvd player and no remote. Not, that it mattered because there is no where to sit to watch tv anyway. They offered to let me switch rooms but I had already waited for the first room and had unloaded all of mine and my dogs stuff. Why pay extra for a suite @ this place when somewhere way cheaper like a la quinta would at least have a chair to sit in and a comforter.

review_title: All in all good stay for a good price
review_text: Just finished our stay here. Close to the airport, with a shuttle to and from. Nice breakfast every morning. Rooms were clean and larger than normal. Seemed to be recently redecorated too. Pretty convenient to downtown, about 15 min. And the price was great for how good everything was. I will stay here next time.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Austin Airport

review_title: Service made this hotel great for our family.
review_text: We booked this hotel for our family vacation through Priceline. While the hotel is designed for business, it was great for our family. The service at the desk was excellent and all the staff was very friendly. The hotel was clean. The pool is small and outdoor, but well taken care of. Overall, I would stay here again.

I attended NASW meeting at Wyndham and got excellent service from the staff. My room was comfortable and there were lots of towels, which I love! Cassandra was so helpful about arranging the shuttle and early check in. Marrisa was a great van driver and Liz was helpful as well. My only disappointment was the pool didn't open until 9 and I wanted an early swim.

This place is quite charming in a way. It is a lovely old building, with nice looking rooms. The check in staff were fairly inefficient, although they were dealing with a wedding that was on the night we stayed. The location is a fair way out of the action- either drive or be prepared for a long walk...
The beds- I have to say they were far too soft. I admit I prefer a firmer bed than most, but these were beyond soft! However, I can forgive that. What is less forgivable is the noise that kept us up for a good part of the night. First, the plumbing is noisy. I know it is an old place, but it really needs addressing. Second, we somehow ended up with a noisy ice machine AND the housekeeping storeroom right outside our door! Third, there was what sounded like a rave going on next door right outside our window.
This somewhat spoiled our night at the Mansion. I've decided to give it 3 stars- it's not without its charms and with a better located room would have been a reasonable experience. However, on the basis of our experience I couldn't recommend it.

Came for a wedding and was impressed with the reception food. Stayed in a courtyard room with sliding door. Water running down the walls through pipes very distracting at night. Had a wedding Saturday evening and the photographer and wedding party ran us in from the courtyard. We were unable to enjoy the nice evening even though we were guests, also. All in all, a nice place but all guests need to feel special for their entire stay.

Check in was SUPER speedy. Room was quiet and clean and the bed was extremely comfortable. Our remote initially did not work.. On the way to the front desk we passed a mainenance man who asked US if he could help, took the remote and 4 minutes later brought us a working one to the room!! Breakfaat ofifcially started at 6 but they set up early so we even got to eat before we caught the shuttle. Park and Ride feature saved us alot of money !! Shuttle was overbooked but they had called cabs so everyone got a free ride to the airport. A 3-4 star hotel for the price of a 2-3 star. There is a restaurant next door.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Austin Airport

review_text: Beautiful hotel. Great time. Awesome staff. Highly recommend.

Made reservation directly through hotel after over twenty minutes of being put on hold. Had to call back twice. Staff had to call manager to match price on hotels. Com. I should have just saved my time and booked through them and earned some xtra points!!! Ended up driving directly to hotel. No shampoos or soaps left in room two nights. Went to bar this afternoon for happy hour, Placed our order for drinks and appetizers and then a staff person comes up to us to say we had to move as there was a private party!!!! How rude. They should have started out by apologizing. We left and I said to cancel our order and she said she didn't take the order. Clearly they don't communicate with each other.

Second stay at this kimpton property based on my perfect stay in September. Love the location, easy walk to so much. Daniel at the front desk remembered me from my previous stay and made sure all my requests were handled despite being sold out that weekend. Luxury King room was lovely with a gigantic spa tub and views of market street. This is my go-to hotel in San francisco
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: One of the nicest hotels we've stayed at in the US.
review_text: This hotel reminded us of the level of service we've come to enjoy in Asia. Five star in every way. Lovely pool area although an outdoor deck would be a nice touch. Great bar/lounge off the lobby.

The hotel was clean bed was very comfortable The staff god not have been more helpful.the only thing lacking was draw space for clothes and the room could have been a little bigger but over all very nice would stay again
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: They need to change their front desk staff and their policies.
review_text: An officious front desk staff person did not bother to advise us that we had been assigned a one bed room when we booked in, despite us having booked and paid for in advance a twin room. Then as soon as i saw the room, I rang and requested the room we had booked, he said in a derogatory way that with 'your kind of booking we can't guarantee that kind of room availability and unfortunately there isn't any twin rooms available for the entire duration of your stay' (several days!) which I clearly understood to be a lie. He then offered to bring up a rollaway and he would generously waive the $35charge! He had also not provided sufficient numbers of complimentary breakfast vouchers for our stay, which I hadn't noticed until we were in our room requiring me to provide an explanation to the hotel staff taking over in the morning. I have booked and paid for in advance rooms in many states across the US and have never had any issue with getting the room i booked! The room itself was small and situated right next to the air conditioners so was noisy. I am a Kimpton hotel member and paid full price for the room months in advance! I will never book there again, and would not recommend. It is expensive, the staff are rude and their policies uncompetitive. In a nutshell, vote with your feet! Go elsewhere.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
I have stayed here several times this year. The rooms are clean, but the bedding could be better i.e. crisper linen & better pillows.
 I recommend this for business travel more than a romantic get away, as half the hotel is an office complex & the views aren't great.

review_title: Fabulous service...especially at the club level lounge. Wanda in the mornings can brighten anyone's day. Relaxing in the evening
review_text: Rooms are a bit in the small side but the beds are always great for travelers.

review_title: OSU fan great football weekend stay.
review_text: A great place to stay. The rooms are beautiful and clean! The breakfast buffet was wonderful. Walking distance to so many fun places. Stayed the weekend of the OSU--Texas football game. We were treated great by everyone. Would stay again:)

I've stayed at this Omni on trips spanning 20 year, and love coming back. This hotel has beautiful public spaces, a terrific staff, and well-appointed rooms. 
Great location, only a couple of blocks away from 6th Street entertainment and from the Texas Capitol.
Highly recommend.

review_title: DON'T STAY HERE UNLESS YOU WANT YOUR STUFF STOLEN!
review_text: The front desk guy tried to use our credit card to buy 1000 dollars worth of stuff, luckily the bank caught on and cancelled. There are other reviews of people having stuff taken from there rooms, just save yourself the trouble and stay somewhere else..

A true 5 star hotel!
I must say that this was one of the best hotels I've ever stayed in. The room, the service, the facilities and the location were all fantastic. My girlfriend and myself loved how discreet and luxurious the hotel was without being pretentious. 
I don't know what others on here are saying about the noise- it was so quiet, and the amenities in the room were first rate. We didn't go to the restaurant, but the bar can make a great cocktail.
I will definitely go back

review_title: BEDBUGS in an overpriced, outdated room!!
review_text: I was scheduled to stay here for 3 nights during the first week of October for a business trip. I stayed there for 2 of the 3 nights, but on the morning after the second night, I saw a bed bug right there on the sheets when I woke up (I took a picture of it so no one could dispute that it was indeed a bedbug or that it was there). I freaked out and called management. Within minutes, the head manager of the hotel and head housekeeper came up to my room, saw the bug, and verified it was indeed a bedbug. They assured me some outside company was on their way to investigate and that they would be shutting down my floor to heat it up and kill the bedbugs. They also dry cleaned a few items for me, which I had to pick up later that day. When I came back, the front desk was not busy so I made small talk with the people at the front desk (the people who would've been checking people in) and asked if they ended up actually closing down the 18th floor that day. The 3 of them looked at each other and me like I was crazy and said "No, why??" As the 4th person came back with my dry cleaning, I told them my room had bedbugs which is why I had dry cleaning in the first place. DONT TAKE THE RISK - YOU COULD'VE BEEN THE PERSON CHECKED INTO THAT ROOM THE VERY NEXT NIGHT!!

review_title: A good but not great hotel
review_text:
We stayed here recently on a quick trio to San Francisco. We sought a nice boutique hotel and were somewhat disappointed to find that this hotel did not really seem like it had any character. 
We had a nice room although it was slightly small with no views. We were awakened during the night by loud crowds across the hall. We did find that the bed was very comfortable.
The next morning, I went to the Fifth Floor lobby for coffee. Despite it being 6:00 a.m., the music playing was loud rap music. I asked if they could turn it off or at least down but was told they couldn't do anything about it. They suggested I go to the business center for a quiet place to drink coffee and read the news.
My wife and I went to the restaurant for breakfast which was tasty but slow.
For the price, we had hoped this would be better than it was.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Last time I stayed at the Omni was nearly a decade ago. It continues it's high standards and is the place to stay in Austin. Close to 6th Street and an awesome staff, the visit was great! I recommend this place to anyone. A bit pricey, but then again, comperable to anywhere else downtown.

This is a very nice and clean hotel. Great location in the middle of downtown. 
If you are driving your own car you can self park for cheap in the Omni garage just below the hotel.

We needed to find family friendly accommodation, two bedroom, in San Francisco and found this place. Â Was not exactly two rooms as the couch could be converted to a double bed. But served our purposes nicely, and the room was clean,comfy and nicely furnished. Â When we turned up we found the receptionist to be friendly and very helpful, as were all the staff that we had the pleasure to interact with. Â  The room was located on the first floor and and susceptible to sound of the cable cars, but as this was San Francisco just added to the atmosphere, and after a while became non intrusive and enjoyable. Â The hotel is located on one of the tram stops and a bus route, which was advantageous. Â The hotel is located in easy walking distance to a wharf area. Â When we visit San Francisco we will be stay inhere again.

We have been staying at the SF St Regis since it opened. We have stayed at several other hotels in SF and always return to the St Regis.
The staff is cordial and professional without being stuffy. Rooms are roomy and well lit, with good work areas. The location is excellent and within easy walking to shopping, dining, and the financial district.
The rooms are starting to see a bit of wear, but not nealy as much as most other business hotels.
I highly recommend this hotel.
Plenty to do within walking distance. Great location. Clean rooms. Nice hotel bar. A little pricey but would stay here again.

Beautiful hotel with very modern style. Too bad I could hear everything in the hall, people in the next room and street noise. I think the hotel is on a street that a fire station is on or uses often. We where on the 10th floor and could hear the road noise. Same goes for noise in the spa, not very relaxing to have a massage when you can hear cars, motorcycles and sirens. Service from hotel staff was excellent. Be certain to take the house car, a Bentley, to dinner. Lobby bar is great, try the tempura sushi. Spa service was excellent. Due to noise, I would not stay here again.

review_title: This is hotel is a pile of crap.
review_text: They say that they remodeled this hotel 4 years ago. It SURE hasn't been remodled good. The elevator is a piece of crap that barely works. I hit the floor button and 3 different buttons lit up. The wall paper is UGLY. The thermostat and workout machines in the work out room don't work. THERE ARE BEDBUGS!!! And the bed feels like a rock. I don't think there is any stuffing in them. If you want a nice view, inside or out, dont expect to get one at this hotel. I was getting some ice out of the machine and the coke machine started acting like someone put a dollar in it and i was the only one there! Once i left the room i heard a drink fall out, i went back and there was nothing there. Its a REALLY OLD hotel so its probably haunted. The T.V. is horrible. Im surprised it works though because nothing else in the hotel does. There isn't a free breakfast. They don't allow pets. (They can't make the hotel any worst.) I can't get any WiFi.This hotel is an expensive piece of crap. If you ever want a good hotel near here, there is a REALLY nice Courtyard Marriot like less than a mile from here. I usually want to stay in the hotel rooms once i get in them, i wanted to leave once i got in there. There is even like a $20 charge per night if you pay with a debit/credit card. This hotel better not be rated over 2 stars. It shouldn't even be rated 1 star.

Great location. Sumptuous beds, linens and towels. Awesome bath products. Indoor pool. Great gym. Lively bar. Spacious rooms. What would I change? The spa/hot tub/steam/sauna closes a bit early (I wish it was open until 11pm instead of 8pm or 9pm). TV's don't have sleep timers (I called and asked), missing in-room coffee makers, the room controls are a bit complex. The location and other amenities still make it my SF favorite.

This hotel was in the middle of evrything. A trolley car stop just outside the front door. Two blocks from the wharf and one block from Ghirdelli. 
An added feature is that they had onsite parking so you don't have to find parking on the street.

Stayed here for the week of September 11th. Staff is Excellent! Our room was very nice, quite homey infact. It was a bit noisy, but considering it is only a block from the Wharf, I guess that is to be expected. Nice patio to sit out on and watch all the action after a day of exploring. Took public transportation all week, (staff can fill you in on that) and got around nicely. Got the 7 day pass (27.00) and got our money's worth! Would definitely stay here again. Room was straightened every day and cleaned once during the week, which you don't always get. We exchanged our week in our timeshare, so the value was excellent.

We stayed here because we came into town for a longhorns game. It was easy to find and just a straight drive down 35 from downtown. We stayed on the executive level. The room was big and the bed was comfortable. The staff was friendly and we really enjoyed breakfast. We would definetly stay here again for another longhorns game!

review_title: Good place to stay for a trip
review_text: I really enjoy my stay at the Crowne plaza in Austin...great place to stay with great amenites...along with superb hospitality..the agent Gary was very nice and helpful..which made check in pleasant...the room was clean and pleasant to be in and family enjoyed.i want to come back and stay in seventh heaven I heard its awesome...great time in Austin

review_title: Excellent highend modern hotel near Moscone
review_text: Beautiful, modern hotel in the heart of SF near the Moscone center. Rooms are very comfortable and the bathrooms are spacious with separate shower and bathtub with enclosed toilets. Should have double sinks, but that's my pet peeve. Service is supurb. Decor is very modern without being "in your face" flashy. Room controls (blinds, lighting, climate, etc) were very cool. Would definitely stay here again but would try to find discounted rate.

review_title: A Diamond in the middle of the city.
review_text: I've stayed many times and everytime it's such a treat! They welcome my pet and I like royalty. Greeting us by name every time. Though I had an issue with another hotel and a few small hiccups in my stay the service by Rachel and Emilie were above and beyond. My stay left me planning a quick trip back! This is a must stay if you want to feel like you are the only guest in the hotel or want a relaxing/romantic getaway. What more can I say! Except thank you Rachel and Emelie :)
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: An awesome home away from home with really nice people the heart of the city.
review_text: This is a welcoming environment. People like Marcos and Lauren make this place what it is. Beyond the nice bedding, amenities, and complimentary wine happy hour it's truly the staff that makes this place what it is. Complimentary use of some pretty cool bikes and a small but decent gym were appreciated, too.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Modern boutique hotel in great location
review_text:
We stopped off in San Francisco for Â 4 nights on our way to Hawaii for our honeymoon. When the taxi dropped us off at the hotel, I was a little concerned about the size of it - as the bit you see from the road is tiny. Don't let this fool you though... the hotel is massive!
It's located about a 4 minute walk from Union Square (although is in the middle of the Union Square shopping area), 1 min from the cable car turnaround, 1 min from the F-line stop, and 2 mins from the Westfield Center. Â Basically this means that it's ideally located for shopping / restaurants, and is a 10min taxi / 30 min cable car ride from Fishermans Warf / Alcatraz.Â 
The hotel also supply courtesy bicycles should you want to cycle the Golden Gate Bridge etc.Â 
The room was fairly small, but big enough for us both with 4 suitcases! Â It's very modern with a flat panel tv and an iPod dock alarm clock. The view wasn't up to much looking out at a heap of other rooms and into the glass roof of the Old Navy store below - but what do you expect for a city centre hotel?
We got some free continental breakfast vouchers when we checked in, which gave us a small bowl of fruit, a pastry, a cinnamon cake, tea/coffee, fruit juice. Just enough to get us awake and ready to head out.Â 
The restaurant is on the 5th floor and has free tea / coffee in the morning. It also has free margaritas between 5-6pm most nights. We didn't eat in the hotel except breakfast as we were out and about. Â 
The hotel has wifi which is free if you sign up to the Kimpton InTouch website and the staff there couldn't be more helpful if they tried. Reception booked our Alcatraz tour for us, and told us which methods of transport we should get for the various places we wanted to visit
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Tried to check in and the front desk girl barely could speak english. Why have someone who can barely speak english @ a front desk u've got me. Then had to deal with the "manager" Matt. This guy should not be in a manager position. He was so rude and reminded me of a slimy used car salesman. Whoever is in charge of hiring..maybe should look @ their staff. If u stay @ this hotel & for some reason have to deal with a manager, try not to deal with the slimy blonde guy named matt.

review_title: Nice hotel - except for the room
review_text: The lobby is lovely, check in was quick and efficient. Then we got to the room. Tiny, with an odd little closet that looks like a washer/dryer belongs in it. A king bed one(!) end table, a desk and two chairs. No available electric outlets except in the bathroom and that funny little closet. WIFI for a fee (I hate that). One bright spot, the shower. Good pressure, plenty of hot water.
Staff was great- from housekeeping to concierge! Rooms were noisy at night but would stay there again and recommend!

I stayed for a business convention. The Omni is not as close to the convention center as some other hotels. That said, it was a pleasant surprise. Nice clean rooms Ana pleasant staff. Very close to many restaurants and live music venues on 6th.

review_title: Awesome customer service and attention to detail.
review_text: The staff was extremely attentive and catered to any need I had during my stay. Roy went above and beyond his call of duty to ensure I was comfortable and offered to assist me in any way possible. Great attitudes and well trained in a customer focused environment. The front desk staff was exceptional!

hotel staff very friendly. I got a very good rate by preparing and using my aaa discount. A combination of the two and i was able to get cheapist hotel rate near moscone for major convention. The hotel is geared toward business travelers. If bringing family with kids, try elsewhere. Hotel is 1 block from moscone, a half block from market st shopping, and 2 blocks from powell street cable car. Very chic hotel for business traveller. Reminds me of a W Hotel - but on a smaller quieter scale.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Excellent service and attentiveness to customer satisfaction
review_text: Front desk staff went above and beyond to ensure issues with internet were correct and that this customer felt valued, appreciated and satisfied with his stay. Thanks Astrid @ front desk

review_title: Not what I would expect from Four Seasons
review_text:
Stayed in this hotel for 4 nights during our California roadtrip. To start with the positives, the location was great: right in the middle of market street, with good public transportation connections to all major sights.
The rooms were outdated, and didn't provide the value I would've expected based on the rate and the other hotels we have stayed at of same category. 
The hotel gym and spa were located outside the hotel premises, making them difficult and impractical to access.
Overall, needs a complete update.
The hotel staff are very friendly and helpful. The room was very clean and well stocked with supplies.

review_title: I'd rather have been in a Motel 8
review_text: Booked a suite for a romantic weekend to celebrate our anniversary. The room they gave us had ripped carpet, poorly equipped kitchette, cigarette burns in the carpet and smelled horrible. They then sprayed the carpet with freshner but that only burned our eyes. Could not give us another suite nor would make other arrangements. The manager admitted she would not want to stay in that room. They eventually moved us to a standard room that had been updated, but the mood was lost and the trip a disaster.

review_title: Stay Away From This Awful Hotel
review_text: Simply the worst $250/night hotel room I've ever seen. Hotel staff and management are unaccommodating, and worse still, unapologetic. Avoid this place.

review_title: Mediocre hotel. Will not stay again
review_text:
This is a beautiful historic building with nice rooms with poor amenities and little extras. The staff ranged from very friendly to indifferent and just plain rude. Room service was slow to answer the phone and slow to deliver. One morning, our breakfast card we left hanging on the door wasnt even picked up. When I called the front desk, they were indifferent and didnt apologize or acknowledge a mistake had been made. A front desk attendant attempted to discipline our children in front of us quite rudely. There is a 45 dollar valet parking charge nightly and the GUESTS need to go downstairs and retrieve their own cars! They are not brought up for you. On a positive note, the bellmen were very friendly and helpful and the staff in the bar at night were extremely classy and friendly. 
For the price, stay at the Four Seasons. You'll get much better service and amenities for the same prices. We stayed at the Hotel Monaco a few years back which is a much better hotel. We will not stay at Palomar again.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: The Kimpton is a fabulous boutique hotel with 5 o'clock drinks for in house guests. Great restaurant. The staff are wonderful.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: This hotel is very nice and the best of it they are petfriendly!! I traveled with my family and enjoyed our stay! The people there is very nice but we only had one problem! At the moment of our check-out the lost our open vocuher that we left for extras! The room was already prepaid! So after we left they charged us the whole stay again :s
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: A unique place to stay with super staff and nice touches.
review_text: An older, small little hotel. The staff is super friendly. The rooms are older, but comfortable. No AC, but not needed when I was there. An open window was enough. Wine and cheese in the evening was complementary as was breakfast. And a late night cookie jar was a surprise. Great location in the Theater District. An easy walk to great restaurants.

What else can I add to all the previous reviews except ditto. We are staying here as I type and my wife and I love this hotel and totally warrents the previous reviews.
No hesitation, I would recommend this to anyone.

review_title: The lap of luxury -- at an affordable rate.
review_text: I struggled with where to stay on my recent trip to San Fran. So on a whim, I checked the Four Season's website and found a bed and breakfast package. The staff is flawless! Upon checking in, they upgraded my room. And I inquired with the concierge about returning my rental car. His response: just hand me the valet ticket and rental contract. That was it! I am a fan of this property. Oh! The breakfast was excellent even if a little pricey. Good thing I got the B&B package.

review_title: Excellent hotel in a great central location
review_text: Small hotel in the center of town. excellent rooms, comfortable and well appointed. nice touches like free wine tasting each evening and a tasty continental breakfast each morning. no complaints at all.

review_title: No elevator service, so we had to climb 4 floors with heavy suitcases. It seems that it was just an unfortunate coincidence on o
review_text: Rooms are small, the corridors are narrow. Our room faced a wall. Booked a king size bed a got a queen size, with the information that it was "an upgrade". No air conditioning in a very hot SFO day. We left. The staff, and manager however were brilliant, and very flexible.

review_title: Always stay here when in SF. Guest since 1987.
review_text: Perfect home away from home. Won't stay anywhere else when in town.

Stayed here during our recent visit. Everything was exceptional, from the breakfast, to the daily wine and cheese. Restaurant recommendations were superb!
The beds were great, and the rooms quiet. What more can you ask for?

review_title: Everything you'ld expect at a Four Seasons
review_text: My wife and I had a very pleasurable short stay at the four seasons. Everything you'ld expect at a four seasons. Highlights included a very comfortable room, super helpful concierge, and a very tasty breakfast.
Very, very nice hotel. It satisfied our desire to make the most of our wedding anniversary and allowed us to have a memorable time. I will seek out Four Seasons Hotels going forth as I travel.

review_title: Plain downright great service (plus fantastic location)
review_text: This is my first visit to San Fran. my friend told me to stay in either Union Square or at Fishermans Wharf. I chose The Inn at Union purely because of its positive Trip Advisor reviews. I have enjoyed everything about my stay here. From the overly friendly front desk lady, Annie, to the gorgeously furnished Junior Suite that I am staying in, to the delicious wine and cheeses serves in the afternoons, I can happily recommend this hotel. Business travelers may prefer to stay in a more swanky hotel such as the Hilton, but for me the old school glamour of this boutique gem is perfect.

review_title: Great staff, great location, great place
review_text:
Very happy memories of this hotel. Our room was lovely, if a little strangely shaped. The staff were very friendly & helpful. The complimentary cheese & wine every evening is a great idea - a chance to meet new people and compare notes in a strange city. Breakfast is help yourself and take it back to your room. 
We were there the night the Giants won the World Series (rounders); it was one of the best nights of my life.

Pros:
Everyone that I met there (reception, valet, maids) was very very nice. 
Wine Reception was fun each night. 
Bed was comfortable. 
Price was pretty good for the location. 
Cons:
Bathroom was a little scary - didn't really want to walk on that nasty tile in bare feet. 
Although wifi was free, it was actually much slower than my AT&T 3G. 
The worst problem was the cooling system. Even though it was brisk outside, the room was hot. Not feasible to open the window at night because of the noise. The AC was bad. It barely cooled the room. And worse yet, to run it you have to leave the curtains wide open - so the room is as bright as Times Square. Shorter curtains would fix this issue, but some genius installed full length. 
But overall, it is a decent hotel.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: This is an older hotel. The rooms are a little dated and cramped but the staff more than make up for it. Rooms were extremely clean and staff are exceptional. Two thumbs up!!!!
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Located in the heart of SF with excellent decor and amenities.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: The GP is a hidden gem in the heart of San Francisco's financial and tourist districts. I am a native of the area and appreciate all that this hotel offers, which is quintessential San Francisco. The service here is provided by the best staff around, who will greet you by name and a legitimate friendliness you won't find anywhere else. I love this place and just keep coming back. I post this recommendation with only one concern: the GP gets so popular that they won't have a room available for me.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_title: Amazing service .. Home away from home!
review_text: Stayed here with my sister and we loved it!! The breakfast was great, rooms were very quiet and comfy.. Wine and cheese in the evenings was great! Staff were really friendly and always willing to help! Will definitely be back!
Perfect location. Friendly staff and guests. Wonderful atmosphere. Newspaper in the morning, wine in the evening and turn down service at night. You couldn't ask for more.

We were in SF for the Nike Women's Marathon and wanted to stay near union square. The Galleria offered the best value for the location. Once there, we were pleasantly surprised. The building is wonderful, the service was excellent and the location was perfect. Close enough to all the action but far enough from all the noise. They even accommodated for us with an early checkin and late check-out because of the race. Overall it was a great experience!
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Everything was clean, staff was friendly and everything looked exactly as we expected from photos. Only minor complaint is that it took a long time for the bellman to handle our bags twice. Other than that I give it 5 stars.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_title: Great location, charming rooms and very hospitable staff.
review_text: My husband and I came to San Fran for three days and chose this hotel because of trip advisor. We were not dissapointed. Staff goes out of their way to help and they remember you. Cozy rooms, very clean and you are in the city at a great location. Great breakfast, wine reception and cookies at night. Would return without question. Plus they gave us sparkling wine and chocolates upon arrival since I mentioned at booking it was our first trip without our kids.

review_title: Nice hotel in a great location
review_text: The Galleria Park is a small hotel between the Financial district and the Union Square areas. It's also around the block from Chinatown and the 'French' block. Great location that's not dead at night but also isn't noisy. The rooms are small but I've seen a lot worse in SF and unlike some places, the bathroom doesn't require contortions to enter and use. Place was quite clean also. My room didn't have a view but it still got plenty of light. Good choice for the price.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Stayed for the 2nd time in 12 mths. Good service from arrival to departure. Comfortably rooms with all the needed facilities. Wine service in lobby was a nice touch. Bell boys very attentive. Lots of bars and restaurants in the area and very close to union sq. Can recommend pachino pizzeria 318 Kearny st only 3mths old at this time. If you want a nice comfy hotel with good service this is the place for you.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: I booked this hotel for a honeymoon based on the wonderful reviews posted on tripadvisor. The second I walked in to our "suite" I was immediately formulating a plan to leave this hotel and transfer to another. The entire place is ver cramped, the hallways are dark and narrow and the rooms are stuffy and outdated. The breakfast is nothing to write home about and their turn down service consists of a warm bottle of water and some chocolates. I would settle for this hotel if I were paying maybe $60 a night, not several hundred dollars. The location and staff are great, but there are lots of nicer, newer, cleaner hotels in SF with equally good people. This place is way overpriced.

review_title: Decent price for a major city, good location.
review_text:
I booked a room at this hotel for my annual Father - Daughter trip that I take with my dad. The pros include a courteous and informative front desk staff, including the bellhops. Convienient location to BART, about 2 blocks from the Montgomery St. Station. It was walking distance to Union Square and Chinatown and a $10 cab ride to the Fisherman's Wharf. The decor is modern and attractive, but the rooms w/ 2 double beds are small. I only saw my room, so I don't know about space in the other room types.
We had a slight plumbing issue - toilet kept running and sink drained very slow. We reported the issue and someone came to fix it very quickly. No problems after that.
I missed the free wine hour, but I did have the complimentary coffee in the morning. I feel like I probably shouldn't complain about it, since it's free, but I really didn't like the hotel blend of coffee. Sorry, I'm a big coffee drinker, I wish there was a wider variety to choose from, but hey it was free. 
The beds were really soft, I loved the pillows. Overall, I had a nice stay.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Had a great experience. Will stay again for sure. Although expensive, it's probably the least expensive hotel in the neighborhood. Walking distance to bars, restaurants, cable cars, AT&T park, market street, union square... Highly recommend!
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_title: Great hotel with very helpfull and friendly staff and a super location.
review_text: We stayed here for 5 nights at the beginning of our trip through California. We were returning to Denmark from SF and therefore had one night prior to leaving. When we left the hotel to drive down the coast we booked our final night at the same hotel because they are just so friendly and the rooms really clean with good beds. We were upgraded om both pur stays sjovt also makes you feel thar they Will do what they can to make the guest feel at home. Each afternoon at 5 there is complimentary cheese and and at weekdays the Inn keeper Wayne Olson joines the guests and gives good restaurant tips etc. The bestctip we got was to dine at Rue Lepic on Pine Street.

review_title: Good hotel in a good location
review_text: My wife and I stayed at the Donatello for one night during October. The room was nice, spacious and clean. We dined at the hotel's Italian restaurant which was not on the cheap side, but worth every cent. The restaurant is run by Italians and the food was delicious ! The hotel is located in the union square area which is convenient for accessing shops and restaurants by foot. One word of advice: there is no free parking around the hotel. There is a valet parking at the hotel which costs 30$ per day. Take this into account when booking as hotel prices around this area aren't cheap. All in all, it was a good stay and I would recommend this hotel to people wanting to stay around union square. In my next visit to SF I will probably consider a cheaper place outside the town center, providing I have a rented vehicle.

JOEL, JOEL, JOEL! the key to our vacation was the superior customer service we received by our personal city entertainment coordinator. He knew the must see, must shop and must eats of san Fransisco. 
While the hotel left something to be desired in the area of luxury and serenity, they did provide us with out treasured Joel. He was able to predict the likes and dislikes of veteraned san Fran visitors. He opened our eyes to new places and reminded us of treasured old haunts. 
While the room rate was not exorbadent it was acceptable for the value it offered. 
Bottom line: customer service A+, accommodations C+.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Wir hatten dieses Hotel eine Woche lang genossen. Dieses Hotel ist besonders fÃ¼r Shoppingbegeisterte geeignet, da es direkt am Union Square gelegen ist. Die Zimmer sind frisch renoviert und tadellos. Das Personal ist sehr freundlich. Nachteile sind, dass man die Fenster nicht renoviert hat und somit nicht lÃ¤rmempfindlich sein darf und der zweite Nachteil ist die fehlende Lobby, wo man relaxen kÃ¶nnte. Das Restaurant im obersten Stockwerk ist genial.

My recent stay at the Galleria Park Hotel was wonderful. It's a boutique hotel that is perfectly located to everything you need and want to do in San Fran. It's a place that offers a charming and intimate environment with the kindest, modt helpful staff you will ever meet. You never feel crowded or overwhelmed like you do in a larger hotel but you still have all the amenities and then some. The evening wine tasting,the outdoor walking/jogging track and the 24Hr Fitness center next door made it the perfect place for me. Chinatown and every store you could want to shop at are very near. I look forward to my next stay.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Staff was great. Molly was very friendly and helpful in particular. The hotel is close to many good restaurants and attractions in Union Square. It's also close to the muni and BART lines, making a car a non-necessity. Although it didn't bother me, the rooms are rather small and lack much of a view, but they are cozy, clean, and nicely decorated.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_title: Vista meravigliosa al centro di San francisco
review_text: Sono stato in questo albergo in occasione di un congresso ai primi di novembre. L'albergo e' ubicato in una posizione strategica al centro di San Francisco a due passi dal centro congressi del moscone center. E' circondato da alberghi e negozi di lusso . Il grattacielo Dell ' albergo offre una vista spettacolare su tutta la citta'. Consigliata la cena o l'aperitivo al 36 piano. Ci tornerÃ² ' sicuramente anche per piacere.

review_title: Good location, service not the best
review_text:
After much research we decided to stay at the Donatello.
The good....
- big rooms
- great location
The bad....
- A/C unit did not work. Had been down for 3 days
- water pressure is shower measured slightly above a drip
- staff didn't know what was going on with A/C unit. Kept promising an "engineer" would be up to fix it. No one ever showed up.
We left hotel after one night and moved into Marriott Union Square. Besides the price, Marriott much better hotel and experience.

review_title: Great location and staff. Room itself is less attractive
review_text:
I stay at the hotel for a convention with two colleagues. My room was the smallest and the sink was at the main room rather than in the shower (?). the room was clean and bed is comfortable. Location is superb and staff attention is great.
Overall a decent stay not more then that.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Great location, great rooms, and the friendliest, most courteous and helpful staff of any hotel we have ever stayed at.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text:
The rooms are charming and beds comfortable. Large shower/tub and quiet for what seems to be an older building. 
Wish the fitness center was larger.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_title: Well worth the money in my opinion
review_text: Right on union square, great hotel lovely rooms. Complimentary tea, coffee and hot choc is lovely touch. Rooms with dressing gowns as well as great sized towels. It was a little bit noisy but kind of expected as so central. Service was amazing.

We stayed here for three nights. The bed was huge and very comfortable! Great location in a not too hilly area and an easy walk to heaps of shops and restaurants, plus public transport that will take you all the places you'll want to go. Staff were friendly and helpful. Room had all the necessary conveniences and was a little dated but nice and clean. A great find in SF!

My boyfriend and I stayed at the Drisco hotel for 5 nights, and loved it!
The hotel is located in pacific heights which is not right in the centre of SF but the location is fabulous and there is easy buses stop just nearby.
The staff was so helpful ( just to name some of them Ann and Bob were so helpful and welcoming)
The room was charming , the breakfast and wine reception perfect!

A great option in San Francisco. The hotel staff is really helpfull. Rooms are spacious and clean. The only problem regarding my stay was with the wifi connection, it only worked near the door of my room or in the lobby.

review_title: The rooms are loud. Could not sleep
review_text: We were woken up at 5am by stomping from the rooms above us. We returned from dinner to find turn down service did not happen. They sent in some guy who said his housekeeper went home. Very disappointing. Will never stay here ever again. Horrible. The noise factor is the pits

As with all the reviews on this hotel, our stay was perfect. This hotel makes you feel as though you are at home among the multi million dollar homes it is nestled between. Sitting high atop the hill in PAcfic Heights you get great city (our room 407) views or bay views. The breakfast is diverse and fantastic. The wine reception relaxing. It's quiet, elegant, and a joy to spend our anniversary at!

review_title: avoid the terrible smell from the outside
review_text: the terrible smell, stench, odor from the outside made is change rooms the first night. this night it statred again. I googled milpitas odor and it seems to be a well known local problem. I will not return
Hotel is very nice and very clean. Rooms are comfortable and quiet. Staff is very pleasant. Price is a little spendy, but decent vale.

Was there for family medical treatment for 7 night. Nothing to complain about. The area is still being devloped, so there is nothing within walking distance yet. The mall has just been finished so in couple months it will be better.
The suites were good. Swimming pool and social area nicely furnished.
Staff were extremely nice.
Hotel Sierra is one of my favourite chain.
Traveling with children can be difficult. Magnolia Hotel Dallas helped sooth weary travelers after a long day. The milk and cookies were a highlight for the whole family.

review_title: The Place To Stay In San Francisco
review_text: Galleria Park Hotel is one of the best hotels I've ever stayed at!!! The rooms are very modern and clean. The location is perfect cause it's in the heart of the city. The staff are very friendly, hospitable and helpful! Zach, Richard, and Aaron were awesome. The manager James made sure that all my needs were met! They were all very professional. It was like staying in a 5 star Hotel. They have a wine hour complimentary to the guest which is cool and relaxing. The Japanese restaurant at the Hotel, Hecho is to die for. Overall best place to stay!!! You'll want to come back for more. It's my home away from home!!!!!! Thank you Galleria Park Hotel Team!!'
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text:
As always I rely heavily on Tripadvisor reviews to select accommodation. The Drisco was ranked 2 but some reviewers had some negative comments which largely related to a location out of the city centre and some complaints about noise.
My wife and I spent three nights at the Drisco in September and all I can say is that this hotel is charming,fantastic, good value and beautifully presented.
