As for location there is nothing inconvenient. The Route 3 bus is a block away and about 10-15 minutes to Union Square. But there is so much more to San Francisco than Union Square. Filmore Street, Cow Hollow, Union Street , Chestnut Street and so many other interesting spots are close to the Drisco. The Drisco is also in a beautiful part of San Francisco, Pacific Heights.
We had a car and parking at no cost without risk of tow aways was no problem.
From the moment of our arrival when the doorman Tranh rushed out to greet us and take our bags we felt welcome and in friendly helpful hands. The staff we dealt with apart from Tranh were Bob, Anne and Marti. I cannot speak highly enough of their service and happy helpful disposition. I can only say thank you.
Our room was on the fourth floor and with a view to the city through the San Francisco fog ! The room was lovely and comfortable. The rate was less than US $ 275 and very good value. A continental breakfast beautifully presented is included.
I don't know how you could go past the Drisco. And as tends to be the place in hotels like this the other guests tend to be friendly adding to the experience.
Lastly some recommendations for dinner all of which were excellent are Elite cafe and bar in Filmore Street, Baker & Banker ( superb ) on the corner of Octavia & Bush, and Bistro Aix in Steiner Street around the corner from CHestnut Street.

review_title: Fabulous location with great service and lots of extras
review_text: We were so impressed with the boutique style, personal service, so many extras from "happy hr" and 24hr teas etc., help with parking and so much more. A stylish hotel well located at the "top of the town" if you like to walk & explore and enjoy lovely streets, close to Presidio park and after staying first time at Fishermans Wharf - staying at Pacific Heights is a must.....

We stayed three nights over a weekend, and enjoyed everything about it. Marti at reception got us oriented and pointed us to some great destinations. The room was spacious and had great amenities. 
The breakfast in the morning is light years ahead of the continental breakfast you see at most hotels. We loved the wine and cheese at day's end, as well. The wine may not have pleased hard core wine but they were quality merlots and cabs from the region. Julio was a terrific host for that.
Our only warnng to people is that they either need to rely on cabs or be in good shape. The hotel is at the height of Pacific Heights and it is a steep climb up. Not for weak hearts. One tip ... the #3 Jackson bus runs one block below and goes all the way downtown for $2.

review_title: Friendly staff, very clean rooms and a mattress you wish you could take home. Ask for a room with a city view.
review_text: My wife and I are from NJ and visiting San Francisco CA for the 1st time. I chose this hotel for it's up scale location, close location to restaurants and sites. It's so much worth it to spend a little more. The staff is great and Bob who first greeted us provided some very useful tips. Parking is NO problem in this area just like the hotel states. Very nice breakfast each morning, wine in the afternoon, and very clean rooms. I just wish we could have taken the mattress home. After a day of site seeing it was a pleasure to roll into bed and have great back support and wake up totally rested. I would gladly recommend this boutique hotel to anyone.

review_title: Smart friendly hotel but a bit out of the way for us.
review_text: This is an elegant hotel in a smart area. The room was spacious and comfortable but unfortunately we didnt have the nice view that lots of other reviewers have mentioned. We also felt it was a little too far away from the main tourist attractions which some people may prefer but as we only had 2 days in SF we would have liked to be more central. Staff were friendly and helpful and free wi fi and 24 hour tea and coffee were appreciated. A nice breakfast was included. Overall a pleasant stay.

review_title: Nice location, but loud at night
review_text:
We enjoyed the location of this hotel. We were able to walk to most destinations within 30 min. There were several dining options of all prices ranges within 10-15 minutes walk. 
The staff were polite, but generally nothing exceptional. Our room was a good size and clean. It was well maintained during our stay. Most nights we were there however, we were awoken by the trash collection between 2-3 am. This noise would carry on for quite a few minutes, enough to wake you up to an alert state. Maybe better windows would be an idea.

review_title: Satisfied at first, but later found out I got charged an extra $94.
review_text: I thought the hotel was pretty nice. The people at the front desk were friendly and made me feel comfortable. I was asked if I was 21 years of age upon checking in and since I was not they removed all the alcoholic beverages from the honor bar in our room. The room was nicely decorated, although a bit cramped. You can only open the bathroom door halfway because the door is in the corner of the room and they decided to place a chair and ottoman in that same corner. Also, the TV did not turn on with both the remote and manually. Someone had to come reset the TV for us which took nearly 15 minutes for him to do so. Overall, I would not pay $200 to stay here for just one night. Very nice people and good service, but not worth the money. I left satisfied until a few days later I noticed $94 in various charges on my credit card bill. I called the hotel and explained that the alcoholic beverages were taken out upon my arrival, so it was adjusted to $55. I asked why I was even charged for the $55 and she did not even know and told me I would have to wait for the front desk to reach me within the next 24 hours. Now I am definitely never returning to this hotel. Its just not worth all the trouble.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_text: Awesome place, what a treat to spend your time and money in such a top notch establishment. Out of the way but worth the effort.

review_title: Milk and cookies are always a good treat
review_text: Great hotel. Close to all of the great sites in and around downtown Dallas.

review_title: This hotel is nice, great staff and location, would stay again.
review_text: My family stayed here 7 nights. The room was large and comfortable. The bed was very comfortable. The street noise was loud but you get accustomed to it very easily. The staff was very nice and extremely helpful with recommendations and directions. If you think you are going to use WiFi, think again and head to Starbucks. Overall, great value.

Horrible experience. The rooms are cramped & the shades were broken, so we woke up to the sun beating down on our faces. The room was fairly clean, but as far as the beds go, they were not that comfortable at all. I would definitely recommend a Sheraton if comfort is what you desire. The Magnloia is just too pricy and you're paying for the name & the history, not the quality.

We have stayed at The Magnolia many times and have enjoyed it each time. Upon arrival this time we were asked by the friendly employee if we would like to upgrade for an additional $25 to a suite. We accepted and were then asked if we had a preference of a high floor or lower floor. We chose the high floor and were very pleased. Our room had a full kitchen and living area along with many windows looking over Big D. The bed was comfy, bathroom was nice and roomy, air seemed a little warm even turned down however it is Texas and June and lots of windows. We were unable to take advantage of the evening reception, milk and cookies, or breakfast just due to not having enough time. Valet was quick to retrieve our car only thing was both times we needed to park we had to go find the valet. Overall Excellence!
The location is the best.Powell st. One block Bart close buy everything walking distance.aloha tommy

review_title: Not the same upscale hotel it used to be.
review_text: There was a large event in the lounge area taking place when my husband I were staying here for a wedding we went to in downtown Dallas. The event was so loud and disruptive, with security attending to some sort of situation. I've stayed at this hotel before over the course of 5 years and it was always peaceful and upscale. Not the case this time. Along with the fact the hotel keys weren't working and they had to have maintenance meet us at our room to let us in everytime. Not a pleasant experience.

review_title: Best hotel in San Francisco with European charm
review_text: One of the best location in the city, Pacific Heights, hidden between old money mansions and amazing views of the city and the bay, the Drisco is truly an European hotel. Building has old charm, but rooms are modern, with state of the art amenities (flat screen TV, DVD, CD, free wifi throughout), extremely well maintained, and with a killer breakfast (not to mention the afternoon free wine and cheese reception!). The prices are well below similar quality high end hotels such as th Ritz or Four Seasons. I have stayed in a lot of hotels in San Francisco over the years, buy after discovering the Drisco. I wouldn't stay anywhere else.

review_title: Hotel was great. Service needs improvement.
review_text:
We arrived at 4:15, check in is 3 pm. We were told the rooms weren't cleaned yet. That we had to wait up to an hour. We had to be at a wedding at 6 and needed the room. After much deliberation with staff he upgraded us to get us into a room. 
Valet brought our car around but never told us when we asked for it that it would be in front. We saw many cars being brouht to the covered area and we waited there. 
We just made the wedding with minutes to spare. 
My daughters room suddenly had a sewer smell fill the 
room. She was disturbed the next morning at 9 for room
 service for a total of three times. She finally got angry 
and ugly towards the staff before she was left in peace. 
Breakfast was lacking as well. Milk was not cold, no butter for pancakes. I think overall holiday inn would serve a better breakfast. 
Most guest seemed satisfied so I think it was just our turn to have a not so great experience.

review_title: Great location and wonderful customer service and attention!
review_text: Stayed in two different rooms during the stay and enjoyed both. Large bath tubs with really hot water was amazing! Beautiful views from windows. Right around corner from great nightlife. We literally walked around corner to clubs and restaurants. Next door was neiman's flagship store too!

review_title: Great location, beautiful decor, excellent service, wonderful place to stay!
review_text: I only spent one night, but it was a delight. The service was very good. Easy checking in and out. The complimentary breakfast was the best I've ever had. The location was perfect. The room wad small but nice. The view wasn't so good. Clean and bed was very comfy. A great place to stay!

review_title: I recommend anyone booking a hotel any where Magnolia has a location book here.
review_text: The hotel offers a clean, safe and friendly environment. They offer a beer and wine reception as well as a cookie reception for a midnight treat. Everyone is so nice and always willing to help. I love this hotel and plan to stay at the one in Nebraska in May.

Perfectly situated.Public transport nearby and great shops/eateries surround you.
Spottless quiet rooms.

We lived The Donatello! The service was fantastic and welcoming. Location was great with an awesome coffee shop close by ( diagonally across road to the left). 
Rooms were great and cozy. Club floor was also a good relaxing area.
We received complimentary wine & chocolates for my birthday from the hotel which was a nice touch. Would stay here again for sure!!

review_title:
This Friendly&Well Appointed Hotel
I put in my Top 10 after 44 years of
Traveling the World!
review_text:
From Check-In to Check-Out this 
Centrally located SanFranHotel was 
100% Up to Speed for friendly service. Aside from No HD Signal
&No MSNBC on the New Tv's,my
Room 511 was As Excellent as I've 
Experienced in all my 44 years of 
World Travel....

review_title: Much better quality than other hotels more highly priced in SF.
review_text: I based my booking on reviews read here. Expectations were high. All expectations met and some surpassed. Location was excellent for our needs. High end amenities and service. Front desk/concierge recommendations were spot on. Business center, convenient and free for printing airline tickets. Breakfast spread surpassed my expectaions. And... the coziest robe, i've ever been provided at any hotel. Will definitely book again when in the city.

The Magnolia Dallas is my most favorite hotel yet! The art deco is charming and the personal service is impeccable. The room I stayed in had a nice hallway to the bedroom that made it feel homey. The bathroom has a large garden tub. Not to mention, the amenities such as milk and cookies in the evening and free breakfast were delightful. I highly recommend this place anytime you're in uptown Dallas.

Stayed here for the Big 10 championship game. Great downtown location. Staff was helpful even with the crowds. Great that you can use the enclosed walkway to get around. Don't need a coat in the winter! Pool is gorgeous. Capitol Grille in the lobby is a must for breakfast

The best thing about this hotel is its location. It is close to Union Square and in walking distance to galleries, the waterfront, Nob Hill, restaurants and the shops. The hotel staff were helpful without being overbearing. The complementary apples on the front desk are a nice touch as is the lounge on the top floor. The only downside of staying at the Donatello was the hopelessly slow wireless internet connection. This aspect of staying at the hotel could impact on guests returning to the Donatello. Other than this though the Donatello is worth a look in.

I'm a hotel designer and travel the world doing hotels of all types...so I know what I'm talking about. This little gem in SF was truly fabulous! 
The amazing thing about the Drisco is how they treated me under my unique circumstances...I am transgender and was there recovering from some cosmetic surgery. The staff was truly amazing...and went above and beyond to make my 2 week stay there perfect! Extra pillows, special meals, arranging transportation...and the ability to put up with me in full diva-mode deserves a medal.
...plus, having the bellman teach my aunt tai chi in our suite was truly entertaining...lol
Given, this hotel has all the 4-star amenities...except room service and central heat, but the service more than made up for the couple chilly nights and temporary power outage...since we were there in February during a freak winter storm, it was not a major flaw. 
I'm coming back this summer, and it's so nice to know I already have my hotel accommodations set and I know the staff will remember me.
...how could they forget
...I'm fabulous also!!!...haha
xoxo
Jessika
Las Vegas
[-]
ps I almost don't want to write this review since I want to keep this place a secret. I hope the Drisco doesn't get too popular and lose it's charm...xoxo

Great service, nice rooms, inviting club and tasty resteraunt! All staff was great, from the valet parking to the house keeping. Bobby at the front desk was informitive and delightfully funny. We called for help in the middle of the night, our son got ill, and the response was so quick. The club floor was a real nice touch when we needed more space and a cup of hot tea/coffee or cocoa. The food was delicious and we enjoyed the live music at dinner too. We plan to come back without kids and really enjoy the quiet. What a find!

review_title: Very nice rooms and really comfortable stay. Worth staying.close to all important transport facilities.
review_text: Very nice rooms and really comfortable stay. Worth staying.close to all important transport facilities.
hotel_name: Galleria Park, a Joie de Vivre hotel

review_title: A five star that is starting to slip a bit
review_text:
This was at one time my favorite hotel in the US. However over the past few years it has started to slip. It's the little things that make a five star special and it seems those things are slipping away. The turn downs, the free shoe shine, knowing your name before you get to the desk. All these things made this a fantastic gem. 
As with any hotel things get frayed after a few years and start showing wear. Still a great property but with a JW Marriott down the street my hope is they kick it back into high gear. 
Also when checking out there needs to be more than one desk clerk at peak hours. To the mid-40's blond concierge who seemed to cool for school. Drop the attitude. Your job is to be there and if the hard working desk guy has guests 5 deep don't act put out when a guest hands you the room key. You are the Conrad NOT the Hampton. I can handle snark for $99 a night not $479.

Booked after reading trip advisor and was totally happy with experience - initially was concerned at location but quickly came to appreciate it. Had a fabulous suite that looked to Alcatraz and price at $350 odd very much ok by comparison to others. John at desk very welcoming and helpful. Would definitely return.
Magnola is a homely atmosphere jus keep listening to your guest needs and you will stay on top

review_title: Valet/Shuttle Service was TERRIBLE and management was invisible, unavailable, unresponsive.
review_text: While there were plenty of vehicles and staff, valet/shuttle service available, for 4 days in a row they were still unable to transport our group in a timely fashion to and from our conference 8 blocks away. The free breakfast was fabulous and the rooms decent but if you need to rely on hotel for shuttle service, this is not the hotel for you.

Stopped for 1 night in San Jose & picked Hotel Sierra based on reviews & price. What a find!! This is a new Hyatt property & we loved it. Rooms were very nice-not huge but plenty of room & very nice decor. We had happy hour in the gorgeous bar & it ended up being our dinner...nachos, pizza, & drinks! The breakfast was yummy too. The hot dishes were eggs, potatoes, sausage, & French toast. They also had an omelette station & all the usual cold items. All included with the room price! The staff was extremely friendly. Bonus: in the same parking lot there is a Target & 3 nice "fast food" options-Five Guys, Chipotle, & Panda Express. Highly recommend the Hotel Sierra!!

review_title: Best hotel we have stayed at so far!
review_text: Suite was awesome and better yet was connected to a room that a family member stayed in! Loved the complimentary drinks and cookies even though we were not there to try them! Staff was great as well! Will definitely stay there again!!!

review_title: A very nice hotel with great location.
review_text: location next to circle mall joined by sky wall and art garden.

review_title: One of the best stays I've had.
review_text: Super clean and excellent service. Love the bathroom. I'm used to having a tv in my bathroom so I felt right at home. They brought free bottled bottle by in the evening with ice so I didn't have to get myself! Turned my bed down and had music playing n the background. Felt pampered. Price was great too.

I was really looking forward to staying here and seeing SF again after 11 years - back then I was 20 now I'm with my kids. 
This hotel was fantastic, the friendliest most helpful and kid friendly I have ever encountered in such a nice hotel. The rooms are nice, food in the resturant was great- especially the steak. Hot apple cider daily in the lobby with gingerbread and apples was enjoyed by my kids 3 & 4 and us parents also. 
Milk and cookies every night when we got back to our room was such a nice touch.
We spent a quick weekend here, and the price was good for this hotel that was very convenient to the City. Would recommend

We stayed here on our Anniversary and had a great time. Our terrace room was spacious and clean. Service was outstanding. A great value and a great location.
The only negative was a loud,noisy nightclub across the street. But you are staying downtown in a big city so some noise should be expected.
Loved the free beer and wine hour, the cookie bar before bed, and the attentiveness of staff made it feel more like a resort!

The Hotel moved me I nicer suite for my Birthday! We had a great time. My only complaint would be to tell us about service fees for room service. Paid to much for a Hamburger and pizza.44.00 was total with fees. But other than that we loved our suite!!!

review_title: Excellent stay! Home away from home!
review_text: our stay at the Magnolia was great. They didn't have a room with 2beds upon arrival so they upgraded us to a suite. We've been in that situation at other hotels in the past with no upgrades. We highly recommend this hotel. Excellent staff.

review_title: The upscale feel of other high dollar hotels without the upscale attitude or price.
review_text: We couldn't believe the room we were given. Huge with a kitchen at half the price of other (boutique) hotels. Really handy with the kid. Nice valet and hotel staff. We enjoyed the cookies and breakfast. This is our new hotel for all our Dallas trips. We can stay twice as long compared to other downtown hotels. The service is top with no attitude. A very clean hotel as well. We were already planning our next stay on the drive home. The best. Thanks Magnolia staff!

I was happy with my stay at Omni SF. I think location was pretty good...our room was clean, comfy bathrobes (bought as soon as I got home), nice bathrooms and a really fab gym. Hotel staff was helpful, however they had a $ charge just to use the business center which is something I have never heard of and felt was a little rediculous. Other than that, good place to stay in SF.

Most of what I have to say is similar to what others have said.
Saw hotel but missed the Riverside entrance on the first pass. The Hyatt (I think) sign was bigger and I did not expect dual hotel entrance.
On the value rating, I did get an excellent holiday rate. On the other hand, I have been so used to hotels with free hot breakfast buffets that I forgot how expensive a pay buffet can be. $9.95.
Room was fine, but I have come to expect that from Courtyards. TV was in a weird location if trying to view from king bed. But a very minor point.
Clean throughout, as others have noted, excellent staff.
When in the area again I would consider this hotel, but probably eat breakfast at the nearby Waffle House or Dennys. Or else try one of the hotels that includes breakfast.

From the time I made the reservation until my farewell... this hotel made me feel at home. The amazing approachable staff sets the tone. One block from almost everything you can think of. The front desk helpful suggestions, like buying a transportation city pass. If using public transit, I recommend you get one. Kitchenette in the room is convenient. WIFI is spotty, but its free. I will come back and stay here again on my next visit to San Francisco.

review_title: Friendly service, comfortable surrounds, and a touch of elegance
review_text:
Nothing is over the top except the service at the Omni Hotel. 
We had a very clean, very comfortable room - nice linens, flat screen, plenty of fluffy towels...everything you'd need for a restful base. 
Room service is tasty and prompt. Even the housekeepers are super friendly - and they have a turn down service with nice local chocolates for your pillow. 
We'll be back.
My stay was the best. The room was gorgeous and outfitted with the best bed ever. The hotel employees were very nice and helpful.

review_title: The hotel is ok. The staff are great.
review_text:
Stayed here whilst working in Austin. The hotel is pretty much standard fare but the staff are what make this place diifferent. They are extremely pleasant and helpful. The front desk staff especially Adiah and Crystal (?) were possibly the friendliest and warmest I have experienced and are a credit to Marriott. Give them a pay rise!
Only downside is the lack of bar and restaurant facilities at the weekend which was a bit of a shame.
It's only 15 minutes drive to downtown Austin.

review_title: Average room, ac not getting cold, staff and service was good.
review_text: Room was average. No fridge or hair dryer and AC was not getting cold. Had problem with toilet not flushing properly. Staff was friendly. Hard to find since it is not located right on road and we could hear the planes flying over.

review_title: It's been better in the past!
review_text: The room was smaller than previous stay... Don't like that you have to pay for wi-fi. Other than that it was a decent stay at one of my favorite Indy luxury hotels. But I believe I will have to go with the JW Marriott next trip to Indy. :-( I hear it's a lot better!

Like the other reviewers have said, great shower and bath room. We had a minisuite with a couch so lots of room. Appreciated the large 42" TV and the mini one in the bathroom. Continental breakfast was great. Only slight negative was the young staff, not very knowledgeable about the area or the hotel. Also, the outside door staff enjoyed each other more than their jobs. Staff needs to be schooled better. Room was clean and the bed gave me a perfect night's sleep.

review_title: Great location to UT and for conferences
review_text: Great room and conference food given the size of the conference. The location is extremely convenient to UT Austin. Conference facilities have been extremely good, though haven't had time to venture out yet
hotel_name: AT&T Executive Education and Conference Center

review_text: Only stayed one night last Friday and I was a beautiful location and the room was superb. Beautiful travertine baths with Grohe fixtures. Nice touches of excellence.

We had a great time there. Worth every cent.
Everybody is happy and really nice.
The apartment is huge, and we really used all the space.
We had family over, we order a movie and popcorn.
Also the hotel has a car that can drive you up to 2 miles from the hotel, and they also pick you up.
Thanks everyone there that made our stay really good.

Nice, but small rooms. Attendant and friendly staff...very service oriented and helpful. Their parking during the week is close to $50/day!!! Suggest parking across the street at Bank of America. Didn't appreciate the tall doorman ogling my daughter as we walked out. Overall, a nice place, but nothing spectacular.

review_title: Excelente ubicaciÃ³n para visita a San Francisco.
review_text:
El hotel estÃ¡ excelentemente bien ubicado para visitar San Francisco. Es muy recomendable que al solicitar la habitaciÃ³n se pida de los pisos mÃ¡s altos para tener unas muy buenas vistas de San Francisco. 
El resto estupendo tambiÃ©n. Tuve la suerte de encontrar una oferta que hizo que me saliera bien de precio. Si volviera a San Francisco, repetirÃ­a seguro.
Excelente idea el fast checkout. Te dejan la factura en la habitaciÃ³n y puedes irte sin pasar por recepciÃ³n.

review_title: Bello se ti danno la camera giusta
review_text: Hotel bello, ubicato a 2 passi da Union Square, internet a pagamento, ma esiste un sala con 4 pc dove si naviga gratis, trovare il posto non sempre e' facile, camere pulite, ma non lavano i vetri, la forma della stragrande maggioranza delle camere e' molto bella piena di vetrate sembra di essere in strada, bellissimo ma se ti danno la camera sbagliata ti ritrovi con una finestra nel lato interno dell' hotel, personale alterno, ho chiesto una bella camera, mi hanno rifilato una stanza con una fonestrina sull'interno, quando sono sceso a lamentarmi me l' hanno cambiata e finalmente mi hanno dato una camera decente, nei dintorni si trova i tutto negozi, ristoranti ecc...

I take family holidays at least once a year for the last 15 years and this is the best holiday hotel I have stayed. 
There were too many things we enjoyed in our stay.
- right after I booked my stay on the Internet, I received a welcome email from the hotel, introducing and telling me the facilities I could use during my stay. On this same trip, I was going to stay in two other "top" hotels in LA and LV But none other offered such service.
- on arrival, we (family of 4) were greeted warmly and our first surprise was we were upgraded to a 2 bedroom apartment for free, normally in US an upgrade is offered at a discount.
- the room was simply stunning. Even though we didn't get the Bay View room, the interior of the room was really nice and clean. The fire pit was a nice feature too.
- while the design is classical, the features are absolutely state of the art. The lightings are with dimmer, the fantastic TV and hi-fi system produced great sound, plus wine cellar and laundry are nice touch too.
- we stayed for 4 nights and our greatest day was spent on the bicycle from the hotel. The bike rental was complimentary, and they even provided helmet, lock, and back pack with water bottle in it for all 4 of us! Great attention to details!
- the house car was another great feature. The pickup was always on time.
- we absolutely loved the complimentary breakfast. Nice cosy setting with good quality food.
- the pool table, board games, and the large DVD collections were nice features too, though my kids were disappointed that we could not get our waitlisted DVD, "Escape from Alcatraz" after waited for 4 nights as the hotel has the policy of not asking back from the guest once it is out
- the service from the duty manager to the concierge were very friendly and attentive. 
I want to take this opportunity to thank the duty managers, Spencer and Jeremy. You really made our stay memorable. We just checked out this morning and we already miss you! In fact we are now just in our 2nd stop at Venetian in LV before going to LA, but we knew we have had our best stay already! We will be back!

I stayed in this hotel in a holiday weekend. I didn't have a reservation, walked in and got a better price. Front desk person was very helpful. All rooms are suits nice if you have kids. Two flat screen 42'' TVs. The bed was comfortable, sofa bed was nit so much but that's okay. Breakfast was very good, they make fresh omlette to your taste. All rooms face to the open area in the lobby so it it was loud in the evening and in the morning you might wake up with coffee smell and breakfast crowd's noise.

My husband and I had such a wonderful time here. The apartment was a 2 bedroom place. Beautiful design and the softest linen. Loved the original bare brick walls. 
The service is the thing that really makes the Fairmont Ghirardelli though. From check in, to porters and doormen this place excels.
The complimentary BMW bikes are a great touch, but most fantastic is the free 4x4 chevy to drop off and pick up within 2 miles. Thanks to Santiago for picking us up at various bars! You were polite, professional and so helpful, a great asset to the Fairmont! Shall recommend to EVERYONE!

I really enjoyed the Omni it is a first class place. Bob's is a great spot especially the bar. We got special treatment because it was our anniversary! They sent up chocolate covered strawberries and a special turn down service with a rose. It is also is a great location you can jump on the cable car right in front of the hotel. Short walk to several great spots including China Town and the Ferry building. We ate at Wayfare Tavern and Bix both within a short walk. Also great views of the Transamerican Pyramid. Only down side was I couldn't get good wireless on the 17th floor.
I have stayed here for a week every year for work for the last three years. Clean, great location, courteous staff.
hotel_name: AT&T Executive Education and Conference Center

review_title: Beautiful hotel in a great location
review_text: Gorgeous building, clean and updated rooms. Location is convenient to campus and a nice but longer walk to downtown. Would absolutely stay here again.
hotel_name: AT&T Executive Education and Conference Center

review_text:
Los hoteles en San Francisco son caros. Nos dimos de alta en la pÃ¡gina de Wyndhan esperando ofertas y Ã©sta llegÃ³. Pudimos coger una habitaciÃ³n executive en la planta 28 con acceso al SalÃ³n de la planta 31 donde servÃ­an un desayuno bastante adecuado hasta las 10 y refrigerios por la tarde a partir de las 5. La habitaciÃ³n era bastante amplia, limpia, cama muy cÃ³moda y baÃ±o genial. HabÃ­a, como en casi todos sitios, mucho personal que hablaba espaÃ±ol y siempre te hacÃ­an todo mÃ¡s fÃ¡cil. La situaciÃ³n es inmejorable, pegado a Market y Union Square. La Ãºnica pega es que el internet es de pago (14,95$/dÃ­a).
En definitiva, perfecto lugar para pasar las Vacaciones en San Francisco.

review_title: Great base for a city visit
review_text: Friendly staff greeted us and the hotel is very impressive when you arrive. We were given an upgraded room but it had a view of the side of a building and the sink was cracked. Overall we were very pleased, but it was let down by the small details

review_title: Lives up to it's reputation for service excellence
review_text: Stayed here with my wife and niece at the end of our US trip. Had read good things about Omni before and our visit did not disappoint. All staff excellent. Great location, enjoyed Bob's. Milk and cookies for my niece every night was an excellent touch.
One of the best hotels I've been in and with excellent service through out the stay
If you can afford to stay here with the Bay view, you have to do it. perfect location and service was great.

Nice place to stay right at edge of financial district. Hotel staff was quite friendly and helpful. Room clean and bed quite comfortable. Trolley service right outside door, though you might be waiting awhile for it to arrive. Location is on California Ave. which is convenient to Union Square & short walk to BART and F-line. No need for taxi service.

Booked this due to recommendations online. Our first stop on a 4 week US trip, it was fantastically located right near union square.
Lack of service from staff, but I guess that is expected with its rating - however we arrived from airport early at 11am & without even asking our room was available immediately, very appreciated after the long flight from Sydney.
Our room was very clean & well maintained & I love the green colour theme they use! Bathroom was spotless & the rubber duck was very cute.
We had a view out of our window of the alley I think but could also see Union Square Park & Macys. Although the room was on the small side there was a huge walk in wardrobe where we stored our luggage - this made a big difference in terms of room space! Room was cleaned daily. Others have commented about the lack of air conditioning, San Fran was unseasonally warm in the days we were there, but we slept with the windows open & were surprised how quiet the city was!
Also walked down to Fishermans Wharf from here - never felt unsafe at night!
Being across the road from saks was handy as could drop our purchases back before heading to other stores.
Free wifi was much appreciated & although there was no tea/coffee facilities in the room, they were always available complimentary in the lobby bar.
Would definitely stay again.

We stayed here for 2 nights and had 3 couples in a 3 bedroom suite. The rooms are amazing. The staff is so helpful and friendly. The hotel car will take you anywhere you want to go within a 2 mi radius. Mustards terrace has a view to die for overlooking the bay. We had an unforgettable trip. We wish we could have stayed longer.

Stayed here for a weekend sans kids. Terrific service from the moment we pulled up. The doorman was incredibly welcoming and helpful, offering suggestions on where to dine & even calling to try and get us a table. We have enough dinner suggestions from him for three more weekend getaways! We were upgraded to a suite, and it was fabulous! Nice living room, spacious bedroom and swanky bath. We returned from dinner to find slippers by our bed, robes out and-get this-two roses on our pillows! 
Definitely recommend joining the free Omni reward program as you get lots of goodies that make you feel totally pampered...they brought us chocolates when we checked in, and free morning beverage and pastry of your choice the next morning. 
Location is terrific...easy walking distance to all of downtown. Whole interior is gorgeous. But what makes it really top notch is the friendly, professional service and little personal touches. Not to mention rates are very reasonable for a big city hotel! We'll be back...hopefully at least every other month if the babysitting gods are good to us!

Spero che la mia recensione possa esservi utile.... Chose this hotel based on good reviews from trip advisor. Stayed for 2 nights with toddler. On our 2nd night they brought complimentary milk & cookies for my daughter, this was a very nice touch. Overall a nice place to stay. Highly recommended. The only drawback are very small windows.

Our first impression- Olga (per her name badge) at the check-in counter provided some of the worst customer service I've seen yet. She was rude, moved at glacial speed, and never once smiled or said thank you. 
The room was small but well decorated. The bathroom was clean but needed some updating. 
The hotel's only restaurant- our last impression, reaffirmed the title of our review. The staff was pleasant but borderline incompetent. The restaurant was empty, yet my wife actually got up, walked out to the main lobby and poured her own coffee from the welcome desk because the staff ignored us for 15 minutes. When our food arrived, it was decent, with the exception of the bacon with looked to be about 4 days old. 
Needless to say, we won't return.

review_title: Gives the neighboring, higher priced hotels a run for their money
review_text: So, neighboring hotels include The Sir Francis Drake, Marriott and The Westin St. Francis... with top hotels like those as neighbors, how can The Chancellor Hotel not be great? The Chancellor Hotel has immense character at a fraction of the cost. Highlights include: nice, clean rooms with LCD TV's, free Wi-Fi, room safe, ceiling fan over the bed, complimentary gym access to Club One (a block away) and close by sundry items easily available from Walgreens and 7-Eleven. I come down to San Francisco each holiday season and this is my NEW favorite hotel. If you want to experience true San Francisco charm, try the Chancellor Hotel! You will not be disappointed.

We were welcomed with chocolate covered strawberries, a yellow rose on the bed and a nice note welcoming us! That being said the customer service was fabulous! Welcoming, friendly, very accommodating! The only drawback was trying to eat after 8-9, and the room service charges. But I DO recommend the Greek yogurt with honey in the morning. If you are a loyalty member you will get free wifi and a free morning beverage.

From the morning coffee/tea/juice in your room to the apples in the lobby in the mid-afternoon it is all of the extras at make this hotel a true joy and respite in the middle of a bustling city. Excellent walkable and safe location in SF. I will stay nowhere else if possible next time in San Francisco.

I had read all the good reviews but had not stayed before. My 11 year-old and I were in town with a few other moms and daughters for a cheer competition at the convention center. The girls loved the cookie bar, and the moms loved the lounge! Great service, large, cozy rooms, and a warm, friendly, attentive staff. The clientele was also very nice. I'm extremely picky and am a self-described hotel snob, so trust me and stay at The Magnolia the next time you are in Dallas.
Although fishermans wharf touristy the ghirardelli feels apart and offers great accommodation great service and a really delicious breakfast. Recommended.

Questo hotel Ã¨ magnifico, ci hanno assegnato una camera al 28' piano con due grandi finestre che offrivano una vista stupenda sui grattacieli di San Francisco.
Il letto era molto confortevole e il bagno grande e fornito di sapone, balsamo, crema ecc.
La notte dormivano con le tende aperte e ci incantavamo a guardare quello spettacolo che San Francisco ci offriva.
Il personale Ã¨ molto gentile, siamo arrivati la mattina molto presto e ci hanno fatto lasciare le valigie per visitare liberamente la cittÃ . La posizione Ã¨ perfetta a dieci passi (veramente) da market St. e dalla fermata del cable car. 
Evitate di andare dall'hotel verso il tenderloin a piedi non Ã¨ molto raccomandabile come zona, per il resto San Francisco ci ha regalato emozioni uniche. 
Consigliatissimo parc 55!

review_title: Wine with our check in WOW!
review_text:
After a long drive down the coast road from Mendocino with my husband driving our rental like it was a Porsche, I need a drink! The doorman who greeted us was friendly & I asked him where the nearest bar was. He said we had arrived during happy hour & did we like red or white wine? As he took care of our bags & car, we went to check in. As we got our keys & turned there was the doorman with two glasses of wine! Now that is service! 
The building is a beautiful repurpose of an old cannery. We were only staying one night, so just picked a standard room that was decorated rather like a nautical themed Marriott. We did not upgrade. The other Kimptons we have stayed at had more sumptuous rooms, but this one was very comfortable. We have always found the staff friendly & helpful at all the locations!
The hotel was nice but the service I received at the front desk was the bestbi have seen. I travel a lot and it's not offten that I have felt to write such a positive review.

review_title: Don't stay in the upper rooms!
review_text: This hotel was overall very nice. However beware that the walls are very thin. I stayed on the top floor and thought it was an upgrade. Then I realized that the hotel is directly under the airport flight path and you can really hear the planes flying over. Stick to the lower floors and you should be fine. This hotel is much nicer than the others in the vicinity.

Beautiful hotel, great service, fantastic location. We had a great time here. Our room was lovely with the exception of a dirty ottoman. It had several large what seemed to be grease spots on it. Maybe someone put a greasy pizza box on it??? When I called the front desk they seemed legitimately horrified and apologized profusely. Overall, our stay was wonderful and the staff was fantastic. We will stay here again.

My husband and I spent our wedding night at the hotel. Unable to afford a honeymoon, we decided to treat ourselves for one night at a fancy hotel. When we checked in, still in our wedding attire, we were treated very nicely. However, after we changed into our casuals, our service drastically changed also. Everytime we went in or out of the hotel we were asked for proof that we belonged there. We were profiled on the sidewalk before even attempting to enter the building. We were asked if we were guests. Then we were asked what room we were staying in. And then finally we would be asked to show them our room keys. Of course they then would apologize but at that point it didn't matter. It was demeaning the first time and down right ridiculous everytime after that. We had checked out by 8 the next morning, not even interested in claiming the breakfast in bed we paid for. It was the worst way to spend our first night as husband and wife and we blame the hotel Valencia for that. We wouldn't stay there again even if it was free. I will say that the ladies working the front desk were consistently pleasant and professional. Our terrible interactions occurred with the security guards in black. We know we were amongst wealthier people than ourselves but we didn't deserve to be interrogated while others walked right in without so much as a glance from the doormen. Next time we'll opt for only 3 stars, but actually enjoy our experience. I plan to inform everyone I know about the snobs who work at the Hotel Valencia.

review_title: Great value, excellent location, and made up for their service errors.
review_text: Stayed here over Christmas Eve as part of a family anniversary celebration. Rooms awesome (of a $250/night calibre), nice lobby, excellent location. Easily would get 5 stars if not for numerous surprising mistakes handling the treatment of the anniversary couple whose room was to be charged to us. Put wrong name on welcome card in room, delivered comp food and gifts to wrong room, couldn't correct it, forgot to provide treats to pet dog even though they were included in the pet charge and we were charged for them. Concierge was mixed with excellent guidance on sightseeing, but couldn't call a house car or taxi for us in less than 30 min. In the end, they made up for all this by apologizing repeatedly, comp'ing parking, and comp'ing a large Christmas brunch for 8 family members, which was very nice of them. All those gestures brought them back to 4 stars even though all the mistakes were annoying at the time. Given everything, I would try them again and go back there because of their efforts and the otherwise great property.

We just came home from our third stay at the Lake Austin Spa resort. My wife and I just love this place.
It is very friendly and casual and we both feel very comfortable here. It doesn't take much effort to start a conversation with other guests or with staff.
The whole resort is gorgeous and feels very uncrowded. It is easy to be by yourself there if you so choose. For example, My favorite swimming pool at the resort is located in a large barn. It is a 75 foot long lap pool, open on several sides. Like all the spaces there, it is very tastefully done. I've done laps there 5 different times and each time I have had the pool all to myself. Then I finish it up with whirlpool, sauna and finally an outdoor shower. Just love it.
I like that I have a choice of where to have my meals. Most days we ate in the main dining room but we sometimes ate up at the spa house and we could have had our meals delivered to our room and eaten on the porch if we had so wanted.
They had a nice selection of classes and the teachers were all good. Learned how to use a SUP ie a stand up paddle board. Also enjoyed the boat trip on the lake.
Will definitely return again

review_title: Great hotel in just the right location for Silicon Valley
review_text: This is the 3rd time I have stayed at this Fairmont hotel. The location is outstanding. Great access to key locations in Sunnyvale, San Jose, etc. The hotel is established but well maintained. Staff is excellent. Rooms sizes are outstanding, although certain elements like the bathrooms are showing their age. Very clean, just dated. Beds are fantastic. Great food and a really nice bar area for meeting folks. Recommended!
Fabulous hotel in a great location. Rooms were comfortable and staff very friendly and helpful. Thanks for a great stay!

review_title: Great reception, perfect location, reasonable value
review_text: This hotel lived up to the expectations Tripadvisor reviews had raised. We have no hesitation in recommending it.

review_title: A European feel in downtown San Jose.
review_text:
Great staff and location.
Rooms are clean and comfortable.
Stayed here on business and fiund it very nice. The lobby and bar were big but comfortable.
The staff was friendly and helpful.
The area around the hotel building was nice, a walking 'mall' area with pastry shops, bars and restaurants.
The parking weas a bit pricy and vallet setup odd.

review_title: Best hotel for customer service and families.
review_text:
Debated over if to stay here or the Renaissance and Omni won over with all the great reviews. Stayed for 3 nts with husband and kids ages 13, 11, and 3. Everyone from doormen, to front desk, to maids were all so happy and delighted to help throughout our stay. 
Kids loved the goody bags(even gave them another round of bags next day cause they had a new and 
improved version). The cookies and milk waiting for us when we came back each night after a day of 
adventure was just pure perfect! Drinks each morning waiting outside our door was another extra. Kids loved all these lil' surprises!
Location was great. Away from all the nightlife noise but centrally located between Union Square, China Town, Fishermans Wharf, and Ferry Bldg. Kids loved taking the 
trollies up and down all the slopes. Felt very safe in the area. Our last evening we ventured out a lil' too far and think we ended up in the Tenderloin area. Heard about this "do not go" area and let me just say...we made a u-turn quickly. Lol
Overall, GREAT say. Will definitely stay again. Best customer service we have ever encountered.

review_title: If you don't mind a 30 min walk to anywhere...*
review_text: Would deffo recommend this hotel. We loved the location in the very quiet financial district esp over the holiday weekend. We really like exploring cities and everywhere bar perhaps the Castro area was easily walkable and easy to find. Made our stay in San Fran super easy*

Stayed here for 4 nights. Good new room in the second tower. Very big bathroom with seperate shower. Friendly frontdesk, slow bell service. Beautiful lobby, BUT very small gym, huge letdown for a Fairmont.

Very upmarket hotel, the furnishings are all very beautiful! 
The areas were separated and we had a lovely lounge area. 
The only issue is our air con didn't work which meant we had a very stuffy room however I was able to open the windows for air. I am sure if I had bought this to their attention it would have been rectified.
In-Room dinning was very expensive also.
Great pool area and close to the HP Pavilion Stadium.

review_title: Great location and price but Noisy AC Unit was terrrible
review_text: Location was in a great part of town within walking distance of restaurants. Lobby level bar had a fun ambiance but service was slow. Rooms were only $79 and a great value, only thing is that the AC unit was so noisy, it woke me up even though I was wearing ear plugs!
What kind I say that everyone else hasn't said before?! This hotel is quaint and has a wonderful location. It is centraled located and is a great value! I would highly recommend this property!

review_title: Good value, great location though pretty loud
review_text:
Stayed here on a recent mini-vacation to San Fran. We were very happy with this hotel.
It is conveniently located near union sq. And the bart. The Powell st. Cable car literally passes by right outside the window.
The hotel itself is old, but the owners have done a good job to keep it clean and add character. The rooms were small, but nice. I think my only 'complaints' were that our room on the second floor was really loud (though that's not really the hotel's fault) and the shower heads are really low (had to awkwardly duck in the shower, but no big deal)
The cookies in the lobby were great and the bed was super comfy! The staff was very friendly as well. We'd have no problems staying here again.

After reading the great reviews on trip advisor we choose this hotel for our first visit to San Francisco. It is centrally located and near the union square and market St shopping area. We walked to the ferry building for a yummy breakfast. If you want a nice expresso coffee visit blue bottle coffee company in the ferry building well worth the wait. The chancellor hotel staff were so friendly and helpful. We stored our bags overnight whilst we visited yosemite park this was no problem. We also needed to send a 15 page fax to Australian customs regarding a bike bag we were sending home this was done at no charge by the hotel. We loved the cookies, fresh fruit and coffees in the lobby and the candy jar in our room was a nice touch. Don't expect massive rooms as you are in central San Francisco but really it doesn't matter as if you are like us you will be out all day exploring the city. Great hotel will be recommending to our friends!

Pretty hotel. Very nice. 
If i must say something negative, the breakfast wasn't fantastic.

Odor in the hallways smelled of musty, dirty carpets. Room not cleaned well; flat surfaces (tables and counters) in our pool-side had food leftover from previous guests. Two nights in a row there were very loud parties and music that continued after repeated calls to management. Not what I have come to expect from the Fairmont chain.

We booked our stay through Hotwire for our daughter's wedding and got a great value ($75.00 per nite) We had a double on the 14th floor with a nice view of SJSU. The room had a flat screen t.v., nice big bathroom with separate shower, tub and water closet. Beds were very comfy. There was entertainment every evening except Sunday which was great because we had about 20 guests all booked there for the weekend and we partied in the lobby bar on Friday evening and Saturday after the wedding. Lots of places to eat within walking distance which was good because in room dining was rather pricey.

We stayed at the Omni June 25-27, and will be back July 4-7. We arrived at midnight and got what I guess was one of the last rooms left...right next to the elevators and facing the street. We were worried about noise, but it was surprisingly quiet. The beds were very comfy, and the room and amenities were nice.
We stopped at the front desk on out way out our first morning and were absolutely blesses to have met Stephen...he was SO helpful with breakfast and sight seeing recommendations. He was patient and took plenty of time to answer our questions and draw all over our map to help us figure out where to go. Thank you! Because of Stephen, we are very much looking forward to our return tom the Omni next week!
Julie and Peter Hans

review_title: Mixed Emotions but think I liked it!
review_text: Got a great deal through PL, upgraded to a suite at check in and deal still great. The suite was huge and proximity to pool with our patio wonderful but the furniture needs to be thrown out and replaced. Splurged on room service, guy on the phone in too much of a hurry and overcharged us (corrected day after check out). In the end I was won over by the awesome customer service.

Room and bed were comfortable and clean, but the bathroom was disappointing-- small, tile shower and fluorescent light. Only there one night and we got a cheap rate, but wouldn't call it a five star experience like the ritz or four seasons.

review_title: Look for a bargain and you'll clean up!
review_text: This is a very lovely hotel. The staff is wonderful, the rooms are lovely. The rooftop pool is a delight, warm enough to swim even on brisk days. Check on their website for web-only deals or seasonal specials to get a great stay for an even better price. The bummer: the food is pricey at all meals in all of the restaurants and kiosks.

review_title: Impecible customer service, and friendly staff!
review_text: Initial welcome was great, and did'nt disapoint our expectations. Location was great to explore all areas of Frisco, tram stop directly outside the hotel. City line, buses & bart also located in all areas close to hotel. Tram line currently being improved outside hotel but this did not spoil our stay. Did'nt eat at hotel as it was quite pridcey. But again this did not spoil ourstay in anyway as the choices of eatery are in abundance.Chinatown very close, and Northbeach. Always light refreshments; warm cider or iced tea and fruit in reception. Sign in to guessed services, it takes to minutes, and is free. You can have tea, coffee, or hot chocolate for free delivered to your room, plus internet access. Would go back to the Omni again. All were welcomed, from business people to families :)

review_title: Understated elegance, well run and well appointed hotel
review_text:
Stayed for a week on business in April,I was very pleased with the Omni. 
It is perfectly situated to all amenities and the great shopping of Union Square, great food and restaurants nearby, and close to financial district for work.
I was greeted by name, made to feel welcome, and thoroughly enjoyed the hotel amenities. Comfy beds, luxuriously appointed rooms, this is one of the better San Francisco hotels, no question.

review_title: Possibly the best place to stay in San Jose during the Holiday Season.
review_text: Great staff, the front desk attendant who I spoke to days prior to arriving (i believe her name was Hilary) was very helpful and very receptiive to all our requests. Other than that it is a beautiful hotel with cozy rooms and in a great location.
the rooms and overall hotel is great and clean. it looks like its a new hotel, the breakfast was very good too, and the customer service was always very friendly.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Austin Airport

review_title: Great hotel at a great value.
review_text:
When I was looking for a hotel in San Francisco, I noticed that the hotels were expensive and parking at the hotel was outrageously expensive as well. I didn't even look at Omni at first because I figured that I would not be able to afford it, Omni being a 4 star hotel and all. To my surprise, Omni rate was very reasonable even the parking included. The room was small but that is the only complain I have about Omni. Everything else exceeded our expectations. The staff was extremely helpful and nice. The room was very clean and well furnished. Upon chech-in, the hotel gave my kids goodie-bags full of neat toys. As turn-down service, they gave us cookies and milk for the kids every night.
The location was unbeatable as well, situated in the heart of financial district with the cable car right in front of the hotel @ California street.
This is a great hotel with exceptional service at a extraordinary value.
Thank you Omni for a great stay.

review_title: Very close to national instruments campus
review_text: If u are visiting NI, this hotel is less than a couple of miles away and about 15 mins from the airport

review_title: If you are looking for no frills upscale, this is the place!
review_text:
I had a two day stayover in San Jose and stayed at this Fairmont. This is a large hotel with a handsome lobby but needs to pay attention to some of the details. 
Service was okay, but nothing to write home about. When I checked out of the hotel, the lady made no eye contact and didn't make any conversation. I have had friendlier service at Super 8 Motels and Holiday Inn's. There was a gentleman standing next to her that also seemed unfriendly and focused on other things. 
The rooms are large and that is a positive but they are falling apart. There was a large iron burn on the carpet. Its the first thing I noticed and I got stuck in the shower because the door would not open. To top it all off, the tolet was difficult and hard to flush. Generally these are very basic conditions you would expect from any hotel. 
There are some airplane noises also. 
The pool area looked closed, mainly because of the mess and debris all over the place. I would expected that should that would be seen from my room would be at minimum kept clean. 
It is a okay hotel, but next time I will be trying something else.

This former spiritual retreat provides wonderful service, fabulous food, lots of activities, and spa treatments that surpass any I've experienced. It is NOT a shi-shi type of spa. The staff is very personable & friendly. I would return in the future & recommend it to anyone.

We were just in Austin a few days prior, but it was fully booked and couldnt accommodate our last minute change of plans, so we found ourselves at The Hampton Inn (practically across the street from our first stay). One thing NICER about this hotel is the included breakfast, but the downside is not being able to walk to the shops / restaurants at the Domain (poor us, we had to get ourselves in our car and drive 1/2 a mile!). 
No complaints on the quality of this hotel!! Top notch, its just that the first one had a location that couldn't be beat for the price!

Super friendly and attentive, clean and quiet. Walk down to the lobby for some complimentary Starbuck's coffee in the morning and whoever is at the front desk will greet you with more than just a smile. They will spend tons of time with you and help you in whatever way they can. Love the sheets, the shower curtain looked brand new, and the drinking glasses in the bathroom were actually clean. (I always look and I'm disgusted when they are wiped, usually still with lip marks and lint.). Loved our stay and will return.

review_title: Reasonably priced hotel in central SF
review_text: For a mid priced city centre hotel , this is a very good choice . I had a 4 night stay and was very happy with everything . The rooms were very clean and the hotel is centrally located to make all the main attractions easily accessible ( we walked everywhere !) . The only negative comment which is more for feedback for the hotel than as a potential guest - is personally I would prefer tea/ coffee making facilities in my room instead of a communal area. It's nice to be able to have a cuppa when I wake rather than having to get showered / dressed first etc . But this is only a minor detail ;)

Clean, comfortable room at union square...no AC.
Great location. We did not eat at the hotel nor use the complimentary gym but both looked great.

estuvimos en este hotel 4 amig@s en un viaje nyc-sfo-vegas. yo diria que de todos los hoteles en los q estuvimos durante nuestra estancia fue el mejor con diferencia. a pesar q no incluia desayuno, a diferencia de los otros hoteles visitados, estaba fantasticamente situado. a dos pasos de walgreens. y a pocas calles de loris diner, sitio fantastico para comer en sfo.
hotel_name: Hotel Palomar San Francisco - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Nice hotel in great location. Friendly and courteous staff.

Unbelievable customer service. No "snobby" attitudes here; just an honest desire to be as helpful as possible. 
Lobby - classy, elegant. 
Room - very clean and quiet. Bed was very comfortable. 
Misc - wifi worked great. Location is really good- cable car stop nearby, lots of sites in walking distance.

We spent one night here before heading to the wine country. This is in the heart of Fishermans Wharf and likely the best hotel for the area. As others have said the walls are paper thin. The nautical theme is a little cheesy for our taste. If you are looking for a place to stay that screams sponge bob and commercialism...this is the place. We would not return.

review_title: Great place with top notch service
review_text:
My wife and I stayed here during the last week of October. It was just great setting is spectacular, pool is awesome, food is great. Waiters ans waitresses so friendly and nice. It is not cheap but with a great breakfast and classes I thought it was good value. We went to a great cooking demo and yoga class. Really enjoyed both. But the highlight was the equine experience. Amazing
It does take about 30 minutes to get downtown. We thought it was a nice mix of being at a beautiful hotel but also being able to go into Austin for fun and culture 
 We went when it wasn't crowded and there wasn't much scheduled in the way of activities. When we expressed our disappointment they went out of their way to add stuff
Bathrooms are clean and fine but were a bit outdated for a hotel of this quality
We are going back. It is great

review_title: Our stay was relaxing, invigorating, and really fun!
review_text: We stayed at Travaasa for a long weekend get away without our small children. It is so beautiful, the environment is relaxing but also offers so many activities that will invigorate you, or if you like, inspire you. We had fabulous massages from the extensive list if spa offerings. The food was delicious and healthy. The service was excellent. Anything that was requested was met with a "sure, no problem". It is a short drive to downtown Austin, so after a day spent relaxing, we headed to Austin with a huge selection of delicious restaurants and lively night life. We are definitely going to return!!!

Beautiful hotel. Nice location. Clean room. So why did I give service a 1. Let me explain and it all involves intergrity.
Made reservation over phone and I asked if there was any construction going on. Was told no sir. I check in and front desk says "just to let you know we have "soft remodeling" a floor above you on 3rd floor going on from 8am-8pm" I asked why I wasn't told about this when I made reservation, and here's the kicker " you asked about construction sir, not about soft remodeling " Really?? 
Soft remodeling is removing/replacing wall paper, changing interior fixtures... But sir don't worry, there's no tear outs happening and it's confined to the 3rd floor. Another kicker, I go upstairs and guess what, they are on the 2nd floor, drilling and hammering away. 
I wasn't able to get any rest with the constant noise surrounding me.
This happened both days: sat and Sunday. I tell the front desk and they assure me no one is on the 2nd floor. Are you kidding me..?
I asked the lady to come look for herself if she didn't believe me...I'll check into it and get back to you. I'm still waiting....
Integrity means a lot to me when traveling. So make sure you ask about "soft construction" when booking. These word games show me a complete lack of integrity.

I am very late with this review. I stayed at this Hotel with my niece in October of 2009. I visit San Francisco 2 to 3 times a year. I love the cities Boutique Hotels; I have stayed in many, this is absolutely one of the best! We arrived close to 10:00pm on a Wednesday night and still got great service. I had reserved a Deluxe Queen room and we got a doozy. Front and center from our window was Alcatraz. This was my nieces 1st visit to the city so I could not have asked for anything better. We ate in the on-site restaurant 3 times and everything was great! Even though our room was right above the entrance, we never heard any noise. I heard people in the next room one night and all I had to do to muffle the noise was turn the fan on in the room. Beautiful room, lovely bed and linens, great location; you can't ask for more. Highly recommend this hotel!

review_title: Top location, clean and very comfortable room.
review_text:
Excellent location - very central for tourists.
Outstanding room condition, including super comfortable bed and fresh new looking linen.
Clean fresh bathroom facilities.
Great breakfast service.

review_title: Very good location and excellent staff
review_text:
We recently stayed 5 nights at The Argonaut. The location is ideal, towards the quieter end of Fishermans Wharf, right by Ghirardelli Sq and the cable car turntable. Having requested a room with a view we had a perfect view across the bay to the Golden Gate Bridge which was perfect. 
The staff at the hotel is excellent. Nothing was ever too much trouble, the concierge was very helpful at suggesting things to do and booking excursions for us and everyone was extremely friendly and welcoming. The complimentary wine reception each evening is also a very nice touch and brings a lively atmosphere to the hotel around the open fire in the reception. 
Compared with other upmarket hotels, we would comment that the bedrooms here (especially the bathroom) are more on the serviceable side rather than the height of luxury, but for that reason this hotel doesn't feel like another corporate clone which is a refreshing change. That being said, the rooms are very comfortable, well equipped, spotlessly clean and there is plenty of space. We were not disappointed with the room in the slightest. 
Expect to pay captive audience tourist prices in the attached Blue Mermaid restaurant if you stay in-house for breakfast, but the food is very good and service excellent. There are some very good diners very close by which are better value and help to ring the changes - recommended to us by the concierge (now how many hotels would advise you to eat elsewhere just for the experience?).
All in all, we had a lovely stay at The Argonaut and would definitely return here if ever we travel to San Francisco again.

review_title: Couldn't have asked for anything better.clean and comfy. Wood go back in a minute. Loved it

review_title: The perfect hotel in the perfect location
review_text: At the juncture of the waterfront area, cable car, and trolley bus lines we enjoyed our week here. The staff are good, the rooms have a unique style and class, and as the hotel is build in part of the old cannery, there are other similar styled retail places nearby. The attached restaurant, the Blue Mermaid, is very good and we had breakfast there every morning for a week. Best of all for me, was the free Wi Fi if you join the Kimpton loyalty programme. The standard of the rooms was excellent and if we come back to San Fran this is definitely our hotel of choice. We will be passing this recommendation on to our friends at home in Mew Zealand too. Great value for money.

review_text: Great value for money and in a superb location. Very good rooms, even the ones without a view. Free wine 'happy hour' fantastic!

review_title: Great location....cleanest hotel I have stayed at.
review_text: Great room, great service, great location right accross the street from fisher mans wharf and the Alcatraz ferry. Close to everything food....especially the city's little Italy. We ate at the Mona Lisa restaurant...it was fantastic. Just a great experience here at the hotel and when we go back to San Francisco, we will stay here.

The Westin Austin is a hotel that really gets what a superior customer experience is all about. Here's what we appreciated the most:
Service that went above and beyond what was expected. 
Spotless room
Terrific location
Swift room service
Tremendous value
I would not hesitate to recomenend to a friend.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_title: The Best for Corporate Strategic Planning Event in San Francisco!!!!
review_text:
Staff, facilities, guest rooms, food, location, hosted wine tasting, ambiance ALL AWESOME!!!!!!
As a city native the Argonaut is San Francisco at it's finest! Location within a couple of blocks of the Buena Vista (Irish Coffees), Scomas, Lou's House of Blues, Hyde Street Cablecar and so much more!
We batted 1000% at the Argonaut!
JC CEO Sierra Central

review_title: All the reviews we're right, this place is superb!
review_text:
Just a confirmation of everything that has already been said about this great hotel. If you have a car worth staying outside of the city for this great value!
As a tip, I would recommend asking for a room on the north side. There is a Metro garage on the south side and the buses can sometimes make noise late into the night. It is by no means unbearable (we just turned on the A/C fan), but something to consider if you have a choice when booking.

We were extremely pleased with our stay during the ACL festival. Clean, large room, run by a very hard working family, Starbucks at breakfast for $100/night during a festival weekend... Only problem is that there is literally NOTHING around it. One needs to drive for 3 miles or so to find even a Taco Bell, anything better requires a 10-15 minute drive into town. Otherwise highly recommended!

review_title: Well located, comfortable and good value hotel
review_text:
Stayed for five nights and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. 
Yes, the rooms are 'cosy' but in a city like San Francisco there's so much to see and do that you'll not spend long in your room anyway. 
Stayed in one of the infamous low level, front facing rooms and I have to say the double-glazing works a treat and the room wasn't at all noisy. 
The free tea and coffee in the lobby is a nice touch.
I only used the restaurant for breakfast but found the food quality to be good and reasonably priced. The staff in the restaurant were particularly helpful.

We just completed a 4 night stay in the Chancellor. We chose the hotel based on reviews on trip advisor. 
With the hotel ranked in the top 10, it's fair to say that we had high expectations. 
By far the best aspect of our stay was the location. It's right on Union Square so perfect for shopping and getting the cable car to Fishermans Wharf. We were even close enough to walk to the Wharf on a couple of occasions. 
We found the hotel itself to be quite average. The service was fine and staff perfectly friendly.
The room itself was okay if a little small (although we were prepared for this from doing some research). We were quite disappointed with the cleanliness of the bathroom. It looked like the tub could have done with a good clean. 
Overall we were satisfied with our stay. The location definitely made it worthwhile but still can't understand why it's ranked in the top 10.

review_title: Great location, friendly, comfortable and worth the money
review_text: Perfect location for union square and shopping. Very professional and friendly staff. Convenient tour desk who were proactive in ensuring I was taken care of for airport transfers, activities etc. Room was small, but pleasantly furnished and very clean. Hotel itself is older but charming. Would highly recommend.

Staff was very friendly and helpful in all hotel facilities. Excellent breakfast (actually had quality, healthy choices ). Things like fresh fruit, fresh stone milled oats, and smoked salmon.
The fitness center is the best I have seen outside of a resort. 
Great location. Convenient to downtown and great shopping/dining at Domain. A little far from airport.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text: My husband and I came to stay here for our honeymoon, upon arrival we were disappointed with some of the things we experienced and we talked to manager Danielle. It was extremely late that evening and we were very upset at the time and Danielle went above and beyond to turn around our experience and make it a positive one. She surpassed all our expectations and personally went out of her way to ensure we had a wonderful time. She provided 5 star service and treated customers better than anyone could ask for. Her genuine care for and skill of customer service is one that all employees could only hope to learn. We also spoke to Andrew before we made the reservation and he was an incredible help to us. Upon check out Elrick was full of life and kindness. We recommend this hotel to future people based off these 3 employees alone! Thank you Danielle and staff for making our stay great, we truly appreciate it!
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_title: Front Desk Gets It Done Again
review_text: Thanks to Caylee at the front desk my long day became much better. Extremely knowledgeable and friendly. Once again the restaurant failed and was out of bread pudding but the rest of the stay and facilities are top notch and no fee to park.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

We arrived at the end of Oracle World and the beginning of Fleet week. Had I known it was Fleet week I might have booked a different hotel. It is a nice hotel but if you are looking for the boutique hotel experience go elsewherethe afternoon wine tasting is something to behold -we waked off the elevator into a wall of people and noise!
