review_title: Above average hotel - pity about the locattion
review_text: We stayed just one night in The Argonaut. The rooms were nice and clean and generous in size. While all he fittings look new, the "argonaut" theme is taken a bit too far with the decor! The gym is very good, nice equipment and quite spacious.

Glowing reviews brought our family here. It's an average hotel. Staff not all that friendly. Rooms are average. Pool is small. It's just ok. If you have a lot planned and won't be in your room much it's fine. But this hotel is LOUD. It's extremely hard to sleep with all the car/plane noise and sounded like elephant herds on the floor above us!!

This is an excellent hotel... Never stayed at a super 8 but the reviews made me do that and changed my perception about super 8s ....it's a great hotel, everything is perfect and as one of the other review says...the hotel has gone out of the way to take care of small details.
Near to the airport, great staff, courteous to ask us at 5am if we wanted to take some of the breakfast along as it was ready even when their breakfast starts at 6.
But trust me way better than any holiday inns or hamptons 
Go for it

review_title: Great location just off Union Square but perhaps a bit pricey for the size of rooms
review_text:
The hotel was in a great location a stones through away from Union square and the cable car to Fishermans Wharf is across the road.
The rooms are tastefully decorated but are fairly small and don't have air con which are typical of the age of the building. 
Parking is a block or so away and is 33 dollars per day although there is a guest parking zone outside for luggage drop off/pick up. We had a fault in the bathroom and whilst maintenance were sent up immediately we didn't get an apology and the problem wan't fully rectified.

Very clean, roomso were well decorated, bed was awesome, great value. This hotel is a 5 and a definite place we will return to.
The breakfast was good, belgian waffles were good, the Starbucks coffee machine was great, lots of choices.
Get the best rate possible on www.super8.com, front desk couldn't match the company's web price, so I used their computer in the lobby to book the room!
These are Wyndham properties, this hotel was awesome.
Would stay here again any time I we are in Austin and recommend you do too.
The only constructive criticism would be to put planters along the fence around the pool or some kind of privacy material on the fence, need to shelter the guests from the view of the parking lot.

Justin the hotel desk person was awesome.Very kind and helpful in getting directions where to eat and places to see.Ask him,you won't find a nicer person.very clean,other hotel staff very nice and friendly.

review_title: Fantastic Hotel in a fantastic location!
review_text:
I arrived after 26hrs traveling & was greeted at check in by Voula, who was friendly, efficient & sympathetic to the fact I just wanted to get to my room. I can't tell you how long it took - I was in my room before I could look at my watch! 
I loved the furnishings, bed was the most comfortable I've had in a hotel & the pillows were so comfy! Loved the umbrella in the wardrobe but San Fran gave me no reason to use it!
Located in Union Square - fantastic! Cable car stop outside was great for returning from a long days sightseeing! Also walking distance to Powell St muni station where I caught muni to At&T Park & Golden Gate Park.

The hotel was nice and in a good location. It is walkable distance to the shops and restuarants at the domain. I liked how self service parking was available and for free. I was not too impressed with the service. For example, we called for toothpaste and they had told us that the front desk had them and we would have to pick it up ourselves. The staff did not seem up to par as the other Westins I have stayed in. Although, the concierge, Fran, was helpful in leading us to the right directions... whether it be to the shops/restuarants or even around the hotel.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_title: Enjoyed it, central in union square, good room and services
review_text: Pulled up outside and it didn't have a large frontage but everything else about this hotel was great. Good room and services. Great location for food, shopping and the trams. Enjoyed it and will be back. Now in hawaii for some sun

Very clean rooms and ours had the decor of a retro apt, it was great. They do lots of little things that add up to a great stay. Comfy beds, nice crib, airport shuttle. 
Some Hwy noise but otherwise very enj

review_title: Best place for park sleep fly
review_text:
If you need to fly out of austin airport and park your car this is the place for you. If you book through parksleepfly you get a hotel night, parking for up to 14 days and a free ride to the airport. The staff is so friendly. Once we forgot our tickets at home and they picked us back up at the airport and took us back to the hotel. When we came back from home we parked and they took us back to the airport! 
We have used this hotel and website countless times and it is amazing!!! You will not regret it! Continental breakfast included!

review_title: Great accomodations at a reasonable price
review_text: The hotel was clean and the staff was extremely accomodating. The room was average size for an older downtown hotel. The location could not have been better. You are in the heart of dining, shopping and many attractions. The value is outstanding and I would stay there again.

This place is 10 minutes from downtown! Very easy if you have a car. 
The staff was very friendly and the double queen room was super clean.
Will stay here again.

First off let me say this is a VERY reasonable price for the hotel. The staff was great and really did try hard to please but,,,,,the first night the pool was out of order. Our microwave didn't and in the middle of the night it starting beeping and wouldn't quit until we unplugged it. This is one thing I find unacceptable! The first night I noticed a stain on the top of my sheet, guess what I noticed the second night???? The same stain on my sheet!!! They hadn't changed the sheets! Definitely not a good thing, I wonder how long they had been on the bed? 
Another thing, if you are wanting to stay somewhere close to the city, 6th street, downtown, zilker park, don't pick this hotel, it is alittle out of the way.

review_title: Felt like I was at a Hilton!
review_text: When my husband told me he booked a Super 8 for our weekend stay, I was pretty peeved. We normally stay in resorts and higher end hotels so I was expecting a dumpy motel. Wow was I wrong!! The people at the front desk were so friendly and attentive. The hotel itself was comforting, inviting, and surprisingly modern! They even had a dessert bar! The room was spacious and there was even a pillow menu and terrycloth bathrobe to wear. The free breakfast was far above standard continental. Fresh waffles, fruit, pastries, eggs, bacon, you name it! I have to admit, my husband outdid himself on this one. We WILL be returning. :)

review_title: Best money ever spent on a hotel room!
review_text: I stayed here for just one night and definitely plan on returning. I needed a hotel that was close to the airport because I had an early flight to Hawaii the next morning and when i called, they only had one room left so we took it. When we got there, they upgraded our room to a suite at no extra charge because the suite was actually the last room left. Definitely a surprise! The suite was more than expected! The service was wonderful and the suite was very clean and the bed was so comfortable, I wanted to take it with me! The money I spent was well with it! Will definitely stay here again.

My husband and I stayed here during 4th of July. We enjoyed the Asian suite with a swing ! The flat screen was nice and house keep did a good job cleaning the bed. They came at a good hour, not 8 a.m. like the super 8 in Colby KS. The only trouble was finding the place, we had the GPS lead us to two other super 8's then a series of circles til I switch to my phone then found it. Its way south on 183. But I would suggest staying here. Breakfast is good and the people are helpful.

This hotel receives excellent review after review for a reason! 
First the location is fantastic, right on Union Square on Powell Street. All the shops you could want on the door step. Fishermans wharf is a pleasant 30 minute walk away straight down Powell St. Alternatively if you don't fancy braving the hills then the Cable cars stop right out the front door. A taxi cost less than $10. We walked to te wharf there and back every day for 4 days and enjoyed the walk.
Next the rooms are great, very comfortable bed, pillow menu with a choice of a dozen pillows. All the usual room amenities tv, iron, safe, toiletries, rubber duck, ceiling fan. 
We were there during the height of summer and didn't need any air con, the ceiling fan was more than sufficient. Also noise was not an issue as some other reviews have 
stated. 
As we were on honeymoon we even received a bottle of champagne, chocolates and even a photo frame as a present. 
The hotel bar is great for cocktails and Rory the bar tender gave us some fantastic recommendations for restaurants. 
Scala the Italian across the road is very good. We also ate at a plae called First Crush which was a few blocks away and very good too. 
The coffee, cookies and popcorn available in reception all day every day is a lovely touch. They don't have coffee making facilities in the room but it is no bother nipping down for some. 
This hotel is amazing value and I would definately stay here again without a second thought! Thanks to the Chancellor for kicking off our honeymoon in style.

I spent 9 days in SF on a mother/daughter trip. No need to rent a car. This hotel is on the cable car line and only a short walk to the Subway. Union square is right outside the door. Great value. Staff was great. Food was great. Would stay again on a heartbeat.

review_title: great if you are on biz or shopping north end of Austin
review_text: Overall this is a great biz hotel. Had really clean and nice rooms. Internet was free wifi in the lobby, pretty standard. Wish there were minibars in room, and fridge was a wine bottle cooler. Housekeeping excellent. they had live music in the lounge and I ate there the first night. Awesome spinach salad which I saved half of in the room fridge for bfast because it had melon wrapped with prosciutto! Bar and kitchen staff were very professional and competent. Pork chop was very good with a nice sauce. My water in room was free, and 2$ in vending. Standard. My room happened to be next to vending/ice but wasn't disturbed until housekeeping accessed storage closet in same area at 8AM. The doors seemed to close extra loud which was disturbing after the world series game, maybe the dampen ears can be adjusted to close slower but firmly. AC is an in room unit, high quality but louder than central. Windows don't open which usually forces me to turn off AC to sleep. Was cool enough with weather an auxiliary ventilation to sleep. Bed was heavenly. Pool and hot tub were clean and outdoors. Enjoyed them alone since it was in the 50s at night. Gym was clean and very well equipped. My friends and I walke from the hotel the second night and had a good meal after happy hour at the hotel which was a good value. Didn't use the biz center but it looked great. Lobby is nice to hang out in. I'll stay here again a third time.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text: Great first impressions and freindly door staff with memorable uniform, however first impressions wore thin once we got into the room. Walls are paper thin; we had to complain due to excessive noise level next door and they said they would call the room to tell him to turn down TV and noise level (we were on floor 4). Realized that they would not hear the phone even ring (could hear every word to a song they were playing and every word of what they were doing). Went downstairs and we were angry as they could not change our rooms, the woman we dealt with didn't know what to do but other reception staff stepped in and said that after 10pm security can be called. Luckily, we went out and when we came back the noise level had piped down. We had asked to change the room pending the situation and next day concierge arrived at door asking us if we were ready to move. This was suprising as nothing had be pre-arranged and there had been no communication from the staff the following day, so a bit baffling they turned up a room at 6pm following day. This was all assumptions. Did have bottle of red wine which was nice gesture, but really we were furious about noise level. Did not expect this from 4 star hotel. Also disappointing a disabled shower in room - no bath - love a long hot soak after walking around the city. Again, would have expected this is standard in all 4 star rooms.

review_title: Charming hotel in a great location.
review_text: The location of this hotel is outstanding. Complimentary parking at the nearby parking garage. Nice pool area with great views. Spacious room, comfortable bed. Could use more lighting though and an in room safe. Loved the 7th floor bar and The Club V bars. Would definitely stay here again.

review_title: The stay at the Weston was absolutely fabulous!
review_text: The Westin is a wonderful hotel to stay at and very accomodating to your needs. They made my friends 30th bday very special by placing balloons, chocolates and a card in the room for her. She was excited!
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text: Prior to our stay we emailed the manager Antonio flores and requested a bay view room. My husband had recently lost his father so this was a much needed trip! He replied to us and assured us that our request would be met. Indeed it was. Our room was amazing! It was huge! The staff were great and nothing was too much trouble. We are already planning our next visit.

review_title: Great location, great service, great hotel!
review_text: Booked this hotel on priceline and was so glad we got it! I probably won't have found it on my own and it was a great place for a great price. Location was right in the heart of Fisherman's Wharf but wasn't noisy. The first night we were upgraded to a beautiful suite and then had our reguarly booked room for the second night. Suite was amazing but the standard room was nice as well. Employees were very friendly and the bell staff could just entertain you all day! Highly recommend and will look for other Kimpton Hotels for future travel.

review_title: Amazingly helpful and friendly staff, especially for my weird schedule.
review_text: After my flight was cancelled when I got to the airport, they worked to get me a shuttle back, even though I had already checked out and it was hard to get the request into their 'system.' It made all the difference in the world not to have to sit in the airport for 6 hours. Of course the room was clean and the continental breakfast was fine, but it's the little things like the shuttle ride that make the difference. I'm extremely pleased.

review_title: Complete package for a hotel with best service to boot.
review_text: An overall very clean and comfortable hotel with staff that makes sure you are attended to. Very good bar food and service.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_title: Great place in a great location
review_text:
We stayed at the Chancellor for 4 nights as part of our tour of California. We had read lots of reviews prior to arrival and were keen to see if it lived up to our expectations. Oh and it did! 
A fantastic little hotel that had the most amazing location. Right in the heart of union square, close to cable car stops, shops and restaurants. 
We drank at the bar once during happy hour and it was nice. We had free tea & coffee everyday which was perfect. 
The rooms were on the small side but were perfect as let's face it, all you do is sleep there. You're out the whole day sightseeing!! 
Didn't eat at the Chancellor but it smelt good. We had breakfast at Sears next door (yum yum)
We would definitely come back to the Chancellor, an excellent hotel in the heart of union square!

Stayed at this hotel after reading reviews. This was a really great place to stay! Rooms were immaculate and common areas were beautiful. The staff was great and we really enjoyed the breakfast and all other amenities.

This was our second stay and all of our reasons for coming back are still there so we'll be back again and again. Great location, rooms and amenities. The staff is great. Everyone from the front desk to the bartenders to housekeeping made you feel welcome.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_title: Good hotel, though value for money questionable
review_text:
The hotel is in a great location and generally staff are lovely, especially John the doorman. However at over $300 a night room only (Inc taxes) for an internal facing room it seems expensive. The decor is quirky. 
The hotel is great for being on the wharf and next to the cable car stop, but the wharf area is quite seedy. A couple of times I got hassled by people on the street, one very creepy. 
Didn't eat in the hotel apart from breakfast, which again seemed quite expensive at about $18 for a croissant, bagel and 2 coffees, better going to the Starbucks at the back of the hotel. 
The sound-proofing between the rooms is not good, I could hear the couple next door chatting through the night/woken up when they did early in the morning. 
The wine hour is good and it's nice to get a chance to socialise with the other guests. 
Would recommend on the basis could get a deal which would reduce price.
Overall ok, but seems dated inside and doesn't seem the cleanest

The hotel worked well for us because of its location near union square and the BART system. We arrived late and checked out the next morning. Additional pluses were the free wifi, nice staff, good beds and price. Down sides were the absence of air conditioning and fridge/mini bar, lots of city noise, tiny bathrooms, peeling paint and a lobby that needs a remodel. Would not recommend this hotel unless, like us, your stay is only for one night.

review_title: Clean, friendly, big rooms, what a great hotel!
review_text: I cannot say enough nice things about this hotel. The rooms are large and well-equipped. The buffet, even in the last hour of service was full of good, fresh, hot, food as well as a large selection of fresh fruit. It's location is very, very safe (I traveled with two young children and was alone most of the time with them.) The bed was comfortable and had good pillows. The sofa bed didn't look super comfortable, but my kids had no complaints! I will absolutely stay here again!!

review_title: Super good value for the money.
review_text: This hotel has good reviews for a reason. I booked the hotel via hotwire and got a great price. It had a 2 1/2 star rating which is low because it deserves better. The place is located well, clean, and has pleasant and efficient staff. You can tell that it is managed well.

This is written at the end of a three nite stay. Great location, very nice staff especially front desk staff. On the not so good side, bed was not made once, trash was not taken away once, only got towels because I asked. When I inquired about the towels and the bed not getting made, she told me it has happened before and guests have complained. Well then do something about it!!!! I just can't believe not once in three days did we see evidence of housekeeping .

review_title: Great place to stay if you drive
review_text: We really enjoyed our stay. The hotel is new and the rooms are clean and modern. Everything works, from the cooling system to the water pressure in the bathrooms to the internet access. The service staff are helpful and courteous, but in a subtle way not in-your-face. Shopping and dining at The Domain across the street are enjoyable. One slight negative was that the location was around 20 mins from downtown, which is okay if you are driving (free self park in front of the hotel). But if you want to be immersed in touristy things it is better to stay downtown. anithe slight negative was that our room had a whooshing noise in the background, which we attributed either to the cooling system or water pipes in the wall. But it was not overly loud.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text:
I booked this hotel after reading the reviews on trip advisor and I can saftely say I've not been disappointed. The Chanceller is in a very central location in the city, great for shopping with department stores and higher end shops minutes away. Acsess to public transport is good, cable car right outside and buses jus on the corner.
Our room was 704, quite compact for an American hotel, more like something you would find in England with dark wood furniture and marble worktops but functional. The only thing which let's this room down was a lack of a view, a billboard obstructs the view of union square. Maybe the rooms a little higher are a bit more lucky?
Free wifi helped me plan and navigate the city as well as keep friends updated with our holiday progress from my iPhone.
Also the hotel app came in handy with deals and a good list of places to eat out in the area, a very nice touch.

This was our third hotel on our honeymoon and was the only one that made us feel totally special. Everything about hotel was outstanding, although there is no kettle in rooms there is a tea and coffee station in the lobby which is always well stocked with cookies and popcorn in the evening! Can't wait to revisit!

Food was great. Urban grill had great brunch options especially egg options. Service was exceptional by the night staff at front desk. They helped us with a medical emergency at 2 am. I have stayed at lot of Starwood properties but you guys really rock.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text: This is our third time staying at the Chacellor and we just love this wonderful, privately own charming hotel. To begin with you could not ask for a better location, steps from Union Square on Powell street. The rooms are small but comfortable and clean and have been renovated since our last stay. The restaurant serves a very good breakfast for a fair price considering we are talking about San Francisco. Everyone from the reception to the waiter is extremely friendly. I know I will be back here again on our next trip.

I booked the Argonault after investigating many hotels on this site and in tour books. This hotel offers staff who truly go out of their way to help make your stay pleasant from the front doorman to the staff who pour wine and sangria free of charge daily for an hour at 5pm. My room had no view, but a comfortable bed with a down comforter and plenty of comfortable pillows. The walls were thin. I heard my next store neighbor snoring. That being said, I wasn't in San Francisco to stay in a hotel room all day. This hotel is at the best end of the wharf. Less traffic to contend with and close to Starbucks, Giradelli chocolate, trolley turn around, great Italian and seafood. Alcatraz ferry is only a few blocks away. If u r a foodie like me, u will trek even on foot to get to the great restaurants that are very close to this motel. We had a car overnight there which costs us $45.00!!! Truth to be told, parking in the city can take 45 minutes. Pay the money and sprend your time having a stress free glass of wine instead. Car rental agencies r right around the block from the hotel. This hotel does a great job at making u feel that they do care about your stay. Bottom line...Location, location, location.

review_title: Very pleasant experience. Some trouble parking.
review_text:
Very nice hotel, helpful & pleasant staff. Also quite a good value. Front desk staff granted my request for a late check out due to the hours I had to work while in town and amazingly housekeeping did NOT attempt to enter my room as has happened so often at other 
locations. Only downer was that zero parking was available since I was the last one in. Standard Comfort breakfast which could be improved across the board but that's not the fault of this hotel...

We stayed here for five nights. The location is great, right beside union square. Rooms are good, not huge but big enough. Didn't really have any encounters with the staff but the one I did have was great. We had breakfast in the restaurant a couple of days, it's convenient but I'm sure you could find much better value and service close by. I did love that the fitness facility was a gym around the corner. So rather than a small fitness centre in the hotel you get a fully fitted out gym. Would definitely stay here again.
Very nice, modern, recently - 3yrs ago built. Bigger than usual rooms, comfortable beds, super close to both stadiums.

My family and I stayed at the Westin at the Domain and it was great! The Westin is located in a fabulous area with premium shopping, upscale to casual restaurants and a movie theatre located within steps from the hotel. Macy's is literally across the street!
Also, if you are a dog lover, you are in luck! Dogs under 40 lbs are welcome at the hotel. They will even provide your pooch a bed if needed. How awesome is that! Rover is even welcome to join you at some of the restuarants and even at the stores. If you are looking to get away for the weekend, this is the perfect place. With something to do for the entire family, you will love your stay.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_title: Great Hotel for the start of our honeymoon.
review_text:
This hotel has a perfect location for a San Fran sightseeing stay. Restaurant "blue mermaid" was fantastic with great chowder. Free wine evenings in the hotel is great for hearing stories and gaining tips from others. 
Rooms were clean and themed well for the area. Air con is great but a little noisy.
Typical Kimpton amenities make the hotel that much better.

This hotel is great but the location is the main selling point- directly om union square. The only drawback is that there is no breakfast or fridge supplied which means dining out which is very expensive but the complimentary tea & coffee in the lobby is great! 
I would definately recommend this hotel. 
 after visiting fishermans wharf I would advise staying on Union Sqaure rather than the Wharf

review_title: Great value for money in terms of location
review_text:
Stayed here for 4 nights and 5 days back in February. We booked this place after reading glowing reviews on trip advisor. Unfortunately the hotel itself was a little disappointing, yes the hotel is somewhat historic, but the rooms were very small and pokey. There is a tourist desk at the lobby, which is helpful when you're not familiar with San Francisco, but the lady there can rip you off and give you misleading information! She's a bit amusing though. 
The location of this hotel is possibly the best! It may not be as luxurious as the Westin which is two blocks away, but if you're only using the hotel to sleep in, paying the fraction of price is great value.. 
The tram stop is literally at the front, Macy's, saks fifth, Tiffany's and Williams Sonoma is across the road! You are definitely in the middle of union square! This is so convenient and there are great places to eat around there too! 
So the hotel although not fantastic, the location is amazing!

My husband booked this place, and I was quite excited following reading trip advisor. 
We arrived to find the two delux rooms we had booked not available, the reception said they would compensate us for the downgrade in the rooms, which they did. 
As we arrived at 21.30, we enquirer what time the restaurant was open until and was told 22.30, by reception. They stopped serving at 
22.00, so had to out for dinner, this was not good after a 5 hour drive. 
The rooms are not great for the amount they cost, they are fairly small, poor amount of wardrobe space, bathroom really small. Nice toiletries though.
Concierge was not to helpful either, we wanted tickets for Alcatraz, they told us to check the website, we had already done that and non where available.we hoped they may have an alternative agency they could use. We also wanted theatre tickets, which they did manage to acquire for us.
The hotel is at the end of fishermans wharf, which is a strangely tacky area, lots of tourist shops and not to much else. The cable car to the centre of the city is just at the side of the hotel.
I don't like to be negative about places I was just disappointed!

Very surprised with the cost of wifi and the fact they charged our debit card a deposit of $500. Given the room was prepaid for 5 nights, I thought this was over the top and was not well explained. Otherwise all was good.

review_title: Great location, great staff, great rooms.
review_text: This location is perfect with easy access to shops and eateries! The hotel staff lives up to the Westin name of true professionals.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text: We booked on hot-wire. Very nice and clan for the price. Breakfast (free) has nice DIY waffles.
We stay here when we are in Indy. Nice folks that are very helpful. Nice big indoor pool for the kids. Breakfast is included do that's nice.

From the time we got picked up At the airport till the time we got dropped of after our stay we were treated like FAMILY by all Customer facing staff. Especially a Fantastic Houskeeper / Shuttle driver (Michele). Michele always went out of her way to make sure we had a great stay at the Jameson. When I think of Hotels to stay at in Indy I only think of the face of the Jameson Michele. I will be Back Thank You Michele.

review_title: Great place to stay at union square.
review_text: Our stay here has been great. Friendly staff, clean room and the convenience of it all is what made the trip. It's seconds away from the trolley stop and union square it across the street. Small note if you've never been to San Francisco. Union square is extremely busy and noisy even at night. We stayed on the 8th floor and had the jazz musicians on the square put us to sleep while the trolley's bell and brakes wake us up! Not the hotels fault but should be noted if your a light sleeper. The area also seems to be much safer and less homelessness than any other part of town. A great charming place that I would definitely stay at again.

review_title: You owe yourself a stay here at this Westin !!!
review_text: This hotel not only is beautiful but they bend over backwards to make you comfortable and enjoy your stay. Have Sunday buffet there it was delish!!!! Order anything you want and you won't be disappointed handy rides on a golf cart to the great mall was very welcome .
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text:
We booked a stay here because it was close to the Domain with shopping and restaurants . Because it was more expensive than most places we expected above average service and were dissapointed that it did not measure up. The room was not stocked with amenities such as shampoo and shower caps....basics at most places.....there was no information books listing resturanr menus or even numbers to call if you needed something like directions to the pool .....the second day our room was never cleaned or even clean towels provided....and it took several calls to request things and then only part of the items we needed were supplied.....
Hopefully this was all the result of the hotel being new.....it certainly was not up to Westin standards, regardless we will not stay here again.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text: Very cool historic building in great location. Excellent access to trolleys and restaurants. Would definitely send family and friends here!

review_title: Nice, just need to be aware off...
review_text: the noise. Ok if you plan to stay in the Wharf this is a great place. We had a big nice clean room with a view of the golden gate. te star shaped cover pillow is bizzarre. they have nice Aveda bath products. Not a flat screen but when are u on the TV? Great assess to the wharf, embarcadero, etc. There is some generic noise at times from neighboring rooms which is minor but definitely noise from the halls. this hotel is not filled with young, drunk people so this is not to big an issue but you can hear hallway noise and this can be annoying if talkative loud folks are walking past frequently. so advise against room near elevator. otherwise a nice comfortable hotel.

review_title: Great view small noisy Bay view. suite
review_text: Bay view suite delivers a great view from small window in long narrow room Wish I had read other review paper thin walls I have noisy kids next door Alot of street noise I unloaded my luggage while 2 porters had a chat My kids in standard double queen - don't bother small room looking at other rooms why pay extra for this location when you could be anywhere Overall disappointed

review_title: One hour experience at the bar
review_text: The valet was ($7 for 2 hours) to visit the bar. At the bar, the beer was surprisingly $4/ea, which seems at the low end price for the high end hotel. The atmosphere is relaxing and the lights are very dimmed. There is also a bar room that is lit red when you walk in. The service was horrible. She did not look or approach us once. We were dressed casually against everyone else in the bar, so I dont know if that was the "problem". Overall, it is a nice bar.

review_title: Nice hotel in a north side location.
review_text: This hotel was not huge, but rather just the right size. The staff was friendly, the rooms were clean and nice, and the pool was warm. I wish the hotel had a hot tub and I wish they weren't so far off the main road, but I was satisfied with our stay. I would stay here again.

We stayed here as the first stop on a recent US trip so it was the first place we arrived at after a 14 hour flight. Although there wasn't a room ready yet they held our bags and did everything they could to accommodate. When we returned and were finding it hard to stay awake on the comfortable couch in reception they were able to soon arrange a room. 
The only negative that I can think of was the staff speaking loudly outside our door one morning but as it was to another guest I find that understandable. 
I would stay here again for sure.

review_title: Wonderful hotel! Delivers all you would expect.
review_text:
This is the perfect hotel to be located in downtown Austin. It has everything it should, polite and attentive staff, unique interiors,
gorgeous views, a wonderful spa, and beautiful pool areas that look up to the spectacular Austin skyline. 
Easy walking distance to the best restaurants, coffee places etc. It is just fun to be there!

We chose the hotel because of other tripadvisor recommendations and weren't disappointed. The rooms are not spacious, but you have everything you need. The breakfast is good and reasonably priced. We loved the rubber duck on the rim of the bathtub!

Within walking distance of the baseball, basketball, American football, mall, restaurants, capitol building, main city circle and easy access from expressway and airport. Typical Marriott so nothing woo-hoo but good solid standard.

review_title: Won't stay here again unless I have to.
review_text: I stayed here for four nights on business. Rock hard bed, my room smelled of cigarettes, the ac couldn't keep up, the room was humid and dank, and I ate something in the restaurant that had me sick for three days. Yuck.

If you want to shop in SF, look no further. Hotel is on Union Square. Hotel is exactly what I was looking for. I like staying in five star hotels just like anyone would, and this hotel is not a five star hotel. But, if you are generally an easy going, non high strung person not irritated that something is not 'perfect' and brand new- this is a great hotel on Powell St. where the cable cars run and close to everything we wanted to do. Room is smallish but so what- all I did was sleep there. How much room beside the bed do you need? Bathroom has a shower, sink, and toilet. They all were clean and functioning. What else do you need? Breakfast was convenient and tasty.
Bottom line: if you don't need a five star hotel in SF then you don't have to pay for one and can still have a great room at a great price (with add-on parking I would suggest). Loved the uniqueness and boutique feel. Keep doing what your doing Chancellor. I'll be back!

Location location location. Extremely clean. Comfy beds. Nice linen & pillows. 'Boutique' covers description of decor but still old fashioned. Lovely service at breakfast. San Fran weather is unpredictable so lack of air con a non issue. Bathroom was dated but spotlessly clean. Would defo recommend.

review_title: Nice place. They had trouble booking me at our group rate...
review_text:
... Despite the fact that ther were apparently plenty of rooms available.
NOTE! There are two Marriotts a block apart: the Downtown and the J.W. be clear with your cab driver ( and traveling party!) about which one you want.

We found this hotel by chance on sale at Otel.com and I'm so glad we did. Great location, rooms, service and quality - you couldn't fault it. Complimentary wine hour each evening was a bonus. Would recommend to all. We paid approx Â£125pn - not bad for fishermans wharf..

review_title: Didn't know service like this still existed
review_text: Came down on a Sunday for business expecting to leave on Tuesday morning. Came down with a VERY bad case of Strep on Monday morning. They extended my stay for an additional night at the same rate I was paying even though current rates on Expeidia were almost $100 per night more. When I called down to the front desk and asked if someone could please get me some nyquil from the little store. They came to the door with the nyquil and a bowl of Chicken soup with saltines. Seriously what hotel staff has the simple kindness to think ahead and bring someone who feels miserable something that will make them feel better? Everyone I talked to was so kind and considerate. The sweet lady that brought up my room service for lunch told me her hours and to call down and ask for anything that I could think of that would help and she would take care of me. Made me feel like I had an extra mom in the hotel (and I am well past 35 and a very frequent traveler). Thanks to the Marriott hotel staff.
Perfect location. Helpful staff. Overall can't fault the hotel and everyone working in it.

review_title: Nice hotel in great location-easy access to transportation and shopping.
review_text: We enjoyed this hotel because of its charm (glass doorknobs on wooden doors, small library, cookies available 24/7). It was a bit noisy with the cable cars right outside and people playing instruments on the street but that really just added to the charm and never kept us awake. Free coffee, too, that was excellent.

review_title: What one would expect from a Marriott.
review_text: Check in was very easy. Every staff member we came into contact with was friendly. Room was smallish, but very clean. Very comfortable bed and great water pressure in the shower. Use the mat, because the tub is dangerously slick. Concierge made an excellent recommendation for brunch at patachou on the park. Parking was free on the street for the weekends or $15 in the state building lot on the side of the hotel across Missouri street, so do not pay $28 to park in the hotel garage. Overall a very nice one night stay.

The hotel looked promising, but when you have a late check-in at 2 am, you don't scrutinize too closely. If you're dead tired, you may not be able to actual pinpoint the awful smell as vomit, but the identity of the scent is clear after you've been inhaling it for a while. The staff tried to make up for this with a free breakfast which was laughable as my stomach was so wretched I couldn't eat for hours and ran into the cold winter morning to clear my head. Cleanliness leaves a lot to be desired.

My fiancÃ© and I reserved a king bed room for the Brickyard 400 weekend. While the location was great, we were surprised to received a double bed room at check-in. When we asked for the king we reserved, we were told the hotel 'never guarantees bed type' and that the kings were sold outs had we known, we would have stayed at the Westin instead. Also---we went to the pool to have a quick swim and found the water to be really, really cloudy and gross. Pick another hotel, folks!!

Located in the perfect area of downtown Austin..within walking distance of the best bars and eats of Austin..the living room is the bar located at the W...scenery and service was great..enjoy the pool area and ask about the cabana rental...well worth it as the pool tends to get packed in the afternoon...you must try the signature cucumber pepper drink...delicious..

I stayed at the Marriot for a convention. It's nice that it's right across the street from the convention center and it's connected by a breezeway. Service in the hotel restaurants was pretty bad. Also, the hotel does not offer wifi, which I believe is unacceptable for a hotel at this level.

Great location. Right next door to the cable car. Walking distance to Alcatraz and fishermans wharf. Staff very friendly. Valet was very fast got our car within a few minutes of calling for it. Great location to both bridges to go to both the redwoods and tour jelly belly factory. Rooms were very clean beds comfy. Will stay there again had a great vacation.

review_title: A few things marred what could have been a good stay
review_text:
So am going to be fair here. This is a charming hotel, very clean and with smart rooms. It's very good value for money.
Our stay was marred by many of our clothes being ruined by an obviously incompetent laundry contractor. The hotel resolved this in a way we were comfortable with but I would recommend that you do not use their dry cleaning / laundry service during your stay.
The bed sheets were stained both nights. The first night we were too tired to wait for them to be changed so we didn't report it, however when the new sheets the next day also were stained and ripped we asked for them to be changed, which there were quickly.
Front desk staff generally ok apart from a particularly odious man called Oscar who had an air of arrogant self importance. 
Am sure The Chancellor was just having an unfortunate off couple of days as I can see why this is generally a popular hotel.

We stayed 2 night for memorial day weekend and absolutely love the hotel and it's location. San Francisco is a walkable city but the fact that this hotel is right on the Wharf makes it so much more convenient. You have cable trolleys right in front the hotel, city bus tours around the corner, you are a few piers up from pier 39, the aquarium and Alcatraz just to name a few. This hotel is considered a 4 star because it does not have a pool otherwise it would be a 5 star, but to me, this was a great find!!
Stay away. The staff are rude and condescending. Concierge was the worst - a short blond kid couldn't hail a cab to save his life - he had to take it away from someone else who had jailed a cab

Love the Hotel, but if you ever stay here DO NOT use the Room Service.. you will get ripped off. We ordered a simple dinner and it cost us over 50 bucks. Not including tip. And. The food looked and tasted like it came out of a microwave. This food service is not affiliated with Laquinta
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn Indianapolis East-Post Drive

review_text: Beds were comfy, pillows were not, lots and lots of noise...could even hear the next door guests using the bathroom. Sounded like the water lines were going to explode anytime someone around or above you flushed the toilet or turned on the shower. Gang activity or something requiring lots of cops happening across the street from the hotel lobby. Parking rediculously priced...overall worst hotel experience of my life.

Stayed for 6nights over Easter weekend. Nicely done out hotel, however sound travelled easily. Dissapointed when we were called one evening to ask us to keep our children quiet as there was a complaint from room below.. We didn't have any children a fact they could have checked before calling! 
They had a wine hour each day but despite being in california near wine valleys the wine was imported from
France! Apparently because the chain imports wine for hotels world wide ... To me this just seemed to be them missing the point! 
Staff were generally helpful but the traveling noise would prevent me from staying again! 
The hotel also claimed it would offend if it celebrated Easter so pretended the holiday didn't happen!

This hotel was wonderful in every way, from Cindy at the Pullman Bar to Mike at the front desk, I can't wait to go back! We stayed in one of the train car rooms and loved it. The hotel was clean and the food in the hotel restaurant was really good. Thank you Crown Plaza for a fantastic vacation!

very dirty hallways paper thin walls and doors pay to park 25 bucks. wet bar sink out of order. ugh
bus stop ij front of hotel unsavory people hanging out alll hours

review_title: This place is in dire need of a major renovation and some housekeeping!
review_text: Poorly kept ! Dated! No safes in rooms! When was the last renovation? Many things broke or in need of renovation and general curb appeal is bad. Smoking allowed by the front door so ashes everywhere by the front door. Generally dirty at front door, one of which wouldn't open all the way. Closet door off the track, lightbulb burnt out, tub wouldn't drain. Dated bath tile and countertop. However, room was clean, bed decent and pillows terrible.

review_title: A fantastic hotel in an ideal location!
review_text:
We stayed at the Argonaut for the first four days of our honeymoon in San Fran, and it was utterly perfect.
The location was amazing, right on Fisherman's Wharf. There were loads of bars, restaurants and shops within walking distance, most notably Pier 39.
The hotel staff were great too - so welcoming and attentive. We even got a little welcome gift in our room to celebrate our honeymoon!
Our room was a great size, with everything you could want - including free wifi and a view of the Golden Gate bridge! We loved the nautical theme running throughout the decor as well.
To top it all, the hotel runs a free wine tasting evening every night - what's not to like?!
A fantastic hotel - highly recommended, we'll be back!!

I stayed there a few times and was given different reasons why the price was higher than the advertised price. (the race, the weekend starts on friday, smoking rooms are cheaper). It was also dirty and smelly on each occassion - NEVER AGAIN!

review_title: Only stay as a last resort!!!!
review_text:
Right from the start I wasn't very impressed. Only reason I stayed in the first place was I'm on a college budget so the cheaper places usually win. When I arrived to check in the desk clerk was asleep with no way to wake her. They didn't have any kind of buzzer or doorbell to alert anyone was at the check-in "booth" (I arrived late after the office had closed). AFTER she woke up and filled in the check-in card did I see the rate was higher than advertised. She said it was the weekend rate. Had I know that it wasn't gonna be as cheap as I thought I should have gone somewhere else, but decided to give it a try since it was late and I was tired. 
When I got to the room, it was freezing. They had the heat turned off, which I can kinda understand but at the same time I feel they should have a couple rooms on that are next to be rented out. First thing I did was check the sheets to make sure there weren't any stains of sort, luckily I found em to be clean. But that's about the only positive part of my stay. The room was missing basic ammenities such as an alarm clock and a hair dryer. The tv didn't have a remote, which didn't bother me since they didn't have a good selection of channels. 
I had a very restless night. The heater was very loud and noisy and did not shut off the entire night. It kept waking me up and made it very hard to fall back asleep. The bed itself wasn't very comfortable, and the sheets didn't do much to keep me warm.
In the morning, I noticed the carpet was highly stained, which made me glad I had kept my socks on. When I went to take a shower, I noticed the toliet seat was extremely dirty. Never have I had to cover a seat at a hotel before. I feel like that shouldn't have to happen. When I got in the shower the tub was sticky, and the water didn't drain out properly. And then trying to find a decent temperature was a joke. If you moved the knob just slightly the temperature jumped drastically. There wasn't much of finding a satisfying spot. When I got out I find that the towel is really tiny. It barely fit around my waist, and I'm extremely skinny. That pissed me off. 
All in all it was ok to crash for a few hours, but I will never sleep there again. Id rather pay a couple extra dollars and stay across the street at the motel 6. They may also be "cheap", but at least I've never had as bad problems with them as I did here.

Booked this hotel for 2 nights for my daughter and I. Not a child friendly atmosphere. The rooms were fair for the price, but not very clean. The breakfast is a JOKE!! The pool appears to be very nice in the pics, but be warned it is NASTY!! We did not get in it at all. DO NOT RECOMMEND to anyone looking for a nice pleasant stay.
If you dont care about mildew, non-functioning facilities, noise, and an unavailable front desk clerk then by ALL means... STAY HERE!

review_title: Overall poor quality. Inattentive, boorish, standoffish mgmt. No attention to local health or building standards.
review_text:
Complete and total thumbs down.
No redeeming qualities.
Local fast food delivery establishments refuse to come here.

One of the worst hotel experiences I've ever had. Dirty panties and marijuana in the room for starters. Old food was left in the fridge along with dirty dishes. Called and complained over and over again. They never even offered to move our room. Asked to talk to manager and were told she was unavailable. No one could even get us extra blankets, pillows and towels.

review_title: Clean,comfortable,unique what more could you want from a hotel.
review_text: I read multiple reviews about this hotel before I decided to stay hear. All the negative stuff about the train noise and virbration, blah, blah ,blah. My room was on the third floor I felt train vibration, but there really was no train noise, the noise comes from inconsiderate guests who slam doors and think that yelling in the hall ways is acceptable. That can happen in any hotel. My king bed was very comfortable, my bathroom was large and clean, shower pressure was a little lacking. My room was cleaned promptly each day. I had breakfast twice in the Pullman restaurant the buffet is average at best powdered eggs and rock hard biskets. Order off the menu the food is much better, you get actual eggs. Had a burger in the bar one night was very good. Unless you stay in a five star hotel....hotel food is hotel food, besides there are multiple food options within walking distance in downtown Indy. Parking for 27.00 a night is a little expensive, add the valet tip and it's really 30+ a day. unlimited in and out might make it worth it if you are site seeing. I did not stay in the train cars but if I come back I will looks very cool, if you have kids that like trains what a great experience. Fitness room is small with lots of equipment however, seemed odd they had the treadmills and bikes facing away from the TV's , even the though they had smaller separate screens on them, I prefer to run with my head up rather than looking down a a 6 inch screen. All in all I would stay here again, especially for convensions Brel attaches to convension center via skywalk and it's right across the street from Lucas Oil Stadium.

The hotel is pretty old - the rooms have that aged smell. The rooms' air conditioning is bad. My room had no electrical outlets. So I had to unplug some of my lights to plug my laptop and other chargers. They also had a water outage one day and in the evening when the water was restored, only muddy water came through the faucets. The American breakfast served in the restaurant was okay. The plus sides in this hotel are the free Internet and has free airport shuttle.

review_title: Perfect location for football, conventions, bars and restaurants.
review_text: First time I have stayed here and was very happy. Located downtown adjacent to the convention center and closest good hotel to new Colt's stadium and within walking distance to many restaurants, bars and nightclubs. Located at old train station they also have real train cars as rooms. Regular rooms clean and roomy. Everyone friendly, will stay here again.
This is a very nice well kept hotel. It is small and has friendly staff. We will definitely stay here again when passing through.

review_title: Dingy, dark, dirty and depressing. Only good thing is the location.
review_text:
Location next to the convention centre is excellent.
First impressions, poor and dingy rooms.
Air conditioning is louder than the trains that run through the hotel like an earthquake. Not enough to supress the sounds of the next rooms guest snoring.
Air conditioning panel is loose.
No in room safe.
Shower is dreadful, spits out the head and bath tap at the same time. The tap was loose and stuck to the bottom of the bath is a non slip sheet which has come partially un stuck and when lifted reveals a disgusting collection of hairs and other body debris.
Bath and the sink don't want to drain away. Stayed in room 329 avoid at all vosts,the view is of an internal wall no natural light to talk of.
Hated the hotel it resembles Disneys tower of terror. Stay somewhere else...

Room was bigger than average. King room with pillow top and down pillows. What was interesting was the front room with full size sleeper with cocktail table. Between they area and the bed was an arch. It added a nice touch. One complaint- TV is severely outdated.

To start with, the room we stayed in was of average size - don't expect the rooms to be very spacious. Â Deluxe continental breakfast consisted of toast,Â begals, oatmeal, small selection of yogurt, waffles, coffee, juices, hard boiled eggs, Â cereals, and pastries. Â Beds were very firm to say the least. Â Our room was listed as two "double" beds (more like two "full" size beds). Â Due to the size of the headboards compared to the beds size - the room appears to have been originally setup for two queen beds. Â Two queen beds would have been more of what I would have expected. Â Pillows may have been small in size, but they were soft. If you like big pillows - bring your own. Outlet that was by coffee maker needed to be replaced. It was loose in the wall, faceplate was coming off, and nothing would stay plugged in. Pool was on the small side, but hot tub appeared to be able to fit about 10-12 people. Â There is a nice open atrium area (next to pool) for sitting and relaxing, but it could use some more comfortable seating. Â Also, the so called deluxe breakfast is served in the atrium area. All in all - for a one night stay it was slightly below what I would expect. Â They were setting up the theater area for church services when we were checking out on Sunday morning. Â Price was $74 a night - add taxes and it came to $86.58.
I don't know why this hotel gets bad reviews. This is the hotel I stay at when I visit Indy. It has a nice pool. Good value for the price.

Stayed here for four nights on business in a converted train car. I had been looking forward to this aspect of my trip and the room itself did not disappoint. However, housekeeping did not show up one of the days at all, but then knocked on my door every half hour on my final morning even with a do not disturb sign posted. I was also "upgraded" with club lounge access, but it was a complete joke. I realize I might have been spoiled with CPs in other locations (Little Rock and Columbus, OH come to mind), but this lounge was truly lacking in every way. Breakfast one morning consisted of slices of French toast with nothing else. The same went for dinner snacks with fairly pitiful (grease laden) selections. 
The only other bright spots were Walt (the bartender) and a few of the valet drivers who always had smiles on their faces.

review_title: Seemed like a nice place, but nothing in our room worked.
review_text:
This Clarion Hotel is in a decent area and seems to be well kept.... until we attempted to use anything in our room.
First, the positives: The hotel offers a nice lobby, breakfast area, and pool. The rooms are clean and comfortable as you would expect for a hotel in this class.
However.... upon settling into our room, it didn't take long to realize that maintenance needs to be more diligent. First thing I always do upon entering a hotel room is to adjust the temperature. After fiddling with the controls I finally coaxed the A/C compressor into running.... for 30 seconds. The room remained stuffy and a bit warm throughout the night. Also, the in-room phone was unusable. Not sure what the issue was, but it sounded like the dial tone was having a fight with a bobcat. Finally, I had chosen a room with a whirlpool tub. One problem.... there was no way to plug the tub. There was some odd thing in the plug hole, but there was no way to make it stop the water from draining. I'm fairly mechanically inclined, yet I was baffled. Obviously, a whirlpool tub is useless without the ability to hold water.
For fairness, I need to mention that due to the fact that my sleepy family of 5 arrived at the hotel late, these issues were not mentioned to the staff until morning, so they had no opportunity to rectify them. The staff was very apologetic and professional in the morning. I would have been more upset had this not been a free stay through then Choice Hotels rewards program. Nevertheless, having this many things broken in one room should never happen at a hotel in this class.

review_title: Great staff and service if you are not trying to rip them off
review_text: Me an my family stayed at this hotel after reading the reviews on this site.You people only give credit when you find something to complain about to get your money back. I enjoyed the whole stay from check in ( hot but funny front desk staff). The food was awesome. The people working at the bar were great to.The only thing I saw were other families not controlling there kids an expecting the staff to do it (hotel not daycare). A couple of people complained about A different guest an wanted A full refund. Come on people stop looking for something for nothing

review_title: Wish I would have done it different.
review_text: This place is terrible. We checked in and I automatically thought "what have I gotten myself into?" It is scary old--"historic, if you will"--good thing the valet parking is a deal at $27 DOLLARS a day!!! A train went through and scared the living hell out of my wife and I. I didn't sleep for two days, nor did she. Good thing the front desk warned us about this before hand--oh wait, no they didn't. The concierge acted surprised when I told him about the train rattling my room and stated that the front desk should have warned me about the trains. I will never, ever, ever stay here again and I hope God has mercy on the souls of all who decide to stay here.

review_title: HORRIBLE experience from start to finish
review_text:
We will NEVER be back. The water park is okay, but certainly not worth 25 bucks per wristband. Give me a break! Our hotel room was dirty, the shower was disgusting. I was so uncomfortable on there regular beds I traded one of the kids for the roll away. The roll away was more comfortable than the actual bed. It also irritated me that we had 5 ppl in our room, myself and my son's 3 friends. They would only let four of us eat breakfast and were even going to make me PAY for a cup of coffee! After paying 170.00 for the room! Horrbile customer service, horrible beds, horrible experience. NEVER coming back and making sure none of my friends or family come here either.
Save yourself some money and go somewhere else!

We did not have a good experience at this hotel at all. We picked it for its convenient location (right off the interstate) and because it had an indoor pool. Overall, the hotel was just plain dirty.
The common areas are the worst. The pool area was pretty disgusting with standing water on the floor and dirty towels strewn about. The pool was freezing and the hot tub was not even lukewarm. Someone had complained to the front desk staff about the hit tub, but nothing was done about it. 
The front desk was only staffed with one person and, as a result, the lobby was always crowded and there was a line. In general, it seemed like there were a lot of people just hanging around the outside and lobby. 
Our room was ok at best. The ceiling was falling down in one area. The bathroom smelled and the frig had some nasty smelling liquid in the bottom of it. We opened the window to cool things off at bedtime and got serenaded by the cars on the interstate. It was loud!
Long story short, even for a cheap hotel, this place is nasty. Stay somewhere else!

The hotel itself is very decent. Six floors, smoking rooms. My room was top floor and smoking (which I requested). No fridge/micro, but it had a nice bathroom and was all in all very serviceable. Average restaurant with excellent waitstaff. Excellent location, considering it's Indy's East Side.
My only real complaint was the poor service from housekeeping, whom I tipped well. They didn't vacuum or even clean up the still-crusty spots of "something" from the last guests, failed to take out the trash two out of five days, and gave much better service to my neighbors (who didn't tip).

review_title: Not Pleasant, but very cheap and close to Airport
review_text: Whole hotel seems rundown and in need of renovation, peeling wallpaper, damaged fixtures in rooms, but kept clean enough and friendly service, we paid a very low rate for 2 nights, and for that it is OK, but I wouldn't want to stay more than a couple of nights

I read some of the reviews of this hotel and I was nervous. I don't know if there has been a drastic change but I couldn't find a single thing wrong with this hotel.
Check in was a breeze and the staff was very friendly. I asked for a king size bed and they were super accomadating. She also gave a lot of detail about restaurant and shuttle:-) 
The room was lovely. Very clean and well maintained. I was pleased with the sleep number bed and the ample pillows that were provided. The linens and towels were great quality and made the comfort level very high!
I found the location to be very convinient. I also was impressed with the restaurant and their pricing was very reasonable!!
I would stay here again in a heartbeat. They were a hit with me in every way:-)

Don't have a vehicle bigger than a car. Checked in and paid for my room. Went upstairs to my room and turned on the heater, (which rattled horribly), just to have the phone ring. It was the front desk calling to tell me I had to leave the parking lot because I have a truck. There is no posted no truck sign on either entrance. Parked out of the way. When I asked for a refund, I was met with an attitude about I would have to come back when the manager is in the office. So we just went next door to the La Quinta (which gladly accepts any vehicle). I was going to stay here due to a discount that my company gets here, but will never stay here again. I had stayed here many times before but WILL NOT STAY HERE EVEN FOR FREE. Do yourself a favor and stay next door. Much better rooms for $1 more. Bigger bathroom, flatscreen tv, faster internet and friendlier service.

Overall, I would not recommend this hotel. The rooms are old fashion. They have old school handles on the toielets and the rooms have old school tvs, not flat screen, and the carpets in room are badly stained.
More importantly, the Front desk staff is the worst that I have experienced. I am a goldpoints gold member, but because I booked through priceline they insisted that all benefits for being a loyal guest were null and they could only give me rooms on the back side of hotel. I had to switch my room 3 times to find one that was half decent. I worked with Jessica and Amanda, and they seemed to find my issue amusing. Hopefully, this hotel can better train it's staff and make some renovations to rooms. At this point, there are better options in the area for similar price. Hyatt place and wydham are other options, and much better.

Cut my finger on jagged edged desk chair...noisy, near runway...maids don't pay attention to the do not disturb sign...cable and internet down (was told it would be fixed tomorrow!) For a business hotel, there can't have failing internet!
Stay somewhere else!

I have stayed here before, and it was a pretty bad stay. After seeing that this hotel has been renovated and that the price is right, I tried it again and the changes are very noticeable. The room was outstanding, and so was the staff. I encountered one small issue and it was resolved immediately and in a fashion far beyond my expectations. Location isn't great, but shuttle service is available. For the price, this place can't be beat.
This was the dirtiest hotel I have ever stayed in. The place even smelled bad. I have never checked out of the hotel early but I did for this one

places a complete hole!!! I feel bad I even book this place ! we actually moved to the marriott ! rooms are dirty the pool is dirty the clientele is dirty and the management could care less . it's not a water park it's a pool that has some attractions ! I would you stay here again if it was free !!!

I stayed at this hotel for the weekend, along with most of my extended family for our family reunion. Our rooms were very clean and we never had any issues. 
The grandkids loved the pool and we all loved the convenience of a restaurant, Damon's, being inside the hotel, which even offered Room Service at a fair price. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful and the food was great. (They have some of the best ribs we've ever had! Definitely, a great place to take your family for dinner!) 
We had some unplanned changes to our location for our Family Reunion, and after being upset that we weren't going to be able to have our reunion, the staff at Ramada Inn were eager to rent us one of their banquet rooms for the day. They just happened to have one available the day we needed. They set the room up to our liking and had Damon's cater our food for the event. The pricing was even cheaper than the first place we had booked! 
Our stay was great and I would recommend it to anybody!

review_title: AC unit caught on fire & smoke detector never went off!!!
review_text:
My family and I recently stayed overnight in your hotel along with some friends of ours... Around 1am we heard the AC unit make a loud buzzing noise & then a very foul smell that reminded us of an oven being cleaned. My husband got out of bed and walked over to the unit & it started big time sparking (like fireworks)!!! Â Our room had smoke in it & he told me and our young daughters to get out of the room, about that time it stopped for a short second as the girls & I were getting up to leave then it started sparking 10x's more & it caught on fire!!! Â My husband was able to put it out, by beating it with a towel. 
We called the front desk & they brought us a room key for another room that was down the hall. 
Needless to say, we were all very Â shook up over this & I had to calm my girls down to get them to sleep. I however was not able to sleep! Â My biggest complaint with this situation is that our smoke detector never went off!!! Â We had plenty of smoke in our room, there is no reason it didn't go off!!
I was also a little upset with the lack of concern of the staff, they of course did say they were sorry but acted very nonchalant about it. As we checkout the next morning the gentleman who check us out ask how our stay was... I replied it was good, except for the FIRE!! Â He too was nonchalant in my opinion with his reply that he had heard about that, but they switched us rooms right away & took care of it. He also stated that the unit was now fixed, which I don't believe to be true, b/c as we were on our way to check out, I stopped by the room (the door was propped open) & I seen tools & pieces of the unit on the floor!?!
All in all, I was very upset about the smoke detector the most, b/c had we been asleep I hate to think of what might have happened!!!

This hotel is impossible to reach with construction everywhere. The rooms are dingy,beds uncomfortable,but the last straw is the lukewarm water in the showers. The sinks have tons of hot,but the showers none. We were in a group that had eight rooms booked and they were all the same.

Found this on hotwire and got a good deal. The room was clean and the staff was friendly. There are a ton of restaurants in the area which is good. If you are looking for something safe, clean and a good value...I would reccomend this hotel and would stay again.
Got a killer deal on this hotel. Clean and plenty good for a place to crash for the night.

I was involed in a automobile accident with severe back issues.One of the reasons we picked this hotel was because of the spa and heated pool for my back. The was ice cold and indoors and the spa was filthy with brown foam on the top complained to front desk she called the owner he came down and said he changex water. The water was dirty and hottub had dirt in the bottom of it.

Hotel is a bit run down. Breakfast was ok but the eating area was a bit messy. Room was ok but not great. Over all, a very average to below average stay. We stayed for a soccer tournament and they seemed a bit unprepared and overwhelmed.

I stayed at this hotel for one night earlier this week (I was in Indy for work), and I was very happy with the whole experience. The suite was spacious and clean, the staff very professional and helpful. It took me about 15-20 minutes to drive downtown for my meeting at 8 am. I wanted to avoid the pricier downtown hotels, and it was well worth it. Free parking and Internet were also a bonus you dont always get downtown. Communal areas (elevators, some hallways) need some updates but a very good impression overall.
I had a great stay at the Westin Austin at the Domain. The staff was hospitable and friendly. Our organization had it's conference there and everything went great.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text: From the check in to conference I attend here to the check out all was a pleasant experience. All staff was very helpful and location was great.
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_title: Great location and very comfortable .... No complaints - would recommend
review_text: Manager's reception was very welcome after a day's sightseeing (between 5 and 6) worth getting the Kimpton membership which gave us 10 dollars off the mini bar and the possibility of money idf a massage.... Which we didn't have but the thought was there! The location was great for bike hire and was the much better end of the wharf as it was no here near as noisy as further up towards the main piers.

What can I say...the staff were so friendly. We were on r honeymoon and got a free upgrade to a room with a view of Alcatraz. Fishermans wharf was the ideal place to stay with great sea food restaurants. id definitely stay there again.

Everything about the Westin Dimsin exceeded my and my sister's expectations! We loved the "little town/ city" feel it had with restaraunts, shops and a movie theatre RIGHT THERE ... Walking distances away!! Amazing room and staff and the lobby is exquisite!!
hotel_name: The Westin Austin at The Domain

review_text:
I've gone to this hotel often whenever I'm in Austin. The comfortness of bed, cleaniness, and staffs are superb and top-notch. It feels like I'm in a luxury hotel without a bubbling tub.
Great WiFi service; I haven't gotten disconnected during videocalling or gaming. Excellent breakfast too; Not just cereal or waffles, they serve bacon, biscuits with sausages, eggs, yogurt, bagels, muffins, and much more.
You can request a down feather pillows for extra comfort as well!
Oh, that's not all! Free dessert during the evenings; it's a random lottery with the dessert as molten chocolate cake, fresh chocolate chip cookies, or what have you.
All that for an amazing price! What are you waiting for? Allright, I usually don't do a saleman pitch for anything but this one is a must!

Good: close to the airport for the park and fly
Bad: if you don't mind outdated, worn out, mildew in the shower, and a junk van taking you to and from the airport then this might be for you. 
I would rather sleep at the airport next time.

The best hospitality I've ever come across in a hotel that wasn't "luxury". Every employee we came across greeted us and was super friendly. Someone even cleared our styrafoam plates from our continental breakfast! Everything was clean, location right off freeway. I'd stay here again.

This is a nice hotel, nothing fancy. It is new, clean, had good service, room was very accommodating for my wife & I. If your looking for a nice, comfortable place to stay then this is your hotel. Close to freeway and not far from airport.

review_title: Spacious place to stay, close to downtown Indy
review_text: Stayed here for 4 nights while touring with my company. The rooms are the size of apartments with full kitchens and lots of closet space. Laundry facilities are free. There's a gym and small store by the front desk. The hotel is not too close to anything, so it would be more convinient to have a car. The shuttle is a good way to grab groceries at a local supermarket or go downtown. Overall a good hotel.

review_title: If you need sleep, get a good location & mattress.....
review_text:

Our room was so small we had to first move a chair to pull the sofa bed out. Once we got the bed out, we had about 3 inches of same between the bed and sleeper sofa, very tight. 
Our queen bed was uncomfortable, both my husband & I tossed and turned all night. 
Our room was very clean, but in a bad location first floor next to the pool (which was used until 1am). Plus near the check in desk so there were doors opening & closing all night!

review_title: Good one night stay, nice heated indoor pool!
review_text: Good hotel near restaurants, very nice heated pool, close to.airport and attractions, elevator takes forever better to take the stairs, kids game room was under construction but will be very nice for families when finished

review_text: Great surprise for the price! Friendly staff and a great bar
