review_text: We booked a room for three people, when we got to the hotel we were told there was only one queen bed and a couch. We were dumbfounded. We asked to get a room with 2 beds (any hotel that is 3 stars would have accomodated us) I finally asked to speak to the GM who proceeded to tell me I had 2 options 1. take their room or 2. LEAVE. He was incredibly rude. We had already paid for 14 nights. On the 4th night we find there are ants everywhere. I wouldn't reccommend this hotel to anyone.

Recently stayed 2 nights and could not have been a better experience. Th hotel staff were very friendly and the airport shuttle was waiting on us outside when we walked out. Clean rooms and comfortable beds. Good price as well. They offer a park and fly option as well. In addition to the breakfast they also have a manager reception on Thursday evening with hot food. Would definetly stay again.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites Indianapolis Airport South

review_text: Very happy with our stay here. The rooms were clean, the beds were super comfortable, and it only cost $80 tax Inc. A+ recommend.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites Indianapolis Airport South

review_text:
Staying here for 5 weeks through work. When myself and 4 other coworkers arrived the first night, we came to find out we didn't have fridges or microwaves like HR stated through our work.
After a quick call, the staff arranged so we could put anything we needed chilled in the kitched fridge for the night while they sourced rooms for us to all switch to the next day.
Breakfast is decent. A little variety once in a while with French Toast instead of eggs. Sausage links, potatoes, and/or sausage patties are often. Waffles are better if you leave them in another 10-15 sec after the timer goes off, haha.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites Indianapolis Airport South

review_text:
This hotel is conveniently located just south of the airport and I-70. The entire hotel is very clean and orderly. My friend was very impressed with the pool and jacuzzi area. 
The staff were very friendly and professional. The airport shuttle is a huge plus!
There were 3 minor issues: the entrance is not clearly marked, if you are a light sleeper, ask for a room away from the highway, and shuttle pick up confusion at the airport. FYI-it is located at ground level across the street from the baggage claim in the Ground Transportation Center. 
I will stay here again and highly recommend it.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites Indianapolis Airport South

review_title: Decent hotel with nice amenities and close proximity to Greenwood and south Indy.
review_text: We stayed here during the night of the Big 10 championship game. We checked in late and got the last room, which resulted in us paying more than I thought the room was worth (150/night). Probably not that expensive normally, just high that night due to demand. The room was fairly nice, having a king bed, whirlpool tub, microwave, fridge, and flat screen tv.

The room was clean and equipped with what we needed. The staircase to the second floor could use some attention. The location was only 15 minutes from downtown. There are many restaurants and shopping nearby too.
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn Indianapolis North - College Park

review_title: Worst Western. Don't even stay there
review_text: I booked my room via Priceline. Requested 1 room 2 beds. Got there had 1bed. Spent 1hour talking with desk clerk who I guess was only one there, but she could not make a management decision. So motel chafed me an extra 15.00 for a stinking day bed. Very very customer experience. Do not stay there ever

review_title: Great downtown location. Good rooms at fair price.
review_text: Nice Embassy connected well to downtown amenities and close to Lucas Oil Field, Statehouse and Convention Center. Colts Sports Bar downstairs had great food and atmosphere. Good free breakfast and manager's reception. Connected to Roof Ballroom which was an amazing atmosphere. Great location...OK price.

review_title: Feels dated - service was very low
review_text: I checked in with my family for a mid-week visit to the Children's Museum. A bell staff to help with luggage was non-existent and when we got to our room, the decor and amenities (outside the new TV's) was very dated. This Embassy is connected to a mall, which made dinner very easy for our family. The breakfast was of lower quality than other Embassy Suites, so we went to Panera (connected to hotel). I'm a Hilton Honors Diamond and will try other Indy Hilton properties before staying here again.

1st this hotel is not in downtown. 2nd the service is horrible and front desk people are rude and not helpful. 3rd $20 for parking and its not in downtown?!?!?!?! I would only stay here again if stuck from Priceline or Hotwire, never by choice.
hotel_name: University Place Conference Center & Hotel Indianapolis

review_title: Front desk staff could have enhanced experience
review_text:
We booked through hotwire and stayed for a few days. The hotel location is great as it is 5-10 minutes away from downtown and the hotel has a shuttle service. There is also a city bus service which runs a shrt route between the campus an downtown, with a stop right in front of the hotel. 
The room was fine: roomy with a really comfortable king bed. Restaurant staff were friendly. The disappointments were the shuttle bus not picking us up from downtown the second time we used it and the unfriendly front desk staff on check-in. Some maps of the area would also have been helpful.
hotel_name: University Place Conference Center & Hotel Indianapolis

review_text: Nice hotel, old but very clean. Not the Ritz, but a good value for the average Joe. See Alicia at the bar for great drinks and better dining recommendations.
this was the best place to stay. The whole staff was so Nice and always willing to go out of their way to make my stay more comfortable. I will never stay anywhere else but the homewood suite
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Indianapolis At The Crossing

review_title: Amazing location, great price and a perfect service
review_text: The hotel was exactly what I expected, perfect location, great service would go back in a heartbeat. I have been to the city twice now and cannot think of a more ideal location. Every request I made was fulfilled and more. Just brilliant

review_title: The best hotel I've ever stayed at!
review_text: Everyone at this hotel is kind and generous. They made the stay perfect. It is in the middle of lots of things to do. Would recommend this hotel to anyone going to Indianapolis and staying the night.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Indianapolis At The Crossing

review_text: The overall cleanliness of the room was excellent, but when arriving in Indianapolis at 2am after a 9hour drive I could NOT get to sleep with all the noise outside the room. You could hear the ice machine down the hall, in the mornings housekeeping going in and out of all rooms up and down the halls.. I could hear upstairs running or just othr random noises that seemed to be coming from all angels of my room (below,above,right,left).. I'm usually a sleep anytime, anywhere type person but not this weekend.. I ended up sleeping with the tv & a fan running just to drain out the noise (with more noise) lol If it weren't for all of this, I would definitely stay here again.. Good distance to downtown & major highways, very clean hotel (small bathroom) but nice size room for just 2 people. There wasn't any parking (even at 2am) luckily for me someone was leaving when I was coming & complimentary breakfast that I didn't get up early enough to experience due to the sleepless nights!!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express and Suites Indianapolis East

review_text: Drove 20 minutes out of way because I promised kids swimming. Call asked about pool, arrived about 30 min after the call to find the pool closed. And it did not open next morning early enough for us to swim. Beds were very comfy! There was millepede type bug in bathroom. Was under construction while we were there. Our room was near some kind of motor that came on at least 2 times during night.

Fairly functional...nothing fancy. Rooms are compact with smallish bathrooms. He gym has 2 treadmills, 1 stairmaster, 1 cycle and a couple of benches for ab exercises (something not commonly found everywhere). The hotel has daily specials for guests be it wings, nachos, or snacks with free wine or beer. This comes in very handy as there are not any decent restaurants within walking distance from the hotel.
I have been at this hotel many times. I like it because it's close to my meeting location. Nice people, and easy to get to

review_title: Extended stay better than prior reviewed
review_text:
Keeping in mind this ban extended stay hotel, I found the past reviews to be unfounded. 
Pros:
* pretty clean and great location near major highways. They only clean your room once a week so if you trash it it will smell but you know that going in. 
* quiet when we were there but again I suppose your neighbors make a difference. Their staff is gone at late night so I can see complaints may not go anywhere. 
* free parking, great room price, area is safe, can get on priceline
Cons:
* $5 wireless fee 
* of course continental breakfast sucks but so what?

Sometimes you just have to write a review because you have a duty to the community. We stayed here on the way from CLT to CHI. We got it because we Hotwired a hotel and we chose this 'hood over downtown in order to not have to deal with valeting the car or parking charges.
But it's a Holiday Inn Express. Aren't they all the same? It was clean. The bed was comfortable. Mostly traveling salesmen and construction workers as guests. Free cheap beer.
Sometimes staying in a hotel is just a boring necessity.

review_title: A Viable Choice For A Colt's Game-Only
review_text: We chose the Staybridge Suites as we were in Indianapolis to watch the Packers defeat the Colts with our small dog & most of the lodging Downtown was sold out. We were given a "dog room" on the 2nd floor for an additional $75 pet fee. I believe the inhabitants of room 211 before us must have "bunked" with a pack of wolves.Not only did the room smell like a sordid kennel, but there were stains every where as witness to past beastly soil. Our little pup was scratching for 3 days & it was difficult to sleep.The suite itself was large,with a kitchenette & nondescript decor.Rooms were "lightly cleaned," & sheets were changed once a week.Cleanliness was not next to godliness.Parking cost 12 bucks & if the lot was filled, you had the privlledge of using a parking structure 2 blocks away.The hotel is only 2 blocks from Lucas Oil Stsdium. That's it's only saving grace.
Friendly staff. Great price. Comfortable room. New flat-screen tv with crystal clear cable.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn Indianapolis Airport Executive Drive

review_title: Not a Hilton but no complaints!
review_text: This is our third stay here and I'm actually laying on the comfy bed in my guest room as I'm typing this! You can tell this is an older building but the renovations they've made in the last year or so have greatly improved its appearance inside and out! The staff is always friendly and the vending machines are always stocked with munchies! Be sure you bring a roll of Charmin ultra soft, as the tp in the rooms are made out of the mulch from out front. If you have any complaints about the room, just ask the half naked Mexican that travels the hallways from time to time. The fridge and microwave are newer and spotless, all the furniture matches, and the view of the heliport out back is to die for! The ventilation in the rooms isn't the greatest so make sure not to stop at white castle before you check in! If you're claustrophobic, you might not like the elevator but don't worry...it will get you to your floor sometime before check-out time. All in all, for the price, amenities, breakfast, free parking, location, and laughter this place brings us...we will continue to stay here when we travel to Indy each and every time! I've stayed in WAY worse places!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Indianapolis Downtown

review_text:
I've been a fan of La Quinta for 2 years. But I was sort of disappointed this time.
Room wasn't so wide, but it was clean and newly renovated. Room has a flat screen TV and Micro-fridge. Shampoo and body lotion in the bathroom were Days Inn brand's(this hotel is the former Days Inn). Bathroom was clean as well. However, the layout wasn't comfortable, bathroom and sink were right close to the door.
On the negative side, I never got housekeeping service in my room. The last day, when I went out, I asked for front desk person to tell housekeepers to clean up my room. More than 2 hours later, I got back to hotel. Still, it seemed no one came into my room.
 Another thing, though it's not hotel's fault. Someone came up to my room at 4:30am, knocking the door TOO LOUDLY for a few minutes. I was woken up by that terrific noise. I was in my room alone, so scared!
However, the desk staff was kind and helpful. The location and price were great. If you can stand the occasional inconvenience, I think it's worth it.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Indianapolis Downtown

review_text: I recently attended a conference in Indy - it was the third year the conference was held there and the third time I stayed at the Westin. In past years, I was upgraded to the Executive floor. This time I was told I had to pay an extra $30 extra per night which I agreed to do, but after seeing several people attending the conference had been moved to the Exec level at no extra charge, I went to the front desk and the manager changed my rate to the standard rate of $155. It's a great location - walking distance to some good restaurants and of course very handy to the Convention Center. I found the staff to be very helpful. And being on the Exec floor gave me access to the Lounge and free Internet.

Good points first: great downtown location, next to the convention center, close to downtown restaurants. Valet guys are polite.
Now to the bad points:
Checked into Westin Indianapolis last night. No upgrade as a Platinum, fair enough, they are overbooked. This Platinum couldn't even get a club floor, nothing.
Asked about 4 pm checkout, was told no way in a rude manner by the front desk gentleman. Informed him it's a Platinum benefit, he wouldn't budge. Called Platinum concierge, they called the hotel about the late checkout. Hotel still won't give it. Not 4pm, not 3pm, not 2pm, nothing. 
Late check out is the only benefit of Platinum I was hoping to get, this hotel is not a resort or convention hotel designated (albeit next to the convention center), as confirmed by the supervisor at SPG customer support, therefore they should extend this benefit, but they would not.
Noone asked about what I want for my platinum amenity at checkin either, at this point it's irrelevant I suppose.
Parking is $32 a day for valet and $28 a day for self park. 
Shulas is the restaurant on property, if you are into that.

Ideal for any city centre event otherwise nothing exceptional. Very expensive in bar/restaurant but I'm sure other major hotels are comparable. Was very surprised that in-room WiFi was $10 per day as this was the 7th hotel we stayed in on a 3 week tour and the ONLY hotel to charge - come on, Westin, Internet in the room is now as much a utility as water and air. Valet parking was convenient but, again, required deep pockets - parking in the city anywhere is not cheap. Hotel was undergoing refurb but this didn't spoil our stay. We did experience problems with room keys not working and our bill being messed up but these were sorted out reasonably quickly. Room was clean and in reasonable condition -fridge had to be requested. Overall not bad for a city centre hotel but Westin could differentiate themselves by making small changes.

review_title: Great location - Connects to the convention center
review_text: Typical Marriott style hotel. Nothing overly fancy but it is nice. Really comfortable beds and flat screen TV. The hotel is connected by a skyway to the convention center. The hotel is within walking distance to many restaurants.

review_title: Great hotel in good location (but definitely not downtown Indy)
review_text: Thankfully, we booked several months before Gencon because the Sheraton was booked solid. I could tell they were crazy busy the first night. Loved that the hotel is attached to the mall. One day, we even stayed on site to check it all out. Great restaurants, nice shopping, great kicking back. With Hotwire, only $65/night. Sweet deal. The only drawback, though, was I reserved for 3 adults and a child and the room we had had a king bed and pull out sofa. Thankfully, we had reserved another room for the successive nights. It was identical. It was definitely more appropriate for 2 people.
hotel_name: Sheraton Indianapolis Hotel at Keystone Crossing

review_title: Generally nice hotel but currently under construction for remodeling
review_text: I have stayed here many time before, but I was surprised to check in to find the property under construction. I am slightly annoyed that the lobby is a mess and the Starbucks has not been operational for the past 2 days. Conditionally recommended - this place should be better post renovation. Until then, there are many other options

My husband and I were celebrating our anniversary and wanted to live it up for a night so we thought the Westin was a good choice. When we walked into the hotel we were very impressed but that didn't last long. The room was very dated and extremely small. The bathroom was so small the door couldn't open all the way and the shower sprayed up and out over the shower curtain. I was hoping for a room like what was pictured on the site and it was far from it. The bed was very comfortable and clean so I will give them that. It was in a great location as well so that was a plus. We just wanted something a little more luxurious for the money we spent.

Stayed for a conference since the new JW Marriott was sold out. First room had a rattle in the AC so I requested a room change which solved the problem. Everything was clean, elevators are fast and the skywalks connect everything. Internet is around $10 per day which is annoying for a $140+ room. GPS will say you have 'arrived at destination' but parking is tricky.

This review will be short and sweet. It's not the newest hotel around but it's location could not be better. Rooms are well maintained and clean. I wouldn't tell someone to book their summer vacation here, but if you need a place to stay on the north side of Indy you really can't go wrong with this hotel.
hotel_name: Sheraton Indianapolis Hotel at Keystone Crossing

review_title: An upscale hotel in an upscale area
review_text: I got a tremendous rate on hot wire for a one night stay while passing through to Georgia and was worried it would be awful. But the lobby was modern and clean with attention towards the business traveler. The room was nice, brand new furnishings, with very comfortable bedding. The beds were small, wish they had been queens for my sons. But it was quiet and we slept great. The mall gave us many dining options and very convenient. I would definitely stay again.
hotel_name: Sheraton Indianapolis Hotel at Keystone Crossing

review_title: Time to try a new hotel
review_text:
We've made an annual trip to Indianapolis for the last 4 -5 years and we always stayed at this hotel. The location is great for downtown activities. But this stay was pretty mediocre. There were good things such as the friendly helpful staff. But there were many minor annoyances.
We arrived to find that the one queen bed room we had reserved was not available because a previous guest had hung laundry on the sprinkler causing massive flooding. So we were upgraded to a king suite. It was a true suite with 2 rooms with a door between. But it was quite cold in the room and we discovered that the heat in the bedroom was off. Odd for a day when the temp never reached 40. But we turned it on and went out to dinner. The room still felt chilly when we returned and we kept turning up the heat all evening. It's an old building and the room was on the corner with windows on both sides so seemingly it was hard to heat. The room never really felt comfortably warm. Through the night I was awakened repeatedly by the noisy rattling whenever the heat turned on. I usually travel with earplugs just in case but had forgotten them and the front desk didn't have any.
The shower head was way too high, at least 7 feet up making water pressure poor by the time it got down to me. 
Breakfast the first morning was okay but the second morning there were no bananas and the bowl of cut fruit was mostly empty.
Time to move on to a new hotel!
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Indianapolis Dwtn Across from Circle Centre

review_text: Looks very nice from the outside, but rooms smell funny, mold in the shower. Internet expensive. Front desk staff did not seem knowledge and in a hurry to get rid of you. Someone standing in line with me was told he could not get a receipt for his stay. Would not recommend to others.

Pros: got a good deal on priceline.
Great bed.
Nice flat screen tv.
Nice lobby and bar area.
Lots of nearby shopping and restaurants 
Cons: smelly hallways.
Poor selection of channels on tv
I asked for an extra hour before checkout to shower aster my marathon, and was refused.
hotel_name: Sheraton Indianapolis Hotel at Keystone Crossing

review_text: Our stay in Indy was fantastic! The rooms and staff were great. The lobby of the hotel was beautiful. Right next to the mall which is connected to the convention center by a skywalk. The only problem they couldn't fix for us was the rain!
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Indianapolis Dwtn Across from Circle Centre

review_text:
We stayed for 2 nights (May 29 & 30, 2011). We came in to a room with pubic hairs in the tub and trash on the floor from the previous guest and found a spider IN my bed! We ordered room service for dinner and despite their 30 minute guarantee, 3 phone calls and 75 minutes later, still no food so we cancelled the order and went out!
The next day, we had to call to get housekeeping because they never showed up. When they finally came, the coffee filters were not emptied, they didn't give us more coffee and they didn't give us enough towels and wash cloths.
It's a great location, but their service and management needs A LOT of work to be able to proudy carry the Sheraton name!
hotel_name: Sheraton Indianapolis Hotel at Keystone Crossing

review_title: Place needs attention! Consider anything else.
review_text:
I came expecting one nice night at a upper-mid-level hotel. This place was dirty. The room we stayed felt dirty. In the bathroom there were signs of long term neglect in the vents and other areas.
The Sheraton was disappointing.
Considering the nice area of Indianapolis, this property should be nicer.
hotel_name: Sheraton Indianapolis Hotel at Keystone Crossing

review_text: I was stunned to see this facility rated so low. Beautiful hotel, standard great Westin rooms, good fitness room, great location. I've stayed here many times over the years and have always enjoyed my stay. Highly recommended.

We are retired and traveling the US by car. We picked this motel from a coupon in the motel coupon book at the interstate rest area. This is an excellent little motel that does the job right. Room was clean, plenty of outlets for our electronic gadgets, desk, iron, micro, frig, hair dryer, toiletries, coffee, excellent lightning, and many channels to select on the TV. Breakfast was excellent. The total coupon rate with tax included was $64 and this included a free 2 topping 14 inch pizza delivered right to the room by the front desk. Not a knock off frozon pizza but a real one from the italion restaurant next door. An amazing motel offering exceptional value. Don't pass this one by. Conveniently located on the interstate near the airport.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Indianapolis Airport

review_title: I will never stay at another chain hotel again!!
review_text: We came into town from Atlanta and decided to do something different from a hotel standpoint. Boy were we pleasantly surprised! We arrived and were immediately greeted and from then on called by name. We stayed in room 1206 which was the Presidential Suite. It was so charming and the views of the city were fabulous. The owners Dianne and Turner were on hand when we stayed and they took a hands on approach to insure everyone had an amazing stay. We stopped in this hotel about a year ago and we cannot believe the transformation this place has had. We truly had a great stay. No more chain hotels for us.

review_title: Decent for one night on a modest budget.
review_text: From all the previous reviews, we felt we made an excellent choice, but we were sort of disappointed. The desk clerk was busy talking with someone else the whole time I was checking in. We had asked for a non-smoking room only to find a musty, smokey stench on the floor we stayed on. The smell wasn't as bad in our room, but there was an ashtray in our room. Why, if it's a non-smoking room? The room itself was decent, but not great. Definitely doable if you want to save a buck and certain smells don't bother you.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Indianapolis Airport

review_text: Tucked into a small complex of hotels near a Sam's Club, just off I-465, and not too far from I-70. Clean and comfortable. Free wireless, but signal faded in our second-floor room at end of the hall. If you want to take advantage of the refrigerator and microwave in your room, there's a pretty good Kroger's about three miles away on Crawfordsville Rd. If not, there's a restaurant next door for which we received a coupon at check-in.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Indianapolis Airport

review_text: Kyle is the reason I am rating this hotel a 5. If it wasn't for him I would not be returning. He is a great business professional & awesome at customer service. He is an asset to this hotel and I would recommend anyone staying at this hotel to visit with him. A thumbs up for Kyle.
Very nice hotel. Great service and location. Turner's bar was excellent. Would highly recommend.
Just between cOnseco fieldhouse, circle center and hard rock. Friendly staff. Has shuttle upon request to IU hospital
hotel_name: Hampton Inn Indianapolis Dwtn Across from Circle Centre

review_title: Highly recommended - nice room and good service
review_text:
I've been to several hotels in this area before, I can say that this hotel is the best ever. Front desk staff was very friendly and helpful. I arrived here around 12:45pm, I could check-in immediately.
The location of this hotel might be a little bit off the beaten path. However, as someone mentioned, a restaurant is next door, and Sam's Club is right across the parking lot. CVS pharmacy and some restaurants are also walking distance. I wanted to go in Sam's Club, though I'm not US resident. I asked for the front desk person about that, she gave me a member number. So I could totally enjoy shopping!
Room was nice and wide, basically clean. Only a complaint was that I found stains and someone's hair in the fridge. But the housekeepers seemed to work hard. Suttle driver was professional, I could get to the airport on time.
Overall, everything was great. I think there are not so many hotels that have adequate rooms with Micro-fridge at affordable rates. I would stay here again!
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Indianapolis Airport

review_text: Fine hotel right ON the freeway. Very bad noise all night. Judging just the hotel....nice. Judging the amount of sleep......not.

Struttura recente, tutti i confort. Camere spaziose e ben tenute. Buon livello di pulizia.
Personale disponibile.
PossibilitÃ  di parcheggio per auto a 18-20$ per notte.
Decisamente lontano dal centro (30min circa a piedi), ma possibilitÃ  navetta hotel. Il quartiere Ã© quello universitario, molto tranquillo e affatto rumoroso.
Purtroppo ci sono pochi bar/ristoranti nelle immediate vicinanze; all'interno della struttura sono presenti un ristorante e un bar
hotel_name: University Place Conference Center & Hotel Indianapolis

review_text: Just stayed for two nights. Very clean hotel at a great value. No bedbugs, and I check thoroughly. Great bartender, Kyle. And like others have stated, he remembers your name and does a great job serving you and making you feel very comfortable. Excellent local IPA draft priced right. Bed was very comfortable. And although the hotel is older, they've done a nice job keeping it up. Much better than the Doubletree that I stayed at last time. Just don't expect any perks for SPG Gold or Platinum members. I was told this when I checked in and asked.
Kyle, the bartender, does a great job of making everyone feel welcome. Recommend it.
Kyle at the bar was very entertaining and made everyone comfortable

review_title: Great place to stay in Carmel.
review_text: I would definately recommend this hotel. Clean rooms, great service, and the bar downstairs is great. The bartenders name is Kyle and he is fantastic. Very entertaining...and stays open late!

review_title: Difficult to reach this overrated hotel
review_text:
Thankfully we only paid $60 for this place on Hotwire (which claimed it was 3-1/2 star property). While the rooms may have been renovated, the overall decor is stuck in the 70s. I swear the pool, in an open atrium, was in the movie Cedar
Rapids! When kids were in the pool, you could hear their screaming even in a room on the third floor down a hallway.
465 is under construction at both exits near the hotel so it's a bit difficult to get there. 
bed was not too bad, despite being pretty firm. Good shower pressure but towels were pretty rough. 
Wouldn't pay full price for this property.

review_title: Good value and location for our needs.
review_text: Stayed here prior to a flight out of indy. Very good service, rooms, location. Road construction made for some pains in the neck but overall fine. We will be staying again for our next trip.

review_title: Do not stay here if you need sleep!!!!
review_text: The hotel is full service, however, the air conditioning in the public areas including restaurant does not work! It was hotter inside the hotel then it was outside! It was like being baked in an oven. The room was set on 60 and I was still hot. The a/c never stopped running all night. Generally speaking I turn off the a/c in most hotels because it is too cold. The other issue was planes buzzing the hotel all night! They do not stop (fedex)! They do not stay there! At least the crews that buzz the hotels stay at the wyndam so clearly they know! The rooms are renovated. The room I ended up in was clean however the first one was not! Staff iis friendly and accommodating.

We had a great experience at this hotel. Staff were very friendly. The hotel has been recently redecorated. The pool area was very clean with ample seating and fresh towels. Kids had a great time! The rooms were clean and neat. Beds were comfortable. We had dinner at the restaurant which was really great!! Waitstaff was very friendly and food was delicious with huge portions. The restaurant is nicely decorated. The same area has Starbucks coffee in the morning and pastries for sale. Even though thus hotel is by the airport, I never heard one airplane from the pool, lobby, restaurant or our room! I would definitely stay here again!

My Wife and I booked a Studio Suite at this Hotel over the weekend. We had tickets to a show at Beef & Boards Theater (only a couple of miles away). The room was clean and comfortable. The breakfast buffet was very tasty and well prepared. We will definitely stay here again in the future
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Indianapolis Northwest

review_text: When me and my husband and sister in law and brother where checking in the girl at the front desk was very very rude and kept on shushing us saying their are construction workers sleeping and we were just checking in talking to her I was very very upset I will never stay again because of MISTY at the front desk I've stayed before because of traveling and she was rude then but thought maybe a bad day but how she was yesterday very unacceptable they lost business and for service like that 89 a room to much

I've stayed at this Crown Plaza many times over the years. Nice place as airport hotels go. Good service, food is not exactly gourmet at the restaurant. Not very close to the new airport terminal. Clean but smallish rooms. Poor fitness room.

The hotels location was great. Very close to downtown where all the bars and restaurants were. We stayed in a exec suite which was very nice. The staff were very friendly and extremely helpful. My only complaint was the cost of the valet parking which we were not advised about. It was $30 a day which i thought was a little steep.

review_title: Nice, clean, comfortable hotel near the airport
review_text: I have stayed at this hotel several times over the past year for business and I am always pleased. The hotel is very clean, the staff people are extremely accommodating and always eager to help. There is a nice workout facility with free weights, treadmills, and an elliptical machine. There is also an indoor pool and hot tub. The only down side to the hotel is its location. It is convenient to the Indianapolis airport, but there are not very many restaurant choices close by. The area is in growth mode though and dining options seem to pop up all the time. All in all, this is hotel is a great value and well worth a stay.
I stay at this property on a regular basis and it is beautiful with impeccable service. A must when Austin and the restaurant is great as well!
Great location, will be nicer when renovation is complete.
If you want understated business luxury, this four seasons delivers. great spa, nice outdoor restaurant and service is four seasons nice. Close to the downtown action but secluded enough.
Clean, nicely appointed room. Seemed they were lacking staff at check in. Lots of noise in room from hotel construction.

Hotelazo en el centro de San Francisco, a 5 min de Union Square y 20 del muelle 39. 
Todo tipo de detalles de hotel de lujo, gran trato, housekeeper 24 horas, excelentes habitaciones pero algunos defectos basico como el alto precio por la wifi, 10$ al dia.

The hotel is a large no-frills convention hotel well located downtown, next to Circle mall. There are a number of good restaurants nearby. The rooms are standard quality. One high point is the revolving restaurant on the roof. 
One thing that did not impress me was the staff's attitude. Black Expo was held during the time I was there, and the staff was extremely anxious. The hotel handed out bracelets that had to be worn when entering after 7 pm. To test this, I entered after 8, with my bracelet out of sight in my pocket. The guards didn't ask to see my bracelet at all, while black guests were asked for theirs (I'm white). A disappointing experience.

Spacious clean room terrific staff we will stay again. Very upscale downtown place with little difference from the more expensive Conrad where we have stayed before in Indy. Glad the Cards beat Butler.

I was here for a week to attend a conference held at the Hilton. I was very pleased with my guest room. The rooms are big and the bedding is very comfortable. I didn't notice much moose from the hall or from outside.
The meeting rooms were about what you'd expect, but I was surprised to learn we couldn't the lights separately when the Indianapolis Ballroom was split into the A and B sides. One switch does bother ends.
Food for the conference was quite good overall, so no complaints there.
The Hilton's location is hard to beat. It's only a block from the Capitol, Monument Circle, and the mall. It's a short walk to the state offices complex, Convention Center, Lucas Oil Stadium, Conseco Fieldhouse, etc.
Be aware that parking isn't cheap here. Valet parking us $28 per night.

Wir waren fÃ¼r 3 NÃ¤chte im Hotel. Das Hotel hat ein sehr gute Lage. Chinatown 5 Minuten zu Fuss. Die Zimmern waren immer sehr sauber und auch ruhig ( fÃ¼r Amerikanische VerhÃ¤ltnisse )
Was aber das Hotel ausmacht ist das Personal und der Service.
In diesen 3 NÃ¤chten mussten wir nicht ein mal selber die TÃ¼r aufmachen , wir hatten schon angst um die Mitarbeiter da sie sich immer fast etwas brachen weil sie immer zur TÃ¼r rennten als sie uns sahen damit sie vor uns da waren um die TÃ¼r aufzuhalten :-))

When I think of a good hotel stay, this is it. Nothing stands out in my mind, and that's a good thing. A very good thing.
Walking distance or super short cab ride to all ATX fun!!

review_title: If the little things matter, then this property should matter when you're planning a trip to Indianapolis.
review_text:
Hotel grounds:
Immaculate. Great first impression. Front drive looked almost polished. A great contrast to all of the pre-Super Bowl construction. 
Lobby:
The automatic revolving door is a right squeeze for a carry-on roller and computer bag. I wish the hotel employed a door attendant. Valets seem to open doors when not involved with drivers. Several guests arriving at the same time struggled to enter.
Checkin:
My reservations were made by an event planner and not through the hotel. There were some hiccups because of that. However DEION went above and beyond to solve the problems caused by the event planner. I am VERY grateful. 
MEETING ROOM:
We had a series of meetings in Circle City 5. The room was perfect. Seriously. It was as if Adrian Monk went through the water service, placement of the mints, pens and paper, and arrangement of the chairs. Wow!
The technology in the room was flawless. 
I have used many meeting rooms in my travels and I have NEVER had a conference room that was this well appointed and easy-to-use.
ROOM:
The same person who inspected my conference room must have inspected my guest room. If only I could've stayed longer. 
BED:
Perfect
TV:
Finally! A widescreen TV in a hotel that changes aspect ration depending on the signal! No stretched and pixilated low def signals. No squeezed or microscopic HD signals. Kudos!
SECURITY:
My hat is off to GENNY for safeguarding the conference room. I had to run downstairs after setting up my equipment. I did NOT have a keycard to the room, so I left it cracked so I could re-enter. GENNY spotted this and locked the door, left a note explaining why, and gave me information on how to contact her when I returned. Above and beyond. 
Valet:
I did not valet, however another man in my company considered it. He was quoted $20/day. Nearby public parking (with no in/out privileges is $10/day)
He asked the valet what the statue nearby was about. He said, "Oh, it's some tourist thing."
Poor answer.
I found the valet staff to be kind and proficient.

review_title: A nice hotel in every way
review_text: We spent three nights at the Drury Inn over the Thanksgiving holiday. Rooms were clean, breakfasts were good and amenities were excellent such as free wi fi and a nice workout room. Staff were helpful and friendly. I would stay here again.

After reading horrible reviews for the hotels located next to the speedway, I have stumbled upon mostly positive reviews for this hotel and was not disappointed. Great, clean and affordable hotel. Highly recommend.

It's just ok. Not alot nearby and the beds are harder than the usual Courtyard beds. Also, the sheets and towels are really cheap. The ac doesn't really crank all that great. It's really clean and if you have a car to get around and don't mind a hard bed, this place is ok. Katherine in the snack bar and Kasi at the front desk rock though!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Indianapolis at the Capitol

review_text: I've stayed at this Hyatt many times over the years. Very pretty and elegant. About as good a workout room as you get in a hotel. Nice, clean rooms. Very close and indoor walk to the mall. Good bar.

review_title: Great Place! Great Value! 5 Star Service!
review_text: The staff was amazing! Everyone greeted us and asked everyday for the 5 days that we were there how we were enjoying our stay. Whatever we needed, they provided with no problems. The rooms were clean and inviting. This is probably one of the best hotels I,'ve stayed in within the last couple of years. The only issue...breakfast is not included and the cafe is short staffed as service in that area is slow. But overall a good experience.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Indianapolis at the Capitol

review_text:
Hotel was very nice, clean, modern, and had a nice outdoor pool. Breakfast was very small continental with waffles, and buscuits with gravey(constanly ran out, took forever to refill)
We stayed 1 night while traveling. They had a huge family reunion which was hosted in a conference room located across the hall from our room. Thy were suposed to be out at 9pm but stayed all night. Constant flow of kids running the halls screaming and playing, not to mention the intoxicated adults that were wose then the kids! Finally fell asleep around 4am when the noice quieted down. Then woke up the next morning covered in bites. Fleas or bedbugs I have no idea but I had about 150 bites all over my body. When I talked to the front desk I got no responce at all.....very bad customer service!!!!!!

The Hilton in downtown Indianapolis will not cloak you in 5 star luxury, but for value & location, it can't be beat. The rooms are large, clean, & accommodating, but the rooms, hallways, lobby etc, have not been renovated since the early 1980s. My guess is that there will be an overhaul of this hotel before the next Super Bowl & that prices will go up. That will be too bad, because I do not expect hotels in Indy to compete with Saint Tropez & the Hilton fit the bill for reasonable lodging. The Conrad across the street was $100 more per night! The service @ the Hilton was young, unpolished, & immature but I didn't expect concierge like help. This Hilton was perfect for our needs

review_title: Did not live up to their reputation
review_text:
We are accustomed to large plush suites at this price range and were disappointed with the room. However, the staff were wonderful and really attempted to make our stay comfortable. They even changed out the mattress for us after our first night, as it was very uncomfortable, squeaky, and bouncy. 
Overall it was great experience, however after requesting the mattress and a few other complaints, we just did not want to point out the small things. Used coffee cups and glasses were not replaced, neither were the coffee bags, or the toiletries. Room service items were left to languish and no newspaper in the morning. 
I would still recommend the hotel, as in the end, all items were made right.

review_title: Beautiful hotel with park and fly
review_text: Wonderful hotel with friendly staff. Room was lovely and comfortable. Loved the soap,shampoo dispensor in shower. Room had refrig and lovely sitting area with large flat screened tv. Left early for airport using park and fly. All went very smooth and convenient to airport. Even provided breakfast to go which we enjoyed once we checked in at airport. Will plan to use this hotel again!

review_title: Great Staff Makes it an Incredible Hotel
review_text:
I bOoked my business travel through Priceline, and my bid rendered this hotel. I've always liked Residence Inn's because of The larger rooms, The great complimentary breakfast, and The manager's cocktail parties.
I checked in on Wednesday, and was greates by Rio. He made the check in process easy and pleasant.
He informed me about the pool, fitness center, the free hot breakfast as well
As suggesting I grab a drink
As The cocktail party was winding down( I got there at 7:00 and it only lasts until 7:30 Monday - Wednesday).
I was less than impressed with the studio room I was assigned via Priceline.
I dropped my bags and then
Asked Rio about Restarants- which I provided a list for.
Thursday when I was back from work, Rio asked how I liked my room- I exPlained how I felt the studio room was not on standard to the regular Residence Inn's I've stayed at nationally.
He without a beat- said he wanted to see what he could do, since their studios and one bedrooms have Thr same rate, and wanted to upgrade me. Unfortunately due to booking through Priceline- he couldn't change my room, I was fine with that. The rest of my stay was pleasant- and all the staff greater me when they saw me- from maintenance, to the maids, to all front desk staff. I would highly recommend this hotel- not only for the staff- but all the great restaurants within walking distance( cheeseburger in paradise is next door, and Wolfie's a local
Pub, and Petersons- an upscale restaurant were across the street).
For peoPle who travel For business- having a hotel that employs people like Rio- makes being away from home bearable!!

review_title: Best hotel by far in austin
review_text: Everyone at the four seasons is friendly and beyond helpful. The staff make you feel as you are the most important guest at the hotel. The rooms are clean and the beds are delightfully comfortable. I love the l'occtaine shampoo and conditioner. The hotel is located right off of a running trail which makes it great to exercise yet doesn't cause unwanted guests. Be sure to stay for Sunday brunch. It's the best Austin has to offer! I can't wait until my husband surprises me with a trip again.
Checkin was a breeze. The rooms were awesome and since you are near downtown everything is in walking distance. The only negative is you have to pay 20 a day for parking

Had an enjoyable long weekend stay here. The room was very nice and a great value. The only negative to the room is the lack of windows. Breakfast was good and the staff were all very nice. Unfortunately the pool was very cold. Overall a very good experience.

This hotel really exceeded my expectations. The room was clean and updated (standard Courtyard decor). The parking garage took a little figuring out at first, but after that it was a snap, and the price seemed reasonable for downtown. The service was great, especially the front desk staff and Bistro staff. Speaking of which, the food quality was good, and they have great hours. There's also a Friday's next door which was also very good. Location was excellent, very close to the Canal Walk, which was great for running. 
All in all a great experience, and I will be back if/when I'm in the area again.

Stayed labor day weekend with some friends, had a great time. The staff were helpful in every aspect from giving us directions to broad ripple, honest restaurant reviews, and helping us get a free night during our stay

review_title: Super nice rooms in a good location!
review_text: I stayed at this hotel for 10 consecutive nights starting on the 5th Dec 2011-16th Dec 2011. I LOVED it!!! For the value, the rooms were VERY nice! Good full breakfast every morning plus a small meal at night(usually not too impressive, but free beer). Some of my friends stayed at the Courtyard across the street for the same price and didnt get nearly the same benefits. All the rooms have also been recently remodeled. It's about a 3/4- 1 mile walk to bars and restaurants downtown, or a $5 cab. If you're staying on business for an extended period, I would highly recommend this hotel!!!
hotel_name: Residence Inn Indianapolis Downtown on the Canal

review_text:
This August, I stayed in the Homewood Suites Indianapolis Downtown for the second consecutive year for an annual convention that I go to. Once again, I fund this to be a wonderful hotel. Breakfast was included, as was dinner on weeknights. The fitness area was nice and adeuwate, as was the pool. The staff were uniformly helpful, supportive, friendly, accommodating and professional.
One odd thing about this stay - I was assigned to what appeared to be a handicapped suite, in that it had a sign by the door, but I saw no other evidence of handicapped support in the room - normal bathroom, etc. Definitely suggest that handicapped customers check just what accommodations are available for them before booking, because if what I was in really was the handicapped suite it would not be helpful to wheel-chair bound visitors.
Did I mention free, good wifi? And room for six people comfortably? And a full kitchen? Love this hotel! Already booked for next August! :)

We were in town for a family wedding and stayed 2 nights. We rented two rooms for our 4 adult family members. We were pleased to find we had been assigned adjoining suites. This was a wonderful conveniece as it made our space the size of a small 
apartment. This is a newer hotel and we found it clean and welcoming. (We travel frequently and this hotel is exceptional when compared to other hotels in its price range.) The queen sized beds were extremely comfortable and seemed to have mattress toppers. Bed linens were newer and spotless. Hotel offers a continental breakfast of fruit, packaged rolls, coffee & juice. We enjoy a hot cooked breakfast when traveling so did not partake. There are several breakfast restaurants nearby. We ate at Perkins first day LePeep's the next. (LePeep's is located in the shopping center next door to Towneplace and is a wonderful local chain. Perkins is about 5 minutes east.) Hotel is a bit hard to find and entrance is almost hidden from view of 86th St. The entrance is directly across from Keystone Crossing Mall. There is also a regular Mariott located at Keystone Crossing but after talking to wedding guests who stayed there it seemed the the rooms were no nicer and the cost was considerably more. Only negative was Town Place ran out of hot water about 8:30 am. We contacted the front desk who promptly checked into the situation who I formed us that happens 'once in while'. Within a few minutes of our call hot water was plentiful.

We loved being on the canal, very relaxing hearing the sound of the water. Loved the fact the windows opened! The staff are fantastic, extremely friendly and helpful. Tlo top things off, we were provided dinner and wine on Wednesday and Thursday night as well as breakfast. Very relaxed and welcoming atmosphere!!
hotel_name: Residence Inn Indianapolis Downtown on the Canal

review_title: Second stay as good as the first time
review_text: I stayed here in 2009 for an audit. I liked it so much that I returned in 2011 for another audit. The hotel was just as great as the first time. The food sucks but you're close to a mall and other restaurants. You also have a full refigerator and microwave to heat up and store leftovers!

You can't stay at a nicer facility in Austin. Too make matters better, the downstairs lobby and bar is an awesome place to hang out.
Sure, the rooms could be updated, but that's really splitting hairs for this extremely excellent choice.

My wife and I stayed two nights for our honeymoon with our daughter at the four seasons Austin. The setup for our daughter was above and beyond anything we expected. They gave her a little stuffed pony as well as providing wipes shapoo lotion powder and a diaper hamper for our use. I highly recommend this hotel!
What you would exepect from Hilton in a great location. Plenty of dining options around. Circle center mall is right out the front door.

Had a great stay till we checked out. Our flight was later in the day so we left our luggage at the concierge. We came back to get the luggage on our way to the airport and my bag was missing. They had loaded it into another guest's car without checking the name tag. My bag ended up in Ft Worth! I expect far better from a Four Seasons! On top of all that they said it would arrive at my house the next day and it didn't.

Nice location, nice rooms & good service. Its located across from NCAA/Convention Center and close to everything else in Indy. Family stayed here for my Sister's wedding. 
Front Desk was always willing to help w/whatever questions we asked. Wii downstairs, indoor pool, ATM, Grocery Store etc. All the Marriott Hotels are connected so Parking can be a pain in Parking Garage. 
Will come back again if we spend night in Indy.
Clean, friendly staff etc. Nice place.

I stayed here one night on business in December 2011, and I was very impressed with every aspect of the property. The lobby is beautiful and is what you would expect from a charming historic property. The rooms were great -- everything appeared to be newly renovated and the decor felt modern and yet still appropriate for an historic hotel. I was upgraded to a beautiful and roomy suite; this certainly impressed. The bed was super-comfortable. The bath towels were nice, as was the robe; I also liked the products in the bath. Internet service worked well and was complimentary for members of the loyalty program. Speaking of, members of that program get hot coffee delivered to their door in the morning...I love this part of Omni properties. The coffee arrived right on-time. I also ordered room service for dinner (they have a 24-hour menu with hot items until 11p); it came quickly and tasted great. It was also reasonably priced. The hotel's service impressed...check-in was a breeze with my key already prepared, the hotel gave me late check-out without a problem, and everyone was very nice and anxious to assist. Location is great...right in downtown and close to several restaurants, etc. Overall, I was extremely impressed by the property; it did a great job meeting my needs as a business travel and, especially for the room rate, offered a high-end and very enjoyable experience. I will seek out this hotel on my return to Indianapolis.

We spent a nice sports weekend in Downtown Indy. The Omni was a great base for us as it was right in between Conseco Fieldhouse and Lucas Oil Stadium and only two blocks away from both. The staff at this hotel seemed genuinely happy to attend to any need. The only problem (If you could even call it one) we had was a long wait for the valet. But understandable because it was right after a Colts game and traffic is crazy. Otherwise everything else was perfect. The rooms have been recently renovated, the elevators move quickly and the skywalk connection is a big plus. The Omni Severin is our new first choice hotel whenever we decide to go to Indianapolis and it has everything to do with the level of service we received. Keep up the good work!

We stayed 3 nights at this hotel near Christmas time.
Pluses:
- bed was incredibly comfortable
- balcony doors open to outside for fresh air
- quiet location, convenient to interstate but far enough away to be protected from traffic sounds
- good coffee in the mornings
- nice wine at the managers reception
Minuses: 
- room decor quite dated
- very small tv
- hotel over run by small children (numerous birthday celebrations going on?)
- breakfast mediocre

We actually just arrived home today and felt the need to write a review right away. The hotel was as good as I expected it to be. Our room was clean and pretty big. The location was ideal and probably the selling point. Since we were in te city for the colts game it was so convenient that it was only about a 10 minute walk..if that! The hotel has a special skywalks enterance connecting it the the circle centre mall and it was great during those windy days. All in all I would stay there again and again...just love Indy!!! Can't wait to return!

I travel to Indy quite a bit for work and the Omni is wonderful. The staff are all so friendly. The rooms are a nice size. Great location to Lucas Oil Stadium and lots of nice restaurants and bars. I like to valet my car because they give you a bottle of water when you get your car. Silly, I know, but that is a refreshing treat!

review_title: Best hotel in Indy! Hands down!
review_text: The staff at this hotel are outstanding! I have stayed here numerous times and will continue to make this MY hotel in Indy! Exceptional service everytime! I can always expect to have a wonderful stay!

review_title: Sevice as it should be everywhere...
review_text: Friendly and outgoing describes the staff and completely satisfying describes the facility.

review_title: I'm hard to please but this place pleased me!!
review_text: I live in an Indianapolis suburb called Carmel. I came to this hotel to shut myself in to pray. As a pastor I needed to seek some answers for several major issues. From the time I talked with Melissa, then jaimee, then Hillary I knew I chose the right hotel. I've traveled around the world and I haven't found a nicer staff or as clean and comfortable a hotel. A#1 in my book.

We were driving from Asheville to Chicago and ran out of steam near Louisville. A quick look at TAdvisor found this hotel south of Indy. Super clean. Very friendly. New large suite rooms. As loved it. Constance is at the desk and she is professional, cheerful, and super-helpful just like the last reviewer said. You won't regret staying here. Plus it is surrounded by many restaurants.

review_title: Great location - clean & modern but room a bit small.
review_text: Stayed here for a wedding. Booked the room as a deal that was provided to the wedding guests. Being from out of town we found the location to be fantastic. Wish I had realized how nice the city was. I would have probably stayed another day or so. The hotel is close to many great restaurants, stores and to Lucas Oil Field, home of the Colts. The hotel is very clean and appears to have recently been updated. The staff was very friendly and helpful. My only issue and it was a minor one was that our room was rather small. I would definitely stay here again if I return to Indianapolis. I would just request a larger room.

review_title: If you are looking for a property near the airport this isn't it. 30+ minute ride to/from. It worked for where my meeting was.
review_text: The property was very clean and well kept. I was a little disappointed in the TV. Lights and light switches seemed to be in odd locations. I think the space used for the sink in the bedroom could be better used as a closet and take the hulking free standing out to give more space.

review_title: This is my new fave en route to Ohio from Illinois.
review_text: We use this hotel as a mid-point when traveling from Illinois to Ohio if we get a late start driving. It's definitely a fave. I even search it out to see if it has available rooms, knowing that the construction in the area is a mess. My kid gets his explorer backpack when he arrives and cookies and milk, too. Little treats matter. BTW, the hotel is nice, great decor without feeling stuffy. If you tire of staying at family budget hotels but crave family friendly, this is a good option.

We have stayed here on several occasions over the years. I like staying on the top floor with the patio door, and this is my daughters favorite thing also. My husband and I have privacy away from our daughter with the two room suite with two tvs. And the breakfast is wonderful! Great value for the money and I love the location.

review_title: If your looking for a cheap room close to everything downtown this is it.
review_text:
This place is old all the entry doors are from the out side. We rented 8 rooms for our group not one door had an air tight seal. You could hear the wind blow through. Out of the 8 rooms 2 were in my opinion useable. All the rooms smelled of stale smoke. All my cloths stink of smoke. The beds vary drastically out of the 8, 4 were not bad mine was horrible mattress was older than me. Bed bugs? I don't know I'm still searching my body for any evidence of them.
This place reminds of a hooker hotel where the room is rented by the visit. Some of our group was ther for 2 nights I stayed for one and if the city wasn't booked solid I wouldn't have stayed the one night!

review_title: Dirty doesn't describe this crap whole
review_text: First of all you get an actual key for check in, get to our rooms carpet all stained up asked for king bed we get a full instead, rooms are wicked tiny, bathroom is nothing but just a closet converted and better wear sandals in the shower its filthy towels were all staind up...I wouldn't recomend this hotel to anyone even if its the only hotel that had openings don't let the lobby fool you on this place lobby looks nice hotel is not...would rather sleep on the streets of detroit than stay here there deffinately cleaner

I'm a very easy person to please. I don't mind little hotel rooms with basic needs. This hotel was just horrible though! Within the first 2 minutes of even being there, at the lobby, we already had a guy bothering us to let us help him get a room because he only had a paper id. 
When we got inside the room, the bed was a tiny bed with barely a cover, and in order to turn the heat on it had to be cranked to 90. One of the nights we left it on all night (to drone out the noise) and it smelled like burning hair in our room all the next day. There is no bath but a stand up shower instead.
We ordered chicken wings from the 'pizza marvelous grill' which were probably the worst wings I've ever had, plus they brought the wrong pop. When we looked in the trash later, we saw few hundred ants eating away at the rest of the chicken....
Both nights we stayed here we got woken up half a dozen times by the people upstairs going in and out of the room as well as a person circling the parking lot honking the horn over and over at like 3 in the morning. (I read that there was a prostitution problem here as well)
The breakfast they offered consisted of a plate of various muffins, a plate of bagels and some orange juice. 
Had a horrible time and will NEVER come back!!

The location is excellent and the price is affordable. After that, there are no positives. I'm used to staying in economy hotels (Super 8, Motel 6, Red Roof Inn, etc) and this pales in comparison to anything I have ever stayed in before.
Where to start...
1. They lost our reservation.
2. They put us in a room with two beds suitable for third graders at camp. We reserved double beds and these were the smallest beds I have slept in since my nephews bunk bed (he's four).
3. Bed squeeked if you moved slightly.
4. Tv was the size and quality of something my parents had in their bedroom in 1984.
5. Despite being put in wrong room and losing reservation, we were rudely called by the front desk clerk informing me that check out was at eleven, I let her know our reservation was for two nights and she proceeded to argue with me.
6. When I went downstairs to resolve the situation, the woman acted like a diva, argued with me, rolled her eyes and after being proven wrong, refused to apologize.
7. They tried to charge me twice so be careful with credit card.
8. They never made our room and seemed troubled when we asked for some towels - at a bare minimum. 
9. Shower curtain had hole in it.
10. Shower curtain had mold on it.
11. No internet in room or anywhere in the hotel. 
12. Paint peeling off walls and ceiling.
In summary, I'd rather sleep in downtown detroit in the middle of winter in the worst neighborhood than stay here again!

i stayed at the Staybridge and was Highly disappointed.. Before i even checked in it too the front desk associate 5 minutes to come to the desk and she didnt even Greet me.. After finally checking in i come into my room although very clean and neat VERY outdated.. old TV's with a VHS/DVD combo and unlike most staybridges old ragged comforter and the ice machine didnt work on the fridge.. the elevator was sticky and dirty and kids were making noise in the hallways.. Im.a priority club member and I was not acknowledged at check in mor givien a priority bag, but a guest who checked in shortly after me recieved one.. The woman at the desk did not want to honor my late check out request (PC Member) and said it was up to Housekeeping.. At 9am i get a loud knock from house keeping , check out is niot till 11 which i requested a late one.. (lack of commucation) I love Staybridges breakfast but this one SUCKED, sticky tables , watery juice, the waffle maker was crusty.. The fruit was old and very soggy and biscuts and eggs were dry and cold.. I accidently left an item in my room and the impatient front desk.associate didnt even take the time to take my name down before transferring me to voicemail.. But the icing on the cake was when THE FRONT DESK ASSOCIATE HAD HER SON THERE N TOLD HIM HE BETTER SHUT UP FOR THE NEXT 4 HOURS TILL SHE GETS OFF.. Beyond unprofessional then comes back to desk with a bag od chips and finally helps me.. IF YOUR GOING TO STAY STAYBRIDGE DRIVE THE EXTRA 25 MINS AND GO TO BALLYANTINE , THAT LOCATION IS EXCEPTIONAL WITH AMAZING SERVICE..AND FREE COOKIES UNLIKE CHARLOTTE -ARROWWOOD.. THEY MAKE IHG AND THE STAYBRIDGE BRAND LOOK BAD..

This hotel is nasty, and thats put in a nice way. I was in room 258, after being inside no more then 2 hours , turning the air off up pop MENY roachs ,i video tape them crawling over my things and up the walls, they told me i could'nt get a refund, cause we checked in after 5, that they would move us. AND they did! @ 8pm to room 338 we were so tired and upset we just went on to bed after making sure there was no bugs.,next day @ 9am ,we found that the toilet didnt work :-0 & the office did not open til 12 noon checkout time. wow!! got us good. just because a room is a few bucks cheaper doesnt mean i want to lay with bugs or take them home. I will NEVER stay here again!!! worst thing ever happen to me.

Got there around 4:37 am, was told i had 2 wait an hour & a half 2 check n. Now i can understand she had an audit 2 run & put 2gether, but that does not take 2 hours, nor does it take an hour & a half. Because i came in on the train i had 2 stand OUTSIDE all that time n a very bad side of town.
I just dont get it.!!! Where the hell did true customer service go!!! I'll take customer service even. People working n that field need 2 understand, the most important reason 4 their job is CUSTOMER SERVICE. Without people like me there would be no need 4 jobs like theirs.

review_title: This motel is the exact opposite of a flagship motel.
review_text:
So here it is...
I was driving the family down to Florida and we decided to take the scenic route. This motel was convenient because it was on the way and allows pets. So there were 8 of us with 3 dogs. We needed two rooms next to each other so we made reservations to have them. When we arrived we were greeted to the site of some strange guy with a large knife walking around the office area in his bathing suit which freaked the kids out. So then we get to the counter to be told there are no rooms together and they're sorry. We were not happy and they offered to call a different motel 6 that might have two rooms together. We declined to leave and somehow they suddenly found two rooms adjoining, looking back I wish we had left. We get to the rooms and they are absolutely disgusting and smelly. We were so tired we stayed but should have left the smell in one room was like urine and the other cigarettes yet both were labeled no smoking and the smoke detectors were all tampered with and disconnected. So we wanted food and they told us only dominoes delivered there, what a shock the key cards were pre printed with their info. We couldn't even call from the room phone because it didn't work. So we got that nasty pizza if you can even call it pizza and were all sorry with bathroom needs. Also it seemed there was a hotel party above us with people going from room to room all night. Also you need to pay $3 for wifi at this motel. So overall it was just a disgusting and miserable place to stay I decided cheap was not the way to go on the way home. And read the reviews to find our return hotel. We spent $52 a night here at this time.

review_title: The manager, Willie kenna is comparable 2 a slum landlord, no morals @ all.
review_text: After taking my money 4 7 days, because i had a problem with not getting clean sheets & towels, having 2 go get the items myself, i felt i shoul get a free night, after all this was the 3rd time that happened, plus i was locked in the room, the handle broke off, i had 2 wait 4 some1 2 get there 2 let me out. The manager willie kenna,no longer wanted 2 speak with me, he wanted 2 speak with my husdand, he offered $10 off. This guy, willie kenna wouldnt know customer service if it stood n front him. He told my husband we had 2 be out by 2pm. He just took our money, wouldnt make things right, & then told us 2 leave.

Great place good value. The staff was fun and the FREE barbq was a wonderful surprise. They do it every friday for us. No other hotel i have stayed at does it. I work for the airlines, they do not have a shuttle but the manager even walked me to the bus stop which is in front of the hotel. MR. Brigham stayed there and we talked while i waited. What a wonderful heart he has. I will be staying there again.

review_title: Loved it, but could use some help
review_text: Friends and I stayed here for 5 days and it was nice. Large, spacious rooms which was good because we had 7 people total and we were not on top of each other. The pool was refreshing after a long day of being outside, and as a smoker I love the little smoker courtyard. Breakfast had a good selection for those picky eaters. The only thing that was bad was that underneath my bed there was a lot of trash, and broken glass on the floor in the living room area. If that wouldn't have been there my stay would have been almost perfect, but the ac should keep me cool, and not sweating in the middle of the night. *bonus free laundry room!
this hotel is an excellent hotel. Your staff treats you like a family member. It is so great and has a great value per price. So, I recommend this hotel if you are going to stay in Charlotte.

Got this hotel on hot-wire $43 per night. All I can say is believe all previous reviews and stay elsewhere. We arrived late 10.30pm, got to our room in need of a coffee. Coffee maker did not have the carafe so we forgot that idea and decided on a shower instead. Beware of shower floor, it was very very slippery. Had to hold onto bar in shower to avoid falling. Lighting in room was very poor. Room outdated. Breakfast was poor. Fruit in bowl needed to be thrown out. Coffee - the worst I have ever had at any hotel. Had quick look at pool....would not consider swimming in it. It seriously needed a clean. Slime on bottom of pool. Service was just ok. Don't waste your money Here.

I travel for a living and the staff at the crown plaza hotel go way out of their way to make me and my team feel welcome. The food in the restaurant is outstanding...rooms are clean and the property is centrally located for getting out and about....one of my favorite places to stay in my travels...

review_title: 5 Star Hotel and Staff....forget staying anywhere else in Charlotte.
review_text: From the second you walk in the door you can see the difference. The staff welcomes you as if your the very first person staying there. Jeff and Alex were totally exceptional! The rooms and the layout is perfect. The breakfast is a must and the fresh omelette bar was awesome! The location is set back off the road perfectly and you don't hear a thing! This Sheraton is a perfect example of their new campaign to revisit them! Tops all the way!

review_title: Don't stay here! Anywhere else has to be better!
review_text: It just sucked! Air conditioning did not work. Staff did not attempt to fix it until next day at 10a. Hour before check out. Stinky, hot, not safe, incompetent staff, no ammenities at all, cheap towels, 40 min late transport to airport, sleazy. Yuck! Yuck! Yuck!
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn Charlotte Airport West

review_text: Nice location good service nice free breakfast coming back next month

review_title: For the $, it was a great deal.
review_text: Not at all like most shetatons i've stayed at. The outdoor pool closes at 7:30pm. Overall, I enjoyed my stay. The staffs' service was great....very helpful and friendly.
It's just older. It's more than clean, staff was very helpful and for this family of four it was a fine place to spend the night and save $50.00. I was not grossed out at all; give it a shot.

I stay at Hotels all around the country and I think the Crowne Plaza Charlotte has the best staff. I want to personally name Tiffany at the front desk for doing a great job with efficiency & good cheer.

review_title: Outdated hotel with thin walls and poor customer service.
review_text:
A direct copy of the email I sent the hotel GM the day i checked out of the hotel, to which he never responded.
Bill -
My fiancee and I stayed at your Charlotte Uptown hotel last night with a reservation made through priceline.com. Â Upon checking in, the gentleman at the front desk went out of his way to tell us that you would be serving a complimentary breakfast buffet. Â He said we had to try it because it was a great selection of southern style breakfast items. Â We were surprised to hear that a complimentary breakfast buffet was included with our room, but he assured us it was. Â 
We were very disappointed this morning when upon eating breakfast we were informed we needed a voucher. Â We went to the front desk to obtain this voucher and were informed that because we used priceline.com to book our room we did not receive the complimentary breakfast we were told all about at check-in. Â We of course paid for the food we ate. Â However, I cannot help but feel that a bait and switch occurred and Crown Plaza hoped to recoup the loss from the discounted room with a vastly overpriced breakfast. Â If we had not been told all about the complimentary buffet at check-in, we would have chose a different Charlotte restaurant for breakfast. Â Paying for breakfast is not the issue, the issue is in the misrepresentation. Â 
You may want to use this as a training tool for your front desk staff as it seems that they are uneducated in the services provided by the hotel and what types of reservations receive which services. Â I can understand that because I had a discounted booking I would not receive extra benefits, but when a member of your staff tells me about a service that assuredly comes with my reservation how am I to believe otherwise?
Regards
In addition this hotel is outdated and has paper thin walls. We could hear conversations in other rooms as if they were in our own. Pretty much the only good part of this hotel was the price.

Found hotel very comfortable and staff helpful. Have to remember you're paying only paying $85 for a room in what was once a major business hotel for GM, sure it's glory days are gone but it is still full of quiet elegance. At the time we stayed the restaurant was closed but due to reopen soon. The "New Centre Eatery" across the St serves great food. Cab downtown about $10. Detroit is an incredible city to visit and the hotel is a great safe low cost option.

review_title: Do not stay here no matter!!!!
review_text: Where do i begin with this horrible no good worthless excuse for a hotel!!! Dirty rooms mold in the bathtub constant leaky bathtub faucet, no cookware even though they say they provide, no daily housekeeping no fresh towels. We had four people in our room and only two towels and washclothes!! When we called to get more they said they had no clean towels!!!! We ended up going to a walmart and buying towels which is an unneeded expense when staying at a hotel!!! They r overpriced, if u r gonna spend $65 a night for a room which is there normal rate please stay at the best western or the fairfield next door for the same price!! I complained and complained to the front desk and manager and she even called the regional manager and yet we would not be issued a refund!!!

review_title: Drunks, sex offenders, fighting in stairwells.... RUN from this sleezy motel.
review_text: Rented a room and the problems started immediately. Cop cars in the parking lot right after check in... all day long there was kids running and screaming in hallway, at 9pm the drunks started fighting. So ar.ound midnight it sounded like a riot so the so called guard yelled for everyone to get the f**k in their rooms, now at 2am someone is yelling in the stairwell for someone to go to taco bell. Doors slamming all night I'm scared to leave my room. Earlier in the day a man said a little girl was dragged into the room of a know peodifiles room. Remote didn't work and sunk towel had brown stains where it was not washed. Please do not stay here if u value your life. I would complain but front office left at 9pm. the only good thing was the front desk clerk named keesha was extremely nice and professional but she wad gone by 4pm.

review_title: Seriously the worst hotel ever! I beg you not to stay here!!!!
review_text: We stayed here New Years eve 2010 because everything else was booked. I have stayed at many Detroit hotels and have never seen anything like this place! Everything is true in previous reviews! Dirty, actually disgusting! No ice, staff is aloof, rooms are outdated. Ghetto, ghetto, ghetto!!!! Felt very uncomfortable and when we went out for the evening, I took all my valuables with me. I would not stay here even if the rooms were free! Do not bring a family here as it is unsafe and unsanitary. I can't believe legally a hotel can be run like that! The red roof inn is like a 5 star hotel compared to this dump!!!! I wish I would have read these reviews first. My only hope is that I can save someone else!!!!

Booked through Expedia. Yes, I knew ahead of time that I was going for budget & not luxury, but this was terrible. Booked king, non-smoking & they put us in a double, smoking. It was awful. Had to show our original reservation to get changed to room we actually booked even after being told they were sold out for the night & couldn't change our room. In the end, our room was changed but I would still never stay here again. The areas leading up to the room were littered with trash. Not like any Days Inn I've ever visited.
hotel_name: Days Inn Woodlawn Rd. Near Carowinds

review_text: I stayed at this hotel for 4 days while visiting Charlotte. The location rocks. It's seconds from the interstate, public transit, and South Blvd (which is a main road, perfect for getting anywhere you're trying to go). Minutes from malls, downtown, and sweet restaurants! (Try the Italian pie on East Blvd). The staff was very funny and friendly! I ended up staying and extra day, and the front desk was very accomidating. Breakfast was hot and yummy. Basic continental breakfast. They also had dinner, which was amazing and delicious. The room was your average hotel room. Everything was clean and tidy. I reserved a non smoking room and that's exactly what i got. Pool is nice, fitness center rocks. And the price was was unbeatable! This is where I'm staying every time I come to visit.
Clean rooms. Comfy bed. Hot showers. 'Nuf said. What more do you need for the price?

review_title: If you want to SLEEP, do NOT stay here!!
review_text: Took teen daughter and two of her friends to a concert down the street and booked here from a recommendation of the venue. Room was ok, convenient to venue which was only plus. From 1:30-2:30 am our next door neighbor decided to go in and out their door at least a dozen times, SLAMMING it shut every time and waking us up every time. I called front desk and asked them to call neighbor to tell them to stop which they finally did. At 6:30 am the same neighbor began exact same door slamming.
