I angrily poked my head out door and asked them to stop. They looked at me incredulously and seemed to not even realize their obnoxious behavior. We quickly packed up and checked out. When I mentioned to the front desk clerk how unhappy I was all she said was sorry. I left frustrated, irritable and VERY TIRED. At least my girls had fun at concert. I would never stay here again.

My son and I traveled to Charlotte for the East Coast Regional Yu-Gi-Oh finals. Found a perfect place to stay free of downtown traffic. The property is maybe a mile to the Lynx parking lot (free). A 15 minute ride and we were at the convention center. 
There are plenty of restaurants near the property. From check in to check out we had no problems. A very good breakfast and coffee throughout the day. Front desk was fantastic with area info. 
Will stay there again.
We stayed 3 nights and our stay was ok. Room was clean and service was good. We enjoyed breakfast. Property looks tired overall but out a/c worked fine. Small TV and the colors were off.

review_title: Barely a Bates Motel plus- no bargain here
review_text:
Got placed here after missing a connecting flight. Even though i only payed a "discount" rate of $55, I still feel ripped off. The place has been heavily painted, but paint cant fix everything. The rooms all open to the outside. My door had clearly been forced at some point but "smoothed". Door was dented and dirty. Remote didnt work, phone wires were ripped out of wall and phone didnt work, and fridge turned on and off with the light switch. No wifi, of course. No security cameras, only a security guard that's shared w the neighboring red roof. I jumped every time i heard a sound, and you can hear every car door close, room door slam... Not even worth $55. Quality should revoke their franchise!
There's hardly anything around- just a cracker barrel and a gas station quickie mart. It does have an attentive front desk guy, and the shuttle driver was kind. Shuttle itself, however, was falling apart.

Had I not been in a brand new Courtyard last night, this location would have seemed adequate. The lobby has been remodeled to equal the newer Courtyards, the furniture in the room changed, however the layout of the room and particularly the bathroom is a throwback to earlier Courtyard styles. It was clean, about 2 miles off I77,and attempting to be aucourant, but a little lacking. The staff is very friendly, which goes a long way to a more pleasant stay. If room size and modern accommodations matter to you, find a newer Courtyard.

Stayed at Arrowood Marriott with large group. Front desk staff was very welcoming of the group. First time I have seen three checkin staff ready to help. Lobby, meeting rooms and our room were all very clean. Bathroom had nothing broken-that is rare in hotels. Will be back again.

My husband and I stayed here over Christmas weekend while visiting family in the area. We had our dog with us so we picked this hotel because it is pet friendly. We were worried that the room would smell of past dogs and be very dirty, but we were pleasantly surprised! It was very clean and we had a great room on the lower floor so it was easy to take our dog out for walks. We would definitely stay here again and I would recommend it to other pet owners!
This is a good, cheap hotel near airport. Small rooms. Friendly staff.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn by Wyndham Charlotte Airport

review_text: One night stay to catch an early flight. The hotel is in serious need of updating. The room was relatively clean but that is about all I can say. The fridge and microwave sitting on top of it stuck out which made it easy to hit when you got out of the bed. I chose Microtel because I had such a pleasant experience at another Microtel in Johsnstown, NY this past summer. There is no comparison between the two.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn by Wyndham Charlotte Airport

review_title: Such a great value if you are flying in/out
review_text: We picked this hotel because of the free shuttle to the airport and you can park there for free if you are going to be gone less than 21 days....which is a big savings over the long term parking at the airport and your car is safer. The price for a nights stay and the parking was only 55 bucks! As long as you don't come in expecting the ritz carlton for that price you will be fine. The rooms are small, the tv small and old, and the walls very thin so don't expect a great nights sleep (had a rude bunch of motorcycles in and out all night when we were there). On the positive the place was clean and the air conditioner worked great and there was a mini fridge. Also, the staff was friendly and helpful and our shuttle driver got us to the airport on time.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn by Wyndham Charlotte Airport

review_text: The people were so nice and welcoming! The hotel was fantastic and spacious! They have a "heavenly" bed which is similar to a sleep number bed. I thought it was a little uncomfortable because it never got soft enough for me. Overall it was very nice!

review_title: Overall it is pretty decent. Good choice if you have to fly.
review_text:
Stayed here for two nights in room 121. The room was very nice and spacious. It was a one bedroom suite that was given to me as an upgrade. It appears that the rooms have been updated recently, but the rest of the property leaves somewhat less to be desired. Lobby is VERY small and hallways are awkward and smokey in some parts. They could probably update the halls and common areas, however I know it's expensive to do such. The place was clean though and everyone was pleasant. Thanks to Michelle for assisting me with my reservation! My pre-arrival experience was very interesting, however the stay once I was there made up for the oddities. 
The only things I noted, and they are minor things, was while the room was clean and fresh, it seems housekeeping forgot to pick up the last guests used Q-tip from beside the TV stand in the room and I did find some stray hairs in the towels. Also, I noticed dishes and room service trays stayed in the hallways for extended periods of time. 
Other then those few minor things, I enjoyed the stay and I would definitely recommend the property to others.

review_title: You'll wait forever for a shuttle and the staff is overwhelmingly rude
review_text: I waited one hour for a shuttle for a hotel just a few miles away. Called the hotel 3 times and they kept telling me it was on its way. I finally took a cab to the hotel. The staff is complacent and rude. The rooms are dirty. Not your typical DTree. There are better place to stay.

review_title: Sometimes it's not all about location, location, location
review_text:
This hotel is way over priced for what it actually is. The neighborhood is very nice for a relatively new, and still developing complex, but is that reason enough to pay $20 - $30 extra a night?
The hotel itself is a very well kept building, and the staff were very accommodating during normal business hours. After hours, the place became a ghost town, and when you could find someone, they looked at you like you were a hoodlum who didn't belong.
The rooms need work... The air conditioning was a noisy window unit with a fan that cannot be switched to a permanent ON position. This reduces the overall white noise, so now you can hear all of your neighbors, and the interstate in the distance. The bathrooms were poorly maintained, but spotless clean. How is that? Someone comes in, and polishes the loose faucets? Seemed just like poor attention to details.

review_title: Great value, friendly and helpful staff....clean convenient location.
review_text:
D at the front desk was very helpful when we arrived at the wrong homewood location. He took care of everything including rebooking our reservation getting us an excellent room and making us feel at home. The hotel manager was also on sight and made us feel welcome. 
We love staying at homewood and know we will be well taken care of. Lights have dimmers so kids can see in the middle of the night, the kitchen allows us to cook for our picky eater and we all love the breakfast. Our rooms are beautifully decorated and very clean. We will come back again and again! Highly recommend !
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Charlotte-North/University Research Park

review_text: With the renovations this is a great hotel for the money. Ignore all of the reviews including and prior to the complaint that the manage responded to. They are no longer relevant. The beds and bedding are what you would expect at a Hilton, very comfortable. The furniture and granite countertops are beautiful. The kitchen and appliances are very nice. The staff are very friendly and helpful. Overall, I highly recommend it and will be staying here the next time I am in Charlotte.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Charlotte-North/University Research Park

review_title: Amazing Service in a clean airport hotel!
review_text: This hotel is a great place to stay...if you need to stay close to the airport. Super friendly staff and very clean.

review_title: Love the staff, food is GREAT, don't love the bed..
review_text: First off the staff was very friendly. Supposedly the beds are adjustable, but my back hurt after sleeping on them. Love the breakfast. Daniel makes the BEST grits on the planet. Crystal remembered us from the first day at breakfast and had our drinks to us quick. She knew we had one guy who finished off his drink quickly so she started him with two the next morning. The hot tub jets didn't work and we didn't check to see if they fixed it the next day. Night clerk got us extra blankets and foam pillows from behind the desk instead of waiting for someone to bring them to us. Nice because we were getting in late and were ready for bed.

review_title: Beware truck stop on east side of hotel.
review_text: Overall a very good value for the money. Clean, modern rooms. Hotel shuttle. Exercise facility. But there is a truck stop next to this hotel and if you get a room on the east side of the building (even numbered rooms) the trucks are very noisy and will wake you up all night.
Layed in the bed for two hours n got bit by bed bugs

My children, 1 of their friends & I "were" (& i use that word loosly) going 2 stay at the sleep inn but once we arrived there after drivin 5 hrs with 9 more to go, sleeping in 2 double beds was not an option. Not 2 mention the musty smell in the room as well as the construction/ supposed remodeling going on I had 2 ask 4 my $$ back because sleeping in my car would have been far more comfortable as well as cleaner than that place. After going 2 find another place 2 stay, I was informed that the Sleep Inn is no place 4 children or adults 4 that matter & they have a sever bed big problem!!! Thanks but no thanks!!!

review_title: Confortable and clean with a responsive staff.
review_text: This location has a very responsive staff that helped to rearrange our accommodations as was needed. Eat location to access all Of Charlotte's sites yet plenty of restaurants and shopping in the vicinity.
The staff was friendly. The hotel is close to a lot of restaurants. I would stay again.

This ALoft is a nice hotel. Clean, modern and a great location. However - if you need to sleep before 3AM - DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL. There are Bars and Nightclubs just below and beside the Hotel that pump out LOAD music until 2 AM OR later EVERY night of the week. The music isn't bad - just makes it impossible to sleep!
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_text:
I stayed here over Halloween weekend. While I expected some noise due to the location and the weekend's activities. However, the walls are really really thin here and you can hear lots of noise from other rooms and outside. 
While a pretty good value, you get what you pay for: few amenities, bed & pillows not so comfortable, and a bit noisy. One block down you can get a hotel room for around the same price with more amenities and more comforts. If you want the location, stay here.
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_title: Hotel was like a W, except a bit shanty.
review_text: The hotel is in a great location and the staff was pleasant. The room was interesting - the bed faced the windows which was a little annoying in the morning and the closet was very small but I liked the shower and sink.
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_text:
We stayed overnight for a wedding and had the worst hotel going experience in the history of earth. Upon arrival, there were two people in line for check in and there were two clerks, one if whom did not appear to be taking any customers. After the first guest in line was checked in, two more guests arrived in line. One of the guests behind us in line approached the inactive clerk and asked if he was available to assist him, to which the clerk replied yes. I guess he just didn't want to do his job unless he absolutely had to. Meanwhile it took us an hour to check in.
Additionally, we were booked in a room with hazard tape prohibiting access to the balcony. We paid full price for the room and did not have access to the agreed upon amenities. Also, the in room coffee maker was non functional. I alerted the front desk, and was assured the situation would be remedied. It was not.
I also felt the hotel's parking situation was one of the worst I have ever seen. The spaces were obviously undersized, numerically insufficient and there was some type of water leak, and I'm fairly certain the hotel does not employ security personnel to patrol the lot.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Charlotte - SouthPark

review_title: Old Marriott. Good rate noisy room
review_text: Older marriott remodeled. But heater was noisy. And bathroom door was dirty. Concierge loundge not open . $109 rate was good

The rooms were nice, clean, and updated. Beds were comfy. Our room had a fridge and microwave- no problems with either. Didn't notice any bad/ odd smells at the hotel or in the room. All staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. It was a great stay for the price!

As others have said, front desk people very nice. Lobby decor is intriguing. Our room was adequate but the mattresses were very uncomfortable, and the bathroom was just silly. Toilet not bolted to the floor, soap dish in shower barely hanging on, hair dryer coming off the wall. Took 15 mins for hot water to show up in the shower. The half-glass enclosure is awkward and inconvenient. Bare minimum toiletries. We checked out after the first night and moved to another hotel a block away where for $20 more (and less parking fee) we upscaled to real comfort.

This Marriott is a business-traveler's hotel. Located right on the interstate, it does not offer the bells and whistles a family wants, but is a very good hotel for the business traveler. The exterior is a little dated, but the interior was top notch. Great staff and wonderful service.

Stayed here for one week for business. Check-in was very easy. The rooms have been refurbished and are nicely appointed. I didn't notice any outside noise, but the HVAC wasn't the quietest, although not loud enough to hinde sleep. Bathroom is on the smaller side, but not unacceptable. Wifi throughout for a fee unless you have Marriott status. Breakfast buffet was satisfying with typical fare including omelette station. I would stay here again if back in town. Note that there is a <a-hem> "men's club" within sight. I associate geographical areas that have these establishments lower than others in my book, but that doesn't seem to be the case for this area.

review_title: Decent hotel, but a tough place to get some sleep.
review_text: It's not your typical hotel. Seems like a upscale dorm room. You've got soap and shampoo in shower dispensers like a dorm or health club. Property is located above bars so you here noise till the wee hours. Windows are not sound proof. Staff is average. A bit arrogant when mentioned "noise" issue. They're like it's typical on gamedays. Cafe coffee machine broken. Aloft brings down the SPG family of hotels.
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_text: This hotel is so out of date and doesn't know how to treat their guests. This is a ridiculous representation of the Doubletree/Hilton brands. I hear it's being renovated, yet I haven't seen anything happen yet. I hope the service will change with the renovations.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Charlotte - SouthPark

review_text: I stayed here on business it has a mall 300 feet away lots of food options, every room is a suit and just all around great experience
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Charlotte - SouthPark

review_text: The people that checked us in greeted us with a smile. It was mentioned that we were celebrating our anniversary and when we got back to our room later that night we received a complimentary bottle of champagne. I would recommend this hotel to anyone!!
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_title: Stay away! The staff is rude and unaccomodating and you most likely will not get the room you booked.
review_text: We booked our room 6 months in advance on expedia requesting 2 double beds as we had 2 couples with my wife being pregnant. When we arrived and tried to check in 15 minutes prior to check in we were informed our room type was not available. Instead we were given a handicap room with a queen bed and twin blowup mattress. When we told management
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_title: Staff and service made the stay amazing
review_text:
Stayed at the Mariott for three days on business and had a great stay. 
I was picked up at the airport by their complementary shuttle. It took about 15 minutes to get to the hotel. I requested a room on the lower floors but was not able to be boarded their but I did check in early and none were ready. They did try. 
The room was really nice. The bed was comfortable and had both soft and hard pillows. The room I had faced the highway and was a bit loud but I was not bothered with it. If others are sensitive to noise, ask for a room not facing the road. The tv was newer with a good selecction of channels with some HD. The bathroom was one of the cleanest I'd ever seen. 
I was able to wlk to the light rail system that got me to uptown in about 15 minutes. It was a 10 minute walk to the station but was offered the shuttle to there also.
I had the lunch buffet three times and it was very good and well priced. The options for the vegetarian diner are limited, but the vegige burger was good and the swet potato fries were addictive.
A great stay made great by clean rooms and really friendly staff. I would stay again

Last weekend I expend three nights in this hotel. I should read this reviews before checking in. Apparently they don't have housekeeping every day in every room. I was lucky and they made my bed once. I also had the privilege of hot water, my boss was in the next room and she had only cold water for three days. The lobby is nice, but once you get into the elevator everything turns creepy. The breakfast cost $10 dollars and they just offer coffee, melon and scrambles eggs with toast. The last day I only wanted a coffee and the guy in the restaurant was very rude and told me that the coffee will cost me 10 dollars. He asked me for a voucher. I told him that I would prefer to have my coffee elsewhere, but in my credit card they charge me $30 dollars for three breakfast and I only had two. Very poor service. I paid $390 for a super 8 type hotel.

review_title: Poorly managed hotel. A nightmare location.
review_text: I have stayed at The Blake and it's predecessor The Adams Mark several times. This last stay was the worse. I know they are renovating for the Democratic convention but they need to take care of current business. I attended a show last weekend and was astounded at how much the hotel and some of it's service had deteriorated. First, the lamp had no light bulb. Secondly there were no washcloths and then no hot water. I did not want to move do they sent me with my stuff to two more rooms before I was able to shower. My hot water mixer was supposed to be fixed but it was not. Another call to the front desk finally got that taken care of. They were nice enough to compensate me but what I really wanted was a nice, clean, functioning room. I asked about ice and I was sent there. Floors down to an ice machine that was broken and remained broken for the 4 days I was there. The front desk did not tell me there was a machine on my floor and of course it was out as it was being used by the whole hotel. We were offered breakfast coupons and when I went to claim them, the front desk person was very snotty and rude and asked me if I the name of the front desk person who offered me the coupons. We also and a problem with the TV remote and were told someone would bring us a battery. Well no one showed. The rooms are very dark and it's very difficult to see the thermostat when trying to adjust the very loud and hissing AC. I could not believe that in the public bathroom several of the sinks had plastic bags on the fixtures! Another guest called for a reservation and she was told that there were no more rooms available at the contract show rates! She went on Expedia and got a cheaper rate. This hotel has become a nightmare location.

I had did my research so I was prepared for the good, the bad and the ugly! What wasn't prepared for was the overcharges on my card. When I asked about it I was told. The so that make sure you have money for any other charges that may occur. Yes I have money in the bank, if I didn't I wouldn't have used the card!! I let it slide because I was there to have fun. I learning the "real" meaning of complimentary, it does not mean FREE(WiFi)! When my friend went to log on it said your complimentary WiFi will be charged to you room. So of course we didn't use WiFi or drink the complimentary bottle water. I guess we were too loud (no one was even talking at the time) we got a nice little knock on the door requesting us to keep it down. Apparently another room(which I didn't hear) was too loud also. Because my sister said she heard a knock on another door before ours. All in all we had a good time. That's what we came for. The valet service was great worth all $20.
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_text: I'm really not one to write reviews but the service here was so awful I felt an obligation to. I'm a starwood preferred guest and stay at these hotels all the time for work. I was staying here for pleasure and it was a horrible idea the staff is very young (possibly still in high school) and has no concept of professionalism. When I first checked in they were unwelcoming and made checking me in seem bothersome. Also, several of the lights in the room had burned out and it was a very dimly lit experience. The location is great, but there are about 10 other hotels on the same 2 block stretch so I'd say go with another.
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_title: Find another place to spend your money on
review_text: They fool you with the lobby. The lobby is beautiful. The elevator, rooms and staff is the issue. As soon as you get on the elevator you realize you are in an old hotel. Take the elevator forever! The rooms are very small. The bathrooms are smaller. Don't even think about putting 2 in the bathroom. And washing a child will be hell. The king bed is a king but hard as a brick! The a/c did not work well. A desk in the room that reaches 2" before touching the bed. I had to squeeze to get between the bed and desk. It was just horrible. I've stayed in worst, but not at this rate!

Very average as far as a Marriott goes. However, this was the smallest bathroom I have ever had at a Marriott. 
Very average room.

review_title: No place better for a weekend of fun!
review_text: My boyfriend and I stay here every time we come to charlotte. The location is amazing, and the hotel is so hip, cool, and trendy. It is unlike anywhere you have stayed before. My ONLY complaint would be that the rooms are not very sound proof. We always travel with ear plugs so.that is not a huge deal for us. the hotel decor, downstairs bar, re fuel, pool, all amazing. and its worth it to valet park your car, and easy, they just charge it.to your room, and your car is ready anytime you need.it, just call down. we love this hotel, and honestly would not consider staying anywhere else near the epicenter, the aloft is it for.us.
hotel_name: Aloft Charlotte Uptown at the EpiCentre

review_text:
Nice stay. Did have a fire alarm late in the night, though.
Wish there had been an indoor pool, too.
However, good overall stay and good room.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn and Suites Charlotte - Arrowood Rd.

review_text: If you like banging on your roof or incessant construction vehicle noise stay here!! I travel with children so I book a suite. Stayed here in summer 2010 and there was roof work being done- had to switch rooms it was so loud! I thought I would try this hotel again (may 2011) and as I write this there has been beeping from construction vehicles for 6 hours! Our patio was taped off so we could not use it. We were not given the option of another room. DO NOT stay here if you want peace and quiet!!!!!!!
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Charlotte - SouthPark

review_text: Great prices for nice rooms with really comfortable beds. I'd go back for sure.

Hotel was great. It is in great shape, however I noticed a display board in the lobby that showed their plan for refurbish. The photos looked amazing! Just hope they don't raise the price! I love staying in candlewoods across the country but I live on an expense account 8 months out of the year and I am hoping this location doesn't put themselves in a position to have to be over $80/night in November.

We stayed one night on the way back from a week on the Smokies, on points. A very nicely designed and appointed place. Easy back entrance to the airport, prompt free shuttle. Really nice rooms, breakfast area, etc. Staff was friendly and helpful. My ONLY complaint is that their wifi requires you to re-login again and again. Irritating! 
If you need dinner, like locally-owned family type places, and Mexican food, try Miguel's. It's very nearby, good, and reasonably priced.

We stay here when flying out of Charlotte Airport. They have a newly completed lobby that is super nice. Soon they will have a sleek new bar and Starbucks as well. It's a typical Marriott, great beds, clean and bright and free airport transport. We left our car here 20 days ago and saved a ton compared to airport long term parking plus we felt the car was more secure. 
The draw backs are the staff. Unfortunately we have encountered this more and more. The counter staff was not sensitive to our need to be near an elevator or wanting to be in the room asap after a ful 24 hour of travel time coming in from Athens. They assured us we had a nearby room, then we walked and walked to get to the elevator and then once on the third floor we walked to the furthest point from the elevator. I don't call that close. There was a time when being a loyal return customer meant something. Still this is a nice hotel, free Internet and free ride to the airport mean we'll be back.

review_title: Fantastic Value...in spite of a few shortcomings!
review_text:
Stayed here for 4 nights and have quite a few good and quite a few bad things to say...
On the good side, the rooms are very good value, room service is prompt and of good quality, and I was particularly impressed by the public restrooms!
On the bad side, the executive lounge was closed for unknown reasons, check in staff were young ladies who preferred multitasking such as speaking to each other or checking their mobiles while serving customers... Housekeeping had a dire need to clean in spite of a do not disturb sign placed!
Location is pretty good with amenities and restaurants closely. I did not use the shuttle service so cannot comment on that...

review_title: Excellent price for a clean Android nice room...
review_text: I love staying at the wyndham because every hotel of their's i've stayed in looked the same... no unexpected dissapointment. I will continue to stay at the wyndham wherever i may go and encourage everyone else to check them out (only wyndham Android wyndham wingate)...
hotel_name: Wingate By Wyndham Charlotte Airport I-85/I-485

review_text: It is hard to sit in a meeting all day without wireless. I had to go outside constantly to get any service. And this is suppose to be a business hotel!

review_title: Great if you work for an airline
review_text:
Long drive from upstate New York put us in around 11pm. Desk clerk was very busy flirting with airline employee. Guess he did not think I was much in my comfortable driving clothes. Room was acceptable but key light at closet was out and desk clerk was rude when I asked that it be fixed. Engineering never showed, found out later no help after 11pm, but no call from desk to tell me that. Elevator in disrepair, trapping my wife and no answer from service phone. No coffee in lobby.
Long time hilton traveller with 1/2 million points so I am very familiar with the chain. This location is not worthy of the hilton name.

I have stayed at this hotel a few times in the past, so when I found out I had to be in Charlotte I booked it because I remember it being decent... Not this time. My room was obviously not cleaned well: Urine on toilet seat, crumbs on floor, grout obviously not cleaned, coffee maker had a crust building up in it, etc. Obvious signs of poor housekeeping. After coming back to my room late evening because of dinner with friends I got ready for a shower and realized they did not leave soap out. Thought I would save the staff a trip and went downstairs- they handed me soap without even saying they were sorry. I travel a lot and am fairly picky when it comes to hotels being clean.. If you are not picky, this place is for you. I think if they hire better housekeeping it would be great.
People definitely make up the shortcomings here! Bartenders are awesome and everyone you pass in the hallways are genuinely friendly. The location is amazing and the pool scene is fit for kings!

Clean rooms, breakfast AND dinner (no stale muffin continental breakfasts here!!!), easy access everywhere. I have found few hotels to match Homewood Suites for total value, and have never been disappointed by this hotel in particular or the brand in general.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Charlotte Airport / Coliseum

review_title: Nice place to stay in the middle of everything!
review_text: Our reservations at another hotel were messed up so they found holiday inn for us. We were very thankful. The hotel is updated and very nice. Very clean and super friendly staff everywhere. They went out of their way to find me a sewing kit. The entire experience was a blessing! The only negative for kids was no indoor pool but plenty to do around hotel instead.

We stayed at hotel for 3 days for my son's funeral. The bathroom was dirty and the elevator broke down with my young grandchildren in it. The staff was friendly I will say that. The hot water is too hot and the knobs in shower were loose so it would change temperature the whole time while showering. It was horrible. I have traveled the world and stayed at the finest hotels and some not so nice. This hotel wants to be upscale but is not. Not a hotel for children as my daughter had a hard time with kids with no milk, no restaurant, etc... this is a hotel for men in 20's who are going out to party.
Did not feel up to complain since I had just lost my son but it was not a place to stay for peace and quite especially since you can hear people upstairs and downstairs.

Nice hotel, but a little bit tired rooms. Not worn down, but soon(?). Lots of tv channels, if you stay in one night! Staying for the weekend? Friday nights are usually noisy, people being out partying... Staff is nice, and if going for business the complimentary breakfast/dinner snack at 15th floor is highly recommended. Very small gym, but works. Close to everything in Charlotte, since it's perfect on spot in Uptown. Tight hotel parking, go for valet. Lots of great restaurants nearby. Recommend Whiskey River and O'Connellys (around the corner, basically) if you don't like the somewhat highly priced hotel bar... .)

review_title: Close to the airport, far from everything else.
review_text: This hotel is clean, but it's a good thing the food at the hotel bar is good, because that's the only thing nearby.

We stayed here for a business meeting and my wife and I enjoyed our stay. Rooms were large and stylish. Bed was great. Nice shower with good pressure. Clean facilities. Breakfast buffet and free cocktails in the evening from 5:30-7:30 was a big bonus. I would stay here again if I were in Charlotte.

The Charlotte Embassy Suites is where my family always stays in our trips from NY to Florida. It is easy access on and off the highway and very convenient. The managers reception and the great breakfast are both nice perks for the price. I was able to get an incredible teacher rate. You can't find it online, but if you call and ask they usually have it! A great place to stay.

review_title: Definitely not a four star property
review_text: We were in town for one night to pick up a car from a local dealer. We arrived late and went straight to the hotel. The front desk clerk was nice and we checked in without a problem. On the way up to the room I noticed that everything was very outdated. It appears that the hotel was remodeled in the 80's and nothing has been changed since that time. There are only 3 elevators to reach the rooms on the upper floors and one was closed because someone had gotten sick and No one cleaned it until after 10 the next morning. The room was ok but again it was outdated and lacked the extra decorations and comfort you expect in a 4 star hotel. The beds were clean but very hard. Watch out for extra charges at this hotel as everything has an extra charge. Local phone calls were a dollar which we found out after ordering a pizza. They had hot bottles of water in the room for $4 each. Who wants to pay that much for hot water? The rooms do not have a fridge or microwave. Again no extras just a bare bones room. The pool was clean but it is in the lobby beside the resturant so people eating dinner are watching you swim. The restaurant was ok at breakfast but very expensive. Overall this hotel is ok but it definitely shouldn't have a 4 star rating. 2 1/2 star would be more appropriate for this hotel.

review_title: Direkt neben der southgate mall; GroÃŸe Zimmer
review_text: Hotel ist auÃŸerhalb von Charlotte direkt an der Southgate Mall gelegen. Viele Restaurants in der NÃ¤he. Suiten sind riesig mit KÃ¼che und getrenntem wohn- und Schlafzimmern. Zimmer machen einen sauberen Eindruck. Gym sah gepflegt aus. GenÃ¼gend kostenlose ParkplÃ¤tze vorhanden. Die KÃ¼che war allerdings nicht gut ausgestattet, was fÃ¼r uns nicht relevant war, da wir auÃŸerhalb gegessen haben.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Charlotte - SouthPark

review_title: The best place for a girls weekend getaway!
review_text: They treated me like royalty. I planned a low key bachelorette weekend and the location was perfect downtown within walking distance to bars/restaurants! The staff was fantastic and we spent the days at the rooftop pool. I would definitely recommend this hotel. The rooms and Lobby were 4 stars!

review_title: Unexpectedly surprised with this Holiday Inn.
review_text: I recently had to travel to Charlotte for a meeting and I usually stay at Marriott hotels but the one in downtown Charlotte was booked. I was a little skeptical after reading some reviews but found this hotel to be very clean, located right in the middle of town and close to this center with lots of restaurants and a movie theater. I booked a king and at check-in the lady at the desk offered for me to upgrade to a new room for only $20 more. Nice new room and yes the sink was a little high but I'm kinda short and I had no problems. There was no HD but hotel had a notice posted apologizing that there was a delay in getting HD and they expected it by end of July. I will definitely return to this hotel if my travels bring me back to Charlotte.

I travel very often for work and frequent mostly Westins and sometimes Sheratons. The 1 st room they gave me had hair all over the bathroom. The 2nd room had a bug infestation on the desk. The mgr was rude and clearly was not interested in helping. She acted like I was intruding on her day. Halls were dingy. Rooms need renovation. Skip it.
Never again.

Stayed for a week in June. The hotel is very clean and accomidating. The breakfast is wonderful and I found the managers reception very relaxing. I think what makes this hotel is the staff. The are very polite and helpful. The restaurant Omaha Steakhouse was wonderful as well. Overall a great place to stay.

review_title: conference rooms were hot the entire weekend we stayed here.
review_text: I Travel and work in lots of hotels and resorts. Check in was fast, hotel beautiful and staff (front desk) were awesome especially catherine and chris (concierge). We worked in the conference rooms and each day someone would have to come in and fix the air conditioner and they always took their time. But they were sweethearts so that made up for it. The rooms were dark, there were smokers in the room across from us (no smoking policy in rooms) they moved our entire two room group opposed to moving them (smoke allergy employee on board) and lastly rooms were extremely dark even with all the lights on. The customer service makes up for all of this though.

review_title: A beautiful place to stay in Charlotte.
review_text:
We spent one night here on our way back from Florida. The suite was spacious, and very clean. The breakfast was outstanding, made to order if you wish. We have stayed in many hotels and this is one of very few that we found were not kept awake or woken in the morning by slamming doors and people talking loudly in the halls.
Our suite had comfortable furnishings and a very good bed.
Staff was very friendly and helpful. Comfortable bed. Perfect location. Overall very clean and well maintained.

The Omni Hotel has a super location in uptown Charlotte. Hotel was very nice and the folks that work there were polite and professional. I had a lovely room and my only complaint would be that I could hear all the "fun" the people in the adjoining room were having at 3am....when I called the front desk in the morning they apologized and moved me to a new room on a different floor. That room was very quiet...but had a overpowering mildew smell. I'm sure they would have moved me again...but I decided to stay. I did let them know upon checkout. I had read about the "thin" walls on trip advisor....even so I was surprised how thin! Still overall, I enjoyed my stay.
Very nice. Clean rooms with a modern vibe. Breakfast was nice they had a good selection to choose from. Great location next to office park and lots of restaraunts and shops.

review_title: Great hotel on all accounts! Nice and attentive staff, great for families with the Omni Kids stuff, perfect for business, close
review_text: We mixed business and family into a fun week in Charlotte. Our stay at the Omni was great! Everyone was very nice and helpful. All of our needs were met there and we will be back!

review_title: Nice hotel in a great location
review_text: Stayed overnight in Charlotte to catch a Panthers game. I felt the price match the amenities of the hotel. I am familiar with Omni and this particular Omni is not as upscale as some others, but was a great value. The hotel is in a perfect location in downtown Charlotte. Everything including the stadium was in walking distance!

review_title: Clean, friendly staff and a good location
review_text: In town for a quick weekend. The staff was super friendly, good location nice exercise room. Overall nice hotel
This is a nice property, clean, safe, a very typical Marriott

review_title: Good spot for business, needs a face lift
review_text: Stayed at this hotel for business. It is in a good spot for the business traveler. The room was very spacious with a nice sized bathroom. The location is good for downtown. The hotel itself is about 10 years overdue for a renovation.

review_title: Booking a meeting?? Dont stay here!!!
review_text: There is so much wrong with this property I don't know where to start! The Director of Sales needs to be removed from his position. He doesn't know the first thing about how to take care of his clients. We pay your salary!!!!! The food in the presidential suite was not kept at safe food handling temps. Sushi was left sit out without ice for 5 hours, yogurt in the morning had no ice and was left out for over 3 1/2 hours. These were only a few of the numerous mistakes this hotel made. In Embers they won't serve a burger less than "well done" they said its NC law! That is incorrect! They dont have a chef on staff and are afraid of food bourne illness and getting sued. The food and lack of customer service are not up to Westin standards. This place should be called Western as in Best Western! Because that is the service and property they most reflect. Buyer beware. Stay somewhere else.
Right next to The Village shops and Southpark Mall. Upscale decor, large rooms, proximity to shopping and restaurants make this a great choice!

I surprised my boyfriend for his birthday by staying at the Hilton for one night (we're locals). 
What an incredible stay! Clean room, super-comfy bed, high-quality toiletries, nice TV, superb location, and great service! The Hilton is a great value. :-)
Will definitely stay here again next time we want to get away for a night.

My experience in westin Charlotte was so pleasant . Everything was just great starting from the room which is well furnished n clean to the location of the hotel that lies in the heart of the city . All staff were friendly and nice . I highly recommend it :)

I stayed wiry my family at the Hilton for one night after a bobcats basketball game. The location is perfect and the rooms are big and clean. We got free room upgrades upon arrival and received free breakfast and free wine and cheese in the evening! Great stay!

Stayed over due to a strom and a missed fligh, we stayed at the marriot at Indianapolis and the difference is overwhelming, this hotel is not worth the money I was charged, the room was ok but it needs renovations and better cleaning service

review_title: If you want great customer service DON'T come here!!!!!
review_text: We came for a romantic getaway. The staff does not make you feel like you are ay a 4 stage hotel. Go to Omni or the Ritz instead. They make you feel happy to spend the money there. We were truly disappointed. I should have listened to the reviews!!

what they say about southern hospitality is true at Hilton Charlotte Center City. Everyone at the hotel was extremely courteous and real. Not a fake smile around. The rooms were clean without that musty smell you sometimes encounter. The bathrooms are upgraded with spacious showers and great water pressure. I stayed for 3 nights for business with a group on a higher floor. I believe the hotel was full, but you could not tell since they had fast elevator service. Yes, I would definitely stay again when visiting Charlotte !

This is a nice hotel in a convenient location. Rooms have nice amenities, comfortable beds, and comfortable furnishings. The room was in overall good condition, but the bathroom shower tile needed some work. The tile and grout on the shower floor looked old and needed repair. Also, the doors throughout the hallways are a bit beaten up and in need of a coat of paint. Also, the elevators are a bit slow.
Nice hotel, but needs some work.

Wow were do I start. Came to stay at the hotel bc it was close to the bobcats arena. Didn't have a problem with the price bc your in uptown charlotte near everything. I was disappointed about the additional fees that they don't notify you of. 12$ a night to park, as much as it cost a night parking should be free. 12$ a day for wifi, you can get free wifi at a 40$ a night hotel. To top it all off we were told that breakfast was free at j wales, but staff failed to tell us that it ended at 9am. They recommended that we eat at their restaurant for 12$ a plate. Honestly if I knew that they charge you for everything, I would have stayed at another hotel.
hotel_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Charlotte - Gateway Village

review_text: Very nice but u pay so much u would think there would be continental n wi do. U can stay at an average hotel for 50 dollars n get both of those for free
I love the sheets! Service was great and staff extremely accommodating! The location is convenient because it is in the heart of commerce in Charlotte.. Perfect especially for business travellers

review_title: Nice place, a little pricey but $18/day for parking?
review_text:
The service here was great. I loved the room...nicely appointed, very clean and up to date. The bed was so comfortable. I realized staying downtown was going to be more expensive but the room rates were rather high and then they charged $18 per day just to park your car in their deck. 
I would recommend the place but be forewarned to bring your cash!
Anything that can possibly go right, did. Everyone was so nice and friendly. I will defenetly be staying here again.

This hotel is centrally located in a great part of Downtown Detroit. Detroit's RiverWalk is a great outdoor attraction and is steps away from this hotel. The rooms at the hotel were very clean, spacious, and offered amazing views of the river and Canadian coastline. I live in the neighborhood and recommend this hotel to everyone who comes to visit me.

Stayed here for business , rooms good size, beds very comfortable , nothing out standing about bathrooms but they are clean. Staff were very good, near to lovely restaurants and only 15mims from airport

review_title: A pretty building and pretty high prices.
review_text: My stay here was during a week long convention. My assessment is that, although the property is very attractive, the service was adequate, rather than superior and the prices were well above the norm. When our organization holds a convention, we always arrange for complimentary internet access for our members in their rooms. Not so here, as the hotel was unwilling to budge from the $13 per day charge per room. They nickeled and dimed us at every turn for the convention and banquet services throughout our stay. The house restaurant is very proud of their food, charging very steep prices for small portions of average fare. My feeling, and that of most of the other folks in our group is, this is a place to which we should not return. If we hold our convention in this city again, I'll certainly recommend we look for a different venue.

This hotel was perfect for a night on the town! The rooms were clean, very nice, and the hotel staff was extremely nice! It's just a short walk to the epicenter where we spent our evening with its many restaurants and bars!

Very good downtown location if you have business nearby. Expected Hilton in room standards but for the price in comparison to other family member hotels, i was hoping a real lobby, a bar atmosphere but entrance is more like residencial building. Breakfast room and restaurant gave me a depressing feeling, probably because of the vast empty space around it. But if you have business in adjacent office building it is a sure bet.

Great place for what I paid, $111 for king bed/2 adults. Bed very comfortable, sheets very soft, pillows excellent! Bath & body works brand shampoo, conditioner good quality. Excellent tv, good coffee. Room very clean and nicely decorated. Bar/restaurant had decent prices and good tasting food (had walleye). Shuttle runs every 20 min's. Will definitely stay again!

I want to give props to Jillian who works there. I am a traveler at heart and always need guidance on key places to go since I got limited time and do not want to waste it on boring places. Jillian basically drew out for me a trail that crosses novelty stores, the best park in charlotte (freedom) and other attractions. She knows so well because she lived there - better than those that throw a standard picklist at you and havent been to half the places there. Good job!
Location of hotel is good. Walking distance to the EpiCenter - charlottes nightlife district.
Very clean, excellent location. I have stayed in much nicer Marriott properties, but this one is still nice. No complaints.

review_title: Great value and good Marriott quality experience
review_text: Very good value, great clean room with nice amenities. Very loud lobby.

Some of the reviews seem to be from before the hotel's renovation. The rooms are beautiful, with huge LCD televisions, clean linens, and a bright, modern bathroom. Our room had a beautiful view of the city from the 22nd floor. The light rail stops at the hotel, so you can save money by parking streetside or simply parking at a Lynx park-and-ride, both of which are free. The hotel is downtown, next to the convention center and NASCAR Hall of Fame, and convenient to a number of museums, the football stadium, and an assortment of restaurants, bars, and nightclubs. Great for business or a weekend vacation. You will not be disappointed by how beautiful this hotel has become since it's renovation!
I had the best and largest room ever when staying here. Free snacks, drinks and great service. Plus casino for entertainment. Really enjoyed my stay here....

We stayed here for a night downtown. We wanted to stay at the Marriott in the Renaissance Center but they didn't have any rooms available. The check in process was easy and the room was great! We had a view of the Detroit river and Belle Isle. I would definitely stay here again!

review_title: Do NOT give cash for parking unless you make sure to get a reciept! We got ripped off!
review_text: We stayed at this location Fri July 22nd to Sun 24th. All of our stay was great except that we ended up double charged for parking as my husband unknowingly paid cash to desk clerk (approx. 4:30am July 23rd) when I had used the same card I paid with upon checking in on friday the 22nd, in the afternoon. We were then charged a third time at checkout on Sunday. We explained we had paid for two nights parking already and the desk clerk was argumentative so we tools her we would not stand there and argue over $18.

review_title: Fantastic hotel - great service - so-so location
review_text: We booked a single night on Expedia and were upgraded to the lounge floor. The room was huge! We had a great view of the city and river from the 13th floor. Great bed, very nice bathroom. The restaurants were good, but expensive. The casino was OK, but very smokey. We'll do it again someday.

Just stayed on 08/12. Arrived at room late in the evening and noted blood on the bed sheets. Floor towel in the bathroom was dirty. Elevators were dirty as well. Good central location in Detroit. Usually not the lack of cleanliness you would find in most HI Express' these days

My husband I just got back from a night out to celebrate our anniversary. The hotel was great. The staff was very nice and helpful. The tub and shower are awesome. The room was good, a few things could of been better, our jetted tub didn't work,we asked for a late check out and were told no even though we wanted to blow our money in the casino during that time. Some areas of the hotel smelled like bad cologne. I felt like my lungs were filling with it. I think someone with asthma would find that a problem. I think they are using it to cover smoke smell.
We had a great time with all that said. I do think its worth trying.

I been to all the casinos in Detroit several of times. But Motor City Casino became my regular place. The staff is amazing as well as the rooms. The buffet is great!!! 
As far as gambling, wow the pit boss and dealers are the BEST. They make u feel so welcomed, some even call me by my name! The bartenders are great and I can't wait to come back to Detroit just to visit Motor City Casino.... Well done!

review_title: Helpful staff but a bit pricey for a Courtyard
review_text:
This property is near the GM complex and is right on the People Mover. This makes getting around downtown Detroit pretty easy. Also, the staff was helpful with directions and options for getting around. 
But that being said, it seemed a bit pricey for a Courtyard. Not that the hotel is bad. It is a standard Courtyard room and is everything I would expect from a Courtyard. It just seems to be priced more like a full service Marriott.

review_title: Don't believe hype of hotel security checkpoint
review_text: While other reviews talk about airport security checkpoint, problem is being a guest at Westin is nothing special for it. Everybody else may use that checkpoint too. Even some "regulars" intentionally go there thinking lineup shorter. In my case, waited as long there as I have any other DTW visits. Overall nice hotel, overpriced unless you're doing park & fly package, then it's an excellent value.

review_title: It is a Holiday Inn again!
review_text: I was pleasantly surprised with this hotel. I was a little worried after reading the reviews, but everything went smoothly. The rooms were updated and clean, and the staff was helpful and friendly. Great value, would stay here again.

This is a pretty standard Hilton Garden, but for a folks staying Downtown, you cannot beat the location, especially if you are going to a Tigers game or to Ford Field. Very close the the Greektown area. It has a bar and small restaurant on site. I found the staff to be friendly and helpful.

I arrived at airport at midnight and wanted to stay at hotel on airport I could just walk to...not wait on shuttle so I could get to sleep faster. Ended up having to take shuttle after all and didn't get to room until 130am. Room was large, clean and beds were super comfortable. Hotel charged for bottled water and Internet access on top of overpriced room rate. Discovered there was no shampoo in room as I was taking a shower...too late to call front desk.

You would never think that this Westin at the airport would be that good, but it is!!! This hotel is tearing up the market due to its great location and superior product. If you are traveling you must check it out.....only thing missing is a draft beer at the trendy bar.
The security entrance into the airport makes it worth the stay.

The hotel was fairly nice and clean, but it seemed as if the staff was trying to make my stay as difficult as possible. They seemed more interested in talking amongst themselves than dealing with their customers. I would rather stay at a motel 6 in a bad neighborhood than this hotel. I will not be coming back

Very pleased with my stay. It especially smelled clean, without the saturation of cigarette smoke that you often find in hotels that are supposed to be "non-smoking." Flatscreen tv, wireless and wired internet worked well. Nice complementary toiletries. Fitness center was a little small and tight, but was still able to use the treadmill without having to wait. Didn't use the pool or hot tub, but they looked clean and functioning. Breakfast buffet was a little pricey at $12, and was similar to what you would get at Embassy Suites (although Embassy Suites is free). Would definitely stay there again, though I would probably walk a few blocks to Greektown to find some eats rather than the hotel.
One of the best hotels I've ever stayed at. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling in the Detroit area.
Early morning flights are a pain. This is a convenient solution

Beautifully rennovated downtown building. Massive room with separate living room/desk area. Really great exercise room. Attentive staff. Exceptionally clean. Nice to see an older building restored to its former glory.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Detroit Downtown - Fort Shelby

review_title: Overall good experience with a few quirks
review_text:
I spent two nights at the Doubletree with my boyfriend and two friends. Overall, the hotel provided a nice stay; however, there were a few quirks that weren't deal break breakers but could have improved our experience. 
First, the good-
The hotel staff is friendly and helpful. Also, the rooms are clean and offer a lot of space. Our suite was big enough to sleep 4 adults comfortably. Finally, The hotel is easy to find and close to all the casinos and restaurants in the area.
The quirks-
There were some details in the room that I wouldn't have expected to be overlooked. First, the door handles on the bathroom and bedroom doors were loose. Pull too hard and the entire handle came off. Second, if you are allergic to down feathers, call ahead. The pillows and comforters are all down. Lastly, the room was a little chilly. Personally, I don't mind a room at 65*, but some of my travel mates did. The heat couldn't seem to get above 68* in the room.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Detroit Downtown - Fort Shelby

review_title: It's a nice Urban Chic Hotel, old mixed with new.
review_text: My stay at the Hilton (Doubletree) was very good. I stayed around Thanksgiving holiday. I arrived on Thursday afternoon, thanksgiving day. I was tired, long drive. My husband went to the lobby to get the keys to the room but unfortunately he came back with some bad news. He told me that the rooms won't be ready until 2:30. I said, "Are you kidding me, after a long ride we all want to lay down!" Well, I had to go in and try to get a room. I talked to a nice young man name Joseth. He really helped me. He called upstairs to see if he could get me and my family a room right away. After several minutes of calling and checking he was able to get me a room that was ready! I was so glad, thanks a lot Joseth. Well, the only complaint I have is valet parking. Management, can you somehow make that free. Other than that, I enjoyed my stay at Doubletree in the "D".
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Detroit Downtown - Fort Shelby

review_title: This hotel is in a great location.
review_text: The hotel staff is great. The rooms are clean and hughe. Food is good too. You have a shuttle service to Red Wings games. You will be pleased with this hotel.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Detroit Downtown - Fort Shelby

review_title: When stranded by Delta - make the best of it here.
review_text:
Compared to other airport hotels, the Westin is a winner. It is very quiet considering the huge jets just yards away. It's relatively new and in good shape. 
I wouldn't stay here if I had business in Oakland, Macomb, or Livingston counties, but when Delta strands you in Detroit (again!!!) this is the best option. It's a two minute walk to the TSA checkpoint in the airport and the hotel has its own checkpoint open from 8am-7pm. 
This place is a solid 3-3.5 star and strong value at $125 (maybe more depending how you value convenience).

review_title: Double Tree Fort Shelby offers fair value, but falls short of three stars.
review_text:
The Double Tree Fort Shelby is a nice hotel for a decent price. Unfortunately the dining area, lounge, and room service close way too early. Unfortunately, in downtown Detroit you are 100% dependent upon your hotel for dining, etc. Don't pack your food either because there is no refrigerator or microwave in the room.
If you can eat early or are free to drive a distance this hotel is comfortable and conveniently located by the Derroit International Jazz Festival.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Detroit Downtown - Fort Shelby

review_text: We arrived with two chocolate labs. The staff was great giving dog treats and cookies to us. The valet was great as well as the staff. There is a small place across the street to walk the dogs. We would stay again room was a little small but for the most part a great experience. 5 paws says the dogs.
hotel_name: Doubletree by Hilton Detroit Downtown - Fort Shelby
