review_title: Decent enough property, but bathrooms could use an update
review_text:
This is an older property that they have done a decent enough job keeping up to date. The carpet, furnishings, paint, etc are all in decent shape. 
The one area that could use work is the tile in the bathroom. It is showing its age. The grout is discolored and there is caulk that is peeling. Nothing terribly bad, but noticeable. 
The staff was very friendly. They welcomed me and seemed to want to help.

Hubby and I enjoyed a spontaneous overnight here a couple weekends ago. Service was great and the rooms were so cozy. The bath wasn't anything special or fancy, but that's small potatoes. Great location to downtown shopping and sports.

Nice, clean hallways and rooms. Great views. Great lobby and bar. Bar staff is the hotel highlight...very friendly and helpful. Drinks are priced like an upscale hotel. Market prices in town are about 50% less. But, it was worth the price for the great atmosphere, service, and convenience.
This is the GM headquarters so GM is everywhere which didn't bother me. The lobby at center of complex can be confusing due to circular ramps but it provides great open spaces to the gallery. 
The rooms are very nice, bedding is comfortable and rooms are spacious. Views are excellent. The gym is exceptional! If you want to workout on your trip this is the place!
hotel_name: Detroit Marriott at the Renaissance Center

review_text: After paying nearly $500 for a single room, no view, not even a suite - they were rude at the desk, expected extra deposits they never detailed in the initial $500, and expected us to put down ANOTHER $200 that we wouldnt get back for 6-12 business days. Would not accept credit card from me, and required 3rd party presence even though we were 500+ miles away from home (how many ppl do u know w available credit cards in each city of the world?) so we were unable to complete our stay. Had to search everywhere for different hotel & casino missed out on a good paying customer. As we were leaving the valet gave us a hard time about returning our vehicle bc their incoherant Valet man misspelled our last name. Very upset & were treated poorly, had plenty of money on card and in cash but apparently was no good there! Judgement was obvious, as we are a younger couple. So disappointed!

First of all, we decided to book this hotel because of the recommodation of Tripadivser and it was a complete flop. The personal at the hotel was very obliging. At first our room has mold. My wife become headache and there was no opportunity to get another room. The manager on duty tells us, that she will check it, but nothing happened. The next frustrating thing was the breakfast. The plates and the tables sticking and breakfast is only till 9:30am. The last thing I really had was the gym. To come to the gym you have to go through the pool area. The pool area was very slippery. Overall I do not understand, why this Doubletree is getting such a good rating in Tripadivisor.
Great hotel. OK value. rooms were great and luxurious. Only negative is that I was there with our son and he couldn't go to some of the restaraunts as he isn't 18.

review_title: Great location, awesome staff! Home away from home.
review_text:
Lassandra who cooks the complimentary breakfasts in the morning always greets me by name with a big smile. Absolute treasure. She sets the tone for a great day.
 Ryan who works the front desk is super-friendly and always makes you feel right at home when you check in, even at 530 on Monday mornings he is always upbeat. Great folks.

review_title: Good consistent quality of the Doubletree standard
review_text: Just stayed here for one night and had no issues at all. We've stayed at other Doubletree's and this one meets the quality you come to expect from a Doubletree. I had one of the best check-in experiences and the front desk was outstanding in making me feel wanted and they did all they could to help us.

review_title: Everything at this hotel is excellent.
review_text: Easy to get to being right off I-75 and superb valet service. Check-in was quick and easy. The staff is friendly and courteous. The room is gorgeous. We ate at the Palette(buffet) twice and really enjoyed everything we tried... and they had lots to choose from.

Ok let me start by saying i received a great price on the hotel. 89 per night on the weekend is great. All the other reviews are right, hotel is clean, no unauthorized charges on our card, good location(except there is construction all around the hotel). My only complaint is, i booked a queen size bed, and we received a full size! we checked in last night after 11, so i was too tired to complain. when i called to tell them, they acted like i was crazy! i told multiple people this is not a queen bed, i have one at home. the front desk said "we have no double beds on the property" then told me they were completely booked except for a room with 2 double beds! i am outdone! at least be honest and say maybe we made a mistake! i am having a baby next month, and this was our little get away before he is born,and i wanted the bed to be great.we leave tomorrow.no one believes anything should be done about our problem.other than that, the hotel is ok, but be aware their "queen size" are really full size!

The Westin at DTW is a hotel like no other I've been. So conveniently located at the airport but what sets them apart from other similar hotels at/near the airport is that the Delta airline counter is just outside the hotel lobby! Plus it's only one of the few hotels who have their TSA, no need to go all the way to the main airport. A true perk! Granted there might be a few pre-arrangements but ir's not much of a hassle. The hotel itself d nor disappoint! Hip as always in decor and service is topnotch, from the front desk to the restaurant! Will definitely stay here if we come to Detroit hsin!

review_title: The hotel of choice in downtown Indy.
review_text:
The hotel staff is what sets the hotel apart. They are very attentive and helpful (except whoever the bartender after midnight on New Years Eve '10, she was very rude.) I loved the classic and rich decoration used throughout the hotel. The rooms are beautiful especially the penthouse with the full deck and window! The TVs are outdated, but are to be replaced soon. The bath was gorgeous, with adequate water pressure and plenty of towels.
The only problem I have is I was charged and additional overnight valet parking fee, $27 which is very high. I have not called to question this yet. 
If this gets taking care of I will be referring all my business relations, friends and family to this hotel.

Stayed at MGM when my husband returned from deployment to Kuwait. Splurged on luxury suite which was beautiful. Dinner at Wolfgang Puck was delicious. Plenty of entertainment options. Perfect blend of romance and fun. Would definitely stay again!

This is an amazing hotel in downtown Detroit. The rooms are beautiful, the gym is state of the art, but most importantly the service was impeccable. The staff went of their way to make our stay as welcoming as possible. I will definitely be back!

Stayed on a crazy rained soaked Saturday night. We were going to a Kenny Chesney concert that night and they had a baseball game going on the same time. So traffic was awful. Finally made it through traffic and found the hotel. We just valet parked because it just seemed easier, it was worth the $25.00. Check in was very easy, did request a king bed but they said they only had doubles left. I find it a little hard to believe in such a huge hotel, but I didn't argue. It worked out ok on the long run. I wish the front desk person would gave explained how to use the elevators. You need to slip your card in a slot once in the elevator, but know one told us we had to push our room number. We just figured it read it on the card. We were on the 58th floor. So it pretty much goes high speed up but since we didn't push what room it went high speed down all the way to the lobby. Scared to daylights out of me. I thought it was broken. Someone finally explained it to us. So finally got to the room and kind of smelled like smoke. The carpet was kind of icky. The bathroom was nice. The beds were very comfy. I slept great in it and so did my husband. The room wasn't very sound proof. We got in from the concert around 11:30 and heard the people next door till about 1am. Like that check put wasn't till 12, that was nice. We ate at the breakfast buffet in the hotel. It was pricey, but tasty. Check out was easy. Paying for valet was stupid, you had to go downstairs and wait on a long line and then you had to wait again for your car. The GM building was cool with all the cars in the building but everything was closed since it was Sunday. I thought that was dumb. There was a lot of people in the hotel that day, that was like us a tired to see the cars. Overall it was an ok hotel. I would stay again if I went back to Detroit.
hotel_name: Detroit Marriott at the Renaissance Center

review_title: Not what I expect from marriott
review_text: There was construction during our stay which was noisy and inconvenient. The beds were not the usual Marriott beds and were uncomfortable. Walls are paper thin you can hear conversations from other rooms.

One of the reasons we came to Detroit was because our son wanted to stay in this high rise hotel in GM headquarters. 
Unfortunately, we found the hotel to have drab rooms and the worst part was its lack of cleanliness. The hallways had debris like spent sunflower seeds and food particles. We had to change rooms because of the loud buzzing of the fluorescent lights in the bathroom. 
Good parts of the hotel were the lively Volt bar and the view of the water. 
Ps. We told management about our concerns about cleanliness and the noisy light and they apologized, but didn't seem too surprised by our complaints.
hotel_name: Detroit Marriott at the Renaissance Center

review_text: I recently had to pick up the husben at the airport and decided to stay I'n the westin the night before since he was on an early flight. It was great just easy from the valet parking,,, it's I'n the airport so could just wait I'n the lobby,,clean, comphy rooms,,sure it's a bit pricy ,,but well worth the price,,will be staying again!!!
The people are super friendly , wonderful stay. This was our first time in Detroit and this place has really made it worth while.

Everyone treated us great as an SPG member and put us on the preferred floor. The food and service was great and amazing location! Made our international travel so easy! Thanks for another great stay Westin!!

review_title: A great way to experience Detroit.
review_text:
Agree with all the positive reviews and thumbs up! And the staff is great, take advantage of the free shuttle service, and ask Steve to give you a tour of Detroit. A passionate man still in love with a great city. 
But ask carefully about what kind of room you get. Three flights of stairs can be a challenge with luggage, even if the renovation is perfect,

We stayed here one night on a trip to see the great lakes. Although I was hesitant to stay at a b & b since we are accustom to staying in hotels. This ended up being our favorite stay. We were a party of 3 staying in the Smith carriage house. A separate apartment behind the house was actually 2 rooms a hallway, sitting room and bathroom. All beautifully decorated and restored. There are some scary neighborhoods as you drive to ferry street bit upon arriving see an avenue of lovely restored mansions. Breakfast was wonderful as was the service. There is a man that also watches the cars parked on the lot behind the houses. One drawback was we did have to carry our luggage up to the second story, not a problem for us but could be for some. Would love to stay here again.

review_title: Besides the location, overpriced restaurants and quirky ac not bad
review_text:
Pricey for what it is
Mattresses were the worst in a long time. Many conference attenddees were complaining of sore backs.
Nice gym though.
hotel_name: Detroit Marriott at the Renaissance Center

review_text:
Drury has always been my place to stay while on the road. 
Free hot breakfast. Free hot dinner and free drinks.
Rooms are exceptionally clean, and the staff is very friendly

We stayed here on July 31 to August 1st this last summer for my wife's and Mother's Birthday and had a double bed room and suite room. I was a little concerned about the views at first being from Michigan and driving threw Detroit many times, but must say this hotel had some of the best views of Detroit and Windsor I had ever seen not only that the staff was very helpful and the hotel was very clean and quite. It's located right in the greek town area which has lots of restaurants and night life plus is connected to the casino.
 We also did some sight seeing that night and took a cruise on the Detroit river the nice thing about that is the people mover which is one of the Detroits few public transits was connected to the casino and we could get on board and took us very close to the river, which is very nice to not have to drive or do a lot of walking.
 Back to the hotel for the price and location this is a great hotel for a weekend get away or going to one of the sporting events in the area, we also had a birthday party at one of the restaurants in the area and some of the guest came and looked at the rooms and were speechless at how nice, clean and the great views of Detroit. This is one of Detroits best gems and I would highly recommend this hotel for weekend get a ways or even a family weekend, yes they do allow kids just not in the casino.
 My ownly commit is I wish they had a pool for people who wish to use that and not just gamble or doing the night life.

review_title: Great hotel meets all your needs
review_text: The breakfast offers a nice variety. Room was large and clean. Very nice staff

Westin does it perfectly. Stress free. Stay and fly. Excellent service and food. We arrived easy check it, immaculate rooms,great service and food at lounge. Similar experience for breakfast. Relaxing atmosphere. Easy departure to airport.

review_title: Roll out of bed, go throug the private TSA security checkpoint exclusively for hotel guests, and stroll to your gate.
review_text: Fairly standard Westin (heavenly bed, shower, etc.) located in DTW. Some of the nicer suites at a U.S. Westin. Dema restaurant is great. Room service is prompt and courteous. Decent gym. Super friendly staff.

review_title: Upscale and affordable at $99 per night!
review_text: We will definitely stay at this hotel again in future! Popcorn & soda pop (all you wanted) in the evening. The full breakfast at no extra charge was great too! Everything from fresh made waffles to eggs, sausage, toast, bagels, fruit, oatmeal, cereal and more. Pool is nice as well. It is partially indoor, partially outdoor. We slept great on top of all this
This hotel chain is great - clean, pet-friendly rooms at a really good price. But this hotel was pristine, and it had an ultra-professional staff and excellent room rates.

We stayed here for two nights as we were here for the Lions-Falcons game. The hotel itself is very nice & the staff couldn't be more polite & friendly. I used my Starwood points for a free night & we received a king room with a nice view of downtown. I room itself was nice, but a little small for my taste...the bed was very comfortable. There are quite a bit of eating places around the hotel within walking distance, plus a nice bar & grill located inside the hotel. Parking is either valet or self-park & the garage is located right behind the hotel. The only small complaint about this hotel is when you check-in, there isn't enough parking spots in front of the hotel...just a minor issue on my part. :-). I would definitely recommend this hotel if staying in the downtown Detroit area!

review_title: Great place for a short stay
review_text: The Greektown Casino is positioned in the heart if downtown Detroit, the staff were always welcoming and friendly. The hotel is connected to the casino across the street by a walkway which is ideal in my opinion as it has the convenience without the 24hr hustle underneath you! Close to the people mover it was easy and cheap to get around.

Went for a ballgame and the casino. Very friendly staff. Close to the ballpark and after the game if you show your tickets you receive $2 draft beers all night. Good price $99 for the night with two $10 vouchers and 2 breakfast buffets. Mgm wanted $249 a night. Great deal will def be back.
Hotel is clean. Great service. Hard working staff.. free appetizerss and free continental breakfast make it a tremendous value. Highly recommended

review_title: Awesome way to start our family cross country vacation.
review_text: We had never stayed at this chain of hotel before, but were pleasantly surprised. It was not only decorated beautifully, but extremely clean. My family liked it so well that during our cross country vacation, we changed some of our reservations to stay where one of these hotels were available.

The West BC is a great hotel in downtown Detroit. The staff is very friendly and the rooms were large, modern and very clean. The only slightly negative aspect was expensive or inconvenient parking options. Despite that, this property is amazing and is a great example of Detroit's future!

review_title: This is the best way to travel from DTW!
review_text: Staying at the Detroit Westin provides a stress-free environment and allows for easy access to your outbound flight, as well as valet service for parking (for departure & return). It totally simplifies our travel, especially when we travel with our four children!

review_title: Great renovation, a gem in the heart of Detroit
review_text: I stayed here in August and was pleasantly surprised by how nice it was! My colleague had stayed here several times and highly recommended it, but I was still a skeptical because I had never been to Detroit and there has been so much news coverage about Detroits economy that I didn't believe they had a hotel like this. It's been beautifully done and definitely lives up to (and often surpasses) the westin standards. The room are very new, clean, well decorated and very large! The room service is fast and tasty and the restaurant downstairs (Motor something) is awesome. My only slight complaint is that the gym is on the bottom floor and faces into an alley, so not much to look at. If my work brings me to Detroit again, I would stay here in a heartbeat! Great rates as well!!
Stay @ Blackwell during OSU football season. We have season txts and stay here each time. Staff is great and hotel is top notch.

Best hotel I have stayed ever. The rooms are latest out great. Service is great loved the evening turn down. The restaurant is great and gym is awesome. Nothing but perfection. Only complaint was we requested a double bed because hotel was sold out and they saved all the rooms for the osu. Football team
 Thought this was odd because we were staying for a week. Located in campus and it is clean and safe.
Staying right at the airport takes away all the pre trip anxiety. Even going through security is a more pleasant experience.

We stayed here for our trip to Carowinds. I looked at the pictures online and read others reviews and decided to give it a try. When we got to our room it was sparkling clean! I checked every part of the room and checked the sheets for stray hairs and the whole room was nice and clean and smelled nice. My 4 year old daughter screamed that she loved this place! The beds were nice and soft yet not too soft to hurt my back. Kitchen was a nice size and again very clean. The fireplace was a nice feature and although it was 80+ outside we fired it up just to see what it was like, really nice gas fireplace. TVs in all rooms were nice and had excellent picture quality. We went to pool and had a great time. The hot tub was a nice treat and just what we needed to soothe our aching feet after walking all over Carowinds. The breakfast on Friday morning was very good and they even had grits! Saturday morning they had someone preparing waffles for us and again had grits in addition to the other breakfast items which made it much more of a real breakfast than the standard pre-processed microwave food that some places offer as breakfast. It is also very close to shopping and restaurants. We had a great time and on our next trip we look forward to staying here again.
hotel_name: Residence Inn Charlotte South at I-77/Tyvola Road

review_text: Have used the Westin several times in the past few years but my last visit was exceptional!! I had booked the stay and fly package and left my vehicle parked at the hotel for eight days. Upon returning from our trip, my vehicle would not start due to the extreme temperatures from the past week. The staff started my car and were so helpful despite the freezing temperatures...Stay here!!!

review_title: Beautiful renovation and walking distance to Cobo Center
review_text:
I was here for a convention at Cobo. It was less than 10 minutes to walk there and although I never felt unsafe, it was not a pretty walk. 
The hotle has undergone a major renovation and the rooms were all up to date with flat screen TV's etc. Ther were 2 elevators out of order which caused major crowds at the beginning and end of each day. The bar was hopping at night.
The pool and fitness room is on the ground floor so you have to walk through the lobby in gym clothes to get there but the facilities were nice.
Very friendly service knowledgable about area and very friendly staff
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Charlotte Airport South

review_text: It was based on Trip Advisor tips I'd chosen this hotel for one night in Charlotte. It offered the basic a hotel this category could but my bathtube was somewhat dirty with a few short black hair. I've chosen not to say anything since it was only for one night. The staff responded well when requested. Overall I'd look for something else in Charlotte for a longer stay.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Charlotte Airport South

review_text: This was my first time staying at a La Quinta Inn & Suites and I must say that for the money it is not bad at all. There was a problem on our initial check-in as they room they assigned us wasn't yet ready to be occupied by anyone. The beds had been stripped down and the kinsman were on the floor and the bathroom had not yet been refreshed because someone had just checked out at 12 but we arrived at 4:45 pm. The young man at the front was very apologetic and accommodating though and he fixed the problem immediately. The good thing about this hotel is that it has been renovated in the past year and it was in a central location to the major highway, 77, and various food and shopping establishments. There is a free breakfast every morning which wad a plus for the kids and me and there was plenty of free parking. The beds were comfortable and overall the stay was pretty good. Also they do have a pool and fitness center on site. If you are looking for basic, comfortable accommodations, at a reasonable price this is your hotel.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Charlotte Airport South

review_text: Stay for about a week. Great comfortable place. The staff was excellent and the chef I believe his name was Matt was a breath of fresh air. I would hate to be near the people complaining about this place and the staff, seems they might have some issues they need to address themselves.

review_title: A must stay when in the area!
review_text: Wonderful property! Friendly staff, clean modern rooms and very quiet! Highly recommended!! The food is good but pass on the chili.

This was our first stay at a Hyatt ofany kind. The staff was outstanding and really made the stay wonderful. They went above and beyond to help us feel welcome. It was sincere. Not phony. Very nice. The price was great and our room was very nicely done. Loved the layout. Our family of three look forward to staying here again.

My husband and I stayed at the Hyatt Place from Saturday through Monday. The rooms and hotel were beautifully decorated in a classic modern style and it was very clean. The thing that we were most impressed with was ALL of the staff at the hotel were incredibly helpful, cheerful and made you feel right at home. We were always greeted by all the staff as we came in the door. In addition, we watched as they were very helpful and accommodating to other hotel guests. When I had to wait just a few minutes for a latte that I ordered, they gave it to me at no charge. It really was a pleasure to stay at the Hyatt Place. We plan to stay there again when we return. highly recommended!

I booked this not knowing area that well for 2 days of our vacation, its about a 5 min walk to almost everything. If you are going to any of the sporting events it's perfect. As for the hotel, it was a bit older and the room air conditioner was garbage and noisy. Most of staff was so nice, especially with the hotel sold out for bowl game. Breakfast was below standard but again a lot of people eating, they should have been prepared. I would definitley recommend minus the air issue and sell out. My tough ratings system 1-100 is an 84.

review_text:
The Hyatt at South Street blvd is a a great quality airport hotel. It is within 10 minutes of the airport in a quiet business/commercial area. 
Breakfasts are top quality and have Starbucks brew coffee. 
The rooms are of a decent size for a airport hotel and the staff are friendy and conscientious. 
I have no hesitation in recommending this hotel.

review_title: Great staff and great location. I highly recommend this hotel.
review_text: We experienced wonderful service from the staff. Everyone was so helpful. The room was a little small, (which is expected from a historic hotel) but very clean and nicely decorated. The location is perfect. We were able to walk to the downtown hot spots. We really enjoyed our stay here and we would love to return. I highly recommend this hotel.

review_title: Historic hotel with a great staff in uptown Charlotte!
review_text: From Pete the bartender to Pete at the front desk, the staff rocks. The location is great and the rooms are comfortable well cleaned. I'd highly recommend the Dunhill hotel. Many celebs including Bonnie Raitt, James Worthy, Paul McCartney and Alycia Keys have stayed here too.

This quaint luxury hotel nestled in the heart of the Queen's City uptown area is a pleasant get away from the hustle and bustle of city life. The rooms are comfortably welcoming and well appointed. In your room is a refrigerator stocked with complimentary water and soda awaiting your arrival. The staff is very accommodating and full of Southern charm. I can't wait until my next visit.

review_title: Couldn't ask for a better hotel!
review_text: First of all, where could you go wrong with a hotel that gives you 3 free alcoholic beverages every evening??? The staff was above and beyond friendly and helpful. Room was perfectly clean and spacious, bed and pillows comfy, and breakfast was delicious. The rates were very reasonable. My only complaint is that if you're going to be out all night and need to sleep in, be sure and display your do not disturb sign. The morning we were checking out, housekeeping was banging on our door at 815 wanting to clean our room. Other than that, you absolutely can't beat this hotel!!

review_title: Great hotel especially if you are wanting to Park and Fly out of Charlotte
review_text: We stayed at the Hyatt Place before flying out the next morning. The hotel is easy to find right off of the interstate. The rooms are very spacious with a separate sitting area that includes a pull out sofa. We paid a little extra to leave our car there for the week, but it was still less than airport parking. The rooms were very modern and clean. The staff was friendly. It is within walking distance to some places to get a bite to eat. The have a small area that you can order drinks and a limited menu. The Quesadillas were really yummy. The shuttle runs every 30 minutes. I enjoyed my stay here.

review_title: 2-yr old hotel feels more like 10-yrs old. Dirty and worn-down.
review_text: This is not an old hotel, but you would never know that. One if the most worn- down dirty Hampton Inns that we have ever stayed at. We are local to Charlotte, but stayed here because my husband was running in a race that started and finished outside the hotel, so we stayed here for the convenience. I wouldn't recommend it to friends or family coming in to visit.

review_title: Hotel de lujo en todos los sentidos.
review_text:
Creo que esta fue la primera vez que me aloje en un resort de estas caracteristicas y quede impresionado. Es enorme y precioso, con unos jardines que son lo mejor para dar un paseo. Fui a Phoenix para asistir a WM26 y este era el hotel ofrecido dentro del pack platinum.
Eso si, coche necesario si o si!

review_title: uno degli alberghi piÃ¹ belli nei quali abbia mai dormito
review_text: ho dormito una notte in quest'albergo nell'agosto 2011. Saremmo rimasti a phoenix solo una notte ma alla fine complice la stanchezza abbiamo deciso di non uscire : ci dispiaceva lasciare quel paradiso. We stayed here for one night for a wedding. The room was huge, there was a separate sitting area, the bed was comfortable, the TV was hage! It was great. I felt like we were staying in a much more expensive, higher end hotel!

From the moment you walk into the lobby of this hotel there is a feeling of luxury and comfort. Staff is friendly and professional. Amenities are clean and up to date from the gorgeous fitness room to the salt water pool that is kept at a comfortable temperature. Located close to great restaurants and shopping. This is definitely one of my favourites and I look forward to going back!

"Location is great, right off the freeway. Clean, spacious rooms. Bathroom is in need of a Reno and tub surround looked old and stained. The beds were comfy and the room had a bar fridge, sink and large seating area with a HUGE flat screen TV. Breakfast was continental with a pretty good selection of fruit, cereals, breads and yogurt. If you wanted eggs/omelettes, you could order it over the counter and was reasonably priced. The staff were very nice and polite."

I travel to Charlotte at least 10 times a year, I will will not stay anywhere else, this hotel is the best from the staff and location. I thought at first I was getting bite by bugs, later to find out the comforter is made with down feathers and I was allergic. I now request that the down be replaced with a blanket before my arrival and it has worked like a charm. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone coming to Charlotte.

review_text: I chose this airport hotel because I had to fly out of Charlotte after a long day of meetings in the Asheville area. The front desk clerk was very friendly and quick, which I certainly appreciated! The lobby was simple but nice. The rooms are large and well appointed, but could use some updating (carpet especially). Breakfast was very good And I especially liked the coffee! Overall, I would give this hotel high marks and would definitely stay here again.
Clean, good sized room; free guest laundry; continental b'fast; free Internet and close to restaurants. Staff very friendly & helpful! We were only there 1 night but would happy stay there longer.

review_title: Just as the other reviews state
review_text: This hotel was an excellent choice. Just about everything was depicted on reviews. The only problem I had was the housekeeper trying to eye my fiancee when she thought I wasn't looking, so ladies make sure you don't slack off, other than that an excellent stay.

review_title: Fantastic staff, outstanding rooms, great location!
review_text: Thanks Jennifer for exceeding our expectations for the arrangements and accommodations this past week/weekend with my daughter's wedding block of rooms. From the moment my daughter and I met with you last Tuesday, I knew this was going to be a great spot for the folks staying in the 12 rooms. Everyone were delighted with your facility. Absolutely is one of the best experiences ever!!! Thanks so very much.

This was my 3rd time staying here. Each time gets better. The location is great, service is great and now that all the rooms have been renovated, they are wonderful. Plus, the beds are wonderful! I absolutely love this hotel and hopefully will have a 4th visit.

Recently visited Charlotte for the first time on business. My company choose this hotel for some unusual reason. I am not entirely sure why considering how far we were from our manufacturing plant. Anyway...
Overall, it was a pleasant stay and a great hotel for business. 
Beds are GREAT! Staff are extremely friendly. Gym was over the top! 
For all my needs, this hotel was perfect.

review_title: Great stay.Can't wait to go back.
review_text: Had a nice mini weekend vacation.Rooms were nice and clean, the beds were like sleeping on a cloud.Hotel staff were nice, friendly and very knowledgeable about the area.Can't wait to return.

review_title: Secluded ultramodern styling that's energy efficient
review_text: If you like very modern styling in your hotels, this is for you. It appeals to those who like lofts (go figure) or rehabbed warehouses- that's the feel of the rooms at this hotel. I felt like I was stepping onto the bridge of a starship, complete with a hologram meeting you at the door- pretty cool. The rooms have an industrial feel that isn't very warm and cozy. They are clean and bare and efficient (your key card 'powers' the room, as in, no power without it being 'plugged in'). There are not many things nearby, but are a close drive away. The customer service is top notch. There's a bar, pool open until 1, and breakfast made to order. This hotel definitely caters to a younger hip crowd. Check out my photos.
Room 234 had a very musty smell. We all woke up with sore throats. The bed sheets did not fit the beds and kept coming off

review_title: Was a 10 but very disappointed now
review_text: When I've stayed at this Wyndam hote in the past it has been amazing with service that was untouchable and a very welcoming staff. This last visit my colleague complained about one of the front desk staff being rude to her. I was shocked because this has been an amazing hotel and my company uses it frequently, the front desk know my executive by name. First the tub was backed up, to say drained slow would be an understatement, and the shower leaked all over the floor. It took two days for them to fix and still the shower leaked. The maid service was pretty bad and not once did they leave me clean glasses I had to wash them each night in the sink with shampoo. My last night I asked if I could grab milk and a little cereal and was told no. I've always been accomodatining with a request like this the manager even searched for wine one night for me. One would assume a request like that wouldn't be so hard considering the hotel isn't conveniant to any resteraunt for those of us that have no means of ground transportation when staying. I was just very disappointed in my visit especially compared to past visits. I'm going to say I'd recommend based on past visits but I do hope my visit is much better.
hotel_name: Wingate by Wyndham Charlotte Airport South/ I-77 Tyvola

review_text: I stayed in a double room on the 5th floor over the Thankgiving holiday. I was hesitant to book based on what other reviewers wrote about the room size. I found the double room (2 queen beds) to have quite enough room for my wife, 10 year old daughter and I. The rooms are very functional and well designed. The lack of a dresser would only be a problem on a long stay. The little shop downstairs was well stocked with fruit and other healthy choices. The bar had good specials and the staff was friendly. The price was good with AAA discount for what we got. I would stay here again. We had stayed at the Ballantyne resort in previous years. This was half the price and almost as nice.

review_title: Reminded me of my favorite minimalist hotel in Athens
review_text: Had recently stayed in a boutique hotel in a very trendy section of Athens (Kolonaki). The Aloft had the same vibe as the Hotel Periscope - very hip for this middle aged old lady! Chose the Aloft because it was pet friendly, and ended up with much more than expected.

review_title: Great location.... If you are flying.
review_text: I stayed here with a deal booked through hotels.com. I was visiting friends in different parts of the city, and this hotel had the best deal. Excellent front desk service. Room was clean, except didn't seem to be vacuumed. A tshirts was left on the floor from a previous guest also. Excellent room location. Crowded parking lot. Breakfast was ok, typical continental breakfast. I love the tvs in the lobby. I am a woman and was traveling alone and I felt safe the whole weekend. I'd stay here again.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn and Suites Charlotte Airport

review_text: My husband and I have stayed at several Towneplace Suite properties throughout texas. This one was newer and very clean. The kitchenette was updated with nice appliances and the flooring was much improved. The rate was reasonable and the front desk staff was very accommodating. If you are looking for trendy and modern, this is not the place for you. If you want clean, great price, location to the downtown area and main attractions and a kitchenette to help with your food budget this is the place to be!

We were here or a hairshow back in October & I have to say this was such a wonderful little hotel. Breakfast was great. Everything you could possibly want was served! Happy hour was good & the girls in the front desk were super helpful! Overall the experience was great! Quiet location, even after being filled with crazy hairstylist(hairshow) & cowboys(some kinda horse show). 
p.s. Our instructors & others stayed at a high priced hotel & when the girls & I told them what Quality Inn, boy did they wish they were here!

Our company hosted our annual executive meetings here. We are a small group, but you would of never of guessed it. From the bid process, through our meetings to our checkout the hotel blew away their other "diamond" competitors in the area. While not the cheapest choice, we are very, very glad we choose this world class location!

review_title: One of the best in Charlotte!!
review_text: Without a doubt, a great hotel in the middle of downtown-probably the best in the city. Walk across the street to the epicenter for a late movie. Great service. Green hotel. Rooms very clean and well appointed. Can't go wrong here. Hotel less than 2 yrs old.

My wife and I enjoyed our stay at the Super 8. We travel quite frequently and always try to find a quality a hotel at a budget price, sometimes theyâ€™re hit or miss and this certainly was a hit for us. We traveled all the way from Louisiana and made really good timing, we were extremely tired from the overnight drive and the clerk allowed us to check in early. The staff was courteous in our request to have a first floor room. We were quite iffy when going to our rooms because of some of the reviews that we had read the night before but overall were satisfied. Everything was clean and comfortable, not sure if this was an upgraded room or not but it had a microwave and a fridge. Couldâ€™ve used some firmer pillows. Hotel was very close to stockyards - about a 10 min drive. The desk clerk was very nice in printing me some directions to get to downtown and giving me some good places to eat around there. Breakfast was okay, there was a line for the waffles so we didnâ€™t end up eating those, they ran out of fruit. We just ended up going to McDonaldâ€™s right next door. We will definitely be coming back on the way back home, in fact, the clerk already made the reservation for me.

If you want the very best this is for you. 
Quality at every turn.
Dinning option is 5 star nothing less then the best.
 Crown Royal bottoms up! Enjoy with friends...

review_title: Simple rooms, cute bistro, decent location
review_text: Average hotel in a decent location in the city. A bonus is how close it is to the river and it's trails. For Active people it's a great location to get your morning workout in with a decent view. Sometimes heard the trains as others reviewed but it's not as bad as they said. My only complaint is how late in the day the come to turn over your room.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Fort Worth University Drive

review_text: My husband stayed here a couple of nights after our wedding as a make shift honeymoon since neither of us were able to go far that weekend. The service was above and beyond, the facilities are beautiful, and the location is fantastic. Very pleased.

review_title: You could not pay me to deal with week end management the most disrespectful awful manered women in the world.Dirty/crooked
review_text: I will say other than the weekend manager who locked us out of our room while at work when we made arrangements to settle up with them when we returned, we were denied entry to our room and not let back in for more than 4 hours later when we held good to our word of payment had balance and another advance payment for more stay when finally getting into our room our dogs 2 small chiuauas were without water and food not to mention they were denied outside bathroom breaks for another 4 hours. When finally let back in and paid in full questioned management and was totally amazed by the unprofessionalism and degrading response of manager telling us corprate made that decision and proceeded to lie about feeding and watering our dogs. When we told her we were going to call corp. We were forced to move. By far do they have any class or respect. She did find time to go through our personal items. Violated that's how we feel
hotel_name: Crossland Economy Studios - Fort Worth - Fossil Creek

review_title: I found the staff to be professional and accommodating.
review_text: I arrived 11:00 pm to attend a funeral the next morning, not having a reservation, the staff attended to my needs and went above and beyond to accommodate my family & I in our time of need.

review_title: Comfy bed! Nice lakeside with playground, boardwalk and restaurants!
review_text: We will def. stay here again!! It was perfect for our toddler to get out and stretch his legs on our long road trip. The staff gave us complementary drinks and appetizers because the executive lounge was closed for the thanksgiving week. Great deal! Beautiful walking around the lake and the BBQ restaurant was awesome! Must Go!!

review_title: Good price for a good stay
review_text: On our way to Austin we decided to stay in this hotel for the night, it is located right next to the highway so it is convenient if you are just stopping on your way. the hotel look is average and a bit old but it all seemed clean and the bed was very comfortable. The only bad thing i noticed is the walls are very thin so we could hear the people around. I recommend this hotel if you are just stopping for a night or two, it is a very good price with free parking and breakfast.
hotel_name: Baymont Inn & Suites Fort Worth South

review_text: Fabulous hotel, would stay again next time in Charlotte!
Unlike many Marriott properties I have stayed at lately, this one actually had very fast Internet. Otherwise, it is clean and the service is decent. There are several good restaurants nearby.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Fort Worth Downtown/Blackstone

review_text: Staff was not friendly or courteous. Things were stolen from my room when staff were cleaning. When I complained nothing was done. The water in the hotel smells awful. The complimentary breakfast costs 3 bucks each morning. My mattress had blood and urine stains on it. Again when I complained nothing was done and they told me if I continued to complain they would throw me out. Also everyone beware this motel has BED BUGS!!! They will not admit they have them. However when a fellow guest caught a few of them the staff was quoted saying "these are not the bed bugs we usually have" on top of all this they decided they would check me out with out telling me....while there was an ice storm and I could not find another hotel since it is superbly week....do yourself a favor and go somewhere else...this place is the worst place I've ever stayed at and should be shut down immediately!

I was down during the superbowl and my stay was horrible.The first night it was so hot we had to sleep with the door opens because the a/c unit only blew hot air. The shower was dirty and you never knew if the water was going to be freezing cold or burning hot. The third night we were there my roomate broke out with rashes all over his body and had to go the emergency room and get shots and medication for bug bites . We had to change rooms and the second room was not any better ! If you have any type of allergies or do not like dirty , dusty places do not stay here !!!!!

review_title: Stay away or sleep with your clothes on.
review_text:
So...we arrived late and I wasn't overly impressed. Said that it seemed unclean, but then...I worry a lot anyhow. With my worrying head on...I slept fully clothed, but sadly my boyfriend didn't. He woke up covered in bed bug bites. They are clearly bed bug bites too. I will upload some photos.
The lady on reception is exactly as everyone else describes and is rude, unhelpful and makes you feel like a complete inconvenience.
It is in a great place and has great potential, but sadly it's ruined.

review_title: Extremely HOT and poor service. Beware!
review_text:
Our room was extremely hot. Upon arrival, air conditioners were not turned on in our 2nd floor room on a 90+ degree day. Room was still 85 degrees after we turned the AC on and returned 6 hours later. We were promised a room with working AC in the morning. This room too had a malfunctioning air conditioner and ended up at temps in excess of 85 degrees by the evening. Staff was rude and not very accommodating. We requested a partial refund, but we were told this was not possible. 
The hotel reeks of middle eastern food because the family the runs the hotel also lives there. It was filthy too. The continental breakfast consists of stale Fruit Loops and Raisin Bran. Windows are painted shut. Mold on shower curtains. 
I have stayed here several times in the past and the previous owner was wonderful to deal with and kept the hotel in tip-top shape. This is very sad that such a beautiful hotel in the heart of the Fort Worth Stockyards is being run like this. 
I encourage anyone else that has had a bad experience to contact Magnuson Hotels and report them. Magnuson currently provides them representation online and makes their reservations.

review_title: Great service at reception, room very comfortable and excellent value
review_text:
We stayed at this hotel for 2 nights and as soon as we arrived the staff were very helpful
Their local knowledge helped us decide where to go shopping and the hotel free courtesy bus to anywhere local is a great idea
hotel_name: Radisson Hotel Ft Worth - Fossil Creek

review_text: This renovated Motel 6 has very clean, updated rooms. The neighborhood is probably not the best, but they do have a friendly security guard patrolling at night.
Pretty average stay, it was ok, we got it on priceline, but it was just ok. Nothing spectacular.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Fort Worth Fossil Creek

review_text: I stayed here for four days the beds was very comfortable. Probably the best thing. The mini fridges doesn't get very cold,nor does the a/c. Been on the lowest temperature and never gets very cold.for the price.don't think I will stay here again.rooms are small old tv stayed in better for alot cheaper.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Fort Worth Fossil Creek

review_title: Our stay was so traveler and family friendly.
review_text: We've stayed at aloft before and overall the experience was good. This aloft in particular was awesome. All alofts come with the same services/amenities, but the service at this one was incredible. Everyone really went out their way to make our stay comfortable. We traveled with our 2 little ones, ages 4 and 2, and everyone was super nie to them. We love the aloft model. It is definitely a great value. There are many dining and shopping options nearby. We came to Charlotte to do some of the touristy things...NASCAR Hall of Fame, Latta Plantation, DISCOVERY Kids, and we just hopped on the interstate near the aloft.

review_title: Avoid this place like the plague
review_text:
Be forewarned, this place is a dump in the middle of no where. If you don't rent a car at the airport you will be trapped on this dismal property. Don't believe the website photos...they must have been photoshopped big time.
The guest rooms are crazy small, smells moldy, and are dimly lit. The bed is rock hard. I like a good firm mattress, but this was like sleeping on a plank.
If you must attend a conference here, do yourself a favor and stay off property, even if it's only one night. One night here is one too many.
hotel_name: American Airlines Training and Conference Center

review_text:
Paris Brown was the check in clerk and he acknowledged me as a Priority Club Gold member and accommodated me with my request for top floor, end of hall next to stairs. He also gave me a voucher for breakfast. 
I will return for stay because of him and his attitude. A very nice, polite young man. 
Thanks,
Francis Carmon
Priority Club Gold member.

review_title: My second home. Staff is like family!
review_text:
Unexpected stay. We were in Charlotte for the Coca Cola 600 but never made it. My wife had to have emergency surgery. The staff here helped me with a room for the week. They even upgraded the room to the Hhonors level which was amazing. The staff treated me and my two small children like family making an unexpected stay feel like we had never left our home. They are truly amazing so helpful. They ask each day how my wife is doing and if I need anything for her. They have gone as far as to give me additional toiletries to bring to her to make her hospital stay more comfortable. Special thanks to the following staff members,
Thomas
Lexsa 
Elena
Kim
Carlos
Fanny
Krysta
Mr. Afriyie 
Kaitlyn
Marretta

The staff could not have been more welcoming and helpful. A happy smile and friendly service at check in makes all the difference but the staff continued to check we were happy in the pool, at breakfast and every time we passed by the lobby. The rooms are clean and very comfortable and this hotel has everything you need including a great location near the Fort Worth Stock Yards. They also let us have a late check out at no extra cost!
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Fort Worth North

review_text: We had a pleasant stay! The room was nice, big, & clean. The bed was comfortable. We had a beautiful view of the city lit up. Staff was friendly. This hotel is pet friendly and there is no charge. The only complaints is having to pay $15 for parking and there isn't a great dog walking area.
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text:
On April16,2011 I began a new chapter in my life with the help of the Hilton University Place the location for my wedding ceremony and reception. Jenna Yates,wedding specialist, made all of my day so special from the moment I met her up until the day of the event she was ever so helpful and accomadating to my ever changing needs simply an angel!!!!!! My guest are still raving about the food the location and the beautifulsetting for a wedding!!!! My experience with the Hilton was in one word 
remarkable and stress free!!! With the Hilton and Jenna as your wedding specialist you have absolutey nothing to stress over I highly recommend the Hilton for your next event

You can't beat this hotel for the value. We paid $70/night. Its only 4 miles to the Stockyards. The lobby is very clean & upscale looking. Service was great! Allowed us to check in 2 hrs early. Rooms were decent. Only con is you can hear the freeway but the AC drowned it out. Would recommend!
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Fort Worth North

review_title: Good choice for out of town location
review_text: From the moment of walking through the entrance to checking out , we were made to feel so welcome and a valued guest. The food choices were varied and fresh. Would recommend booking executive suite if your budget allows - let you find out the extra benefits as it was a most pleasant surprise. It was bit too early for outside pool but with the warmer weather we were able to enjoy the adjacent boardwalk facilities. There are numerous functions regularly held nut we found these did not detract from the high level of service we experienced. This was our first of 4 different hotels we stayed on our 'virgin ' trip to USA - the staff got us off to a great start . We do conclude our Usa journey with our last 2 nights stay on 22/23 Apr back at this hotel- I am sure our welcome will be as good as our first

After reading some negative reviews we were a bit dubious about staying here but it turned out great. The hotel was clean and the staff were very friendly. The shuttle service was great to get to the stockyards. Standard chain hotel breakfast but plenty of choices. The room was very quiet which was ideal to sleep after a long flight. We stayed two nights and on our second day plenty of clean towels and toiletries replenished. The only negative thing I could say is that the hotel allows pets and I think the smell always lingers, also only wired internet access in the room. Overall though, no complaints.

For the price I expected SO much more. The room looked NOTHING like the photo. We had a tiny approx 48"x24" window facing a wall and AC unit. NO VIEW. Like being in prison. Room 304. It shouldn't even be allowed to be sold to people. The room was big and the shower head was awesome as was flat screen HD. That's all I can say good about it. Room service had to come from a great restaurant but that restaurant is a fortune. My daughter and I were treating ourselves to a mom and daughter night off and we were so sad when we opened the door to our room.. :(. I didn't complain tho because there was so much trouble checking in I was too put out to bother. I know that's my fault. But still. Had the photos looked like the room itd been nice. But the window with a view of the city is the whole point! :(
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text:
We stayed here over the weekend and we weren't that impressed. The walls were pretty thin and our bathroom was tiny!
Located at the end of the dt area and parking was fairly expensive. Decent place to stay but nothing great.
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text:
I picked this hotel based upon a previous Sheraton hotel and this hotel was a slight disappointment. The lobby is very nice looking. Once you get to the rooms, you can tell they are old. The bathroom was the most telling. When I turned on the water, at first, it was completely rusty!! 
The front desk staff was not very friendly and didnt seem to want to help me with a late check out the next day. 
The hotel is at the opposite end from Sundance Square and not really walkable. It is right across the street from the water garden.
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text: We travel often to Fort Worth. Usually we stay at a very expensive downtown hotel and have stayed in equally expensive hotels near TCU. We stayed at the Hyatt Place last year when every hotel in the city was booked out. Now it is a top choice when we go to FW --and this was our 3rd stay. Why? Clean. Inexpensive. Well appointed rooms with huge flat screen tv, divided seating area and excellent computer connectivity and charging station in every room. It is very very convenient both to TCU and all the supply shopping you need for your student. (target, Costco, container store). Every large chain restaurant imaginable is close by. The staff is helpful but you need to be patient as this is not full service luxury. Confirm and reconfirm your late check in because they have a line of people waiting for a no show room to free up. Best to get that done at the 800 number where fluent English is assured. Breakfast ok but they have better food and coffee for sale. We will go back. It a bargain and we have always had a good experience.
This hotel has everything you would need, but a little pricey. Definitely great service and accommodating.
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text: Stay at this property on a regular basis. Overall hotel is clean and in good condition. During my most recent stay, there were repeated problems with loud guests at night...and like many hotels...the staff could not compel these individuals to quiet down and would not remove them from the hotel. After traveling for many years, I am still perplexed why hotels will not expel guests who refuse to quiet down at night, and act in a disrespectful manner towards other guests. This is an industry wide problem, but because of the Most recent issue, I can not recommend the property.
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text: We are from the FW area but needed a night out. Got a great rate on a King room. Very clean, spacious, staff were very friendly. Would definitely recommend. It's a bit farther south than Sundance Square but still walking distance or a very cheap cab ride. Had a few drinks at Shula's and it was nice. The menu looked pretty good. Chose valet over self-parking bc it's garage.
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text: My wife and I are travel agents and have to say it was an ok stay the room was very nice but the bathroom was very small compared to other 3 to 4 stars chain. The other problems was at check in the clerk that we had was not very friendly. We also had to carry our bell cart up to our room not what we expected for a hotel that is as nice. We also called down to see if we could get some one to pick up the cart and never got an answer all three times that we called. Now the spa was awesome according to my wife best service in the whole hotel. The restaurant needs help. But overall we really enjoyed ourselves will stay here again for the spa
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text: Place was god. Found someone's half full Starbucks cup on the bathroom counter when I checked in but otherwise it was good. Free internet and great location.
hotel_name: Sheraton Fort Worth Hotel and Spa

review_text: I was impressed with the hotel the minute the super polite shuttle driver picked me up at the airport. After a super short ride, I arrived at a very clean and modern hotel. This location featured a business center with unlimited printing, a large hot tub, and a fitness center. My room was enormous. It featured a large sitting area, a desk with numerous electrical outlets, a fridge with a modern coffee pod machine and wet bar area, neutrogena toiletries including conditioner and eye makeup remover, two phones including one cordless, and a friendly, helpful staff.
hotel_name: Wingate by Wyndham Charlotte Airport South/ I-77 Tyvola

review_text: Very nice, clean and well kept hotel. I am always impressed by Wingate hotels and this one met my expectations. The suite was spacious and properly maintained. I have no complaints! This will be my hotel of choice when in the Charlotte area!
hotel_name: Wingate by Wyndham Charlotte Airport South/ I-77 Tyvola

review_title: A new take on boring hotels
review_text: In town for a few nights and really enjoyed the hotel. They try a little too hard to be hip, but its better than being boring. Nice rooms, friendly staff. Would stay again when in town.

I am not sure what Trip Advisor uses to rate hotels. During this trip we stayed at both the Ritz Carlton, rated #8 and Hilton University Place, rated #4. One would assume that #4 would be a nicer hotel than #8. Wrong!! When we drove up to the Hilton, I was hoping we were in the wrong place. The hotel exterior was drab and depressing. One would think that the Presidential Suite would be nice. Wrong again! The furniture in the room was old and shabby. The glass on the dining table had crumbs and grunge underneath it, visible from the top. We were so unhappy that we left 2 hours after checking in, booked an earlier flight and flew home one day earlier than planned. I must say that the hotel staff was very accomodating and polite, they were the only positive thing about the Hilton University Place. Not a nice way to end a wonderful vacation!

review_title: Dated, in need of a re-model
review_text:
There is nothing wrong with this hotel if you had arrived here 20 years ago when it was new. However, now, the carpet is old, the paint is old, the dining options limited and the prices are expensive. It needs a refresh with so many better more affordable alternatives nearby (i.e. the Hampton Inn and Sheraton that are just north of the airport are both nice and more affordable in general). 
On the plus side - good shuttle to the airport, the fitness room is in good shape with new equipment, and the staff is generally helpful if not friendly. Full TV selection including showtime and "suite" style rooms. 
On the negative side, very dated, looks and appears worn, they charge for wifi unless you work a deal in advance, and the food in the restaurant and bar is at best ok - but nothing special - and is over-priced. 
Personally, I would rather stay at the Hampton which lacks the amenities but it is very clean and comfortable and has a great staff. If you want full amenties I would recommend the Sheraton.

review_title: Nice hotel well worth the money
review_text: The hotel was great, but the added fees for internet, and the $50 refundable deposit per night were a little unecpected... great value for the price though

I went to Charlotte NC on an overnight business trip, and mngde these reservations online. The photographs on the site were nice, but they did the hotel no justice. When I arrived, I was pleasantly surprised by the exterior of the building, tall and pleasing to the eye. When I walked in through the revolving door, I was amazed by how beautiful the interior was. I had a suite on the 6th floor. In the entryway was a huge open dining area and bar. The hotel floors were square shaped, with the rooms opening onto the floor passageway which overlooked the central dining area. All of it was beautifully lit from a skylight/window far above in the roof. On every level there were plants that ringed the open area that looked down below. 
The room itself was a very nicely furnished suite with a separate bedroom and living room. The decorations and furniture were tasteful. There were 2 large LCD TVs, one in the bedroom and one in the living area. All said, I had a very enjoyable overnight here, and will definitely book here again should my travels take me to Charlotte NC. I am not sure on what that price was, because I purchased a travel package flight/hotel/rental car, but I believe it was around $99.

the price was right and the staff very nice. The room was large and mostly clean with the exception of several sticky spots on the rug near the bathroom entrance. Good check out time and not far from the botanic gardens and zoo.
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Ft. Worth North/At Fossil Creek

review_title: Nice, clean and away from downtown!
review_text: Although my husband and I prefer Fairfields or smaller chains, this was very nice and the staff were all friendly! It was also tucked away from everything, but only 6 miles to a large, very nice mall. Enjoyed our stay! The food in the restaurant also wasn't bad!!!!

This hotel was immaculate. We stayed during a convention that we came into town for and couldn't be happier with the hotel itself. The only downfall is the location. However, the hotel did an amazing job of providing a shuttle to the local lightrail station where we could ride the train directly to the arena downtown. Overall it was a great experience!

This was our first time ever staying at Renaissance. This is a beautiful hotel. The breakfast was excellent. The rooms are large enough for families. I particularly like the fact that the beds are separated by a door making the bedroom private.

Used by business travelers, but good for families with kids. Pull out couch/living area, great for kids. Separate king bedroom WITH door!
Pool is nice. Very clean

review_title: Nice rooms with a Filthy pool and spa area
review_text: I visited the Renaissance hotel in May of 2011. The rooms were nice but housekeeping service was much to be desired. When I returned to the room after the room was cleaned I found muddy shoe prints on the bathroom floor. When I told housekeeping about it they eventually cleaned it after insinuating that we dirtied the floor. The spa had some kind of dirty film of foam floating on top and the pool was dingy. The attendant said they would get to it in two hours. I came back three hours later and it wasn't done. Yuck!!!

This hotel has nice rooms and great staff. Tere is no free breakfast, but they do have a breakfast buffet and a grill/bar that you can pay for. We didn't eat at the breakfast buffet, but it smelled good. The location is adequate as you are near some decent eating and such. However, at the time of this review, there is construction on the freeway which is a pain to navigate. My only complaint about this hotel is that the bed we slept on was
As not very comfortable. My wife says it was fine, but I guess I slept in the one spot on the king size bed that everyone else slept on as I felt like I sank when I sat/laid there.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Fort Worth Alliance Airport

review_title: 1st try at a Drury and I am SUPER impressed. Wish you had more locations.
review_text: My most important things are Cleanliness, Location, Staff Friendliness, View and Age of hotel. This Drury was all of that plus they allowed dogs for NO CHARGE and had a FREE breakfast. Normally dog hotels are a dump, NOT this place it's nicer than some of the higher end hotels I have stayed. The breakfast was self serve and just fine. We traveled 12hrs that day with the kids and dogs. When we arrived the room was ready, Cathy from the front desk was so nice and had a huge smile on her face. The room was a decent size at a very fair rate from web price. I definitely WOULD RECOMMEND recommend if passing thru with or without pets. My tough rating scale 92.

review_title: A beautiful hotel with great service
review_text: My husband and I stayed here for a night after his holiday party in the hotel's ballroom. The lobby area is beautiful and check in was quick and easy. I was concerned that our view wouldn't be great as we were on the back side of the hotel, but we had a great view of White River State Park. Ask for a higher floor and either side will have a great view. The room was very large and exceptionally clean and well appointed. A mistake on our bill was quickly taken care of and we had a great night in the hotel. We would recommend the hotel to anyone coming to Indy for a stay.
The hotel has that airport look and needs to be renovated but the beds are newer and comfy. The staff is very friendly and they offer a free coffee bar. Overall it was a great stay and value!

review_title: Bad experience with long delayed check in and poor hotel service in the elite lounge.
review_text: I had expected a better hotel that other Marriott locations we have stayed at before. As a platinum elite member I had hopes for this location while taking my family here but was greatly disappointed. Upon arrival after 4:00 room was not ready. We had to wait an hour and half for housekeeping after being told it would take only 30 minutes. We had plan on shopping but lost value time waiting on JW. It would have taken longer if we had not ask what was taking so long. Found out they forgot about us. We waited in the lounge for elite members but they appeared to be unprepared as there were no snacks available and would not restock. Also upon our return in the evening the lounge was was also out of dessert and was told sorry again due to being unprepared again. Room was OK but rather small compared to other Marriott locations we have visited. Currently considering canceling future reservations due to poor service. The hotel is a long walk to anywhere interesting other than the convention center. Forget about carrying shopping bags from the Circle Centre.
This is a great place to stay. The staff is great, the rooms are new and clean, and the food and drinks at dinner time are high quality.

We stayed here for the Big Ten football championship & everything was first class. The staff is very professional & polite, from the valet to the front desk clerk to the bell hop.
The room is very well decorated & we had a great view of the city from the 30th floor. We had access to the Executive Lounge, which I highly recommend...free Pepsi products & snacks.
The location is perfect for attending a football game or any other event in the downtown area. I highly recommend the JW Marriott for the traveler that likes to be pampered. :-)

review_title: Clean rooms & friendly staff for a great value.
review_text: I have stayed here several times over the last couple of months and will be staying several more times in the coming months. I've also stayed at several other hotels in Charlotte and this one is tops for value and friendly staff. They really make you feel at home.

I stayed at the JW last month for a conference. I live in Indianapolis, so I only stayed one night at this hotel for a four day conference. The rooms are very similar to any other JW. They are very clean and the materials used throughout are of high qualities. The bathroom was very large, and contained a great multi-shower head shower. 
I only stayed one night, but with my Marriott rewards, I had access to the club level lounge. This was a nice feature as well. There were plenty if options for breakfast, and an evening cocktail. Finally, as eapected, the service at this hotel is top notch! Several employees have been assigned to different areas of this hotel, so if you need anything...someone will be waiting to help!
If you are able to secure a decent rate at this hotel (the prices seem to always be changing), the experience is worth it!!
Stayed here while our belongings were in transit. Very friendly and accomodating staff. Near some very good restaurants (Firebirds at he mall across the street).

We were originally quoted $225 per night to stay here; good hotel, but not worth that much. We were able to get a 119 rate, and this hotel is worth every penny. Very clean, free parking, great location.
hotel_name: Residence Inn Fort Worth Cultural District

review_text:
Clint & Jennifer were amazing!!! They went over & above all expectations! 
 I wish I had both of them as part of my staff in my ofc. They are the epitome of excellent customer service.

review_title: The only thing good is the location
review_text: We stayed at this hotel to attend a wedding. The location was perfect. When we checked in at 12:30 we were informed we would have to wait until 3:00 because no rooms were clean. We came back at 3:00 and were told we would have to wait until 5:00. We strongly objected and did receive a room. There was no need for the snobbishness. The door jam of our hotel room was not square with the door and let in a great deal of light. The bell hops and room service staff were very nice. We were under impressed with the front desk staff. The hotel is showing it's age. The rudeness at check in was unacceptable.

We rarely stay at the same hotel more than once because we always feel we'll find a better hotel/resort on our next trip. Well, NO MORE!! This is our second stay in less than two months. The customer service surpasses all others, however, we do have a favorite and his name is Rafik. I've worked in customer service for many years and it's so refreshing to receive the same superior level of service that I strive to give. Rafik allowed us to check in early so we could get an earlier tee time, upgraded us to the concierge floor, AND fixed my husband's iPhone. This dude is the real deal. By the way, we brought our entire summer basketball team and their families on this visit so they can also experience a little slice of DFW heaven!!!!!
hotel_name: Marriott Hotel & Golf Club at Champions Circle

review_title: Places like this are going to run the so-called "5 Stars" out of business.
review_text: It's all taken care of. Nice room, parking, breakfast, dinner, and plenty to drink(alcohol and non). No hidden charges to speak of. There is nothing about Drury or their staff that is not 5 star.

review_title: If Holiday Inn has free Wi-Fi, shouldn't Renaissance?
review_text:
Since I work on the road, I need/like to feel at home in a hotel. The rooms were very clean, very nice, but I wish they would have spent less on the fancy AV box to make room for WiFi. $13 per day for internet? That's almost as bad as some of the airline fees! In my line of work the hotel is chosen for me, and it's never good to show up to my temporary home to find I can't access important info! 
If you are traveling for vacation, it's great. If you are traveling for business, you might be better off somewhere else.

review_title: One of my best experiences with Marriott.
review_text: A friend and I stayed here Halloween weekend. Quite simply one of the best Marriotts where I have stayed. The lobby, common spaces and rooms are tastefully designed. Rooms are more spacious than at most marriotts, and we had an excellent view of the white river park. Concierge lounge was fully stocked, had excellent view of downtown, and best of all is open on weekends. One of the best hotel fitness rooms I have seen. And paid under $100 a night, and were even comped for the valet parking. Staff was very friendly, no line at check in. Definitely would stay again any time I am in Indy.

Very clean and well maintained hotel. Rooms are nice, but average sized. Shower was excellent. Pool is small, but gym is very nice. Upgrading to include the evening reception and breakfast is well worth it. The staff here are terrific.

Me and my boyfriend stayed in both this one in charlotte and the one in greensboro while visiting the area to look for an apartment. The staff are so nice and friendly and really take care of your needs. The rooms are really beautiful,clean and the best that ive ever seen! The free breakfast and 5/530 kickbacks are pretty good! Love the baked potatoes! Anybody visiting either area should definitely check out the chain because they are awesome! You get a lot with the price paid!

review_title: Best Hotel Ive stayed in ever....
review_text: Well what can I say about this place. Friendly helpful staff, trouble free speedy check-in and a large exceptionally clean room with inclusive free wi-fi, breakfast drinks and snacks! This place is superb value and I cant wait to come back. Me and the girlfriend came to thd us from ireland and also stayed in hotels in new york (un plaza hotel) and in chicago (central loop hotel) and in our honest opinion this place was far superior for less cost. Almost afraid to rate this place too much incase i cant get a room when we decide to come back!

review_title: Great semi parking. Quiet, off the freeway.
review_text: Courteous staff. Upgraded rooms. Hotel is behind others on a hill providing privacy and quiet.
