review_text: What a fantastic view. Lucky enough to get a corner room and with the floor to ceiling windows the view was spectacular at day and night. Well worth for this reason alone. Service good. Room was very tastefully decorated. Breakfast excellent. A few minor disappointments: had to ask for a second robe twice, wifi was not free as advertised, car parking expensive and there was no fridge in room. These disappointments were far outweighed by the many positives found in this hotel. A great stay. Well worth it!
It was clean and modern. Liked the view from the room that I stayed. The staffs are very friendly. I will definitely stay in the Marriott again when I go visit in IN. The best hotel in IN!!!!!

review_title: That's what I am talking about
review_text:
Finally I great hotel that makes sense. Great service, great people, friendly hotel staff willing to make your stay as comfortable as possible.Granted this hotel is relatively new but it really seems to be running on all cyclinders. Restaurants are not bad either considering when it comes to hotel food. The rooms are spacious and the bathroom is a decent size. Lovely decor and great views depending on your floor level.
This hotel is a winner in my opinion for any road warrior who like myself has particular expectations when away from home. You cannot go wrong by staying at this hotel. 
I cannot wait to find a way to get back to this property assuming there is no major sporting event in town. Being it is a relatively close to the main football stadium. The hotel is connected by walkways to the major stores and dining places so cold weather should be no issue.
Check this place out before the word gets out...

review_title: Nice and clean with a very nice staff.
review_text: This hotel is nice and clean and has a very welcoming staff. The suites have everything you need to stay, including a full size fridge and everything you need to cook. Very comortable bed and quite. Well appointed gym. You need a car at this hotel. That said, you are next to the highway (no noise) and can get anywhere pretty quick. Several restuarants within a few minutes walk that are well priced and have tasty food. You are a short ride to 6 Flags, ball parks and the C.R. Smith Aviation Musuem at the American Airlines Training Center-nearly across the street. If you have a car, I would recommend this hotel.

Stayed here for one night and was really shocked at this quality hotel in Indy. It looks like a mini version of the Wynn in Vegas. Very clean and new with great service from the large staff working at the hotel. My room had a great view, very comfortable bed and would highly recommend it.

This is easily one of the best Hamptons I've ever stayed at. As a HHonors gold member I was given a suite at check in. Front desk service was courteous, prompt, and efficient. The room itself was excellent. Very spacious, modern, and comfortable - everything I would expect from a Hampton plus more. The property also has a pool, hot tub, and outdoor patio all of which were modern and very well maintained. Overall this was an excellent choice.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Fort Worth Fossil Creek

review_text: Went to see the Bobcats game. The hotel is literally right next door. The hotel has all the amenities that you need such as gym, pool, laundry, valet, a nice breakfast in the morning. Just had a couple of issues such as trash under the sink and the toilet seat was flimsy. I told the front desk and the game us a different room. Besides that the stay was prime.

review_title: Great facilities. Gym and pool. Clean!!! Located near good food.
review_text: Great facilities. Gym and pool. Clean!!! Located near good food.

As usual I am delighted by the kindness and thoughtfulness of the staff in this hotel. Once again everyone from parking staff to bar service to front desk was there for me. They are offering great discounts on comfy, quiet rooms with the best staff ever. Thank you all for a terrific 3 night stay. You won't be disappointed if service matters to you. S Brown, 504 is a great room

Very cool old west hotel in the heart of the stockyards. Everything in the hotel has old Texas charm. The only negatives were the walls are thin, and it is loud on Friday nights. Also, no breakfast until 9 am on Saturday mornings.

Great rooms great location. Fantastic bathrooms! 
Front desk needs to be a little more respectful of their guests. But that was more them talking about guests in too loud of a voice. Unprofessional. But they were very nice once you were in front of them.

review_title: Highly recommend if visiting Fort Worth!
review_text: Super cool hotel! My friend and I did not want to stay in another chain hotel on our trip cross country and this place was perfect! The decor was unique, the employees were super friendly and the location is centered close to everything! There is a restaurant and bar that is connected to the hotel... Food was great, beer cold and it was perfect for grabbing a bite after being on the road for hours. Twice a day there is a cattle drive with real longhorns that come down the street! Lots of bars, steak houses and shopping within walking distance. The hotel is over 100 years old so the set up is unique. Check it out! I will definitely come back!!!

review_title: My overall experience with my room was great but..........
review_text: The hotel was great, but the walls are thin where you're able to hear the guest next to you and the only parking for the hotel is Valet parking for $22the a night.

We stayed at the JW this past weekend. Stayed on the 19th floor. We had a great view overlooking the city. Beds were very nice. Nice fluffy towels. Staff went out of their way to find me some bandaids also...

Spent our anniversary in The Stockyards. The stay at the hotel was perfect. H3 dinner wad great. Lots to see and do in the area. Had a room overlooking Exchange and enjoyed the view. Hotel is old but very clean. So glad we decided to stay there.

review_title: Fun accommodations sans big price tag
review_text: This is a high value smaller hotel that's also high on ease. The Sierra is hip without pretense meaning a cool relaxing vibe without some of the often unnecessary frills. A surprisingly great bar, yummy included breakfast, free wifi and reasonably priced dinner menu make this an absolute steal. The rooms are nicely sized with well equipped kitchens for longer stays and the pantry in the lobby offers reasonably priced food/beverages to actually make the kitchens worthwhile. Everything is just a notch or two below top of the line, but it all works - great concept overall.

review_title: Good location good value for money
review_text: Walking distance to all public transport. Rooms were spacious and clean. Service was readily available at all times. Restaurants were of good quality.

review_title: Nice, you get what you pay for.
review_text: While in town for the motogp, we decided to splurge and stay here. Location is good close to some nice parks and restaurants. Bar was excellent, beds comfortable. Very clean, no complaints.

We stayed at the JW last weekend. Celebrated our anniversary and saw a Colts game. The hotel's location is one of the best in the city. The rooms are spacious and clean, and the staff were all helpful and friendly. The cost wad also extremely good. We will most definitely stay again. Overall an excellent hotel with a super breakfast buffet.

We stayed one night at Hilton Fort Worth after bOoking through hotwire - and were very happy with our stay. The rooms are clean and comfortable, lovely beds, great, large bathroom with excellent shower, and large flat screen tvs.
The best thing about the Hilton was the service. Mike on concierge was so enthusiastic about his city, and had great selections for dinner, entertainment etc. He was the best! The guys on valet were awesome too. 
Overall a great stay!

First off, this hotel is clean and safe. That is what I always check for first when booking a hotel. The location is great, pretty much right downtown. We had a wedding to attend at the Indiana State Musuem so this hotel was perfect for that. 
The outside of the hotel and the lobby are both lovely. The rooms are very modern and nice (although nothing overly spectacular). 
My only real complaint is that I requested a King bed in March, our stay was the end of July, and we didnt get the bed. Not a huge deal, but it was important to me and I had requested it so far in advance that I was really disappointed that they couldn't give us the bed we had asked for.

I have spent about 5 weeks in total at the Hilton FW so far this year and the service has been exceptional from the entire staff. 
Their room service menu could use some updating and greater variety and it would be great if they offered mini refrigerators in the room - even just as a fee-based option.
Location is fantastic for easy downtown access and exploration.

This place is a dump, in the heart of a red light district. Filthy, smoky, disgusting, I was afraid I was going to get bedbugs or my dog was going to get fleas. Other guests looked to be mainly prostitutes and their clients. Avoid at all costs.

I stayed here numerous times but the day I checked in, I seen a pest control guy at the front desk. I asked him what he was doing and he replied "just doing some preventative maintaince" . Sounded good to me glad to see it actually. But I think he gave me a don't want to scare you responce. Because the next morning I woke up with red chicken pox like blotches all over my body. I will not come back and I have called the health department.
Country inn has the best staff Brian is great at the front desk best breakfast

This is the absolute best and affordable hotel in the Laquinta chain for this area. I am a gold member and thoroughly enjoy the exceptional service. When i come in the staff knows me by name which proves they appreciate me as a repeat customer. The rooms are always clean and ready. As an added bonus a smiling representative is always a gauranteed brightness to this hotel.Keep up the great work!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Ft. Worth - Forest Hill, TX

review_text: I was in Columbus for a 2 day conference which was held at the Easton Hilton. I was not about to pay over $200 a night there. I got onto Priceline, said I wanted a 3 star and up hotel for around $55. They found this hotel so I booked it. After reading some of the reviews on here I was a little scared about staying there. The hotel was very easy to find, it was right off the highway. I believe 270. It took me about 5-10 minutes to get to Easton. The front desk was very friendly and accommodating. Since my mom came with me I asked uf there was a shuttle that could take me to the Hilton since I had to be there at 7 am each day. They said sure no problem. We got to our room which was very clean. The entire hotel is non-smoking which was wonderful since I have asthma and smoke triggers an attack. There was an indoor pool and spa which we didn't use because we were too tired and shopped the rest of the time. There was free wi-fi and decent cable channels. Yes some of the channels are worse than others, but that is because some channels are digital and some are analog. They have ice machines and a small snack area by the front desk. As far as the area around the hotel there is not much. I preferred thia as traffic was at a minimum. There are probably 3-4 other hotels in the same area, 2 gas stations, McDonald's, and Wendy's. Our hotel had a restaurant that is only open for breakfast. I did not eat there since my conference had free breakfast. They did have a third party company that would deliver food to your room until about midnight. That food was decent. There is a bar and grill at the hotel next door. We ate at Easton since it was close also. I would definately stay here again.
New hotel next to restaurants and 24 hour fitness club. Clean and friendly with free breakfast. Lots of channels and Internet was fast.

Stayed for two weeks and met most of staff who are friendly and courteous. Great location as there are plenty of restaurants within walking distance and easy access to expressway. Planning on coming back in a couple of weeks.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Ft. Worth - Forest Hill, TX

review_title: This is a great place to stay when visiting the Forest Hill area, with great rooms, cleanliness, and excellent service!
review_text:
I really enjoyed my time at the Forest Hill La Quinta location. The hotel was very clean, with attractive, spacious rooms. The staff at the Forest Hill location was very attentive and polite, and helpful in directing me around the area sights.
I was quite pleased with the rates that the hotel featured, it was a great value. The indoor pool was great, and the business center had everything needed. The Forest Hill La Quinta is a great place to stay whether on business or vacation - I would recommend it to anyone.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Ft. Worth - Forest Hill, TX

review_text: Great hotel and service! Very clean rooms and Awsome breakfast. Hard working staff!!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Ft. Worth - Forest Hill, TX

review_text: This is your average courtyard. A little pricey for what you get(which is a room, don't expect breakfast, although there is a wafflehouse and various fast food places around it. We stayed two nights didn't see a housekeeper on Saturday had to go get towels for the next morning. The highlight of my stay was being propositioned by three prostitutes and their pimp in the pool room at 11pm on a Friday. I guess there could be some lonely travelers it is by the airport, it did add a special "touch of class" though. If had to do it over I definitely would have stayed downtown. Your a ways away from anything in Columbus.

I even asked front desk clerk if rooms were clean. He said yes. If this is clean, I'd hate to see what his idea of dirty is! Paint peeling, holes in wall, carpet may as well have been in a garage, leaking air at windows. Afraidto touch pillows so I used a shirt over it. Pubic hairs on towels. I asked for a non smoking room, but I felt like I was in a smokey bar. Some foreign liquid on tv remote. Free breakfast consisited of toast and orange juice. Then asks for my cresit card again at checkout and tries to bill me MORE! Really don't see how they are in business, much less pass inspections.
They told me the wireless connection was great. Not if you aren't in the rooms closest to the office. Also had feces streaked on the shower curtains. Tv remote had no back. One outlet in the room.
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - Columbus / North

review_title: Don't walk....run away from this hotel!!!!
review_text: At first glance from the outside, this hotel looked acceptable....although there was a lot of trash scattered in the parking lot. The gentleman that checked us in seemed like we were inconviencing him. The rooms were so-so. There was a lot of "riff-raff" hanging around the side doors of the building. When we went out a side door in the morning an individual let in a good 10 people ( young adults/teen).....not sure what that was about, but I'm sure a free breakfast was had by all. I did not feel safe in this hotel at all and would highly recommend staying somewhere else.....a few miles north would be a smart choice!!!

review_title: I felt this was a great value
review_text: Checked in after a long drive and I was pleased with the size of my room and the bed was an absolute dream! Sooo comfy. The hotel was absolutely fine for a budget overnight stay. The only thing I noted was the bathroom ceiling had severe water damage. I would stay again for $50 for sure.
hotel_name: Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham Airport Columbus East

review_text: do not listen to any other reviews this place sucks!!!!!! its falling apart, dirt, the service here is even worse they told my uncle when his shower was broken to shower in another room, the hotel rooms our dirty and under supplied. as i said before DO NOT STAY HERE!!!!!
hotel_name: Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham Airport Columbus East

review_text: Multiple hotel choices in immediate vicinity. Room was clean and roomy. However, initially checked into an already occupied room - never a good experience. Exercise room tiny and dark. Breakfast included, but not worth the effort. Plenty of restaurant choices in immediate vicinity. Many other alternate comparably priced hotels in immediate vicinity.

review_title: Shoulda have stayed at the Hampton
review_text:
Was staying just for a night as I was passing through town visiting some friends from the Columbus area. All in all not a terrible hotel but was slightly dissapointed with the cleanliness. 
For starters the bathroom is spacious enough but upon turning the water in the sink on the handle completely came off attachment. The shower was adequate. The room appears to be slightly outdated but very spacious. I would make the overall suggestion that the room itself could have been cleaned a lot more thorough. The carpets could have been cleaned better and I suggest you pull the bed and nightstand out to clean up under and behind as it looks like it hasn't been done in months. The room provides the basic compliment Internet in room movies a small fridge and a microwave. A single cup coffee maker is also in the room. The bed is a little soft for me but not too uncomfortable. 
Overall a mediocre hotel at best and for the price I will pay 20.00 more next time and choose another hotel in the area.

I read all the reviews before we booked the room. My boyfriend and I were only in town to watch our hockey team play the last game ofthe season. I thought "well, I will just check the room before we sign the registration." so I checked. Notvery pretty at all, but clean enough. We brought our own sheets and towels, pillows and blankets anyways. I am a former hotel general manager and checked for bedbugs. Seemed ok. A little unsettling having the smell of marijuana in the hallway when we checked in. Then we started noticing the people wandering around the property. Really unsettling. But, my boyfriend is a big guy and we keep to our selves. We were only going to be in the room to sleep. We came back from the game and I had to get a new room key. I always do this so that we have the newest keys and noone cam get in the room. The "security guard" there made some sideways comment about mushrooms and other drugs. I asked what he said. He responded "I wasn't talking to you. Go back to your room." I went back to the room and realized I only had one key. I go back to the desk, bringing my boyfriend with me this time. I was not comfortable with the riff-raff that was sitting in the lobby. I asked the guy at the front desk for two new keys. The security guard made a comment to my boyfriend about me. The guy at the front desk said the security guard really was not talking to me before. The security guard continues antagonizing my boyfriend. I step between them and the security guard SHOVES me. Then he jumps at my boyfriend and tries to knock him down. I get them to stop, hand the security guard his hat that flew off, and we go back to the room. I begin packing because I am not staying in this place. It is not safe! Then the police show up at the door! Very very nice officers by the way! I explained that they were welcome in the room but the security guard is not. He tries to push his way in. The officers stop him. He starts yelling about his Bluetooth that we "stole". What? The officers explain that we are being told to leave. I said we are leaving anyways because it is not safe. The female officer explains that they get a lot of calls to this motel. I called Orbitz and they said the hotel would not refund the money because we had an extra person in the room. The reservation was for two people, we signed for two people! It's not worth the argent, it was only $30.00. We checked into the Super 8 in the same plaza and were much happier and safer. Do not stay in that motel! I have the report number and will be filing assault and battery charges. Be careful where you stay! Also, the bathroom in the lobby had black mold all over the baseboards by the toilet! Pic to follow!

review_title: NOT upscale hotel - not even close
review_text:
This hotel Needs to be Renovated! 
The room is half updated half out of the 1990s at best. The building has an "older" feel to it in general. The Furniture is old and worn. Chairs and couch have stains! The bed? It wasn't very clean. Sheets should smell clean! Not like Sweat! I set the pillows on the couch. I had the king suite room, Not worth the $139 I paid. Not at all. I wouldn't recommend anyone stay here, unless you can pay $40 for the night. Which should be spent on the 2 star hotels instead. Seriously don't waste your money here. The hotel NEEDS TO BE UPDATED! THE ROOMS NEED NEWER EVERYTHING! THIS IS 2011 NOT 1990 people!!
Very pretty hotel, comfy beds, clean room, easy location. Was a last minute choice for a concert. Loved it!

We checked in and the smell from the pool was overwhelming. Went to the room, opened the door--it was an already occupied room! Went back down (with kids & luggage in tow) got a new room. Went to swim and the smell was horrible; the boys only lasted about 20 minutes. I swear the chlorine smell stayed in my nose for about 2 days. 
The bathroom was small and as usual not enough towels for 4 people. Beds ok; b'fast ok; front desk guy not so ok. Glad we don't ever have to go back!

This is not as palatial as some Comfort Suites. The lobby is small and the desk clerk had a skimpy little tank top which definitely was not the corporate uniform. The breakfast was not as spectacular as other CSs, having prepared egg patties, but we left fed. Will probably stay again because of proximity to interstate.

review_title: Nice people, decent room, terrible to get to.
review_text: We came to this hotel after canceling our reservation at the Ramada down the street in a very bad part of town. It took us forever to figure out how to get to it with all of the one way streets surrounding it (you have to loop around and make a U turn before the rental car drop off and parking garages). The people at the front desk were very friendly and accommodating. The lady gave us better instructions of how to find the entrance to the parking lot. We told them we were in town for a concert and when we got back later that night, they asked us how it was as we passed by. Very nice people. The TV was outdated and not had 20 or so basic channels. The bathroom was clean, though the toilet was awkwardly low. I didn't sleep well at all, but I thought the bed was quite comfortable anyway. Our air conditioner made a trickling sound all night and it all made sense in the morning when the carpet was soaked. The breakfast was very nice; There was a Belgian waffle maker, juice, different kinds of coffee, eggs, omelets, bacon, bread, bagels, cereal, yogurt, fruit, and probably even more. The tables and chairs in the breakfast area were pretty old and nasty. We were told over the phone that the rates were $99 a night. After taxes, the total was $150, so be aware of that. If we ever come back to Columbus, we would probably not stay here just because of the high rates and difficulty to get to.

Stayed here on a trip going West on I-70. Had a wonderful stay at a great value. 
Pros:
-Value. Room was comparable to a 120 dollar a room hotel at about half the price. 
-Room was large and well appointed; great linens, bath amenities and granite bathroom. 
-Very clean lobby, room and bathroom. 
-Very nice continental breakfast that didn't leave us wanting. 
-Easily accessible from 70. 
Cons:
-Lackluster location with mostly fast food and chains adjacent. 
Cons
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn & Suites Columbus - W. Broad

review_text: An older property, in good shape, standard Hamptonn amenities.

Seriously, do not stay at this disgusting hotel. I refused to stay in the room, so I slept in my car. Every other hotel in the area was booked up for Rock on the Range, but I was willing to give up my tickets to the show after this horrible hotel experience.

If you use hotel websites you can get a room for under $35. And its very unlike motel 6 and knights inn. I won't stay in those because usually the price reflects the clientelle. This is located behind the comfort inn that has the exact same building structure. It is INSIDE ENTRANCE which is a must. The rooms have been remodeled and have a decor that is more upscale offering a chaise and ottoman in king rooms. We have stayed here about 8 times and it's very consistent. The only thing that I would mention is in the winter there is no heat in the hallways but you just have to hurry into your room. I would strongly suggest parking on the front of the building even if you can't see your car because they have bright flood lights and you feel more secure versus the back where there are only two dimmer street lights. Also a lot of people think the staff is rude. Thr daytime man is middle eastern descent and the nighttime is a man from new jersey. Its just their personalities and there dialect. Give it a chance as the rooms are definitely more impressive than the exterior appearance.
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn Columbus - Ohio State Fairgrounds

review_title: You get what you pay for
review_text: Sketchy location, right off the highway, but definitely not somewhere I'd want to stay for a long time. Front desk person could not possibly care less. Room was clean and just okay. This is LOW budget travel. NO elevator. Be prepared to drag your stuff up the stairs. Doubles are full size beds, not queens. Tough parking when coming in late. Front lobby entrance reeks of bug killer spray. Would not stay here again.
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn Columbus - Ohio State Fairgrounds

review_text:
We checked in late and the front desk clerk was nice enough to give usa late checkout for the next day.....we didn't ask for it he just put that into the computer.
Nice accomodations. Will stay here again.
The hotel is great. Our room opens up right to the pool, which is good for the kids. Very clean, open and friendly.

I just returned from a conference held here. Check in was quick and friendly and she even helped us find a place to eat. The room was clean, the beds were comfy- no complaints. Breakfast at the conference was yummy and they were very attentive with picking up plates and filling up the water pitcher. I would definitely recomend this hotel to anyone staying in the area.

The candlewood at Polaris is one of my favorite places to stay when I'm in Columbus for work. It's right on the main drag and across the street from the mall and several restaurants. Every room is a suite with a queen bed, full kitchen, and updated bathrooms. The rooms are very clean. The only update I would suggest is a flat screen tv. I like candlewood because housekeeping isn't in my room everyday and I don't have to worry about my things being rummaged through.

review_title: This is a wonderful, new, and small hotel. Very convenient for the medical center. Quiet and clean.
review_text: Everything was and is from my experience excellent. The rooms are large comfortable, homey, (i.e., refrigerator, microwave, sturdy paper plates) and clean. The Priority membership is a nice bonus but you pay for it the hotels rates but then it's a Holiday Inn. The rates are a little pricey; i had short night stay. The rate given was $124 but when it was all said and done the actual cost was $145--nowhere near the 116 price. Had a surgical appt. at 5a so didn't have an opportunity to have the breakfast buffet.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Columbus University Area - OSU

review_text: We were in Columbus for an educational conference....we booked at the last minute so we we a little off the beaten path but the hotel was great...I so enjoyed the pool at the end of the day...the ease for our group to meet in the lobby and do plan Ning...nice place!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Columbus Downtown Capital Square

review_text:
I dont understand why people are posting poor reviews of this hotel, I stayed here the last week of July and had an EXCELLENT stay. If you ask questions to the staff they are more than willing to go out if their way to help you. 
The people that work in the mornings generally seem overwhelmed, but the evening staff is excellent, always going above and beyond what I would expect for a holiday inn. 
Only complaint I have would be, wish they had flat screen tvs in the rooms.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Columbus Downtown Capital Square

review_text: The location is what makes this property. 4 minute drive to the north campus. Lots of dining options and bars nearby. Small hotel but the property has been refreshed. Thee is granite in the bathrooms and flat screen TV's. Easy freeway access also. I would stay at this location over other HIE's in the area.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Columbus University Area - OSU

review_text: Full occupancy but we did not hear a sound from surrounding rooms - guests. Clean and well maintained. Perhaps to clean in pool area. Extremely strong chlorine odor. Staff Accomadating and friendly.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Columbus University Area - OSU

review_title: Dated but clean and helpful staff
review_text: The hotel staff at the bar, front desk and drivers are great! My room was upgraded by the female manager at the front desk. Maintenance man Dave was helpful and fixed my issue right away. My housekeeping lady was great as well. No flat screen TVs but rooms are clean. $10 parking fee buts its downtown with in/out options. Breakfast was horrible .... rude staff, poor service, food on buffet was old. Saw a mgr and asked to speak with him- he made it sound like it was my fault I had problems!! Asked if I could order off the menu he was evenmore angry shoved his hands in his pocket and muttered something under his breath and walked away. Diamond at fd arranged for driver to take us to a local spot instead. I would stay again just skip the meals!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Columbus Downtown Capital Square

review_title: Average hotel with good location in downtown
review_text: The hotel stay was average. The rooms were not too good the staff was not too friendly. The food was average the location is good close to lots of places in downtown but still that good feel was missing. Average hotel
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Columbus Downtown Capital Square

review_text: My wife and I arrived a little before 11 PM after a 16 hours car ride. Needless to say we were exhausted. All of the employees that we encountered were very pleasant and attentive to our needs. They seemed to genuinely care about our stay. Two of the front desk employees Laura and Jacky greeted us with a warm and energetic welcome at the door. Since the valet were clearly busy, Jacky even helped us with luggage! Maybe they had a lot of caffeine or something because they seemed to be thrilled to be of assistance at 11 PM! We were so grateful since we also had three toddlers with us! While we were getting a late night snack, they left us a goodie box including a goodies for our 3 children and a gift certificate to the Starbucks in the lobby. Let me tell you, after a 16 hours drive Starbucks was the ticket for the next morning. They also had an incredible breakfast, not just cereal and bagels. They had a wide variety of both, made to order omelets, biscuits and gravy, sausage, bacon, potatoes and more than you'd get if you were at your grandma's house. We didn't make it to the nightly reception but unlimited alcohol? We will be back(probably without the kids) next time!

Great value. They clearly put some thought into this hotel. Very friendly front desk staff. Booked an eSaver room rate over the phone shortly before arriving. Cost $83.99, with tax it was $97.64. My husband liked the in-room recliner. The water pressure in the shower was the best on our week long trip. Nice indoor/outdoor pool. Evening snacks included three free cocktails per adult. Free WiFi. Nice hot buffet breakfast. Well lit parking. Adjacent to mall, an easy walk.

review_title: Friendly evening front desk staff. Good value, nice rooms, musty smelling.
review_text: Nice breakfast, friendly staff, convenient location (right next to Mall). First room smelled musty, asked to be moved, second room smelled less musty. We all slept well but those with allergies to mold or who are sensitive to smells might choose a different location.

We frequent Columbus about once a month for shopping and use discount sites. I know that every hotel on polaris parkway is upper middle class And for $38 a night I knew it would be an effeciency suit of some sort which is a bargain. If you are not familiar with the area THIS WILL BE HARD TO SPOT since the signage on building is small. It is located off 71 which for us is in between my preferred shopping. It also is located across the street (eight lanes) from Polaris fashion place (very large enclosed mall with lifestyle center and it us also within walking distance (like yards so same side of street) to Wendy's Quaker steak carrabas and go cart game center. And just walk up the street and there is a target and a beginning of a long and large upscale strip mall that has old navy ulta tjmaxx world market beat buy big lots lane Bryant hallmark and thats just a few. This is one of the best exits within Columbus because there is so much and it stretches left and right with choices. Safe surroundings too. Polaris parkway is surrounded by upscale neighborhoods. 
NOW ABOUT THE BEDS
YOU WILL WANT TO READ
We got a studio with a queen bed and it was so hard I couldn't sleep until 6 am! And there will be an oversized chair and guess what it is a pull out twin bed! No one told us about this! I discovered it after trying to use cushions as pillows because there are not extras in the room. But I will add that I'm 5'6 170 pounds and anyone bigger or taller will not fit on the pullout. It is a mini twin. And our carpet needed more cleaning as it was stained. The room did have a full size fridge and cabinets but had few pans and had two small burners.

We checked in Tuesday the very sweet black girl gave us a second room after the first one smelled bad and had dirty walls and carpet. the lobby carpet was so filthy I wanted to turn around and leave. We had to stay as we booked the room from priceline. The front desk was always abandoned.

review_title: I've stayed in way nicer Doubletree's
review_text: This DT felt a little dated in my opinion; something reminiscent of older Hiltons. The bathroom smelled awful; like cleaning toxins that just wouldn't vacate the non-ventilated, closed in space. The room seemed drab. The bed was very comfortable, which obviously is the main focus of any hotel. Not sure I'd revisit this location however.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Columbus Downtown

review_title: Great stay, great location, great value
review_text: We were amazed at the Doubletree Suites Downtown Columbus. For the quality and location we would have expected to pay much more. Arrived late and the staff were pleasant and accommodating.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Columbus Downtown

review_text: I went to fort rapids with my youth group. Ccym was holding a conference for all the youth groups in eastern ohio. The room I wasn't impressed with and the waterpark was disgusting! trash every where, no towels,no tubes we had to wait an hour to get one, bandaids everywhere. I even steped in gum! We left yesterday ( 11-12-11) when I woke up this morning, I had a text from my youth leader saying she found bed bugs in her clothes! eww! I was in the same room with her! Also, a member of my youth group got his phone, wallet, and shoes stolen! I have been her several times, to give this place a chance but, it never changes! don't go!

review_title: Overall a nice hotel, could use some maintainance, cleaning lady will knock on your door at 8 in the morning.
review_text: We were headed down to Columbus to do some late night partying with friends so decided to book this hotel due to its more northern proximity. Check in was smooth, we dropped our bags, jumped on the internet in the lobby (they charge for in room internet usage) and then went out for the night. We arrived back at the hotel at about 3am and went directly to sleep only to be jarred awake at 8:20 in the morning by the cleaning lady trying to get in our room. This was definitely a first for us. After shouting from our bed at the top of our lungs for her to go away she finally left us alone. Not exactly the relaxing morning we were looking for! Other than that snafus, the hotel was pretty clean, a little worn, but the front desk people were very polite and helpful. Beds were not very comfortable (firm and pitted) but the linens were pretty nice. Could use some deep cleaning, painting and new wallpaper where it is beginning to bubble. Just those kind of maintainance issues.

review_title: in need of some serious care...
review_text: Although the staff were courteous and well mannered, they seemed to miss the mark on listening to the guest. At check-in, we inquired about upgrading to a 2 bedroom suite, and they instead tried to put us in just a larger 2 bed single room. After this, we were checked-in, went upstairs and found a king size single bed for me, my wife, and our teenage son. We went back down to the desk, and got this corrected to a 2 bed basic room. The room was clean, though well worn, so we went to enjoy the attached indoor water park. The entrance smelled really foul leading into the park. The park had plenty of nicely installed slides, but was quite warm and humid. Several parts of the park were filthy including the moldy stairs and changing rooms. All in all, the park was fun, though. Returning to the room for a relaxing evening, we found several issues with the room. Many of the usual hotel comforts were lacking, such as bath mats and luggage butlers; and items such as a shower curtain that was too short, or a refridgerator that didn't close properly. That aside, the real issue was that the mattresses were worn out. A good night sleep was not to be had. After several hours trying to sleep through highway noise, hotel noise, painful mattresses, and light that came in through windows and under doors, we got up early to check out. At check-out, we were asked if we had received a bill, and we stated no, and were then asked if we had gotten room service, as there was an extra $71 charge on our room. We told them no, as we hadn't, and quickly we were told there would be no additional charge. We were never asked how our stay was. I will be watching for my credit card statement to make sure there are no mystery charges.

Me and the wife &kids have stayed there twice I would recommend this hotel.once for the AAu baseball tournament only 8minutes away from fields.very clean only set back that I found was if you want breakfast you must be early riser it stops at 10:00.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Ohio State Fair/Expo Center

review_text: The rooms were great so was the indoor pool. Beware the $4 water they leave in your room. And the inroom coffee is a very strong Starbucks blend. The $14 breakfast buffet not worth it. But there is alot of great restaurants nearby.

I booked this hotel based on the waterpark and didn't read Trip Advisor, BIG mistake! If I could give zero's, I would! I took my kids and my parents decided to join us. Like several other guests, checked in early and headed to the water park. I have no complaints for the waterpark. When we hit the room, at 9PM b/c the water park closed (ok, 1 complaint), we found the carpet had numerous stains, the mattress and box springs were dirty (no bedskirts made this easy), the lamp between the 2 beds didn't work, the shower was dirty, the wallpaper in the bathroom was peeling, the thermostat to adjust the air was supposed to be on the "tv wall", I never found it and the worst part, (we had adjoining rooms with my parents) is that my mom was banging on the door at 11:45 at night-THEY HAD BED BUGS!! The night manager came up and moved them to a new room and only offered them free breakfast! Then with some insistance, offered 10% off, my mom shut the door on him. Upon check-out (we didn't even want to eat breakfast there!!) The manager didn't want to issue a credit at all! After we had left, they finally refunded the room rate, but not the water park admission. Do Not Stay Here!!

review_title: Wheelchair accessible suite was a let down!!!!
review_text:
The hyatt is a beautiful hotel however the wheelchair suite was a great disappointment. The room that appear on their website gave me the impression that my daughter and I would be very comfortable during our two week stay, boy was I wrong. The room that we stayed is was extremely smaller then the one shown on the website. My daughter is in a wheelchair and trying to get her chair in the bathroom was a dreadful chore! There is only about three feet of space between the end of the bed and the wall leading to the bathroom. 
The rooms do not have a microwave and the fridge is impractically small. The good news is that the hotel is surrounded by numerous restaurant and Marcus theater is a short walking distance from the hotel.
The staff is wonderfully pleasant and the continental breakfast is okay. Overall this hotel is nice for a few days stay for a family but anytime longer one may become claustrophobic.
Room spacious and clean. Very well designed TV is great. I checked in after 10 pm and reception was very friendly and helpful. Good value. Will stay here again

Upon arrival we received our water park passes and were pleased with the park. Although the bathrooms connected to the waterpark area were gross. Many hours later we made our way to the room with a very tired five year old. The rooms were disgusting. I insisted everyone keep their shoes on and requested no one take a shower. In the seconds it took to decide I wanted to leave my daughter was asleep. I rooms are old. The carpet is gross. There are stains on the walls and there were stains on the mattress. The tub was molded and the floor of the tub was dirty. The lock on the door was broken. The hotel was overcroweded and there were no luggage carts available during our stay. My husband waited five minutes for the elevator. While waiting he watched the hotel staff complaining and were less than helpful. I would not stay again if someone paid us!!!

Long story short: I would definitely recommend 
A family with a 3-year-old, we stayed overnight at the hotel. Wonderful time and made wonderful memories. Clean rooms. Extra towels promptly brought when requested. The locker rooms at the park were clean. 
Ended up having to buy an extra swimsuit in the giftshop - pleasantly surprised by its VERY reasonable price. The park pass is good from check in till closing the following day. Which she loved, along with the arcade. Also enjoyed storytime (with milk and cookies!) after a day of playing before bedtime.
Plenty of life guards on duty to ensure safety for the little ones. The staff was really great - very accommodating. One small example, they rounded up her tickets at the arcade so she could get a certain prize - a small gesture that means a lot to a kid. 
Easton Mall is about a 15 minute drive away. 
Also worth mentioning - there were many high school/college kids also enjoying themselves - not just for families. I enjoyed the hot-tub (and a couple cocktails).

Sold us waterpark tickets even though the waterpark was closed. Not cool. Management was very rude and said it wasn't their fault. Offered us a refund which I have yet to see. Save yourselves a headache and go to great wolf lodge in cinncinati where you can stay for a lot less and have a much better facility.

We had an amazing day at Ft. Rapids. We visited the waterpark for the day. The young ladies checking us in were quick and effecient. They were giggling about something when they checked us in...it was nice to see employees enjoying themselves. Every employee we met was kind and curteous. They seemed to be doing their jobs well, but honestly I don't know their exact job descriptions. :) Yes, towels ran short, but the staff was great about letting you know when some fresh new ones would be coming.

review_title: Looking for a reason to return.
review_text: Picked this location because of convenience and first time trying Wyndham Rewards. Pleasantly surprised and impressed. Was expecting a "room" and enjoyed a "studio." personable small staff was helpful. Will definitely revisit.
hotel_name: Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham Columbus, Zumstein Dr

review_text: I have stayed at many hotels, and I found this Best Western to be exceptional. The room was affordable and exactly what I needed. The customer service definitely exceeded my expectations! Thank you!

review_title: Don't ever go there even for free.
review_text: Awful manager.(bevery). Cold cold water. Too crowded because they sale daypass even when they were sold out in spring break.for every complain she said it is not our fault. They don't give u towels when u ask for it even though it is a water park. I would not go there even for free.

I can't believe that I took my family on a 2hour drive to this place. When we got there we waited over 2 hours for our room. When we finally got to our room it was clean. Dressed the kids and thought that was our glitch for the weekend...I was sorely mistaken. When we got to the waterpark it was totally over crowded and couldn't find anyplace to put our 1 bag. Water was so cold! My sons feet turn purple so my husband had to take him back to the room. My other children were freezing so we decided to order pizza from the food stand. Waited a half an hour to place my order then they ran out of pizza and gave me a broken buzzer and told me to come back in 25 mind to get my food. Pizza was a joke! My kids didn't want to play in the freezing water anymore so we went back to our room. Tried dinner at the only restaurant they had. Put our name on the wait list and was told it would be 10 minute wait. 45 min and my name being skipped a couple times we finally sat down. Server didn't come to our table for 15 mins. So we decided to get food anyway. When he finally did cone over he looked annoyed that we had food and was crappy to us the rest of the evening. Quiet hours are from 11pm to 6am but heard people running up and down halls and letting doors bang shut!!! My kids did not want to stay the next day so went to the breakfast buffet and same thing. No server for 15 mins, food was sooo cold and I was so upset. Check out was at 11am we left before 10!!! NEVER WILL I GO BACK EVEN IF THEY OFFERED ME A FREE NIGHT!!

review_title: I just checked in, and I am already regretting it.
review_text:
Let me start off by writing that the only reason I'm using my phone to write this review is because the wi-fi connection is so weak that my laptop can't even connect to it. 
The next thing I must point out is that I am currently listening to a white noise app I just had to download to my phone just to try to dim the highway noise that is pounding through the windows as I am trying to focus on writing this. I turned it all the way up, and I still couldn't drown out the car and truck noise enough to fall asleep. I have two small children that I'll be trying to take care of tomorrow while stumbling around like a zombie from all this.
The other negative reviews are correct so far. It's loud, in a terrible location, and the rooms are not fully equipped with kitchen supplies, like mugs and saucers, for instance. My room also smelled like smoke when we walked in because the windows and doors obviously are not sealing out smoke like they aren't sealing out the noise. Our next-door neighbors have folding chairs set outside the door with an ash tray full of cigarettes between them. A non-smoking policy means nothing if people can just sit right outside their door and smoke five feet away from the next unit's door. My son already had an asthma attack because of it.
The worst thing about all of this is that I'm stuck here for a week, and I know I won't be getting enough sleep to be a good mother, much less to enjoy my vacation. The full kitchen and decent-sized room isn't worth all this stress. I don't know if I'm more disappointed in the room or in myself for falling for what I thought was a deal.
hotel_name: Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham Columbus, Zumstein Dr

review_title: Dated hotel that was given 3.5 stars and should be 2.5.
review_text: We found the location fine and staf fine. The room had a hole in the carpet and the mirror was not clean. My bath towel was musty. Our bed was certainly not comfortable but bouncy. The pool was pretty and nice. The decor was stuck in the early 90's.

review_title: Friendly staff and a great value
review_text: Rooms were nice and clean. NO smell like some rooms can be. Perfect location. Staff was very friendly and cheerful people. Which I would like to say thank you to them.
Booked with good rate on Priceline. Predictable and vanilla but just fine for two overnights. Shuttle from Airport is $17 and takes 12 minutes.
hotel_name: Sheraton Columbus at Capitol Square Hotel

review_text: This hotel is in an older building but most of the furnishings were nice and updated. It is located in a quiet area and is well maintained. Flat screen tvs, decent bed, etc. Best part is the pool. It is large and crystal clear. It goes outside and inside and has several depths. The hot tub is very large as well. For the price paid, I was very pleased.

Stayed for two nights at the Staybridge Suites for a conference on the outskirts of Columbus. Overall, I was very impressed with the hotel and the services it offered.
I had the one bed "suite" which was actually one big room. The room was very big and included a couch, small kitchen area, in addition to the bed. It was clean for the most part except for a couple stains on the carpet and a couple of hairs on the bathroom counter. The tv swivels between the sitting area and the bed, which is a nice touch, and it had a lot of channels. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom area offered plenty of room, which was appreciated.
The location was great if you are going to the airport or to Easton, which is about 5 minutes away. The hotel offers a shuttle, which is good since fast food is the only option within walking distance.
The hotel offered a variety of services for the longer stay. The breakfast, which was included, was good although it offered limited choices. The evening reception, with beer, wine, and a light dinner was excellent and greatly appreciated.
Overall, I was impressed with my stay and would stay again.

I chose fort rapids because of its location..when i arrived check in was easy cause we booked the room via internet. There was a long line with an inadequete amount of staff to assist. In the aracade room, again there were not enough staff to assist and the place was unorganized and staff members there were not friendly or sure of what was going on...very unorganized. Not enough staff. No tubes to go on the cowboy river. No towels for the pool. No chairs or tables to put belongings. My 3 year old son was forced to hear an unruley 10 yr old using extreme profanity that i had to take care of myself because the children who were there were not being supervised. The food was good and the waiters again were overwhelmed due to inadequete staffing...i will not be going back!

Excellent place to stay during my seminar. Restaurants all within walking distance. Fitness center on-site was very large and wide variety of weights and machines. Wish I had more time in my room, very comfortable and relaxing.

review_title: You get what you pay for...
review_text:
Let me start by giving the positives. The arcade and mining were awesome. My boys had a great time doing those two activities. They also had a great time the last two hours the water park was opened and the oodles of people left. 
From the moment we arrived, we new this was a bad choice, we read the reviews and decided we had to see for ourselves and the management told us that other water parks wrote the negative reviews. So, against our better judgement we went, heck its cheapest of them all.
First, we paid for early check in and after driving 6 hours of driving, we got there at noon and were told we had to wait till 4. Thank God my husband blew a gasket and they were able to get us in at two. We played in the arcade for awhile and after listening to the kids whine four two hours, we finally got into our room. 
It was clean except for the bunk beds, they had crumbs on them and between the sheets. The phone was broken and the heater button was gone, so our room was cold but they came amd fixed it, which consisted of taking it out of another room. They fixed the phone as well, which again they took from another room.
Upon arrival to the water park, it was packed, not just packed, but over crowded, way overbooked. There was no seats anywhere a nd my boys saw the tubes, but were unable to secure one. This was the entire night.
The story time was ok, but the young man doing it was inappropriate a few times, even teasing a little boy for getting his cookie at the wrong time. Clearly tbe little boy didnt hear tbe direction, had that been my child, he would have gotten an earful.
The lobby was ice cold as was the entire hotel. The water was freezing, the hottub was off limits to kids and my boys love the hot tub. I can understand kids only allowed with parents, but not allowed at all is ridiculous. 
The food in the hotel was terrible and should have been free for kids 12 and under, but we didn't see it. The pizza was cardboard thin and gross. 
our room was given away twice, we met them in our hallway and the key worked. Thank God we were in our room. 
I feel this could be a gold mine if it were managed better. They were completely disorganized and unprepared for the rush of people. They need, more experienced employees that make us feel welcome. I paid 550.00 for two nights, we had to ask for everything we were supposed to get, free mining, arcade passes, upgrade for.breakfast and our pizza coupon.
Anyway, we survived it and will go back to castaway bay which is the Taj Mahal next to this place, the water their is warm and they make u feel special.
Even my kids wont go back...
P.S. I am not employed by any hotel or affiliated with any hotels, I just go to lots of water parks. 
...we did not see any bed bugs or cockroaches

I guess I'll start at the beginning of this horrible story. When we first walk in the lobby, we realize that there was a very long line to check in! With 2 small kids, you could imagine how that went! We finally got our bracelets 35 minutes later. Finally we were ready to go to the water park! We walk in and realize that it was so crowded in there, there was no place to sit! We ended up sitting on the concrete floor by a door so we were frozen every time the door opened. When you look around, all you can see are a bunch of fat hillbillies with tattoos. You could certainly tell that it is income tax time. The lines for any slide was ridiculous! To ride the toilet bowl slide, my son and I waited 45 minutes! It's worse by the lazy river, where you actually have to wait in line for a innertube!! Please people, invest a little money!! Disgusted, we left for dinner and didn't go back that night. When we finally got up to our room, we were greeted with yellow-stained sheets and comforters, and urine still left in the toilet. GROSS!!!! The night seemed to be going well after that, until about 1 am when we started hearing noises outside our room. These people were obviously drunk. It got to the point where my kids woke up and asked what was going on. Every word out of their mouth was [--], very inappropriate for kids to hear. When we left our room in the morning, there were beer bottles on the ledges of the hallway, and cigarette butts in them, that nobody, including housekeeping never bothered to clean up. I am NEVER one to complain, so I didn't. I doubt they would do anything about it anyway. I just thought I'd share my story so nobody wastes their money on this disgusting "resort" go to co co key. I have been there many times and always have a great time!

review_title: A great Holiday Inn for the price.
review_text:
The hotel is practically new. Rooms are nicely appointed with all amenities. Rooms were clean and comfortable. Staff was very friendly and helpful, especially Milene at the bar! If you spend any time there drop in and say hi to Milene. 
My only complaint was that the city of Hilliard and the hotel need to step up security in the parking lot. My friends car got broken into and gps stolen. After looking around you could see broken glass from past break ins. The town didn't even feel like it was in a bad area ; maybe just a rash of juveniles. 
Other than that, great hotel and stay!

So, priceline says this is three and a half stars, 2 is more like it. I rate it below a Hampton or Courtyard. It is supposed to be on par with a Marriott - no way. 
Service is very poor - Levi at the front desk refused to give adjoining rooms because we booked online and they were sold out. Lie. Once checked in, I logged in and cod have booked any room combo I wanted. 
Now, the physical plant is really in bad shape. Mold and peeling paint in bathrooms. 
I think they have written these other reviews to mKe it look good - no way they got those reviews.

The location is good. Close to the office place and nice surrounding. Good food and nice city as well. Also the free pick and drop service was really good. The mall is also near by with some good restaurants as well.

review_title: Paper-thin walls, get to know your neighbors whether you want to or not!
review_text: Service:great.Room size and features:great.Big enough to walk around. Unfortunately, so was the room above us--heard every step of the family in the room over our heads. Also listened to the guest in the next room snoring all night, which means he could hear us too. Good amenities,but cheap construction. Will avoid Staybridge and go for one of many comparable competitors next time.

It was easy to check in/ check out of the hotel. Staff was pleasant, rooms were clean and decent size. The elevators stop on almost every floor so it takes a while to get down. 
Only one issue with the place. We wanted egg and cheese sandwiches on a bagel to go and were told by the restaurant manager to go to the perks coffee stand to get them. When it was our turn to order, the girl did not know what to charge and came back telling us it was $12 a sandwich. A bit much for a simple sandwich. Would recommend going to einsteins (only open during the week thus not an option on the weekend) or north market instead for a reasonable priced and delicious breakfast sandwich.

review_title: I would not plan to stay here with children again.
review_text: We stayed at this hotel due to discounted prices offered through a group we were with for a function held at the hotel. I found it odd that the tv line up did not include any kid friendly channels. No Disney or nickelodeon. This made for a long weekend. However, I would recommend it for couples or friends traveling together. Good location. Near restaurants and the Nationwide Arena. Park in the garage a block or two away for $12 a day. It is completely connected to the hotel by skywalks.

Stayed there for 2 nights for a wedding. Staff snubbed me and I complained upon check out. I question money being held on my card and she was rude the entire time. Only a couple of staff members acknowledged us. I would never return.

review_title: Great - if you like sewage dripping on your head..
review_text:
First, for reference, I am a Hilton Diamond Hhonors traveler. I do around 90 nights a year in hotels, mostly Hiltons. 
So I checked into this Garden Inn. Typically Garden Inns are newer and clean. This one is newer for sure. But it sits at the end of a runway and is noisy. It's across the street from mcdonalds so it's smelly. 
My room, a king bed as requested, had dirty water coming through the bathroom ceiling. Yeah. That kind of water to judge by the smell and color. 
I immediately went to the desk to get a new room and thus found myself in a handicap accessible room with two doubles. I don't fit in doubles. So it was either the sewage or a too-small bed. I took the tiny bed. 
I also noted the bed(s) were not the adjustable type standard in Garden Inns. Just a plain old cheapo mattress with dingy off-white bedding. 
Nice place. Nice for somebody else that is. I wouldn't stay here again on a dare.
Standard HI GI, setup amenities and very good service. Room had an air conditioning problem on checkin, immediately solved.

review_title: I am very irritated that WiFi costs $9.95-on my last visit here several years ago it was free.
review_text:
Very nice hotel
Vey nice staff
Clean
Big flat screen
BUT it burns me how such a nice place can nickle and dime you on this. I can see that they don't like you streaming movies for free when they can charge you $14.99 for a pay per view. My moyher is down the street at the Marriott Suites...free wiFi there. I guess on my next trip its the Marriott.

review_title: Better than I expected. Good stay for conference. Corner room made big difference
review_text: Overall, great hotel for conference or convention ctr event and not far from restaurant row on High Street. New Hilton being built down street so I imagine this Hyatt will need to work even harder to improve in future. I usually don't get to excited about good customer service but all staff were very friendly and quick to please. Had room 1934 which was at end of hall and triangular. Try an end of hall "corner room" for something different than the typical bland hotel room. But be warned, this particular room had small closet and shower (no tub,) if it matters. Overall, room was clean with long wall of windows (lots of natural light) and appeared to be renovated sometime in past 5-7 years and great bed. slept well and it was quiet at end of hall.

review_title: Don't stay here if you wake up to the sound of construction or trains....
review_text: Well, not a great experience. The rooms were ok, however, there's so much construction going on around the hotel that it makes it hard to sleep. Also, the hotel is right next to a railway, which makes beautiful music at 330am. Also, the location is just a few blocks too far south of the nicer part of the downtownn area. While walking up to the Hyde Park Steakhouse to meet some clients, I was approached by a few beggars looking for a handout. Definitely won't stay here again....

review_title: Nice place and great location for conference goers at Columnus Convention Center.
review_text:
I always adore Hyatts. This Regency is very nice. The property is adjacent (indoor connection) to the Columbus Convention Center. Additionally some hreat restaurants are a few blocks north on High Street. For grab and go options there are plenty of choices in the convention center. 
The staff are all very friendly. The rooms are nice with all of the typical Hyatt Regency amenities. The cleaning products used in the bathroom were a bit strong smelling upon entry but aired out quickly when I left the door open for a few minutes. Room service pizza was disappointing but otherwise things have been fine.

review_title: Excellent location and nice view of the city
review_text: The hotel is right next to the arena district on high street and close to almost all the good places to eat in Columbus. The staff if helpful and friendly with good breakfast and nice view almost the whole day.

When we checked in at the front desk the man seemed disoriented and asked me the same questions a few times. We then requested a shuttle appointment which they kept rescheduling. We had an adjoining room which we had not asked for and in the next room was a screaming baby who kept us up most of the night. The bed was very uncomfortable. There was a used q-tip on the bathroom and the rest of the room didn't look much better. I don't think we will every go back to the hotel. I would rather spend a little more and have a better stay.

review_title: Great choice for a simple comfortable hotel near the airport.
review_text: The service is friendly, bed is comfortable, and the rooms are typical quality of a Marriott hotel. This hotel has higher quality bedding similar to all of the Grand Marriott hotels that we have been to even though this one doesn't have a spa it appears to have all if the other amenities and is a well maintained property. The long term parking program is wonderful and made this place the perfect location to stay and leave our car before a vacation that was nearly 2 weeks.

review_title: Good value and attentive friendly staff
review_text: We went to Columbus for shopping and a show We hadn't made any reservations ahead of time. We tried a couple of places at Easton before calling the Hamton Inn. I gave them a call ahead of time. Thier prices were quite reasonable and we were able to use our AAA discount. The rooms were clean and comfortable, the Free Breakfast was better than most with hot and cold items and a variety of coffees. The staff was friendly and helpful.
The hotel, service and food was great but not much to look at or visit around the area.great if you just want to stay closer to airport with free shuttle.

I stayed here for a conference for 3 nights. Check-in was very quick, and I was given a newly renovated room on the 19th floor. The gentleman at the front desk, Ryan, found my reservation easily and was very polite.
I went upstairs and was very pleased with the room. It had a king bed, 42" flat screen tv, fridge, chaise sofa, desk and a decent size bathroom. Room service prices were reasonable and the food was delivered within 30 min and tasted great! If you're looking for someplace else to eat there's a Max & Erma's or Michael O'Tooles pub across the street.
I didn't go to the business center or anything. I think there is an indoor pool but I didn't go to it either.
All in all I would highly recommend this hotel if you're coming to Columbus for a conference! Everyone was very professional and the room was very clean.

review_title: Squeaky clean hotel near Easton Town Center Mall.
review_text: Very clean hotel, friendly staff, huge shopping area on same exit, Alum Creek Rail-Trail nearby, what more can you ask for?

review_title: Do not stay here unless you want a smoking room. They have a 24 he cancellation policy and no room guarantee.
review_text: I have stayed here 3 times because of convenience. Every time I thought I had a confirmed non smoking but upon check in got a bait and switch to smoking. I have asthma and am cancer survivor and before last night they were able to switch last night there were no non smoking and I checked out room and it stunk. I tried to cancel room and left to stay at another hotel and they would not let me out of confirmation. Had to pay for room even though it was dirty. Unacceptable customer service. I stay in Cmh 5-6 nights and will never seat here again. Make all hamptons and hhonors look bad.
The rooms were great and had a good view. Latitude 41 was great and good view. The only thing I didn't like was for their Wi-Fi, $12.95 from noon to noon.

review_title: Fantastic hotel! Especially Guest Services employee, Ernest!
review_text:
My girlfriend and I stayed at the Crowne for a short getaway and were very impressed. The decor and design were simple yet elegent, just our style. I loved the layout of the lobby with the bar as a bit of a focal point. That gave our initial impression a feeling of a welcoming yet fun atmosphere.
The front desk staff was very friendly, smiling and bantering with us and the other guests. Ernest in particular was superb. He checked us in and set the tone off right for our stay. First interactions at a hotel are very important and the Crowne's staff is terrific.
The room was just what we needed and the beds/pillows were wonderful. We love cold A.C. in our room as we sleep (even though it is 50 degrees outside) and the thermostat worked wonderfully.
The valets were great, asking if we had directions or needed any suggestions on shopping or dining. They were very prompt with retrieval of the car as well.
The negative review below this one blows my mind. I can only assume that someone who puts their child in beauty pageants has impossible standards for others, so I feel safe in attributing her unhappiness with her experience to an unrealistic feeling of entitlement. 
The people at the Crowne are amazing.

We stayed there while on a business trip and the staff was outstanding. The hotel is gorgeous and right across the street from the convention center. 
Valet was fast and very helpful and I can't say enough good things about the concierge. 
Will recommend this hotel to clients and friends.

The hotel is very nice with modern decor and a perfect location. It is next to te White River park, museums, NCAA builing and Victory field. The bar is nice. The only complaint was a request for a rollaway. I was there for three nights and needed a roll away bed for the last night. I requested the bed at check in and the clerk said no problem. However, the third day when I went to confirm the bed request, I was told that with two queen beds they were not allowed to give me one due to a fire hazard. The extra person had to sleep on the floor. Without this issue, I would have provided a 5star rating across the board.

review_title: It was a 3 star at best
review_text: Dated hotel people were ok valet was 33 per day. Really ? Service at bar was slow. Rooms are dated and while clean, they were worn. Don't think I would stay again

review_title: Great location, huge rooms, friendly staff.
review_text: Visited just for one night. Got this hotel at a great rate on Priceline. Right in heart of downtown next to the convention center. I work in a hotel so am usually ultra critical of hotels but really enjoyed this property. Check in was smooth and personable. Got to room, very clean large area for bedroom and sitting area. Nice products in bathroom. Walking around, its a very historic hotel (JFK & Jackie stayed there before that infamous day in Dallas) so there are great photos all around the hotel. Great place and would recommend to anyone. If I were to find a negative, it would have to be with the valet. They were prompt but just did not seem to be at same caliber as rest if the hotel. Not even a thank you or offer help to the car. again I work in a hotel and the valet where I am actually hands you the seat belt and offers directions so would say there's room for improvement here. Not a huge deal but worth the mention, otherwise really top notch hotel from my experience.

review_title: Excellent business and leisure resort-like hotel
review_text: Fabulous building and service make it my favorite Marriott right now. Only detraction is the pool which is small if bringing a family. Lobby has a Manhattan-buzz every evening I've been there.

review_title: Best staff ever! Good location in downtown.
review_text: Every single staff was extremely nice and helpful. Food was amazing. Very nice and new. Fast elevators. The only negative would be room size was a little on the small size.

Great service from Valet, Lobby bellman and concierge staff. Beautiful decor everywhere. Very clean and modern. There was an issue with room temperature staying comfortable. The fancy restaurant in the hotel was very disappointing. They got my kid's order wrong and then delivered a dish that was inedible.

From the FW area but had an event downtown and made a night of it. Hilton was the least expensive of the downtown hotels. It's a bit dated but still nice. Formerly was the Hotel Texas, where JFK spent his last night, and they have got pics and memorabilia on the walls. Staff were very friendly. Room was clean, spacious, had a big bathroom.

Was here for an ACEP conference for a week. Every single staff member was extremely helpful and friendly.
I know its been mentioned about having to get wet turning shower on but in my opinion it was no big deal. I didn't care if my arm got a little bit wet as I was going to shower anyway. You had to turn the faucet only minimally to the correct temp in my room 1011 
I wish I could have used the pool but the conference took up all my time. It looked wonderful and the pool deck area was huge and lots of seats

review_title: Not Cheap, No Freebies, but a Good Facility
review_text:
I was here for a training event recently. The meeting facilities and service were both top notch. the rooms were very nice as well. Nothing over the top fancy but nice.
They advertise $10 a day wifi, but they gave me the code on check-in. This could've been due to my training class or PC membership though. However, it was INCREDIBLY slow. I used my 3G all week instead. 
They have an onsite restaurant but the breakfast buffet after tip was about $15. Too pricey for me.
There was a mini fridge in the room but no microwave. 
Overall a nice facility but across the street (connected by skywalks) is the Drury Plaza which has free breakfast, Internet, evening reception, etc. If I had to come back I try that instead.
Also it was a bit pricey.

My family stayed at the JW Marriott on the way to a big family reunion. We found a great deal for this hotel on Priceline! Anyway, the hotel was easy to find, parking was cheap ($6/ day) for a major city and the hotel is right across the street from a museum and a big park. The hotel itself is modern in style and guest services (touch screen lobby directory and free wifi). The rooms were very clean, the towels and linens were soft. What I did not like is that the ice machine was on the 2nd floor, and staying on the 14th floor, we found that inconvenient. Also, in order to use the internet service IN the business center I had to pay. 40 cents/min. Other than those things, I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Indianapolis.

We stayed at Hotel Sierra by chance, through a random booking with Hotwire.com to receive a better deal. After finding out our hotel we were amazed.
Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Rooms were amazing! Big beds, lots of lighting, amazing bathroom! The hotel was spotlessly clean. Pool on 7th floor and weight room.
Complementary breakfast was the best I have experienced: omlettes, bacon, sausage, French toast, cereals, muffins, bagels, fresh fruit and yogurt. Complementary Starbucks coffe, assorted teas, milk, and orange juice.
Best hotel experience I have had within the states. Hotel Sierra is providing the service most hotels lack. Very impressive and would recommend to anyone.

Price line room, good price! We were put once again at the very end of the hallway! This has happened so much to us, it's a joke! I guess the hotels want to reserve the rooms close to the elevators for their full price paying customers.
Overall, a good experience, we saved a bundle. Nice hotel, friendly staff. We would for sure come again.

This is a great new and exciting hotel. Highly recommend staying here for conventions and downtown business.
Rooms are beautiful but just average in size.

review_title: This is a very home away from home hotel.
review_text: Large spacious rooms with all the amenities and a very friendly staff. Also a great free breakfast!!!

This hotel is a strange place. We were part of a Greek Orthodox wedding party this weekend. It's as if they had it all there but just couldn't figure out how to do it right. All of their 'accommodations' were nice, but the execution was awful. They charged an arm and leg for simply the basics. Room service took at least twice as long as they predicted on the phone, forcing us to cancel our order just so we could make it to the ceremony on time, even though we left an hour of time to order and then eat in the room. Clearly this wasn't enough time for the staff of the renaissance, even though they said the order would take 25 minutes. Also, You essentially had to beg for anyone to serve you or take your order at the bar, and the service took forever. The restaraunt hours were just plain stupid and inconvenient. Will not be staying here again, and will strongly recommend to AVOID this place.
