Also, You essentially had to beg for anyone to serve you or take your order at the bar, and the service took forever. The restaraunt hours were just plain stupid and inconvenient. Will not be staying here again, and will strongly recommend to AVOID this place.

This property is great if you are looking for a decent hotel downtown. The rooms themselves leave a bit to be desired. Most notably is the awkward bathrooms that appear as though they were an architectural after-thought.

-no one was there to greet us an d had to wait
-when we did arrive, he insisted that I use credit to pay instead of cash. Very wrong!!
-earwigs in shower and shower curtain was filthy
-hairs all over the floor
-room smelt soo bad!!
-bed snapped on half...seriously!!
-eggs for breakfast were cold and tasted gross...please do not it.
-hassle to get an extra toilet paper roll. Had to use tissue.
Please do not stay here because if you get a room like ours or the seÂ®ivce we did, you will regret it.

Hidden inside is the best bistro in Dallas, food is fresh, service is quick if you are in a hurry or visiting on business. Best part is when I visit they remember my name and what I ordered before! Best service ever thanks to Amber. Visit and you won't be disappointed!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South

review_text: The floors were not carpeted. You could hear every sound. There was an all night/morning party going on and no one stopped it. I got very little sleep. I know there was a big dance competition going on and there were college dance teams staying there. There was also a home football game with Penn State....no excuse in my book. When we complained in the morning we were told we should have called the desk and they only took off our parking fee. ($10)!!! I never thought about calling...just felt that it should have been handled internally. We were only on the 3rd floor and those kids were up and down the elevator CONSTANTLY...there is no way that could have been missed at those late night and early morning times.
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn Columbus Downtown - Convention Center

review_text: Great location, comfortable and clean rooms. The staff was very helpful and attentive. We missed the breakfast so we cannot rate it but overall we would stay again and recommend to anyone.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Fort Worth Downtown

review_text: This is a well run hotel, with good service. Very clean, feels new and modern and it is comfortable. Great value. Free parking, free breakfast and free Internet. What more do you want, except for a free room?
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Fort Worth Downtown

review_title: Don't call for the shuttle service
review_text: All was well - aside from the 'free' shuttle service from the airport. If your definition of free is multiple calls to check the status and a 45 minute wait, then your expectations will be met.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South

review_text: I'd highly recommend this hotel! The staff is awesome! They had a cute package just for us along with a handwritten note welcoming us! They even called to make sure we had everything we needed! I was shocked at the service we received! We will definetely stay here again!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Fort Worth Downtown

review_text: We stay here every year in Oct. For the Quarter Horse Congress. The room is clean, staff is helpful, foreign but friendly and knowledgeable. I'm sure the hotel is fully booked with "horse people" so that may take care of the "local trouble." There is activity 24 hours a day with the horse show. Very convenient to fairgrounds, would stay there in a heartbeat!!!!!!

I booked this hotel for a group I had. 43 rooms total. I loved the hotel everything was new and clean. Gloria & Susana at the front desk took very care of us all my team and we felt like it was our home. The resturant waitress were also great thanks to the ladies ana, vanessa, & patricia. I will difinitely will come back!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South

review_text: The service we received was excellent, but the continental breakfast wasn't anything hot as in meat. There was just things such as eggs and waffles to eat. Then there was a cockroach in our bathroom. Other than that it was a pretty okay hotel.

review_title: Good business hotel; great shoe shine
review_text: Good hotel for a business traveler. Strong Internet in room and common areas.

We had our wedding reception here and couldn't say enough good things about the venue and all of the services provided! Many compliments have been given...including "that was the BEST wedding EVER!" The rooms were clean and ready for all of our guests! Thanks go out to everyone who helped make this day perfect!

review_title: This hotel makes customer service a top priority.
review_text:
This was one of the best stays I've experienced in my recent travels and hotel stays. The front desk staff was polite and provided prompt service. The night manager, Brandon, was attentive and courteous. The room was clean and comfortable.
I will make reservations in the future at this location and would recommend others to do so as well.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South

review_text: Overpriced ($160 a night) for what is essentially a cheap chain hotel on an industrial estate near the airport. Room was small, with an awkward desk. Wi Fi never worked (though plug in Internet was better) and the restaurant was predictably mediocre. To cap things off, reception managed to balls up my departure taxi, making me late for a meeting
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South

review_text: I'm obsessed with clean hotels and sometimes I don't get a lot of sleep worrying about bugs. Not at the JW Marriott. The room was spotlessly clean and still smelled new. The hosts were very helpful. The room service was pricey so we opted for High Velocity - one of the restaurants at the hotel that was open later. It was delicious and reasonably priced. I'd probably find the hotel to be too expensive if we hadn't gotten such a good deal online. Overall, this place was super clean, super comfortable, and very much worth it.

review_title: Fantastic staff! GrEat customer service. Love this hotel. Great Wi-Fi available all over.....it was a great experience and I wil
review_text: From the front desk, chef, lounge/food, to the events director and the housekeeping staff, can't say enough positive things. I live with my wi-fi both I-Pad and computer and their Wi-Fi is superior.

The room we stayed in was small and dirty. Although the hotel was slow, noone bothered to offer help with our bags. The bed was comfortable as reported in other posts. I had called ahead and requested special service for which they said no problem, but they failed or were unable to provide. Our experience was poor for a Westin.

review_title: Nice - but too many extra charges.
review_text: We came into town for a weekend road trip - saw a concert at the Newport. Like other reviews have noted, the rooms were smaller than average but super clean and crisp to make up for it. If you're looking for a value though, consider more than just the room charge. Internet is $9.95 per day, parking (non-valet) is $20 per day, there are no vending machines, no continental breakfast, and the restaurant downstairs is minimum $15 per person. Ala carte is fine in more metropolitan areas, but downtown Columbus is not very busy and my past several hotel experiences with other "above average" chains have been a much better value (most places are now providing wifi complimentary). Overall this Westin was nice - these comments are not complaints, just a warning.

We loved this hotel and will definitely go back the next time we are in Indy. The staff was more than helpful and the service was over the top. I visited the Tavern on the Plaza for a quick lunch; it was beautiful, and, again, the service was spectacular! One word of caution: there are a few websites that say this hotel has an outdoor pool. It does NOT; only an indoor pool is at the hotel. 
Our room looked out over Lucas Oil Stadium--the floor to ceiling windows were a great asset to the view! 
The bathroom was spotless. The shower was a walk-in with many jets; it was wonderful!
Definitely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Indy!!

Ciao questo e' un ottimo hotel soprattutto se si approfitta delle offerte on line, posizionato nel cuore di San Francisco vicini union square e ben collegato a tutta la cittÃ  le camere sono pulite grandi e spaziose se si vuol proprio trovare un difetto il bagno piccolo e datato, pero' davvero un ottimo hotel

I have to say all the staff is awesome they are very polite . It felt like I was at home and I have been in hotels travling alot and have not come across a nicer hotel . I have to come back in a few weeks and I know my stay will be good thank you for a great hotel .

review_title: The hotel staff is always willing to accommodate their guests.
review_text: As a frequent traveler, my demands tend to be greater than most guests. This particular staff is always willing to accommodate. Lovely pool and outdoor sitting area complete with heat lamps for windy Dallas nights. And GREAT beds. Enjoy!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Dallas DFW Airport - South

Muy poco para criticar. Lo Ãºnico deficiente fue la conecciÃ³n de internet la cual llegaba muy deficientemente a la habitaciÃ³n, seguramente al estar bastante alejada del punto de acceso. Por lo demÃ¡s, fue todo muy recomendable.
Beautiful building inside and out!! Loved my stay here, great location too.

Room was very nice, though a little small. It was very clean and smelled very nice. My only complaint with the place is the expensive charges for a few extras. Parking costs $20 (it includes valet, but self parking is also $20) and internet is another $10 (but they have free wifi in the lobby)... then of course there's the overly expensive snacks available in room.

review_title: Greate location but mattresses need replacing
review_text: Very convenient for those who want to enjoy Easton without the fuss of a long late-night drive home. Overall the rooms are great, but the mattresses are in poor shape as they lack firmness - it felt like my feet were higher than my head! I did not get a good night's sleep primarily because of that. Get new mattresses and the place would be perfect!

Easton is a strange place created by this outdoors mall environment. The Residence inn is the perfect, pleasant compliment to this strange mall-world. Nothing there feels older than a month. No structures seem permanent. It's a fleeting Vegas-kind-of-place. There's pubs close, restaurants close. it's nice. Period. No more no less.
Booze usually helps this kind of mediocrity go down smoother and regrettably you need to byob as the Residence Inn does not have bottle service. That's my only criticism. Breakfast was surprisingly yummy too, and the staffers were top notch. Very.... Nice.

review_title: Shopping heaven, with spot on service.
review_text: The front desk helped with menus and shopping information. Across from giant shopping and restaurants with free parking.
Excellent, modern, clean and friendly hotel. Located in the heart of Easton near grocery, restaurants and shopping.

We come every year for a car show held in Columbus. The staff is always friendly and helpful. The location is within walking distance to excellent restaurants and entertainment. Always clean, and quiet on a very busy weekend..
The hotek was great, great staff, comfortable rooms BUT there was music playing ALL NIGHT at magic mountain next door...i got no sleep at all, and the ac wouldnt stay on?
great staff beautiful rooms, very qiet, but pleasant....

Very clean, cozy and comfortable. One bedroom suite was just perfect for our family of 5. Mom & Dad slept wonderfully in the super comfy queen bed while 8yr old & 5yr old snoozed in the sofa bed and 2yr was perfect in the provided play yard. Looking forward to staying here again next year.
Stayed here for the 2nd time, clean spacious rooms, convenient to airport, bar and food good and reasonably priced...basic but can't grumble at the price for what you get..good choice.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Columbus Ohio Airport

review_text: Wonderful property, very few negatives but for me one exists, just one Why should they position a a very good tv in a room that you can't watch it from bed.
Very pleasant staff. Great location without the high Polaris price. Very clean and comfy.

review_title: Nice rooms, comfortable beds, great workout/pool area, but they need dark out curtains.
review_text: Overall I enjoyed my stay. Great customer service...the guy working the night desk let me use his personal iPod cord to charge my I touch. It has a pizza place and a jimmy johns a 2 minute walk away. The restaurants curry was good. The workout Area was nice and the saline pool was a nice feature. My only dislike was they did nOt have dark out curtains. The lights from the parking lot were pretty bright.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Columbus Ohio Airport

review_title: Wish I had more time to explore the area!
review_text: I was here for a 3 day conference and it was a great property. Sleeping rooms were large, my only complaint is that the bath towels seemed a little substandard when compared to other amenities. Meeting space was easy to get to and the pool bar and ' Whiskey and Rye' bar lounge were perfect for networking after the days sessions. I only wish I had some more freedoms to explore the area. Ther is a free trolleybthat would make this easy. Next time, I guess.
The Omni is a great place to stay while visiting Fort Worth. We have stayed in other downtown hotels and they just do not measure up.

review_title: Made me feel like a star!
review_text: Probably one of the nicest hotels I've stayed in. I was in town for a conference, so the rate was reasonable. It had a great location and is only a short walk to great bars and restaurants. The bathroom was huge and the on-site restaurants were delicious.

Hotel was very close to the interstate. Smoke free environment which was great. It was just shy $90 for one person which is not too bad, only gripe I have is the bed was a little on the hard side.. Other than that.. Free breakfast and pool made it a good stay
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Columbus West - Hilliard

review_text: Nice stay at courtyard at Easton. Clean and great location for shopping!

review_title: Overall a nice hotel. Pool was very small
review_text: This hotel is in a great location in Easton town center. Very convenient for shopping. So many shopping choices. The lobby was very clean and modern. Our room was also very nice and clean with modern decor. We had chose the breakfast option and the breakfast food was just ok. They had a 24 hr Starbucks which I loved. They have a really nice outdoor firepit too. The only con is the indoor pool. It was so small and freezing cold. We were looking forward to enjoying it since my 16 month old son loves the water but not this water! Too cold. I would recommend this hotel and would stay here again for the price. Next time we are at Easton we are going to give the Hilton a try though just because we have stayed at both marriotts and want to try a different hotel.

review_title: Housekeeping not up to par with Marriott standards
review_text:
I've stayed at this new Springhill Suites twice in the last few months and I love the location, fresh look and amenities.
The one thing that troubles me is the housekeeping service. Both times I stayed here when I checked in I noticed random hairs all over the place (sink, bed, floor) and both stays after returning to my room for the 2nd and 3rd evenings I found the rooms as messy as I left them with the exception of everything being straightened and fresh towels. Vacuumed? Nope. Toilet, sink, shower cleaned? Nope. Bed linens changed even after requesting them changed with the card they provide you? Nope. Management needs to step in and start doing a better job of making sure rooms are actually being cleaned and not straightened before guests arrive at their rooms.
With many nice other hotels to stay at in Columbus, I doubt I will return. Is it too much to ask for daily cleaning service when your paying $150 per night?

Had a short one night stay here. The gym area was pretty good. 
Though accessing internet was a hassle since we need to keep putting in the password. But overall it's a nice stay.
It is very close by the airport and there is Donatos Pizza close by.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Columbus Ohio Airport

review_title: Stop complaining,really good for the money!!!!
review_text: I stay all the time and the hotel and staff are great!!! People posting bad reveiws are people who need attitude adjustments. 1.do your reasearch,if you dont want to stay out where they are,dont go!!! 2.I have seen very rude people who walk in and expect the front desk to drop everything that second to help them, who are you? Get there first get help first,grow up people! Some people are just rude. Bottom line, it's a nice hotel, friendly staff and amanda the desk manager is great! I will continue useing them when i'm in town.
hotel_name: Baymont Inn and Suites Columbus at Rickenbacker

review_title: Great new property close to OSU!
review_text: Very nice new hotel. I travel a good bit for business and I'm always looking for good hotels for my $$$. Marriott does not disappoint with the new Springhill Suites. I liked that there are semi-separate sleeping and lounging quarters and that there is a split bathroom. Kinda cool people. Breakfast is free. There is a nice bar and patio area. I'll stay here on my next visit to Columbus.

review_title: Conference hotel with good service and location.
review_text: Clean, good staff, well equipped rooms with small fridge, large desk, free wireless, etc. Views from our room were poor (overlooking a roof 'garden') but overall a well- run conference hotel.

Front desk staff was indifferent, there were no newspapers, the pool was very cold, the deadbolt on our door was broken, the room smelled musty and we didn't care for the bathroom "barn door". Could be a nicer hotel with more attention to the details.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Columbus Ohio Airport

review_text: It is very close to Columbus airport. They have a big parking lot and there pizza and sandwich shop at the end of the parking lot. Best pizza ever! Hotel is a few years old (I think) so rooms are in good shape. Internet is fast , curtains are good enough to make the room dark. Bed is comfortable. I like this hotel. I stayed at this hotel three different times and I liked it every time. I hope they keep the good job. By the way airplanes dud not bother me at all.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Columbus Ohio Airport

review_title: Absolutely love staying at the Drury Inn at Columbus Convention Center.
review_text: I love this place. This hotel is conveniently located. Easy access to convention center. The rooms are comfortable & clean. The breakfast is fabulous...lots of options. Love the pool. This hotel is my preference when I come into the area.
hotel_name: Drury Inn & Suites Columbus Convention Center

review_text: Hotel was nice exempt first room had stain on the carpet the second room was very clean. The breakfast was ok could've had a better choice of foods though. Also you pay for parking that was a negative.
hotel_name: Drury Inn & Suites Columbus Convention Center

review_title: When we go back this will be my 1st choice of stay.
review_text: Room very clean. Employees very nice and know the area, very informative.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Fort Worth Inn & Suites

review_title: Nice Hotel if your going to the convention center
review_text: We had to stay 1 night in town because of a function at the convention center. The hotel is connected to the center so you never have to go outside in the weather. The hotel was clean and the staff was very friendly. The morning complimentary breakfast was better than most. I liked the added security of the locked garage and having to use your key to run the elevator. The room was $162.00 which is heavy for my taste but may be normal for downtown. It was a nice place to stay wish I could have gotten a better price but who doesn't. I would stay here again.
hotel_name: Drury Inn & Suites Columbus Convention Center

review_text:
Maybe bad luck, bad timing. But I have a suspicion that this stuff goes on after normal business hours. 
Speedy check-in. I asked for a quiet room - was told there were no kings left as I had booked. I said that's fine. Got to room 2** to hear young adults yelling, screaming, loud TV - again, no big deal. 
Went down requested different room. Went up - within 10 min someone was trying to open my door. The desk agent had given the same room to someone else. I called down to let them know. 10 minutes later my phone rang (probably the front desk) and hung up. 
All this at 10 pm. 
Because I didn't feel like hearing an explanation for all this chaos - I didn't ask for any concession. We will see if Four Points wants my business when I do ask.
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Columbus Ohio Airport

review_text: The only bad thing I can say was the bathroom was too small. This place was great. Good free breakfast...made to order omelets, hot oatmeal, etc. Free unlimited cocktails from 5-7! Great courtyard, nice size room. And best of all it was inexpensive!

I have mixed feelings about this review. Reviews here are correct to point out the helpful service. However I can't overlook the state of the first room we were given. 
We were just settling in and were interrupted by the front desk staff opening the door. Apparently the fact the room was occupied had slipped her mind, even though we had only checked in 20 minutes earlier. To be fair, she was profoundly apologetic. The reason for this room check became apparent when I pulled the covers back on the bed and it was covered in hair! This was a shock to say the least. I started brushing it off. But it became apparent that something had gone seriously wrong with the housekeeping. We rang reception and complained and got moved to another room (and upgraded to a suite). This was nice, but the damage had been done. I hope they got to the bottom of what happened with the room.
As mentioned, the staff were friendly and apologetic. Unfortunately I can't excuse the state of the original room.
Other points: value is pretty good. Location is not central at all, but you know that before arriving. Breakfast is very average- not worth it- go somewhere else an get a decent feed.
Overall, a disappointing experience. The staff did their best to make up for it, but it was hard to get over th initial experience.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Fort Worth Inn & Suites

review_text: We stayed here for two nights with our teenage daughters. The room was clean and modern - two large flat-screen TVs. Every single staff member we encountered was polite and gracious to a fault.

This hotel is Great. I stayed here for 3 nights. Had an excellent time! The check in process was simple. I was even able to view my suite prior to paying for it. I'm one real light sleeper so I had to make sure I'd get my sleep. I sure did. The clerk was real nice and respectful. The next day I ordered breakfast. My order wasn't correct but the kitchen then gave me one complimentary breakfast. That was also very appropriate customer service. On my 2nd day I slept in due to my work and flight schedule from the day before. Housekeeping still came back to sort my room out that afternoon. That was greatly appreciated. I used their shuttle service for some work appointments I had. Their driver Mike is excellent. Always respectful. I tipped him accordingly. I took the shuttle to the nearby Rave theatre. Great location as I was able to get some dinner at the Sushi restaurant next door before the movie began. So overall this newer hotel is in an excellent location. It's an upper scale hotel in one very classy area. If you like the nicer, contemporary atmospheres stay here. It's WORTH your Time as well as your money. It's Money well spent!

review_title: Don't stay here if you ever want to see your car again.
review_text: Stay here was a mess! No customer service. We waited over an hour for valet service to bring our car. While waiting we witnessed several people have to go into the valet room and locate their own keys. Valet couldnt even locate the cars of 2 other couples. People have waited over an hour and a half fortheir cars. This hotel isn't worth the money. There are plenty of others in the area closer to things you want to see and do without wasting your time here.

Sono stato al hotel argonaut per tre notti, in luna di miele e mi sono trovato veramente bene. Organizzazione, pulizia, cibo, posizione, cortesia tutto ciÃ² Ã¨ possibile all'Argonaut. Da notare che ogni sera per un'ora c'era gratis la degustazione vini per gli ospiti dell'albergo. L'arredamento in stile marinaro ne fanno un pisto unico e grazie alla posizione sul Fisherman's wharf e vicino al capolinea del cable car, in un attimo raggiungi il centro.

This is a lovely hotel with spacious rooms. We had a queen bed with a pullout sofa, both of which were comfortable. The only criticism I have is that there no extra blankets. The service was friendly, the restaurant serves great food, fresh ingredients and prompt service.

review_title: Great place to stay. Shop for deals!
review_text: First off, let me say that I am a less than leisure travler. My wife and I like good deals and I am not a snob. Which is to say I don't mind paying for nicer things if they are practical. With that said if you are looking for a nice place to stay omni fort worth is worth consideration. I booked through priceline which was the best deal available. Omni wanted 159 while I was able to get 95 through priceline. Upon arrival we were greeted by the valet and friendly staff. At check in the clerk was friendly and pleasent. My 2 year old son was given a bag of goodys when we checked in. The clerk asked if it was alright to let him have it which I thought was nice. The rooms were clean with no funky smell. The showers and restroom were nice. I didn't feel like I had to run around and disinfect everything. We stayed for 2 nights and would definantly book again.

I needed to stay near the Ft Worth Air Station and this was the perfect place. It was affordable and conveniently located. The staff was all very helpful, and the owner is such a warm, friendly man who is very concerned with making it the best possible stay. I had an extremely spacious amd clean room. Overall great and will be staying here again!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Fort Worth Inn & Suites

review_text: Not a 5 Star full service hotel, but in many ways it is better. Very clean, price is competitive and the extras make this place a must stay.
hotel_name: Drury Inn & Suites Columbus Convention Center

review_title: Very nice stay for shopping at Easton.
review_text: Upon calling to get reservations I felt the guy I spoke to talked down to me when I would ask a question. After that our experience was good. Very close to Easton shopping and restaurants. Expensive but nice

Driving down 70 took a wrong turn looking for a place to stay for the night on our NC to MI road trip. Ended up at this great location with clean rooms and facilities. Room was a great value for $107 and as a Hilton diamond breakfast was included. I was shocked to see soy milk on the buffet!! Breakfast is buffet and made to order. Neutrogena products in all bathrooms and conplimentary tazo teas and Starbucks coffee. Great stay!!

As a Hilton Diamond Member we usually stay in Hilton Properties, but this Marriott property was the best price we could find in the reward properties in which we are enrolled. This place impressed all 4 of us and we would be happy to visit this chain again. Clean, pleasant staff,
good breakfast...what more could you want?

review_title: Great room, good location, average service
review_text:
Just left this hotel after an 18-night stay. The rooms, like almost any Residence Inn, were terrific. Monday thru Thursday they provide dinner and breakfast is served 5 days a week. The lady in charge of breakfast puts out a wonderful spread but has a tendency to start clean-up early. We were in town to conduct a 3-week army fitness study, which generally had us working from 3:30am to 9:00ish. Often we'd get back at 9:20 to find the food out buy the plates and silverware already put away. The lady was sweet as pie and my gut feeling is that she was just trying to be efficient, but it was still a little off-putting.
The location is very handy, next it I-10 and across the street from a mall and movie theater. Yvette and Luis at the front desk were extremely friendly and helpful. The housekeeping staff just about gave me an ulcer however. Due to my schedule above I normally got back to my room at 10am. In order to facilitate an uninterrupted nap, I asked the housekeeper to do my room before I got back. For 3 days in a row, I came home to a beautiful room. After that, some days she'd fail to come at all, or forget she'd already done the room and come back, waking me up when I heard her come in. Given that I'd be sleeping on the bed in boxers and a t-shirt, this got annoying very quickly.
So, to summarize: great room, good location, so so service...

review_title: Don't go with the high tripadvisor rating..worst hotel stay of our holiday
review_text:
How this hotel ended up number 3 of hotels in fort worth is beyond me. upon arrival I asked if we could swap our queen room for a king as I made a mistake. I was informed that there were none available. Upon entering our room out was like stepping back outside into the 40c heat. The air con although working had only just been switched on. The fridge door head been left open so water was leaking onto the floor and the smoke alarm was hanging from the wall by loose wires! Upon checking via my phone to check availability at this hotel, I noted that there were still 2 king rooms available. I complained to the receptionist who advised me that there were none available. He then gave me another queen room that was actually hotter than outside, so I was forced to accept my original cool luxurious room. I challenged the receptionist a to why the air con had just been switched on and was advised that it was because they had not been in use so he only just switched them on. Check in for this hotel is 3pm so I guess unless you are lucky enough that someone was staying in the room that you are allocated the day before, I wouldn't bother arriving until after dark if you like to sleep in non saharan
 conditions. Again, i'd love to know how this hotel got such high ratings? Quite frankly not worth to carry the Best Western name..avoid at all costs.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Fort Worth Inn & Suites

review_text: Def will stay again. Convenient to airport. Nice, clean and comfortable.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express El Paso - Central

review_title: Breath of fresh area compared with other hotels in this town; wonderful experience!
review_text: Great experience! I had been at a few other hotels in town and they were extremely run down. Grateful that we found one in a good location that was clean and comfortable!

review_title: Aging Residence Inn in a convenient location with outstanding front desk service
review_text: Stayed here for one week in hot August. The HVAC worked wonderfully well. The rooms are spacious but showing their age. Comfortable and very functional, like a solid apartment. Not fancy. TVs were upgraded while I was there....a good sign that they are improving the place. Norma and other front desk staff were very friendly and helpful...getting to know guests and offering helpful suggestions and directions. Standard breakfast selections. I will stay there again, due to the staff. Their effort make this four star rating turn to five.

I stay at this hotel for business purposes and I enjoy staying here. Rooms are very clean and decent size. I get free Internet access as well. Breakfast in the morning is average and you can order from the kitchen as well but for this you are charged. Overall, great hotel and very clean.

We stay in El Paso a couple of times each year. This is the best we have found for the price. Includes continental breakfast and you can pay for hot breakfast. Clean, free Internet, updated rooms and Hyatt points to boot. We'll be back.

review_title: Friendly staff, great breakfast, good value for the cost.
review_text: Friendly staff, great breakfast, good value for the cost.

review_title: Huge improvement - kudos to the staff
review_text: We have stayed in this hotel for a business meeting several years in a row. While it has always been a great hotel, this year I have noticed major service improvements. The rooms are cleaner, staff is friendlier, even the toiletries are nicer (Peter Thomas Roth). There is a new guest service hotline button on the phone that saves you from trying to figure out who to call with your request. Last night we called at 11 pm and asked for a hypoallergenic pillow & we delivered 2 within minutes. It is nice to see that this hotel has made improvements...in my mind they have gone from good to great!

Our room is nice. 80s decor, but very clean. Room has king-size bed, sitting area, small kitchen with microwave and refrigerator, bathroom with tub. Comfortable and clean. Better than average room. Location is right off I-10, but inside room is quiet. Outside looks like an apartment complex. No complaints. Have stayed in much worse.

review_title: Great service, good location, nice facility.
review_text: Very close to elp, this marriott stands apart from others with its great service. Clearly they are working to modernize the facilities. Very convenient location for business travel, the service works hard to help make the trip successful.

Good location. 
Nice property that has seen better times. 
Carpets needs replacement, or at least some intensive cleaning. Hallway carpets were filthy. 
Elliptical machine at the gym is old and noisy. 
Service is correct but slow, nothing special. 
Needs improvement to keep up with Hilton standards.

review_title: Great inexpensive, central location in El Paso.
review_text:
We stayed here while attending a wedding in El Paso. It was great because the hotel is right in I-10 making it impossible to not find your way back. It's clearly visible from any direction. 
The hotel itself is nicely updated and the rooms are very effecient, yet comfortable and stylish. I was able to get a good sleep in the bed ad the room temp was very consistent which, if you travel frequently, you know is rarely the case. 
The lobby is nice and very easy to relax in. The pool and hot tub are small but they serve their purpose and the outdoor patio is a great place to enjoy the warm El Paso nights. Food, gas, airport, and shopping are all very close. The food selection is limited and expensive and there's no continental breakfast to be had. We have family throughout the area so we still didn't spend much on eats, but if you don't be prepared to shell out $$ for every meal. You can request a room with a fridge, but none have microwaves. 
For the price you can't beat it. Probably the least expensive but the mos modern hotel in the area.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott El Paso Airport

review_text:
My stay wasn't bad but I'm glad it was only one night. The staff was very nice as was the shuttle service to the airport. There's a free, continental breakfast and manager's reception which are perks also.
The rooms are very small and in dire need of updates. The room I stayed in was moderately clean but if you looked under the sink and on the sides of the beds or near the outlets which were hard to get to- there was dust, dirt and neglect. I wouldn't walk barefoot in the room but the shower and bed seemed clean.
Again, for $88 and one evening- the stay was fine. I don't think I'd pay more or stay there longer than a night or two.

After reading some of the reviews on this hotel it's obvious the people who gave more than a 2 rating don't know what clean or well kept means! I didn't spend more than 30 minutes in the room because it was so horrible! Completely nasty! The ac unit was falling apart and had duck tap around it! The bath tube had stains in it. There was hair in the sink, toilet, and all over the floor! If you don't think that's unsanitary than your an idiot! My husband is six feet plus tall and the shower came to his chest?! There where stains on the carpet, lounge chair, computer chair, bed sheets, and walls! The curtains had mildew on them. The lady at the front desk was a complete bit**!!!!!! she hung up on my husband when he called to complain and gave me an attitude when I told her we wanted a refund, she didn't even ask what was wrong!! The pool was a joke! And restaurant and bar had flies everywhere! Needless to say we will be making a call to headquarters to complain! If you have any common sense DO NOT STAY HERE!!!!!!!!!!

This was my first time in el paso to visit my brother who is stationed here. The hotel was convienently 1 mile from ft. Bliss and about 4 minutes from the airport. The staff was very helpful with recommendations. There is a big outdoor pool. The continental breakfast was also great and included american and mexican dishes

This a nice place to stay and a safe place. With all the news about Mexico borders you wold think that El Paso is a war zone. During the day, it was fine and all the stuff is happening across the border. I played it safe and dtayed here and ordered meals in and stayed off the roads ad much as possible.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott El Paso Airport

review_title: Older hotel that use a makeover buy was still nice.
review_text:
I stayed here on May 20th for one night on my way to San Antonio. The hotel was easy to find and had plenty of parking. Check in was quick and the staff very nice. Our room was dated yet very clean. Our bed was awesome and the linens white and crisp. Overall it was a good value for what I paid. I booked on name your own price on priceline and won $59.00 plus fees and taxes
We looked at the food menu and it seemed pricy so we opted for one of many places to eat within walking distance. 
I can't com

Checked in to the Suite which was more like a Roach Inn. Great location right off the highway was not worth all the itchy eyes, sneezing. My roomy took a shower, walked around to get dressed then upon putting her shoes on, her feet were black from the disgustingly, filthy carpet! Mind you they were squeaky clean! When we asked to move to a better room, the rebuttal was the rooms are all the same. Scary! And this is a Ramada!!? No Thanks!!

review_title: Help I can't get out fast enough!!
review_text: Old and run down! The lobby is fabulous! To bad the rest looks like a run down trailer park!! The carpet is grimy and very scary dirty!!! Smells like old mold. I went to the front desk an asked for a better room and I was told that is what all their rooms look like. I could not get out fast ENOUGH!! Come on Ramada you can do way better than this!!

review_title: Fine, but I'd look elsewhere before booking this hotel.
review_text:
I stayed at this hotel for one night before flying home from a business trip, and it was fine for that purpose. The hotel was not as well kept as most Hampton Inns where I've stayed. Some things have been updated recently (bathroom tile, vanity, some fixtures), but most of the hotel needs to be updated. The carpet, in particular, needs to be replaced. 
Again, it was fine for one night; however, I would look for another airport hotel before staying here again.
It's good enough but you need to ask for a room at the back so you don't hear the noise of the Highway

review_title: Close to the airport but horrible WIFI ACCESS
review_text: I was very exited about this hotel when I had it on my schedule but once at the hotel I noticed there was a huge problem with wifi access. I wasn't able to connect to wifi on my room and the few times I got connected it was just for few secondsand then it goes away again. Maybe for some people this is not a big issue but it is for me since I am a business man and have a lot of work to do.

Do NOT stay here!!!! We checked in, went to our room and checked right back out. The room smelled musty and moldy, the couch was filthy and torn -looked about 40 years old. Did check for bed bugs and did not find any, however I would have rather slept in the bathroom. The room as a whole was horrible. I rated the service as very good bc the guy gave us all our money back.
hotel_name: Studio Plus Deluxe Studios - El Paso - West

review_title: Excellent hotel in downtown El Paso
review_text: When arriving in El Paso you can't miss the Doubletree. It 's right next downtown and one of the largest buildings. This hotel is typically a business orientated facility, but is for us as tourists also very pleasant. Rooms are excellent, breakfast wonderfull. Typical Hilton quality.
hotel_name: Doubletree Hotel El Paso Downtown/City Center

review_text: Keeping in mind this is basic economy lodging, you get a basic, clean and comfortable room at a good value. This property is very old but was built as a Holiday Inn originally, therefore the room size is much larger than a typical Motel 6. I've stayed here several times and have always found the room to be clean and the front desk staff courteous & helpful. Also the guest laundry works well and the location, while in a mediocre neighborhood, is very convenient to all parts of the city. If you expect luxury you'll be disappointed, but if a basic clean room is what you need, this is it!

The bar next door is great - but evety local here told us its known as an "hourly" motel. We were expecting not great facilities but we encountered total heebiejeebies. Its hot, the AC sucks, it smells like something weird happened in there, and the tv only plays telemundo. Lets just say its lucky STDs arent contracted via pillowcases. Only redeeming quality is the Hoppy Monk next door, great people and great beer.

U get wat u pay for, when we got in the room the tv buttons were all broke there was no remote control we call frnt dsk and the guy said he was on it way to bring it well he never showed up pillows had hairs and were dirty fire alarm was broke plus walls were dirty from a party or so, we asked for another room and the frfont desk guy said no because we had already been there for 15mins obviously we were waiting for him to bring us the control and there went the 15mins he was rude and had the "I don't care" attitude they should really checked the rooms before renting it, I will never go back and will mark mesa inn on my black list

Stayed there briefly front desk was dirty and not friendly at all if that's your first impression what more could I expect the room was handicap did not like that I thought that was for handicap people only it sad couse if they needed that room we would have to move but oh well so much for customer service right
hotel_name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham El Paso West

review_text:
Of all the different hotels I have stayed at over the years, the Chase Suite Hotel is one of the very best. The staff will make you feel right at home. They are also a pet friendly hotel; allowing both dogs and cats.
I would most definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to stay at a suite hotel whether just for the night or an extended stay; and have someone else do the grocery shopping for them.

review_title: Alles bestens und das in toller Lage
review_text:
Wir haben drei Nachte in dem Hotel verbracht. Die Lage ist perfekt zentral, die Leute freundlich und sonst entsprach alles den Erwartungen. Ich wÃ¼rde meinen nÃ¤chsten Aufenthalt in San Fran wieder hier buchen.
Rundherum gibt es auch noch ein paar gute MÃ¶glichkeiten zum shoppen und zum Essen und Trinken.

My husband is stationed at Fort Bliss and is deploying in a few weeks. The waiting list for on base housing is months long and it's pointless to get an apartment so we had to stay at the Travelodge. The first night wasn't bad. We were on the second flood in a non smoking room. The second night was worse. The smoke from the room below us was coming up into our room. Also, do not stay here if you have a pet. They hate animals and will find any excuse to make you pay more money for them or force you to leave. They have a $10/night pet policy but somehow tried to charge us $25/night. Our dog barked once(I was there), it ticked someone off, and the manager charged us for it. When I tried to talk to her about it, she refused to talk to me. I do not recommend anyone stay here. Another thing, the floors are filthy. My socks and slippers are literally black with filth from the floor. I plan on calling the better business bureau on this dump

My room was very clean. No problems with my room. The breakfest kinda sucked but its free. My only problem was there WiFi was awful could never get connected. Staff moved me to another room but didn't help. Staff was very freindly

I have been wanting to stay here for the last 10 years and what a let down!! We are relocating to Columbus and my company put me up here so I didn't even pay for it and complained for their money! First my SO and I are both tall. I am 5'9" and he is 6'2". Why they put us in an ADA room with a short shower is beyond me. Then the shower was dirty, complete with someones sliver of soap. The sheets are not high quality as you would expect in this hotel. Parking is a nightmare for guests. You either pay the $10 for valet or be prepared to hoof it to one of of the mall garages with your stuff. The Internet is $10 a day. Upon check in you are asked to sign an agreement saying you will pay $100 fee if you cuy your stay short - I've traveled all over the world and have never encountered this. They clearly know this hotel is not worth the price. I've stayed on the other end of the strip at the Courtyard and would go back there in a second. The atmosphere is pretty though! When I complained to the from desk gal regarding all these issues, all I got was a bunch of blinking eyes and continued "I'm sorry". Hardly makes up for $400 of wasted money.

My sister and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The convenience from the airport is a reasonable walking distance for most people. To be able to shoot right back to the airport on departure day allowed us to enjoy an extra hour and a half at the pool.
We stayed here for 2 nights. Staff is accommodating. They will shuttle you within I think about a 3 mi radius.
The pool is very nice with a bar area nearby, lots of chairs and music for just about anyone. We even enjoyed the waterside.
If you book through expedia, you may get a room in the outer buildings which other reviewers said were noisy. You get what you pay for! If you book a suite ( which you can do on expedia or other travel sites) you will probably get a room in the main building. We had a double suite which also had a living area. We had no complaints about our room except that there was a problem calling any of the hotel services from our room phone.
Very happy with our choice of hotels and after visiting the downtown area, glad we made the choice we did! I also just wanted to note the helpfulness and great attitude of the citizens we encountered there!

review_title: Not a Hilton or Marriot but.......
review_text: The room is clean and peaceful. Yeah, outdated and no flair at all but it's not hard to manipulate the front desk into a cheaper rate if you know how to talk. I probably would not put the wife and kids here but when traveling alone, I recommend it.

review_title: Enormous space, with a wonderful view. You will be glad that you stayed here.
review_text: Everything that you would want within a hotel is here trust me you will not regret your stay.

review_title: Over all good stay.... but lacking...
review_text:
This was a very nice, clean, affordable hotel room. The location was very convenient for shopping and restaurants.. We were happy with the location. The Staff was very friendly..
 However my only complaint was no microwave or fridge.. the coffee maker was in the restroom???? The spa was closed..?? We weren't able to get extra towels our last night.. They ran out?? Also we were in Room 208 Right behind the elevator.. All we heard was the elevator going up and down our entire stay. A little annoying after awhile. I do not recommend to get those rooms 108, 208, 308, 408.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites I-10 East

review_title: For the price its worth it
review_text: The title says all ... Not the best hotel ever but overall i would spend another night here
hotel_name: Americas Best Value Inn - El Paso / Medical Center

review_text: This place is quite clean and nice. The beds are comfy and although the area is kinda sketchy, I haven't had any problems. I've stayed here on countless occasions as I drive back in forth from Texas to Arizona and I keep coming back :)
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites El Paso Bartlett

review_title: Not worthy of the name Holiday Inn.
review_text:
I have stayed in this hotel two times over a three year period. 
This time I was trying to avoid it and thought I was booking a different location. I arrived and was sad to realize my mistake. 
I love the brand, but this hotel is old and the bathrooms were not updated, actually needing repair.
 Showers are moldy and have mildew on ceiling. Shower tiles were cracked and loose. 
Sink was ugly. This felt like a $30 room, but it was over $150.
The bed had stained sheets. 
Room key would not work in card reader, and neither would its replacement. 
Owner needs to spend some $ on updating before I stay here again.
Actually, I won't ever stay here again.

review_title: Nice enough for the price you pay.
review_text: This hotel is located near numerous restaurants and a movie theater. It was clean and comfortable. The only negative about the room was the small bathroom. The complimentary breakfast was just okay. There was no hot food but you could walk next door to Crackle Barrel if you wanted to.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn El Paso West

review_text: Overall I had a great stay the person at the front desk was very friendly and helpful Ivan Juarez was his name. So I would stay here again and would also recommend this hotel. Great staff
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn - El Paso West

review_text:
I stayed in this dump with my parents, when we made the
Check in the clerk desk employee was extremly rude , my mother asked this guy for a first floor room and he said NO in a very disrespectufull way , then the ice machine did not work, the hotel smelled awfull . I would recomend every one to stay away from this crapy hotel
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn - El Paso West

review_text: Nel complesso un buon hotel, niente di eccezionale, perÃ³ fa respirare l'aria della vecchia Frisco... Ãˆ comodissimo, direttamente su Union Square. Per chi viaggia in macchina, considerate che questo Ã¨ uno dei pochi hotel che offre il parcheggio gratuito e non Ã¨ cosa da poco considerato che mediamente ci vorrebbero almeno 50 dollari al giorno...
I stayed here at the holiday inn and had the best stay ever. The rooms are super clean and the staff is great.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn El Paso-Sunland & I-10 W.

review_text: The hotel was nice. Very clean, nice accommodations (sleep number beds), and very close to the airport. Despite being close to the airport, I did not remember hearing airplane noise. Nice place, would definitely stay here again.

review_title: 1. The Good, 2. the Bad, and 3. the Ugly
review_text:
1. Easy access from the freeway if traveling west to east.
1. Free wiFi.Â 
1. Microwave and fridge and in-room coffee.
1. Good bed clothes.Â 
2. Front desk clerk with halitosis and stains on his pants.
2. Sign leading to nowhere when looking for ice.

The other unlabeled pillows were as hard and of the same size until you grabbed one by the seamed end of the pillow case and gave a mighty shake. Voila! A standard pillow in size and softness!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn El Paso-Sunland & I-10 W.

review_title: Comfortable, clean, and great service at front desk.
review_text: We chose this hotel based on location, north El Paso, but the location is better than imagined near restaurants, movies, and shopping. They were out of king bedrooms so we chose 2 doubles and found the beds quite comfortable. My husband liked the large recliner, and I was impressed by the modern kitchenette which was well stocked. The bathroom was well designed with hook on the wall instead of the back of the door, and the water was hot. The snack store was nice too. We did not use the fitness center but it looked better than most.
Very close to base but had no breakfast and shower had hair in it. I could have stayed at mariot for same price.

review_title: Best Staff, Clean, and Great Location.
review_text:
I just stayed for 2 nights, Sept 2011, here and I was seriously impressed. Honestly I don't ever book Holiday Inn - this was more like a Marriott.
The rooms are average but clean, flat screen, and most importantly room service. We had a club sandwich and fries and it was excellent.
The staff is AMAZING. I came with a family member for a medical procedure and w encountered several medical problems while there. The staff was so helpful...shuttle to and from medical office, Walgreens for prescriptiins, restaurants for food, etc. Edgar is a maintenance guy there and since the shuttle persin wasn't available he even stepped up and drove me out for food. Also the dining area went out of their way to make a couple things off the menu as my niece was ill.
The pool area is nice and relaxing with loungers.
Location is great...mall across street, PF Changs, and many other chain restaurants.
Overall, if I ever ended up back in El Paso I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. The staff deserve a round of thanks! great job.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn El Paso-Sunland & I-10 W.

review_text: Descent room rate - comfortable bed - quiet room- clean bathroom - all employees very nice & helpful - good breakfast buffet - was charged incorrectly for in room movie but was assured it would be corrected when management arrived .
hotel_name: Holiday Inn El Paso-Sunland & I-10 W.

review_text: Good hotel, but not great. Some of the staff was unpersonable, but there where a few that where very nice! Sarah was very sweet, and helped us a lot! The room was spacious and I liked the fridge and microwave. But I do wish the comforter wasn't one of those tipocall trashy hotel ones. But other than that it was a nice hotel, especially for the price!

review_title: Definitely Not #1--Something is not right about reviews
review_text: We saw the #1 rating and having never been in El Paso before, made a reservation. People are friendly, but hotel has external room doors like a motel, very dated, room smelled a little off and air conditioning is old. Just does not compare well to the newer value chains at exits 24 and 25. Trip Advisor let us down on this one.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn El Paso-Sunland & I-10 W.

review_text: This hotel is one of the best values in El Paso. During the week hotels prices for mid range to high quality hotels are at a premium. This is one of the most reasonably priced. Hotel is very clean and attractive. Rooms are nice with flatscreen tv. Lots of good restaurants in vicinity. Standard fare for breakfast. Decent exercise room and indoor pool and hot tub.

review_title: Nice hotel in a bad location
review_text: Room was very clean and comfortable except for the long ugly hair I found in one of the 2 ceramic coffe mugs. Bed was a little to hard for me but ok. Loved the shower. Unfortunately the hotel is next to the freeway and the rooms arent very sound proof. Had to use the fan to drown out the traffic noise and the sounds of someone walking in the room above me. Nice but small work out room, went down twice to work out but someone was always on the machine I use. Close to alot of stores and food also close to airport.
Por mejorar. El internet si es muy malo, por lo menos el dÃ­a que me quede
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn El Paso Lomaland

review_text: There's only two things this hotel needed to make the best for me, a microwave and mini fridge in the regular rooms! We stayed three nights and the staff was excellent very professional and acted like they where truly happy to see us!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites El Paso Airport Area

review_text: I was in town to visit family for several days. I chose this hotel because it was close to family. The Hotel was clean and the staff were very nice and helpful. Beds are comfy. In-room microwave fridge and coffee maker were nice. The breakfast is ok - make your own continental style. It's way better than buying a breakfast burrito at a local fast food chain. Lots of restaurants close by. A bit pricey for the location, since you can hear I-10 from the room. I still gave it a high rating as the cleanliness and other amenities make it a good place to stay.

I stayed there for three nights and had my camera case with it's accessories totaling about $80 stolen the first day! And of course no one will confess. I left my name, number, and description of the stolen items at the front desk and they never even called to say weather it was or wasn't retrieved. And the location is horrible! Don't stay on the left side unless you want to hear roaring traffic from the highway all night and don't stay on the right side if you would like to open your window and see more than a cement wall with graffiti like advertisements across it. And pray you don't get put in the handicap room and someone rings the makeshift doorbell in the middle of the night. It's literally the EXACT same thing as a smoke detector going off. And if you value your life please don't use the toxic hot tub. They put so much chlorine in it you could smell it through the the in the "workout room" and they had to close it. Smh, never going back.

Magnifico tutto: la camera, pulita e ricca di ogni confort (sembrava di dormire sottoperta in barca!), la colazione nell'attiguo bar (dolce, salato, frutta, ecc), la posizione sul lungomare, non distante dal Pier 39. Per finire, l'happy hour con vino e snack. Un indirizzo sicuro, da tornarci subito!!

Awesome hotel! STAY HERE!! Not only do you get a free breakfast they serve dinners on sertain nights for FREE! Excellent room! Clean clean clean! Service was beyond helpfull! If I could live here I would! Haha deffinitley get a suite! It's like a mini apartment! I don't know what else I could say to tell you how great this place is overall!
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites El Paso Airport Area

review_title: The "Lindset Lohan" of hotels; beautiful on the outside, a wreck on the inside.
review_text:
This hotel looks great from the outside and even better from the lobby, but that is the extent of it, period. The Doom Bar inside is cool, but the rooms are atrocious. The hotel wreaks of mold & mildew from years of using evaporative cooling. I booked a huge room with an attached large living room - supposed to be one of the nicest and definitely one of the most expensive ($300+), but it looked like communist-block era accommodations: no pictures on the walls, everything was run down & looked like it belonged in a hotel in which you pay by the hour. One of the worst I've ever stayed in.
The staff is nice and professional.
Don't waste your money here, unless you're going to the bar only. You'd do better at a Motel6, no joke.
Excellent customer service! Good rooms and comfortable stay!
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn - El Paso East

review_text: First of all this hotel is in America so why isn't their website in english? And why does the staff speak spanish to you first instead of English? The room was very outdated, the bathroom fixtures were disgusting! The tub faucet had holes in it.
First time in El Paso this place needs an upgrade/ remodel soon!! Squeaky old elevators scary!!
The gentlemen in front desk ( Aurther ) was very helpful...need more friendly people like him....
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn - El Paso East

review_text: Thouroughly enjoyed my stay. Restaurants were excellent and the overall service was great. Will definitely stay there again

My family and I had driven for 13hrs straight,when we got to el paso we pulled in at the red roof inn Arthur (front desk clerk) cattered to our needs and made us feel welcomed and most important, guaranteed our continuous business at the red roof inn!!!!
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn - El Paso East

review_text: We stayed in a one bed suite and we loved the hardwood floor and the heater warmed us up right away. We also enjoyed watching movies on the flat panel television. The receptionist, Bea, was very friendly and helpful as well!
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn - El Paso East

review_title: Feel at home away from home
review_text: Always helpful staff....V at front desk always nice and helpful....this is where ill continue to stay
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn - El Paso East

review_text:
The lady at the front desk double charged my husband AND myself after we asked to extend our stay an extra night. After we notices that we had BOTH been charged for the same room for different lengths of stay, the lady was very rude and not cooperative. Seeing how we were to check out very early the following morning we wanted to resolve the problem. At no point was the lady able to explain the difference between 'authorizing' a credit card and 'charging' which apparently were the same thing. 
Be careful when extending your stay!
hotel_name: Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham - El Paso

review_text: I stayed here the evening of Thanksgiving with my family. The entire hotel is clean, modern, and very comfy. The beds are comfy and bathrooms quite roomy. The breakfast was quite good with lots to choose from.
Staff is very rude, i had things come up missing when i went to complain i was told to leave if i didnt like it there
hotel_name: Red Roof Inn - El Paso East

review_title: Don't kiss this frog, no prince awaits.
review_text:
I lived in El Paso for almost ten years and never stepped foot in a room until now. What a letdown.
The charm of the hotel is overshadowed by the dated fixtures and amenities. The Dome Bar is neat, the architecture wonderful and detailed. 
Then there's the rooms... 
Old.
Dated fixtures.
Poor plumbing and air conditioning.
TV's you've already thrown away.
No closets, just an armoire.
Leaky toilets.
It took three times for me to get a room I accepted, and that was because I was tired of going up and down to get a new key.
Service...
Kind of bi-polar. Some very helpful individuals, and happy to assist, then others that were collecting a paycheck and you are their daily hazard.
Parking... $6 is a joke. $6 for what?
$6 to park in a crime scene waiting happen?
I used a pay first website to book this hotel, and am disappointed all around. Last time I was fortunate to get another downtown hotel and was more than satisfied with my experience. This time, not so much.
If you have the choice, stay at another hotel and come have a beverage in the bar. Take a picture. Then go back to your updated and more appropriately priced accommodations.
This is my second time here and glad I came back! Rooms are great, and the manager special is awesome!

review_title: Convenient location, great choice when staying in Columbus.
review_text: Very clean rooms. Location is close to downtown and convenient, seems very safe. The hotel itself is located in a business plaza with 2 restaurants and a gym, but nothing else is within walking distance. Free parking in a garage and free continental breakfast (which, to be honest, is mediocre) The employees were all very nice and helpful. Rooms were clean, well stocked. The indoor pool was a bit on the cold side and a extremely chlorinated-kids came out with bright red eyes. Overall a great choice and we would stay here again.

review_title: Great for events at convention center!
review_text: We were attending an event at the convention center and this is the absolut closest. Got a great rate of $90 a night on the Internet. This is an older historic hotel that was updated and renovated in 1986 so keep that in mind. Rooms are large and we had a great view of the mountains. Free wifi and it worked great. Also on Friday and Saturday night there was a free concert series going on at a pavillion right outside so that added some free entertainment.

This was our first stay in a Hyatt Place and we were very impressed!
The layout of the room is great because of the large l-shaped couch creating your sitting area. It felt so much more spacious than a standard hotel room.
Great to have a fridge and coffee maker in the room.
The location is quite handy - we walked to both Short North and downtown on separate occasions. It's about a half hour walk to either - it's not scenic cause you are crossing the freeway but it's an easy walk.
The staff were really friendly but seemed to be new cause they didn't have a lot of info on the local area.
Free breakfast and wifi were great! It is a continental breakfast only so hot food must be ordered and paid for but with cereal, fruit, toast, muffins or bagels and yogurt plus juice and coffee, there is still plenty to choose from.
Definitely a fan of the Hyatt Place brand now!

review_title: Friendly but painfully inadequately trained staff...
review_text: Came to the camino hotel for the 2010 Sun Bowl (Go Irish) and, initially was quite impressed with the appearance and feel of the hotel. My wife and I thought the lobby and room was full of character; however, there were only about 12 people in the bar by the time we made our way down with 3 bartenders and they could not keep up, their beer was warm and incredibly pricey. Then, the next morning we were charged for a complimentary breakfast and made to pay, our waitress, although incredibly sweet and hard working did not speak English very well and I had to wait over 20 minutes for a diet coke and a bailey's cream coffee. My sister and brother in law who were staying in a room joining ours called for room service for breakfast and could not get anyone to answer the phone at the restaurant, perhaps they weren't prepared for the influx of fans but, with that being said, 20 minutes for a soft drink is ridiculous. Also, the heating and ac in the rooms were terrible, it was either freezing or a sauna...no in between. Further, with the price and so called 3 1/2 star rating and self proclaimed top ten world rated bars, perhaps the beds would be more comfortable, the staff more prepared and the ammenities more adequate. I didn't hate my experience here but don't think I'll be returning.

I stay at this hotel once a month for work and have never been disappointed... except when they are booked up and I have to stay somewhere else! The area offers shopping, restaurants, and convenience to Memphis.

This hotel is a great affordable hotel for the family. I would have given it 5 stars if it was really smoke free. Someone should enforce the non smoking rule. Good housekeeping, fast check in and out, and pretty good breakfast.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Galleria Inn and Suites

review_title: Fluctuating water temperature not a great way to start the day!
review_text: We were accommodated with an early check-in, very helpful. Room was small and a/c not working well. Small bathroom and water temperature and pressure very average. Breakfast quite good and microwave and fridge in room good also. Only 1 elevator which was frustratingly slow and also shared by hotel employees, service elevator needed. Free parking a plus but no complimentary newspapers.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Galleria Inn and Suites

review_text: The tripadvisor summary says there is a continental breakfast - there is none but a $10/person buffet. Also a crib cost $10/night. Other than that it was a great place - nicely updated, comfy pillows and beds, vry clean, good service etc. Also I booked thru priceline and got the roomfor $89 instead of the $99 quoted at front desk. Good night stay!
hotel_name: Four Points by Sheraton Memphis East

review_text: Average hotel, looks like they upgraded recently but the room still looks a little run down. Bathroom needs renovation. AC was so loud and the room still felt sticky after it was on high for a while. Okay for one night. Should be closer to like $60-$70 bux a night. Breakfast was okay. Attendant during breakfast was very nice & helpful. Served its purpose...decent nights sleep, in safe area.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Galleria Inn and Suites

review_text: While traveling on business I chose this hotel for a 3 week stay. The location was second too none. The hotel staff was professional and courteous the entire stay. Would recommend anyone traveling in this area to select this hotel for their accommodations.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Galleria Inn and Suites

review_text: We became a fan om facebook and got a discounted rate. Our room was big! It was clean too. We always pull out beds and check for pests and we found none. Pull out sofa matress was new but lumpy and uncomfortable fyi. Double beds were soft and nice. Overall it was a good stay breakfast was good and the location was close to everything you could want to see or do. Our rate with facebook friend was $83 plus tax.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Galleria Inn and Suites

review_text: My only suggestion for someone staying at this hotel would be to get a room on the side not next to the interstate.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Galleria Inn and Suites

review_text:
My stay at this Sleep Inn was awesome!!!
Stayed in a king suite room that had two bathrooms and separate sitting area with sofa sleeper. The decor of the room was very modern and beautiful. The staff was friendly. Trolley stops in front of hotel. Great area to enjoy downtown activities!!!

review_title: Excellent hotel, good value for money
review_text:
Stayed here for three nights, 16 to 18 October. Great location,easy walking distance to main attractions, Beale Street etc, but quiet. Staff were very helpful and pleasant. We ate breakfast in the bistro each day, didn't seem too expensive and staff were obliging in fixing suitable food to meet our vegetarian needs. The room was a good size, lots of storage space so we could properly unpack. Great shower. Free wifi though not the most powerful, fridge didn't work as others have complained,but this didn't affect our stay. Free guest laundry was an unexpected bonus.
Enjoyed our stay here!

I have stayed at Hyatt's so I have a high expectation of them. The room is nice. It wad clean and very spacious. I was annoyed that I left at 9am and returned at 4pm and my room still hadn't been cleaned! I had to call down and ask for it to he serviced. Also the walls are thin. My room say over the entrance to the hotel on the second floor. I awoke at 2am to drunken partiers hanging out front! I called down to complain. The next night I called to ask for a fan because if what happened the night before but they didn't have any. The free breakfast is a joke. I've stayed at far cheaper hotels with MUCH better breakfast. If you want a hot meal they will make it but it vist an arm and a leg!

review_title: The room is just atrociously dirty!
review_text:
I am writing this as I am sitting in the room...and looking at the black stains that grace almost the entire carpeted area (I refuse to look at the colorful grime around the toilet again).
I just settled into the room after a long day and proceed to turn on lights and get ready for bed...
Turning on the lights was the mistake.
1. The carpet is covered in some sort of dried grime (like a spill that was never cleaned properly & allowed to collect dirt).
2. The bathroom on cursory inspection seemed clean, until I dropped my ring and it rolled towards the toilet. I will not elaborate further.
3. The beds were made quite nicely. The only quip (after pulling back the comforter) is that the sheets were not changed from the previous guest (are you kidding me?!?)
I am sorry...to say this is unacceptable is an understatement. I have stayed in clay structures in Tanzania that had better hygiene.
Then the little things just complete the picture: the in room safe is broken (so I had to leave my laptop at the front desk). The stale smell in the room when I first came in (forturnately the windows open slightly to allow in fresh air).
For $160 a night I would have done better sleeping in my car.
I will be having a conversation with management in the morning. Now to try to find someplace clean to sleep...eck!

We really enjoyed our stay in downtown Memphis. Everything about this hotel was in order. It was clean, new looking, and had excellent service. My husband's only complaints were that it wasn't on Beale street, and the Internet wasn't fast enough to watch movies. It was just fine for surfing web sites and checking email, but not for Netflix. On the plus side, there is a trolley stop right outside the hotel and our 3 year old had great fun riding the trolley around.

I normally choose the luxury Marriott properties but I heard that this Courtyard come pretty close to the higher end Marriott hotels despite my impression that Courtyard typically offers basic Accomodations and limited service. That's one factor in why I chose to stay here, the other important reason was it's a little closer to the sites, restaurants than the other Marriott location. Keep in mind that this hotel is still a long walk (about 5 long blocks)to Beale Street and the attractions near that. I walked once just to see what was around then took the trolley once I got my bearings. A trolley pass was worth the money to me for as many timed I used it. It's easy to use, but I'm very used to using public transport. It was nice that I was in my home country and state this time so didn't have a language barrier. A few attractions or restaurants were 
easier to drive to and valet parking was available sometimes. There aren't many restaurants very close by you need to go a couple of blocks away for that. There's a sub shop across the way from where you drive up to the hotel for valet parking if you're short on time or don't feel like going far. A few nearby restaurants deliver but there's a minimum purchase amount and a delivery fee.
The inside of the hotel looks 
modern. Basic accomodations, I wasn't expecting the 5 star full 
service luxury here that I'm 
accustomed to. But don't get me 
wrong, this was adequately 
comfortable and I didn't feel like I 
suffered. The rooms and bathroom 
are a bit small but I was on a high floor at the end of the hall and that made up for it. I felt 
like I had a private entrance and 
didn't have to listen to people 
coming and going down the hall and 
to/from the elevator. The front desk
 employee was friendly and 
accomodating upon Checkin and 
honored my request for a higher 
floor as was noted on my 
reservation form. The Checkin/out
process was fast and easy. My requests were honored promptly and effeciently. They didn 't have a stool though, the bathroom sink was a little too tall for me to reach without standing on my tiptoes. 
Refrigerator in room as another reviewer mentioned isn't quite cold enough and no way to adjust the temperature. I had my phone and IPod touch for Internet so I only used the hotel computer for Internet once. Yes, indeed it's very slow and I just used my phone or I touch since it was way faster.
Valet parking was reasonably priced to me $15/day. I was pleased w/ the service.
Breakfast was an extra charge, but there were a few nearbyrestaurants that I wanted to have breakfast at so no big deal. 
Only issue was that at times there was no one available at the bar or front desk when needed. So some time was wasted trying to find someone to help. Once I found someone they were friendly and helpful. 
One irritating thing was that there was only skim or reduced fat milk available for sale in the hotel. And like most eateries these days there's no real butter available even for an extra charge.I had to go to the local market to get normal milk, butter, and cream for my coffee. 
Skim & reduced fat milk in coffee is awful, almost as nasty as putting 
soymilk in coffee.
Overall I 'd stay here again next time I'm in town. Even though it's a hike to some of the sightseeing action the trolley was useful and convenient, but beware- limited service on Sunday.
The downtown area and nearby the hotel overall was much less 
crowded than I expected. Heavy police presence, but I never felt afraid or threatened even though I was by myself. Just as you would do anywhere, having street 
knowledge never hurts.
Also I didn't realize until I was leaving how close the Cotton Museum was to the hotel. It's on my list for next time. The Mud... can't remember the name of the museum might be worth a look for me next time as well.
The hotel was easy to find, drove up from Mississppi, so arrived a different way than I left to get home, either way easy to find and 
get to. Of course a certain GPS phone app was very helpful and 
very accurate. I will be back. I didn't have time to visit the zoo as well as a few other places I'm interested in and missed.

review_title: Very nice rooms with great service
review_text: Stopped here while traveling for the holidays. Great service. Location right off I-40. Neal was great!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis East-Sycamore View

review_text:
First time to stay at a Comfort Inn.
Staff was awesome ! Helpful, kind, just warm and friendly.
Perfect location if you want to walk to Beal St, theatre, restaurants, river is right across the street. Rooms were super big, clean , updated, fluffy towels, micro wave, frig, flat screen tv. The free breakfast had biscuits and gravy , one of my favorites, fruit, cereal, pancakes, really a great selection of food. Well stocked so when the late risers , such as my self , still had plenty to chose from. Cost $8 to park your car but unlimited access.
This is really a 3 to 3/12 star property.
I would not hesitate to go back or search out to stay in another city.

review_title: Pet friendly, clean, well lit parking lot!
review_text: The best deal in town, especially if you have a pet! The rooms were clean, the parking lot felt very secure to leave vehicle filled with luggage and such. The breakfast was great, and could certainly be described as more than a simple continental breakfast. The staff was so friendly and Accommodating, I'd stay here again if in Memphis.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis East-Sycamore View

review_text: There's nothing great about the location or the hotel itself, other than they did upgrades to the room and the bedding is very comfortable. However, no views or easy access to downtown. But, at least it is cleaner, safer and better than the cheap motels on the southend.

We were pleasantly surpised by this hotel, nice rooms, clean and free coffee in the room! As for facilities, breakfast included, which is continental, with toast, fresh fruit, coffee, tea and juice, english breakfast and even DIY waffles! 
There are two, well maintained pools on the ninth floor and a fitness center and every now and then there are free cookies in the lobby! 
Its very close to Beale street but not so close you cant sleep thanks to the noise and the view is great. I would recommend this hotel for evryone going to Memphis
