Accueil trÃ¨s bien. Chambres bien Ã©quipÃ©es avec de quoi se faire du cafÃ©. 
SituÃ© en face de l'aÃ©roport, nous avons pu y aller Ã  pieds. MalgrÃ© cette situation gÃ©ographique, c'est un hÃ´tel peu bruyant.

Great location, nicely decorated rooms, clean and comfortable, with a very friendly and accommodating staff. Our only complaint which left us with three restless and uncomfortable nights was that the hotel has and old style two-pipe heating/cooling system, meaning that the temperature in your room is largely a function of the water temperature that us being circulated through the system's central chiller. Since we like our bedroom at home around 63 to get a good night's sleep, it was possible to get the room that cool, and of course, you can't open a window. I must say that the hotel really tried hard to address our concerns by sending two maintenance guys to open the damper (a device that controls air flow into the room), and sent us a fan, which gave us a little relief. But if you want the modern convenience of heating or cooling on demand, this hotel isn't for you. That's a shame, really, because they're hitting on all cylinders otherwise. We got a terrific rate, the hotel is nice and the staff is caring and well trained (except for a grumpy night auditor who treated my query about an open Starbucks as if I were an interruption to whatever it is that night auditors do).
hotel_name: Red Lion Hotel on Fifth Avenue Seattle

review_text: My husband was there for a conference and I tagged along. The hotel was good - great location, decent price, clean room, good workout room and comfortable beds. However, the room was dark and has inadequate lighting.
hotel_name: Red Lion Hotel on Fifth Avenue Seattle

review_title: Great location to check out downtown!
review_text: We enjoyed the location very much. While the rooms are very basic, they are extremely clean and comfortable. The microwave and mini fridge were useful reheating some great Greek leftovers as well. As far as the additional fee for dvd's, bike rental, etc. We opted out of it with no problem.

review_title: The parking package with NO parking
review_text: This hotel bills itself as a stay and park option for SeaTac. The valet parking is provided by MasterPark, which abuts the hotel. I reserved a 7-day stay and park package and when I moved my car to the valet I was told to put it back where it was (in front of the hotel restaurant) since they were taking no more cars that were there for the parking package. They did have parking spaces and offered me parking at $14.95/day. MasterPark didn't care that I had already paid for 7 days of parking, Only after I steadfastly refused to leave my car along the side of the restaurant (I might as well have put a sign on the car that said "please vandalize me") did the hotel agree to let me park the car in a roped off area behind the hotel. However that meant I had to drag my luggage around the hotel in a rainstorm to catch the shuttle. And of course I will have to do the same when I return. This is not valet parking! Sadly this is the third, and last, time this has happened with this hotel. The prior two times the manage apologized profusely and one time even gave us an entire parking package for free. He also assured us the problems with MasterPark had been solved. However, as the saying goes "The definition of insanity is doing the same trying over and over and hoping for a different result". So I am stopping the insanity and will not stay at this hotel again, nor will I use any of the MasterPark parking facilities. They can take their squabble out on some other unsuspecting customer.

Stayed here in 2011 after about two years of absence. Nothing has changed much, not for the worse but also not for the better. Place could use sn upgrade.
Room was ok, very spacious. Breakfast facilities are meager. BF is not included and the sstuff their small shop is selling is so and so. No decent place to sit.
Check In / Check out is legendarily inefficient. Also, they don't care too much about the HHonors "gold" status a customer might have.
WiFi is free of charge in the lobby but not in the rooms.
Would recommend this hotel only for a quick transfer between flights due to its proximity to SeaTac and free shuttle.

Nice hotel, well-lit and secure parking. Close to highway, convenient, but a little noisy. Dogs allowed which is why we always choose La Quinta! Friendly staff, great breakfast, GREAT coffee...thank you for that!!
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Airport Graceland

review_text: our stay was awesome no complains housekeeping was very courtious, I was impressed on needing a code to get in property peace of mind. Thanks la quinta staff.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Airport Graceland

review_text: Was driving cross country and this was our stop in memphis. Stayed here bc of the price, location, and pet policy. Best front desk people ever. Friendly, hilarious, and just put me in a good mood when I checked in. They gave us restaurant recommendations, called us a cab, broke my $100 bill. I guess those things aren't so remarkable but they were just so nice about everything. Rooms were larger than I expected. Good value.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Airport Graceland

review_text: For the price, you really can't beat this hotel. Comfortable beds, clean sheets instead of gross bed spreads on the beds, a breakfast buffet that includes every thing you need. That said, they should upgrade the bathroom and clean it a little better.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Airport Graceland

review_title: Great place to stay in downtown Seattle
review_text: I stayed here several years ago and was passing through so I stayed here for two nights. The check in was quick and painless. I was staying in a deluxe king room-1907. The view of the water and the market was great. There was a building in they way for a clear view, but it was still great. The rooms had been updated with lcd televisions, and newer fixtures. My package included breakfast buffet. It was a standard buffet; sausage, bacon, potatoes, scrambled eggs, bagels, toast, and pastries. The real beauty of this hotel is its location. It is right in the heart of the city with lots of eating and shopping within walking distance. The parking is under the hotel and expensive, but that is pretty much standard in downtown hotels.
hotel_name: Red Lion Hotel on Fifth Avenue Seattle

review_text: Excellence customer services, friendly staff, breakfast was really good. I would suggest some snacks with cocktail hours in evening. We will be back soon.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Airport Graceland

review_text: There were tow nails left on the bed, and on the carpet next to the bed. There was also several strands of hair on one of the bed pillows. This was the worst hotel experience I've ever had.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Airport Graceland

review_text:
Have stayed here several times. Employees are very helpful and friendly. Location us great and close to light rail train ti airport if you can walk a few blocks.
Ask for a corner room on north side for views and less noise.

Spent 2 nights at the Crowne Plaza. Got a really good corporate rate and the room included free wifi and breakfast. As I understand it, compared to the Sheraton and Westin, the Crowne Plaza's rates are far more competitive. A taxi to/from the airport will cost you $39. If you feel like spoiling yourself or are in a group of more than 3, you can opt for a stretch limo for $45.
The biggest plus is the location. Minutes walking distance from everything - Pacific Place, Pike Market, Nordstrom, Macy's, Louis Vitton, Gucci, Loft, Art galleries and restaurants. Simply walk to your left when exiting the hotel down Seneca and turn right on 5th Avenue. The Sheraton and Westin are slightly closer but you are only shaving off a couple of minutes. The front desk will supply a walking map. The front desk and concierge was very helpful with directions and suggestions on where to go, shop, etc.
The hotel from the lobby, elevators, hallways and rooms are spotlessly clean. Housekeeping is very quiet and courteous. I had left a few personal care items at home and the front desk sent to my room right away. 
I had a Deluxe King Room on a high floor. Very spacious and great view. The bed was comfy, linens were crisp and bathroom was spotless. 
I'm not a huge fan of the Crowne Plaza chain's Renu soaps and toiletries, but that's just me. Much better than what Sheraton hotels offer in general, but nothing exceptional. I usually take my own anyway. 
The breakfast buffet was simple: omelette and waffle station, cereals, baked goods, fruit, meat and potatoes, pancakes, French toast. I was very satisfied with my omelette. If you are looking for a gourmet breakfast, then this is not the place for you. However, is you are looking for something simple with a few options, this is fine. 
I will stay here again. In terms of rating, I would give this a very high 3.5 - or 4 star, only losing points for not having a spa and gourmet dining. If you dont need a spa or gourmet food, the Crowne Plaza is exceptional.

review_title: These Guys Block Netflix and limit TV to make you buy their movies
review_text: I'd recommend this hotel with caveats. Nice older hotel, but not up to date with limited electrical outlets (no bars furnished) and they block Netflix. Really a tacky way of doing business. I will look for somewhere else next time or preload my computer with what I want to watch.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Seattle Airport - Southcenter

review_title: Short walk to market and shopping.
review_text: Great room and view. We had early flight into Seattle. Hotel had room ready and welcoming. There are many great hotels in area, Hilton, Red Lion. I would not hesitate to stay at any of them. Crowne Plaza was great for us, though we spent most of our time at market or shopping. Recommend using light rail from airport to University St station. Inexpensive though takes longer than we had anticipated. The people in Seattle were extremely helpful. One flight attendant walked us to light rail platform - it would have been difficult to find without the help. Great places to eat -Pikes Brew Pub, the cheese making place on corner by market. So many good bakeries, coffee shops, chocolate, wine.

review_title: Smokey smell in room 1831 and bra left in drawer
review_text:
We stayed at the Doubletree on the Remembrance Day long weekend with a shopping bus tour from Kelowna. We got our keys for 1831 and went upstairs. We opened the door and I was overwhelmed by cigarette smoke smell. I have asthma and I couldn't stay in there 10 seconds. After getting a second room (1801) we were a little disturbed when we found a bra in the drawer under the TV. 
The salmon dinner we had on the Friday night was outstanding.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Seattle Airport - Southcenter

review_title: Brilliantly placed in the heart of history!!!!!!!!!
review_text: Historic!!!! The hotel is modern but right in the heart of history it self.. One of the best weekends away from it all and the kids thank you. We loved every min of it!!! They gave great service and wonderful advice for outings. I will be back my friend Weston Memphis you can bet on it...

I really expected this hotel to be top notch but was disappointed Our TV and phone lines in tha room did not work after calling the front desk from my cell phone they sent a maintenance worker to the room. He was very pleasant and did his best to try and repair it but was unable to do so. My husband went to the front desk to inquire about another room but was told they were sold out and none were available. I went downstairs and told them that we needed to be moved and "magically" there was another room available. Also on the first room that we were in the toilet paper holder was pulled out of the wall and sitting on the counter. At breakfast the next morning I ordered a Belgium waffle. It took so long that by the time the waiter brought it to me it was so cold the butter would not melt. The waiter has another one cooked for me but again it took so long I had to leave before eating as I had a meeting to attend

We frequently stay overnight before we fly out early. We have stayed at several places. This was better than I expected. Very quiet, very comfortable beds. I was pleasantly surprised. We did the park and fly. Very convenient. We would stay here again. As a side note, we have stayed at other Red Lions with our dog and they are very accomodating. If you join their frequent stayed plan( which we are not) the dog stays free!

review_title: Nice hotel for staying near airport. The suites are roomy
review_text: We got a good rate online through hotels.com ($99 per night). Would advise travelers to check out other websites first tho- since they charged us for all 7 nights up front in order to get the $99 rate. This hotel also holds a security/amenities amount of $40 per day then reimburses you a few days after departure. Some aspects of room were old (bath tub and sink) and the heater did not work so well. Otherwise it was a comfortable spacious room. Tully's coffee in lobby was great. Walking distance to some restaurants and a huge mall with movie theater. Appreciated airport shuttle. Had to go to another Hilton hotel for laundry facility.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Seattle Airport - Southcenter

review_title: Clean and comfortable rooms with friendly staff.
review_text: I stayed here when my mother was in town for a visit. I really liked the layout of the suites, however the sleeper sofa wasn't all that comfortable but ok for a nights stay. The rooms were very clean and cozy. We really liked the location of the hotel, as it was in close proximity to many restaurants and a lot of shopping. The staff at the front desk were friendly and helpful when we inquired about restaurants in the area.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Seattle Airport - Southcenter

review_text: This hotel is perfectly located and really nice. But, yes, the cleaning was lazy. Still probably cleaner than my house though, so whatever. We had a room overlooking Beale St and yes, you can hear it. But you shouldn't get a hotel near a party street if you came here to go to bed early. Great place to stay if you want to party at night and be close to daytime sightseeing as well. And they have Gibson guitars you can check out in the lobby!

review_title: Amazing place to stay. Very pet friendly and extremely great with Military families.
review_text: My husband, our pet, and I stayed here a couple days ago and it was a great "welcome back to the states from Japan." Everyone that worked at the hotel are very helpful,friendly,and professional. The restaurant next door has really delicious food. Even though the menu said cheeseburger I had asked if they could make it to a mushroom Swiss burger instead and they did without any problems. It was one of the tastiest Mushroom Swiss burgers I have ever had in my life. The ribs are also a must to try!! I wanted to Thank Kara for her outstanding customer service at the front desk. She was very kind and helpful to us. Thank you so much Red Lion Inn for a great stay.

This is a very nice looking hotel which we got for a reasonable price; however, we were surprised to find that other than a grand lobby, there are no amenities to speak of (no pool, no hot tub) and you have to pay for WIFI. Ridiculous. 
It is also located by a major highway and although we were on the highest floor we were overwhelmed with noise. Turning on the train-like AC system didn't help. We wondered why there were complimentary ear plugs in the room. I am not kidding; and, I had to use them.
This hotel is suited for business travelers I imagine; but, as a family, it was not for us. Thankfully we were there for only one night. We were taking the Clipper the next morning - and, the staff messed up our taxi request. At 7am we were scrambling to find our way and I was not impressed! 
If you just want a bed, you sleep like a rock, and you get it for a good rate, then it might be for you.

review_title: Excellent place to stay, pet friendly!!!
review_text: Had a wonderful stay!! All the employees were very nice, room was nice and comfy and within walking distance to some great restaurants. I will definately stay there again. Pet friendly which is very important to me! Thank you

Stayed with Husband For his conference. Great location. Very convenient to Beale St., Fed Ex Forum, Starbucks, and easy walking distance to Civil Rights Museum, Trolley line, Rendevue (awesome ribs!) and other sites of interest. The free bus to Sun Records and Graceland is right across the street.
Service was terrific - especially Sarah and Glyn at the Front Desk. hubby loved the free use of the Gibson guitars (Gibson Factory and tour is across street - We did not do tour since service in store was poor, but told us we would not see much since it was last tour of day). 
Room was modern and bed very comfy (even for a Marriott bed fan). Loved the large windows and big bathroom (including seperate tub and glass shower). Always appreciate the room safes (this one was on top closet shelf).
Great stay, but if I had to pick negatives, they would be: closet door opens towards bathroom (making it less convenient to dress between closet and bathroom), shower tile grout needs refreshing (dingey) and housekeeping did not come until after a 5 PM call the first day (they may have thought we exercised the no daily housekeeping feature offered). The conference area is very small and confining. Would have been nice to have free wireless in lobby.
Restaurant suggestion: Flights - all courses and wine pairings served as full size or in "flights" with 3 smaller servings of diffent items.

review_title: Great Westin--very convenient to Beale Street and FedEx Forum.
review_text: Excellent location adjacent to FedEx forum and within steps of Beale Street. This Westin exceeded all expectations -- very comfortable rooms/bed and great typical Westin shower/bathroom.
I fell in love with this place immediatly as i had crosse the threshold of doors

Absolutely well located, a few blocks from downtown Seattle, a few blocks from the Public Market, this Hotel has excellent service, great and spacious rooms, clean and comfortable. Wi-fi was also working in my room. Not to mention the Moore Coffee, a small and beaultiful coffee shop just for you. If you are going to Seattle, this is your hotel.
The Moore hotel is awesome. You can't beat the value and the rooms are boutiquey and vintage. Lots of style. The staff rocks as does the location. Best bet in Seattle!

review_title: Very nice place in in one of Seattle's nicest shopping areas
review_text: Can't beat the price for what we got. 1 bedroom suite Wirh lots of room, gorgeous lobby with restaurant and bar. Loads of close by shopping, restaurants and entertainment.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Seattle Airport - Southcenter

review_text: Lovely old building with tremendous character, lots of space and an EXCELLENT location. Market, drugstore, and ER nearby. Fabulous restaurants across each street. Close to wharf and Needle. Used hotwire and then upgraded upon check-in. I will be back!

review_title: This hotel does not meet the Westin standard!
review_text: From the time I checked in my experience at the Westin Memphis was TERRIBLE! They did not have the room I requested, then proceeded to challenge me on what I had reserved. They gave me a handicap room. When they moved me the room was NOT CLEAN! The elevator was broken for the 8th floor. When I came back from business gone from 7 am - 4:30 my room had not been cleaned and for my entire stay I have been called Mr and Mrs Smith. Well can Mr or Mrs Smith pay my bill? Get it together Westin you disgrace the brand here in Memphis. I will NEVER stay here again and I will be sure to tell all my colleagues the same. NO WESTIN IN MEMPHIS!

We stayed in this hotel around Christmas of last year. We stayed in a big one bedroom suite, with a living area with a mini fridge, a small dining table with four chairs and a little sink. A nice comfy bed!! Nice spacious closet and in the same room with double sink and a separate room for the bathtub and toilet. I like the amenities like swimming pool, a sauna, jacuzzi tub, and a big spacious workout room. The hotel is across Southcenter mall, nice restaurants like Cheesecake Factory, Olive Garden, Outback, Claim Jumper, Spaghetti Factory, Red Robins and so many more. It's about 10 min. ride from the airport and about 15 min drive to downtown Seattle. Free parking. If you like Filipino food!! There is a Seafood City, Valerio Bakery, Chow King, Red Ribbon and I can't think of the Chicken place, in one corner across JC Penney. I almost forgot our room came with free breakfast!! Two flat screen televisions, one in the bedroom and one in the living room with a sofa bed.
hotel_name: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Seattle Airport - Southcenter

review_text: My brother and I stayed at the C Plaza for three nights in August and attended two Mariner games. The hotel is in a good location, however, not for those who have difficulty walking hills. We were only a short walk from great restaurants, bars and shopping. Cab's to and from the games were under $10.00. I would definitely stay here again.

Spent two nights this week. Were skeptical about location until we served. Wonderful staff, free shuttle downtown and to ferry. Helpful staff. We illmstay here again. Dining was average but we did not really eat much.
Booked the room on hotwire. Very clean hotel, great location with a free shuttle! Definitely will be staying here again!

In a nutshell it is clean and new feeling and a good value.
Overall we liked it and it met our needs but it felt like an apartment more than a hotel and had no energy to it, if that makes sense. Finally, if you stay here as for street side as the back alleyr side gets dumpster visits regularly.

review_title: Awesome stay at a great value!
review_text: Rooms are better than Marriott or Sheraton. Great Shuttle service with excellent drivers. Front desk and room service staff were wonderful. Really loved great air control, great beds and great 42' TV for some R & R.

We stayed here one night for a wedding. The hotel is nice and our room was very clean and spacious. The hallways and bathrooms are a little dated, but everything was very neat and clean. The staff was all very pleasant and accommodating. Overall, we were very happy with our stay here, especially for the rate. Also, we were walking distance to Beale Street and the Riverfront.

review_title: An old hotel but clean, well-kept and a great value.
review_text: The value of the Moore is hard to beat. The location is stellar, they validate parking and the rooms are clean and orderly. It is a 100 year old building and nothing fancy...however, the budget minded traveler will appreciate the value. I will certainly return should I need to visit Seattle again.

review_title: Central location between Safeco/Qwest and Pike Place Market
review_text:
Just returned from 2 night trip to Seattle and stayed at Courtyard. If you're going to a game AND wanting to spend time at Pike Place Market and/or shopping district, this is a great place to stay. The property was clean and the staff provided very good service. Here are some pros & cons:
PROS
- proximity to stadiums - approx 15 min walk along Occidental through Pioneer Square
- rooms, room with 2 queens was a great size, was clean and comfortable
- staff provided good customer service
CONS
- don't get a room on Cherry St side near the alley. The garbage trucks arrived between 10pm - midnight and they were very loud. 
- rooms generally weren't sound proof so if you like silence, you will be challenged to sleep. 
- $28 valet parking but I assume all hotels in downtown area would be similar. 
If you are going to Seattle to just go to shopping district, you should look for a hotel near that area but if you are doing that and going to a game, this is a great place.

review_title: Best location in town if you want to party on Beale St.
review_text: Clean, big rooms, great price. Only a few steps from the center of Beale St. action. Also a very SAFE location which can be an issue in Memphis

We stayed two nights. Booked through Expedia after reading all of the reviews. Overall this hotel is in a good location to walk around downtown Seattle. We used the valet parking which was convienient but $28 day. The room was as advertised. It was clean and modern with a nice king bed. Staff were very good to us. We were traveling with a 1 1/2 year old and had no troubles. The bistro at the hotel was pricy but tasty. I would stay here again. I did feel the rates were a bit high though and the pool was very small.
Stayed in room on north side of hotel adjacent to bale st Extremely loud Friday night.Music from street party heard until 2 00am. Free Gibson guitar rental while at hotel.

review_title: THE budget hotel choice in the Northwest
review_text: Have stayed here before. They charge 74 dollars vs over 150 at every other hotel downtown. Steps to Pike Place Market. Not far from transit options. Large ceilings and rooms that open. I had Room 700 facing Macys which was very quiet. Rooms clean as a whistle. Fans in room since A-C rarely needed in Seattle. Neighborhood sketch at night. Nearvy Cafe d'Arte has great coffee drinks. Walk down one block to First Avenue for a selection of great Belltown Restaurants. If you are a frugal traveller, you will like the Moore. Otherwise pay the 200+ plus per night and stay elsewhere.

We stayed there for one night only and we enjoyed it. Large "appartement type" room. Close to Space needle and downtowb easily accesible by bus.
The only thing is that we seem to have got an "handicaped" room but it was no problen for us. Staff was friendly and have a free continental breakfast.
Would recommend staying there

review_title: Good for downtown seattle but that's only because seattle is so expensive
review_text: No breakfast included small rooms high prices but everything else is up to good marriott standards. A few blocks from everything downtown easy to get to from the train station. Valet parking only for 28 dollars a night. Forget the rental car take the train here and stay downtown for a good price for seattle

review_title: Great value but a bit out of the way
review_text:
Had a great stay. The room was large, clean and comfortable. They have a decent breakfast menu at the hotel's restaurant.
My only concerns were about the location (multiple cab drivers told us nicely not to walk around the area in the evening) and the noise youcan hear when your neighbor leaves their room. The doors slamming shut were very loud.

review_title: Horrible vallet service, will never use them again!
review_text: We had a big event in Seattle and thought we would spend the weekend, enjoying Seattle. Upon our arrival we had about an hour before we had to be at our event, just enough time to check in, change and freshin up a bit. After driving around for about 20 min looking for a place to park we decided to use their vallet service. However they were so busy that we were told that if we only wanted to have vallet park for a short time to only allow us to check in and freshin up we would have to find our own place to park, they would not park for us. Even though we were being charged for it we couldn't use it. We were extremly upset and disapointed. Unable to change and get ready for our event due to there being absolutly no parking anywhere. We only stayed the one night and traveled back home the next day. After telling the front desk about what happened we felt perhaps we should have been compted something for our trouble. We weren't and we will never stay at another Marriott again.

review_title: Things aren't always what they seem!
review_text: I am very disapointed in my stay at The Westin, especially considering the price I paid. Several things were not up to par. Housekeeping never showed up and when I called at 530 pm to check on why my room had not been serviced yet, I was told housekeeping was still making their rounds. At that time of day, I would expect my bed to already be made. And beware, staying here when there are nearby concerts or Beale st activites. My husband and I had to stand in line to use the elevator to get to our room, with the hotel full of intoxicated people, yelling, one man even hollering for marijuana, all this right in the lobby of a Westin. Not what I would expect of a luxury hotel. Will never stay here again.
Great access to pike place market and harbor. Rooms average, old hotel, noisy hallways, but location makes up for it. Good value.

The Moore Hotel is a terrific deal! I have never said at a hotel this nice for much an inexpensive price! The room and bed were perfectly clean, amazing location, super cool staff, fun historic theater next door. The walls are a little thin but the building is hundreds of years old! When I come back to Seattle, I will most definitely stay at the Moore Hotel.

review_title: Great hotel in a good location.
review_text: Stayed here for 5 days in early December. The location is right across the street from the waterfront with a great view of Puget Sound if you have a water view room. Very comfortable, clean room. You can explore most of downtown Seattle from this location if you don't mind walking. We like to walk so it was perfect for us. There is a public elevator right next to the hotel that takes some of the hike out of getting to the Public Market. The hotel staff was very friendly and helpful. We did all 5 days in Seattle without a car from this hotel. Take the train fron SeaTac to the end of the line in Seattle and then grab a taxi from there to the hotel. It is just as fast as a taxi and costs $10 for 2 people instead of $40. Be sure to check out the happy hour deals in the hotel bar. They have some good beers and tasty snacks at great prices.

Hotel was conveniently located....close to many restaurants, Pike Place Market, etc. We walked to Pioneer Place with no problem. Our room was nicely furnished, very clean and quiet. I am a single parent travelling with my young child and would stay at The Moore again without hesitation. Great value for the price.

I arrived at 10pm from the east coast and there was no one at the front desk.....for 10 minutes! I had to go find someone. Next morning they forgot to deliver breakfast until I called twice to remind them they were 30 minutes late.
Room was very average and you had to walk forever to get there. Would not stay here again.

We stayed here for one night. Great location for Pike Place Market, also walking distance to the Space Needle area. We stayed in a 2 bedroom suite on the 5th Floor. There was a play going on that night and we could hear the music and the croud, but it didn't last too long.
We'd definitely stay here again.

review_title: Perfect. Just what we were looking for.
review_text: We stayed at the Silver Cloud for 2 nights in June 2010. We had two 7 years old girls with us to attend a Mariners game and this hotel was the perfect location at a great price. We were able to walk everywhere from the hotel and the girls loved the rooftop pool. We will definitley be staying here again.

review_title: One of the better places to stay in Seattle
review_text:
Very, very nice Marriott right at the waterfront next to pier 66. You can walk easily from the hotel throughout the wharf area with its restaurants and all. 
Hotel is really nice, very efficient staff. Rooms are nice,clean And well maintained. 
Only downsides are wifi service is only available on the lobby, wired service only in the room. So I'd you want to use your iPhone you'll need to Be in the lobby. 
Wonderful gym and pool. 
Recommend.

review_title: Location, location, location (and a killer view too)
review_text: Went for business, and except for the ridiculously slow room service, it was great. Everyone was friendly. There is a computer and printer in the lobby for boarding passes. If you are carless and looking for great home base for a weekend trip - so close to Pike's Place and the sculpture park. Nice walking/jogging by the water.

Stay was okay at best. Rooms are super small and can get claustrophobic when trying to escape the rain. Wireless internet was terrible in the rooms, barely could stay connected. Room thermostat didn't work right, would either keep blowing hit air non-stop or would shut off completely so we would be either sweating or freezing. Probably will stay somewhere else next time we visit Seattle...in fact we are. Next time in February we will be at the Hyatt. 
Got a deal on Expedia,$103 including parking. I would refuse to pay anymore than that.
People are nice until you pay them, which you cannot do without an ID or credit card.... be warned. Don't stay here unless u want to spend three or four times what they are saying they will charge.
Got an amazing sea front, corner room. Floor to ceiling glass overlooking the Seattle waterfront. Gorgeous! The room luxurious and the hotel restaurant and cocktail bar were great. Great hotel.

We booked through hotels.com, and they messed up and didn't send our reservation in, but the staff was determined to make it right even though it wasn't their fault. They thought they were out of king rooms (what we had reserved), but they found one more (handicap accessible). The room was nice and clean. The only problem was the water pressure, and I think this was due to the handheld shower head that was in the handicap shower. Still...I am sure someone that needed the accessible shower would like some water pressure. I am an IT, and the first thing I noticed was that I (5'6") had to stand on my tip toes to control the air. A person in a w/c would not even come close to being able to reach it! Overall, we were very pleased. Everything was kind of dated except for the lobby. The iron looked about 50 years old. Haha. The TV and bed/bedding were modern, so we were good! I didn't eat the breakfast, but it looked good.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN Galleria Inn and Suites

review_title: It was awesome my wife n kids enjoyed da pool n waffles.
review_text: The hotel was awesome my wife n kids loved da pool n da waffe n da moring we had a great vacation.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Primacy Parkway

review_title: A Hop, Skip & A Jump To Graceland
review_text: Loved this Elvis themed motel. 3 Elvis movie channels on TV plus a guitar shaped pool plus Elvis pictures everywhere made for a great Graceland holiday.

THE GOOD = The front desk girls are fantastic...funny,smiles and helpful. The location is perfect for GRACELAND ,nice pool,good shower,free breakfast.Airport shuttle is free. DON'T USE BLUE TAXIS THEY WILL TRY AND RIP YOU OFF....STAY AWAY FROM BLUE TAXIS!!!!!)
THE BAD= the beds are terrible...they get hot and are too soft!!!! This is my only complaint about the hotel.

I was paying through Memphis on my way to Mississippi, and I decided to stay here because of all the Elvis stuff. I got more than I bargained for. The staff were incredibly nice, the room was incredibly clean and comfortable. I expected less from a Days Inn. Cecil B. Day himself would be proud of this hotel. I would definitely go out of my way to stay here again.

If you want to visit Graceland, this is the place to stay. It's very Elvisey, especially in the foyer/ breakfast room. And you can walk to Graceland in about 3 minutes, which saves you having to pay for parking. There's not much else around this area, but try Uncle Lou's Southern Chicken, about a 5 min drive away. Not much to look at, but GREAT food.

review_title: Near the water, that's about it.
review_text: We just got back from a brief stay in Seattle. The hotel was fine, just not nearly as nice as I had expected given the rate. Also, walking to and from the "Market" in the evening can be very scary! Understaffed. Cleaning lady was nice.

Clean rooms, so close to Graceland, awesome looking pool...so much Elvis stuff which was perfect for a fan like me..great tv selections which include 3 Elvis movie channels..only complaints were even though our room was non smoking you could smell smoke from other rooms or from outside and the breakfast couldve had more selections...other than that a wonderful place to stay and we enjoyed it!!
No complaints. Room was small but clean and adequate. Only downside is lack of breakfast, but there is a Starbucks across the street.

We chose the Roosevelt because of a rate that included valet parking in downtown Seattle. The hotel is within walking distance of many attractions, including Pike's Place Market. The room, while on the smaller side, was clean and featured an incredibly comfortable queen-size bed. There are many shops and restaurants surrounding the hotel. I would definitely stay here again.
I have stayed here the last two years while I have been in Seattle. Its a great location right on the water. It's very convenient to most of downtown and in a walkable location.

The cream of the crop when it comes to Marriot. While the brand speaks for itself, often times some of their hotels stand out. This is one of those stand outs. The hotel is situated right on Alaskan Way and is perfectly located to explore the city and wake up with a fabulous view of the Puget Sound. Just make sure to ask for a room with the sound view otherwise you may be looking at a courtyard of the neighboring condos. 
Staff is excellent and accommodating, food is fantastic, but pricey so go grab dinner down the street if you don't have to have dinner at the hotel if only to experience Seattle a bit more.
Great hotel, no complaints.

review_title: This place makes me want to move to Seattle!
review_text: Wow. Friendliest staff I've ever encountered. Treated my fiancÃ© and I like we were old friends, recommended excellent bars and restaurants, always helpful if we needed directions. I read the shared bathroom thing and was very nervous but the rates were so good I booked anyway. There were at least ten bathrooms and I literally never saw less than four available. This area is walking distance from anywhere you'd want to be. As for the rooms, just look at their site, very trendy and cozy. Highly recommend renting a bike and riding along the coast. Breakfast in the morning was such a nice touch. Yummy waffles and they always had soy milk available for the health conscious! Cyclops, the restaurant downstairs is absolutely delicious you must try anything on their menu but if you like burgers, get one! They've changed my opinion on what a burger should taste like.

review_title: Simple but that's a positive for this place, never a criticism
review_text:
Superb place, simple but stylish and very welcoming. We absolutely loved the artsy interior and the layout of the place. Staff couldn't be more helpful and even gave us a free upgrade on our last evening after they made a mistake with our room booking. 
The only downside was our first room was above a busy, noisy bar and had no air con but the fan cooling us down also provided a good, steady alternative noise to the bar!
No question though, we'd stay there again if we were in Seattle.
The only not so great thing is the breakfast. The rest is just great

review_title: Ace hotel was ace for us!
review_text:
I stayed here with my husband for three nights in September. We really liked the simplicity of the hotel, both in terms of decor and set up (the staff leave you yo your own devices unless you ask for something). The location was good to, about halfway between Pike Place and the Space Needle. We were initially unsure about sharing a bathroom with the other guests, but it was fine. I figured that people pay hundreds of pounds to stay at spa hotels and wander round in their robes, and this was no different! The bathrooms were all spotlessly clean, and there was always one free. The staff on reception were always friendly and helpful, making fab recommendations for eating/drinking. We would never have found Bathtub Gin without them!
But I have to turn to the downsides. Our first night there was a Saturday, and it was pretty noisy from the bar downstairs until about 0230. We were also in the middle of a random heatwave, and with no air con in the room, just a desk fan, it was HOT! I am keen on a cold room, so others may not have had as much of an issue as me. It's true there was no wardrobe, but we were living out of out cases anyway, so we weren't worried about that. I guess the othernthing would be the size of the room, about the size of a double (not the master) bedroom in a modern house in the UK. We thought it was OK, but probably smaller than most would expect, especially in the US.
The negative bits really didn't worry us, and I'd def recommend to others, just maybe not on a hot Saturday night!

Fashionable but very comfortable good deal hotel surrounded by cafes. Loved the decoration. Our room was one without bathroom but there were plenty individual bathrooms and showers very near and very clean. Waffles for breakfast and comfortable sheets were great!

review_title: Trendy, simple, well worth the money!
review_text: My girlfriend and I stayed here in July the night before the bite of Seattle. I called this place last minute and got the last available standard room. We were very impressed upon entering the unassuming entrance to the hotel. A stairway up to the front desk lead us to a beautiful lobby with giant ceiling. Very modern feeling inside. We ended up paying about $100 for one night. The room had a single full sized bed (sufficient for my gf and I), a table and a sink with toiletries supplied, also two white robes. The bathrooms were down the hall as well as the showers which are shared between patrons. Very clean and private. The location is great. It sits above the cyclops bar which has some great food. I recommend the fish tacos! Lots of great restaurants and bars in the neighborhood. Overall a great experience here. Friendly staff and free waffles in the morning!!

review_title: Treated our family with kindness, respect and graciousness.
review_text: Our family has been staying at the Silver Cloud Inn on Broadway for almost two weeks now due to it's proximity to Swedish Medical Center where my dad is in ICU. I cannot rave enough about our experience here. From the front desk staff, the housekeepers, the shuttle drivers and the entire crew at Jimmy's they have been amazing. Their care and genuine hospitality have meant so much to my family. From placing our rooms close together on the same floor, accommodating for very late night/early morning check-in's for our large family without reservations, and for Jimmy's for extending so many requests, kind, positive words and seating our large groups several times a day. The beautiful part was that they all made it seem so effortless even during this busy Holiday season. I would recommend this hotel to anyone who is looking for a clean, safe, comfortable place to stay in the Downtown, Broadway, First Hill areas of Seattle no matter the reason for your visit.

I have stayed here a couple weeks and am very impressed with place. The reception area is nice and they have on-site, underground parking ($$), but given the crummy Seattle weather, that works real nice. Rooms are excellent and, if you stay on the lake side, you get nice views. Typical Marriott quality. Breakfast is really excellent. Evening receptions are also very nice. Really, no downsides except the expensive parking, but if you are a biz traveller, no Biggy. I plan on staying here for a good long time.

review_title: Nice rooms, friendly staff but post location.
review_text: As with most of the Marriots the rooms are big, the staff friendly and the hotel clean. But location isn't the best. I was here on bussiness so for me it didn't matter.

review_title: Very roomy, very comfy, very clean
review_text: Great hotel experience. Nice staff to great, great restaurant with very well priced happy hour. Rooms were huge and quiet relative to many Seattle hotels I stayed at. Very comfortable beds, huge clean rooms, big tv. Shuttle service was awesome. Dropped us in heart of city right up till ten thirty. And picked us up til that time also

review_title: Excellent service. Hotel exceeded my expectations. Employee seem happy. Shuttle service was great.
review_text: Stayed for a recent conference. Hotel and staff was great.
Tiene microondas y neveras en todas las habitaciones

We stayed three nights and were delighted to be upgraded at no cost to a suite. The suite was generously sized and appointed. We chose the property based on previous positive experience with Silver Cloud and were not disappointed. 
The only criticism is that Wi-fi was a little slow. 
The adjoining Jimmy's restaurant was excellent - great cocktails and top quality meals.

review_title: Comfy beds and overall very nice
review_text: Yes, the trolley does run late, so if you want quiet, stay on side facing river. But-- of you will be out into the late evening, go for a room with balcony. They are few but face the park and it's a nice place to enjoy a good conversation, glass of wine, or breakfast. Loved the beds.. Very comfortable. And the kitchen with own sink was nice. Will stay here again.
This is are second time here and the rooms were large and the breakfast was outstanding. Good value all around!

The room rate is far over the limit. For close 269$ plus 23.13$ Room Tax plus 18.83$ Occupation Tax plux Valet Parking with no choice of selfparking 34.00$ plus 7.45$ Tax is that hotel a worst pricy hotel. No internet, rooms are standart. The Balcony is redicoules small and the view extreme poor.

We found a used joint in our linens after giving our toddlers a bath. I expressed my concern with the front desk and was not even given an apology. I was simply told that it would be given to the gm. I wasn't expecting a room comp but an apology would have been nice.
Nice accommodations, friendly and helpful staff, close to the medical center, free shuttle to area locations. Good resturant on site

Very convenient for parents of Seattle University students. Literally across the street. Room was clean, but a little small (we had odd shaped room next to elevator). Highly recommend the on site restaurant (Nicks???). Breakfast was great and I had wish I had known about the great beer selection on tap. It's a little pricey
for a Silver Cloud, but better rates than most places in the vicinity.

Enjoyed my stay here and have only one problem. (which I'll get to a bit later)
Staff was excellent and lobby/rooms were well maintained. There is a free shuttle that will drop you off at downtown points of interest like Pike Place Market, Pioneer Square and Westlake center near the mall and light rail. 
Now my one issue is not with he hotel but with priceline. I bid on 3.5* downtown near Pikes Place and was surprised to receive this hotel which is not in downtown. It is in a neighborhood on the outskirts of downtown called "Capitol Hill" a nearly 20 min walk just to get to 
the center of downtown. I feel this is misleading and priceline needs to define this zone separately. As for the immediate neighborhood it's in a "gay friendly" neighborhood similar to "the village" in NYC, except a bit quieter/low-key if that's your scene. Also near is a hospital and University.
That said, the free shuttle to downtown was extremely helpful. Because of this and the absolutely pleasant stay I had, I actually wouldn't mind returning to this property in the future.

review_title: Yikes, old and needs revamping big time!
review_text: Our family comes downtown every year to enjoy all the Christmas festivities for a weekend. We have stayed at the Westin every year past and decided to try the edgewater this year. It's been a mistake since the start. As someone else has stated the beauty begins and ends at the fireplace outside the entrance. We were never greeted at te door, with kids in tow a door held open is always a nice gesture. After check in we walked the long, dark, dank and very stinky hallwall to our room. Gross. We called once in the room about the old musty, stale cigarette smell. Yuck. They promptly moved us to rm 352. Smell was better, but little did we know then that the walls are paper thin! The edgewater provides earplugs for the train, ha! We needed more than one pair, the whole family was up all night from the noise of people normally talking in hall. This room also happened to be above, below or next door to the laundry. So we enjoyed the racket of that early in the as well. We are so disappointed with this hotel. The rooms need some help, from the old carpet you do not wish to walk barefoot on, the 15 inch tube tv in the giant armoire, tiny beds and gross ring stained toilet. Do the fireplaces even turn on? We will not be back, ever. We have enjoyed the restaurant 67 in the past, amazing food...we would expect the same from the hotel.

Spent the night here while stopping in Seattle. Check in was quick and friendly. The room is clean and modern. The restaurant downstairs is Jimmy's and I highly recommend it. It would be a good stand alone restaurant so for a hotel one it is 5*
The hotel isn't walking distance to Pike Place or shopping but they offer a free shuttle. Good idea as parking is scarce and expensive around Pike Pl. Good value for the price.

I was warmly greeted every time I passed the front desk. Sheets clean, room clean, a very cozy property. The onsite restaurant, Jimmys on Broadway, exceeded my expectations. The portions were surprisingly large, can be a bit pricey as expected from hotel restaurants. The price of the room was slightly below the average median which made for a great value. Wasn't very knowledgable about my surroundings so I don't know how to fairly rate the hotels location. Overall a great property, I will be returning. 
PS- Kudos for the hotel-SEA shuttle!

review_title: Stay elsewhere!! Definitely not a 4 star hotel!!
review_text:
We were in Seattle for our wedding anniversary. When We booked our room I called prior to arrival to make sure that we had a water view.
When we arrived to Edgewater we were a little worried with the decore. VERY rustic, strange fake trees every where in the lobby. Kind of dark? We received our room key and proceeded down a long creepy dingy, smelly,narrow hallway to our room. 
We were shocked to find out that we didn't have a water view! The room was so small there was barely room for a bed! Immediately I called the front desk I was told that they were out of waterview rooms. We were given an option of a room with 2 beds. The new room was normal in size. Nothing exciting. Needless to say totally disappointing. Will not be back and we are not recommending to family and friends.
We had stayed 2 days prior at The Hyatt Place near the space needle. Now that's Awesome hotel! Book a room at the Hyatt and you wont be disappointed!!

review_title: Frendliest, Staff, great location, good value
review_text: I recently returned from a cruise, I stayed at This hotel 1 night before and 1 night after cruise. I have never saw a hotel where every staff member at the front desk was this friendly and helpful. These 3 ladies were all equally great at their job, and you could tell they loved their job. If i needed directions , suggestions, they took time to explain in detail. I had arrived back from cruise around 9 am and they stored my luggage and told me we were welcomed to have breakfast,where you could make fresh waffles, cereal, juices, biscuits, gravy. They have a very clean, large breakfast room, with TV. The rooms were large, very clean, modern. Frig and microwave. Balconys.bed was very comfortable, nice sheets.the windows were big, with room darkening shades. Its your choice, bright and light or dark and cozy for sleeping. There is a patio out front with table and chairs with flowers surrounding, i sat out there several times to enjoy the fresh air. It cost $11 from pier 91 to the hotel. We did the pre post tour with " lets tour Seattle" where they dropped us off at the cruise ship, please dont waste your $$ on this cruise, our party of 4 was bored out of our mind. Also , we walked to pikes market, space needle. And there is several pizza pasta restaurants that deliver to this hotel.flat rate for taxi to airport $32 we took a suv from airport, that accomodated 4 with 8 pieces of luggage, it was $90. So your best bet is the taxi,be careful though, i paid $11 in a mini van from ship and sis paid 16 in a prius, that had a hard time getting 4 pieces of luggage in.the price was great and I would certainly stay here again, without a doubt.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Seattle Downtown

review_text: Very nice place to stay. We had a water view room on the first floor facing west. If you get a room facing south the view is not the great. Very quiet and it felt like home.

review_title: Great place to stay; but watch cost of reservation changes
review_text:
Great place to stay. Reports of highway noise in other reviews are exaggerated. I am sensitive to such things and it was simply not an issue.
We walked practically everywhere from this great location. Don't let the proximity to interstate 5 throw you. Pedestrian traffic is beautifully accommodated, and protected, in Seattle and there is a walkway/sidewalk straight down Pike. Coming back will be mostly uphill so it is a little harder if you aren't in shape.
The only problem we had was a need to leave, unexpectedly, a day early. Our room rate for our entire stay was impacted. Never had a Hilton brand do this to me before. :(
Overall though good suite hotel. Clean. Can't beat location.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites Seattle Convention Center Pike Street

review_title: Bom custo benefÃ­cio. Muito bem localizado.
review_text: Nada a criticar. Hotel mediano, adequado ao que se propÃµe. Excelente localizaÃ§Ã£o.

This hotel is in a great location. It is within walking distance to Pike Place Market and many other tourist spots. We got a waterfront room and the views were amazing. The shuttle was great, my husband used it everyday. 
Our room was nice, you can tell the hotel is a bit older of you look closely, but it was still very nice. The walls were a bit thin, we could hear our neighbors and the people in the hall quite clearly.
Overall, a great stay. We really liked having the gas fireplace in the room!
Noisy air system, cold restaurant, bad tv, running toilet. However the staff is fantastic and the food is good, just not worth the $$ with so many other great places to stay in Seattle for the price

Rooms are a good size with a kitchenette, living room, bedroom and bathroom. I enjoyed the extra space which is good when you are away from home for several days. 
The free breakfast is limited in choice but it is free.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites Seattle Convention Center Pike Street

review_title: Close to everything, wit friendly service.
review_text: Free breakfast and evening reception with dinner-like food and drinks. Staff is particularly friendly.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites Seattle Convention Center Pike Street

review_title: Great place to stay for business travelers
review_text: I travel for business and have stayed here 5 times since March. It is clean, great service, roomy, and it is so nice to be able to eat a full breakfast and dinner on site. Get an interior room as the street side can be noisy.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites Seattle Convention Center Pike Street

review_title: Great place to stay in a funky pedestrian neighbourhood
review_text: The staff were friendly and answered all our questions effectively with personal suggestions and good restaurant options. The room was clean, quiet (even though we were across from the elevator) and well appointed.
Edgewater is in a great quite location, close walk to downtown and pike place etc, use the shuttle gets you anywhere downtown quicker, nice clean rooms, fireplace and comfy bed.

We stayed here for two days and it was great the whole time, first it is very convienent to plenty of foods options, bars and bus stop. Also the restaurant inside had great food. You must try the mac and cheese. The shower had great water pressure, shampoo/conditioner and body soap was awesome...oh and the view was breathtaking of downtown Seattle.
A very nice hotel with a great Seattle location. A little spending but for the experience was ok for pricing. Clean quiet room with a comfortable bed.
Best service by far. Colin at the front desk was amazing and made our nights stay very comfortable and special. Absolutely recommend hotel deca to anyone.

review_title: Overpriced, rude, smelly and paper thin walls!
review_text:
We stayed here October 8-11 but we paid till the 12th! Location isn't bad but I would rather walk 10 miles then stay here! The nicest thing was the front entrance fireplace outdoors!
First night the next door neighbors were drunk and had their music on very loud but it sounded like it was our room! I could hear every word and we turned our tv up on max and the music and the 2 voices overruled our tv. I called the front desk and they told me I had to deal with it till 11pm! Wtf?!! He was rude and basically hung up in my face as if I was being unrealistic! I can handle music next door but this was like I was sitting in their room! So they went on drinking and talking for about another hour with the music on bust! Then went out and came home about 4am drunk ad loud! So first night ruined! 
The hotel stunk like an old house! I had to spray stuff around our room it was so bad! The room was small and we had no where for our suitcases. The bathroom was nice but don't dare take the stinky cheap shampoo cuz they charge you $20 and I am sure it's a bottle they keep refilling. Oh the best part $200 a night and no FREE Internet!!! Yes you read that right! Who in this day and age doesn't have free wifi?! I forget the price of it but I told them they were crazy! And vallet parking $34 a night! Needless to say we did not tip them once! Complete rip off! Every turn this Hotel wa charging for something! No vending machines and the gift shop had like 2 types of drinks to buy! The walk to the room was endless dreary and dark! 
I've stayed at many hotels and some not the best quality but never ever left with a complaint or a feeling of being raped of our money! We even checked out a day early and headed back to Canada. It actually ruined my Seattle visit and we usually make the best of any situation. 
All these awards mentioned on their website must have been given back at the grand opening on the 1930s or soemthing! If this ppl rate this hotel as the best I would hate to see their worst!
I only stayed for one night but the room was very clean and comfortable. The staff was very friendly and the price was reasonable.
Centrico, buenas camas, servicio y limpieza. Un pelo caro para mi gusto.
I stayed in a water view room. I enjoyed the decor and the fireplace in the room. The location is great for the public market. This was my second stay at the hotel, and I would return again.

Homewood is always the best for extended stays. This location has great service and a wonderful location. Excellent weekday receptions. Salmon and cocktails are on the menus. Decent daily breakfast and clean comfortable rooms.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites Seattle Convention Center Pike Street

review_text: A plastic chest of drawers with a microwave on top is in the tiny closet. Closet had shower curtain-like "door." Bathroom had no shower curtain. It had a liner hung on cheap rings that weren't even clipped. Shower had giant shampoo, conditioner and lotion bottles where you pumped what you needed. No Internet in room despite 3 calls. Motel, er, Hotel must be run by students. Not worth the money. Shameful.

review_title: Fantastic experience, a great place to stay.
review_text: We had a great experience here. Staff were fantastic, and we received a free room upgrade by checking in on FourSquare. The location was fairly central for Seattle proper, however, it was a 15-20 minute drive from downtown. The hotel offers complementary shuttle downtown, and that worked great for us. Lots of perks like free parking, breakfast, microwaves and fridges in the room. We had a wonderful stay.

In diesem Hotel stimmt einfach alles:eine fantastische Lage am Wasser, schÃ¶ne, gerÃ¤umige Zimmer (unter anderem gibt es ein super Bett mit einer kuscheligen Bettdecke, nicht unbedingt Standard in den USA), aufmerksames und freundliches Personal in allen Bereichen. Man ist mit dem nahegelegenen Aufzug schnell im Stadtzentrum und auf dem Pike Market. Freue mich schon aufs wiederkommen.

I stayed at The Edgewater with my two children, & my wife for one week in early July. The accommodations were clean, yet the hallways were dark. There are no vending machines, (which I've come to take for granted for a late night snack). Although they boast of an excellent shuttle system that can get guests to & from various Seattle locations, you must be OK with there schedule, & be OK with receiving guilt in requesting the shuttle from some staff that answer the shuttle hotline. We enjoyed walking & exploring downtown, so bring your sneakers and enjoy walking to your destinations. Also- pay the extra money and treat yourself to a water view room...Unless of course you LOVE listening & seeing trains constantly go past your window. This was cool for our 6 year old, but the rest of us would have rather gazed out over the water. Also the bathroom was odd in that you felt very exposed with modern partial barriers. Btw- our son fell out of bed at 1:00am. When I asked the front desk what I should do with a child with a quickly swelling child's ear that was changing various colors, they responded with we can call an ambulance. Idk what I expected, maybe ice? Maybe an EMT on call? This is a nice hotel...but just enough quirks to make you question spending your hard earned money:(

review_title: Great room in a very nice hotel
review_text:
We stayed from the 1st to the 5th of July and really enjoyed Hotel Deca. The staff were very friendly and helpful, even when they were working on 4th July. The cafe (Tullys) attached to hotel is very convinient and the restaraunt also attached (The District) was alao very nice and reasonably priced. Alcohol was very cheap during happy hour.
After initially declining a $15 per night room upgrade to a double queen suite, the guy at the desk bumped us up for free anyway.
It's fairly easy to get around on the bus from one street over and there's mostly young college folk on board so it's a comfy ride.
Finally, we left our camera behind in the room and only realised when we got to the Amtrak station. We called and the front desk was only too happy to collect it, wrap it in bubble wrap and send to our next stay in Vancouver, Canada.
I'd recomend this place to anyone and the renovations to building look great.

After reading some of the comments for this hotel I was a little concerned. More so with the train noise as our room faced directly to the tracks. 
The room was very sound proof. There was some train noise but not enough to effect your sleep. The room was very clean and loved the decor. We took there limo service to the airport and upon checking thru security at the airport we realized my wife left here wallet in the limo. 
We called the hotel and the driver did find it and they where so good as to send the driver back out to the airport with it. 
This is service above and beyond. 
Would highly recommend the Edgewater.

review_title: Thin walls... You can hear everything.
review_text:
On my reservation I requested a quite room... I was told I was was given a quite room overlooking the parking lot but the walls were so thin I could hear the people in the next room and everyone in the hall.
The water in the shower turns from warm to hot to cold in thd middle of your shower. 
The free shuttle was a touch and the room had a decent layout but your main needs... Sleeping and a warm constance temp shower might not be meet.

El hotel pertenece a una franquicia de Marriott, y a pesar de eso las camas son malisimas. Los colchones estan totalmente desgastados, por lo que la cama King Size de nuestra habitacion, era incomodisima. Tanto mi esposa como yo, casi nos caiamos de la cama, ya que el centro de la misma era muy alto, y a los lados eran bajisimos y con desnivel hacia el suelo. Reclamamos al hotel, y lo unico que hicieron fue poner unas tablas de madera najo el colchon, y la situacion siguio exactamente igual. El personal de mantenimiento nos dijo que esta era una queja comun entre los huespedes, ya que las camas eran muy viejas. Ademas de la anterior, el estacionamiento es incomodisimo y extremadamente caro. En resumen, no nos gusto el hotel, por lo que no volveremos.

I called this place to make reservation because I wanted to book a oceanview room to watch fireworks from our room!! So kids would enjoy and would not be stuck in traffic for hours after fireworks!! The lady assured me I could see fireworks from that room. Once I got there checked in and they told me I can't see fireworks from that room but they will give is free shuttle to space needle but we will have to take taxi back cuz thru don't have shuttle after 10. Space needle didn't even have fireworks this year!!! I paid $350 a night for the room and got yo see nothing and I was gone most of the evening somewhere else!! When I asked why did they give me wrong info? All they had to say is " there's a comment card in the room please write your concerns" wow!!! Major disappointment!!!

This place is north of seattle in the university district near university of Washington. The hotel, from the outside looks modern if this was 1971. The inside is nice and updated. So don't fear. The staff was friendly and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable. Not a bad place to stay. Plenty of free parking. The area seems a little dirty, but all of Seattle does. Like it needs a good scrubbing with the frequent washdowns of rain it gets.

The Deca is a mid-size, mid-range, non-chain hotel in the University District (about 5 miles north of the Seattle CBD) and offering good value and good service. The immediate locality is interesting, with a good mall 1 mile away and lots of cheap & cheerful restaurants nearby. The hotel offers a very useful free shuttle into the CBD, which makes up for any disadvantage with the location. Excellent service and efficiencies or economies such as a Tully's coffee shop next to the lobby. Recommended.

Way overpriced, but it seems most of Seattle is. We had a nice waterside room with great views. Clawfoot tub that opens up to the view. Good location, walking distance to pikes market and the space needle and other touristy stuff. Expensive restaurant and bar in the hotel. Food was good, service was as well, but expect to pay for it. The worst is $34 a night to park unless you want to leave your car out on the street a block away. I wouldn't, Seattle is full of homeless and others who might mess with your nice car. Seattle is a dump and the edgewater made it tolerable for one night for a high price.

Attended wedding taking place at the University and bride chose this hotel for guests. Great choice! Rooms clean, staff accommodating and helpful. Shuttle available to campus which was extremely convenient. I would consider staying here again.

review_title: Very nice , fair price for location
review_text: Very clean , great location . Beter than what we expected
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Pioneer Square Hotel

review_title: Very,nice ,convenient friendly and gem of the area!
review_text: I am staying here on business and couldn't be happier! Beds are super comfy , staff if friendly, breakfast is free, location is great and a free bus to pick us up and drop us off at night!!! I think recently renovated because everything looks brand new! Fantastic for the business traveler!

Wonderful stay at Hyatt Place! Very friendly and welcoming staff. Rooms were very clean and well designed. The free shuttle service to the centre of the city was excellent. Drivers were very helpful. 
Will definetely stay here again!

Don't judge a book by its cover. When I drove up to this hotel at night, I had second thoughts about making that reservation. It looked like a seedy hotel in a forgotten part of town. But step inside, and you'll find a quaint, well-decorated space with a friendly, attentive staff. Our room was clean and bright with large windows and high ceilings. The location is south of the busy downtown, but there are plenty of great eateries and interesting shops. It's just a couple of blocks from the waterfront. Pike Place Market is further away, but we walked there--the blocks are short. We parked our car in an off-site parking garage nearby and walked everywhere. It rained non-stop, but the hotel loaned us umbrellas. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. This will be my Seattle hotel from now on.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Pioneer Square Hotel

review_text: We stayed here 2 nights and we absolutely loved it. The rooms were clean and comfy, view was great, and the free shuttle was a wonderful bonus. Unlike most of the downtown hotels parking is free here and with the free shuttle we could get downtown in just a matter of minutes. The front desk people were super helpful. We will definitely be back!

review_title: Ok if you don't want to sleep
review_text: The room was clean and updated. There was plenty of space for me, my wife and 2 daughters. The problem is that it is right off of a very busy road and it was nearly impossible to sleep. Also the breakfast buffet was horribly inefficient even with three breakfast attendants. Most Homewoood suites I've stayed at only have one and do a much better job. Trash was overflowing, they were constantly out of hot items, and finding a clean table was impossible. These are all the things that kept me from giving the hotel a higher rating. As I mentioned before the room itself was great.
hotel_name: Homewood Suites Seattle Convention Center Pike Street

review_text: Hotel is nice. The room could have been a little cleaner. The 2am staff showed they really cared for my every need. Young man was vey professional and polite. No name tag though so never got his name. Thankyou for the accomodations and making us know u cared about us.

review_title: One of our best hotel stays ever!
review_text:
My sister and I spent last weekend in Seattle and booked the Hyatt Place based on reviews on this site. Needless to say, we were not disappointed. Our check in was quick and pleasant. As soon as I walked into the lobby I was greeted with a smile. Our room was very clean, the beds were extra comfortable...I slept better here than at home.
The Space Needle and EMP are a short walk from the hotel and there is also a 24 Hour shuttle to take you anywhere in the immediate area. I have to give extra recognition to the two shuttle drivers that helped us over the weekend. I wish I had their names, but we never waited more than 10 minutes for a pick up and when the bus was full, my sister got to ride up front so we wouldn't have to wait for the driver to come back.
Overall I was extremely happy with our time at the hotel. I have already been recommending it to some coworkers who are planning trips to Seattle in the near future.
We are a family four and found this hotel a great value for the money. Free parking, free breakfast and free shuttle to most attractions. Rooms were clean, and staff was friendly.

review_title: Historic location- great base to explore from
review_text: We booked the 4 night package prior to joining a cruise, we had stayed in Seattle before in a hotel with a room that was no bigger than a shoe box. This was not the case with this hotel, the room was large, light and airy and the bathroom had a very unusual shower that also doubled as a bath. The first impression of the hotel was not that good, there is a lot of dark wood panelling in reception and the lighting is a bit gloomy, however check in was both speedy and friendly, with the welcome news that the hotel had free wifi. The breakfast which is included in the room rate is good, always great to make your own waffles. The down side of the breakfast room is that it can be a bit cramped when busy and I'm afraid some guests have been quite careless and spilled things on the floor and stained the carpet - it really could do with a good shampoo just to tidy it up. The hotel is in a perfect location, near to the water front, so handy for ferries. For a bargain rate of just $2.75 you can take the light railway from the airport and the walk the block and a half to the hotel. Would definitely stay here again, also plenty of good eating places in walking distance.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Pioneer Square Hotel

review_text:
We stayed in this hotel during our vacation in July. We have 3 young children, ages 8, 5, and 3. 
The location is very good. If you stay in rooms facing Lake Union, the view is very nice and you can see Space Needle from your room. On July 4, you can see the fireworks from your room. Just make sure that you stay in high floors (6 or 7). 
Rooms are spacious, clean, and breakfast is nice but crowded during our stay.

We were pleased with our stay at Hyatt Place Seattle. Rooms felt fairly new, comfortable and spacious. Positive features included decor, comfortable mattress, clean modern bathroom with tall shower head, big flat screen TV, couch, desk and chair, complimentary breakfast, with no noise from other rooms. The only negative was the shuttle service which at times is unreliable because it over promises and under delivers. We would choose this one again.

When looking for a place to stay in Seattle this place hit the mark for our family. Free parking. Breakfast included. Pool. Shuttle service to local sights. 
Breakfast had all the standards, pastries, cereals, yogurts, waffles, bacon and eggs. It's a nice, bright dining area with plenty of tables. 
The shuttle service was great with drop off and pick up when requested at the Space Needle, Underground Tour or Pikes Place Market. The shuttle also would also do drop off and pick ups in the evenings at local restaurants. 
The staff were helpful and knowledgeable about local restaurants and had recommendations for every budget. 
We would definitely stay here again on our next visit to Seattle and have recommended it to friends.

review_title: Great place. Big rooms and free parking and great breakfast!
review_text: We were impressed by the size of the rooms. Had complimentary parking and Internet. Good location. Shuttle service to downtown.

review_title: Great location, lovely rooms, average service
review_text: Awesome location but was disappointed by staff/service. When I asked for help booking a show I was told that the concierge was off and they couldn't help me. I also asked for a shower cap that they just never brougt minor but annoying. However it is so close to shopping and dining and the rooms are quite lovely so I would still recommend.

We've stayed there a few times and would do so again.Â 
Some rooms face towards the city and the railroad tracks are very nearby with freight trains moving through at times all night long. The hotel does supply earplugs in those rooms. We prefer the waterfront rooms which have nice views over the water to the dock area with large cranes for large ships. Â Ferries go by too.
Â Desk staff is friendly. The resturAnt has a very nice view and a good happy hour. Breakfasts also fine although some wait staff left quite a bit to be desired.
Â The rooms have gas fireplaces but we've noticed they can have problems lighting and we have had to get a maintenance man up repeatedly to crawl around on the floor to light them.

My spouse & I have stayed @ many Best Westerns, this one is over the top when it comes to customer service. I had left my Sturgis 2010 hoodie in armor. Long story short, they mailed it back to me in Canada...at THEIR cost! I was grateful that they found it, as a lot of hotels would just say the item isn't there. When it showed up in the mail I was even happier we had chosen this hotel. The location is the best if wanting to walk Pier 57 or old Pioneer Square. Check out the glass blowing a block away!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Pioneer Square Hotel

review_text: We had a great stay here. We were on a short break from victoria and we have stayed in several hotels in seattle before but this was by far the best. The rooms are all themed as if you were travelling in the 1800s but are a great size. The bar and the Food are excellent and the hotel is close to downtown and a 5 minute walk to pike place we will definatley stay there again
hotel_name: The Arctic Club Seattle - a DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel

review_text: Our stay at the Sheraton was great. Our room was very nice and clean -- I wish it would have had a kitchenette, but other than that, I can't complain. The location in the middle of downtown was PERFECT!
Absolutely fantastic hotel. Rooms had character, were clean, and the service was terrific.
hotel_name: The Arctic Club Seattle - a DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel
hotel_address: {'region': 'WA', 'street-address': '700 3rd Ave (corner of Third and Cherry - hotel entrance on Cherry Street)', 'postal-code': '98104', 'locality': 'Seattle'}

review_text: I've read a lot of the negative reviews and I don't get it. We were on the city side, with a view of the parking lot and the noise of the trains, but none of that mattered. We barely heard the trains, and we definitely didn't sit around staring out the window. We easily walked to the Space Needle, Pike Place, even Safeco field. The view from the restaurant and the lobby is gorgeous and the rooms are so cozy. And although the parking was a little expensive, the service was exemplary; the valets, doormen, front desk, servers, housekeepers, were all great. We'll definitely come back!

As a Sheraton member I have stayed at this hotel a number of times. Great location for shopping without a doubt but being a "Preferred Guest" doesn't seem to be a benefit. No late checkout, only 2 towels in the room (for 2 people), no morning newspaper, charged $3/luggage bag to store for a couple of hours and the most annoying thing is being asked to pay $11 for WiFi, which we didn't. When will hotels get the message that this is a real sticking point for travelers, especially when paying $200+ for a room. On this point alone, our next stay in Seattle won't be at the Sheraton.

review_title: Shuttle service makes a good choice
review_text: Not a wow hotel but nice enough standard rooms with a pretty view, the staff are extremely helpful and the shuttlevto downtown made this a nice pick for a post Alaska cruise stay
Friendly helpful beautiful elegant walk to link, Pike place and stores
hotel_name: The Arctic Club Seattle - a DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel
