I took full use of this and enjoyed the cleanest bum in boston for the four days I was there. What a treat. The restaurant at the hotel was good. But expensive. Eggs and bacon. 17 dollars. Ouch. But I would stay here again. I got a web special and paged about 850 including taxes for 3the nights.

Das Zimmer lies keine wÃ¼nsche offen wenn man sich auch ein Wifi for free in einem Hotel dieser Preisklasse erwarten wÃ¼rde. Das Personal ausgesucht freundlich und hilfsbereit. Im Restaurant hat's ziemlich gedauert obwohl nix los war. Der Concierge besorgt einem alles. Die Lage des Hotels kÃ¶nnte besser nicht sein und ist Mit dem Auto problemlos zu erreichen.

My wife and I enjoyed our stay. The location is great, within an easy walk to Quincy market and the north end. Plus, the harbor is a block away.
But, please be aware that the hotel is old so the walls are thin and the floor squeaks so it could be a little noisy. Also, the front desk staff is a little indifferent but the housekeeping staff is great! 
We would recommend for a vacation but not a business trip!
Clean and updated rooms. Friendly and helpful staff. Perfect location to enjoy several parts of the city.

review_title: Nice hotel but don't eat at their restaurant!
review_text: Very nice hotel with great staff, especially the bell hop. The restaurant however was HORRIBLE. Food was so so but the service was awful. We waited forever just to place our orders which caused most of us to get the breakfast buffet even though we didn't know it was $23 each. My husband and I ordered eggs and a yogurt parfait. This took at least 30 minutes. By the time they brought out the food the yogurt was room temp and disgusting. Eggs were good but how hard is that to make. The icing on the cake was when the server did not return our friends change and gave himself a $10 tip that was undeserved.
Clean and updated rooms. Friendly and helpful staff. Perfect location to enjoy several parts of the city.

Sono stata in questo hotel con mio marito x 4 notti.
Sinceramente non mi sento di parlare male di questo hotel ma non mi sento nemmeno di elogiarlo come ho letto in molte recensioni.
E' un design hotel molto freddo. Soggiornare all'ames e' come dormire sopra ad un ristorante / bar alla moda. 
A mio avviso non lascia nessuna sensazione, si sta bene, probabilmente fa molto Figo dire di soggiornare all'ames ma x me e' un po' ridicolo
Partiamo dal fatto che ti offre tutto ma si paga tutto... Ma proprio tutto e con dei prezzi allucinanti.
L'ubicazione e' buona, 5 min dal quincy market.
Mi ha molto infastidito il fatto che mi abbiano bloccato piu del doppio del prezzo del mio soggiorno e che una volta pagato ( con un'altra carta di credito) i miei soldi siano rimasti bloccati x 10 giorni e non esiste un'assistenza di nessun tipo Ps late check out ( si paga la meta' della camera) quando 130 dollari ( x 4 ore)

review_title: Excellent rapport qualite/prix pour cet hotel
review_text:
Hotel tres moderne grande chambre
Petit dejeuner inclus de bonne facture copieux 
Tres bonne situatoon dans la ville tous les sites touristiques sont accessibles a pied
Concierge tres efficace et bien au fait des principaux restaurants de la ville
A recommander sans hesitation pour tous types de sejour
Agence avis a 2 minutes a pied

review_title: A very nice historic hotel, walking distance to everything
review_text: We had a lovely stay at the Omni Parker House. We were there for the second half of a 50th birthday celebration and it was a great hotel. Upon arriving we were met with champagne and chocolate covered strawberries and that was so nice of the hotel. The room was very comfy, a great bed, slept like a rock. The hotel is on the older side but has been updated and it was very modern and comfortable. If I had a complaint, it's a tiny one and that's the tiny bathroom. Otherwise, the room was very nice. The hotel has a lot of history associated with it and the lobby ceiling is gorgeous. I suggest you go to the sportsbar/lounge and try the world famous Boston Cream Pie, it was excellent. The staff was also very friendly and happy to answer any questions we had.

review_title: Si puedes permitirtelo y vas a apovechar la habitacion, no lo dudes
review_text:
La entrada del hotel dificil de encontrar, no tiene ninguna identificacion en la entrada, por lo visto se llama como el edificio, pero como no sepas este dato, piensas que el GPS te esta tomando el pelo. La habitacion tenia un amplio recibidor con un pasillo y al final una habitacion en tonos blancos muy acogedora, los tonos de pintura elegidos crean ambiente sofisticado,y lo curioso es el banyo, con su pared divisoria acristalada, pero con una cortina que deja pasar la luz, y que no deja ver el interior del banyo.Agua de disenyo en la habitaciona 8 Usd.Wifi de pago.
La recepcion preciosa, lampara de disenyo (todo en hotel lo es, desde las amenities hasta las sabanas, por cierto buenisimas), del restaurante no puedo opinar, pero justo al lado esta el centro y el market lleno de ellos. Esta en pleno centro, el parking, 1 dia 42Usd

We stayed at Back Bay for one night on our way to Maine. I used price line and got a room for about $150. The hotel is boutique pretty and the staff is top notch. The rooms are luxurious, the common area beautiful and location is 5 minutes from Newbury street. The concierge worked hard to find us reservations, and find me a last minute manicure on Newbury street. This hotel is a jem!
Toda la estancia fue fabulosa.esta en un sitio muy bueno y la atenciÃ³n fue excelente

review_title: Perfect location, great staff, kids loved it!
review_text: We stayed for an overnight getaway, and loved it. Kids liked the kids Package and the walking tour was a good value. Walking distance to T stop, Fanueil, Common, harbor, aquarium, duck tours...everything you want to see in Boston. When the bellman heard we hadn't had the Boston cream pie, he went and got us two to go for the ride home. The breakfast was elegant and comfortable, not noisy even though all the tables were full, and roomy. Food was excellent, miles ahead of what passes for breakfast in a lot of places.

review_title: Excellent fun choice...big bathrooms for Boston
review_text:
This was our first stay but likely not our last. The room we stayed in was a deluxe upper floor room. The room size was more than ample and the bathroom very roomy with a well functioning shower and drainage. The linens were very plush and the bed quite comfortable.
The wine hour is a nice touch too. 
This is a very well located hotel. If you are driving in from out of town park at the Boston Common Garage as the nights and weekend rates are a fraction of the cost of valet.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Fantastic location, incompetent staff and crazy-expensive parking. Nice bed, graffitied walls and a wall outside the window. I can check staying at this grand dame of Boston off my list and don't have to do it again - so many better options are available.

This was our first trip to Boston, so we wanted to stay close to the freedom trail and downtown. We couldn't have picked a better spot! We were right outside the old city hall, and pretty much everytime we walked out we saw a band playing there; so cool. Great access to basically everything, and anywhere we wanted to go in the city was no longer than a 15 minute cab ride. Very easy to get cabs in this city!!
Yes, the bathrooms are small. If you are traveling with a lot of people, this may not be the place for you. However it was only my fiancee and I so we didn't care.
Beds are amazing! Can't beat it!
The hotel staff was always friendly and eager to help! 
Great stay; I can't wait to go back to Boston and would stay here again!

Second Kimpton Hotel stay in a week, and, glad to say, another jewel. Super helpful staff, Thomas the bellman and Gabriella on front desk, the standouts from a great team. Funky but functional (the description for this chain) Everything works, beautifully. Great restaurant. Can't wait to return.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Great place for a great price
review_text: This hotel was great for what we were looking for. We came to boston for the day and decided to stay over. After looking around at all the 200-500 per night hotels we thought we were doomed. Then we saw the harborside inn. It took us less than 5 minutes to check-in and the staff was helpful. The room was clean and appeared to be recently remodeled. There was a mini-fridge in the room which is a rare find for moderately priced hotels. As long as you aren't a pretentious jerk you will be happy with the harborside inn.

review_title: Amazing staff, hotel, location and view!
review_text: I cannot say enough good things to say about this hotel. The staff was professional and helpful with any of my needs. I will always pick this hotel to stay in when in Seattle!

We had an excellent stay at the Omni Parker house. The room was extremely clean and the housekeepers were very attentive. 
They don't mention this on the booking, but they offer free 
Wifi if you register to the omni select program which is also free!
As some of the negative reviews mention, booking with hotwire means the room was near an ice machine and you get a double bed, but for the money paid it was excellent. At the end of the day, if you're a heavy sleeper, you get to stay in a beautiful and clean hotel for very little money. I'd recommend the hotel to everyone.
Also, the location was great! Close to the Italian north end and right on the freedom trail!

I have to agree with the last poster about the noise. Hotel doors slam shut making a loud noise and waking me up. Invest in door silencers! Furthermore, can clearly hear cinversations from the hallway. If there were only another door between the entrance and the bedroom area, this would quiet things down a lot. If you do stay here, make sure the hotel is not fully booked, especiallt with rowdy kids in my case. Brand new does not mean quiet, and modern comforts do not make up for lack of soundproofing and a good night's sleep.

I really enjoy staying at the Langham hotels. Boston's Langham is very conveniently located in the historic district of the city. It is easy to walk to from South Station and is a $35.00 taxi ride from Logan airport. 
The service is good, I arrived late and they were able to check in my friend who was already at the hotel. It did take me 10 minutes holding before reception took my call. 
The rooms were comfortable and the seating area made it feel like a junior suite. The bathroom is older and could do with a refurbishment initiative. 
Concierge was also busy and poor man was on multiple calls as well as helping customers. It took a while before we were helped.
Overall a nice stay and a nice hotel with nice facilities.
Had a lovely stay at this hotel. The staff were friendly, the rooms very comfortable and the location is great!

This location has it all! Walk out and you're at the Steelhead Diner, near a French Bakery, and very close to Pike's Market. You'll love it! We can't wait to come back here. The bellmen are super. The desk staff is wonderful. Thanks, Carmen!

We live here about an hour outside Seattle. We occasionally stay downtown for an evening event instead of driving home late. We were in town to go to the symphony and the next morning my husband had a meeting. We were first in need of assistance when my husband needed a seam in his suit pants mended. I stopped by the front desk on our way out asking for a needle and thread. They sent up the most little amazing sewing kit to the room. The next morning my husband got up and at 7 am there was NO hot water for a shower. I called down to the front desk and they said they were just aware of the problem and were working on it. He didn't have time to wait, so had to take a very cool quick shower. He mentioned it to the front desk on his way out and they said they would adjust the bill but not any more. When I checked out ( after getting a hot shower at 9) they had taken our room charge from $255 down to $99. I was surprised and delighted and appologized again for the inconvenience. They couldn't solve the problem in time for his shower, but they made up for it the way a first rate hotel should. We will definitely be coming back.

review_title: For its history, building and location, the service and rooms should be much nicer.
review_text: I'm sure some of the rooms are very nice but the traditional rooms with its double beds are awful. The service is ok, just well below the standards of what a "4" star hotel should be.

review_title: A great place and great location.
review_text: Sitting in the hotel as I write this. Great service, very nice hotel. Great location, but you do really pay for it.

Grande dame hotel home to parker house rolls, boston cream pie and where jfk proposed to jackie. We have stayed here several times and will again. We stay in a suite. Bathroom is tiny but room is, large and comfortable

review_title: Great location! Quaint, cozy and excellent service
review_text: Began with Raphael the most friendly, professional and accommodating doorman/valet I've met. Rooms were very clean. My family had the 2 double beds which was decent in size for a city hotel, our travelling companions had a king which was quite small. Love the Copley area, lots of amazing restaurants in area and cleaner and more attractive then the historic area. Front desk/concierge was very helpful and patient in answering all my questions.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Boston Copley Square

review_title: Not as good as other Morgan gp hotels
review_text:
Room was small and noisy due to street construction. Front desk was accomodating and did a room change, but no upgrade. Overall, would
Not return, stay at the w hotel, for a better bar and restaurant with better rooms and amenities. Gym was really small too.
Enjoyed our stay, location great, wifi didn't work in our room.

review_title: Lovely building, great location, stylish vibe.
review_text: Got a great deal through Expedia, met all our requirements, very central for all attractions. Only criticisms are the rooms are small and no tea/coffee making facilities. Free Wifi though!

review_title: Small, sparse room but great location.
review_text: The Omni is located right on the Freedom walk, as well as minutes away from the Boston Common. Walk everywhere - North End, historic sights, waterfront, dining, parks. Lobby is impressive but room was average and looked like someone stole the furniture that should have been there. Queen bed very comfortable. Air conditioner was loud but effective.

review_title: Not quite as good as it was
review_text: We have stayed at the Back Bay for our one night in Boston over the Memorial day for the past 5 years, and we've continued to go back as the hotel has offered everything that we've needed for a relaxing stopover. This year, for the first time, things were not as perfect as they have been. It's still a good place to stay, but we feel it has slipped a bit, eg rooms looking a bit tatty, cooked breakfast poor and we had to ask 3 times to get a foam pillow delivered to the room. Still a good hotel, just not as great as it was.

review_title: Great service, great location, great style!
review_text: Went up to Boston to enjoy a nice weekend with the wife and could not have picked a better place to stay! Service was exceptional, the room was trendy and comfortable and the wine reception was a really nice touch. Really enjoyed our stay there and what a view!
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Very nice hotel and great location. Subway, tours, etc are near the hotel. Nice staff and clean rooms. I will come back to this hotel if ever in Boston again.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Just checked in and I am very impressed with the staff. The hotel rooms are small but intelligently laid out. We have a corner king room with great views of the common. Plus I am really digging the CD in the player. I guess a mix by the hotel staff. Overall pleasentlu surprised. Finally although it is a pet friendly hotel my allergies have not acted up at all. Saw a full size poodle in the lobby. I like this place and will be back
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Perfektes Hotel ! Einziger kleiner Negativpunkt sind die Preise aber bei dieser ZimmerqualitÃ¤t (Aussicht etc.) kein Problem. Restaurants waren perfekt, gute Stimmung besonders am Samstag Abend / Nacht. Design des Hotels top! Service und Freundlichkeit auch genial. Zimmer war im 21. Stockwerk mit Blick Ã¼ber den Fluss auf die Skyline. Gerne wieder!

Just returned from our first trip to Boston and miss the city already! We were there for three nights for a convention but got to explore the city as well. Omni Parker House is in a prefect location right on the Freedom Trail. The bed at this hotel was the most comfortable and we slept well every night of our stay. The room was clean and everything was lovely througout our stay. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Boston. Very easy to find and located near the trains if you are coming from Logan Airport. The loyalty program is worth signing up for, they bring you a newspaper and morning breakfast beverage plus free wi-fi. It was nice having fresh coffee brought to us each morning while we were getting ready and then heading to one of Boston's many Dunkin Donuts or Starbucks to start our day off.

review_title: Great location, poor night sleep a/c goes off/on all night.
review_text:
Excellent location. Great service. 
We stayed at suite and ,except for bathroom size, it was comfortable.
The only problem is the air conditioning. No matter the settings you use,it keeps turning on and off all night.

We stayed at the Back Bay hotel for 7 nights from 21st April. The room was very clean and beds very comfortable. Standard rooms have no bath only a shower, but it was a lovely huge shower but could do with more shelving or storage for shampoo, etc. Rooms come with free wi-fi which was great for keeping in touch with family and getting any tourist info on the city. You also got 2free bottles of water daily to your room, which again is great considering other 4* hotels can charge $2-4 per bottle!
There are coffee making facilities in the room, but no tea facilities. However on asking for some we got a tray with a kettle, mugs and teabags sent up to our room! 
There is a fantastic irish bar, Cuffs downstairs which we tended to go to for a few drinks most nights and food on a couple of occasions. Food and drink was reasonably priced for a hotel and very tasty, excellent staff and service aswell here. The hotel was in an ideal location for getting around Boston, it was 5 -10 mins walk from Newbury and Boylston Streets, Copley Plaza and Prudential Centre. My husband and I also walked to Long Wharf for the harbour cruise and aquarium. It was about 1.5miles away which took us no more than 30mins to walk. This was also beside Quincy Market and Fanuiel Hall. It was also only 15mins away from Boston Common and Theatre District. Very centrally located.
while in Boston I had an accident and burnt my fingers on hot tea, the help and assistance provided by Nuala Creedon, Asst Front of House Manager, was great. She was very helpful and directed us to the local ER. Thereafter she offered us any help we required for the duration o our stay. 
We didn't use concierge as I like to plan ahead for holidays, but I heard 2 different members of staff being very helpful and informative with guests, which was lovely to see.
Overall I would highly recommend the Back Bay hotel for your stay in Boston. We will definitively return!

review_title: I Love Kimpton Hotels and Nine Zero Is No Exception.
review_text:
We've stayed at Nine Zero twice and Kimpton Hotels in Philadelphia and Seattle as well. Even though they are part of a chain each hotel has a distinct personality (although they all have a wine tasting and animal print robes!). Nine Zero is sleek and stylish. The rooms and bathrooms are adequate size and the beds are excellent. The staff is enthusiastic and friendly. The location is also perfect for us because it is within easy walkiing distance of the Quincy Market area, the North End and Back Bay. It is also convenient to the major transportation hubs of North Station, South Station and Downtown Crossing.
This is our hotel whenever we are in Boston.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Great location, great views, great food and great service!!!! Loved everything about it
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: The best service and most comfortable beds at any hotel!
review_text: I very much enjoyed my stay at the Omni Parker House. The staff was always very friendly, particularly Seamus Murphy. He told my brother and I the things to do in Boston and the things not to do. He gave us very good directions and also told us about the ghost stories of the hotel. Definitely seek him out if you have never been to Boston before. The room was a very decent size as we asked for the larger standard room, which was definitely worth the extra money. Also, the beds were so comfortable I had no problem sleeping away from home. Definitely stay here! Its a hotel that has a ton of history to it.

My husband surprised me with a trip to Boston for our anniversary and booked a room at the Nine Zero. This hotel is fantastic. From the rooms, to the service, to the location. I can not say one bad thing about this hotel. Our room was very hip and comfortable. The hotel has a great restaurant on the premise, hosted a wine hour in the afternoon and recommended a wonderful little wine bar near the Common. I would definitely stay here if you are looking for a quite, hip place to stay in the heart of Boston.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Boston is a very walkable city and the Nine Zero Hotel is perfectly located. I am partially handicapped but I was able to walk to Newbury St, Copley Plaza, Boston Common, Beacon Hill,Freedom Trail, Fanueil Hall, Paul Revere House, North Church and the North Side. Remember, many of the sidewalks are uneven bricks so be careful when walking. Make sure you buy tickets to the Freedom Trail Tour. Michael was our tour guide and was excellent. A must to understand Boston and our history. Loved the cemeteries-amazing they date back to the 1600's. 
Breakfast-walk to the Paramount on Charles St. Stand in line, order, pay and they will seat you. Line moves quickly. 
Lunch-Legal Seafood. Loved the chowder and clam roll. 
Dinner-Union Oyster House for history and good food. Mooo on Beacon St for maybe one of the best dinners we've had. Ordered the Delmonico steak and caramelized scallops. Share the sides of mashed potatoes, Parmesan fries, don't miss the corn succotash and creamed spinach. Finished with warm blueberry pie with vanilla ice cream. Worth the $150 for 2. We've paid more for dinner butbhave never had better. 
Back to the Nine Zero-the breakfast was great, especially the view of the granary cemetery. People are all very helpful and the room was beautiful, large and clean. Love the bed!
Great trip! We plan on staying at the Nine Zero again.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Solid hotel choice in a central location
review_text: We found everything that was said in the other positive reviews to be true. Our king room was very comfy and quiet - order allergy pillows in advance if you do want them. The location is perfect and the wine hour (5-6) is very welcome. The only slightly odd thing was that the bar and restaurant were shut on sunday and Monday which wasn't ideal. The staff were all very friendly and helpful at recommending other places to go though. Overall a very good stay.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
After an incredibly trying road trip from New York (our fault for heading over on Labour Day weekend!), my husband and I arrived after 6pm (previous ETA had been 2.30pm!). Tired and jaded, we were greeted by the awesome staff, who took our car and bags and immediately brought me a glass of wine and my husband a beer... 
This was just the start of their fabulous service. It was our honeymoon and we went to our room to find champagne and chocolate strawberries waiting for us.
We took full advantage of the great consierge service, listening to their advice on tours to take and letting them book us into restaurants they recommended.
The room was fabulous, although the gym was a little bit small. With a complimentary wine reception each evening, hotel Nine Zero was an absolute gem of an hotel, a small boutique feel in a large hotel- PERFECT!
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: While a little pricey the location is great - we could see Boston Common from our window. Very convenient to many historic sites. Parking is $$$ but it is downtown Boston. Room not large but well organized. Bath is small but well laid out.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: It was a pleasure being guest at this hotel. It was hard to find it at the beginning, you have to pay attention to the small signs. Rooms are big and clean, people friendly and helpful, atmosphere posh and classy. It is really well positioned on the freedom trail. A wonderful choice. I will suggest this hotel to the people who will want to spend some days in boston.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Good time, will stay there again
review_text:
Overall great hotel and service. We liked the no tipping policy (service included). Roomy, clean rooms. Location was ok, removed from most sites by a couple of
Miles, but still ok. We walked everywhere. Being next to the water was nice.
Great location and service. Would highly recommend to all. Just around the corner from Boston's best shopping and within walking distance or short drive from great dining choices.

My husband and I stayed here for 2 nights. We loved the pillow menu! Very clean room and bathroom was very nice. The hotel offers free wine and drinks from 5-6 in their lobby. 
We also ate breakfast both days at the hotel's restaurant. Good food but very expensive. We paid $12 for a small plate of fruit:( The hotel does not offer free coffee and tea and it is very expensive to order it from room service ($7 got tea, $5 for coffee). When we couldn't find a coffee shop open around the hotel later in the evening, the front desk sent us complimentary tea and coffee - bonus points!! 
Location of this hotel is great and the staff is excellent!!
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Modern slick and clean. No view to speak of in the room we were in (literally pulled curtains open to see a brick wall) but made up by the lovely lounge vibe and complimentary cocktails. Good location easy walk to the harbour for whale watching tour - though we saw none! Not even any false alarms :( Also easy walk to shops, Boston commons, excellent Atlantic Fish restaurant which you should not miss
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Stayed here for two nights to attend a conference being held at the hotel. Arrived very late and was checked in quickly and efficiently. Rooms are very clean - not the most modern but very clean. The staff I encountered were awesome - courteous and nothing was too much. Exceptional stay and loved the location.

Stayed here for five nights while on business at Emerson College. Lovely hotel in very convenient location. The Park St station for the T is steps away with connections on two popular T lines (Green and Red). There are also restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and a movie theater within walking distance. As to the hotel itself, the room was great and beautifully furnished. Small point deduction for the outdated CRT TV that occasionally buzzed with a bad picture, but otherwise it was fine. Loved the fully-stocked minibar and comfy robes. I would have given this hotel five stars had they not double-charged me for my room (once with Expedia, once on my incidentals credit card). by the time I discovered the error and called the hotel, they had reversed the charges. If I am in this neighborhood again, I will definitely consider the Nine Zero (and just watch my bill at checkout).
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
We stayed here for 3 nights over new years and had a great stay. All the staff were helpful and gave us really good ideas for things to do on new years. 
We stayed in the base room and were very happy with the size and quality of the room. The little touches such as heated towel rails and sensored night light in the bathroom and many others set this hotel apart from others.
The location is great as you can find pretty much anything you want in a 5 minute walking radius from the hotel. In room dining had. Decent selection and wasn't all that expensive.
The only things I didn't like about this hotel was that the restaurant doesn't really offer a selection of simple food as it was very Irish orientated and also there always seemed to be a queue at reception. 
I would gladly reccommend this hotel to anyone.
Rooms are average but views are nice. The location is good for anything in that area.

Stayed in the colonnade for 3 nights with 2 friends. Room wasn't huge but was big enough for 3 of ius and our cases etc. Lovely tv, coffee machine, modern bathroom. Service at concierge desk a little grumpy but reception were always more than happy to help. Free wifi in the lobby and a gorgeous restaurant in hotel. Hotel is directly opposite the prudential mall, cheesecake factory and of changs also starbucks across street. Will definately return.

The room I stayed in was nice for one person, with a comfy king sized bed. Convenient Kurig coffee machine in the bathroom. For the price, breakfast should have been included. Across the street from the T, but you have to transfer to other lines for most tourist attractions.
The front desk personnel was uppity when I asked about getting a double bed room. This hotel has a dearth of double beds. But they did fax something for me for free and there were computers with internet for free too at the business office.
I did not have a good experience in the hotel restaurant Tamo. The waitress was rude about the coupon they kept on giving out at the front desk. But since the tip is included in the check I guess she did not have to be pleasant. Do not get the Bostonian burger: it is a heart attack on a bun: burger with bacon and boston baked beans and fried egg! 
Good thing this hotel is within walking distance to many restaurants: Legal Seafood, Legal Test Kitchen, No Name and Yankee Lobster. My favorite thing about Boston was the relatively cheap lobster.

Stayed for conference located at a nearby hotel. Location is good and T station right outside the back entrance for easy travel. The 24 hour business center was very handy. Did not have time to utilize spa, restaurant, or room services. Room was small and outdated with a desperate need for new furnishings. Normally, I wouldn't mind, but for the price and rating I expected more. With the exception of check out staff, most were unhelpful and some just rude. I received much better service at a chain hotel just down the road.

The hotel was immaculate! Service is impecable! The food absolutely amazing! Loved every minute of our stay however the bed was not very comfortable! Best part tips are included... All tips! Awesome location to the harbor walk and fabulous restaurants!

We paid alittle more for the waterview and it was so worth it. The room was very spacious, nice and clean with an excellent view of The World Trade Centet. The locstion was great. Its a trendy new hot spot with great resturaunts and bar/clubs. We were pleased with the hotel and staff but the walls are very thin so in the early morning u can hear doors shutting and people talking. Overll experience good though.

review_title: Great Location and Very Good Service
review_text: Excellent location by the water front in Boston. Check-in was a little slow due to low staff numbers, but room was just as ordered. Highlights were the fitness center - very large and well equipped; also the brunch buffet was excellent and very good value. Only downsides were noise due to several functions in the hotel with a party on the same floor as our room.

My daughter and I stayed for 9 nights whilst attending an event at the World Centre opposite. Everything was clean and staff (particularly housekeeping) were friendly and most polite! Room service was excellent and bar and restaurant staff courteous and meals reasonably priced. The doormen were ultra helpful and really nothing was too much trouble! We loved the tourist trolley service right from the hotel door and felt safe strolling to the eateries close by the hotel. Loved Boston - wonderful city and hope we can return someday.

this could be the best hotel ever. First of all the location is perfect. The building is a gorgeous old building. Beautiful architecture, and design. You will feel like you are time warped back to old Boston and getting a taste of luxury. 
The rooms are incredible with fireplaces, large flat screens, surround sound, iPod stereo, posh furniture, jetted tub and oversized shower heads. Even the shampoos, soaps etc. we're high class. I especially enjoyed the vanilla lip balm. 
The hotel also provides the guest with rooftop access to enjoy a drink and enjoy the skyline 
The staff is also the best hotel staff I have ever encountered. The valet and bell hop were incredibly helpful. I enjoyed the surpise visit in the early evening by the staff to drop off a plate of gourmet cookies The front desk friendly, and the concierge made the best recommendation for a restaurant ever. It was also pretty nice that the hotel provided a complimentary Lexus and driver for the guests needs. 
If you stay in Boston and you don't stay here then you are crazy.

I have been here with my wife for 2 nights for Thanksgiving and we both love this hotel. Our corner room was very clean and with every thing you need. We dined at the Moo restaurant and the turkey was very good too!!
Overall, it is a great small hotel in a perfect location!

My first experience in the Seaport area was a good one. The Tamo (Restaurant) servers were wonderful especially Kristin and Marion. A little pricey compared to other similar hotels but seemed average for the area. $50 for room service breakfast was hefty for 1 person and a basic order. The tip included thing was refreshing and more places should take note. Wish I had a waterfront view, maybe next time since I'll be there a few more weeks.

review_title: Perfect stay for the Boston marathon
review_text: Great hotel - very nice for a reasonable price (by Boston standards). We went for the Boston marathon and liked that it wasn't in the middle of all the hustle and bustle. Only a 5 minute cab ride from where buses pick u upbin morning and about 10 min cab ride from finish (you could walk!) Hotel had a special all u can eat pasta buffet night before-- very nice touch!

review_title: Seaport Hotel in Boston is Full of Delighters!
review_text:
I've stayed at Seaport Hotel several times and love it. This hotel not only is convenient to the subway but is also within walking distance of great eats. The hotel staff is attentive, rooms are spacious and very clean. Best of all, the rooms are full of extras, such as full size blowdryers, makeup cloths, shampoo & conditioners in the shower and a big umbrella in every room. I can't say enough about this hotel. Will stay here again and again.
Highly recommend Whiskey Priest, Legal Test Kitchen and Barking Crab. All are within walking distance and are great!

review_title: Many Thanks to Hilary the doorman for excellent service-he truly made it feel like home away from home. Maryna Theron
review_text: Excellent service -especially from Hilary! He makes his guests feel special and cared for.
Everything very good. Priced reasonably for Boston and location. And super good restaurant Brassiere Jo's on premises made dining delightful, tasty and an equally good value

review_title: Great service in a cool hotel
review_text: Enjoyed my stay! Got a running map from the front desk and took off exploring. Great location, restaurant bar had a nice atmosphere. Would recommend for sure!
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Worst hotel I've ever stayed at
review_text: Awful service, awful workers. Not a single positive I can say

Great little boutique hotel, especially liked the way the rooms were thought out, with the electronic controls next to the bed, mini flat screens in the bathrooms and overall comfort. Was given a complimentary upgrade overlooking the park, thank you! Bar service could have been a Little frendlier but all in all I would highly recommend this hotel over the more commercial hotel options Boston seems to have to much of.

Good hotel in a great location, right by a T stop and within easy walking distance of Back Bay's wide choice of bars, cafes, restaurants and shops, and will excellent transport links to the rest of the City.
Attractive, well-appointed room. Very comfortable bed. Small bathroom but perfectly functional. 
Great staff: friendly, welcoming and helpful. 
Shame the free wi-fi is only available in the lobby. Surely that's crazy in this day and age?
Ludicrously expensive wine in the hotel bar but that's not uncommon in US hotels and wouldn't put me off returning.

The hotel is well located and the front desk staff are incredibly helpful. However, I would not recommend this hotel to anyone who would like to sleep past 7:30 am. Each morning at around 8, my husband and I were jolted awake by housekeeping literally slamming doors and yelling at each other down hallways. We did not get a single night's sleep. I expected more based on previous Kimptons I have stayed at and the rate I paid. Location and hip decor does not matter if you can't sleep at a hotel.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: From the location to the service to the plush beds and floor to ceiling windows. Don't stay anywhere else in Boston.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: We had an 18th floor room with a beautiful view if the Boston Common & Charles River. Excellent location, very accessible to metro. Good service, comfortable room.
hotel_name: Nine Zero Hotel - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Gjorde ferien min enda mer perfekt.
Veldig god utsikt, gode senger og fantastisk service! Hadde villet bod der sÃ¥ lenge som jeg kunne!

Really nice hotel! Front desk clerk was really great and it just went uphill from there! Clean and modern in the rooms, charming in the rest of the hotel. Only complaint was noisy guests in hallway for several hours. Not really the hotel's fault, just rude people!

review_title: Luxurious Boutique Hotel right in the heart of Boston
review_text:
This is a five star calibre boutique hotel
Rooms are spacious with fireplaces as sitting area
Great restaurant
Walking distance to parks, sights, newbury street.
Very comfortable in all aspects.
Complementary car service to all destinations within 2 miles

We stayed at XV Beacon for 4 nights the end of July. We had a fabulous experience here...loved the room...we had a sitting area and fireplace always love rooms with a little foyer. The staff was friendly warm and accomodating the concierge helped us get wonderful seats to Fenway and the house car was available all week( it does help to give her all your appointments ahead of time)
moo the restaurant was about to close as we arrived late but they accommodated us and we had a great meal as well as a few breakfast. Room service coffee and breakfast was good and fast 
My one complaint and downgrade was the wi fi was so poor. Numerous calls to desk and support still didnt resolve the slowness of wi fi so if doing business. You must be able to plug into ethernet

Stayed here whilst on business in Boston. T (subway) stop is right outside so easy to get around. Prudential Centre shops are directly opposite and a few yards up the street there is a great supermarket and also the stop for Duck Tours. Room was spacious with a great view - I was on the 10th floor. A/C was a bit noisy but I preferred to have the window open so no problem. Staff are friendly, helpful and efficient. Turn down service with a card giving the next day's weather forecast is a nice touch. Restaurant is nice but there are loads nearby so it's good to get some variety! All in all a great experience!

This was our first stay at the Colonnade but our 5th visit to Boston, we'll certainly stay at the hotel again.
The staff were welcoming especially Jimmy, the restaurant and bar were both great.
The roof top pool was wonderful, a lovely place to eat breakfast.
The rooms were clean and spacious and the beds were the comfiest ever.

Had friends&family coming in for a birthday party. I googled a location close to my area that i lived by for everyone could be close. Didnt check the reviews, HUGE MISTAKE!! Customer service@this location suck!! The front desk clerk named Mimi was very rude!! She gave such attitude&even tried arguing wit me over. I even got the eyebrow frown from her. I feel if ur not goin to do your job&treat peoplr with respect go home because there are too many unemployed people that would love to have a job&do a good job at it, so if u want to be treated with disrespect at your expense, go see Mimi@Extendedstay!! She's guaranteed to give u a attitude&frown@ur own expense....
hotel_name: Extended Stay America - Memphis - Mt. Moriah

review_text:
Arrived for an extended 3 week stay and we were very pleased with the front desk and ease of check-in. However, had to change rooms 3 times for various reasons before settling into room 300. Last room, end of hall. 
The major problem we had was housekeeping, which was very very lacking. Management always responded quickly and apologized, but day after day of nothing but clean towels became a common event. The next problem we had was that almost every weekend the hotel is fully booked with kids soccer teams. The lack of control of these hundreds of kids running and screaming thru the halls and stair wells aggravated us for 3 days each week. Plus the location of our room, we had the ice machine directly outside our door. 6 A.M. Saturday and Sunday mornings, parents and coaches began filling their Ice chests for the day. It was very irritating to be woken up that early 2 days a week. 
Joey, the general manager, and all the front staff are amazing and willing to help in any way. However, if I was planning on stating thru a weekend and was not playing soccer.... I would ask if there was a tournament that weekend. It's mayhem... Honestly!

Passing through Memphis, we stayed for one night. Very convenient location. Reservation was easily made, our king suite was well appointed, very clean (including all bed linens), and the bed was comfortable, providing a very good rest. Wonderful breakfast selections (hot and cold healthy selections), and staff was great! Thank you for a very nice experience!

Entering the hotel via a parking lot the appears abandoned set the tone. We arrived at 4:30 pm and our reserved rooms had not been "inspected" yet. The staff was very nice! Unfortunately, the hotel has a musty smell and so do the rooms. This Fairfield Inn just does not meet my expectations of Marriott properties. I won't be returning...

I had such a great experience from the minute I walked in the door. Everyone was so polite, professional, and so friendly!! The doorman James and the manager Jerry were the best!! Anytime I'm back in Boston this is where I'm staying!

review_title: Nothing fancy but works when you need a nice place to sleep for the night.
review_text: Stayed for one night while driving cross country. Check in staff was nice and accomodating. It stated on the website that there is a restaurant onsite, but they did not have one. Sucks cause my husband and I were driving all day and he was starving upon arrival and was really looking forward to getting a bite to eat without driving to a nearby restaurant. We ordered in instead. It's located in a street lined with other hotels/motels. Not the best location. There were hookers working the corner down the street, but not so bad you'd be afraid to walk outside. Overall rooms were clean, nice shampoo soap set, security cameras all over the perimeter making sure our moving truck filled with valuables were safe and sound. Not bad for the price we paid.
This Courtyard is not renovated. It is the old style. Won't be staying there again.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Memphis East/Lenox Corporate Park

review_title: Super convenient, clean and a good value.
review_text: I was in town on business. The hotel was located within 2 blocks of my office building, so it was very convienent. There are some great restaurants nearby, especially Buckley's Steakhouse just a block away. About 15 minutes from downtown memphis, this hotel is a great location. The only downside could be the train tracks across the street. I was on the back side of the building, so I never heard the trains. I wouldn't hesitate to go back. The only disappointment was how small the "fitness center" was.
Thanks for your kind service and you still have the best breakfast around!

The smoke detector had been disconnected.
Refrigerator was broken.
Trash cans were filthy.
Manager refused to honor AARP discount.

Wonderful convenience, we walked everywhere. The people were always quick and more than happy to help. Jimmy was wonderful and you can tell he loves his job. Hilary was just as great and so helpful at the door.

Was in town for two days .it has new owners the rooms have been remodeled had cable,room was clean,hardly no noise all night, internet was kinda slow but on the bright side felt very safe coming and going since they also had an armed gaurd in the parking lot all night. So yes for the price ill definatly be back

review_title: Worst hotel experience in my lifetime!
review_text: The room #320 I was given was horrible. I was going to bed and there was this strong smell of pee. There was a moderate pee stain in the bed. The staff at this hotel were rude and unprofessional. They expected us to be happy and pay full price. I will Never stay at a best western again!! I have filed a complaint with the BBB. And with Bestwestern.com I will continue to write reviews on as many sites as possible. I have pictures and video.
Great choice...super friendly staff, gorgeous pool, great location. A terrific choice!

The front desk, and staff were very helpful and friendly. The suite we rented was disappointing. Very worn with only one tv and no movie rentals available. The atrium is under construction, so we know they are trying, just wish the rooms were in better shape.
Room was awesome very clean and huge king size comfortable bed. A nice and happy staff made me very comfortable. Food at conference was superb! Excellent hotel organization!

First room was smoked in, this is a smoke free hotel. Desk staff apoligized and moved us. Second door had to be slammed to lock. These are minor issues, but room was just ok. I can't complain, but as I stated it was just ok. Nothing special.

review_title: One Of The Best Experiences Of My Life
review_text: I really enjoyed all aspects of my stay,from the front desk too housekeeping

We stayed here for one night which was more than enough. The only reason we stated in this gross place was because I had just driven for 10 hours straight and was completely exhausted. For starters, there was major construction going on in the lobby and only 1 of the 2 elevators were working (they had a sign saying we could use the freight elevator which I'm sure was a huge liability issue). Once we got to our floor, a Hilton honors floor, you could smell cigarette smoke coming out of the restricted area room. It was the first thing you smelled as soon as you got off the elevator. Once in the room, we had ripped towels, missing wall art, a broken luggage stand, the furniture had black dirt marks, and worse of all, some type of blood looking stains on the wall paper in the bathroom! Yuck! I took pictures cause I couldn't believe that this was a Hilton honors floor much less a doubletree! Highly disappointed.

review_title: The whole hotel is a scam for a complete BURGLARY operation!!!
review_text: We checked in on a Sunday and originally got checked into someone elses room or so we thought, then 3 minutes after we checked into the 2nd room, a man opened our door and tried to break in! The hotel refused to call the cops and lied about doing so until about 30 people were in the lobby complaining about a 6ft. black man with a bald head trying to break in to their room. and we had to call the cops ourselves. This place is still getting away with this even though we ate certain that at the least the woman at the front desk and another staff member are involved. Do not stay here!

When we got here our first impression was medicore at best. It is 2 miles from down town and only an 8$ cab ride away. There is security that patrols the parking lot all night which was one of our large concerns. They were nice and accommodating, but would I stay here again? Probably not. Like I said medicore at best.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express - Medical Center Midtown

review_text: I was surprised that I would have so many issues with a Doubletree. The amenities weren't horrible, but they weren't clean...mostly because there was an old non-digital thermostat that kept the room very humid do everything felt a bit damp. I was also surprised to find what appeared to be dried blood on the bathroom walls. When I told the front desk staff, they said they would report it, but it was still there after the cleaning crew came in. The pool was ok, but the garbage dumpster was right outside the gate, so there was a smell of "ripe" garbage so it was hard to stay by the pool long. Overall it just didn't feel clean and was not up to typical Hilton standards.

review_title: Not worth the price of the room.
review_text: This was the worst hotel I have ever stayed in. The room had bugs all over the window. We had 2 nights reserved and the 2nd night our keys didn't work. We needed more towels so w told front desk on the way to our room we saw housekeeping and he didn't want to give us any. They ran out of breakfast and it still had 30 mins left. People was still coming down. Don't waste your money. I only stayed here because of the jacuzzi tub.

review_title: Location! Friendly staff and great service
review_text: The Colonnade is an excellent hotel. Great location near Prudential/Copley, easy access to Back Bay and South End. Friendly staff and good service. Clean, comfortable rooms. Good value for rate.
They have the best cookies I've ever had. Very descent place to stay. We booked through Priceline so we got a good deal. I Like the way the room is set up. Overall good place.

I am writing this review as I am currently staying at this hotel. Look elsewhere if you are looking for a deal. The rooms have a weird smell and seem unclean. The neighborhood is far from desirable. It's in a seemlying unsafe looking neighborhood. Definitely would not recommend this hotel to anyone
hotel_address: {'region': 'TN', 'street-address': '210 South Pauline Street - I-240 at Union Avenue/Madison Avenue, Exit #30', 'postal-code': '38104', 'locality': 'Memphis'}

review_text:
The Colonnade is a well managed hotel with friendly and helpful staff. The rooms are comfortable with all the amenities necessary for the discerning traveller. We were offered umbrellas when it was raining and given assistance with all our travel questions in the city.
We have found our home in Boston.

review_title: No more or less than expected
review_text: I stayed at this Motel 6 with a friend during a music festival. I picked it because it was close enough to Beale St and it was the right price. The room was small and dingy as expected, but I didn't feel like it was dirty. It was easy, quick, and cheap to get a cab to Beale St which was the most important thing for me that weekend. But it's a motel 6, it exceededmy expectations by not having visible grime and stains. I would recommend this place of you're strapped for cash.
