review_text: Nasty rooms bad customer service all amenties were not available they didnt wanna give me a pillow or iron breakfast ended before time

review_title: Never stay there unless you want houskeeping to steal your stuff
review_text: Went to hotel and door to bathroom broken off hinges and bedspread with big burn hole and it stunk. Checked out after 3 hrs there at 11 pm. Realized left wallet in dresser and housekeeping of course hadn't seen it. I hate that place in many ways

I had booked this hotel online & was pleased to see it was a decent-looking place when we drove up. However, I went in & found the staff were completely rude. We went into the hotel room & found it dirty - stains in the pillows & little, black hairs on the bed. The location was scary (we decided not to leave or open the door after sundown). In the morning we had to remind the staff we needed a shuttle (which had been scheduled the night before) & wait 15 mins. for someone to take us to the airport (good thing we werent running on a tight schedule!). Breakfast is cereal & bagels (no cream cheese). It's cheap & close to the airport, but I wouldn't stay here again & would NEVER stay here alone.

review_title: Ok place to stay but it might be time for a freshen up.
review_text:
This is my first stay at this hotel after a recommendation from a co-worker. 
Unlike other reviews, i found the staff to be attentive and overall the service at the hotel was good. I did not get an opportunity to experience the restaurant at the hotel, as there are many great restaurants to chose from in the Memphis area.
The room was clean, the bed comfortable but the decor seems as if it is a little outdated as compared to other hotels I've stayed in recently.
We had a nice stay here. It was quiet, the bed was so comfortable, staff seemed friendly.

review_title: Nice and not too out of the way
review_text: I went to Memphis for my 30th birthday. It was always a dream of mine to see Graceland. In looking for a nice and reasonably priced hotel we stumbled upon this Hilton. It is a littlebout side of town, but being with my family that was great! There is a lot going on downtown and not really were you want to be after dark with the kids, besides a quick car ride will get you anywhere you want to go. When arriving at the hotel were blown away as to just how nice the hotel was, it is beautiful! Heck in was speedy, but a little scary when they said we were on the 18th floor, seeing as how I am scared of heights! We got to the room and as scary as it was it was beautiful as the lobby and the full wall window was amazing! We as a family did enjoy the pool area as well. I would definitely suggest to any and all looking to visit Memphis to stay here!
Nice hotel. Perfect location to I 40. No upcharge or hassles with my dog. Thank you Drury Inn.

Unique hotel. The rooms are not located off a straight hallways but circle around. I liked this hotel except for the incredibly thin walls and noisiness. While in your room, you can hear every single sound outside. Seriously. I don't know if the circular pattern affects this or increases the noise but it's bad. Someone beside me ordered room service and I opened my door BC I could have sworn they were knocking on my door! 
All in all, if you wear earplugs at night, good hotel.

The hotel was clean, comfortable and a decent value for the price. The only negatives I could find were we stayed on a Saturday night the free food & drink time was really crowded and there were kids running up and down the halls aloof outside our room Drury could offer a parenting class to help parents keep there kids under control it might have made things better...just kidding Drury some kids and their parents are just obnoxious!!

review_title: Good if you like to hear the neighbors party all night, bad if you want sleep.
review_text: I should be sleeping, but I'm writing this review. Noise travels too easily in this hotel. Avoid if you need actual rest.

review_title: Stay away from the Colonade at all cost; Boston too if possible.
review_text:
1. The hotel has no free wireless for guests, even Motel 6 has that in 2011.
2. The "rooftop pool" is completely off limits due to construction, one can't even relax on the roof.
3. The gym is also inaccessible after 8pm.
4. Do not expect a polite desk clerk or staff, they are more apt to treat you like a criminal stealing a room after you've paid. They even card you when you come back if you go for a walk!
The ONLY positive is that the room is fairly clean, but at these prices I expect more than a room with a made bed and clean floor.
Save your time and money to go elsewhere, this town is a smelly dump and The Colonade isn'Å£ an improvement on the town.
This Holiday Inn was purchased by new owners and closed down in mid-July. The Holiday Inn signs have been removed. News reports indicate that new owner plans to renovate the property and rebrand it.
first time at this place. Loved the room and very comforable bed. The only draw back might have been the very long walk from the parking area.

This hotel is in a great location. Near plenty of resturants and shopping. Also had a nice bar with good food on site. If I had a complaint, it would be that no breakfast is included if not a priority member. For less per night this is included at other hotels. Otherwise it was fine, would recommend.

review_title: Excellent hotel in a perfect location
review_text: Great hotel...big rooms with big comfy bed! Service was excellent and location was perfect

We recently spent two nights at the Scottish Inn, a little rough, but doable. We were hot and tired and just needed rest. After we checked in and given towels and wash cloths through a 2" opening at the Front Desk window, I started to worry! Hmm, but went to the second floor to find all the room doors propped open and being cleaned. The room wasn't horrible, but wasn't standard either. Advertised Frig and Micro in all rooms. Not! Had a small frig that was frozen up and wouldn't hold a six pack of soda for the ice. No micro in the room. The dead bolt was broken as-well-as the slap lock and you had to make sure you pulled on the door to ensure that it latched. But the people were friendly and no bugs! So doable!

The hotel seemed to be what you would expect when paying 40 bucks a night... UNTIL our second night, when someone (who obviously had a key) tried to come in our room! The latch at the top of the door kept him from coming in, thank God, but did not deter him from standing there peering through the 2 inch gap the latch allowed him, even after I screamed "HEY!" I yelled at him again, to get out, and finally he shut the door without a word. When I called the front desk, the lady tried convincing me it was our imagination, then asked if I seen what he looked like. I called back 2 min later to ask who had a key to our room... her story changed to one about her hearing a couple quarreling (apparently with her super sonic hearing, since we were on the 5th floor) and she sent housekeeping to check on it. I angrily went down to the lobby to demand a factual explanation, and found that the lady had left to take housekeeping home... hmmm! I waited for her return, she stuck to the couple quarreling story and pretended not to understand english. I called customer service for super 8 upon returning home, they listened and told me I would hear from the manager. I received a very generic letter from him that basically said sorry for the inconvenience, we look forward to serving your hotel needs in the future. WHAAAT??? PLEASE heed this warning... we were two women traveling alone, and we would have left on the spot had we not had a .38 in the room with us, which laid right next to me on the bedside table the rest of the night. And, a sidenote: a man was complaining in the lobby the following morning about people trying to come in his room even with the do not disturb sign on his door. Unreal!

The hotel room we has was clean and the bulding is gated but the staff is very rude and will nickel and dime you for everything. First I called and asked if there were any rooms available and was told there where and it was $65 a night. When we arrived I asked the night worker for a two bed room and he said they were sold out. When I told him we would just keep looking he magically found a double bed room. Then I was told the room was $85, even though I had just called. They charge $5 to use thier computer in the lobby and $25 per pet. The fruit for the breakfast was old and there are signs everywhere stating you can not take the food out of the lobby. The beds are very hard and the pool is small. There are plenty of hotels in the area so I would skip this one.
We were on the last leg of our trip and very tired. We were pleased with the comfortable beds.
Ok location but convenient for flying in and then easy to get where you need to go. New lunch buffet has good good and they told me bar opens soon.

I had a room here for ABC, Anime Blues Con. The room was clean and pretty and didn't smell odd. The tv was a flat screen high def with HBO and normal tv channels. They also had a fridge in our room, which is normally extra but they didn't charge us.
Now for the bad parts. The bathroom had mold in the ceiling, so be careful those with allergies. None of the ice machines were working, and not because everyone was hogging the ice. They just didn't function. This hotel has four elevators, which move quickly and have a window so you can look outside. But the second day I was there, two of said elevators stopped working. You had to wait and wait and wait for an elevator, and you never knew if it would be full or the idiots would let the doors shut (that happened not once but TWICE to us).
All in all, location was great and the hotel was pleasurable. But ask in advance if anything big is happening, such as a convention with 600+ all trying to check out of their rooms on a Sunday.

This is one of my favorite Hilton hotels in the US. Great east side location and in the center of the business hub. The lobby is very unique and you just want to sink in the big leather chairs and relax. I had an egg white omlette that was excellent. Good value for the money. You can only make a great decision staying here.

review_title: Perfect location for early a.m. Flight
review_text: I was on a marathon business trip and needed one night in Memphis. I grabbed a fresh sandwich and snacks in the lobby? Settled in for a nice quiet evening. Josh was great at the front desk.

review_title: Average Courtyard, close to airport and Medtronic
review_text:
Location: I was traveling for Medtronic an able to walk next door for my meetings, literally next door. The airport is about 5-10 minutes away, but the rental car location is even closer. No restaurants nearby - just a Subway.
The hotel is in a business park, nothing glamorous at all. 
Room: My room had a parking lot view and was a little smaller than most Courtyards. Very nice bed and TV. Mini fridge, coffee, and full plug-in hairdryer (nice). There was a couch and table and a work desk. I got a strong WI-fi signal and that was free. I was in 159 and got the Medtronic rate - I mention this because I actually had to prove that I was there for them. It saved me $45 per night. 
Bathroom: strong shower, separate room from sink. Again a little small it fine for one person. 
All very clean. 
Gym: let's call it a room with a treadmill, elliptical, a bench and tweets of dumbbells (15 & 20).
Whirpool is inside next to gym - windows to gym & business area. 
Pool is outside and pretty nice - closes at 11pm. 
Business area had about 5 computers and was open in the lobby. 
Breakfast: good buffet, several hot and cold voices, eggs, sausage and gravy, waffles, cereal, fruit, etc. Service there was awesome - they GET business travel and were super quick. 
I'd recommend for Medtronic, may look elsewhere for airport, definitely go downtown otherwise if I return.

Basic hotel, a bit dated. No coffee or tea other than 5am -12pm in lobby. Breakfast start 7am so not good for early flights. Shuttle pickup at rental cars is good, as is to airport. Small, dated bathroom but all is adequate. If you don't have a car, forget redtaurants as there is nothing commercial close.

review_title: It was terrible at this locatioo!
review_text: Words cannot describe how awful the experience. We complained to the manager-nothing. i called corporate-nothing. he you like filthy rooms and no service, stay here:-(
hotel_name: Homestead Studio Suites - Memphis - Poplar Avenue

review_title: This place sucked and it's not in Memphis!
review_text: I always book using priceline and usually don't have problems ensuring double beds if they are available. However if you want double beds here be prepared for a $12 upcharge. Additionally they put u on the 3rd floor which is all smoking and smells horrible. They have no ice machine in the hotel. No pool. The beds are horribly uncomfortable. To top it off our a/c didn't work and it was boiling. They do have a full kitchen in each room but the fridge was not pre cooled and the glasses were dirty. Hotel staff very rude. Lastly the hotel is not in Memphis. They made the driveway on the Memphis side of the city limits so it's 35-45 min drive to any of the Memphis cites.
hotel_name: Homestead Studio Suites - Memphis - Poplar Avenue

review_text: Me and my husband was ask if we would stay here since the extended stay didn't have any available rooms we agreed to. This hotel was not clean at all, our room was dirty , however the staff were very friendly they came and cleaned up room for us but want be back.
hotel_name: Homestead Studio Suites - Memphis - Poplar Avenue

review_text: Weren't sure what to expect and thought it could be poor but pleased to say it was pretty good for a city centre hotel with friendly easy going staff. Beds were very comfortable. Breakfast a bit plain but it is a budget hotel

review_title: Old but clean, friendly staff and 4 blocks from Beale St.
review_text: Ok after reading the reviews I was a little skeptical however this really fit my budget so I booked it. I was picking my husband up there because he works on the Mississippi. He had been gone for 45 days I wanted it to be a nice night. Upon check in while talking to the clerk about why I was there she printed me directions to pick up my husband without me asking. Got to the room which is better than most Econo Lodges it wasn't finished being made up. The housekeeper apologized brought me a just laundered spread and asked if needed anything. So if you're expecting The Peabody you should probably book there! Keep up the good work Econo Lodge we will be visiting pretty frequently! Thank Again!

My friend and I stayed two nights and were pleased with the overall experience. It is an inexpensive hotel, and the room reflected that. It was small, but tidy. The beds were very comfortable. The staff was friendly. The hotel was within walking distance of lots of great things downtown and close to the interstate too. Keep your expectations in check and you won't be disappointed! I will certainly stay here again.

Stayed here for more than a month. Great location and almost incredibly quite for being so close to several very busy roads. Tha rooms are sizable with a recliner and small kitchenette included. They are somewhat Spartan but the A/C works well and the employes are helpful. Seemingly very safe neiborhood which is a big plus in Memphis.
Highly recommended for those planning on an extended stay. I paid 30/night and that was at least 10 dollars less than any other hotel I found in Memphis.
hotel_name: Extended Stay America - Memphis - Poplar Avenue

review_text: beautifully designed, friendly staff, great location and all the special touches

Just left the place now, stayed 5 minutes and left in fear of both my safety and health. The place should be shut down. From a person who regularly stays in hostels in both Europe and the USA, this is by far the worst place I have ever been. All the bed linen was filthy with pubic hairs and stains of various natures (let's say bodily fluid) covering it. The floor was disgusting, the bathroom was unclean with faeces stains. The room was suposedly non smoking but stank of cigarettes and the door to the adjoining room had only what I can describe as a bathroom lock on it separating me from whoever was next door. I can only imagine that this hellhole is used for pay by the hour clientele, no sane person would stay here. I would not recommend it to my worst enemy. We have booked into the Marriott suites, beautiful! : )

Everything about our 4 night stay here was perfect. We came with our two teenage sons and per the reservationist suggestion booked a corner studio. It provided us with ample room, great amenities, and super comfy beds. The best thing about staying here besides the hip factor, was the exceptional concierge service! All of the staff helped to make it a special trip!

Stayed here for 3 nights, on arrival we were greeted in a friendly manner and told where our room was, the rooms are detached from the main building, more like a motel, when we got to the suite it smelt musty and horrible and the toilets didn't flush, we reported both, toilets was fixed the next day and we were offered air freshener for the smell, at first glance decor looks ok, but after wandering through the corridors several times you do notice it's out dated appearance and decor faults like coving coming away, dirty walls. Our suite was furthest away from the main building so a bit of a trek through corridors to get breakfast.
Breakfast was good and a lovely lady named Betty was fantastic, very friendly and helpful, really cheered my day up. Not what we expected from a Homewood Suite or the Hilton chain, very disappointing, we are travelling across USA and stayed in Hilton chain hotel and suites and this is the most disappointing by far, would not stay here again.

review_title: Don't be scared to stay here, pleanty safe!
review_text:
This passed my test. I have no idea what 'crack house' the people on here were talking about. But I will say in or outside of any city, you have to take precautions and not leave temptations laying around your car that make people want to smash and grab. The whole parking lot had a huge iron gate around it. The hotel was in the medical area. There was a Holiday Inn Express just behind the hotel, which again tells me the area wasn't so bad. If you've never been to a big city I can relate to hesitations, just be aware of your self and surroundings. We even jumped in the trolly a few blocks down and took it to Beal. 
The room hotel and room passed my personal test of white linens. Everything was clean. The staff was real nice and helped us with our hesitations by recomending a cab back if after 11pm. I'm sure if you walk around the hotel with a magnifying glass you'll find something you don't like anywhere you go. Nothing seemed gross, sketchy or dingy. I wish there was some way i could ebb fears from here. I was seriously worried about it after the reviews i read and had already paid on priceline. My husband was REAL worried too. But this hotel is just fine! The free breakfast was decent. I WOULD recommend staying here.
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Gen X Inn

review_text: We spent two nights in this great boutique hotel. The location was perfect we walked to everything. The aquarium, eating, shopping, was aii with in walking distance. The only thing we needed a car for was Fenway and the hotel had a curtusy car at our disposal. We eat both night in moo and were more than satisfied with our meal. We had no complaints at all about this little gem. Our bed was very comfortable our room was beautiful and the service was very accommodating and friendly. Our driver that took us to Fenway Park was very helpful with shopping and eating tips. This hotel made our trip to Boston very pleasant.

review_title: UNSAFE, UNSANITARY, UNPROFESSIONAL! Do NOT STAY!!!
review_text: Written confirmation was not provided after making reservation. Requested accommodations were not available at check-in. Lobby sofa was stained & filthy. Parking lot did not look secure & family member's car was broken into overnight, along with several other guests. Staff did NOT notify guests or police. Rooms were unsanitary (large stains on carpet & black footprints in tub). Manager & hotel staff were unsympathetic & REFUSED to allow us to cancel reservation without penalty. Locals reported that hotel is adjacent to "crack house" & frequented by sex workers. Worst hotel experience EVER!!!
hotel_name: BEST WESTERN PLUS Gen X Inn

review_text: This hotel has many of the amenities that we anticipate have grown to appreciate when staying at a Hampton Inn. I would not recommend this hotel for a long term stay. The gym only has a treadmill and an eliptical. The cable on the TV is fuzzy and there are not that many channels. The location is convenient to the highway, but very close to Beale street or any great restaurants. If you are staying short term this place is great for a nights rest. The lobby is very nice.
Located over the road from Peabody hotel with it's famous ducks. Five minute walk from Beale street and the blues clubs.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_text: I always passed the Boston harbour hotel and wanted to stay there. After over 10 years of trips to Boston my wife finally took me for my anniversary. It was everything I expected it to be. This hotel does all the little things to make you feel like royalty. Rooms are antique looking. Dinner Mints by the hotel lobby elevators at night fresh apples during the day. Turn down service at night. I swam laps in a clean lap pool and sipped cucumber water in the steam room in the morning (get to the pool early in the morning if you want peace and quiet) note the kids hours very important. Staff was overly attentive to detail and friendly. Everyone from the maids to concierge to doorman always had a smile and greeted you with a friendly "hello". 100% of the time. It is the pricier of the hotels in Boston but it is well worth it. I will be back there for a return stay. So impressed and so glad to have expereinced this hotel.

The location is what this hotel is all about. It is two blocks from Beale St. So you can't go wrong. The hotel itself is a little tired. The parking, while convenient, is incredibly tight. We watched an SUV take 15 minutes to get out of a space. The elevator is slow, and a little scary. The Internet was frustrating. It took many, many tries to connect, even with the help on the call up tech support. But, despite those negatives, the room was comfortable, as were the beds. The staff was very friendly and helpful. If you don't set your expectations for a new hotel, and just think about the great location, this hotel is well worth it.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_text: We stayed here for the Boston wine EXPO. It was nicely located across the street.

review_title: An amazing start to our honeymoon!
review_text: From the moment we arrived at the BHH we knew we had chosen somewhere very special. The approach to the hotel was beautiful with the trees all decorated with lights. When we arrived, it was very late and yet everyone was still very friendly and accommodating. The views from our room are incredible, out over the harbor. We have ordered room service on a few occasions and the food has been lovely. Must say that we have felt like royalty here, it has been amazing. We are now moving onto Washington DC and hoping we get even half the service and luxury that we have experienced here. Thank you BHH for making our honeymoon extra-special.

review_title: Superior experience...location, service and amenities exceeded our high expectations.
review_text: My husband and I stayed here for our 14th wedding anniversary. We felt like royalty from our interaction with the valet, doorman, front desk and concierge. Our room was classy and spacious and the harbor view was an added bonus. We researched several other hotels and even checked them out during our walks on the harborwalk and we are confident we chose correctly.

review_title: Top notch, great location, attentive staff, amazing views
review_text: An abundance of staff was visible and eager to make our stay pleasant from when we valeted the car until we left. Unbelievable views especially in the corner rooms where the harbor and the city was visible. Near fine dining, faneuil hall, and the children's museum. Also great lap/leisure pool and spa. Would definitely stay again.
Service is the top pointbhere, everyone wants to help and is very pleasant. Clean hotel, flat screen tvs, decent size rooms, comfy beds/pillows. A sure thing...

review_title: Ideally situated for the Memphis Action!
review_text:
My wife and I stayed for three nights over the Labor Day weekend and certainly we picked the right hotel.
Maybe not the most modern of the Holiday Inn hotels and maybe a bit structurally worn in places - (the service lift to the car park was slow but we were warned in advance) but the best was being done to keep it up to standard. 
The room was very comfortable and had a good view of the Peabody and down 2nd Street towards Beale Street although, being in a city centre a trifle noisy. However that was catered for by the provision of efficient earplugs! 
Very very convenient for visiting sights such as Beale Street and the National Civil Rights Museum and others in the city centre.
Will certainly stay again if I am able to revisit Memphis.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_title: This place is crummy and dirty And expensive!
review_text:
Omg do the actually paint or clean or maintain the place??
The rooms are musty , dusty and dirty (filthy in fact...yuck!) 
They are charging a rate for a 3 or 4 star but this is like a two-nit flea bag hotel !
I have stayed t many hotels around the world and this one is terrible, disgusting in fact .. I am suprised that holiday inn allow this hotel to carry it's name ! 
We checked out early and rather stayed at the Peabody .. Worth the extra money ... Yes 70$ more buy sooo worth it! 
We also needed to stay an extra night , too much time spent at graceland lol , and the scottish inn didn't look bad .. Well we checked the room first and ita great ! 
Massive room , bigger thatn Peabody (by the way holiday inn was pokey) 
The Scottish in is ony 85$ a night , all in plus breakfast and free parking and it's only 5 minutes walk from graceland ! 
Stay anywhere rather than the holiday inn .. Omg it's gross!
And Denny's down the road is much the same YUCK !! is it the sme owners ...bleh ! 
Open some windows , kill the dated decor and get a life please! Make it Clean clean clean !
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_text: Front desk acknowleged me as a returning guest. Housekeeper left me a bookmarker for my library book. Morning expresso good as usual.

Stayed at the heartbreak hotel for 2 nights as part of a birthday celebration. From the moment we were collected from the airport by the hotels free shuttle the welcome we were given was excellent. Everyone we encountered was so friendly and we certainly did not experience any poor service at all. The king suite rooms we had were great, clean and spacious and had everything we needed. We would have no hesitation in returning and indeed I am sure we will.

review_title: Best welcome we have received, nice rooms, excellent shuttle service, poor breakfast.
review_text:
The staff on check in are about the most friendly we have ever encountered, a definite asset to the hotel.
The location isn't great but certainly not a problem as there is a fantastic shuttle service that you can call and the driver will collect you from anywhere central. 
The rooms are clean and basic, it's cheap so good for what you pay.
We had breakfast here once and it was really poor choice so never ate here again.

review_title: Old elegant Boston with phenomenal views.
review_text: You must have a view to the harbor, the hotel is great in almost everything but it's views are just amazing, they transport you to what Boston most have been hundreds of years ago Of course the old elegance of the hotel helps with that feeling quite a lot. The bedroom has a good size and although the bathroom could be bigger it is very elegant with charming amenities. They have an outside terrace which is not exclusive to hotel guests which is fine but you have to make a line along with everybody else. They should have a few tables just for guests. Having said that the inside rich mahogany bar is great and it goes perfect with the hotel.

review_title: Excellent hotel, but no twin rooms made it uncomfortable for person sleeping on pull out bed.
review_text: Had a fabulous stay at heartbreak, me and a friend stayed but did not wish to share the bed, so I had to sleep on the pull out bed which was not great, couldnt sleep due to uncomforable bed! would of been perfect had I had a bed. The staff, location an everything about this hotel was fabulous. Elvis fans will love it.

review_title: Great summer at the Crowne Plaza!
review_text: I spent three months here this summer on an extended business trip. I have never experienced such a welcoming and accommodating hotel staff. They are curteous, knowledgeable about the area, and motivated to help. Everyone from the general manager to the cleaning staff was an absolute professional. Our event manager, Rhonda, was amazing. Super helpful and enthusiastic. I would come back again just to visit them. The rooms were clean and furnished with contemporary furniture. The gym on the 11th floor was small but had all the essentials. The location is perfect and the shuttle will take you anywhere and pick you back up too. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this hotel to anyone!

review_title: Customer Service was friendly and on key!
review_text: My stay in the Crowne Plaza was 3 months. Anything I needed was handled on the spot. The cleaning staff was AWESOME! They were more than willing to work around my schedule to make my stay more comfortable. The restaurant staff was friendly and always had a smile. The entire hotel staff had no problem doing whatever they could to make my stay perfect! A++

Stayed overnight on trip out west. Nice hotel but very old inside since the building is old. The rooms are smaller than what you would find in newer hotels but who cares you are in Memphis to see the sites and eat great food. The bathroom was small but again not a big deal. The hotel must have caught onto the amount 
of noise from Union Street below 
because there are ear plugs in 
every room I thought that was kind of neat.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_text: Having never stayed at a Crowne Plaza Hotel before I had high hopes for my visit. Needless to say it was less than what would be expected at a Motel 6. We arrived to the hotel rather late and we were completely exhausted. It was the first stop of three days of driving. The "valet attendant" didn't seem to know wich way was up and was very frantic. We went to the counter to check in and found out to park the car ON TOP of their garage (uncovered I might add) was an additional $15. Valet parking would be $18. On top of the additional fees we were going to have a room with two full beds vs. a king or queen bed. We let that go and headed to our room. The room was dark and dingy. It felt dirty and didn't smell great. There was no trash can to be found and the tv didn't work oh but don't worry, our entertainment for the evening was the dripping/leaking ac unit in the window. We did bring our laptop and had some business to take care of. The internet connection was aweful. We ended up giving up and trying to get some rest. Once we got all snuggled up in bed I felt something crawling on my back, arms, stomach, and legs. Of course I didn't stay in the bed. I sat in the chair by desk while my babe slept soundly in his bed. Finally morning! I know this because I watched the sun come up. We can get out of this hell hole! I go to get in the shower and the curtain covers maybe a foot and a half of the actual shower. I can only assume a previous guest used the curved shower curtain rod as a chin up bar. What the hell is the place? I asked my other half if he would go grab some breakfast and bring it up so we could get out of here. He came back in a hurry and informed me it was another additional charge. We packed up and left. Never to return!!!

review_title: Great location, friendly staff, tiny bathrooms
review_text: You can easily walk to Beale street. Excellent restaurants are near by. The staff is friendly amd knowledgeable. The only problem, the bathrooms are for munchins.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_title: The For Seasons is top of the line.
review_text: Overall, the nicest hotel I ever stayed at. When I arrived it was raining however the hotel was warm and cozy inside. All the employees were friendly and accomodating. I used the spa one day and the female attendant eas most helpful. When I asked for a robe she was right there to provide me with one and also a pair of slippers. I have no complaints with your hotel. Thank you.

review_title: Great location Great hotel just the wrong weekend!
review_text: We arrived on a Saturday (7-23) and experienced the same group of college kids!! We were up most of the night with a party outside our room. Security was there met of the night as well. If they have a policy against groups of that nature they surely didn't enforce it! With 2 small children on a road trip across the south a good night's sleep is important. We found everything else to be PERFECT!! I would recommend and stay again....well, minus the Sigma Chi fraternity and their girlfriends!
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_title: Bristol lounge .. Doomed.. What happened towhat used to the upscale food and service
review_text:
I am writing this review out of my concern about a place used to be the epitome of class and perfection. I was so disappointed with my recent experience and kind of embarrassed. I had out of town friends visiting and after a long shopping day, I wanted to treat them for a nice dinner and drink at what I expected ( and used to at Tahoe place) to be an upscale quality food and service.
The bad signs started when the waiter brought the bottle of water and glasses. Tried to take a sip and was so upset by the fishy small of the glasses. We usher to a waiter and asked to change the glasses, another waiter who noticed our reaction came to our table and he had a running nose ( must be cold) and looked very sloppy and replaced the glasses. The food came and as a big disappointment, the soup, then the salad, the press presentation and taste were more of a cheap fast food or chain restaurant quality wise. Even the tea and the way it was served was so unlike what I am used to get at this same Four Seasons.
All in all, very disappointing and sad to see how bas this place has gone..
I hope the management takes notes and try to salvage this place before it is too late,.....

This hotel is in a fantastic location but has few other good features. Out of four lifts only one was operating which meant exceedingly long waits. We checked in at the same time as what seemed like hundreds of teenage college students on some kind of fraternity weekend, many were on our floor and they proceeded to spend two days and nights running around hollering at the top of their voices and slamming doors. The rooms are adequate but the aircon system is weak and far too noisy. This meant two nights with very little sleep for us which was a real downer in an otherwise great visit to Memphis.
The breakfast at the restaurant in the lobby is cheap and good and the waiters are nice. 
Wouldn't recommend, Im sure there are better value hotels in Memphis in this price range.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_title: Excellent city hotel - one of the best!
review_text: I was amazed by the charming room. It was more like a suite- light and bright with a superb decor. Very well thought out with comfort in mind. In room service was prompt and second to none!

review_title: Everything about our stay was excellent!
review_text: After a horrendous experience at the Scottish Inn down the road we moved to the Elvis Presley Hearttbreak Hotel and were extremely satsfied with our stay there. First of all the security was very professional and courteous with a check station at the main entrance. The hotel staff was also very professional as well as friendly and helpful. The room was spacious, very clean, and quiet. The continental breakfast was one of the best we've had and once again the staff was friendly and kept all areas well-stocked and extremely clean! There was plenty of seating at clean tables. Following breakfast it was just a short walk to the Graceland ticket pavillion. We would highly, highly recommend this hotel!
The Boston Four Seasons is one of my favorite hotels. The location is perfect, the staff is very pleasant, and the rooms are terrific. I highly recommend this hotel.

Nice modern hotel. Respectable size rooms which were clean, and the bed comfortable. Short walking distant to Beale street. Staff were helpful and give you a warm cookie when you check in. Woken up one morning about 4am by drunk noisy guests in the hotel (not the hotels fault) but maybe some better sound proofing with fix that problem. Overall enjoyable stay and no real complaints.
What a fantastic hotel! Service was spectacular, hotel was beautiful, location was perfect. Can't wait to go back!

review_title: Perhaps the best hotel in the North East and my favorite in the US.
review_text: Wonderful hotel, this is my fourth stay and the hotel remains impeccable from the moment you arrive in the driveway to the moment you leave. I have been both with and without my family. Four business it is perfect with all the comforts. For the family it's amazing. They have a little red wagon behind the front desk full of stuffed animals so each toddler chooses their own. This os accompanied by little four seasons robes and matching slippers waiting in the room. The bedrooms are very large and comfortable with the typical Four Seasons elegance, great flat screen tv with plenty of channels. I recommend the view to the park although I didn't have one from my room, but it is stil pleasant and quiet. The bathrooms are good size and they have nice amenities and great towels They have a great gym and pool. The common rooms are very elegant yet comfortable. The service is superb, from the front desk to the housekeeping staff.

Overall we enjoyed our stay here. We thought the rooms were going to a bit more Elvis themed (there were 2 pictures in our room) after viewing the hotel online but I guess there are special theme rooms available for an additional cost. It was very clean, the heart shaped pool was great, the complimentary breakfast was nice and the location is great (just a short walk to Graceland and attractions) but my favorite part was the lobby that had a vintage tv showing back to back Elvis movies...

review_title: The Heartbreak Hotel broke my heart
review_text:
We planned our Tennessee road trip around availability at the Heartbreak, and wished we hadn't bothered. With the exception of the themed suites, which are fabulous, the rest of the hotel is more like student halls.
We were booked in for 4 nights. Judging by other reviews, we must have had the worst room in the place - the sofabed in the living area had a huge stain across both sofa cushions and smelt bad, so our daughter ended up with us, and the double bed felt damp, so we ended up sleeping on top of the covers. The towels in the bathroom were threadbare.
We asked reception if we could move rooms, and were even prepared to pay for an upgrade, but reception refused and were disinterested in our complaints. In fact, when we told them we could not use the sofabed because of the stain and the smell, housekeeping took away all the bedding, but didn't offer any alternative - after this, we just left and moved to the lovely Peabody in town, where the Peabody staff told us we were the 5th couple that day to transfer from the Heartbreak.
On the plus side, the location for Graceland is unbeatable, and the Elvis movies in the rooms and dining room are great but unless you book a suite, save your money and stay somewhere else.
The Presley foundation should hang their heads in shame.

review_title: Best location but too kid friendly.
review_text: Great location for sightseeing. Best concierge service we have ever experienced. Ask for Jason. His restaurant and sightseeing arrangements were excellent. The one downside is that the Four Seasons caters to families, so service for adults has suffered. Expect kids running all over at breakfast.

Graceland is directly across the street... This is the only benefit. Other than that stay downtown. There are tons of nice hotels that are more affordable and clean than this. We travel a lot and stay a lot of places but I was a little freaked out about even walking around without shoes on in our room.

review_title: Most comfy hotel I've had in Boston
review_text: Quiet, relaxing and conveniently located. Would be nice to have breakfast before 7am but the coffee and bagel counter by the lobby will do

review_title: Stunning location, pool is a fantasic bonus, would return.
review_text: This is a beautiful hotel in a wonderful location. The fitness centre & swimming pool are great. The rooms are really nice but not amazing & the bathroom very ordinary. Room service is just ridiculously expensive. The staff & concierge were charming & helpful.
Nice hotel.great location good service. Fair price
Perfect location and service that exceeds all expectations. We will never stay anywhere else when visiting Boston. Thank you for making our anniversary the perfect weekend.

This hotel is clean, but woefully in need of a massive update. Everything except the bathroom sink and that curved shower rod (love it) needs to be redone. The chair I had in my room had a huge stain on it. The walls in the bathroom have mold ( no fan). The paint job in the bathroom was messy. The carpet needs to be shampooed. It's tolerable, but I couldn't have done more than one night. You are overpaying if you pay more than 100 dollars. As always the cookies are excellent! Best part of the stay...

review_title: Un buen hotel para visitar Boston
review_text:
Estuvimos cuatro dias en Boston en Seaport Hotel, es muy recomendable no le falta nada,
Habitaciones amplias y limpias con buena ropa, una cafetera y heladerita.
Tiene todos los servicios de un hotel 5 estrellas.
Si bien no esta cerca del centro a 50 mts hay una parada de subway que lo conecta perfectamente con todo.
Sin dudas volverÃ­a a alojarme en este hotel.

My partner and I stayed here for 3 days at the beginning of July. This is a hotel where the staff are so helpful its almost too much. The decor is grandiose but then it is a boutique hotel. We never got round to eating in the hotel but the on-site pub is really good. Some fabulous touches from the receptionists, so if you want plenty of attentive service, the Lenox is for you. Try and meet Johnny, the world war 2 veteran octagenarian still working in the hotel. Boston is a fabulous place.

The location of this quality hotel is very central to main points of interest, shopping, subways and eateries. The environment is very conducive and safe, within 3 mins walk to the Prudential center which house several shops and the famous Boston Legal Seafoods and Cheesecake factory. Our family with teens got a good price with advance booking and we stayed in the corner suite for about a week. It was very spacious, clean and comfortable. The lobby serves complementary and good coffee/tea in the mornings and juice in the evenings. We saw other neighborhoods but nothing beats Lenox with its great price, quality stay and great locale. Highly recommended.
Usual marriot quality just don't take breakfast there. Instead the blue plate cafe is half the price and twice the quality it's also two stops away on the trolly $1

Lenox hotel was a great place to stay. We enjoyed our room, but would've liked a bigger tub. Great location in trendy back bay, with easy access to the T at Copley station. Would definitely stay again.

review_title: Perfect combination of professionalism and friendliness
review_text: The Lenox is always my first choice when in Boston. Excellent staff and unbeatable location.
El desayuno buffet esta include, yo me quede en el Peabody y desayune ahi por $10 muy bueno Es pequeno pero tiene de todo, frutas, cereal, Danish, yogur, bagel, y jugo.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Memphis - Downtown (Beale Street)

review_title: Perfect for our quick Boston trip!
review_text: My husband and I recently stayed at the Lenox Hotel for a quick trip to the city. Our stay could not have been better. The location of this beautiful historic hotel is perfect-- within walking distance of many shops, restaurants, pubs, attractions, and fine dining (even in heels!) and also very close to the T. The hotel itself was beautifully decorated, keeping true to the historical elements while also adding subtle luxurious amenities and details. The staff was helpful and attentive (although we did miss turndown service). We will definitely stay at the Lennox again and in fact we can't wait!

Stayed here for nearly a week, I and many of my friends were bit by flees. If you stay and find that this happens to you please catch the bug for proof the staff will argue you down about not having an infestation of flees. Rude staff old building and not in a charming way start elsewhere else
From the second we arrived we were treated like family! Beautiful hotel. Wonderful staff. Great location. 12 out of 10 !!

review_title: Beautiful Boston in The Lenox Hotel. A wonderful friendly location for a get away.
review_text: We went on our annual Anniversary trip to the USA to Boston MA this year, and boy did we need (and have) a nice get away! Arriving in Boston on a beautiful sunset sky we were taken to our hotel for the week - The Lenox. First impressions of the lobby are of old charm and opulence. We were shown to our room and settled in, I must admit our room was a tad snug, we decided to ask if we could move and were told that if we tried the next day they may be able to help. The next day we went and asked again and were moved to a much nicer, larger room with a view over the city... We were very pleased! The room was lovely, a huge bed and flat screen TV, free WIFI and a lovely bathroom. The staff at The Lenox were helpful and friendly, happy to see us and never rude. The Lenox is situated in a good location as the city is very walkable, all in all we had a fantastic holiday and will return in the future.

review_title: Can't imagine staying anywhere else when we return to Boston!
review_text: What makes this place special are the people. You could stay at one of the larger hotels nearby that have more modern rooms, large open lobbies, etc. This place is an older hotel, well maintained, but with it's lovable quirks. The floor in our room (925 - good room with a decent view) sloped slightly, the stairs, which our kids loved to take daily, are narrow and winding - all of this adds charm! The lobby is not large an modern but smaller with a fireplace and a nice place to hang out and watch people. The staff is as good as I have experienced at much more expensive hotels - think The Ritz. Everyone from the doorman (Peter was great in suggesting local places to dine!) to the front desk, to the bartenders...you get the picture. The price-point is similar to the Marriot but I would much rather stay here with this amazing staff
Charming old feel in this 110 year old hotel. Staff was informed this was a birthday trip and promptly upgraded our room. All staff were friendly and accommodating I highly recommend this hotel

This is my second stay at this hotel and the staff always exceed the standard!!! Late night sickness, nothing open, the front desk had the bar opened and room service brought up a ginger ale!!! The room was very clean, bed comfy, bathroom clean and roomy. My only complaint with hotels in general "clean the tv remotes"

Very nice hotel. (I'm not terribly picky; never really had a bad stay)
Everyone is extremely nice, helpful.
Close to Beale St., very clean, ascetically pleasing! 
TV Sucks, only 20 or so channels. $15 for a movie!?! If you arrive too late to 'do stuff', can't count on tv to help pass the time.

I have worked for a national travel agency as well as a major airline, so I have stayed in many hotel rooms over the years. This was the worst hotel room that I have EVER been in! The sheets were dirty, the toilet had dried urine all over the front and pooled around the entire bottom, and the management on duty was not helpful at all. We checked in very late at night and obviously delt with the overnight management and staff. The hotel manager offered us another room, which wasn't much better than the last. I will never stay there again and warn anyone thinking of it, stay at the Hampton Inn and Suites on Beale down the street!

The hotel is a very nice conversion property from an old bank building which makes for one of the most interesting residence inns I have stayed in. That being said, the breakfast area is probably one of tackiest and least user friendly areas of the hotel. The vault door is in the breakfast area is a very neat thing to see though. 
The staff at the hotel was efficient and very welcoming as well. We arrived after midnight and were greeted with a friendly smile and speedy check-in from the young man at the desk. Over all the stay was very nice an I would recommend to friends and family.
Liked the building, location, staff and room all very much. Check out the Tiptop bar/restaurant across the street!

Stayed at this hotel over night for a conference. I found it to be very clean, the workers were friendly, and the location was perfect. Word to the wise bring a sweater or dress warmly if you will be attending a conference as the ballroom is freezing!

Our King room was huge. Nothing fancy, but very clean, soft towels and sheets, comfortable bed, quiet air unit, fridge, a desk and separate table, good shower, strong wifi signal. I felt that the neighborhood was perfectly safe.
The weekly rate was a really good deal. The weekend rate is a little steep, in my opinion.
Would definitely recommend.

Doesn't look like much from the outside and the immediate neighborhood looks sketchy, but true to the reviews this is a great hotel. We were allowed to bring our animal, and upon arriving the room smelled great. Large rooms, clean, hair dryer, fridge, granite counters, microwave, coffee maker, iron, board. Great service, and good breakfast. Thanks rodeway, our stay couldn't have been better.

I am from Columbus and wanted to take my mom to an upscale hotel for a night due to her being sick and not being able to travel. I picked this hotel in an effort to give my mom a night she could remember. I had preordered a gourmet cheese tray and chocolate covered strawberries to be in our room when we got in our room. review_title: Pretty descent room. But right in the ghetto.
review_text: I booked my room online with site advisor, because I read some really nice reviews.I stayed for one night, a Saturday in September of 2011. The rooms are big,like advertised. The guest service wasn't bad, but nothing special. The outside did look a little ghetto, like the other reviews said. But the inside of the room was clean, the a/c worked fine, the bathroom was small but that's not a big priority to me. The furniture wasn't bad either. On the other hand, the bed me and my wife slept in is the hardest bed I've ever slept in, the continental breakfast was a joke. And worst of all me and my wife didn't feel safe. There were prostitutes on the corner 40 yards from our room at 3 in the morning. It was loud outside all night, there were homeless people walking down the street all night as well as thugs. So overall, considering everything it just depends on what you are looking for and what your priorities are. I personally will not be staying again.

review_title: Your typical Hampton Inn with one exception.
review_text: Breakfast was large, hot and tasty! Not the typical Hampton Inn breakfast experience. The pool is outdoors and small. The suite room was medium sized with full kitchen including dishwasher. Towels felt cheap and less than usual hotel quality, like sandpaper on your skin.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis-Shady Grove Road

review_text:
Had a great experience here,stayed for business from late sept they mid Oct,almost 3 weeks,can't say enough about the staff and facility,the hotel is brand new,the rooms modern and beautiful,42 inch Hdtv's and pillowtop mattresses,Indoor pool and hottub! Its right next to a major shopping mall,a gazillion restaurants,not to mention its right off interstate The staff were all friendly and accommodating from the front desk to housekeeping staff and all had such good attitudes that it's certainly is a reflection on the 
management.just a great hotel.
hotel_name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Wolfchase

review_text:
Everybody is friendly, and efficient.
Melissa, who happens to be one of the bartenders, is a pleasure to be around. Very friendly and after a long busy day it's nice to unwind to some pleasant conversation, and it doesn't hurt that with each visit she has remembered my favorite drink.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Memphis-Wolfchase Galleria

review_title: Service was special, Marie is awsome.
review_text: Marie at the front desk was awsome. She made my stay. The hotel couldn't accommodate a upgrade so she presented me and my friend with free breakfast coupons. Would always choose this hotel over others in Memphis.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Memphis-Wolfchase Galleria

review_text: I disagree with the reviews about a shady area. It's next to the hospital parking garage, and patrolled by security and mpd, not that is was needed. The outside is freshly painted and clean, I mean really clean. The rooms are clean also, even the bath. I never let a tip for housekeeping, but felt the need to for this place. Quiet all night didn't hear a thing, and our shiny new jeep fit in with the other cars in the lot, didn't look like any trashy cars parked here. Beale st is a 5 min drive with one turn of linden and your there, paid 5$ to park!

We'll stay again at this hotel b/c it offers a convenient location, large suite and helpful staff. Loved BB kings and the front desk was dead on to recommend interstate BBQ. Thanks for a great weekend.

I will listen to trip advisor. From the outside it looked extra shady. But from.check in to my room it was all solid from there. Rooms are huge so the little ones could literally run around. Very clean, ice cold ac. 2 min drive to beale street. Free parking. Free continental breakfast. All that for under 80 a night? Good business! Tremendous value. Only negs are shady looking outside, no elevator, no pool.

Had a great 3 day stay here recently. Beautiful King room with view of river and downtown. Awesome service from the valets to the front desk staff. The concierge for Marriott rewards gold level members was a high point! Great breakfast with fresh fruit and delicious muffins! In addition free wifi was fast and easy.Thanks for a great stay!

We are current guests having booked this hotel through Expedia. The hotel is undergoing MAJOR renovations and should not be occupied. There is no lobby at present- front desk staff are working out of a closet. We are here for a wedding and arrived with no choice. We were not given an option to stay at another Marriott and given no refund in part of the purchase. I can't even open the curtains as there is scaffolding outside my window. I expect much more from a Marriott property. I should have been informed there was this renovation going on and given the option to re-book. After a 50 min call to Expedia I have been offered a voucher for a future trip, but not even a partial refund from Marriott. There'd is dust and debris outside in the hallway- construction equipment everywhere.

This was my second stay here at the Lenox. I was here for a reunion and stayed only one night. I was impressed with everone that worked here. Everyone was friendly and helpful. Our room was comfortable and well appointed. They are very "green" and even have a basket that has separate areas for recycling. I would definately stay here again (for longer than one night).

The desk staff is all very friendly and went out of their way to make our stay very enjoyable. The hotel looks brand new and was very clean, and the beds were super comfortable. We will be back the next time we stop in Memphis.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Memphis-Wolfchase Galleria

review_text: From the moment we arrived at the Lenox till the moment we left everything was absolutely "their pleasure!". The rooms are beautifully decorated & spacious. Bathrooms are a bit dark but the service by the staff makes up for any shortcomings in bathroom lighting. We were in Boston to attend the Head of the Charles & the Lennox provided an amazing VIP tent riverside that made our stay extra enjoyable. Nina wasaybe the best concierge I've ever had the fortune to deal with. She was so ind, knowledgeable & connected not to mention efficient & delightful. My new favorite Boston hotel!!!

The best reason to stay at Residence Inn Memphis is the location. It is close to the action, walking distance to Beale St and other sights such as the civil rights museum. The rooms are serviceable. They are quite small however. Our room wad an odd shape- long and narrow. The kitchenette would be useful on a longer stay. The bed was too soft for my taste, the bathroom was small and the shower fairly ordinary. In all, just ok.
Service was generally good. Valet parking is pricey, but to be expected for a downtown option. The breakfast was passable, but nothing exceptional. It is decent value given the location. I would recommend but with a few caveats.

review_title: Once again this hotel meets and exxeeds my expectations
review_text: I arrived to the hotel on short notice. The sales manager Christy arranged a room on the spot. the next morning the wait staff in the restaurant took excellent care of me as well. Will definitely be back.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Memphis-Wolfchase Galleria

review_text: The managment staff is awesome. would go again in a heartbeat. Loved the pool
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Memphis-Wolfchase Galleria

review_text: My husband and I stay at the Residence Inn in downtown Memphis everytime we visit! It is in a great location very close to the "nightlife" of Beale street, but being far enough away from all the noise. They staff are so friendly and the breakfast buffet is awesome! There is a restaurant right across the street that is wonderful! We also love to go to the rooftop of the hotel and look out at the Memphis skyline!

We stayed one night at this hotel and were very happy with our choice. Hugh at the front net was so friendly and greeted us with a great sense of humor. The Valet was so friendly and helpful as well. It was an excellent room that worked perfectly for us because we had our 2 yr old son with us. He was able to sleep on the sofa bed and we still had privacy and were able to watch TV after he went to sleep. Breakfast was great, hotel was easy to find and close to the river which made a great view.
The service and location were perfect. The room and bathroom were small. Our family of four had a hard time with the tiny bathroom.

review_title: Best for your buck in Memphis!
review_text:
I stayed here 3 nights with my 6- year-old son and my parents. My dad was in Memphis for business and we tagged along for the free trip. Staybridge is about 20 minutes out of downtown Memphis in a very nice little area. The free shuttle is only minutes from a variety of shopping and restaurants and the drive down town was a breeze. 
The room itself was beautiful. It had a very nice kitchenette that was fully stocked with everything you could need, including two burners, microwave, full size fridge and dishwasher. It had a good sized dining area in addition to a comfy pull out couch with large tv and DVD player. No flat screen, but not a big deal. 
The bedroom was in a separate room behind double doors with a very luxurious queen bed. We slept very well all three nights. The bathroom and adjacent area were both clean and modern and well lit. There was plenty of room for several of us to get ready at the same time.
Aside from the room itself, the hotel had many amenities. The Bridgemart at the lobby had all the little things that you may have forgotten, such as toothbrushes and deodorant as well as a fair variety of food and snacks. They were pricey, but being stuck in the hotel all day, it was nice to be able to run downstairs and grab ice cream with my son to kill time. There is a very small library which doesn't have many books but does have two computers the were free to use, including a printer. The laundry was free with purchase of detergent and the basic Internet was free. It was pretty good speed compared to what I'm used to at hotels. You had the option to pay more for higher speeds but the free internet was just fine for us. 
It may sound like you are nickel and dimed here but one of the best parts of our stay was the free breakfast AND dinner. Every morning they server a full breakfast with many choices, including just plain cereal for my picky little eater and delicious omelettes and fruit salads for me. There were pancakes, muffins, sausage, and more, all freshly made. During the week, they also serve a free dinner. The meal changes every night. We were there for burritos one night and soup and salad the next. As you can imagine, having two free meals a day for four people saved us a lot of money!
To top it off, the staff was all very friendly and seemed genuinely happy to be there. We were a little sad to go after our stay and wished we could stay in Memphis a little longer. Staybridge was truly a home away from home. For the price, it really is well worth every penny. Compared to the competition, you get a lot more bang for your buck here! Every time www are back in Memphis, we will be back at the beautiful Staybridge!
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Memphis - Poplar Ave East

review_text: We stayed in a king room for the first few days of our honeymoon. Concierge and reception staff were great during our stay and we even received a bottle of bubbles in our room. Unfortunately I was very disappointed in our room. It was spacious and clean but the bathroom was tiny and very dated with some peeling paint. Not what I expected given the other reviews. Staff in the city restaurant were a little abrupt and we weren't made to feel very welcome when eating. Also, reception got confused over our visa debit card and processed it incorrectly so it was declined, we then had to use our UK visa credit card which charged us a significant amount to use it abroad. As a result our visa debit cards were blocked by the bank and we had to spend over an hour on the phone trying to Sort it out. We are returning to Boston this weekend at the end of our honeymoon and have booked a different hotel! Says it all really.

review_title: Reasonable rate for a home away from home with an incredible friendly and accommodating staff.
review_text:
Two of my sons and I stayed here for a few days on a multi-stop vacation. We had a room with a double and a fold out couch. It had a complete kitchen and a full size bathroom. The staff was unbelievably friendly and helpful. They made you feel as if was genuinely important to them that you be 100% satisfied with your stay. The room was very clean, but some of the bedding for the fold out couch had a few stains in it. We called down to ask for replacements and seemingly before we hug up the phone, it was there.
Breakfast is included every morning. It was the typical continental fare with nothing terribly exciting, but it was all VERY fresh. It did include one specialty item svegliarsi morning, which kept it interesting. The dining/ meeting area is very nice and has a computer kiosk with free internet access for patrons. On some night, a complimentary snack and drinks are served.
The hotel had a small, but adequate workout room which my son and I used every day. They had coin operated laundry with complementary detergent and dryer sheets, which was extremely useful to us as we packed light. 
The location is EXCELLENT and a 60 second walk to the main street trolley. 
My ONLY complaint - or more accurately disappointment, is that there was no pool. We stayed during record heat and there was a rooftop HOT TUB, but no pool. Too bad because we would certainly have used it and gotten some sun while enjoying the view of the Mississippi river. 
I will probably stay here again.

This is a lovely hotel, don't get me wrong. It has a significant amount of history behind it and the style is amazing. It is in a good location between Fenway Park and Boston Common, very close to a T line. There was just a couple of things: when we checked in, we were given directions to the room and told about the Wifi. It was only on wandering around that we found a gym, a business centre and at the restaurant did breakfast. There was no info in the room as it was all on the tv hotel info which froze regularly and was difficult to navigate. The next thing was the room: now I don't mind spending a bit extra but in this hotel, I could only afford the classic room. Just don't. The room wasn't particularly big and far more suitable for one person than two particularly, as my husband succinctly pointed out, you couldn't go to the loo standing or sitting without being at an angle due to the wall being 6 inches in front of the pan-literally! The last matter was the noise-initially, I thought I could put up with the traffic noise. Then we found that we were on the side by what appeared to be a service entrance so each morning, there was incessant beeping from one or more trucks, followed between 7am and 8.30am by the slamming of doors in the corridor (we joked it began to sound like the 1812 overture every morning) from inconsiderate guests and as the fire station was along Boylston Street, each night was accompanied at least once by fire sirens. If I could recommend anything at this hotel, grade as much as you can afford!

The suite is a nice size, with everything one would need for a comfortable stay- except for the televisions. They are very dated and have poor picture quality. Flat panel televisions, even lower quality ones, are pretty standard in a hotel of this class, and even in hotels of lesser class. I'd say that they are well worth the investment, especially for a hotel catering to business travelers who would likely spend much of their time on site, and not out sight seeing. That as an aside, everything else was nice and clean (with the exception of some questionable hairs found under the pull-out sofa mattress, which one would likely never notice unless the mattress didn't unfold on it's own without some assistance as in the case with my stay. I can see why housekeeping would miss them in such a spot).
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Memphis - Poplar Ave East

review_text:
We recently completed a 5 night stay at the Lenox and had a great stay. 
The hotel was clean and well kept and the staff were very friendly and helpful. Our room was lovely, lots of nice details like a waste bin that included recycling options, and a long list of products that they would supply to you if you had forgotten them. 
The location of the hotel was great, 2 minutes from copely square, and less from the metro. 
I would recommend this hotel.

Spent two weeks at the Staybridge while in Memphis for training. The hotel was wonderful! I'll start with housekeeping: I am VERY picky and thoroughly checked my room when I arrived. Everything looked clean. I was surprised (but appreciative) when I left a glass in the sink one morning while in a rush, and when I came back it was in the dishwasher! I ran into a couple housekeeping staff in the hallways throughout my stay, and each time they greeted me with a smile and asked if I was enjoying my stay. I did not catch their names but the genuine friendliness was across the board.
The front desk staff were wonderful too! Very personable and again, always ready to greet me with a warm smile. They gave me great advice about where to go around town and always followed-up with "how did it go?"
The hotel has a shuttle that will take you anywhere within a 5 mile radius. The shuttle drivers were so friendly too! My favorite, hands-down, was Eric. He juggled a large group of us with different interests and I never waited long. I'm also a horrible backseat driver but I felt safe with Eric. He drove well, recommended places to go to, and warned us about areas we would probably want to avoid. 
Now the food. The Staybridge offers a free breakfast buffet, not just continental, everyday and happy hour Monday -Thursday. The breakfast offers a huge variety--bagels, eggs, bacon, sausage, biscuits, oatmeal, waffles and the list goes on! The happy hour offers free beer and wine and a small meal (I.e. sloppy joes, egg rolls, tacos...). The only thing better than the variety and the quality of the food is the man who makes it--Mr. LB! He is the nicest man and so accommodating. I was part of a large group who insisted on sitting together all the time. Mr. LB allowed us to move tables and chairs and never told us to turn the volume down despite the fact that we were very loud at times. He went as far as to bake cookies for our group...twice!! 
If I had to sum up the Staybridge in a few words...clean, accommodating, and welcoming. As home-sick as I was feeling, the staff really made me feel better. I hope I have the opportunity to come back soon. Thank you Staybridge staff!!
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Memphis - Poplar Ave East

review_title: Great location, good price but a bit chince.
review_text:
You couldn't ask for a better location. 
Special mention to girl on front desk that was extremely helpful and welcoming.
Rooms were good size and very clean although hotel as a whole is a bit chince.
Service was hit and miss. Majority of staff were excellent. Breakfast staff were a bit slow and seemed like they didn't know what they were doing and concierge, although very polite, missed the fact that there was a major fashion event (fashion night out) being held at Newbury street (next to hotel) even though I specifically events if any events were happening that weekend. What was worse was the Lenox hotel actually helped sponsor the event.
Taxi drivers were all mad and didn't know where they were going. He didn't know what street the stadium was!? Luckily hotel helped to set him right.
Good hotel at a good price and great location. I would recommend it over any other hotels in the area for the price.For all my gripes, we had a great stay overall.

review_title: Kitchen needs better support from management; but overall very good
review_text: Kitchen ran out of breakfast and evening reception items twice during my short stay; and lobby coffee was empty twice. Kitchen staff was apologetic and attentive, but clearly lacked the resources they needed. There was no salad offered during the evening reception - something that business travelers who frequent the Staybridge chain depend on for a healthy, balanced road meal. However; front desk staff was excellent iin their efficiency and attentiveness, room & property were clean and well-maintained, and hotel is in a nice office-park area. This property had the best price in the area for hotels in this class when I booked. Would stay here again.
hotel_name: Staybridge Suites Memphis - Poplar Ave East

review_title: A hotel with amazing staff service
review_text:
We stayed in the hotel for 3 nights with our 2 yr old. The reception staff were very friendly, wanted to know our daughters name. Within an hour a basket of goodies and a teddy bear arrived for her.
The staff were friendly throughout our stay, the concierge was helpful and booked us tables at great kid friendly restaurants.
The room was a good size, we had 2 doubles, very clean. A fridge and free water was provided along with safe but no coffee making facility in the room.
Lovely hotel and staff, good location for shopping and great time had.

review_title: Very nice, clean, and close to everything!!!
review_text: My friend and I stay here for the weekend, and I was very satisfied with how attentive and polite the staff was at all times, the hotel and our room was very clean and spacious, both beds were comfy, bathroom was roomy, and it was a walk or a trolley ride away from all the action. Next time I visit Memphis this will be my first choice to stay!!!

Price does not natch the experience. Requested king bed which was noted on my reservation. We were given a room with 2 double beds. No one seemed to really care and there is no wireless Internet in the rooms. Food and service are less than adequate for the service received. Even getting a taxi at check out took longer than usual

The location was good for driving to, free parking right out front and less than 2 miles from Beale street, although I wouldn't suggest walking around the area. The rooms are huge with cable tv, fridge and microwave, sofa and good shower. Don't use the local dominoes they are rubbish. Service was fantastic and breakfast was fine for a freebie. We decided to stay an extra night and when we were in reception another guest asked to do the same.

I live at Marriott. No less than 3 nights a week. A few nights away from Platinum status. I only say this because I know what to expect from Marriott. The wife and I stayed at this location over Memorial Day weekend...using some of my many accumulated points. There's nothing of interest in the immediate neighborhood, but you can catch the trolley right outside the door ($1) for a short ride into city center.The hotel's staff was great. The room was decent. The Cafe was good (for breakfast). The Fitness Center was very good. I was surprised that they didn't have an outdoor pool (May in Memphis and it was already well over 90 degrees). The indoor pool was very unappealing. The bar/lounge is in a desperate need of a makeover (very bland). Overall, good marks, but some room for improvement.

To make it short and sweet staff is nice and the hotel is nice as well. However, there is not any free parking, valet for $20 self parking for $18 or drop quarters in a meter. Did not expect that but it is what it is. In room dining is pretty good and was very acomidating to our daughters request...lol....over all not a bad place.

review_title: Lovely hotel, great staff, great location
review_text: Stayed here for a long weekend and had a great time. Room was lovely, with great views of the city. V nice staff who were very helpful.
This is becoming my favorite chain. Clean,safe, comfortable rooms and ok breakfast make it ideal.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn and Suites Columbus Downtown

review_text: Great location. Across the street from the convention center, and in the midst of Columbus' revitalized art and restaurant district. Room was clean, but each day maid didn't clean up our coffee cups from the morning. Had to handle my baggage by myself, even when the staff could see I was struggling with the luggage and my disabled mother! Free breakfast was a B minus--enough to get me going in the morning, but nothing to wait around for. Would recommend for the independent traveler who needs a safe place to stay in downtown Columbus.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn and Suites Columbus Downtown

review_title: Perfect location for Arena District events
review_text: The hotel was excellent for what I needed...close access to the Arena district. Staff were courteous and efficient. Room was clean and quiet. My only gripe was that there were too many people at breakfast for the hotel to accomodate. I would stay here again any time I needed this location.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn and Suites Columbus Downtown

review_text: I stay in hotels about a 100 nights a year, so I no how much they are and if one is special. This room was the most points I have ever given for a room and it was just ordinary. Average size room, clean as any other Hampton, basically the same breakfast. Some good things --- omg if u are going to Beale street or the fedex forum it is a super great location, the comensatry was well stocked and reasonably priced, they also comped the parking. Its the usual 3 star Hampton otherwise
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text: We just spent two night at the Hampton Inn at Beale Street. What a great location! We could walk to so many places! Granted you need a car to go to Graceland or the Stax Museum, but we did walk to the Sun Record Studio, and Beale Street is just a block away. Loved seeing the ducks at the Peabody Hotel which is very close to the hotel. We enjoyed the Flight restaurant, and also went to Rendezvous which is well-known for its ribs but we felt it was just okay. We highly recommend seeing Graceland, and the Sun Record Studios. The rooms are most comfortable and very clean. The hotel staff is extremely friendly and helpful, and the breakfast hits the spot! Also, there is parking for your car in a garage attached to the hotel.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_title: Individual style and comfort in a fabulous location.
review_text: I have used the Lenox asva home-from-home for the last 10 years. It has never failed to be a pleasure staying there. The staff are excellent, the rooms large and comfortable with complimentary wi-fi avreal plus. This part of th Back Bay is excellent for shops (Newbury St in particular), restaurants and spectacular architecture. Stay here and you are guaranteed a relaxing and pleasurable stay.

I have stayed at this hotel a few times and keep coming back. The rooms are comfortable, the shower heads are at a height that works for a 6'5" guy and it is walking distance to a number of great restaurants. 
During my last stay, I found a billing error after I checked out. I contacted the hotel and they put it right immediately.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn and Suites Columbus Downtown

review_text: Insgesamt ein super Hotel.Sehr schÃ¶n,super Lage und sauber.Hatten ein schÃ¶nes und gerÃ¤umiges Zimmer mit Blick auf die Stadt...ein Traum!Zwei Tage vorher gebucht und einiges gespart.Aber mal ernsthaft,kostenloses W-LAN gehÃ¶rt doch heute,selbst in jedem Mittelklasse Motel,zum Standard!?14$/Tag fÃ¼r W-LAN,das zahle ich zu Hause im Monat...

While the room was beautifully decorated, the bed was the most uncomfortable thing I have ever slept in. I barely slept the two nights we stayed at the Madison and my lower back also hurt from the awful mattress. My travel companions had the same issue as well. If your looking for decent sleep- go to the Peabody.

My husband and I stayed 2 nights at the Madison Hotel for a romantic weekend getaway. Very nice hotel!! The staff is so friendly and helpful.
