Friendly staff, beautiful room, clean, and the best location. They treat you like family. The staff seems to care about the sucess of the hotel and your stay.

Stayed one night over Memorial Day paid $208 which included tax. Then there was parking and the $10 resort fee. The staff were all very friendly but Empress was amazingly helpful. 
We were able to check in early, stayed on the third floor. The room was big and clean, could use some minor updating, but the lighting really needs to improved. The room had catherdral ceilings so not if that was part of the reason. Not a big deal though.
Can't beat the location. 
Totally would suggest you put Pier 5 on your short list of hotels to stay at while in Baltimore.

This hotel has some of the best front desk staff I've come across. Everyone was very friendly and obviously well trained.
Rooms layout, size and amenities are very good. We especially liked the curtain that helped give our family of three some privacy. 
The value proposition is hard to beat for the size of room you get.
Finally, they serve very good free coffee.
hotel_name: Home2 Suites by Hilton Baltimore Downtown

review_text:
1. I have stayed in every metro Baltimore hilton and this new brand is my FAV. 
2. Location: monument area..not as thouristy, great food within walking distance. Grocery right across the street. SUPER easy to access johns Hopkins. Baltimore can be confusing to drive around but this location is perfect for getting to Hopkins. 
3. Hotel appearance: clean modern and green. I love the sheets! And want to get a set for home. There are outlets by the bed!!!!!! And the ihome alarm is a really touch. 
4. Hotel staff: unha has checked me in several times and couldn't be nicer. I messed up my confirmation this last time and she was speedy in finding me a room. 
5. Jhu has a special rate so call for details.
hotel_name: Home2 Suites by Hilton Baltimore Downtown

review_title: Great place to stay, but don't go to the bar...
review_text: The hotel is really nice and in a great location, but after dark I was warned by lots of people not to go outside Because of the homeless problem which was a little frustrating. My friend and I had also decided to get a beer at the lobby bar before we went out for dinner. We noticed that the bartender was not really keeping everything clean. A little while later we both felt ill and had to cut our night short. Otherwise I would definitely recommend this hotel for a short of long term visit.
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Baltimore Downtown/Inner Harbor

review_title: We had a great stay at pier 5.
review_text: We stayed at Pier 5 Hotel due to our son being treated at Johns Hopkins. We had a wonderful experience. We also took or small children to the National Aquarium. It was a great trip.
As a business traveler, this is my kind of hotel. Spacious rooms, big working spaces, a kitchen and a full breakfast downstairs.
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Baltimore Downtown/Inner Harbor

review_text: The worst hotel. Please don't stay here. The staff is rude. The late night manager is rude. Find somewhere else to stay if you are crashing in Baltimore for the night
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Baltimore Downtown/Inner Harbor

review_text:
We stayed here for 3 nights to see the Red Sox. I had booked this long ago or so I thought. I inadvertently did not confirm it. They were able to find us a room for 3 nights. Originally we were put on the 3rd floor. Because this hotel is in the heart of the city on a busy street you hear all the noise on a lower floor. The 2nd night we moved to the 9th floor and it was much better. You could hear a pin drop inside the hotel...it is very quiet.
The hotel staff were very friendly and more then happy to give us directions daily. Free bus around town is right outside the door!! They also take pets here...which u never hear any noise from them. They had a Labordoodle staying with them. His owner would be at the hospital 12 hours a day. The front desk staff would take him behind the desk every day and take him out for walks. 
Breakfast is 630-930a daily and contains many hot items...scrambled eggs, oatmeal, sausage, waffles, etc. Inner harbor is within walking distance with many restaurant choices. We never even needed a cab the whole 4 days we were there! Camden Yard is an easy walk there or take the free bus!!!
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Baltimore Downtown/Inner Harbor

review_text: New renovation, super clean, great staff, I wouldn't stay anywhere else, best hotel in Baltimore. and the restaurant downstairs has a great new menu, try the crab cakes!
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Baltimore Downtown/Inner Harbor

review_text: Stayed two days for mini vacation. Great access to harbor, little italy, restaurants. Stayed in suite with friends for 200per night. Room was great. Parking 32 per night. Slow service for breakfast. I would stay again.
hotel_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Baltimore Downtown/Inner Harbor

review_title: Great place to stay, the staff is AWESOME!!!
review_text:
I'm a business traveler and this hotel meets my needs perfectly. It has a great location thats walking distance to the Inner Harbors restaurants and shopping. The rooms are large, continental breakfast, free wifi, happy hour, parking and an exercise room. The shinning star is the staff, they are GREAT (Keri), very fun and they make you feel like family.
I recommend this location to all of my friends and colleagues.
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_title: Great location, great price, great service!
review_text: I visited the US with my best friend, traveling down the east coast. We stopped in Baltimore for one night before heading on to DC. We loved this hotel! It is just a short walk to the Inner Harbor area, and Little Italy where we went for dinner. The rate was within our budget and I could not say enough good things about the staff, they were wonderful! If I ever make another trip to Baltimore I will definitely stay here again! Thank you Sleep Inn for making our trip to Baltimore a memorable one.
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_text:
We stayed at this hotel very recently for one night while being on a business trip. We arrived very late, close to midnight and we met the manager at front desk. He was extremely nice and check-in was fast, we really felt welcomed!
From the entrance the hotel gives you the impression of a very clean place with nice furnishings.
The room was beautiful, very large with high ceilings and modern furniture. Bed was super comfy and everything was sparkling of cleanliness!
Breakfast was free and had a good selection but being in a hurry I couldn't enjoy everything, had to quickly grab some cereals and leave.
Overall was an excellent experience, the hotel being also a quiet place and I would definitely recommend it! It's more a 3 and a half star hotel for a great price!
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_text: Stayed for a week. Very good prices and big rooms. Had that old classic feeling. Nice location too. Great bar at explorers lounge. Very friendly staff at this Hotel, including the Very helpful and always smiling Nicole.
Great hotel! Rooms are awesome and clean. Staff was super friendly! Location was great as we could walk to the Inner Harbor. Would definately stay there again and recommend to friends!
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_title: Second stay...just as good as the first
review_text:
When returning to the Baltimore area we immediately booked this hotel again.
Rooms are fairly large and nicely decorated. There is a large flat screen tv, desk area, good sized bathroom and the beds are COMFY. Hotel is in a renovated warehouse, lovely lobby area with huge ceilings and a nice sitting area. There is a computer and printer for guest use. I didn't use the fitness room but the machines looked quite new, looked really nice. The breakfast area has tables and a breakfast bar all along the windows. It gets busy, but people come and go quickly. Good selection of items, hot and cold. 
Location isn't where people would think of when they think 'inner harbor', but it's only about a 10 minute walk to the Aquarium, historic ships, and shops. There is a water taxi stop just down the street. 2 blocks from the restaurants at Power Plant Live, 15 minute walk to the pubs/shops in Fell's Point, 10 minute walk to Little Italy. The one downfall is that there is a church just down the street with a large park where a good amount of 'underprivledged' people were 'living'. I can see how that could make some people uneasy. We never had an issue walking by, but it didn't have the nicest smell when you pass. On our first stay at the hotel the desk clerk suggested was cab back from Little Italy if it was after dark. No concerns during the day though. 
My only complaint about the hotel is how heavy the room doors are. Our friends heard doors closing (slamming) quite often thoughout the night. Also, the bathroom door in our room wedged into the frame and made it impossible to quietly shut the door during the night. We did report that to the hotel when we checked out though. Isolated issue. 
Great stay overall
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_text:
Got off a flight from Newark to Boston having flown from Manchester UK. I was horribly sweaty before I even got to Manchester, had baggage trauma at Newark (not an airport I'd recommend) and eventually arrived at The Lenox hot, tired & smelly. The door staff were utterly charming, as were the staff at reception. 
The location is great, everywhere is walkable. 
Breakfast wasn't included but there's a 7-11 over the road, and a bakery/deli attached to the hotel.
Wifi was only available in reception.

review_title: You'll be thrilled with your choice!!
review_text: This property is an awesome find. Its a uniquely renovated furniture showroom and warehouse. The architecture style embraces what once was into a cool place to stay. The rooms and public areas are clean and the beds are comfortable. The staff is superb and very helpful. My husband has been staying there while working on a project nearby. Its a quick walk to the inner harbor and little Italy. Stay here, you'll be glad you did!
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_title: Free parking, wifi, breakfast and all new!
review_text: Only a 10 min walk down to the harbor or little Italy. My new jeep was fine parked in the hotels lot and we felt safe walking around at night. Clean and modern furnishings with showers and great water pressure. Kerri at check in was friendly, warm and helpfull. Very nice lobby felt more like a marriott than a sleep. The breakast was your standard no thrills but clean and hot, even though it was over at 9 we did not feel rushed after 9:15.
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_title: Excellent location for most of the downtown events for a relatively reasonable rate
review_text: Very large rooms, clean, surprisingly quiet considering its location. Breakfast was above average but not outstanding. Employees seemed happy and were helpful. Adequate exercise facilities, nice pool and hot tub both on the basement level. Remember to take into account the nightly parking fee... currently 26 per night... Valet only

The hotel staff went above and beyond for us during the marathon last weekend. They found a friendly Baltimore police woman who would actually let us cross the race route in our car. Otherwise we would have been trapped.

review_title: Excellent staff so eager to please and professional
review_text:
Hotel was 
Definitely 4 star in service and rooms

This was my first trip to Boston with two friends and to cut down on expense we decided to share a room. I phoned The Lenox and asked if a room with three beds could be arranged. They very graciously accommodated us with a room with two queen beds and a comfortable roll away bed. All this was on place on our arrival. The girls at the desk were most polite and helpful and provided us with tourist information. The room was first class with beautiful decor and the beds were most comfortable. We were provided with complimentary bottled water each day and chocolates with the turn down service. Comlimentary coffee and fruit was available from early in the morning in the lobby and iced tea and cookies in the late evening. Complimentary use of the business centre was very much appreciated. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the luxurious Lenox Hotel and would return there

review_title: one of the best luxury value hotels I have been in
review_text:
i was only there for one night, but the room was fantastic, comfortable, luxurious, beautiful and with a comfortable bed!
Check inn was a little late (4pm) and we paid extra for a harbor view that was marginal at. Best, but I have no real complaints.
I have stayed in more expensive higher profile hotels and spent twice as much for less.
Great hotel.

review_title: Great location for old- style luxury!
review_text:
My husband and two children recently spent two nights at Lenox for sightseeing in Boston. We instantly loved this hotel. The location is excellent- across street from Copley square, t-system, Boston public library, and quick walk to prudential center. Lots of great restaurants nearby. I definitely recommend Legal Seafoods, and the Duck Boat Tour. We loved both and they were very child- friendly as well.
The hotel is luxurious, and little fridge is room was great little perk! We had a junior suite (room 314). The room was spacious with nice sized bathroom and closet. The only down- side was there was no view- just brick wall next door and ugly rooftop venting out of other window. Other than that, hotel was great and the stuffed animals for girls at check-in was nice touch. They also have a car which we took to airport $40, and it was much nicer than cab. In all, we highly recommend this hotel!

Will come again in spite of a couple of small things... We requested a room close to the lobby as walking is a problem, but that request was ignored and we had to wait over a half hour for another room. The TV did not work well and the remote was broken. Someone came and played w the TV, got it to work on one channel but it was annoying to have to get up to shut it after dozing off. Never got our complimentary wine either. All in all though, a nice place and as I said, we would give them another try.
It was a great value with a decent breakfast and clean overall. I will stay there again.
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_text: Great service. Every employee we saw said hello to us. Chris checked us in, very friendly. Location is wonderful, right at the habour and just blocks from Camden Yards. Parking tip: if you pay the garage directly there is no tax, but one day is 24 hours. If you pay the hotel, you pay tax but one day is considered 30 hours.
My husband I stayed at the Sleep Inn n Suites Inner Harbor. All I can say is we will be back baby. Great Staff n Breakfast. Convenient location n price. Love the decor
hotel_name: Sleep Inn & Suites Downtown Inner Harbor

review_text: Wife and I recently stayed for two nights. We live in the area so knew the section of the city we wanted to stay in. The location is really perfect if you want to be in the Back Bay. Boylston St, Newbury St., the Public Gardens, Boston Common, Copley Square are all right there. And easy T access at Copley, too if you want to head elsewhere in the city. The "classic" room was very clean and nicely updated. Nice big HD tv, and the bed was quite comfortable. The room was fairly small by US standards, but we have certainly seen smaller rooms in Europe, so no big deal. The bathroom was our one gripe. The shower was too small for both of us (it was a couples weekend after all!). And we literally had to maneuver to get onto the toilet, and we are both very thin! The wall jutted out by your left leg, and the toilet paper roll sat over your left thigh. Very tight by any measure! All I can say is Zdeno Chara would not be able to use that bathroom! Even so it was a great hotel and we will definitely stay there again.

review_title: An excellent addition to the harbor magic hotel group!
review_text: I couldn't be more pleased with my recent stay at Hendersons Wharf Inn. The location In Fells Point is superb and just as convenient as the Admiral Fell hotel (another of my favorites). The service provided at the front desk by Kevin was excellent. My room was spacious, clean and comfortable. The bathroom was spotless and well-stocked. The complimentary breakfast was full of delicious pastries, fresh fruit, etc. The coffee selection was very good. I could go on... I will definitely be booking my next stay in Baltimore at this hotel!

review_title: From beginning of my stay to the end of my stay the hotel was perfect!
review_text:
After a long redeye flight from Arizona, we arrived just after 10 am and was greeted at the cab door by the bellstaff with a smile. We walked into the main lobby and was greated with smiles by the two ladies working at the front desk.
Our room was ready and we were escorted to our room an given a quick tour of our room and amenities. The suite was perfect with one of the best views of the harbor. One of the best places to take pictures of the harbor was from our room. The oversize room and bathroom was more than accomidating. The bath tub was like a small private pool with a tv close by...one could live on the bathroom alone.
With only two days we hit the ground running to see all that Baltimore had to offer. But before departing the resort we stopped by the concierge for recommendations. The concierge had a great. He had a great recommendation for lunch and assisted with ideas on transportation around the city.
After a busy day of sight seeing we decided to sleep in. Before heading out for the second day we had a quick bit to eat in the coffee shop. The wonderful ladies behind the counter were great and the breakfast croissant was perfect.
No matter what time of day/night or who you encountered around the hotel the staff was very friendly and wonderful with suggestions.
I recommend the resort not only for the perfect location to the harbor, shopping, sight seeing, and restaurants...but for the staff and their hospitality in their home/city.

Great location. We were looking for something a little bit different. Not a chain then room itself was alright old fashioned but with a certain charm. Thenrug needs a change though. The only complaint would be that one can hear everything going on outside. Bathrooms were clean and fairly standard (shower curtains...?) the service was GREAT!. Welcome was friendly our son got a stuffed animal on arrival which was a hit and the bellhop actually brought up a gallon of milk for the baby. Way to go the extra mile. Our drivers were polite and very professional and the restaurant staff was also very good. Example; after a long day of walking our son fell asleep and we thought we could sneak in a quick drink at the bar before we had to go and basically retire to our room for the night well of course he woke up and wasn't too thrilled at finding himself at the bar so needless to say we had to leave, however, the hostess offered to take the drinks up to our room since my wife was carrying the toddler and I looked after the carriage, I thought that was a nice gesture. All in all I would recommend this hotel.

review_title: Elegant property, beautiful view, wonderful service
review_text: A lovely two day stay. We had a room with a view of the harbor. From check in until check out, hotel staff was corteous and kind, always with a smile. The Fitness center was up to date and fully equipped. Ice cold cucumber water waiting in the lobby was a great touch. The rooms manager heard we were in town for a special occasion, introduced himself and sent up a very nice amenity. We look forward to returning to Baltimore and staying at this property again.

Sheraton Baltimore
Lobby extremamente escuro e mau cheiro
Me deram um quarto que jÃ¡ estava ocupado
Corredor todo sujo e com caixas espalhadas por tudo, lixo nas portasÂ 
Mau educados no front desk
Toalhas furadas e sujas. Ao ligar 4 vezes para a recepÃ§Ã£o ninguÃ©m atendeu.
Friendly, helpful staff. Great rooms, optimal location.

review_title: Great location and convenient to the best things to do in Memphis
review_text: Great value, clean , above average service and the best hotel on proximity to all of the Memphis sights. The only negative was when we checked in we asked if they honored our reservation for a balcony room overlooking the street. The clerk didn't even check and replied "No". However the next day a different clerk was very helpful in lining up our walking route to see all the sights we wanted to see . This is a great family hotel with the free breakfast they offered. Little noisy on Friday and Saturday nights with the bands on Beale street but can't beat the convenience of this location. I would stay here again.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text:
Interestingly, my review written shortly after my visit last month has disappeared. Not sure how that happened. So here is the review again:
This used to be my favorite hotel in Baltimore. This last trip marked my 5th time at the hotel and, unfortunately, it was nothing like the first few in which the staff and management were beyond reproach. 
On this visit, despite being a Preferred Guest, the manager not only charged a rate that was $60 over any previous visit, but settled me into the smallest room. The wine that had been a standard with a visit was no longer offered unless one asked. Be prepared to manage your luggage without assistance or a nod toward a luggage cart. Manager I dealt with was curt and unwilling to extend an offer on the website for a dining certificate at a local restaurant, claiming he already given me a reduced rate (199. was reduced rate in smallest, non-harborview room.
I have no problem paying for an exceptional hotel and service but unfortunately this stay represented increase cost and a decrease in quality. As a frequent guest, I was surprised by this inhospitable visit.
On a positive note, hotel is still in a fabulous location.
Loved the location, although be aware that it's proximity to Beale Street means there will be noise until the bars close. Earplugs were helpful.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text: I have just returned from memphis today, what can i say staff were amazing, we thought the car park was very overpriced , 17 dollars for 1 nite but as we were staying for a week they only charged us for one nite after asking for a discount, which i thought was brilliant. Rooms were great cleaned every day n clean towels nothing was too much trouble. Beale st is fab did gracelands n backbeat tour which is a must super hotel n super holiday new orleans next !!!!!!!
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text: I stayed here for a whole week. Very nice hotel, and great location. Make sure to travel with your flip flops. The carpet in the rooms is nasty dirty. Turned my entire families feet black just from walking around the room. Don't move the furniture unless you really want to throw up. The carpet is that dirty. Oh...and the front desk wont offer you to move rooms.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text: I enjoyed the stay.The location is awesome.I felt safe at all times.We had an incident where we returned to our room from Beale St. and could not get into room.We was told to report to front desk.He ask my name..then said we have your room showing not occupied.So he got our room cards and swipe them over then we were good to go.That was okay.Good they were checking the customers out to make sure everybody was were they were supposeto be.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text: Check in worked well. The hotel GM personally greeted us and made sure that the room allocated was suitable for us (there were 3 of us and some hotel "double beds" are quite narrow). There was some noise from Beale Street nearby, but our room faced the other way and we had no problem with noise. Breakfast standard Hampton Inn. Parking was adjacent to the hotel and this worked well. We will certainly stay here again if we ever visit Memphis again.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text:
Das traditionsreiche Hotel liegt mitten in Boston Down Town. Wir hatten ein Doppelzimmer das uns doch sehr klein vorkam, vor allem das Bad, aber alles ist sauber und ordentlich. Man bekommt den Eindruck dass das Hotel einer Renovierung/Modernisierung bedarf.
Eventuell sollte auch die Kommunikation verbessert werden; im Preisangebot war ein kostenloser Garagenplatz ( Winterangebot ). Leider war die Dame an der Rezeption davon nicht informiert. Nach Intervention und Vorlage der BestÃ¤tigung haben wir den Platz bekommen.
hotel_name: The Boston Park Plaza Hotel & Towers

review_text: The staff was friendly and informative. The location was within walking distance to all the attractions. Breakfast was fresh and exciting each day. The hotel its self was extremely clean. The price was affordable in todays economy.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text: Big clean rooms, free wifi, complementary airport shuttle, rich breakfast, very reasonable price. You will not ask for more from your airport hotel.

review_title: Nice and People friendly but rooms...
review_text:
When we first walked through the doors it seemed nice and clean. The man up front was very nice and helpful. We checked in fast. We got a suite with a King's bed and 2 pullout couches. There was plenty of room to move around in the two rooms and plenty of closet space. The little kitchen area is nice and the service is great.
A few complaints:
We found a couple of spiders in the room but had them taken care of.
The bathroom was quite small and did not have any drawers for my family's things.
The restraunt had weird hours. 5pm-11pm.
Overall we had a good taste of Denver.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Denver Cherry Creek

review_text: We always stay here if we have an early flight out of DIA. Good food, friendly staff and clean rooms.

review_title: Okay hotel - nothing bad - nothing great...
review_text:
... okay for a quick business trip...
Check-in was good - friendly and quick.
Room - I had an executive room which was very large, well equipped for a business traveler and very clean. Previous reviews mentioned that walls were paper thin, I didn't find this - except for the elevator noise (I was right next to it) which wasn't disturbing and the occasional voices in the hallway I didn't hear anything from the neighbouring rooms... And the hotel was full.
Restaurant - breakfast buffet, choice and price as well as quality was good. We had catered food at lunch and unfortunately it was terrible.
Service - very friendly and helpful staff - I had an issue with my room on the third night and they quickly moved me without a fuss.
Location - if you have a car it's okay but we didn't and this left us with little choice for good restaurants in walking distance. Black Eyed Pea across the road is actually very good - great comfort food!
Cost us about 92$ inc tip in cab from airport - we used a car service on the return and it was a flat fee 65$ + tip.
Overall - nothing bad - but just nothing to rave about either. The staff is the best thing going for this hotel.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Denver Cherry Creek

review_text: bed buds,drug addicts, rudeness,false advertising,over charging,dirty, nothing works, faulty wiring. Just stay away from here. The rates are WRONG, they have no posted rates so they charge what they want.

My husband & I decided to spend the night after a late night dinner out in Denver with friends, instead of driving back up north to our home in Loveland. We didn't want to spend the money on the high-dollar downtown hotels. I found this Marriott based on the location of our restaurant. What a pleasant surprise!! The lobby was clean & modern with a restaurant & bar that was actually still open past 10 pm! They have ice cold water infused with fruit in the lobby & a coffee bar. I also saw but did not use their business center also located in the lobby. 
The rooms were lovely, clean & while the bed was probably the hardest I've ever slept on, both my husband & I were amazed at how well we slept on it! They also offer free Internet access for 24 hours. While the bathroom was a bit small & tight, it really didn't matter much. There was also a coffee maker, mini-fridge, iron & ironing board in the room. There was also a flat screen TV. An extra added bonus that we had not requested was a view of the mountains. 
And while you cannot even comoare the location of this hotel with those downtown, I feel that for the price this was a fantastic value!
All in all we just fell in love with this hotel & will most definitely be back!
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Denver Cherry Creek

review_text: I was not impressed within properties appearance, service or location. It was one of the worst properties I've ever stayed at. It should be demolished.

review_title: Unsanitary conditions with condescending and rude ownership
review_text: I knew it was risky renting a room at a motel on the fly in a city center, but we were exhausted and needed a place to crash. For $55 a night, I knew it couldn't be beat, and I had my expectations set quite low for that price. Even with low expectations, I am disappointed. I was willing to forgive the owners condescending tone and casual saunter to our room when the key wouldn't work. I could have overlooked the dust covered room, old furniture, cigarette burned trays, and mildew covered shower curtain. But, when my partner woke up at 530 covered, literally covered, in bug bites, that was it. Luckily the motel does have WiFi so I was able to research what to do, but having just checked out this morning, we still are at a laundry washing and rewashing, and also spending $90 on new clothes so we don't take bed bugs back home with us. When I brought it to the owners attention, he did seem surprised and refunded our money, but please be wary.

The front desk personnel are incredibly rude, unprofessional, ill-mannered, unresponsive, and unaccommodating. The rooms are filthy, dusty, smelly, with multiple versions of bugs and when you complain you're asked to vacate on short notice. The general help does not speak english very well. It was not worth the $34.99 per night. I moved over to the Hampton Suites and Inn for $129.00 per night for quality. Would I recommend The Budget Host Inn?? Only to an enemy.

I was laying down and I just seen a bug crawling on me so I got up and told the dude i need a new room because there's bed bug. They was even on the Walsh I didn't see them at first. He got me another room and I seen another bug. I lifted back the sheets I didn't see any bugs until I looked at the seams of the mattress and that's where I seen the blood from the bugs. Its just gross it don't even look like they clean the tub. And there is holes everywhere. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE.

review_title: Great location and in the middle of lots of activities
review_text: Stayed here for 3 nts to start our vacation in Colorado. Great location near shopping centers, parks, zoo and highways. Clean, well managed hotel and very friendly staff. Rooms are a little tight, especially for four, but we managed.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Denver Cherry Creek

review_text: Arrived last night via Amtrak. Driver from hotel Wyatt came and got us. He was awesome. Great place from priceline. Can't beat their price. Room is huge with two sliders facing street so tons of fresh air. Lounge had food til ten. Had tapas and salad. Awesome. Good value too. Beds so comfy. Shower super flow! Front desk girl a bit of a dud but overall no complaints!

This motel is conveniently located near Mile High but the good stops there. The buildings are falling down, electrical code violations everywhere and the place appears to have never been cleaned. Resist the temptation to stay at the adjacent Ramada as it appeared just as mismanaged and dirty. The ramada staff are responsible for check in/out and appear to run this establishment. This reflects poorly on Ramada and I'm holding this visit against them.
hotel_name: Knights Inn Denver - Gateway to Downtown

review_text: Shower did not work after returning from gym. Upon checking out I informed front desk and the only response she could come up with is "do you need your statement?" What? No I needed a shower or some customer service. Never again.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Denver Cherry Creek

review_title: No help when animal was in hot car in their parking lot
review_text: When we returned to our room at the Marriott we noticed in the Marriott parking lot a dog in the back window of a car.The windows of the car were half way down and dog was panting. The sun was shining in the car and the temp. Today are 87-93 degrees and it was 6:05 p.m. This situation bothered me so I went to the front desk to ask for help for this dog. We talked to Eric at the front desk. He said he could not do anything for this dog even though the car was of their property. Eric said well the windows in the car are down. My husband and I called animal contol. We noticed the owner of car was the same guy that we seen in the bar as we went up to our room. Very dissappointed that Eric felt this dog was of no concern.we are platinum members with marriott. But this is the worst customer service I have ever dealt with when staying at marriott.I would of rather given customer service a 0 but 1 was the lowest.
hotel_name: Courtyard by Marriott Denver Cherry Creek

review_text: When a hotel is listed as 4.4 stars you don't expect dirty rooms, broken furniture, and old broken appliances in the "full suites".
Can't believe our work's travel company booked us a room here! We will be complaining on Monday. Avoid this place at all costs and stay nearer the city centre.

review_title: Great hotel but needs to offer free WI Fi in the rooms
review_text: Service is great, good value, but they need to get with the times and offer free WI Fi in the rooms.

I stay at this property around 20-25 nights a year. The staff is friendly and professional and many have been in place for longer than I have been staying with them.
They will start a full remodeling this fall and will move to the top tier in Denver when they finish.

review_title: Huge rooms would be great for a family of four!
review_text: We got a great deal on Priceline and were anxious to try this place out. When we checked in we asked and were upgraded to a room with view of downtown. The room we had was huge- living room, dining area, kitchen, bathroom and big bedroom! Definitely plenty of room for a family traveling with kids. Good location - not within walking distance of most things downtown, but the free shuttle was a huge plus. And it was only about a $7 cab ride from Coors Field on both nights we went to the game. A couple of weird things happened - the mirror in our room fell one night at about 12:30, and the bathroom sink would turn on by itself several times. And thus is in a residential area and we were awoken by car alarms one night and sirens the next. But other than all that we enjoyed our stay! Free parking is a nice touch and the lounge and restaurant looked nice.

review_title: Not where you think it is and old school all the way
review_text:
First this hotel is not in downtown Denver. Yes we could have checked a map, it was only one night, but clarity by hotel website would be useful. If you want to be downtown, don't stay here. 
While the hotel was sold out, be sure NOT to stay on the 2nd floor. The meeting rooms are on that floor so all the traffic, noise and clean up is heard in your room. And walls are thin, heard alarm clocks, coughing and hair dryers by neighbors on both sides. 
The TV required set up by maintenance staff. There was no signal from the satellite. 
The rooms may be been recently updated but looked very old school and dated. I am not a fan of sleeping w a bedspread that others have sat on, placed luggage on etc. I expect a separate blanket that has been washed or a triple sheet bed that keeps it fresh and clean near me. I don't know when the last time this bedspread was cleaned. The pillows are minis. Not even home size pillows. Don't get that. And in a day and age of Internet connection don't understand hotels who charge you for it. They do here. 
Overall the place is dated. We were here on a layover before a drive to Beaver Creek. Not a big deal for one night but would not come back or recommend to anyone.

Wretched rooms, smelly, black mold on tub. Bed was not flat, kept falling off side of the boxspring. Loud neighbors with tv on full blast for hours. Tv signal poor cause they use one cable box for 100 rooms. Unreasonable management. Too expensive unless you stay for the weekly rate. Many nicer motor inns nearby for same price if not less than the $50 per night charged

I booked this hotel after looking at the TripAdvidor rating. I was wrong. Checkin took some 30 minutes for me and my two coworkers. The guy at the front desk was confused and inept. Then finding the room was almost impossible due to the confusing room numbering and lack of signage.
You can make also a budget hotel like this inviting or at least value for money. This is neither. 
The room was dirty with some cuttings of computer cable in the middle of the floor. It was not possible to bolt the door. The bathroom mirror was cracked. The bed-lamp did not work since plug was not connected. And finally, the bed was badly creaking.
hotel_name: Homestead Studio Suites - Denver - Tech Center - North

review_title: Non-responsive management - loud unruly guests. Bad customer service
review_text:
I qualify for gold upgrades but they stuck me in a horrible room next to ultra loud folks and didn't move me. I only have a limited number of hours before a business meeting.
One of the worst Marriott experiences I've had.
We typically stay at Hilton hotels and Hampton is a great Place to stay when we are seeing sights like Beale street. This one was great; I have truly nothing negative to say.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text: Worst place I EVER stayed in my life, and I've traveled the world! Loud partying until 6 AM and the management does NOTHING about it. If you're going to spend money on a hotel, don't waste it here!

review_title: You get what you pay for
review_text: Would not recommend it to anyone, especially families.

Where to start,first of all you will never get a better value anywhere in Denver, believe me I know. The staff that I've dealt with the "ladies" are very nice & have always been acomadating to me and others that I have witnessed. There are obvious problems with hotel such as the smell,trash,and maintence issues which can be corrected by weeding out all staff that don't care & keep the ones that do. The guest that stay there are part responsible with their careless attitude,nasty habits,pets,people that destroy and vandalize the place. It makes a losing battle for the ones that are trying and do care. 
Yes I would stay there again, look for amie, heather,& Shayla with their smiles and professionalism.

review_title: Cheap renovation of dumpy old building trys to be chic and fails at hoteling but succeeds at being overpriced
review_text: Where do I begin with the litany of complaints I racked up after a week here? First the cheap carpeting in the rooms is just disgusting. Way overpriced for what you get. Renovation money obviously didn't make it to the bathroom. Total lack of detail in the renovation of this old building. Holes in the wall and poor room layout eg flat screen tv to the left of the bed and wardrobe in front of the bed? Would running power and cable 15ft to set up this room properly really have been that much of an expense? Speaking of power the console table converted into a desk right under the flat screen barely had room for my laptop and the two power outlets under it were in use for the tv and cable! A desk with no outlets?? Bed felt like a futon and the hotel is staffed by a bunch of hipster kids who lack refinement (um.. like really??) and any real experience. Then again they're barely out of high school so it's not really their fault. Housekeeping never replaced the items I consumed in the minibar either. Also no fitness center so you have to go a block away to another hotel to use theirs.

Per the description on expedia, there is a office center on every floor and a complimentary continental buffet every morning. How bout rather having to ask the check in desk to print your boarding pass for the airport and eating a smashed muffin (there was a little fruit but NOTHING ELSE) after you have to get your car our of the lot across the street THAT THEY RECOMMEND by 8am no matter what time you parked it the day before. Not ideal. Lovation is good but I wouldn't stay here again.

review_title: Teure Unterkunft - wenig und schlechter Service

review_text: The hotel has a bit of a funky smell, the location would be ok if it was for the round about, backwoods streets you have to take to actually get in to the hotel. There is no view. On the lighter side, the staff has been really nice and inviting.

The entire hotel smelled of cigarette, body odor and some mystery flavor to top it off! Inside our room, the trash had not been taken out from the previous residents, there were used towels, rags, and bar of soap lying around the bathroom, the carpets were bunched up from the floor, and there a lot of suspect people acting really shady around every corner of the hotel. We arrived at 3am in the morning, so we were too tired to go elsewhere and napped for just a couple of hours on top of the comforter outside of the blankets because c'mon now, if they can't empty a trash bin or swap out a rag, what are the chances they stripped the bed and gave it some clean sheets?? NOT WORTH IT EVEN IF THEY HAD PAID ME THE 35 BUCKS! We slept in my tiny civic the next night til we could arrange alternate accommodations!

review_title: Not worth the savings! And not worth five minutes of your time.
review_text:
Never again will I reserve a room here. The room was filthy (although the sheets did appear clean) everything else was noticeably dirty. My mom cut her leg on the bed, the area of town was sketchy, nothing about this hotel was worth a cheaper room. 
We checked out immediately and did NOT stay more than five minutes!

We ended up here for an event downtown which made it very easy to get to. There is a lot within walking distance. Pedestrian mall was fun. So much to do in such a close and accesible area. We loved the hotel. Staff was great. Very clean. Easy to check in. Easy to park. Parking is affordable. Would definitely return.

It's a newer hotel and service is slow and disorganized. A half hour to get a bottle opener? Twenty minutes to check in with no other customers? The staff should spend the night at the Four Seasons to see how to run a hotel.

review_title: Never will or want to stay in a place like that again!!!
review_text: This was the grossest place that I have ever stayed in that I had to write a review! First our feet were black from walking on the carpet in the room as if I had been walking barefoot for miles down the street. Secondly, my daughter whom is 17, was doing our laundry and had to sit there cuz she knew someone was going to come in and throw our stuff out to do theirs. As she is waiting for it to be done a guest walks in while smoking a joint asking her if she is using all the machines. Unbelievable!!!

review_title: If you need a cheap hotel with a clean bed and bathroom and nothing else this place is decent.
review_text:
incredibly old and gloomy, my friend said he felt like he was in the movie The Shinning because of the old elevator, very hot room and when I asked if they keep the hotel at set temperature they giggled (apparently in embarasment) and said "we can only do air or heat tomorrow might be air."
If you can overlook the asthetics in exchange for value the bed and bathrooms were clean.

I check out reviews and the hotels website pretty thoroughly before booking, but I honestly picked this one only because its distance/price to Coors Field. Highliight: The 16th street mall is an open air 'downtown' walkway with pretty much all the stores you can think of and the free reliable mall shuttle is right next to the hotel. It was perfect for our trip. We were put right next to elevator, but never heard it. Would go back again!

review_title: If I had to go to Baltimore again, I would stay here and never leave the hotel.
review_text: I wasn't impressed with Baltimore at all, but this hotel is what you would expect from a kimoton.

Second time staying here on business and love love love this hotel. Would also be great for a romantic getaway. Classic yet contemporary vibe, very lush rooms with amazing beds and baths. First stay, I had a huge walk-in shower. Most recent stay the room had a walk-in shower and step-up jaccuzzi tub - awesome after a day on the expo floor. Short wine service in lobby at night, followed by fresh chocolate chip cookies and milk. Comfortable walking distance to conv ctr, Inner Harbor and Camden Yards but they also rent bikes. Only warning is it can be a bit pricey so check their web site often for specials. One of my favorites from a self proclaimed hotel snob.

The hotel was a. Gem. Located in the heart of downtown near the sports arena, train station and great restaurants. Love the European feel was very stately. We came vfor a wedding with our 3 year old. She stayed on the couch with make sift bumpers while we slept in the bedroom. It was tight quarters but comfy and cozy. The hotel was in great shape and I recommend it.

review_title: A little gem in the heart of Denver
review_text: Awesome hotel within walking distance to the city center, restaurants and clubs. Complementary breakfast, wifi and awesome health club!!!!

Het hotel is dichtbij het centrum gelegen. Wij verbleven 4 nachten in het hotel. De kamers zijn schoon en ruim. Gratis internet werkte prima. Op de eerste nacht hadden we last van bouw activiteiten. Nadat dit gemeld was bij de receptie kregen we direct een andere kamer aangeboden, perfect!
Parkeren was een probleem in de buurt. Valet parking werkte goed maar vonden wij veel te duur!

review_title: Don't plan on using the bathrooms, awful.
review_text: After driving almost half way across the country we made our destination in Denver for some fun , real food and comfort. We walked in and it smelled like cookies, very inviting. The front desk mentioned that we were getting a newly renovated bathroom and that we would love it ! I went to take a shower and stood in it freezing with ice cold water waiting for it to warm and to cold to flee. After 10 min I opted for Luke warm water just to get it over with. My partner then had to also take a cold shower and stand in my dirty water as it would not drain any water what so ever. The shower was then cut even shorter because it started to over flow. I called down to the front desk and politely explained and all that she offered was to send a technician into our room. I explained that the last thing we wanted was an employee in our room and asked if we could switch and was told we could not. That night we returned from dinner and called room service and once again received the front desk as "room service was busy" and they would call back. Two calls and an hour later the front desk said they had confirmed they would call us back and finally connected us after an hour. In the morning I took a 1 min ice cold shower and it still did not ever warm and overflowed into the bathroom. Upon checkout they asked how our stay was and we explained and they gave very little understanding and we paid full price for a non working bathroom. I might also mention that the toilet had fragments that lingered in the bottom even after multiple flushes. I would NEVER stay here again and after reading the other reviews about all of the issues I would not suggest anyone else to stay there either.

I stayed here last November and was amazed at the beauty and cleanliness of this hotel...the location is ok and close to inner harbor walking wise...the room was spotless and beautiful....I didn't have much interaction with the staff other than check in which went fine..their restaurant was delicious! It is pricey a bit but not extreme! I would have stayed there again this year but they increased their prices per nite so its not affordable for us....I would definitely recommend.

How amazing it is to have a hotel chain that actually goes out of their way to accommodate guests with pets. How liberating it is to walk freely in a hotel and not feel gawking eyes and flaring attitudes. 
The hotel staff is friendly and always happy to assist no matter the request. The room decor is well done with vibrant and balanced colors. Room is clean, decent size and done in a contempary manner with nice size bathroom. The place is rather well maintained. No worn out carpets, no fraying curtains no shabby torn wallpaper. This hotel does it right and really fits the bill of what you expect at a "Boutique hotel" 
Whether you travel with your pet or not, the important thing is this hotel is a great spot to stay at. I know my dog had a good time. The dog bed and treats she got during her stay had me wondering when I may find myself at another Kimpton property again with my beloved pet.

review_title: The name says it all! Best name I've ever heard!
review_text:
The name alone makes this awesome!
I suggest reading the title as I wouldn't want to get into it as much but for a motel it had everything a motel would want. 
Better than a motel 6 for sure though.
Great staff. Yummy breakfast. Clean rooms. Free shuttle. Next to Denver merchandise mart at crossroads of 70 and 25.

review_title: good value for road trip i Denver but not recommend for those do not drive
review_text:
We booked a 5 days double room in Denver for a conference. Here are my comments for Econo Lodge Downtown.
+: extrememly good values with ~$65 for a night. room is equiped with standard stuffs for short term stay in. space is acceptable, we went to Denver with 4luggages and the room still have spaces for walking around. Bathroom is big enough, look and feel is more than expected for a budget motel. Front desk is helpful. Breakfast was provided
-:15mins walking to Downtown, quite a number of homeless around the hotel, not so good for traveller who need to walk to the downtown , 16th st mall, convention center. Breakfast is provided but limitted to few options (since it is motel so we did not expect much from this).

Very near to 16th Street Mall and the central museums. Neighbourhood was absolutely fine. 
Our room was very large and clean although it smelt of stale smoke as did the rest of the hotel. At first I was dubious but the place was actually very safe and clean. The showers were difficult to figure out but did have hot water if you turned it all the way and then back to 8 o'clock. 
There seem to be lots of people living there but we never had any trouble at all and the staff were as attentive as a normal hotel.
It was fine for us as we were out during the day. It isn't perfect but it's central, safe and very good value.

review_title: A little dated and a few bugs.
review_text: Had over night stay for business meeting at the hotel. Check in was uneventful. Room was a bit small, furniture ok but really mothing special. Bathroom was small and dated. In fact, despite a new tv and desk, the rest of the accomdations seemed dated. Had room service for a late dinner which was ok-had a steak and at my request, they made obvious effort to bring it up quick so as not to get cold. What really dragged my opinion down occurred the next morning at my meeting where they had coffee and mini breakfast. Lost my appetite when I saw 2 roaches crawling on the wheeled cart which made me think they came from kitchen. Regardless, not a good thing.

review_title: Perfect Stay for Conference and Fun
review_text: Stayed at the Monaco for a conference at the convention center and a couple extra days to see Baltimore. Really great service by all the staff. Pet goldfish to keep me company in a lovely room on the top floor was a great touch. The stylish room was very comfortable and kept perfectly clean during my 8 days there late checkout on the last day was easy to arrange. Entire hotel was beautifully decorated and happy hour wine tastings were fabulous. Would stay again anytime.

Was a little worried when we arrived as far away from downtown. Staff were really helpful and they even have a free shuttle bus. We used this many times to 16th street mall and other attractions! Very helpful when you have no car. 
Manager very helpful and Michael at front desk
Would stay here again

Three elevators, two elevators, then one elevator ....kept breaking...group of people got stuck on elevators!!! Told one price then when we arrived told another price...ice machines busted..staff wash/dryers busted so used the patrons....breakfast horrible.......window kept on track by piece of metal....gave room key to some guy walked in on kids ... do not stay here RUN!!!!! Staff seemed polite, ,,you can tell their hands are tied...feel sorry for the maids......

Great location as it's just minutes from 16th mall. But that's about it really. Rooms are pretty poor equipped, no mini bar or mini fridge in rooms. Thats quiet annoying. 
Other wise comfy beds, nice shower and great tv service. Staff are pretty nice and helpful.

review_title: Excellent Hotel service and good value for money
review_text: It was pleasant stay at quality inn with exellent service.I liked their free hot breakfast, great shuttle service. I had here before but it is dramatic change under new ownership and management. Great job. We enjoyed our stay and congratulate on new face of hotel. I definitely be back for sure!

Goed hotel, ruime kamer, lekkere bedden! Het ontbijt is erg uitgebreid met vers fruit, ei, ham, wafels etc. Het personeel is vriendelijk en helpt je graag! Het zwembad is okÃ© en lekker om even af te koelen! Echte aanrader!

Op het eerste gezicht leek dit hotel nog oud en minder comfortabel, maar de check in verliep soepel en de kamer is echt heel groot. Zwembad is goed en het is slechts een klein stukje naar het centrum van Denver. 
Helaas hadden wij geen koelkast, maar na een vraag hierover aan de receptie, stond er later een in de kamer. Top service dus!

review_title: Only stay here for football games.
review_text: This hotel is fine, the people are nice, and the location is literally in the Bronco's football stadium parking lot. It's OK to grill out and tailgate. The hotel is old and a bit of a dump - but the location is great. I paid $175 for one night - less than a football ticket!

Rooms were clean, staff friendly. Breakfast was good as well. TV outdated and channels limited. Internet is terrible. Called the help line and they were going to look into it and call back - no call and net signal kept dropping out. If you need Internet stay elsewhere.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Denver - Cherry Creek

review_title: Great customer service and in the most convenient location for sports fans.
review_text: I found this hotel online. It's location is extremely easy to get to right off the freeway. The front desk people are very courteous, hard working and intelligent. I enjoyed my stay there. Though I am not a sports fan the place is absolutely perfect for anyone going to a bronco's game since you can literally walk out the door and see the huge stadium right in front of you. It seems like it would be the place to stay. There is a sports bar upstairs on the 14 th floor and a printer in the business area. When staying there they helped me send out an important fax and scanned a document for me! Awesome place. Excellent value. I recommend this hotel.

I actually stayed here twice in one week. I gamble on Hotwire and I won this for the accommodations on my trip. Has nice Lobby bar and an expensive breakfast buffet dining room. The workout room is spacious enough that more than one person can workout with out having to endur another person in their personal space. 
If you are driving a big car. The parking garages are a nightmare!! Very tight. 
The room was clean enough. It is in that quasi updated look. New bedding. Old furniture. The age shows in the hallways - they really need to get new carpeting.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Denver - Cherry Creek

review_text:
Very old rooms
Dirty old carpet 
Very small 
Difficult parking
Should qualify as a 2 star at the most
Disappointed in quality for price
Would not recommend
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Denver - Cherry Creek

review_text: This is an older hotel that has been remodeled in the lobby. Very nice to walk into, now it is time to remodel the rooms. Please start with beds! I haven't seen an olive green and gold striped mattress since the 70's! The beds are cheap, thin and uncomfortable! I loved the hotel being round and the location is amazing! It does need some TLC to make it as amazing as the location. If you remodel it they will come! The hotel staff is very friendly and willing to help.

Well about 3 am the entire hallway on the ninth floor reeked of marijuana, although its a no smoking facility. Prior to that there were many people outside smoking pot in front of the hotel check in:( then when people ordered room service their dishes literally sat outside the room all day, and I saw workers up there just pass it by up until 9 pm that night. Disgusting! the entire hotel past the front desk was gross, apparently they do not have cleaning services, or the hotel employees are just too lazy.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Select Denver - Cherry Creek

review_text: I stayed in his hotel over labor day and attempted to do the Elitch Gardens packet. We found out the tickets were not valid that weekend after confirming it with them. Needless to say they gave us a great rate so we could still go do something or even go to Elitch with how much they saved us. I will stay there each time I go to Denver!

This motel is dated, but it is one of the cleanest places at which we have ever stayed. the location is within walking distance of downtown Denver. It was quiet and has free wifi in the rooms. There are no bell hops or concierge service. If you are self reliant and don't need atmosphere this place is for you. The price is right.
Do not stay here! Save your money and go somewhere else. Bad area, smoky halls and rooms, food is horrible!

I had a good stay at this courtyard which is what I have come to expect of this hotel. Staff was very friendly and the rooms were comfortable and clean. My only complaint would be that it is tricky to get to even though it is right off the freeway. No big deal though and I will stay here again.

Located on Colfax Ave,which is the main street for sightseeing but this is at the slightly rougher end so be wary at night. Great location for every kind of fast food 24/7,although we liked Tom's diner a couple of blocks closer to the centre.
Walking half a mile or so down the street will bring you to the Capitol District which then leads to 16th st mall and LoDo. We like to walk everywhere but it was accessible by bus and there was a free shuttle from the hotel to anywhere within a 3 mile radius (collection too). From the airport bus,you can get off at 30th and Downing and get a free transfer on the no12 bus to opposite the hotel,very easy.
Rooms were clean,comfortable and nicely decorated. The lift was slow but we were only one floor up so used the stairs. Restaurant was mid-priced but there were plenty of places within easy walking distance. Likewise there was a 7/11 and a drugstore a block away for drinks and snacks.

review_title: Really great hotel for the money
review_text:
This is the second year that I have stayed in this hotel. The staff bend over backwards to help. One night the shuttle was out and Jason refunded the cost of a taxi into the city centre. He didn't have to do this but it's this kind of little touch that would have me recommend this hotel to all. So what if it needs a lick of paint here and there. It's great value for money and in a decent location.
And as for Denver...one of the best cities in the USA in my opinion

review_title: Don't Let The Lobby Fool You
review_text: Stayed here with family over thanksgiving. The location is confusing to get to and almost everyone missed it the first time. When you walk in the lobby looks really nice and clean and new. The front desk staff was very friendly and helpful. But, when we entered the hotel from the side door to go to our room the place smelled like cigarettes and looked dingy and run down. Our room was small and had two full sized beds, not queens as expected. TV remote did not work. The pillows were old and very lumpy. The hot water took 5-10 minutes to get hot. Breakfast buffet was pretty good. Tasty fresh pineapple and other fruit, but one morning we found spots in the eggs that looked a lot like mold. Overall service great, overall hotel not so great.

Enjoyed the hotel as a place to rest my head after being out all day. Clean rooms, well situated to major routes and happy with the service. Only downside is the train which honks its horn 2 times or so in the night.

I stayed by myself in a huge room with a giant bed and a patio. The room was a bit dated, but had everything I needed and the bed was very comfy. It was very noisy in the corridor until about 3 am because a lot of people were coming back from clubs and concerts. The desk staff were very nice and the location was ideal. Nothing wrong with the neighbourhood as far as I could tell.

review_title: Best customer service of any hotel at which I have stayed !
review_text:
Total commitment to quality customer service. 
Staff is very friendly and willing to help in any way.
Restaurant is outstanding.

I did not feel safe at this hotel. The lighting in the parkinglot is very poor. I stayed for work and was there three day and the gym was very, very bad. Cheap, unsturdy treadmills. No room to move in the weight area. If fitness is important, this is not for you.

21.f. A friend and I stayed in a king suite for a night while passing through. About 15 minute drive to downtown Denver! Impressed with the room for the price ranges. Is pretty quiet at night. So if you're looking for an affordable, quiet, and nice place to stay right outside of downtown, I would recommend!

My fiancee and I stayed here two nights in a row. We had no problems with check in or check out. The staff I saw was friendly for the most part, one woman seemed bothered by my asking questions. Our room was comfortable, we loved the bed! The a/c unit wasnt great but it wad okay. The location was perfect too. Overall, we enjoyed our stay here and will stay here again!

Our family had a wonderful stay at this hotel. Everything was incredible from the front desk personnel to the clean swimming pool and hot tub to the evening manager's reception! There was something for all age groups. The rooms were clean and the staff was exceptionally helpful. This is an older embassy suites but an incredibly charming one close to several majors highways in the Denver metro area.

review_title: Excellent location with great food and wonderful customer service
review_text: The customer service is excellent. Great rate that includes a full breakfast buffet. I will stay here any time I come back

review_title: The staff was amazing but the hotel was old and the ac could not cool the room adequately.
review_text: We were disappointed in the facility. The staff was exactly what we have come to expect from embassy and they deserve a facility that matches their commitment to outstanding service. We could not get passed the location and condition of the hotel. The maintenance person checked our ac unit and found nothing wrong but the room never cooled down adequately.

review_title: It's not like it used to be..
review_text:
I have been staying at this particular property for almost 3 years. Collectively I have spent close to 45 days in this hotel during that time. I have seen the remodel and a few changes over that time. 
I recently returned to Denver after a one year hiatus from the city due to work. I got two rooms for our group 171 and 165. 
171 is a king room - it has a huge gash in the door and a broken door handle. That doesn't bug me - but what did bug me was the bathroom floor - it had some weird, questionable stains. Didn't know if it was clean or not. Also to be mentioned the carpet in the room is dirty. Not just debris dirty but mud ground in dirty. The saddest part of the room was simply the fact the TV was worn out. The picture couldn't stay put in the tube- it would wiggle and make some interesting electronic noises. 
165- remarkably different story. Cleaner for sure, everything was working. One major issue was the smell- unless the AC was on there was a modly odor that overtook the room. Its hard to explain, but it does stop you in your tracks once you walk into the room. 
Otter facilities in the hotel are good. Outdoor pool and excercise rooms are all great. Breakfast is interesting with some odd eggs but fun instant pancake maker. 
Overall I think that the hotel needs a bit of preventative maintenance and a deep clean. We all mentioned this to two different desk clerks who just blindly didn't akwnoledge the issues and continued on with their duties. I can not recommend this hotel strictly based on the wide variety of differences in room quality and cleanliness.
Tower road is the closest to the airport. Checked in and checked in for early morning flight on computer in lobby. Room was fine. Price was great for a short night before flight home.
hotel_name: Days Inn & Suites DIA-Denver International Airport

review_text: A decent hotel with terrible service. Don't count on the shuttle to take you or pick you up. Was given the wrong information twice. Given your other options take one of those.

Nicely appointed. Large comfortable rooms and beds. Even a microwave in the room. Friendly and accommodating service. Great value. The only slight negative would be the bar/restaurant who serves rather uninspired food.
Cook to order breakfast was great, the staff was very helpful and the hotel itself was very nice.

Huge Marriott and conference center. Nice hotel and amenities are very good (pool, gym) and the bar is good. They have bison on the menu. 
If you have business in the tech center area, stay here.

review_title: This was the worst hotel experience I've ever had. We had a reservation but the hotel overbooked.
review_text: After throwing a huge fit in the lobby, they miraculously found us a room. Absolutely terrible stay. They had electrical problems and jackhammered outside rooms at 2am to repair power outage. We had no electricity for 12 hours and it was 95 degrees outside. Restaurant was understaffed. Lots of disgruntled guests during our stay.

review_title: Great place to stay if u have an early am flight!
review_text: This is one of the newer Hampton Inns I have stayed in. It was very clean & the staff was very helpful.

review_title: Great place to park your car
review_text: I love the park stay and fly rate. It is convenient and with 24 hour shuttle service it works for any out if town travler

Overall this hotel was good. The location, free shuttle service, free wifi and breakfast made this a great deal. The only problem was the hotel was crowded and if going for breakfast close to 9 there were long lines for the food and limited seating.
