review_title: Nice hotel, convenient for airport service
review_text:
Location- we stayed here due to the location to the airport and the 24 HR free shuttle service. We got in late, took the shuttle in the am back to the airport and got our rental car, saved a day.
Room-was a good size room, clean and spacious. No fridge in room.
No free breakfast like the holiday inn express. They have a restaurant/bar at this location.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Hotel & Suites Denver Airport

review_text: This place was wonderful!!! Although out of town it was just so relaxing!!! The room service was some of the best I have ever had!!! It was warm, fast and tasted delicious! Loved the neutrogena toiletries and the pantry they offered! Will stay again when I return!
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Denver Tech Center

review_title: Near airport and highway which is good for business and casual traveler.
review_text: A paper at your door in the a.m. And coffee in the room. Pet friendly. Spacious property. Bar and restaurant for stay in convenience. Ample, plush linens. Breakfast and happy hour: ES staples. Gracious staff.

Other than the construction that precludes an afternoon nap, it's a fabulous hotel! Great apartment like rooms for a great value! The rooms are lovely and the cleaning service is thorough. Just check if they're still under construction if you're planning a visit. And don't count on the pool, it's tiny.

I rate the service I was provided a 10 out of 10. Miss KRISTY went out her way to make the stay by me and my group a memorable one. THANK YOU MISS KRISTY! I wish they all had the deduction and understanding you showed me and my group.
Wonderful hotel perfectly situated in beautiful Boston near great shopping and train stations. Big rooms, very clean and super friendly and helpful staff. Cannot wait to return

review_title: Best Quality Inn I've ever stayed at!
review_text: My stay was highlighted by an excellent room, outstanding customer service, and perfect location. I had a well furnished over sized super clean room. Check in literally took less than 2 minutes. I had to leave early so I don't know about breakfast. Wifi works great and plenty of tv choices on a nice sized flat panel. Will happily return!
hotel_name: Quality Inn & Suites Denver International Airport

review_text: The service is so amazing and the employees are always so nice here i love going there i would stay anywhere else

review_title: Nice hotel. Not close to airport.
review_text: This property has an airport shuttle but it is a long drive. Shuttle also has a regular sched for local shopping. Room was clean. Lots of linens. Great pillows. Not a fan of the heating system with no thermostat but overall a good stay. Bartender was very nice.
Older hotel, but the service is great and the sleep number beds are awesome. I sleep better here than any other hotel.

I stay here several times a month for my job and definitely feel it's the best value hotel near the airport. Quiet, clean, spacious rooms and a free breakfast in the morning. Usually eggs, bacon, sausage, etc. In addition to the standard cereal and toast kinda stuff. The van runs like clockwork every twenty minutes to the airport so not a lot of time wasted waiting around.
hotel_name: Quality Inn & Suites Denver International Airport

review_text: Breakfast buffet is mediocre and the service at the bar sucks! Front desk was helpful, as well as concierge and yheir shuttles. Shopping center close by and bus stops conveniently located. The hotel itself was decent.

First trip to Boston, on a college search. Took along the entire gang.
The Lenox is in the heart of everything. Walking distance to all. We only paid for a cab one night and the car never left the garage.
The staff is beyond excellent. Warm smiles, great conversationists, eager to please, this really made our stay so comfortable. They gave us a room upgrade because it was available and they thought it would be nice to have the extra space. My 7th old was greeted with a stuffed animal as soon as we arrived. Made his day and he took it everywhere we went. The conceirge Nina was the best I've encountered thus far. 
Reservations were taken care of everynight and she is very good at her job. Snacks for the road trip home and another friend for my 7 yr old sealed the deal.
In the end this was the best hotel experience ever. Fantastic job.

We had a great stay at the best Holiday Inn we have found. Clean comfortable rooms, wi-fi, great beds, and a big deck off the room. 
Great views of downtown also. 
We will return.

Myself & 2 friends recently stayed at this hotel. What a fabulous place to stay. From the moment we arrived we felt at home. Reception staff are friendly and so helpful. The room was large enough we didn't feel like we were sitting on top of each other and so cozy. The shower was lovely especially after a long day travelling/sightseeing. The location is ideal, centred to mostly everything we wanted to see. I fell in love with Boston and this hotel, would stay there again and would recommend to others!

review_title: Best hotel and location to everything on this side of town.
review_text: Really like the renovations and the staff is always warm and friendly. Tracy was amazing and helped my wife with some tips for her plans for the local area. The new Perks Coffee shop is super nice with expanded selections and great for grab and go. Will definitely be back.

I have stayed at the Hyatt two times and was impressed with the service, the clean rooms and the amenities. It is perfect for a work conference but far away from the downtown area and the airport. I do like this hotel and recommend it for conferences or work trips requiring proximity to the Tech Center.

The hotel is slightly more outdated than typical Hilton properties, but still a comfortable stay. bathrooms are a little on the small side. lots of food choices on the property, and more a few blocks North and South. free shuttle service to and from DIA is nice.

I was there for my family reunion for 3 days. This was a nice hotel with a good location. But it was a little outdated & the vents and fans did need some dusting. I did enjoy the sleep number bed but not all rooms have them. The shuttle was right on time & free. Overall our family did enjoy out stay.

review_title: Wish I could have stayed longer!
review_text: I stayed here because I missed my flight in Denver. I arrived about 8pm and left @ 6am. The lobby had an upscale, hip vibe which I would not expect from a Springhill Suites. My room had 2 queens, very comfortable with nice linens. The living room area was nicely decorated and spacious. There were even 2 closets in the suite! Internet service was complimentary. Breakfast was also included and began @ 5am to accommodate guests with early flights. Seemed like a broader selection than usually offered @ free breakfast chains. My standard of measure? Hot oatmeal with walnuts, brown sugar and raisins!

We chose this hotel because of its proximity to family. We would definetly return in the future. From the warm and friendly welcome upon our arrival to the delicious breakfast buffet this hotel ranks up there with some of the best. 
There was a gigantic Halloween party Sat night and they were ahead of any possible problem, from removing glasses from rooms to giving us complimentary valet parking. We were on the 11 th floor and were not aware of any noise, when we went to breakfast the next morning there was no evidence of any party the previous night. When I think of proper training of service providers at hotels I will recall the employees at this Hyatt.

review_title: Friendly, helpful staff, well maintained facilities.
review_text: Was there for a conference and stayed for 3 nights. Very good experience but that's partially because I didn't have to leave the hotel. Unsure if the hotel is accessible by public transit.

review_title: Poor Service kills otherwise acceptable hotel.
review_text: Selected this hotel to be near Dicks Sporting Goods complex. Nit the most scenic part of Denver but you don't have much choice if you want to be near the sports complex. Booked two rooms requested adjoining. Poor service started with check in. Took twenty mintues for the front desk to look through a book to find adjoining rooms. Got to the rooms and the locks on the doors between the rooms was broken. Three phones calls, three promises to fix it and 24 hours yielded nothing. Gave up and accepted they were not going to do anything about it. A good enough hotel for what I was there for but the poor service killed the hotel for me.

review_title: Great stay. We will be back.
review_text:
We stayed 1 night while passing through town. Check- in couldnt have been any quicker or easier. The staff throughout the entire hotel was great, and we loved the Starbucks in the lobby. 
The room was fantastic. Clean, great beds, and quiet. The view was also nice. We will, without a doubt, be back next time we're in Denver.

Stayed for 2 nights as part of a conference. Staff were good. The initial allocated room however looked out onto a big grey steel shed, however within a few minutes of requesting a change was moved to the 9th floor with views to the mountains in far distance. The food during the conference was excellent, healthy and varied. It cost 22 dollars direct from the airport via the shuttle and the hotel did a good pick up and drop off service to the local shopping mall which has an Apple Store ;)
The gym got busy at 6am but had a good variety of equipment and the pool and hot tub were tempting. 
Would definitely stay there again.
Like the atmosphere in the lobby and rooms. The meal and drink prices are a little steep

Family four (2 kids 8 &11) great location especially with kids in tow. One street back from Newbury St (shopping and restaurants) next door to lordTaylor and Saks (prudential centre) shopping an Duck Tours, walking distance to Fenway (red sox) and Boston common ( freedom walk tours). You are out of the touristy part of fanueli hall etc. Breakfast in the restaurant lively and about on par price wise with other restaurants... Tip not alot of places open for breakfast this end of town except for Starbucks an the like. Service very peppy, turn down service with chocolates. No coffee or tea making in room but in lobby. That and lack of hooks in bathroom and no laundry facilities only downside a bit petty and not really worth mentioning!
Great location downtown Denver nice rooms would recommend I would try to stay in the tower above lobby as tower accross street is a bit away

Nice enough hotel, but this is dated, depressing and as neutral... Bland and "Up in the air" as it gets... 
Please get me out of the mediocrity...!!!

We stayed at The Lenox for my wife's 40th birthday and our first trip to Boston. Upon our arrival check in was easy as they accomodated our request for an early check in. 
The hotel is very nice and the entire building was immaculate. When we entered our room (junior suite) there was a birthday card from the staff with a complimentary bottle of wine. I must have mentioned the reason for our trip when making the reservation and they obviously ran with it. Since we were eager to see the city we dropped our bags and immediately headed out. The concieerge and front desk staff were incredibly helpful with directions, maps, reservations, anything we asked they took care of. 
When we arrived back at the room later that night we started to settle in but noticed the stale smell of cigarettes. We grabbed someone from the housekeeping staff and asked for a spray air freshener. They apologized for the smoke (and yes it is a non-smoking hotel) and freshened the room. We said no big deal and thanked them. Five minutes later the phone rang, they apologized again and said that Vincent the bellman will be up shortly to move us to another room. We said it was fine but they insisted. Needless to say, we were quickly relocated to another junior suite. 
All in all, the customer service was out of this world. The location was perfect with easy access to the T, shopping, restaurants and more. The rooms were large and comfortable for the most part, but I can't help but think that the staff is what really made our stay fantastic. Kudos to the entire group, we will definitely return on our next trip to Boston.

I stayed for 3 nights & checked in early to a large, well appointed room. Unknowingly had chosen "pick your perk" option which allowed 20$ food & beverage credit + another "perk" ranging from fruit & cheese platter, discount massage or a bottle of Robert Mondavi Canvas (bottled for Hyatt) Was in Denver for a graduation @ DU & super friendly & helpful bellman/guest services gents drove me via courtesy car even though it was out of the usual range. 
Gym was adequate & the cold towels (should chill water, too) & headphones were a nice touch. It was a little warm as gym is part if indoor pool/hot tub area. 
The Cafe offered "Hyatt Stay Fit" options that were tasty: buckwheat waffle & goat cheese/pear sandwich were great. Cafe was closed often for lunch/dinner & Garrity's had standard pub fare & Happy Hour specials. Drinks were on the expensive side, but staff was friendly & the salmon dinner was good & healthy. 
The coffee shop offered non processed foods, smoothies, fruit & nice options (MALT sandwich is lovely) even carrying my favorite coconut water. Having a refrigerator in room was helpful for leftovers & to keep water cool.
All staff were friendly, accommodating & cheerful. There were two weddings my last night there and the only noise I heard on 7th floor was a poor tipsy fellow who kept trying to get into my room mistakenly. 
I would stay here again on future trips. The RTD light rail is a short walk away, courtesy shuttle & Hertz rent a car on site. Particularly good choice for health conscious, fitness oriented travel.

review_title:
I would never go
Back to the hyatt!EVER!!!
review_text:
When I made reservations at the hyatt i was verry excited about the looks of it. I travelled from St.Loius and was planning on staying there for one night there was a convention
In town and many peopple were attendending it. So I rellied on this hotel to give me a place to stay. When i got there they told me they had given my room to someone I was furious had no place to stay and Had already payed a deposite! I ended up staying in a low class motel but that i would overall rate so much better!

review_title: Good, convenient, if undifferentiated large hotel
review_text: This is a large, relatively undifferentiated hotel, well located in the heart of downtown on the main shopping street. It is quite acceptable and comfortable, if unmemorable. It is particularly convenient for events in the conference centre to which it is attached. By the way, it's no fault of the hotel, but the conference center itself is a confusing rabbit-warren. Get clear directions from the concierge if that's your destination!

My family went up to Denver for the weekend and we stayed at the Hyatt at the DTC it was one of the best trips we had in Denver . We did not leave the rooms much they had so much stuff to do there. Next time we go back we will make sure to stay there. I would like to thank them for a great weekend.

review_title: Best hotel I've stayed at, very good cost
review_text:
This hotel was great! Very clean and pretty. It had just been renovated, so everything looked new. Coffee shop and gift shop were useful. Very quiet, mostly business men. Little far from downtown, but worth it for the quietness and peace off mind.
All in all, would recommend to anyone and stay again.

Spent 4 nights at a convention and the Sheraton surpassed expectations. The staff was extremely helpful, room twice the size as the average hotel, bed and bedding fabulous, very clean and when there were minor problems (light out) they were quickly fixed. Enjoyed the very large fitness center as well. Except for a light shower and food that was just okay, it was a nearly perfect stay in a perfect downtown location.

review_title: A bit overwhelmed by a huge convention
review_text: Once the chaotic checkin was over and we finally (after 3) got our room we discovered that we had been upgraded to a suite for no discernible reason. It was huge, immaculate and super comfortable. The bathroom was not luxurious and the amenities basic but all worked well and the shower didn't require an advanced engineering degree. Well located and definitely built for a crowd this a a good convention facility lacking intimacy and charm but efficient and user friendly.

L'hotel Ã¨ pulito e le stanze sono belle e spaziose, il personale gentile e disponibile. Purtroppo perÃ² le finestre non isolano dal rumore fortissimo fatto dall'impianto di condizionamento dell'albergo, posto al piano terra, molto fastidioso per dormire, perfino se eravamo al settimo piano. Non oso pensare per chi capiti al secondo o terzo piano. Suppongo che altre colonne non abbiano questo problema.

We spent the last night of our vacation here before flying back to the UK. The welcome was half hearted, the bathroom sink wouldn't empty, the bath wouldn't fill and the lock on my daughters door stuck so we had to call maintenance, I realise that stuff happens but as these prices.... We stayed at a hotel half the price on the way out and it was twice as good. The location on 16th street Mall doesn't justify the attitude.
Right out the door is 16th street which has numerous shops and restaurants. Free bus transportation along the way which gets you quickly to your destination. Highly recommended.

review_title: Great place to stay in Boston
review_text: The staff is so kind and very helpful. The location is great. We took subway to Fenway Park and walked to the North End and harbour area. The shopping is incredible, dozens of stores within 5 minutes of hotel. Can't wait to stay here again!

review_title: Ok hotel but I expected more
review_text: The hotel was ok but compared to most westin's I have stayed in, this one seemed very dated. The bathrooms were clean but not very nice. The room had a musty smell & the air conditioner did not work well. The pillows & bed were disappointing. I did order breakfast in the room & it came right in time & was very good.

review_title: Parking a nightmare. Wifi a joke.
review_text:
Wifi in guest room wouldn't connect. Front desk sent an 'engineer' to our room to see if I was just too stupid to figure out the problem. Engineer shrugged his shoulders and said maybe it was because I had an iPad and they weren't used to seeing those. Really!?!!! 
We had early morning appts both days of our stay. When we tried to leave the underground parking lot, the validation card wouldn't open the gate. On the first day, service call button was answered and attendant let us leave garage. The second morning, no one answered call and we had to walk out of garage and ask valet if we could exit thru restricted valet exit. This process took 30 minutes- just to drive out of hotel.

We stumbled upon the black olive inn when coming to baltimore for a concert. The staff are so friendly, everyone is awesome. The room that we had was spacious, clean and had a good view. We were able to walk to attractions and restaurants. We had our service dog with us, and the inn accommodated every need for her. It was one of the best places we've stayed at, we will tell our friends about it and we will definitely be back in the future.

review_title: No hot water and it comes with attitude.
review_text: Lovely hotel. Great location. No hot water. Ok it happens. But how you deal with it is everything. We got disinterest and a rude response. No offer to help or provide some recompense. Had to debate with the front desk manger to get any attention. Refused to refund any of the rate or offer anything. I literally had to argue my way into having them pay for lunch. Stay elsewhere unless you are looking for disrespectful and uninterested staff.

Nice hotel with a great location. The room was good, I loved the bed. The only issues I had were self parking cost $24/day, wireless internet was $11/day I thought that was a little steep. This may be no fault of the hotels but my verizon cell phone service was poor in my room, I had to literally sit in the windowsill to carry on a phone conversation.

Great hotel and I really like that the bar/restaurant called the Yard House is attached to the hotel. Great TV's in there for watching sports and the beer and service at the Yard House is even better. Nice combo to set this hotel apart from others.

review_title: This place is a rip off!!!
review_text:
I previewed a ton of hotels before choosing the Intercontinental soley based on pictures. For 200 dollars a night I thought for sure it would be a very comfortable place to stay for one night. I really looked forward to using the jetted tub as shown on line. I also paid extra for valet service. The moment we pulled up and checked in the valet "suggested" we park ourselves if we were just bringing our stuff in then going out. We had to pay 8 extra dollars on top of what we already paid for parking. When we went to our room the "floor to ceiling" windows looked rigt out onto a courtyard and everyother room. No sight of the harbor seen. The bathroom was small, no jetted tub, and no water pressure either. The towles had holes in them! The mini bar was locked with only complimentary tea and coffee, but no instructions on how to use the coffee maker. The bedroom furniture was tiny compared to the room size. The dust was four inches thick behind the headboard, yuk! The night stand was chipped and worn. The tv is
 small and the reception was poor. I asked the front desk for a password to use wifi, and the clerk was pretentious in telling me it was 12.95 a device per night to use! You've got to be kidding me. I could have paid half the price for a room at the Holiday Inn and would have had free wifi and some vending machines atleast! This place is not worth than money, and the pictures online are terribly deceptive. I will never stay here again, and would not recommend this place to anyone but my worst enemy!

My wife and I started staying at the Intercontinental Baltimore about six years ago in conjunction with visits to Johns Hopkins University Hospital. There is a discount for JHU visitors. We lucked into a free upgrade to a junior suite overlooking the inner harbor and it has been a favorite. Pet friendly. The staff has been great from the doormen to room service. Even pre-checkin has been great with Zorbey on our last reservation. You have to work it a bit to speak to a reservation person in Baltimore as the standard response is to transfer to some central reservation service.

Stayed a couple of nights and enjoyed the atmosphere in the hotel. We enjoyed the food and the surroundings. Rooms were large and airy, also relatively quite for such a central location. The downside are the bathrooms which, although clean, definitely need to be upgraded.

Stayed here for 2 nights while in town for the Rock n' Roll Marathon. Was very convenient to the 16th Street mall area, restaurants and our race. Easy to take the mall bus to any area. The hotel room was nice, modern and lots of amenities. My main complaint was in the close proximity to the elevators. But after running I'm not sure i could have heard a freight train! Robes were a nice touch. Comfy beds and linens. Lovely pool area and view. Hot tub seemed a bit outdated and was blocked off so you couldn't see the nice view. It was nice having a full Starbucks as you come down the elevators! Valet parking is the only way to go in a location like this. Worth every penny! Can come and go as many times as you want during the day for the same price. We got an excellent deal on hotwire.com. Would stay here again!

Our family has stayed here several times over the years. For attending pro sports or cultural events , the location is central to most venues. The bustling LoDo area is accessible right outside the hotel, with a wide variety of stores, street shops, and dining options being accessible within easy walking distance. Our kids favorite place is the ESPN-Zone , which is actually attached to the Westin , which makes it very convenient! There's a nice pool and small workout area on the roof of the hotel. Although we have family members in the vicinity in the area whose homes we could stay at, we just love the convenience and quality of the Westin! You will not be disappointed!

In town for a work meeting that lasted 4 days. Staff was extremely attentive and to me, personally, as well as to the meeting group. Smiles, nice attitudes, and helpfulness abound. I did have a bathrobe in my room, and quite enjoyed the pool. On the 13th floor, it's quite peaceful, but a mini-walk to what's happening at 16th street. Great location. The rooms was decorated well, and the bed was super comfy. Would have liked bottled water, but no biggie.

Stayed one night in a suite with our 4 kids. Hotel was inexpensive, quiet, lady at front desk was very nice. Wish we had been there early enough to try the outdoor pool. Breakfast area was well stocked and clean. Great hot chocolate.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Denver Tech Center

review_text: Generally met our expectations for accommodations in this price range. Our room was tiny (not even big enough for a chair), but the bed was very comfortable. The free breakfast was fine, but typical of most free motel breakfasts. The location was in some kind of high-end business area, so there were lots of restaurant options within a short drive. We did have a problem with getting ANY parking spot one night, but it was generally a pleasant stay.
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Denver Tech Center

review_text:
This is a great hotel! Great location, very convenient parking. It is within easy walking distance (or a VERY cheap cab ride) to all the places you want to go downtown. 
Walking in the front door, we were immediately impressed by the style and cleanliness. That however was soon over-shadowed by the front desk staff, really warm and professional. 
Our room was a king suite. Very large and well laid out. Was perfect to serve as a gathering place for our friends after an evening on the mall and dinner downtown. We had the opportunity to use the business center to print out the ol' Groupons It had three computers, was well appointed and FREE. 
I strongly recommend this Hampton!

Not sure how but we jagged 3 nights staying here in a king bed room for under 100 bucks per night.
Our room was super clean and comfortable and had everything we needed as did the hotel itself.
Breakfast was fresh, heaps of variety and filling.
The location is just out of downtown but an easy walk down to the main street to catch to free shuttle.
If you don't want to be ripped off by staying in the centre of downtown this is a great place to stay.

This stay was kicked off by an unwelcome distraction of a fire alarm at 9.00 a.m. on our first day, a Saturday. A false alarm fortunately. It did however reinforce that every time you stay in an unfamiliar hotel you should really look at the fire exit plan! This hotel was in a convenient location, provided the usual standard that we have come to expect from this chain and breakfast in the package makes it good value.

I stayed here for a night after flying into Denver. They have free shuttles to/from the airport. The hotel was clean and recently updated. I thought the rooms were bright and welcoming. The free breakfast was a good way to save some money. For the price I paid, I would stay here again.

Really enjoyed this hotel. The service can be summed up by when I called the front desk to ask if I could borrow a bottle opener. The man there said he had one on his personal key chain and would be right up to my room. He was there in 2 minutes! Rooms were nice and clean and we enjoyed the late night pool and hot tub. Could walk to 16th St in about 10 minutes for plenty to do!

review_title: Wouldn't stay here again, even if it was another free night from the airlines.
review_text: Flight was delayed due to maintenance so I took a flight the next day instead. Was given the Fairfield from American Airlines, free for the night. Had to switch rooms because the first phone didn't work and there was blood on the sheets. Second room was upstairs which was fine...no big problems there. Asked for a wake up call and never got one. Signed up for the shuttle at check in as requested but the next morning that shuttle was full and I had to wait for the next one. Not the best for an airport hotel when the purpose is to get people up and to their flights on time. WiFi existed at hotel which is nice but had to request code from front desk after second room switch. Just overall below average stay.

review_title: Location, location, location - and great people too!
review_text: We stayed at this Hampton Inn over Labor Day weekend and couldn't have found a better place for the price. The Hotel was nice, the people were very friendly, and the breakfast area was spacious. The beds were also very comfortable and the room was very clean and well-kept! We also couldn't hear a thing out of the neighboring rooms. The best part though was the convenient location. The Taste of Colorado festival was going on downtown and we were close enough to walk there very comfortably but just out-of-the-way enough to avoid the congestion. Parking can be a nightmare downtown and very expensive, but the lot across the street allowed for at least 24 hours for $4. That was by far the cheapest we saw. We'd stay there again in a heartbeat!

What do you do with a hotel that has lost in sparkle.I would say a brand change is on the horizon.Better points are the great beds ,the breakfast in the club Lounge .If you don't book club floors there are much better hotels in Denver .sorry I'm still a Hyatt fan.

Love the Hilton family hotel beds...only Sheraton has better. The service here is great, and as a return guest I've experienced even more gracious care. Great breakfast buffet provided and the managers reception in thee evening is nice.

At about 7:55 in the morn it seems that someone turned on an aircompressor and powertools (floorsander?) In the floor or two above us (not directly above our room as I think that would be louder). However, it was loud enough to shake light fixtures in the bathroom. After a night on the town, making this a little staycation, not being able to sleep in was disappointing. 
Overall, been here many times for conferences, but 1st time overnight. For a conference hotel, it works well (good for business traveller; there is room service, etc). For a vacation traveller, I am puzzled as to how it could be 4 star
(Currently writing this from 2405 since I can't sleep)

We used up some Marriott Reward points to have a one night stay with our 3 boys (had 2 rooms). One word.........wow! This hotel is one of the best that I have stayed in and I travel a lot staying in many different Marriott and Hilton hotels worldwide. Service was very attentive, the rooms were great and the views of the harbor were awesome. If you have access to the concierge lounge, make sure to use it. The evening appetizers and the daily breakfast were exceptional.
Would definitely go back.

review_title: My family and I had a wonderful short stay!
review_text: Close to DIA, wonderful rooms, restaurants close, clean pool & hot tub.... We will return! Only negative, my 9 year old found it too easy to purchase pay per view without us knowing! The hotel gladly subtracted the charges.

To make a long story short, after an incredibly long day this staff went above and beyond. The rooms and ammenities are certainly nice but the care and treatment by the Marriott team out this hotel a cut above

review_title: The V Lounge and especially Andrea S.
review_text: Great. Steps to 16th street market. Andrea S. In the V Lounge was exceptional.

I stayed here for a meeting at the Denver Convention Center which is about 3 blocks away. It is also just about 2 blocks away from the 16th St Mall. I arrived about 2:40pm in the afternoon and waited in line for about 15-20 min to check in. One bottleneck was a person whose reservation they couldn't find. And there were 2 people inline ahead of me who were checking back to see if there room was ready (they weren't ) and mine wasn't either. I was told that checkin time was 3pm and they would call me when the room was ready. I looked for a bellman to check my bag and trudged to the meeting with my backpack. As soon as I got there I got a call that the room was ready so trudged back. I checked in with the same person I had spoken to 30 minutes earlier and he acted like he had never seen me before. I checked out with the same person and no recognition then either. The room was adequate and the fitness center was well-equipped although very crowded one morning. When i asked for a FedEx box to ship some things home, I just got a point 'There's a FedEx across the street.' I needed a bellman for something a couple of times and there was a wait both times. In contrast, when I walked out of the Hyatt Regency coming back from the convention center (the Regency is across from the conv ctr) there were several helpful bellmen, always asking if I needed help or directions. Also the Regency had a bustling lobby with nice bar, restaurant, and coffee shop. Grand Hyatt had small and quiet lobby with much smaller bar and plain looking restaurant. Would not stay at thisnGrand Hyatt again if I had a choice.

review_title: Nice hotel close to the 16th st mall
review_text: The hotel is positioned close to the 16th street mall. The rooms were clean and the employees were friendly

The only thing this hotel is lacking is white noise in the rooms, and next time i'll bring my own. My room was very quiet (no a/c or fan noise), but when there was street or hallway noise it seemed louder because of that. 
If you are a workout fanatic, there is a nice health club across the street that allows the Hyatt guests to workout for a small fee. 
This is a nice hotel in a great location, and I recommend it.

review_title: Only place to stay in downtown Denver.
review_text: Have stayed there on two different occasions, both times have had outstanding experiences. The staff is very helpful and polite, the rooms are very comfortable. There is a culture here that tends to every detail of a visit. The only thing I would change is to add a tv in the lounge for sports viewing.
Stayed in Tower building, older part. Rooms smelled moldy, very noisy. Did not get any sleep. Waste of money.

review_title: Good rooms, but bad Valet and room cleaning.
review_text: I came to stay here for 2 nights for a bachelor party. Overall, the rooms were good and fairly priced. However, the services - namely the valet and room cleaning staff - were subpar. We had to wait for 25 minutes one time just to drop off our car and the room was just picked up after the first night - not cleaned. The hotel is right on 16th street mall and the free bus runs all the time.

review_title: A bargain for the location, food, and rooms
review_text: This hotel offered excellent service, clean and comfortable rooms with modern style, and had a great breakfast. I'd recommend it.
This hotel was steps away from Beale, so clean, friendly staff, I have nothing but good things to say about this hotel. No question when staying in downtown Memphis, this is the spot!
hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis - Beale Street

review_text: My husband and I got a mountain view room. It was beautiful. This was a clean hotel. I am picky and get grossed out easily! This was the first hotel I felt I could actually sit on the comforter!! Lots of restaurants in walking distance.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Denver Cherry Creek

review_title: Excellent large rooms with great view
review_text: Really impressed in this great location near the inner harbor or fells point. Panoramic views from the top floors, so be sure to ask for a room at the top. Buzzing new restaurants and bars within easy walk. We will use it again.

We stayed 4 nights at HGI Cherry Creek, uncluding a weekend: good online Bed & Breakfast deal.
Hotel is quite new, cool, "urban" design and interior decoration, clean and functional: everything seemed to be managed and working pretty well.
Good location: short drives to Downtown and most other interesting Denver areas.
Used the Fitness Room and the complimentary WIFI and was happy with both.
HGI breakfast buffet and cooked to order options never disappointing.
Just one flaw: window curtains in room 630 are not enough to keep the room dark in the early morning, so had to wear one of those masks.
Reccomended hotel!
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Denver Cherry Creek

review_text: Standard Marriott, recent renovation of rooms mean they are clean and comfortable. Easy to locate and easy to get to locations from the hotel. Bar area nothing to speak of, however barman very friendly. Would use again. Valet parking was expensive.

I loved it! The room was nice and clean with a beautiful waterfront view. The location was great which was walking distance to different attractions such as Little Italy, Fell's Point, etc. My only qualm was the shower with the slow drain but other than that, awesome hotel!

review_title: Great staff, made wedding weekend stressless.
review_text:
Just stayed at the grand hyatt for my sister's wedding. All of our family members had such a great time and check in was effortless. We needed a couple things for the bridal suite and it was sent up immediately. Room service was great and came right on time. 
Definitely would recommend for a wedding weekend!

review_title: Great location but a bit pricey
review_text: Beautiful hotel with a really good location in downtown Denver, but the price wasn't competitive with other great properties in the area.

review_title: Nice hotel in a great location
review_text: The rooms were quiet and comfortable. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Next to the Cherry Creek bike path and near some very nice parks. I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Denver Cherry Creek

review_text:
My wife and I booked through name your own price site. This particular Hyatt was not my first choice. It is downtown within walking distance of 16th street but slightly further away than some other options. There is nothing that really jumps out at you here in terms of uniqueness but as a hyatt you know what to expect and that is the goal for many business travelers I suppose. 
Beds were comfortable. Thermostat was in working order and kept the room cool. There is a fed ex office center in the same complex. Plenty of good restaurants near by. Would recommend if you can get a discounted rate, are here for business and/ or already like hyatt properties.

Rooms were clean, parking was free; some nights were very noisy based on the location (outside, not within the hotel). Staff was nice, housekeeping did a good job. Nice to have a ceiling fan in the room. Overall nothing special - just a place to sleep.

review_title: great location and staff, but not so clean.
review_text:
my husband booked this hotel off priceline so we got a great rate. the hotel was in a great location - very close to all of the 16th street shopping. the hotel personel were great, too.
my big complaint was the level of cleanliness in the room. the carpet had some big stains, as did the upholstery in the chairs. the curtains had a mysterious red substance on them, too.
i would recommend this place to a friend but ONLY if they got a deal like we did.

We stayed here for our downtown wedding and everything was perfect! We stayed in the honeymoon suite (I think that was the name) and my parents had a suite with a living room. Our view was amazing! My dad graciously paid for our rooms, so i cant attest to value. I definitely recommend a stay here.

review_text: HÃ´tel trÃ¨s bien situÃ© dans le centre historique de Boston (fameuse Freedom Trail). Chambre petite mais trÃ¨s confortable (bonne literie, Ã©quipements modernes sauf Tv avec peu de chaÃ®nes en service) wifi gratuit pour les membres du programme de fidÃ©litÃ©, hÃ´tel Ã  recommander pour une Ã©tape, Ã  noter le service agrÃ©able (portier, bagagistes, rÃ©ception...).

review_title: Right on 16th St. Mall- you pay high prices for the convience. Clean, helpful staff, modern rooms.
review_text: We stayed with a large group for a convention. The staff was prepared for us and helpful. This hotel appeared to cater to business travelers. Sheraton is right on 16th St. Mall-walk out to shopping! be prepared to pay for staying downtown. Parking= $24 a day, breakfast buffet=$15. If you decline housekeeping, you get a $5 voucher good only at the 3 hotel restaurants. Overall, convention stay was pleasant-except the 20 min. wait for elevators. The elevators could not keep up w/ large amount of visitors.
Our first visit to Baltimore and could not have been happier with our stay. Great service, great location, and great overall experience. People in Baltimore were so friendly and helpful.

review_title: Location and overall was great we loved it....
review_text: We visit from Dallas wife and 4 year old kid the location was great many bars restaurants on six street hotel was great got a presidential suite and it was great also clean and great view...we all love def will stay here again..

Would give this place a 0 overall If I could...obnoxiously loud construction going on all three days we were there in the rooms next to us and all they could say was sorry...at least that's what I think they said since I couldn't hear them over the drilling....yes it was seriously that loud

we booked the reservation through motels.com and we were a little weary at first getting an excellent price but thinking we were gonna get some second rate room. The room was first rate, hotel right in the middle of downtown, walking distance to everything that is great about Denver. The staff and Service was excellent!!! My only issue was having to park next door at $15/night because they only have valet at $26/night but it beat parking on the street!

review_title: Un beau sÃ©jour en plein coeur du centre-ville.
review_text: Excellent accueil : demandez Jean- Louis pour un service bilingue.... Il nous a aidez Ã  notre arrivÃ©e avec la rÃ©ception. La chambre est trÃ¨s propre et l'emplacement au centre-ville des plus qu'excellent. Vente de billets pour les matchs des Red Sox : 2 billets pour 54$. Un trÃ¨s beau sÃ©jour dans un dÃ©cor historique.

I really enjoyed this hotel. It is in a great location on the harbor and the views are fantastic! The service is great. Nice brunch. I loved being right there at the convention center for our conference.

review_title: Great location- great staff- great Hotel
review_text: Stayed here on my way through to Aspen. Fantastic hotel; staff couldn't have been more helpful, room was modern with a quality blow dryer, great price and close to 16th St Mall

Great hotel!! Especially in the afraid customer service, they exceeded my expectations. I'm a frequent traveler, and I wish all hotels treated me the way Hilton Garden Inn, Downtown Denver did. Clean, friendly, great location for the Convention Center or Theatre District.

For our First time in Denver and we choose the HGI due to its close location to the convention center. We were very happy with our stay for following reasons - 12pm checkout (not 11am) - the hotel was small enough to navigate quickly from the lobby to the elevator to our room effortlessly - adjustable mattress that were extremely comfortable - the lobby had a little serving table with fresh lemon/strawberry water served all day - free coffee/tea in am - and cookies in the evening - small but decent stocked pantry and fast checkout at the front desk - free wifi - super shuttle leaves every 15 minutes to the airport - free gym/pool/hot tub - quiet room - we slept great!!!

review_title: What great service, they know how to treat you special.
review_text: We stayed here for a conference and what a great hotel. The beds are to die for. We asked about pizza places, they brought menus to our room. Would stay again

review_title: Exceptionally friendly staff in well located hotel
review_text: Stayed here while attending conference at the Sheraton and think I got a better deal. Nice rooms, good breakfast and 2 blocks from main shopping street. Reception staff are superb- lots of recommendations of where to go and where to eat. Made me feel very welcome

The rooms were clean. The location was convenient to the convention center & 16th street shopping. All the staff was extremely friendly & the servers in the hotel restaurant went above and beyond. The only downside was the parking. They offered valet parking only which was pricey. Instead, we parked a couple of blocks away near the Denver Pavilions shopping complex.

New, clean, Hilton Garden Inn. However, this place bends over backwards to please. The room is typical of most HGI's. Breakfast was above average for this chain. Only 1 block from convention center. Valet parking was prompt and efficient. This is first hotel with a service to provide your boarding pass with morning bill under the door on last day. I highly recommend this hotel.
A very friendly receptionist. Superb family room with everything you could wish for. Good breakfast. Free shuttle to Airport next morning to collect hire car. Good value for money.
Great hotel, great staff, the rooms were clean. There were some great views! Enjoy the patio area to see the views. Book your room today, you won't regret it.

We spent 3 nights here and couldn't have been happier. The staff was all extremely helpful and friendly, the rooms were clean and well appointed, and we looked forward to the breakfast every day. We will definitely stay here again! Thanks!
We had an incredible view! Customer service was great. We will definitely return.

We were traveling and looked for a clean value place. For ca 100$/night we ended up with a spacious two room suite. King size bed, living room with corner couch, and a full kitchen. The hotel is pretty new and still very clean. For the hotel class and price range this seems like a decent value.

We were only staying 1 night in Denver. Hotels for the most part are fairly pricey and The Oxford although not cheap by any means for this type of hotel was a bit more moderate than the other boutique hotels. The hotel is a little on the tired side. Carpets are a tad worn, lobby is somewhat dowdy. The room was overlooking a series of vents from the bldg next door. The bed was so high I had to place a chair next to it in order to hoist myself high enough to get in.The bathtub was quite bizarre, you needed to be at least 6 ft tall to get in or you had to straddle the tiled platform like you were riding a horse. Weird! And to top it off there are vents in the room where you actually hear guests voices wafting through. 
The staff was very nice and accommodating. Location was excellent for restaurants etc. I think that I will opt for a different hotel next time I'm in Denver.

review_title: Best value in Downtown Denver, bar none!
review_text: The bathroom is a little cramped, but overall a great stay! It's nice to stay at a hotel where you really "feel" welcome and a staff that genuinely cares that you are there! I will not stay anywhere else when in Denver, my kids loved the pool too!

review_title: Friendly service, comfortable room, wonderful location!
review_text: We stayed for 3 nights - everyone was so helpful and friendly, particularly Patrick & Heather. Using the town car was really handy for going out to dinner. The room was comfortable. The history of the Oxford makes it special! Definitely recommend!

Missed my connection so spending the night in denver with only my purse and the clothes on my back and this hotel made it much more bearable. Staff was super friendly and helpful, free shuttle and breakfast, room was so clean and new I felt like maybe I was the first person to stay in it. Specific to a last minute hotel stay there is no restaurant on site but the staff provided lots of takeout menus and delivery was only 20 min. Also when choosing at the airport it seemed far away at 7 miles from the airport but as it ends up all the Denver airport hotels are this far. Very convenient and comfortable.

review_title: Treated like royalty during our stay in this beautifully appointed, historic, grand hotel.
review_text: The most prefect place to stay in Denver. We could walk to the best resurants in town, including McCormick's, located just downstairs. 16th St is just around corner or so with free public transportation to shops & sites. Use the towncar service at least once tho! The Oxford Spa adjoins the hotel & their ahhhh-some services are easily accessed by private elevator. I slipped in & out unnoticed every morning to the gym & steam room wearing the long, plush robe provided. The entire staff went out of their way to make our trip a memorable one. Our last night, we sat by a cozy fire downstairs with our drinks fromthe bar. The temperature dropped from 80Â° day before! and the snow began to fall. I (honestly) tearfully left the next morning, after awaking to a winter wonderland.

Another great stay! Staff are friendly and appreciate guests. The bellman was really grateful to get a tip. Fitness room is large and well equipped. Bed and linens are great Ask for room 18 on a high floor for mountain views

review_title: In a very HIP district, lots of nice restaurants around
review_text: Would recommend for anyone. Very old and venerable hotel- sumptuous decor. Incredibly easy to get to from airport on public transport. Very helpful staff - will take you anywhere in a two mile radius by the hotel car. Next to the Union Station - fair warning Union Station is being renovated, so Amtrak is picking up down the track in temporary quarters.

Awesome boutique hotel filled with fun atmosphere, perfect for young professionals. Great meeting rooms and conference staff. Food is very good. Great bar and trendy restaurant. Big, clean guest rooms. Pet friendly. Walking distance to the best of downtown Denver. 10 on a scale of 1 to 10 .

review_title: Restaurant and shuttle to convention center
review_text: I can't believe the deal I got from priceline and as a grad student this came in handy $95/night! The hotel is simply stunning. The location is about three blocks from plenty of restaurants. But you don't have to go far with Randolph's. A great restaurant. The room was more than spacious. Being placed in a room ending with 07 meant I was subjected to the elevator chimes all times of the night and morning. But it was spacious with a balcony and small partial view of downtown. Internet is $10/day. Downtown is about 5 blocks away. The free shuttle to/from convention center was a life saver. All of the drivers are so friendly. I would stay here again.

review_title: Great location; too bad a non-functioning AC ruined the trip.
review_text: AC did not work. Staff gave lame excuse and was not helpful. Too bad this small and definitely fixable problem ruined what would have been a great stay at a great hotel.

review_title: Lovely hotel in a prime location
review_text: We stayed at the Oxford Hotel for 2 nights and found it to be a very comfortable and pleasant place to stay. The staff were friendly and efficient and the room was well appointed and spotlessly clean. The beds and pillows were especially good and if the pillows didn't suite you there was a pillow 'menu' in the room so that you could get something more suitable! The hotel is in a great location for Coors Field and also the16th Street Mall which is a great place to walk, shop and eat and there is a free shuttle bus that runs the length of 16th so you can hop on and off. There is a nice feeling of calm when you step into the lobby and although the hotel has a reasonable amount of rooms it doesn't feel too big. My only gripe is that for us English people not used to driving in Denver we found it hard to find-this may have been made more tricky by road works and road closures due to Labor Day celebrations.

This hotel was one of the best we have stayed at ever. My wife and I realized after staying here that we had the best sleeps we have ever had in a hotel. Can't understand why other than the pillows were great, it was quiet and nicely situated. We would come back in a heart beat. We stayed at the Warwick in New York before and liked it as well. Eric & Carol Muir

review_title: Best room I've ever stayed at in my entire life
review_text: I had missed my connection at the greyhound station and the next one wasn't for 24 hours later. My parents put me up at the Oxford Hotel last night. The service was amazing!!!! They picked me up at the station to bring me to the hotel so I didn't have to haul all my heavy luggage alone there. The room was gorgeous!!! Best ever. They allowed me to stay until 2pm and even held my luggage while I roamed the area until my bus came. A driver took me back to the station and even carried my bags inside to where I needed to be instead of just dropping me off at the location. Now that's customer service!!!! The only thing I would have to comment on is that there isn't a complimentary breakfast, which I would have loved or perhaps a slight discount at McCormicks for being a guest at the Oxford Hotel. I will definitely stay here again if I am ever in Denver again!

review_title: The Fun of Travel- Wake Up Calls by Austin Powers and Mr T
review_text: Love the high concept of comedy, recordings in and out of the elevators, great staff, themed Disco Brunch w decor and dressed up wait staff... And the quality of a Doubletree
We enjoyed our 2 night stay. The staff was wonderful. Don't miss a visit to the original bar which was the first one opened after prohibition.

review_title: Great location - perfect if you get it thru priceline - otherwise a little over priced
review_text: Clean rooms, awesome location downtown! They advertise themed rooms...but it's more like themed hallways. The environment is fun, but I'm glad we bid for it online. My boyfriend ordered room service and it wasn't right. But really really, the pros outweigh the cons! Just don't expect a five star trendy NYC style hotel.

review_title: The Curtis is a fun hotel!
review_text: The Curtis was a neat hotel. The decor was fun. The location was great! The room was clean, but rather on the boring side considering the themes for each floor. The fitness room was huge! There were several treadmills, ellipticals, bike, weight area. We recommend the hotel for a great weekend getaway. :).

Perfect location when need a place close to the airport. We stayed there after flying into Denver and visiting Boulder for a day before traveling further around in Colorado.
Nice breakfast and clean room.
hotel_name: Baymont Inn and Suites Denver International Airport

review_text: The Curtis is not your run of the mill hotel, and that's what makes it special. Each floor has it's own theme and is decorated to the max. Very well done! Great place!

review_title: Will return as soon as possible!
review_text: my hubby and I went here for a mini honeymoon. We loved the hotel...close enough to 16th street...and we were upgraded to a suite! It was perfect...i will definetely return! Best part is the penthouse pool!

My friends and I booked two rooms off Priceline for $65 per night. I thought this was a great deal for the Warwick. Rooms were spacious and pleasantly cleaned. The bathrooms looked updated as well. 
The rooftop pool had AMAZING views, but the pool itself and lounge chairs were extremely basic! Considering we spent the day rock climbing, the pool did its service in helping us relax. 
For the cons - Location, location, location. The downtown vibe seems to be around Market St and 16th St Mall. The hotel is a very lengthy walk to these areas and I found myself walking next to sleeping homeless people at night. So if you don't mind the distance, I would recommend staying at the hotel but have some sort of transportation readily available.

review_title: I have stayed in Marriott properties for over a hundred times this year in various locations, this has been the worst.
review_text: Overall the location of this hotel is great. The building itself is definitely not sound proof. You can easily here people outside the hotel late at night drinking and socializing only to get awaken by the house keeping vacuuming the room the room next store at 7. Ironically maid service neglected our room and we had to call to get more towels. Overall as a platinum marriott rewards member, I was highly disappointed. Oh, and as far as being in a safe area, be prepared for the panhandlers as you walk out of the hotel.

review_title: Decent, but not as depicted on website and in photos.
review_text: The Curtis is a nice enough hotel in a great location. My problem with the hotel is that it's nothing like what they depict on the website and in photos. It's really just your average, aging Sheraton hotel that they've tried to add a few gimmicks to and increase the price. That being said, the location of the hotel is nice.

Kitchy, tongue in cheek design both audio & visual straight out of the '70's with some '80's sprinkled in for confusion.
Fashion forward bathrooms have clear glass shower enclosures and NO towel bars at all, making it very difficult for multiple guests to efficiently use the room.
Decor is great if you like orange, but it seems there's a reason society moved away from this look decades ago.

The hotel is located right downtown by the convention center, which is nice. The staff, however, was beyond unhelpful which was a major, major turn-off. 
When I arrived at the hotel, I was informed that although I'd reserved a room, none was currently available. They were apparently all dirty. This was at 11:30AM, so I wasn't too concerned, just a bit annoyed. I left my bag (but kept my laptop) and walked around a bit, took care of some business, and had lunch. When I returned at 2:30PM, however, I was told to return later with no up-date or explanation beyond "it will be ready later" - no time-frame provided. I showed up again at 3:30 and was told the room should be ready "maybe by 4..." I waited in the lobby and watched several other guests check in while I waited. I inquired if rooms were becoming available but was told that mine was not yet ready. I didn't understand why other people were receiving rooms when I was not, and no substantive clarification was provided beyond "the maids are working very hard" and "the hotel is very full". When I finally was informed that my room was ready at 4:45PM, I was quite annoyed. Again, this ordeal would not have been as annoying if there'd been some semblance of communication from the staff - the empty platitudes without specifics were useless and watching people get rooms in front of me with no explanation was incredibly frustrating.
The room that I had waited so very long to get did not make everything better. It was minuscule, dominated by the bed, which was somewhat difficult to maneuver around. 
And then there were the little things: no ironing board (but there was an iron), no coffee machine (but there was coffee packets, sugar, and creamer), no express check-out capability (what century are we in?), no view (just the brick wall of the building next door), and - no surprise here - very late housekeeping (after 3PM every day of my stay).
Needless to say, I will not be staying at the Courtyard by Marriott in Denver again.

review_title: The most fun, friendly, chic hotel ever!
review_text: My first time in Denver, and I was lucky enough to book a room at The Curtis. I truly had a wonderful experience. Starting with the oven fresa cookie upon arrival, the pop-culture themed floors, friendly and warm staff, top-notch restaurant, 5 star service throughout. I can't rate it higher! I only wish I could find The Curtis hotels everywhere I travelled! Definite #1 recommendation in Denver.

We bought a package which included 4 beers delivered to our room whenever we wanted. Our room was exactly what we wanted and extremely clean. I loved that there were dogs in and out of the hotel despite the fact that we didn't bring our own. The service was fast and pleasant. And the restaurant was amazing. We had such a great night with the modern Italian and wine selection.
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Denver - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Cool hotel in a cool town
review_text: Great, funky hotel. Retro but modern at the same time. The staff was super friendly and helpful. Nice sized rooms That are kept really clean. The hotel restaurant was a nice place too.
Good room, no wake-up call as requested but they gave me a $25 breakfast voucher. Satisfactory gym with great restaurant.
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Denver - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Best part is that it is right by the shops etc. Went with my two year old and they gave her a toy and a goldfish to keep in room. Where else does that? Great hotel and excellent staff. Restaurant is NOT kid friendly and we were very unwelcome
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Denver - a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Spent another thanksgiving at the brown palace. The buffet at Ellyingtons is over the top with traditional thanksgiving feast and seafood, sushi, pork loin, prime rib, salads, cheeses and tons of desserts. It is cheaper betty than making dinner at home and so much better; especially with bottomless champagne option. We compement our brunch with a stay over. This time we opted for a room at the "top of the brown". Room was very large as eas bathroom. Had a separate dressing and make -up area & a keurig coffee maker. Only disappointment was a stale smoke odor in room that they tried to cover up with room spray. Staff are fabulous and treat you wonderfully.
hotel_name: The Brown Palace Hotel and Spa

review_text: The hotel is historic and well kempt. The stained glass ceiling is beautiful as well as the wrought iron railing and decorative details. The lobby area table and chairs (where afternoon tea is served) looked cheap compared to the grandeur of the hotel. It would be nice to see some marble top tables and antique chairs. I assumed the tea was complimentary for guests, but there is a charge of about $30 per person. The bed was comfortable and sheets were soft. The amenities in the room were modern and comfortable, but the bathroom was very small with a nice dual shower but no tub. On Fruday night the odors of the restaurant four floors below were making it up to our room. We turned on the ceiling fan and it seemed to dissipate a bit. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
hotel_name: The Brown Palace Hotel and Spa

review_title: Great location, great staff, newer property, tremendous value.
review_text: I stayed here for four nights, and had a wonderful stay. The property was very well maintained, rooms were nice, and location was outstanding. I was within walking distance to the 16th Street Mall area (many restaurants, bars, entertaInment). The hotel was relaxed and not pretentious. The lobby and common areas were clean and modern. The hotel provides a decent breakfast each morning included in the stay. The parking is convenient and the hotel felt very safe, with a key card being required in elevator to allow access the guest room floors and parking floors. My only concern, was the very slow internet connection, although it was free, so I can't complain much. Overall, a wonderful stay!

review_title: I enjoyed my stay in this hotel
review_text: This is a good hotel. Meals are free in the morning and in the evening. Free drinks are served during happy hour. Full kitchen with all needed to cook and eat in your room. Rooms are very clean.

Love the location and the Cherry Creek neighborhood. So many dining choices and a vibrant area. The rooms are very nice and modern. I organized several conferences and service was over the top. Kronos was incredible , would love to be there again

review_title: We loved every minute of our stay.
review_text: I only wish we had been able to stay longer. It was the perfect hotel for the Christmas holiday. Excellent service, spacious rooms, friendly staff...
hotel_name: The Brown Palace Hotel and Spa

review_title: Teenagers beware for technolgoy fails you here.
review_text:
I being a 18 year old highschool guy came to Denver for a family reunion and stayed at the Hyatt. I brought my Xbox for as any other teenage guy, are eager to play some of the new games. But.... Even though the tv has all the input plug-ins needed, the hotel still locked the tv inputs which forbidden me to play Xbox. I thought, oh well I just get my laptop out. Wrong again. Wi-fi doesn't come free here and it's not cheap. ($10/per night) crap.
Although the service is good, staff is friendly, and rooms are nice, if you don't have a teenager who wants to escape his family reunion to playing video games, then come here. Otherwise go to a lower grade place that doesn't have the technology to block tv inputs and charge for wi-fi.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_text: We read the reviews and had no idea what to expect. It was quirky, the staff went out of their way to help, the room was sensational it was huge and made for a lovely stay. The restaurant was fantastic and the location was brilliant. Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

review_title: Teenagers beware for technolgoy fails you here.
review_text:
I being a 18 year old highschool guy came to Denver for a family reunion and stayed at the Hyatt. I brought my Xbox for as any other teenage guy, are eager to play some of the new games. But.... hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_text: I have stayed at this hotel numerous times and have never been disappointed. Rooms are spotless and designed so well -- right down to storage spot for luggage in closet. Altitudes bar is beautiful and a great hangout for an evening drink. Walk to 16th st mall convention ctr, performing arts complex and lodo. Will return soon.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_title: Hyatt Regency at Convention Center will go above and beyond for good service!
review_text: We arrived at the Hyatt Regency for a day at Thanksgiving getaway and things didn't start off well. There were some mix-ups with our hotels.com reservation and some misunderstandings with staff. I am glad we stuck it out though. This ultra comfortable, uber clean, sleek modern hotel was perfect. We appreciated the roominess of the junior suite, the cozy club level service and the brand new gym and spa. But it's the restaurant and the service overall that really standout. Thank you Jake R and Ryan. We'll be back soon!
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_text: This hotel is excellent. Goes beyond anything you would normally expect from a hotel. The first time I stayed there I got sick, and they took great care of me. I have gone back and been greetted so warmly that it just makes me feel at home. I have stayed at other hotels in Denver, and been treated well. In the end nothing compares to the residence inn city center

After being delayed repeatedly on my flight to Denver during business travel, I was exhausted upon my arrival to Hotel Monaco. 
The front desk staff was very empathic and went out of their way to make me feel better, including upgrading my room and giving me free Spa products for the jacuzzi. After a very long week of continuos travel and long hours it was so refreshing to receive this level of customer service. 
After a long week of con
hotel_name: Hotel Monaco Denver - a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Best hotel in down town Denver
review_text: 5th time i have stayed here i have to say always worth it! Bar upstairs and in hotel lobby are great, Peak lounge has some great after dinner drinks, good selection of scotch. Best hotel gym i have ever worked out in. Massive in size with great equipment and pool. The main restaraunt is excellent never had a bad meal. I had friends stay at the Grand Hyatt and they said they really liked the regency better. Only knock is rooms are small but they are clean and nice. They have free internet in the lobby also.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_title: Best time I had thanks Residence Inn Employees
review_text:
I came out for a seminar 3 day stay thinking it was gonna be the same like the other stays! Breakfast was awesome and that's where I met the young man named "Jimmy " he came up and just started talking to me asked me if I was doing ok then I asked him if there was somewhere to hang out for a fun time since he looked young and knew any places to go! He told me about this place Coyote Ugly on a Tuesday night ! I would like to tell him thanks for the positive attitude jokes and company ! That is the kind of person that needs to be around the guests if I could gave him something it would be more friends and family to visit him so "Jimmy" better find some more places to go cause there are coming to "The Residence Inn on Champa" 
Thanks Chris
We stayed one night in a two bedroom suite. The hotel was very helpful and friendly. Hotel was close to downtown and some great places to dine. Great place to stay downtown

Like all other downtown huge chain hotels this one is pricey. Of course, there is no free wi-fi and meals are expensive. My main complaint is how the room maintained during our stay. Wash clothes left in tub and the bottom sheet in our bed was two feet short of the end of the bed. So, all night I was pulling my feet up away from the scratchy mattress pad. Not a restful sleep for sure. Bring your own soap. The soap and shampoo they use smells like toilet bowl cleaner. I had to go out and buy my own.
The valets, doormen and desk personnel were very nice and helpful. 
Downtown is typical big city. There are a lot of homeless around. There are a lot of good restaurants nearby and some shopping.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_title: Excellent business hotel, bathrooms slightly dated...
review_text: Stayed here recently during a conference. Although the hotel was fully booked and extremely busy, staff were very helpful and friendly. When I got hungry in the middle of the night and technically there was no room service, the lady from the all night coffee shop on site made sure a sandwich was brought up yo my room! The rooms are nice and contemporary, but please let somebody upgrade the bathrooms too, cause taking a shower without getting your hair wet is not possible.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_title: Part of the fabric of Cherry Creek, fits quietly into the neighborhood with great rooms, service and valet parking response time
review_text:
Looking for a tranquil retreat in Denver that is close to great restaurants, shopping, the Botanic Gardens, the Art Museum in theCherry Creek neighborhood? This is the place!
We had read about slow parking valet times, but our waits for the retrieval of our car averaged two minutes! I suppose if you wanted your car during intervals of high turnover (check-in and check-out), it might takelonger. I suggest you ask the valet staff if you are concerned.
Back to the hotel room,we specified a room with mountain views and got a nice one. Large large bathroom with separate tub and bath appointed with marble floors and granite countertops. rooms facing west in the summer, you might want to leave your AC a little lower before you leave for dinner. Linens comfortable and pretty. The wallpaper was bold and dramatics...nice touch!
Hope to return soon for another relaxing stay...eat and drink at North restaurant...40 steps from the front door of JW Marriott. You will not be disappointed!

review_title: Like sleeping in the train station? Teatro's for you! Too noisy.
review_text:
In a nutshell, cramped room with falling off bathroom fixtures, water wouldn't drain, wifi hopeless & too darn noisy from local train crossing where train's have to hoot.....every hour or sometimes half hour!!!!
Staff making the best of poor facilities. 
Expensive, we paid $600 for 2 nights no breakfast

review_title: How did I not stay here before?
review_text: We were in town for the GABF and I was thrilled my husband had booked this adorable, classy boutique hotel not even three blocks away from the Convention Center. The location is great , nearby all the fun shopping, theaters and convention center. We had numerous adventurous "rickshaw" rides around town to different events. The entire hotel s comfortable and classy. The staff was so friendly and helpful organizing a rental car for me and having the hotel Suburban take me to the care rental after tracking me down at Starbucks. I hope we stay here on our next trip to Denver

review_title: Great hotel with a great view of the Rockies
review_text: The lobby of the Hyatt Regency in worth the stay alone. If you get a westward facing room, you'll be more than pleased by the Rocky Mountains. Very nice, clean rooms
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_title: A great boutique hotel with service above the chains...
review_text: I had to find a hotel in Denver on short notice and all my usual chain hotels were full. I found this hotel on Kayak and booked a corner room for about $300. They followed up to confirm and did and excellent job of follow up and communication. When I arrived the hotel was great, good location in the downtown. The check in was an excellent experience and the room was far beyond my expectations. Great bed, large room, fantastic view from the top corner. Great soaking tub and large rainfall shower. Flat screen tv's and excellent Internet. Turn down service each night with chocolates was a nice touch. Even though the hotel was great, the staff and customer service made this place shine above almost any chain I have stayed at. I will stay here anytime I return to Denver!

The hotel is wonderful. Would stay there again. Elway's at breakfast was terrible. Service was very slow and food is better at Denny's. Drinks at Elway's in the evening was ok, not great but good. Didn't eat dinner there.

My wife and I spent two nights at The Brown Palace while two of our married children stayed a few blocks down 17th St. As a guy who spent thirty-five years traveling extensively there is no way the Magnolia is better than this awesome home away from home. Yet had we listened to our fellow Trip Advisor friends we'd have selected the Magnolia. The rooms are much better decorated, the lobby is not to be compared, the bar is far superior offering a much better menu and the afternoon tea is not to be surpassed unless you leave the US. So let's get more people who have tried both to tell me why in the world they'd select the Magnolia over The Brown Palace. Two more things... We got a King room via Internet fir $150 & the wait staff in Ships bar are tops!
hotel_name: The Brown Palace Hotel and Spa

review_title: Elegant hotel. Beautiful music each day in the lobby.
review_text: Historical hotel with elegant atmosphere. Great staff. Perfect downtown location.
hotel_name: The Brown Palace Hotel and Spa

review_title: Great hotel and not too expensive
review_text: We stayed here for one night. Rooms are the standard of a ritz Carlton. Separate bath and shower were a treat as was the rain shower which was more like a waterfall! Bed was very comfy and there was even a tv in the bathroom to entertain you in the bath. Super quiet and lovely staff. No complaints at all.
Perfectly located to convention center, restaurants and bars in downtown
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_text: I stayed there with my husband and our two kids for the taste of Colorado and Elitchs and the location was convenient we were able to walk to most things. Upon arrival the staff was amazing and friendly the pop machine wasn't working but they fixed it immediately following a call from the assistant manager they went out of there way to make sure everything was perfect for us plus the pool was great for the kids also great view from the 17th floor. We will definitely be back.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_text: My family and i stayed this past Saturday night for the broncos game. We experienced top notch service as well as excellent rooms. We travel to Denver a lot for the bronco games and we look forward to staying here again.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_title: Nice boutique hotel in a great location
review_text:
We stayed here for three nights and had a pleasant time. The corner room was large and comfortable and the bed was superb. The lighting in the huge bathroom was poor, but they did provide a lighted makeup mirror I liked the way they didn't nickel and dime us as some high end hotels do--the Internet was free as well as the bottled water and the Wall Street Journal. Parking,alas, was $29 a day and it took 20 minutes to get our car one day. Luckily we could walk to toms of delightful restaurants. 
All in all we had a great time and would consider going again.
Stayed here for convention. Room were updated but tiny. Turn down service was great and bed was super comfortable. Hotel is at the edge of downtown with short walks to restaurants, shops, etc

I have stayed here three times and with each successive visit my expectations are further exceeded!
From the valet to the chamber maids, everyone demonstrates professionalism and warmth. 
If you are able, try to reserve one of the terrace rooms on the 9th floor! My room in particular had a beautifully appointed wrap around widows walk that was complimented by outdoor plants and outdoor carpeting. Our view faced north/east and north/west and the views of the setting sphere aglow in firery pastels over the front range made our room especially sweet!
Great avers products in our bathroom and comfy robes! Our sitting room was charming but I was especially pleased when the concierge, aware of my wifes fondness for dvd's to watch at night had a player waiting! This type of valued anticipation is what makes the teatro special!

Stayed for a convention. You can't beat the location. Everything you need and want is within walking distance. The food and beverage outlets took a little longer than usual, even when it wasnt at peak times. Front desk was very pleasant and helpful. Perfect for a business traveler.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_text: 4:00am right now, listening to the couple next door getting frisky. Headboard banging, voices, music. Seems like I'm in the room with them. A new hotel like this should have done better with the accoustics. Stay elsewhere.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_text: This Ritz Carlton location has excellent service, an expanded spa and exquisite rooms. It is walking distance to many Denver attractions.

review_title: Luxury at it's best; awesome restaurant and gym!
review_text:
I stayed at the Ritz recently on a business trip and was very impressed by the entire stay. The room was pristine, beautiful, and very comfortable. Additional amenities such as the included 52,000 sq ft gym next door (with fitness classes included - I took a TRX suspension trainer class!), a daily newsletter of Rockies games, Red Rocks concerts and other local happenings, and the espresso machine took the experience to another level.
