I got this room at a very affordable government rate, and it is well worth the extra price. 
The location made my co-worker nervous since it is farther than some of the other hotels but I found it to be a great location and very walkable. There is also a free streetcar 3 blocks over that takes you up and down most of 16th St (lots of shops and restaurants). The Ritz was also very convenient to Coors Field and Ellway's was a popular destination for others at the conference so after dinner I was right at my room!
The Ritz staff was unsurpassed in friendliness and attentiveness. I highly recommend this hotel and myself will be checking for a Ritz Carlton hotel before any others on all future trips.

Stayed here for business for 3 weeks and all I can say is wow. Everyone is so nice, they have complimentary breakfast and dinner.
Amazing, the GM and AGM are the best I have come across.
Recommended 1000%

review_title: Perfect spot for attending SIA Show at Convention Center.
review_text: We booked it at the last minute for a business trip to the Show. Can't believe they still had rooms. Right across the street from the convention center; great rooms; and not even expensive! What a find! The staff was really terrific and accommodating. If I go to SIA next year, I wouldn't even consider staying anywhere else.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Denver At Colorado Convention Center

review_title: Great value for clean, spacious room near airport.
review_text: Booking online was easy, friendly service at check-in, VERY clean, spacious room, hot breakfast in a nice, spacious common area with cozy fireplace. We couldn't believe we got such a great place for the price for our weekend trip to Denver to visit family.

I have the privilege of staying at Homewood suites and meeting the great chefs, wonderful general manager and awesome drivers. I am from a big city and travel often. I was extremely impress with the service, tentativeness of the staff and cleanliness of the hotel. Sandy, Carlos, Ray, Jim and the entire staff are the beat hotel staff I have experienced in years. Thank you for a great 3 week stay.
Room was clean, spacious, and well appointed. Staff was extremely friendly made us feel welcome everytime we returned "home".

review_title: One of the most business friendly hotels I've ever stayed at.
review_text: I will start by saying the general manager of the hotel is awesome, her and her staff are complete professionals. The rooms are always immaculate and well maintained. This property makes you feel like truly a home away from home. I won't stay anywhere else when I travel to Denver.

review_title: EXCELLENT ACCOMODATION FOR FLYING TO/FROM DENVER INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
review_text:
Huge suite, 100% comfort, clean and updted property, complimentary breakfast and airport shuttle.
Professional and friendly staff.
Exacly what we needed to recover from our jet-lag after flying in from our hometown in Italy.
Recommended for long stays, families and business travellers.
I wonder why the site is now asking for reviews over 300 letters...time-consuming for both writers and readers: doea anyone agree?

The service here was incredible! The staff really catered to us & got us anything we needed. The location was perfect for walking/running/biking to the monuments & museums & then to shops & restaurants in G'town. Our best trip to DC ever & we will return!

Quiet part of town with not much nearby is the only negative to this hotel. Rooms are clean, sumptuous, and spacious. Bathroom is well appointed and water pressure in the shower was refreshing. Courtyard view rooms are nice.

review_title: Not on Par with Ritz Standards
review_text: Was very disappointed with the service and the room decor. Many of the small details here are being missed.

review_title: Amazing! Friendly and helpful staff, perfect hotel experience!
review_text: Lovely hotel, fantastic experience! From the moment we arrived we were made to feel so welcome and the hotel had a lovely atmosphere. The staff went out of their way for us and were so friendly. I highly recommend this hotel.
Beautiful, exceptional service, great location, top notch. Stayed there to run the MCM and they had so many special treats for us! Loved it!

This was the first time that I have stayed at this property but the ritz never disappoints. The location is not as great as I would have liked but DC is easy to vet around in and cabs are cheap. Room was clean and the club lounge was inviting. It was great having a fitness club next door. Why would anyone stay anywhere but a ritz property. The service is great and the amenities top of the line. Only negative is the wife does not like the shampoo and conditioner. The hotel can even takes care of that problem. Great trip. I would not bring my kids here as there is no pool.

review_title: Wow! Fantastic value for top hotel
review_text:
I have stayed in a number of Four Seasons properties and am a Four Seasons fan. This hotel was selected by someone else for me for a business trip. What a great surprise, especially considering the rate. 
Highly recommended.

review_title: A Business Suite Solution in Washington DC
review_text:
Excellent option for business travellers who want long stay VFM. 
I took a team of 6 to this hotel! Allonthe advice of TripIt and I was not disappointed. Room for improvement but as they say, everything can be improved.
Rooms missing detailing but offer a sense of freedom and space which other hotels do not and a VFM solution. 
Excellent bar, good amenities in the room, and fit for purpose given it's location.... The location is excellent. 
Needs to work on detailing and ambience. The bar is fantastic but not worked into it's full potential. 
Staffers friendly but not so well informed to advise where to go for leisure, food and site seeing. 
These are nitty details, which detract from a great concept in hoteling... Just quite not there but has to be said, it is VFM.
Stayed the weekend of the Rock n Roll Marathon. Best decision ever. Great spa services post-run and within walking distance to really good food.

review_title: Slightly disappointed with our Denver Four Seasons stay
review_text:
I don't usually write reviews, but I feel I needed to express my frustration with the Four Seasons in Denver.Â  This is a fairly new hotel, and I expected so much more from the property.Â  We stayed for 3 nights at the end of September 2011.Â  The hospitality was great and the hotel in general was clean and nice so I don't want to deter anyone from staying there based on those issues.Â  The location was also great!Â 
My disappointment comes from things that I wouldn't expect from a luxury hotel such as the Four Seasons.Â  When we arrived and unpacked our bags we were scoping out the nice new room.Â  Right when I walked into the bathroom, there were 3 boxes of light bulbs sitting on the bathroom counter.Â  Not a huge deal, but definitely not what you would expect from any luxury hotel.Â  As we left to grab some food I brought the light bulbs down to the front desk, and was half-heartedly apologized to.
The first morning we used the Nespresso machine which is a nice added touch to the room (something you would expect).Â  The second morning, the Nespresso box was refilled, but this time one of the cartridges was already used!Â  The back of the cartridge was punctured by the machine, but the front was not.Â  It is kind of gross to think that this was used in someone else's room.Â  I wouldn't even expect this from a Holiday Inn, let alone a Four Seasons.Â 
I can give the staff the benefit of the doubt on both of these occasions.Â  It may just have been bad luck on our part to have both the light bulbs left in the room and the Nespresso cartridge stocked already used.Â  However, like I said earlier, these are not things you would expect from luxury branded hotels that pride themselves on the details.
Just a few minor things that I didn't like about the hotel were the parking and internet fees.Â  When you are paying a premium for a hotel room these types of fees should be included.Â  I am not rating my experience on the Four Seasons based on those things though because they were things that I knew about before booking.Â  They are just a little frustrating.
Hopefully, if you decide to stay at the Four Season Denver, your experience will be more on par with the other Four Seasons than ours was.

Nice hotel in a good location rooms are well furnished and kept and very unique /) nice touch with red in every room if you like red staff very friendly and helpful would stay again one thing you have to sign upto kimpton hotels to access the wifi and also ask for toiletries for the room and no coffee or tea in the room :( otherwise a good hotel and a differnt place to stay

This is a very nice hotel with trendy modern decor. The sinks in the bathroom light up from below which is pretty cool. The rooms have a great tub that is large enough for two and a really good shower as well. There aren't any ice machines on the guest room floors which is good because you don't have to have a room next to it, but if you want ice, you had to wait for them to bring it to you. Overall, this is a clean, modern, nice hotel in a great location. Close to the restaurants, shops and clubs downtown.

You can count on The Four Seasons to be consistent in its service culture. Denver is no exception. We stayed on a companion promotion and enjoyed every minute. They did run out of coffee in the lobby but good ol' reliable Starbucks was practically next door. A great staff. A great location. And a top notch hotel.

The Four Seasons recently opened in downtown Denver. As with every other Four Seasons Hotel we have stayed at, it is outstanding for service, room quality, facilities, etc. In addition to our hotel room, during our stay we utilized the pool, spa and Edge bar. All were exceptionally nice. The hotel is located very close to Larimer Square, performing arts theater and 3 major sports facilities.

review_title: Finally a mix of luxury and fun in Denver!!
review_text: The place to stay! Luxury with friendly staff and one of the most fun hotel lobby bars- tvs in the mirrors of bathrooms!
Just across from Georgetown. Room service was great; recommend the eggs with crab Benedict. Room was comfortable and staff was hospitable. Will be back.

The staff there reminded me of what service used to be like..people cared. I needed 3 things while I was there: an extra coffee, a small repair and a cab. Each were provided literally In less than 3 minutes. The rooms were roomy, updated and clean and the view was awesome. The free parking was a huge bonus. A plus!
Only downside is the metro subway is 1.8 miles and shuttle is only morning & evening.

Excellent hotel! Staff were very helpful especially Vince - he couldn't do enough to help us he was lovely! Wifi is excellent good strong signal, free secure parking is a bonus too. Location is excellent. 5 minute walk to national cathedral and restaurants/supermarkets nearby. We were 5 mins from the 'circulator' bus stop which is only $1 takes u to White house/Capitol hill too, taxi is only around $10 to White house. 5 minute walk to Georgetown which is a lovely area with nice shops & cafes etc. Rooms had flat screen tv's, microwave and fridge, sink and plates/cutlery too (we had normal king room). Would definitely stay here again!

We stayed for 4 nights in this hotel last week. We chose this hotel because we wanted to visit museums at the National Mall and wanted to be near them. Well it is about 12 mins walk to the National Mall. Metro station is also nearby. We got a free upgrade to a one bedroom suite complete with a fully-equipped mini-kitchen (dish washer, microwave, coffee maker, fridge with freezer and ice-maker, cooking and dining utensils). Also included was complimentary breakfast with good variety. Nice surprise was complimentary dinner (Mon-Wed only). Another plus is coin-operated laundary on 2nd floor, which made it easy for light-travelers like us.
There is parking in the basement for $35.40/night including taxes (yes, don't forget parking tax). The entrance to the parking lot is extremely narrow so you have to drive carefully. 
This hotel is primarily located within office area so it's hard to find restaurants/cafe at night or places for grocery shopping nearby.
Front desk staff was just ok but the staff in the dining area was extremely friendly and efficient considering the holiday crowd.
Overall we enjoyed our stay here and will recommend it to others.

The rooms are spacious and clean. It's also close to restaurants and little shops. The bus stop is only about one block away. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful.
The only bad thing is that it is not close to a subway station, but the hotel provide free shuttle to and from the nearest subway station.

review_title: Three blocks from Air & Space museum.
review_text: We stayed here with two other families during a long weekend in November. Hotel requirements were free breakfast and a pool. This hotel has both! Starbucks is two blocks away. Front desk staff were very helpful and accommodating. Def will stay he again with family.

review_title: Stayed for Denver Day of Rock
review_text: Loved the location.... Only liked the hotel. 40 mintues to have our bags delivered and that was only after we called? The room was super clean and very well furnished. Great location and only 2 blocks from everything good in downtown Denver. Only other issue was that our room never cooled as it should and when the air ran the unit squeaked badly.

review_title: This was my 2nd stay here, and I won't stay in any other hotel in DC!
review_text: The service was amazing - staff is helpful, and the rooms are clean, pretty, and have all the amenities. The van and shuttle service is the BEST! A huge thank you to Kevin Grell and his staff and to Mike with the van and shuttle service! See you next year or the one after!

review_title: This was the perfect Christmas vacation!
review_text:
The staff at Embassy Suites was absolutely fantastic. We had 3 families together, the front desk person Britney made 3-4 changes to find us 3 rooms together. The rooms were gorgeous, the food was good in the morning, the pool was great and the free drinks in the evening was just an icing on the cake. 
I highly recommend this hotel especially with family after sating at many hotels in DC.

We were here for the Susan Komen 3Day for the Cure walk. Stayed here before and after the walk. The staff were delightful. The wine reception every might was a nice treat. Pricey by my standards, but then this is DC. Price was comparable to other hotels in the area. My first but certainly not last stay at a Kimpton hotel!! Make sure u sign up as a Kimpton in Touch member before your stay!prepare to be well taken care of!

review_title: Cafe Lombardy--Old fashioned charm just down the street from 1600 PA.
review_text:
My wife and I met friends for lunch at Cafe Lombardy recently. This small restaurant, just down the street from the White House is just right for a nice lunch with excellent food and outstanding service. We had various appetizers-- an excellent chicken and corn chowder for me and French onion soup for others. In two words, ummmm good. My wife had an eggplant and chicken salad, one friend had a juicy burger,another had chicken pot pie and I had crab cake with sweet corn and salad. We all judged our meals as excellent. Pinot Grigio and Chardonnay were the wines of choice. No space left for anything but coffee. 
You should know, this place is pricey and if you decide to have more than one glass of wine, consider buying a bottle. 
But we will be back since in past times my wife and I would meet here for breakfast--she loves their Eggs Benedict with Lox. 
Was forced to rate the room although we did not stay there.

Here for business alot and always try to stay here. Great location near a metro. Quieter part of town. Excellent workout facilities. Good breakfast. Dinners are okay but I prefer to cook. Kitchen in room is good. Clean hotel. Laundry facilities are also good. Dry cleaners directly across the street and church is two blocks.

review_title: Very good to excellent for everything!
review_text:
I enjoyed my stay very much! All of the staff was very pleasant and very helpful, but I was particularly impressed with Deenny. He always greeted me on my return to the hotel as if I was a long lost friend and gave me excellent instructions on what train to take on the Metro to and from the Capitol. The Metro is pretty simple to use if you know what train to take and Deenny made sure I did! 
Ray Walker
arayw@aol.com

review_title: Lovely hotel, great location, clean and comfortable with friendly staff.
review_text: This boutique hotel was exactly what it showed on the website. The rooms were clean and trendy with a big comfortable bed. The location was perfect for walking down town to the White house or up to foggy bottom and George town. I would definitely stay here again.
Location of the hotel is great 5 min walk to georgetown. Our room was very big and very clean! The door man and front desk service was not of a 4 star hotel.

We were in DC with our teenage children to sightsee and visit Georgetown and GW colleges. I thought the Embassy Suites would fit the families needs for space with four of us. 
At $460 night expected a lot more from the rooms and hotel in general. Staff was great! Helpful, courteous and did their best to accommodate our needs.
They say they are remodeling some rooms which is desperately needed. The happy hour and overall feeling of the hotel was not up to par.....big bowls of chips, preztels, tables of toddlers screaming and an overall feeling of.......this for $460???
Next were the rooms, first room was across from huge construction project, poorly laid out, old popcorn ceilings and press board furniture with old huge tube tv's. Just a feeling of a old holiday inn in the hallways and rooms! Changed rooms and it was not much more appealing, hallway walls scratched and spotted carpet, just not up to par. We had to get put and go for a walk, spoke to family and we ended up going out for a walk and researchig last minute accomodations and found the JW Marriott which was beautifu! Well appointed and simply elegant hotel with updated rooms, nice finishes and we were offered a two room junior suite for $600 night.....night and day difference on the quality of hotel and definitely worth the extra $140 per night.
The great staff at Embassy Suites could not make up for the worn out finishes, outdated rooms and tacky feel.
Stayed for 3 nights. Have no complaints. Location was perfect for walking to all the sites. Would stay again for sure!

review_title: Loved it the first time so We stayed again
review_text: Love everything about this place.. Only one complaint this time.. Super loud and noisy neighbors from 12-3 am ...I guess that group didn't have to sign the waiver about being loud and having parties in the rooms since it was the weekend :( very frustrating!

I stayed here with my boyfriend and we loved it. The rooms were huge. I never had so much space in a regular room. The staff was polite and did things quickly. Free drinks at night and they did a secret password to get a free appetizer or desert. I got the red velvet cupcakes which were dry and i didn't like them. But everything else makes up for them and hey they were free anyway so i wasn't highly disappointed. I would def stay there again.

review_title: Great hotel but at a price
review_text: We stayed here for a 5 day trip to Washington. We opted for the price that did not include breakfast. I was glad we did as it is only a simple continental breakfast with limited options. For the price of the breakfast it would not have been worth it. The staff was excellent and made you feel at home. They were great with kids and were very helpful. There is no pool for the youngsters but there are games avalailable. There is also not shuttle but cabs line up out front to take you wherever. One tip is to opt for the private Town Car drivers as they give you a much better deal than the actual cabbie with their meters. They really jack up the extra charges. The hotel isn't real close to a metro statio which is about the only draw back. There are also very few restaurants right near by. Aside from that, I loved the hotel and would recommend if you got a good deal. They are great about hiding your bags also I you get in early it want to stat late.

I love the location if you want access to the convention center or a few block walk to China Town. Parking fees and somewhat tighter than usual suite space is to be expected in an urban location. I'm a bit surprised to have a flat panel TV in the living room and old tube TV in bedroom.

review_title: Great location and great for families!
review_text: I stayed there this week with my husband and 2 yr old son and it was great. Staff was helpful and comp breakfast and dinners were very good and convenient. Easy walking distance to all attractions. Would love to stay again.

review_title: One of the best hotel experiences I've ever had
review_text: My wife and I spent our 10 year wedding anniversary there over the weekend and the hotel staff went out of their way to make it a weekend we will cherish for the rest of our lives. They were polite, pleasant and didn't wait for us to approach them for questions or require help. The entire staff deserves a huge service award. We will definitely be staying with them again soon.

review_title: The best thing about this boutique hotel is the attentive staff who made it our home away from home.
review_text: Great location and much more personal attention than at the larger chain hotels. I travel a lot and can honestly say staying at the Lombardy made this our best family vacation. The bell staff was incredible!! Whether it was arranging transportation, helping plan excursions, or offering something extra as we headed out for the day, they treated us like family. We also enjoyed wonderful breakfasts (especially the almond French toast) and dinner at their restaurant, also with impeccable service! All too often the hotel you choose is just a place to sleep while away from home. But, the staff at the Hotel Lombardy truly made us feel like it was our home!

Come on! Even the cheapest place gives you FREE WIFI! They want $14.95. Parking car is $45! I stayed here 5 years ago and it is going down hill fast. Sorry I recommended to stay here with our friends on our road trip. the free breakfast was great as we were early risers. Manager reception was not so good because of all the kids running around. I know they have no control over this though. The concierge was very good and 
Helpful and the gal who checked us in was very friendly. The rooms were good but showing wear with chipped paint and mold on shower curtain. EWwww! Location was so-so. do not expect the Big bus tour they recommend to be good as we waited over an hour at one spot to be picked up and we finally had to take a taxi to the starting point at Ford theater where they were rude. Overall disappointing and embarrassing to recommend this place to out traveling companions.

review_title: Nice, spacious room with excellent staffs.
review_text: I enjoyed my stay at Hotel Rouge. The room was clean and spacious. Most importantly, the staffs are wonderful, helpful and friendly. The overnight staffs always acknowledge me and smiled at me even though I was drunk like a sailor. Personally, I could not force myself to smile at 3AM in the morning. In any case, I highly recommend this hotel.

First the good. The location is great, walking distance to the Mall and White House. The room was huge, more like a small apartment. Also, there was a very good Italian restaurant next door, Piatti something. Highly recommended, especially on a warm night.
Now the bad. Front desk staff was not especially helpful, bell captain became noticeably cool after receiving only a $5 tip. (?) Also, WiFi was supposed to be included, but it never worked in the room. We were told to try the Lobby, and then told to go in the bar, because it worked better there. This is not acceptable. WiFi is important to us, especially when staying for three days as we did. In any case, the physical surroundings were great, but the staff was not always helpful.

Nice newer building close to many museums, galleries, etc. Suites were really clean and nicely decorated. Great pool and gym area. Parking was a bit expensive at $30 a day so if I stayed again I would use the garage next door for $10 a day. Great free breakfast!

review_title: Great service, cool rooms and close to Dupont Circle
review_text:
My husband and I recently stayed here to see all the DC sights. We chose this hotel after looking at many options. From reading other reviews and looking at photos it seemed to us Rouge was a funky, fun, clean hotel with good service and I'm happy to say we found that to be true. We learned that Rouge would match any price we could find online and we found a cheaper price on Expedia. We also signed up for their Kimpton Hotels membership and that gave a few perks. 
When we arrived at the hotel, we decided to park our car with their valet and the guys were really nice. We had looked around for other parking options as the cost per night was $36! But we couldn't find anything cheaper in the neighborhood. Most hotels in DC charge over $30/night for parking, or at least the ones we looked at did. I just had to add that to the nightly hotel rate and I still think we got a bit of a deal.
The one thing we had trouble with was the wi-fi. One of the Kimpton Hotel membership benefits was free wi-fi, which is normally about $10/night. I had trouble connecting to their wi-fi everyday of our 5 day stay. We were on the 7th floor and if I went into the bathroom area, I could connect, but as soon as I walked back over to the bed, I would lose the signal. It really was never a huge deal as I could just turn off wi-fi and use 3G, but if I had been there on business, it would have been annoying. 
The hotel offered a Happy Hour one night while we were there. They offered great sangrias, wine and beer. It was much appreciated after a long hot day of walking around DC.
My husband and I opted to not eat or drink in the onsite bar. There are some cool restaurants, bars and a Whole Foods about 5 minutes away near Logan Circle. 
We really appreciated the front desk check-in staff. They were very helpful and friendly.
We would definitely stay here again.

review_title: Great value---skip the expensive alternatives and you won't be sorry!
review_text: I have taken a group here twice--once in April 2010 and again in November 2011. The hotel has made significant upgrades. The rooms are newly furnished in a simple, tasteful, and comfortable manner. They are small but quite adequate. Breakfast is very good with plenty of hot and cold options. Most of all, the staff is friendly and extremely accommodating and helpful. They took care of my group's special needs with good cheer. I can only say positive things about this hotel--great value in an excellent location. Why stay somewhere that charges almost double the rate? You won't be sorry if you have a group or are traveling alone or with family for business or pleasure.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn Downtown DC / Convention Center

review_title: Staff great aside from front desk.
review_text: Everyone outside and involved in service was great - except the front desk clerks who had their noses high in the air. Special thanks to Amadou who went far out of his way to give us spectacular customer service.

This hotel has a lot going for it. The rooms are large, the location is good, the breakfast was excellent, and the evening reception was nice. My only complaint is the cost of parking and the lack of free Wi-Fi. I am always amazed that I can stay in a cheap hotel and have free Wi-Fi, but more expensive hotels charge. It is too bad that the on off trolleys don't make stops at the hotels like they do in other cities. It is a short walk though.

review_title: We loved the rouge kimpton in Washington d. C.!
review_text: Rooms were very clean. Great service. A bit of a walk to the attractions but if your kids are old enough it is very worth it! Good neighborhood and quiet at night. They like kids and dogs and we got a night of free valet parking because we have a red car! You can ask for a pet free room if you want. Totally cool hotel with great decor and wine tasting for free in evening.

this hotel is great!!! you must stay here! the only thing that bothered me is that the air conditioning was not very good. I stayed in the room with the king bed and bunk beds and it was very nice but had one small bathroom for four of us which didn't work well.

review_title: great stay and great employeesNice hotel
review_text: hotel was great. Would stay again without a doubt.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn Downtown DC / Convention Center

review_text: I stayed here with my wife for our anniversary last year. Classic starwood property with all the service and amenities one would expect. Great staff, clean large rooms and a pretty good location. Highly recommended for business and pleasure travelers.

review_title: All around best place to stay in DC!
review_text: The hotel is well manicured, with impeccable rooms! The bathroom spacious with an amazing double shower head. The staff are on the point. We were greeted with smiles and a great help and assitance when needed. The location is perfect, walking distance to the metro and Georgetown and cabs are always standing ready to take you anywhere further. Overall great experience. Will be back soon!

Location was great, breakfast was great, rooms were great but very thin walls. Any noise in hallway or next door and you could hear it. The front desk staff was clueless and awful, and our room wasn't ready on time. However I would stay again if the price issue right. Note....different price for two doubles vs one king bed....never had that before in an embassy suites, especially when the rooms were the same size.

I was so unure about this hotel judging from the outside but inside its so nice. The red floors were spic n span..the staff was supa nice and it was so modern with the art and red decor. Supa supa clean! The rooms look way better in person. I had the deluxe room and it is by far the best room I ever stayed in..bed was sooo comfy and the room n bathroom was clean. I'm coming back soon..loved it

Good location - if you like to walk, you can walk to the White House, the Mall, and Georgetown. And Metro and Circulatory (buses) are only a few blocks away.
The staff has consistently been responsive. The room is clean and the beds and bedding are in good shape and comfy.
The issues we've had:
Wifi only worked for one of our 6 days. We asked for them to fix this every day. We were told the routers are stored in guest rooms, and they couldn't reboot the one we access because there is a do not disturb sign on that room's door!
We ordered the same breakfasts every day for room service - sides of eggs - and what we got wasn't consistent - different amount of eggs, sometimes charged for the toast and sometimes not...
There's no fan in the bathroom.

review_title: Great hotel at a great price!
review_text:
We stayed at this hotel for 4 nights. The place was great. The location is good - about a 20 minute walk to the national mall and the rooms are a good size.
The service we recieved was excellent. Staff were polite and very helpful.
The hotel gives free cookies at 3pm in the lobby area. Try these -They're wonderful!
Breakfast included everything you could ever need with a good selection of breads, cereals and hot items.
There aren't many great restaraunts near this hotel so we ended up having to take cabs most evenings. But cabs are cheap and never cost more than $6. It is possible to walk. It took us 20 minutes to walk north towards u street where there are loads of restaraunts and bars. When we did walk we felt 110% safe as the hotel is in a decent area of the city. Washington has loads of expensive hotels, and so this is great for the price and what it offers. A must place if you want a good quality, clean hotel and dont mind walking short distances to the main sights and restarunts.
hotel_name: Comfort Inn Downtown DC / Convention Center

review_text: This was a very nice Hilton Hotel. As you enter the lobby it has the feel of a small boutique hotel not a big chain. Bar area off the lobby was quite nice and so was the staff. Our room was a nice size with a king bed. The bed was a sleep number bed and it was great to be able to adjust the firmness. There is a small refrigerator & microwave in the room. All the staff that we met were very helpful. The only drawback to this hotel is the fact that the street noise can be heard in the room. Even on the 9th floor. Also be careful of the valet parking costs. It is not a 24 hour cost. No matter what time you check in the cost of your parking restarts at noon the next day (checkout time). And yes that fact is stated at the valet station. Just seems a bit extreme since I have stayed in other Hilton's and the cost is for a 24 hour period.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington, DC Downtown

review_text: Comfy beds, quiet rooms, amazing service, great food. Have stayed at much more expensive hotels and not had nearly as impressive of an experience. Our Only complaints were the ridiculously cold pool and not having complimentary wifi. Would definitely recommend this hotel.
hotel_name: Embassy Suites Denver - Downtown / Convention Center

review_title: Hotel couldn't have been nicer or had better service.
review_text: Service was outstanding. Deenny was very friendly and proactive.I would have preferred if their were more restrooms in the conference areas.

review_title: nice place but if you need to be at work in am DONT go to breakfast!
review_text: Nice place, friendly people but don't try to get up in the morning and go to breakfast before work! line was out the door of the dining room 3 days straight. rooms are nice. managers happy hour is terrible! kids running all over the place! happy is hour is for adults not for kids ordering smurf drinks and holding up the beverage line. yes folks be prepared for that! it's bad enough happy hour is a short as it is, now mix in screaming demanding little kids in the mix. next time I am here in business I am going to choose another "executive" type hotel. so if your here on business find another place. trust me you will be glad I told you so. other than all that the suites are clean staff is great on all levels.

review_title: Eclectic but functional nice people good service
review_text:
Comfortable room of a decent size.
Everything worked well. Good service and friendly people. Walking distance to good restaurants shops etc.
Good service, but not very close to anything 4 blocks from the metro and is hard to get a cab. Room service is reasonable and is good

Arrived thanksgiving day to friendly staff and rooms that where ready, check was easy and they valet the car, the kids were excited to get up stairs to the room
Room. Was very clean we were on the 10th floor and it was nice that you can not access the upper floors with out a key card.
Hotel is within walking distance to the white house and mall, but you have to enjoy walking.
stated 
The breakfast buffet was fantastic and the ex chef was very accommodating as was all of the staff. I would reccomend this hotel for short or long stays.
The metro was across the street as was a Starbucks.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington, DC Downtown

review_title: Georgetown is a great place to stay.
review_text: Amadou/Erwing great guys a lot of help, would recommend this hotel to multiple friends, plan on staying here everytime I come to georgetown or even the greater D.C. Area.

We stayed here in a velvety red room with a king size bed that was quite comfortable. No complaints.
The only con to this hotel is that it's a bit of a walk to/from the Metro. But Dupont Circle is a great neighborhood to walk through.
And thanks to an efficient staff member, the loud bridal party in the suite next door shut up quickly.

review_title: Valet attendents were helpful, my car was immediately available every time I wanted it. Amadou & Erwing saw to it.
review_text: I was disappointed and because I am writting this on my blackberry I will not go into detail. However, I will look into the Ritz next time.

So here are the positives:
The hotel is within walking distance to the metro and is easily accessed from outside the city.
The rooms are of a good size and clean.
The free breakfast is good and not too crowded if you arrive before 8am.
Here is the negative:
I came with two other people and one slept on the couch in the living room area. We were on the fifth floor facing the atrium and at night it was ridiculously loud. I'm not sure if there is a dance club in the lobby but it certainly sounded that way!
My conclusion is that it is a pretty good hotel but I would seriously recommend asking to be placed higher than the 5th floor (the last floor that is open to the atrium) to avoid the noise.

The front desk receptionist made checking in and out awkward. The cooling system kept going off during our stay (it was turned off). Nicely situated near the White House we were able to walk to many monuments. Unfortunately, there aren't too many shops and restaurants open in the area on weekends. You have to travel to eat if you aren't eating in the hotel.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington, DC Downtown

review_text: Stayed here for Marine Corps Marathon. Located across street from Metro and within walking distance of great restaurants, sites, etc. Two Starbucks within 2 blocks in either direction. Staff was super friendly and attentive. Shannon in restaurant/lounge was awesome! Definitely would stay here on next visit to DC.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington, DC Downtown

review_text: Sure, there are finer, classier, and more interesting hotels in Washington, DC. In fact my husband and I stayed here while we attended a wedding at The Willard Intercontinental (which is, for the record, wow!). But the Hilton Garden Inn has it all: location, spacious rooms, friendly staff, and did I mention location? We had an amazing wedding rate of $119 a night which made it a steal.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington, DC Downtown

review_title: Awesome ...loved the flavored water as you walked into the lobby....lime and lemon with Mint leaves....very refreshing ... I lov
review_text: One complaint .....A huge Roach on the Hilton welcome mat when I came in from the parking lot! This thing had a social security number it was so big! Lol...
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington, DC Downtown

review_title: Was over and beyond our expectations!
review_text: Rooms clean, beds very comfortable..staff was awesome and very accommodating! Food was very good. Great place for a family vacation! Budget friendly without giving up any luxury!

My husband and I stayed here one night in June. If we could have gotten another room in a different hotel when we checked in we would have left immediately! The room was tiny and dirty. There was hair all over the sheets and stains. One of the worst hotels I've ever stayed in. We checked out first thing in the morning.

Pleasantly surprised by this particular hotel, a notch above other Hilton Garden Inns that I stayed at. Within walking distance to the National Mall and the White House. I left some items in the room after checking out and leaving town. Angel, housekeeping supervisor, tracked them down and will send them back to me. Great service and friendly to boot. Thank you so much. (value is based on the room rate booked.)
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington, DC Downtown

review_text: This place is well located for Georgetown and metro stops. You can walk anywhere of any interest from here if you want. Smithsonian is about 30 mins and verizon about 20 min walk. Bed was really comfy but rooms a little noisy as theres a lot of sirens on the night due to close proximity of hospital and obama's entourage driving past. Breakfast is ok, average. We didn't get our room cleaned for 3 days! However, we would probably stay here again as it was relatively cheap. Gym is poor though. 2 runners, 1 bike xtraineer and a step machine!

I am Hilton gold member. Have stayed in lots of embassy suites. By far this is the worse. Not your typical suites. First only thing good is location. Rooms are smaller than typical embassy suites with 2 beds. Breakast forget about it. Packed and line out the door. Couldn't get table. Pool very small and crowded. Cell phone and Internet wifi doesn't work in rooms. Cable movie service was out of order. Pick another hotel close by.

review_title: Great location and value for DC tourists
review_text:
We were visiting DC with a group of friends over the weekend and stayed here. DC is a walking city anyway and the transit system is really very efficient. This hotel is very near the Metro (subway) stop. It has a daily manager's reception, which unfortunately we missed out on because we were going around in the afternoon. Free breakfast is always good anywhere but here they have hot breakfast options. 
For first timers in DC, make sure you drop by the concierge to get tour options, restaurant recommendations and even airport shuttle arrangements.
We were really happy with our stay here, inspite of the hot and humid weather this past weekend.

review_title: Fantastic lay-out for a 60 person meeting!
review_text: We hosted a 2 day meeting event at this location and had a great experience with the convention, banquet and bell staff. Our participants enjoyed the fresh and tasty food and rooms, we enjoyed that all the meeting space was conveniently located on 1 level. And without the attentive assistance of Amadou and Erwing at the door our complicated arrivals and departures in bad weather would not have been such an easy process! Thanks and we look forward to using you again!

I have stayed in many Mariotts - from JWs and Courtyards to Residence Inn. This is the most underwhelming. The room for our family was small and old - time for a refurb. Washington is expensive but this didn't represent value for money.

review_title: It's ok...wouldn't stay here again though...
review_text:
Pros:
Hotel itself is very nice and clean. Staff were very friendly. 
Cons:
I was afraid to walk in the area alone. There was an HBO pamphlet in the room but no HBO. There were no blackout curtains...just a thin white curtain...there are tons of lights outside, so it's very bright when you're trying to sleep.
hotel_name: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Washington DC-Northeast

review_text: Just stayed at the Tabard Inn and would thoroughly recommend it - it is charming, full of character, relaxing and in a great location. The breakfast was healthy and delicious and there were passes for the local gym included. Perfect place for holiday but maybe not for business traveller.

I lived in dc for four years before moving away. My husband and I were returning fir new years and were so excited to get a room there for the weekend. I must admit, we were a but enchanted by the quaintness of the place and thought it would be special. However, from minute one to the minute we finally left there everything was absolutely awful. We had to hunt down staff ti get our key when we would return from being out, we got yelled at for hanging out in the lobby, the beds were barely sleep able and the breakfast was mediocre at best. Also, no ine ever hepled us with our bags coming in or leaving which i found surprising given tight stairwells. Overall, I'd give it a rating of "simply awful" and will not only never stay ere but strongly advise others looking for a place in dc not to stay there. Sad really.

I stayed for a few nights in early December 2011. Overall very pleased with my stay. A lot of reviews claim the rooms are too small. I had the 'Standard Room' and found it a very decent size. I was traveling by myself. Very friendly staff. And it's all about Location Location Location. 2 metro stations right nearby. Excellent choice of restaurants nearby including some nice vegan restaurants. (Try Maoz Vegetatian) it was awesome. 
Pros: very secure (I locked myself out within the first hour and had to goto the desk to tell them. They checked my id which I thought was excellent on their part so that they just wouldn't let anyone in)
Very friendly staff. 
Great location. 
Nice rates. 
Mostly clean
Nice shower
Chilled bottled water
Cons: light dust, a few stray hairs on bed sheet. 
Sub-standard tv. It claims to be hd, but it looks standard to me, kinda small too. 
Very noisy past 6am. Don't plan on sleeping in due to lots of traffic noise, as well as hotel noise. 
Cafe Solei does not deliver just drinks to your room as the in room menu claims that it does, you have to order food too. 
Movies are overpriced. 
So overall, I would certainly recommend this hotel. Especially of its just for one or two travelers. I ride the metro so many times and it's very nice to have close access to the whole city via the metro. Did not eat at the Cafe so I can't rate their food. If I travel to dc again, this will be the first hotel I check out again.

We went to DC for a Nationals game and stayed the night so we could tour the mall with the kids the next day. The Best Western was great. Close to the metro or a shirt Taxi ride to the monuments if you prefer. Lots of great restaurants nearby although it is not actually in Georgetown. The hotel is great for the price and good for our family.

Accompanied my hubby to a conference in DC at the Mandarin Oriental where the hotel was comfortable, the bed heavenly, the decor understated Asian elegant. Awesome viiew of the Washington Monument from our room I enjoyed spending time in and around the pristine swimming pool with lap lane and comfy cushioned lounge chairs sunlit and with surprising harbor views. The women's spa facilities were superb with excellent steam room, therapy pool and shower feature. The bath and spa products were magnificent. The house keeping services were timely and unobtrusive. Because not many nearby dining options, ate several delectable meals at SouWest restaurant. hotel has a most convivial bar with live music in the evening. All service was uniformly excellent throughout the hotel even though the large scale doesn't allow it to be very personal. There were extra touches such as delivery of several daily newspapers, complimentary morning coffee service in the lobby and several free movie channels. A CVS and Starbucks next door supplied added conveniences. The concierge was helpful with easy directions to the Bureau of Printing and Engraving and Holocaust museum, easy walks close by. Hubby and I took quick walk to the nearby DC Wharf for fresh seafood lunch. other sights were also within easy walking or cab distance, as was a Metro stop. I had a fabulous time all in all, and amazed to end a city stay feeling so relaxed and refreshed.

The location is great; but that's all! Metro with good restaurants & drug stores nearby. The service (except for Regina who is professional & customer centered) is horrible to mediocre. The hotel leadership's flaws are evident in staff performance. We left with a suitcase full if "I'm sorry's and it's not my fault". Problems= $25/day inconvenient, self park, gave away our confirmed room size, cheap uncomfortable sofabed, rough towels, carpet over uneven floor, breakfast was so-so, rude night shift, broken ac/noisy box fan, chauvinistic comments, meeting room space inadequate.

review_title: Great hotel, great service, great location.
review_text: We stayed here for 3 nights this past weekend on HHonors points. Everyone at the hotel was courteous and eager to help. Location is great for sightseeing. We walked to the museums and most of the monuments from here. The nightly manager's reception was great after a day of walking. Rooms were comfortable. The bell desk and valet were very nice, always looking to help with directions. Azi at the Concierge desk was fabulous, very helpful. Parking was pricey but you had in and out priviliges if you wanted. Plenty of Internet kiosks in the lobby. All in all a real winner.

review_title: Mandarin Makes The Best of an Awkward Location
review_text:
The Mandarin Oriental in Washington, DC is a luxury property located in an odd little pocket of the capital city. Overlooking the Potomac, Tidal Basin, and Interstate 395, the development surrounding the hotel is a gem in a neighborhood that lacks the feel of an actual neighborhood. It is very conveniently located, provided you know how to get around.
The staff at the Mandarin are top notch--from the moment you arrive you will find friendly, helpful and discreet people at every turn. The rooms are well appointed and the conference facilities extensive.

review_title: Great location if you're looking for something clean, safe and relatively basic
review_text: Great location, 5 mins walk into Georgetown and easy access to subway for getting to mall, museums etc (although they are also within walking distance of the hotel if you feel up to it). Friendly and speedy check in, surprised by size of room (huge with bedroom, bathroom and large lounge/kitchen area). Decor throughout hotel was a little dated and basic but very clean - when we stayed all carpets and soft furnishings were being cleaned which apparently happens on a regular basis. Didn't sample breakfast, friends told us it was okay, but again pretty basic. Don't come here for 5 star luxury, but if you want somewhere clean, safe and well located this is the place

The hotel is in a great location for sightseeing. We stayed here on vacation using HHonors points. It is walking distance from the white house and China town. It is also across the street from a metro (subway) station. The metro there is very clean and safe by the way. The decor in the lobby and breakfast area were modern and cool. The front desk area is tiny and very busy. It was hard to get bell service sometimes because they were so busy. We needed to store our bags after we checked out and had to wait a long time for help. then they gave us claim checks but left the bags in the hall and went outside to help people. We asked the clerks at the desk about when our bags would be put away. One lady was snippy and said we just needed to wait. However another lady ignored the first one and put our bags in storage herself and was very nice. They have a restaurant not a self service breakfast and breakfast is not included in your stay. the servers were very good. The room
was average size.
hotel_name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington, DC Downtown

review_text: Thoroughly enjoyed my stay! The concierge level was so helpful when we didn't feel like a big meal and/or going to a restaurant.
We stayed at the Marriott during our April Vacation. The location was perfect as was the Room. Staff were very helpful. Would definitely recommend and would stay here again.

review_title: Nice Marriott, about a mile from Georgetown University
review_text: Service was overall very good. My husband had to go across the street for a morning cup of coffee after being ignored by the restaurant employees on Sunday. However, the staff late Saturday night were very accommodating for a late night burger.

This is what you would expect of a business hotel but doesn't seem to carry the banner as well as mandarins in theorist of the world. The rooms were fair sized and the bathroom was nicely appointed. It is all looking a bit old number but the club lounge had a decent selection for breakfast but they are obviously concerned that wecare going to pig out and gave us the tiny side plates. Of course I pigged out I just went up a number of times and used more and more plates. The fruit in he room iscan old custom that I still enjoy and was tasty and ripe. Laundery was reasonable and efficient. Business Centre is unmanned on the weekend and for the life of me didn't quite grasp the complexities of logging onto the computer an credit card usage. Not cheap at $850 pn but all together nothing to complain about nor rave about!

review_title: Average hotel with above average prices !!
review_text: I was totally underwhelmed with this hotel. for$650 a night, i was expecting a room that was more than one step above a Marriott. Breakfast buffet was average and the choices for in romm dining were poor. I would definitely NOT stay here again.

review_title: Fair is fair: My recent experiences are much better than the past one
review_text:
I previously wrote a review where I roundly criticized the hotel for overbooking and sending me elsewhere after midnight following a long day of travel.
As a very frequent business who routinely calls a hotel the day of arrival to confirm my room, I think it is fair to say I was not a very happy camper and made that clear on my tripadvisor comment.
So what is the follow-up?
Since my organization has a preferred vendor relationship with Hilton and this is otherwise a nice place with a good location for what I need to do when I am in Washington, i have stayed there several time subsequently.
Frst, i will say that the manager and I had a discussion about he events. That discussion was useful and I appreciate his effort.
Second, this IS a nice hotel for business travel. Room service is fine for what it is, and the breakfast is great. I must take note here of the fact that the gentleman who cooks the breakfast is terrific. And i do mean terrific. He is incredibly pleasant, hard working, and has something nice to say to everyone. Don't laugh, but I think he may be one of the most engaging short order cooks i have met. I actually look forward to saying hello to him in the morning.
As to the rest of the details, the rooms are fine, the location great, staff reasonably pleasant (although on my last stay the lady who checked me out did not even look me in the eye and say thank you when she handed me the invoice. But that one episode is more than balanced by the kindnesses of other desk staffers on other occasions).
Finally, not a bad workout area although sometimes the ellipticals are filled early in the morning.
All in all, a good hotel with reasonable rooms in a good location, depending on what your needs are. And one really terrific cook who can get your day off to a very pleasant start.

review_title: Secluded, yet in the middle of town. Elegant, yet comfortable and practical.
review_text: Excellent hotel, typical Mandarin large elegant open spaces, spotless and fantastic service. I was there with my two young kids and we had cookies and mm's waiting in our fantastic room overlooking the Washington monument. The bathroom is huge with separate shower and bathtub. We dined downstairs in the patio and it was delicious. All the staff was very professional yet friendly. Just be careful if you are checking out early as I waited for a cab for 30 minutes.

review_title: Perfect entral location to all business or pleasure in DC.
review_text: Easy accesss to Georgetown or K street or the National Mall. Quiet street easy to find with a very friendly, helpful reception desk.

review_title: Not a hotel worth the money
review_text:
Arrived at 11pm tired,hungry, and in search of an adult beverage.Told that all restaurants and bars, including room service are closed tight at 11pm, no exceptions to be made. Was made aware by the night qmanager that my close to $400 spend should be considered a bargain, and that there was a pizza joint 4 blocks away that was open.
Just as a heads up, I am not one to whine..but to pay what I did and essentially have no better service than a Hampton Inn in BFE...justbmakes nomsense to me.

review_title: Perfect hotel for the Nation's Capital City
review_text:
A gem of a hotel in the middle of DC. Close to everything, including downtown nightlife and main tourist areas. 
Super clean public areas and guest rooms. Stayed in a one bedroom suite which was fantastic. Travel frequently and was impressed with how quiet and well-maintained the room was at this hotel. 
Other pros: one of the best breakfasts I have had at a hotel. Great choices, tasty, and FREE. Fun complimentary happy hour reception every evening. Staff, from the front desk to the general manager, were professional and made us feel welcome. 
Had dinner at hotel's restaurant in the evening. Great steak and fun bar.
Definitely will stay here again when I need a hotel downtown DC. Also will recommend for any family or friends who want a great hotel in the middle of all the action in DC. 
Very impressed.

Stayed during a heat wave. The hotel's common areas were at least 80 degrees. The room's air co had 2 settings - off or full blast. Hallways were dark, and probably dingy, but hard to see. Not high on my list to return.

Stayed here during a trip to DC for work. Staff VERY friendly! Bed was the most comfy hotel bed I've ever slept on, everything about this hotel is plush. Downside- longer walk than I'd like to the metro, about 10 minutes. Also every restaurant in that area closes early--so if you want to go out for a drink or snack you're pretty well out of luck. Of course you could eat at the hotel, it's only $14 for 3 scoops of
Ice cream!!! Who pays that?! The snacks in the mini bar are crazy too, I think $4 or $6 for a little coke? There are no vending machines in the hotel. Bring tip cash!! I guess I'm more of a Hampton Inn girl. :) don't get me wrong, this hotel was sweet, but more fancy than I need.

I arrived at the hotel around 10:30. No one was at the door to lete in and the doors aren't automatic so after struggling to get my luggage through the door I then waited for the one person to check me in. There were 2 people waiting, one person getting checked in with lira of hotel staff milling around but no one offering to help. I got to my room anxious to take a hot bath to relax from my day of travel. I quickly see the ton has not been cleaned as there were toe nails in the tub. Almost got sick. I called the front desk. After waiting 30 minutes with no response I jumped into the shower only to find scolding hit water that could not bs regulated. Bellman shows up 5 minutes after I attempted to take shower and finally escorts me to a new room (40 minutes later). This hotel is sn embarrassment to the mandarin oriental. Do not waste your money By the way the manager on duty never bothered to call.

review_title: Not worth the money, not 5 star, not the Ritz Carlton
review_text:
Overall experience was oK, not worth the money. 
1) Hotel, room appointments were mid-range, not high end. (Furniture, bath, spa, etc)
2) When my wife and I get away from our young kids (not often), we like to spend part of the trip alone in the room. Usually we'll watch a movie. But no pay-per-view? Instead a DVD player? That went out of date before this hotel was even built! Not to mention out of date selection of dvd's, but really, I shouldn't have to leave my room (or put on my pants) to watch a movie. 
3) "club level" was a disappointment. Food was ok, but again not on par w 5 star hotel. But main problem was the hours of service. Usually open all day w noshes. But here only breakfast and dinner, no lunch or late nite dessert. So I asked for that portion of money back. 
4)Not enough spa personnel on duty for my wife to get an appointment all weekend. Excuse was "its a holiday". Well, of course it was, when else do they get customers?
In every category Ritz Carlton scores higher. We usually stay there. Guess we're spoiled. Won't go back to Mandarin.

review_title: Parfait pour visiter Washington en famille
review_text:
MÃªme si l'hÃ´tel est un peu loin du mÃ©tro (10 minutes) Ã  pied, le rapport qualitÃ© prix est excellent pour visiter la ville. Le petit dÃ©jeuner n'est pas mal, l'hÃ´tel est propre et les chambres sont trÃ¨s bien.
Dans le quartier, il y a beaucoup de restaurants, bars et night clubs donc pas de souci pour sortir.

My husband and I stayed for 4 nights in October 2011. Comfortable hotel, big room, cookies at check in were delicious! Wear your walking shoes, the hotel is a few blocks away from attractions (but not a major issue as most sites are well spread out in Washington). Would definitely recommend. Free Internet room was useful (a business centre).
I highly recommend this place especially the location

The first thing about the hotel to consider is the location , the metro station is nearby and the are many many attractions,bars,restaurants around the dupont circle ! The hotel used to be a great hotel in the past but according to todays standards is ok,to access the reception and the elevators you have to go down couple of stairs which with our luggage was annoying ... Rooms were big and ok , but the A/C was not very good it made the room very hot or very cold , bathroom was clean and good, bed comfy and the view is great you see many embassies from the window and gives you a diplomatic feeling! Price was reasonable too so its a nice place if you want to stay around Doupent circle !,

We enjoyed our stay very much. Hotel is very clean and front desk people were very friendly and accommodating. I enjoyed the complimentary warm cookie and fresh lemon water that was offered upon check-in. Valet is a bit steep @ $33.00 but it's a city.. Overall, wonderful experience and I would definitely stay here again :)

This hotel has a great location if you have business at the US Capitol. The room was clean and tasteful. Front Desk personnel were sharp, good looking and professional. Hallways kind of had a bit of a dingy, dark feel to them.. How about buying some light bulbs guys... Food at the "Article One" Restaurant in the lobby left a lot to be desired. If anything else is open, even the West Wing deli next door, spend your money there. But the biggest rip off I have ever seen in a hotel was the valet parking. I drive an SUV, and was physically in the hotel for 14 hours and they attempted to charge me $104 plus tax. There story is that the valet rolls over at 10 am. Shame, shame on you Hyatt for this over the top cost, and double shame on you for the 10am trickery. Mt room rate was an incredible deal, so the parking was more than the room. When I raised a complaint, they backed one day off the valet tab.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill

review_text: Friendly check in-- first room had a noisy heater--they moved us with out any issues. The furniture in the rooms is pretty worn out--funny old TV and phones--carpet stained. Good location is a big plus.

review_title: Great location. Needs a few up dates.
review_text: Nice looking hotel in a good location starting to show its age. 19" tv bit then who watches tv in Georgetown. Staff is friendly.

Next time would stay more central as this place is on the outskirts however you still have to pay $24 night for parking which is crazy this far out of the city. Check in process was lengthy, took around 15 mins cause checkin lady was continually answering the phone and could not multi task. Room had a king bed, fairly spacious, clean, free wi fi. Bed was comfortable but pillows were tiny.

My husband and I arrived at the hotel during a "HEAT WAVE" over 100 degrees and the AC was not working in the room.Maintenance finally came and we insisted he replace the AC, which he did. There was a " ROACH" in the bathroom & "COCKROACH" in the bedroom.No refrig,iron or microwave. We wouldn't stay again even if the room was free. LEE from Philly

review_title: They try it's inexpensive but you get what you pay for
review_text:
Had problems with checking. Make sure that you bring paper receipts their 800number doesn't seem to match the front desk. Keys don't hold room number for more than one use. It does h ave great location and is
Clean. Tv is an old-timer 19 inch

My friend and I ended up staying here because of the good price. We're both college girls who were there for the Powershift conference. Needless to say, this place was not the best choice. Arriving in the cab we could see the neighborhood was definitely not the greatest. The bulletproof glass separating the staff from us was our second clue. However the room was clean and tidy and the deadbolt worked so we stayed. We didn't feel safe walking so we took cabs at roughly $10 a ride. On our last ride back the cab driver asked us why we were staying there and told us to be careful. He then proceeded to tell us of people he knew who were shot in the parking lot, how muggers will watch you for a few days to learn your habits and then attack you and the scar on his wrist where he was shot when he was mugged in front of this motel. He also told us of the prostitution and the drug dealing going on. This was particularly unnerving considering we had someone knocking on our door several times during the night the night before. Upon arriving at the motel, we packed our bags and returned the key. While waiting for a taxi we saw numerous cars with pimps and prostitutes arrive and leave. Moral of the story: If you don't mind dangerous neighborhoods and not being close to the national mall and other tourist attractions, then this will be OK for you. Even though I'm a martial artist and have been for twelve years, I would not stay here again. If you do, make sure you can handle yourself should the need arise, use common sense and travel with at least one other person, preferably a guy if you're female. otherwise, it's not worth the risk.

review_title: A bit run down but clean and good location and price for DC
review_text: Generally friendly and helpful staff. Close to attractions. Bit of a halfway house for abused women I think, occasional noise from outside and in reception area. But clean and good value considering other options.

review_title: Old, shabby, and not very clean
review_text: Hotel is very old and shabby on the outside. Inside, the carpet, walls and furnishings are very old and grimy. Carpet in particular is pretty bad. The elevator had a "last serviced" sticker on it dated 1997... Yet the stairs were worse and seemed like they were sinking when you walked on them! Room was not great. All the skirting boards, walls, doors, cupboards etc are moldy and peeling. The carpet is dirty - we did not feel comfortable walking barefoot on it. Bed covers were stained. Bathroom was pretty good - fairly newish and in good condition.

Being female this area is bad news. Pay the extra money and stay closer to the downtown area. You will also save on transport. I paid extra for taxi to metro because there was no safe way to cross tge street. Plus I did not feel like i wanted to get mugged.

We were extremely excited to visit DC for our son's 10th birthday; however, our mood was soon halted by our arrival to the Latham hotel. First of all, we were never notified that we would have a $32/night valet charge (no there is no other way to park your vehicle). Then, when we finally get to our room, it's only to find a smaller than small "junior suite" with barely enough room to walk around the bed. There was no refridgerator, ice machine (or ice buckets, for that matter!). The bathroom and sink areas were soooo tiny only one person can get ready at a time (really, we were literally bumping around while getting ready)! Now, here's the worst part.....our FIRST morning there I wake up with an awful red, itchy skin rash that caused me to miss out on the very first day of sight-seeing! After two days of benadryl I find out that this "rash" is actually bed bug bites! Some very expensive bed bug bites! Our experience at the Latham Hotel in DC put a HUGE damper on our family vacation! Do NOT be fooled by any of the management responses to our reviews....nothing has been done about the out dated rooms, loud AC units, bad service, horrible valets, or the dirty/musty carpets & drapes! Oh and, luckily, we reviewed our bill and noticed we were being over-charged for parking! Yup, an extra farewell fee, I suppose (just to add a little insult to injury)! We obbiously DO NOT recommend this establishment for all the above noted reasons.

review_title: Great location, affordable & get what you pay for.
review_text: Great location, within 10 minute walk to The White House & 2 minute walk to metro station. Rooms are small & should only be thought of a place to sleep, shower and store your stuff at. It is a hostel!! People are friendly and helpful.

review_title: Do yourself a favour... Don't stay here!
review_text: I'm not that precious but this place is awful. It's moldy and dirty.
Although we stayed for one night, everything was great, the rooms, the hygiene... the staff was very helpful and polite, overall it was well worth the money.

We were frustrated by traffic getting to the hotel and found the parking garage to be both expensive and difficult to maneuver around. Not a good start for our stay but the rest of the stay was very good. Everything was clean and well taken care of. I didn't look into it but there is probably an interesting history to the building. The older section looks very interesting. I had no complaints at all over the four days we stayed. Several options on site for eating. Prices seemed on the high side but really pretty typical for the area. There are some good options for restaurants a few blocks away. Wireless in rooms is not free so be prepared to visit the lobby for free access or pay for Internet. Conference facilities are good if staying for business. Fitness center was one of the better ones I've been in at a hotel. This is one of only hotels in the area. Right next to Metro.

review_title: Not the Marriott experience we expected.
review_text: We spent 3 nights at this hotel. The pro's: good location, onsite metro station, comfortable bed and pillows, onsite conference center, higher-end bathroom toiletries. The con's: very small room, no place to put luggage, drafty windows, very tight bathroom, shower head too low for the average person, takes a long time for water to heat up, cheap toilet paper, NO EXHAUST FAN, no vending machines and very expensive to buy anything in the snack bar, room service charge is outrageous, and very thin walls.

review_title: Large hotel with lots of concerences.
review_text: This is a nice hotel. I was here for a conference and unfortunately a lot of us were forced to move rooms after the first night. I balked and got free wireless and access to Concierge Lounge. They said it was due to construction but later found out the president of a foreign country was here and I think security issues may have been at play.

L'hotel si trova,almeno per noi, in ottima posizione, nel quartiere universitario a circa 15 min a piedi dalla casa bianca. Pulizia, servizio offerto e rapporto qualitÃ  prezzo assolutamente di categoria superiore. Poi a noi Ã¨ capitata anche la camera ad angolo con due splendide finestre, quindi anche questo influenza la nostra recensione. Hotel consigliatissimo per visitare questa meravigliosa cittÃ . Inoltre ha due fermate della metro molto vicine.

review_title: Superb staff, especially the front desk.
review_text: Very good location. Superb staff. Facility was in good condition. Pool is a little small but at least there is one.

Hotel hosts a lot of conferences so it's that kind of crowd in the elevators, restaurants & bar. Staff is friendly. Rooms are smallish with relatively comfortable beds. Bathroom seems recently remodeled but is also on the smaller side. There is nothing luxurious abt the hotel or rooms but they are fine. My only complaint would be that the walls btw the rooms seem abt a centimeter thick. I could hear the full conversations of my neighbors and the tv shows they watched very clearly. So be forewarned.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill

review_text: Service in the bar and at the front door was great. Everywhere else was terrible. The rooms are small and noise is an issue throughout. Too bad because the location is great!
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill

review_title: Nice hotel. Rooms small but modern.
review_text: Just 3 blocks from Metro and DC bikeshare and about a mile from White House! Surprised that the hotel didn't provide continental breakfast that is traditionally offered at a Four Points. Modern, clean and convenient! TVs and lighting in fitness center needs updating.

review_title: Great value, clean, close to lots.
review_text: We got a great deal for this great hotel. Rooms were clean and updated. We went for the NCAA tournament and this hotel is really close to the areana, but also to the monuments, white house, etc.

My family and I stayed here for Labor Day weekend and I was a little worried prior to my arrival because of some of the reviews I read. It definitely was not the best hotel I have ever stayed in but far from being the worst. It was clean and the staff very nice. Great location once you venture down K street and to see the sights. The room was comfortable but seemed small. Not Miami or NYC small but small compared to other Sheraton chains I have stayed at before. The wifi connected fine on my iPad and my daughter's laptop and the other things that matter to me (comfort of bed and water pressure and tempin the shower ) were impressive. My only complaint, which was just " one of those things" one of the elevators malfunctioned causing a big delay for those checking in, out and like myself just trying to return to my room. There was someone there working on it when we left so I assume it's no longer an issue.

I desire a hotel that provides the basics for business, I.e., clean, comfortable bed, desk, reading chair , good shower, etc. This hotel does have some pluses: the restaurant is very good, very good service. However the shower is horrible, with control of water flow such that it takes twice as long to shower with such a little flow, really bothersome. The elevators are old and slow, the lighting in the hallways is poor and the carpeting dingy, as is the color of the walls, really depressing, the hangers for men's pants have slippery bars, so they are useless to hang up trousers, as they slip right off. The ice bucket is too large for the plastic bags for the ice, and the bucket leaked water all mover the desk and ruined some papers I had on the desk. When I asked for a late check out (only to 1 pm) they made me feel like they were doing a one time special favor for me and I am an elite member with them. That really disgusted me. I would not go out of my way tom stay there again.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill

review_title: Great place to stay in NW DC
review_text: Beautiful grounds, lovely interior and well located hotel with many good places to eat within a few blocks and easy access to the Metro

This hotel is the biggest in dc! Lovely rooms and surrounding gardens. Easy check in and out. Mlocation is great. Right near a subway station which is about 10 to the mall and white house. Good facilities in the hotel and there are lots off restaurants close by as well.
The staff was awesome. Rooms clean and welcoming. Very convenient.

review_title: Not worth the price or attitude of staff.stay anywhere else. Breakfast buffet like motel 6.
review_text: Platinum member and even I can't give benefit of doubt.Stayed 50 nights on road and even second time here was bad.Must be driven from top mgt or they are out of touch with employees and property.Shame really.
Great location, very close to many attractions! Room service dining costs were ridiculously high, so don't bother. Staff were nice. Rooms well furnished. Would come back here again!
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill

review_text: I needed a place to crash as I spent mostof my day and night checkingout the many sights at the nations Capitol. Well this place was just that, a clean great bed within walking distance to the Metro. Exactly what I needed.

review_title: Watch 9th floor west side, mold smell, but otherwise ok
review_text: Hot summer AC was likely running to much, mold smell all night, otherwise bed was good, Internet was faster than average, food was good but bring the greenback
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill

review_text:
In my mind, I expect Hyatt hotels to be a cut above most, not all, others. Well, this Hyatt Regency is a decent hotel. The lobby is large and open and my room was fairly decent, a somewhat modern styling, but not super impressive. The rooms & hotel were overall quite clean. I got a really good deal through hotwire.com and the price was so hard to beat I really shouldn't complain, but I'm basing this review on the fact that they market themselves as a 4-star hotel. I wouldn't quite put them at 4, maybe a 3. I wouldn't put it near the quality or accommodations of any of The W hotels. 
Then there is the issue of location. It is near the capitol building, but that is it for the pluses. The hotel is located on the far east side of the mall area, so you will be walking a lot. Additionally, about one block west is some sort of "projects" facility, which attracts many of the type of people that make you nervous to walk by during the day, let alone at night. It was VERY ghetto, but out was only that block, the rest was fine and none of the ghetto cats ever approached me or even talked to me.
Not sure I would go to this hotel again, as there are better locations (speaking in terms of geographically & neighborhood). Plus, like other supposed "4-star" hotels, wifi internet is not free. I find this more than annoying since hotels like Holiday Inn Express provide it free along with some crack cocaine they call cinnamon rolls :-). And they are way cheaper than a Hyatt, so it doesn't make sense. Not to mention, this particular Hyatt is barely a notch above an HIE (definitely not a full star). (Note: I'm aware the lobby and full restaurant & bar would raise the Hyatt's rating, but I'm basing this on what YOU will think, not the rating "official".
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill

review_text: Walk from the red line stop at union station - just a few blocks. The lobby is a bit on the annoying side as too many people always seem to be milling around. It's loud, busy, and generally uncomfortable for someone looking for a relaxing and peaceful entrance. Check in was quick and I was upgraded to the Club level after the clerk saw that I was a platinum level member. My room was comfortable but interestingly my room key wouldn't let me in to the club itself. That would be another $50, I was told. The room was large with a good sized bathroom with two sinks. The room was quiet with a well service hvac system. There was no elevator or hallway noise to speak of. Bath towels are too small. Elevators are sufficient in number and are reasonably fast. The club (I went with a friend) is small but very well stocked. Smoked salmon, yogurt, cereal, and fresh fruit with freshly squeezed oj for breakfast. Worth the $50 if you have two people and are here for a couple of days or more.
hotel_name: Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill

review_text: I stayed at the Marriott Wardman for a conference and the room was incredibly small compared to other Marriott hotels in the area. When I sat at the desk the chair bumped up against the bed. Conference services also left much to be desired as well.

Centrally located near Capitol Hill. Walking distance to the National Mall and Union Station. Nice hotel for a business conference however at spring break there were several families with school age children. Many very good restaurants nearby.
