review_title: Funky style in surprisingly great location.
review_text: Location is fab. Cool beer bar. Whole foods and other shopping locations. Feel like a local staying here. Good rooms with huge tv although tiny bathrooms. Good service and hostel like lounge actually enhance the feel. Go. For it.

I had booked a stay with Hotel Monaco, but only found out that my booking through hotel.com did not go through when I reached the hotel! 
The front of desk manager, Anthony, together with his team, proved to be extremely helpful and went out of their way to help us get another booking at nearby Courtyard by Mariott since they were fully booked for the night. Anthony even walked us to the hotel to make sure that we were promptly checked in. 
When we eventually checked into Hotel Monaco the next day, we were absolutely overwhelmed by the surprise. We were upgraded to a suite (I think...) and Team Monaco had left us a card welcoming our stay with some discount vouchers and complimentary fruits, just so we could enjoy out stay and take away the unpleasant evening encounter from the previous night! 
What was initially somewhat nightmarish turned out to be a blessing in disguise. We loved the room and the great location and friendly services provided. Should I be back in DC, I know where I'll be staying. :) 
Thank you Team Monaco! :)
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Hotel is very convenient. There is a Metro station across the street & many restaurants nearby. However, the rooms are very small and boxy. The staff seem a little stuffy also.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Love the location, but found the room tiny and noisy! When we arrived, take away food from the previous customers had been left in the room!! Bathroom door is not private.

We loved our stay in this hotel - we got a deal through Groupon and stayed over the Thanksgiving weekend. The hotel rooms and service were exceptional. The location, right on DuPont circle was excellent. Loved Cafe DuPont and would definitely go back.
Was a little disappointed with the hotel , very shabby looking foyer and the staff on the front desk weren't very friendly , rooms and hotel in general was just ok

When we first stepped into the Monaco, everything was lovely. They had an upgrade, we took it. The lady said we had a view from the room, but do you call looking at a grungy office building a view? I would expect more. Also, my family requested a late checkout, due to sightseeing, so we got 1:00. Fair enough, right? Well, we went to our room at 12:45ish, tried the key numerous times, and it didnt work. On top of that, no i'm sorry or anything! Also, house keeping took our pillows when they were cleaning! On the bright side, there was an hour or two with free drinks every day.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Safe area, great friendly helpful staff. Not far from metro. Couldnt ask for a better place to visit than the helix in dc.

My wife and I spent three nights here. Our experience was outstanding. The complimentary champagne for our anniversary was quite unexpected. The rooms, service, and overall quality and feel made our stay very memorable. Easy walk to all the sights for us. Most definitely will stay again and recommend to all.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
We booked through hotwire and were pleasantly suprised. The we arrived early and put our bags into storage. The staff were amazing and very helpful giving us tips about the area and places to go. Ask them for the concierges list of things to do.
Sangria and beers at 5 on the house is great. Our room was beautiful huge bed, great shower, heaps of space and funky bathrobes! I would definately recommend staying. DC is a beautiful city.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: My husband and I traveled to DC with our two pups over the Christmas holiday and we are so thrilled we found the Topaz!! It was our first time in DC and first experience with the Kipton chain and it really was a great hotel experience. We booked a king room and it was huge!! This hotel is so convenient to everything, staff is so warm and welcoming, hotel is beautiful, great coffee, hot chocolate, and wine hour (all complimentary for hotel guests) I really could go on and on!!! If we ever make it back, we are definitely staying here again! DC was an amazing city...too much to do and see..wish we had more time there. Thanks Topaz and DC for such an awesome vacay!! ~The Kremer's

What a great place! We stayed there for three nights, and we had the best time. The hotel is Very cozy, the staff was very friendly, and the room was very comfortable.
The location is withing walking distance to the white house and all the restaurants. Also within walking distance to the dupont circle. If you like a stylish hotel this place has it.
Enjoy your stay!

We are a family of six that traveled to DC for pleasure. DC is a great place to visit. Beautiful. The hotel was just ok. We really like boutique hotels. We try to stay in them everywhere we go. This had the feel that we wanted. Very small and intimate. The restaurant was not my favorite, but we made the best of it. It was nice to get back from walking all day and have a martini at the bar while we planned for the following day's events. Bar staff was helpful and very pleasant. The bar and restaurant have different menus. The front desk was very helpful as was the concierge. The rooms were the main issue. The size is what you expect from this type of hotel but the cleanliness was the main issue. The beds were done but that was all. Trash cans were not changed and towels were just hung back up. I would only place the ones that needed changing in the tub. They were not changed. Just folded up and placed back under the sink. The room next to us was occupied with my husband's parents. They experienced the same issues with cleanliness. The biggest issue I had was the number of bites I experience on my legs after the first evening. I had never experienced this before, so I am not sure if these were caused by bed bugs. Regardless, it was not a happy experience. I thought it was just me. Come to find out my husband and parents in law got bites as well. Our legs are full of them. Luckily the kids did not get bitten as far as they know. I will check them at home. It is a shame. Planned on returning in June, I think we will try another hotel.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: Preparedness is everything to a tired traveler
review_text: Arrived at the hotel right at check in time only to be told to take a number behind some other (better customers?) guests. The Stanley Cup playlets were fullon, with a game right across the street being played the next afternoon. We had reserved a suite and it would not be ready for another two hours, we were told. We headed to the restaurant , two children in tow, only to be glared at by waitstaff when meals were taking so long and kids were restless. Great food, great waiter, hosts were not friendly and couldn't accommodate kids in the open dining/bar atmosphere with a booth, or something, say-family friendly. Whatever-restaurant did have a great atmosphere and food was delicious. Room was ready in two hours, bags were not in room along with the little goldfish promised. They were fine with it, though, as exhaustion set in. Bed linens were perfection, as was bed! Room was clean and roomy. Surroundings were surprisingly quiet. I love Kimpton Hotels, but believe this stay was not impressive because staff couldn't handle the volume or demand of it's guests this particular super busy Easter weekend.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Was greeted by a chic and modern lobby. Hotel staffs are helpful. The room is clean and the bed and room is comfortable for two pax. Short distance to union station. Room price is reasonable. Will definitely stay here again if I'm back to Washington.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: Great service, nice place to hang out.
review_text: I would like this hotel for the location convenient to the Hill, as well as the fun restaurant and bar. But I love it for its friendly and skilled front desk staff. Jessica, a young woman with stylish white glasses and a can-do attitude is probably the best front desk person I have ever encountered in my years of business travel. They are remodeling the rooms now, so it will soon get even better.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text: My family and I spent 4 nights. Upon check in we were informed that the A/c was broken. They were willing to move us to a sister property. However my family had been traveling all day and wanted to settle in. They had outfitted the room with a fan that helped circulate the air. Jennifer at the front desk was absolutely amazing. She did everything she could to make sure my family were as comfortable during our stay. When staying at the Manaco I suggest asking for Jennifer. You won't be disappointed.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: We chose this hotel for its boutique, romantic advertisement. We were upgraded to a suite for our anniversary. Unfortunately the upgrade was directly over the bar. Parties back to back nights until 3am prevented a romantic feel. We couldn't get to sleep either night. The breakfast area was in the bar, which had the remnants from the night before. The manager provided a discount, but the romantic weekend we had planned was ruined.

review_title: Better than avg, but new decor is over the top 1960's kitsch
review_text: Hotels are a clean place to sleep with good location and service, and the TH is a great value on those attributes. However, I did find the gaudy attempt at being hip way over the top and not to my taste. I would recommend with those reservations, pun intended.

review_title: Great hotel in a super location!
review_text: DuPont Circle is a trendy area with a bunch of awesome restaurants and bars that is a very short walk from the White House & National Mall. Just like other Kimpton Hotels we have stayed at, the service is beyond what you expect. The wine hour at Kimptons is cool too. Check Kimpton's Facebook page for the secret word to get you special deals, and sign up for the free "in touch" reward program for free wireless access and a $10 mini bar credit.

What a great hotel! I travel a lot, and this hotel has the nicest, most accommodating staff that I have come across! Rooms and public spaces very well done, by keeping the feel of the 19th century building, with all of the modern amenities.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Overall: loved everything except bathroom privacy, which could be a major turn-off for couples on a first trip together. Everyone else will enjoy their stay. We plan to return.
Location: unbeatable. On Dupont Circle, 1 block to Metro, easy walk to tons of restaurants, bars, shops, etc.
Service: impeccable. Valet, bellhop, concierge, room service, front desk, maid and engineer were all top-notch. Front desk even sent up a complimentary gift for my g/f's b-day.
Room: modern, clean, very good. A little small but decent sized for a city hotel. Bed very comfortable, easy sleeping. Good temp controls. Only downside is the bathroom -- earlier poster correct about lack of privacy. Also no exhaust fan, so others in bedroom can hear your, ahem, business. Loved the shower, but had to open window with no exhaust fan, OK in Aug, not sure if OK in Feb.
Noise: quiet. Room faced the circle, but minimal traffic noise. A/C not loud. No noise from other rooms, only once heard hallway noise. Bar exceptionally loud, made the airport seem like the library, but couldn't hear it upstairs.
Other: business center good. Valet-only parking.

I stayed at the hotel Helix for 4 nights in April. We had a room on the 9th floor overlooking the back of the hotel, which had occasional noise in the morning from a refuse truck. The room was spacious, well decorated and clean. 
The bed was really comfortable but the pillows were very thick and made some sleeping positions difficult.
This hotel is in a fantastic location. Lots of delis and a supermarket within 5 minutes walk and only 10 minutes walk to the White house.
Loved the funky decor especially the Snakeskin lifts! Would definitely come back if we were in town : )

We stayed at the Topaz Hotel for a long weekend with our 4yr old daughter and were very pleased with our stay. The location of the hotel was great for us as it is centrally located (cab fare to the White House, Georgetown, and Lincoln Memorial was $8). The rooms are spacious, well decorated, and clean. Noise was not a problem, though given my choice I would have selected a room off the street. The hotel staff was very accommodating. The hotel runs various promotions so you will most likely be best served using the online reservation system to take advantage of the one that suits you best. We did not eat at the hotel, but that is not a reflection of the perceived quality of the restaurant. There are many dining options within close proximity of the hotel that we wanted to at least check out.

We visited DC after three weeks cross crossing the US staying in 4.5 star hotels and this was by far the best experience. Great building, great location, great staff, particularly the guy on check out who I had a chat to about the F1 race that night. We booked through hotwire and got a super cheap price. Would stay again.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Boutique hotel, good for a few nights stay.
review_text:
This is an older property recently renovated. Decor is modern and trendy as is service approach. Hotel is good for business travellers, couples on vacation but not recommended for family travel. 
Good: housekeeping, restaurant, desk, front door, and bar staff all excellent. Great location.
Needs improvement: no robes, desks in rooms have no lamps so rooms tend to be dark. Refrigerator is a mini vendor type, zero room for personal drinks, etc. Valet took 20 minutes to retrieve our car on checkout. No guest laundry, no pool or gym onsite (guets are referred to Mint gym). For laundry, recommend Imperial Valet close by, $2.50 per pound.
Overall it was an okay stay but will look elsewhere on the return.

review_title: The rooms & location were great, but the noise not so great.
review_text: I was very pleasantly surprised by how nice the rooms were, really liked the light & air coming on by sensor and the environmentally friendly bathroom products were a great idea. All the staff were very friendly & helpful, and the hotel is in a great location to walk around the monuments and sight see, am told tour buses also pick up out front if you don't like to walk. My only problem was all the noise, unfortunately did not get one good nights sleep (even though the bed was great). Start with the hotel is next to a Fire Dept which goes out many times a night often under sirens then has to reverse back in ( beep beep beep) was surprised to see Washington still standing after the first night. Next was hotel maintenance, started at 11:15 pm first night, power drills, hammering etc, after 30 minutes went and asked him how long & no idea, contacted Reception and they made him stop, but he started again at 5:15 am. Our room was on the top (10 th floor) right under the 24 hour Gym, I was surprised that people wanted to work out after midnight & how noisy dropping weights really is. I had heard how nice the rooftop & pool area was , but unfortunately you are not allowed up there now, not sure why. Still hotel & staff great, avoid the top floor!
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: It's ok ... Location good Long term stay (more 3 days) NO
review_text: Only stay here a couple of days... I was here for a week and this place is not, repeat not designed for that. Laundry none, you have to pay $6++ an article, the bar Is pricey. I ordered a mojito at around 7:15 pm I get a mini hi ball glass for $11 really!!???? Bar is overcrowded with local yuppies, no room for guests of the hotel really. Room relatively small. Bathroom.... I am not into the open shower thing. Whereas you have a small glass pane on one side to prevent splash the rest is open kinda deal. Intersting addition is the heated bathroom floor. I guess thats all good in the winter months! Short stay great. Long term go to embassy suites, they are more equipped to handle ya there. I recommend this place only on a few reservations that u mentioned above

review_title: Quirky and fun; worlds away from the hustle of DC, a short walk away from everything.
review_text:
Red and I checked into Topaz for a 3 night end of summer vacation. Just looking through their website is what got me hooked on the Kimpton brand five years ago - a quirky little boutique hotel with a focus on zen, tranquility, and self actualization. Seriously! 
The staff are amazing - professional but not at all stuffy. I was challenged to a hula-hoop off by their general manager for an upgrade and even though I lost (due to a technical foul!), they still gave me an *amazing* room. I could probably fit three regular sized cookie cutter hotel's rooms in it. Everything was AMAZINGLY clean with attention to detail.
During wine hour the staff was friendly and engaging - helping us with dinner and brunch recommendations. This is quite on par with the Kimpton brand but leaps and bounds what you would find anywhere else considering the star rating and price.
Red and I felt like super celebrities in a little known boutique hotel around the corner from everything. Between two metro stops - the location was perfect.
I began to wonder how they do it all so well. But a look at their Facebook pages and a look into their job culture shows a company who values ALL their employees and treats each client (down to the littlest puppy) like the most important one they have. Clean, convenient, friendly, attention to detail, and a defined personality. I'll definitely be back.
Very accommodating staff made this 2nd Kimpton Hotel experience a joy. The spacious room and comfortable bed helped relax a busy schedule in DC and adjoining neighborhoods.

review_title: A wonderful hidden gem in the city
review_text:
We were 4 college friends meeting over a weekend and found this hotel online. The location is ideal for leaving your car and walking to delicious restaurants and sites. The staff was extremely accommodating and made our stay effortless. There were lots of big parties at the hotel but it never impacted us. They kept everything flowing.
The rooms were clean, quiet and the beds were so comfortable!
The food and courtyard was the perfect place to meet. It was bustling with an array of people having a great time without loud music to drawn out your conversation. 
Pet friendly. Lots of guests had their dogs which seemed fine. 
We are definitely returning for another good experience.
Thank You Jennifer, Kelly, Anthony and Jason
Stephanie, Anne, Lauren and Jane
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Great location for tourists - would stay again
review_text:
Stayed in a double double with my mum for two nights.
Had a really comfortable stay. Easy to reach from Union station and a short walk to the Capitol and then a little further to the National Mall. 
Good facilities with a 'pillow menu' and choice of packs for walkers, picnickers and tourists.
Room on the smaller side for a double double, but big enough for two ladies!
Felt safe enough in the location and a nice roof-top pool, although we didn't use it. 
Good for wide range of visitors from kids through to couples.
Comfortable beds - nothing to fault really, but also nothing 'wow'!
restaurant was good with a good atmosphere.
Would return if visiting Washington again.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text: I had a wonderful experience at the Hotel Helix. The room was huge and beautifully decorated. I love that the hotel is focused on being eco-friendly. The staff was phenomenal and the location was perfect. Great stay!

review_title: Great hotel, great location, courteous staff!
review_text:
Aside from great rooms and ambiance, what I love best about the Fairmont is the location. It's in the West End and a short walk from Georgetown, GWU, State Department, PAHO and about 7 blocks from the White House. This is a great, residential-like neighborhood, tucked quietly away from the hustle and bustle of DC. 
The spa and fitness center are a bit dated, but nothing to turn your nose at either!

review_title: Large deposit required upon check in
review_text: This hotel has a great location and is very modern design, fun boutique hotel! I was shocked to discover that there is a $100 deposit for each night that they charge your card upon arrival. I was charged an extra $400 plus the $1000 plus for the actual cost of my entire stay. Beware when you check in that this is their policy. Otherwise a great hotel!!

Let me start by saying that I would whole heartedly recommend this hotel. My husband and I had a two week vacation scheduled in Cape Hatteras, North Carolina. Hurricane Irene came through, we didn't get to go for our vacation due to the damage on the island. We scheduled a trip to Washington DC at the last minute to salvage some of our anniversary vacation. When we arrived, Simone met us at the check in desk with a smile, and a warm welcome. There was a small mix up with our room, she sent us to lunch at Art and Soul (which was great) at no charge to us. The hotel was busy I am sure, but Simone, Dwayne and other staff made us feel as though we were their only concern. We received very personalized attention throughout our stay. We were sent up a great complimentary fruit and cheese tray to celebrate our anniversary. Any request or concern we had was promptly and efficiently handled. The customer service was outstanding. Our room was beautiful, clean, and well appointed. At midnight the last night of our stay, we received a call informing us that our return train was cancelled secondary to damage from flooding on the tracks. When I called the front desk I was given the information to get in contact with a rental car agency right away, to make our way back home. We were given a late checkout time, and had ample time to visit the Eastern Market before we reluctantly loaded the rental car to leave. Although, unbelievably, we have to file trip insurance paperwork twice in the space of two weeks, the Capitol Liaison and it's staff was an incredible bright spot.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text: Great "funky" decor and friendly accommodating staff.
Stayed here a couple nights for a conference. It is a great hotel and well run by the staff. Rates seemed a bit steep to me, but if price isn't your top focus this is a great hotel.

review_title: Spectacular stay! Amazing staff! I would definitely stay here again!
review_text: We had a great time here! Beautiful modern hotel, great restaurant, friendly helpful staff, lovely rooftop pool and close to all the sights! We will definitely stay here again!
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text: The room we stayed in was what you would expect. The 3rd night when we got into bed the sheets were slightly damp. Though upon check-out we were comped our breakfast by Van so that really made up for the slight discomfort. Also Jessica the night front desk was exceptionally kind and helpful. The service given really made up for all the shortcomings. I would stay again.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text:
400 US Dollars for a room is bit too much for a 4 star hotel, also as they charge a lot for internet and drinks!
However the rooms and the shower are huge, and location is great, halfway between Georgetown and the city center. The bed was very comfortable. More accuracy in cleaning is needed, as I found a used tissue in a corner when I arrived, and it was removed only after two days!

review_title: The very best service in the perfect location
review_text: Amazing stay! We booked a room with a view and was upgraded to the Jenny Lind suite. Service was over the top yet not stuffy. Warm staff, perfect historic hotel and First Class service. We will stay every time we are in the city

The service was impeccable at this Fairmont. We arrived at 8 pm and my husband needed a shirt cleaned for a party the next evening. By 10 am the next morning his shirt was delivered to our door. Breakfast was delivered exactly on time with piping hot coffee. The front desk receptionist asked if we were new to the area and gave us a map and a quick intro to what was in the neighborhood upon check-in. The atrium bar is a lovely setting for a drink. No more than 10 minute walk to Foggy Bottom metro stop and 5-10 minute walk to Georgetown restaurants and shops.
Cons: The room itself was very clean, but for some reason the tub floor seemed a bit slippery - they need a better standing surface for showering. The wifi service was atrocious: very weak signal. I used 3G most of the time I was there.

Our stay was great! My only complaint was lack of help when we arrived. We had drove ao when we arrived we needed parking and help with all our bags. There wasn't many people available to help. Overall, it was great!

review_title: Beautiful hotel in a great location near Georgetown.
review_text: We stayed three nights at the Fairmont. Our room was large and very clean. The staff was extremely friendly. We ordered room service, and it was very pricey and the food was just mediocre. The one thing that bothered us is that we felt we were being nickel and dimed for everything. Parking was $40/ night. The fitness center was $15/day per person. And I needed to send a one page fax, and the cost was $6. And that wasn't including the $5 charge to use the computer and print one page. Also, they charge almost $14/day to use wifi. I felt that was ridiculous. We stayed at a Holiday Inn Express the week before and they had free wifi, fitness center, and were more than happy to fax multiple documents at no charge. For a hotel of this quality, I was surprised at all the extra charges.

review_title: Beds are wonderful. Art and Soul Restaurant located in hotel Superb!
review_text: Rooms and clean a bit on the small side. Beds are wonderful, I traveled with my mom and she enjoyed the hotel as well. The hotel is close to the Metro station about 4 blocks away. The hotel is closer to the Capital building than other attractions but extremly close to the airport.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: Did what it said on the tin
review_text: When taken overall this hotel has to score 5 because every category was good, but overall it didn't feel like the Hyatt opposite, but there again nor was the price. The receptionist was most helpful, as were the bell staff. The location is excellent, a few minutes walk from the Capitol.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: "A" for Effort, but There Is Room for Improvement.
review_text: Ok, honestly this hotel is a lovely boutique hotel trying to do a good job. It is in a wonderful location in Dupont Circle close to the metro and many restaurants, coffee places etc. Recently renovated, its decor is quirky bur not too over the top. Rooms are nice sized. Join their Kimpton rewards program and you get generous perks. I cannot give this hotel or it's front desk staff a bad review as they were pleasant and helpful. The problem lies in not having enough staff especially in the restaurant/bar. Breakfast time in the restaurant was busy with not enough seating, food, or staff. I think they had a free breakfast promo and just couldn't handle it. I would stay at Kimpton again but probably not here though other Kimptons in DC are more expensive. Still it is a decent option for the good price we got so it is worth staying here just isn't as fabulous as other Kimpton hotels but like I said it's trying and gets an A for effort.

Amazing staff! Very service oriented. Like the high style of the decor without being overly ornate. Rooms were a bit crowded due to large furniture ( I stayed in superior king by myself). Bathroom was nice size, shower huge, great water pressure. Downsides, I could hear my neighbors clearly, need more insulation. Room lighting was a bit dark. Workout facility is in basement and fairly small. Hotel does give free passed to University club down the street.

Yes, the Four Seasons in always expensive... but it's the service that seems to make so worth it. Rooms are great, location is great, the restaurant is fantastic but it's that attention to the client (you) that puts this hotel over the top. Think it or wish it and the Four Seasons staff does their best...surprisingly many times before you even thought to think of it. If you want a pampered relaxation....go! Just be willing to pay for it.

We love Hotel Monaco! The location is perfect, the managers reception is always a treat, the rooms are fabulous and the service is exceptional. We've stayed at Hotel Monaco at least 10 times and have never been disappointed.
hotel_name: Monaco Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: We had a wonderful time at this hotel. The rooms & facilities are stunning, although very pricey. The concierge & all the staff were incredibly helpful & did everything they could to make the stay better. The location is a bit out of the town centre, but Georgetown itself is a great spot.

review_title: Elegant, and friendly without being snooty.
review_text:
Stayed here with my wife and son for the Columbus Day three day weekend and was pleasantly surprised. The room was larger than I expected with a king sized bed and a bathroom bigger than most studio apartments in NYC.
The valet parking is expensive but it beats getting a parking spot in this neighborhood or getting a ticket for not feeding he meter. My wife forgot her book in the trunk of our car and the valet attendant graciously went to get the book from the underground garage and brought it to our room.
Built in keurig coffee maker was a plus, but the coffee was horrible. There's a Starbucks across the street and that is where we went to get our daily caffiene fix.
There is a great universal charger unit by the flatscreen tv that comes in handy to charge your iPhone or USB powered devices. There are also two AC outets and VGA ports in this unit.
The bedside alarm clock offers an iPod charging station also and comes preprogrammed with nature sounds.
The closest metro stop is Foggy Bottom on the GWU campus, though we only used it once. We wound up walking everywhere from the Lincoln memorial to the Capitol and back (don't try this unless you're New Yorkers)
Wireless acess is free in the room if you join the complimentary Presidents Club program.
If you get a room, try and stay away from those next to the elevator as it gets very loud. Something about getting to the elevator makes everyone speak louder than they really should.
Oh and complimentary copies of The NY Times are available in the lobby on a first come basis.
It's not cheap but a better option than the Four Seasons or the Ritz.

review_title: Old world elegance with all modern amenities
review_text: My wife and me went with our son, his wife and baby, for a weekend in D.C. And my son booked us into this very elegant hotel. The large rooms are very well out fitted and tastefully furnished. The bed and pillows are very comfortable and the house keeping is very attentive. The concierge was very helpful and gave us good tips about a good place to eat at and sightseeing.

Stayed 4 nights staff is arrogant, unfriendly and unattentive - begining with front desk check-in. Wrong room return to desk and made to feel like it was my problem service in Juniper was poor. Food excellent bar service poor. Overall great location,quality rooms but arrogance of staff makes for bad experience.

I made a reservation via expedia and received a good room rate for our stay. I have to agree that the bath room design is a not odd if traveling with other guests. The frosted glass doesn't leave much for privacy. However the heated floor tiles were a great touch. The beds very comfy. Room size overall not to bad as we had three people in 2 double beds. Spacing was a bit tight but manageable. The only thing that was that the windows over the bar/restaurant does not tone out the sound. Ask for a room that is opposite of the restaurant as the sound does carry. All in all a great hotel to stay in as it is very close to the metro and lots of restaurants and shops.

review_title: Great location for a great vacation
review_text: Woderful staff and very hip decor. Some rooms seemed small but we asked for and received wheel chair accessible room which was quite spacious. Awesome location on Dupont Circle. Walking distance to Georgetown and monuments/museums plus Dupont area is great. Watch the world go by from the outdoor bar and meet people from around the world. We'll be back.

review_title: I WARN YOU DO NOT STAY HERE EVER ! I'm not a crazy person saying just don't stay here mistaken me and stay at the Haytt across t
review_text: Terrible terrible the rooms smelled awful. We went to 3 different rooms and they all smelled terrible! Go across the street to the Haytt! It's much much much better!!!! And there is no infinity pool at the liason! This hotel is way overpriced!
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text:
Very nice hotel. Hip (expensive) bar, great food. Great location, steps from Metro... BUT, for the life of me, I can NOT understand why anyone would recommend this place for anyone with kids. 
Double room was bug enough for two people, not four. No door on bathroom (you better room with someone you're intimate with), no pool, no in-room movies... NOTHING for kids... Yet every guidebook recommends it for families. Go figure. 
Again, great place... If my wife and I were in DC alone. NOT for kids.

review_title: Great boutique hotel and perfect location near Union Station.
review_text: Family trip to DC. Great hotel. Great service. Hotel pool nice but very crowded. Pricey bar drinks at pool. $7 beer. Art and Soul restaurant ...not that good...fried chicken was burnt!
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: One of my favorites in the city!
review_text:
I have stayed in many great hotels in Washington DC and the Fairmont is one of the top on my list. In fact it's my first choice. The rooms are big, luxurious, clean and very well appointed. The washrooms are also large and very nice. The room service (although pricey) is amazing. When I stay here I feel like i'm treating myself to a guilty pleasure.
Great location, a short walk to Georgetown.
I'm surprised it's only 19 on the list as I have stayed at several of the top 5 and comparatively speaking this should be in the top 5.
great place to stay near columbus circle/union station. Nice room, size reasonable for DC. I'll stay here again!
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: One of the best Intercontinental hotels!
review_text: A long time ago I wanted to pick a chain that would reward loyalty and chose this chain. I have been extremely happy with stays on 3 continents, soon to be a 4th. This hotel is one of the best. At check in I was upgraded to an awesome Willard room and the friendliness of front desk was very nice to experience after a long drive. The location of the hotel is hard to best as well. As I am an Priority Club Ambassador once a year I get a free weekend night stay so one of my 2 nights was free saving me over $350. Rooms are clean, public areas as well and are really nice. The hotel bar is good albeit pricey but hey you are 100 yards from the White House!

review_title: Perhaps the best hotel with history & heritage.
review_text: We stayed here for one night on a Sunday into a Monday. The location can not be beat being a block from the White House. The food is pricey-brunch for Waffles and an order of eggs bennidict with soup was $75. The lobby is beautiful- look up at the ceiling to see the seals of all the states, they had a harpist and a pianist playing and the general decor was awesome. The room was larger than I had imagined or needed. The furnishings were new and clean. The linins and bed was very comfortable. The bathroom was older but updated fixtures. The only disappointment was finding someones old catering items behind the chairs..ie utensils and salt & pepper. This should have easily been found by housekeeping but it wasn't. I would not hesitate to stay here again.

My husband and I stayed here with our 4 month old while my husband did some business in the city. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The lounge chair in the room was perfect for nursing my daughter and it was so thoughtful for the hotel to provide some baby amenities. We had a relaxing stay and enjoyed having a drink before bed in the gorgeous lobby. Great location close to Georgetown and also the metro.

review_title: Grand old girl with the best of addressses.
review_text: The Willard is steeped in history, sits two blocks from the White House, stares down Penn. Ave., has enormous suites and a staff that I wanted to bring home. All Pros and no Cons from a notoriously picky traveller. I mean REALLY picky.

This was our first time in Washington DC so we did alot of research to find the right hotel. The Affinia was perfect. Perfect location. Two mins from Capital Hill. Also very close to Union Station and good restaurants. Au Bon Pain perfect for breakfast. Boutique hotel. So more personal. Perfect for families. We took adjoining rooms. Pool on roof was perfect. You can also see 4th July fireworks from roof.. Not a perfect view but we preferred it to waiting with huge crowds in the heat for hours. One negative.. They put a new sound system on the roof, which they used the last night. It was very very loud in our room. So I suggest you ask for a quiet room. The music stopped at 11pm though. So not too late unless you have young children. The gym was also very well equipped.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text:
Excellent location with wonderful service and a nice pool to relax at on the hot days. The fourth of ju
Ly was magnificent and I will always stAy here in dc.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: They need to fix their wifi.
review_text: Nice luxurious hotel but wifi was completely unreliable. Stayed for business training but wifi failure kept stalling our training. They tried 4 different wifi setups and all 4 failed. Time for this hotel to hire an IT staff!

review_title: Excellent option if price is reasonable
review_text: We stayed for a conference that offered a discounted rate, or else we couldn't afford this option. Location & service were excellent if perhaps a little aloof. However, the conference was excellently run and the rooms were extremely comfortable. If a Fairmont is in your price range, this is likely a comfortable if unsurprising option.

My only issue is that there isn't 24 hour room service. It's so empty there that if u don't eat early you won't be able to eat. The front desk will give you menus for places but it's not a lot of options. We ordered pizza it took over an hour to arrive.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text:
This is a grand and historic hotel located almost next to the White House. it is just one of these Washington classics. 
However, I was disappointed by the hotel as rooms are in need of refurbishment. For me the hotel was a bit stuffy. I know these things are personal but everything in the room was a bit dated and didn't really present any atmosphere or personality, it was just a very flowery room.
Service was good, but then you are in a 5 star InterContinental.

review_title: Ritz-Carlton Loyalist Tries a Four Seasons
review_text:
I am a major fan and devotee of Ritz-Carlton hotels and am a Gold Elite member with The Ritz-Carlton Rewards. I am very partial to the brand. 
On a whim, I decided to try the Four Seasons in DC instead of my usual Ritz choices because of an enticing promotion that the FS Washington was running for Memorial Day weekend - the Staycation Package. The Four Seasons, along with The Ritz-Carlton Georgetown, are usually the priciest rooms in the city, but unlike the Ritz, rates at the Four Seasons don't usually budge depending on occupancy. There is not even a AAA discount or Government rate offered. The package included parking and a generous breakfast credit - all for a price usually never seen at this particular Four Seasons. It was a great deal.
Overall, this is an excellent hotel that has also turned me on to the Four Seasons brand. Service is polished, efficient, and thoughtful. The rooms are also very well equipped, and include cable television with a vast selection of channels, nicely stocked refreshment bars with gourmet candy bar selections (Dylan's Candy), and bathrooms equipped with a nice selection of L'Occitane toiletries. Room service was very professional, and delivered a tasty breakfast. When I forgot to pack collar stays, the Concierge (Mel) quickly delivered them with a smile. In addition, one practice I particularly enjoyed was hotel staff not delivering a bill to the room on the check-out morning. It is a practice that I find tacky and not needed.
Again, this was a great experience in totality. If I had to detail any complaints, one would be that the complimentary forgotten items that the hotel provides are of a very low quality. The shaving razor was especially poor in design - very unlike the good quality implements given out at Ritz-Carltons.
I will likely return to the Four Seasons in Washington, and will recommend it to colleagues and associates. It definitely is a great choice, especially if the prices are competitive with Ritz Georgetown at the time of booking. Cheers, FS Washington!

review_title: Should be considered a 5 star hotel, it was wonderful beyond expectation!
review_text:
From check-in to check-out every moment was flawless. Whenwe mentioned it was out 10th anniversary they pulled out even more fantastic service. We rec'd a personalized card, wine and a fruit plate! How fabulous. The pillow menu was a huge hit with my husband as well. The bar was modern and service was wonderful. Couldn't be happier!
Oh, and the bed was soooo comfortable!
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text: We're never suspect when planning a trip that Four Seasons will be our hotel for. No difference here! This is a beautiful gem in DC. Some areas can be quite dangerous there so knowing that we'd be coming back here at the end of the night was the ultimate luxury! Love the staff and cleanliness as always.

review_title: The most impressive value for money in over 30 hotels visited
review_text:
This hotel is incredible. From the idling doormen, to the fast check and amazing service. The rooms are generous and cleverly designed. Bathroom is a surprise in terms of quality and comfort. Le Labo products!!! 
 Breakfast is of superior standards and I can't stress the quality of everything. Elevators are fast and even have a bench. It's well located and walking distance to Georgetown shopping and restaurants. I have been to over 30 five star hotels in 4 continents this year, and this is the best so far. I am on love with the experience of having had everything go to perfection! I am a convert to park Hyatt from now on!
Gracious and welcoming front desk service from Andrea. Asian style rooms, modern, walk in shower. Best hotel I have stayed in in DC and will be back.
Excellent hotel. Comfortable, clean and at a hotwire price of $100, no complaints.
hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_title: Dc luxury at it's finest thanks to Amex
review_text: My Girlfriend and I came down for a police 5k run and looked at several hotels. I decided to look at the Amex fine hotels an resorts and found this hotel to be the bes due to it's location an class. We arrived on the 13th around 1pm. As soon as we stepped out of our vehicle we were treated like royalty. Two people in there mid twenties usually aren't treated this way. We were escorted to the front desk and Ali took my name. After a few moments he said, "Since you booked your hotel through Amex fine hotels you are getting a room upgrade to the oval suite!" we couldn't believe it. This room had to be the nicest room we have ever stayed in. The service us impeccable and we Will be coming back!

As you would expect from a hotel of this range it has all the basics right but there is more to this place than a good standard business hotel. I felt duty bound to comment on how wonderful and genuine the staff were. From the moment we arrived we were made to feel special, they took care of our every need from the doorman offering me cold water on return from my morning run to the accurate and personal restaurant recommendations, nothing was too much trouble and it all felt very sincere too. Even my husband, who usually hates the often impersonal service of these large hotels, was impressed. 
The restaurant is also well worth a visit. Quite unusual food but lovely, scallops like saucers, divine! Also delivered by the same friendly and personal service. 
Would definitely go back.

After spending 6 weeks traveling throughout the united states, we rated this hotel at the top of the list for customer service, location, room quality and style. I love the wide timber floor boards used throughout the foyer....beautiful!
I'll be back someday!
D.L
Melbourne, Australia

My friend and I stayed here for a week in mid December. The service and communication were great, the staff combined two bookings for us (we extended our stay and booked on Expedia and the hotel website). Very competant and efficient. Staff were all helpful and pleasant. The room was great- very clean and the beds and pillows were really comfortable. It is a great location, most hotels in the area require walking but this was close to the white house (10 mins walk) which was great. Expedia booking was great value (one night free). I have nothing bad to say about this hotel, would definately stay here again.

Check in was good. Once we got to our room, we saw they gave us a room in the corner of the building near the air vent system. The bathroom shower head falls with the pressure of the water and the only updated portion of the bathroom was the sink & mirror. The toilet clogged several times and we had to adjust the thing inside. The bed was comfortable and they give complimentary Keurig coffee (nice). We only stayed one might, so it was okay for us. Checkout took a very long time. Just when it was our turn, the front desk person asked someone else to approach instead of us. This guy was staying in the penthouse and probably got preference over us because of this. No apology or anything. I wouldn't stay here again and wouldn't have chose this hotel if I knew the service was so poor.

review_title: Not what it used to be
review_text: I've stayed at the Madison for years. Loved the staff, generous (for the city) sized rooms, and great location. Bar and restaurant were big pluses. Not so much anymore. Location, staff and rooms remain the same. Old bar is gone along with superb staff. New restaurant/bar lacks soul and professionalism. Still a good place if you don't have memories of what was, but order roast chicken from room service --- far better than anything in The Federalist.

I highly recommend this hotel. This was our first time to DC and my family and I loved it. We walked everywhere. It was 2 blocks away from the White House and Georgetown is very close. I would stay here again!

Great hotel rooms with very comfortable beds. The front desk was very polite and offered a complimentary upgrade! Always nice to receive little perks like this especially for business travels. 
Service was excellent and the staff even dropped a message to apologize to the guests when the daily newspaper was unavailable for one day.

review_title: Deco decor and embassy row location.
review_text: Rooms have showers only, no bathtubs. We couldn't find how to change from a/c to heat. There was a weird odor in the kitchenette from the microwave. First morning there was only decaf coffee in the room. And luckily we got the last parking space onsite. We were warned about the parking so the car did not move during our stay. The doorman suggested U St for dinner possibilities. Dupont Circle is a better bet. We stayed here on a 40% off unnamed location deal. After payment we found out it was the Carlyle Suites. If we had paid the full price we would have been disappointed.

I would recommend this hotel to anybody, the customer service is incredible, everybody was so nice to my mom and me, the room was very clean and the breakfast Buffett was really good. We'll stay there everytime we go to DC from now on.

review_title: Too small for parents w 1 child
review_text: Booked w points and was to be a 4.5 star hotel-it was the smallest we have ever stayed in-no room at all to move-shower handle cut my finger -not a pleasant stay w a 2 yr old

review_title: Great service, good location, pretty art deco hotel
review_text: We enjoyed our stay. It's about a half hour walk to the White House, and then from there, you can see all the sites. The decor is great, service was superb. Parking lot is small, so make sure they save a space for you if driving. We had dinner in the bar, which was also superb. Breakfast is typical free buffe from hotels. Shower temperature a bit difficult to control. Rooms were a very nice size - large with kitchens with a stove even! TV was great - we didn't have to miss Breaking Bad. Great neighborhood - wish we could have stayed longer.

review_title: Nice hotel. A good find if you like a tempur-pedic mattress.
review_text: This is a sweet hotel. Not much life in the bar, but the staff was beyond nice. The food was good also. The room was nicely appointed and very spacious. I am not a fan of the tempur-pedic mattress, so this was a bummer for me. Otherwise, it was a great experience. So, if you are good with the mattress, you will be happy here. I would say this is a 3.5 star hotel.
Boutique hotel in upscale, quiet neighborhood, with diverse selection of restaurants nearby.

review_title: Gem, minutes away from White House.
review_text: Stayed at this hotel on recommendation of friend. We arrived very late on Friday 8/12/2011. Surprised to find a valet and front desk attendant waiting on us! it was 2am in the morning. On top of the very kind and attentive staff, the room was spacious, clean, and the beds fantastic.
big rooms , clean , good location Very good service we enjoyed staying ther for two days

review_title: Excellent - great staff, service and place
review_text:
Overall a pleasant stay. Room comfy and well equipped. Loved the iPod radio and charge! This is a hotel that understands that the little things matter. 
It's a little busy with business folk but they allow dogs to stay and is such a friendly place. 
The gym is awful for those who train seriously. I mean, come on Madison just a few more bits, another bench, hamstring machine or dip bar.... 
Overall a great stay. We enjoyed Washington from this hotel and loved the free wine in the evening. Bonus

review_title: Great location and staff, comfortable beds, but loud doors.
review_text: We were upgraded to a larger room since we were staying 5 nights. The room was very comfortable and clean. Hotel staff very friendly and accommodating. The location of this hotel is ideal. Lots of restaurants and small shops just a few blocks away; easy walking in safe neighborhood. Subway is also just a few blocks away and can get you anywhere you need to go so no need for a car. We used the MC sedan service to and from airport and they were also excellent- worth it not to hassle with parking and driving in D.C. Only complaint would be loud doors slamming at night, but clientele was mostly settled in before midnight anyhow. We would definitely stay here again if we are in DC.

review_title: Spacious rooms, free coffee in room, good showers and Service with a smile even when arriving at 02:00 am for checkin
review_text: Spacious rooms, free coffee in room, good showers and Service with a smile even when arriving at 02:00 am for checkin

review_title: Great location, but rooms not as nice as they seem on the website.
review_text:
First, the good things: this hotelnis located in a very nice neighborhood in walking distance to Dupont Circle, the subway and many restaurants. The staff was very helpful. There is a clean laundry, good wifi in the rooms and laptop room safes.
However, the room we had was not nearly as good loooking asbthe rooms displayed on the website, but much darker jd not very modern. The kitchen was not very clean, there was a lot ofbdirt between the appliances on the floor. The bathroom could also have been cleaned more throroughly, the bed and linen was clean, however. A major downside tonournroom wasnthat we could hear every word spoken in the next room through the ventilation ... and unfortunatley for us this room was occupied by a group of teenagers. 
Inprobably could imagine to stay there again, but I would also explore oth options.

review_title: Great value for money for comfort in a pretty good location to explore DC
review_text: I stayed here last week with another friend from Australia and we were both very happy with the location, the rooms and the service. The only negative issue we had occurred on arrival when I noted that the bed linen did not appear clean or ironed. The hotel team advised m that they have an in house laundry which cleans and dries the linen but that they do not routinely iron the linen. I expressed my surprise at this practice as I have never come across this elsewhere in the US, Europe, Australia, Hong Kong or even Havana in Cuba I pointed out that regardless of the ironing issue, there were a number of stains and 'yellowed' areas on the linen. The team swung into action and the two beds were then completely stripped and remade with brand new linen straight out of the packets. that was a perfect solution to my concern and I was delighted with the remainder of my four night stay. If you don't mind the bed linen not being ironed, then I would recommend this place. Personally, I like crisp white sheets on hotel beds and so it's not likely that I will return unless they start ironing again. My scores above are brought down by the experience of having to deal with he bed linen issue.

We spent two nights here on Nov 26, and 27th. Had a great room at a great price. Location was great. Walked to the corner and can see the capitol. Room was quiet, and just the right size. Entire room was very clean. Not a single complaint. 
Decided to try the Bistro Bis for breakfast. At first the prices surprised me, but I can honestly say it was the BEST breakfast I've ever had in my life. I had the french toast, and it was amazing. Well worth the money. 
Entire stay was great. Left the Hotel George and went to stay at another Kimpton hotel in Alexandria. Excellent value hotel. Perfect stay!

We stayed here my coworkers and I , for a business trip , we were impressed by the facility , the staff and the location . We had dinner and breakfast every morning and each time it was great , staff speaks more than one language , overall a great experience .
From the time we pulled up to the hotel the service was impeccable. Beautiful hotel, beautiful rooms, and great location. The front desk staff is very helpful I would definitely stay here again!

review_title: Lovely hotel, good base to explore DC
review_text: We arrived by car and took advantage of the valet parking. We were met by friendly staff and immediately informed that we had been given a free upgrade to a suite. The helpful porter showed us to our room which was huge and very modern. Staff were excellent throughout our stay and I would recommend staying here
Stayed forbusiness. Very nice rooms. Service was great. 2 blocks from Capitol and Union Station. Only downside, no vending machines

We like Kimptons and were not sorry here. My only slight issue was the restaurant. The food was wonderful but our simple breakfast for 2 cost almost $50 after tax and tip for oatmeal toast and coffee. Everything is ala carte and very pricey.

Upon approaching the hotel, still a block away, we heard a commotion and assumed it was a festival. It was a huge picket line with multiple megaphones, drums and assorted percussion equipment. They were almost attacking cars as they pulled up to the hotel, increasing in volume and intensity as patrons entered the hotel. We immediately called and canceled our reservation because the noise level was so loud. We could only assume it would begin early in the morning and go well into the evening. Not worth it when sleeping is one of the main reasons for staying.

review_title: Cool hotel for your DC trip if you don't mind walking
review_text: Cool hotel staff were extremely helpful, location nice and quiet but close to Dupont square. You are looking at 30minutes walk to down town DC which we didn't mind. Also the off site gym is nearly half a mike away I enjoyed the rub though and the gym itself was excellent

review_title: Great hotel in Capitol Hill area
review_text: My husband and 14 yo step-daughter stayed here for four nights. The location of the hotel is perfect (one block from Union Station) for touring the city. Our room was spacious enough for three people, front desk service is very friendly, and the hotel has a very hip feel to it. My step-daughter loved the animal print robes. We opted for breakfast at the West Wing Cafe, around the corner on New Jersey Ave. Plenty of good restaurants within 10 minutes walk. Be careful leaving the hotel and walking downtown because the neighborhood makes an abrupt change after a few blocks. It's a short section that looks bad, but it might be best to avoid it at night.
the only problem is the breakfast value, it's too expensive. But that wasn't a real problem, there are a lot of options in the neighbourhood.

Forget the fact that the rooms are tiny and that the hotel has no real amenities and that the restaurant is now closed and they no longer offer room service. This was nothing compared to how poorly rub this place is. I never stayed here before management switched hands but were I a betting man I'd say this place goes under in less than a year. The place was empty over the weekend we stayed. Maybe saw 5 other guests in our 3 days. However that didn't stop them from giving us an annexed room on the top floor facing an industrial park furthest from any elevator. The plus side of this was the rabid protestors were only quasi audible from Our room. Should have walked away the moment I saw 60+ unhappy union workers passionately protesting this place. Sounds like management really hasn't got a clue.

review_title: Very nice hotel; would stay there again.
review_text: Stayed here late August, 2011. No complaints. We checked in very late on a Thursday night and had no problems. We had great customer service. The room was spacious, comfortable. Bathroom shower has built-in shampoo, conditioner and soap dispenser. The bar has great drinks if you need a nightcap.

review_title: A nice room with a great location and friendly staff.
review_text: Stayed 4 nights at this hotel and was very happy with our stay. Room was clean and spacious as was the lobby. It is a great location to the Capitol and Union Station. Would stay here again. Join their rewards program for free Internet and $10 for the mini bar in your room.

Fabulous accommodation, very friendly service at reception and the bar. Sleeping was a dream with luxury pillow choices. Fully fitted, spacious bathroom was wonderful. Very friendly afternoon cocktails in reception were a real treat :)

review_title: Comfortable but not the most convenient location for tourists.
review_text:
We booked 3 nights here through Hotwire for a visit to see daughter who was interning in DC and staying on Capitol Hill. while the hotel was convenient to Union Station and Metro, it was far from many restaurants and attractions we wanted to visit.
The hotel itself was a very good value for the price paid. We had 3 adults in a room with king bed. A roll away was provided for daughter and there was ample room. The bathroom was very nice, with a separate tub and glass enclosed shower stall. The vanity was long, but very narrow. I missed having someone close by to grab a breakfast pastry but at least there was in room coffee. Do sign up for the Kimpton rewards program in advance as you receive free Internet and $10 credit for mini bar. Prices for mini bar weren't bad anyway but free chocolate is even better!

My boyfriend and I loved this hotel. Just a short walk to metro and in a gorgeous quiet neighborhood. room was spacious with clean and comfy linens. If we visit dc again we will return. parking is limited but expected in a city.

review_title: Loved the hotel, but the parking was $$$
review_text:
The staff was serviceable and friendly, the kids got free milk and cookies room service (and loved it) and the location was great for visiting the national mall.
My only complaint was a steep $45 per day fee for hotel parking, with few options nearby (there is an underground parking garage across the street for little less). Given the room rate is not cheap, the added cost for parking doesn't make this stay a great deal.
But we enjoyed it very much nonetheless.

review_title: Solid + convenient place to stay I DC
review_text: While there aren't a lot of the frills that other hotels provide - ones that don't necessarily make for a better stay - this hotel has become a favorite for my husband and I when we come to DC. The price is very reasonable for a perfectly-located, clean, quiet and friendly hotel. Plus there's free wifi in the rooms and Keurig coffee! Sometimes it doesn't take much to please a weary traveller.

review_title: Super staff, big room (though older could use renovation), clean
review_text: The staff here were terrific...polite & helpful. They were great with our rambunctious boys (6 & 8). Good breakfast buffet reasonably priced too. The metro is about 6-7 blocks away; but neighborhood is beautiful and safe. The only drawback is the room could use renovation (but the bathroom looked newly remodeled and was very clean). A great value suite.

review_title: A very comfortable hotel in a great location!
review_text: I stayed for five night. The hotel is very convenient to great restaurants, shopping, museums, and the Metro subway system. Hotel George has a wonderful complimentary wine hour during the week from 5-6 pm. The hotel restaurant and bar are exceptional. My room was spacious, clean, and quiet. I enjoyed my stay!!

recensire questo albergo est veramente difficile perche ha solo lati positivi a parte :
wifi solo nella lobby
air conditioned very high
il resto est davvero tutto stile old fashioned american style . Palestra ok sauna e bagno turco ok e gratis . Starbuck a 10 mt white house pure . La zona dei musei est a portata di piede. Veramente ben ubicato.

review_title: Wonderful stay in the heart of DC
review_text:
Wow! One of THE best hotels we have ever stayed in. Service in the bar and at reception was faultless. When they found out it was my birthday we had chocolate cake and mineral water waiting in our room. The room itself was spotlessly clean and amenities (especially the l'occittaine toiletries) were first class.
Only downside to all this was the breakfast...service was slow even though there were only 4 people dining at that time but the food was good.
Have saved the best for last. The staff in the bar, particularly Jennifer and the deputy bar manager were incredible and a real credit to the hotel. When next in Washington, this will be the only place to stay.

L'hotel si trova a due passi da Georgetown, strada di negozi e ristoranti piena di vita. 
Lo stile e' particolare, sobrio ed incantevole. Lo staff e' disponibile, simpatico, cordiale e molto premuroso. 
La pulizia e' buonissima, ci hanno pure piegato i vestiti lasciati in giro per la stanza.
Gli ascensori sono particolari perchÃ© hanno delle specie di panchine al loro interno.

I have stayed at Kimpton Hotels in Miami, Chicago, San Diego and now DC, and they never fail to disappoint. 
Hotel George is right near the Capitol building, and only 2 blocks from Union station, which has metro and amtrak. Service was superior. No problems with check in, I never saw the housekeeping staff, but everything was always freshened in my room upon my return, and when I called down to the front desk because I forgot a toiletry, it was delivered within minutes. An excellent visit in a quiet neighborhood.
Stayed for 4 nights. Easy walk to the mall and metro station. Staff very friendly. Room was nice with lots of space. Restaurant down stairs is good.

review_title: Great location, but would not return
review_text: Stayed here with husband 6th to 10th October. As we were staying 4 nights we got a four for the price of three which was a good saving & the deciding factor in choosing this hotel. That, and the location which was excellent. I re~read Trip Advisor reviews before arriving and requested tea/coffee making facility in the room, which was agreed. I had not noticed the wifi charge which was irritating. The room was fine but small for two people, as others have commented: the worst aspect was having to improvise places to unpack clothing. Wouldn't have been a problem in a one night stay where you don't unpack. Service was excellent in some respects: if something was requested it was immediately attended to.However it was irritating having to ask for things which in other hotels are automatically provided. e.g. the coffee maker only used particular coffee pods(don't know how else to describe them!) so we had to request these, an engineer was needed to set the clock to the correct time. We didn't eat here so can't comment on this. Staff were helpful and polite but I have to agree with other reviews that it seemed a little pretentious. By the time we left I had grown to like it more, but I would try another hotel for my next visit to Washington.

Needed a room to beat the snow in the mountains the night before our flight. Chose Country Inn & Suites based on price and other reviews.
Evening reception is practically dinner lite! Enjoyed our Fat Tire, but wine and sodas are available... Snacks were yummy and they had a delicious soup on as well.
Room was CLEAN and good size. had tv, microwave, coffee pot, fridge, hairdryer... Everything you'd need.
Nice bed linens, warm and clean! Just what we needed for a cold, snowy night.
Breakfast was great too. More than standard fair for continental breakfast. They have a whole mini fridge dedicated to 4 or more Yougurt types, as well as oatmeal, waffles and several hot dishes (omlets and biscuits & gravy).
Coffee was good, and they always have full cookie jars (yes, plural) at the reception desk.
Good shower, too. We're a tall couple and it was fine. Water pressure good!
Our AAA rate was not advertised, so ask if you are in the club, and you will probably save even more!
Happy Travels!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_text: Las habitaciÃ³n que nos toco era gigante! Buena ubicaciÃ³n, y el personal era bueno, pero no siempre supieron ayudar a recomendarnos activdades. Destaco lo bueno de Stephen, conserge, que hizo muy buenas recomentadciones

review_title: Absolutely Beautiful Hotel In Fantastic Location
review_text:
My husband and I stayed in a luxury room for 4 nights. Check in was smooth and efficient. The room was spacious and well appointed. Finishings were what we expected for the 5 star standard. Staff were so polite and again up to the 5 star standards you are paying for.
We ordered room service as we had just come off a 20 hour flight and it arrived quickly and was very tasty.
Breakfast at the restaurant was fabulous. If I had one gripe/suggestion it would be not to bother pre purchasing breakfast. The restaurant offered well priced alacarte where the pre purchase offered a set menu. I would have preferred the variety. That said the food was amazing!
The location was perfect. 5 minutes stroll to the White House, 15 to the National Mall. 
I would not hesitate in returning next time I'm in Washington.

We stayed for two days following a trip to Europe. From the minute we walked in the service was excellent. We happened to mention we were celebrating our anniversary and they upgraded our room and bought us a drink. The bar had good cocktails. The restaurant had excellent breakfasts including very authentic French breads and pastries and great teas. The room was very comfortable with a bed that was a huge improvement on what we experienced in Europe. The concierge was helpful and recommended a dining spot that was just what we were looking for. Thanks to Jean Patrick for a super experience. The only suggestion for improvement would be tv reception. Our room had surround sound but got very few digital stations

Thanks to Michael Love and Beverly Bethea all my needs were taken care of....they are first class. Bistto Bis offers very good food that will delight most tastes and the location can't be missed. Will be back soon.

Very convenient to airport w/ free shuttle, walk to several good restaurants & bars. Staff very friendly & helpful. Hot express breakfast w/mini-omelets & sausage gravy..good! Awesome cookies at front desk. Excellent room & bed. Best value around!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_title: Great stay, some minor service issues.
review_text:
This was our second stay at the Sofitel. Great location, easy to walk to white house, restaurants and all the museums at the Smithsonian.
Beautiful design of lobby and rooms. Beds are super comfortable. Doorman is very attentive (sorry I forgot his name). We stayed in a junior suite this time. 2 adults slept in king size bed in large private bedroom while 2 kids slept on sofa bed in outer room.
Here were the minor service issues which they need to work on:
check in is 3pm. We arrived around 3:05 after a long car ride from NY. Rooms were not ready due to late departure of IMF guests so the front desk offered us free snacks in Le Bar until room was ready. They asked for our mobile number so that we could receive a call from them when the room was available. After 45 minutes and some delicious French fries, we left Le Bar and asked front desk how much longer. They said they weren't sure so they continued to store our luggage for us and we told them we were going to walk to the museums. One of the front desk people advised us that they would send up milk and cookies for our kids later that night as an accommodation, we never saw these cookies or milk the entire weekend.
At this point it was after 4pm but we managed to squeeze in a visit to the Smithsonian. 
We returned to the Sofitel around 6pm and asked the front desk if the room was ready. They seemed surprised that I would ask and I explained that they never called us on our mobile to alert us. 
Room was great. Before leaving for dinner I checked the sofa bed to find that it had no sheets or pillows and none in the closet. I called the front desk and they said they will send someone up so I gave them a time and sure enough, when we returned from dinner that night the sofa bed was made. I was a little surprised that they didn't do turn down service on our king bed, but only some hotels offer that. We called for an extra pillow and that arrived before the kids went to bed.
Nice touch is that they offer foam or feather. 
I asked about room service for breakfast and the evening serviceman said we should have had a card to fill out, but he brought us one since it was missing.
We put it on the door for an early delivery around 8:45.
At 8:30 we received a call that they didn't have Belgium waffles. Not a huge deal but with 15 minutes notice I wondered when they discovered the missing batter? One of my kids was disappointed but had pancakes instead. Very delicious food!
On 2nd night, no turn down service for sofa bed or our bed but at least the sheets were on the sofa bed.
Overall, great stay. Would like more than 1 bar of soap in bathroom. Hotel was great about giving us evian water to use in the 1 cup coffeemaker. The only other option is to walk all the way to the bathroom with a cup of water at a time to make coffee.
There are no soda machines or candy machines in hotel. Only a very expensive mini fridge of items in the room. We walked to CVS for a $1 dollar chocolate bar instead of the $7 candy bar in the mini fridge.

We arrived late to DIA and the shuttle driver was prompt and nice. Great proximity to airport services, and if you rent a car through Enterprise, not only will they give you 10% off but they'll pick you up at the hotel. 
Fresh cookies at the lobby desk and a great continental breakfast. For $90 including tax this was an incredible bang for my buck. Not to mention the wicked friendly staff and super comfortable beds!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_title: Very nice if You can afford it
review_text: Near White House. Otherwise boring area. Very high standard. Excellent breakfast and service. If You like luxury and have the budget....

After a fantastic stay at the Queenstown (NZ) Sofitel, I had high hopes for the DC branch. Have to say it didn't quite meet the mark.
Good: wonderfully spacious room; plenty of space in the bathroom; large comfy bed; impressive selection of toiletries; very close to the metro; circulator and the tourist attractions, reception and concierge were pleasant and helpful.
Not so good: checking in, the bed only had a really thick cover and no thin blanket so it was sweltering hot till we asked for one the following day (and got two since they remade the bed properly); the aircon didn't function correctly so the room was very hot one night; aircon was really really loud even on low; no kettle or tea or cups in the room; room service took forever (when calling again after 30mins, was told they were very busy); poor service at breakfast (but attentive service at dinner); area can be a bit desolate at night and there's construction next door.
Wouldn't stay in the DC hotel again.

review_title: Clean, quiet and very helpful staff.
review_text: Great value airport hotel. Comfortable beds, breakfast buffet had a good variety. Very clean and the staff were very helpful. Would definitely use this chain again. A selevtion of restaurants in walking distance, we ate at a cheap but good Thai 5 mins walk away.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_title: Best hotel we stayed at the end of our trip to Colorado and Wyoming
review_text: great hotel, friendly staff at the front desk. large clean modern room. great biscuits at front desk. staff upgraded us after checking loyaly card. brilliant. totally recommend this and will return.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_title: Great place to stay---clean room, full breakfast, good price.
review_text: We stayed one night. Our flight did not leave until late afternoon. We had planned to sightsee but weather was terrible so we decided to stay in. We were given a later checkout time. Staff was very accommodating. Would definitely stay here again!!!!!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_text: Loved the hotel -- great location to see sites at The Mall. Easy metro and walking... Stayed with husband and 2 teens ... Nice size room... Would stay again!
The service is prompt, the rooms are clean and tastefully decorated and the beds are comfortable. The location in DC is tough to beat.
