review_title: Great stay so close to union station!
review_text: This hotel was great from the bed with great pillows to the front desk staff that assisted me with my early check in at 11 am. They really think of everything. The free WIFI for Kimpton In Touch members great speed easy to connect to. The location of the hotel is 1 block away from union station and you can see the Capitol bluiding from the corner of the street. Rooms are kind of small, but well equiped. A great choice when in DC.

review_title: Great value convenient hotel with added extras.
review_text: We arrived after travelling for 24hrs to a very welcome. The hotel was easy to find (quiet location esp considering proximity to airport) and has plentiful parking and a few restaurants within walking distance. All parts of the hotel were clean and well presented. The pool and hot tub were a real bonus. On the downside there was a real "chain" feel with no character and the breakfast was OK not great and was served in a room which was really too small for the size of hotel. Location not great to get to central Denver. These things apart i would rate the hotel as excellent.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_text: My 12 year old son and I stayed here for four days while visiting the sites in DC. The service was exceptional, particularly from the concierge. Location, food & room also excellent. Would highly recommend.

review_title: Fabulous hotel, food and location. What more could I say.
review_text: We stayed her for 2 nights with teenagers. Fab location - White House just around the corner. The rooms were spotless and service excellent. We ate in the Bistro for dinner and the food was amazing. Breakfast outside was also fab and drinks in the bar were lovely with a modern decor which I liked. Staff were over attentive and the concierge very helpful too. Only thing I didn't like was the strong air freshener/perfume smell in the lobby which was overpowering. Also our suite on the 4th floor was directly opposite the lift and during the night we could hear the "ping" of the lift as it stopped on each floor-very annoying.

review_title: Great location between Denver and the airport.
review_text: I needed a place to stay on my last night in Denver and this was perfect. Very clean with good breakfast. I needed a gas station with a carwash and the desk personnel were helpful with directions.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_text: I chose this hotel because it is the closest to the White House and we only had 2 days to visit Washington DC. It was a real treat to stay in such a luxury hotel. Rooms were spacious, the beds were incredibly comfortable and the whole ambiance was one of elegant sophistication. The concierge Jack was a gem and helped us with restaurant reservations and an amazing 4 hour private tour of DC. I guess the highlight was stepping outside of the hotel and walking across the road to the White House gardens.

The absolute best motel in Denver. This has been my families get away for over a yr now... Always clean, everybody is so friendly and welcoming. The rooms are cozy and beds are to die for. Walking distance to shopping/restaurants which is also a plus. Would definately recommend...
Good clean property. There is an outback and a pizza UNO next door. It's a good place to stay if you Hace an early morning flight out or late arrival.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_text: I didn't actually stay here, but was going to. We walked in for an early check-in and the woman at the desk was very nice and said we could do it. The room we got was a smoking room and we don't remember saying we wanted one, but the woman at the front desk did say she asked us if we wanted a smoking room. Anyway, it grossed us out very much, but if you smoke, it probably wouldn't have been bad. Wasn't the quality we would want.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_text: Lovely helpful staff! Beautiful spacious suites and convenient location!! Walked back to the hotel after a night out on the town. Harrys bar is pretty trendy! I'll definitely be recommending to friends and family members!!

The Hay-Adams has an old-fashioned, luxurious English feel. The staff were friendly and accommodating, and the style in the room is relaxing and comfortable. The room service food was very excellent: fresh, delicious, and prompt. They couldn't make an iced cafe latte, and the bathroom periodically smelled strongly of cigarettes (vents from an adjacent room?), but one cannot quibble. They were also remarkably kind to our children.
Stayed there for the night. Awesome location right in downtown. Very pleasant hotel. Highly recommend.

1st impression was great, friendly valet and front desk. Room is small with no view. Makeup mirror light is broken. Room is dim, so hard to get ready. Not a lot of space to put all your stuff away. This is only the first night, we will see how rest of the stay goes.

Clean & beautiful rooms! Helpful and friendly staff, a reception where you receive free drinks, cookies in the evening & a FULL free breakfast in the morning...who could ask for more?!?! The Magnolia has the greatest value for your money right along with the convenience of downtown fun & shopping all around the hotel. We ONLY stay here when we're in town.
The staff was incredible and the service excellent!

review_title: Great place to stay with our family.
review_text: Clean place to stay. Staff pleasant, helpful. Great breakfast...more than others offer. It was so good we ate there both mornings rather than going out. Waffels, scrambled eggs,danish, ect. The afternoon snack bar was a nice treat too. Would definately stay here again. Priceline deal.
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_title: One of the very best in DC!
review_text: This is our third time at the Hay-Adams and it is better than ever. Rooms are comfortable and beautifully decorated and service is top-notch......equal to any Ritz!

Wonderful stay! They treated our children so nice! They even sent complimentary milk & cookies for the kids after we arrived and also accommodated an early (9am) check in! Literally walking distance from everywhere!! Would stay again.

review_title: If you need to stay near the airport this is the place.
review_text: This place gets good reviews for a very good reason. Definitely worth the few extra $. We had a 6:40 flight and had to leave the hotel at 4:15 AM. They cooked breakfast for us - FREE! Stay here!
hotel_name: Country Inn & Suites By Carlson, Denver International Airport

review_title: Across street from white house.location does not get better than this. Great for kids. Near monument etc.
review_text: Best location in town. Rooms on older side but comfy.

review_title: Very disappointing room view and layout
review_text: Excited to take break and visit our capital. We were shown to our room only to open the drapes and find we were looking directly into an office building (zero view). The closest doors, which swung out, couldn't be opened all of the way - they stopped when they hit the bed. We had a desk was positioned between the beds which was just weird. It was supposed to alternate as night stands and a desk. Not realistic with two guests in the room. There wasn't any place in the bathroom to put a small toiletry bag. We immediately requested a different room and were told it would be an additional $100/night on top of the $500/night we had already paid if we wanted to move. Very disappointing to have a room like the one we had combined with a response like that from a hotel like this.
Exceptional Service, wonderful room and delicious breakfast.

review_title: Simply the best hotel in DC
review_text:
We recently stayed at the Sofitel in DC and it exceeded every expectation we had. 
Location - can not be beat. Near a metro stop; easy walk to the Mall; plenty of taxis.
Room- we stayed at in a luxury king room. The room was clean, well appointed, and had a nice view. The bed was amazing. We are actually going to order one for home. The only negative was that the showerhead would not move.
Service - This is where this hotel shines. Both my wife and I agree that the service level at this hotel beats many of the St. Regis and Four Season hotels we have stayed at. They are truly reviving the lost art of providing amazing hospitality. We feel that the staff honestly wants you to feel at home and that they anticipate your needs even before the you ask.
This hotel was not only beautiful but the service was excillant!

review_title: Our favorite place to stay when away from home!
review_text: The Magnolia is our favorite hotel when away from home! We have stayed at the Denver location 5 times in the last year. The staff is always very friendly and professional. This organization is very details oriented and it shows in their day to day operations. You will not be disappointed.

I had a one night stay here recently. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable. Although it was beyond the hotels control others staying on the same floor were not so quiet. This was some what expected since it is an old hotel however its also a very high end hotel I didn't expect to be kept up by other guest screaming in the hallway or children running up and down. Overall this was a good hotel. My next visit will be to the intercontinental as its a little closer to the mall.
This hotel offers wonderful accommodation. We enjoyed it tremendously!

review_title: A genuine home away from home atmosphere.
review_text: The rooms are generous in size, very clean and quiet. For business downtown or shopping the 16th Street Mall area the location is ideal. The complimentary wine & beer tastings, full breakfast buffet & evening cookies & milk are terrific.

Great service, excellent rooms and a superb location. So why less than 5-stars across the board? Two things: hotels at less than half the price provide free Wi-Fi yet here you're expected to pay; the valet parking is bordering on extortion - but then you are in the Capital City.

review_title: Cookies were nice receptionist was rude.
review_text: Good location and nice gym. I really liked the cookies and pool table. The receptionist was a extremely rude but everything else was cool.

hotel_name: The Liaison Capitol Hill, An Affinia Hotel

review_text: My husband and I got a great deal on the Sofitel through jetsetter.com. We stayed 3 nights over Easter weekend. The hotel is in a great location, a block from the metro and close to restaurants. We arrived early (noon-ish), and our room wasn't ready, but the hotel held our bags and we had time go exploring. The room-service breakfast was good but extremely expensive ($20 plus tax, tip and delivery charge). Valet parking was also pricey at $42/day, but we opted for it since it was easier than trying to find parking. We had a king superior room on the 8th floor with no view. The room was a decent size and the bathroom was lovely - full-size hairdryer (not the flimsy wall mounted kind), large stall shower with separate bath, and a separate makeup mirror. We heard some room noise in the hallway but we couldn't hear anything in our own room. Overall the hotel was great - nice rooms, superb location. If we were able to get the same great rate I would definitely stay here again.

review_title: Stylish, great location and flawless service
review_text: Nice departure from the norm. Stylish, well placed hotel convenient to everything. Thoughtful service, impeccably designed with some great touches. Great decor and the restaurant - Eastern Standard - was terrific. Can't say enough.
Kitchen in suite a little dated but overall very nice stay

I'm a BU parent and the location can't be beat. Eastern Standard restaurant offers exceptional food in an English Pub atmosphere. The T is outside the door so it's an easy trip to downtown. It's expensive but worth it for me to be on the campus of BU. Needs coffee maker in the room.
I travel a lot and I love hotels! This was the best hotel by far! They are kind, attentive, and treat you like royalty!

I had a great time at the hotel. The hotel is beautiful but most of the service was impeccable. I brought a friend with me who said she felt like a movie star. Everyone treats you like your somebody. I believe that's the best you can get! Room was beautiful and loved the location.

I just stayed here for work and loved it! Only a 30 dollar cab ride from Logan Airport. Great walking neighborhood and a very nice place. Room was clean, elegant and modern. The amenities were great and I loved having wifi. Oyster restaurant in lobby was delicious

We spent one night and were very impressed. The location downtown was perfect for walking to Larimer Square and LoDo. The bathroom light switches were in weird locations, and one of them looked like it has on loan from a auto shop, but other than that, wonderful stay.

review_title: #2 in Denver? You've got to be kidding!
review_text: Just wrapped up a very unpleasant stay. Here's a tip for future guests--don't let them put you on the first floor. I was in room 116 which, as it turns out is right above the valet area. I was awakened several times by "exuberant" guests waiting for their cars...at 2 and 3 am. Called down to complain and the front desk clerk was nonplussed and not apologetic. The room service waiter was rude--left all my plates tightly wrapped in plastic wrap which was so tightly sealed that it was practically cold by the time I could get them open. He seemed irritated when I told him I wanted to charge the meal instead of paying cash (odd since most people charge to their room). My room smelled "fusty" as my Scottish mom would say...kind of stale and gross. My experience was the polar opposite of many reviewed here. The capper was when I went to check out and the desk clerk asked me how it was and I said "not good, actually" and her reaction was "hmmm, yeah sorry about that" without any eye contact or additional apology. A great hotel, of course, would have had my previous night's complaint already recorded and asked me about it proactively. Ugh!!

We stayed for a week at the Sofitel in Jan. Great location, and the rooms where spacious and tidy. 
Our outbound flights to DC were cancelled at very short notice due to snow in the UK, so we called the hotel to change our reservation dates. This was done with pleasure and they even held the special rates for the extra nights we stayed. 
Concierge was knowledgeable. Only improvement would be free wifi in rooms, but there is free Internet access in the lobby which we took advantage of.

review_title: Swanky but affordable even with kids and pets!
review_text: I love staying here with my kids and taking the dog too. They have kids robes, pet bowls and beds - super well sorted. All that and it feels like a W Hotel. Good location, great crepe place across the street too. Kimpton always seems to get it right.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Large rooms in a modern and clean hotel just steps from the 16th Street pedestrian area. Staff very helpful as well. All good.

We spent a week at the palomar and were very impressed with the staff. From the very knowledgable Phillip as the concierge through the the bell hops everyone had a smile on their face and happy to help
We thoroughly recommend the Palomar
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
We stayed (my partner and I) for 3 days recently.
We loved the room and hotel - it is clean, welcoming and impressive!
We are at the hotel restaurant and were amazed at the food!! I had the braised beef and my partner had the scallops. We loved it so much we ate there a second night too!! The crab linguini is amazing!!!
we took advantage of the 3 day special (3rd day free) and it was called 'i love chocolate'. I was a little disappointed to read in other info abt this, that we should gave had a breakfast free too, and afternoon tea with chocolate! We weren't told about this at all when we checked in - or at any tine in our stay.
Apart from that - we had a fantastic time.

I have to agree with Kathleen42's review. I too have stayed at Kimpton hotels in the past, including the Madera just down the street, and found the Palomar to be just ok. My room was minuscule - smaller than my master bath at home - the wifi signal was poor, no working Ethernet port for a hard wire connection, and the bathroom, too, was very small. I'm not sure I would stay at this property again, which is sad because I think Kimpton generally has good properties and good service.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: I've stayed at the Palomar a number of times and I'm a Klimpton member - I usually have a great experience. Not so much, this time around. Apparently, I've never had the standard size room before - it is minuscule. Barely room to move and no where to sit except the bed and desk. Then there was glitchy stuff. I was never able to connect to the wifi and just when I needed to shower, the hot water went down for the entire hotel. The staff was variably helpful. On the plus side, the location is great, the rooms are spotless, and the restaurant, Urbana, is really good.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: This was our first stay and not our last. Great location next to the T and rooms were comfortable,quiet and spacious.

review_title: Great stay. Great service. Great hotel.
review_text: First time in DC with my boyfriend for a weekend getaway from Miami. We were lucky enough to score a deal for the Palomar on Jetsetter.com for $110 a night with an executive king upgrade. What a lovely hotel! Customer service was exceptional from all ends. Really enjoyed the free wine reception from 5-6 Friday and Saturday by the cozy fireplace as well as the free hot chocolate and coffee served every morning and afternoon. Most comfortable hotel bed ever slept in and really liked the Aveda products. Overall, great chic hotel in the heart of DC. I def recommend!
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Perfect family hotel in great location
review_text: Loved the milk and cookies every night and excellent breakfast buffet.

review_title: Cool, funky decor with great value adds like the free breakfast, evening reception and nightime milk and cookies.
review_text: Staff are all nice, friendly and helpful. Decor is cool. Breakfast buffet was good in terms of selection and quality. Night time cookies were a great touch and very tasty. The hotel bar/restaurant is a little small but there are lots of restaurants near by. The lounge area where breakfast, evening reception and cookies are served is a great space (complete with water/rock garden)

review_title: Great clean rooms at affordable prices.
review_text: I love staying here on business trips. The rooms are very nice, clean and new. The staff is attentive and accomadating.

Hotel is right on dupont circle, easy to get to subway and some great eateries nearby. Hotel had nice style, good rooms, good service, free wine in evenings, got some great tripadvisor recommendations for nearby restaurants. Would definitely stay again.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Good hotel in great downtown location
review_text: I stayed at the Magnolia for on night on business. Upon arrival I was upgraded to a large suite with a full kitchen, which was a pleasant surprise. The room was approx 600 square feet, had 14 foot ceilings and overlooked the street. The decor was nice but not spectacular; was very comfortable; and felt like someplace I could relax after a long day. My only complaint was the kitchen, which needs an upgrade to fit with the remainder of the suite. The staff were pleasant and helpful. The bar on the first floor was hip but crowded. Overall, I would definitely stay there again.
Beautiful,clean,upgraded our room without extra charge,wonderful restaurant adjoining,ideal location for Boston College or Boston University visit.

We stayed at Magnolia for 2 nights and this was our first visit to Denver. We arrived by car (just picked it up from the airport) and parking facilities were very good. They had a valet parking or you could park your car in the adjoining parking lot, which worked out cheaper for us as we didn't need the car in town. The 16th street shopping area is around the corner which was convenient. We liked the breakfast, enough choice and a lot of fresh fruit! Good selection of teas too. Friendly front desk. All in all a good experience for our visit to Denver and our first stop for roadtrip.
Wonderful Hotel in a great location in downtown Denver. Loved the complementary breakfast and the milk and cookies at night were a nice treat. Very friendly staff.

Stayed here for 2 nights in aug. booked an executive room. Massive room - really comfortable - (fake) leopard skin robes - maybe the other one was a zebra - can't quite remember. Well worth the money. DuPont circle not too far from everything - metro close - just down the road from the Phillips gallery - which is fantastic by the way. Staff were friendly enough -our package came with a basic breakfast - there was wine tasting hour for free booze one night we were there - free internet - overall felt like we were staying in a stylish, slightly hip hotel - will try these kimpton hotels next time I'm in the US
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: I was here for my sisters wedding and things were not well prepared. That aside, however, all staff were very friendly, rooms are clean and comfy and the location is good. I would expect more from this price range, i.e. Pool, jacuzzi, and not charging $8 for someone to print wedding vows...If you need something central and decent this is a good pick but I wouldn't put your wedding party here.

We stayed at the Magnolia the night of the U2 concert in Denver. 
Its a smaller older hotel which attempts to be charming. I found the loud in room air conditioner and mattress with no cushioning not so charming. It felt like I was in an old hotel. With so many hotels offering upgraded beds I find it hard to pick one that has a mattress that looks like it came out of a dorm room. 
Starbucks in front is closed on Sunday's.

review_title: Relaxing getaway in the middle of the action!
review_text: My husband and I both work in hotels in the Boston area and were pleasantly surprised by the level of service and the ambiance of the Hotel Commonwealth! We had a couple of noise issues that were IMMEDIATELY resolved upon calling the front desk; Ryan also apologized and offered us complimentary breakfast at Eastern Standard (great restaurant located in the same building) and gave us a later checkout time so we could sleep in a little longer! This was definitely a very generous way to make up for the disturbance. We live in Cambridge (about 10 minutes from the hotel) and are definitely looking forward to staying here again in the future for a night away! The location is great and the rooms are wonderfully spacious, and that's not just by city standards!

We stayed here for just one night. I surprised my husband with a night out (without our 22-week old baby) for some husband/wife time. When I booked the room, the conceirge offered to make our dinner reservation, too. Very nice. Also, and more impressively, when we returned from dinner there were two bottles of wine and 6 gourmet cupcakes with a Happy Birthday card waiting in our room! I had told the front desk it was my husband's bday when I booked the reservation and they obviously took note.
Finally, I am a nursing mother of a 22-week old and had to pump during my stay (so romantic I know). There was a mini bar with a sign reading "do not store personal items in fridge" so I had nowhere to store my milk. I called the front desk and they brought me up a separate mini fridge. I thought that was awesome.

Quirky Intelligent Engaging Chic Subtle - just words to describe the staff, valet, checkin, bar, bartender and other guests!! Truly a 5 star place with ab fab rooms - fantastic value - would recommend to families and couples and friends who look for something really really special
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Really fun decor, great location, very functional and most comfy beds!!
review_text: We stayed in the fireplace suite with a full kitchen. We took advantage of the free happy hour, made dinner in our room, went out for the evening, came back and enjoyed the sitting area with fireplace and then took a bath in the large tub. This hotel was very nice. We got a great night's sleep in the super comfortable bed. Great pillows too! The breakfast was alright- not great. Overall a very fun getaway from the kiddos! This hotel does things right.
From the moment we arrived, everyone was extremely helpful. Would highly recommend the hotel and will definitely stay there any time I come to Boston

review_title: One of the finest hotels I have ever stayed at and the best in Boston!
review_text: Fantastic. Everythig was perfect. Staff is super friendly and accomodating.

review_title: The staff is what sets this hotel apart.
review_text: Great hotel. The staff was very friendly, helpful and accommodating. Rooms were fine. Location is great. Wonderful restaurant.

review_title: Gorgeous spacious room, quiet yet right in the center of Kenmore square where all the action is!
review_text: We stayed one night in Boston for a red sox game and chose the Commonwealth because of the location ( walking distance to Fenway). We were a little hesitant to book it because the price was a little high, but we did get a aaa discount. The service from the valet to the front desk was above par! Everyone was friendly and eager to help. We got back from the game at 1 am and the front desk people were still very friendly! The room was huge, so many windows. It had a modern look yet old charm too. The bedspread was a down comforter and so comfy and the toiletries are high quality too for people who like to use those! Very pleased all in all!!
The staff at this hotel are a credit to their company, when we visit the US we will always stay at a kimpton hotel. We had a great stay,which made it a great holiday. Thanks.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: My family and I like to stay here when visiting DC. They cater to kids so perfectly: movies, cookies and milk delivered to te room free - the kids must call to request. Very cute. Just a clean, hip, modern hotel that's cool with kids - and pets!
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: We stay at Hotel Commonwealth anytime we come to Boston. The hotel is in a great location, the staff are so accommodating, and the rooms are always spotless! We look forward to staying here again and again!
It was perfect. FREE wine, beer, n cookies. How can u go wrong. We walk to all the action to the 16th street shopping. Great location. We will be back

I was really surprised how big the room was. Overall, good service, great decor, a decent price for DC. No negatives at all. 
I highly recommend it. Sign up for InTouch so you get all the little extras.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: We stayed at the Commonwealth about a month ago and couldn't wait to come back. From the charming doormen to the helpful and warm staff ready to greet you at the desk, this hotel is the best. This past weekend we returned and they upgraded us to a wonderful suite. The room was beautiful, spacious and clean. We loved this most recent stay because we were going to an event at Fenway and we could walk there and back. We love everything about this hotel and can't wait to return.

review_title: A hotel that will make your holiday!
review_text:
What can I say.... From the polite and efficient reception staff, ton the fabulous rooms, great location, yummy breakfast, this hotel was perfect for my short break in DC.
2 mins (flatish) to the Dupont Circle metro and bus tour. We used the Grays hop on hop off from here which doesn't run that often (it's on it's less popular yellow line) sonwols think again if returning. Metro was good even at rush hour.
The hotel and staff really were perfect. Highly recommend.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Great hotel in good location. Close to dupont circle and lots of restaurants/bars nearby. We checked in early and were upgraded to a fantastic, huge room! We knew the Kimpton password for august so also received a bonus bottle of wine.
Staff very friendly and helpful. Didn't make the complimentary wine hour as were too busy around the city. Pool area quite small and only catches sunlight for some of the day but didn't bother us as we were out and about. Breakfast lovely too - tables a bit close together but a minor detail.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
We are a family of 3 with a 4 year old child. Receptionists are hospitable. Upon check-in, we were given all the information about the hotel and our bebenifts as a Kimpton member (it's free to join and you get a lot of benefits - so worth it).
Our room was with 1 king bed, just as I requested. We were on the 4th floor but it was quiet and we didn't hear anything from the street level.
Just 2 blocks away is Dupont Circle where there is a CVS (drugstore and mini mart), Paradiso Pizzeria (great pizza at very reasonable prices) and a lot more establishments. The subway is also located in this area.
I would definitely stay in this hotel again. I was able to get a very good rate of USD190 per night thru directrooms.com.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: New and excellent in all regards. Rooms were large and beautiful .

review_title: First class hotel in excellent location.
review_text:
Just spent 9 nights at the Palomar Hotel Wahington DC, fantastic hotel, we had an oversize King suite c/w Japanese soak bath which was a great way to ease the aches and pains after visiting the sights of Washington.
Hotel staff were attentive without being over bearing, and as for the very popular wine hour at 5pm every day, you could not ask for more.
Dupont circle metro 2 minutes walk away made access to the rest of Washington very easy.
As for any concerns around this being a pet friendly hotel, saw many dogs but never ever heard one bark the time we were there so no problems.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: This hotel was one of the best I have ever had the pleasure of staying in. The room was huge, immaculate, well furnished. The staff were constantly on hand to help, the service first rate. The food was fine, atmosphere fine, we only wish we could have stayed longer. Thank you for making our stay in Washington an excellent experience.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Great hotel in great location. Very friendly, nice perks (breakfast, cookies). Would stay again.

Pricey, but teriffic hotel, great location, and friendly, welcoming staff. For a game at Fenway you can't ask for a better location! But for the cost, it's not too much to expect a bar of soap for BOTH the sink and shower right? Small thing, but if you're trying to cater to everything a guest might like to feel at home, don't make them transfer soap from the sink to shower.
Had a great stay at the Palomar. The staff was friendly and helpful, and the room was quite large and very clean. The area had lots if great restaurants to choose from, I recommend Eola.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
Nice staff, great value in it's class and generous sized rooms. We checked in to a second floor room which looked on to the pool.. Fantastic if you like to be near the gym, but not very private. Next day the reception staff cheerfully moved us to a higher and nicer room that freed up that morning, resulting in a very pleasant stay. The buffet breakfast is basic but ok as a timesaver in the morning, but Dupont is full of great places to eat if you have more time. The location is a taxi ride from most places, but the metro is really nearby as an alternative.
We'd stay here again, but watch the room preferences pre check in. But then that's a common experience with online booking through a third party- isn't it?
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: Great hotel in the perfect location.
review_text: Great service. Great food. Great room. Went for our wedding anniversary and had ourselves a wonderful time.

review_title: Magnolia Hotel, yes it is a nice place to stay!
review_text: I would give Excellent across the board, if only the parking wasn't so expensive and the towels are softer to the touch. Great staff, and really nice place to stay!!!!

review_title: A coffee pot in the room would have made it perfect.
review_text: Everthing was great. They upgraded us to a bigger room and when we opened the curtains, Fenway Park was right there. It was rather magical. There were wine glasses and a bottle opener, which I thought was nice. The staff was great and the place was very clean too. Only issue was there was no coffee pot in the room and the only fridge was full of things to buy. Hard to put anything in it. Otherwise it was great!!!!!!!

review_title: We were pleased with every aspect of our stay.
review_text: The staff will make your stay in Washington a very pleasant one.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_title: You will NOT find better service in Denver - Period.
review_text: Magnolia is our FAVORITE place to stay in Denver! So much better than the rest!
The staff was very friendly! The room was clean and in great shape. We will be staying there again!

review_title: They get the big things right but details need work.
review_text: Stayed here for a three day business trip. As others have noted this is a fantastic location, the rooms are beautiful and both restaurants on the property are outstanding. However, the overall experience did not meet my expectations because small but important elements were missing that I've come to expect in hotels of this class: only one bar of soap so had to keep switching it from sink to bath, no conditioner, 3 bath towels for 2 guests, poor lighting for bathroom vanity (I think light needed to be replaced in makeup mirror or something), no electrical outlets near the entry which would have been the best place to set up ironing board...I could go on but I think you get the drift.

review_title: Best spot with best service in boston!
review_text:
We have stayed at this hotel several times and the service is impeccable, 
The location is prime and I can't say enough about the staffs extra efforts when you are celebrating a special occasion. If I'm staying in Boston I'm staying at the hotel commonwealth !

I can not say enough good things about the staff, accommodations and location relative to Fenway. Plain and simple we paid a good penny and every penny was worth it. In fact I'm saving my pennies for a return visit. We will stay at no other place when we head back. If my wife is smiling then u know it's quality.

review_title: Comfy rooms, friendly staff, GREAT location!
review_text: We've stayed in the magnolia hotel twice, and have been very satisfied with both experiences. The rooms are very comfortable and clean, the staff is extremely friendly and accomodating, and I would recommend a stay here to annyone. If you don't stay in the hotel, Harry's Bar downstairs is a great little spot to have a drink.

We just came back from another great stay at the Palomar. The room was lovely and the service was GREAT! And the location just can't be beat. We will definitely come back again next time we're in town!
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text:
We were in Boston with our daughter to look at colleges when we stayed at your hotel. We enjoyed everything The Commonwealth had to offer. The room was great and the staff was fantastic!!! Now...if you could just help our daughter get in a college up there, then we'll be back to visit your hotel frequently!
Sincerely, 
Shareen Grayson

review_title: Location, elegance and friendly staff all in one gorgeous hotel.
review_text: I stayed at the hotel Commonwealth in Boston while visiting from Florida. The hotel has beautifully appointed rooms which are also spacious and very Comfortable. My cousins from Scotland were very impressed with my room. We had a fantastic dinner at the adjoining Island Creek Oyster bar and then caught up with all the family news sitting in the wonderful sitting area of my room. Everything about this hotel is far above average . There is even a cute coffee cart off the lobby with a very pleasant server. Boston is a fabulous city and this hotel is truly the best place to stay while exploring bean town.

review_title: Beautiful Hotel but it could be better
review_text: My husband and I stayed at Hotel Palomar in Dupont Circle this past weekend. We checked in on Thursday and checked out today (Monday). Overall, this hotel was gorgeous... The lobby, the restaurant and the room were stunning... We stayed in a King Spa room on the tenth floor. The view was of another building but it's understandable not having a great view so that didn't bother us at all. It was really hot up in the tenth floor which was kind of annoying but not too big of a deal since the room was nice and cool. The elevators were sooooo slow & not roomy at all. It was horrible to wait several minutes only to have the elevator arrive and already be crammed with people and have to wait for the next one. That again wouldn't have been a big deal if it wasn't so darn hot on our floor. However, it was over 100 degrees when we stayed there so perhaps that's why it was so hot. The staff was very nice & friendly. They had free coffee and tea every morning and free wine/sangria & lemonade each evening which was very nice. I also enjoyed seeing all of the guests' dogs since we were unable to bring our own. There is one major problem that really bugged me though. We were going to DC to celebrate my husband's 30th birthday and I wanted to do something special for him prior to our arrival. I contacted the concierge twice via the Palomar website to try to arrainge this and never received a response. Perhaps I should've also followed this up with a phone call but I was crazy w/ work prior to our departure and email would have been much easier for me to deal with. So, if you are looking for a nice hotel with comfortable beds and friendly staff that's in a great location , stay here! If you want to arrange for something special dont email!
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: My husband and I stayed here for a special night away from the kids. Had a great time! Great location, great value, wonderful service! Milk and were yummy and the breakfast buffet wasnice too!

great location, great service. Tubs are large, bed was comfy. Milk ran out for nighttime cookie service by 830 and wasn't replaced, but overall service was fantastic. Food from room service was hot, tasty, and definitely worth it.

review_title: Great Dupont location,even better hotel happy hour!
review_text: Like all the other Kimpton hotels we were welcome to an every day 5 o clock happy hour in the lobby. The location was blocks from Dupont Circle,near lots of restaurants and coffee places and within walking distance of all the great DC landmarks. The view from our room faced the alley and the dumpster but the room itself was huge and very comfortable. The $36 a night valet parking (the only parking available) was a let down but the comfort and location made up for it.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: We were impressed from the moment the door man, Jeff, greeted us to moment we left the hotel. The staff was professional, concerned about our stay- eager to please us and ensure we were completely satisfied with everything! The room was beautiful and extremely clean and you can't beat the location. I was second guessing my choice because of the expense BEFORE I got there... but now it's the only hotel I want to stay at when we visit our daughter- I dont care how much it costs- IT'S WORTH EVERY PENNY! Thank you Hotel Commonwealth for making our trip to Boston that much more enjoyable- by the way this is the first time I ever felt compelled to write a review! Again- Thank you!!! Bethanne Hollis

review_title: Literally around the corner from Fenway Park, an excellent, clean hotel.
review_text: We stay here every time we attend a Sox game. It is conveniently located within like 5 minutes from Fenway Park and countless restaurants. The T station is the next door over so you can really tour Boston easily. Always have a perfect stay! Will be returning in August. Can't wait!
From valet to the room the service was outstanding.

review_title: A wealth of service which is anything BUT common.
review_text: We searched for bars and found none better; we searched for food and found none better; a beautiful room and excellent service. Search no more.

Not sure why this hotel is ranked #1. I trusted that ranking and booked this hotel; it is nothing special. We did not have any problems but we did not experience anything special either. We should have stayed across the street for much less money. Choose another DC hotel; I will next time.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Had such a great time! Everyone was so friendly and accommodation- the staff truly went out of their way to make sure we enjoyed our stay. The location and views were amazing and the decor and rooms were so classy and elegant... Definitely the perfect place to get ready before a wedding!
Great hotel! Can't wait to go back. Beautiful room, attentive staff, Fresh amenities, and a fantastic meal at Eastern Standard. Complimentary room upgrade upon check in was appreciated.
A wonderful hotel. Attentive staff, nice rooms, good breakfast.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: I decided to stay at this hotel because I had really enjoyed its 2 restaurants on previous trips. It is close to Fenway, but also close to the freeway so you get a lot of vibration in the hotel. The room was fine, good space, okay furnishings, bathroom was good size, room service horrible. You can get a good rate at this hotel, and you will probably sleep fine, just remember to go downstairs for your meals. The oyster bar restaurant is especially good.
Great hotel. Clean nice rooms and good concept. I got the motion room and enjoyed the in room bike and Gigi bath every day. I recomend this place.
hotel_name: Palomar Washington DC, a Kimpton Hotel

review_text: Because of work, I travel to Boston twice a month and stay at this amazing place. This is not just comfortable but everything about this place is unmatched. The service, the luxury, the rooms and the amenities: a class apart! If i were to pick up on something, it would be the internet connectivity which becomes overloaded and unreachable with the number of guests lodged.

We've stayed at this hotel many times these past few years visiting with our daughter. With her continuing studies at Boston University and our son soon starting at Tufts University, we look forward to many future stays at this wonderful hotel. We are always welcomed with excellent hospitality, friendly and informed staff, and top amenities. The rooms are very spacious and clean with all up to date amenities- I especially love the convenience of the charging dock. The new restaurant on site, the Island Creek Oyster Bar, is an added bonus serving fabulous food in an atmosphere of casual sophistication!

review_title: Could not have been happier with choice!
review_text: I found the hotel online and it exceeded my expectations! Do not miss the Oyster House Restaurant. The combination of beautiful decor, fabulous beds and an outstanding restaurant made this visit memorable.

review_title: Came to run the Boston Marathon and ended up running in style by staying at the Commonwealth.
review_text: Great service and staff...we'll be back next April for the 116th Boston Marathon.

Stayed for one night and loved it. Only problem was with the elevators. They are operated using room keys and neither my wife nor I were able to get out on the floors that have ice. Seems strange since the gym is also on that floor. We both ended up having to ride the elevators up and down from the lobby a couple of times when the elevators took over. If you are claustrophobic you might want to avoid this place- other than the odd elevator rides it is great!

My daughter and I first stayed here a year ago when visiting Boston University. The staff is very welcoming, the rooms, beautiful and spacious. Since then, my husband has stayed once, and we are both booked two more times in the next few months. The location is perfect (easy access to Storrow Drive and the T), and you can walk to plenty of shopping and other attractions. The Hotel Commonwealth has become our go-to hotel in Boston!
